jobs.title: State Veterinarian
jobs.summary: State Veterinarian position in Skukuza requiring a BVSc degree and SAVC registration to conduct wildlife disease surveillance, monitoring and diagnostic services.
jobs.requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and Bachelor of Veterinary Science (BVSc / BVMCh) Registration with the South African Veterinary Council as a Veterinarian Job related work experience: A minimum of one (1) year of experience as a State Veterinarian or Compulsory Community Service veterinarian in a regulatory state veterinary area in South Africa. Job related knowledge: Applications for the Animal Diseases Act, 1984 (Act No. 35 of 1984). Practical working knowledge and experience in application of Meat Safety Act, 2000 (Act No. 40 of 2000). Knowledge and practical experience of laboratory international standards ISO-IEC 17025. Knowledge and practical experience of import and export facilitation. Job related skills: Analytical skills. Research skills. Ability to communicate clearly, both verbally and written. Administration and organisational skills. Ability to function efficiently under various types of pressure with professionalism and integrity. Complex problem-solving skills. Ability to think logically and adapt to change. Ability to maintain good interpersonal relationships and work in a team. Ability to work extended working hours. Valid weapons’ competency certificate for handguns, shotguns and rifles. Relevant firearm license. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Wildlife disease surveillance, monitoring, control and delivery of a clinical and diagnostic services. Plan, direct, supervise and co-ordinate wildlife disease surveillance, monitoring and control. Performing necropsies of various species, managing sample processing and disease diagnostic services in the laboratory. Provide a health plan for ECI dogs as well as clinical and emergency services for working dogs (ECI, SAPS, SANDF). Plan, supervise wildlife disease epidemiological investigations and expand into applied disease research. Collaboration on scientific papers with regards to various controlled diseases or novel wildlife emerging diseases. Perform procedures and functions relevant to Veterinary Public Health activities. Plan, provide and coordinate a wildlife veterinary public health service. Field inspections during culling operations and carcass inspections at abattoir. Sanitary and quality control of final products and abattoir compliance. Inspections assist with activities pertaining to plant collection missions. Disease risk assessment, extension and information services. Provide information services to the conservation agencies and wildlife industry and participate on Departmental Advisory Groups. Stray buffalo/livestock control and communication to relevant stakeholders. Lectures to HR’s, visiting students, on controlled diseases, conservation and financial impacts. Contribute to risk analysis services with emphasis on wildlife translocations and wildlife associated diseases. Advise Provincial Veterinary Directors, State Veterinarians, Private Veterinarians and Farmers on buffalo diseases testing and movement. Assess the needs and status of Gene bank facilities and equipment. Develop policies, norms, standards and legislation for the prevention and control of animal disease. Assist in the process of developing, formulating, modifying and analysing policies, norms, standards and legislation for managing wildlife disease risks and disease control (including fences). Section 20 assistance and evaluation of projects. Assistance with wildlife related litigation involving the Department. Office and personnel administration. Compile monthly reports and update all relevant registers. Budgeting, procurement and financial planning (follow-up & control) and training. Attendance of relevant meetings/ workshops/ seminars.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email SVrecruit83@nda.gov.za

af.title: Staatsveearts
af.summary: Staatsveearts-pos in Skukuza wat 'n BVSc-graad en SAVC-registrasie vereis om siekte-toezig, monitering en diagnostiese dienste vir wildlewe uit te voer.
af.requirements: Aansoeker moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Baccalaureus in Veeartsenykunde (BVSc / BVMCh). Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Veeartsenykundige Raad as 'n Veearts. Werksverwante werkservaring: 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar ervaring as 'n Staatsveearts of Verpligte Gemeenskapsdiens-veearts in 'n regulasione staatsveeartsenykundige gebied in Suid-Afrika. Werksverwante kennis: Toepassing van die Animal Diseases Act, 1984 (Act No. 35 of 1984). Praktiese werkkennis en ervaring in die toepassing van die Meat Safety Act, 2000 (Act No. 40 of 2000). Kennis en praktiese ervaring van laboratorium internasionale standaarde ISO-IEC 17025. Kennis en praktiese ervaring van invoer- en uitvoerfasilitering. Werksverwante vaardighede: Analitiese vaardighede. Navorsingsvaardighede. Vermoë om duidelik te kommunikeer, beide mondelings en skriftelik. Administratiewe en organisatoriese vaardighede. Vermoë om doeltreffend te funksioneer onder verskillende tipes druk met professionaliteit en integriteit. Complekse probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om logies te dink en by verandering aan te pas. Vermoë om goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings te handhaaf en in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om lang werksure te werk. Geldige wapenbevoegdheidssertifikaat vir handwapens, haelgewere en gewere. Relevante vuurwapenlisensie. Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Siekte-toezig, monitering, beheer en levering van kliniese en diagnostiese dienste vir wildlewe. Beplan, bestuur, hou toesig en koördineer siekte-toezig, monitering en beheer van wildlewensiektes. Uitvoer van nekropsies van verskillende spesies, bestuur van monsterverwerking en siektediagnostiese dienste in die laboratorium. Verskaf 'n gesondheidsplan vir ECI-honde asook kliniese en nooddiens vir werks honde (ECI, SAPS, SANDF). Beplan en hou toesig oor epidemiologiese ondersoeke na wildlewensiektes en brei uit tot toegepaste siektenavorsing. Samewerking aan wetenskaplike referate rakende verskeie beheerde siektes of nuut ontluikende wildlewensiektes. Voer prosedures en funksies relevant tot Veeartsenykundige Openbare Gesondheidsaktiwiteite uit. Beplan, verskaf en koördineer 'n veeartsenykundige openbare gesondheidsdiens vir wildlewe. Veldinspeksies tydens uitdunoperasies en karkasinspeksies by abattoirs. Sanitêre en gehaltebeheer van finale produkte en abattoir-nakoming. Inspeksies help met aktiwiteite rakende plantversamelingsendings. Siekterisiko-assessering, voorligting en inligtingsdienste. Verskaf inligtingsdienste aan die bewaringsagentskappe en die wildlewebedryf en neem deel aan Departementele Adviesgroepe. Beheer van verdwaalde buffels/vee en kommunikasie aan relevante belanghebbendes. Lesings aan HR's, besoekende studente, oor beheerde siektes, bewaring en finansiële impakte. Dra by tot risiko-analise dienste met die klem op wildlewe-verplasing en wildlewe-geassosieerde siektes. Adviseer Proviniale Veeartsenykundige Direkteurs, Staatsveeartse, Privaat Veeartse en Boere oor buffelsiekte-toetsing en -beweging. Assesser die behoeftes en status van Gene-bank fasiliteite en toerusting. Ontwikkel beleide, norme, standaarde en wetgewing vir die voorkoming en beheer van diersiektes. Bystand in die proses van die ontwikkeling, formulering, wysiging en analise van beleide, norme, standaarde en wetgewing vir die bestuur van wildlewensiekterisiko's en siektebeheer (insluitend heinings). Sekshut 20 bystand en evaluering van projekte. Bystand met wildlewe-verwante litigasie wat die Departement betref. Kantoor- en personeeladministrasie. Stel maandelikse verslae op en dateer alle relevante registers op. Begroting, verkryging en finansiële beplanning (opvolg en beheer) en opleiding. Bywoning van relevante vergaderings/ werkswinkels/ seminare.

zu.title: State Veterinarian
zu.summary: Isikhundla soGqwelesikhoMphakathi kwi-South African Veterinary Council kudinga iziqu ze-Bachelor of Veterinary Science (BVSc / BVMCh) ne-SAVC registration ukwenza isimo sezifo kanye nokuphenya izifo ezithinta izilwane zasendle.
zu.requirements: Umhaladi kumele abe nesitifiketi se-GRADE 12 kanye ne-Bachelor of Veterinary Science (BVSc / BVMCh) Ukuqanjwa ngesiko kwi-South African Veterinary Council njengeSibhedlela sezilwane Imfundo ngomsebenzi ohlobene: A minimum of one (1) year of experience as a State Veterinarian or Compulsory Community Service veterinarian in a regulatory state veterinary area in South Africa. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Applications for the Animal Diseases Act, 1984 (Act No. 35 of 1984). Practical working knowledge and experience in application of Meat Safety Act, 2000 (Act No. 40 of 2000). Knowledge and practical experience of laboratory international standards ISO-IEC 17025. Knowledge and practical experience of import and export facilitation. Amakhono ohlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okuhlaziya. Amakhono uphando. Ikhono lokuchaza ngokucacile, ngomlomo nakubhalwe. Amakhono lolwezindlela zokuphatha kanye nobuhlakani bokuhlela. Ikhono lokusebenza kahle ngaphansi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zengcindezi ngobungcweti nokuzigqajisa. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga eziyinkimbinkimbi. Ikhono lokucabanga ngokulawulwa ukulula futhi ivumele ukushintshwa. Ikhono lokugcina ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu nokusebenza eqenjini. Ikhono lokusebenza amahora amide. Valid weapons’ competency certificate for handguns, shotguns and rifles. Relevant firearm license. Valid driver’s license.
zu.duties: Ukuqapha, ukulawula, nokuqaphisisa izifo ezithinta izilwane zasendle, kanye nokunikezela amasevisi okwelapha nokuqaphisisa izifo. Ukuhlela, ukuhola, ukubuka, nokuqamba indlela yokuqapha nokulawula izifo ezithinta izilwane zasendle. Ukwenza izihlobo ezahlukene zokuhlola izidumbu, ukuphatha ukucutshungulwa kwamasampula namasevisi okuqaphisisa izifo kwelabhorethri. Ukunikeza uhlelo lwezempilo lwezinja ze-ECI kanye namasevisi okwelapha esibhacedele ezingezelweni zezinja ezisebenzayo (ECI, SAPS, SANDF). Ukuhlela futhi ukubuka uphando ngezigameko zezifo ezithinta izilwane zasendle, bese kulwetshwa kwaba uphando olusetshenziswayo mayelana nezifo. Ukusebenzisana ekubhalweni kwamaphepha esayensi mayelana nezifo ezahlukene ezilawulwayo noma izifo ezintsha ezibonakala ezilwaneni zasendle. Ukwenza izinqubo nemisebenzi ehlobene nemisebenzi yeZempilo Yomphakathi Yabachibiyeli. Ukuhlela, ukunikeza futhi uqambe indlela yamasevisi ezempilo yomphakathi yabachibiyeli bezilwane zasendle. Ukuhlola ensimini ngesikhathi kusetshenziswa izindlela zokubulala izilwane kanye nokuqapha izidumbu esilabathini. Ukulawula ukuhlanzwa nokuqinisekwa ikhwalithi yemikhiqizo yokugcina kanye nokuhambisana nemithetho yesilabathi. Ukuqapha futhi usize imisebenzi ehlobene namamishini okuqoqa izitshalo. Ukuhlola engozini yezifo, ukululeka kanye namasevisi wolwazi. Ukunikeza amasevisi wolwazi kumajenti okulondolozwa kanye noshintsho lolwandle bezilwane, futhi ubambe iqhaza emaqembu Engeluleko Lomnyango. Ukulawula amabhafolo/izinkomo eziyize le futhi uxoxe nabahlanganyele balo. Ukufundisa ngabasebenzi, abafundi abavakashiwe, ngabezifo abalawulwayo, ukulondolozwa kanye nokuthinta kwezimali. Ukufaka isandla kumasevisi ekuhlaziywa kwengozi ngokugcizelela ekudlulisweni kwezilwane zasendle kanye nezifo eziyihambelana nezilwane zasendle. Ukuphakamisa abaphathi bavelo njengezinja, othisha bezinja abakumphakathi, nabalimi ngohlelo lokuhlola izifo zababhafolo kanye nokunyakaza. Ukubuka izidingo kanye nesimo semitholampilo yamajenos kanye nezinsimbi. Ukuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo, izindinganiso, amaphuzu kanye nomthetho wokuvikela nokulawula izifo ezithinta izilwane. Ukusiza ekwenzeni, ekubhaleni, ekulungeniseni nasekuhlaziyeni izinqubomgomo, izindinganiso, amaphuzu kanye nomthetho wokuphatha ingozi yezifo ezithinta izilwane kanye nokuzelelwa kwezifo (okuhlanganisa izivalo). Usizo lwesigaba 20 kanye nekuhlolwa kwezinhlelo. Ukusiza ezinkantolo ezihlobene nezilwane ezibandakanya Umnyango. Ukuphatha ihhovisi nabasebenzi. Ukuqamba okubikwayo nyanga zonke futhi uvuselele wonke amarejista ahlobene. Ukwenza izabelomali, ukuthenga kanye nokuqamba izimali (ukuqhuba nokulawula) kanye nokwelapha ngemfundo. Ukubambe iqhaza emihlanganweni / emiklamlweni / kumasingcengcele ehlobene nokuhamba eqophelweni lwezinyamalalo zezilwane zasendle.

jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09), (plus 37% in lieu of benefits)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for Employee Relations in Pretoria, requiring a National Diploma or Degree and three years supervisory experience in labour relations.

Minimum of three (3) years supervisory experience in the field of Labour Law / Labour Relations. Job related knowledge: Experience and knowledge of the following legislations: Labour and Employment Legislation and Public Service Regulations. Job related skills: Investigation skills, Report writing skills, Computer Literacy, Communication skills, (written and verbal) Negotiation skills, Conflict resolution skills, Problem solving skills, Interpersonal skills, Presentation and facilitation skills, Analytical skills. Must have a valid driver`s license, work irregular hours and willing to travel.
jobs.duties: Facilitate the prompt finalisation of grievance: Monitor implementation and adherence of prescripts governing grievances. Ensure prompt referral of grievances to the Executive Authority (EA) and Public Service Commission (PSC) when necessary. Ensure and monitor the implementation of grievances. Effective application of labour relations policies, procedures, regulations and legislation: Provide advice to clients and ensure effective and efficient application of labour relations policies. Facilitate the effective finalisation of disputes: Identify cases that need to be dealt with by legal services or external service providers / counsel. Proper preparation and presentation of cases. Obtain mandate and/or negotiate settlement agreements to resolve disputes where applicable. Represent the Department at conciliation and arbitration. Manage an effective labour relations reporting system for allocated cases: Timeous submission of monthly statistics. Assist in compilation of quarterly, annual and ad hoc reports. Monitor and capture all grievance cases in PERSAL. Facilitate capacity building programs: Provide and facilitate training to business unit on request. Advise employees daily. Assist in the implementation of misconduct guidelines and processes: Opening misconduct files and filing of misconduct documents. Facilitate finalisation of disciplinary cases and ensure that they are finalised within 90 calendar days. Ensure the implementation of the outcome of formal and informal disciplinary process. Supervise, monitor and ensure the implementation of the outcome of formal and informal disciplinary processes. Provide efficient and effective advice on disciplinary matters. Draft, Initiate and finalise all formal disciplinary processes. Monitor PERSAL on the outcome of the disciplinary process. Draft reports on misconduct matters.

Werksverwante kennis: Ervaring en kennis van die volgende wetgewing: Arbeids- en Indiensnemingwetgewing en Publieke Diensregulasies. Werksverwante vaardighede: Ondersoekvaardighede, Verslagdoeningsvaardighede, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Kommunikasievaardighede, (skriftelik en mondelings) Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Konflikoplossingsvaardighede, Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Interpersoonlike vaardighede, Voorleggings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede, Analitiese vaardighede. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê, onreëlmatige ure werk en gewillig wees om te reis.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die vinnige afhandeling van griewe: Monitor die implementering en nakoming van voorskrifte wat griewe regeer. Fasiliteer grieftsake en verseker dat dit binne 30 werksdae/ooreengekome tydrame hanteer word. Verseker doeltreffende advies vir die oplossing van griewe. Verseker tydige verwysing van griewe na die Uitvoerende Gesag (EA) en die Publieke Dienskommissie (PSC) wanneer nodig. Verseker en monitor die implementering van griewe. Doeltreffende toepassing van arbeidsverhoudingsbeleid, prosedures, regulasies en wetgewing: Verskaf advies aan kliënte en verseker doeltreffende en doeltreffende toepassing van arbeidsverhoudingsbeleid. Fasiliteer die doeltreffende afhandeling van geskille: Identifiseer sake wat deur regsdienste of eksterne diensverskaffers/adviseurs hanteer moet word. Behoorlike voorbereiding en voorlegging van sake. Verkry mandaat en/of onderhandel skikkooreenkomste om geskille op te los waar van toepassing. Verteenwoordig die Departement by konsiliasie en arbitrasie. Bestuur 'n doeltreffende arbeidsverhoudingsverslagdoeningstelsel vir toegekende sake: Tydige indiening van maandelikse statistieke. Bymeestering van kwartaal-, jaarlikse en ad hoc-verslae. Monitor en boekstaaf alle grieftsake in PERSAL. Fasiliteer kapasiteitsbouprogramme: Verskaf en fasiliteer opleiding aan besigheidseenhede op versoek. Adviseer werknemers daagliks. Bystand verleen aan die implementering van wangedragriglyne en -prosesse: Open wangedraglêers en lê wangedragdokumente weg. Fasiliteer afhandeling van dissiplinêre sake en verseker dat dit binne 90 kalenderdae afgehandel word. Verseker die implementering van die uitslag van formele en informele dissiplinêre prosesse. Oulig, monitor en verseker die implementering van die uitslag van formele en informele dissiplinêre prosesse. Verskaf doeltreffende en effektiewe advies oor dissiplinêre aangeleenthede. Opstel, inisieer en finaliseer alle formele dissiplinêre prosesse. Monitor PERSAL oor die uitslag van die dissiplinêre proses. Stel verslae oor wangedragsaangeleenthede op.

zu.title: Umncedi: Izindaba Zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Umncedi wezindaba zabasebenzi ePretoria, ofuna i-National Diploma noma i-Degree kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava okuphatha ezindabeni zomsebenzi.
zu.requirements: Umthunywa kumele abe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma noma i-Degree kwezindaba zomsebenzi/omthetho wabasebenzi/abaphathi bensiza zomuntu/Mphathi kahulumeni (NQF 6). Okungenani eminyakeni emithathu (3) yamava okuphatha kuleminyango yomthetho wabasebenzi/izindaba zomsebenzi. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Amava nolwazi ngomthetho olandelayo: umthetho wabasebenzi kanye nemithethonqubo yesevisi yomphakathi. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhano okuphenya, amakhano okubhala imibiko, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha, amakhano okuxhumana, (okubhalwayo nokukhulunwayo) amakhano okuxoxisana, amakhano okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhano okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhano abantu, amakhano okubonisa nokuqondisa, amakhano okuhlaziya. Kumele ube nelayisensi evumelekile yokushayela, ukusebenza amahora angajwayelekile futhi ukwazi ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Qondisa ngokusheshisela ukugqamisa izikhalazo: Qapha ukuphumelelwa komthethonqobo ohola izikhalazo. Qondisa izinkulumo zezikhalazo uze qiniseke ukuthi ziphathwa kumahora amashumi amathathu asebenzayo/izikhathi ezivunyelwe. Qinisekisa ukweluleka ngempumelelo ekuxazululweni kwezikhalazo. Qinisekisa ukusheshisela kokuthumela izikhalazo ku-Executive Authority (EA) nasekwi-Public Service Commission (PSC) lapho kudingeka. Qinisekisa futhi uqaphe ukuphumelelwa kwezikhalazo. Ukusebenzisa ngempumelelo imithethonqobo, izinqubo, imithetho kanye nomthetho wezindaba zomsebenzi: Nikeza izeluleko abathengi uze qinisekise ukusebenziswa ngempumelelo nangokushesha imithethonqobo yezindaba zomsebenzi. Qondisa ukugqamiswa ngempumelelo kwezinkinga: Hlukanisa izinkulu ezidinga ukuphathwa yimisebenzi yomthetho noma abanikezeli besevisi / abasomile. Lungiselela futhi ubonise izinkulu ngokufanele. Thola imandla kanye/noma xoxisana ngemvumelwano yokuxazulula izinkinga lapho kufanele khona. Mela umnyango ekubumbanweni nasekuphenyweni. Phatha uhlelo olusebenzayo lokubika ngezindaba zomsebenzi kumacala abekiwe: Thumela izibalo zanyanga ngonyaka ngokushesha. Siza ekubhalweni kwemibiko yekota, yonyaka kanye naleyanga ngamunye. Qapha futhi ubhale wonke amacala ezikhalazo kwi-PERSAL. Qondisa izinhlela zokwakha ikhono: Nikeza futhi qondisela ukwelatshwa amayunithi ebhizinisi ngesicelo. Lulela abasebenzi nsuku zonke. Sisa ekuphumelelweni kwezinqubo kanye namacebo okuhlukunyezwa: Ukuvula amafayela okuhlukunyezwa kanye nokubeka amadokhumenti okuhlukunyezwa. Qondisa ukugqamiswa kwamacala eziphathelene nokuhlukunyezwa uze qinisekise ukuthi agqamiswe kumahora angu-90. Qinisekisa ukuphumelelwa kwemiphumela yenqubo yokuhlukunyezwa esemthethweni nengakamthetho. Qapha, lolobhe futhi qinisekise ukuphumelelwa kwemiphumela yamaprocessi okuhlukunyezwa esemthethweni nengakamthetho. Nikeza izeluleko ezisebenzayo futhi eziphumelelwe ngamacala okuhlukunyezwa. Bhala, qale futhi ugqamise wonke amaprocessi okuhlukunyezwa. Qapha i-PERSAL ngemiphumela yenqubo yokuhlukunyezwa. Bhala imibiko ngamacala okuhlukunyezwa.

xh.title: Umlawuli Ophathwayo: Uququzelelo lwabaBasebenzi
xh.summary: Umlawuli Ophathwayo wokuQuquzelela uQuquzelelo lwabaBasebenzi ePretoria, ofuna iDiploma yesiLwimi sikaZwelonke okanye iQadi kwiMiba zeNtshukumo yokuSebenza / uMthetho weNtshukumo yokuSebenza / uLawulo lweMinyanya yoBantu / uLawulo kaRhulumende, kunye namashumi amatandathu (3) eminyaka yamava ngokulawula kwindalo yomthetho weNtshukumo yokuSebenza.
xh.requirements: UmKhangeli weSicelo kufuneka abe neSatiZatikolo senQanaba lesi-12 kunye neDiploma yesiLwimi sikaZwelonke okanye iQadi kwiMiba zeNtshukumo yokuSebenza / uMthetho weNtshukumo yokuSebenza / uLawulo lweMinyanya yoBantu / uLawulo kaRhulumende (NQF 6). Iqondo elingaphantsi kwamashumi amatandathu (3) eminyaka yamava ngokulawula kwindalo kaMthetho weNtshukumo yokuSebenza / iMiba zeNtshukumo yokuSebenza. Ulwazi oluhlobene nesiCima: Amava nolwazi ngomthetho olandelayo: uMthetho weNtshukumo yokuSebenza nokuQashwa kunye neMigaqo yeNkonzo kaRhulumende. Amakhono ahlobene nesiCima: Amakhono oPhando, amakhono oKubhalwa kweSicelo, uKwazi ukuSebenzisa iKhompyutha, amakhono oXulumo, (okubhaliweyo nokuThethwayo) amakhono oNxibelelwano, amakhono oSombululo lweengxaki, amakhono oBomi obuNgqonile, amakhono oSombululo lweengxaki, amakhono oBonakalisa nokuQquubelela, amakhono oTshalo-Chazo. Kufuneka abe nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni, aze akwazi ukusebenza iiyure ezingaqhelekanga kwaye alungelelani ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa ukuqedwa ngokukhawuleza kwezimbhikisho: Ukugcina amehlo kumalathise nokuzigcina ngokomthetho olawula iimbhikisho. Ukuqinisekisa iimbhikisho neqinisekisa ukuba ziqedwa kwangaphakathi kweentsuku ezingama-30 zokusebenza / kwixesha elivunyelwene ngalo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba kusinikwa icebiso elisebenzayo ngokukhubekiswa kwezimbhikisho. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iimbhikisho zithunyelwa kwinto eNkundla ePhakamileyo (EA) nakuKomishini yeNkonzo kaRhulumende (PSC) xa kuyimfuneko. Ukuqinisekisa kwaye kugcinwe amehlo ekusebenziseni kwezimbhikisho. Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo iinkqubo, iinkqubo, imigaqo nomthetho wolawulo lwentshukumo yabasebenzi: Ukunika icebiso abathengi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okusebenzayo nokuChaneleyo kweenkqubo zolawulo lwentshukumo yabasebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuqedwa ngokuchaneleyo kweengxabano: Ukuqamba iimeko ezifuna ukuba ziphathwe ngamaphakathi woMthetho okanye ababoneleli beenkonzo / ingcebiso. Ukuqhubelela ngokuchanekileyo nokubonakalisa iimeko. Ukuze kufunyanwe imvume kunye nokuba kuxoxwe ngeendlebe zeSivumelwano ngokuQonda ngeengxabano xa zifanelekile. Ukumela iSebe ekuqameni nasekubuyisweni kwengxabano eNkundla. Ukuqamba inkqubo echaneleyo yokuhlola ulawulo lwentshukumo yabasebenzi kwezo meko ezabelwe zona: Ukuzisa izibalo zenyanga ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukuncedisa ekubhaleni iingxelo zeekwota, unyaka nezongezelelweyo. Ukugcina amehlo baze kubhalwe naziphi na iimbhikisho kwiPERSAL. Ukuqinisekisa amaqhingaba okwakha amandla: Ukunika kwaye kuqiniseqiswe ukufundisa umba wamava kwicandelo leshishini ngesicelo. Ukunika icebiso kubasebenzi yonke imihla. Ukuncedisa ekusebenziseni iinkqubo neenkqubo ezilawula iNtshukumo yokwenza Ize: UkuVula iifayile ezingeyonto efanelekileyo baze kubekelwe kwindawo ezingeyonto efanelekileyo iifayile. Ukuqinisekisa ukuqedwa kweengxatshano kwaye kuqinisekiswe ukuba ziqedwa ngaphakathi kweentsuku ezingama-90 zokucwangciswa. Ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kolwamkelo lwenkqubo yeNtshukumo efanelekileyo nengachanekanga eNkqubo yokuzilawula. Ukugcina amehlo, ukuLawula kwaye kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kolwamkelo lwenkqubo yeNtshukumo efanelekileyo nengachanekanga eNkqubo yokuzilawula. Ukunika icebiso elichanekileyo nelisebenzayo kwimiba yeNtshukumo yokuzilawula. Ukwakha, ukuQalisa kwaye aqedwe zonke iinkqubo eNtshukumo yokuzilawula. Ukugcina amehlo ngokuLulamkiwe kwePERSAL ngolwamkelo lweNtshukumo yokuzilawula. Ukubhala iingxelo ngemiba yeNtshukumo yokwenya.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant
jobs.closing_date_text: 28 September 2026 at 16h00 (Applications received after the closing date and faxed copies will not be considered).
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and administrative support to the Secretary for Defence at the Armscor Building in Pretoria, requiring Grade 12, a secretarial diploma, and three years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) or equivalent with Secretarial Diploma. A National Diploma (NQF Level 6) will serve as an added advantage or equivalent qualification. A minimum of three (3) years collective experience, rendering a support service to Senior Management and executive administrative support services inclusive of report writing and briefing preparation with strong organisational skills to Senior Management. Knowledge of Public Service legislation, Records Management, Office Administration, and Financial Administration. Special requirements (skills needed): Sound organisational skills and time management skills. Good people skills. High level of reliability. Proven written and verbal communication skills. Ability to act with tact and discretion. Ability to do research and analyse documents and situations. Good grooming and presentation. Self-management and motivation. Proven computer skills including use of PowerPoint computer program.
jobs.duties: A successful candidate will be required to perform the following duties: Provide secretarial, reception and administrative support services to the Secretary for Defence. Receive visitors, screen and direct telephone calls and handle enquiries in professional manner. Ensure efficient and effective administrative support to the Secretary for Defence in accordance with departmental requirements. Scrutinises documents to determine actions/information/other documents required for meetings. Maintain an effective filing and records management system and administrative co-ordination in accordance with applicable policies and procedures. Remain abreast of relevant legislation, prescripts, policies, procedures and directives applicable to the work environment. Prepare and compile briefing notes, reports, correspondence, submissions, other documents and relevant information for the Secretary for Defence as required. Coordinate logistical arrangements for meetings, including venues, catering, documentation and technical requirements. Coordinates the procurement of goods and items for the activities of the Secretary for Defence. Coordinates the travel and accommodation arrangements for the Secretary for Defence during meetings and visits. Liaise with internal and external stakeholders on behalf of the Secretary for Defence. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information and documents at all times.
jobs.applications: Department of Defence, Office of the Secretary for Defence, Private Bag X910, Pretoria, 0001 or you may hand deliver to ARMSCOR Building C/O Nossob & Delmas Ave, Erasmuskloof Ext 4, Pretoria, 0001 or email to zama.mahlangu@dod.mil.za
jobs.notes: It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability) through       the    filling  of   these     posts   with     candidates     whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity in line with the numeric targets as contained in our Employment Equity plan. Applications must be submitted on the prescribed form Z83 (obtainable from any Public Service Department office, i.e., effective 01 January 2021, or on the DPSA website link: https://www.dpsa.gov.za/newsroom/psvc/. Should an application be received using incorrect application employment form Z83, it will be disqualified, which must be originally signed and dated by the applicant, and which must be accompanied by a detailed CV only (with full particulars of the applicants’ training, qualifications, competencies, knowledge & experience). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview which should not be older than six months. Failure to comply with the above instructions will result in applications being disqualified. Applicants applying for more than one post must submit a separate form Z83 (as well as the documentation mentioned above) in respect of each post being applied for. If an applicant wishes to withdraw an application, it must be done in writing. Should an application be received where an applicant applies for more than one post on the same applications form, the application will only be considered for the first post indicated on the application and not for any of the other posts. Under no circumstances will photostat copies or faxed copies of application documents be accepted. The successful candidates will be subjected to Personnel Suitability Checks (criminal record, citizenship & financial/asset record checks and qualification and employment verification). Successful candidates will also be subjected to security clearance processes. The level of appointments is dependent upon, qualifications, relevant experience and research output. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The competency assessment will be limited to successful candidates in the interview process only. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability checks (pre-employment screening) which may include social media profiles checks. A successful candidate will have to undergo a full security vetting while in the employ of the department and negative outcome shall nullify employment contract. Failure to submit the required documents will result in your application not being considered. Successful candidates will be required to disclose their financial interests within one (1) month of appointment. Applicants who do not receive confirmation or feedback within 3 (three) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Due to the large volume of responses anticipated, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged, and correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. For more information on the job description(s) please contact the person indicated in the post details. Successful candidates will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) months in terms of the prescribed rules. OTHER POST

af.title: Persoonlike Assistent
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Sekretaris vir Verdediging by die Armscor-gebou in Pretoria, met Graad 12, 'n sekretariële diploma en drie jaar se ervaring as vereistes.
af.requirements: Graad 12 (NQF Level 4) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie met 'n Sekretariële Diploma. 'n Nationale Diploma (NQF Level 6) sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se gesamentlike ervaring in die lewer van 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan Senior Bestuur en uitvoerende administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste, insluitend verslagskrywing en voorbereiding van agtergrondnotas, met sterk organisatoriese vaardighede vir Senior Bestuur. Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing, Rekordbestuur, Kantooradministrasie en Finansiële Administrasie. Spesiale vereistes (vaardighede benodig): Sund organisatoriese vaardighede en tydbestuurvaardighede. Goeie mensevaardighede. Hoë vlak van betroubaarheid. Bewese skriftelike en verbale kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree. Vermoë om navorsing te doen en dokumente en situasies te ontleed. Goeie versorging en aanbieding. Selfbestuur en motivering. Bewese rekenaarvaardighede, insluitend die gebruik van die PowerPoint-rekenaarprogram.
af.duties: 'n Suksesvolle kandidaat sal vereis word om die volgende pligte uit te voer: Verskaf sekretariële, ontvangs- en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die Sekretaris vir Verdediging. Ontvang besoekers, sift en stuur telefoonoproepe en hanteer navrae op professionele wyse. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Sekretaris vir Verdediging in ooreenstemming met departementele vereistes. Ondersoek dokumente om aksies/inligting/ander dokumente vir vergaderings te bepaal. Onderhou 'n doeltreffende lêer- en rekordbestuurstelsel en administratiewe koördinasie in ooreenstemming met toepaslike beleide en prosedures. Bly op hoogte van relevante wetgewing, voorskrifte, beleide, prosedures en direktiewe wat op die werksomgewing van toepassing is. Berei en stel agtergrondnotas, verslae, korrespondensie, voorleggings, ander dokumente en relevante inligting vir die Sekretaris vir Verdediging op soos vereis. Koördineer logistieke reëlings vir vergaderings, insluitend plekke, voorsiening van etes, dokumentasie en tegniese vereistes. Koördineer die verkryging van goedere en items vir die aktiwiteite van die Sekretaris vir Verdediging. Koördineer die reis- en akkommodasiereëlings vir die Sekretaris vir Verdediging tydens vergaderings en besoekte. Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes namens die Sekretaris vir Verdediging. Onderhou te alle tye die vertroulikheid van sensitiewe inligting en dokumente.

zu.title: Umncedi Omuntu
zu.summary: ukunika insekelo yobunxibeleselisi nolawu kwiSekelamengamela woMzimba woKuvikwa e-Armscor Building e-Pretoria, okudinga i-Grade 12, idiploma yobunxibeleselisi, nomnyakeni omithathu wobumnyama.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) noma okulinganayo nediploma yobunxibeleselisi. I-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) izoba yinsekelo efanayo noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Okungenani eminyakeni emithathu (3) yokuhlangenwe kokho ubumnyama, ukunika insekelo kwabaphathi Abaphezulu nensekelo yolawu yabaphathi abaphakeme okuhlanganisa ukubhala imibalo nokulungiselela ukwazisa ngamakhono aqotho wolungelelaniso kwabaphathi Abaphezulu. ulwazi ngomthetho woMsebenzi kaZwelonke, uLawulo lwezibhalo, uLawulo leOfisi, kanye noLawulo lwezezimali. Izidingo ezikhethekile (amakhono adingekayo): Amakhono alungelelaniswa kahle nangokuphathwa kwesikhathi. Amakhono amahle obuntu. Izinga eliphezulu lobunye. Amakhono abhaliwe nobukhulumayo abuchwepheshe. Ikono lomoya wokuqondisa nokuziba. Ikono lokwenza uphando nokuhlola imibhalo kanye nezimo. Ukuzilungisa nokubukeka kahle. uLawulo lwakho nendlela. Amakhono obuchwepheshe obuchwepheshe ehlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwekhompyutha i-PowerPoint.
zu.duties: Umuntu ohlangeneyo uzodingeka ukuba enze imisebenzi elandelayo: Hlinzeka ngemisebenzi yobunxibeleselisi, yokwamukela abakhamela kanye nensekelo yolawu kwiSekelamengamela woMzimba woKuvikwa e-Armscor Building e-Pretoria. Amukela abakhamela, hlola futhi uhlele amakholi omabhonimbe uphathwe imibuzo ngendlela eqotho. Qinisekisa insekelo yolawu esebenzayo nesebenzayo kwiSekelamengamela woMzimba woKuvikwa ngokushaya kwezidingo zomnyango. Hlola imibhalo ukunikela ngokuthi yimiphi imisebenzi/mininingwana/eminye imibhalo edingekayo emihlanganweni. Gcina uhlelo olusebenzayo lokugcina amafayela kanye nolawulo lwemibhalo nelungelelaniso lolawu ngokushaya komthetho osebenzayo nemigomo. Hlala ufunde ngomthetho, imiyalo, imigomo, izinqubo nemiyalo elawula indawo yokusebenza. Lungiselela uphinde uqoke amanoti okwazisa, imibiko, ukuxhumana, izithakazelo, eminye imibhalo nenminingwane edingekayo kwiSekelamengamela woMzimba woKuvikwa njengoba kudingeka. Linganisa izicoliswa zokulungelelanisa imihlangano, okuhlanganisa izindawo, ukuphatha ukudla, imibhalo nezidingo zobuchwepheshe. Linganisa ukuthengwa kwezimpahla nezinto ezimisebenzini yeSekelamengamela woMzimba woKuvikwa. Linganisa izicoliswa zokuhamba nokuwomisa iSekelamengamela woMzimba woKuvikwa ngesikhathi semihlangano nokuvakashela. Xhumana nabalingane bangaphakathi nabangaphandle ngesiwa seSekelamengamela woMzimba woKuvikwa. Gcina iyimfihlo imininingwane nemibalo ebuqotho ngaso sonke isikhathi.

xh.title: Somsebenzi womntu ngamnye
xh.summary: Kubonelela ngeenkonzo zokwncedisa ngomsebenzi wesekeralari nolawulo kuNobulungu woKhuselo e-Armscor Building e-Pretoria, kufuneka Grade 12, neediploma yomsekeralari, nolunyuki lweminyaka emithathu yamava.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 (NQF Level 4) okanye esinjengexabiso elingana nalo neediploma yomsekeralari. I-Diploma yesizwe (NQF Level 6) iya kuba yinto eyongezelelako okanye isiqinisekiso esinjengesabo. Ukuba nolunyuki lweminyaka emithathu (3) ngokubanzi kulwazi lokwenza inkonzo yoncedise abaphathi Abakhulu noloncediso lolawulo ngeenk on the side of the administration of the Senior Management inclusive of report writing and briefing preparation with strong organisational skills to Senior Management. Ulwazi ngomthetho weKhaladi yoLuntu, ulawulo lweRekhodi, ulawulo lweOfisi, nolawulo lwezeMali. Iimfuno ezikhethekileyo (amakhono afunekayo): Amakhono amn牛z okum la ngeqhing el liso nokulawula ixesha. Amakhono amahle abantu. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuthembeka. Amakhony obungcalibox in the written and verbal communication skills. Ulwazi noku phumeza amaxwebhu olu dibe dieondio kata of tact and discretion. Ulwazi loku vhumba ing grafting and analysis of documents and situations. Ukuzihlamba ngok uhlelo elixhasa and presentation. Ukuzibusa namakhono.

Qinisekisa inkonzo yolawulo echanekileyo neseziko kwiNkatha yoKhuselo ngokwemfuno yesebe. Hlola amaxwebhu ukuze aqonde iintshukumo/ulwazi/amaxwebhu amanye afunekayo kumanyano. Phuhlisa inkqubo efanelekileyo yokulondolozo amaxwebhu nokulawula irekhodi nokuqhubekeka kolawulo ngokomthetho nemigaqo esebenzayo. Zigcine ufumene ulwazi ngomthetho, imigaqo, iinkqubo neem funo ezisebenza kwindawo yomsebenzi. Lungelela ukuhlela amaxwebhu okwazisa, iingxelo, unxibelelwano, iinethlekethlo, namaxwebhu amanye nolwazi olufanelekileyo kwiNkatha yoKhuselo njengoko kufuneka. Qhubekeka nezicwangciso zengqungqushela, kuquka izindlu zomanyano, ukutya, amaxwebhu, nokuqhubekeka kolawulo ngokwelwazi tekniki. Zama ukufumana izinto namachiza emisebenzi yeNkatha yoKhuselo. Qhubekeka nezicwangciso zohambo nezindlu zokuhlala zeNkatha yoKhuselo kwiinyanga zomanyano nakunyanga zendwendzo. Thintela ngokunxibelelwano nabantu bakwaphakathi nangaphandle ixesha elonke iqela leNkatha yoKhuselo. Zigcine iimfihlo zelwizi namaxwebhu ixesha elonke.

af.title: Employment Service Practitioner
af.summary: Employment Service Practitioner by die Mashishing Labour Centre wat verantwoordelik is vir die bemarking van openbare indiensnemingsdienste, die werwing van werkssoekers en die verwerking van grensoorskrydende arbeidsmigrasie-aansoeke.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jarige kwalifikasie in Social Science (Psychology, Industrial Psychology) / Public Administration / Business Management / Public Management. zu.title: Employment Service Practitioner

xh.summary: Umkhwili wenkonzo yokuzisebenzela eMashishing Labour Centre oqhubekayo ekuthengiseni iinkonzo zeqasho karhulumente, ekuqasheni abafuna umsebenzi nakwindlela yokucutshungula iinkqubo zokuhamba kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwamazwe.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seminyaka emithathu (3) kwiZezolimo eZithintelayo (iPsychology, iPsychology yoMveliso) / uLawulo lukaRhulumente / uLawulo loQamba / uLawulo lukaRhulumente. xh.duties: Ukuhlela phambili iinkonzo ze-PES kubaphathi abanomdla ukuze kufunyenwe ithuba lensimbi kwaye kwenziwe ukukhethwa kokuba mqeshiwe, ukusetyenziswa nokuza kubekwa kwindawo ababhaliswe kuyo abafuna umsebenzi. Ukucutshungula iimfuno zemiba yokuhamba kwabasebenzi Ngaphakathi kweli loMazwe (ICBLM) kunye negalelo malunga nobukho bekhono. Ukuqinisekisa ukubhaliswa ngokuvumelana noMthetho we-Unemployment Insurance Act kanye noMthetho we-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act. Cwasa, phenya futhi uqedele ngokuzimele izehlo nezikhalazo ezibikiwe ezithinta uMthetho we-OHS kanye nezimiso ezihlobene futhi zigcinze njengoba kudingeka, avele enkantolo njengofakazi bembuso. jobs.title: Inspector

Draft and maintain inspection plans and reports including analysis and compilation of consolidated statistical reports on only allocated cases.

af.title: Inspekteur
af.summary: Inspekteur by die Department of Employment and Labour in Johannesburg; voer nakomingsinspeksies uit en handhaaf arbeidswetgewing.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jaar relevante tersiêre kwalifikasie in Labour Relations Management / BCOM Law / LLB. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Een (1) jaar funksionele ervaring in Inspection and Enforcement Services. Kennis: Departementele beleide en prosedures, Skills Development Act, Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Skills Development Levies Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, COIDA, Unemployment Insurance Act, UI Contribution Act, Employment Equity Act. Vaardighede: Fasiliteringsvaardighede, Beplanning en organiserende (hoofsaaklik vir eie), Rekenaarvaardigheid, Interpersoonlike vaardighede, Konflikhanteringsvaardighede, Onderhandelingsvaardighede, Probleemoplossingsvaardighede, Onderhoud-, luister- en waarnemingsvaardighede, Aanbiedingsvaardighede, Innovatief, Analities, Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Beplan en voer onafhanklik inspeksies uit met die doel om nakoming van die Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA) te verseker. Voer onafhanklik ondersoeke uit op aangemelde sake rakende oortreding van arbeidswetgewing en handhaaf soos en wanneer nodig. Beplan en voer gereeld proaktiewe (Blitz) inspeksies uit om nakoming van arbeidswetgewing te monitor. Voer onafhanklik voorskiedingsveldtogte oor alle arbeidswetgewing uit. Opstel en onderhou inspeksieplanne en verslae, insluitend ontleding en samestelling van gekonsolideerde statistiese verslae oor slegs toegewysde sake.

zu.title: Umhloli
zu.summary: Umhloli eDipartimenti yeZemisebenzi ngezenhlalo eJohannesburg; wenze izinhlolovo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho uphinde ulawule umthetho wabasebenzi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-tertiary ezithize iminyaka emithathu (3) ebandakanya ukuphathwa kwezidingo zabasebenzi / BCOM Law / LLB. Ilayisensi yokushayela esevisi. Unyaka omu (1) wokuhlomula eceleni kwesikhundla sokuhlola nokuphoqa. Ulwazi: Amapholisi nemayelana nomnyango, Umthetho wokuthuthukisa amakhono, Umthetho wezidingo zabasebenzi, Umthetho wezimo ezisisekelo zomsebenzi, Umthetho wamali yokuthuthukisa amakhono, Umthetho wezempilo nokuphepha kusebenzweni, COIDA, Umthetho wokungasebenzi, Umthetho wokuhweba ngomnikelo we-UI, Umthetho we-employment equity. Amakhono: Amakhono okukhuthaza, ukuhlela nokuhlela (Okuvamisele ukubhekana nabomuntu zimboni), ulwazi lwekhompyutha, amakhono abantu, amakhono okupatha izinkinga, amakhono okuxoxisana, amakhono okusombulula izinkinga, amakhono okubuzwa, okuzwa nokubheka, amakhono okubonisa, ukubakhona okusha, ukuhlaziya, amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala.
zu.duties: Hlela uphathe ngokuzimele izinhlolovo nenhloso yokweqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwe umthetho wezimo ezisisekelo zomsebenzi (BCEA). Phenya ngokuzimele izingxenye ezibikwe ukuba zingahloniphi umthetho wabasebenzi uphinde ulawule lapho kunesidingo. Hlela uphinde wenze njalo izinhlolovo ezibheke phambili (Blitz) ukuze ulawule ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho wabasebenzi. Yenza ngokuzimele imikhankaso yokuqondisa ngawo onke amabhanga omthetho abasebenzi. Bhala ulondoloze amaphulani nezibiko zezinhlolovo kuhlanganise nanokuhlaziya nokuhlanganisa izibiko ezibalomshwana ezibhekene nenhloso lezo icala onikezwezona.

xh.title: Mvakaleli
xh.summary: Mvakaleli kwiSebe loMsebenzi noNgoro e Johannesburg; phatha iindwendwe zokwanelisa umthetho uze uqine umthetho weMisebenzi.
xh.requirements: Izidanga zeminyaka emithathu (3) ezifanelekileyo ezisesikhathini sezifundo eziphakamileyo kuLawulo loBudlelwano bezeMisebenzi / BCOM Law / LLB. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni. Umva wonyaka omnye (1) wobuchule obusebenzayo kuZiko loNdwendwe noQiniso lomthetho. Ulwazi: Iinkqubo namagqabantshiwo esebe, uMthetho woPhuhliso lwamakhono, uMthetho woBudlelwano bezeMisebenzi, uMthetho weziMigaqo eziYimfuneko eNtshona zeMisebenzi, uMthetho woRhelo lwoPhuhliso lwamakhono, uMthetho weMpilo yoNdalo noKhuseleko, COIDA, uMthetho woRhelo lwabangafumaniyo msebenzi, uMthetho woRhelo lwaManxowa Msebenzi, uMthetho woLingano lwaBasebenzi. Amakhono: Amakhono okukhokela, ukuCwangcisa nokuLungisa (Ngokuyinhloko ngawakho), ukuGqitha kwesiKhompyutha, amakhono oBudlelwano nabantu, amakhono okupatha iingxabano, amakhono okuxoxisana ngeentlngiselo, amakhono okuSombulula iingxaki, ukuPhicotha imibuzo, ukumamela nokwaBuza amakhono, amakhono okuBonakalisa, uBuchule obutsha, ukuHlalutya, amakhono oThetho olubhalweyo nolwenziwayo.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa uze uphele ngokuzimela iindwendwe ezinjengoko kujoliswe kuqinisekiso ukwanelisa iMthetho weziMigaqo eziYimfuneko eNtshona zeMisebenzi (BCEA). Phatha ngokuzimela iintanda ezibikisiweyo ezinxulumene nokwaphula umthetho wezeMisebenzi uze uqine njengoko kufuneka. Cwangcisa uze uphele ngokuthe ngqo (Blitz) iindwendwe rhoqo ukulawula ukwanelisa umthetho wezeMisebenzi. Phatha amajangqo okusesikweni ngayo yonke imithetho yeMisebenzi ngokuzimela. Cacisa uze ulondoloze iindlela zokucwangcisa iindwendwe neendego ezibandakanya ukuhlalutya nokuqulunqa iindego ezibhiyozelweyo ezibalo ngemizekelo ebaluliweyo kuphela.

af.title: Inspekteur
af.summary: Inspekteurs word by vier Free State arbeidsentrums gesoek om beroepsinspeksies uit te voer, oortredings van arbeidswetgewing te ondersoek en nakoming af te dwing.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jaar se tersaaklike kwalifikasie in Arbeidsverhoudinge / BCOM Regte / LLB. Geen ervaring vereis. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Departementele beleide en prosedures. Skills Development Act Labour Relations Act. Basic Conditions of Employment Act. Unemployment Insurance Act. Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act. Vaardighede: Fasiliteringsvaardighede, beplanning en organisering (eie werk), rekenaargebruik (sigblaaie, PowerPoint en woordverwerking), interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossingsvaardighede, onderhoudvoeringvaardighede, analitiese, mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, Employment Equity.
af.duties: Voer beroepsinspeksies uit met die doel om nakoming van alle arbeidswetgewing te verseker. Voer ondersoeke uit na aangemelde sake rakende die oortreding van arbeidswetgewing en tree waar en wanneer nodig op om nakoming af te dwing. Voer gereeld proaktiewe (Blitz) inspeksies uit om nakoming van arbeidswetgewing te monitor. Voer voorligtingsveldtogte uit oor geïdentifiseerde en toegekenende arbeidswetgewing. Bystand verleen met die opstel van inspeksieplanne, verslae en die samestelling van statistieke oor toegewysde sake.

zu.summary: Kufunwa abainspektha kumazinga amane ezikhungweni zomsebenzi e-Free State ukwenza ukuphenya ngemisebenzi, ukuphenya ngokungalandelwa kwemithetho yomsebenzi nokuphoqa ukulandelwa kwayo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezithathu (3) ezihambisana noMphathiswano Womsebenzi / BCOM Law / LLB., Akukho muzwa odingekayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Izinqubo nezinhlelo zomnyango. I Skills Development Act ne Labour Relations Act. I Basic Conditions of Employment Act. I Unemployment Insurance Act. I Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act. Amafomu: Amafomu okuhola, ukulungisa futhi uhlele (umsebenzi wakho), ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (amaspredishithi, i-PowerPoint nokubhala), Amafomu okuxhumana nabantu, amafomu okuxazulula izinkinga, amafomu okuphenya, ukuhlaziya, ukuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhala, i-Employment Equity.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuphenya ngemisebenzi ngenjongo yokulandela yonke imithetho yomsebenzi. Phatha ukuphenya izindaba ezibikwe ngokungalandelwa kwemithetho yomsebenzi uphinde uphoqe lapho nini futhi noma lapho kudingeka khona. Yenza ukuphenya okuzenzakalayo (i-Blitz) njalo ukuze ubheke ukulandelwa kwemithetho yomsebenzi. Yenza imikankamiso yokuqinisekisa ngemithetho yomsebenzi etholwe futhi enikezwe. Siza ekubhalweni kwezinhlelo zokuphenya, emibikeni nakokuqoqa izibalo ngalezindaba ezinikeziwe.

Nceda ekubhalweni kwezicwangciso zeempshonobho, iimavezo nakudityaniseni izibalo kwimeko ebelweyo.
