af.summary: Die Unemployment Insurance Fund soek 'n senior beoefenaar om kontrakte te administreer, biedprosesse te ondersteun, en hulpbronne binne verworingsbestuur te bestuur.
af.requirements: Drie (3) jaar se tersiêre kwalifikasie (NQF Level 6) in Purchasing Management/Facility Management/Logistic Management/Management. Twee (2) jaar se funksionele ervaring in 'n Acquisition Management-omgewing. Kennis: Unemployment Insurance Act and Regulations (UIAR). Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act (UICA). Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA). Labour Relation Act (LRA). Employment Equity Act (EEA). Electronic Operations System • Public Service Regulations (PSR). Public Service Act (PSA). National Treasury Regulations. Supply Chain Management Systems and Processes. Bid Processes. Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE). Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Vaardighede: Probleemoplossing. Voorlegging. Beplanning en organisering. Kommunikasie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Verslagskrywing. Finansiële Bestuur. Analise. Tydbestuur. Syfervaardigheid.
af.duties: Lewer kontrakadministrasie vir die UIF. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning oor biedprosesse. Verskaf maandelikse verslagdoening oor toegekenne kontrakte en tenders. Lewer sekretariële funksies aan die Biedadjudikasiekomitees. Bestuur hulpbronne (Menslike, Finansiële, Toerusting/Bates) in die afdelings.

zu.title: Inkokeli yeNkqubo yokwamkela imali: National Treasury
zu.summary: I-National Treasury ixfuna umntu onelwazi okuzobe angachaza amacebo okuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwezi ntengiso kunye neenkqubo, anokwazi ukuqonda iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokuqinisekiswa kwezimali ezingekho msinya, ahlele iindaba ezingalinganiyo, axhaselwe ngamakhono okuziphatha komntu ngamnye kunye nokusebenza ngokutsha tyhilwa kwemigaqo yentsapho, axhasa inkqubo yokubeka iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zentsapho kwindawo yokwenza imali ekusingathweni kwentsapho.
zu.requirements: Isatifikethi sezidingo kwiminyaka emithathu (3) kwazinga lesi-6 (NQF) kwimigaqo yokuthenga izinto/Ukuphatha iindlu/UPhatho loLwaHamba-hamba/Ukuphatha. Imimandla emibini (2) yamava osebenzayo kwindawo yoPhatho loNcedo. ulwazi: UMthetho weNkxaso-mali yokuQhwalela (UIA) neMigaqo yayo (UIAR). UMthetho wemiNikelo yokuNika ngemali (UICA). UMthetho weNkululeko kaRhulumente (PFMA). UMthetho weMimiselo yoBomi besiSebenze (BCEA). UMthetho weQhina loNyango (LRA). UMthetho wokuYiya iinkqubela ekuSebenziseni (EEA). Inkqubo yeGalelo leNdalo • IziMiso zoMsebenzi kaRhulumente (PSR). UMthetho woMsebenzi kaRhulumente (PSA). IziMiso zeQhina laVeluManzi. Inkqubo yoQeqesho lokuSebenza kwayo nayiNkqubo. Amacwecwe eLungelelaniso nokuNika izinto. Imigaqo yokuNika amakhadi (BBBEE). UMthetho weNqubo yoNcedo (PPPFA). Amakhono: uKusombulula iingxaki. iNkcazelo. uQeqesho lwemigaqo. uKuncedisa. iNkqubo yeKhompyutha. uBhalo beMibiko. uPhatho lweMali. uKwahlula. uPhatho lweSikhathi. iMikhooda.
zu.duties: Hlela izinkontiwaithe ze-UIF. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kumacwecwe wobuNdlu. Hlela umbiko wenyanga wezinkontiwaithe nezentengo ezinikezwe. Hlela imisebenzi yesikhwama kwiKomiti zoMgaqo-siseko zokuSika isixa eNtsika. Phatha iimveliso kumanqwanqwa (ezoBomi, ezoMali, isiXhobo/iziQwengqwe) kumanqwanqwa.

xh.title: Umprathunja oPhezulu: uLawulo lokuFunyanwa kwezinto
xh.summary: I-Unemployment Insurance Fund iFunza umprathunja ophakamileyo ukuba alawule amagqeba ezenzo, anike inkxaso kwiinkqubo zokwenza izaphulelo, aze alawule izixhobo ngaphakathi kolawulo lokufunyanwa kwezinto.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seminyaka emithathu (3) kwiziko lemfundo ephakamileyo (NQF Level 6) kokuLawula kuThengiso / uLawulo lweziZakhiwo / uLawulo lwezomGCina / uLawulo. Imihla yamava eminyaka emi-2 (2) yokusebenza kwindawo yoLawulo loKufunyanwa kwezinto. Ulwazi: Unemployment Insurance Act and Regulations (UIAR). Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act (UICA). Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA). Labour Relation Act (LRA). Employment Equity Act (EEA). Iinkqubo zoBuchwepheshe zeziNkcukacha • Public Service Regulations (PSR). Public Service Act (PSA). National Treasury Regulations. Iinkqubo neNkqubo zoLawulo lweNkcitho yomthengiso. Iinkqubo zoKwenza izaphulelo. Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment (BBBEE). Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Amakhono: Ukuxazulula iingxaki. Okuboniswayo. Ukuceba nokuhlela. Unxibelelwano. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. UkuBhala iingxelo. uLawulo lwezeMali. Ukuhlalutya. uLawulo lweXesha. Ukubala.
xh.duties: Yenza ulawulo lwamagqeba ezenzo kwi-UIF. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kwiinkqubo zokwenza izaphulelo. Nikeza iingxelo nyanga zonke malunga namagqeba ezenzo namazaphulelo anikiweyo. Yenza imisebenzi yobunobulumko kwiKomiti ZoLulamlo lweZaphulelo. Lawula izixhobo (Abantu, ezeMali, Iimpahla/Iimpahla ezibalulekileyo) kumacandelo.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Finance Specialist (JOBS Fund)
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive), PSR 44 will apply to candidates appointed in the salary level
jobs.summary: Lead origination and structuring of high-impact employment-focused investment opportunities for the Jobs Fund, requiring 10-15 years' project finance experience and a relevant NQF 7 degree.
jobs.requirements: A degree (NQF Level 7 or higher) in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Management, Development Finance, or a related field. Formal training or qualification in project or programme management. 10–15 years’ experience in project finance, corporate finance, structured finance, or investment analysis, including appraisal and closing of complex transactions. Demonstrated experience assessing innovative or non-standard financial structures and grant-based funding mechanisms. Strong understanding of private-sector financing, incentives, and risk dynamics. Proven ability to conduct due diligence, analyse financial statements and models, and exercise sound investment judgment. 5 years of experience at a senior managerial level. Advantageous Experience and Qualifications: Post graduate qualifications in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Management, Development Finance, or a related field. CFA, CA(SA), MBA (Finance/Strategy), or equivalent senior professional qualification. Experience in development finance, impact investing, blended finance, climate finance, or transition finance. Experience working on green economy, informal economy, or Just Energy Transition–related projects or value chains. Experience conducting or translating research on value chains, labour absorption, or economic development outcomes. Ideal Candidate Profile: You are a senior technical finance professional who combines strong analytical rigour with practical deal-making experience. You are comfortable working between public and private sectors, interrogating complex financial structures, and applying an investment lens to real-world job creation challenges. You bring independence of thought, strong judgment, and a commitment to using public resources catalytically for inclusive growth.
jobs.duties: Originate and develop a pipeline of high-impact, employment-focused investment opportunities in partnership with private sector firms, intermediaries, developers, and ecosystem partners. Analyse, structure, and assess complex financial instruments and funding models, including blended finance, debt structures, outcome-based financing, and performance-linked grants. Conduct rigorous financial, commercial, and operational due diligence on project applications, including assessment of financial additionality, sustainability, and execution risk. Identify and analyse financial, market, governance, and performance risks arising from different project structures, and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies. Lead and quality-assure appraisal reports and funding recommendations submitted to Technical Evaluation and Investment Committees. Provide technical oversight of high-risk or complex projects within the Jobs Fund portfolio and support remedial action where performance challenges arise. Conduct independent applied research on job creation opportunities, priority value chains, the informal economy, and green and Just Energy Transition–related sectors, translating insights into funding and strategy inputs. Present financial, risk, and research findings clearly to internal decision-makers and external stakeholders. Coach, mentor, and technically support junior staff, building institutional capability in financial appraisal, risk analysis, and innovative finance. Represent the Jobs Fund in relevant stakeholder engagements, market forums, and learning platforms.
jobs.applications: Please register or if you are already registered, sign in and apply for the position/s on the GTAC eRecruitment website: https://erecruitment.gtac.gov.za/erecruitment/
jobs.notes: The Jobs Fund is recruiting a Senior Technical Finance Specialist to strengthen its capacity to originate, structure, appraise, and oversee innovative, employment-generating projects that leverage public finance to unlock private investment. This is a senior specialist role suited to an experienced finance professional with strong private-sector exposure and a deep understanding of development, impact, and transition finance. Only South African Citizens, and Permanent Residents need to apply as per PSR 2016. Applications should be accompanied by a duly completed and signed Z83 form (obtainable from any Public Service department). The post title and reference number must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. A recent comprehensive CV should be submitted. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be required to be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview from shortlisted candidates. All short-listed candidates will be subjected to security vetting to confirm employment, personnel suitability checks. Short-listed candidates must make themselves available for a panel interview on the date determined by GTAC. Late applications, and those not meeting the requirements, will not be considered. Should you not receive feedback from GTAC within 2 months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. GTAC reserves the right to fill or not fill the advertised post. Preference will be given according to EE and Gender target. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. In accordance with the DPSA Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days and Minimum requirements, this SMS level appointment will be subject to the completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Government. The applicants should therefore have proof that they have registered for the Pre-entry certificate and have completed the course before the appointment. The cost of the pre-entry certificate is at the candidate’s expense. To access the pre-certificate course, please       visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Applications: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications not accompanied by a comprehensive CV and fully completed and signed Z83 form will not be considered. The GTAC is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applications from women and people with disabilities. Our buildings are accessible to people with disabilities and reasonable accommodation is provided for persons with disabilities. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Senior Tegniese Finansiespesialis (JOBS Fund)
af.summary: Beklee 'n leidende rol in die oorsprong en strukturering van hoë-impak werkskeppingsgefokusde beleggingsgeleenthede vir die Jobs Fund, wat 10-15 jaar se projekfinansieringservaring en 'n toepaslike NQF 7-graad vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad (NQF vlak 7 of hoër) in Finansies, Ekonomie, Rekenkunde, Besigheidsbestuur, Ontwikkelingsfinansiering, of 'n verwante veld. Formele opleiding of kwalifikasie in projek- of programbestuur. 10–15 jaar se ervaring in projekfinansiering, korporatiewe finansiering, gestruktureerde finansiering of beleggingsontleding, insluitend die waardering en afsluiting van komplekse transaksies. Bewese ervaring in die assessering van innoverende of nie-standaard finansiese strukture en toelaaggebaseerde finansieringsmeganismes. Sterk begrip van privaatsektorfinansiering, aansporings en risikodinamika. Bewese vermoë om due diligence uit te voer, finansiele state en modelle te ontleed en goeie beleggingsbesluitvorming toe te pas. 5 jaar ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. Voordeelige Ervaring en Kwalifikasies: Nagraadse kwalifikasies in Finansies, Ekonomie, Rekenkunde, Besigheidsbestuur, Ontwikkelingsfinansiering of 'n verwante veld. CFA, CA(SA), MBA (Finansies/Strategie), of 'n ewekragige senior professionele kwalifikasie. Ervaring in ontwikkelingsfinansiering, impakbelegging, gemengde finansiering, klimaatfinansiering of oorgangsfinansiering. Ervaring in die werk aan projekte of waardekettings wat verband hou met die groen ekonomie, informele ekonomie, of die Regverdige Energie-oorgang. Ervaring in die uitvoer of vertaling van navorsing oor waardekettings, arbeidsabsorpsie of ekonomiese ontwikkelingsuitkomste. Ideale Kandidaatprofiel: U is 'n senior tegniese finansieprofessionele wat sterk analitiese stipheid met praktiese transaksie-ervaring kombineer. U is gemaklik om tussen die openbare en privaat sektor te werk, komplekse finansiese strukture te ondersoek en 'n beleggingslens op werklike werkskeppingsuitdagings toe te pas. U bring onafhanklikheid van denke, sterk oordeel en 'n toewyding om openbare hulpbronne katalities vir inklusiewe groei te gebruik.
af.duties: Oorspronklik ontwikkel en ontwikkel 'n pyplyn van hoë-impak, werkskeppingsgefokusde beleggingsgeleenthede in vennootskap met privaatsektorfirmas, tussengangers, ontwikkelaars en ekosisteemvennote. Ontleed, struktureer en beoordeel komplekse finansiese instrumente en finansieringsmodelle, insluitend gemengde finansiering, skuldstrukture, uitkomsgebaseerde finansiering en prestasiegekoppelde toelaes. Voer streng finansiele, kommersiële en operasionele due diligence op projektoepassings uit, insluitend assessering van finansiele bykomstigheid, volhoubaarheid en uitvoeringsrisiko. Identifiseer en ontleed finansiele, mark-, bestuurs- en prestasierisiko's wat uit verskillende projekstrukture ontstaan, en beveel toepaslike versagtingsstrategieë aan. Lei en verseker gehalte van waarderingsverslae en finansieringsaanbevelings wat aan Tegniese Evaluering- en Beleggingskomitees voorgelê word. Verskaf tegniese toesig oor hoë-risiko of komplekse projekte binne die Jobs Fund-portefeulje en ondersteun remediërende optrede waar prestasie-uitdagings ontstaan. Voer onafhanklike toegepaste navorsing uit oor werkskeppingsgeleenthede, prioriteitswaardekettings, die informele ekonomie en groen en Regverdige Energie-oorgang-verwante sektore, en vertaal insigte na finansierings- en strategie-insette. Presenteer finansiele, risiko- en navorsingsbevindings duidelik aan interne besluitnemers en eksterne belanghebbendes. Skakel, mentor en bied tegniese ondersteuning aan junior personeel, en bou institutionele vermoë in finansiele waardering, risiko-ontleding en innoverende finansiering. Verteenwoordig die Jobs Fund in toepaslike belanghebbende-betrokkenhede, markforums en leersisteme.

zu.title: Onguchwepheshe Omkhulu Wezimali Ezenzakwenayo (i-JOBS Fund)
zu.summary: Qondisa ukungena kokuqala nokwakheka kwamathuba okutshalwa imali ahlose ukwakha amathuba omsebenzi ahloniphekile e-Jobs Fund, okudinga unyaka angu-10-15 wokuqashelwa emzameni wezimali zamaphrojekthi kanye nesidanga esifanele se-NQF 7.
zu.requirements: Isidanga (i-NQF Level 7 noma ngaphezulu) kwezimali, i-Economics, i-Accounting, i-Business Management, i-Development Finance, noma inkabongo ehlobene nalesi sikhungo. Ukugadathwa ngokusemthethweni noma isidanga ekuphathweni kwamaphrojekthi noma amaphroghramu. Ukuba namava angu-10–15 kumzamo wezimali wamaphrojekthi, izimali zamakhampani, izimali ezakhiwe, noma ukuhlaziya okutshaliwe, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola nokubamba izinkontileka eziyinkimbinkimbi. Awa abonakalayo ekuhlolweni izakhiwo zezimali ezintsha noma ezingavamile kanye nezindlela zokuxhaswa ngezibonelelo. Ukuqonda okuqinile ngokuxhaswa kwangasese komkhakha wezangasese, izindlela zokukhuthaza, kanye namandla okubelethiswa. Ikhono elibonisiwe lokwenza ucwaningo lwangaphambi kokwenza isivumelwano, ukuhlaziya izitatimende nezifanekiselo zezimali, nokusebenzisa isiphumo esihle sokutshala imali. Unyaka angu-5 abengowohlelo lokuphatha ngenkathi usezinga eliphezulu. Awa Noseziga Abo Phambili: Izidanga eziphakeme ngemva kwesiqu kwezimali, i-Economics, i-Accounting, i-Business Management, i-Development Finance, noma inkabongo ehlobene nalesi sikhungo. I-CFA, i-CA(SA), i-MBA (i-Finance/Strategy), noma isidanga sokuchwepheshe esiphezulu esilinganayo. Awa ekutshalweni kwezimali ezenzayo, ukutshala imali ngokuhlose imiphumela egcwele, izimali ezixubekile, izimali zesimo sezulu, noma izimali zokuguqulwa. Awa ekusebenzeni kumaphrojekthi noma amasonto emikhiqizo ahlobene nomnotho oluhlaza, umnotho ongakahlelekwa, noma i-Just Energy Transition. Awa ekwenzeni noma ekuhumusheni ucwaningo ngamasonto emikhiqizo, ukumuncwa kwebandla, noma imiphumela yokuthuthukiswa komnotho. Inqobo Yomuntu Ofanelekileyo: Ungonguchwepheshe wezimali ezenzayo ophathe kakhulu ohlanganisa ukuhlaziya okuqinile namaKhono okwenza izinkontileka. Uzwela kahle ukusebenza phakathi komkhakha kahulumeni nowangasese, ukubheka izakhiwo zezimali eziyinkimbinkimbi, nokusebenzisa isibhekele sokutshala imali ezinkangeni zokwakha amathuba omsebenzi ezweni. Uleta inkcepthe yokucabanga ngokuzimele, isipumbu esiqinile, nokuzibophezela ekusebenzisweni amathuba kahulumeni ngendlela ekhiqiza ukukhula okuhlanganisiwe.
zu.duties: Qondisa bese ukhiqiza uhlu lwamathuba okutshala imalu ahlose nokwakha amathuba omsebenzi ahloniphekile ngokubambisana namakhampani angasese, ababadisi, abakhi, kanye nabalingani bolimo. Hlaziya, yakha, futhi hloola izinsiza zezimali eziyinkimbinkimbi namamodeli okuxhasa, okuhlanganisa izimali ezixubekile, izakhiwo zezikweletu, izimali ezingosizo, kanye nezibonelelo eziqhathaniswa nempumelelo. Yenza ucwaningo olunzima ngemali, ngokuqashisa, nangokusebenza ngokwezimali kumafomu amaphrojekthi, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola ukungezwa ngokwezimali, ukumelana, nengozi yokwenza. Hlaba futhi uhlaziye izingozi zemali, zomhlaba, zokuphatha, kanye nempumelelo ezibhoboza ezahlukene zamaphrojekthi, bese ukuleta izindlela ezifanele zokunciphisa lezo zingozi. Qhatha bese uqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwemibiko yokuhlola kanye nezindlela ezinconyiwe zokuxhaswa ezibuyiselwa kwi-Technical Evaluation and Investment Committees. Nikeza ulawulo lwobuchwepheshe lwamaphrojekthi anengozi ephezulu noma eziyinkimbinkimbi ngaphakathi kwe-Jobs Fund portfolio futhi usekele ukuthathwa kokuxhaswayo lapho kuvela izinkinga zempumelelo. Yenza ocwaningo oluzimele ngokusetshenziswa kwamathuba okwakha amathuba omsebenzi, amasonto emikhiqizo ahamba phambili, umnotho ongakahlelekwa, kanye namabhizinisi amuhlaza kanye namabhizinisi ohlobene ne-Just Energy Transition, ehumusha ukuqonda kube imibiko yezimali ngesu kanye nezimali. Yethula ngokucacile imiphumela yezimali, yezingozi, kanye nocwaningo kubantu abenza izinqumo bangaphakathi nakubalingani bangaphandle. Qondisa, nikela iseluleko, futhi usekele ngobuchwepheshe abasebenzi abasezingeni eliphansi, wakhe ikhono lezikhungo ekulawulweni imali, ekuhlaziyeni izingozi, kanye kwezimali ezintsha. Mela i-Jobs Fund ezinkantwaneni ezihlobene nabalingani, emakethe futhi emapulatifomu okufunda.

xh.title: Uphondo lobuchwephesha oluphezulu lwezimali (JOBS Fund)
xh.summary: Qhuba ukuqaliswa kokwenziwa kwaye uze uphehle amathuba emisebenzi onomthelela omkhulu egxile ekutyalweni kwemali ukuba usebenze ngo-Jobs Fund, efunwa iiminyaka eli-10-15 yamava kwiprojekthi yemali nesidanga esifanelekileyo se-NQF 7.
xh.requirements: Isidanga (NQF Level 7 okanye ngaphezulu) kwi-Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Management, Development Finance, okanye indlela enxulumene nayo. Uqeqesho olusesikweni okanye isifikelelo ekulawuleweni kweprojekthi okanye inkqubo. Iiminyaka eli-10–15 yamava kwiprojekthi yemali, imali yeshishini, imali eyakhiweyo, okanye uhlalutyo lotyalo-mali, kuquka ukuqinisekiswa kuvalwa iinkqubo ezinzima. Iimava ezibonisiweyo ekuqwalaselweni kweendlela ezitsha okanye ezingezizo ezingagqibekanga ezimali neendlela ezisekelwe kwimali yemibuzo efunwa. Ukuqonda okuqinileyo ngemali yeshishini labucala, izidlali, kunye nobungozi beendalo. Ikhono elibonisiweyo lokwenza isenzo elingathathwanga ngaphambili, ukuhlalutya iinkqubo zamafayile ezimali namamodeli, kunye nokusebenzisa isigqibo esiswe kumava esimali. Iiminyaka eli-5 yamava kwinqanaba elingowomlawuli ophakamileyo. Iimava kunye Nezifikelelo Ezilungele Ukuze Zincede: Izifikelelo eziphezulu kwi-Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Management, Development Finance, okanye indlela enxulumene nayo. Isifikelelo se-CFA, i-CA(SA), i-MBA (Finance/Strategy), okanye esingolu bunzima bomlinganiswa ongowingcali ophakamileyo. Iimava kwimali yophuhliso, ukutyala imali esinomdla, imali edityanisiweyo, imali yemozulu, okanye imali yotshintsho. Iimava kokusebenza ngamashishino aluhlaza, kwurhwebo olungaqeqelwanga, okanye iiprojekthi okanye iinthungo ezinxulumene noTshintsho loShishino loYaqaqamba kweza-Enerjhi. Iimava ekuqhubeni okutshintsha uphononongo malunga neentlobo zeendlela ezinexabiso, ukuthatha abasebenzi, okanye iziphumo zophuhliso loqoqosho. Iprofayile Yomntu Ofanelekileyo Ofunwayo: Ungowingcali yobuchwephesha ephezulu kwezimali odityanisela ukuqonda okuqinileyo ngohlalutyo namava okwenza isivumelwano esekela ngesinye isandla. Uyazithwalela kakuhle ukusebenza phakathi kwezicwangciso zikarhulumente neshishini labucala, ukuqhatha iinkqubo ezinzima zamalojari ezezimali, nokusebenzisa imbono yotyalo-mali kumaphupu okwenza amathuba emisebenzi asetyenziswa ngokwenene. Uza nokuqabambelela kwengcinga ezelweyo, isigqibo esomelezileyo, nomyalezo wokusebenzisa izibonelelo zikarhulumente njengesixhobo sokukhuthaza ukhulo olubandakanya bonke.
xh.duties: Qalisa kwaye uze uphehle inkqubo yamathuba emisebenzi ephathwe ngokusesikweni egxile ekudaleni amathuba emisebenzi ngokusebenzisana namashishini esikwtala sezimali, ababambi bamathambo, abaphuhlisi, nabanye abalinganisana nendalo. Hlaziya, yila, kwaye uhlolisise izixhobo ezizezimali ezinzima neemodeli ezimali, kuquka imali edityanisiweyo, iinkqubo zetyala, imali esekwe kumziphumo, namaxabiso anxulumene nokwenziwa kwemiraro. Yenza uphononongo oluchanekileyo ngemali, njengeshishini, nangokusebenza kwemitsho yamaphepha esicelo seprojekthi, kuquka nokuqinisekiswa ukongezwa kwezimali, ukuzinza, kunye nobungozi bokwenza imisebenzi. Qinisekisa kwaye uhlaziye ubungozi ezimalini, kwimasini, kolawulo, nakuphoqo lwenkqubo obusuka kwezinye iindlela ezenziweyo zeeprojekthi, kwaye ucelephule iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokunciphisa ubungozi. Qhatha kwaye uqinisekise umgangatho weepepha zokuqinisekisa kunye neesindululo ezimali ezisiwa kuKomiti Lokuqinisekisa ngamalungiselelo obuchwephesha kunye neQela LoTyalo-mali. Zeza isalathiso sobuchwephesha kumaprojekthi ezobungozi obuphezulu okanye ezinzima kwithilofu ye-Jobs Fund kwaye uxhase inyathelo lokulungisa apho kuvela iingxaki zomgangatho. Yenza uphononongo oluzimeleyo nolusetyenziswa ngokutsha ngamathuba okudala amathuba emisebenzi, iinthungo ezibalulekileyo zexabiso, urhwebo olungaqeqelwanga, kunye namashishino aluhlaza anxulumene noShishino loTshintsho loYaqonda kwezaEnerjhi, wandululise iingcamango kwimibalabala yokufaka imali nakuqhuba inkqubo. Siveza iziphumo zemali, ubungozi, nophononongo ngocacileyo kubagqibo bangaphakathi nabanabanye abanomdla. Fundisa, gada, kwaye uxhase ngamalungiselelo obuchwephesha abasebenzi abasebamthethweni, wakhe amandla eshishini ekuhloleni izimali, ekuhlalutyeni ubungozi, nakwezimali ezitsha. Mela i-Jobs Fund kwindibano ezibalulekileyo nababanomdwa, kumajoni orhwebo, nakwindawo zokufunda.

jobs.title: Technical Finance Specialist (JOBS Fund)
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive), PSR 44 will apply to candidates appointed in the salary level
jobs.summary: Technical Finance Specialist needed at GTAC in Pretoria to provide due diligence and project finance support for the Jobs Fund, requiring a postgraduate qualification and 10 to 15 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A postgraduate qualification (NQF Level 8) in Finance, Management Accounting, Financial Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. 10–15 years' experience in appraising, negotiating and closing project finance and corporate finance transactions. A minimum of 7 years' experience in a project management environment. 5 years of experience at a middle / senior managerial level. Advantageous: Experience in deal structuring. Practice as a project manager. Public sector and grant management experience. Strong analytical skills, strategic and critical thinking, risk management and communication skills. Experience in the use of relevant AI tools. Ideal Candidate Profile: You are an experienced finance professional who combines strong technical and analytical ability with sound project management practice. You are comfortable engaging with both internal teams and external stakeholders, quality assuring complex financial appraisals, and applying rigorous risk management across a diverse project portfolio. You bring integrity, strong communication skills and a commitment to using public and grant funding effectively to support job creation.
jobs.duties: Provide financial technical support on project due diligence and appraisals of new projects, including financial structuring of new applications, and manage a portfolio of projects and team. Provide input into the quarterly stakeholder reports. Prepare and contribute to the development of Term Sheets for new funding rounds and assist with project origination to build a pipeline of fundable projects; quality assure appraisals before submission to the Technical Evaluation and Investment Committees and support the team in presenting recommendations. Ensure the contracting of new projects is finalised within prescribed timelines, including drafting of financial contractual obligations, and conduct roadshows for new funding rounds. Facilitate efficiency improvements to the Jobs Fund's Grant Management Framework and Procedures, and provide technical support to project teams to meet the Fund's annual disbursement and job targets. Conduct risk-based oversight of the project portfolio, design and implement remedial actions to address underperformance, and prepare for and participate in quarterly Disbursement Panel meetings. Quality assures disbursement memoranda and ensure audit readiness of the project portfolio, with timeous resolution of audit findings and appropriate controls to prevent repeat findings. Conduct baseline assessments of key business processes, support the implementation of new technologies to improve operational efficiency, and support sound governance and document management practices. Effective planning of project site visits (SV) to ensure effective project implementation, and efficient utilisation of operational budget. Improve the visibility of the Jobs Fund's work by cultivating stakeholder relationships, producing discussion documents and Practice Notes, preparing webinar content, and representing the Fund at conferences and panel discussions. Generate, package and disseminate research information, support the development of terms of reference for project evaluations and close-out reports, and prepare Learning and Research Papers, Practice Guides and Articles. Contribute to the Jobs Fund's internal learning agenda through brown-bag sessions and related learning material, and coordinate with the finance team on financial information and forecasts. Maintain communication with staff and stakeholders on financial matters, motivate and support project teams, and maintain relationships with Contracted Intermediaries to ensure sound risk management at project and portfolio level. Develop and manage the Jobs Fund Risk Framework, develop strategies to mitigate financial and performance risk, and monitor portfolio-level risk status, implementing corrective actions as needed. Support the Management team in developing the Jobs Fund's financing strategy, own and manage specific financial management processes, provide training to staff to improve financial appraisal and management skills, and contribute to strategic planning sessions within the Jobs Fund and its sub-programmes.
jobs.applications: Please register or if you are already registered, sign in and apply for the position/s on the GTAC eRecruitment website: https://erecruitment.gtac.gov.za/erecruitment/
jobs.notes: The Jobs Fund is recruiting a Technical Finance Specialist to provide technical financial support in the management of its portfolio of projects and to contribute to the achievement of projected outcomes and the knowledge and learning agenda of the Fund. This is a specialist role suited to an experienced finance professional with strong project finance and corporate finance experience. Only South African Citizens, and Permanent Residents need to apply as per PSR 2016. Applications should be accompanied by a duly completed and signed Z83 form (obtainable from any Public Service department). The post title and reference number must be clearly indicated on the Z83 form. A recent comprehensive CV should be submitted. Certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be required to be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview from shortlisted candidates. All short-listed candidates will be subjected to security vetting to confirm employment, personnel suitability checks. Short-listed candidates must make themselves available for a panel interview on the date determined by GTAC. Late applications, and those not meeting the requirements, will not be considered. Should you not receive feedback from GTAC within 2 months of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. GTAC reserves the right to fill or not fill the advertised post. Preference will be given according to EE and Gender target. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. In accordance with the DPSA Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days and Minimum requirements, this SMS level appointment will be subject to the completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry programme as endorsed by the National School of Government. The applicants should therefore have proof that they have registered for the Pre-entry certificate and have completed the course before the appointment. The cost of the pre-entry certificate is at the candidate’s expense. To access the pre-certificate course, please       visit:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Applications: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications not accompanied by a comprehensive CV and fully completed and signed Z83 form will not be considered. The GTAC is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applications from women and people with disabilities. Our buildings are accessible to people with disabilities and reasonable accommodation is provided for persons with disabilities. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Tegniese Finansiespesialis (JOBS Fund)
af.summary: Tegniese Finansiespesialis benodig by GTAC in Pretoria om verskaffing van due diligence en projekfinansieringsondersteuning vir die Jobs Fund te bied, waarvoor 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie en 10 tot 15 jaar se ervaring vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Level 8) in Finansies, Bestuursrekeningkunde, Finansiële Rekeningkunde, Ekonomie, Besigheidsadministrasie of 'n verwante veld. 10–15 jaar se ervaring in die beoordeling, onderhandeling en afsluiting van projekfinansierings- en korporatiewe finansieringstransaksies. 'n Minimum van 7 jaar se ervaring in 'n projekbestuursomgewing. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Voordeelig: Ervaring in transaksiestrukturering. Praktyk as 'n projekbestuurder. Openbare sektor- en toekenningbestuurservaring. Sterke analitiese vaardighede, strategiese en kritiese denke, risikobestuur en kommunikasievaardighede. Ervaring in die gebruik van toepaslike AI-instrumente. Ideale Kandidaatprofiel: Jy is 'n ervare finansiesprofesioneel wat sterk tegniese en analitiese vermoë koppel met deeglike projekbestuurspraktyk. Jy is gemaklik om met beide interne spanne en eksterne belanghebbendes te skakel, komplekse finansiële beoordelings van kwaliteit te verseker, en streng risikobestuur oor 'n uiteenlopende projekportefeulje toe te pas. Jy bring integriteit, sterk kommunikasievaardighede en 'n toewyding om openbare en toekenningsbefondsing doeltreffend te gebruik om werkskepping te ondersteun.
af.duties: Verskaf finansiële tegniese ondersteuning by projekdue diligence en beoordelings van nuwe projekte, insluitend finansiële strukturering van nuwe aansoeke, en bestuur 'n portefeulje van projekte en 'n span. Lewer insette tot die kwartaallikse belanghebbendeverslae. Berei voor en dra by tot die ontwikkeling van Term Sheets vir nuwe befondingsrondtes en help met projekontstaan om 'n pyplyn van befondingsbare projekte op te bou; verseker die gehalte van beoordelings voor voorlegging aan die Technical Evaluation en Investment Committees en ondersteun die span in die voorlegging van aanbevelings. Verseker dat die kontraktering van nuwe projekte binne voorgeskrewe tydlyne afgehandel word, insluitend die opstel van finansiële kontraktuele verpligtinge, en voer padvertonings vir nuwe befondingsrondtes uit. Fasiliteer doeltreffendheidsverbeterings tot die Jobs Fund se Grant Management Framework en Procedures, en verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan projekspanne om die Fonds se jaarlikse uitbetalings- en werkskeppingsdoelwitte te bereik. Voer risikogebaseerde toesig oor die projekportefeulje uit, ontwerp en implementeer remediërende maatreëls om onderprestasie aan te spreek, en berei voor vir en neem deel aan kwartaallikse Disbursement Panel-vergaderings. Verseker die gehalte van uitbetalingsmemorandums en verseker ouditgereedheid van die projekportefeulje, met tydige oplossing van ouditbevindings en toepaslike kontroles om herhaling van bevindings te voorkom. Voer basislynassessering van sleutelbesigheidsprosesse uit, ondersteun die implementering van nuwe tegnologie om operasionele doeltreffendheid te verbeter, en ondersteun goeie bestuur en dokumentbestuurspraktyke. Effektiewe beplanning van projekwerfbesoeke (SV) om effektiewe projekimplementering te verseker, en doeltreffende benutting van operasionele begroting. Verbeter die sigbaarheid van die Jobs Fund se werk deur belanghebbendeverhoudings te kweek, besprekingsdokumente en Practice Notes op te stel, webinar-inhoud voor te berei, en die Fonds by konferensies en paneelbesprekings te verteenwoordig. Genereer, verpak en versprei navorsingsinligting, ondersteun die ontwikkeling van terme van verwysing vir projektevaluasies en afsluitingsverslae, en berei Learning and Research Papers, Practice Guides en Articles voor. Dra by tot die Jobs Fund se interne leeragenda deur middel van brown-bag-sessies en verwante leermateriaal, en koördineer met die finansiespan oor finansiële inligting en vooruitskattings. Onderhou kommunikasie met personeel en belanghebbendes oor finansiële aangeleenthede, motiveer en ondersteun projekspanne, en onderhou verhoudinge met Contracted Intermediaries om goeie risikobestuur op projek- en portefeuljievlak te verseker. Ontwikkel en bestuur die Jobs Fund Risk Framework, ontwikkel strategieë om finansiële en prestasierisiko te verminder, en monitor portefeuljievlak-risikostatus, en implementeer regstellende maatreëls soos benodig. Ondersteun die bestuurspan in die ontwikkeling van die Jobs Fund se finansieringsstrategie, besit en bestuur spesifieke finansiële bestuursprosesse, verskaf opleiding aan personeel om finansiële beoordelings- en bestuursvaardighede te verbeter, en dra by tot strategiese beplanningsessies binne die Jobs Fund en sy subprogramme.

zu.title: I-TTechnical Finance Specialist (JOBS Fund)
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Technical Finance Specialist e-GTAC e-Pretoria ukunikeza ukweluleka okujulile kwezimali nokusekela izimali zephrojekthi ze-Jobs Fund, kudinga izifundo zangemva kwabafundi kanye namava iminyaka eyi-10 kuye kweyi-15.
zu.requirements: Izifundo zangemva kwabafundi (NQF Level 8) kwi-Finance, Management Accounting, Financial Accounting, Economics, Business Administration noma enye indlela ehlobene. Amava eminyaka engu-10–15 ekuhlola, ekuxoxisana nasekuvaleni izimali zephrojekthi nezimali zentsha. Okuncane amava eminyaka eyi-7 endaweni yokuqondisa amaphrojekthi. Amava eminyaka eyi-5 ezingeni lomphathi wesigaba esiphakathi / esiphakemeko. Kuyabusisa: Amava ekwakhiweni kwezinkontilaka. Ukusebenza njengomphathi wamaphrojekthi. Amava emkhakheni kahulumeni nasekuphatweni ezibonelelo. Ikhono elikhulu lokuhlaziya, ukucabanga ngokwenqondo kanye nokubuka kabusha, ukuphatha ingozi kanye nekhono lokuxhumana. Amava ekusebenziseni amathuluzi ajwayelekile e-AI. Incazelo yomuntu ofanele: Uyingxenye yomuntu osebenzela izimali onamava ohlanganisa ikhono elikhulu lobuchwepheshe nokuhlaziya namaphupho alawula amaphrojekthi. Uyakhululeka ukuxhumana namateckamu angaphakathi nabanikabelo bangaphandle, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuhlola izimali okuyinkimbinkimbi kwenziwe kahle, kanye nokusebenzisa ukuphatha ingozi ngokuqinisekile emhlanganweni wezinhlobo ezahlukene zamaphrojekthi. Uletha ukuzipha, ikhono lokuxhumana nokuqinisekiswa ekusebenziseni izimali zikahulumene nezibonelelo ngendlela efanele ukusekela ukudalwa kwamathuba omsebenzi.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokwesekela kobuchwepheshe bezimali ekuhloleni iziphakamiso zamaphrojekthi kanye nokuqhathanisa amaphrojekthi amasha, okuhlanganisa ukucubungula izimali ezinguqulweni ezisha, futhi uphathe ibhange lamaphrojekthi kanye nethimba. Nikela ngolwazi emibikweni yabanikabelo yamakhota amane. Lungelelisa futhi unikele ekuthuthukisweni kwe-Term Sheets emajikweni amasha ezimali futhi usekele ekuqaleni kwamaphrojekthi ukwakha umgudwana wamaphrojekthi angaxhaswa ngemali; qinisekisa ukuthi kuhloliwe ngokugcwele ngaphambi kokuthunyelwa kwi-Technical Evaluation and Investment Committees futhi usekele ithimba ekudluliseleni izinkombandlela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukusayinwa kwamaphrojekthi amasha kuqedwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe, okuhlanganisa ukubhala izibopho zezimali ezinkontilakweni, futhi wenze izinkomba zomgwaqo emajikeni amasha ezimali. Yisa izinto ezintsha ukwenza isikhungo se-Jobs Fund Grant Management Framework and Procedures sisebenze kahle, futhi unikeze isekela lobuchwepheshe kwamathimba amaphrojekthi ukuhlangabezana nemitshombo yonyaka kanye nengozi yokudalwa kwamathuba. Yenza ukulawula ngezinga lenkinga ibhange lamaphrojekthi, diza futhi uqale izinyathelo zokulungisa ukuze ubhekane nokungasebenzi kahle, futhi ulungelele futhi uthathe inxaxheba emihlanganweni ye-Disbursement Panel yamakhota amane. Qinisekisa ukuthi imemoranda yemitshombo ihlolwe kahle futhi uqinisekise ukulungele ukuhlolwa ibhange lamaphrojekthi, ngokusombulula ngokushesha izincazelo zokuqinisekisa futhi kubekho izintela ezifanele ukuze kwingabi ukuphinda kwalezo zincazelo. Yenza izilinganiselo zokuqala kwenqubo ebalulekile yezohwebo, usekele ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe obusha ukwenza ukusebenza kahle kwezinsizakusebenza, futhi usekele ukuphatha kahle nokuphathwa kwamadokhumenti. Cwaza ngokubhala ukubukelwa kwezindawo zamaphrojekthi (SV) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa kahle kwephrojekthi, kanye nokusebenzisa kahle uhlelo lwezimali zokusebenza. Yenza ukubonakala komsebenzi we-Jobs Fund ngokwakida ubuhlobo nabakabelo, ukukhiqiza amadokhumenti enkingayo ne-Practice Notes, ukulungela okuqukethwe kwamaseminari, futhi umele i-Fund emikhakheni kanye nezinkulumo phakathi. Khipha, hlanganisa futhi sasaza ulwazi lolwazi, usekele ukuthuthukiswa kwamacala angukubuka kwamaphrojekthi namalebula afaka isandawana, futhi ulungiselele i-Learning and Research Papers, Practice Guides kanye nama-Articles. Nikela ekuhlangabezana nemigomo yakhono yangaphakathi ye-Jobs Fund ngesikhathi se-brown-bag sessions namanye amakhono afanele, futhi uhlanganise namathimba ezimali ngolwazi lwezimali kanye nemibhede yezokusikela. Gcina ukuxhumana nabasebenzi nabanikabelo ngemikhakha yezimali, khuthaza futhi usekele amathimba amaphrojekthi, futhi ugcinise ubuhlobo ne-Contracted Intermediaries ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphatha ingozi kahle ezingeni lephrojekthi nasekuqondiseni ibhange. Diza futhi uphathe umgomo we-Jobs Fund Risk Framework, diza izindlela zokunciphisa ingozi yezimali nokungalungi, futhi ulawule ukuthi kusezingeni bani ingozi kubhange, uqale izinyathelo zokulungisa uma kudingeka. Sekela ithimba lokuphatha ekuthuthukiseni umgomo wokuxhaswa kwezimali we-Jobs Fund, ube yinduna futhi uphathe inqabo ezithile zezimali, unikeze uqeqesho abasebenzeni ukuthuthukisa ikhono lokuhlolisisa nokuphatha izimali, futhi unikeze ekuqondiseni okujulile ngaphakathi kwe-Jobs Fund namaphrojekthi ayo asezansi.

xh.title: Iselwe sokuQamba Izixhobo zamaMali (i-JOBS Fund)
xh.summary: Kufuneka kubekho iselwe sokuqamba izixhobo zamali kwi-GTAC e-Pretoria ukunika inkxaso yokuzinika isixhobo ngenkqubo yokulinganisela imali yeprojekthi kwi-Jobs Fund, kwaye kufuneka kubekho isiqu semfundo ngemfundo ephezulu neminye yamava emvelwane ukuya kowaka elishumi ukuya kwelishumi elinesihlanu.
xh.requirements: Isiqu semfundo ephezulu (NQF Level 8) kwi-Finance, Management Accounting, Financial Accounting, Economics, Business Administration okanye indlela enxulumene nayo. 10–15 years' experience ekulinganiseleni, ekuxoxeni nasekuvaleni iinkqubo zomvuzo weprojekthi nethemale. Ubuncinane beminye elishumi kobungo-7 bamava kwimeko yolawulo lweprojekthi. Iminye emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi eliphezulu lolawulo. Iinkcaso ezisisiza: Amava ekwakheni inkqubo yokuqamba. Ukuzilolonga njengomlawuli weprojekthi. Amava kwicala likarhulumbe nakulawulweni lemali ezelweyo. Amandla aphakamileyo ekuhlaziyeni, okuqonda nokuqonda ngokuchanekileyo, ukulawula iingozi namandla ekunxibelelaneni. Amava ekusebenziseni izixhobo ze-AI ezifanelekileyo. Imo yenkomfa ekufuneka ibekho: Ungumchweli wezimali onamava ogqithiselwa phambili owadibanisa namandla aphakamileyo obuchwepheshe nokuhlalutya kunye nokuzilolonga kakuhle ekulawulweni kweprojekthi. Uyaziqhelanisa nokunxibelelana nakwabangaphakathi nakwabangaphandle, ukuqinisekisa ukwahlulwa ngokuchanekileyo kokulinganisela iimali ezinzima, nokusebenzisa ukulawula iingozi ngokungathandabuzekiyo kumbiko weprojekthi osebenzayo. Uletha intembeko, namandla ekunxibelelaneni nokuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwemali yomphakathi neyemali ezelweyo ngokusebenzayo ukuze inkxaso ikhuthaze ukudalwa kwamathuba emisebenzi.
xh.duties: Yinkxaso yobuchwepheshe bemali ekulinganiseleni iiprojekthi nokuziqinisekisa iiprojekthi ezintsha, kuquka ukulungiselela iimali kumagama amatsha, aze alawule ibhunga leeprojekthi neqela labasebenzi. Nikela nengeniso kwimibiko yabathintekwayo yenyanga zonke. Lungiselela uxhaso ekuphuhliseni i-Term Sheets ngeentsapho ezintsha zemali uxase ekwakheni iiprojekthi ukuvakalisa ukudalwa kwamathuba; qinisekisa ukulinganiswa kweziphithiphithi phambi kokuzinika kwi-Technical Evaluation and Investment Committees uze uxase iqela ekuboniseni izinto ezinconywayo. Qinisekisa ukuba isivumelwano seeprojekthi ezintsha sigqitywa ngaphakathi kwemigaqo yexesha elibekiweyo, kuquka nokulungiselela iinkqubo zezimali, uze wenze iindlela zokuqhuba ngokutsha iintsapho ezintsha zemali. Yiba yikhuthazo ekuphuculweni kwe-Framework yemali ezelweyo kwi-Jobs Fund kwaye unike inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kumateyim eeprojekthi ukuze bagqibeke kunqanaba le-Fund ngeminyaka yokuhambisa imali nangaphezulu. Yiba nokulawula iingozi ngokusetyenziswa kwemiba yobungozi kwibhunga leeprojekthi, uphuhle uze usebenzise iindlela zokulungisa ukungasebenzi kakuhle, uze ulungiselele ukuzithabatha inxaxheba kumaphaneli okuhambisa imali ajoliswe kwinyanga zonke. Qinisekisa ukucocwa kwememo yemali kwaye uqiniseke ukulungiselelwa kolwazi lolawulo ngokuchanekileyo, kuqonde ngexesha elizele iindinganiso zolwazi nokulawula ukuphindaphinda iindinganiso. Yenza ukuhlola kwesiseko seenkcwadi zoshishino eziphambili, uxase ekusebenziseni iindlela ezintsha zolwazi ukuphucula isebenziso, kwaye uxasele kulawulo olulungileyo nasekulawulweni kweenkcwadi. Cwangcisa ngokusebenzayo iindwendwe zesiza seprojekthi (SV) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kweprojekthi kakuhle, nokusetyenziswa kwesabelo semali ngokusebenzayo. Phucula ukubonakala komsbenzi we-Jobs Fund ngokukhuthaza ubudlelwane nabathintekwayo, ngokudalwa okukhutshwa iindlela zokubonisana nokuqinisekisa iinkcukacha, ulungiselele ngenani lolwazi lwe-webinar, uze umele i-Fund kumanyano nasekuhleni iipanel. Zala, uqwalasele uze usasaze ulwazi lophando, uxasele ekuphuhliseni iindlela zombuzo wophando lweeprojekthi nemibiko yokubuyela emva, kwaye ulungiselele iiphepha loPhando noFundo, iindlela zokuqamba nemiqulu. Nikela ekufundeni kwangaphakathi kwe-Jobs Fund ngeenkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokufundiswa nemiba yokufunda, uze ulawulane neqela lemali ngolwazi nangokutsho kwamaxhesha. Gcina inxibelelwano nabasebenzi nabathintekwayo ngezicelo zemali, ukhuthaze uze uxase amaqela eeprojekthi, kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane nakwabaPhakathi bajelwe ukunika isixhobo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula iingozi ngokuchanekileyo kwiqela leeprojekthi nakumabala abo. Phuhlisa uze ulawule i-Framework yeengozi ze-Jobs Fund, phuhlisa iindlela ezisawolawula ngenxa yamathuba nangokusilela kwamandla okusebenza, uze uqaphele isimo seengozi ngokusilela kwamandla okusebenza, usebenzise iindlela zokuqhuba ekulungiseni iimeko ezifanelekileyo. Xhasa iqela loLawulo ekuphuhliseni iindlela zemali ze-Jobs Fund, yiba nalo nise ulawule iindlela ezithile zolawulo lwezimali, uze unike imfundo abasebenzi ukuphucula ukulinganiswa nokuqonda ukulawula imali, kwaye unikele ngenkxaso nakuqamba nakuqamba iindlela ngaphakathi kwe-Jobs Fund nakumagatya abo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Corporate Services
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Senior management role overseeing corporate services, HR management and administration for the Department of Higher Education and Training in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Postgraduate qualification (NQF level 8) in Human Resource Management / Business Administration / Public Management / Public Administration / Management/ Marketing / Public Relations or related qualification. A minimum of eight (8) years’ relevant experience at senior management level in corporate service environment and five (5) years must be as a member of the SMS in the Public Service. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed as endorsed by NSG. Knowledge and skills: understanding of the Higher Education sector; policies and governance environment of TVET Colleges; annual reporting requirements by the Higher Education Institutions; knowledge and understanding of TVET Administration; Public Service Acts and Regulations; PFMA; Information Technology and Communication; Facilities Management; Labour Relation Acts; Implementing DPSA Directive and PSBC resolutions; knowledge in human resource management/ OD and change management Directives. Strategic capability and leadership; people management and empowerment; programmed and project management; change management; knowledge management; service delivery innovation; problem solving and analysis; client orientation; excellent verbal and written communication; decision making; financial management; conflict management. Values required are: Client service focus, integrity, committed/ dedicated, proactive, loyal, ethics, professional, respect, and goal-driven. Valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: To manage, oversee and provide efficient, cost-effective corporate management support services to the branches in the Department. Oversee Human Resources Management and Development Services. Provide oversight of human resource administration and systems control services. Ensure human resource development and performance management services. Oversee organisational development, human resource planning, employment, equity, policy and strategy services. Provide employee health and wellness programs. Oversee grievance dispute and misconduct resolution processes. Oversee the departmental collective bargaining. Provide Corporate Communication services. Ensure marketing and publications. Oversee external communication and medialising. Oversee internal communication and client services. Provide oversight of Information Technology and Business Systems Management Services. Oversee information technology (IT) infrastructure support and operation. Ensure application development support. Oversee information knowledge and records management services. Align DHET’s information security to legislation, governance standards and security frameworks. Provide Security Management Services and oversee Facilities Management services. Oversee the physical security management services. Manage the Vetting services and processes. Provide Facilities Management services. Oversee Asset management processes. Provide Administrative support to the Offices of the Director-General and Ministry. Ensure effective management of correspondence, documentation, records and confidential information. Coordinate preparation and quality assurance of executive submissions, briefing notes and parliamentary responses. Facilitate efficient information flow and stakeholder engagement involving the Director-General and the Ministry. Ensure compliance with service standards, governance requirements and audit readiness. Oversee and coordinate administrative, protocol and logistical support services for executive offices. Management and Control of the Branch: Corporate Services. Provide strategic direction to Corporate Services and contribute to departmental strategic planning. Provide guidance and ensure adequate support for the development of the staff of the branch. Ensure compliance with all administrative requirements, regulations, rules and instructions pertaining to the branch. Ensure implementation of the department’s strategic plan and performance agreements. Establish and maintain governance and administrative system’s continuity within the work of the branch. Ensure the development of financial reports for forecasting, trending and results analysis. Oversee the preparation and submission of project plans and implementation plans. Authorise expenditure, set budget levels ensuring that there is compliance with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations and related prescripts. Monitor quality control of work and ensure the compilation of the annual report and strategic plan of the branch. Ensure the monitoring, the planning, organising and delegation of work. Ensure the development of strategic plan, annual performance plan and annual report. Ensure monitoring and evaluation is carried out in all areas of the branch.
jobs.applications: DHET invites applicants to apply online on the New Z83 form by accessing the Departmental Website (click the ‘apply now’ button) or http://z83.ngnscan.co.za/apply
jobs.notes: Follow the easy prompts/instructions. Upload the supporting document namely, (1) a comprehensive CV and any other document (where required). A fully completed and signed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae will be considered. A helpful user guide and videos are available on the DHET website careers page to enable completion of the digital Z83. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents/copies of qualifications and other relevant documents to support the application on or before the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Candidates whose appointments promote representativity in terms of race, gender, and disability will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One of the minimum entry requirements for the SMS position is the Pre-entry Certificate. No appointment will occur without successfully completing the pre-entry certificate and submission thereof. For more details on the pre-entry course visit: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.          The candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance agreement, disclose his/her financial interests, and be subjected to security clearance. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record check, citizenship verification, qualification/study verification, and previous employment verification). Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. “DHET is committed to providing equal opportunities and practising affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representatives in terms of (race, gender, and disability) in the organisation”. Employment Equity principles will be applied in accordance with the Departmental Employment Equity Policy, taking into consideration the applicable equity targets, representativity, and legislative requirements. N.B. All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a relevant competency exercise.

af.title: Adjunk-direkteur-generaal: Korporatiewe Dienste
af.summary: Senior bestuurspos wat toesig hou oor korporatiewe dienste, HR-bestuur en -administrasie vir die Department of Higher Education and Training in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 8) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur / Besigheidsadministrasie / Openbare Bestuur / Openbare Administrasie / Bestuur / Bemarking / Openbare Betrekkinge of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van agt (8) jaar se tersaaklike ervaring op senior bestuursvlak in 'n korporatiewe diensomgewing en vyf (5) jaar moet as 'n lid van die SMS in die Openbare Diens wees. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed soos deur NSG goedgekeur. Kennis en vaardighede: begrip van die Hoër Onderwyssektor; beleide en bestuursomgewing van TVET Colleges; jaarlikse verslagdoeningsvereistes deur die Hoër Onderwysinstellings; kennis en begrip van TVET Administrasie; Public Service Acts and Regulations; PFMA; Inligtingstegnologie en Kommunikasie; Fasiliteitebestuur; Labour Relation Acts; implementering van DPSA Directive en PSBC-resolusies; kennis van menslike hulpbronbestuur / OD en veranderingbestuursdirektiewe. Strategiese vermoë en leierskap; mensebestuur en bemagtiging; program- en projebestuur; veranderingbestuur; kennisbestuur; diensleweringinnovassie; probleemoplossing en analise; kliëntgerigtheid; uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie; besluitneming; finansiële bestuur; konflikbestuur. Vereiste waardes is: kliëntdiensfokus, integriteit, toegewyd/mededingend, proaktief, lojaal, etiek, professioneel, respek, en doelgerig. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur, hou toesig oor en verskaf doeltreffende, kostedoeltreffende korporatiewe bestuursondersteuningsdienste aan die takke in die Department. Hou toesig oor Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en Ontwikkelingsdienste. Verskaf toesig oor menslike hulpbronadministrasie en stelselbeheerdienste. Verseker menslike hulpbronontwikkeling en prestasiebestuursdienste. Hou toesig oor organisatoriese ontwikkeling, menslike hulpbronbeplanning, indiensneming, billikheid, beleid en strategiedienste. Verskaf werknemergesondheids- en welstandsprogramme. Hou toesig oor grievansie-, geskil- en wangedragskwessies. Hou toesig oor departementele kollektiewe bedinging. Verskaf Korporatiewe Kommunikasiedienste. Verseker bemarking en publikasies. Hou toesig oor eksterne kommunikasie en medialising. Hou toesig oor interne kommunikasie en kliëntdienste. Verskaf toesig oor Inligtingstegnologie- en Besigheidstelselbestuursdienste. Hou toesig oor inligtingstegnologie (IT) infrastruktuurondersteuning en -bedryf. Verseker toepassingsontwikkelingsondersteuning. Hou toesig oor inligtingskennis en rekordbestuursdienste. Belyn DHET se inligtingsekerheid met wetgewing, bestuursstandaarde en sekuriteitsraamwerke. Verskaf Sekuriteitsbestuursdienste en hou toesig oor Fasiliteitebestuursdienste. Hou toesig oor die fisiese sekuriteitsbestuursdienste. Bestuur die veetingsdienste en -prosesse. Verskaf Fasiliteitebestuursdienste. Hou toesig oor batebestuursprosesse. Verskaf Administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Kantore van die Direkteur-generaal en die Ministerie. Verseker effektiewe bestuur van korrespondensie, dokumentasie, rekords en vertroulike inligting. Koördineer voorbereiding en gehaltversekering van uitvoerende voorleggings, kortnotas en parlementêre response. Fasiliteer doeltreffende inligtingsvloei en belangenhebbengesamentliking wat die Direkteur-generaal en die Ministerie behels. Verseker nakoming van diensstandaarde, bestuursvereistes en ouditgereedheid. Hou toesig oor en koördineer administratiewe, protokol- en logistieke ondersteuningsdienste vir uitvoerende kantore. Bestuur en beheer van die Tak: Korporatiewe Dienste. Verskaf strategiese rigting aan Korporatiewe Dienste en dra by tot departementele strategiese beplanning. Verskaf leiding en verseker voldoende ondersteuning vir die ontwikkeling van die personeel van die tak. Verseker nakoming van alle administratiewe vereistes, regulasies, reëls en instruksies wat op die tak van toepassing is. Verseker implementering van die departement se strategiese plan en prestasieooreenkomste. Vestig en handhaaf kontinuïteit van bestuurs- en administratiewe stelsels binne die werk van die tak. Verseker die ontwikkeling van finansiële verslae vir prognostisering, tendense en resultateontleding. Hou toesig oor die voorbereiding en indiening van projekplanne en implementeringsplanne. Magtig besteding, stel begrotingsvlakke en verseker nakoming van die PFMA, Tesourieregulasies en verwante voorskrifte. Monitor gehaltebeheer van werk en verseker die opstel van die jaarverslag en strategiese plan van die tak. Verseker die monitering, beplanning, organisering en delegering van werk. Verseker die ontwikkeling van strategiese plan, jaarlikse prestasieplan en jaarverslag. Verseker dat monitering en evaluering in alle areas van die tak uitgevoer word.

zu.title: Sekela-Nobala-Jikelele: Imisebenzi Yezinkampani
zu.summary: Isikhundla sophatha abaphakeme esibuka phezulu imisebenzi yezinkampani, ukuPhathwa kwe-HR kanye nokuqashwa kwabasebenzi koMnyango weMfundo Ephakeme noQeqesho e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele zesiqu sangemva kwamabanga (izinga le-NQF 8) ekuPhathweni Kwamatholwabo Abantu / ekuPhathweni Kwezebhizinisi / ekuPhathweni Kwezomphakathi / ekuPhathweni Kwezomphakathi / ekuPhathweni / ekuThengiseni / Ubudlelwano Bezomphakathi noma iziqu ezihlobene. Ubuncwane beminyaka eyisishiyagalombhi (8) yamava ahlobene ezingeni lokuPhatha abaphakeme endaweni yamasevisi ezinkampani futhi iminyaka emihlanu (5) kumele ibe ngulungu le-SMS ezinkampheni zomphakathi. Ukuphela ngemvelo i-Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programmed njengoba kugunyazwe yi-NSG. Ulwazi namakhono: ukuqonda umkhakha weMfundo Ephakeme; imiqubu nendawo yokuphathwa kwezikholeji ze-TVET; izidingo zembiko sonyaka ngeMithombo yeMfundo Ephakeme; ulwazi nokuqonda koPhathwa be-TVET; i-Public Service Acts and Regulations; i-PFMA; i-Information Technology and Communication; i-Facilities Management; i-Labour Relation Acts; ukuphatha imiyalo ye-DPSA nezinqumo ze-PSBC; ulwazi lokuPhathwa kwamatholwabo abantu / i-OD nokuPhathwa kokushintsha imiyalo. Ikholo lokuhlela amasu nobuholi; ukuPhatha abantu nokuSusa amandla; ukuPhathwa kwezinhlela namaphrojekthi; ukuPhathwa kokushintsha; ukuPhathwa kolwazi; intuthuko yokulethwa kwisevisi; ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuHlaziya; ukuqondiswa kabathengi; ukuxhumana okuhle ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe; ukwenza izinqumo; ukuPhathwa kwezimali; ukuPhathwa kwesiphithiphithi. Amanani afunwayo: ukuqondiswa kwabathengi, ukuzinza, ukuzibophezela/ukuzinikezela, ukuba ngumuntu ophambili, ukwethembeka, izimilo, ukuba ngumuntu ochwepheshe, inhlonipho, futhi uqhutywe imigqomo. Qinisekisa futhi ugcine ukuhlanganiswa kwemibigo yokuqhubeka phambili kwabafundi, izitatimende, imiphumela nemibuzo yabafundi. Nikeza abafundi nokuqondiswa ekukhethwa ikhompyutha, ukwelulekwa kanye nosekelo emfundweni. Hlela futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlela zokuqondisa ekukhethweni ikhompyutha zabafundi abafisa ukungena kanye nalabo babhalisile ekuzukeni iziqu. Qapha futhi ugcine imisebenzi yezemidlalo, zonkhezonke, ubuciko kanye namasiko abafundi. Hlelanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwemihlandla yezemidlalo kanye nezinhlela zokuzonkondla. Yenza sibe lula ukubusa kwabafundi kanye nentuthuko yokuba ngabaholi babafundi. Hlelanganisa futhi ulawule izinqubo zokhetho lwe-SRC lemnyaka yonke. Five (5) years’ experience in Curriculum Development plus a minimum of 3 year’s supervisory experience and a valid driver’s licence. Leadership skills and management skills, project management skills and communication, inclusive of presentation skills. Ability to work independently as well as a team. jobs.duties: To facilitate: Occupational qualifications implementation. Occupational qualifications policy development and implementation. OHS Compliance, POE’s format and content, types of machinery used. Tools handling in the workshop and storage. Floor demarcations and workshop cubicles, teaching and learning Policy, Assessment, Certification and Appeals policy. Leaner support services, before, during and after the training intervention. Teaching& learning portfolios content aligned to QCTO. Identify new market trends to determine needs and opportunities. Formulate strategies to expand delivery of occupational programmes. Develop and review procedures and templates for the implementation of occupational learning programmes. Manage and facilitate registration of learning programmes. Beplanning, organisering, leiding en beheervaardighede. Navorsing, verslagdoening en aanbieding.

Inhoud van onderrig-en-leerportefeuljes in ooreenstemming met QCTO. Identifiseer nuwe markneigings om behoeftes en geleenthede te bepaal. zu.title: Osiza Umqondisi: Ukuthuthukiswa KweKhilakhulumo Nokuphathwa
zu.summary: Osiza umqondisi woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa KweKhilakhulumo nokuphathwa kwezinto eMnyangweni we-Higher Education and Training, okudinga amava ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kwekhilakhulumo nokuhola.
zu.requirements: Ithifikheti ye-Senior Certificate/Grade 12/ STD 10 noma i-NCV level 4 kanye nediploma/degree yezwe ezithathwa emuva kweminyaka emithathu (3) eyamukelwayo (NQF L7) kanye nethifikheti yokufundisa eamukelwayo, Ithifikheti ye-SACE. Uhambele iminyaka emihlanu (5) ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kohlaka kanye nokuba namava okuhola okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) kanye nelaysense yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono namandla okuqonda: Ukuqonda i-Public Service Act, ukuqonda i-CET Act ka-2006 njengoba kulungisiwe, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuba ngumholi kanye namakhono okulawula, amakhono okulawula amaphrojekthi nakho ukuxhumana, okuhlanganisa namakhano esiboniso. Ikhono lokusebenza ngabanye kanye naseqenjini. Ikhono lokwelula, ukulunga izinto, ukuhola nokulawula. Ukucwaninga, ukubika kanye nokubonisa.
zu.duties: Ukuhola: Ukuphatha izidingo zobusebenzi. Ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo yezidingo zobusebenzi nokuphathwayo. Ukulandelwa kwe-OHS, isakhiwo nokuqukethwe kwe-POE, izinhlobo zemishini esetshenziswayo. Ukuphathwa kwamathuluzi ohloleni kanye nesitoreji. Ukuhlukaniswa kwendawo kanye namakhabhula oholelo lokusebenza, inqubomgomo yokufundisa nokufunda, ukuhlolwa, izitifiketi kanye nenqubomgomo yeziyalezo. Izinsiza zokusekela abafundi, ngaphambi, ngesikhathi nangemva kwenhlanganisela yokholisisa. Okuqukethwe kwamaphothifoliyo okufundisa nokufunda kuqondaniswe ne-QCTO. Ukuhlola imigendingo emissha emkhakheni ukuze kuqunywe izidingo namathuba. Ukubumba izinqubomgomo zokwandisa ukulethwa kohlaka lobusebenzi. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuhlola izinqubo namathempleyithi okuphatha izinhlela zokufunda zohlaka lobusebenzi. Ukuphatha futhi ukuhola ubhaliso lwezinhlela zokufunda. Ukubhalisa abaholi bamaphrojekthi, abahloli, abasebenzisi be-RPL kanye nabahloli bahlelo kumagunya ahambisanayo. Ukuhlanganyela namabhizinisi. Imisebenzi yokwenza isiqiniseko sokulunga iyenziwa ngokulandelwa kwemithetho elandzelwe. Ukuhola ukunikwa kwezitifiketi kubafundi abakghono ngokuvumelana nomthetho ohambisanayo kanye nezidingo ze-QCTO. Ukunika ukusekelwa ekuthuthukiseni nokuphathweni kohlaka lobusebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukwamukelwa kwezinhlela ezinikelwayo nasekubhalweni kolwazi ngokusebenzisa ukwamukelwa okuhambisanayo.

xh.title: Umthunywa oseduze noMlawuli: Ukuphla kweNkqubo yolwazi no
xh.summary: Umthunywa oseduze noMlawuli weNkqubo yokuphla kweNkqubo yolwazi kwisebe lezeMfundo ePhezulu nokuQeqeshwa, ofuna imfundo ngokuqamba iinkqubo nokuqonda ukulawula abantu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seNqanaba eliPhakamileyo sikaGredy 10 okanye i-NCV level 4 kunye neDiploma/Digri yesizwe (NQF L7) emazipho iiminyaka emithathu (3) ekuqatshelwa njengesatifikethi somthunywa, kunye nesatifikethi sobuthisha esaziwayo, isatifikethi se-SACE. Iimveliso zeminyaka emihlanu (5) ekuqatshelwa kwiinkqubo zokufundisa kunye nokulawula iiminyaka ezintathu (3) kunye nesatifikethi sokushayela esiyiyo. Amandla namava okuzinza: Ulwazi ngePublic Service Act, ulwazi nge-CET Act of 2006 njengoko iguqulwe, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amaphawu okulawula nokuqonda, amaphawu okuphatha iiprojekthi nokuqhathaniswa, kuquka namaphawu okubonisa. Amandla okusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nakuluntu. Amandla okucinga, ukuqamba, ukulawula nokuqhuba. Uphando, iinkqubo zokuqamba nokuvezwa.
xh.duties: Ukwenza lula: Ukusebenzisa izigqibo zomsebenzi. Ukuphla kunye nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zemigaqo yezigqibo zomsebenzi. Ukuzaliseka kwe-OHS, ifomathi kunye nokuqukathwe kwe-POE, iintlobo zezixhobo ezisetyenziswayo. Ukuphatha izixhobo kwisixhobo somsebenzi nendawo yokugcina. Iimaphu zangaphantsi kunye neecandelo zomsebenzi, iNkqubo yokufundisa nokufunda, ukuqwalasela, ukuqinisekisa kunye nenkqubo yokuweza iizikhalazo. Iinkonzo zokuxhasa abafundi, ngaphambi, ngexesha kunye nemva kokuthintela ukufundisa.okuqukathwe kwamaqokelelo okufundisa nokufunda ahambelana ne-QCTO. Ukuchonga iintshuko ezitsha zentengiso ukumisimela iimfuno namathuba. Ukwenza iindlela zokwandisa ukulawuliswa kweenkqubo zomsebenzi. Ukuphucula kunye nokuhlolwa iinkqubo kunye namaph Athensi ekusingathweni kweenkqubo zokufunda ngomsebenzi. Ukulawula nokwenza lula ukubhaliswa kweenkqubo zokufunda. Ukubhaliswa kabanqongoxhali beprojekthi, babavavayo, basebenzi be-RPL kunye nabahloli kurhulumente abahambelanayo. Ubumanyano namanqanaba emveliso. Iinkonzo zokuqinisekisa imgangatho zenziwa ngokulandela imigaqo efunekayo. Ukwenza lula ukufakwa kwezaziso kwabafundi abakwaziyo ngokwemigaqo egqithiswayo nokuvela kwe-QCTO.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Student Registration Services
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 per annum (Level 10), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Oversee student registration processes including policy development, admission procedures and record management at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4). Must be in possession of a recognised (3) three-year National Diploma (NQF Level 6)/ Degree in Business Administration, Public Management/Administration or any other relevant qualification is essential. A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years of experience at supervisory level, salary level 7 or 8 in an administration environment is required. A valid Code B driver’s license is compulsory. Experience within the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector will be considered an added advantage. The ideal candidate must possess sound knowledge of enrolment standard operating procedures, data capturing procedures, and the use of computerized systems. A clear understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service, as well as knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures relevant to the working environment, is expected. The candidate must demonstrate strong report writing and presentation skills, particularly within the context of public sector governance. Effective communication, people empowerment, planning and execution capabilities are essential. Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint is required, along with a proven ability to manage change effectively. Leadership skills, a commitment to quality work, sound human resource management, and the ability to communicate and lead with integrity form the foundation of the required values and attitudes for this role. Knowledge of Public Service legislation and policies. Knowledge of PSET. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET/CET Administration. Understanding of the Higher Education Sector. Understanding of corporate governance. Understanding Cost center budgetary, expenditure and cash flow management. Employment Equity Act, Public Services Regulations and Public Services Act, Labour Relations Act and any other related legislation. Sound Computer Skills in MS Office (intermediate levels) Self- motivated. Good organizing, planning, problem solving skills. Planning and organizing. Financial management. Report writing. Communication and interpersonal skills. Problem solving. Computer literacy. Analytical. Client oriented.
jobs.duties: Manage the administration of the overall student registration process, ensuring the development, review, and effective implementation of policies and procedures related to registration, admission, scheduling, and student records. Facilitate workshops to promote awareness and consistent application of these policies. Develop and implement marketing strategies aimed at attracting new student enrolments and oversee the accuracy of registration documentation. Supervise the management of student data systems, including graduate and alumni databases, and ensure accurate pre-entry support services such as financial aid, accommodation, and bursary assistance are available. Provide student guidance, placement testing, and maintain up-to-date programme enrolment records. Ensure orientation programmes are conducted across the college and on campuses, and that student data is accurately captured on the Information Technology System (ITS). Oversee the administration of student financial aid and bursary support, ensuring compliance with TVET Bursary Scheme rules and guidelines. Coordinate and chair financial aid committee meetings, facilitate funding awards, verify bursary statistics, and monitor compliance with bursary requirements while identifying and engaging potential academic sponsors. Administer the management of student learning materials, including the issuance, collection, and upkeep of textbooks and learning resources. Manage the coordination of career exhibition services, marketing college programmes at schools, open days, and exhibitions. Oversee the management of all human, financial, and other resources within the unit, ensuring optimal performance and adherence to relevant legislation and institutional policies.
jobs.enquiries: Ms P Xamesi / Ms N Mjonono / Ms U Ncethelo / Ms S Jali at 087 238 2223
