All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Studenteregistrasiedienste
af.summary: Hou toesig oor studenteregistrasieprosesse, insluitend beleidsontwikkeling, toelatingsprosedures en rekordbestuur by die Department of Higher Education and Training se sentrale kantoor.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4). Moet in besit wees van 'n erkende (3) driejaar National Diploma (NQF Level 6)/ Degree in Business Administration, Public Management/Administration of enige ander tersaaklike kwalifikasie is noodsaaklik. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op toesighoudende vlak, salarisvlak 7 of 8 in 'n administratiewe omgewing word vereis. 'n Geldige Code B-bestuurslisensie is verpligtend. Ervaring binne die Post-School Education and Training (PSET)-sektor sal as 'n bykomende voordeel beskou word. Die ideale kandidaat moet oor deeglike kennis van inskrywingsstandaardbedryfsprosedures, datavasleggingsprosedures en die gebruik van gerekeniseerde stelsels beskik. 'n Duidelike begrip van die wetlike raamwerk wat die Public Service regeer, asook kennis van bergings- en onttrekkingsprosedures wat relevant is tot die werksomgewing, word verwag. Die kandidaat moet sterk verslagskryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede toon, veral binne die konteks van openbare-sektorbestuur. Doeltreffende kommunikasie, mensebemagtiging, beplanning en uitvoeringsvermoëns is noodsaaklik. Bedreweheid in MS Word, Excel en PowerPoint word vereis, tesame met 'n bewese vermoë om verandering doeltreffend te bestuur. Leierskapsvaardighede, 'n toewyding aan gehaltewerk, deeglike menslikehulpbronbestuur, en die vermoë om met integriteit te kommunikeer en te lei, vorm die grondslag van die vereiste waardes en gesindhede vir hierdie rol. Kennis van Public Service-wetgewing en -beleide. Kennis van PSET. Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET-administrasie. Begrip van die Higher Education Sector. Begrip van korporatiewe bestuur. Begrip van kostesentrumbegroting, besteding en kontantvloeibestuur. Employment Equity Act, Public Services Regulations en Public Services Act, Labour Relations Act en enige ander verwante wetgewing. Deeglike rekenaarvaardighede in MS Office ( intermediêre vlakke). Selfgemotiveerd. Goeie organisering, beplanning, probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Beplanning en organisering. Finansiële bestuur. Verslagskrywing. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossing. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Analities. Kliëntegerig.
af.duties: Bestuur die administrasie van die algehele studenteregistrasieproses, en verseker die ontwikkeling, hersiening en doeltreffende implementering van beleide en prosedures rakende registrasie, toelating, skedulering en studenterekords. Fasiliteer werkswinkels om bewustheid en konsekwente toepassing van hierdie beleide te bevorder. Ontwikkel en implementeer bemarkingstrategieë wat gemik is op die lok van nuwe studentinskrywings en hou toesig oor die akkuraatheid van registrasiedokumentasie. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van studentedatatestelsels, insluitend gegradueerde en oudstudentedatabasisse, en verseker dat akkurate voor-toelatingsondersteuningsdienste soos finansiële hulp, akkommodasie en beursbywerking beskikbaar is. Verskaf studentebegeleiding, plekstoetsing, en handhaak opgedateerde programinskrywingsrekords. Verseker dat oriëntasieprogramme dwarsoor die kollege en op kampusse uitgevoer word, en dat studentedata akkuraat op die Information Technology System (ITS) vasgelê word. Hou toesig oor die administrasie van studentefinansiële hulp en beursondersteuning, en verseker voldoening aan TVET Bursary Scheme-reëls en riglyne. Koördineer en tree as voorsitter op by vergaderings van die finansiële hulpte komitee, fasiliteer befondsingstoekennings, verifieer beursstatistieke, en monitor voldoening aan beursvereistes terwyl potensiële akademiese borgs geïdentifiseer en betrokke gemaak word. Administreer die bestuur van studenteleermateriaal, insluitend die uitreiking, insameling en onderhoud van handboeke en leermiddels. Bestuur die koördinering van beroepsuitstallingsdienste, en bemark kollege-programme by skole, oopdae en uitstallings. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van alle menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne binne die eenheid, en verseker optimale prestasie en voldoening aan toepaslike wetgewing en instellingbeleide.

zu.title: Umphathi Osekela: Izinsiza Zokubhaliswa Kwabafundi
zu.summary: Bhekela izinqubo zokubhaliswa kwabafundi okuhlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo, izinqubo zokwamukelwa, kanye nokuphathwa kwarekhodi ehhovisi likahulumeni lika-Department of Higher Education and Training central office.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4). Kumele ube neziqu ze-(3) three-year National Diploma (NQF Level 6)/ Degree in Business Administration, Public Management/Administration noma nanoma yisiphi esinye isiqu esihambisanayo, okuyimfuneko. Kudingeka kube nokuba namava amuncu we-(3) kuya kwengu-(5) eminyaka ezingeni lobukhomishane, izinga leholo 7 noma 8 emhlabeni wokuphathwa. Ilayisensi yomshayeli ye-Code B evumelekile iyafezwa. Amava ngaphakathi kwesigaba se-Post-School Education and Training (PSET) bayothathwa njengento eyengeza inzuzo. Isikhulu esihle kumele sibe nolwazi olujwayelekile ngezinqubo ezisemthethweni zokubhalisa, izinqubo zokubamba idatha, nokusebenzisa amasistimu ekhompyutha. Kulindeleke ukuba kube nokuzuva okucacile kwesakhiwo somthetho esibusisa Inkonzo Yomphakathi, kanye nolwazi ngezinqubo zokulondoloza nokukhipha ulwazi ezihambene nendawo yokusebenza. Isikhulu kumele siveze amakhono amakhulu abhali amaphawu adlulisa ulwazi ngokubhaliwe, ikakhulukazi ngaphakathi kwezokuphathwa kahulumeni wabantu. Ekhombisa amakhono amakhulu okuxhumana, ukulunga abantu, ukubhekwa phambili, amakhono okuhlela nokuphumelelisa kubalulekile. Kuqashwa nenzalo ekusebenziseni MS Word, Excel, kanye ne-PowerPoint, kanye nokuveza abakhona ukuphathwa kokushintsha kahle. Amakhono okuba ngumphathi, ukuzinikela emsebenzini ohle Baleko, ukuphathwa kwabantu okuhle, nendlela yokuba ngumphathi ohlakaniphile, kuyisisekelo sezindingo zamakhonko nesimo mpilo samaphuzu kulendima. ULwazi ngomthetho mayelana nabasebenzi bantu nezenzimi zeNkonzo Yomphakathi. ULwazi nge-PSET. ULwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-TVET/CET. Ukuqonda isigaba seMfundo ePhakeme. Ukuqonda ukulawulwa komhlangano. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezimali, kwezindleko, kanye nokuphathwa kwezimali ezibambeze. Employment Equity Act, Public Services Regulations and Public Services Act, Labour Relations Act kanye nanoma yimuphi umunye umthetho ohlobene. Amakhono okusebenza ngekhompyutha MS Office (izinga eliphakathi). Zizimele. Amakhono amahle okuhlela, ukulunga, ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukulunga nokuhlela. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukwabhala imibiko. Ukuxhumana nokuqonda abantu. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ukuhlaziya. Ukugxila kumthengi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuphathwa kwenqubo yonke yokubhalisa abafundi, kuqinisekiswa ukuthuthukiswa, ukubuyekezwa, nokuphumeleliswa okusebenzayo kwezinqubomgomo nezinqubo ezihlobene nokubhalisa, ukungena, ukulandelwa kwesikhathi, namarekhodi abafundi. Hlela amasemina ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuqwashiswa nokusetshenziswa okungaguquki kwalezi zinqubomgomo.uthuthukise futhi uphumelelise izindlela zokumaketha ezihloselwe ukukhanga ukubhaliswa kwabafundi abasha uphinde ulawule ukunemba kwamadokhumenti okubhalisa. Qapha ukuphathwa kwamasistimu wedatha yabafundi, okuhlanganisa amaphothokwezo abafundi abaqede baphinde abangasebenyo, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kukhona izinsiza zokwesekwa ngaphambi kokungena ezifana nenzalo yemali, indawo yokuhlala, nenzalo yemali. Nikeza abafundi imiyalo, ukuhlolwa kokubekwa endaweni, futhi igcine amarekhodi okubhaliswa ohlelweni abahamba njalo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokwazisa ziyenziwa esikhungweni samakholishi nakumakhampasi, nokuthi idatha yabafundi iboshiwe ngokunemba kusistimu yobuchwepheshe bolwazi (ITS). Lawula ukuphathwa kwenzalo yemali yabafudi nezinsiza zezibhasidi, uqinisekise ukuthikamela ngokusho nemithetho yesikeme se-TVET Bursary Scheme. Linganisa uphinde ubambe amhlanganwe ekomidi lezalo yemali, wenze izabelo zemali, uqinisekise izibalo zeziNgxowa zimali ezinikezwayo futhi ulawule ukuthikamela kwemithetho edinga izibhasidi. Lawula ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zokufunda abafundi, okuhlanganisa ukunikezwa, ukuqoqa, nokugcina izincwadi zokufunda nezinsiza zokufunda. Phatha ukubumbana kwemisebenzi yokuboniswa kwemisebenzi, ukwenza umakethe wamahlela wekhampasi ezikoleni, eminsini ovulekile, nasemibukisweni. Lawula ukuphathwa kwayo yonke iminyango, imali, nezinye izinsiza kuleyo unit, uqinisekise ukusebenza okuhle nokuthikamela ngokusho kwemithetho ehlobene nenhlelo yezikole.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Iinkonzo zoBhaliso lweziFundi
xh.summary: Qondisa iinkqubo zobhaliso lwezifundi eziquka ukuphuqa iinkqubo, iindlela zokwamkelwa kunye nolawulo lweerekhodi kwindlu enkulu yeNqkululeko yoFundo eNgaphezulu nokuQeqesha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sePhezulu / Isidayara 12/ Isatifikethi se-NCV (Inqanaba 4). Kufuneka ube ne-Diploma yebazali le-(3) yeminyaka yamathathu (Inqanaba 6 le-NQF)/ Isidanga kwiQhinga loLawulo, uLawulo/oLawulo lwakuLuntu noma naliphi na esinye isatifikethi esithintelekayo. Kufuneka ube namava amabalwa amathathu (3) ukuya kwamahlanu (5) eminyaka kwinqanaba lokuqonda, inqanaba 7 lo mvuzo noma 8 kwimeko yolawulo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba ye-Code B esemthethweni iyaphothwe. Amava kwicandelo leFundo loMva seKholo nokuQeqesha (PSET) aza kuthathwa njengenzuzo eyongezelelweyo. Umfa kaqaliswe kufuneka abe nolwazi olululo ngeenkqubo ezisesekweni zokubhalisa, iinkqubo zokuqokelela iingcombolo, noku usebenzisa iinkqubo zekhompyutha. Kuqalelekisa ukuqonda ngokucacileyo kwesakhiwo somthetho esilawula Inkonzo yakuLuntu, kunye nolwazi ngeenkqubo zogcino noku kutsha iinkcukacha ezithintela nendawo yokusebenza. Umfa kufuneka abe nobuchule obuqinileyo ekubhaliweyo kweekhathhograph noku phetha iinkumbulo, ngokukodwa ngokwendlela yolawulo kwicandelo likarhulumende. Unxibelelwano olusebenzayo, ukunika amandla abantu, ukuqamba noku zenza izicwangciso yimfuno. Ulwazi kwi-MS Word, i-Excel, kunye ne-PowerPoint kufuneka, kunye nokuqonda ukuguqula izinto ngokusebenzayo. Amandla okuba ngumbuki, izimiso zokwenza umsebenzi omthathu, ulawulo lwamandla abantu oluhle, nokuqhwamela ukuqwaleka nokuba ngumbuki ngokuzinikela yimfuno kweli gaba. Ulwazi ngomthetho nolu lululo ngeNkonzo yakuLuntu. Ulwazi nge-PSET. Ulwazi noQonda nokuLawula i-TVET/CET. Ukuqonda ngeCandela loFundo ePhakamileyo. Ukuqonda ulawulo lweekhompani. Ukuqonda ulawulo lwebhajeti yendawo yexabiso, iindleko noku lawula imali egqithayo. Umthetho weNkqubo eThintelekayo yokuSebenza, Izicwangciso zeNkonzo yakuLuntu kunye noMthetho weNkonzo yakuLuntu, Umthetho weQabane lolawulo naye naninye na umthetho othintelekayo. Amakhono eKhompyutha aliqotho kwi-MS Office (iinqanaba ezingaphakathi) Uzigqatsela ngokwakhe. Ukuyila okuhle, ukuqamba, amakhono oku sisombulu. Ukuqamba noku yila. Ulawulo lwezi mali. Ukubhala iikhathhograph. Unxibelelwano nakhono abantu. Uku sisombulu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ukuhlalutya. Uqwalaselo lomthengi.
xh.duties: Lawula ulawulo lweenkqubo zonke zobhaliso lwezifundi, kuqinisekiswa ukuphuqa, ukuhlola, nokuphumeza ngokusebenzayo iinkqubo neendlela ezithintela ukubhalisa, ukwamkelwa, ukuqamba iqhinga, noku gxothwa kwezifundi. Qhankqotha iindibano zokukhulisa ukuqonda nokusebenzisa ngokuqinileyo ezi nkqubo. Qamba Uphumeze iinkqubo zokuqhankqotha ezijoliswe ekutsaleni izifundi ezintsha kubhaliso nokuqinisekisa ukuchaneka kwezixhobo zobhaliso. Lawula ulawulo lweenkqubo zeedatha zezifundi, eziquka i-data bases zo bhaliswa noku qeqeswa okuphelayo, kuqinisekiswa ukuba inkonzo zo xhaso lokungena ngaphambili ezifana noko xhaswa imali, ukutsha, noku nxibelelana ngezibonelelo ziyafumaneka. Nikezisa inkqondo kwezifundi, ukuqwalaselwa koku bhaliswa, noku gcina iirekhodi zobhaliso lwazi. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokuqalisa ziyenziwa kwi-kholeji naku kwingcampa, nokuqinisekisa ukuba idatha yezifundi iqokelelwa ngokuchanekileyo kwiNkqubo yeTeknoloji yolwazi (ITS). Lawula ulawulo lokuxhaswa kwezifundi ezimalini nokuqinisekisa ukuxhaswa ngokuthobela imithetho nolawulo lwe-TVET Bursary Scheme. Lawula ndese qhankqotha iindibano zekomiti yokuxhaswa nemali, qhankqotha izibonelelo zemali, qinisekisa iidata yezibonelelo, nokuqwalasela ukuthobela imfuno noku qwalasela abaxhasi abanokubakho. Lawula ulawulo lwezixhobo zokufunda ezifunda, eziquka ukunikwa, ukugcinwa, noku pulula iibhuku noku xhaswa amathuba okufunda. Lawula ulungelelwaniso lweekonzo zokubonisana ngemisebenzi, nokuqhankqotha iinkqubo zekholeji eziwindla, iintsapho zokuvula, nokuqhankqotha. Qondisa ulawulo lwawo onke amandla, imali, noku nyewe iinkonzo kwicandelo, kuqinisekiswa ukuphumeza ngokupheleleyo noku landela imithetho elandelayo nolu lululo ngeenkqubo zolawulo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Examinations and Assessments
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 per annum (Level 10), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Assistant Director managing examinations and assessments at a TVET college, ensuring compliance with DHET, Umalusi and QCTO policies.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4). An appropriate M+3- year degree or Diploma. Recognised teaching qualification. At least three (3) years teaching experience in the TVET College. A minimum of three (3) to five (5) years of experience at supervisory level. An in-depth knowledge of academic support with proven experience. A proven understanding of vocational training and its importance for delivery of critical skills. Knowledge of all Education related legislative framework such as PAM, CET Act of 2006 as amended, all Assessment related policies &guidelines, curriculum guidelines, Public Service Act. Be in a possession of a valid code 8 driver’s license. Sound Computer Skills in MS Office (Beginners-intermediate level) and self-motivated good organizing, planning, problem solving and analytical skills. Registration with SACE. An extensive understanding of the DHET Examination & Assessment Policies and latest ICASS Guidelines; Excellent management and organization skills; when the arises. Must be able to work under pressure and adapt to changes in the TVET sector. Computer literate on Assessment & Examinations eLearning platforms.
jobs.duties: Manage and coordinate internal and external examinations and assessments activities across the College. Ensure compliance with DHET, Umalusi, QCTO and institutional assessment and examination policies, procedures and regulations. Coordinate examination and assessment planning, candidate registration, mark capturing results processing and verification processes. Manage, secure handling of examination materials and scripts. Coordinate invigilation, marking and moderation processes. Manage assessment and examination irregularities. Monitor examination centre readiness and compliance. Coordinate outstanding results, certification and National N Diploma matters. Analyse assessment results and prepare performance reports, support academic interventions arising from assessment performance, maintain examination records and assessment databases, liaise with relevant regulatory and certification bodies. Supervise staff and manage the performance of the examinations and assessments function.
jobs.enquiries: Ms P Xamesi / Ms N Mjonono / Ms U Ncethelo / Ms S Jali at 087 238 2223
jobs.applications: Please hand-deliver or courier your applications to the reception area quoting the relevant reference number addressed to the Acting Principal, Lovedale TVET College, Corporate Office, 1 Amatola Row, Qonce, 5600. Email Address: vacancies@lovedale.org.za
jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed New Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by a SAQA evaluation report. Successful candidates will be subjected to a vetting and financial disclosure process (criminal record, citizenship, qualification verification and employment verification). Lovedale TVET College is an equal opportunities employer and reserves the right not to fill the posts. People living with disability are encouraged to apply. If you have not been contacted within six months after closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. NB Please ensure that the Z83 form is completed in full. Incomplete Z83 will be disqualified. The college reserves the right to withdraw the posts at any time. Communication will only be entered into with the shortlisted and successful candidates. All shortlisted candidates may be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal records, citizenship, and qualification verification). The suitable candidates will be required to annually disclose their financial interests and declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Eksamens en Assesserings
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur wat eksamens en assesserings by 'n TVET college bestuur, en nakoming van DHET, Umalusi en QCTO-beleid verseker.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4). 'n Toepaslike M+3-jaar graad of Diploma. Erkende onderwyskwalifikasie. Ten minste drie (3) jaar onderwyservaring in die TVET College. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar ervaring op toesighoudende vlak. Diepgaande kennis van akademiese ondersteuning met bewese ervaring. 'n Bewese begrip van beroepsonderwys en die belangrikheid daarvan vir die lewer van kritieke vaardighede. Kennis van alle onderwysverwante wetgewende raamwerke soos PAM, CET Act of 2006 soos gewysig, alle assesseringsverwante beleide & riglyne, kurrikulumriglyne, Public Service Act. Besit 'n geldige kode 8 bestuurderslisensie. Klankrekenaarvaardighede in MS Office (beginners-tussenvlak) en selfgemotiveerde goeie organisasie-, beplannings-, probleemoplossings- en analitiese vaardighede. Registrasie by SACE. 'n Uitgebreide begrip van die DHET Examination & Assessment Policies en jongste ICASS Guidelines; Uitstekende bestuurs- en organisasievaardighede; wanneer die geleentheid ontstaan. Moet onder druk kan werk en aanpas by veranderinge in die TVET-sektor. Rekenaarvaardig op Assessment & Examinations eLearning platforms.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer interne en eksterne eksamens en assesseringsaktiwiteite regoor die Kollege. Verseker nakoming van DHET, Umalusi, QCTO en institusionele assessering- en eksamenbeleid, prosedures en regulasies. Koördineer eksamen- en beoordelingsbeplanning, kandidaatregistrasie, merk van resultate, verwerking en verifikasieprosesse. Bestuur en verseker die veilige hantering van eksamenmateriaal en skrifte. Koördineer invigilasie, merk en moderasie prosesse. Bestuur assesserings- en eksamenonreëlmatighede. Monitor gereedheid en nakoming van eksamensentrums. Koördineer uitstaande resultate, sertifisering en Nasionale N Diploma-aangeleenthede. Analiseer assesseringsresultate en berei prestasieverslae voor, ondersteun akademiese ingrypings wat voortvloei uit assesseringsprestasie, onderhou eksamenrekords en assesseringsdatabasisse, skakel met relevante regulerende en sertifiseringsliggame. Hou toesig oor personeel en bestuur die prestasie van die eksamens- en assesseringsfunksie.

zu.title: Msizi Womkhakha Wabaholi: Ukulingiswa Nokuhlola
zu.summary: Onozindlela ohlele imibhalo yokuhloleka nokuhlola kwamakhosi afundwayo nakwindawo ye-TVET, aze aqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana nemithethonqubo ye-DHET, Umalusi kanye ne-QCTO.
zu.requirements: Ithifikethi Samabanga Aphakeme / Isifikethi SeGredy 12 / Ithifikethi le-NCV (Izinga 4). Ithifikethi elingenisa ngobunjalo obukodwa noma i-M+3- year degree noma i-Diploma. Isimemozesikole esamukelekile. Ukuze kube okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) yokuhlola kule TVET College. Okungenani iminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kwayisihlanu (5) yohlu oluqondisayo. Ukwazi okujulile ngokusekelwa kwezemfunda ngesipiliwozi esiqinisekisiwe. Ukweshekela ngempela imfundoyemisebenzi kanye nakuqakatheke kwayo ekuletheni izidingo eziyimfihlo. Ukwesula imithetho yonke yokuthungatha imfundo efana ne-PAM, i-CET Act ka-2006 njengoba ihlaliswe kabusha, nazozonke izinkomba ezihlobene nokuhlola, izinkomba zesifundo, nomthetho we-Public Service. Ukuba namalayisense wokushayela ohamba isikhathi eside (code 8). Amakhono ewe-Computer e-MS Office (Izinga elinganiselwe ngaphakathi nangaphandle) kwaye uzimotile ngokuhlela amakhono, ukuhlela amaphuzu, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono okuhlaziya imibhalo. Ukubhalisela kwi-SACE. Ukwesula okujulile ngemithethonqubo ye-DHET yokuhlola kanye nezinkomba ekuqinisekiswa ngokuhlola nezinkomba zamanqamu ezingeni eliphezulu; amakhono aphezulu okuphatha kokuqondisa nokuqinisekiswa; kanye nokuba nokuqina ekubeni nokuba nokuba khona kwabakwa ekubeni khona kwamaphoyisa nokuqinisekiswa kokuhlangana. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza phantsi kwesinkwa sethiya kwaye ulungele ukutshintsha kwindawo ye-TVET. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa amaphosphor nokuqinisekisa ngapha kwamanqamu aphakathi nobhalo (eLearning platforms).
zu.duties: Phatha futhi uhlobole imisebenzi yokuhalaza nokuhlola kwangaphakathi nangaphandle kwothishkolongo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho yesikhungo kanye nemithethonqubo, inqubo nomthetho we-DHET, i-Umalusi, i-QCTO mayelana nokuhalaza nokuqinisekisa. Hlela uhlelo lokuhalaza nokuqinisekisa, ukubhalisa abafundi, ukufaka amaphuzu, ukucubungula imiphumela kanye nenqubo yokuqinisekisa. Phatha futhi uvikele ukuphathwa kwemibhalo namaphepha okuhalaza. Hlela inqubo yokugadlela, ukufaka amaphuzu nokuhlolwa kwemiphumela. Phatha amaphutha nokuhalaza nokuqinisekisa. Qaphela ukulungile kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezikhungo zokuhalaza. Hlela imiphumela engagqitshiwe, izitifiketi kanye nemibuzo ye-National N Diploma. Hlaziya imiphumela yokuhlola futhi ulungise imibiko yemiphumela, useke izinhlelo zemfundo eziqhutshwa imiphumela yokuqinisekisa, ulondoloze izinkomba zokuhalaza nakumasayithi wemiphumela yokuhlola, uxhumane nemibutho eqinisekisayo enemigqa yemithetho. Qondise abasebenzi futhi uphathe imiphumela yomsebenzi wokuhalaza nokuqinisekisa.

xh.title: i-Assistant Director: Examinations and Assessments
xh.summary: i-Assistant Director ephatha iimviwo nezeqondo kwi-TVET college, eqinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zemigaqo ze-DHET, Umalusi kunye ne-QCTO.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4). Isidanga okanye iDiploma esifanelekileyo se-M+3- year. Isidanga esamkelweyo sokufundisa. Okona ingqinelana Neminyaka emithathu (3) yamava okufundisa kwi-TVET College. Okona ingqinelana Neminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kuhlwesihlanu (5) yamava kwinqanaba lobalule. Ulwazi oluqinisiweyo ngexhaso lemfundo nhamava abonakalisiweyo. Ukuqonda okubonakalisiweyo ngemfundo yamakhono abantu kwaye baluleke ekuphathweni kwamakhono abalulekileyo. Ulwazi ngazo zonke iinkqubo zomthetho ezidityaniswe nemfundo ezinjengokuba yi-PAM, CET Act of 2006 njengoko iguquliwe, zonke iinkqubo zemigaqo &emigaqo ephathelene neqondo, iinkqubo zocwangco lwezifundo, Public Service Act. Kufuneka ube nelayisense yokushayela yekhowudi 8 esebedlayo. Amakhono amakhulu ekhompyutha kwi-MS Office (Beginners-intermediate level) kwaye ube nomdla wakho, luncedo lokuzama, ucwangco, ukusombulula iingxaki nolwazi lokuhlalutya. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SACE. Ukuqonda okubanzi kwemigaqo ye-DHET Examination & Assessment Policies nakwi-ICASS Guidelines yakutshanje; Amakhono amakhulu ekulawula nokuqamba izinto; xa kusenakho. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo kwaye ugqibe ukutshintsha kwicandelo le-TVET. Ukuba mkhulu kakhulu kwiikhompyutha kwii-Assessment & Examinations eLearning platforms.
xh.duties: Phatha kwaye ulungiselele imisebenzi yangaphakathi nangaphandle yeeqondo nemviwo kulo lonke iKholeji. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zemigaqo, iindlela zokwenza neemithetho ye-DHET, Umalusi, QCTO nakwiziko lemviwo nezeqondo. Lungiselela ucwangco lweemviwo nezeqondo, ukubhaliswa kwabafundi, ukubamba amanqaku, ukucubungula iinqondo, neenqubo zokuqinisekisa. Phatha ngokhuseleko ukuphathwa kwabantu beemviwo namaphepha okuvakalayo. Lungiselela iinkqubo zokuqhuba iimviwo, ukumaka nokulungisa. Phatha iingxaki ezingaqiqwanga zeemviwo nezeqondo. Qonda ulungelo lweziko lemviwo nokuthobela imigaqo. Lungiselela iinqondo ezingekahlaziwa, iimviwo zokuqinisekiswa, neemicimbi ye-National N Diploma. Cosa iinqondo zeqondo ulungise iingxelo zokusebenza, xhasa ukungenelela kwemfundo okusuka kwindlela yokusebenza kweemviwo, gcina iirekhodi zeemviwo namabhebha eendawo zeemviwo, qhagamshelana namabhunga afanelekileyo olawulo nokuqinisekiswa. Lawula abasebenzi uphathe ukusebenza kolusebenzi lweemviwo nezeqondo.

af.summary: Assistentedirekteur vir Kurrikulumontwikkeling by die Departement of Higher Education se sentrale kantoor in King William's Town, Vlak 10.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Vlak 4). Geskikte diploma/graad (prioriteitsvelde is Ingenieurswese / Landbou / IKV / Ekonomie & Bestuurswetenskappe). Erkende onderwyskwalifikasie. Kennis van QCTO, SETA en NSF stelsels. 3 jaar se ervaring in toesighoudende/bestuur van personeel. 2 jaar se ervaring in die implementering van operasionele projekte. 2 jaar se bewese ervaring in werk met SETAs. Goeie rekenaarvaardighede. Bestuurslisensie. Bykomende vereistes / bygevoegde voordeel: Geskoolde ambagsman. Vaardighede: Beroepskurrikulum en akkreditasiekennis, Projek- en programbestuur, Kwaliteitsversekering en nakoming, Werkswinkel/simulasiegereedheidsbeplanning, Belanghebbende- en reguleerderkommunikasie, Analitiese verslagdoening en prestasie monitering, Fasilitering en personeelontwikkeling, Insette vir verkrygingspesifikasies en hulpbronbeplanning, Risikobestuur, Strategiese beplanning en veranderingbestuur, Onderhandeling, Kommunikasie, Voorlegging, Beplanning en organisering. Finansiële bestuur Verslagdoening Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik. Probleemoplossing Rekenaarvaardigheid Analities Kliëntgerig Projektbestuur Spanleierskap, Beplanning en organisering, Personeelbestuur. Kennis van: PSET en CET Wet. Kennis van Onderrig en Leer. Skills Development Act, Public Service Regulations en Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act. Kennis van die Publieke TVET-sektor en sy regulerings- en wetgewingsraamwerk. Begrip van die Hoër Onderwys-sektor. Kennis van Education Act.
af.duties: Verseker groei deur vaardighede, leerderskappe en vakleerlingskappe te bied. Vestig vennootskappe met bedrywe. Verseker plasing van studente by bedrywe. Bestuur en fasiliteer registrasie van leergange. Fasiliteer die implementering van ambagsontwikkelingsprogramme en verteenwoordig die Kollege in alle ambagsontwikkelingsforums. Ontwikkel en hersien prosedures en sjablone vir implementering van die leergange. Verseker implementering van leergangbeleide. Voer werfbesoeke uit om die implementering van ambagsontwikkelingsprogramme te monitor. Fasiliteer sertifiseringsproses vir bekwame leerders in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en QCTO vereistes. Verseker dat kwaliteitsversekeringsfunksies uitgevoer word in ooreenstemming met die vasgestelde regulasies. Bystaan om te verseker dat kampuswerkswinkels, simulasiekamers en klaskamers aan die vereiste standaarde vir beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid voldoen. Verskaf ondersteuning aan kampusse om te verseker dat vereiste fisiese hulpbronne gespesifiseer om leerders se bevoegdheid aangaande die beroepskwalifikasie of gedeeltelike kwalifikasie te assesseer, beskikbaar gestel word. Koördineer registrasie van projekfasiliteerders, assessore, RPL-praktisyne en modereerders by die onderskeie owerhede insluitend QCTO, SETAs, DHET en gasheerwerkgewers. Verseker dat geskik gekwalifiseerde personeel aangestel word om onderrig en leer in die onderskeie ambag of beroep te fasiliteer. Verskaf ondersteuning om te verseker dat ambagsmodereerders by National Artisan Moderation Body (NAMB) geregistreer is. Stel stelsels in plek om ARPL en nasionale ambagstoetse wat deur NAMB goedgekeur is, te bestuur. Stel 'n doeltreffende stelsel op vir die veilige bewaring en vernietiging (indien nodig) van alle assesseringsdokumentasie en toetsstukke. Verseker werkplekke wat die nasionale gestandaardiseerde ambagsleerder-werkplek volg. Ontwerp implementeringsplan vir beroepsprogramme. Raak betrokke by kurrikulumkwessies vir beroepsprogramme. Formuleer strategieë om levering van beroepsprogramme uit te brei. Fasiliteer administratiewe bestuur van projekte (insluitend vereiste registrasie van leerders by onderskeie owerhede) verifikasie en sertifsering van programme wat in die projekte aangebied word. Voer induksie uit vir nuut aangestelde Fasiliteerders en Modereerders. Monitor die gedrag van assesserings in alle beroepsprogramme. Berei voor vir kurrikulumaangeleenthede van die beroepsprogramme in die kwartaalakademiese raadsvergaderings. Koördineer aktiwiteite vir die ontwikkeling van Leer materiaal (indien nodig). Voer die eksterne geïntegreerde summatiewe assessering uit in ooreenstemming met die standaarde wat deur die QCTO of relevante SETA gestel is. Rapporteer aan die QCTO of relevante SETA oor die Kollege se prestasie in die vorm en wyse wat deur die versekerende liggaam vereis word. Verseker dat alle beroepskwalifikasies wat by die Kollege aangebied word, aan blootleer deelneem. Verseker dat die Kollege voldoen aan die QCTO en AQP assesseringsbeleid en -prosedures.

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqobo: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwemfundvo Nesayensi
zu.summary: Umncedisi weQobo woKuthuthukiswa kwemfundvo ohlinzeka ngesikhungo esikgulu seMnyango weMfundo ePhezulu e-King William's Town, ezingeni eli-10.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 / NCV Certificate (Level 4). I-Diploma/degree efanele (izinkomba eziphambili yi-Engineering / Agriculture / ICT / Economics & Management Sciences). Isifundo sokufundisa esaziwayo. Ulwazi ngezimiso ze-QCTO, SETA kanye ne-NSF. Iminyaka eyi-3 yamava enkundenla ephathu / ephatha abasebenzi. Iminyaka eyi-2 yamava ekuphatheni imisebenzi yokusebenza. Iminyaka eyi-2 yamava abakhombisile ekusebenzeni ne-SETA. Amakhono amahle ekhomphyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela. Izidingo ezengeziwe / izinzuzo: Umkhakhasi othize. Amakhono: Ulwazi lokuhlelwa kwemfundvo yokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi, ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi, ukuhlehla kwezinto, ukuxhumana nabaphathi, ukubika ngokuhlaziya, ukuqashwa kwezinsizakalo, ukuphathwa kwezengozi, ukuhlela ukwenza ibhizinisi, ukuxoxisana, ukuxhumana, ukuthula, ukuhlela nokuhlela. Ukuphathwa kwemali. Ukwabhala imibiko. Ukuxhumana nokusebenza. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lwekhomphyutha. Ukutshalukazi. Ukugxila kumthengi. Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Ukuphathwa kwesiqu, ukuhlela nokuhlela, ukuphathwa kwabantu. Ulwazi: I-PSET ne-CET Act. Ulwazi loKufundisa nokufunda. I-Skills Development Act, i-Public Service Regulations ne-Public Service Act, i-Labour Relations Act. Ulwazi ngemikhakha ye-Public TVET kanye nezimiso zayo. Ukuqonda ngemikhakha ye-Mfundo ePhezulu. Ulwazi lwe-Education Act.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukukhula ngokunikela amakhono, izifundo kanye nokufundiswa kwemisebenzi. Sizakala kubaphathi bemikhakha. Qinisekisa ukubekwa kwabafundi kubaphathi bemikhakha. Phatha futhi usize ukubhaliswa kwemikhakha yokufunda. Usiza ukuphatha imisebenzi yokuthuthukiswa kwabakhakhasi, imele i-College kuzo zonke izinkundla zokuthuthukiswa kwabakhakhasi. Hlela futhi uhlaze izinqubo nezifanekiso ekusebenzeni kwemikhakha yokufunda. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwezinqubo zemikhakha yokufunda. Yenza ukuvakashela izindawo ukubuka ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yokuthuthukiswa kwabakhakhasi. Usize inqubo yokufakwa kwegama labafundi abakwaziyo ngokuhambisana nemithetho ehlobene kanye nezidingo ze-QCTO. Qinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yokuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi yenziwa ngokuhambisana nemithetho. Siza ekwenzeni izikhungo zokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi ezinga elidlule, izikhungo zokusampula kanye namakilasi ahlangabezana namazinga afunekayo emphakathini wezempilo nokuphepha. Nikeza inkuxazo ezikhungweni ekugqameni ukuthi zitholakale izinsiza ezifunekayo ekuhloleni amakhono abafundi ngemikhakha yokusebenza. Hlela kabuhlungu ukubhaliswa kwabaholi bephrojekthi, abahloli, abaphathi be-RPL kanye nabahloli bokuqinisekisa emkhakheni wabo ohlelekile, okuhlanganisa ne-QCTO, i-SETA, i-DHET kanye nabaphathi bokusampula. Qinisekisa ukuthi kubekiwe abasebenzi abafanele ukuthi basebenze ekufundiseni nokufundeni. Siza ekugqamiseni ukuthi abahloli bokusebenza babhaliswe kwi-National Artisan Moderation Body (NAMB). Hlela izimiso ekuphathweni kwe-ARPL kanye nokuhlolwa kwemisebenzi emkhakheni ekuqinisekiswe i-NAMB. Hlela isimiso esihle ekugcineni nokuphahlazeni (uma kudingeka) kwakho konke ukwaziswa kwesihlaziyo kanye nezinto zokuqinisekisa. Qinisekisa izindawo zokusebenza ezilandela izimiso ezihlelekile zesikhulumi sokufunda ngemisebenzi ekuqinisekiswe i-Namb. Hlela uhlelo lokuphatha imikhakha yokusebenza. Ukuxhumaneka kwezinkinga zemikhakha yezifundo ezihlelekile. Hlela izinqubo zokwandisa ukulethwa kwemikhakha yokusebenza. Siza ekuphathweni kwezomphathe kaqobo (okuhlanganisa ukubhaliswa kwabafundi kubaphathi). Qinisekisa nokubekwa kwegama lemikhakha eqinisekiswe i-AQP.

xh.title: Umphathiswa weNqanaba: uPhuhliso lweNkqubo yeFundo
xh.summary: Umphathiswa weNqanaba woPhuhliso lweNkqubo yeFundo kwindlu enkulu yesebe le-Department of Higher Education eKing William's Town, inqanaba le-10.
xh.requirements: Ithifikethi yeSenior Certificate / ibanga le-12 / Ithifikethi ye-NCV (Level 4). Idiploma/idigri efanelekile (amabanga aphambili yi-Engineering / Agriculture / ICT / Economics & Management Sciences). Isifundo sokufundisa esiqaphelekileyo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo ze-QCTO, SETA ne-NSF. Iminyaka engama-3 yamava ekuqondiseni/uphathweni lwabasebenzi. Iminyaka engama-2 yamava kokuzezelisa amaprojekthi asebenzayo. Iminyaka engama-2 yamava aqaphelekayo okusebenza ne-SETAs. Amapuleqwe amakhulu ekhompyutha. Ilayisenisi yokushayela. Iimfuno ezongezelelweyo / ilungelo elongezelelekileyo: Umenzi wezandla ophumeleleyo. Amakhono: Ulwazi lokugunyaziswa nokuqinisekiswa kwenkqubo yeFundo yomsebenzi, ulawulwa lweprojekthi nenkqubo, ukuqinisekiswa kwakhona ulwelo nokuhambelana, icebo lokulungelelisa iworkshop/okulinganiselwayo, unxibelelwano nabanxulumeni nabalawuli, ukubika ngokuhlalutyo nokuphatha inkqubo, ukukhuthaza uphuhliso lwabasebenzi, okuqulethwayo ekumisweni kwemigaqo yemali nokuqhawula amacebo, ulawulo lwengozi, icebo lokucwangcisa nolawulo lotshintsho, uthethathethwano, unxibelelwano, okuboniswa, ukuqamba icwangciso nokuqamba. Ulawulo lwemali, ukubala iirepothi, unxibelelwano nolwandle. Ukusombulula iingxaki, ukubakho malunga nekhompyutha, ukuhlalutya, ukumiselwa kuklayenti, ulawulo lweprojekthi, intsha yolawulo, ukuqamba icwangciso nokuqamba, ulawulo lwabantu. Ulwazi ngama: uPSET ne-CET Act. Ulwazi ngokuFunda nokuFundisa. I-Skills Development Act, i-Public Service Regulations ne-Public Service Act, i-Labour Relations Act. Ulwazi ngommandla we-TVET kaRhulumente nolwakhiwo lawo olubeka imigaqo nokushukumisa. Ukuqonda ummandla we-Higher Education. Ulwazi ngokukwazisiwa kwemigaqo ye-Education Act.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukhula ngokunika amakhono, iilearnerships nama-apprenticeships. Misela unxibelelwano namashishini. Qinisekisa ukubekwa kwabafundi kwishishini. Phatha futhi ukhuthaze ukubhaliswa kweenkqubo zokufunda. Khuthaza ukuzezeliswa kweenkqubo zophuhliso labomenzi bezandla kwaye ube ngumelwele iKholeji kuzo zonke iindawo zophuhliso labomenzi bezandla. Phuhlisa futhi uphinde utshintshe iinkqubo neetempleyiti zokuzezelisa iinkqubo zokufunda. Qinisekisa ukuzezeliswa kwemigaqo yeenkqubo zokufunda. Yenza ukundwendwela kweendawo ukuze ulawule ukuzezeliswa kweenkqubo zophuhliso labomenzi bezandla. Khuthaza inkqubo yokunikwa kwezithifikethi kubafundi abangabalulekileyo ngokuvumelana nomthetho ofanelekileyo nokuqonda iimfuno ze-QCTO. Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yokubuyela ngokuqinisekiswa yenziwa ngokuvumelana nemigaqo efunwayo. Nceda ekuqinisekiseni ukuba iinkqubo zamaworkshop, iindawo zokulinganisa neklasi zikwisiqhengwana zihlangabezana namazinga afunekayo ohlelo lokhuseleko lokusebenza nempilo yomsebenzi. Nika inkxaso kumacampasi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba amacebo okwenziwa afunekayo okuqinisekisa ukuba nabaphi abafundi ekuqwalaselweni kwamakhono abo ngokunxulumene nekhwalifikheshini yomsebenzi okanye ngenxalenye yayo ayafumaneka. Lawula ukubhaliswa kwabanxulume beprojekthi, abaqwalaseli, abenzi be-RPL futhi abalawuli kumagunya ahambelanayo kuquka ne-QCTO, i-SETA, i-DHET namashishini abanxibelelwano nabo. Qinisekisa ukuba abasebenzi abanamakhono afanelekileyo bajatshulwa ukuze bakhuthaze ukufundisa nokufunda kwakulowo naluphi na uhwebo okanye umsebenzi. Nika inkxaso ekuqinisekiseni ukuba abalawuli bohwebo labomenzi bezandla babhalise kwi-National Artisan Moderation Body (NAMB). Misela iinkqubo zokulawula ukuqinisekiswa koku-Gunyaziswa kokuqinisekiswa ekuqaleni kakhulu (ARPL) kwaye kuvavanywe ngokuqinisekiswa kwelizwe lwamenzi wezandla oluvunyiwe yi-NAMB. Misela inkqubo esebenzayo yokugcina ngokukhuselekileyo nokutshatyalalisa (xa kufuneka) yayo yonke imibhalo ekuqwalaselweni namacebo okuvavanya. Qinisekisa iindawo zokusebenza ezilandela eyona nkqubo ilungiselelweyo yendawo yokusebenza yamenzi wezandla welizwe. Bhala icebo elingaphakathi lokuzezelisa iinkqubo zokufunda yomsebenzi. Thabatha inxaxheba kumabanga enkqubo yeFundo yeenkqubo zomsebenzi. Cwangcisa izicwangciso zokwandisa ukwaziswa kweekhosi zomsebenzi. Khuthaza ulawulo lolawulo lwamaprojekthi (kuquka nokubhaliswa okufunekayo kwabafundi kumagunya ahambelanayo) ukunyanisekiswa nokunika izithifikethi kweenkqubo ezithi zibonelelwe kumaprojekthi. Yenza inkqubo yokwaziswa kwabafundisi abajatshulwe kutsha, kunye nabalawuli. Lawula indlela eyenziwa ngayo ikuqwalaselo kuzo zonke iinkqubo zomsebenzi. Zilungiselele amabanga enkqubo yeFundo yeenkqubo zomsebenzi kwiindibano zebhodi yemfundo yehlobo elinye. Lawula imisebenzi yokuYila imiYalezo yokusebenza kwamaxa athile. Lawula ukwenza uvavanyo lwangaphandle oludityanisiweyo lokunika iziphumo ngokuvumelana namazinga abekwe yi-QCTO okanye i-SETA ehambelanayo. Bikela i-QCTO okanye i-SETA ehambelanayo ngemveliso yeKholeji ngendlela nendlela efunwa ligunya eliqinisekisayo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iikhwalifikheshini zomsebenzi ezithi zibonelelwa kwiKholeji zithabathe inxaxheba kufundo edityanisiweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iKholeji ihambelana namaxwebhu e-QCTO ne-AQP amaxwebhu neprothokholidi.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Curriculum Implementation
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R605 742 per annum (Level 10), plus actual benefits
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role coordinating curriculum implementation, blended learning and academic improvement interventions at the DHET central office in King William's Town.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate recognised three-year qualification in Education, Curriculum Studies, Education Technology, Open/Distance Learning, Institutional Design or related field. A relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage. Relevant experience in TVET/post school curriculum implementation, teaching and learning, e-learning/LMS implementation, instructional design or academic development, with demonstrated coordination. At least three years at supervisory level. Sound knowledge of NC(V), occupational and other applicable Ministerial programmes and curriculum implementation requirements. Practical knowledge of Moodle or a comparable Learning Management System, including course design, quizzes, assignments, resource management and learning analytics. Knowledge of blended, remote and distance learning principles, digital learning material development, copyright/OER considerations and online assessment integrity. Ability to train and support lecturers, manage projects, analyse academic performance and prepare management reports. Ability to develop academically sound and costed concepts for short courses, continuing education and remote learning offerings in collaboration with Finance and Partnerships and Linkages. Computer Literacy and a valid driving license. Skills: Curriculum implementation and quality assurance, digital/blended/remote teaching, Moodle/LMS academic Implementation, Instructional design and learning- material development, lecturer development and facilitation, Data analytics and learning analytics, project and change management, business-case development and innovation, stakeholder management, strong communication and report-writing skills. Extensive knowledge of relevant academic governance, assessment and moderation processes, including the Continuing Education and Training Colleges Act, 2006 (CET Act) and the General and Further Education and Training Quality Assurance Act, 2001 (Act No. 58 of 2001).
jobs.duties: Coordinate and monitor implementation of Ministerial programmes. Ensure curriculum coverage and compliance with DHET curriculum requirements, coordinate teaching plans, pacing schedules and academic improvement interventions, lead implementation of blended, online and distance learning. Manage institutional utilisation of Moodle and other approved learning platforms. Coordinate development and quality assurance of digital learning content, promote online quizzes, virtual classrooms, simulations and technology-enabled teaching. Monitor lecturer and student participation on digital learning platforms. Coordinate lecturer development in digital teaching methodologies, support student digital literacy and online learning access. Develop and monitor distance-learning delivery models, collaborate with ICT and relevant partners on digital learning infrastructure and innovation. Monitor the impact of digital learning on student performance and access, prepare curriculum implementation and digital learning reports, support expansion of flexible learning opportunities and alternative revenue-generating programme delivery in collaboration with finance and Linkages and Partnerships. Supervise staff and manage the performance of the portfolio.
jobs.enquiries: Ms P Xamesi / Ms U Ncethelo / Ms S Jali at 087 238 2223
jobs.applications: Please hand-deliver or courier your applications to the reception area quoting the relevant reference number addressed to the Acting Principal, Lovedale TVET College, Corporate Office, 1 Amatola Row, Qonce, 5600. Email: Address: vacancies@lovedale.org.za
jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed NEW Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by a SAQA evaluation report. Successful candidates will be subjected to a vetting and financial disclosure process (criminal record, citizenship, qualification verification and employment verification). Lovedale TVET College is an equal opportunities employer and reserves the right not to fill the posts. People living with disability are encouraged to apply. If you have not been contacted within six months after closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. NB Please ensure that the Z83 form is completed in full. Incomplete Z83 will be disqualified. The college reserves the right to withdraw the posts at any time. Communication will only be entered into with the shortlisted and successful candidates. All shortlisted candidates may be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal records, citizenship, and qualification verification). The suitable candidates will be required to annually disclose their financial interests and declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

xh.title: Assistant Director: Curriculum Implementation
xh.summary: Indima kaAssistant Director yokulungelelanisa ukusebenza kohlwahlwemfundo, ukufunda okuxutyiweyo nokuqalwa kwezithinteli zokuphucula izifundo kwindawo ekuqwalaselwa kuyo eDHET King William's Town.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esaziwayo seminyaka emithathu sokuqala seMfundo, iZifundo zeHlelo loMsebenzi, iNgcine yoQeqesho eMfundweni, uQeqesho lusule phandle/kuQeqesho lukaKude, uKwakhiwa kweZiko okanye indawo enxulumene nayo. Isifundo sepostgraduate esinxulumeyo siza kuba lingenelo elongeziweyo. Amava ahambelanayo ekusebenzeni kohlwahlwemfundo kwi-TVET/kwisikolo saselugcinweni, ekufundiseni nasekufundeni, ekusebenzeni nge-e-learning/LMS, ekwakhiweni kolwazi lomsebenzi okanye ekuphuculweni kwezifundo, ngokuqinisekiswa ukulungelelanisa. Ubuncinane ihlwembu zeminyaka emithathu kwinqanaba logqatsha. Ulwazi olunamandla malunga ne-NC(V), nokusebenza okunye kweenkqubo zeNgcondo ezikwaziswa kwaye naziimfuno zokusebenza kohlwahlwemfundo. Ulwazi lwenkqubo yeMoodle okanye i-Learning Management System elingana nayo, kuquka ukwakhiwa kweeklasi, izibuzo, izabelo, ulawulo lwezibonelelo nokuqondaniswa kokufunda. Ulwazi malunga nemigaqo yokufunda okuxutyiweyo, nase kude nasekuqeqeshweni ngokuzimela, kuphuhlisweni kwezinto zokufunda ezikwizikrini, ekuzingelweni nge-copyright/OER nakwintegrite yokuqwalasela inthanethi. Ikono lokuyalela nokuyalela ootitshala, ukuqhuba iiprojekthi, ukuhlalutya ukusebenza kwamava eafundo nokulungisa iingxelo zolawulo. Ikono lokwakha iinkqubo zezifundo ezifanelekileyo kumlinganiselo weemfuno negalelo lemali leenkqubo zamaxesha amafutshane, uqeqesho olukhulayo nokuqeqesho ngokude kwaye kwenziwe ngokudibana neNgingeqeetyi kwaye nabahlobo abanengxibelelwano. Ukuqonda ukusebenzise ikhompyutha nokuba nelungelo lokushukuma. Amakhono: ukusebenza kohlwahlwemfundo noqiniseko lokuza ngokuhambelanayo, ukufundisa okukwisikrini/okuxutyiweyo/ngokude, ukusebenzisa inkqubo yeMoodle/LMS kwizifundo, ukwakhiwa kolwazi lomsebenzi nokuphuhliswa kwezinto zokufunda, ukuqeqeshwa kootitshala nokuqhuba inkqubo, uhlalutyo lwedata nolwazi lokufunda, ulawulo lwe projekthi nokuqhutywa kwenkqubo, ukwakhiwa kwe-business-case nokuchukumisa izinto ezintsha, ulawulo lwabo banengxibelelwano, amakhono anamandla okunxibelelanisa nokubhala iingxelo. Ulwazi olubanzi malunga nokuzinza kwemigaqo yezifundo, ukuqwalasela iinkqubo nokuguqula iinkqubo okuzelwe, kuquka ne Continuing Education and Training Colleges Act, 2006 (CET Act) ne General and Further Education and Training Quality Assurance Act, 2001 (Act No. 58 of 2001).
xh.duties: Lungelelanisa kwaye ulawule ukusetyenziswa kweenkqabo zeNgcondo. Qinisekisa ukubanika kwakho uhlwahlwemfundo kwaye uhambelane neemfuno zohlwahlwemfundo ze-DHET, lungelanisa iiplani zokufundisa, izikedyu zenkqubo yexesha nokuqalwa kwezithinteli zokuphucula izifundo, qhobosha ekusebenzeni kolwazi oluxutyiweyo, kwisikrini nakukufunda ngokude. Lawula ukusetyenziswa kweziko kuleMoodle ngenkqubo yamanye amaphalatifomu okufunda avunyelweyo. Lungelelanisa ukuphuhliswa noqiniseko lweziqulatho zokufunda kwisikrini, khuthaza iiklwi ezikwisikrini ezingaqwalaselwa ngokutsha, iindlu zokufundela ezikwisikrini, imilinganiselo yemveliso yamandla ikwazi nokuqhuba inkqabo yokufunda ngekhompyutha. Qwalasela ukuzibandakanya kootitshala nabafundi kwiiphelatifomu zokufunda kwisikrini. Lungelelanisa ukuphuhliswa kootitshala kwiindlela zokufundisa kwisikrini, yixhasa abafundi ekuzinzeni kwabo ekufundeni kwisikrini nakungeniso lwamava abanawo. Phuhlisa kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuqhuba inkqubo yamava yokufunda ngokude, dagqiba ukusebenza nabasebenzi bemveliso yamandla esikrini kwikhompyutha kwaye nabanokungenisa ithuba lokwenza usasazo kwinkqubo yokufunda ngokuzimela. Qwalasela isiphumo sokusebenza kweziqulatho kwisikrini kumava abafundi nakungeniseni lwamava abanawo, lungise iingxelo zokusebenza kohlwahlwemfundo nakusetyenziswa kweziqulatho kwisikrini, yixhasa ukwandiswa kwamathuba okufunda ngokuguquguquka nakuqhubweni ngenkqabo ezikwazisa amanye amava ekuqhubeni inkqabo ngokudibana neNgingeqeetyi kwaye nabanegalelo ngokungenisa ithuba. Qeqeshe abasebenzi kwaye ulawule ukusebenza kwamava emisebenzi yale ndima.

jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed NEW Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references. If you have not been contacted within six months after closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. NB Please ensure that the Z83 form is completed in full. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical generic requirements, and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

zu.title: i-Assistant Director: Partnership & Linkages
zu.summary: i-Assistant Director for Partnership & Linkages ehofisini elikhulu le-Higher Education and Training, edinga i-National Diploma kanye neminyaka eyi-3-5 yamava okuqondisa abantu.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior Certificate / Grade 12/ NCV Certificate (Level 4). IDiploma Yebuso lezwe eminyakeni emithathu eqashelwe (NQF 6) Project Management noma Marketing noma noma yikuphi okunye okufanele. Iminyaka eyi-3-5 yokusebenza Project Management kanye/noma Business development. Ilayisensi yokushayela: Code B. Iminyaka eyi-3-5 yamava ezingeni lokuqondisa. Amakhono: Sakha ubudlelwano. Innovation Marketing kanye nobuhlakani bokuvula amabhizinisi. Financial Management. Ukuqoqa izinsiza, incazelo kwemithetho, ulwazi loMthetho wePublic Service, PFMA, Treasury regulations kanye namanye amashekedi. Amakhono eBusiness planning: Negotiation Communication Presentation. Izinqubo zezemfundo kanye nokuqeqeshwa. Izindaba zobungqangi. Ukuhlela futhi uhlele. Financial management. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuxhumana nabantu kanye nobuhlobo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakhompyutha. Ukuhlaziya. Usekelo lomthengi. Project management. Beka abantu iqhaza. Ukuhlela futhi uhlele. Ukuphatha abantu.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwabashibambe bashibambe: Sakha idathabhesi yamabhizinisi endawo nezinye izixhumanisi. Bamba iqhaza emifanekisweni yamabhizinisi futhi uthole amathuba amaphrojekthi. Thuthukisa amaphurophozali wamaphrojekthi amapulani ezinhlelweni ezihlanganyelwayo. Phatha ukugqashuliswa kwabaphathi be-College. Ukuhlola amathuba amabhizinisi: Thola amathuba okukhiqiza imali eyongenyelwe i-College. Misa ikhono lokulingisa indawo yokusebenza. Nikeza isizathu senani lemidingo yemakethe yamathuba onke. Thola umshibambe noma umhleki ohambisanayo. Lawula ukungenisa izinto ezithunywayo namaphurophozali emali. Nikeza ulwazi nemibiko ohlelweni, emalini, nasokuhambisana ne-DHET kanye nabanye abahlanganyeli. Izibaphi zahulumeni wendawo nasifundazwe: Thuthukisa futhi ubuyekeze uhlu lwamaphrojekthi nahuthuba hulumeni wendawo. Thola ukuthi i-College inganomthelela othile emiminyeni yesifundazwe. Sakha ubudlelwano nabasebenzi abahambisanayo, misa idathabhesi yoxhumo olubalulekile bese ubamba iqhaza emihlanganweni lapho kufanele khona. Thuthukisa amaphurophozali okuhambisana ohlelweni oluthile lwamathuba ahambisana nomsebenzi oyisiseko we-College. Phathwa kolwazi: Qhuba izifundo zokubonakala yonke imiphakathi emitsha necelwayo. Thuthukisa iphrojekthi nebhalansi. Hamba nozimele bamagunya aphathwayo abalulekile. Xoxa futhi usayine izivumelwano zenkonza noma izinkontileka namakhasimende. Ensure proper implementation of disciplinary procedures, grievance procedures and code of conduct. Conduct investigation and disciplinary hearings. Management of Strike action, Minimize labour dispute. Facilitate and conduct labour relations training and workshop, Ensure proper implementation of the collective bargaining council resolutions. af.title: Assistent-direkteur Arbeidsverhoudinge
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur Arbeidsverhoudinge pos wat 'n diploma in Arbeidsverhoudinge of Menslike Hulpbronbestuur benodig, plus 3-5 jaar ervaring in 'n arbeidsverhoudinge-omgewing.
af.requirements: Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12/STD10 of NCV level 4. 'n Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Arbeidsverhoudinge, Arbeidsverhoudinge en Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of Menslike Hulpbronne en verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar werkervaring in 'n Arbeidsverhoudinge- of Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing tot verwante veld. Kennis van die Labour Relations Act, Public Service Legislations en beleide verwant aan Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Diep kennis van arbeidsverhoudinge-status. Diep kennis van die Internal Labour Organization (ILO). Kennis en begrip van die TVET/CET Administrasie. Kennis en begrip van die hoëronderwyssektor. Administratiewe, beplannings- en organisasievaardighede, Finansiële Bestuur, Verslagskrywing, Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede, Probleemoplossing, Rekenaargeletterdheid, Analities, Kliëntgerig, Projektbestuur, Spanleierskap, Mensebestuur, Ondersoekvoering, Aanbiedingsvaardighede, Kliëntediens-fokus, integriteit, Toegewyd, Proaktief, Loyaal en Etiek. Nasionale Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12/STD 10 of NCV level 4. 'n Relevante Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) in Inligtingstegnologie of IT verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar werkervaring in 'n IT-omgewing. Drie (3) jaar toesig-/bestuurservaring. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis van rekenaarhardeware, sagteware en programme. Kennis van beleids- en bestuursomgewing van TVET Colleges, insluitend kennis van die jaarlikse verslagdoeningsvereistes deur die Higher Education Institutions. Kennis en begrip van Korporatiewe IT-beginsels en begrip van die monitering van prestasiebestuurstelsel. Administreer rekenaarhardeware, sagteware en netwerkvaardighede. Administratief, beplanning en organisering. Finansiële bestuur, Verslagskrywing, Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid, Analities, Kliëntgerig en projekbestuur. Spanleierskap, Mensebestuur, Beplanning en organiseringsvaardighede.
af.duties: Onderhou goeie arbeidsverhoudinge. Gee advies oor arbeidsverwante aangeleenthede. Ontwikkel en implementeer Menslike Hulpbronbeleide en handleidings. Verseker behoorlike implementering van dissiplinêre prosedures, klagteprosedures en gedragskode. Voer ondersoeke en dissiplinêre verhore uit. Bestuur van stakingsaksies, minimaliseer arbeidsdispute. Fassiliteer en voer arbeidsverhoudinge-opleiding en werkswinkels uit. Verseker behoorlike implementering van die kollektiewe bedingingsraad se besluite. Bestuur van alle Menslike, Finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid. Ondersoek wangedrag-sake en stel ondersoekverslae op. Bestuur van dissipline, verteenwoordig die departement tydens formele dissiplinêre verhore, gee advies oor informele verhore en verseker die implementering van dissiplinêre sanksies. Ondersoek en finaliseer alle klagtes en beswaarskrifte wat van werknemers in die departement / kolleges ontvang word. Koördineer en verskaf ondersteuning met betrekking tot die verteenwoordiging van die departement/kolleges in alle disputes wat na die Public Service Sectoral Bargaining Council /Education Labour Relations Council en die Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration verwys word. Bestuur inligting en rekords van alle aktiwiteite in die arbeidsverhoudinge by die kollege. Bestuur hulpbronne van die afdeling. Moniteer voorsorgskorsings by die kollege. Ontwikkeling, hersiening en monitering van die implementering van Inligtings- en Kommunikasietegnologie (IT) beleide. Doen navorsing oor nasionale en provinsiale beleidsraamwerke, wetgewing, kollektiewe ooreenkomste, internet, relevante leesstof ens. Verseker die konsultasieproses van konsepbeleide met alle relevante belanghebbendes. Verseker dat alle nuwe IT-beleide in werkswinkels aan alle personeel bekend gestel word. Verseker die ontwikkeling en vestiging van toepaslike E-besture en IT-beleide, raamwerke en standaarde. Implementeer, handhaaf en verseker nakoming van IT-beleide en -prosedures by alle kampusse. Verseker dat toepaslike beleide en prosesse vir risikobestuur in plek gestel word. Inligtingstelselbestuur, administreer en moniteer IT-sekuriteit en elektroniese toegang. Vestig stelsels om hardeware en data te beskerm. Voer stelselrugsteune uit. Netwerkbestuur en -onderhoud. Doen navorsing en ontwikkel spesifikasies vir Local Area Network& Wide Area Network (LAN en WAN) tegnologieë volgens die kollege se vereistes. Verkry LAN en WAN tegnologieë. Verskaf LAN en WAN toegang aan studente en personeel volgens die kollege se beleid en behoeftes. Opstel, bestuur en onderhou WAN, LAN, E-pos en internetverbindings na al die kolleges. Ontsinning, oplossing en dokumentering van alle IT-verwante kwessies.

zu.title: Umncedisi weNkantolo YezeMisebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somCedisi weNkantolo YezeMisebenzi esidinga idiploma kwiNkantolo YezeMisebenzi noma ekuPhathweni KweMintho Yabantu ngaphezu kweminyaka engu-3-5 yohlu oluLUHLOLA IZIMPINTHI endaweni yenkantolo yezemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-Certificate yesizwe yesiphakeme / i-Grade 12/STD10 noma i-NCV level 4. I-National Diploma (NQF6) efanele kwiNkantolo YezeMisebenzi, Izinhlelo Zomsebenzi Nezomthetho kanye noMphathi Wamathuluzi Umuntu noma i-HR kanye nelayisensi ehlobene layo. Ubuncane beminyaka engu-3-5 yokusebenza emndeni wenkantolo yezemisebenzi noma ekuPhathweni KweMintho Yabantu endaweni ehlobene layo. Ulwazi nge-Labour Relations Act, uMthetho Wezikhulu Zomphakathi kanye Nemigomo ehlobene noMphathi Wamathuluzi Umuntu. ULwazi olujulile ngesimo senkantolo yezemisebenzi. Ulwazi olujulile ngemfiume yokuqamba izinto (ILO) njengoba iqanjwe ngo-Internal Labour Organization. ULwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-TVET/CET. ULwazi nokuqonda umkhakha weMfundo ePhakeme. Izindlela zokuphatha, ukuhlela kanye nokuhleleka, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukubhala imibiko, Ukuxhumana kanye nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ulwazi lwekhomphyutha, ukuhlaziya, ukugxila kwothile, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuba nguMphathi Wothi, ukuphatha abantu, ukuqhuba iziphongo, amakhono abalwayo, ukugxila eNkonzeni yothile ukuzethemba, ukuzibophezela, ukuba nomoya wokuqamba, ukuzithoba kanye Neziko lokuqinisa. I-Certificate yesizwe yesiphakeme/i-Grade12/STD 10 noma i-NCV level 4. I-National Diploma (NQF6) ehlobene namatheknoloji yolwazi noma i-IT kanye nelayisensi ehlobene layo. Ubuncane beminyaka engu-3-5 yokusebenza endaweni ye-IT. Im experience yeminyaka eyi-3 yokuba nguMphathi. Idrayivense elungile. ULwazi ngekhomphyutha, isoftware namaphroghramu. ULwazi ngemigomo kanye nendaweni yokuphatha eyi-TVET Colleges okuhlanganisa nalwazi lwezidingo ezibhaliwe izinga zonyaka ze-High Education Institutions. ULwazi nokuqonda imigomo ye-Corporate ICT kanye nokuqonda ukuqashwa kwesistimu yokuphatha ukusebenza. UKuphatha i-hardware yekhomphyutha, isoftware namakhono e-network. Izindlela zokuphatha, ukuhlela nokuhleleka. Ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana kanye nabanye ukuxazulula izinkinga. ULwazi lwekhomphyutha, ukuhlaziya, ukugxila kwabathengi kanye nokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi. Ukuba nguMphathi Wothi, ukuphatha abantu, ukuhlela kanye nokuhlelelwa.
zu.duties: Yigcine iNkantolo YezeMisebenzi egcwele, Nikeza izeluleko ngezinto eziphathelene nemisebenzi. Bumba futhi usebenzise imigomo yamathuluzi umuntu kanye nezincwadi eziholelayo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezindlela zokuqhuba isiphithiphithi, izindlela zezikhondlakhondla kanye nekhaladi yokuziphatha. Qhuba iziphongo kanye nezenzelo zokuqhuba isiphithiphithi. Ukuphatha isenzo sokuhlehlisa, nciphisa izingxabano zemisebenzi. Qondisa futhi uqhamise izifundo zeNkantolo YezeMisebenzi kanye noshikela, qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezinqumo zekhansela leNkantolo. Ukuphatha yonke imiNtho Yabantu, ezimali kanye nabanye abatholakalayo besection. Phenya izehlakalo zokungalaleli uze uhlole imibiko yokuqhuba ukuphathwa kokungalaleli, imele iNkantolo ngesikhathi senzelo yokungalaleli esemthethweni, inike izeluleko ngenzelo ezingekho emthethweni futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezethulo zokuqhuba isiphithiphithi. Phenya futhi uqedele yonke izikhondlakhondla kanye nezinkinga ezitholwe kubasebenzi beNkantolo / Kwezikole. Hlela futhi unikeze usizo mayelana nokumela iNkantolo / Izikole kuyo yonke izingxabano ezithunyelwe kuPublic Service Sectoral Bargaining Council /Education Labour Relations Council kanye ne-Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration. Phatha ulwazi kanye namarekhodi yonke imisebenzi kwiNkantolo YezeMisebenzi esikoleni. Phatha abatholakalayo besection. Qaphela ukumiswa kwabasebenzi ngokwesiqaphamo esikoleni. Bumba, buza kabusha futhi uqaphele ukusetshenziswa kwemigomo ye-Information Communication Technology (ICT). Qhuba ucwaningo mayelana nezinhlelo zezigaba zezwe kanye nesifundazwe, umthetho, izivumelwano zesibhaxu, i-internet, okufundwayo okuhlobene njll. Qinisekisa inqubo yokuqondisa imigomo eqanjwe kubo bonke abahlotshaniswe. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imigomo ye-ICT emisha ithunyelwa kubo bonke abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kubunjwa, kumiswa kahle i-E- governance kanye nemigomo ye-ICT, izinhlelo kanye namazinga. Zifake, phoqa futhi qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemigomo kanye nezindlela ze-IT kuyo yonke i-campuses. Qinisekisa ukuthi kumiswa imigomo kanye nabaqhubi be-risk management. Ukuphatha i-Information System, Qondisa futhi qaphela i-IT Security kanye noNgeniso Lwe Electronic. Misela izinhlelo zokuvikela i-hardware kanye nemininingwane, Zenza i-backup yesistimu. Ukuphathwa kanye nokugcina i-Network, Cinga futhi bumba izinkomba ze-LAN ne-WAN technologies ngokwezidingo zesikole. Thenga i-LAN ne-WAN technologies. Sabalalisa i-LAN ne-WAN access kubafundi kanye nabasebenzi ngokwemigomo yesikole kanye nezezidingo. Misa, phatha futhi gcina ukuhlanganiswa kwe-WAN, LAN, i-Email kanye ne-internet kuyo yonke izikole, ukuxazulula, ukuqamba kanye ukubhala yonke izinto ezihlobene ne-ICT.

xh.title: Umncedisi ongunyumzana weLabour Relations
xh.summary: Isithuba soBudlelwano baseBenmini somncedisi ongunyumzana, sifuna isidanga kwindawo yokusebenza okanye kulawulo lwabantu kwaye sifune amava eminyaka eli-3-5 kwindawo ethize.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu / Igredi 12 / STD10 okanye iNCV level 4. I-National Diploma (NQF6) eyaneleyo kwindawo yokuphathwa kokusebenza kwabantu, ulawulo lwabasebenzi kunye nokulawulwa kwabantu okanye isidanga kwindawo ekufuphi nale. Ukuba ufuna isidanga esingaphantsi kweminyaka eyi-3-5 kwindawo ethile yokuphathwa kokusebenza kwabantu okanye kulawulo lwabantu kwakhona kwindawo efanayo. Ulwazi malunga neLabour Relations Act, iimpolisa zoluntu kunye namagqabantshintshi ahambelana nolawulo lwabantu. Ulwazi olukhulu malunga nesimo seLabour Relations. Ulwazi olukhulu malunga neqela labasebenzi basekhaya (ILO) Ulwazi lokuqonda ukulawulwa kwe-TVET / CET. Ulwazi lokuqonda iqela lemfundo ephakamileyo. Ikhono lokulawula, ukuyila nokuhlelwa, ukulawula imali, ukuqulunqa iingxelo, ukunxibelelana nabantu, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuqonda iingcangcazelo, ukwanelisa izifiso zabathengi, ukulawula iiprojekthi, ukulawula iqela labasebenzi, ukulawula abantu, ukuvelisa iingxelo, amakhono okubonisa ngamehlo abo, ukuzinikela ngokupheleleyo ekwenzeni iinkonzo zabathengi, ukuzinikela, ukuba mandla, ukuzithanda kunye nokuziphatha. Isatifikethi esingangangomntu oneminyaka eli-12 ubudala / Igredi 12 / STD 10 okanye i-NCV level 4. I-Diploma yesizwe (NQF 6) mayelana nabantu kwikhompyutha okanye isidanga esihlobene ne-IT. Amava eminyaka engama-3-5 yokusebenza kwakhona endaweni yokusebenza yekhompyutha. Amava eminyaka emithathu (3) kokulawula abantu / ngabasebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela eyasezizo. Ulwazi malunga namaxabiso nekhowudi ekhompyutha, amathuba nezinkqubo zekhompyutha. Ulwazi malunga neendlela zokusebenza kwamapolicy kwakhona namagunya amakoleji e-TVET angenisa ulwazi olumayelana nemfuno yokubika ngenyanga ngeminyaka yamakoleji aphakamileyo. Ulwazi lokuqonda iinkonkqo zobuqu bekhompyutha njengoko kukucacisa iinkqubo ezikhuselayo imicimbi ekuyo. Lawula izixhobo zekhompyutha, isoftware kunye nolonze uluntu lukwikhompyutha. Ukulawula, ukuyila nokuhlelwa kokusebenza. Ukulawula imali, ukubhala iingxelo, ukunxibelelana nabantu kunye namakhono okusombulula iingxaki. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuqonda iingcangcazelo, ukuzinikela kubathengi nakulawulo kweprojekthi. Ukulawula abantu, ukulawula iqela labasebenzi, ukuyila nokuhlelwa kokusebenza.
xh.duties: Elonda iindaba ezichanekileyo zoBudlelwano baseBenmini, zigqibe izigqibo ngemisebenzi ehlobene noBudlelwano baseBenmini. Yila uze usebenzise iinqobo zobuqu kunye nezikhokelo ngendlela yokulawula abantu. Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa ngokuchanekileyo iinkqubo zoluleko lwesigwebo, iinkqubo zezinxwala kunye nemigaqo yokuziphatha. Yenza uphando olujoliswe kwiingxaki kunye neenkomfa zoluleko lwesigwebo. Lawula iintshukumo ezithintela ukusebenza, nciphisa iingxabano ezithintela ukusebenza. Qonda uze ulawule iimfundo kunye neenkonzwana ezinikelwe kwindawo yokusebenza, Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa ngokuchanekileyo izigqibo zeBhunga loThengiselwano lilinye. Lawula onke amathambo abantu, eemali kunye namanye amathuba esikhundla. Phanda iimeko zosenzo esingekho mthethweni uze uqulunqe iingxelo zophando Lawula isigwebo, mela iSebe ngexesha leenkomfa ezisemthethweni zoluleko lwesigwebo, nikela izigqibo kwiinkomfa ezingekho semthethweni uze uqinisekise ukusebenziswa kwemiqathango yesigwebo. Phanda uze uqedele onke iingxwala nezikhalazo ezifunyanwe kubasebenzi kuSebe / nakwikholeji. Linganisa uze unike inkxaso malunga nomelo iSebe / amakoleji kuzo zonke iingxabano ezithunyelwa kuBhunga loThengiselwano loLwazi lweNkonzo kaSebe / iBhunga loBudlelwano baseBenmini loMfundo kunye neKomishoni yokubulunga, ukubuyisana kunye noBumba. Lawula ulwazi kunye namarekhodo emisebenzi yonke kwindawo yokulawula amalungiselelo abasebenzi nakwikholeji. Lawula amathuba ohluo. Qwalasela iinkqubo ezixhonyiweyo zokulinda abasebenzi abakwisimo esingathintelwa ukusebenza nakwikholeji. Yila, qwalasela uze ulawule ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zolwazi ngeteknoloji (ICT). Yenza uphando malunga namakonkqo ohlolwa ngamanyathelo abuzwa ngeengcinga-malinge, umthetho, iinkonzo ezidityanisiweyo, internet, izifundo ezifanelekileyo njl.njl. Qinisekisa inqubo yocalulo colwazi kuwo onke abathintekayo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iinkqubo ezintsha zeICT zithintelwe kuwo onke abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuyila, ukusekwa kweekonkqo ezifanelekileyo ze-E- ulawulo lweminye yemveliso kunye neenkqubo, iinkonkqo kunye namagqabantshintshi zoLwazi ngeTekhnoloji. Sebenzisa, yomeleze uze uqinisekise ukulandeleka kweenkqubo kunye neendlela zomthetho wekhompyutha kuzo zonke iindawo ezikwiphondo. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo kunye neendlela ezifanelekileyo zibekwa endlwini ukuze kusetyenziswe ngokuchanekileyo. Lawula inkqubo yolwazi, lawula uze ulinde imicimbi yokhuseleko Ikhompyutha nakule nto yefayili yokungena ngemivo ekhoyo. Seka iinkqubo zokhusela amathambo ecomputer kunye namafayili, yenza imveliso yelifayili ekhoyo. Lawula kunye nolungiselelo lwendawo yokusetyenziswa kwe computer, yenza uphando uze yila iinkcazelo ze (Local Area Network & Wide Area Network) LAN kunye noshishino lwe WAN ngokweemfuno zekoleji. Thenga iitekhnoloji zeLAN kunye neWAN. Sabela iinkonzo ezichaziweyo eziyimaxwebhu asetyenziswa abafundi kunye nabasebenzi ngokwemigaqo nakwimfuno yekholeji. jobs.title: Assistant Director: Office Manager

A valid drivers’ licence. Knowledge of Public Service legislation and policies. Knowledge of PSET. Knowledge and understanding of the CET Act. Understanding of the Higher Education Sector. Understanding of corporate governance. Understanding Cost centre budgetary, expenditure and cash flow management. Employment Equity Act, Public Services Regulations and Public Services Act, Labour Relations Act and any other related legislation. Sound Computer Skills in MS Office (intermediate levels). Self- motivated. Good organizing, planning, problem solving skills. Planning and organizing. Financial management. Report writing. Communication and interpersonal skills. Problem solving. Computer literacy. Analytical. Client oriented.

Establish office procedures and operating systems. Render administrative/executive support services in the office of the Principal including effective and efficient management of the college and management of workflow in the office of the Principal. Conduct research and provide expert administrative advice to the Principal and other officials in the college. Draft letters, memorandums and submissions. Ensure that approved minutes are signed off and safely kept. Prepare all presentations, speeches, addresses, report of the college and council committee meetings. Oversee and maintain logistics within the office of the Principal including arrangement of meeting and training interventions. Oversee and monitor the budget in the office of the Principal. Assist in ensuring effective and efficient administration and management of operations in the Principal’s office, Manage the risk register of the Principal’s office and champion risk management function. Maintain office budget and database of its expenditure. Ensure payment are authorized are underpinned by sound documentary support. Provide secretariat support to Senior Management and other external stakeholders. Maintain the calendar plan for scheduling and fixing meetings and communicate with all members of the above structures. Provide technical support during meetings, proceedings and activities of the above structures. Distribution of relevant documents for meetings of above structures. Keeping a register of resolutions and supporting all relevant Council Members/Managers/Officials through continuous correspondence to remind them of what needs to be done. Provide strategic management, monitoring, and evaluation services. Oversee and coordinate strategic, annual, and operational planning within the Office of the Principal, including the consolidation of college plans, reports, and performance information to support effective governance and institutional performance. Coordinate, monitor, and manage the Audit Action Implementation Plan to ensure timely resolution of audit findings, compliance with internal controls, and effective risk management.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Kantoorbestuurder
af.summary: 'n Assistent-direkteur: Kantoorbestuurder word gesoek om uitvoerende en administratiewe ondersteuning in die kantoor van die Skoolhoof by die Sentrale Kantoor in King William's Town te verskaf.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Bachelors-graad / Nasionale Diploma in Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie / Publieke Bestuur / Besigheidsbestuur of 'n verwante kwalifikasie wat deur SAQA erken word. 'n Minimum van drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se toesigervaring in die tersaaklike veld word vereis. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar in 'n strategiese beplannings- en administratiewe omgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van openbare dienswetgewing en beleide. Kennis van PSET. Kennis en begrip van die CET-wet. Begrip van die hoër onderwyssektor. Begrip van korporatiewe bestuur. Begrip van kostesentrumbegroting, besteding en kontantvloeiBESTUUR. Employment Equity Act, Public Services Regulations en Public Services Act, Labour Relations Act en enige ander verwante wetgewing. Soliede rekenaarvaardighede in MS Office (intermediêre vlakke). Selfgemotiveerd. Goeie organisasie-, beplannings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Beplanning en organisering. Finansiële bestuur. Verslagskrywing. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossing. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Analities. Kliëntgerig.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe/uitvoerende ondersteuningsdienste in die kantoor van die Skoolhoof. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van beleide. Stel kantoorprosedures en bedryfstelsels in. Verskaf administratiewe/uitvoerende ondersteuningsdienste in die kantoor van die Skoolhoof, insluitend doeltreffende en doeltrekkende bestuur van die kollege en bestuur van werkvloei in die kantoor van die Skoolhoof. Doen navorsing en verskaf kundige administratiewe advies aan die Skoolhoof en ander amptenare in die kollege. Opstel van briewe, memoranda en voorleggings. Verseker dat goedgekeurde notule onderteken en veilig bewaar word. Berei alle aanbiedings, toesprake, adresse, verslae van die kollege en raadskomiteevergaderings voor. Hou toesig oor en handhaaf logistiek binne die kantoor van die Skoolhoof, insluitend reëling van vergaderings en opleidingsintervensies. Hou toesig oor en monitor die begroting in die kantoor van die Skoolhoof. Help om doeltreffende en doeltrekkende administrasie en bestuur van bedrywighede in die Skoolhoof se kantoor te verseker, Bestuur die risikoregister van die Skoolhoof se kantoor en bevorder die risikobestuursfunksie. Handhaaf die kantoorbegroting en databasis van die bestedings daarvan. Behartig transaksionele verwerkingsvolgorde teen toegewysde begroting van aangegaande besteding, eise en aftrekkings wat ingesamel en aangestuur word vir verdere verwerking. Verseker dat magtigings vir betalings deur soliede dokumentêre ondersteuning gedra word. Verskaf sekretariële ondersteuning aan Senior Bestuur en ander eksterne belanghebbendes. Handhaaf die kalenderplan vir die skedulering en vasstelling van vergaderings en kommunikeer met alle lede van bogenoemde strukture. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning tydens vergaderings, verrigtinge en aktiwiteite van bogenoemde strukture. Verspreiding van tersaaklike dokumente vir vergaderings van bogenoemde strukture. Hou 'n register van besluite en ondersteun alle tersaaklike Raadslede/Bestuurders/Amptenare deurlopend deur korrespondensie om hulle te herinner aan wat gedoen moet word. Verskaf strategiese bestuurs-, moniterings- en evalueringsdienste. Hou toesig oor en koördineer strategiese, jaarlikse en operasionele beplanning binne die kantoor van die Skoolhoof, insluitend die konsolidasie van kollegeplanne, verslae en prestasie-inligting om doeltreffende bestuur en institusionele prestasie te ondersteun. Koördineer, monitor en bestuur die Oudit-aksie-implementeringsplan om tydige skikking van ouditbevindings, nakoming van interne kontroles en doeltreffende risikobestuur te verseker.

zu.requirements: Isiqu esifanele seBachelors' Degree / National Diploma kwi-Office Management and Technology / Public Management / Business Management noma isiqu esihlobene esamukelwa yi-SAQA. Kudingeka ubambebe ubuhle bokuba ngumphathi iminyaka engu-three (3) kuya kwaye ngu-five (5) kwimpahlaka. Iminyaka engu-three (3) kuya kwengu-five (5) ekubekweni inkqubo-mgama nokuphathwa.
