Ukulawula imali. Ukwabhala iingxelo. Amakhono ethu...
zu.duties: Bonelela izinsiza zokusebenza ezibhalwe phansi/zokwesekwa okuphezulu ehhovisi likaMongameli. Qapha intuthuko, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokulandelela kwezinqubomgomo. Misa izinqubo zehhovisi kanye namasistimu okusebenza. Bonelela izinsiza zokusebenza ezibhalwe phansi/zokwesekwa okuphezulu ehhovisi likaMongameli kufaka phakathi ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokuqondile kwesikole kanye nokuphathwa kwegagasi lomsebenzi ehhovisi likaMongameli. Yenza ucwaningo futhi unikeze izeluleko ezibalulekile zokusebenza ezibhalwe phansi kuMongameli kanye nabanye abaphathi balesi sikole. Bhala izinhlamvu zamagwinya, imemorandamu kanye nezimalulelo. Qinisekisa ukuthi imizuzu egunyaziwe ibhalwa ngosayino futhi igcinwe kaphathe. Lungisa wonke amaprezenteshi, izinkulumo, amakheli, umbiko wesikole kanye nezinkundla zamakomidi. Qapha futhi ulondoloze amalogistiki ehhovisi likaMongameli kufaka phakathi ulungelelwaniso lwezinkundla kanye nezindlela zokuqeqesha. Qapha futhi ulandelele ibhajethi ehhovisi likaMongameli. Siza ekuqinisekiseni ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokuqondile kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsiza ehhovisi likaMongameli, Phatha irejista yezingozi ehhovisi likaMongameli futhi ube nogxeggo ekusebenziseni umsebenzi wokuphathwa kwezingozi. Londoloza ibhajethi yehhovisi kanye nesisekelo sedatha yoku sebenzisa imali. Yiba nobuso ekulandelweni kwenqubo yokucutshungula izinkokhelo ngokuhambisana nebhejethi eyabelwe ukusetshenziswa kwemali, izikhalazo kanye nokukhishwa, ukuqoqa futhi uthumele inani elihlanganiswe ngokulinganiselwa ukuthi lenqunywe. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo ezivunyiwe zisekelwe uhlobo oluphephile lwamafayela. Bonelela unxulumano olusemthethweni oluseduzane noBuhlobo beNkundla yeNhloko kanye nalabo. Qapha kanti futhi ulandelele ibhejethi ohhovisi likaMongameli.

xh.title: Um lawuli oncedisayo: Um lawuli we Ofisi
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe Um lawuli oncedisayo: Um lawuli we Ofisi ukunika inkxaso yabaphathi nakomthetho yolawulo kwiofisi yo M lawuli ngase Kwindla e Phakathi e King William's Town.
xh.requirements: I Degree yesidanga / National Diploma efanelekileyo kwi Office Management and Technology / Public Management / Business Management okwesifundo esinxulumene neso samkelwa ngu SAQA. Kufuneka kube kunamava okulawula abantu ubuncinane beminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kwemihlanu (5) kwicala elinxulumene nalo. Iminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kwemihlanu (5) kulawulo lokucwangcisa nokwenza izicwangciso zendalo yemisebenzi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngomthetho namapolisi alo moya wolawulo kazwelonke. Ulwazi nge PSET. Ulwazi nokuqonda u Cet Act. Ukuqonda iqela lemfundo e Phakamileyo. Ukuqonda urhulumente ochongiweyo wolawulo lwent lokorile. Ukuqonda ukulawula ibhajeti, ukuchithwa kwemali noku lawula imali egqitha ilinye. I Employment Equity Act, Public Services Regulations and Public Services Act, Labour Relations Act nayipla lenkxaso yomnye umthetho onxulumene naye. Amandla okusebenza ngama khompyutha kwi MS Office (izinga eliphakathi). Uzikhaile ezizikhuthazayo. Amandla oku lungelelanisa, okucwangcisa, nokuzisombulula iinkinga. Uku cwangcisa noku lungelelanisa. Uku lawula iimali. Ukubhala iingxelo. Amandla oku thetha nabantu nokwazi ukuxabana nabantu. Ukuzisombulula iinkinga. Ukuba nolwazi lwe khompyutha. Ukuhlola ngononophelo. Ukuqonda iimfuno zabathengi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ngomthetho wolawulo/abaphathi kwiofisi yo M lawuli. Qwalasela ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenziswa nokuqwalaselwa kwamapolisi. Misela iinkqubo ziofisi namacebo oku sebenza. Nika inkxaso ngomthetho wolawulo/abaphathi kwiofisi yo M lawuli kuquka noku lawula ngokusebenza kwayo noku sebenza kakuhle kweso sikhulu noku lawula ukuhamba kweenkonzo kwiofisi yo M lawuli. Yenza uphando unike izeluleko ngenkxaso yolawulo ogqithisileyo ku M lawuli nakulo naluphi na uphando olunxulumene neso sikhulu. Bhala amagama, i memorandums nezicelo. Qinisekisa ukuba i minutes ezamkelekileyo zityikitywe zigcinwe kakuhle. Lungela yonke imiboniso, iinkulumo, iindaba, iingxelo zeso sikhulu namagqabantshintsho komkhandlu we komiti. Qwalasela ulondolazo kwiofisi yo M lawuli kuquka noku lungiselela iindibano noku ncediswa kolwazi kwiofisi. Qwalasela ulawulo lwebhajeti kwiofisi yo M lawuli. Ncedisa eku qinisekiseni ukulawula ngokusebenza noku sebenza kakuhle kwezomthetho nolawulo lweenkonzo kwiofisi yo M lawuli, Lawula irekhodi leengozi kwiofisi yo M lawuli ube ngumthunywa wolawulo lweengozi. Gcina ibhajeti yofisi nedatabase yokuchithwa kwayo. Yiba nokuqwalaselwa kokuhamba kweekonzo ukuchithwa kwemali exhaswe yibhajeti ehangqwwe nemigiqwa yokubuyisa ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba kobuchule bobugcisa buka mthetho. Qinisekisa ukuba iimali ezikhokwayo zivunyiwe zinamaphepha axhasa ngokusemthethweni. Nika inkxaso yomabhalwe ku Lawulo eliphezulu naku ba babantu base nxulumene naye bangaphandle. Gcina icebo lokucwangcisa iindibano zokuqwalasela nokumisa iindibano uze uxoxe nabo bonke abantu bale ngqungqutha. Nika inkxaso yobugcisa bobugcisa ngelixa kwenziwa iindibano, iinkqubo nemisebenzi yale ngqungqutha. Sabela ngamaxhoba abalulekileyo alungele iindibano zale ngqungqutha. Gcina irekhodi yemiqulu yokungqina inkxaso yalo naliphi na igqabantshintsho likaMkhandlu/Iilawuli/Onxibelelano ngokuhlala bexela ukubakhumbuza nako okufuneka kwenziwe. Nika inkxaso ngomthetho wolawulo, ulawulo nokuqwalaselwa kweenkonzo. Qwalasela ulungelelaniso ngomthetho wolawulo, unyaka nonke noku cwangcisa iinkqubo zolawulo kwiofisi yo M lawuli, kuquka nokudibana kwezicwangciso, iingxelo, nolwazi lokusebenza kweso sikhulu ukuze kunikezelwe inkxazo ekubeni kusebenza kakuhle ngurhulumente nokusebenza kwentsika. Linganisa noku lawula noku cwangcisa i Audit Action Implementation Plan ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqwalaselwa nokuqwalaselwa kwemiba yokuhlolwa ngokusesikweni, ukuhambelana nolawulo lwangaphakathi nolawulo olusebenzayo lweengozi.

jobs.title: Senior Management Information System (MIS) Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Manage and maintain the TVET MIS and Business Management System, overseeing data capture, validation and institutional reporting within the Department of Higher Education and Training.
jobs.requirements: Matric/Grade12 Certificate plus a recognised 3-year National Diploma or Degree in Information Management / Data Management, Management Information Systems or any other relevant qualification. Must have a minimum of 3 to 5 years relevant work experience in data management, TVET- MIS environment, database administration, information systems support, institutional reporting, or data analytics. Must be computer literate. Must have a valid driver’s license. Competencies, Knowledge, And Skills: Must have knowledge and understanding of office administration. Knowledge of Public Service legislations and policies. Knowledge and understanding of the TVETMIS system, annual reporting requirements by the Higher Education understanding, application and interpretation of office/information management systems. Business Management Systems (BMS), data management, compiling and interpretation of results and other statistics. Must have effective office administrative skills, team leadership and outcome driven, project management, sound communication (verbal and written) skills. Ability to work independently and within a team. Good organisational, co-ordination and planning skills.
jobs.duties: Maintain and manage the Business Management System (BMS) and related platforms, ensuring alignment with the DHET requirements through vigorous quality control and validation process. Ensure the overall supervision and proper management of TVET MIS, capturing and data extraction for the college within specified deadlines. Ensure the overall supervision, coordination, compilation and submission of MIS reports and statics. Ensure the overall supervision and verification of inputs captured on the Business Management System and other related system. Ensure the overall supervision and administration of all academic and student related system. Ensure the overall supervision and maintenance of MIS licenses are renewed before expiry dates. Provide support in the administration, maintenance and optimisation of the College's Management Information Systems (MIS) to ensure integrity, availability and security of institutional information. Maintain and administer institutional databases, perform data validation and reconciliation, monitor system performance, implement system updates, maintain user access controls, perform routine backups and support the implementation of information security and data governance standards. Facilitate user training and assist in the implementation of system enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives in support of institutional objectives. Collect, extract, analyse, interpret and report on institutional data to support planning, monitoring and evidence-based decision-making. Develop and generate management reports, dashboards and statistical reports. Compiling weekly, quarterly and monthly reports on student’s statistics amongst others for management, DHET and other stakeholders. Support the coordination and submission of statutory reports, monitor data quality and compliance with DHET reporting requirements, identify trends and provide analytical insights to improve institutional performance, ensure compliance with college policies, the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) and other applicable legislation.

af.title: Senior Bestuursinligtingstelsel (MIS) Beampte
af.summary: Bestuur en onderhou die TVET MIS en Besigheidsbestuurstelsel, en hou toesig oor datainvang, validering en instellingsverslagdoening binne die Department of Higher Education and Training.
af.requirements: Matric/Grade12 Sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Inligtingsbestuur / Databestuur, Bestuursinligtingstelsels of enige ander relevante kwalifikasie. Moet 'n minimum van 3 tot 5 jaar se relevante werkervaring in databestuur, TVET-MIS-omgewing, databasisadministrasie, inligtingstelselondersteuning, instellingsverslagdoening, of data-analise hê. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Bevoegdhede, Kennis, En Vaardighede: Moet kennis en begrip van kantooradministrasie hê. Kennis van Openbare Diens-wetgewing en beleide. Kennis en begrip van die TVETMIS-stelsel, jaarlikse verslagdoeningsvereistes deur Higher Education begrip, toepassing en interpretasie van kantoor-/inligtingsbestuurstelsels. Business Management Systems (BMS), databestuur, samestelling en interpretasie van resultate en ander statistieke. Moet effektiewe kantooradministratiewe vaardighede, spanleierskap en uitkomsgerigtheid, projekbestuur, goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik) vaardighede hê. Vermoë om onafhanklik en binne 'n span te werk. Goeie organisatoriese, koördinerings- en beplanningsvaardighede.
af.duties: Onderhou en bestuur die Business Management System (BMS) en verwante platforms, en verseker belyning met die DHET-vereistes deur middel van streng gehaltebeheer en validasieprosesse. Verseker die algehele toesig en behoorlike bestuur van TVET MIS, datavangst en data-onttrekking vir die kollege binne gespesifiseerde sperdatums. Verseker die algehele toesig, koördinering, samestelling en indiening van MIS-verslae en statistieke. Verseker die algehele toesig en verifikasie van insette op die Business Management System en ander verwante stelsels. Verseker die algehele toesig en administrasie van alle akademiese en studenteverwante stelsels. Verseker die algehele toesig en instandhouding dat MIS-lisensies voor vervaldatums hernu word. Verskaf ondersteuning in die administrasie, instandhouding en optimalisering van die Kollege se Bestuursinligtingstelsels (MIS) om die integriteit, beskikbaarheid en sekuriteit van instellingsinligting te verseker. Onderhou en administreer instellingsdatabasisse, voer datavalidering en rekonsiliasie uit, monitor stelselprestasie, implementeer stelselopdaterings, onderhou gebruikerstoegangbeheer, voer roetine-rugsteune uit en ondersteun die implementering van inligtingsekuriteit en databeheerstandaarde. Fasiliteer gebruikersopleiding en help met die implementering van stelselverbeterings en deurlopende verbeteringsinisiatiewe ter ondersteuning van instellingsdoelwitte. Versamel, onttrek, ontleed, interpreteer en rapporteer oor instellingsdata ter ondersteuning van beplanning, monitering en bewysgebaseerde besluitneming. Ontwikkel en genereer bestuursverslae, kontroleskerms en statistiese verslae. Stel weeklikse, kwartaallikse en maandelikse verslae oor studentestatistieke onder andere vir bestuur, DHET en ander belanghebbendes op. Ondersteun die koördinering en indiening van statutêre verslae, monitor datakwaliteit en nakoming van DHET-verslagdoeningsvereistes, identifiseer tendense en verskaf analitiese insigte om instellingsprestasie te verbeter, en verseker nakoming van kollegebeleid, die Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) en ander toepaslike wetgewing.

zu.title: I-ofisa Eliphezulu Le-Senior Management Information System (MIS)
zu.summary: Phatha ulondoloze i-TVET MIS kanye ne-Business Management System, uphathe ukubhalwa kwedatha, ukuqinisekiswa kwayo kanye nembiko lesikhungo ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric/Grade12 kahanye ne-Diploma yezwe enaminyaka eyi-3 noma i-Degree ebonwa ngomkhakha we-Information Management / Data Management, Management Information Systems noma noma yisiphi esinye isidingo esihlobene. Kumele ube nomuzwa ongaphansi kweminyaka eyi-3 kuya kweyi-5 emsebenzini otekuhle kwi-data management, TVET- MIS environment, database administration, information systems support, institutional reporting, noma data analytics. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuytha. Kumele ube nelisensi yokushayela esetshenziswa ngokomthetho. Isidingo, ulwazi, Namakhono: Kumele ube nolwazi kanye nokuqonda ngokuphathwa kohlobo. Ulwazi ngomthetho namapholisi kazwelonke. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda isimiso se-TVETMIS, izidingo zembiko wonyaka nge-Higher Education ukuqonda, ukusebenzisa kanye nokuchaza izimiso zokuphathwa kohlobo/zokwaziswa. Business Management Systems (BMS), data management, ukuhlanganisa kanye nokuchaza imiphumela kanye nezinye izibalo. Kumele ube namakhono okuphatha kahle uhlobo, ukuba ngumholi wabahlanganyeli kanye nokuqhuba imiphumela, ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, amakhono okuxhumana (abhalwe nokuKhulunywa). Ikono lokusebenza eyedwa futhi kuhlangothi lwesiqhenge esihlanganyenayo. Amakhono ohlelo, ukuhlelelana kanye nokweluleka.
zu.duties: Londoloza uphathe i-Business Management System (BMS) nama-platform ahlobene, uqiniseke ukuthi ahambisana nezidingo ze-DHET ngokusebenzisa inqubo yokulawula izinga elihle kakhulu nokuqinisekisa. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokuphelele kanye nokulawula okululehle i-TVET MIS, ukubhalwa kanye nokukhipha idatha yasekolishi ngemva kwemikhawulo elingisiwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokuphelele, ukuhlelelana, ukulungiswa nokuthunyelwa kwemibiko ye-MIS kanye nezibalo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokuphelele kanye nokuhlola okufakiwe okubhalwe kwi-Business Management System kanye nezinye izinhlela ezihlobene. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokuphepelele kanye nokuphathwa kwayo yonke imikhakha yezindlela zezimfundo nezinkomfa ezihlobene. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokuphelele kanye nokugcinwa kwamalayisensi e-MIS abuye kabusha ngaphambi kokuba kuphelelwe yisikhathi. Nikeza inkxaso ekuphathweni, ekugcineni nasekusizeni ukuba ngcono kwezinhlela ze-College's Management Information Systems (MIS) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthembeka, ukutholakala nokuphepha kwendawo yokwaziswa yesikhungo. Gcina uphathe izindawo zokulondoloza idatha zesikhungo, yenze ukubuyekezwa kanye nokuhambisanisa idatha, qapha ukusebenza kwezinhlela, faka izibuyekezo zezinhlela, gcina izilawuli zokufinyelela komsebenzisi, yenze ukulondoloza njalo idatha, uphinde unikeze inkxaso ekusebenziseni izindingo zokuphepha kwendawo yokwaziswa kanye nezindingo zokuphathwa kwedatha. Siza ekusebenziseni ukukhokisa abasebenzisi uphinde usize ekufakeni izinto ezizisa izinhlela ezintsha kanye nezinhlobonhlobo zokuqhuba phambili eziyisikhuthazo nenhloso yesikhungo. Qoqa, khhipha, hlaziya, chaza futhi ungembiko ngendawo yokwaziswa yesikhungo ukuze uxhase ukweluleka, ukulondoloza kanye nokwenza izinquma ezigxile emaqiniso. Bhala uphinde ukhiqize imibiko yokuphatha, ama-dashboard kanye nemibiko yezibalo. Ukuhlanganisa imibiko yangesonto, yesikhashana kanyenenyanga ezibalongezinkomfa phakathi kwabanye abayikho ukuphathwa, i-DHET kanye namanye abahlanganyeli. Xhasa ukuhlelelana kanye nokuthunyelwa kwemibiko esemthethweni, qapha izinga ledata kanye nokuhambisana nezidingo zembiko ze-DHET, khomba izindleko uphide unikeze izibalo ezicacile ukuthi zisize ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwesikhungo, qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana namapholisi eKolishi, i-Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) kanye nomthetho othe ukuyikho.

Makabe nokuba mkhulu unyaka oyi-3 ukuya kwi-5 wamava wokusebenza okufanelekileyo kwilawulo le-data, kummandla we-TVET-MIS, kulawulo lwesiseko seencwadi, ekukenxaxheni kweenkqubo zolwazi, ekubhalweni iinkqubo ngokusetyenziswa njengoko kubhalwa ngokubhalwa ngokubukela iinkalo ezahlukeneyo, okanye ekuhlaluhleni iinkqubo. Makakwazi ulwazi ngokubhalwa ngokubhalwa ngokubukela iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ngokubukela iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ngokubukela iinkalo ezahlukeneyo ngokubukela iinkalo ezahlukeneyo. xh.duties: Phatha ulungelelwaniso kwaye ulawule i-Business Management System (BMS) nezinkalo ezinxulumene nayo, kuqinisekiswa ukuvumelana neemfuno ze-DHET ngokusebenzisa inqobo yolawulo lwekhwalithi nenqubo yoqinisekiso. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokubanzi nolawulo olulungele i-TVET MIS, ukuthatha nokutsalwa kwedata yekholeji phakathi kwemiqesho eceliweyo. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokubanzi, ukuqamba ngokuvumelana, ukuqunjwa nokunikezwa kweembiko ze-MIS namanani abhalwe ngendlela eqhagamshelwanayo. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokubanzi nokuqinisekisa iimpawu ezithathiwe kwi-Business Management System nakwezinye iinkqubo ezinxulumene naloo ndlela. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokubanzi nolawulo lwezonke iinkqubo ezinxulumene nezemfundo nabaFundi. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokubanzi nokuqinisekisa ukuba iilayisenisi ze-MIS zihlaziwa ngaphambi kokuba ziphelelwe yisikhathi. Nikeza inkxaso ekulawuleni, ekugcinweni nasekulungelelwanisweni iinkqubo ze-College's Management Information Systems (MIS) ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza, ukufumaneka nokhuseleko kolwazi lesiseko. jobs.title: Senior Financial Aid/bursary Officer
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Manage and coordinate student bursary schemes and financial aid administrative services for a college campus, ensuring compliance with NSFAS guidelines.
jobs.requirements: Matric/Grade12 Certificate plus a recognised 3-year National Diploma or Degree in Financial Management / Accounting or any other relevant qualification. Must have a minimum of 3 to 5 years relevant work experience in bursary / financial aid services. Must be computer literate. Must be proficient in MS-Excel. Must have a valid driver’s license. Competencies, Knowledge, And Skills: Must have knowledge and understanding of financial functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collate financial statistics. Knowledge of the Public Service financial legislations, procedures and Treasury Regulations (PFMA, NSFAS guidelines and Financial Management practices and principles). Knowledge of basic financial operating systems. Must have good verbal and written communication, basic numeracy skills, ability to perform routine tasks, ability to operate office equipment, flexibility, interpersonal relations, accuracy and aptitudes of figures.
jobs.duties: Ensure overall supervision and coordination of student bursary schemes and financial aid administrative support services for the entire college. Ensure the overall supervision and administration of bursary and financial aid schemes application processes for the entire college in line with NSFAS guidelines, funder MOU/SLA and policies. Ensure overall supervision and authorisation of disbursement of funds. Ensure overall supervision and facilitation of other financial aid schemes. Ensure overall supervision, monitoring, evaluation and maintenance of database of all student applications in terms of Department of Higher Education and Training and NSFAS requirements. Ensure overall supervision and consolidate reports on all bursary and financial aid allocations for the entire college. Uploading and posting of all NSFAS student tuition remittances on the Pastel and Coltech systems including reconciliation and balancing thereof. Prepare and conclude annual NSFAS reconciliation report in terms of advances and tuition fee receipts/remittances. Identify all NSFAS overpayments and credits with interest that should be repaid and refunded to NSFAS annually. Follow up on outstanding close reports.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Hlatshwayo/Mr P Motai Tel No: (011) 692 4004 Ext. 1010/1061/1062
jobs.applications: Please hand deliver your application or email it to seniorfin@westcol.co.za in a pdf format and as one attachment, quoting the relevant reference number to the Principal, Western TVET College, Corporate Office, 42 Johnstone Street, Randfontein, 1760.
jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed NEW Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of original documents with academic records/transcripts and other relevant supporting documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR Office. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by a SAQA evaluation report. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. If you have not been contacted within six months after the closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a vetting and financial disclosure process (criminal record, citizenship, qualification verification and employment verification). People living with disability are encouraged to apply. If you have not been contacted within six months after closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Western TVET College is an equal opportunities employer and reserves the right not to fill the posts. People with disability are encouraged to apply. Please ensure that the Z83 form is completed in full. Incomplete Z83 will be disqualified.

af.title: Senior Finansiële Bystand-/Beursbeampte
af.summary: Bestuur en koördineer studentebeurskemas en finansiële bystand administratiewe dienste vir 'n kollege-kampus, en verseker nakoming van NSFAS-riglyne.
af.requirements: Matric/Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Finansiële Bestuur / Rekeningkunde of enige ander relevante kwalifikasie. Moet 'n minimum van 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in beurs- / finansiële bystandsdienste hê. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees. Moet in MS-Excel vaardig wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie hê. Bevoegdhede, Kennis, en Vaardighede: Moet kennis en begrip van finansiële funksies, gebruike asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële statistiek bymekaar te maak, hê. Kennis van die Openbare Dienst finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en Tesourie-regulasies (PFMA, NSFAS-riglyne en Finansiële Bestuursgebruike en beginsels). Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels. Moet goeie mondelingse en geskrewe kommunikasie, basiese syfergeletterdheidsvaardighede, vermoë om roetine-take uit te voer, vermoë om kantoortoerusting te bedryf, buigsaamheid, interpersoonlike verhoudings, akkuraatheid en aanleg vir syfers hê.
af.duties: Verseker algehele toesig en koördinering van studentebeurskemas en finansiële bystand administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste vir die hele kollege. Verseker die algehele toesig en administrasie van beurs- en finansiële bystandskemas se aansoekprosesse vir die hele kollege in ooreenstemming met NSFAS-riglyne, befondser MOU/SLA en beleide. Verseker algehele toesig en magtiging van die uitbetaling van fondse. Verseker algehele toesig en fasilitering van ander finansiële bystandskemas. Verseker algehele toesig, monitering, evaluering en onderhoud van 'n databasis van alle studenteaansoeke volgens Department of Higher Education and Training- en NSFAS-vereistes. Verseker algehele toesig en konsolideer verslae oor alle beurs- en finansiële bystandstoekenning vir die hele kollege. Laai op en boek alle NSFAS-student lesgeldoorbetaling op die Pastel- en Coltech-stelsels, insluitend die rekonsiliering en balansering daarvan. Berei voor en voltooi die jaarlikse NSFAS-rekonsilieringsverslag ten opsigte van vooruitbetaling en lesgeldkwitansies/oorbetaling. Identifiseer alle NSFAS-oorbetaling en krediete met rente wat teruggestal en jaarliks aan NSFAS terugbetaal moet word. Volg uitstaande sluitverslae na.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlezi Kahle Wamasheya Wemali Wezifundo/Izibonezelo Zezimali
zu.summary: Phatha futhi uhlobozi izinhlela zamabhasudi abafundi nezinsizakalo zezintengiselwano zosizo lwemali enkampusi yekholidji, qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemihlahlandlela ye-NSFAS.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric/Grade12 kahle nesidiploma sezwe izikhathi ezi-3 noma isiqu esinezwi nakho kwi-Financial Management / Accounting noma noma yisiphi isiqu esihambisanayo. Kumele kube nokuhlonipha okuncane eminyakeni eyi-3 kuya kweyi-5 yemisebenzi ephathelene namabhasudi / usizo lwemali. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-MS-Excel kahle. Kumele ube nelayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile. Amakhono, Ulwazi, Nekhono: Kumele ube nolwazi nokugonda imisebenzi yezimali, izindlela okwenziwa ngayo kanye nethonya lokuthatha ulwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zemali. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezimali yesebenzabo Setshaba, izindlela nemithetho ye-Treasury Regulations (PFMA, imihlahlandlela ye-NSFAS kanye nezindlela namagagu e-Financial Management). Ulwazi ngamasistimu wemisebenzi yemali osemqoka. Kumele ube nokuKhuluma kahle ngomlomo nokubhala, amakhono wethemathiki, ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi ejwayelekile, ikhono lokusebenzisa izinto zohlelo, ukuguquguquka, ubuhlobo nabantu, ukunemba nethonya lokubala izibalo.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphatha jikelele nokuhlelela izinhlela zamabhasudi abafundi nezinsizakalo zokusekelwa kwezintengiselwano zosizo lwemali kukho konke ikholidji. Qinisekisa ukuphatha nokulawula konke izinqubo zokusichenza kwamabhasudi nezinhlela zosizo lwemali kukho konke ikholidji ngokuhambisana nemihlahlandlela ye-NSFAS, i-MOU/SLA yenikeli wezimali namapholisi. Qinisekisa ukuphatha nokugunyaza ukukhishwa kwezimali. Qinisekisa ukuphatha nokweluleka ezinye izinhlela zosizo lwemali. Qinisekisa ukuphatha, ukuqapha, ukuhlola nokugcina uhlaziye isiqu sedatha yazo zonke izicelo zabafundi ngokuhambisana nezidingo ze-Department of Higher Education and Training ne-NSFAS. Qinisekisa ukuphatha nokuhlanganisa imibiko yonke imabelo amabhasudi nosizo lwemali kukho konke ikholidji. Ukulayisha nokuthumela onke ama-remittance afundiswa abafundi be-NSFAS kumasistimu we-Pastel ne-Coltech okuhlanganisa nokuhambisisa nokulinganisa. Luklalele futhi uqedele imibiko yonyaka yokuhambisana kwe-NSFAS mayelana nezimali ezinikezwe kanye nezimali ezifunwayo/ifomu lemfundiso noma ama-remittance. Chaza onke amakhokho awegeme kwe-NSFAS nezimali ezingeziwe ezinenzalo ezimele zibuyiswe noma zibuyiswe kwi-NSFAS ngonyaka. Landela imibiko engapelayo. UWethulwe.

xh.title: Umntu oPhezulu woLwazi loNxibelelaniso ophathe iNkundla/Mabhuleti
xh.summary: Lawula nokuqamba ndawonye iinkqubo zamabhasari abafundi nemisebenzi yolawulo yoxhaso lwemali kwikhampasi yekholeji, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo ye-NSFAS.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi se-Matric/Grade12 edutyulwa kwi-Diploma yaseMzantsiAfrika eyaziwayo yeminyaka elikhuni noma i-Degree kwi-Financial Management / Accounting noma nayiphi na eminye ipheleleliso eluncedo. Kufuneka abe nobomi obutsha nobuchwephetshe bomsebenzi ongangeyminyaka elithoba elithathu ukuya kwelithlanu kulwazi lokusebenza ukwimi ixhaso noma iinkonzo zoluxhaso lwemali. Kufuneka abe nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenzisa i-MS-Excel. Kufuneka abe nothungelwano olusemthethweni lokusesha iimoto. Ukukwazi, ulwazi, namakhono: Kufuneka abe nolwazi nokuqonda iinkonzo zemali, neendlela ekwazi ngazo ukungena iidatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela iingxelo zemali. Ulwazi ngeenkqabo-mthetho zolonke-lwazi ze-Public Service zemali, iinkqubo nokuLondoloza iNkqubo yoBuhle bemali (i-PFMA, iinkqubo zee-NSFAS kunye nemigaqo nolawulo lwemali). Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zolonke-lwazi zemali ezisisiseko. Kufuneka abe namakhono oluntu oluluncedo ehlabathini nakwelokuBhala, ukukwazi ukubala iimathematiki, ukukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo, ukukwazi ukusebenzisa izixhobo zehhovisi, ukuguqu-guquka, ukuhlobana nabantu, ukuchaneeka namakhondo-mlilo amanani.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukulawula nokuqamba ndawonye kwemixhaso yabafundi kunye nemisebenzi yolawulo yonke yoxhaso lwemali kwikhorari jikelele. Qinisekisa ukulawula nolawulo jikelele lokuqhuba iinkqubo zomceli-mali wemixhaso nolonke loxhaso lwemali kwikhorari jikelele ngokwemigaqo ye-NSFAS, nge-MOU/SLA yomnikazi-wemali nangokweenkqubo ezamkelayo. Qinisekisa ukulawula nokugunyazisa ukuphuma kwemali jikelele. Qinisekisa ukulawula nokulungelelanisa eminye imixhaso yoluxhaso lwemali jikelele. Qinisekisa ukulawula, ukuqonda, ukulinganisela nokulondoloza isiseko sedatha yomceli-mali wonke abafundi ngokweemfuno ze-Department of Higher Education and Training ngeze-NSFAS jikelele. Qinisekisa ukulawula kwangaphambili nokuqokelela iingxelo zamaxhaso nobomi bonke yoluxhaso lwemali kwiikhorari jikelele. Ukulayisha nokupapasha zonke izityhilelo zefundiso zabafundi be-NSFAS kwiiNkqubo ze-Pastel nge-Coltechsystems eziquka ukuqondanisa nokuqambisa ibhalansi yazo. Lungiselela nokuqedela ingxelo yokulinganisela ngeminyaka yonke ye-NSFAS malunga naphambili nobungu-efundiso zeziqwengana-efundiso / izityhilelo. Balula nokuqonda zonke iindlela ezikhohlwayo nezibonelelo ezineentsALI zoku-rhA yi-NSFAS kwakunye noku-rhA yi-NSFAS kwiminyaka yonke. Landela iingxelo ezibandeleyo ezingekaqediwa.

jobs.title: Senior State Accountant: Financial Accounting
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: The Department of Higher Education and Training seeks a Senior State Accountant for financial accounting at its Corporate Office, requiring a relevant diploma or degree and three to five years of finance experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric/Grade12 Certificate plus a recognised 3-year National Diploma or Degree in Accounting / Financial Management / Cost and Management Accounting or any other relevant qualification. Must have a minimum of 3 to 5 years relevant work experience in a financial management or finance environment. Must be computer literate. Must have a valid driver’s license. Competencies, Knowledge, and Skills: Must have knowledge of the TVET sector prescripts, regulations and legislative framework. Knowledge of Public Service Act and Regulations. Must have knowledge of financial functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collate financial statistics. Must have knowledge of financial accounting procedures, methods and principles established for the processing of specific salary/ financial transactions. Must have knowledge of the Public Service legislations, procedures, and Treasury Regulations (PFMA, GRAP, Financial Manual). Knowledge of financial operating systems (COLTECH, BAS, COLTECH, PASTEL etc). af.title: Seniorstaatsrekenmeester: Finansiële Rekenkunde
af.summary: Die Department of Higher Education and Training soek 'n Seniorstaatsrekenmeester vir finansiële rekenkunde by sy Korporatiewe Kantoor, wat 'n relevante diploma of graad vereis en drie tot vyf jaar se finansiële ervaring.
af.requirements: Matric/Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Rekenkunde / Finansiële Bestuur / Koste- en Bestuursrekenkunde of enige ander relevante kwalifikasie. Moet 'n minimum van 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkservaring in 'n finansiële bestuurs- of finansie-omgewing hê. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees. Moet 'n geldige bestuurslisensie hê. Bevoegdhede, Kennis en Vaardighede: Moet kennis hê van die TVET-sektor se voorskrifte, regulasies en wetgewende raamwerk. Kennis van die Openbaredienswet en Regulasies. Moet kennis hê van finansiële funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële statistiek bymekaar te maak. Moet kennis hê van finansiële rekenkundige prosedures, metodes en beginsels wat vasgestel is vir die verwerking van spesifieke salaris-/finansiële transaksies. Moet kennis hê van Openbaredienswetgewing, prosedures en Tesourieregulasies (PFMA, GRAP, Finansiële Handleiding). Kennis van finansiële bedryfstelsels (COLTECH, BAS, COLTECH, PASTEL ens). Behoort goeie syfer-, akkuraatheids-, verslagskryf-, probleemoplossings-, beplannings-, organisatoriese, spanleierskaps- en kommunikasievaardighede te hê.
af.duties: Verseker die algehele voorbereiding en toesig en voorsiening van finansiële verslagdoening. Indiening van maandelikse verslae aan DHET, bestuur en die raad se subkomitee soos en wanneer vereis. Voorbereiding van betalingspakkies en afstemming van alle rekeninge op Pastel. Bestuur van alle retensie-skuldeisers. Verseker van akkuraatheid van betalings voordat betalings vrygestel word. Skakel alle onbekende depositorekeninge uit, verwerk studenteterugbetalings, bestuur skuldinvorderaar, voorbereiding van toepaslike verslae vir interne bestuursbesluite, voorbereiding van maandelikse finansiële rekeninge, verwerking van maandeindjoernale, balansering van Vastebatesregisters om akkurate maandeindverslagdoening te verseker. Hersiening van alle inkomste en balansering van skuldeisersbeheerrekeninge met Pastel. Verseker algehele toesig oor bank-, kontant- en inkomstebestuursdienste. Stem alle MOU/As maandeliks met SETAs af, insluitend fakturering, invordering van uitstaande fondse van SETAs, voorbereiding van 'n jaarlikse ouditafstemmingskedule van SETAs teen stipendiums wat per individuele SETA betaal is. Onderhou ten volle bygewerkte, getekende en volledige dokumentasie van elke deur SETA ondertekende ooreenkoms. Bestuur finansiële interne ouditdienste. Verseker akkuraatheid van algemene balanse en berei jaarliks alle ondersteunende skedules vir eksterne oudit voor. Hersien huidige finansieelbeleide en ontwikkel nuwe beleide waar nodig. Bystand met alle ad hoc-versoeke.

zu.title: Isiphathimandla Esiphezulu Sezimali Eziyisifundo: Ubuhlelwe Buccombe Bemali
zu.summary: I-Department of Higher Education and Training ifuna Isiphathimandla Esiphezulu Sezimali Eziyisifundo ehhlinzeka ngemali ehhlinzeka ngayo kwi-Corporate Office yayo, kudingeka idiploma noma idigri ehambisana nalokhu kanye namakhulu eminyaka amathathu kuya kwamahlanu okuhlolwa kwemali.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Matric/Grade12 esihambisana ne-Diploma Yezwe leminyaka engu-3 noma i-Degree ekwaziwayo kwi-Accounting / Financial Management / Cost and Management Accounting noma noma yikuphi okunye ukufaneleka okuhambisana nalokhu. Kudingeka abe nobuhlobo beminyaka engu-3 kuya kwengu-5 bomsebenzi ohambisana nalokhu kuhlolweni emkhakheni we-financial management noma wezimali. Kudingeka akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Kudingeka abe namalayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukufaneleka, ulwazi, kanye namakhono: Kudingeka abe nolwazi ngemigaqo yomkhakha we-TVET, imigoqo kanye nesakhiwo somthetho. Ulwazi ngoMthetho kanye namaRegulation Wezinsizakalo Zomphakathi. Kudingeka abe nolwazi ngemisebenzi yezimali, izindlela zokwenza kanye nakhono lokungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zemali. Kudingeka abe nolwazi ngokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi yokubhala imali, izindlela nezimiso ezisetshenziselwa ukucubungula ngemali noma izimali ezithile. Kudingeka abe nolwazi ngemithetho yezinsizakalo zomphakathi, izindlela, kanye namaTreasury Regulations (PFMA, GRAP, Financial Manual). Ulwazi ngamasistimu okusebenza ngemali (COLTECH, BAS, COLTECH, PASTEL etc). Kudingeka abe nakhono lokubala, ukucophelela, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuhlela, ukuhlela, ukuba ngumholi wethimba kanye nakhono lokuthintana nabantu.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukulungiselelwa okuphelele, ukuphatha kanye nokuhlinzeka ngemibiko yezimali. Ukuletha imibiko yanyanga zonke ku-DHET, ekuqineni nakwikomidi elingaphansi kwekhanjella noma lapho kudingeka khona. Ukulungiselela amaphakheji wokuHlinzekelwa ukuHlinzeka kwezimali kwi-Pastel. Ukuphathwa kwazo zonke izimali ezibambe ze-retention. Ukuthi kugqamise ukuqinisekiswa kwemali ngaphambi kokuba inkokhelo ikhishwe. Ukusula yonke imali engaziwa, ukucubungula imbuyiselo yezimali yafundi, ukuphatha umqoqi wezimali, ukulungiselela imibiko ehambisana noma ngasiphi isinqumo sakho ngaphakathi, ukulungiselela imali yamakhulu amnyama, ukucubungula amajamula wakho wamakhulu ekupheleni, ukuqinisekisa ukuqinisekiswa kokugcina imali yakho amakhulu amnyama ngokuthi kusukuma isibali sakho i-Fixed Asset Register. Ukubuyekezwa kwawo wonke amali okungenayo nokulinganisa amakhulu amakhulu amakhulu e-debtors kanye ne-Pastel. Qinisekisa ukuphatha kwaye uqiniseke ngemali yokungenisa, ngemali ethile, ukuzinza ngemali e-Pastel.

xh.title: Umlawuli Okhokelayo weLizwe: Ukubala kweMali
xh.summary: Isebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha lifuna Umlawuli Okhokelayo weLizwe wokubala kweMali kwiNkundla yalo yeShishini, kufuneka nediroma okanye idigri elifanelekileyo kunye neminyaka emithathu ukuya kwemihlanu yamava kwimali.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric/Grade12 sokwenzela nesidanga seNational Diploma seminyaka emithathu esemthethweni okanye iDegree kwi-Accounting / Financial Management / Cost and Management Accounting okanye naliphi na oyilo oluhambelana nalo. Kufuneka abe namava okusebenza ahambelana nayo amaminithi eminyaka engama-3 ukuya kwengama-5 kwindawo yokulawula imali okanye kwindawo yemali. Kufuneka azi ukusebenza kwikhompyutha. Kufuneka abe nam layisensi yokushuka ethe ngqo. Ikhono, ulwazi, namakhono: Kufuneka abe nolwazi ngemithetho nengcamango yesebe lama-TVET, narhumelo namagugu. Ulwazi lwe-Public Service Act nakuRhulumente. Kufuneka abe nolwazi ngemisebenzi yemali, namacebo kwakhona nakhono lokufaka idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokudibanisa iimveliso-mali. Kufuneka abe nolwazi ngeendlela, iindlela namagugu okubala imali asungulwe ukuqhuba iintengiso ezithile zemali/ ezezimali. Kufuneka abe nolwazi ngemithetho yesebe likarhulumente, iindlela, kunye noRhulumente lwezezimali (i-PFMA, i-GRAP, i-Financial Manual). Ulwazi ngamajelo okusebenza ezezimali (i-COLTECH, i-BAS, i-COLTECH, i-PASTEL njl). Kufuneka abe namakhono amaninzi elinganisa, ukuchaneka, ukubhala iingxelo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuqamba, ukuhlanganisa, ukukhokela iqela kunye nokunxibelelana.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulwako lwayo ipreparation kunye nokuqondisa kunye nokunikwa kweengxelo zemali. Uku rhwebisa iingxelo zenyanga kwi-DHET, kulawulo nakwibhunga elingaphantsi njengoko kufuneka. Ukulungiselela amapakhe ezimali kunye nokulinganisa yonke imi-akhawunti kwi-Pastel. Ulawulo lwabo bonke abathengi abagcinayo. Kuqinisekiswa ukuchaneka kweemali phambi kokuba zikhululwe. Ukucoca yonke imi-akhawunti yemigca engaziwayo, ukuqhuba iimbaziso zabafundi, ulawulo lomnyathi weenkqubo, ukulungiselela iingxelo ezifanelekileyo ezimayelana nokugqibela kwangaphakathi, ukulungiselela iinkqubo zemali zenyanga, ukuqhuba ijurnali zokuvala inyanga, ukulinganisa ama-Fixed Asset Registers ukuqinisekisa iingxelo ezichanekileyo zokuvala inyanga. Ukuphonononga yonke imali yenkomishini kunye nokulinganisa iinkqubo zolawulo zabenikwa nge-Pastel. Qinisekisa uqondiso jikelele lwebhanki, lemali nenkcitho yokulawula. Linganisa zonke i-MOU/As ne-SETAs nyanga zonke kuquka uku rhwebisa, ukulungisa imali eleyingxwathiro kwi-SETA'S, ukulungiselela ishedi yonyaka yoku linganiswa kwe audit ye-SETAs ngokumathathwa kwemali yamavavanyo ngalunye u-SETA. Gcina ixatso elibhaliweyo, elisayiniweyo negqitywe ngokupheleleyo lesayini ngayinye nge-SETA. Lawula iinkonzo ze audit yangaphakathi zemali. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka kwemilinganiselo jikelelo ulungisele ngonyaka zonke ishedi ezixhasayo ze audit yangaphandle. Phonononga iinkqubo zemali ezikhoyo yaza udale iinkqubo ezintsha apho kufuneka khona. Ukuncedisa zonke iimfuno ezingaqwalaselwa.

zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seMatric / Grade12 kahle nge-Diploma yezwe ezifundwe iminyaka engu-3 noma i-Degree ekuqashelwayo kwi-Communication/Marketing/Public Relations noma noma yisiphi esinye isimiso esihambisana nalesi. jobs.title: Chief Administration Clerk (CONDITIONS of Service)
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 per annum (Level 07), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Sector
jobs.summary: The Department of Higher Education and Training seeks a Chief Administration Clerk for Conditions of Service at its Central Office, requiring a diploma or degree and two years of HR experience.
jobs.requirements: A Nation Senior Certificate plus an appropriate National Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resource Management / Public Administration / Public Management. A minimum of two (2) years relevant experience. Introduction to PERSAL Management Certificate. A valid driver’s licence. Skills and Competencies: Extensive knowledge of Human Resource Management in the Public Service and employment legislation i.e Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Basic Conditions of Employment, Public Finance Management Act, Employment Equity Act. Policy on Incapacity Leave and Ill-health retirement, Promotion and Access of Information Act (PAIA). Promotion of Administrative Justice Act (PAJA). Computer literacy (Microsoft Office package). Communication Skills (verbal and written). Planning and organising skills. Knowledge and experience in pension administration and leave management.
jobs.duties: Provide Service Conditions and Employee Benefits. Administer Service Terminations. Capture service terminations on PERSAL timeously. Complete and ensure correct submission of pension forms including nominations forms. Follow-up on all outstanding pension claims with Government Employees Pension Fund (GEPF). Advise deceased employee’s family to claim funeral benefits from GEPF. Capture transactions such as but not limited to housing payment of all allowances etc. Administer leave matters. Implement leave transactions and ensure the correct codes are used on PERSAL and on VIP system. Ensure leave applications comply with policies and prescripts. Ensure proper administration of incapacity leave. Draft circulars and make necessary arrangements pertaining road shows/ information sessions regarding conditions of service.
jobs.applications: All applications should be emailed to the specified email address. The name of the post and reference number must be indicated in the email subject line. Applications should be sent as one PDF document, without any qualifications. No Faxed applications will be accepted. Applications that do not comply with the above specifications will be disqualified. Email: Applications.central@umfolozi.edu.za
jobs.notes: A fully completed new Z83 form (in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022), obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.dpsa.gov.za, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Copies of qualifications and other relevant documents must not be included in the application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications on the day of the interview. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates. A separate application must be submitted for each post that you are applying for. Late applications (received after closing date and time) and incomplete applications will not be considered. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender and disability). The Employer reserves the right not to make an appointment. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills test. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. zu.title: IT Technician
zu.summary: Nikeza inkxaso yedesktoptop nethi-hardware ye-IT okubandakanya ukumiswa lwe-akhawunti yomsebenzisi, ukusetha kwakhona amagama okungena, iibhakaphu kunye nencekwaba ye-antivirus eRandfontein Campus.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric/Grade12 okanye okulingana nesikhathi sekhosi esingu-3 yasezikoleni i-Diploma noma i-Degree kwi-Information Technology/ Computer Science noma noma yisiphi esinye iziqu ehambisana nalokhu. Kumele ube nolunye uhlolojikelele iminyaka engu-1 kuya kwaye ngu-2 yamava wokusebenza kulo mnyaka wezezimali. Kumele ube namalayisense wokushayela osebenzayo. Kumele ube nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono, Ulwazi, Namandla: Kumele ube nolwazi kwaye uqonde i-hardware nesoftware ye-IT. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngezikhathi ezibekiweyo, zenethiwekhi, nolwazi ngokunxibelelwana ngelizwi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngenkqubo yedesktoptop, yenethiwekhi, nakolwazi lwemijoliso. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukusebenza kwe-help desk ye-IT kwaye nakufakwa inkqubo. Ulwazi ngamagosa okuqala neyokunye ilayini yonikezelo. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-MIS, BAS, PERSAL, COLTECH nanantoni na i-desktop systems ekhoyo. Kufuneka ube namandla ethile okunxibelelwana, okulawula isikhathi, ukubhala iingxelo, ukuzonakalisa iingxaki, ukuzinikezela kumxhasi, ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba, ukukhokela iqela, amandla okulawula abantu. Mandla okunxibelelana neenkonzo ezinikezela inkonzo.
zu.duties: Hlela akhawunti yomsebenzisi kudesktoptop ngekhomphyutha ethi laptop (ibhokisi le-imeyili kanye nawayindowsi). Kukhishwe iphasiwedi kusetshenziswa i-Admin Pack. Ukuhlela idesktoptop, abaphrinti, kanye nabaprojektha bedatha. Sicusa ekugcineni ikhathalogu yesevisi nendlela ezilandeleka yokusebenza. Yenza amakhophi okulondolozwa kolwazi, ukusekela i-antivirus nokulondolozwa kwenye indawo. Yeka ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlolwa kokubonakalayo. Sekela ukutholakala kwezinsiza ze-imeyili, izinsiza ze-intanethi, nezinsiza zohlelo kudesktoptop kanye nokutholakala kokuxhumana nomtholamshini wongqongo. Yenza imisebenzi yokufaka, ukuhlela, ukuhlola nokwenza ngaphezulu okungase kudinge ucwaningo kanye nokuqonda. Qinisekisa ukubeka amakhebula e-ntanethi. Yenza ukufaka ama-PC kanye nokufaka izinhlelo. Nikeza ukusekela ngobuchwepheshe ekuhleni, ukufakeni, ukulungiseni nasekushintsheni khomphyutha, abaphrinti, namafoni. Nikeza ukusekela ekushintshweni kwedatha ngenkathi kuhlelwa khomphyutha. Nikeza izinsiza zokuphathwa kolwazi lwe-IT. Hlela,uthuthuse futhi uthuthukise izinhlelo zolwazi ezusekelwe khomphyutheni. Gcina izinhlelo zokuphathwa kolwazi njengesisekelo sedatha ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukwethembeka nokuphepha kwedatha. Nikeza usizo kumisebenzi yephrojekthi ephathelene ne-ICT. Siza ekuthuthukiseni, ekusebenziseni, nasekuqaphelelweni kwezinqubomgomo ze-ICT.

xh.title: Ummanduli we-IT
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yedesktop nobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha kuquka ukumiswa kwe-akhawunti yomsebenzisi, ukutshintsha amagama okungena, amakhophi angabuyiswa nanceda ekubeni kubekho ubulawu-bebagundi kwiRandfontein Campus.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethda seMatric/Grade12 kunye neDiploma yaseLizwe yeminyaka emi-3 evunyiweyo okanye iDegree kwiNzululwazi lolwazi / iNzululwazi leKhompyutha okanye naniphi na izifundo ezizelelo ezihambelana nalo. Kufuneka abe nomvuzo opheleleyo weminyaka eyi-1 ukuya kwi-2 yamava okusebenza ezahambelana nenkqubo yolwazi lwesikhokelo. Kufuneka abe nelayisense yokushayela esebenzayo. Kufuneka akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iikhompetensi, ulwazi, nakhono: Kufuneka abe nolwazi nakuqonda ngohwebo bakho nobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha kunye nesoftware. Ulwazi nakuqonda nge desktop, nethiwekhi, kunye nomgaqo-siseko wonxibelelwano ngelizwi. Ulwazi nakuqonda nokuqhuba idesksi yoncedo lolwazi nolwazi lokuphumeza iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngokwexesha lokuthintela nokuqwalasela ulwazi lwesikhokelo kwiNkqubo yoLawulo lwamaQabane apho kwenziwa iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi nakuqonda ngesiphithiphithi seMIS, BAS, PERSAL, COLTECH kunye nazo zonke iinkqubo zolawulo lwamagama ahlobene nekhompyutha. Makabe nokuzipatha kakuhle, ukulawula ixesha, ukubhala iingxelo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukujolisa kumthengi, ukucwangcisa, ukuqulunqa, ukulawula iqela, nakhono lolawulo lwabantu. Akwazi ukunxibelelana nabahanisi benkonzo.
xh.duties: Misa iakhawunti yomsebenzisi kwidesktop nelaptop (ibhokisi yeposi nwindows). Kuvalwe amagama agqithiswayo kusetyenziswa iAdmin Pack. Misela idesktop, abaphinti, kunye nabagcinisi bedatha. Nceda ukugcina ikhathalogu yenkonzo kunye neendlela ezisemthethweni zokusebenza. Yenza iibhakaphu zelwazi, inkxaso yobulawu-bebagundi nokugcinwa kwindawo engaphandle. Yenza ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda iimbangela. Xhasa ukufumaneka kweenkonzo ze-imeyile, iinkonzo ze-intanethi, iinkonzo zesicelo kwisixhobo sokusebenza nokuza kufumaneka konxibelelwano kunye nenkqubo yendalo egqithiswayo. Yenza umsebenzi wokumisa, uqwalaselo, ukuqwalasela nokuhlaziya onokufuna uphando nolanalo. Qinisekisa intambo yenethiwekhi. Yenza ukumisa kwePC nokumisa kwesoftware. Yonke inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ekumiseni, uqwalaselweni, kulungisweni nokuze kubekho ezitsha kwiikhompyutha, abaphinti, kunye namatelefon. Yonke inkxaso ekuthuthweni kwedatha ngelixa kumiswa ikhompyutha. Yenza iinkonzo zolawulo lwelwazi le-IT. Cwangcisa, yaphula izinto kwaye uluhlaze iinkqubo zolwazi ezisekwe kwikhompyutha. Gcina iinkqubo zolawulo lwelwazi ezinjengedatabase ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuchaneka nokhuseleko lwedatha. Yonke inkxaso kwimisebenzi yamaphulo ehlobene ne-ICT. Nceda ekuphuhliseni, ukuphumezeni, nokuqwalaseleni iinkqabo ze-ICT.

af.duties: Koördineer studentbeurskemas en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste vir finansiële hulp op die sentrum. Administreer die aansoekprosesse vir beurs- en finansiële hulpskemas vir die sentrum in ooreenstemming met NSFAS-riglyne, funder se MOU/SLA en beleide. Hersien aansoeke om finansiële hulp. Analiseer voorwaardelik gefinansierde NSFAS-studente. Koördineer die magtiging van uitbetalingsfondse. Fasiliteer ander finansiële hulpskemas. Rapporteer oor alle beurs- en finansiële hulptoekenings aan die komitee vir finansiële hulp en ander belanghebbendes. Tydige oplaai van alle studentbeursaansoeke op die NSFAS-portaal insluitend die indiening van enige addisionele inligting/dokumente wat deur NSFAS vereis word om alle aansoeke suksesvol te verwerk. Afstemming van opgelaaide data op NSFAS, met Pastel en Coltech maandeliks insluitend die opvolg van alle uitstaande sake.

zu.title: Abaphathi be-Financial Aid/bursary Officers
zu.summary: Abaphathi bezimali zokwesekwa bahlela izinhlela zamasidi yezifundi kanye nezicelo ze-NSFAS kumakhabhu amane e-West Rand.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric/Grade12 kahle nge-National Diploma yeminyaka engu-3 evunyiwe noma i-Degree kwi-Financial Management/Accounting noma noma yisiphi esinye isidingo esihambisana nalokhu. Kufanele ube nopilo lokuqasha olungu-2 kuya kwengu-3 emisebenzini ehambisana nemisebenzi yamabusari / imali yokwesekwa. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza ngobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha. Kufanele ube namalayisensi okushayela ahambisana nemigomo. Ikhono, ulwazi, nemakhono: Kufanele ube ulwazi oluyisisekelo nokuqonda okuhambisana nemisebenzi yezimali, imikhakha yokuqashwa kanye nethonya elokhu lokugcina idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nokuqoqa izibalo zezimali. Ulwazi ngemithetho yezimali yomphakathi, inqubo nemikhawulo ye-Treasury Regulations (i-PFMA, imikhawulo ye-NSFAS kanye nemikhakha kanye nemigomo yokuqashwa kwezimali). Ulwazi ngemikhakha yezimali ebonakalayo. Kufanele ube nokuqonda okuhle okukhulunywayo nokubhalwayo, amakhono alula okubala, ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi evamile, ikhono lokusebenzisa izinto zokusebenza ofisini, ukuguquguquka, ubudlelwano obuhle nomuntu, ukuqiniseka kanye nokuqonda amanani.
zu.duties: Hlela izinhlela zamasidi yezifundi nemisebenzi yomculo ongemuva kwezimali enkampusini. Phatha inqubo yokuqasha amasidi kanye nesicelo sezimali zokwesekwa ezinkampusini ngokuhambisana nemikhawulo ye-NSFAS, isivumelwano sabanikazi bemali/SLA kanye namapholisi. Hlola izicelo ezimali zokwesekwa. Hlaziya izifundi ezifakiwe ngokwesikhashana e-NSFAS. Hlela imvume yokwabelwa ngemali. Phathisa eminye imikhakha yesimali yokwesekwa. Bika ngawo onke amabalwa amasidi nezimali zokwesekwa komkhandlu wezimali zokwesekwa kanye nabanye abahlolisiso. Layisha ngokushesha wonke amasidi ezifundi ephathelwa ne-NSFAS portal kufaka phakathi ukuthumela noma yisiphi isiqikizi esingaphezulu/izibhamu ezidingwa yi-NSFAS ukuze kwenziwe ngempumelelo wonke izicelo. Ukuhambisana kwedatha elayishiwe e-NSFAS, ne-Pastel kanye ne-Coltech nyanga zonke kufaka phakathi ukulandela wonke amaphoyisa aphuma phandle.

xh.title: Abaphathi beNkxaso yeMali/abursary
xh.summary: Abaphathi benkxaso yemali baqondanisa amacebo obursary abafundi namagepha abasetyenziswa abakhethiweyo a-4 iWest Rand.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric/Grade12 kunye neDiploma yesizwe esamkelweyo yeminyaka elithathu okanye iDegree kuFinancial Management/Accounting okanye naniphi na ezinye iimviwo ezifanelekileyo. Makabe nenguqu yeminyaka elingama-2 ukuya kweli-3 yamava ebalo ngokubhekisele kumasebenzi obursary / enkxaso yemali. Makabe nelwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Makabenelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ikhono, ulwazi, namakhono: Makabe nolwazi olusisiseko nokuqonda iinkalo zemali, amasiko nakho nokuba nokhono lokungenisa idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zemali. Ulwazi ngemithetho yemali kwiPublic Service, iinkqubo kunye namagqabantshintshe eTreasury Regulations (PFMA, iinkqubo zokuqondisa iNSFAS namasiko kunye namagqabantshintshe oLawulo lweMali). Ulwazi ngamajelo abonelelo abalulekileyo, usetyenziso lwemali. Makabe nobulongwe bolwimi nolubhaliweyo olulungele, amakhono abalo asisiseko, ukhono lokwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo, ukhono lokusebenzisa izixhobo zofiso, ukuguqu-guquka, ukuhlobana nabantu, ukuchaneka nokuzalwa ngokubala.
xh.duties: Qondanisa amacebo obursary abafundi kunye namasebenzi abalulekileyo enkxaso yolawulo cebo kwiCampus. Lawula iinkqubo zokusetyenziswa kwamacebo obursary nobuncwane benkxaso yemali kwicampus ngokwemigaqo yeNSFAS, funder MOU/SLA namagqabantshintshe. Phonononga isicelo senkxaso yemali. Sikhangele abafundi abaxhaswa ngokuqhelekileyo yiNSFAS. Qondanisa igunya lokuhlawula imali. Qedisa amanye amacebo enkxaso yemali. Xela ngawo onke amabi awabursary negalelo lenkxaso yemali kwikomiti enkxaso yemali nakubanye abantu ababalulekileyo. Ukulayisha ngexesha elifanelekileyo nawo onke amagqabenkqubo obursary abafundi kwiporthali yeNSFAS kuquka nokuthumela nanayo nayiphi na iinkcukacha/zixhobo ezifunekayo yiNSFAS ukuqhubela phambili ngempumelelo nawo onke amagqabenkqubo. Ulungiselelano lwedata elayishiweyo kwiNSFAS, ngePastel neColtech nyanga zonke kuquka nokulandela nawo onke amabinzima angaphelelwayo.

jobs.title: Administrative Clerks: Finance
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Carletonville Campus Ref No: CARL/FINANCE/10 Krugersdorp West Campus Ref No: KW/FINANCE/11
jobs.summary: Two administrative finance clerks needed at Carletonville and Krugersdorp West campuses to handle invoices, payments and student debt management.
jobs.requirements: Matric/Grade12 Certificate plus a recognised 3-year National Diploma or Degree in Finance/Financial Accounting/ Cost and Management Accounting / Internal Auditing or any other relevant qualification. Must be computer literate. Competencies, Knowledge, And Skills: Must have basic knowledge of financial functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collate financial statistics. Basic knowledge of the Public Service financial legislations, procedures, and Treasury Regulations (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Knowledge of basic financial operation, ability to perform adequately and methodically under pressure. Knowledge of COLTECH, SAGE evolution and other relevant business information management systems. Should have good administrative, basic numeracy, accuracy, people management, communication, problem solving, planning, and organising skills.
jobs.duties: Render financial accounting transactions, receive invoices, check correctness, verification, and approval and submitting for payment. Process invoices (capture payments). Follow-up on all outstanding student debts including clearing of student unknown deposit accounts. Prepare monthly debt management report on outstanding debts, recoveries. Reconcile campus tuition fee bank account. Submitting all refund and overpayments to Corporate for processing. Capturing all procurement requests on Pastel and follow through with procurement management. Assist in administration and controlling of petrol cards and college car bookings of all vehicles issued to campus (vehicles and generators). Assist with the coordination of bursary allocations. Administer the ordering of stationery and textbooks. Issue textbooks to students. Record issued stock. Conduct regular fixed asset verification ensuring all assets barcoded, correct details captured (location, description) and reconciled with Fixed Assets Register (moveable and immoveable) Administer and record the movement of all assets on the fixed assets register. Identify all unusable and obsolete assets. Ensure completeness and accuracy of the fixed asset register for the annual external audit preparation.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Hlatshwayo/Mr P Motai Tel No: (011) 692 4004, Ext. 1010/1061/1062
jobs.applications: Please hand deliver your application or email it to: Admin Clerk: Finance (Carletonville) – carlfinclerk@westcol.co.za Admin Clerk: Finance (Krugersdorp West) – kwfinclerk@westcol.co.za in a pdf format and as one attachment, quoting the relevant reference number to the Principal, Western TVET College, Corporate Office, 42 Johnstone Street, Randfontein, 1760.
jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed New Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by a SAQA evaluation report. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. If you have not been contacted within six months after the closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Successful candidates will be subjected to a vetting and financial disclosure process (criminal record, citizenship, qualification verification and employment verification). People living with disability are encouraged to apply. If you have not been contacted within six months after closing date, please consider your application as unsuccessful. Western TVET College is an equal opportunities employer and reserves the right not to fill the posts. People with disability are encouraged to apply. Please ensure that the Z83 form is completed in full. Incomplete Z83 will be disqualified.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerke: Finansies
af.summary: Twee administratiewe finansieklerke word benodig by Carletonville en Krugersdorp West-kampusse om fakture, betalings en bestuur van studenteskuld te hanteer.
af.requirements: Matriek/Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jarige Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Finansies/Finansiële Rekeningkunde/Koste- en Bestuursrekeningkunde/Interne Oudit of enige ander relevante kwalifikasie. Moet rekenaargeletterd wees. Bevoegdhede, Kennis, En Vaardighede: Moet basiese kennis van finansiële funksies, praktyke hê asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaar te bedien en finansiële statistiek bymekaar te maak. Basiese kennis van die Openbare Diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosedures, en Tesourie-regulasies (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Finansiële Handleiding). Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryf, vermoë om adequately en metodies onder druk te presteer. Kennis van COLTECH, SAGE evolution en ander tersaaklike besigheidsinligtingbestuurstelsels. Behoort goeie administratiewe, basiese syferkundigheid, akkuraatheid, mensebestuur, kommunikasie, probleemoplossing, beplanning, en organisatoriese vaardighede te hê.
af.duties: Lewer finansiële rekeningkundige transaksies, ontvang fakture, kontroleer korrektheid, verifiëring, en goedkeuring en dien in vir betaling. Proseseer fakture (lê betalings vas). Opvolging op alle uitstaande studenteskuld insluitend die skraping van studente se onbekende depositorekeninge. Stel maandelikse skuldbestuursverslag op oor uitstaande skuld, herstnings. Rekonsilieer kampus se studiegeldbankrekening. Dien alle terugbetalings en oorbetaling by Korporatief in vir verwerking. Lê alle verkrygingsversoeke op Pastel vas en volg dit deur met verkrygingsbestuur. Bied hulp met administrasie en beheer van petrolkaarte en kollege-motorbesprekings van alle voertuie aan kampus uitgereik (voertuie en genereerders). Bied hulp met die koördinering van beurs toekenning. Administreer die bestelling van skryfbehoeftes en handboeke. Reik handboeke aan studente uit. Lys uitgereikte voorraad. Voer gereelde vaste-bate-verifikasie uit om te verseker alle bates is strepieskoodged, korrekte besonderhede is vasgevang (ligging, beskrywing) en is rekonsilieer met die vastebatesregister (roerbaar en onroerend) Administreer en lys die beweging van alle bates op die vastebatesregister. Identifiseer alle onbruikbare en verouderde bates. Verseker volledigheid en akkuraatheid van die vastebatesregister vir die voorbereiding van die jaarlikse eksterne oudit.

zu.title: Abakliniki Bokuphathwa: Izimali
zu.summary: Badingwa abakliniki ababili bezimali abaphathwa kahle emakhasi ase-Carletonville nase-Krugersdorp West ukuphatha amanothi okukhokha, izinkokhelo kanye nokuphathwa kwezikweletu zabafundi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric/Grade12 kahlanganise ne-Diploma yezwe elimyaka ngeminyaka eyi-3 noma i-Degree kwezimali/ukuBhalwa kwezimali/ iNani kanye nokuPhathwa kwezimali / ukuPhepha ngangaphakathi noma noma iyiphi enye izifiso efanayo. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono, ulwazi, namakhono: Kufanele ube lolwazi oluyisisekelo ngemisebenzi yezimali, izindlela zokwenza kanye nethuba lokubhala imininingwane, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zezimali. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemithetho yezimali yesevisi kazwelonke, izinqubo, kanye Nezimiso zeTreasury (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, iFinancial Manual). Ulwazi ngokusebenza kwezimali okuyisisekelo, ikhono lokusebenza kahle ngokulandelana phansi koxinzelelo. Ulwazi nge-COLTECH, i-SAGE evolution kanye namanye amasistimu afanele okuphathwa kolwazi lwebhizinisi. Kufanele ube namakhono obulungile okuphathwa, ukuqonda izibalo ngokuyisisekelo, ukunemba, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuxhumana, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukulungiselela, kanye nokuhlela.
zu.duties: Hlela izinkokhelo zezimali, amukela amanothi okukhokha, hlola ukuthi zilungile, qinisekisa, vuluma bese uzithumela ukuba zikhokhwe. Phatha amanothi okukhokha (bhala izinkokhelo). Landa konke ukwehluleka kwabafundi ekubhaleni izikolwa kuhlanganise nokusula ama-akhawunti abafundi ezingaziwa ukuthi ngobani bakhokhe. Lungiselela umbiko wenyanga ngokuphathwa kwesikweletu mayelana nezikweletu ezingakhokhiwe nokubuyiswa kwemali. Hambisanisa i-akhawunti yasekhempasini yokufunda ibhange. Thumela konke ukubuyiswa kwemali nokukhokha kakhulu e-Corporate ukuze kuphathwe. Bhala konke izicelo zokuthenga ku-Pastel bese ulandela ngokuphathwa kokuthenga. Siza ekuphathweni nasekulawulen iikhadi zepetrol kanye nokubeka amakolishi amimoto wonke amimoto anikiwe isikhungo (imoto kanye nama-jeneretha). Siza ekubambisweni kwezabelo zamabhasa. Phatha ukulandelwa kokuthenga kwamapensela namabhuku. Aba namabhuku abafundi. Bala izinto ezinikiwe. Yenza ukubekwa kwezimpahla ezihlala njalo kuqinisekisa ukuthi wonke amaphuzu ezimpahla abhalwe ngamakhodi, imininingwane efanele ibhalwe (indawo, incazelo) futhi ihambisane noLuhlu Lwezimpahla Ezibekiwe (ezihambahambayo noma ezingahambahambayo) Phatha futhi ubale ukunyuka nokuhamba kwazo zonke izimpahla kuluhlu lwazo. Khomba wonke izimpahla ezingasebenzi futhi ezize ngokwazo. Qinisekisa ukugqamiswa nokulunga koluhlu lwezimpahla ezihlala njalo ngokulungiselela ukuphengwa kwangaphandle konyaka.

xh.title: Ababali BoMphatho: IzeMali
xh.summary: Kufuneka ababali bomphatho bemali ababini kwikhampasi zaseCarletonville naseKrugersdorp West ukubala iinvoices, iinkokhelo nokulawula amatyala abafundi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethdi seMatric/Grade12 kakunye nedi-ploma yesizwe ezifunwayo yeminyaka-3 okanye idigri kwiFinance/Financial Accounting/ Cost and Management Accounting / Internal Auditing okanye nangolunye ulwazi oluhambelanayo. Kufuneka ube nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla, ulwazi, namakhono: Kufuneka ube nolwazi olusisiseko lweemisebenzi yemali, amaqela nakho nokuqhuba iinkcukacha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nakugqitha iisampulu zemali. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemithetho yemali yesebe lenkonzo, iinkqubo, kunye neTreasury Regulations (PFMA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Ulwazi lweemisebenzi esisiseko yemali, amandla okwenza ngokwaneleyo nangokulandela inkqubo phantsi komthwalo. Ulwazi ngeCOLTECH, SAGE evolution nakwelinye iinkqabo zolawulo lolwazi lwebhizinisi. Kufuneka ube namakhono olawulo oluhle, ukubala okusisiseko, ukuchanekileyo, ulawulo labantu, unxibelelwano, ukuxazulula iingxaki, ukuca, nokulungiselela.
xh.duties: Zenza iintengiso zovimba weemali, wamkela iinvoices, ukuqinisekisa ukuchanekileyo, ukuqinisekisa, nokugunyazisa ukuze zingeniswe ngenxa yokuhlawulwa. Ukuqhuba iinvoices (ukufaka iinkokhelo). Ukulandela onke amatyala abafundi angazalwanga kubandakanya nokucotha i-akhawunti zegcino elingaziwayo labafundi. Ulungelela ingxelo yenyanga yokulawula amatyala ngeentyala ezingazalwanga, ezibuyiselwayo. Ukuyamanisa iakhawunti yebhanki yefee yemfundo yekhampasi. Ukungenisa zonke iimbuyekezo kunye neendiphiso ezidlulileyo kwi-Corporate ukwenziwa kwenkqubo. Ukufaka zonke iimfuno zokuthenga kwi-Pastel kwaye uzilandele nkolawulo lokuthenga. Ukuncedisa kulawulo nolawulo lwekhadi lepetrol kunye nokubhuka iimoto zekholeji zonke iimoto ezinikiwe kwikhampasi (iimoto kunye nejenereyitha). Ukuncedisa nokulungelelanisa ukwabiwa kwe-bursaries. Ukulawula ukuodisa amaxwebhu okubhala kunye nezibhalo. Ukupha abafundi izibhalo. Ukugcina isitokhwe esinikiweyo. Ukuqhuba ukuqinisekisa ngokuqhubekayo impahla egqithisiweyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke impahla inebakhodi, iinkcukacha ezichanekileyo zifakiwe (indawo, inkcazelo) kwaye ziyamaniswe ne-Fixed Assets Register (ezihambahambayo kunye nongaahambahambi) Ukulawula kwaye ugqibe iintshukumo zonke impahla kwirejista yempahla egqithisiweyo. Ukuqaphela yonke impahla engasetyenziswa nengasebenzi. Ukuqinisekisa ukugqitywa nokuchanekileyo kwerejista yempahla egqithisiweyo ngolungelelwaniso lonyaka lokuqingqamba kwangaphandle.

af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Administrasiedienste
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk gesoek by Randfontein-kampus om studenteregistrasieprosesse te administreer, wat 'n diploma of graad in publieke administrasie of 'n verwante veld vereis.
af.requirements: Matriek/Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Publieke Administrasie/Bestuursassistent/Kantoorbestuur en Tegnologie of enige ander relevante kwalifikasie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees. Bevoegdhede, Kennis, En Vaardighede: Moet kennis en begrip van die registrasieprosesse en -prosedures hê. Vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en agtergronde te kommunikeer. Moet kennis van skakelbordbedryf hê. Moet goeie telefoonetiket hê. Vermoë om data vas te vang. Behoort goeie organisatoriese vaardighede te hê, beplanning, organisering, kommunikasie, kliëntediens en verslagskryfvaardighede. Hoë vlak van integriteit en lojaliteit.
af.duties: Administreer en help met studenteregistrasieprosesse in ooreenstemming met die kollege se Standaard Bedryfsprosedures (SOP's). Vang en verifieer studentinligting op die Besigheidsbestuurstelsel (BMS) vas. Druk en versprei kontrollyste en klasregister. Verifieer data voordat dit aan die Departement van Hoër Onderwys en Opleiding (DHET) voorgelê word. Sif en verwerk aanlyn aansoeke. Hanteer student- en publieke navrae. Bedryf die kampus se skakelbord en rig oproepe behoorlik. Vang studentpunte en afwesigheid akkuraat vas. Hou opgedateerde studentakademiese rekords en verseker dat alle inligting veilig gestoor en op aanvraag toeganklik is. Vasvanging en administrasie van rekwisisievorms, ontvang goedere en dienste, verifieer aflewerings teen toepaslike dokumente, en volg uitstaande bestellings na. Verseker behoorlike dokumentasie en lêerwerk vir alle verkrygingverwante transaksies op kampusvlak. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste (toepassing van kollegebeurse) aan die kampusbestuurspan.

zu.title: Admin Clerk: Administration Services
zu.summary: Kufunwa iclerk yolawulo eRandfontein Campus ukuze iphathe iinkqubo zokuqunjwa kwesitudeni, idinga idiploma okanye idigri kwilawulo koluntu okwenzana nako.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samatrikulu/Okwabanga le-12 kanye nesidiploma sezwe esihloniphekwe seminyaka eyi-3 noma idigri kuPublic Administration/Management Assistant/Office Management and Technology noma nanoma yisiphi esinye isiqu esihambisana. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile izoba yinzuzo. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda, ulwazi kanye namakhono: Kumele ube nolwazi nokuqonda imikhuba kanye nendlela yokwenza ukuqunjwa. Ukukwazi ukuxhumana kahle nabantu abangezizingeni ezahlukene nasemvelweni ehlukene. Kumele ube nolwazi lokuqhuba iswichibhodi. Kumele ube nobuhlakani obuhle bokusebenzisa ucingo. Ukukwazi ukufaka idatha. Kumele ube namakhono okuhlelela, ukuphepha, ukuqamba, ukuhlelela, ukuxhumanisa, amasimomsebenzi nakhasimende kanye noku-fayela. Izinga eliphakeme lokuqina futhi abelwe, kwaye nokuzinikela.
zu.duties: Lawula futhi usize ngemikhuba yokuqunjelwa kwabafundi ngokulandela izinqamulelo ezivamile zokuqhuba (Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)) zesikole. Faka futhi uhlole ulwazi lwabafundi kusistimu yokuphatha ibhizinisi (Business Management System (BMS)). Shicilela futhi uluhlelele izinhlu zolawulo nezithombe zabanumzane bamakilasi. Hlola idatha ngaphambi kokuyinikeza uMnyango weMfundo ePhakeme noqeqesho (Department of Higher Education and Training (DHET)). Hlola futhi ucusse izicelo ezithunyelwe inthanethi. Phendula imibuzo yabafuni nokuyimiphakathi. Phepha iswichibhodi yesikhungo futhi uqondise amakholi endlela efanele. Faka ngokunembile amamaki kabafundi nokungele kokuhamba kwesikole. Gcina amarekhodi ezemfundo zabafundi abahlanzekile futhi wonke ulwazi lugcinwe ngokuphepha futhi lutholakale lapho kudingeka. Ukuhlanganiswa nokulawula amafomu esicelo, ukwamukela izimpahla kanye nasezinsizeni, ukuhlola ukulethwa ngokwezixhumanisi ezifanele, kanye nokulandela izimbestelo ezingakakho. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa okulungile kanye nokulondoloza amafomu kuzo zonke izinkomba eziyisibopho ngamakhono ezinketho emazingeni esikhungo. Nikeza amasiza abaphathi ngokomsebenzi (kufakwa kwamabhasari esikole) eqenjini labaphathi bas esikhungweni.

xh.title: Umlawuli weofisi: Iinkonzo zoLawulo
xh.summary: Kufunwa umlawuli weofisi kwiRandfontein Campus ukulawula iinkqubo zokubhalisa abafundi, kufuneka abe neDiploma okanye iDegree kolawulo lukarhulumente okanye kwelinye ibhalwe elinxulumene nalo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samatikuletsheni / Isatifikethi seGrade 12 negunya leminyaka elithathu iDiploma yezizwe okugunyazisiweyo okanye iDegree kuLawulo lukaRhulumente / Ncedo lokuLawula / uLawulo loBume kunne nobuThungelwane okanye naziphi na ezinye izifundo ezifanelekileyo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela evakalayo kuya kuba lusazo olongezelelweyo. Kufuneka ukwazi kusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono, ulwazi, nanamava: Kufuneka ube nolwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo nemigaqo yobhaliso. Ikakhono lokuchazachaza kakuhle nabantu abakwinqanaba nembali ezahlukeneyo. Kufuneka ube nolwazi ngokusebenza kweswitchboard. Kufuneka ube namava amahle efonini. Ikakhono lokubamba idatha. Kufuneka ube namava olwakhiweyo lokuqamba, ukucwangcisa, ukwakha, ukuchazachaza, iinkonzo zabathengi nanamava okubhala iingxelo. Inqanaba eliphezulu lokuzithembisa nokuqina.
xh.duties: Lawula uncedo kumisebenzi yobhaliso lwabafundi ngokwemigaqo esemthethweni yabasebenzi (SOPs) yekholeji. Bamba uqinisekise ulwazi lwabafundi kwinkqubo yoLawulo loShishino (BMS). Printa aze abhalise uluhlu lolawulo namarejista ekilasi. Qinisekisa idatha phambi kokuyinikela kuSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha (DHET). Hlola aze acubungule iimfuneko ezikwi-intanethi. Phendula imibuzo yabafundi noluntu. Sebenzisa iswitchboard yesikolo aze aqondise iicolekwayo ngokufanelekileyo. Bamba ngokuchanekileyo amanqaku nabafundi abangekhoyo. Gcina amarejista abafundi abahlaziyiweyo aze aqinisekise ukuba yonke imiba igcinwe ngokukhuselekileyo nendlela ifikelelwa xa kufuneka. Ukubamba nolawulo lweefomu eziceliweyo, wamkela izinto neenkonzo, uqinisekisa ukuba iziphetho ziyahambelana namaxwebhu ahambelanayo, aze ulandele iiodolo ezingagqitywanga. Qinisekisa uxwebhu oluchanekileyo nokugcina kwamafxahu oonxaxheba bokuthenga onqanaba lesikolo. Nikeza iinkonzo zolawulo (ukufaka iibhasari zekholeji) kqeqesho leqela elilawula isikolo.

jobs.title: Admin Clerk: Marketing and Communication

jobs.summary: Admin clerk supporting marketing, promotions, branding, public relations and event coordination at a higher education corporate office.

Relevant work experience in marketing or communications will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s license will be an added advantage. Must be computer literate. Competencies, Knowledge, And Skills: Knowledge of social media practice and channels. Understanding of the importance of brand guidelines, graphic design and applying across a range of channels. Knowledge and understanding of stakeholder management. Knowledge of events management. Knowledge and understanding of website maintenance Knowledge of policies and governance environment of TVET Colleges including knowledge of the annual reporting requirements by the Higher Education Institutions. Knowledge and understanding of digital marketing.
jobs.duties: Assist in marketing, promotions and branding services. Assist in the coordination of public relations and media liaison services. Assist in the coordination of photographic services and drafting of articles. Assist in the coordination of college events and communication administration services. Assist in updating the content, design and layout of the college website.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Hlatshwayo/Mr P Motai Tel No: (011) 692 4004, Ext. 1010/1061/1062
jobs.applications: Please hand deliver your application or email it to Admin Clerk: Marketing and Communication Corporate – corpadmin@westcol.co.za in a pdf format and as one attachment, quoting the relevant reference number to the Principal, Western TVET College, Corporate Office, 42 Johnstone Street, Randfontein, 1760.
jobs.notes: All applications must be accompanied by a signed and fully completed New Z83 form obtainable from any public service Department or DPSA website, a comprehensive CV including at least three contactable references.
