af.title: Administratiewe Klerk: Bemarking en Kommunikasie
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk wat bemarking, bevorderings, handelsmerkvestiging, openbare betrekkinge en geleentheidskoördinering by 'n korporatiewe kantoor vir hoër onderwys ondersteun.
af.requirements: Matriek/Grade12-sertifikaat plus 'n erkende 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Kommunikasie/Bemarking/Openbare Betrekkinge. Relevante werkervaring in bemarking of kommunikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Moet rekenaarvaardig wees. Bevoegdhede, Kennis, en Vaardighede: Kennis van sosiale media-praktyk en -kanale. Begrip van die belang van handelsmerkriglyne, grafiese ontwerp en toepassing daarvan oor 'n verskeidenheid kanale. Kennis en begrip van belangehebbende-bestuur. Kennis van geleentheidbestuur. Kennis en begrip van webwerfonderhoud. Kennis van beleide en die bestuursomgewing van TVET Colleges, insluitend kennis van die jaarlikse verslagdoeningsvereistes deur die Hoër Onderwysinstellings. Kennis en begrip van digitale bemarking.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met bemarking, bevordering en handelsmerkdienste. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van openbare betrekkinge en mediakontakdienste. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van fotografiese dienste en die opstel van artikels. Bystand verleen met die koördinering van kollegegeleenthede en kommunikasie-administrasiedienste. Bystand verleen met die opdatering van die inhoud, ontwerp en uitleg van die kollege se webwerf.

zu.title: Ilikhirimende Lolawu: Izokumaketha Nokuxhumana
zu.summary: Ilikhirimende lolawu elisiza emisebenzini yokumaketha, ukukhuthaza, ukwakha uphawu lenkampani, ezokuxhumana nomphakathi kanye nokuhlanganisa imicimbi esikhungweni sehovisi lephakeme lemfundo.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Matric/Grade12 kahle nesidiploma sezwe izinkathi ezingu-3 esemthethweni noma iziqu eZokuxhumana/ezokuMaketha/ezokuxhumana nomphakathi. Ulwazi lomsebenzi ohlobene nomakethe noma ezokuxhumana kuzoba yinzuzo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni izoba yinzuzo. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono, ulwazi, namakhono: Ulwazi ngokwenza kwezokuxhumanana kwentengiso nendlela ezisetshenziswa kuzo. Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kokuhola kwephawu lenkampani, ukwakheka kwezithombe kanye nokusebenzisa kuzo zonke izindlela. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwabanomthwalo wemfanelo. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwemicimbi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukugcinwa kwesiza le-inthanethi. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemikhawulo yokuphathwa kwezinto kwezikhungo ze-TVET Colleges kufaka phakathi ulwazi ngezidingo zebiko lonyaka ezibekwa izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukumaketha okusekuyo.
zu.duties: Siza emisebenzini yokumaketha, ukukhuthaza nokwakha uphawu lenkampani. Siza ekuhlanganiseni imisebenzi yezokuxhumana nomphakathi nokuxhumana namamedia. Siza ekuhlanganiseni imisebenzi yokuthatha izithombe nokubhala izihloko. Siza ekuhlanganiseni imicimbi yekolishi nemisebenzi yolawulo yezokuxhumana. Siza ekubuyekeleni okuqukethwe, ukwakheka nekusasa lwesiza le-inthanethi lekolishi.

xh.title: Umntu olawula iofisi: Iindibano kunye nokuXhumana
xh.summary: Iofisi yamathala ende eburhulumente ethatha inxaxheba kumetho, ukukhuthaza, ukudibanisa uphawu, ubudlelwane nomphakathi kwaye ndicanise ekusingathweni kwemicimbi ofisi yerhwebo yemfundo ephakamileyo.
xh.requirements: Isetifikathi samatikiti lesi-12/Isigaba-12 plus idiploma yeliYive leminyaka emi-3 okanye idigri ekuqatshelwa kwiNdibano/Metho/Abaphathi baphambili bomphakathi. Ukuba namava wemisebenzi efanelekileyo kumetho okanye kwindibano kuya kuba luncedo. Ulayisenisi yomqhubi osebenzayo kuya kuba luncedo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha. Iakhoni, ulwazi, namakhono: Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwezikhululo zolonwabo social media. Ukuqonda ngokubaluleka kokulawula iingcebiso zophawu, ukudweba izinto ezibonakalayo kunye nokuzisebenzisa kumajoni ahlukeneyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokulawula abaphathi bomphakathi. Ulwazi lokulawula imicimbi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokulondolozwa kwewebhusayithi Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela yolawulo kolawulo lweKholeji ze-TVET kuquka ulwazi ngemfuno yexelo nyaka ziyiveliswa zizikhululo zemfundo ephakamileyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngometho wekhompyutha.
xh.duties: Nceda kwiinkonzo zemetho, ukukhuthaza kunye nokudibanisa uphawu. Nceda kuwo oyilwe abaphathi bancedisane koluntu nababali. Nceda kuwo oyilwe abaphathi bokuwathumba amathambookusetya idisaini nezibhalo. Nceda kuwo oyilwe abaphathi bemicimbi yekholeji nesezolwazi zolawulo. Nceda ekubuyeleleni iindaba, idisaini nobume be webhusayithi yekholeji.

af.title: Bestuurder/boodskapper
af.summary: Die Department of Higher Education and Training soek drie bestuurders en boodskappers om personeel en studente te vervoer, voertuie te onderhou, en pos te aflewer oor Carletonville, Randfontein, en korporatiewe kantore.
af.requirements: Graad 12/Matrieksertifikaat of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie plus 'n geldige Code 10 bestuurderslisensie. Moet 'n geldige Professionele Bestuurderspermit (PDP) hê. Moet 'n minimum van 1 tot 2 jaar se relevante werkervaring as 'n bestuurder hê. Bevoegdhede, Kennis, En Vaardighede: Moet basiese kennis en begrip hê van relevante wetgewing, voorskrifte, beleide en prosedures. Prosedure vir motoronderhoud van 'n motorkoetuis. Roetingskantoorondersteuning d.w.s. register. Sekondêre funksie van die maak van kopieë. Prosedure vir motoronderhoud. Prosedure om ritmagtiging te verkry. Voltooiing van logboek van die motorkoetuis. Optekening van brandstofverbruikbare goedere. Optekening van kilometerdienste. Bied boodskapperdienste aan. Moet uitstekende bestuursvaardighede hê. Moet in staat wees om plat bande te herstel of te vervang. Moet in staat wees om die voertuie skoon te maak. Moet bereid wees om buite kantoorure en oor naweke te werk. Sal vereis word om dienste oor alle kampusse/terreine te lewer.
af.duties: Bestuur ligte en mediumgrootte motorkoetuiies om passasiers (personeel en studente) te vervoer en ander items (pos en dokumente) te aflewer. Doen roetine-onderhoud aan die toegewysde voertuig en rapporteer gebreke betyds. Voltooi al die vereiste en voorgeskrewe rekords en logboeke aangaande die voertuig en die goedere wat hanteer word. Lewer 'n klerklike ondersteunings-/boodskapperdiens in die betrokke kantoor. Dit sal, onder andere, die volgende behels: Help in die register, kopieer en faks dokumente. Versamel en aflewer dokumentasie en verwante items in die departement.

zu.title: Ukuthutha/Ukuthuma
zu.summary: I-Department of Higher Education and Training ifuna abashayeli abathathu kanye nabathunywa ukuthi bathute abasebenzi kanye nabafundi, sigcine izimoto futhi silethe iposi kuwo wonke amakhempani Carletonville, Randfontein, namahhovu wobunikazi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade 12/Matric noma iziqu ezilinganayo kanye nelayisense yokushayela ye-Code 10 esevisayo. Kumele ubene-Professional Driving Permit (PDP) esevisayo. Kumele ube nohlu lohlelo olungu-1 kuya koshumi lweminyaka yohlu lokushayela. Ikhono, ulwazi, Namakhono abomothukuthe: Kumele ube nolwazi oluyisisekelo kanye nokuqonda kwezimo ezihambisanayo ngemithetho, imiyalo, izinqubomgomo kanye nendlela zokusebenza. Indlela yokulungisa kwezimoto. Ukuphatha inkonzo yohlelo kwikhasi lendawo yokusebenza. Umsebenzi wesibili wokwenza amakhophi. Indlela yokulungisa kwezimoto. Indlela yokuthola igunya lokuhamba. Qedela ibhuku lokuloga lesimoto. Ukubhala ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha. Ukubhala amakhilomitha. Ukunika inkonzo yokuthuma abanye. Kumele ube namakhono okushayela aphezulu. Kumele ukwazi ukulungisa noma ukushintsha amathaya abulewe. Kumele ukwazi ukuhlanza izimoto. Kumele ube nesimo sokusebenza emva wemiyalo nangamaphelowe. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza kulo lonke izifundo kumasayithi.
zu.duties: Qhuba izimoto ezingavamile nezilinganisi eziphakathi ukuthutha abagibeli (abasebenzi nabafundi) kanye nokuletha eminye imikhakha (iposi namadokhumenti). Yenza ukugcinwa okuvamile kwenkokhelo eznikeziwe futhi ubike iziphazamisi ngasikhathi sinye. Qedela yonke imibhalo eyedwa nemibhalo yokuloga mayelana nesimoto kanye nempahla ephathwayo. Yonke inkonzo yokusekela amalungu/abathunywa ebhokisini elihambelanayo. Lokhu kuzofaka phakathi kokulandelayo: Siza ebhokisini lenkokhelo, kopisha futhi uthumele ngefeksi amadokhumenti. Qoqa futhi ulethe imibhalo kanye nempahla ehambisanayo kuleso sikhundla.

xh.title: Umqhubi/umthunywa
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqesha lifuna abaqhubi abathathu nabathunywa ukuba bathuthabasebenzi nabafundi, bagcine iimoto, kwaye bahambise iposi kuyo yonke iCarletonville, iRandfontein, nakwiofisi ezikomkhulu.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seGreyidi 12/Matric okwesifanekiso esilinganayo negunyazisiweyo esongezelelwe ngelayisensi yokushayela iKhowudi 10. Kufuneka abe nelaysensi yokushayela gunyazisiweyo (PDP). Kufuneka abe nobugcisa bomsebenzi ongummandla obungaphantsi kweminyaka engama-1 ukuya kwa-2 njengomqhubi. Ikhono, ulwazi, Namakhono: Kufuneka abe nolwazi olusetyenziswa ngokwemigaqo nayimigaqo ebeka, izinto ezichaziweyo, iinkqubo kunye nemithetho. Indlela yokusingatha ithoyi kwaye igcinwe ilungile. Inkqubo yesixhaso esincinci esikwiofisi nokuba ngumkBali. Isiphako sesibini sokuqaqa izinto zokutshaya. Indlela yokusingatha ithoyi kwaye igcinwe ilungile. Indlela yokufumana igunya lokuhamba. Ukuqedela incwadi yokubala ithoyi. Ukuqamba amafutha aluncedo. Ukuqamba iikhilomitha ezenziwa ukuba kuhluzwe. Ukubonelela ngenkonzo yomthunywa. Kufuneka abe namakhono amakhulu okuqhuba. Kufuneka akwazi ukulungisa okutsha iithaya ezingenamdla. Kufuneka akwazi ukucoca iimoto. Kufuneka avume ukusebenza ngemini eza kwangaphaya kwamaxesha afanelekileyo nakwiintsuku zokuphumla. Uya kufunwa ukuba abonelele ngenkonzo kuzo zonke iindawo/zithuba.
xh.duties: Qhuba iimoto ezincinci nezikhulu ngobukhulu ukuzeuthutha abagqatswa (abasebenzi nabafundi) kunye nokuhamba nezinye izinto (iposi namaxwebhu). Zenza ukugqinwa okwesiqhelo kwithoyi enikiweyo kwaye ubike iziphako ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Qedela yonke imibhalo edityaniswayo nayemithetho malunga nethoyi kunye namathuba ahambisayo nayo. Zibonelela ngenceba yokulunga/inkonzo yomthunywa kwindawo ethintwe ngayo. Oku kuya kubandakanya, phakathi kwezinye, oku kulandelayo: Nceda kwifayili dosiye, ukhuphe iidokhumenti aze athumele ngefaeksi. Qokelela kwaye uhambise iidokhumenti nendlela ezingommandla kwisebe.

jobs.title: Handyman
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.centre: Corporate – Ref No: CORP/HANDYMAN/17 Randfontein – Ref No: RFT/HANDYMAN/18
jobs.summary: Handyman needed at Corporate office in Randfontein to maintain buildings, attend to minor repairs, and service office equipment and furniture.
jobs.requirements: ABET Level 4/Standard 8/Grade 10. Must have a minimum of 1 to 6 months relevant work experience in semi-skilled manual labour. A valid driver’s license will be an added advantage. Competencies, Knowledge, And Skills: Must have basic knowledge and understanding of building maintenance. Knowledge of infrastructure policies. Knowledge of relevant legislation, prescripts, policies and procedures. Knowledge of building laws. Safe keeping of tools. Storage requirement. Operating equipment. Must have good communication (verbal and written), reading, people management, office management, administration, analytical, problem-solving, planning and organising skills. Must be disciplined. Will be required to provide services across all campuses/sites.

Repair broken furniture and equipment. Ensure tools are cleaned and stored in a safe environment. Report defects. Safekeeping of maintenance tools and supplies. jobs.summary: Manage and process Permanent Residence Permit appeals at the Department of Home Affairs Head Office in Tshwane, requiring legal expertise and junior management experience.

Knowledge of the Constitution of South Africa. Knowledge and u021nderstanding of the Immigration Act and its regulations. Knowledge of Refugee Act. Knowledge of other Department’s policies, prescripts and practices. Understanding of International Conventions and protocols. Knowledge and understanding of Civil Aviation Organization. Broad knowledge and understanding of PFMA and Treasury regulations. Understanding of Public Service Act. Understanding of another relevant legislative framework. Knowledge and understanding of all departmental legislations and prescripts. Knowledge and understanding of Public Service Prescripts and Legislations. Willingness to travel and work extended hours. Required skills and competencies: People Management and Empowerment. Service Delivery Innovation. Client Orientation and Customer Focus. Manpower forecasting and planning. Financial Management. Honesty and integrity. Project Management. Communication. Decision Making. Influencing and Networking. Problem Solving and Conflict management. Business report Writing. Research Methodology. Presentation Skills. Planning and Organising. Strong Analytical Skills. Computer Literacy. Facilitation Skills. Negotiation Skills. Interpersonal Relations.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Manage the processing Permanent Residence Permit appeals. Ensure the effective management and handling of Permanent Residence Permit (PRP) appeals. Manage the review initial decisions, supporting documents, and relevant casefiles. Ensure and verify the completeness, accuracy, and legality of submitted. appeals applications. Manage and ensure that detailed assessments are conducted to determine whether a decision should be upheld, modified. Monitor deadlines and ensure decisions are issued within prescribed timelines. Establish and maintain good working relationship with all the relevant stakeholders regarding PRP appeals process. Implement effective risk and compliance on the processing PRP appeals in line with the relevant legislative prescripts. Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Unit. Coach and guide staff on best practices and compliance with regulatory requirements.

Bheka izinqumo ekuqaleni, amadokhumenti asekelayo, namahele wemicimbo ahambisana nendaba. Qinisekisa futhi qinisekisa ukuthi lokho okuwenziwe okuphikisayo okuthunyelwe kuqeda ngokugcwele, kuqiniseke ukuthi yiqiniso, futhi kusemthethweni. Bheka izinsuku zokuqedela futhi qinisekisa ukuthi izinqumo zinikwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe. Lungelelanise futhi gcine ubuhlobo obuhle bokusebenza bonke abantu abahlobene nale ndaba yokuphathwa kwezindaba eziphikisayo zokuvunyelwa ukuhlala isikhathi eside. Sebenzisa ukubhekwa kwezingozi nokuhambisana nomthetho ekucubungulweni kwezindaba eziphikisayo zokuvunyelwa ukuhlala isikhathi eside ngokuhambisana nemithetho ebekiwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele kokubhalisa, okomzimba, nezimali ngaphakathi kweQofo. Yala futhi khombisa abasebenzi ngendlela yokusebenza efanele nokuhambisana nezidingo zemithetho.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Iingxelo zokuphinda kwenziwe isigqibo

xh.duties: Umgqatswa opumeleleyo uyakuba nogxininiso lokwenza, phakathi kwabanye, oku kulandelayo: ukuphatha ucubungulo lweNgcaciso yoluntu ngokubakho kwePermit yoHlalo. Qinisekisa ukuZeza kwaye uqinisekise ukuba konke okufunekayo, ukuQinisekiswa, kwaye okusesiNqanaba ngokomthetho ekuQinisekiswa. Zisa kwaye uqinisekise uLawulo lweNgozi nokubakho koluntu kulwamkelo lokuNgena koluntu ngokwemigaqo yomthetho echanekileyo. Yalela kwaye ukhokise abasebenzi koluntu ngokwakha amava amakhulu kunye nokuQonda kwakhe konke ukwenzela uLawulo olunesiQalelo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: District Coordination
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 - R573 897 per annum (Level 09), (A basic salary package)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for District Coordination at the Department of Home Affairs in Mopani, responsible for facilitating district operations, monitoring budgets and performance to enhance service delivery.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Public Management, Administration, Public Management, Operations Management at NQF level 6 as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 3 years’ experience as a Senior Administrative Officer is required. Experience in coordination is required. Basic Knowledge of Civic Services and Immigration Acts. Understanding of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury regulations. Knowledge of Departmental Legislation as well as Human Resources Regulatory Framework. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulations. A valid drivers’ license. Willingness to travel and work extended hours. Required skills and competencies: Capability and Leadership. Service Delivery Innovation. Client Orientation and Customer Focus. People Management and Empowerment. Accountability. Business Continuity. Project Management. Conflict Management. Decision Making. Presentation Skills. Problem Solving. Business Report Writing. Influencing and Networking. Planning and Organising. Coordination skills. Computer Literacy. Communication skills. Coordination skills. Patriotic, Honesty, Integrity and Accountability.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Facilitate and coordinate the district operations to enhance service delivery. Monitor the District's budget, developing and implementing plans. Monitor the district's performance by ensuring that the district's operations run smoothly and report to the Line Manager on progress timeously. Communicate all eligible Local Manager’s credential responsibilities, program requirements, and expectations from District Manager. Coordinate the district calendar, meetings, dates, special events, and meetings and events. Collaborate with district staff to align district plans and strategies. Lead the District-level team, and ensure a coordinated approach to all components in the district and resolve concerns or problems. Work with the District Government and other stakeholders to develop annual plans for activities under each component, and to build relationships. Lead communication and stakeholder engagement activities with district government, civil society and private sector. Ensure the timely submission of financial and operational reports. Facilitate and Consolidate information on all operations in the District to enhance service delivery. Ensure successful business transformation. Ensure the implementation of effective risk and compliance management practices. Ensure effective and efficient management of human, physical and financial resources within the Unit. Coach and guide staff on best practices and compliance with regulatory requirements.
jobs.enquiries: Limpopo: Mr J Kgole Tel No: (015) 287 2802
jobs.applications: Applications compliant with the “Directions to Applicants” above, must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za or sent to the correct address specified as follows:-Limpopo: Physical Address: 89 Biccard Street, Polokwane, 0699.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Distrikskoördinasie
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir Distrikskoördinasie by die Department of Home Affairs in Mopani, verantwoordelik vir die fasilitering van distriksbedrywighede, die monitering van begrotings en prestasie om dienslewering te verbeter.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Public Management, Administration, Public Management, Operations Management op NQF level 6 soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring as 'n Senior Administrative Offisier word vereis. Ervaring in koördinasie word vereis. Basiese kennis van Civic Services en Immigration Acts. Begrip van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Treasury-regulasies. Kennis van Departementale Wetgewing asook die Menslike Hulpbronne Regulerende Raamwerk. Kennis van die Public Service Regulations. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en verlengde ure te werk. Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Vermoe en Leierskap. Diensleweringinnovatsie. Kliente-oriëntasie en Klientefokus. Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging. Aanspreeklikheid. Besigheidskontinuïteit. Projekbestuur. Konflikbestuur. Besluitneming. Voorleggingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing. Besigheidsverslagskrywing. Beïnvloeding en Netwerking. Beplanning en Organisering. Koördinasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kommunikasievaardighede. Koördinasievaardighede. Patriotisme, Eerlikheid, Integriteit en Aanspreeklikheid.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal onder andere vir die volgende spesifieke take verantwoordelik wees: Fasiliteer en koordineer die distriksbedrywighede om dienslewering te verbeter. Monitor die distrik se begroting, en ontwikkel en implementeer planne. Monitor die distrik se prestasie deur te verseker dat die distrik se bedrywighede glad verloop en doen tydig verslag aan die Lynbestuurder oor vordering. Kommunikeer alle bevoegde Plaaslike Bestuurders se geloofsbriewe, verantwoordelikhede, programvereistes en verwagtinge van die Distriksbestuurder. Koordineer die distrikskalender, vergaderings, datums, spesiale gebeurtenisse, en vergaderings en gebeurtenisse. Werk saam met distrikspersoneel om distriksplanne en -strategieë in lyn te bring. Lei die span op distriksvlak, en verseker 'n gekoördineerde benadering tot alle komponente in die distrik en los bekommernisse of probleme op. Werk saam met die Distriksregering en ander belanghebbendes om jaarlikse planne vir aktiwiteite onder elke komponent te ontwikkel, en om verhoudings te bou. Lei kommunikasie- en belanghebbende-betrokkenheidsaktiwiteite met distriksregering, burgerlike samelewing en die private sektor. Verseker die tydige indiening van finansiële en operasionele verslae. Fasiliteer en konsolideer inligting oor alle bedrywighede in die distrik om dienslewering te verbeter. Verseker suksesvolle besigheidstransformasie. Verseker die implementering van doeltreffende risiko- en nakomingsbestuurspraktyke. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van menslike, fisiese en finansiële hulpbronne binne die Eenheid. Mentorse en lei personeel oor best praktyke en nakoming van regulasievereistes.

zu.title: Assistant Director: District Coordination
zu.summary: Umqashi we-Assistant Director wo-Coordination we-District e-Department of Home Affairs e-Mopani, obekiwe ukuthi ahlinzele imisebenzi yesifunda, aqaphe imali yesifunda kanye nokusebenza ukwenza ukuthi kwenzeke ukuthi izinsiza zitholakale.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-undergraduate ku-Public Management, Administration, Public Management, Operations Management ezingeni le-NQF level 6 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Kudingeka ubeminye yiminyaka engu-3 ubani nokuthola izinsiza njengo-Senior Administrative Officer. Kudingeka ube namava wokuqondanisa. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo nge-Civic Services and Immigration Acts. Ukuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) nezinqubo ze-Treasury. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Department kanye ne-Human Resources Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi nge-Public Service Regulations. Ilayisensi yokushayela esevisini. Ukulungele ukuhamba nokusebenza amahora amude. Amakhono namandla adingekayo: Ikhono kanye neNkuleleko. Ukuthuthukiswa kokulethwa kwezinsiza. Ukubhekisela kumthengi nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuphathwa kwabantu futhi bakhushulwe. Ukuze ube nekharida. Ukuphila kobuhle bezinsiza. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga. Ukwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okubamba isikhundla. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Ukubhala imibiko yebhizinisi. Ukuthonya futhi ukuxhumana. Ukuhlela futhi uqondanise. Amakhono wokuqondanisa. Ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza ngokwamakhompyutha. Amakhono okuxhumana. Amakhono wokuqondanisa. Umoya wokuthanda izwe, Ukuqiniseka, Intsha kanye Nekharida.
zu.duties: Umqashi oneveshini uzobe nobekiwe eduze kwabanye emisebenzeni elandelayo: Ukuhlinzeka futhi uqondanise imisebenzi yesifunda ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Ukugqamisa ingxenye yesimali yesifunda, ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuphoqa ukusebenza kwezinhlelo. Ukugqamisa ukusebenza kwesifunda ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi imisebenzi yesifunda iyasebenza kahle futhi umbike umphathi wesigaba ngokuqhubeka ngesikhathi esifanele. Ukuxhumana namakhasimende abaholi bendawo abafanelekile, izidingo zohlelo, kanye nethemba elisuswa kumphathi wesifunda. Ukuqondanisa ikhalenda yesifunda, izinkomfa, izinsuku, izinkathi ezikhethekile, kanye nezinkomfa nemicimbi. Ukusebenzisana nabasebenzi besifunda ukuze kuqondaniswe izinhlelo namasu wesifunda. Ukuba yinhloko eqenjini lezinga lesifunda, futhi ukuqinisekisa indlela eqondanisiwe kuyo yonke imikhakha esifundeni futhi ukuxazulula izinkinga noma izinkinga. Ukusebenza noHulumeni wesifunda nabanye abalingisi ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zonyaka zemisebenzi ngaphansi komunye umkhakha, futhi ukwakha ubudlelwano. Ukuba yinhloko yemisebenzi yokuxhumana nokuqapha izinkundla noHulumeni wesifunda, abantu bomphakathi kanye nomkhakha wangasese. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthunywa kwemibiko yezimali nemisebenzi ngesikhathi. Ukuhlinzeka futhi uqoqe ulwazi ngemisebenzi yonke esifundeni ukuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Ukuqinisekisa ukuguqulwa okuphumelelayo kwebhizinisi. Ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezisebenzayo zokuqapha nokuqondisa ingozi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwabasebenzi, izinsiza ezingokomzimba nangokwezimali ngaphakathi kwesigaba. Ukufundisa futhi uhlole abasebenzi ngendlela ezinhle kakhulu nokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho.

xh.title: Umncebi woMlawulo: Ulwalamano lweZithili
xh.summary: UMncebi woMlawulo wolwalamano lwezithili kwiSebe leZabasebenzi baseKhaya e Mopani, unexandaba lokulungiselela izinto ezisebenzayo kwisithili, ukulola amabhajeti nempilo yokusebenza ukuze kuphuculwe ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-undergraduate kwiPublic Management, Administration, Public Management, Operations Management kwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 njengokuhlonelwa yi-SAQA. Kufuneka kubekho iminyaka engu-3 yamava njengengcali yeSenior Administrative Officer. Kufuneka ube namava kwilwalamano. Ulwazi olusemgangathweni malunga neCivic Services kunye neImmigration Acts. Kuqonde iPublic Finance Management Act (PFMA) kunye nemigaqo yeTreasury. Ulwazi ngokuMthetho weSebe nangolwalamano lweHuman Resources Regulatory Framework. Ulwazi ngePublic Service Regulations. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ukulungele ukuhamba kwaye usebenze iiyure eziphansi kwangexesha elide. Amakhono abalulekileyo namandla okuyala: Ulwazi nokuBumba. Ulwazi lokuyila nokuqhuba iinkonzo. Inqwenela kumxhasi kunye nokugxila Kumxhasi. UkuLawula abantu nokuBa amandla. UkuBamba iNtetho. UkuQhubela phambili iNhlangano. Ulawulo lweeProjekthi. Ulawulo lweengxabano. UkuThabatha isiGqibo. AmakhonookuBona iNgxelo. UkuSombulula iingxaki. UkuBhala iiNgxelo zeShishini. Ukuba namandla nokuQhagamshelana. UkuCwangcisa nokuHlela. Amakhono eLwalamano. Ulwazi lweKhompyutha. Amakhono eNtetho. Amakhono eLwalamano. Uthando lweNdzila, uQeqesho, uThembeka nokuBamba iNtetho.
xh.duties: Umqhubi ophumeleleyo uya kuba nenxaxheba kwezinye iindaba ezilandelayo: Ulungiselela ulwalamano lwezinto ezisebenzayo kwisithili ukuphucula ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo. Ulola ibhajeti yesithili, uqambe uze usebenzise iicwangciso. Ulola impilo yokusebenza yesithili ngokuqinisekisa ukuba izinto ezisebenzayo zisithili zihamba ngokulula uze uxelele umlawuli wolayini ngenkqubela yexesha. Yenzela ukudlulisa onke amaxwebhu angxamileyo eManajala baseKhaya leempini, iimfuno zohlelweni, nemithelela evela kumLawuli weSithili. Lawula ikhalenda yesithili, iindibano, iintsuku, iziganeko ezibalulekileyo, kunye neendibano naba ziganeko. Sebenzisana nabasebenzi basesithili ukuvumelanisa iicwangciso nokuqonda isithili. Qhoba iqela kwinqanaba lesithili, uze uqinisekise indlela eya kwelwalamano kuzo zonke iingxenye zesithili uze usombulule iingxaki okanye iingxaki ezikhoyo. Sebenzisana noRhulwana weSithili nabanomdla ukuba baqambe iicwangciso zenyaka zemisebenzi ngaphantsi kwegalelo ngalinye, uze wakhe iintsapho. Qhoba iindaba zentetho nokuqhuba iindaba zonke abanomdla noRhulwana wesithili, abantu bentsapho nabantu bomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuba iingxelo zemali nezobugcisa zithunyelwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Lungelelanisa ulwazi ngazo zonke izinto ezisebenzayo eSithili ukuze kuphuculwe ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo. Qinisekisa uluguqulo oluphumeleleyo lwenhlangano. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa iindlela ezisebenzayo zolawulo lweengozi nokuqwalasela. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokusebenzayo ngokuchanekileyo amathuba abantu, ezemvelo nezemali kuleYunithi. Laela ukuqeqesha abasebenzi ngolwazi olungcono nangokuvumelana nemfuno yolawulo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Information Technology Audits
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), all-inclusive package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS)
jobs.summary: Lead IT audits for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria, requiring a relevant diploma and three years' IT auditing experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Auditing / Information Technology (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in Information Technology Auditing at Assistant Director or equivalent level. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Project management best practice, The Standard of the Institute of Internal Auditors, Risk based Internal Audit methodologies and procedures and software. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written). Interviewing. Analytical and problem- solving ability. Staff and interpersonal relations. Project management. Computer literacy. Business process and analysis. Risk and control assessment. Work under pressure and meet deadlines.
jobs.duties: Participate in the compilation of the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s strategic and operational plans in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies, and procedures on an annual basis. Participate in the compilation of the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s operational plan by April each year. Compile the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s operational and process risk registers by April each year. Implement the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s operational plan and risk register action plans allocated to this position on a continuous basis and report progress to the Director: Information Technology Audit monthly. Participate in the compilation of the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s portion of the Strategic 3 year-Rolling and Annual Internal Audit Plans April each year. Execute / manage the planning of the specialised annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Execute / manage the compilation on the electronic audit software of the planning phase deliverables of the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s specialised projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on a continuous basis and report to the Director: Information Technology Audit on a weekly basis. Execute / manage the execution of the specialised annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Execute / manage the compilation on the electronic audit software of the execution phase deliverables of the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s specialised projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on a continuous basis and report to the Director: Information Technology Audit on a weekly basis. Execute / manage the reporting of the specialised annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda. Execute / manage the compilation on the electronic audit software of the reporting phase deliverables of the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s specialised projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on a continuous basis and report to the Director: Information Technology Audit on a weekly basis. Execute / manage the closure of the specialised annual audit plan projects according to the deliverables and timelines defined on the approved audit projects planning memoranda and Follow-up on implementation of management action plans on Internal Audit reports of specialised annual and previous audit plan projects. Execute / manage the compilation on the electronic audit software of the closure phase deliverables of the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s specialised projects allocated to this position, in line with the Chief Directorate’s quality standards, methodologies, policies and procedures on a continuous basis and report to the Director: Information Technology Audit on a weekly basis. Evaluate the line management’s status of implementation of action plans of the Information Technology Audit Directorate’s specialised internal audit reports allocated to this position and perform the adequacy assessment of management action plans implemented on a quarterly basis. Manage the information Technology Directorate’s resources allocated to this position. Manage human, logistical, and financial resources allocated to this position on an on-going basis in line with Departmental prescripts.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van der Walt Street), Berea Park, Pretoria, 0002 or by email to Post231@dlrrd.gov.za

Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. af.title: Onderdirekteur: Inligtingstegnologie-oudite
af.summary: Funksioneer as hoof van IT-oudite vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria; 'n relevante diploma en drie jaar se IT-ouditervaring word vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Ouditering / Inligtingstegnologie (NQF Level 6) of 'n verwante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in inligtingstegnologie-ouditering op Assistentdirekteur- of gelykwaardige vlak. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Best practice in projekbestuur, die standaarde van die Institute of Internal Auditors, risikogebaseerde interne ouditmetodologieë en prosedures en sagteware. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Onderhoudvoering. Analitiese en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Personeel- en interpersoonlike verhoudings. Projekbestuur. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Besigheidsprosesse en -ontleding. Risiko- en beheerassessering. Werk onder druk en haal sperdatums na.
af.duties: Neem deel aan die opstel van die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se strategiese en operasionele planne in ooreenstemming met die hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandaarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n jaarlikse basis. Neem deel aan die opstel van die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se operasionele plan teen April elke jaar. Stel die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se operasionele en prosesrisikoregisters teen April elke jaar op. Implementeer die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se operasionele plan en risikoregister-aksieplanne wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is, deurlopend en rapporteer maandeliks vordering aan die Direkteur: Inligtingstegnologie-oudit. Neem deel aan die opstel van die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se gedeelte van die strategiese 3-jaar-rollygende en jaarlikse interne ouditplanne teen April elke jaar. Voer uit / bestuur die beplanning van die gespesialiseerde jaarlikse ouditplanprojekte volgens die lewerbare items en tydlyne wat op die goedgekeurde ouditprojekbeplanningsmemoranda gedefinieer is. Voer uit / bestuur die opstel op die elektroniese ouditsagteware van die beplanningsfase-lewerbare items van die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se gespesialiseerde projekte wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is, in ooreenstemming met die hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandaarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis en rapporteer weekliks aan die Direkteur: Inligtingstegnologie-oudit. Voer uit / bestuur die uitvoering van die gespesialiseerde jaarlikse ouditplanprojekte volgens die lewerbare items en tydlyne wat op die goedgekeurde ouditprojekbeplanningsmemoranda gedefinieer is. Voer uit / bestuur die opstel op die elektroniese ouditsagteware van die uitvoeringsfase-lewerbare items van die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se gespesialiseerde projekte wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is, in ooreenstemming met die hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandaarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis en rapporteer weekliks aan die Direkteur: Inligtingstegnologie-oudit. Voer uit / bestuur die verslagdoening van die gespesialiseerde jaarlikse ouditplanprojekte volgens die lewerbare items en tydlyne wat op die goedgekeurde ouditprojekbeplanningsmemoranda gedefinieer is. Voer uit / bestuur die opstel op die elektroniese ouditsagteware van die verslagdoeningsfase-lewerbare items van die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se gespesialiseerde projekte wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is, in ooreenstemming met die hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandaarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis en rapporteer weekliks aan die Direkteur: Inligtingstegnologie-oudit. Voer uit / bestuur die afsluiting van die gespesialiseerde jaarlikse ouditplanprojekte volgens die lewerbare items en tydlyne wat op die goedgekeurde ouditprojekbeplanningsmemoranda gedefinieer is en volg die implementering van bestuursaksieplanne op interne ouditverslae van gespesialiseerde jaarlikse en vorige ouditplanprojekte na. Voer uit / bestuur die opstel op die elektroniese ouditsagteware van die afsluitingsfase-lewerbare items van die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se gespesialiseerde projekte wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is, in ooreenstemming met die hoofdirektoraat se gehaltestandaarde, metodologieë, beleide en prosedures op 'n deurlopende basis en rapporteer weekliks aan die Direkteur: Inligtingstegnologie-oudit. Evalueer die lynbestuur se status van implementering van aksieplanne van die inligtingstegnologie-ouditdirektoraat se gespesialiseerde interne ouditverslae wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is en voer die toereikendheidsassessering van geïmplementeerde bestuursaksieplanne op 'n kwartaallikse basis uit. Bestuur die inligtingstegnologie-direktoraat se bronne wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is. Bestuur menslike, logistieke en finansiële bronne wat aan hierdie pos toegeken is op 'n deurlopende basis in ooreenstemming met departementele voorskrifte.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esiphethe: Ukuhlola Izobuchwepheshe Elokuthintana
zu.summary: Hola ukuhlola kwe-IT ku-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ePretoria, okudinga idiploma ehambisana nalokhu namakhulu eminyaka emithathu ohlolweni lwe-IT.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaki isicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma in Auditing / Information Technology (NQF Level 6) noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezehlangene. Ukuze ube namakhulu eminyaka emi-3 ohlolweni lwe-Information Technology Auditing kwazinga le-Assistant Director noma elinganayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izindlela ezinhle zokulawula iphrojekthi, Izinga le-Institute of Internal Auditors, Izindlela nezinqubomgomo zokuHlola Ngaphakathi okusekelwe esibeni kanye nesofthiwe. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Ukubuzwa imibuzo. Ikakhono lokuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga. Izindaba zomlingisi nokuhlobana nomuntu. Ukulawula iphrojekthi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Inqubo yebhizinisi nokuhlaziya. Ukulinganisa isibi nokulawula. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi nokugcwalisa izinsuku eziyelwe.
zu.duties: Thatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni amaphulani akehliwe nezokusebenza awoMnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology ngokuhambisana nemazinga okhwe, izindlela, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinqubo ze-Office of the Chief Directorate njalo ngonyaka. Thatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni iphulani yokusebenza yomnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology ngo-April minyaka yonke. Hlela imibhalo yesibi senqubo kanye nesezokusebenza yomnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology ngo-April minyaka yonke. Yenza iphulani yokusebenza yomnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology kanye namaphulani somnyango wokwenza oswenziwe kule sizinkundla ngokuphazamiseka okungamakhulu abika inqubo kuDirector: Information Technology Audit njalo nyanga. Thatha inxaxheba ekwenzeni isiqephu somnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology seHlolo se-Strategic 3 year-Rolling neSokuhlola Ngaphakathi SoNyaka ngo-April minyaka yonke. Yenza / phatha ukulungiselela amaphrojekthi amakhulu ohlelo lokuhlola lunyaka ngokuhambisana nemiyo yemphumela kanye nesikhathi esihleliwe kulayisha memora yokuhlela amaphrojekthi okuhlolwa avunyiwe. Yenza / phatha ukuhlanganiswa kusofthiwe yekhompyutha yezokuhlola kwemiphumela yeseqhingini sokuhlela amaphrojekthi amakhulu woMnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology oswenziwe kule sizinkundla, ngokuhambisana nemizinga yokhwe ye-Office of the Chief Directorate, izindlela, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinqubo ngokuphazamiseka okungamakhulu ubike kuDirector: Information Technology Audit njalo ngeviki. Yenza / phatha ukuqashwa kwamaphrojekthi amakhulu ohlelo lokuhlola lunyaka ngokuhambisana nemiyo yemphumela nesikhathi esihleliwe kulayisha memora yokuhlela amaphrojekthi okuhlolwa avunyiwe. Yenza / phatha ukuhlanganiswa kusofthiwe yekhompyutha yezokuhlola kwemiphumela yeseqhingini sokwenza amaphrojekthi amakhulu woMnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology oswenziwe kule sizinkundla, ngokuhambisana nemizinga yokhwe ye-Office of the Chief Directorate, izindlela, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinqubo ngokuphazamiseka okungamakhulu ubike kuDirector: Information Technology Audit njalo ngeviki. Yenza / phatha ukubika kwamaphrojekthi amakhulu ohlelo lokuhlola lunyaka ngokuhambisana nemiyo yemphumela nesikhathi esihleliwe kulayisha memora yokuhlela amaphrojekthi okuhlolwa avunyiwe. Yenza / phatha ukuhlanganiswa kusofthiwe yekhompyutha yezokuhlola kwemiphumela yeseqhingini sokubika amaphrojekthi amakhulu woMnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology oswenziwe kule sizinkundla, ngokuhambisana nemizinga yokhwe ye-Office of the Chief Directorate, izindlela, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinqubo ngokuphazamiseka okungamakhulu ubike kuDirector: Information Technology Audit njalo ngeviki. Yenza / phatha ukuvalwa kwamaphrojekthi amakhulu ohlelo lokuhlola lunyaka ngokuhambisana nemiyo yemphumela nesikhathi esihleliwe kulayisha memora yokuhlela amaphrojekthi okuhlolwa avunyiwe kanye nokulandaza ukuqashwa kwezindlela zomphathi kumabika eHlolo Ngaphakathi amaphrojekthi amakhulu ohlelo lokuhlola lunyaka wangaphambilini. Yenza / phatha ukuhlanganiswa kusofthiwe yekhompyutha yezokuhlola kwemiphumela yeseqhingini sokuvala amaphrojekthi amakhulu woMnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology oswenziwe kule sizinkundla, ngokuhambisana nemizinga yokhwe ye-Office of the Chief Directorate, izindlela, izinqubomgomo, kanye nezinqubo ngokuphazamiseka okungamakhulu ubike kuDirector: Information Technology Audit njalo ngeviki. Hlola isimo somphathi wolayini ekusebenzeni izindlela zamaphrojekthi amakhulu emibiko yokuhlola ngaphakathi yoMnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology oswenziwe kule sizinkundla kanye nokwenza ukuhlola ukwanelela kwamaphulani womphathi aswenziwe njalo ngekrele. Phatha izinsiza zoMnyango weHlolo le-Information Technology oswenziwe kule sizinkundla. Phatha izinsiza zabantu, ezezimo, nezezimali oswenziwe kule sizinkundla ngokuqhubeka ngokuhambisana nezinqubo zomnyango.

xh.title: Isekela Mnqwebi: Ii-Audit Zobuchwephesha Bolwazi
xh.summary: Qhuba ii-audit ze-IT ze-Sebe leLand Reform and Rural Development ePretoria, efuna isidanga esifanelekileyo kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava oku-audit i-IT.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSetifikathi seGrade 12 kunye neNational Diploma kwiAuditing / Information Technology (NQF Level 6) okanye isifanekiso esihlobene esilinganayo. Ubuncinane beminyakaengu-3 yamava kwii-Audit Zobuchwephesha Bolwazi kwinqanaba leAssistant Director okwa equivalents. Ilayisense yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Izinqobo ezilungileyo zolawulo lweeprojekthi, Izilinganiso ze-Institute of Internal Auditors, iindlela nezicwangciso zeRisk based Internal Audit kunye nesoftwe. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano (lolwimi lwenyawo nelolubhalwayo). Ukuvezwa ngemibuzo. Ikhono lokuhlola kunye nokuqonda iingxaki. Ubudlelwane nabasebenzi kunye nabantu. Ulawulo lweeprojekthi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iinkqubo zoshishino kunye nohlalutyo. Inkqubo yokulinganisa iingozi nolawulo. Ukusebenza ngcangcazelo kunye nokugqibeza ngexesha elichaziweyo.
xh.duties: Thatha inxaxheba ekwakheni iicwangciso ezibalulekileyo nezosebenzayo zeInformation Technology Audit Directorate ngokwemigangatho yekhwalithi, iindlela, iinkqazo, neenkqubo zeChief Directorate ngokonyaka ngamnye. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakheni icwangciso losebenziso leInformation Technology Audit Directorate ngoAprili minyaka le. Yenza iirejista zengozi zosebenziso nenkqubo yeInformation Technology Audit Directorate ngoAprili minyaka le. Phumeza icwangciso losebenziso leInformation Technology Audit Directorate kunye neenkqubo zenkqubo yeenqobo ezingozi ezabelwe kule sithuba ngokuqhubekayo undixe inkqubela kuDirector: Information Technology Audit nyaka ngamnye ngenyanga. Thatha inxaxheba ekwakheni isiqelo seInformation Technology Audit Directorate seStrategic 3 year-Rolling kunye neAnnual Internal Audit Plans ngoAprili minyaka le. Phumeza / lawula ukuhlelwa kweeprojekthi zicwangciso le-audit ezibalulekileyo zonyaka ngokwemilinganiselo namaxesha achaziweyo kumaplan wezicwangciso e-audit egunyazisiweyo. Phumeza / lawula ukuqokelelwa kwesoftware ye-audit yekhompyutha kwemilinganiselo yokuqala yokuqokelela i-audit yeenkqubo zeInformation Technology Audit Directorate ezibalulekileyo ezigqithiselwe kule sithuba, ngokwemigangatho yekhwalithi, iindlela, iinkqazo neenkqubo zeChief Directorate ngokuqhubekayo undixe kuDirector: Information Technology Audit ngeveki nganye. Phumeza / lawula ukuphumeza iinkqubo ze-audit ezibalulekileyo zonyaka ngokwemilinganiselo namaxesha achaziweyo kumaplan wezicwangciso e-audit egunyazisiweyo. Phumeza / lawula ukuqokelelwa kwesoftware ye-audit yekhompyutha kwemilinganiselo yophumezo lwenkqubo ye-audit yeInformation Technology Audit Directorate ezibalulekileyo ezigqithiselwe kule sithuba, ngokwemigangatho yekhwalithi, iindlela, iinkqazo neenkqubo zeChief Directorate ngokuqhubekayo undixe kuDirector: Information Technology Audit ngeveki nganye. Phumeza / lawula ukuchaza iinkqubo ze-audit ezibalulekileyo zonyaka ngokwemilinganiselo namaxesha achaziweyo kumaplan wezicwangciso e-audit egunyazisiweyo. Phumeza / lawula ukuqokelelwa kwesoftware ye-audit yekhompyutha kwemilinganiselo yexesha lokuchaza iinkqubo ze-audit zeInformation Technology Audit Directorate ezibalulekileyo ezigqithiselwe kule sithuba, ngokwemigangatho yekhwalithi, iindlela, iinkqazo neenkqubo zeChief Directorate ngokuqhubekayo undixe kuDirector: Information Technology Audit ngeveki nganye. Phumeza / lawula ukuvala iinkqubo ze-audit ezibalulekileyo zonyaka ngokwemilinganiselo namaxesha achaziweyo kumaplan wezicwangciso e-audit egunyazisiweyo ulandele ukuphunywa kweenkqubo zezenkqubo zeenkqubo zolawulo kwiingxelo zeInternal Audit zeenkqubo ze-audit ezibalulekileyo zonyaka nezangaphambili. Phumeza / lawula ukuqokelelwa kwesoftware ye-audit yekhompyutha kwemilinganiselo yexesha lokuvala iinkqubo ze-audit zeInformation Technology Audit Directorate ezibalulekileyo ezigqithiselwe kule sithuba, ngokwemigangatho yekhwalithi, iindlela, iinkqazo neenkqubo zeChief Directorate ngokuqhubekayo undixe kuDirector: Information Technology Audit ngeveki nganye. Hlola isimo sokuqhuba iinkqubo zenkqubo yolawulo kweeprojekthi ze-audit ezibalulekileyo zeInformation Technology Audit Directorate ezithunyelwe kule sithuba uzenze ukulinganiswa kokwanele kweenkqubo zenkqubo yolawulo ezisetyenziswe kwikota ngalinye. Lawula izixhobo zeInformation Technology Directorate ezabelwe kule sithuba. Lawula izixhobo zabantu, zolawulo, nezemali ezabelwe kule sithuba ngokuqhubekayo ngokweinkqubo zesebe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Financial Planning
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Manage budget compilation, MTEF and ENE processes for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Financial Management / Cost and Management Accounting / or equivalent qualifications (NQF Level 6). Minimum of 3 years of experience at a supervisory level in the budget planning environment. A valid driver's licence. Job related knowledge: Budget systems. Computer accounting software. Knowledge of Financial Accounting Systems. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Job related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Advanced Computer literacy (Excel etc.). Planning and organising. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision making. Time management. Business management. Communication (verbal and written). Ability to work within a team.
jobs.duties: Initiate budget compilation process annually. Develop, implement and evaluate budget inputs for budget framework processes, Adjusted Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE), Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE) and Roll-overs. Manage Branch budget processes as per the action plan. Attend information sessions for budget programmes managers. Consolidate budget input from the Branch. Monitor budget in accordance with the vote. Monitor budget implementation for programmes in accordance with the appropriation bill. Monitor the implementation for capturing the original budget (ENE) and adjust budget (AENE) on Basic Accounting System (BAS) annually. Manage Standard Charts of Accounts (SCOA) segment aligned to vote. Monitor and advice responsibility managers to relocate budget to items with negative balance. Monitor balancing report at the end of the month. Monitor and advise with the preparation of realignment documents quarterly. Manage the budget maintenance. Monitor the implementation of BAS budget structures. Monitor economic reporting format allocation combinations.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van der Walt Street), Berea Park, Pretoria, 0002 or by email to Post223@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Indian, and White Males and Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to the high volume of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Finansiële Beplanning
af.summary: Bestuur begrotingsopstel-, MTEF- en ENE-prosesse vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Finansiële Bestuur / Koste- en Bestuursrekeningkunde / of gelykwaardige kwalifikasies (NQF Level 6). Minimum van 3 jaar ervaring op 'n toesighoudende vlak in die begrotingsbeplanningsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Begrotingstelsels. Rekenaarrekeningkundige sagteware. Kennis van Finansiële Rekeningkundige Stelsels. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Werksverwante vaardighede: Projektebestuur. Spanbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid (Excel ens.). Beplanning en organisering. Hulpbronbeplanning. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Tydbestuur. Besigheidsbestuur. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Begin die begrotingsopstelproses jaarliks. Ontwikkel, implementeer en evalueer begrotingsinvoere vir begrotingsraamwerkprosesse, Aangepaste Ramings van Nasionale Uitgawes (AENE), Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE) en rollovers. Bestuur Tak-begrotingsprosesse volgens die aksieplan. Bywoon inligtingsessies vir begrotingsprogrambestuurders. Konsolideer begrotingsinvoere van die Tak. Monitor begroting in ooreenstemming met die stem. Monitor begrotingsimplementering vir programme in ooreenstemming met die appropriasiewetsontwerp. Monitor die implementering vir die vaslegging van die oorspronklike begroting (ENE) en aangepaste begroting (AENE) op Basic Accounting System (BAS) jaarliks. Bestuur Standard Charts of Accounts (SCOA)-segment in lyn met die stem. Monitor en adviseer verantwoordelikheidsbestuurders om begroting te hervestig na items met 'n negatiewe saldo. Monitor balanseringsverslag aan die einde van die maand. Monitor en adviseer met die voorbereiding van herrangskikkingsdokumente kwartaalliks. Bestuur die begrotingsonderhoud. Monitor die implementering van BAS-begrotingstrukture. Monitor ekonomiese verslagdoeningsformaat-toewysingskombinasies.

zu.title: Umphathi ongwangqwe: Ukucubungula Izimali
zu.summary: Phatha ukuhlela isabelomali, izinqubo ze-MTEF ne-ENE ze-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafakela kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe eMabhala Izimali / Ukuqhathaniswa kanye Nobuhlali Bemali / noma iziqu ezingangalezo (NQF Level 6). Ukwazi okuncane kweminyaka emi-3 yolesitajanga esimaphakathi nendlela yokuqamba imisoco kuleso sikhathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Amasistimu amabhudzheti. Isofthiwe ekubhaleni imali. Ulwazi ngamasistimu abhala imali. Izinhlelo ezamukelwe njengezomthetho Zokubhala Izimali (GAAP). Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Abaphathi bephrojekthi. Abaphathi beqembu. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukubuka kwangaphambili kwesabelomali. Ulwazi oluthuthukile ngokusabela komshini (Excel etc.). Ukucubungula nokuhlela. Ukucubungula izinsiza. Ukwaxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Uphathwa kwesikhathi. Uphathwa kobhizinisi. Ukuthumela imiyalezo (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Isikhathi sokusebenza eqenjini.
zu.duties: Qala inqubo yokuhlela kabusha umthethosisekelo ngonyaka ngamunye. Hlola, faka esebenzini futhi uhlole okufakwayo kwesabelomali kwizinhlaka zemigomo yesabelomali, Izilinganiso Ezilungisiwe Zokuhlotshiwa Kwemali Yezwe (AENE), Isakhiwo Sokusebenzisa Imali Esikhathini Esiphakathi (MTEF), Izilinganiso Zokuhlotshiwa Kwemali Yezwe (ENE) kanye nokudlulisela kabusha. Phatha izinqobo zemisebenzi yesabelomali njengokuhlelelwe endleleni yomuntu. Hlanganyela kumaseshini ezolwazi abaphathi bahlelo besabelomali. Qoqonga okufakwayo kwesabelomali esikhundleni. Qaphela isabelomali ngokuvumelana nevoti. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kwesabelomali bahlelo ngokuvumelana nomthethosivivinywa wokulinganiselwa. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kokufaka isabelomali esikhathini sangaphambilini (ENE) nokuqwalasela isabelomali (AENE) Kwisistimu Esiyisisekelo Yokubhala Izimali (BAS) ngonyaka ngamunye. Phatha imiphumela Yemifanekiso Eqondene Nezabalomali (SCOA) evumelana nevoti. Qaphela futhi unikeze iseluleko abaphathi abanamaphuzu ukuba badlulise isabelomali ezintweni ezinesibalanzi esibi. Qaphela umbiko wokulinganisa ekupheleni kwenyanga. Qaphela futhi unikeze iseluleko ngokulungiselela imibhalo yokulungisa kabusha kanye nasohlelweni lwamakhota amane. Phatha ukugcinwa kwesabelomali. Qaphela ukusetshenziswa kwezakhiwo zamaphuzu esabelomali e-BAS. Qaphela ukuhlelwa kwezinhlanga zemibiko yezomnotho.

xh.title: Umphathi oncedisayo: Uqwalaselo Lwehlelo Lemali
xh.summary: Lawula ukuqhutywa kwehlelo lemali, iinkqubo ze-MTEF ne-ENE kwisebe iDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisezantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Certificate ye-Grade 12 kwaye abe ne-National Diploma kwimaxhoma eFinancial Management / Cost and Management Accounting / okanye izifundo ezingalulingana nazo (NQF Level 6). Iminyaka elishumi elithathu ngenxalaba yamava kwinqanaba lomphathi kwindawo yohlolojio lwehlelo lemali. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esemthethweni. ulwazi oluchaseneyo nomsebenzi: Iinkqubo zohlelo lemali. Isofthiwee yeakhawunti ekhompuyutheni. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zokuqwalasela imali yeakhawunti. Iimvisiswano ezingamkeleka ngokubanzi ekubhaleni iikhawunti (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)). Amaxhoma anceda ngokuchaseneyo nomsebenzi: Ukulawula inxaxheba. Ukulawula iqela. Indlela yokusebenzelana nabantu. Ukuqikelela ihlelo lemali. Ulwazi olubanzi lwekompuyutha (Excel etc.). Ukuqwalasela nokuhlela. Ukuqwalasela amathuba. Ukuziqhelanisa neengxaki nokuqamba isigqibo. Ukulawula ixesha. Ukulawula inkampani. Unxibelelwano (ngemlomo nangokubhaliweyo). Ulawulo lokusebenza ngaphakathi kwelungu lesiqela.
xh.duties: Qalisa inqubo yokudibanisa ihlelo lemali ngonyaka. Ziphuze, zisebenise kwaye zihlole izigqibo ezifakelwa kuhlelo lemali lweziseko, iAdjustments Estimates of National Expenditure (AENE), iMedium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), ukuqikelela kwentshiwalo karhulumente (Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE)) nokudluliswa kwezimali (Roll-overs). Lawula iinqubo zehlelo lemali lesebe njengoko kucacisiwe kwicandelo lenkqubo. Zibandakanye iiseshini zeenkcukacha zabaphathi behlelo lemali. Sidibanisa izigqibo ezifakwa kuhlelo lemali evela kwisebe. Hlola ihlelo lemali ngokwemithetho yovoto. Hlola ukuqatywa kwendlela emakwenziwa ngayo ihlelo lemali lezinkqubo ngokomthetho wokuhlinzwa ngemali (appropriation bill). Hlola ukuqatywa kwendlela yokubhala uhlelo lwangoku lemali (ENE) nokulungiselela uhlelo lemali (AENE) kwindlela esisiseko yemali (Basic Accounting System (BAS)) ngonyaka. Lawula i Standard Charts of Accounts (SCOA) ezimisela umthetho wovoto. Hlola kwaye uhese abaphathi abanoxanduva lokususa uhlelo lemali kwaye badelekelelo kukwindawo enesixa esingaphantsi kwesixa esifunekayo. Hlola ingxelo yezibhalo eziphela ngenyanga. Hlola kwaye uhese ngokuqulunqwa koxwebhu lokuqwalasela ixebe ngokuhamba kwexesha. Lawula ulondolazo lohlelo lemali. Hlola ukuqatywa kwakho zii-structure zehlelo lemali ze-BAS. Hlola iindidi ezahluweneyo zendlela yokwenza ingxelo yamaphakathi woqoqosho (economic reporting format).

jobs.title: Strategic Planning Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Strategic planning officer needed to coordinate departmental planning workshops; requires a diploma, three years' experience and a driver's licence.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Public Management / Public Administration / Business Administration / Business Management / Management or equivalent qualification. Minimum of 3 years’ experience in strategy planning or monitoring and evaluation in a government environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge in government planning cycle (Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), outcomes approach, etc.). Government policies related to strategic planning, monitoring and evaluation, outcomes approach, and those related to the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development. Basic research. Developing indicators and managing performance information. Job related skills: Computer literacy. Report writing. Communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal relations. Information collection analysis and interpretation. Organisational and coordination. Analytical. Teamwork.
jobs.duties: Understand departmental planning processes by arranging, coordinating, and facilitating planning workshops. Arrange and coordinate planning workshops will include sending invitations, securing of venues, crafting agendas and circulation thereof. Facilitate events during and after planning workshops by ensuring that information gathered during and after planning workshops is disseminated to stakeholders and feedback is provided within set timelines. Gather, analyse and organise information in preparation for strategic planning workshops and documents. Collect planning information from branches, provinces analysed in terms of relevance and applicability. Check reliability before being presented to the planning session. Conduct the development of Annual Performance Plans (APP) and Branch Annual Operational Plans (AOP). Coordinate inputs towards APP and AOP for alignment to the Strategic Plan and the Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) documents. Align information to high level plans of the government. Conduct reviews and re- alignment of Annual Performance Plan and Strategic Plan (SP). Assist in coordinating and facilitating the review and re-alignment of the APP and SP. Realign plans taking into consideration resources at the department’s disposal and current performance trends. Assist in coordinating the process of developing the departmental planning guidelines. Provide technical support to provinces during the department of Integrated Operational Plans (IOP). Provide technical support to provinces during the development of IOPs.

af.title: Strategiese Beplanningsbeampte
af.summary: Strategiese beplanningsbeampte benodig om departementele beplanningswerkswinkels te koördineer; vereis 'n diploma, drie jaar se ervaring en 'n bestuurslisensie.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Grade 12-sertifikaat en 'n National Diploma in Public Management / Public Administration / Business Administration / Business Management / Management of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in strategiese beplanning of monitering en evaluering in 'n regeringsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van die regeringsbeplanningsiklus (Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), uitkomste-benadering, ens.). Regeringsbeleid verbonde aan strategiese beplanning, monitering en evaluering, uitkomste-benadering, en dié wat verband hou met die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development. Basiese navorsing. Ontwikkeling van aanwysers en bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Verslagskrywing. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik) en interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Inligtingversameling, -ontleding en -interpretasie. Organisatoriese en koördineringsvermoë. Analitiese vermoë. Spanwerk.
af.duties: Verstaan departementele beplanningsprosesse deur beplanningswerkswinkels te reël, te koördineer en te fasiliteer. Die reël en koördineer van beplanningswerkswinkels sal die stuur van uitnodigings, die bespreek van plekke, die opstel van agenda's en die sirkulasie daarvan behels. Fasiliteer geleenthede tydens en na beplanningswerkswinkels deur te verseker dat inligting wat tydens en na beplanningswerkswinkels ingewin is, aan belanghebbendes versprei word en terugvoering binne vasgestelde tydlyne verskaf word. Versamel, analiseer en organiseer inligting ter voorbereiding vir strategiese beplanningswerkswinkels en dokumente. Versamel beplanningsinligting van takke, provinsies wat ontleed word in terme van relevantie en toepaslikheid. Kontroleer betroubaarheid voordat dit aan die beplanningsessie voorgelê word. Oorsien die ontwikkeling van Annual Performance Plans (APP) en Branch Annual Operational Plans (AOP). Koördineer bydraes tot APP en AOP vir belyning met die Strategiese Plan en die Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) dokumente. Belyn inligting met hoëvlakplanne van die regering. Voer hersienings en herbelyning van Annual Performance Plan en Strategic Plan (SP) uit. Bystand verleen by die koördinering en fasilitering van die hersiening en herbelyning van die APP en SP. Herbelyn planne met inagneming van hulpbronne tot die beskikking van die departement en huidige prestasietendense. Bystand verleen by die koördinering van die proses om departementele beplanningsriglyne te ontwikkel. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan provinsies tydens die departement van Integrated Operational Plans (IOP). Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan provinsies tydens die ontwikkeling van IOP's.

zu.title: Inqindi Yokuqukethwe
zu.summary: Kudingeka inqindi yokuqukethwe ukuze ihambise izinkomfa zokuqukethwa kwezonyango; idinga idiploma, iminyaka emithathu yokuhlukelela, ilayisensi yokushayela.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okungenani: Abafakelayo kufanele babe ne-Sithifikethi se-Grade 12 kanye neDiploma Yezwe kuPhatho Komphakathi / uPhatho Lomphakathi / uPhatho Lwezoshishino / uPhatho Lwebhizinisi / uPhatho noma isiqinisekiso esilinganayo. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 yokuhlukelela ekuhleleni ibhizinisi noma ukubheka kanye nokuhlola endaweni kahulumeni. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngesikhashana sehlelo lahulumeni (Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP),indlela yemiphumela, njll.). Izinqubo kahulumeni ezihlobene nokuhlela ibhizinisi, ukubheka nokuhlola, indlela yemiphumela, nalezo ezihlobene neNyango Yokulungiswa Komhlaba nokuThuthukiswa Kwemaphandle. Ucwaningo olusisekelo. Ukuthuthukiswa kwemilinganiselo nokuphatha ukwaziswa ngemiphumela. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala imibiko. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe) kanye nobudlelwano abantu. Ukuqoqa, ukuhlaziya, nokutolikwa kolwazi. Ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa. Ukuhlaziya. Ukusebenza njengesiqembu.
zu.duties: Qonda izinqubo zokuqukethwe kohlelo lweminyango ngokuhlela, ukuqhathanisa, kanye nokwelula izinkomfa zokuqukethwe. Ukuhlela nokuqhathanisa izinkomfa zokuqukethwe kuzohlanganisa ukuthumela izimemo, ukuthola izindawo, ukwakha ajenda kanye nokuzihambisa. Welula imicimbi phakathi nangemva kwezinkomfa zokuqukethwe ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi olutholwe phakathi nangemva kwezinkomfa zokuqukethwe lusakazwa kubaphathi abaningi bese kunikezwa impendulo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe. Qoqa, hlaziya, futhi uhlele ulwazi ngokulungiselela izinkomfa namadokhumenti ohlelo lokuhlela. Qoqa ulwazi lokuqukethwe ezigabheni, izifundazwe luhlaziwe ngesimo sokubaluleka nokusebenziseka. Hlola ukuthembeka ngaphambi kokuhunyushelwa esikhundleni sokuqukethwa. Qhuba ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo Zokusebenza Zonyaka (APP) nezinhlelo Zokusebenza Zonyaka Zesigaba (AOP). Qhathanisa okufakwe ku-APP naku-AOP ukuze zihambisane neNhlelo Yokuhlela neredokhumenti leNgcwangco Lokuthuthukiswa Lwesikhashana (MTDP). Qhathanisa ulwazi ngenhlelo eziphezulu zahulumeni. Qhuba ukubuyekezwa kabusha kanye nokuqinisekisa kabusha kweNhlelo Yokusebenza Yonyaka neNhlelo Yokuhlela (SP). Siza ekutheni kuqhathaniswe futhi kweluleke ukubuyekezwa kabusha nokulungiswa kabusha kwe-APP ne-SP. Lungisa kabusha izinhlelo ngokuqwalasela izinsiza ezisesikhathini samnyango kanye nokuvela kwezinye izindlela eziseduze ekusetshenzweni. Siza ekugqameni nokuhambiseni kwenqubo yokuthuthukiswa imihlahlandlela yokuqukethwe kweminyango. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ezifundazweni phakathi kweminyango Yezinhlelo Zokusebenza Ezixhunyiwe (IOP). Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe ezifundazweni phakathi kwesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa kwe-IOPs.

xh.title: Ofakeli Woqulunqo-lwezicwangciso
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe ofakeli woluhlu lokuqulunqa izicwangciso ukuze aqhoboshele iinkqubo zemijikelo yoqulunqo-lwesebe; kufuneka abe nediploma, aneminyaka emithathu yamava alale ibhasi lokusebenza.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafake izicelo kufuneka benomvuzo weSatifikethi seKhosi le-12 neseDiploma leSizwe kuLawulo lukaRhulumente / uLawulo lukaRhulumente / uLawulo lweShishini / uLawulo lweShishini / uLawulo okanye isemfuno ezingqilyanayo. Inqanaba lonyaka weminyaka engu-3 lokuhlolwa ekulungelelaniseni isicwangciso okanye ekuboniseni nasekugqibeleleni kwimeko karhulumente. Ilayisensi yomqhubi. Ulwazi oluhambelana nesebe: Ulwazi ngomjikelo wokuqulunqa iicebeto karhulumente (uLwakhiwo lokuXelela iNkxaso-Mali lokuSebenza kwakwiXesha eliphakathi (MTEF), iCebeto elinguPhakathi-iXesha elide eliyiNtshukumo (MTDP), indlela yeziphumo, njl.nj.). Iinkqubo-zorhulumente ezinxulumene nocwangciso lokuqulunqa iicebeto, ukubonisa nasekugqibeleleni, indlela yeziphumo, nakanjani ezi nxulumene neSebe loLwazi lweNtshukumo nasekuPhuhliseni iNdalo zasemakhaya. Uphando olusentlalweni. Ukwenza izalathiso nokulawula ulwazi lokusebenza. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuphatha ikhompyutha. Ukwabhala iingxelo. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhalwa) neendlela zodibano-nxaxheba. Ukuqokelela ukuhlaluya nokutolika ulwazi. Uqulunqo-lwemisebenzi noqhoboshelo. Ukuhlaluta. Ukusebenza ngamanyathelo.
xh.duties: Qonda iinkqubo zokuqulunqa iicebeto zesebe ngokulungiselela, ukuqhoboshela, nokweluleka kumjikelo wokuqulunqa iicebeto. Ukulungiselela nokuqhoboshela kumjikelo wokuqulunqa iicebeto kuya kuquka ukuthumela izimemo, ukufumana iindawo, ukwenza iidijenda nokuzidlulisa. Weluleka kwiiganeko phakathi nangemva kwemijikelo yokuqulunqa iicebeto ngokuqinisekisa ukuba ulwazi oluqokelelwe phakathi nangemva kwemijikelo yokuqulunqa iicebeto lusasazwa kubathathi-nxaxheba kwaye ibuyiselo inikezwe ngaphakathi kweesikhathi ezimisiweyo. Qokelela, hlaluya ulwazi ngolungiselelo lwezinto ezifunekayo kuqulunqo-lwasebela lwemijikelo yokuqulunqa iicebeto namaxwebhu. Qokelela ulwazi lokuqulunqa kuqulunqo-lwasebela, kumaphondo, luhlalutya ngokwendima nangokwemisebenzi yalo. Hlola ukuzinza ngaphambi kokuboniswa kwalo kwisiganeko sokuqulunqa iicebeto. Yenza uqulunqo-lwasebela lweMisebenzi yokuQulunqa iCebe (APP) noQulunqo-lwasebela lokuSebenza kwesiKhathi (AOP). Qhoboshela okufakwayo ku APP naku AOP ukuzingenisa kwiCebeto elinguMngangamiso namaxwebhu eCebeto elinguPhakathi-iXesha elide eliyiNtshukumo (MTDP). Zingenisa ulwazi kwiicebeto ezikhokelileyo karhulumente. Yenza okuphindo-phindwayo nokuzingenisa kwakhona koQulunqo-lwasebela lweMisebenzi yoQobo lweNyanga noQulunqo lweZicwangciso (SP). Nceda ekuthungeni nasekwelulekeni kophindo-phindo nokuzingenisa kwakhona i APP naku SP. Zingenisa kwakhona iicebeto ukubala izixhobo ezikwisandla sesebe nendlela yemisebenzi yangoku. Nceda ekuthungeni inqubo yokuqulunqa iinkqubo-zokuqulunqa-icebeto. Nikeza inkxaso-mbuso kwamaphondo ngelixa lisebenza kuqulunqo-lwasebela oluHlangeneyo lokuSebenza (IOP). Nikeza inkxaso-mbuso kwamaphondo ngelixa lisebenza ngokuqulunqa i IOPs.
