Versamel, analiseer en organiseer inligting ter voorbereiding van strategiese beplanningswerkswinkels en dokumente. Versamel beplanningsinligting van takke, provinsies ontleed in terme van relevansie en toepaslikheid. Kontroleer betroubaarheid voordat dit aan die beplanningsessie voorgelê word. Voer die ontwikkeling van Jaarlike Prestasieplanne (APP) en Tak Jaarlike Operasionele Planne (AOP) uit. Koördineer insette tot APP en AOP vir belyning met die Strategiese Plan en die Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) dokumente. Belyn inligting met hoëvlakplanne van die regering. Voer hersienings en herbelyning van Jaarlike Prestasieplan en Strategiese Plan (SP) uit. Bied hulp by die koördineer en fasiliteer van die hersiening en herbelyning van die APP en SP. Herbelyn planne met inagneming van hulpbronne tot die departement se beskikking en huidige prestasietendense. Bied hulp by die koördineer van die proses vir die ontwikkeling van departementele beplanningsriglyne. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan provinsies tydens die departement van Integrated Operational Plans (IOP). Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan provinsies tydens die ontwikkeling van IOP's.

zu.title: Umlondolozi Wokuqamba Amasu
zu.summary: Ukuhlaziwa kwamasu e-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ePretoria, kudinga i-Diploma Yezwe eNtsha kanye namaphakathi amathathu ahlongakele ekwenzeni amasu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izifundo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe eNtsha eNini Yokuphatha / Uphando Lomphakathi / Ukuphatha Ibhizinisi / Ukuphatha Ibhizinisi / Ukuphatha noma isiqu esihlobene kakhulu. Okuncane eminyakeni eyi-3 yokuhlolakude kokuqamba amasu noma ukulalela nokuhlaziya emkhaliphazeni kahulumeni. Ilayisenisi yomshayeli evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngokuphakama kwesikhashana kokuqamba amasu kahulumeni (Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP), indlela yokuqeda, njll.). Izinqubomgomo kahulumeni ezihehana nokuqamba amasu, ukulalela nokuhlaziya, indlela yokuqeda, nalokhu ehambisana ne-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development. Uphando olusukunyathi. Ukuthuthukisa izinkomba nokuphatha ulwazi lokuqhuba. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala imibhalo. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nokubhaliwe) kanye nobudlelwano bantfu. Ukuqoqa, ukuhlaziya nokuchaza ulwazi. Ukubumba inhlelo nokwenza kubambisane. Ukuhlaziya. Ukusebenza njengeqembu.
zu.duties: Qonda izinqubo zokuqamba amasu omnyango ngokuhlela, ukwenza kubambisane, kanye nokwenza amasekheduli ezinkomphi zokuqamba amasu. Ukuhlela nokwenza kubambisane izinkomphi zokuqamba amasu kuzohlanganisa ukuthumela izimemo, ukuthola izindawo, ukwaksha izinhlela zokuhlangana kanye nokuzidializa. Yenza izigqibo ngesikhathi nangemva kwezinkomphi zokuqamba amasu ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi oluqoqiwe ngesikhathi nangemva kwezinkomphi zokuqamba amasu lusatshalaliswa kubathintekayo futhi impendulo inikezwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekelwe. Qoqa, hlaziya futhi uhlele ulwazi ngokulungiselela izinkomphi zokuqamba amasu namadokhumenti. Qoqa ulwazi lokuhlela amasu ezikhungweni, ezigubini luluqhalalyse ngokuthi luhlobene kangakanani nalusebenza kanjani. Hlola ukuzethemba ngaphambi kokukwethula esikhathini sokuqamba amasu. Hlela ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlelo zokuQhuba Ngonyaka (APP) kanye nezinhlelo Zokusebenza Zesikhungo Ngonyaka (AOP). Yenza kubambisane okufakayo kwi-APP kanye ne-AOP ukuze kuhambisane neNhelelo Yesu kanye namadokhumenti we-Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP). Linganisa ulwazi nezinhlelo eziphezulu kahulumeni. Yenza ukuphonswa kabusha kanye nokulinganisa kabusha kweNhelelo YokuQhuba Ngonyaka kanye neNhelelo Yesu (SP). Siza ekwenzeni kubambisane nasekwenzeni izinkomphi zokuqamba amasu nokulinganisa kabusha kwe-APP ne-SP. Linganisa kabusha izinhlelo ngokubheka izinsiza ezingasetshenziswa umnyango kanye netrendi yokuqhuba okwamanje. Siza ekwenzeni kubambisane inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwemihlahulo yokuqamba amasu komnyango. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe esigubini ngesikhathi kwenziwa izinhlelo Zokusebenza EziBekiwe ndawonye (IOP). Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe esigubini ngesikhathi kuthuthukiswa ama-IOP.

xh.title: Umlondolozo weNqubo
xh.summary: Umlondolozo weNqubo yiNqaba kwisebe loLungelelwaniso nguRhulumente noPhuhliso oPhakathi-nasemaphandleni ePretoria, kufuneka kubekho iDiploma yeSizwe neminyaka elingu-3 yolungelelwaniso olucwangcisiweyo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowasemshini: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seQabane lesi-12 kwaye be neSatifikethi sesiQabane seDiploma kwimiQathango kaRhulumente / yoLawulo lwemiQathango / yoLawulo lweShishini / loLawulo lweShishini / yoLawulo okanye nesiNgangatho esilinganayo. Iqabane elincinci leminyaka elingu-3 emisebenzini yolungelelwaniso okanye ekuboniseni nasekubekwa ngokubakho kwindawo karhulumente. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluxhwithwe kumsebenzi: Ulwazi malunga nendlela karhulumente yokulungelelwaniso (uPhando lwemali eRhulumente iPhakathi nexesha (MTEF), iNqubo yoPhuhliso iPhakathi nexesha (MTDP), iindlela zemiphumela, njl.njl.). Iinkqubo zorhulumente ezinxulumene nolungelelwaniso olucwangcisiweyo, ukubonisa nokubeka ngokubakho, iindlela zemiphumela, nabo bona abanjengoxhumano noQoqosho oluLungelelwanisiweyo noluPhuhliso lwePhakathi. Uphononongo olusisiseko. Ukuphuhlisa iinkomba nokulawula ulwazi ngemisebenzi. Amakhono axhwithwe kumsebenzi: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukubhala iingxelo. Unxibelelwano (olwenziwe ngomlomo nolubhaliweyo) nemiganu yomntu nomntu. Ukuqokeleza, ukuhlalutya nokutolika ulwazi. Ukwakheka kwentsebenziswano nokuyiqweba. Ukwahlula-hlula. Ukusebenza njengqela.
xh.duties: Qonda iinkqubo zolungelelwaniso lwisebe ngokulungiselela, ukuqweba, nokunceda ukuba kwenzeke iindaba ezimalunga nolungelelwaniso. Ukulungiselela nokuqweba iindaba ezimalunga nolungelelwaniso kuya kubandakanya ukuthumela imemorandam, ukufumana amabali, ukwenza iziczabelo kwaye zithunyelwe. Qedelisa iinkqubo ngexesha nangemva kweendaba ezimalunga nolungelelwaniso ngokuqinisekisa ukuba ulwazi olusongiwe ngexesha nangemva kweendaba ezimalunga nolungelelwaniso lusasazwa kubandakanyekayo kwaye nimbiwe malunga nazo kwimizi efunwayo. Qokeleza, hlalutywa ulwazi nilungelelanise ngolungelelwaniso olucwangciswe ngeendaba ezimalunga nolungelelwaniso namaxwebhu. Qokeleza ulwazi ngolungelelwaniso kwizithili, kumaphondo lwahlulwa-hlulwa ngokwento ekuyyo nakwindlela esetyenziswa kuyo. Jonga ukwethembeka ngaphambi kokuba luziswa kwisikhululo solungelelwaniso. Yenza inkqubo yepiliso leNqubo leMinyaka yokuSebenza (APP) neMigangatho yokuSebenza yeNqubo yeSithili (AOP). Qhagamshela imiyalelo kwi-APP nakwi-AOP ukuze ivumelane neNqubo yeLungelelwaniso namaxwebhu eNqubo yePhakathi-xesha leNqubo yoPhuhliso (MTDP). Misela ulwazi ngokweemphawu ezinkulu zolungelelwaniso karhulumente. Yenza iinngcebiso nokubuyisela endleleni eyiyo iNqubo yeMinyaka yokuSebenza neNqubo yeLungelelwaniso (SP). Nceda ekugqamiseni nasekuphumelelisweni kokubuyisela endleleni eyiyo i-APP ne-SP. Buyisela endleleni eyo iinkqubo ukuze ubaleke iingcinga ezifumaneka kwisebe nendlela ekuphela kwayo imisebenzi. Nceda ekugqamiseni inkqubo yokuvelisa izikhokelo zolungelelwaniso lwisebe. Nikela nenceba ekuchanekileyo kumaphondo ngexesha lokhetho lweNqubo yeNqanaba elihleliweyo (IOP). Nikela nenceba ekuchanekileyo kumaphondo ngexesha lokwenza i-IOPs.

jobs.title: Principal Geomatics Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Capture and process geospatial data into the Integrated Topographic System, interpreting imagery and mapping topographical features in Mowbray.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Minimum of 6 years geomatics post qualification experience in geomatics, geospatial information science. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of surveying, photogrammetry, cartography, geo-spatial information science. Good Geographical Information Science (GIS) knowledge regarding data capture, structuring and manipulation. Knowledge of aerial photo interpretation for topographic mapping. Knowledge including feature identification and data representation. Knowledge of Geographical Information Systems software. Performance management and monitoring. Theory, principles and practices of standards. Job related skills: Problem solving and analysis. Decision making. Team leadership and creativity. Customer focus and responsiveness. Communication (verbal and written). Computer literacy. Planning and organising. Conflict management and negotiation.
jobs.duties: Capture different geospatial data into the Integrated Topographic System. Interpret imagery and map the topographical features. Ensure topological rules are applied in accordance with the topographic standard. Document the processes for application of topographical rules. Ensure all topographical features metadata is captured. Map the land cover classes in accordance with the defined standard. Perform geospatial data analysis according to the requirements. Quality check the accuracy of mapped land cover classes in accordance with requirements. Ensure compliance to the standards in maintaining geospatial in the database. Monitor availability of archives tapes. Contribute / participate in the development of procedure and standard documents. Provide reports on the monitoring of the Tape Library equipment’s and software. Ensure random checks on readability of archive tapes. Extract and provide geospatial data from the database. Process the aerial imagery spatial flight plan data (photo, flight lines and boundary) in the database and provide a report. Provide report on all completed and published vector data to Integrated Topographic Information System (ITIS) for aerial Imagery. Store all aerial imagery ground position system data files in the database according to the defined structure. Acquire, process and produce geospatial information for all mapping purposes. Source, edit and manipulate geospatial data for creating maps. Prepare, validate and import geospatial data for map spatial environment. Validate the processed geographic names and ancillary data. Ensure application of defined cartographic generalisation principles to enhance geospatial data during map production. Ensure compliance to standards and specifications at all times. Undertake photogrammetric absolute orientation of aerial imagery in accordance with standards and specifications. Perform quality check and verify accuracy of processed data as required. Archive the final maps and geospatial data in accordance with the standard. Disseminate, promote and quality assure geo-spatial information and services to clients. Provide and ensure the correctness of geo-spatial information to clients in accordance with service delivery standards. Create awareness to internal and external clients. Report on quality related issues and participate in processes to ensure quality. Assist with the revision of datasets of products and services for established vendors with district municipalities. Assist with stock management and stock reconciliations. Maintain copyright of geospatial information. Ensure correctness of invoices and quotations. Perform administrative and related functions. Provide advice to clients on use of products and services, including the Geoportal. Acquire, validate and process ancillary data for topographic mapping purposes. Verify and ensure all geo- spatial data and materials for field annotation are accurate for each map. Use the different ancillary geospatial data and verify all the changes detected on previous edition map are recorded. Prepare a report with all the queries classified from digital field annotation for each map. Source ancillary data and authenticate the geographic names and their geographic position in a map. Ensure all captured and processed ancillary data meets the requirements and available in the database (Integrated Topographic Data).
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 4th floor, No 2 Riebeeck Street, ABSA Building, Cape Town or by email to Post227@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, and Indian Males and African and Indian Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to the high volume of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Hoof Geomatika Beampte
af.summary: Vang en verwerk geospatiale data in die Integrated Topographic System, interpreteer beeldmateriaal en karteer topografiese eienskappe in Mowbray.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatika of 'n Opmetingsbeampte-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5) hê. Minimum van 6 jaar na-kwalifikasie-ervaring in geomatika, geospatiale inligtingswetenskap. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van opmeting, fotogrammetrie, kartografie, geospatiale inligtingswetenskap. Goeie Geografiese Inligtingswetenskap (GIS) kennis rakende datavaslegging, struktuurering en manipulasie. Kennis van lugfoto-interpretasie vir topografiese kartering. Kennis insluitend eienskapsidentifikasie en dataweergawe. Kennis van Geografiese Inligtingstelsels-sagteware. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Teorie, beginsels en gebruike van standaarde. Werksverwante vaardighede: Probleemoplossing en analise. Besluitneming. Spanleierskap en kreatiwiteit. Kliëntefokus en reaksievermoë. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Beplanning en organisering. Konflikbestuur en onderhandeling.
af.duties: Vang verskillende geospatiale data in die Geïntegreerde Topografiese Stelsel vas. Interpreteer beeldmateriaal en karteer die topografiese eienskappe. Verseker dat topologiese reëls ooreenkomstig die topografiese standaard toegepas word. Dokumenteer die prosesse vir die toepassing van topografiese reëls. Verseker dat al die topografiese eienskappe se metadata vasgevang word. Karteer die landbedekkingsklasse ooreenkomstig die gedefinieerde standaard. Voer geospatiale data-analise uit volgens die vereistes. Kontroleer die akkuraatheid van gekarteerde landbedekkingsklasse ooreenkomstig vereistes. Verseker voldoening aan die standaarde by die instandhouding van geospatiale data in die databasis. Monitor die beskikbaarheid van argief bande. Dra by / neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van prosedure- en standaarddokumente. Verskaf verslae oor die monitering van die Bandbiblioteek se toerusting en sagteware. Verseker ewekansige kontroles op die leesbaarheid van argiefbande. Trek geospatiale data uit die databasis en verskaf dit. Verwerk die lugbeeldmateriaal se ruimtelike vlugplandata (foto, vluglyne en grens) in die databasis en verskaf 'n verslag. Verskaf 'n verslag oor alle voltooide en gepubliseerde vektordata aan die Geïntegreerde Topografiese Inligtingstelsel (ITIS) vir lugbeeldmateriaal. Stoor alle lugbeeldmateriaal se grondposisioneringstelsel data-lêers in die databasis volgens die gedefinieerde struktuur. Verkry, verwerk en produseer geospatiale inligting vir alle karteringsdoeleindes. Bron, redigeer en manipuleer geospatiale data vir die skep van kaarte. Berei geospatiale data voor, valideer dit en voer dit in vir die kaart se ruimtelike omgewing. Valideer die verwerkte geografiese name en aanvullende data. Verseker toepassing van gedefinieerde kartografiese veralgemeningsbeginsels om geospatiale data tydens kaartproduksie te verbeter. Verseker te alle tye voldoening aan standaarde en spesifikasies. Onderneem fotogrammetriese absolute oriëntasie van lugbeeldmateriaal ooreenkomstig standaarde en spesifikasies. Voer kwaliteitskontrole uit en verifieer die akkuraatheid van verwerkte data soos vereis. Argiveer die finale kaarte en geospatiale data ooreenkomstig die standaard. Versprei, bevorder en verseker die kwaliteit van geospatiale inligting en dienste aan kliënte. Verskaf en verseker die korrektheid van geospatiale inligting aan kliënte ooreenkomstig diensleweringstandaarde. Skep bewustheid by interne en eksterne kliënte. Rapporteer oor kwaliteitsverwante kwessies en neem deel aan prosesse om kwaliteit te verseker. Help met die hersiening van datastelle van produkte en dienste vir gevestigde verkopers met distriksmunisipaliteite. Help met voorraadbestuur en voorraadafstemming. Handhaaf kopiereg van geospatiale inligting. Verseker die korrektheid van fakture en kwotasies. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Verskaf advies aan kliënte oor die gebruik van produkte en dienste, insluitend die Geoportal. Verkry, valideer en verwerk aanvullende data vir topografiese karteringsdoeleindes. Verifieer en verseker dat alle geospatiale data en materiaal vir veldannotasie vir elke kaart akkuraat is. Gebruik die verskillende aanvullende geospatiale data en verifieer dat al die veranderinge wat op die vorige uitgawe se kaart opgemerk is, aangeteken is. Berei 'n verslag voor met al die navrae wat uit die digitale veldannotasie geklassifiseer is vir elke kaart. Bron aanvullende data en authentiseer die geografiese name en hul geografiese posisie op 'n kaart. Verseker dat al die vasgevangde en verwerkte aanvullende data aan die vereistes voldoen en beskikbaar is in die databasis (Geïntegreerde Topografiese Data).

zu.title: Induna Ephathwe Ngomlinganiso Wamazwe Nomhlaba
zu.summary: Butha futhi ulenze idatha yendaweni yomhlaba ihamba ngaphakathi kwe-Integrated Topographic System, ihumusha imifanekiso yendawo ibe yimaphu ezobonakalisa izici zobuzwe bomhlaba eMowbray.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nesitifiketi se-National Certificate in Geomatics noma i-Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Okuncane eminyakeni engu-6 ngaphezu kokuthola iziqu imisebenzi ehlobene nomlinganiso wamazwe kwe-geomatics, geospatial information science. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngokuqashwa komhlaba, i-photogrammetry, ukwakheka kwamaphu, i-geo-spatial information science. Ulwazi oluhle lokuhlakanisa ulwazi kwe-Geographical Information Science (GIS) mayelana nokubuthwa kwedatha, ukulungelelanisa nokulawula. Ulwazi ngokuhumusha izithombe zasemaphezulu ukuze kwenziwe amaphu ezici zomhlaba. Ulwazi okuhlanganisa ukukhomba izici nezinkomba zedatha. Ulwazi ngesofthiwe i-Geographical Information Systems. Ukuphathwa nokubheka ukusebenza. Inqondo, imigomo kanye nezindlela zomlinganiso wemigomo. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokucazula. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuba ngumbhali weqembu kanye nobuciko. Ukuqakamisa amakhasimende kanye nokuphendula. Ukuthintana (ngomlomo nokubhaliwe). Ukubuka okwengqondo kwekhompyutha. Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye nokuxoxisana.
zu.duties: Butha idatha ehlukene yendaweni yomhlaba ihamba ngaphakathi kwe-Integrated Topographic System. Humusha imifanekiso uze uwabalize izici zobuzwe bomhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yendawo isetshenziswa ngokuvumelana nomlinganiso wobuzwe bomhlaba. Qamba imibhalo ngezinhlaka zokusethwa kwemithetho yobuzwe bomhlaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imininingwane yezici zobuzwe bomhlaba ibuthwe. Baliza amakilasi okumbozisa umhlaba ngokuvumelana nomlinganiso ochaziwe. Yenza ukuhlaziya kwedatha yendaweni yomhlaba ngokuvumelana nezidingo. Hlola izinga lokunemba kwamakilasi okumbozisa umhlaba abhalwe ngokuvumelana nezidingo. Qinisekisa ukuzigcina ngemigomo ephathelene nokugcina idatha yendaweni yomhlaba kwidathabhesi. Bheka ukuthithatheka kwethephu zesikhathi sangaphambili. Ngenisa umnikelo / thatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni kwezinqubo kanye namadokhumenti omlinganiso. Nikela ngemibiko ekubukelweni kwethephu zesikhathi somtapo wolwazi kwezisetshenziswa kanye nesofthiwe. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa okungahleliwe kokubukeka kwethephu zesikhathi sangaphambili. Khupha futhi unike idatha yendaweni yomhlaba esidathabhesini. Lenza idatha yendlela yezulu yezithombe zasemaphezulu (izithombe, imigqa yezindiza kanye nomngcele) esidathabhesini uze unike imibiko. Nikela ngemibiko ngawo wonke amaphu ohlelo lwedatha alensiwe futhi asetshenziswe kwi-Integrated Topographic Information System (ITIS) mayelana nezithombe zasemaphezulu. Gcina wonke amafayela edatha yesistimu yendawo yezithombe zasemaphezulu esidathabhesini ngokuvumelana nendlela echaziwe. Thola, lenze futhi udale ulwazi lwendaweni yomhlaba zonke izinjongo zemaphu. Thola, hlela futhi ulawule idatha yendaweni yomhlaba ngaphandle ukuze udale amaphu. Lungiselela, qinisekisa futhi ufake idatha yendaweni yomhlaba ngaphandle kwendawo yamaphu. Qinisekisa amagama azwe azocutshungulwa kanye nalawo olwazi olungeziwe. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemigomo echaziwe yokunciphiswa kwemaphu ukuthuthukisa idatha yendaweni yomhlaba ngesikhathi senziwa amaphu. Qinisekisa ukuzigcina ngemigomo kanye nezinkomba wonke isikhathi. Yenza ukukalwa okuzimele kokuhlelwa kwemifanekiso yasemaphezulu ngokuvumelana nemigomo kanye nezinkomba. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi ukuqinisekisa ukunemba kwedatha eqoshiwe njengoko kudingeka. Gcina amaphu okugcina kanye nedatha yendaweni yomhlaba ngokuvumelana nomlinganiso. Saza, khuthaza futhi qinisekisa ikhwalithi yolwazi nemisebenzi yendaweni yomhlaba kumakhasimende. Nikela futhi qinisekisa ukunemba kwolwazi lwendaweni yomhlaba kumakhasimende ngokuvumelana nemigomo yokunikeza isevisi. Dala ukwaziswa kwabakhasimende bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Nike imibiko mayelana nezindaba zekhwalithi bese uthatha inxaxheba ezinqamulelweni ukuze uqinisekise ikhwalithi. Siza ngokuhlelwa kabusha kwama-data ukutholakala kwemikhiqizo kanye namasevisi ongadayi balawulayo kwamasenshasenhla. Siza ngokuphathwa kwesitoko kanye nokubuyekezwa kwesitoko. Gcina ilungelo lokushicilela kolwazi lwendaweni yomhlaba. Qinisekisa ukunemba kwezinkokhela kanye namafomu ocela. Yenza imisebenzi yengqungquthle mayelana nemisebenzi ehlobene. Nikezelwa ngeluleko abakhasimende ngokusethwa kwemikhiqizo kanye namasevisi, okuhlanganisa i-Geoportal. Thola, qinisekisa futhi ulenze idatha olungeziwe ngenhlayo yamaphu obuzwe bomhlaba. Qinisekisa futhi oboke ukuthi yonke idatha yendaweni yomhlaba kanye nezinto zokuqasha endaweni zinemba ngamunye amaphu. Sebenzisa idatha ehlukene olungeziwe yendaweni yomhlaba bese uqinisekisa ukuthi yonke izinguquko ezitholiwe kwenguqulo yangaphambili yamaphu zibhalwe. Lungiselela imibiko nazo zonke izinkinga ezhaziwe kusuka ekubhaleni kwendawo ngamunye amaphu. Thola idatha olungeziwe bese uqinisekisa amagama azwe kanye nendawo yawo ohlelweni lwamaphu. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke idatha olungeziwe ebuthiwe necutshungulwe ihambisana nezidingo futhi itholakala esidathabhesini (Integrated Topographic Data).

Phatha imiyalo yokukhokha usebenzisa ulwazi olulungile lwabafuni imali, ukuhlanzwa kanye nezinkambu ezihambisanayo. Gcina ukukhokha kwi-BAS kanye nakwi-PERSAL. Uhlela izinsiza zoMnyango Wezinkonzo Zokuhlinza. Lungiselela imibiko yamakhota eminyaka yonke ukwenzela ukufakwa kwemibiko yezimali (Izibopho, Iintshisekelo Zokuthenga Umhlaba, Ii-Akhawunti Ze-Bhange kanye Nezinto Ezingase Zenzike) ukufakwa kwemibiko yezimali yethemba kanye Nemibiko Yezimali Yonyaka. Phatha imibuzo yokuhlola. Hlela izimiso zokuhlola. Phatha impendulo ekusheshise kwezimiso zokuhlola uqiniseke ukuthi kwamukelewa usuku olumisiwe. Hlela ulwazi olucelwe yi-Office of the Auditor-General, Internal Audit, SIU kanye Nabahloli Bezocalo. Hlanganisa amarekhoda kanye namarekhodi okukhokha. Phatha ukuhlanganisa kwamaphrojekthi phakathi kwe-Commitment Register, Summary Vote sheets, XXX Reports, BAS kanye Namafayela Ephrojekthi njengoba kudingeka. Buyekeza i-Commitment Register kanye ne-Land Purchase Register nyanga zonke. Buyekeza amashithi okufingqa, XXX Reports njengoba kudingeka. Hlela ama-General Journals ezimeni zokuhlanzwa okungalungile ukuze kulungiswe. Buyekeza i-akhawunti yesisindi. Buyekeza i-Suspense Account Summaries. Hlela imibiko ye-akhawunti yesisindi nyanga zonke.

xh.title: Umphathi wegunya likaRhulumente Ogqithisileyo
xh.summary: Isithuba somPhathi wegunya likaRhulumente Ogqithisileyo ePretoria esifuna iDiploma yaseLwizwe kwezeMali kunye neminyaka emibini yamava, sihlawulela R413,001 ngeminyaka yonke kwinqanaba 8.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezifunekayo: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12 nedediploma yaseLwizwe kwezakhiwo zezimali okuloLawulo lwezeMali okuloKuhlelwa kangenangaphakathi okunye naluphi na izidanga ezilinganayo ezifanelekayo. Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe kwakhona umva yeminyaka emi-2 yamava kwezeMali. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olusesentweni ngemisebenzi yezimali, iinkqubo kunye namandla okungena idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zemali. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kweBAS, umthetho wokuqhwabela iNgeniso, umthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zikaRhulumente nomgaqo-nkqubo weTreasury nomthetho ohambelana nokubhalwa kweenkomfa ezingezimali. Ulwazi lolulo lwezeMali, kuquka nomthetho ohambelana nokubhalwa kweenkomfa ezingezimali. Amandla ohambelana nomsebenzi: Ukubhala iingxelo nokucothisa (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo), uqhathaniso lwabantu, ukuziphatha ngokwakhompyutha, amandla ahlalutyiyo nobuchwephesha kwiExcel nakuMS Word.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ngokuthe ngqo intlawulo yokubuyisela kunye neerekhodi zoku-itsentsa. Hlela uluhlu lwentlawulo yamaphrojekthi uze wenze uqhathaniso. Yenza ngokucothiswa iinkcazelo zentlawulo sisebenzisa iinkcukacha ezichanekileyo zabafuni-intlawulo, kwahlulwe kwaye zihambelane nemimiselo. Gcina iintlawulo ze-BAS nePERSAL. Ulungelelaniso iinkonzo zoLawulo lomthombo weKontrakthi. Lungiselela iingxelo zethatu-nyanga ezenzelwa ingeniselo kumagama ezeMali (Izithembiso, Iintshiselwa zokuTyhala iMali, ii-Akhawunti zeBhanki kunye neMiba) ezenzelwa ukungenisa kumagama ezeMali angokuhloboleko nangomnyaka wonke. Lawula imibuzo yokuhlolwa kwangaphakathi. Lungiselelanisa iziphumo soKuhlolwa kwangaphakathi. Yenza ngokucothiswa iimpendulo zethutyana ekuhlohlweni kwaye uqinisekise ukuba umhla owabelwe usetyenziselwa ngokuchanekileyo. Lungiselelanisa ulwazi olucelwa yiOfisi ye-Auditor-General, uKuhlolwa kwangaphakathi, iSIU neKhomishoni yokufumanisa ulwazi ngokutsha. Dibanisa irekhodi zentlawulo. Lawula uqhathaniso lomsebenzi phakathi koQwalaselo lwesithembiso, iisheeti zeVoti ezingohlwahlwana, iiNgxelo ezi-XXX, i-BAS namafayili ephrojekthi njengoko kufuneka. Hlaziya uQwalaselo lwesiThemiso nerejista yokuthengiswa komhlaba rhoqo nyakenye. Hlaziya iisheeti ezididiyiliweyo, iiNgxelo ezi-XXX njengoko kufuneka. Hlela iNkomfa eJikelele xa kukho ukungahambelani ngenjongo zolungiso. Hlaziya ibhanki yokubamba ideyithi. Hlaziya isamari yomtshato wokubamba ideyithi. Hlela iingxelo zebhanki yokubamba ideyithi qho nyakenye.

jobs.title: Information Security Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Information Security Officer needed in Pretoria to implement document security and information management controls within the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicant must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Management / Records Management / Security Management (NQF Level 6) or related equivalent qualification. Minimum of 1 year experience in relevant working environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of information security, records management, and minimum information standards. Job related skills: Communication (verbal and written), Facilitation, Report writing, Interpersonal relations and analytical. Must be able to travel extensively.
jobs.duties: Perform document/information management control. Implement Document and Information Security in terms of MISS. Monitor and inspect the movement of information within DLRRD. Implement standards for ensuring controlled access of information. Implement departmental security policies and standard operating procedures. Develop standard operating procedures in line with MISS. Ensure classification of sensitive information in line with MISS. Ensure that all officials complete declaration of secrecy forms. Perform security audits. Perform after-hours inspections. Report incidents pertaining to information security. Ensure that all officials complete declaration of secrecy forms. Facilitate Communication Security through SSA. Conduct ad hoc Registries Security inspection in line with MISS. Integrated Security Strategy of DLRRD in line with MISS and MPSS. Conduct Information Security Awareness. Conduct induction presentations to newly appointed officials. Conduct feedback sessions on Security Audit and Assessments. Conduct Integrated Security Awareness. Develop an awareness pamphlet and ensure communication. Develop and Communicate Information Security Plans.

af.title: Inligtingsekuriteitsbeampte
af.summary: Inligtingsekuriteitsbeampte benodig in Pretoria om dokumentsekuriteits- en inligtingsbestuurskontroles binne die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development te implementeer.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoeker moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Bestuur / Rekordbestuur / Sekuriteitsbestuur (NQF Level 6) of verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasie hê. Minimum van 1 jaar ondervinding in 'n relevante werksomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werkverwante kennis: Kennis van inligtingsveiligheid, rekordbestuur, en minimum inligtingsstandaarde. Werkverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), fasilitering, verslagskrywing, interpersoonlike verhoudinge en analities. Moet in staat wees om uitgebreid te reis.
af.duties: Voer dokument-/inligtingsbestuurskontrole uit. Implementeer dokument- en inligtingsveiligheid volgens MISS. Monitor en inspekteer die beweging van inligting binne DLRRD. Implementeer standaarde om beheerde toegang tot inligting te verseker. Implementeer departementele sekuriteitsbeleid en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Ontwikkel standaard bedryfsprosedures in ooreenstemming met MISS. Verseker klassifikasie van sensitiewe inligting in ooreenstemming met MISS. Verseker dat alle amptenare geheimhoudingsverklaringsvorms voltooi. Voer sekuriteitsoudits uit. Voer na-uur-inspeksies uit. Rapporteer voorvalle rakende inligtingsveiligheid. Verseker dat alle amptenare geheimhoudingsverklaringsvorms voltooi. Fasiliteer Kommunikasiesekuriteit deur SSA. Voer ad hoc Registratuursekuriteitsinspeksies uit in ooreenstemming met MISS. Geïntegreerde Sekuriteitsstrategie van DLRRD in ooreenstemming met MISS en MPSS. Voer inligtingsveiligheidsbewusmaking uit. Hou indrukpredisentasies vir nuut aangestelde amptenare. Hou terugvoersessies oor Sekuriteitsoudit en Assesserings. Voer Geïntegreerde Sekuriteitsbewusmaking uit. Ontwikkel 'n bewusmakingspamflet en verseker kommunikasie. Ontwikkel en kommunikeer Inligtingssekuriteitsplanne.

zu.title: Inkwenti Yokuvikela Imininingwane
zu.summary: Kudingeka Inkwenti Yokuvikela Imininingwane ePretoria ukufeza izilawuli zokuvikela izibhalo nokuphathwa kolwazi ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
zu.requirements: Izidingo eyingqikithi: Umfundi kufanele abe nesiQinisekiso seGrade 12 kanye neDiploma Yezwe ekuphathweni / ekuphathweni kwezibhalo / ekuphathweni kokuvikela (NQF Level 6) noma iziqu ezingulinganayo. Ukwazisebenza okungenani unyaka o-1 endaweni yokusebenza ehlobene. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwazi ngokuvikela kolwazi, ukuphathwa kwezibhalo, kanye nemingemo eyingqikithi yolwazi. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangesibhalo), ukukhokela, ukubhala imibiko, ubudlelwano obuhloniphane kanye nokuhlaziya. Kufanele ukwazi ukuhamba kakhulu.
zu.duties: Qapha ukulawulwa kwezibhalo/ukuphathwa kwolwazi. Faka ezokuvikela Izibhalo nolwazi ngokusho kwe-MISS. Qapha futhi uhlole ukunyakaza kolwazi ngaphakathi kwe-DLRRD. Faka izingezu eziqinisekisa ukulawula ukungena kolwazi. Faka imigomo yesokuvikela yomnyango kanye nezingezu eziyisisekelo zokusebenza. Buthula izingezu eziyisisekelo zokusebenza ngokuhambisana ne-MISS. Qinisekisa ukuklanywa kolwazi oluzwelayo ngokuhambisana ne-MISS. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bagcwalisa amafomu okumemezela ukuziphatha kuyimfihlo. Yenza ukuhlola kokuvikela. Yenza ukutholula emva vemahora asebenzayo. Bika izenzakalo ezihlobene nokuvikela kolwazi. Qinisekisa ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bagcwalisa amafomu okumemezela ukuziphatha kuyimfihlo. Khokha ukuvikela kolwazi lokuxhumana ngaphandle kwe-SSA. Yenza ukuhlolwa kokuvikela kwe-Registries ngokusho kwe-MISS. Isu Sokuvikela Esihlangene se-DLRRD ngokuhambisana ne-MISS kanye ne-MPSS. Yenza ukwazisa ngokuvikela kolwazi. Yenta izethulo zokwaziswa kubasebenzi abasha abathi bajoyina. Yenza izingxoxo ezinikeza umbiko ngokuhlola kokuvikela kanye nokukalwa. Yenza ukwazisa ngokuvikela okuhlangene. Buthula incwadi yokwazisa futhi uqinisekise ukuxhumana. Buthula futhi uxhume amaPhula Wokuvinjelwa kolwazi.

xh.title: Ngumenzi-msebenzi weKhuseleko ngokubanzi ePitoli esemthethweni wokuhombisa amaqhinga ezenzakalo ezingavelwanga ngexesha nolawulo lweenkqubo ngokusesikweni njengoko kubhalwe kwinkqubo yokuchazwa ngabakwiSebe loGqozo-lwazi neNtshukumo nezokuqinisekiswa kwemiba yolutsha kwisithili esikwisiphithiphithi.
xh.summary: Ngumsebenzi weSikhululi-nkqubo ngokupheleleyo ofuna into ekule ifakweyi kwaye kudwetwe iindidi ezahlukeneyo ezokugcina ukhuseleko kwizinto ezibalulekileyo, nolawulo lweNkqubo yokuSebenzisa iSaziso seZiko esisezantsi kwiSebe leNyuso nekuPhuhlisa iMveliso esuka kwindlela esemthethweni ukuya kwinkqubomgama yoKhuseleko olupheleleyo ngokuzimisela nokuzinza ngokupheleleyo ngendlela ekuqwalaselwa.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno esebenzayo: Umfuni kufuneka abe nesatifikethi seBanga le-12 kwaye abe neDiploma yoLwazi Iqondo seNqanaba (NQF Level 6) kummandla ongabonakaliyo okunye iNgqango eqondene neeNqanaba. Iminyaka engu-1 yamava aphila kwindlela yokusebenza ngokusesikweni namava amakhulu. Ilayisenisi yokushishiya ivakatshelo ekushishini. Ulwazi ngokuchukumbisa uluntu: Ulwazi ngokuchukumbisa uluntu, ukubhalwa kolwazi, kwaye ngokusebenzisa imigangatho ephantsi yolwazi. Amaphupha alungelelanisa: Ukuthetha (ngolwimi nangokubhalwayo), Ukukhokela Iintlanganiso ezingoBomini, ukuBhala Iingxelo, ukuzimisela nokubakho mandla okwahlulahlula. Kufuneka ukuba namandla okuhamba elakuqondileyo eendaweni ezininzi.
xh.duties: Yenza ulawulo lwebhalisi/manokusentsimbi yolwazi. Zisebenzise Ikhuseleko leBhalisi nolwazi ngokweMISS. Lilindele uvakatshelo lokuhamba kolwazi ngaphakathi kwiDLRRD. Zisebenzise iimigangathookuqinisekisa ukufikelela kolwazi olulawulwayo. Zisebenzise iinkqubomgama zokhuseleko zesebe nendlela ezisemgangathweni yokusebenza. Yenza iindlela ezisemgangathweni zokusebenza ngokweMISS. Qinisekisa ukubekwa kohlangothi lolwazi oluzwelayo ngokweMISS. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi bagcwalise iifomu zesivumelwano sokugcina imfihlo. Yenza uphondo lokuqinisekisa ukhuseleko. Yenza uvakatshelo ngemva yamawaka ezamva. Chaza iimeko ezihlotshelwe nokhuseleko lolwazi. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi bagcwalise iifomu zesivumelwano sokugcina imfihlo. Khokela Ikhuseleko loNxibelelwano ngeSSA. Yenza uvakatshelo olungachaziwe lokhuseleko leefayili ngokweMISS. Ingcamango eNamanzi yeKhuseleko yeDLRRD ngokweMISS nakuMPSS. Yenza uQqoniso lweNqanaba loKhuseleko lolwazi. Yiza izandiso ezingasentsomini aphishe abasebenzi abasha. Yiza iintlanganiso ezibuyisela isiphelo malunga noPhando nokulinganisa uKhuseleko. Yiza uQqoniso eNqanaba iNgcamango eNamanzi. Yenza isibhaka-nxaxheba sokwazisa aze aqinisekise ukusetyenziswa kolwimi yokuthetha-cinga. Yiza kunyanzeliswa iNgcamango nokuqhuba imisebenzi yayo ngokweNqanaba iNgcamango yeNyaniso yokuSebenzisa ngokweMPSS. Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kweenkonzo ezinganikezelwa isibhaka-nxaxheba kwikomiti namakomiti amakhulu ezithiyei zolawulo olungalathanga kwiindawo kwiindawo ezikummandla wezantsi nexesha elingekho kwakhona kwiimeko ezakha amacandwe eeNkokheli beNqanaba eli-2 apha kwinkqubo yesi 5 yamashumi amathathu na. Tshintsha iinkqubomgama zokuhombisa amaqhinga ngokomthetho weNqanaba eli-2 leMveliso ngokumiselwa kwendlela ezisemgangathweni zokusebenza ezilandela imithetho neenguqulo ezichaziweyo zeNqanaba eli-2, kwiindlela zokusebenzisa nezinye iinkqubo ezichaziweyo ekungeniseni uLwazi ekuchukumbisweni ngokubanzi. Misa iimeko zokuqinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa imiqathango yokusebenza ngokusetyenziswa kweenkonzo ezinkqubo ezili-10 ezichaziweyo kwinkqubomgama yentengiselwano ngokusebenzisa iinkqubomgama ezizele ezingasemva ekungacacanga. Khulisa amandla oLwazi iNgcamango ngokusebenzisa amanqanaba amathathu eNqanaba iNgcamango ekuqwalaselwa ngokumiliselwa ngokumgangatho wolwazi oqinisekisa ukuba akukho mqondiso kwingcamango ngokubanzi.

jobs.summary: Supervise financial accounting transactions, invoice processing and filing for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.

Basic knowledge and insight of the Public Services Financial legislations procedures and Treasury regulations (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). af.title: Finansieklerk (SUPERVISOR)
af.summary: Bestuur finansiële rekeningkundige transaksies, faktureverwerking en liassering vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Sertifikaat of relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n finansiële omgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Basiese kennis van finansiële funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële statistieke te versamel. Basiese kennis en insig van die Public Services Financial legislations prosedures en Treasury regulations (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS ens). Werksverwante vaardighede: Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaarbedryf. Taal. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Basiese syfervaardighede. Buigsaamheid, Interpersoonlike verhoudinge, Spanwerk, vermoë om roetine take uit te voer, Vermoë om kantoortoerusting te bedryf, Akkuraatheid, Aanleg vir syfers, Bereidwilligheid om addisionele ure te werk soos en wanneer vereis.
af.duties: Bestuur en lewer finansiële rekeningkundige transaksies. Ontvang en wysig fakture. Verifieer fakture vir korrektheid, verifikasie en goedkeuring (Interne beheer). Verifieer verwerking van fakture (bv. vaslegging van betalings). Bestuur die liasserings van alle dokumente. Bestuur die insameling van kontant. Bestuur en verrig salarisadministrasie-ondersteuningsdienste. Ontvang en wysig salarisadviese. Verwerk en verseker die verwerking van salarisadviese (bv. kontroleer adviese vir korrektheid, lê salarisse, bonusse, salariswysigings, lê alle aftrekkings ens). Bestuur die invul van alle dokumente. Bestuur en verrig boekhoudondersteuningsdienste. Verifieer alle finansiële transaksies vasgelê. Ruim suspendeerrekenings uit. Lys debiteure en krediteure. Verifieer en verwerk die verwerking van elektroniese banktransaksies. Stel joernaal op en verifieer die opstel van joernale. Lewer 'n begrotingsondersteuningsdiens. Verifieer inligting versamel van begrotingshouers. Vergelyk en verifieer die vergelyking van besteding teen begroting. Identifiseer afwykings en verifieer die identifisering van afwykings. Verifieer die vaslegging, toewysings oorplasings op begroting. Bestuur die verspreiding van dokumente met betrekking tot die begroting. Bestuur die invul van alle dokumente. Bestuur die ontvangs en vaslegging van kontantbetalings. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne/personeel. Wys toe en verseker gehalte van werk. Personeelsontwikkeling. Evalueer personeel se werkverrigting. Pas dissipline toe.

zu.title: Clerk Wezimali (UMQAPHI)
zu.summary: Qapha izinkokhobo zokubhalwa kwezimali, ukuqashwa kwezinala nokugcinwa kwemibhalo ye-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Okungezona okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu-3 yokuhlangenwe nakho emkhakheni wezimali. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olwesisiseko lokusebenza kwezimali, izindlela zokwenza izinto kanye nokuhlakanipha okufanele kokungena okushelelayo kokusebenza kwezimali olulula kanye nobunye obuyisiseko. Ulwazi olwesisiseko nokuqonda okuseduze kolwazi ngemithetho, izinqubo namasiko ezimali Kolawulo Lomphakathi kanye nemithetho yesikhwama (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Ulwazi ngamahlelo okusebenza kwezimali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGIS etc). Amandla okusebenza ohlotsheni: Ukucinga futhi ulungiselele. Ukuqashwa kwemisebenzi. Ulwazi ngolimi. Ukuzwana okuhle ngomlomo nangokubhala. Ulwazi olulula lwesibalo. Ukuqina, Ukuhlobana nabantu, Ukusebenza ndawonye, amandla okwenza imisebenzi evamile, Amandla okusebenzisa izinsizakusebenza, Ukwenza izinto ngokunemba, Ukuthanda ukubala, Ukuzimisela ukusebenza amasinya njengoba kudingeka.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi unikeze izinkokhobo zokubhalwa kwezimali. Thola futhi wabalule ama-akhawunti ezingeni lokukhokha. Hlola ama-akhawunti ezingeni lokukhokha ukuze qinisekise ukuthi ayilungile, ukuqinisekiswa nokugunyazwa (Ukulawula ngaphakathi). Hlola ukuqashelwa kwama-akhawunti ezingeni lokukhokha (isb. ukufaka izinkokhelo). Qapha ugcino lwemibhalo yonke. Qapha ukuqoqwa kwezimali zasemaholeni. Qapha futhi wenze izinsiza zokweseka ukuphathwa kweziholo. Thola futhi wabalule izaziso ezingezihloko. Qasha futhi uqinisekise ukushaywa kwezaziso ezingezihloko (isb. hlola izaziso ukuthi ziyilungile, faka iziholo, izibhonusi, ukulungiswa kweziholo, faka ukususwa kwemali konke njll). Qapha ugcino lwemibhalo yonke. Qapha futhi wenze izinsiza zokweseka ukuphathwa kwezinhlayiya zemali. Hlola zonke izinkokhobo zemali ezifakiwe. Sula ama-akhawunti alindelayo. Bhalisa izikweletu nabakhokhayo. Hlola futhi uqhashe ukuphathwa kwezinkokhelo zezenhlolvu. Lenga okubhaliwe bese uhlola ukulengwa kwemibhalo. Nikela ngensiza yokweseka isabelo semali. Hlola ulwazi oluqoqiwe kubanikazi bezabelo. Qhathanisa futhi uqinisekise ukuqhathaniswa kokuchithwa kwemimali nesabelo. Hlola okuhlukile futhi uqinisekise ukubonwa kokuhluka. Qapha ukufakwa, ukwabelwa kanye nokudluliswa kwemali kusabelo. Qapha ukusatshwa kwemibhalo mayelana nesabelo. Qapha ugcino lwemibhalo yonke. Qapha ukutholwa nokufakwa kwezinkokhelo zemali zasemaholeni. Qapha abasebenzi. Balule futhi uqinisekise ikhwalithi yomsebenzi. Phuhlisa izisebenzi. Hlola ukusebenza kwesisebenzi. Faka isiyalazo.

xh.title: Mkhuseli Wezimali (UMPHATHI)
xh.summary: Lawula ngokwenziwa kwezimali, ukusingqongilewa kwamasenti kunye nokugcina amanqaku e-Komiti yoLwazi lweNgingqi ePitoli.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi okanye nembambana efanelekileyo. Okungenani unyaka wam-3 wamava kwimeko yezimali. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olusesichengeni ngokusebenza kwezimali, iindlela ezisetyenziswayo nakho nako ukubala iintsoro zolwazi, ukusebenzisa isikompyutha nokubutha iindleke zemizobo yezimali. Ulwazi noluqondo olusesichengeni ngomthetho wezezasemazweni zaseburhulumente iindlela kunye namacebo oLawulo weeNgeniso (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PSR, PPPFA, iNkqubo yokusebenza ngezimali). Ulwazi ngeendlela ezisesichengeni zokusebenza ngezimali (PERSAL, BAS, LOGI nibhaxa). Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: iNkqubo nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisa isikompyutha. Ulwimi. Ingcumisa elungileyo (yomlomo nengxalabhuni). Amakhono amabini okubala. Ukuguquguquka, ukuhambelana nabantu, ukusebenza ngokubini, isiphithiphithi, ukwenza imisebenzi eqhelekileyo, isiphithiphithi sokusebenzisa izixhobo zofisi, ukuchaneka, isakhono kumanani, ukuzifaka ngokuthanda ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo xa kufuneka.
xh.duties: Lawula kwaye uzenze izinto ezimali. Nika amasenti ukuba angenise iimvume ezahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukuba amasenti chanekile, uqinisekise uvume nokuqinisekisa (isiLawulo sangaphakathi). Qinisekisa ukuqhutywa kwemisebenzi yonikezelo lwemali (umz. ukubala iintlalo zentlawulo). Lawula ukugcina amaqokobhe kaqoqwe lunyaka. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kwemali. Lawula kwaye unikeze inkxaso yolwazi ngomvuzo. Nika amanqaku olwazi ngomvuzo ukuba awahlule. Qhubeza kwaye uqinisekise ukuba kuqhutshwa imisebenzi yolwazi lwomvuzo (umz. hlola ukuba amanqaku olwazi chanekile, qamba imivuzo, imivuzo yokukhuthaza, ukulungisa imivuzo, qamba onke amasenti axutyiweyo nobunye). Lawula ukugcwalisa kwaye ugubungela onke amaqokobhe. Lawula kwaye uzenze inkxaso yolwazi lobuchwephetshe. Qinisekisa onke amanqaku ezimali abhaliweyo. Qula iintsoro ezazimisiwe. Bhala abanikazi bentslawulo kunye nabatyaleli. Qinisekisa kwaye uqhubeze ukubhalwa kwemisebenzi yebhanga yabakhweli ngekhompyutha. Qamba iijonali kwaye uqinisekise ukuba ziqanjwe. Zinike inkxazo kwisicwangciso semali. Qinisekisa ulwazi oluqokelelwe kubanikazi besicwangciso. Qamba inguquko yokusetyenziswa kwemali eshishe ngakumbi ngokukhanya kolwango loqoqosho olumiswayo nelwenziwayo. Qinisekisa ukuba iindlela ezibonakalayo zolwazi lweemfuno zibhalwe ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa kweemfuno ezahlukeneyo, ukwabiwo kweemfuno ngokomthetho weli. Lawula ukusasazwa kwamaxwebhu ngenxa yesicwangciso semali. Lawula ukugcwalisa kwaye ugubungela onke amaqokobhe. Lawula ukwamkelwa nokubhalwa kweentlawulo zemali. Lawula abantu/nabasebenzi. Yaba umsebenzi ukuze uqinisekise ukuba ulungile. Ukuphuhlisa izisebenzi. Linganisa iziphumelelo zabasebenzi. Phatha ukwenza okungachanekanga ngokomthetho.

jobs.title: Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Capture and maintain cadastral document data for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mmabatho.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 and Certificate National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Completion of the training prescribed in order to fulfil the required qualification. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy. Understanding spatial data. Knowledge of the functions of Surveyors’-General Offices. Job related skills: Good interpersonal relations. Good communication (verbal and written). Computer software. Good organising ability.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of all cadastral documents: Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted Cadastral documents and undertake mathematical consistency checks and data verification for proposed new land parcels. Update Cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify Historical Cadastral documents. Maintenance of Cadastral Documents in accordance with legislated processes: Perform Withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Amend approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements: Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Perform technical examination of diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of sectional title plans. Supply cadastral information to internal and external clients: Issue Survey data to Land Surveyors when required. Disseminate cadastral information to the public as required, in hard copy or digital formats. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from NGI according to signed service level agreements. Capture, maintain and update spatial data: Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add all newly created land parcels to the spatial datasets. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement, or withdrawal: Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: Cnr James Moroka and Sekame Drive, West Gallery, Megacity, Mmabatho, 2735 or by email to Post224@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to the high volume of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Kadastrale beampte
af.summary: Vang en onderhou kadastrale dokumentdata vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mmabatho.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12 en Sertifikate Nationale Sertifikaat in Geomatika of Opnamebeampte Sertifikaat (NQF Level 5). Voltooiing van die voorgeskryfde opleiding om aan die vereiste kwalifikasie te voldoen. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Begrip van ruimtelike data. Kennis van die funksies van Surveyors'-General Offices. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaarsagteware. Goeie organisasievermoë.
af.duties: Vang, onderhou en dateer alfanumeriese data van alle kadastrale dokumente: Vang alfa- en numeriese inligting uit nuut ingedien kadastrale dokumente en onderneem wiskundige konsekwentheidsondersoeke en dataverifikasie vir voorgestelde nuwe landpercele. Dateer kadastrale opnamedatabasisse deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument om 'n elektroniese alfa-numeriese bewaarplek te onderhou. Vang en verifieer historiese kadastrale dokumente. Onderhoud van kadastrale dokumente in ooreenstemming met wetgewende prosesse: Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente uit. Trek af, kanselleer en endorseer kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde landpercele, huurkontrakte of serwitute. Wysig goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Voeg alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief in. Trek kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggekeerde kadastrale rekords. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer benamings van nuut ingedien indienings: Dateer die aantekenvelde deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale landperceel. Voer tegniese ondersoek van diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opnamerekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van seksionele titelplanne uit. Verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en eksterne kliënte: Reik opnamedata aan Landopnemers uit wanneer nodig. Versprei kadastrale inligting aan die publiek soos vereis, in gedrukte of digitale formaat. Verskaf lugfoto's, geregistreerde beelde en kaarte van NGI volgens ondertekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Vang, onderhou en dateer ruimtelike data: Vang nuut ingedien dokumente om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg alle nuut geskepte landpercele by die ruimtelike datastelles. Voeg data by, dateer en onderhou 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en opdatering van historiese data. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, endossement of onttrekking: Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle opgedateerde kadastrale dokumente. Koppel die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfanumeriese data.

zu.title: Inkantolo Yezindawo
zu.summary: Bamba ulwazi lwemibhalo yezindawo futhi uligcine kuDepartment of Land Reform and Rural Development eMmabatho.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafakelimibhalo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Certificate National Certificate in Geomatics noma i-Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Ukuqedwa kokugadizwa okumisiwe ukuze kugcotshwe isidingo sokufaneleka. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukubuka/kwazi ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda ulwazi lwesikhala. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yamahhovisi ka-Surveyors’-General. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Ukuxhumana okuhle (ngomlomo nangokubhali). I-software yekhompyutha. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela.
zu.duties: Bamba, gcina futhi ubuyekeze ulwazi lwe-alpha numeric lwawo wonke amabhali we-cadastral: Bamba ulwazi lwe-alpha namanani emibhalo emisha ye-Cadastral elotshiwe futhi wenze ukuhlolwa kokuhambisana ngokwezibalo kanye neqiniso kulwazi lwamasimu omhlaba amisha atshiwo. Buyekeza amadathabhazi wocwaningo lwe-Cadastral ngokufaka noma ukulungisa wonke amabhali avunyiwe ukuze kugcinwe indawo yelekthronikhi ye-alpha-numeric. Bamba futhi uqinise ulwazi lwe-Historical Cadastral documents. Ukugcinwa kwemibhalo ye-Cadastral ngokuya nemicimbi esemthethweni: Yenza ukukhishwa noma ukukhanselwa kwemibhalo ye-cadastral. Susa, khansela futhi uqaphele amabhali we-cadastral anosimu olubhalisiwe, izivumelwano zokuphatha noma izinkonzo. Lungisa amabhali we-cadastral avunyiwe futhi abhalisiwe. Faka wonke amabhali amisha we-cadastral avunyiwe e-archiveni. Khupha futhi uphathise amarekhodi we-cadastral. Buyisela efayela amarekhodi we-cadastral abuyiswe. Lungisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi we-cadastral esimweni esihle sokusetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngobuchwepheshe kwemibhalo ye-cadastral. Hlola izinkomba zabalwa ezilotshiwe ezisha: Buyekeza amasheethi okuhlwayo ngokufaka wonke amasimu we-cadastral avunyiwe. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngobuchwepheshe kwamadiagrams kanye nama-general plans. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngobuchwepheshe kwamarekhodi ocwaningo. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngobuchwepheshe kwamaphulani we-sectional title. Nikeza abakithi bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngolwazi we-cadastral: Phathisa i-Survey data kuba-Surveyors beseduze lapho kudingeka. Saza ulwazi we-cadastral kocrowd njengoba kudingwa, ngesimo sokubhali noma esedijithali. Nikeza izithombe ezithathwe phezulu, izithombe ezilungiwe kanye namamephu ku-NGI ngokuya ngesivumelwano esikhiqiwe se-service level agreements. Bamba, gcina futhi ubuyekeze ulwazi lwesikhala: Bamba imibhalo emisha elotshiwe ukuze kutholwe ukuthi bekukhona yini ukungqubuzana kwesikhala ngaphambi kokuvunywa. Faka wonke amasimu omhlaba asanda kudalwa kumadathasethi wesikhala. Faka ulwazi, buyekeza futhi ugcine idathasethi eqinisekile yolwazi lwesikhala lwe-cadastral, okuhlanganisa ukufaka kanye nokubuyekeza ulwazi lwasemandulo. Skena wonke amabhali we-cadastral ngesikhathi kuvunywa, kulungiswa, kuqaphela noma kukhishwa: Skena amabhali amisha we-cadastral avunyiwe. Skena futhi wonke amabhali we-cadastral abuyekeziwe. Xhumanisa izithombe eziskeniwe ezifakiwe kolwazi lwe-alpha numeric.

xh.title: Ofisi yeCadastral
xh.summary: Faza uze ugcinwe idatha yemibhalo yecadastral kwiSebe leLand Reform and Rural Development eMmabatho.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesidanga se-Grade 12 neSatifikhethi eNqanaba leSizwe kwi-Geomatics okanye iSatifikhethi soPhathi woLinganiso (NQF Level 5). Ukugqiba kwesoqeqesho esicetyiweyo ukuze kugqitywe isidanga esifunekayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ukuba noncedo lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ukuqonda idatha yendawo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeziCango zoPhathi bokuLinganisa. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle (oluthethwayo nolubhalwayo). Isofthiwe yeKhompyutha. Ikhono elihle lokuyila.
xh.duties: Faka, gcina uze ubuyisele idatha yamanani negama yayo yonke imicimbi yecadastral: Faza iinkcukacha zamagama namanani kumicimbi yecadastral entsha ethunyelweyo uze wenze iinkonzo zokukhangela ukwaneliseka ngokubala nokqinisekisa idatha iindawo ezintsha zomhlaba ezicebisiweyo. Buyisela ngokutsha iisiseko sedatha zoluhlu lwepephuloecadastral ngokongeza okanye ulungise ngayo yonke imicimbi egunyaziweyo ukuze ugcine indawo yokugcina idatha namagama nanamanani kwekhompyutha. Faza uze uqinisekise imicimbi yecadastral yasendulo. Ukugcinwa kwemicimbi yecadastral ngokwezinqubo ezisiqhogoyi: Yenza ukukhutshwa okanye ukurhoxiswa kwemicimbi yecadastral. Susa, rhoxisa uze uqwalasele imicimbi yecadastral ngeendawo zomhlaba ezibhalisiweyo, iindawo zokuhlala okwesikhashana okanye iinkonzo ezithintelweyo. Lungisa imicimbi yecadastral egunyaziweyo nesebhalisiweyo. Faka yonke imicimbi yecadastral egunyaziweyo entsha kwindawo yokugcina. Khupha uze uphathise iirekhodi zecadastral. Buyisela kwakhona iirekhodi zecadastral ezibuyisiweyo. Lungisa uze ugcine iirekhodi zecadastral zibe kuloo nkqubo elungileyo eyakusebenza. Yenza uphononongo lobuchwepheshe bemicimbi yecadastral. Khangela iinkcazelo zemicimbi entsha ethunyelweyo: Buyisela ngokutsha amakhasi okuqwalasela ngokongeza iindawo zomhlaba zegunyaziso ecadastral. Yenza uphononongo lobuchwepheshe beenkcazelo zemizobo neendlela ezijolise kuso sonke isithuba. Yenza uphononongo lobuchwepheshe beenkcazelo zeedata zokulinganisa. Yenza uphononongo lobuchwepheshe beendlela ezijolise kwihloko lweziqu. Bonezela iinkcukacha zecadastral kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Phathisa idatha yokulinganisa kubalinganisi bomhlaba xa kufuneka. Saza iinkcukacha zecadastral kwiqela elithintelayo njengoko kufunekayo, kwindlela ephathwayo okanye yedijithali. Phathisa iifoto ezithathwa emoyeni, izifanekiso ezilungisiweyo namamephu avela kwi-NGI ngokwezivumelwano ezisayiniweyo zanqanaba lenkonzo. Faka, gcina uze ubuyisele ngokutsha idatha yendawo: Faka imicimbi entsha ethunyelweyo ukuze uqiniseke ukuba kukho na nokuhlangana kwendawo phambi kwegunyaziso. Yongeza onke amacandwe omhlaba asanda kudalwa kwiiseti zedatha yendawo. Yongeza idatha, buyisela ngokutsha uze ugcine iqephu elichanekileyo ledata lenkcazeca yendawo yecadastral, kuquka ukongeza noku-buyisa ngokutsha idatha yasendulo. Skena yonke imicimbi yecadastral kwigunyaziso, ulungiso, uqwalaselo, okanye ukurhoxiswa: Skena imicimbi yecadastral egunyaziweyo entsha. Skena kwakhona yonke imicimbi yecadastral ebuyiseliweyo. Dibanisa izifanekiso eziskeniweyo ezibekiweyo kwidata yamanani negama.

jobs.title: Cadastral Officer
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Capture and maintain cadastral survey data at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Polokwane, requiring a Grade 12 certificate and a National Certificate in Geomatics.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Certificate in Geomatics or Survey Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5). Completion of the training prescribed in order to fulfil the required qualification. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy. Understanding spatial data. Knowledge of the functions of Surveyors’-General Offices. Job related skills: Good interpersonal relations. Good communication (verbal and written). Computer software. Good organising ability.
jobs.duties: Capture, maintain and update alpha numeric data of all cadastral documents: Capture alpha and numeric information from newly submitted Cadastral documents and undertake mathematical consistency checks and data verification for proposed new land parcels. Update Cadastral survey databases through the addition or amendment of every approved document to maintain an electronic alpha-numeric repository. Capture and verify Historical Cadastral documents. Maintenance of Cadastral Documents in accordance with legislated processes: Perform Withdrawal or cancelation of cadastral documents. Deduct, cancel and endorse cadastral documents with registered land parcels, leases or servitudes. Amend approved and registered cadastral documents. Insert all newly approved cadastral documents into the archive. Extract and issue out cadastral records. Refile returned cadastral records. Repair and keep cadastral records in good usable condition. Conduct technical examination of cadastral documents. Check designations of newly submitted lodgements: Update the noting sheets through the addition of every approved cadastral land parcel. Perform technical examination of diagrams and general plans. Perform technical examination of survey records. Perform technical examination of sectional title plans. Supply cadastral information to internal and external clients: Issue Survey data to Land Surveyors when required. Disseminate cadastral information to the public as required, in hard copy or digital formats. Supply aerial photographs, rectified imagery and maps from NGI according to signed service level agreements. Capture, maintain and update spatial data: Capture newly submitted documents to determine if there are any spatial overlaps prior approval. Add all newly created land parcels to the spatial datasets. Add data, update and maintain an accurate dataset of cadastral spatial information, including the addition and updating of historical data. Scan all cadastral documents on approval, amendment, endorsement, or withdrawal: Scan newly approved cadastral documents. Re-scan all updated cadastral documents. Link the deposited scanned images to the alpha numeric data.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 61 Biccard street, Polokwane, 0700 or by email to Post225@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to the high volume of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations.
