af.title: Kadastrale Beampte
af.summary: Vang kadastrale opnamedata in en onderhou dit by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Polokwane, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en Nasionale Sertifikaat in Geomatics of Survey Officer-sertifikaat (NQF Level 5). Voltooiing van die voorgeskryfde opleiding om aan die vereiste kwalifikasie te voldoen. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaargeletterdheid. Begrip van ruimtelike data. Kennis van die funksies van Surveyors'-General Offices. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Rekenaar sagteware. Goeie organisasievermoë.
af.duties: Vang alfanumeriese data van alle kadastrale dokumente in, onderhou en dateer dit op: Vang alfa- en numeriese inligting van nuut ingedien kadastrale dokumente in en onderneem wiskundige konsekwentheidskontroles en dataverifikasie vir voorgestelde nuwe landpakkies. Dateer kadastrale opnamedatabasisse op deur die byvoeging of wysiging van elke goedgekeurde dokument om 'n elektroniese alfanumeriese bewaarplek te onderhou. Vang historiese kadastrale dokumente in en verifieer dit. Onderhoud van kadastrale dokumente in ooreenstemming met wetgewende prosesse: Voer onttrekking of kansellasie van kadastrale dokumente uit. Trek af, kanselleer en ondekteur kadastrale dokumente met geregistreerde landpakkies, huurkontrakte of servitute. Wysig goedgekeurde en geregistreerde kadastrale dokumente. Voeg alle nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente in die argief in. Trek kadastrale rekords uit en reik dit uit. Herlê teruggestuurde kadastrale rekords. Herstel en hou kadastrale rekords in goeie bruikbare toestand. Voer tegniese ondersoek van kadastrale dokumente uit. Kontroleer aanwysings van nuut ingedien indienings: Dateer die notabladsye op deur die byvoeging van elke goedgekeurde kadastrale landpak. Voer tegniese ondersoek van diagramme en algemene planne uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van opnamerekords uit. Voer tegniese ondersoek van afdelingstitelplanne uit. Verskaf kadastrale inligting aan interne en externe kliënte: Reik opnamedata aan Land Surveyors uit wanneer vereis. Versprei kadastrale inligting aan die publiek soos vereis, in hardekopie of digitale formate. Verskaf lugfoto's, geregteerde beeldmateriaal en kaarte van NGI volgens getekende diensvlakooreenkomste. Vang ruimtelike data in, onderhou en dateer dit op: Vang nuut ingedien dokumente in om te bepaal of daar enige ruimtelike oorvleuelings voor goedkeuring is. Voeg alle nuut geskepte landpakkies by die ruimtelike datastelle. Voeg data by, dateer op en onderhou 'n akkurate datastel van kadastrale ruimtelike inligting, insluitend die byvoeging en opdatering van historiese data. Skandeer alle kadastrale dokumente by goedkeuring, wysiging, ondekteuring of onttrekking: Skandeer nuut goedgekeurde kadastrale dokumente. Her-skandeer alle opgedateerde kadastrale dokumente. Koppel die gedeponeerde geskandeerde beelde aan die alfanumeriese data.

zu.title: Ofisi we-Cadastral
zu.summary: Bhala futhi ugcigile idatha yokucwaninga i-cadastral e Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e Polokwane, kudinga isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nesitifiketi samazwe kwe-Geomatics.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwamanani: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nesitifiketi samazwe noma iSurveys Officer Certificate (NQF Level 5) noma isitifiketi sezibalo. Ukuphothula ukuqeqeshe okulawulwayo ukuze kufeze isidingo sokuthweswa ibhodi. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda idatha yezikhala. Ukukwazi imisebenzi yezikhungo ze-Surveyors'-General. Iziqu eziphathelene nomsebenzi: Ubuhlobo obuhle obuwonke nabantu. Ukuthumela imiyalezo ngokwezwi nokubhala. Ukusebenzisa izinsiza zekhompyutha. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela.
zu.duties: Bhala, zigcine futhi zibuyekeze idatha yamagama nemininingwane yazo zonke izixhumi ezibhalwe ngokwesiko le-cadastral: Bhala ulwazi lwamagama nemininingwane ezixhumbeni ezintsha ezithunyelwe zesiko le-cadastral futhi wenze ukuhlola ukuqhubelana phambili ngokwezibalo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwedatha ezinkambeni ezintsha zomhlaba ezihlongozwayo. Buyekeze izindledlana zesiko le-cadastral ngokwengeza noma ulungise lonke uhlu olugunyaziwe ukuze kugcinwe indawo yamagama nemininingwane ngokwezentengo. Bhala futhi uqinisekise izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral ezendulo. Ukugcinwa kwezixhumi zesiko le-cadastral ngokomthetho obekiwe: Yenza ukukhishiwa noma ukukhatshazwa kwezixhumi zesiko le-cadastral. Susa, khisha futhi phawule izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral ezinamasimu abhalisiwe, izikweshana noma izibopho. Lungisa izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral ezigunyaziwe nakezabhalisiwe. Faka bonke izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral ezintsha ezigunyaziwe kwendlu yokugcina imibhalo. Khhipha futhi uhlinze ngezixhumi zesiko le-cadastral. Buyisela emuva izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral ezigciniwe. Bulunga futhi zigcine izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral esimeni esihle sokusetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlola ngokobuchwepheshe izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral. Hlola amagama ezintsha ezithunyelwe ezibhalweni: Buyekeza amakhasi okuqaphela ngokwengeza lonke inkambu yomhlaba yesiko le-cadastral egunyaziwe. Yenza ukuhlola ngokobuchwepheshe kumadigramu kanye nezindaba ezijwayelekile. Yenza ukuhlola ngokobuchwepheshe izixhumi zocingo. Yenza ukuhlola ngokobuchwepheshe izindaba zesiko le-cadastral. Yenza ukuhlola ngokobuchwepheshe izindaba zesiko le-cadastral. Hlinzeka ngolwazi lwesiko le-cadastral kubakhamizi bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Hlinzeka ngedatha yocingo kubachwepheshe bomhlaba uma kudingeka. Saza ulwazi lwesiko le-cadastral kumphakathi njengoba kudingeka, ngesiko elibhaliwe noma ngokwezentengo. Hlinzeka ngezithombe ezikhanya phezulu, izithombe ezilungisiwe kanye namakhasi avela ku-NGI ngokwesivumelwano esibhaliwe sezinga lenkonzo. Bhala, zigcine futhi zibuyekeze idatha yesikhala: Bhala izixhumi ezintsha ezithunyelwe ukuthola ukuthi ngabe kunawo na ukugqamana ngokwesikhala phambi kokugunyazwa. Faka bonke inkambu yomhlaba entsha edalwe kumahlelo idatha yesikhala. Fanga idatha, buyekeza futhi ugcigile isethi yedatha eyiqiniso yodwamayelana nesikhala sesiko le-cadastral, okuhlanganisa ukufaka kanye nokubuyekeza idatha yamaphathi. Sesha zonke izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral ngesikhathi sokuqala ukubhalisa, ukwenza izibhakri, ukukhipha noma ukudlula: Sesha izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral ezintsha ezigunyaziwe. Phinde useshe lonke izixhumi zesiko le-cadastral ezibuyekeziwe. Xhuma izithombe ezibhalisiwe eseshiwe emahleweni idatha yamagama nemininingwane yezibhalo.

xh.title: Isikhululi-Misebenzi se-Cadastral
xh.summary: Bhala ngaphakathi kwaye ugcile idatha yesurvey e-cadastral kwisebe i-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development ePolokwane, kudingwa isatifikethi seGredi 12 nesiSatifikethi seSizwe kwiGeomatics.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki-zicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seBhrasiya yeGredi 12 nesatifikethi leSizwe kwiGeomatics okanye isatifikethi soMmiswedi weSurvey (NQF Level 5). Ukuqedwa kokugqibelela kokuzilolonga ukwenza ulwazi olufunekayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda idatha yesithuba. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi kwiiofisi zobuMmiswedi-boLwazi-mhlaba. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Unobuntu obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle (lwerhalomagama nolokuthetha). Isofthiwe yeKhompyutha. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela.
xh.duties: Bhala ngaphakathi, zigcine uze uzihlaziye idatha yamanani negama yayo yamaxwebhu onke e-cadastral: Bhala iinkcukacha ezinemibhalo yegama namanani kwimixwebhu entsha ye-cadastral egenisiweyo yenziwa isalathiso kwaye uqinisekise ukuvumelana kwemathematics aze uqinisekise idatha kwimizi edityanisiweyo entsha yomhlaba. Hlaziya iisiseko se-data zesurvey ye-cadastral ngokongeza okanye ukuhlela axwebhu ngamnye avunyiweyo ukuze kugcinwe indawo yamabala angenazantsi eelektronikhi. Bhala uze uqinisekise imixwebhu yembali ye-cadastral. Ukugcinwa kwamaxwebhu e-cadastral ngokomthetho obekiweyo: Yenza ukuhoxisa okanye ukurhoxisa imixwebhu e-cadastral. Thyeka, rhoxisa uze ufake iziphatho kwimixwebhu e-cadastral nemizi edityanisiweyo yomhlaba, iileysi okanye iinkonzo ezithile. Hlaziya imixwebhu e-cadastral evunyiweyo nedityanisweyo. Faka onke amaxwebhu amasha e-cadastral avunyiweyo kwindawo yokugcina. Khupha uze unikeze amaxwebhu e-cadastral. Phinda ufake emva amaxwebhu e-cadastral abuyisiweyo. Lungisa uze ugcine amaxwebhu e-cadastral kwimo engcono yokusetyenziswa. Yenza ukuhlola ngobuchwephesha bamaxwebhu e-cadastral. Hlola iinkcazelo kwiminikelo entsha egenisiweyo: Hlaziya amaphepha okubhaliweyo ngokongeza umzi ngamnye omusha womhlaba we-cadastral ovunyiweyo. Yenza ukuhlola ngobuchwepheshe iidayagrams neendawo ezingutshaba. Yenza ukuhlola ngobuchwepheshe iirekhodi zesurvey. Yenza ukuhlola ngobuchwepheshe iiplani zesutu esithilwe. Nikeza iinkcukacha e-cadastral kumaxhasa bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Nikeza idatha yesurvey kubasolomhlaba xa kufuneka. Saza iinkcukacha e-cadastral kummandla njengoko kufuneka, ngokwenziwa ngexwebhu okanye ngokweenkqubo ezingamabala. Nikeza iifoto ezisuka esibhakabhakeni, imifanekiso elungisiweyo namaphepha e-NGI ngokwesivumelwano esigqithisiweyo sevidi. Bhala ngaphakathi, zigcine uze uzihlaziye idatha yesithuba: Bhala imixebhu entsha egenisiweyo ukujonga ukuba kukho na iindawo ezichaphazelekayo ngaphambi kokuvunywa. Yongeza onke imizi entsha yomhlaba kwii-datasets zesithuba. Yongeza idatha, hlaziya uze ugcinembe idatha ethembekileyo e-cadastral yesithuba, kuquka ukongeza nokuhlaziya idatha yembali. Skena onke amaxwebhu e-cadastral xa kuvunywa, ehluzwa, efake iziphatho okanye ehoxiswa: Skena imixwebhu e-cadastral entsha evunyiweyo. Phinda uskene onke amaxwebhu e-cadastral ahluziweyo. Sidibanisa imifanekiso eskiniweyo egqithisiweyo kwidatha yamanani negama.

Ulwazi ngomsebenzi we-Surveyors-General Offices. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ubuhle bokuxhumana nabantu. Ukuxhumana kakuhle (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). I-software yekhompyutha. Amakhono ahle okuhlelwa.
zu.duties: Bamba, bgcine futhi ubuyekeze idatha ye-alpha numeric yamawebhulu awonke amadokhumenti e-cadastral: Bamba ulwazi lwe-alpha namanani kumadokhumenti amasha we-Cadastral athunyelwe bese wenza ukuhlolwa kokuqonda ngokwezibalo kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwedatha kwabalulekile abasha abapakishiwe. Buyekeza amadatabheysi wesiveko we-Cadastral ngokwenezela noma ukulungisa yonke idokhumenti evunyiwe ukuze kugcinwe indawo yegciwane ye-alpha-numeric. Bamba futhi uqinisekise amadokhumenti we-Cadastral Asendlulelolikhathi. Ukugcinwa kwamadokhumenti we-Cadastral ngokuya emthethweni osebenzayo: Yenza ukukhishwa noma ukukhanselwa kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral. Yehlise, khansela futhi uqaphele amadokhumenti we-cadastral anabalulekile ababhalisiwe, izivumelwano zokusebenzisa noma izibopho. Lungisa amadokhumenti we-cadastral avunyiwe futhi abhalisiwe. Faka wonke amadokhumenti amasha we-cadastral avunyiwe kusigcina. Khishwa futhi unikeze irekhodi we-cadastral. Phinda ubhale irekhodi we-cadastral ebuyisiwe. Lungisa futhi ugcine irekhodi we-cadastral esimeni esihle sokusebenza. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngezobuchwepheshe kwamadokhumenti we-cadastral. Hlola iziqu zokubhalisa okusha okuthunyelwe: Buyekeza amakhasi okubhala ngokwenezela balulekile be-cadastral bese kuvunywa. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngezobuchwepheshe kumadiyagramu namaphulani jikelele. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngezobuchwepheshe kwamarekhodi wesiveko. Yenza ukuhlolwa ngezobuchwepheshe kwamaphulani wesihloko sexumu. Nikeza ulwazi we-cadastral kubathintekile bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Nikeza idatha yesiveko kubasolwa Bomhlaba lapho kudingeka khona. Saza ulwazi we-cadastral kumphakathi njengoba kudingeka, ngokubhaliwe noma ngomqondo ongabhalwa. Nikeza izithombe zasemoyeni, izithombe ezilungisiwe namamephu e-NGI ngokuya ngesivumelwano esibhalisiwe. Bamba, gcina futhi ubuyekeze idatha yesikhala: Bamba amadokhumenti amasha athunyelwe ukunikela ukuthi zikhona yini na izikhala eziphindaphindiwe ngaphambi kokuvunywa. Engeza wonke amabalulekile amasha kumaseti we-data yesikhala. Engeza idatha, buyekeze futhi ugcine isethi yedatha eqondile yolwazi we-cadastral yesikhala, okuhlanganisa ukunezela futhi kubuyekezwe idatha yasendlulelolikhathi. Sika wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral ngokuvunywa, ukulungiswa, ukuqashelwa, noma ukukhishwa: Sika amadokhumenti amasha we-cadastral avunyiwe. Phinda usike wonke amadokhumenti we-cadastral abuyekeziwe. Qhubanisa izithombe ezibhandiwe ezibekwe ngedatha ye-alpha numeric.

xh.title: Isicoci seCadastral
xh.summary: Isicoci seCadastral esibhekene nokubamba nolondolozo lwedatha yemibhalo yeCadastral nokuhlaziya iidatabase zesicoci eZikweni leSurveyors-General Office eMbombela.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seQela labaGli 12 neSatifikethi seSizwe kwiiGeomatics okanye iSatifikethi seSicoci soBujografi (iNQF Level 5). Kuqala ugqibe uqeqesho olumisiweyo ukuze ugqibezele isifikelela esifunekayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda idatha yesikhundla. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yeZiko leZiJografi-Jikelele. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Unxibelelwano oluhle kwabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle (olubalwayo nobhalwayo). Isoftware yekhompyutha. Ikhono eluhle lokulungiselela.
xh.duties: Bamba, gcina uze ulungise idatha yamanani negama yayo yonke imibhalo yecadastral: Bumba ulwazi lwamanani namagama kwimibhalo entsha yeCadastral elungisiweyo kwaye wenze iingqinamba zemathematika ukuqinisekisa idatha ngamaphakelo amasha ajingayo omhlaba. Hlaziya iidatabase zesicoci seCadastral ngokongeza okanye ulungise lonke umbhalo ovunyiweyo ukuze ugcine isiko sedatha yamanani namagama kakhompyutha. Bamba uze uqinisekise imibhalo yembali yeCadastral. Igcino lemibhalo yeCadastral ngokweendlela ezisiqithwe ngumthetho: Yenza ukususwa okanye ukurhoxiswa kwemibhalo yeCadastral. Susa, rhoxisa uze ugqithise imibhalo yeCadastral namaphakelo ajingiweyo omhlaba, iilezi okukuqinisekisa. Lungisa imibhalo yeCadastral evunyiweyo nejingiweyo. Faka lonke umbhalo omtsha weCadastral ovunyiweyo kwindawo yogcino. Khupha uze uphace imibhalo yeCadastral. Buyisela kwifayile imibhalo yeCadastral ebuyisiweyo. Lungisa uze ugcine imibhalo yeCadastral isebenziseka ngokulungileyo. Yenza isicoci sobuchwephesha kwimibhalo yeCadastral. Qinisekisa iinkcukacha zemibhalo entsha elungisiweyo: Hlaziya amacephu okubhala ngokongeza qho kwelinye ilifu leCadastral elingumhlaba. Yenza isicoci sobuchwephesha kumagama ejografi kunye neendlela ezijolise ngokubanzi. Yenza isicoci sobuchwephesha kwimibhalo yesicoci. Yenza isicoci sobuchwephesha kwiiplani zamagama ahlukeneyo. Nikela nolwazi lweCadastral kubanxibenye bangaphakathi nangaphandle: Phathisa idatha yesicoci kubaJografi bemihlaba xa kufuneka. Saziqhelanise ulwazi lweCadastral kuluntu njengoko kufuneka, ngokubhalayo okanye ngesikhokelo sedijithali. Phathisa iithogi ezihamba emoyeni, izikhokelo ezilungisiweyo namamepha evela kwi-NGI ngokwezivumelwano ezisayiniweyo zanqanaba lenkonzo. Bamba, gcina uze ulungise idatha yesikhundla: Bamba imibhalo entsha elungisiweyo ukuze uqiniseke ukuba kukho na naziphi na iindawo eziphinda-phindana kwesikhundla phambi kokuSemkelwa. Yongeza onke amaphakelo amasha omhlaba kwiiqembu zedatha yesikhundla. Yongeza idatha, hlaziya uze ugcine iqembu elichanekileyo lemininingwana yesikhundla seCadastral, kuquka ukongeza ukuhlaziya idatha yembali. Scasha yonke imibhalo yeCadastral xa ivunyiwe, ilungiswa, igqithiswa okanye isuswa: Scasha imibhalo yeCadastral entsha evunyiweyo. Phinda uscashe yonke imibhalo yeCadastral ehlaziweyo. Dibanisa izikhokelo ezibhalwe ngomfanekiso ezibekiweyo kwidatha yamanani namagama.

jobs.title: Secretary
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and reception support to the Director, including managing calls, diary appointments and typing documents.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate or relevant equivalent. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) Job related skills: Good telephone etiquette. Sound organisational ability. Good people skills. Computer literacy. Ability to communicate well with people at different levels and from different backgrounds (both written and verbal). Ability to act with tact and discretion.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretariat / receptionist support service to the Director. Receive telephone calls and refer the calls to the correct role players if not meant for the relevant senior manager. Record appointments and events in the diary. Type documents for the senior manager and other staff within the unit. Operate office equipment e.g. computers and photocopiers. Provide a clerical support service to the Senior Manager. Liaise with travel agencies to make travel arrangements. Check arrangements when relevant documents are received. Arrange meetings and events for the senior manager and the staff in the unit. Identifies venues, invite role players, organise refreshments and sets up schedules for meeting and events. Process the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work of the senior manager. Records basic minutes of meetings of the senior manager where required. Draft routine correspondence and reports. Do filing of documents for the senior manager and the unit where necessary. Administer matters like leave registers and telephonic accounts. Receive, records and distributes all incoming and outgoing documents. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationary, refreshments etc. Collects all relevant documents to enable the Director to prepare for meetings. Remains up to date with regard to prescripts / policies and procedures applicable to her / his work environment to ensure efficient and effective support to the senior manager. Study the relevant public service and the departmental prescripts / policies and other documents to ensure that the application thereof is understood properly. Keep abreast with the procedures and process that apply in the office of the senior manager.
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 600 Lilian Ngoyi Street (formerly known as Van Der Walt Street) Berea Park, Pretoria, 0001 or by email to Post221@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: African, Coloured, Indian and White Males and African, Coloured, Indian and White Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. All shortlisted candidate, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, one will be a practical exercise to determine a candidates suitability based on the posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to the high volume of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re-advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Sekretaris
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariële en onvangsondersteuning aan die Direkteur, insluitend die bestuur van oproepe, dagboekafsprake en die tik van dokumente.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of relevante equivalent. Werkverwante kennis: Rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, ens.). Werkverwante vaardighede: Goeie telefoonetiket. Goed organiseringsvermoë. Goeie mensevaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en vanuit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer (sowel skriftelik as mondelings). Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariaats- / onvangsondersteuningsdiens aan die Direkteur. Ontvang telefoonoproepe en verwys die oproepe na die korrete rolspelers indien dit nie vir die betrokke senior bestuurder bedoel is nie. Neem afsprake en geleenthede in die dagboek op. Tik dokumente vir die senior bestuurder en ander personeel binne die eenheid. Bedryf kantooruitrusting bv. rekenaars en fotostootmasjiene. Verskaf 'n klerklike ondersteuningsdiens aan die senior bestuurder. Skakel met reisagente om reelings te tref. Kontroleer reëlings wanneer relevante dokumente ontvang word. Reël vergaderings en geleenthede vir die senior bestuurder en die personeel in die eenheid. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers uit, reël verkwikkings en stel skedules vir vergaderings en geleenthede op. Verwerk die reis- en onderhoudskennings vir die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die aktiwiteite van die werk van die senior bestuurder. Neem basiese notule van vergaderings van die senior bestuurder op waar nodig. Opstel van roetine korrespondensie en verslae. Doen lêwerk van dokumente vir die senior bestuurder en die eenheid waar nodig. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekeninge. Ontvang, neem op en versprei alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente. Hanteer die verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, verkwikkings ens. Versamel alle relevante dokumente om die Direkteur in staat te stel om voor vergaderings voor te berei. Bly op hoogte van voorskrifte / beleide en prosedures wat van toepassing is op haar / sy werk omgewing om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die senior bestuurder te verseker. Bestudeer die relevante openbare diens- en departementele voorskrifte / beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Hou tred met die prosedures en prosesse wat van toepassing is in die kantoor van die senior bestuurder.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Nika insiza yezokhulumiwe nobunkokeli kubaleli, okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwamakholi, ithuba lokubhalisa komshicileli kokubhala amadokhumenti.
zu.requirements: Amasidingo abeka kunendawo: Abafake izibhalo kumele babe ne-Satifiketi se-Grade 12 noma okulinganayo okuhlobene. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, njll.). Izakhono ezihlobene nomsebenzi: Indlela elungile yokukhuluma kocingo. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela. Izakhono ezinhle zokusebenza nabantu. Ulwazi
zu.duties: Nika insiza yezokhulumela / umamukimingi kumqondisi. Amukela amakholi futhi awaqondise kubantu abafanele uma engabhekise kuso isimo somphathi ophakeme. Bhalise ithuba nemikhakha esikhundleni esibukiwe. Thayipha amadokhumenti komphathi ophakeme nakubanye basebenzi bakhona esigabeni. Sebenzisa izinto zohluzo ngesikhungo esikhathi. Bhala ithuba nokulalela abantu. Faka futhi ulunge

xh.title: Umsebenzi wokubhala
xh.summary: Nika inkonzo yoncedo lokubhala nokwamkela abantu kwiDirektha, kuquka nokulawula iifowuni, iinkqubo zecandelo nokuchwetheza amaxwebhu.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisisiseko: Abafaka isicelo kufunekwe babe nesatifikedi seQatha 12 okanye esilinganayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (iMicrosoft Word, iMicrosoft Excel, iPowerPoint, njl.) Amandla ohlobene nomsebenzi: Isiko elilodI lokuthetha ngomatshini wocingo. Amandla okuqhelanisa izinto. Amandla amaninzi. Ulwazi Iwekhompyutha. Amandla wokuthetha kakuhle nabantu abakwinqanaba elahlukeneyo nase kumaphethu ahlukeneyo (kokubhalayo nokuthethayo). Amandla wokwenza ngobubebe nangabamhIe.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo yokwesekela njengomphathi wolwazi eznzima kwaye ube ngumamkeli weefowuni kwiDirektha. Amkela iifowuni zelefon kwaye uzidlulise kubantu abafanelekileyo ukuba azifunelwanga ngum lawuli ophakamileyo. Landa iinkqubo kunye neenzame kumagama qubula. Bhala amaxwebhu ngum lawuli ophakamileyo nakwabanye basebenzi kwisebe. Sebenzisa izixhobo zofice njengakhompyutha kunye nemishini yekopi. Phetha inkonzo yoncedo lwemisebenzi yolulo kum lawuli ophakamileyo. Phathana nee-agensi zohambo lokwenza izicwangciso zohambo. Qinisekisa izicwangciso xa amaxwebhu afanelekileyo efumaniswa. Hlela iintlanganiso kunye neenzame kum lawuli ophakamileyo kwakunye nabasebenzi kwisebe. Zonke iindawo, mema abathathi-nxaxheba, lungisa iziselo kwaye ucwenge iinkqubo zamatyala. Phetha izikhalazo zohambo nesekela ngemali kwisebe. Phetha onke amanqaku ombolo evela kumsebenzi wom lawuli ophakamileyo. Landa iingxoxo ezimfutshane zeentlanganiso kom lawuli ophakamileyo xa kuyimfuneko. Qamba iindaba ezidityanayo neendaba. Zenza ifayile yamaxwebhu kom lawuli ophakamileyo nakwisebe apho kufuneka. Lawula izinto ezinjengesazulu somaxwebhu nokwazi iindleko zefowuni. Thatha, landa kwaye usasaze onke amaxwebhu angaphakathi nangaphandle. Phatha ukuthenga izinto ezingezisisiseko ezinjengesiqwengqa, iziselo njl. Qokelela onke amaxwebhu afanelekileyo ukuvumela iDirektha ukuba ilungiselele iintlanganiso. Hlala ulwazi olutsha malunga nemicimbi / iinkqubo ezisebenza kwindalo yakhe / yomsebenzi yakhe ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkxaso echanekileyo kuwumsebenzi kum lawuli ophakamileyo. Funda ngemicimbi yoluntu yolwazi kunye nemicimbi yesebe / iinkqubo namaxwebhu angeziyo ukuvumela ukuqonda ukusetyenziswa kwawo ngokuchanekileyo. Hlala ulwazi malunga neenkqubo nazizicwangciso ezikwindawo yom lawuli ophakamileyo.

Bestudeer die relevante openbare diens- en departementele voorskrifte/beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Hou treding met die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die senior bestuurder van toepassing is.

zu.title: Ungqongqoshe
zu.summary: Nikela ngesekeli sokwamukela abavakashi kwa Director, ukuphatha amakholi, ukulawula ihlela lokusebenza nokuthayipha amadokhumenti e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesi-Certificate se-Grade 12 noma okulinganayo okufanele. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, njll.) Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Elayisensi elinhle yefoni. Ikono elihle lokuhlela. Amakhono ahle abantu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikono lokuxhumana kahle nabantu abakuwo wonke amanqamle nabeze izindlu ezahlukene (kokubili okubhalwayo nokukhulwayo). Ikono lokuziphatha ngobuqotho nobungaqondakali.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenkonzo yesekeli lokwamukela abavakashi kuDirector. Amukela amakholi futhi ahole amakholi kubantu abafanele uma engabhekise kumphathi ophakeme. Bhalise ithuba nemikhaya yemisebenzi kwikhodi. Thayipha amadokhumenti komphathi ophakeme nabaluleki abanye egumbini. Sebenzisa izinto zokusebenza ohofisini njengekhompyutha nemishini yokukopisha. Nikela ngenkonzo yesekeli lwezoculu komphathi ophakeme. Xhumana nezinkezo zokuhamba ukuze ulungise izinhlela zokuhamba. Hlola izinhlela uma amadokhumenti afanele etholakala. Hlela imihlangano nemikhaya yomphathi ophakeme nabasebenzi egumbini. Ithola amakhosi, imema abadlali beqhaza, ihlela iziphuzo futhi ihlela izinhlela zesikhathi zemihlangano nemikhaya. Cedula izimangalo zokuhamba nokuhlala egini. Cedula yonke imali etholwayo evela kumisebenzi yomphathi ophakeme. Ibhalise imininingwane yemihlangano yomphathi ophakeme lapho kudingeka khona. Bhalisa ukuxhumana okujwayelekile nokubika. Yenza ifayela lamadokhumenti komphathi ophakeme nasegumbini lapho kudingeka khona. Phatha izindaba ezinjengobhalo lwesikhathi sabaleko ne-akhawunti zefoni. Amukela, ibhalise futhi yahlule yonke imibhalo engena naphuma. Phatha ukuthengwa kwezinto ezijwayelekile njengesibhali, iziphuzo, njalonjalo. Iqoqa yonke imibhalo edingekayo ukuze ivume iDirector ukuthi ilungiselele imihlangano. Ihlala ibuyekezwe ngemithetho/nemigomo namasu esebenza kwindawo yakhe yomsebenzi ukuze iqiniseke ukusekelwa okusebenzayo nokuqondile komphathi ophakeme. Fundza imithetho yesevisi yomphakathi nemicimbo yomnyango/nemigomo namanye amadokhumenti ukuze iqiniseke ukuthi kusetshenziswa kahle. Hlala uwazi ngamasu naminqamano asebenza ohofisini komphathi ophakeme.

xh.title: Umkaqayi-we Seitshi
xh.summary: Ukubonelela ngenkxaso yokuba ngumkaqayi-we seitshi nakwinkxaso kwiresepshoni kumlawuli, ukuphatha iinqwanqwa zefowuni, ukulawula idayari nokuchwetheza amaxwebhu kwi-Pretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka isicelo kufunekuba babeswe ngesatifikethi se-Graat 12 okanye esilinganayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-Microsoft Word, i-Microsoft Excel, i-PowerPoint, njl.) Amandla okusebenza ahlobene nomsebenzi: Indlela elungileyo yokuthetha ngomnxeba. Amandla ahloniphekileyo wolawulo. Amandi agqithisileyo ohlonitshanisa nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okuthetha kakuhle nabantu abakwiqanaba elahlukileyo naye abavela kumaphondo ahlukileyo (kokubhalayo nokuthethwayo). Amandla okuziphatha ngobuqhetseba nangobuchwepheshe.
xh.duties: Kubonelelwa inkxaso yomsebenzi yokuba ngumkaqayi-we seitshi nokuwuresepsheni kumlawuli. Ukuyamkala iinqwanqwa zefowuni kwaye uzidlisele kubantu abahlangene nazo ukuba zingengengowomlawuli ophakamileyo. Ukubhala iindululo neenkrwele kwidayari. Ukuchwetheza amaxwebhu omlawuli ophakamileyo nakwelinye igatya elingaphakathi kweyunithi. Ukusebenza ngezixhobo zendawo yokusebenza umzekelo iikhompyutha nakwimizatho ekhupha iikopi. Ukubonelela ngenkxaso yomsebenzi wolawulo kumlawuli ophakamileyo. Ukudibana neenkonzo zohambo ukuze ulungise iindululo zohambo. Ukujonga iindululo xa amaxwebhu ahlobene nawo efikelwa. Ukulungisa iindibano neenkrwele kumlawuli ophakamileyo nakubasebenzi bekunithi. Ukuchonga iindawo zomzkelo, ukumema abahlangene nayo into, ukulungisa okokwela amanzi kwaye umise iichedule zendibano neenkrafu. Ukucubungula iingxelo zohambo nendlela yokutya yeyunithi. Ukucubungula onke amaxwebhu e-akhawuntu aphuma kumisebenzi yomlawuli ophakamileyo. Ukubhala imizuzu yendibano yomlawuli ophakamileyo xa kufuneka. Ukudweba iindaba zemihla leyo neengxelo. Ukuwatshala amaxwebhu omlawuli ophakamileyo nenyunithi xa kufuneka. Ukulawula imiba enjengoba kukubhaliswa kwamagama obutshelo kwaye nobukhulu beetili zefowuni. Ukuyamkela, ukuyibhala kwaye ulwabiise onke amaxwebhu angenayo nawaphumayo. Ukuphatha ukuthenga izinto ezisemgangathweni ezinjengokubhaliweyo, okokwela amanzi njl. Ukubaqokelela onke amaxwebhu ahlobene nawo ukuze abavume umlawuli ukuba alungiselele iindibano. Ukuhlala nakwinqanaba eliya phambili ngokwemigaqo/ iinkqubo namacebo asetyenziswayo kwimeko yakhe yomsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswa inkxaso esebenzayo kakuhle kumlawuli ophakamileyo. Ukufunda imigaqo yensebenzi kaqhalo nesebe kwaye namaxwebhu amnye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba unomvumbelo wokuyisebenzisa. Ukuhlala utshate amaphakama iinkqubo nendlela ezisebenza kwiofisi yomlawuli ophakamileyo.

jobs.title: Senior Court Interpreter
jobs.centre: Western Cape Division of The High Court: Cape Town
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement
jobs.summary: The Office of the Chief Justice seeks a Senior Court Interpreter for the Western Cape High Court in Cape Town, requiring a Legal Interpreting diploma and at least two years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a National Diploma in Legal Interpreting or equivalent qualification at NQF level 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA. Minimum of two (02) years practical experience in Court Interpreting environment or Grade 12 with at least ten (10) years’ practical experience in Court Interpreting environment. Proficiency in English, Afrikaans or isiXhosa. Proficiency in any other indigenous language i.e. Sotho, Tswana or Zulu, etc., a valid driver’s license and knowledge of any foreign language will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of relevant acts and regulations, culture, subject area, how to translate and be able to keep time frame. Skilled in computer literacy (MS Office), communication (written and verbal), time management, interpersonal relations, planning and organising, decision making, analytical thinking, English language, problem solving. Along with the following attributes: flexible, self driven and motivated, ability to work under pressure, accuracy and attention to detail.
jobs.duties: Render interpreting services, interpret in Criminal proceedings, Civil proceedings, Older Persons Act matters, Family, protection from Harassment Act matters, Labour court matters, Maintenance Act matters, Child Justice Matters, Inquests and Equality court matters, interpret in pre-trial proceedings and consultations, liaise with Supervisor or other Department/Organisation for foreign language interpreters, interpret from source target language during court proceedings for pretrials, consultations, interpret non-verbal gestures, dramatization and confessions, engage with the judiciary to confer on the readiness and/or performance in court, render interpreting for probono desk, render audible and clear interpreting from source to target language without embellishment or omissions while preserving the language, convey the correct language in accordance with the language usage of the speaker, control the speaker and ensure that the citations are interpreted correctly, translate legal documents and exhibits, study and analyse the source documents, conduct the necessary research and consult with the relevant parties, ensure accurate cite translation of documents, check, edit and revise the translated documents, translate mechanically recorded audio material, develop terminology and provide support in the reconstruction of records, accumulate terminology and develop a database, populate the terms and respective meaning in the glossary register, gather all trial documents necessary to aid interpretation, coin words and perform specific line and administrative support functions to the Judiciary, Court Manager and Supervisor.
jobs.enquiries: Technical: Mr SD Hlongwane Tel No: (021) 469 4032 HR related enquiries: Ms N Chwethiso Tel No: (021) 480 2411
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/131/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on       internet       at      www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Hoftolk
af.summary: Die Kantoor van die Hoofregter soek 'n Senior Hoftolk vir die Wes-Kaapse Hooggeregshof in Cape Town, wat 'n diploma in Regstolkning en ten minste twee jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Nasionale Diploma in Regstolkning of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 6 met 360 krediete soos deur SAQA erken. Minimum van twee (02) jaar praktiese ervaring in 'n Hofstolkingsomgewing of Graad 12 met ten minste tien (10) jaar se praktiese ervaring in 'n Hofstolkingsomgewing. Begaantheid in Engels, Afrikaans of isiXhosa. Begaantheid in enige ander inheemse taal d.w.s. Sotho, Tswana of Zulu, ens., 'n geldige bestuurslisensie en kennis van enige vreemde taal sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van relevante wette en regulasies, kultuur, vakgebied, hoe om te vertaal en in staat wees om die tydsraamwerk te handhaaf. Bedrewe in rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office), kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling), tydbestuur, interpersoonlike verhoudings, beplanning en organisering, besluitneming, analitiese denke, Engelse taal, probleemoplossing. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: buigsaam, selfgedrewe en gemotiveerd, vermoë om onder druk te werk, akkuraatheid en aandag aan detail.
af.duties: Lewer tolkdienste, tolk in Strafregtelike verrigtinge, Siviele verrigtinge, Wet op Ouer Persone-aangeleenthede, Familie, Wet op Beskerming teen Teistering-aangeleenthede, Arbeidshof-aangeleenthede, Onderhoudswet-aangeleenthede, Kinderjustisie-aangeleenthede, Doodsondersoeke en Gelykheidshof-aangeleenthede, tolk in voorverhoorverrigtinge en konsultasies, skakel met Toesighouer of ander Departement/Organisasie vir vreemdetaaltolke, tolk van brondoeltaal gedurende hofverrigtinge vir voorverhore, konsultasies, tolk nie-verbale gebare, dramatisering en belydenisse, tree in gesprek met die regbank om gereedheid en/of prestasie in die hof te bespreek, lewer tolkdiens vir probono-toonbank, lewer hoorbare en duidelike tolking van brontoeldoeltaal zonder versiering of weglatings terwyl die taal behou word, gee die korrekte taal ooreenkomstig die taalgebruik van die spreker weer, beheer die spreker en verseker dat die aanhalings korrek getolk word, vertaal regsdokumente en getuienis, bestudeer en ontleed die brondokumente, doen die nodige navorsing en raadpleeg die relevante partye, verseker akkurate sitaatvertaling van dokumente, kontroleer, redigeer en hersien die vertaalde dokumente, vertaal meganies opgeneemde audiomateriaal, ontwikkel terminologie en verskaf ondersteuning in die rekonstruksie van rekords, akkumuleer terminologie en ontwikkel 'n databasis, vul die terme en onderskeie betekenis in die glossariumregister in, versamel alle verhoordokumente wat nodig is om tolking te vergemaklik, munt woorde en voer spesifieke lyn- en administratiewe ondersteuningsfunksies uit vir die Regbank, Hofbestuurder en Toesighouer.

zu.title: Umhumushi Ophakamileyo weNkundla
zu.summary: IOfisi yomongameli wezomthetho icesha umhumushi ophakamileyo weNkundla yeWestern Cape High Court eCape Town, edinga i-diploma ekubhaleni izinkulumo ezingezona ngokwebhayologya nobuncwane beeminyaka elitratyi.
zu.requirements: Abafanelwe kumele babe ne-Diploma leSizwe ekubhaleni izinkulumo ezingezona ngokwebhayologya noma isitifiketi esilingana esikwiNqanaba 6 seNQF esinamaphoyinti angu-360 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Ukuze kuhlatshiwe ngokupheleleyo kumele kube nokusetyenziswa kwebhasidi kwiNqanaba le-12 kakhulu kwiminyaka elishumi (10) kusetyenziswa iNkundla yezomthetho mayelana nabahumushi beelimi zendalo ezifana nesiBhulu, isiBhulu, isiNdebele noma okunye ulimi lwendalo ngokomthetho weQhawe, isiqinisekiso sokusebenzisa isithuthi kwaye ulwazi ngalolu nyathelo luya kubakho ngenxa yokuba luluncedo olungakanisekiyo kuqwalaselo lulwazi nangamandla okusebenza kuze kuhlehlwe ngakumbi ngokomthetho nokubhalwa kwakho ukuzalisekisa iNdlela yesiZulu njengamanqanaba ekudityaneni ngeNdlela yeQawe (10) kumsebenzi ozenza ngesandla sokusebenzisa inkundla ekubhaleni izinkulumo ezingezona ngokwebhayologya. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iNgesi, isiBhulu okanye isiXhosa. Ukwazi nolunye ulimi lwendalo okthi isiSotho, isiTswana okanye isiZulu, njalonjalo, ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekileyo nalwazi ngaluphi na ulimi lwangaphandle kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho nemithetho ehambelanayo, isiko, indawo yesihloko, indlela yokuqonda nokuhumusha nokugcina isikhathi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office), ukuxhumana (okubhaliweyo nokukhulunywayo), ukulawula isikhathi, ubudlelwano nabantu, ukuhlela nokuhlela, ukuthatha izinqumo, ukucabanga ngokuhlaziyo, ulimi lwesiNgisi, ukuxazulula izinkinga. Kanye nokuilandelayo: ukuguquguquka, ukuzidela nokwesekwa, ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, uchane nokunaka iinkcukacha.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinkonzo zokuhumusha, humusha ezinkantolo ezingezona ngokwebhayologya, ezinkantolo zezenhlalo, ezindabeni zeZabalazo loMuntu omdala, ezindabeni zeNkilasimilo, ezindabeni zoMthetho wokuSinda ekuHlepheni, ezinkantolo zeBhalo, ezindabini zoMthetho weNakekelo, ezindabini zoBulungiswa beBantwana, ekuBhekeni izifa nasezinkantolo zoMthetho wokulingana, humusha ekwenzeni izinqumo ezihamba phambili nasemibonisanweni, xhumana nomphathi wenhlalo noma omunye umnyango/Nhlangano mayelana nabahumushi balimi okungewona lesiNgisi, humusha ulimi oluyisisekelo luye oluhlakaniphileyo enkantolo izinkantolo ezingezona ngokwebhayologya, imiboniso, humusha izinkomba ezingezona ngamagama, ukudlalwa kwezinto kanye nezikhipho, xhumana nabahluleli ukubonisana ngokuqinisekiswa nokuhamba kahle enkantolo, nikeza izinkonzo zokuhumusha kwideski yesabelo, humusha ngokuphuma okucacile kanye nesandi esihamba kahle kusuka kwisisekelo kuye koluhlakaniphileyo ngaphandle kokuhlobisa noma ukushiya okuthile ngokugcina ulimi, dlulisela olunyathelwe kahle lulimi ngokulandelana kwalo kanye nokusetshenziswa kwakho ngomlonzi, lawula umlonzi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi izibongwa zihumusheke kahle, humusha amadokhumente ezomthetho kanye neziboniswa, funda futhi uhlaziye amadokhumente asisekelo, wenze ucwaningo oludingekayo futhi ubonisane namalunga afanelekile, qinisekisa ukuhumusha okuyiqiniso izibongo zamadokhumente, hlole, hlela kabusha futhi ulungise amadokhumenti ahumushiwe, humusha okurekhodiwe okuwumqulu ongaphandle kwesandi, yakha izigaba zamagama futhi unikeze inkxaso ekuqakulweni kwezibhalo, qoqa izigaba zamagama futhi yakhe idathabheyisi, futhi ugcwalise amagama nentshinga yawo kusiblomulo, qoqa wonke amadokhumenti okulwa abadingekayo ukuze kusize ukuhumusha, bumba amagama futhi wenze imisebenzi ethize yokuxhumana nenkokhelo yezinto mayelana nomsebenzi wezohlelo kulo bonke abasebenzi beNkundla yezomthetho, abaphathi benkundla nomphathi wabo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

xh.title: Umtshumeli weNkantoli ohamba phambili
xh.summary: I-Office of the Chief Justice ijonge i-Senior Court Interpreter ye-Western Cape High Court eCape Town, ifuna i-Diploma kwintatho-ulwimi yomthetho kwaye ibe nobuncinane beminyaka mibini yamava.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Diploma yezwe kwintatho-ulwimi yomthetho okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 6 ne-360 credits njengoko ivunywe yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emibini (02) yamava okusebenza okwenziwayo kwimeko yokuthayitha enkantoli okanye i-Grade 12 eniminyaka elishumi (10) ubuncinane yamava okusebenza okwenziwayo kwimeko yokuthayitha enkantoli. Ukuzoba bulukhuni kwi-English, isi-Afrikaans okanye isiXhosa. Ukuzoba bulukhuni kolunye ulwimi lwasekhaya nangalulwimi i.e. isiSotho, isiTswana okanye isiZulu, nokunye, ilayisensi yokuqeshela epheleleyo nolwazi ngolunye ulwimi lwamanye amazwe luya kuba lusisongezelelo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho nemigaqo edibana nayo, isiko, indawo yesihloko, indlela yokuguqula nokuba nethuba lokugcina isikhathi. Unobongo ekubeni nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office), ekunxibelelaneni (nokubhala nokuthetha), ekulawuleni isikhathi, ekuhlobo lwabantu, ekuqwalaselweni nokuqamba, ekwenzeni izigqibo, ekuqwalaselweni okucokisisa, ulwimi lwesiNgingqi, nokusombulula iingxaki. Ekunye nalemibhalo elandelayo: ukuguquguquka, ukuzikhusela nokuzimisela, ukuba nethuba lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo, ukuchanekileyo nokunakela iinkcukacha.
xh.duties: Nikeza iinkonzo zothayitha, ukuthayitha kumacala obugebengu, kumacala angomthetho wabahlali, kumacala eNqubo yeMthetho yeBantu abaMdingawawela iminyaka, Ekwintsapho, ekukhuslekeni kumthetho weNtshutsho eyingozi, kumacala eNkantoli yeZabasebenzi, kumacala eMthetho woMthengelo, kumacala eBenza ubulungisa kubantwana, ekuphenyeni ukufa nokulingana enkantoli; ukuthayitha kwinkqubo ekuqaliswayo phambi kocalo nezithethwa-njalo, kuqhomfa nomlawuli okanye nesebe/iNhlangano ezinomthetho ochwepheshe kolwimi lwamanye amazwe; ukuthayitha ulwimi olusukela kulo lwimi oluya kulo ngenkqubo yamajaji ukuzimisela ngokulungelelwe nokusebenza enkantoli; nikeza inkonzo yothayitha kwideski yamahala; nikeza uthayitho oluzwakalayo nolucacileyo ukusuka kulwimi olusukela kulo ukuya kulwimi oluya kulo ngaphandle kokuzihombisa okanye ukushiya into ngaphandle ngelixa uligcina ulwimi; dlulisa ulwimi oluchanekileyo ngokwesiseko somthetho wokusebenzisa ulwimi komthethi; lawula umthethi uze uqiniseke ukuba izicatshulwa zithathiwe zithayithwe ngokuchanekileyo; tshintsula umthetho weembiikwaseksebhu nangaphezulu kwezo mdia zokuthayitha; i ukuphanda nokuhlaziya ixwebhu elisukela kulo; zenza uphando olubalulekileyo uze uqhomfe neentsapho ezinxulumene nendaba; qinisekisa ukuba ixwebhu lihlonyelwe ngokuchanekileyo ngokwemithetho ekuthiwa ngamagama edilesi; jonga, hlela uze ulungise izixhobo ezihlonyiweyo ezithayithiweyo; ukuguqula i-Audio ekutsalwe ngemishini; yakha iteminoloyi uze unike inkxaso ekwakhiweni kweekhordhi; qokelela iteminoloyi uze wakhe idatabase; ngenisa amagama entsingiselo yawo kwirejista yeglosari; qokelela zonke iixwebhu ezibalulekileyo zocalo ukuncedisa ukutolikwa; dala amagama uze wenze imisebenzi yolawulo ekunye nolwandlalo lwentsathi kumajaji, kumlawuli weNkantoli noMlawuli.

jobs.title: Judge’s Secretaries
jobs.centre: Gauteng Division of The High Court: Pretoria Ref No: 2026/132/OCJ (X5 Posts) Gauteng Division of The High Court: Johannesburg Ref No: 2026/133/OCJ (X7 Posts)
jobs.salary_text: R338 106 – R398 277 per annum (Level 07). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement
jobs.summary: The Office of the Chief Justice seeks twelve judge's secretaries for the Gauteng High Court in Pretoria and Johannesburg, requiring a Grade 12 certificate and partial LLB completion.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate, a minimum of 20 modules completed towards an LLB, BA / BCOM Law degree. A minimum of two (2) years secretarial experience in the relevant field. Candidate to pass a typing test. A valid driver’s licence will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge on the Constitution of South, relevant legislatives, regulations, case lines, court online, secretariat prescripts, responsibilities, systems and procedures, Electronic Information Resources, online retrieval and Batho Pele principles. Skilled in communication, planning and organising, interpersonal, customer service, typing including Dictaphone typing, time management, Microsoft Office Programs, research capabilities, problem solving, judgment and decision making. Along with the following attributes: Assertive, meticulous, ability to work under pressure, time-bound, flexible, creativity, analytically, professionalism and attention to detail.
jobs.duties: Diarise the appointments and meetings of the Judge, type and file the judgments, ensure the Judgments that are handed down (delivered), signed draft orders granted in court or virtually are sent to the Typist for scanning, upload unto Case-lines/Court-Online and the Library. Ensure that all visitors are received, screened and their queries are attended to, record all incoming and outgoing documents, order and collect stationery for the Judge, collect the files before the commencement of a Criminal matter from the Registrar’s office at the Criminal section, keep update the register of reviews and sign on receipt to return the reviews to the Clerk, ensure that the register/template of the reserved judgement is updated and notify the Statistics Officer and the office of the Judge President when judgment has been handed down, ensure that the transcribed judgements from transcribers reach the Judges for approval and signature, prepare court rolls for Opposed Motion and Urgent Court and distribute to stakeholders, ensure that the Heads of Argument from various stakeholders are available to the Judge as per the filing that was done, administer the correct Oath ID or declaration in court, when required, ensure that the bench book of the Judge is prepared and files are taken by Ushers to court before the commencement of the proceedings, ensure that all stakeholders involved are present in court before commencement of proceedings, ensure that all cases are called on record as per the court roll by means of calling the case number and the parties’ names, before a Judge can allow parties to start with their matters, ensure that in the Criminal Court exhibits are handled, controlled and noted professionally, ensure that all the travel, accommodation arrangements are in order and attend to sign the documents for approval, ensure that the Judge’s logbook is submitted on or before the 5th of every month to the Transport Officer, ensure that the car is booked for either maintenance and service, receive the pre-authorisation for the Judge’s vehicle, remind Judge of the invoices so that the submission of the S&T claims can be processed, ensure the submissions of Cell phone and 3G data claims for process purposes and ensure that all updates on the loose leafs in the Judges library are attended to.

Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Regterssekretarisse
af.summary: Die Kantoor van die Hoofregter soek twaalf regterssekretarisse vir die Hooggeregshof van Gauteng in Pretoria en Johannesburg, wat 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en gedeeltelike LLB-voltooiing vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat, 'n minimum van 20 modules voltooi vir 'n LLB, BA / BCOM-regtegraad. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar sekretariële ervaring in die tersaaklike veld. Kandidaat moet 'n tiktoets slaag. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die Grondwet van Suid, tersaaklike wetgewing, regulasies, case-lines, court online, sekretariaatsvoorskrifte, verantwoordelikhede, stelsels en prosedures, elektroniese inligtingsbronne, aanlynherwinning en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in kommunikasie, beplanning en organisering, interpersoonlik, kliëntediens, tik insluitend diktafoon-tik, tydbestuur, Microsoft Office-programme, navorsingsvermoëns, probleemoplossing, oordeel en besluitneming. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: Selfversekerd, noukeurig, vermoë om onder druk te werk, tydsgebonde, buigsaam, kreatiwiteit, analities, professionalisme en aandag aan besonderhede.
af.duties: Die afsprake en vergaderings van die Regter in die dagboek aanteken, die vonnisse tik en lêer, verseker dat die vonnisse wat gelewer (afgegee) is, getekende konsepbevele wat in die hof of virtueel toegeken is, na die Tikster gestuur word vir skandering, oplaai na Case-lines/Court-Online en die Biblioteek. Verseker dat alle besoekers ontvang, gesif en hul navrae behandel word, alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente aanteken, skryfbehoeftes vir die Regter bestel en versamel, die lêers voor die aanvang van 'n strafsaak by die Kantoor van die Registra in die Straf-afdeling versamel, die register van hersienings op datum hou en by ontvangs teken om die hersienings aan die Klerk terug te gee, verseker dat die register/sjabloon van die gereserveerde vonnis opgedateer word en die Statistiekbeampte en die kantoor van die Regterpresident in kennis stel wanneer vonnis gelewer is, verseker dat die getikte vonnisse van tiksters die Regters bereik vir goedkeuring en handtekening, hofrolle vir Opposed Motion en Urgent Court voorberei en aan belanghebbendes versprei, verseker dat die Hoofde van Argument van verskeie belanghebbendes volgens die indiening wat gedoen is beskikbaar is aan die Regter, die korrekte Eed ID of verklaring in die hof toedien wanneer vereis, verseker dat die bankboek van die Regter voorberei is en lêers deur Ushers voor die aanvang van die verrigtinge na die hof geneem word, verseker dat alle betrokke belanghebbendes voor die aanvang van verrigtinge in die hof teenwoordig is, verseker dat alle sake volgens die hofrol op rekord geroep word deur middel van die roep van die saaknommer en die partye se name, voordat 'n Regter partye kan toelaat om met hul sake te begin, verseker dat in die Strafhof uitstallings professioneel hanteer, beheer en aangeteken word, verseker dat alle reis- en akkommodasie-reëlings in orde is en die dokumente vir goedkeuring onderteken, verseker dat die Regter se logboek op of voor die 5de van elke maand by die Vervoerbeampte ingedien word, verseker dat die motor vir óf instandhouding óf diens bespreek word, die voorafmagtiging vir die Regter se voertuig ontvang, die Regter herinner aan die fakture sodat die indiening van die S&S-eise verwerk kan word, verseker die indiening van selfoon- en 3G-data-eise vir verwerkingsdoeleindes en verseker dat alle opdaterings op die losblaadblaaie in die Regters se biblioteek behandel word.

xh.title: IiSecretaries zomMantshi
xh.summary: I-Office of the Chief Justice ifuna ababusekretarhi bomMantshi abalishumi elibini baka-Gauteng High Court ePretoria nakwa-Johannesburg, kufuneka babe negqabhazo le-Grade 12 kwaye babe ngxenye ye-LLB ezigqityiweyo.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe negqabhazo le-Grade 12, ubuncinane i-20 modules ezigqityiweyo ngomgangatho we-LLB, BA / BCOM Law degree. Ubuncinane iminyaka elishumi (2) yamava obusekretarhi kwicala elihambelanayo. Ummandu kufuneka adlule uvavanyo lwokuchwetheza. Ilayisenisi yokushayela eyasebenzayo iya kuba yingozi elungele. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-Constitution of South, izithintelo ezihambelanayo, iimigaqo, i-case lines, i-court online, i-secretariat prescripts, iindima, iinkqubo neendlela zokusebenza, i-Electronic Information Resources, i-online retrieval kunye namalinge a-Batho Pele. Amava okuziqhelanisa nabantu, amakhono eplanning and organising, amakhono abantu, inkonzo yabakwayo, ukuchwetheza kuquka ukuchwetheza nge-Dictaphone, ulawulo lwexesha, iinkqubo ze-Microsoft Office Programs, amandla okuphanda, ukusombulula iingxaki, isigqibo-nkqubo. Ngokubhekisele kwipropati elandelwayo: Thanda ukuzimela, khabakahle, ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwexinzelelo, ehambelana nexesha, eguquguqukayo, umbono omtsha, ukuyilwa nge-analytical, ukuziphatha kakuhle kunye nenkathalo yokuchaza.
xh.duties: Bhala kwinkqubo yemihla yemigqibelo iimvumelwano namagqabantshintshi loMantshi, tyala kwaye ugcine izigwebo, qinisekisa ukuba izigwebo ezinikwe (ezikhutshwayo), iimvumelwano ezityaliweyo ezinikiwe enkundleni okanye nge-online zithunyelwa kwiTypist ukuze ziskenwe, zifakelwe kwi-Case-lines/Court-Online naseLayibrari. Qinisekisa ukuba bonke ababakwayo bamkelwe, batyalwe kwaye imibuzo yabo iphathwa, bhape amaxwebhu anosulelayo nayaphumayo, odole kwaye aze athathe isixhobo esibhalwayo somMantshi, athathe iifayile ngaphambi kokuba qale icala eliCalumny-of-office esikweni sika-Registrar kwicala lwe-Criminal, gcina ubumbeko lwe-reviews kuqala kwaye usayine xa usamkela ukubuyisela i-reviews kuClerk, qinisekisa ukuba isikelo/itemplate yesigwebo esiyigciniso sihlaziywa kwaye uze wazise i-Statistics Officer kunye nepalamente yomMantshi President xa isigwebo selinikiwe, qinisekisa ukuba izigwebo ezityaliweyo ezivela kwabatyali zifike kooMantshi ukuzamkela kwaye basayine, lungiselela amagqabantshintshi enkundla aza kwi-Opposed Motion ne-Urgent Court kwaye awabeliseabo balungelelaniswayo, qinisekisa ukuba i-Heads of Argument evela kubalungelelaniswayo abahlukeneyo zifumanakile kuMantshi ngokwendlela yokuzifaka ezenziweyo, phatha ngokuchanekileyo i-Oath ID okanye isaziso enkundleni, xa kufuneka, qinisekisa ukuba i-bench book kaMantshi ilungiselelwe kwaye iifayile zithathwe ngoUshers siya enkundleni ngaphambi kokuba qalwe nomsebenzi, qinisekisa ukuba bonke abalungelelaniswayo abathintekayo bakhona enkundleni ngaphambi kokuba qalwe, qinisekisa ukuba onke amacala abizwa ngokubhalwe njengakwinkqubo yegqabantshintshi yenkundla ngokubiza inani lecala namagama amaqela, ngaphambi kokuba uMantshi avume amaqela okuqala nomsebenzi wawo, qinisekisa ukuba kwi-Criminal Court iimpahla ezibonakalayo zithathwa, zilawulwe kwaye zibhalwe ngobuchule, qinisekisa ukuba onke amalungiselelo okuhamba nokuhlala ahleli kakuhle kwaye uzame ukusayina amaxwebhu okuvuma, qinisekisa ukuba i-logbook kaMantshi ithunyelwe ngo-5 wenyanga yonke kwTransport Officer, qinisekisa ukuba imoto ibhukwe ngenjongo yokulungiswa okanye inkonzo, mkela ukuvuma ngaphambi kwexesha imoto kaMantshi, khumbuza uMantshi nge-invoices ukuze ukungenisa kwamangqawala e-S&T kuqhubekwe, qinisekisa ukuba kungeniswa amangqawala e-Cell phone ne-3G data njengoko kufuneka kwaye qinisekisa ukuba wonke amahlaziyo kumaphepha abudoda alugqithiswayo kwi-Library yooMantshi aphathwa.

zu.title: Abasekela be-Judge
zu.summary: I-Office of the Chief Justice ifuna abasekela be-Judge abayishumi nambili besekelwa ikhono e-Gauteng High Court ePretoria naseJohannesburg, kudingeka kuba nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 futhi kube khona ukubekezelela kwe-LLB.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12, okungenani amamojula angu-20 abekiwe ohlelweni lwesiqu se-LLB, BA / BCOM Law degree. Okungenani iminyaka emibili (2) yohlu lokusebenza njengoba sekharikhwe enkundleni ebalulekile. Umuntu kufanele adlule uvivinyo lokuthayipha. Ilayisense yomshayeli elikhoyo kuzoba yinhlawulo ebalulekile. Ulwazi nemakhono: Ulwazi nge-Constitution of South, izincwadi zomthetho ezibalulekile, imithetho, izinkambiso zamehlo abesabi, inkantolo ku-inthanethi, iziqondiso zesikhulu sephimiso, izibophezelo, izinhlelo nezinqubo, izinsiza zolwazi lwesikhathi sangempela, ukukhuluma kwemininingwane ku-inthanethi nemigombe ye-Batho Pele. Ukusebenza kahle ekuxhumaneni, ekwelweni nasekuhleleni, phakathi kwabantu, nanenhlekelele yokukhonza, ekuthayipheni okuhlanganisa ukuthayipha nge-Dictaphone, ekuphatheni isikhathi, ohlelweni lwe-Microsoft Office, amandla okuphenya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwahlulela nokuthatha izinqumo. Kanye nezimo ezilandelayo: Ukuzimela, ukunakeka ngobuningi, amandla okusebenza ngaphansi kwezingxarho, ukuboshwa isikhathi, ukuguquguquka, ukwakha, ukwahlukanisa, ukuziphatha ngobuchwepheshe nokunakisisa imininingwane.
zu.duties: Bhala ohlwini lwesikhathi izinkomisho namihlangano ye-Judge, thayipha futhi ugcine izinkulumo-zigwegwe, qiniseka ukuthi izinkulumo-zigwegwe ezinikezwe (ezethulwe), imiyalo eyayilungiselwe ukuze sayinikeze eNkantolo noma ngokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ithunyelwa ku-Typist ukuze iskenwe, ifakwe kuCase-lines/Court-Online naseSomtholampilo. Qiniseka ukuthi bonke abavakashi bamukeleki, bahlolelwe futhi imibuzo yabo iphendulwe, bhala zonke amafayela amanje naphuma, ole futhi uqoqe izinto zokubhala ze-Judge, qoqe amafayela ngaphambi kokuqala udaba lwobugebengu esikhundleni se-Registrar esigabeni sobugebengu, gcina ubuhlolojwali bokubuyekezwa futhi usayine lapho wamukela ukuze ubuyisele izibuyekezo ku-Clerk, qiniseka ukuthi ifomu lesibuyekezo sabo bonke abantu bayalungiselelwa futhi bafike ngaphambi kokuqala izinkathazo ngokusho kohlaka lwenkantolo lokubiza inombolo yenkantolo namagama amalungu, ngaphambi kokuba i-Judge ivume amalungu noma iqembu ukuqala ngemibuzo yabo, qiniseka ukuthi izinto ezibonwayo eNkantolo yobugebengu ziphathwa, zilawulwa futhi zibhalwe ngobuchwepheshe, qiniseka ukuthi wonke amalungiselelo okuhamba nokuhlala ahlezi kahle futhi uzakale amafayela ukuze asayinwe ngesivumelwano, qiniseka ukuthi i-Judge's logbook ithunyelwa nge-5 yanyanga zonke ku-Transport Officer, qiniseka ukuthi imoto ibhukhiwe nokulungiswa nokukhonza, wamukele isivumelwano sangaphambili semoto ye-Judge, khumbuza i-Judge ngemali efanele ukuthi ngenxa yokuthumela izimangalo ze-S&T zingaqedywa, qiniseka ukuthi izimangalo ze-Cell phone ne-3G data zithunyelwe ukuze ziqedywe, qiniseka ukuthi zonke izinto ezifakwe ezincwadini ezingabunjiwe eNkantolo yabaphathi zahlanzwa.

jobs.title: Registrar (MR3-MR5)
jobs.centre: Gauteng Division of High Court, Johannesburg
jobs.salary_text: R337 563 - R1 155 777 per annum (MR3-MR5), Salary will be in accordance with Occupation Specific Dispensation (Resolution 1 of 2008). Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit service certificate/s for determination of their experience. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Registrar position at the Gauteng Division of the High Court in Johannesburg requiring an LLB degree and minimum two years' legal experience to process default judgments and quasi-judicial court functions.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an LLB Degree qualification at NQF level eight (8). A minimum of two (2) years’ experience in Legal environment obtained after qualification. MR3: LLB degree or equivalent qualification plus a minimum of 2 years post qualification experience in a legal profession (certificates of service must accompany the application). MR4: LLB degree or equivalent qualification plus a minimum of 8 years post-qualification experience in a legal profession (certificates of service must accompany the application). MR5: LLB degree or equivalent qualification plus a minimum of 14 years post- qualification experience in a legal profession (certificates of service must accompany the application). A valid driver’s License will be an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of registry duties, Case Flow Management, legislative framework governing the public service, storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in communication (verbal and written), computer literacy, numerical, planning, organising, problem solving, decision-making, interpersonal, conflict management, time management and analytical skills. Along with the following personal attributes: honesty and integrity, resilience, attention to detail, flexibility, strong work ethics professionalism, time bound, meticulous, trustworthy and observance of confidentiality.
jobs.duties: Process default judgments to enhance efficiency of the court in handling of quasi- judicial functions, consider applications for default judgment (Rule 31[5]) by applying Court rules and regulations, case law, discretion and knowledge, ensure circulation of the outcome to the relevant litigating party, capture and update accurate Default applications register and data tool registered in the office daily, verify data and submit reporting tool on percentage of default judgments granted by Registrars to the Statistician, execute taxations to enhance efficiency of the court in handling of quasi-judicial functions, determine whether pleadings/ processes comply with the court rules. Tax bills of cost-by hearing arguments from the parties and apply discretion and knowledge to the reasonable litigation costs, process and finalise Opposed and Unopposed Taxations in accordance with SOP, deal with and finalise taxation reviews (Rule 48) through the drafting of stated cases, replies, and submission to the Judiciary. Finalise taxation reviews (Rule 48) through the drafting of stated cases, replies, and submission to the Judiciary, capture and update accurate Bills of costs registered and data tools in the Office, submit reporting Tool on Taxations to the Statistician, verify data and submit reporting taxations dealt with by Registrars to the Statistician. Manage criminal/civil process to enhance efficiency of the court, analyse statistical data to assess trends and devise strategies to address identified risk factors, resolve Presidential Hotline queries and chapter 9 institution enquiries’-ordinate and report on the provision of support Registrars supporting offices, manage the allocation of performance information/data/Statistics for purpose of reporting as per Reporting Tools, maintain and update manual registers for Audit of reported Performance information, supervise and develop staff, ensure general supervision of employees. Allocate duties and perform quality control on the work delivered by officials, manage leave of staff, advise and lead supervisees with regard to all aspects of the work, manage performance, conduct and discipline of employees, ensure that all employees are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively, develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning, address enquiries and provide advice and guidance on asset allocation and control.
