af.title: Registrateur (MR3-MR5)
af.summary: Registrateur-pos by die Gauteng Division of the High Court in Johannesburg wat 'n LLB-graad en 'n minimum van twee jaar se regsondervinding vereis om verstekvonnisse en kwasi-regterlike hoffunksies te verwerk.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n LLB-graad-kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak agt (8) beskik. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se ondervinding in 'n Regsomgewing verkry na kwalifikasie. MR3: LLB-graad of ekwivalente kwalifikasie plus 'n minimum van 2 jaar se postkwalifikasie-ondervinding in 'n regsprofessie (dienssertifikate moet die aansoek vergesel). MR4: LLB-graad of ekwivalente kwalifikasie plus 'n minimum van 8 jaar se postkwalifikasie-ondervinding in 'n regsprofessie (dienssertifikate moet die aansoek vergesel). MR5: LLB-graad of ekwivalente kwalifikasie plus 'n minimum van 14 jaar se postkwalifikasie-ondervinding in 'n regsprofessie (dienssertifikate moet die aansoek vergesel). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van registratuurpligte, Case Flow Management, wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare diens regeer, berging en onttrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), rekenaarvaardigheid, numeries, beplanning, organising, probleemoplossing, besluitneming, interpersoonlike, konflikbestuur, tydbestuur en analitiese vaardighede. Saam met die volgende persoonlike eienskappe: eerlikheid en integriteit, veerkragtigheid, aandag aan detail, buigsaamheid, sterk werksetiek, professionaliteit, tydgebonde, noukeurig, betroubaar en waarneming van vertroulikheid.
af.duties: Verwerk verstekvonnisse om die doeltreffendheid van die hof in die hantering van kwasi-regterlike funksies te verbeter; oorweeg aansoeke om verstekvonnis (Reël 31[5]) deur Hofreëls en regulasies, case law, diskresie en kennis toe te pas; verseker sirkulasie van die uitslag aan die betrokke litigerende party; vasleg en dateer akkurate Verstekaansoeke-register en datanutsmiddel wat daagliks in die kantoor geregistreer word; verifieer data en dien verslagdoeningsnutsmiddel oor die persentasie verstekvonnisse wat deur Registrateurs toegestaan is by die Statistikus in; voer belastinge uit om die doeltreffendheid van die hof in die hantering van kwasi-regterlike funksies te verbeter; bepaal of pleitstukke/prosesse met die hofreëls voldoen. Belas rekeninge van koste deur argumente van die partye aan te hoor en diskresie en kennis op redelike litigasiekostes toe te pas; verwerk en finaliseer Teengewerpte en Onteengewerpte Belastinge in ooreenstemming met SOP; hanteer en finaliseer belastinghersienings (Reël 48) deur die opstel van gestelde sake, antwoorde, en voorlegging aan die Regbank. Finaliseer belastinghersienings (Reël 48) deur die opstel van gestelde sake, antwoorde, en voorlegging aan die Regbank; vasleg en dateer akkurate Kosterekene wat geregistreer is en datanutsmiddels in die Kantoor; dien verslagdoeningsnutsmiddel oor Belastinge by die Statistikus in; verifieer data en dien verslagdoeningsbelastinge wat deur Registrateurs hanteer is by die Statistikus in. Bestuur strafregtelike/siviele proses om die doeltreffendheid van die hof te verbeter; analiseer statistiese data om tendense te assesseer en strategieë te ontwerp om geïdentifiseerde risikofaktore aan te spreek; los Presidentshotlyn-navrae en navrae van hoofstuk 9-instellings op; koördineer en rapporteer oor die verskaffing van ondersteuning deur Registrateurs wat kantore ondersteun; bestuur die toewysing van prestasie-inligting/data/statistieke vir die doel van verslagdoening volgens Verslagdoeningsnutsmiddels; handhaaf en dateer handmatige registre vir Oudit van gerapporteerde prestasie-inligting; hou toesig oor en ontwikkel personeel; verseker algemene toesig oor werknemers. Ken pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur amptenare gelewer word; bestuur verlof van personeel; adviseer en lei ondergeskiktes met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk; bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van werknemers; verseker dat alle werknemers opgelei en ontwikkel word om in staat te wees om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te lever; ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werksisteme en -prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker; spreek navrae aan en verskaf advies en leiding oor bate-toewysing en -beheer.

zu.title: Umrejistra (MR3-MR5)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somrejistra esigatshaneni saseGauteng seNkantolo Ephakeme eJohannesburg esidinga iziqu ze-LLB kanye nokutholwa komuntu onamavahe emthethweni okungenani iminyaka emibili ukuqhuba izinkantolo zokungabi khona kanye nemisebenzi yezinkantolo efanayo nelejodayishi.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe neziqu ze-Digri ye-LLB ezingeni le-NQF eight (8). Okungenani amavahe eminyaka emi-2 (2) endaweni yomthetho atholwe ngemva kokuthola iziqu. MR3: Izinga le-LLB noma iziqu ezingulinganayo kanye nokutholwa komuntu onamavahe okungenani eminyakeni eyi-2 ngemva kokuthola iziqu esikhundleni somthetho (izitifiketi zokusebenza kufanele zihambise isicelo). MR4: Izinga le-LLB noma iziqu ezingulinganayo kanye nokutholwa komuntu onamavahe okungenani eminyakeni eyi-8 ngemva kokuthola iziqu esikhundleni somthetho (izitifiketi zokusebenza kufanele zihambise isicelo). MR5: Izinga le-LLB noma iziqu ezingulinganayo kanye nokutholwa komuntu onamavahe okungenani eminyakeni eyi-14 ngemva kokuthola iziqu esikhundleni somthetho (izitifiketi zokusebenza kufanele zihambise isicelo). Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela izokuba yilungelo elengeziwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yerejistri, ukuPhathwa kokuHamba kweziNgqungquthane, umsakazo womthetho ophatha inkonzo kahulumeni, izindlela zokugcina nokuthola ukwaziswa ngokwezomsebenzi namaphethini we-Batho Pele. Ubuchwepheshe ekuxhumeni (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, izibalo, ukwelula, ukuhlelela, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuthatha izinqumo, ubudlelwano babantu, ukuphatha izinkinga, ukuphatha isikhathi namakhono okuhlaziya. Kanye nezimpawu zomuntu ezilandelayo: ukuqotho kanye nobuqotho, ukumelana, ukunaka imininingwane, ukuguquguquka, i-ethiksi eqinile yomsebenzi, ubungcweti, ukuhambisana nesikhathi, ukucophelela, ukwethembeka nokugcina ubumfihlo.
zu.duties: Qhuba izinkantolo zokungabi khona ukuze kube khona ukusebenza okuyinhloko kwenkantolo ekuphathweni kwezinkantolo ezifana nelejodayishi, cabanga izicelo ezinkantolo zokungabi khona (Rule 31[5]) ngokusebenzisa imithetho namacebo enkantolo, umthetho wezinkantolo, incazelo nolwazi, qinisekisa ukuthi izincazelo zomphumela zifike kubandakanywa ekulinganisweni, bamba ubuhlakani futhi uvuse izinkomba ezibhalwe ngokunembile zezicelo zenkantolo zokungabi khona kanye nesiqhongo sedatha ebhalwe kuleyondlu nsuku zonke, qinisekisa idatha bese unikela isiphongo sobuqwethu ngamaphesenti enkantolo zokungabi khona ezinikwe ngabarejistra kumcwetshingqangi, qhuba izinhlawulo ukuze kube khona ukusebenza okuyinhloko kwenkantolo ekuphathweni kwezinkantolo ezifana nelejodayishi,inquma ukuthi izibhalo/ izinqubo zihambisana namacebo enkantolo. Linganisela iziphotheko- ngokuzwa izinkulumo eziphuma kubandakanywa bese usebenzisa incazelo nolwazi ekubeni amaphesenti okufanele wezindleko zezinkantolo, qhuba bese uphelisa izinhlawulu Eziphikisiwe kanye neziNgabi khona ezingaphikisiwe ngokwe-SOP, phatha bese uphelisa ukubukeka kwezinkantolo zokuthintwa (Rule 48) ngokubhala izimo ezibalwayo, impendulo, kanye nokuzinikela eBhungweni lejodayishi. Phelisa ukubukeka kwezinkantolo zokuthintwa (Rule 48) ngokubhala izimo ezibalwayo, impendulo, kanye nokuzinikela eBhungweni lejodayishi, bamba ubuhlakani bese uvuse izinkomba ezibhalwe ngokunembile zeziphotheko zesamba futhi ngeziphongo sedatha ezibhalwe kuleyondlu, thumela isiphongo sezinkantolo zokuthintwa kumcwetshingqangi, qinisekisa idatha bese unikela isiphongo sezinkantolo zokuthintwa eziphathwa ngabarejistra kumcwetshingqangi. Phatha izinqubo zezono/zomthetho ukuze kube khona ukusebenza okuyinhloko kwenkantolo, hlaziya idatha yesibalo ukuze ubone izinto ezivele bese ukha imigomo yokubhekana nengozi ebonakele, xazula imibuzo ye-Presidential Hotline nemibuzo yezikhungo ze-chapter 9 -onge umsebenzi bese ungenisa umbiko kumndeni wezinsiza abarejistra abasiza nabo, phatha ukunikwa kwemininingwane yokusebenza/idatha/izesibalo ngaphandle kwezinto ezidingwa ngokomthetho, setsha uhlobo lwebhange yegciwane futhi luse imibhalo ehleli yokubuka kwemininingwane yokusebenza ngezinto eziphathwayo, kufunde futhi athuthukise abantu, qinisekisa ulawulo olujwayelekile lomsebenzi. Nika umsebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula ikhwalithi ngeyomsebenzi ezokhiqizwa ngabasebenzi, phatha ilavu yomsebenzi, aphule futhi ahole ababhalwa ngezinto ezihlobene nayo yonke imisebenzi, lawule ukusebenza, ukuziphatha kanye nokuqondisa abasebenzi, qinisekise ukuthi bonke abasebenzi bafundiswa futhi bathuthukiswa ukuze bakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngomsebenzi ohambisana nesimo edingwayo, thuthukisa, phumelelisa bese ulawule izinhlelo zomsebenzi namandla ezingaphezulu ukuqinisekisa ukuba khona kokusebenza okuyinhloko, xazula imibuzo bese unikeza ngeluleko nokuqondisa ngokuqashwa nezinto eziphathwayo.

xh.title: uBhalisi (MR3-MR5)
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaBhalisi kwisiKavelo saseGauteng se-High Court eJohannesburg esifuna isidanga se-LLB degree kwaye nobuncinane beminyaka elishumi elinesibini yamava kwemisebenzi yomthetho ukuze kucubungulwe izigwebo ezingenziwanga ndawonye nemisebenzi yenkantolo.
xh.requirements: Abafanelo kufuneka babe ne-LLB Degree kwinqanaba le-NQF level eight (8). Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi elinesibini (2) yamava kwimeko yomthetho efumaneka emva kokufumana isidanga. MR3: LLB degree okanye isidanga esilinganayo nge-LLB degree kunye nobuncinane beminyaka elishumi elinesibini yamava emva kwesidanga kwishishini lamthetho (iitifikhedi zomsebenzi kufuneka zihambisane isicelo). MR4: LLB degree okanye isidanga esilinganayo nge-LLB degree kunye nobuncinane beminyaka elisibhozo yamava emva kwesidanga kwishishini lamthetho (iitifikhedi zomsebenzi kufuneka zihambisane isicelo). MR5: LLB degree okanye isidanga esilinganayo nge-LLB degree kunye nobuncinane beminyaka elishumi elinebhozo yamava emva kwesidanga kwishishini lamthetho (iitifikhedi zomsebenzi kufuneka zihambisane isicelo). Ilayisensi yokuqhuba elisebenzayo iya kuba ngesoncedo esongezelelweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yebhalisi, Case Flow Management, inkqubo yomthetho elawula inkonzo kaRhulumente, iinkqubo zokugcina nokuvelisa iinkcukacha ngokwendlela esetyenziswa kwindlu yokusebenza nakuBatho Pele Principles. Unako ukunxibelelana (ngoluvo nangokubhalwa), ulwazi lwekhompyutha, ukubala, ukuqamba iindaba, ukuqulunqa, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo, ukusebenza nabantu, ukulawula iingxoxo, ukulawula ixesha nolwazi lokuhlalutya. Kunye nolu lokulandelayo malunga nomntu: inyaniso nokwethembeka, ukomelela, ingqalelo kwiinkcukacha, ukuguquguquka, inkqubo yomsebenzi emfutshane yenkqubo yomsebenzo, ukubambe ixesha, ukucocca, ukuthembeka nokugcina iyimfihlo.
xh.duties: Cubungula izigwebo ezingezenziwa ndawonye ukuze konyuse isixhaso senkantolo ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi yenkantolo, phonononga izicelo zezigwebo ezingenziwanga ndawonye (Rule 31[5]) ngokusebenzisa imigaqo nemiyalelo yenkantolo, umthetho wamacala, isigqibo nolwazi, qinisekisa ukusasazwa kwesiphumo kumacala athintekayo, batsha uze uvuselele ngokuchanekileyo irejista yesicelo sesigwebo esingenziwanga ndawonye nethulu leenkcukacha zalo egcinwe kwindlu usuku ngalunye, qinisekisa iinkcukacha zeenkcukacha uze unikeze ithulu lokuvela kwengxelo ngeseseko lezigwebo ezingenziwanga ndawonye ezinikiwe ngabaBhalisi kumBalawuli wamanani, perfoma izohlwayo ukuze konyuse isixhaso senkantolo ekuphathwenzi kwezohlwayo, qinisekisa ukuba amaphepha-mthetho/inkqubo yomthetho ihambelana nemigaqo yenkantolo. Phonononga izikweri zentlawulo-ngokumamela iingxoxo zamacala uze usebenzise isigqibo nolwazi kwentlawulo yamakhalo alungeleyo, cubungula uze uqedele izohlwayo Ezingachaswanga nezoChasiwe ngokwe-SOP, phatha uze uqedele iin.xoxo zohlwayo (Rule 48) ngokulula izicatshulwa zamacala abekiweyo, iimpendulo, nokuzinika abaBeki bomthetho. Qedelela iinxoxo zohlwayo (Rule 48) ngokulula izicatshulwa zamacala abekiweyo, iimpendulo, nokuzinika abaBeki bomthetho, batsha uze uvuselele izikweri zentlawulo egcinwe kunye namathulu eenkcukacha eNkundla, nika iNxholo鹰livo ngeZohlwayo kumBalawuli wamanani, qinisekisa iinkcukacha uze unikeze ingxelo ngeentlawulo eziphathwe ngabaBhalisi kumBalawuli wamanani. Phatha inkqubo yamacala obugebengu/noburhalari ukuze konyuse isixhaso senkantolo, hlalutya iinkcukacha zeenkcukacha ukuze uqonde iindlela ezahlukeneyo uze ucace iindlela ezakujolisa kwingozi efanjiweyo, susa iintsiba ze-Presidential Hotline nangemibuzo ye chapter 9 institutions-hlela uze uchaze ngokunikwa inkxaso abaBhalisi abanika inkxaso iindlu, phatha ukwabiwa kweenkcukacha/amanani/iStats ngenjongo yokuchaza ngokweeThulu ezaKuchaza, gcina uze uvuselele iirejista ezandayo ukuze kwenziwe uviwo lweenkcukacha ezivelwe ngokuSebenza, qonda uze uphuhlise abasebenzi, qinisekisa ulwazi olujikeleleyo abasebenzi. Yabela imisebenzi uze uqhube umthetho wolungiselelo emsebenzini onikezelwe ngabaphathi, lawula ukubhaliswa kwabasebenzi,nika ingcebiso uze uqhaze abo bajongene nabo malunga neendlela zonke zomsebenzi, lawula inkqubo yomsebenzi, indlela nokuziphatha kwabasebenzi, qinisekisa ukuba bonke abasebenzi bafundiswe baze baphuhlise ukuba bakwazi ukunikeza umsebenzi olingana nomgangatho ofunekayo ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenzayo, phuhlise, thumelela uze ulawule iinkqubo nomsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenzayo, phatha imibuzo uze unikeze ingcebiso nolwazi ekubeni nasekulawulweni kwempahla.

af.title: Sekuriteits toesighouer
af.summary: Hou toesig oor sekuriteitsfunksies by die Gauteng Hooggeregshof in Pretoria, wat Graad 12, PSIRA-registrasie en tersaaklike ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat beskik. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar ervaring in die tersaaklike veld. Graad B PSIRA-sertifikaat, 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die toegangskontroleprosedures, maatreëls vir die beheer en beweging van toerusting en voorrade, voorgeskrewe sekuriteitsprosedures (bv. MIS, NISA, Wet op die Beskerming van Inligting, ens.) en die gesag van sekuriteitsbeamptes kragtens hierdie dokumente. Kennis van die tersaaklike noodprosedures Sekuriteitsbeleid en -prosedures, Wet op Toegang tot Openbare Persele en Voertuie, OHS-wet, 85 van 1993. Bedrewe in rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office), kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik), toesighoudend, probleemoplossing, besluitneming, interpersoonlike verhoudinge, luister, beplanning en organisatoriese vaardighede. Saam met die volgende eienskappe: spanwerker, betroubaarheid en verantwoordelikheid, betroubaar, buigsaam, aandag aan besonderhede, vermoë om onder druk te werk en selfvertroue.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor die sekuriteitsfunksies wat deur sekuriteitsbeamptes/diensverskaffers uitgevoer word; magtig toerusting, dokumente en voorrade in of uit die gebou of persele; inspekteer en rapporteer alle niefunksionering van sekuriteitsmaatreëls (bv. X-straalmasjiene, deurloopmetaaldetektore, sekuriteitsligte, ens.); kontroleer voorvalle/voorkomsboeke/registers; monitor en verskaf ondersteuning in noodgevalle; monitor uitkomste en instelleer die nodige korrektiewe maatreëls om afwykings van norme en standaarde aan te spreek; monitor toegangskontrole om ongemagtigde toegang tot geboue en ander persele te voorkom; verskaf sekuriteitsverwante dienste; identifiseer risiko's en bedreigings vir die sekuriteit van die departement; verskaf inligting rakende voorvalle aan ondersoekbeamptes; voer voorlopige voorvalondersoeke uit en dien verslae in; rapporteer defektiewe toerusting/stelsels; verseker dat stelsels optimaal funksioneer deur geskeduleerde dienste; monitor en reageer op alarmstelsel; administreer alle beheerkamerbedrywighede om die departement se bates te beskerm; hou toesig oor alle beheerkameraktiwiteite; rapporteer alle voorvalle en enige geidentifiseerde nie-nakoming rakende sekuriteitsvoorskrifte; hersiening van beeldmateriaal op versoek deur die behoorlike prosedure; dateer alle registers vir die waargenome voorvalle op; verskaf ondersteuning aan administrasie en verwante funksies; bepaal roosters, skofskedules en oortyd; beheer verlof en verwante personeelsake in ooreenstemming met HR-prosedures en voorskrifte; administereer sleutelbeheerstelsel; monitor prestasie van werknemers en bepaal opleidingsbehoeftes.

zu.title: Umphathi wokuPhepha
zu.summary: Qapha imisebenzi yokuphepha eGauteng High Court ePretoria, okudinga isigaba se-12, ukubhalisa kwi-PSIRA namava ahlobene.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesitifiketi sesigaba se-12. Ukube ngaphansi konyakeni omunye (1) wamava enkundleni ehlobene. Isitifiketi se-PSIRA isigaba B, ilayisensi yokuqasha ebikezelwe izimoto izobe ingeyenze njengenyonge. Ulwazi nezakhono: Ulwazi ngezenqubo zokulawula ukungena, izinyathelo zokulawula nokususwa kwezikhungazisetshenziswa namasitore, izenqubo ezibekiwe zokuphepha (isb, MIS, NISA, uMthetho wokuVikelwa kolwazi, njll.) namandla abaluleki bokuphepha ngaphansi kwezileso. Ulwazi ngezenqubo zokwesaba ezihlobene Inqubo nomthetho wokuVikelwa kokuPhepha, ukufinyelela kwendawo yokuzijwayeza kanye noMthetho wezimoto, uMthetho we-OHS, 85 ka-1993. Ukugqamise emkhombandlelensi (MS Office), ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangombhalo), ukuphatha abantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ubuhlobo nomuntu, ukulalela, ukuhlela nobuholi bokuhlela. Kanye nezinye izici ezilandelayo: ukuba ngumuntu osebenza ngokuhlanganyela, ukuthembeka nokubeka izibongo, ukwesaba ukuthiwe okungenasikhathi, ukumelana nanoma isiphi isimo, ukunakisisa okuncane, ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi komfutho nokuzithemba.
zu.duties: Qapha imisebenzi yokuphepha yenziwe abaluleki bokuphepha/babanikezeli ngezenzo, vumela izikhungazisetshenziswa, amadokhumenti namasitore esiya ekhaya noma esiphumela esakhiweni noma endaweni, hlola futhi umbike konke okungasebenzi kwezinyathelo zokuphepha (isb. Izinto ezingamashadi e-X-Ray, abahlahli besimbi esihambahambayo, izibani zokuphepha njll.), hlolisisa incwadi yezenzakalo / incwadi yezikhathi / incwadi zokubhalisa, qapha futhi nikeza inkxaso esethweni sezimosohaya, qapha iziphumelelo futhi sethe izinyathelo zokulungisa eziyimfuneko ukulungisa ukwehluka kwezimiso namazinga, qapha ukulawulwa kwangena ukuvimbela ukungena okungavunyelwe ezakhiweni naso kwezinye izindawo, nikeza izinkonzo ezihlotshaniswe nokuphepha, khomba izingozi nezinsongo ekuphepheni komnyango, nikeza ulwazi ngemayelana nezenzakalo kabaluleki bokuphepha ophenyo,enza uphenyo lokuqala lwezenzakalo futhi uhambise imibiko, biba izikhungazisetshenziswa/izinhlela ezingasebenzi kahle, qiniseka ukuthi izinhlela zisebenza ngendlela evela igqozi ngokusebenzisa izehluleko zocwaningo, qapha futhi aphendule kuhlela lokwesaba, phatha konke ukusebenza kwegumbi lolawulo ukuvikela izimpahla zomnyango, qapha konke ukwenziwa kwegumbi lolawulo, biba yonke imizekelo noma konke okungahambisani nokuphepha kwezinyathelo, cabangisisa izithombe ezibukwe uma kucelwa ngomlando ohambisana nesimo sokuphepha, qapha izimemo kuyo yonke imizekelo eqaphiwe, nikeza inkxaso ekuphathweni kwenkampani kanye nalomsebenzi ongokwayo, hlela izikhathi zokusebenza ngokushintshashintsha, hlela icala lokusebenza ngemva kwezikhathi ezithile kanye nomsebenzi owedlule, lawula ukukhishwa kweholide kanye nezinye izindaba zabasebenzi ngokuhambisana nezenqubo namagunya e-HR, phatha uhlelo lokulawula ukhiye, qapha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi futhi ukhombe izidingo zokuqeqesha.

xh.title: Mlawuli woKhuselo
xh.summary: Qondisa imisebenzi yokhuseleko Kwikhaya leGqitha leGauteng ePretoria, kufuneka iGraji 12, ubhaliso kwi-PSIRA namava afanelekileyo.
xh.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethe seGraji ye-12. Iminyaka elishumi elinanye (1) yamava kwiloba enxulumene nayo. Isatifikethe sePSIRA seGraji B, ilayisenisi yokuqhuba elisebenzayo iya kuba ngeluncedo elongezelelweyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemiqathango yokulawula ukungena, izigqibo zokulawula noshintsho lwesixhobo nendawo egcinwa kuyo, iinkqubo zokhuseleko ezibekiweyo (umz. MIS, NISA, umThetho woKukhuselwa koLwazi, njl.) nangamagunya abaphathi bokhuseleko phantsi kwala maxwebhu. Ulwazi ngemiqathango efanelekile yemiba ephuthumayo Umgaqo-nkqubo weNkonzo zoKhuseleko nemiQathango, uMthetho woNgeno kwiNdawo zoLuntu nokuSebenzisa iiMoto, uMthetho ka-1993 we-85 we-OHS. Ukhethe ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office), ukunxibelelana (ngoluvo nolubhalwayo), ukulawula, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukwenza izigqibo, ukuhlonganisa nabantu, ukulalela, ukuqamba iindawo zokwenza umsebenzi nokuyihlela. Kananjalo ngeempawu zilandelayo: umsebenzi wesithoba, ukuthembeka nokwabelana nengxaxheba, ukuthembeka, ukuguquguquka, ukuchana neenkcukacha, ikhono lokusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo kunye nenkululeko yokuzithemba.
xh.duties: Qondisa imisebenzi yokhuseleko yenziwa ngabaphathi bokhuseleko/baboneleli beadidi, vuma isixhobo, amaxwebhu nezinto ezingenayo nesezinyamelayo kwindlu okanye kwindawo, hlola kwaye ungexelo ngeqhinga elingasebenziyo lwezikhuseleko (umz. iimaxhini ze-X-Ray, iintsingiselo zesinyithi ezihamba-ngaphakathi, iibhanisi zokhuseleko njl.njl.), hlola iincwadi zezenzakalo/nokubakho kwemihla ngemihla/iirejista, qaphela kwaye nikeze inkxaso xa kubakho iimeko eziphuthumayo, qaphela iziphumo kwaye mise izigqibo ezilungileyo zokulungisa iingcapheko ezingqamana nemigangatho namagqabantshintshi, qaphela ulawulo lokungena ukuyithintela iingeno ezingavunyelwanga ezindweni nakwezinye iindawo, nikeze iinkonzo ezinxulumene nokhuseleko, chonga iingozi neengcapheko ekhuselekweni kwisebe, nikeze iinkcazelo ngezenzakalo kubaphandi, yenza uphando lokuba kukho kwangaphambili kwezenzakalo kwaye uzithumele iingxelo, xela ngesixhobo/iinkqubo ezingasebenayo, qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zisebenza ngokupheleleyo ngeenkonzo ezijilijweyo, qaphela kwaye uphendule kwinkqubo yobulumko malunga nobulumko, lawula zonke iinkqubo zegumbi lolawulo ukuze kukhuselwe izinto zesebe, qondisa zonke izenzo zegumbi lolawulo, xela zonke iizenzakalo nayiphi na ingaqamelwanga enxulumene nemiyalelo yokhuseleko, phinda ucocise iifoto eziqhwangiweyo kumcelo ngokulandela iyaqiqo efanelekileyo, hlaziya zonke iirejista ngezenzakalo ezibonwayo, nikeze inkxaso kwabaphathi kwaye nakumisebenzi enxulumene nayo, misa iirejista zomsebenzi wolunyuselo, amaxesha okusebenza nolunyusulo olungaphele kwexesha, lawula iholo lokuphumla neminye imicelo yabasebenzi ngokulandela iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi e-HR, lawula inkqubo yolawulo lamaqhosha, qaphela ukusebenza kwabasebenzi kwaye uchonge iimfuno zolugqatso.

jobs.title: Security Officer
jobs.centre: Kwazulu-Natal Local Division of The High Court: Durban
jobs.salary_text: R170 226 – R200 523.per annum (Level 03) The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Security Officer needed at the Durban High Court to perform access control and security functions.
jobs.requirements: An applicant should be in possession of a grade 10 or equivalent qualification as recognised by SAQA. Basic Security Officer’s course, at least Grade C with a valid PSIRA certificate. A minimum of one (1) year experience in security industry and a valid driver’s license will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of Access to Public Premises and Vehicle Act and other security related legislations, access control procedures, control and movement of equipment and stores, prescribed security procedures (e.g. MIS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, etc.) and the authority of security officers under these documents. Knowledge on the relevant emergency procedures and Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in interpersonal, client service, listening skills, problem solving, decision making, communication, computer and facilitating.
jobs.duties: Perform access control functions, determine whether visitors have appointments/or the service that visitor requires, contact the relevant employees to confirm the appointment or refer the visitor to the relevant service delivery point, ensure that the admission control register is completed and issue admission control documents/ cards as required, utilise walk-through metal detector for the effectiveness of access control, ensure that unauthorised persons and dangerous object do not enter the building/premises, report all the identified security breaches and non-compliance to the supervisor, ensure that equipment, document and store do not leave or enter the building or premises unauthorised, ensure that the registers control the movement of equipment, stores and documents are completed, ensure that no equipment, stores as assets of the department leave the building /premises unauthorised. Inspect vehicles entering and leaving the premises, gather information and report on missing and stolen equipment and stores, handle documents at points of entry according to classification and the prescripts, operate control room security equipment’s, monitor all movements, events, and activities within the department's premises using CCTV equipment’s, ensure that security system is in good working condition, report all incidents monitored, report to the supervisor, monitor all access points for effective access control, report all identified non-compliance to security policy and procedures to improve office security, ensure safety in the building and premises, undertake building/ and the primes patrols to identify and check, apply emergency procedures (in situations like bomb scares, riots etc.) and alert emergency services and department management, monitor and respond to alarm system. Ensure all incidents are recorded in the occurrence books/registers, ensure that recorded information is correct, update the information on the occurrence book/register as and when required, liaise with supervisor to verify information recorded and perform any other duties assigned to you by the supervisor/ Court Manager.
jobs.enquiries: Technical: Ms K Marias Tel No: (031) 492 5502 HR related enquiries: Ms SZ Mvuyana Tel No: (031) 493 1723
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/135/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on       internet       at      www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA); Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Sekuriteitsbeampte
af.summary: Sekuriteitsbeampte benodig by die Durban High Court om toegangsbeheer- en sekuriteitsfunksies uit te voer.
af.requirements: 'n Aansoeker moet oor 'n graad 10 of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie beskik soos deur SAQA erken. Basiese Sekuriteitsbeampte-kursus, ten minste Graad C met 'n geldige PSIRA-sertifikaat. 'n Minimum van een (1) jaar ervaring in die sekuriteitsbedryf en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van die Wet op Toegang tot Openbare Persele en Voertuie en ander sekuriteitsverwante wetgewing, toegangsbeheerprosedures, beheer en beweging van toerusting en voorrade, voorgeskrewe sekuriteitsprosedures (bv. MIS, NISA, Wet op die Beskerming van Inligting, ens.) en die gesag van sekuriteitsbeamptes ingevolge hierdie dokumente. Kennis van die tersaaklike noodprosedures en Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardig in interpersoonlike vaardighede, kliëntediens, luistervaardighede, probleemoplossing, besluitneming, kommunikasie, rekenaar en fasilitering.
af.duties: Voer toegangsbeheerfunksies uit, bepaal of besoekers afsprake het/of die diens wat die besoeker benodig, kontak die betrokke werknemers om die afspraak te bevestig of verwys die besoeker na die betrokke dienslewering punt, verseker dat die toelatingsbeheerregister voltooi is en reik toelatingsbeheerdokumente/kaarte uit soos vereis, gebruik 'n deurloop-metaalopspoorder vir die doeltreffendheid van toegangsbeheer, verseker dat ongemagtigde persone en gevaarlike voorwerpe nie die gebou/perseel binnegaan nie, rapporteer al die geïdentifiseerde sekuriteitskendinge en nie-nakoming aan die toesighouer, verseker dat toerusting, dokumente en voorrade nie ongemagtig die gebou of perseel verlaat of binnegaan nie, verseker dat die registers wat die beweging van toerusting, voorrade en dokumente beheer, voltooi is, verseker dat geen toerusting, voorrade as bates van die departement die gebou/perseel ongemagtig verlaat nie. Inspekteer voertuie wat die perseel binnegaan en verlaat, versamel inligting en rapporteer oor vermiste en gesteelde toerusting en voorrade, hanteer dokumente by toegangspunte volgens klassifikasie en die voorskrifte, bedien sekuriteitstoerusting in die kontrolekamer, monitor alle bewegings, gebeure en aktiwiteite binne die departement se perseel met behulp van CCTV-toerusting, verseker dat die sekuriteitsstelsel in 'n goeie werkende toestand is, rapporteer alle voorvalle wat gemonitor is, rapporteer aan die toesighouer, monitor alle toegangspunte vir doeltreffende toegangsbeheer, rapporteer alle geïdentifiseerde nie-nakoming van sekuriteitsbeleid en prosedures om kantoorsekuriteit te verbeter, verseker veiligheid in die gebou en perseel, onderneem gebou-/en perseelpatrolies om te identifiseer en na te gaan, pas noodprosedures toe (in situasies soos bomdreigemente, onluste ens.) en waarsk nooddienste en departementbestuur, monitor en reageer op alarmsisteme. Verseker dat alle voorvalle in die voorkomsboeke/registers aangeteken word, verseker dat aangetekende inligting korrek is, werk die inligting in die voorkomsboek/register op soos en wanneer vereis, skakel met die toesighouer om aangetekende inligting te verifieer en voer enige ander pligte uit wat deur die toesighouer/Hofbestuurder aan u opgedra word.

zu.title: Iphasela Elokuphepha
zu.summary: Kudingeka iphasela lokuphepha e-Durban High Court ukwenza imisebenzi yokulawula ukungena nemiqondo yokuphepha.
zu.requirements: Umuntu ofaka isicelo kumele abe ne-grade 10 noma iziqu ezilinganayo njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. Ikhosi esisisekelo ye-Security Officer, okungenani i-Grade C ngesitifiketi se-PSIRA esikhathi somthetho. Okungenani aminyaka yoku- (1) yamava enkampanini yokuphepha kanye nesithupha sokushayela esikhathi somthetho kuzoba ngusizo olwengeziwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-Access to Public Premises and Vehicle Act neminye imithetho yokuphepha, izaru zokulawula ukungena, ukulawula futhi kuhambise amafoni wokusesha, izaru zokuphepha ezilandelwayo (isb. MIS, NISA, Protection of Information Act, njll.) namandla amaphasela lokuphepha ngaphansi kwale mibhalo. Ulwazi ngemiyalo yokuphela emezweni ne-Batho Pele Principles. Ukwazi ukuxhumana nabantu, ukukhonza izikhasi, ukuzwa, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukwenza izinqumo, ukucwazimula, ikhompyutha nokubekezelela.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula ukungena, qinisekisa ukuthi abavakashi beminwe noma badinga iyiphi inkonzo, xhumana nemikhuluwa abahambisayo ukuze uqinisekise umnqamulugo noma uholele umvakashi endaweni ekhokha inkonzo, qinisekisa ukuthi i-register yokulawula ukungena igcwalisiwe uphinde unikeze amafomu/amakhadi okulawula ukungena njengokuvela, sebenzisa i-walk-through metal detector ukwenza ukulawula ukungena kube nomphumela, qinisekisa ukuthi abantu abangavunyelwe noma izinto ezibucayi zingangeni esakhiweni/endlalweni, inkcazela yonke imikhawulo yokuphepha ekhishiwe nokungahambisani nomthetho kumkhuluwa, qinisekisa ukuthi izinto, amafomu namafoni awakushiya noma awangeni esakhiweni noma endlalweni bengavunyelwe, qinisekisa ukuthi i-registers elawula inhambakuko yamafoni, izinto nokusetshenziswa kugcwalisiwe, qinisekisa ukuthi ayikho imishini namafana njengefa le-Department esakhiweni/endlalweni bengavunyelwe. Hlola izimoto zingena futhi zishiya indawo, qoqa ulwazi uphinde unikeze inkcazela ngemishini namafana esihlukile nezibe futhi ezibekiwe, khathuna amafathi ngokudlula noma ukuphela ngokwesigaba nemithetho, sebenzisa imishini yokuphepha kwikhaphethi yokulawula, qwashisa wonke ukunyakaza, izenzakalo, namathuba o-Department ngokusuka ikhamera eqandisize, qinisekisa ukuthi isiqufe sokuphepha sisebenzela kahle, inkcazela wonke emikhawu eqashiswe, inkcazela kumkhuluwa, qwashisa zinkamelo zokudlula ukulawula ngendlela eziphumelelayo, inkcazela ukungahambisani kwesinika sokuphepha nezinkamelo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphepha kohhovisi, qinisekisa ukuphepha kwesakhiwo nendlalo, yenza amaphathi e-sakhiwo / nendlalo ukuze kubone kuqhathaniswe, sebenzisa imithetho yokuphela emezweni (njengezimo ezinjengokwesaba ibhamu, ukushabisa, njll.) futhi uxhume i-emergency services kanye nezinkulu za-Department, qwashisa uphinde uphendule i-alarm system. Qinisekisa ukuthi konke okushiwo kugcinwe kwi-occurrence books/registers, qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi olushiwo luyiqiniso, buyekeza ulwazi kwi-occurrence book/register noma kunini uma kudingeka, xhumana nomkhuluwa ukuze uqinisekise ulwazi olushiwo futhi wenze noma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi ekunikiwe ngumkhuluwa/Court Manager.

xh.title: Mqobo woKhuseleko
xh.summary: Kufuneka umqobo wokhuseleko eNkantlo Ephakamileyo yaseDurban ukuqhuba imisebenzi yolawulo lokungena nokhuseleko.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka umfaki-isicelo abe negrede 10 okanye isidanga esilinganayo njengoko sitthaganyelwa yi-SAQA. Ikhosi yomqobo wokhuseleko, okungenani igrede C enesatifikethi se-PSIRA esisebenzayo. Ubuncinane bonyaka omnye (1) wamava kwishishini lokhuseleko nelayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo kuya kuba luncedo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngomthetho wokuNgena kwindawo zaBantu nokuya ngeMoto namanye amathetho ahlobene nokhuseleko, iinkqubo zolawulo lokungena, ulawulo nantshukumo yezixhobo nezinto ezifihliweyo, iinkqubo zokhuseleko ezithathiweyo (umz. MIS, NISA, umthetho woKukhusela uLwazi, njl.) namagunya abaqobo bokhuseleko ngaphansi kwala maxwebhu. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo ezifanelekileyo zeziginqgithi namaQiniso akaBatho Pele. Unamakhono obudlelwane nabantu, inkonzo yabathengi, ukunxibelela kakuhle ngokumamela, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukuthatha izigqibo, unxibelelwano, ikhompyutha nokukhokela.
xh.duties: Qhuba imisebenzi yolawulo lokungena, tsho ukuba ngabashwankatheli babe negqitho lokubonana/nokuba bakufuna ntoni na inkonzo, tsha abasebenzi abafanelekileyo ukuqinisekisa igqitho okanye wathumele umshwankatheli kwicala elifanelekileyo lenkonzo, qinisekisa ukuba incwadi yokulawula okungeni igqityiwe yonke kwaye uphe iifomu/amakhadi okuvumela ukungena njengoko kufuneka, sebenzisa isixhobo sokutyhola intsimbi esihamba kuso umntu ukuze kube luncedo kulawulo lokungena, qinisekisa ukuba abantu abangemthethweni nemitsho engalunganga engangenisi esakhiweni/endlwini, cxela bonke ukwaphula amalungiselelo okhuseleko nokungahambelani nomthetho kumlawuli, qinisekisa ukuba izixhobo, amaxwebhu nezinto ezifihliweyo azishiya kwaye azingenisi esakhiweni okanye endlwini ngaphandle kwemvume, qinisekisa ukuba iincwadi ezilawula intshukumo yezixhobo, izinto ezifihliweyo namaxwebhu zigqityiwe, qinisekisa ukuba akukho zixhobo, izinto ezifihliweyo njengempahla yesebe ezishiya esakhiweni/endlwini ngaphandle kwemvume. Khangele iimoto ezingenayo naphuma endlwini, qokelela ulwazi icele ngemisho izixhobo nezinto ezifihliweko ezilahlekileyo nabezinyathelwa, phatha amaxwebhu kumda wokungena ngokwemigqatho nemimiselo, qhuba izixhobo zokhuseleko kwigumbi lolawulo, luluze bonke ukushukuma, iiganeko nemisebenzi endlwini yesebe usebenzisa izixhobo ze-CCTV, qinisekisa ukuba inkqubo yokhuseleko isebenza kakuhle, xela bonke iiganeko eziluziweyo, xela kumlawuli, luluze onke amacala okungena ukuze kulawulwe ngokusebenzayo ukungena, xela konke ukungahambelani namapolisi nokuhamba kwemigaqo yokhuseleko ukuze kuphuculwe ukhuseleko kwofisi, qinisekisa ukhuseleko esakhiweni nendlwini, yenze ukuqhuba amajola esakhiweni/endlwini ukuze abone ahlole, sebenzisa iinkqubo zeziginqgithi (kwiimeko ezinjengokoyika iibhomu, iintlanga njl.njl.) yenze isazise iinkonzo zeziginqgithi nolawulo lwebhloko, luluze uphendule kwindlebe yolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iiganeko zibhalwe kwiincwadi/abalawuli bezenzakalo, qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi olubhaliweyo luyinyani, hlaziya ulwazi kwiincwadi/abasebenzi bezenzakalo njengoko kufuneka, ixhumane nomlawuli ukuqinisekisa ulwazi olubhaliweyo kwenze nalo naliphi na iqhinga elikunikiwe yimlawuli/Mlawuli weNkantlo.

jobs.title: Internship Programme: Strategy and Service Delivery
jobs.department: Graduate Internship Programme for 01 April 2027 to 31 March 2029 (24 Months)
jobs.summary: 24-month internship in strategy and service delivery at the National Office, requiring a National Diploma in Public Administration or related field.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 certificate and a three-year National Diploma in Public Administration / Developmental Studies / Social Science at NQF level 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA or relevant equivalent qualification at NQF level 6 with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA.
jobs.enquiries: Technical enquiries: Ms P Mahlangu Tel No: (010) 493 2501 HR related enquiries: Mr JM Kgosiemang Tel No: (010) 493 2689
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/SSD07/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new Z83 application form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies/www.judiciary.org.za. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. The completed and signed form should be accompanied by a recently updated CV. Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of: Matric certificate, academic transcripts (qualification/s with 360/480 credits as recognised by SAQA and academic record) and ID). All shortlisted candidates shall undertake a pre-entry practical exercise as part of the assessment method to determine the candidate's suitability based on the post's technical and generic requirements. Candidates wishing to apply for an internship outside their area of residence must be willing to find their own accommodation and transportation considering that they will be earning a stipend. Failure to submit the requested documents/information will result in your application not being considered. Applicants will be expected to be available for assessments and selection interviews at a time, date and place as determined by the Department. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) and National Diploma should be NQF Level 6 (with 360 credits as recognised by SAQA). All appointments for internship are subject to the verification and pre-screening process. The OCJ reserves the right not to make an appointment. Correspondence will be entered into with shortlisted candidates only. Please direct your application to the relevant province and complete a separate application for each reference number. jobs.centre: Specialised Operations: National Intervention Unit Operations: Maupa Naga, Sunnyside, Pretoria
jobs.summary: Supervise administration and management information services for the SAPS National Intervention Unit in Pretoria at salary level 7.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must display competency in the core functions of the post. Be proficient in at least English and one other official language. Be a citizen of the Republic of South Africa of which documentary proof must be furnished on the day of the interview. Be in possession of Grade 12/ Senior Certificate/ NCV Level 4 or equivalent qualification (NQF Level 4 as recognised by SAQA). At least four (4) years’ experience in the field of the post. An applicable three (3) year Diploma / Degree (NQF level 6 or higher as recognised by SAQA) as well as relevant training courses in the field of the post will serve as an added advantage. A valid driver’s license for at least a light motor vehicle will serve as an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Knowledge of relevant prescripts applicable to the Public Service. Good verbal and written communication skills. General Computer literacy (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint, MS Outlook). Demonstrate competency in acting independently, professionally, accountable, and with Credibility. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Report writing. Presentation Skills, Problem Solving, Sound Planning, Organising and Administration skills, Strong Analytical Skills and Facilitation Skills. Be willing to work under pressure and extended hours.
jobs.duties: Render an effective and efficient management information service to the Section Head Prepare presentation for internal utilisation on request of the Section Head. Maintain of database a database containing specific information as requested by the Section Head. Render basic administration duties for the Section: NIU Operations and Support. Manage Iris system relevant to NIU Units. Conduct Monitoring and Evaluations at various Units within the Section. Attend to Auditor General (AG) related matters regarding the national performance indicators.
jobs.enquiries: Lieutenant Colonel Mashau or Captain Modiba Tel No: (012) 400 87/3802/3761/3798
jobs.applications: Direct your application to the following addresses: No. 629 Lavender Road, Bon Accord: Email to: LekalakalaJM@saps.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on a Z83 Form (2021 version), obtainable from http://www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp, which must be accompanied with a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. The post particulars and reference number of the post you are applying for, must be correctly specified on the application form. Please complete a separate application form for each post you wish to apply for. It is the responsibility of the applicants to submit applications timeously to the correct physical address as provided in the advertisement. Please note that applications submitted to an incorrect physical address will not be considered. Late applications will not be accepted or considered. Short-listed candidates will be required to produce originals of their Identity Document (ID), Senior Certificate and all educational qualifications obtained, service certificates from previous employers stating the occupation and motor vehicle driver’s license, before the interview. Qualifications and driver’s licences submitted will be subjected to verification with the relevant institutions. Applicants must have no previous criminal convictions or pending criminal/ departmental cases and shall allow their fingerprints to be taken and background enquiries to be made. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a full security clearance process before or during any stage of employment. Short-listed candidates will be subjected to a vetting process which will include security screening, fingerprint screening, reference checking and verification of address, where necessary. All short-listed candidates, including the SMS, will be expected to undergo a personal interview and shall undertake two pre-entry assessments, (a) a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements, as well as (b) an integrity assessment (ethical conduct). Short-listed candidates for appointments to certain identified posts will be vetted in terms of the Criminal Law (Sexual Offences and Related Matters) Amendment Act, 2007 (Act No 32 of 2007) and the Children’s Act, 2005 (Act No 38 of 2005). A candidate whose particulars appear in either the National Register for Sex Offenders or Part B of the Child Protection Register, will be disqualified from appointment. Candidates are expected to disclose if he/ she is a respondent in an interim or final protection order in terms of the Domestic Violence Act, 1998 (Act no 116 of 1998) or Protection from Harassment Act, 2011 (Act No 17 of 2011), and may be disqualified from appointment. The Criminal Law (Forensic Procedures) Amendment Act, Act 37 of 2013 requires that all new appointments in the South African Police Service as from 31 January 2015 provide a buccal (inside cheek) sample to determine their forensic DNA profile. The forensic DNA profile derived from the sample will be loaded to the Elimination Index of the National Forensic DNA Database. Appointments will be made in terms of the Public Service Act, 1994 (Act No 103 of 1994) as applicable to the post environment. Persons who retired from the Public Service by taking a severance package, early retirement or medical retirement, as well as persons with previous convictions, are excluded. The South African Police Service is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and it is the intention to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of these posts. Persons whose transfer/ appointment will promote representivity will therefore receive preference. The South African Police Service is under no obligation to fill a post after the advertisement thereof. Correspondence will be conducted with successful candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Applicants who previously applied for this post are encouraged to re-apply. OTHER POST

af.title: MIC-ondersteunings: Administratiewe klerk toesighouer
af.summary: Hou toesig oor administrasie en bestuursinligtingsdienste vir die SAPS Nasionale Intervensie-eenheid in Pretoria op salarisvlak 7.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet bevoegdheid toon in die kernfunksies van die pos. Wees vaardig in ten minste Engels en een ander amptelike taal. Wees 'n burger van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika waarvan dokumentêre bewys op die dag van die onderhoud verskaf moet word. Wees in besit van Graad 12/ Senior Sertifikaat/ NCV Vlak 4 of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie (NQF Vlak 4 soos deur SAQA erken). Ten minste vier (4) jaar se ondervinding in die veld van die pos. 'n Toepaslike drie (3) jaar Diploma / Graad (NQF vlak 6 of hoër soos deur SAQA erken) asook relevante opleidingskursusse in die veld van die pos sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie vir ten minste 'n ligte motorvoertuig sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kennis van relevante voorskrifte van toepassing op die Openbare Diens. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Algemene rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Office, MS PowerPoint, MS Outlook). Toon bevoegdheid om onafhanklik, professioneel, verantwoordelik en met Geloofwaardigheid op te tree. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Ster interpersoonlike vaardighede. Verslagskrywing. Aanbiedingsvaardighede, probleemoplossing, deeglike beplanning, organisering en administratiewe vaardighede, sterk analitiese vaardighede en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Wees gewillig om onder druk en verlengde ure te werk.
af.duties: Lewer 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe bestuursinligtingsdiens aan die Afdelinghoof Berei aanbiedings voor vir interne benutting op versoek van die Afdelinghoef. jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating the Gender and Diversity policy implementation in the Department; Developing and compiling mandatory Gender Equality and Women’s Empowerment plans and reports in alignment with relevant frameworks; Developing and compiling mandatory diversity management plans and reports in alignment with relevant frameworks; Attending National Machinery meetings and related to coordinating forums as required; Developing presentations for the machinery and related coordinating forums; Ensuring the provision of all logistical and secretariat services to the Departmental Gender and Diversity Forums and related meetings; Ensuring that the Discussion and Action Register for the forum and related meetings are updated; Coordinating Gender Equality and Women’s Empowerment advocacy and mainstreaming programmes; Planning and coordinating gender-focused information sessions to address key workplace issues affecting women and men, including harassment; Coordinating awareness sessions to support the effective implementation of the Gender Policy; Coordinating gender mainstreaming capacity-building initiatives; Coordinating outreach initiatives to support gender equality; Monitoring and supporting the successful implementation of planned activities of the Women’s and Men’s Fora; Coordinating Diversity and Inclusion advocacy and mainstreaming programmes; Planning and coordinating sensitisation sessions to address key workplace issues affecting persons with disabilities; Coordinating awareness sessions to support the effective implementation of the Disability Management Policy; Coordinating and supporting disability management capacity- building initiatives, including training in South Africa Sign Language (SASL); Coordinating and supporting outreach initiatives to promote diversity and inclusion; Coordinating and monitoring the onboarding process of new employees with disabilities; Providing technical assistance and guidance on reasonable accommodation and assistive devices in line with relevant policy directives and standard operating procedures; Ensuring that the register of reasonable accommodation measures and assistive devices, including their maintenance plans and records is updated regularly; Coordinating Special Projects on Gender and Diversity Inclusion in line with the National Calendar; Developing concept documents for special projects in alignment with national calendar days and months; Coordinating and supporting the implementation of approved concept documents; Monitoring and evaluating special projects and compile close-up reports. Attending National Coordinating Meetings as required.

jobs.notes: EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a Z83 form and CV only. jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: State-owned Companies (SOC),
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 – R2 124 237 per annum (Level 15) of which 30% may be structured according to the individual’s needs.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director-general overseeing state-owned companies in the Transport complex, directing SOC policy framework development and implementation in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 8 as recognised by SAQA in Transport Economics / Finance / Accounting / Auditing / Law / Risk Management / Economics / Business Management / Administration / Public Management with at least 8 years’ experience at a senior management level in an oversight of State- Owned Companies or Public Entities. Certificate of successful completion of the National School of Government’s Senior Management Service Pre-Entry Programme. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of legislative and policy prescripts relevant to the Department and its SOEs. Sound Knowledge of corporate governance as it applies to the public and private sector, as well as Company law. Knowledge and understanding of Enterprise Risk Management Concepts, Framework and methodologies. Knowledge in Company Law, King IV and Ethics. Knowledge of the Public services Anti-Corruption Strategy and measures. Knowledge and understanding of monitoring the performance of public entities. Knowledge of National Treasury Risk Management Framework. Knowledge of the financial and non-financial report writing. Knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Knowledge of shareholder compact development, monitoring and evaluation. Knowledge of board governance, board charters, board committees and board performance processes.
jobs.duties: Direct the development and facilitate the implementation of government's overarching SOC Policy Framework for the Transport complex. Direct and initiate research projects to define the policy “gaps” affecting the optimal functioning of SOCs in the Transport Complex. Collaborate with SOCs, industry and research institutions in developing bridging strategies to enhance the operations of the SOCs in the complex. Lead consultation processes for the adoption of bridging strategies and policy instruments. Lead initiatives to facilitate alignment of the policy at a technical level and regulatory regime falling outside the mandate of the department.
