zu.title: Siza-kaMqondisi-Jikijela: State-owned Companies (SOC),
zu.summary: Umqondisi-Jikijela Ohlangothi abheke izinhlangano ezizimele zorhwebo ku-Transport complex, eqondisa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuphathwa kohlaka lwe-SOC policy framework ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo: Isiqu esisingeni se-NQF level 8 esivunyelwe yi-SAQA kwe-Transport Economics / Finance / Accounting / Auditing / Law / Risk Management / Economics / Business Management / Administration / Public Management okuhambisana neminyaka engu-8 yokuhlola ezingeni lomphathi ophakeme ekubhekeni izinhlangano ezizimele zorhwebo noma izikhungo zomphakathi. Isitifiketi sokuphothula ngaphumelelo i-National School of Government Senior Management Service Pre-Entry Programme. Ulwazi kanye namakhono: Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye namaphilisi ahambisana nomnyango kanye ne-SOE. Ulwazi oluhle ngombuso webhodi njengoba lusetshenziswa esikhundleni somphakathi kanye nesikhundleni sangasese, kanye noMthetho Wezinkampani. Ulwazi kanye nekuqonda izimiso zokuLawula Ubungozi Bezinkampani, uhlaka kanye nezindlela zokwenza. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wezinkampani, i-King IV kanye Nezimilo. Ulwazi ngoMkhuba Wokulwa Nokuqamba Kwamaphoyisa Abasebenzi Komphakathi kanye nezinyathelo. Ulwazi kanye nekuqonda ukubheka imiphumela yezinkampani zomphakathi. Ulwazi lwe-National Treasury Risk Management Framework. Ulwazi mayelana nokubhala imibiko yezimali kanye nengemali. Ulwazi lwe-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Ulwazi ngokuthuthukiswa, ukubheka kanye nokuhlola izivumelwano zamabanikazi. Ulwazi ngombuso webhodi, izibhalo zebhodi, amakomidi ebhodi kanye nokuqhuba inqubo yemiphumela yebhodi.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukuthuthukiswa kwephilisi futhi usize ukuphathwa kohlaka lwe-SOC Policy Framework kahulumeni ohlele i-Transport complex. Qondisa futhi uqale amaphrojekthi ocwaningo ukuze achaze izikhala ezingaphakathi ezithinta ukusebenza okuhle kwezinhlangano ezizimele zorhwebo (SOC) ku-Transport Complex. Sebenzisana ne-SOC, imboni kanye nezikhungo zocwaningo ekuthuthukiseni izindlela ezixhumanisayo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwe-SOC kulesi sinqema. Bumba inqubo yezingxoxo ukuze kuthathwe izindlela ezixhumanisayo kanye namathuluzi amaphilisi. Bumba izinhlelo zokwenza kube khona ukuhambisana kophilisi kwazinga lobuchwepheshe kanye nomthetho osele ngaphandle komsebenzi onikwe umnyango. Qondisa futhi uphathe izinqobo ukuze kuxhaswe ukuhambisana kwezivumelwano zezenhlalo (Shareholder Compacts) ze-SOC ku-Transport complex. Hlanganisa izincomo ezithathwa ngamathimu ahlukene abachwepheshe kuleso sikhundla sokuhamba ukuze kutholakale izidingo zokuqondanisa izivumelwano kwe-SOC kuleso sinqema. Bumba futhi uhlanganise ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkomba zeNtshaliwe-Mali ezibekelwa Ngqongqoshe neKhabhineti mayelana nezidingo eziyisisekelo zokuqondanisa. Bumba esazingeni lobuchwepheshe ukuxoxisana nabaphathi be-SOC kulesi Sinqema ukuze kuxazulule izinkinga zokuqondanisa. Thuthukisa amadokhumenti we-Compact ukuze asayine ngokusesikweni iNgqongqoshe kanye neBhodi le-SOC elihambisana naleso. Bheka, hlola futhi ubike ngemiphumela ye-compact eqondaniswe. Qondisa ukubuyekeza futhi uqondanise izivumelwano zezenhlalo, izinhlelo zomuntu ongunaphakade, izinhlelo eziyisinyezelo kanye nezinhlelo zomsebenzi wonyaka ze-SOC sokuhamba. Qinisekisa ukuthi ihanga lokuvumelana nzenhlalo lilinganiseka, lifanele, luhambisana nomthetho futhi lihambisana nezinto eziyisiphithiphithi kahulumeni. Bheka ukuphathwa kwezibambelo ezivumelanwe kuzo futhi uncome izinyathelo zokulunga lapho kuvela izikhala ekusebenzeni. Nikeza iseluleko sobuchwepheshe kuNgqongqoshe noMqondisi-Jikijela mayelana nezinkulumisano kanye nezivumelwano zezenhlalo. Qondisa futhi uphathe ukuqalwa kwamaphrojekthi ocwaningo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kwebhizinisi kanye nemiphumela ye-SOC ku-Transport complex. Qondisa futhi uhlanganise ukuqaliswa kanye nekuhlelwa kwamaphrojekthi ocwaningo abachwepheshe ukuze kumodelwe imibono yokuthuthukisa ibhizinisi ngesikhashana, phakathi nesesikhathi eside ku-Transport complex. Hlanganisa futhi ubheke ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuphathwa kohlaka lwemithetho yamabhizinisi okuthuthukiswa kanye namathuluzi okuthuthukisa ibhizinisi ku-Transport complex. Sula amathimu amaningi abachwepheshe ukuze enze ucwaningo lokulinganisa ukuzinza kwamamodeli okuthuthukisa ibhizinisi. Bumba esazingeni lobuchwepheshe inqubo yokuxoxa ukuze kuthathwe amamodeli okuthuthukiswa abonwe ngamalungualesinqema. Bumba futhi uhlanganise ukuthuthukiswa kwezinkomba zeNtshaliwe-Mali ezibekelwa iNgqongqoshe ngeKhabhineti ngomphumela wokusetshenziswa kwamamodeli okuthuthukiswa ukuze kuvunyelwe. Bumba esazingeni lobuchwepheshe inqobo yokuthola izinto zokuxhasa imali ukuze kusetshenziswe amamodeli okuthuthukiswa avunyelwe. Bheka, hlola futhi ubike ngemiphumela evela ekusetshenzisweni kwamamodeli okuthuthukisa ibhizinisi avunyelwe. Xoxa nabezimali namagunya emithetho esazingeni lobuchwepheshe ukuze kuncishwe ubungozi kulawulo olungaba nomthelela ekusebenziseni amamodeli okuthuthukisa ibhizinisi. Thuthukisa futhi ugcine ubudlelwano obuyisinyezelo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ithuba lebhizinisi kanye nentuthuko yezakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo, okuphumelelayo futhi okugcina imali kwemithombo enikelwe amaphrojekthiokuqinisekisa umbuso we-SOC. Qinisekisa ukusungulwa kanye nokugcinwa kwezinto zokuqondisa iphrojekthi. Phendula ngokusetshenziswa kwemithobo enikelwe amaphrojekthiokuqinisekisa izimali. Bumba ukusetshenziswa okuphumelelayo kwemithombo ukuze kuxhaswe ukulethwa kwezinto eziyisiphithiphithi zokuqinisekisa umbuso kuso sonke i-SOC sokuhamba. Nikeza ukubheka ngokubanzi mayelana nobuso bebhodi, izibhalo zebhodi, izakhiwo zombuso kanye nethemba labanikazi. Bheka ukuphathwa kwezinzalanhlela ze-King IV kuso sonke i-SOC sokuhamba. Nikeza izeluleko ngokuhluleka kwombuso, izinkinga zokusebenza kwebhodi, ukungahambisani nezinkoleko kanye nobungozi bemfanelo. Bumba ukwenza kube lula ukumiswa kwebhodi, izinqubo zokuqonda ukusebenza kwebhodi kanye nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa umbuso. Phatha iNhlalo Yokubheka Imiphumela Yezimali Nakunye. Nikeza ukubheka ngokobuchwepheshe amafomula wezimali, izibalo, ukugeleza kwemali kanye nezidingo zokuxhasa i-SOC. Phatha ukuzinza kwemali, ubungozi bombuso, imiphumela yokuletha izinsiza ze-SOC kanye nezinkinga eziyaqhubeka zibungaza. Bheka imiphumela engemali uma iqhathaniswa nehanga le-APP. Bheka izinhlela zokuphendula, amamodeli okuthuthukisa ibhizinisi kanye nezinkulumo zokulungisa. Nikeza izincomo eziyisinyezelo ezisekelwe ubufakazi kuGunya Lesikhungo. Bheka ukulandelwa kwemiphumela yokuhlola, izinhlelo zomsebenzi wokuhlola kanye nezinhlavanya ze-AGSA ezithinta i-SOC sokuhamba. Phatha ukuhlola imiphumela yokuhlola, izinhlelo zomsebenzi wokuhlola kanye nezinyathelo zokulungisa. Nikeza isiqondiso esiyisinyezelo ekubhekeni kanye nokuhlola imibiko yemiphumela yamakota kanyaneyonyaka ethunyelwe izikhungo zomphakathi zobuhamba. Phatha ukuhlaziya imigqa yemiphumela yezimali nengemali futhi uphawule ubungozi obuwisayo umbuso, ukusebenza nakuletha izinto. Hlanganisa izinkulumisano zokubuyekeza imiphumela neBhodi le-SOC kanye nabaphathi. Phatha imithombo yeNhlela; Nikeza isiqondiso futhi uxhaso olwanele kanye nentuthuko yabasebenzi; Vumela izinkohliso; Phatha imibuzo yokuhlola; Bheka ukulawula izinga lomsebenzi.

xh.title: UMlawuli-Jikelele oPhethe: Iishishini eziSebenzela kuRhulumente (SOC),
xh.summary: UMlawuli-Jikelele oPhethe ojonga iishishini ezisebenzela kurhulumente kwinkqubo yoThutha, elawula uphuhliso nokusebenza kwemigaqo ye-SOC ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso kumgangatho weNQF 8 njengoko samkelwa yiSAQA kwiTranshubhu yoqoqosho / Imali / ukuTshaya iDatha / ukuVavanya / uMthetho / uLawulo lweengozi / uQoqosho / uLawulo boShishino / uLawulo / uLawulo luka Rhulumente ngokuphawulekayo kwiminyaka eliphela kumgangatho wolawulo ophakamileyo ekujolweni kolawulo lweeShishino eziSebenzela kuRhulumente okwaRhulumente kwisiXeko. Isatifikedi yesiphelo esiphumeleleyo seNkqubo yoRhulumento yoMgangatho weNkqubo kaBaphathi iKhaya leSizwe. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemigaqo yomthetho namacebo ahambelana neSebe nee-SOC zalo. Ulwazi olululo ngolawulo boshi woRhulumente noxhaso olusebenza kwicandelo likarhulumente nolusebenzelayo, kanjalo noMthetho weShishini. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinjongo zoLawulo lweengozi zoShishino, iNkqubo yayo neendlela ezisetyenziswa. Ulwazi kuMthetho weShishino, iV yoMthetho ka Bhele kunye neNtshiso. Ulwazi nokuqonda iNkqubo yoRhulumente iQhinga lokuchasa iNkohlakalo namacebo ayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulilopa ukusebenza kwekhalo zorhulumente. Ulwazi lweNkqubo yoLawulo lweengozi zeNgena yeMali. Ulwazi ngokubhala iingxelo zemali ezingengelongemali. Ulwazi loMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente (iPFMA). Ulwazi ngokuphuhlisa, ukulilopa nokuhamba kweziVumelwano zaBani-beZabelo. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwebhodi, izibhalo zebhodi, amaKomiti ebhodi neenkqubo zokusebenza kwamaBhodi.
xh.duties: Qondisa uphuhliso uze ulawule ukusebenza kwemigaqo yokubambisa kwelilophu yeNkulumbuso ye-SOC kwinkqubo yokuThutha. Qondisa uze uqalise iiprojekthi zophando ukuqamba iingcapho zemigaqo ezichaphazela ukusebenza ngcono kwee-SOC kwinkqubo yeTranshubhu. Sebenzisana nee-SOC, shambling namabalana ephando ekubheni iindlela zokunxibelelanisa ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza kwee-SOC kule nkqubo. Bumba iinkqubo zokuxoxwa ngee-SOC ukuze zamkelwe iindlela zokunxibelelanisa namathuba emigaqo. Phatha iinkqubo zokubamba icala kumgangatho obuchwepheshe kunye namagunya wolawulo angaphandle kolawulo lalapho kubekwa khona isebe. Qondisa ulawule iinkqubo ukuze kulawulwe ulungelelwaniso lweziVumelwano zaBani-beZabelo kwi-SOC kwinkqubo yokuThutha. Lawula iingeniselo zeethim zabal specialist kwicandelo loThutha ukuze kuchazwe iimfuno zolungelelwaniso lweziVumelwano kwi-SOC kule nkqubo. Phatha ekubeni kumgangatho wobuchwepheshe unxibelelwano nabanini bakhulu be-SOC kule nkqubo ukusombulula iingxaki zolungelelwaniso. Bhala amaxwebhu eVumelwano ukuze atyikitywe ngokusesikweni nguNgangezulu nabeBango be-SOC. Lilopa, hatyholisisa iveza ngesiphithiphithi esenziwa ziVumelwano ezilungelelwanisiweyo. Qondisa ukuphononongwa nokulungelelwaniswa kweziVumelwano zaBani-beZabelo, iindlela zoshishino, iindlela ezibalulekileyo namacebo abo mbutho weenkonzo zonyaka ee-SOC zokuThutha. Qinisekisa ukuba iinjongo zeziVumelwano zaBani-beZabelo ziyalengwa, ziyinyani, zihambelana nomthetho nolungelelwaniswa neenjongo zikarhulumente. Lilopa ukuphunywa kweenkqubo zeziVumelwano zaBani-beZabelo uze ucebisise ngokulungiswa apho kuvela khona iingcapho ekuveliseni. Zeza isalathiso sobuchwepheshe kuNgangezulu noMlawuli-Jikelele malunga nezigqibo zeziVumelwano zaBani-beZabelo namagunya azo. Qondisa ulawule ukuqalwa kweeprojekthi zophando ukuze kuphuculwe ukusebenza nosimo bokushishina be-SOC kwinkqubo yokuThutha. Qondisa ulawule ukuqaliswa kunye nokuhlawulwa kweeprojekthi zophando zabaspecialist ukuyila amathuba okuphucula ushishino kwexesha elifutshane, eliphakathi nade mkhulu kwinkqubo yokuThutha. Lawula uze ulawule uphuhliso nokusebenza kweendlela namathuba okuphucula ushishino kwinkqubo yokuThutha. Misela iithim zabal specialist ezininzi iindidi ukuze zenze izivivinyo zokulunga nokomelela kweendlela zokuphucula ushishino. Phatha kumgangatho wobuchwepheshe inkqubo yokuxoxa ukuze zithathwe iindlwana eziyilelweyo ukuphucula ushishino ngamalungu ale nkqubo. Phatha ukubumba iingxelo zamathuba kuNgangezulu nakwiKhabhinathi malunga nokusebenza kweendlela zokuphucula ushishino nengunya. Phatha kumgangatho wobuchwepheshe inkqubo yokufumana izixhobo zexabiso lemali malunga nokuphunywa kweendlela ezithathiweyo zokuphucula ushishino. Lilopa, hatyholisisa iveza ngesiphithiphithi esenziwa ngokusebenza kweendlela ezivunyiweyo zokuphucula ushishino. Nxibelela neendawo zemigaqo nolawulo kumgangatho wobuchwepheshe ukuze kuncitshiswe ingozi kwinkqubo yolawulo enomphumezo ovela ekusebenzeni kweendlela zokuphucula ushishino. Bamba uze ulondoloze u Manyano lwamasiko ukuphucula amathuba woshishino nokuphuhlisa iinfrastrukthru. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo, ngokuchanekileyo nangokugcinwa kwemali yamathuba anikiweyo iiprojekthi zokuqinisekisa ulawulo lwe-SOC. Qinisekisa ukumiswa nokulondolwa kwezixhobo zoLawulo lweP-rojekthi. Phendula ngemali evunyiweyo ukusetyenziswa kwamathuba abekiweyo kwiiprojekthi zokuqinisekisa ulawulo lwemali. Phatha ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo kwemali ukuxhasa ukufikelelwa kweenkqubo zokuqinisekisa ulawulo kuzo zonke i-SOC zokuThutha. Zeza ulawulo olusemgangathweni oluphezulu malunga nolawulo loBango, izibhalo zoBango, iinkqubo zolawulo nethemba labaBani-beZabelo. Lilopa ukusebenza kweemigaqo yoBukosi iV kuzo zonke i-SOC zokuThutha. Beka ngelithi ngeesilelo kulawulo, iingxaki zobungqondo beBango, iingxaki zentshisekelo namathuba okungathembeki. Phatha ukulungelelwanisa ukumiswa koBango, iinkqubo zokusebenza koBango namathuba okuphucula ulawulo. Lawula uLawulo oluPhakathi lokuHamba kwemali nangaphandle kweMali. Zeza ulawulo olusemgangathweni oluphezulu ngamaxwebhu eMali, amaxabiso, ukuhamba kwemali neemfuno zexabiso lemali kwi-SOC. Lawula ukomelela kwemali, iingozi zolawulo, ukusebenza ngokuhamba kwexesha nolawulo lwe-SOC nolungelelwanisa iingozi. Lilopa ukusebenza ngaphandle kwemali ngokuchasene nenjongo ze-APP. Qondisa iindlwana zokujika, iindlwana zokuphucula ushishino namacebo okulunga. Zeza izalathiso ezingundoqo ezisekelwe kwimiqondo kuBhowulu oNgunya. Qondisa ukulilopa kweziphumo zokuvavanya, amacebo okuYila-Gxalabagxalaba kwaye naye nabaBali base-AGSA abachaphazela i-SOC zokuThutha. Lawula ukuvavanywa kweziphumo zokuvavanya, amacebo okuYila-Gxalabagxalaba namacebo okulunga. Zeza isalathiso esibalulekileyo ngomthambo woLilopa nokusetyenziswa kweekhwarthi namaxwebho abo mbutho weenkonzo zonyaka ethunyelwa ziKhalo ezithulwa ngu Manyano wokuThutha. Lawula uChazo lwamathuba eMali angaphandle kwamathuba aMali aze achaze iingozi ezibalulekileyo zolawulo, ukusebenza nokuhamba. Lawula unxibelelwano lokubuyekeza ukusebenza namaBango be-SOC nabaBali bayo. Lawula amathuba eVumba; Zeza isikhokelo naxisixhaso esaneleyo nakuphuhliso lwabasebenzi; Vuma ukutshatyalala; Lawula iimbuzo yosoloko; Lilopa ulawulo lwoyilo lomsebenzi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Road Transport
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 - R2 124 237 per annum (Level 15) of which 30% may be structured according to the individual’s needs.
jobs.summary: Lead road transport infrastructure planning and development as a Deputy Director-General in Pretoria, requiring senior management experience in road infrastructure.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at (NQF 8) as recognised by SAQA in Civil Engineering / Construction Studies with at least 8 years’ relevant experience at a senior management level in the road infrastructure management and development field. Certificate of Successful completion of the National School of Government’s Senior Management Service Pre-Entry Programme. Knowledge and Skill: A sound knowledge and experience in the development of the road infrastructure standards and guidelines. Knowledge and understanding of the guidelines and specifications relevant to civil engineering in South Africa. Extensive knowledge and understanding of the road infrastructure development and roads supervision. Knowledge and understanding of the importance of community development programs and participation. Working knowledge of PFMA, MMFA, Treasury Regulations and GIAMA. Research and Policy experience. Procurement experience & Project Management. Compilation of management and technical reports and proposals. Budgeting, financial management and economic skills.
jobs.duties: Manage the coordination of the planning, development and implementation of a sustainable reliable integrated road infrastructure network. Manage the coordination of road infrastructure planning. Manage the development and implementation of rural roads development strategy and programme. Manage the development, implementation and promotion of the use of low-cost Non- Motorised Transport. Manage the road grants funding. Manage the development and implementation of road engineering standards. Manage the research, coordination of the development and updating of technical norms, standards & guidelines and the best practice. Manage and ensure survey quality control on road works. Manage the coordination of the development of an asset management system for road infrastructure in compliance with the GIAMA and related asset management requirements. Manage the regulation of road traffic environment. Manage the development of all road traffic acts and regulations (National Road Traffic Act, Administration Adjudication of Road Traffic Offences Act & Road Traffic Management Act). Ensure the application of enforcement regulations. Ensure the coordination of road safety projects and related activities. Manage the development of effective road transport policies and strategies. Manage the driving license card account and provide technical support to all Road Transport Entities. Ensure the development and implementation of effective policy on the management of funds. Manage the Driving License Card Trading Account income and expenditure. Ensures that all Road Transport Entities (SANRAL, RAF, RTMC RTIA and C-BRTA) receive technical assistance from the Branch. Manage the resources of the Branch. Provide guidance and adequate support for and development of the staff. Ensure compliance with all administrative requirements, regulations, rules and instructions pertaining to the branch. Establish and maintain governance and administrative system’s continuity within the work of the branch. Develop financial reports for forecasting, trending and results analysis. Prepare and submit implementation plans. Authorise expenditure. Manage audit queries. Recommend and / or monitor budget levels. Monitor quality control of work. Ensure the compilation of the annual report and strategic plan of the branch. Set budget levels. Monitor the planning, organising and delegation of work. Ensure monitoring & evaluation is carried out in all areas of the branch.
jobs.applications: Department of Transport, Private Bag X193, Pretoria, 0001 or hand deliver at the 159 Forum Building, Cnr Struben and Bosman Street, Pretoria for attention Recruitment Unit. Room 4034 or email to: Recruitment@dot.gov.za or at e- recruitment system: recruit.transport.gov.za. Note: email applications must be sent as one attachment to avoid non-delivery of the email and only quotes the name of the post you are applying for on the Subject Line as directed on the post note.
jobs.notes: Applications must be accompanied by a completed new Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department, (or obtainable at). Applicants must fill in full new Z83 form part A, B, C, and D. A recent updated comprehensive CV (previous experience must be comprehensively detailed, i.e. positions held and dates). Applicants will submit certified copies of all qualifications and ID document on the day of the interviews. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process; the logistics will be communicated to candidates prior to the interviews. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo Psychometric Assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Note that National School of Governance (NGS) has introduce compulsory SMS pre-entry certificate with effect from 01 April 2020 as Minimum Entry Requirements for Senior Management Services (submitted prior to appointment) and can be accessed through the following link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/.              The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. The successful candidate must disclose to the Director-General particulars of all registrable financial interests, sign a performance agreement and employment contract with the Director-General within three months from the date of assumption of duty. The successful candidate must be willing to sign an oath of secrecy with the Department. Applicants will be expected to be available for selection interviews and assessments at a time, date and place as determined by the Department. An offer letter will only be issued to the successful candidate once the following has been verified educational qualifications, previous experience, citizenship, reference checks and security vetting. Please note: Correspondence will only be entered into with short-listed candidates. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur-generaal: Padvervoer
af.summary: Lei beplanning en ontwikkeling van padvervoer-infrastruktuur as 'n Adjunkdirekteur-generaal in Pretoria, wat bestuurservaring op senior vlak in pad-infrastruktuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op (NQF 8) soos erken deur SAQA in Siviele Ingenieurswese / Konstruksiestudies met ten minste 8 jaar se relevante ervare op senior bestuursvlak in die veld van pad-infrastruktuurbestuur en -ontwikkeling. Sertifikaat van suksesvolle voltooiing van die National School of Government se Senior Management Service Pre-Entry Programme. Kennis en Vaardigheid: Soliede kennis en ervaring in die ontwikkeling van pad-infrastruktuurstandaarde en riglyne. Kennis en begrip van die riglyne en spesifikasies wat relevant is tot siviele ingenieurswese in Suid-Afrika. Uitgebreide kennis en begrip van pad-infrastruktuurontwikkeling en padtoesig. Kennis en begrip van die belang van gemeenskapsontwikkelingsprogramme en -deelname. Werkende kennis van PFMA, MMFA, Treasury Regulations en GIAMA. Navorsings- en beleidserfaring. Inkoopperfaring en projekbestuur. Opstel van bestuurs- en tegniese verslae en voorstelle. Begroting, finansiële bestuur en ekonomiese vaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die koördinering van die beplanning, ontwikkeling en implementering van 'n volhoubare betroubare geïntegreerde pad-infrastruktuurnetwerk. Bestuur die koördinering van pad-infrastruktuurbeplanning. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van die strategie en programme vir die ontwikkeling van landelike paaie. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, implementering en bevordering van die gebruik van lae-koste nie-gemotoriseerde vervoer. Bestuur die befondsing van padtoelaes. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van padingenieurswese-standaarde. Bestuur die navorsing, koördinering van die ontwikkeling en opdatering van tegniese norme, standaarde en riglyne en die beste praktyk. Bestuur en verseker opname-kwaliteitsbeheer op padwerke. Bestuur die koördinering van die ontwikkeling van 'n batebestuurstelsel vir pad-infrastruktuur in ooreenstemming met die GIAMA en verwante batebestuursvereistes. Bestuur die regulering van die padverkeersomgewing. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van alle padverkeerswette en -regulasies (National Road Traffic Act, Administration Adjudication of Road Traffic Offences Act en Road Traffic Management Act). Verseker die toepassing van handhawingsregulasies. Verseker die koördinering van padveiligheidsprojekte en verwante aktiwiteite. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van effektiewe padvervoerbeleid en -strategieë. Bestuur die bestuur van die bestuursrekening vir bestuurslisensiekaarte en verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan alle Padvervoer-entiteite. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van effektiewe beleid oor die bestuur van fondse. Bestuur die inkomste en uitgawes van die Driving License Card Trading Account. Verseker dat alle Padvervoer-entiteite (SANRAL, RAF, RTMC RTIA en C-BRTA) tegniese bystand van die Tak ontvang. Bestuur die hulpbronne van die Tak. Verskaf leiding en voldoende ondersteuning vir en ontwikkeling van die personeel. Verseker nakoming van alle administratiewe vereistes, regulasies, reëls en instruksies wat op die tak betrekking het. Vestig en handhaaf kontinuiteit van bestuurs- en administratiewe stelsels binne die werk van die tak. Ontwikkel finansiële verslae vir voorspellings, tendense en resultate-ontleding. Berei voor en dien implementeringsplanne in. Magtig uitgawes. Bestuur ouditnavrae. Beveel en/of monitor begrotingsvlakke aan. Monitor kwaliteitsbeheer van werk. Verseker die opstel van die jaarverslag en strategiese plan van die tak. Stel begrotingsvlakke vas. Monitor die beplanning, organiseering en delegasie van werk. Verseker dat monitering en evaluering in alle areas van die tak uitgevoer word.

zu.title: Umongamoni jikelele: Ukuthutha Ngemigwaqo
zu.summary: Bhekisa eduze komqondisi jikelele ohlonze ikhono lokubonakalisa kanye nokuqonda, okubaluleke kakhulu kumuntu oholela isigaba esithile salesi sikhundla, okubandakanya imisebenzi ehlobene nezinto ezithile ezingokoqobo. Ukuba nokuba khona kwakho emsebenzini ohambisana nemigwaqo, ezweni nezindawo zasemakhaya ezimisele ukuba nokuthutha nangaphezulu, okubalulekile mayelana nemizamo yokuthuthukiswa kwezenhlalakahle emiphakathini. Ukusebenza ngokuqinisekile ukuvikela imigwaqo kanye nokuba nokulawula ngokuphelele imisebenzi yokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingeni le-(NQF 8) ezivunywe yi-SAQA kwi-Civil Engineering / Construction Studies okanye enye iziqu ezihambisana nalezo, kanti kufanele kube nokuba namava ayisikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-8 esimeni sobuhlakani esiphezulu ngaphansi komnyango. Kuyadingeka ukuba nomsebenzi ongaguquguquki ohlobene nezenzo ezithile, ezenziwa emkhakheni ohlukile, ngokuba nokuba nomqondo ohlukile ngemisebenzi ebonakala engenakuphikwa. Ulwazi oluzinzile lwabakwa-Civil Engineering oluningi nokusebenza iminyaka eminingana okungenani emkhakheni wakho, okuholela ekutheni ube nesimo esithile. Kufanele ube nokuthi uyiqonde ngokuphelele imisebenzi yakho kanye namagunya akho. I-Certificate ye-Senior Management Services Pre-Entry Programme esuka ku-National School of Government. Ulwazi nemakhono: Ulwazi olujulile nemava ekuthuthukiseni izindinganiso nezindlela ezilungile zokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo. Ulwazi nekuqonda kwemithetho yokuqonda emisebenzini yokuthutha emphakathini nasezindaweni ezahlukene zomsebenzi. Ulwazi olubanzi nekuqonda kokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo kanye nokuqapha imigwaqo. Ulwazi nekuqonda ngobuqotho bezinhlelo zokuthuthukiswa kwemiphakathi nangokuba iqhagamshelana nabantu basekhaya. Ulwazi lomsebenzi mayelana ne-PFMA, MMMA, Treasury Regulations kanye ne-GIAMA. Imiva yokucwaninga nokuhlela amacebo. Imiva yokuthenga izinto & ukuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi. Ukubhalwa kwemibiko yokuphathwa neyobuchwepheshe kanye nezindlela ezihamba phambili. Amakhono okubala izikweletu, ukuphathwa kwezimali kanye neziqu zezomnotho.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuyilanganisa kokuhlela, ukuthuthukisa nokuphumeza inethiwekhi yokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo ehlanganiswe ekusebenzeni okuzinzile nokethembekayo. Phatha ukuyilanganisa kokuqondisa kokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokuphunyuzwa kwenqubo namuhla ongazange uhambe abantu abasezinkundleni zasemakhaya. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukuphumeza nokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezingabizi kakhulu zokuhamba ezingasebenzisi amathambo. Phatha imali enikwa imigwaqo. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa nokuphumeza kwezindinganiso zomculi wemigwaqo. Phatha ucwaningo, ukuyilanganisa kokuthuthukisa nokubuyekeza izimiso ezingokobuchwepheshe, izindinganiso nezindlela ezilungile zokusebenza. Phatha futhi uqiniseke ukulawula izinga lokuhlolwa kwemigwaqo. Phatha ukuyilanganisa kokuthuthukisa isistimu yokuphathwa kwamasethi yokwakhiwa kwemigwaqo ngokuhambisana ne-GIAMA nezinye izidingo zokuphathwa kwamasethi. Phatha ukubaluleka kwemithetho yokuphathwa kwesimo sezokuthutha emigwaqweni. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwawo wonke amaphoyisa nokuphathwa kokuthutha emigwaqweni (National Road Traffic Act, Administration Adjudication of Road Traffic Offences Act & Road Traffic Management Act). Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemithesho yokuphoqelela. Qinisekisa ukuyilanganisa kwamaphrojekthi okuphepha emigwaqweni nemisebenzi ehlobene nawo. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqubomgomo nezindlela ezisebenzayo zokuthutha emigwaqweni. Phatha i-akhawunti yamakhadi ehamba nelayisense futhi unikeze inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kuyo yonke izikhulu zokuthutha emigwaqweni. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuphumeza kwenqubomgomo ezisebenzayo ngokuphathwa kwemali. Phatha imali engenayo nezimali ezikhokhwayo ze-Drawing License Card Trading Account. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amasistimu okuthutha emigwaqweni (SANRAL, RAF, RTMC RTIA and C-BRTA) ethola usizo lobuchwepheshe esigabeni. Phatha izinsiza zesigaba. Nikeza incazelo nenkxaso eyanele yokuqondisa nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuzilandela ngemithetho yezomphatha, imithetho, izintela nemiyalo ehlobene nesigaba. Suka futhi ulondoloze ukuphela kwegunya nezinto zezomphatha ngaphakathi kokusebenza kwesigaba. Butha imibiko yezimali yokuqagela, ukubonisa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kanye nokuhlaziya imiphumela. Lungiselela futhi ufakaze izindlela zokuphumeza. Vuma ukuchithwa kwemali. Phatha imibuzo yokuhofoza. Phakamisa futhi / noma ulawule izinga lezikweletu. Qapha ukulawula izinga lobuchwepheshe emsebenzini. Qinisekisa ukubhalwa kombiko wonyaka uhlelo lwezinto eziyisinqamuli wesigaba. Hlela izinga lezikweletu. Qapha ukuhlela, ukulungisa futhi ukwabelana ngomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukubukezwa nokuqashwa kwenziwa kuyo yonke izindawo zesigaba.

xh.title: ISekela-Ndikulu weSahluko seZohambo ngeNdlela
xh.summary: Meme umyili-mkhulu weSahluko seZohambo ngeNdlela ePretoria njengoSekela-Mongameli ogqithiseleyo ofuna ulwazi ngokulawula izisebe ezinkulu ngokwamandla odliwayo-mangalelo wendlela.
xh.requirements: Ifikelwa mqobo kweligi lesi-(NQF 8) njengoko livunywa yi-SAQA kwiNjinoyela yeNtuthuko / kuTifundo zoLwakhiwo enokuhlobana nobuchwepheshe eminye iminyaka elishumi elinobuchwepheshe obulinganayo kwinqanaba lolawulo lwabanini bokulawula kwindalo yolawulo nokuphuhlisa izinfrastruktur yendlela. Isatifikethi sokuphumelela kwenkqubo ye-National School of Government Senior Management Service Pre-Entry Programme. Ulwazi nobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi olunjalo nobuchwepheshe ngokuphuhlisa amanqanaba nemiqathango yezinfrastruktur yendlela. Ulwazi nokuqonda imiqathango kunye neendikelo ezithintela injinoyela yomzantsi afrika. Ulwazi olubanzi nokuqonda ngophuhliso lwezinfrastruktur yendlela nokulawula iindlela. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngokubaluleka kweekqubo zophuhliso loluntu noluntu lokuthatha inxaxheba. Ulwazi lokusebenza lwe-PFMA, MMFA, Treasury Regulations kunye ne-GIAMA. Ulwazi lophando kweestrategi nexesha elithile. Ulwazi lokuthenga izinto olubanzi & ukulawula iiprojekthi. Ulwazi lokuqulunqa iingxelo zolawulo ezifutshane nobuchwepheshe eziyiindawo eziqulunqwa ngokuchanekileyo. Ulwazi olubanzi lobugcisa beziimali ezibalulekileyo.
xh.duties: Phatha ukuqwelaniswa kokucwangciswa, kuphuhliso nokusebenzisa inethiwekhi yezinfrastruktur yendlela ezahlukahlukenyo ethembekileyo egcinayo. Phatha ukuqwelaniswa kokucwangcisa izinfrastruktur yendlela. Phatha uphuhliso nokusebenzisa iindlela ezisestrategweni nenkqubo yophuhliso lwamagumbi eendlela zaselalini. Phatha uphuhliso, ukusebenzisa nokukhuthaza ukusetyenziswa kwezindleko ezisezantsi ezingahambeli ngesixhobo esinamandla. Phatha imali yemibhaso yendlela. Phatha uphuhliso nokusebenzisa amanqanaba obunjiniyela bendlela. Phatha uphando, ukuqwelanisa uphuhliso nanhlaziyo kwemiqathango yobuchwepheshe, amanqanaba & iinkqubo zokulathela nomgxema ongcono. Phatha ukuqinisekisa ulawulo loyilo lomlinganiselo kulwakhiwo lwendlela. Phatha ukuqwelanisa kuphuhliso kwenkqubo yolawulo lwempahla yezinfrastruktur yendlela ngokuvumelana ne-GIAMA nemfuno elawulwa ngayo yolawulo lwempahla. Phatha ulawulo lwendalo yemowetho yendlela. Phatha uphuhliso kweso sonke isilo somthetho nemithetho yemowetho yendlela (National Road Traffic Act, Administration Adjudication of Road Traffic Offences Act & Road Traffic Management Act). Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwemithetho yokuphohleleka. Qinisekisa ukuqwelaniswa kweeprojekthi zokhuseleko lwendlela nemisebenzi ehlobene nayo. Phatha uphuhliso kweenkqubo zezithatho-iindlela kunye neendlela ezisestrategweni ezisebenzayo zotutho lwendlela. Phatha i-akhawunti yekhadi layilayiseni yabaqhubi kwaye ubonelele ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe kuzo zonke iintitshulu zoTutho lweNdlela. Qinisekisa uphuhliso nokusebenzisa inkqubo yezithatho-iindlela esebenzayo ekulawulweni kwemali. Phatha ingeniso nentlawulo ye-Akhawunti yoThengiso yeKhadi loQhubo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iintitshulu zoTutho lweNdlela (SANRAL, RAF, RTMC RTIA and C-BRTA) zifumana inkxaso yobuchwepheshe kwisiCandaba. Lawula amathuba esiCandaba. Bonelela ngokuqondisa nenkxaso efanelekileyo nophuhliso basebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuzilandelisa ngayo yonke imfuno yolawulo lolawulo, imithetho, iinkqubo nezikhokelo ezimalana nesicandaba. Saziise ulondolozo lenkqubo yolawulo loluqhubekayo kolawulo ngaphakathi komsebenzi wesicandaba. Phatha iingxelo zezimali zokuqikelela, ukutrenda nanqaku lomphumo. Lungisa kwaye ulinganise iindawo zokusebenzisa. Gunyazisa intlawulo. Phatha imibuzo ye-odithi. Phakamisa kwaye / okanye lwathanze amanqanaba eshishini. Lwathanza ulawulo loloyilo lomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuqulunqwa kwengxelo yonyaka nenkqubo esestrategweni yesicandaba. Misela amanqanaba eshishini. Lwathanza ukucwangcisa, ukuqamba kunye nokunikwa kwabanye umsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukulawula & ukuhlola kwenziwa kuzo zonke iindawo zesicandaba.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Driving Licence Card Account
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package) of which 30% can be structured according to individual needs.
jobs.summary: Chief Director needed in Pretoria to lead driving licence card production operations within the Department of Transport, offering R1,554,696 per annum.
jobs.requirements: A qualification at NQF level 7 as recognised by SAQA in Operations Management / Production Management / Industrial Engineering / Business Management with 5 years relevant working experience at a senior management level in a manufacturing or high-volume production environment. Certificate of Successful completion of the National School of Government's Senio Management Service Pre-Entry Programme. Knowledge And Skill: Extensive knowledge of production/manufacturing processes. Knowledge of PFMA, Treasury Regulations, and Supply Chain Framework. Deep understanding of smartcard technologies and personalisation process. Knowledge in managing high-security printing and distribution process. Knowledge of ICT systems integration with production environments. Leadership in organisational transformation, digitisation, or automation. Ability to manage vendors, SLA’s and public-private partnerships. Proven Ethics, integrity and security-conscious leadership. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework. Knowledge of business development practices specifically regarding the printing industry. Knowledge of the compilation of management reports.
jobs.duties: Provide leadership and oversight in the production of driving licence cards. Provide strategic leadership for integrated production services to ensure alignment with organisational objectives, service delivery requirements, and customer expectations. Drive a high-performance culture focused on operational excellence, professionalism, continuous improvement, and people development. Lead and empower production teams to optimise planning, prioritisation, and responsiveness to changing production demands and deadlines. Manage stakeholder alignment through effective engagement, communication, and reporting on production performance, risks, and delivery outcomes. Manage asset and operational efficiency, including plant reliability, maintenance strategies, and cost optimisation initiatives such as waste reduction and process improvement. Provide strategic oversight of security and compliance, ensuring continuous enhancement of security standards in line with organisational and national risk requirements. Liaise with the departmental Chief Financial Officer (CFO), National Treasury, and Auditor-General for compliance, reporting, and audit resolution. Ensure end-to-end production integrity, including secure, compliant manufacturing of sensitive products and full control over production logistics, traceability, and risk mitigation. Ensure the effective management and control of driving licence cards, including proper safekeeping, recordkeeping, and secure dispatch to maintain product integrity and accountability. Manage the DLCA funding and expenditure. Develop and manage the annual budget for the DLCA in line with government financial management frameworks. Align budget allocations to operational needs, strategic goals, and production forecasts. Ensure the budget supports cost recovery and sustainability of the Trading Entity. Ensure compliance with PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Establish and maintain internal controls to prevent misuse, wasteful and irregular expenditure, or fraud. Prepare accurate financial reports for internal decision-making and external audit purposes. Lead preparation for internal and external audits and implement audit recommendations. Manage the consolidation of accounts from registering authorities. Manage the reconciliation of bank statements between the bank and the entity. Establish control measures to manage the debtors of the trading entity. Manage the procurement and contract management. Manage procurement of goods and services in line with Supply Chain Management (SCM) policies. Oversee contracts related to the acquisition of secure materials, card stock, and technology services. Ensure supplier payments are accurate and timely. Manage the provision of risk management services and compliance to the DLCA. Manage the development and implementation of the DLCA’s risk management framework. Facilitate risk identification, assessment and development of risk mitigation strategies. Monitor and report on the implementation of risk mitigation strategies. Maintain regular updating of risk profile for the department and reporting to the Accounting Officer, management and Risk Management Committee. Manage the resources of the DLCA. Ensure compliance with all administrative requirements, regulations, rules and instructions pertaining to the branch. Establish and maintain governance and administrative system’s continuity within the work of the branch. Develop financial reports for forecasting, trending and results analysis. Prepare and submit implementation plans. Evaluate projected spending plans. Monitor quality control of work. Ensure the compilation of the annual report and strategic plan of the chief directorate. Monitor the planning, organising and delegation of work. Ensure monitoring & evaluation is carried out in all areas of the chief directorate.

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Bestuur van Bestuurslisensiekaartrekening
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur benodig in Pretoria om bestuurslisensiekaartproduksiebedrywighede binne die Department of Transport te lei, teen R1,554,696 per jaar.
af.requirements: 'n Kwalifikasie op NQF vlak 7 soos erken deur SAQA in Operations Management / Production Management / Industrial Engineering / Business Management met 5 jaar se relevante werkservaring op seniorbestuursvlak in 'n vervaardigings- of hoëvolume-produksieomgewing. Sertifikat van suksesvolle voltooiing van die National School of Government se Senio Management Service Pre-Entry Programme. Kennis en vaardighede: Uitgebreide kennis van produksie-/vervaardigingsprosesse. Kennis van PFMA, Treasury Regulations, en Supply Chain Framework. Diepgaande begrip van slimkaarttegnologieë en personaliseringsproses. Kennis van die bestuur van hoësekuriteitsdruk en verspreidingsproses. Kennis van ICT-stelselsintegrasie met produksieomgewings. Leierskap in organisatoriese transformasie, digitalisering, of outomatisering. Vermoë om verskaffers, SLA's en openbaar-private vennootskappe te bestuur. Bewese etiek, integriteit en sekuriteitsbewuste leierskap. Kennis van die Public Service Regulatory Framework. Kennis van besigheidsontwikkelingspraktyke spesifiek met betrekking tot die drukkerybedryf. Kennis van die opstel van bestuursverslae.
af.duties: Verskaf leierskap en toesig oor die produksie van bestuurslisensiekaarte. Verskaf strategiese leierskap vir geïntegreerde produksiedienste om belyning met organisatoriese doelwitte, diensleweringvereistes en klantverwagtinge te verseker. Dryf 'n hoëprestasiekultuur aan wat op operasionele uitmuntendheid, professionaliteit, deurlopende verbetering en mense-ontwikkeling fokus. Lei en bemagtig produksiespanne om beplanning, prioritisering en reaksie op veranderende produksiebehoeftes en sperdatums te optimaliseer. Bestuur belanghebbende-belyning deur effektiewe betrokkenheid, kommunikasie en verslagdoening oor produksieprestasie, risiko's en leweringsuitkomste. Bestuur bates en operasionele doeltreffendheid, insluitend aanlegbetroubaarheid, instandhoudingstrategieë, en koste-optimaliseringsinisiatiewe soos afvalvermindering en prosesverbetering. Verskaf strategiese toesig oor sekuriteit en nakoming, en verseker deurlopende verbetering van sekuriteitsstandaarde in ooreenstemming met organisatoriese en nasionale risikobehoeftes. Skakel met die departementele Chief Financial Officer (CFO), National Treasury, en Auditor-General vir nakoming, verslagdoening en ouditoplossing. Verseker end-tot-end produksie-integriteit, insluitend veilige, bystandsmatige vervaardiging van sensitiewe produkte en volledige beheer oor produksielogistiek, naspeurbaarheid en risikobeperking. Verseker die effektiewe bestuur en beheer van bestuurslisensiekaarte, insluitend behoorlike veilige bewaring, rekordhouding en veilige versending om produkintegriteit en verantwoordbaarheid te handhaaf. Bestuur die DLCA-befondsing en -besteding. Ontwikkel en bestuur die jaarlikse begroting vir die DLCA in ooreenstemming met staatsfinansiële bestuursraamwerke. Belyn begrotings-toekennings met operasionele behoeftes, strategiese doelwitte en produksievooruitskattings. Verseker dat die begroting kosteherstel en volhoubaarheid van die Trading Entity ondersteun. Verseker nakoming van PFMA en Treasury Regulations. Stel en handhaaf interne beheermaatreëls om misbruik, sorgelose en onreëlmatige besteding, of bedrog te voorkom. Berei akkurate finansiële verslae voor vir interne besluitneming en eksterne ouditdoeleindes. Lei voorbereiding vir interne en eksterne ouditte en implementeer ouditaanbevelings. Bestuur die konsolidasie van rekeninge van registreringsowerhede. Bestuur die rekonsiliasie van bankstate tussen die bank en die entiteit. Stel beheermaatreëls in om die skuldenaars van die Trading Entity te bestuur. Bestuur die verkryging en kontrakbestuur. Bestuur die verkryging van goedere en dienste in ooreenstemming met Supply Chain Management (SCM)-beleid. Hou toesig oor kontrakte wat verband hou met die verkryging van veilige materiaal, kaartvoorraad en tegnologiedienste. Verseker dat verskaffersbetalings akkuraat en betyds is. Bestuur die verskaffing van risikobestuursdienste en nakoming aan die DLCA. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van die DLCA se risikobestuursraamwerk. Fasiliteer risikoidentifikasie, -assessering en die ontwikkeling van risikobeperkingstrategieë. Monitor en rapporteer oor die implementering van risikobeperkingstrategieë. Handhaaf gereelde opdatering van die risikoprofiel vir die departement en rapporteer aan die Accounting Officer, bestuur en die Risk Management Committee. Bestuur die hulpbronne van die DLCA. Verseker nakoming van alle administratiewe vereistes, regulasies, reëls en instruksies wat op die tak betrekking het. Stel en handhaaf bestuurs- en administratiewe stelselkontinuiteit binne die werk van die tak. Ontwikkel finansiële verslae vir vooruitskattings, neigings en resultate-analise. Berei en dien implementeringsplanne in. Evalueer geprojekteerde bestedingsplanne. Monitor gehaltebeheer van werk. Verseker die opstel van die jaarverslag en strategiese plan van die hoofdirektoraat. Monitor die beplanning, organising en afbakening van werk. Verseker dat monitering en evaluering in alle areas van die hoofdirektoraat uitgevoer word.

zu.title: ISikhundla Esihola Esikhulu: i-Akhawunti Yekhadi Lohlobo Lokushayela
zu.summary: Kudingeka iSikhundla Esihola Esikhulu ePretoria ukuze kuholelwe izenzo zokukhiqiza amakhadi ohlobo lokushayela ngaphakathi kwe-Department of Transport, inikezela i-R1,554,696 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esinganqophiso lesi-7 le-NQF njengoba sivunywa i-SAQA kwi-Operations Management / Production Management / Industrial Engineering / Business Management kanye namaphuzu eminyaka eyi-5 emsebenzini ohambisanayo ezingeni labaphathi abaphakeme endaweni yokukhiqiza noma esikhundleni esikhulu sokukhiqiza. Isitifiketi sokuqedwa ngempumelelo i-National School of Government's Senio Management Service Pre-Entry Programme. Ulwazi NoKhono: Ulwazi olubanzi ngezindlela zokukhiqiza/zokwenza izinto. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulations, kanye ne-Supply Chain Framework. Ukuqonda okujulile ngeteknoloji yamakhadi ahlakaniphile kanye nenqubo yokwenza ngokwakho. Ulwazi ekuphathweni kokushicilela okuphakeme ngokuvikeleka kanye nenqubo yokusatshalaliswa. Ulwazi mayelana nohlanganiso lwezinhlelo ze-ICT endaweni yokukhiqiza. Buka imisebenzi enguquko yenhlangano, ukwenziwa yibhalomshini, noma ukuzenzakalela. Ikhono lokuphatha abathengisi, i-SLA's kanye nohlangano phakathi kwabantu kanye nezinkampani. Buqinile ukuzinza ngokomoya, ukwethembeka kanye nokuholwa ngokuqapha ngokuvikeleka. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokulawula izinsiza Fulumenthu. Ulwazi ngezindlela zokuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi ikakhulukazi mayelana noshintsho lwemboni yokushicilela. Ulwazi mayelana nokuqoqwa kwemibiko yokuphatha.
zu.duties: Nika abukho nombono ohamba phambili ekukhiqizeni amakhadi ohlobo lokushayela. Nika umbono ohamba phambili ngokuzenzakalelayo wezinsizakalo zokukhiqiza ezihlanganiswe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana nemigomo ezinhlobonhlobo zenhlangano, izidingo zokuletha izinsiza, kanye nezethemba labathengi. Phakamisa isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphakeme eligxile ekugqameni ngokuphathwa kwezindlela zokusebenza, ukwethembeka, ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo, kanye nentuthuko yabantu. Hola futhi wamuse amaqembu okukhiqiza ukuze kube nokuhleleka okuhle ekubekweni ohamba phambili ibaluleke kakhulu, ukuhleleka kwezinto ezingangena phambili, kanye nokusabela ekushintsheni izidingo nokujedyiswa kwesikhathi ekukhiqizeni. Phatha ukuhambisana kwabahlanganyeli ngokubamba iqhaza okusebenzayo, ukuxhumana, kanye nokubika ngezenzo zokukhiqiza, izingozi, kanye nemiphumela yokuletha. Phatha okuwuhlobo lwezimpahla nokusebenza kahle kwemisebenzi, okuhlanganisa ukuthembeka kwentengo yokukhiqiza, izindlela zokulondolozwa, kanye nenhlelo yokunciphisa izindleko ezinjengokunciphisa ukungalungi kanye nokuthuthuka kwezindlela zokusebenza. Nika ubukho nombono ohamba phambili ngokuvikeleka nokuhambisana nemithetho, ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo kwemigomo yokuvikeleka ngokuhambisana nezidingo zengozi zenhlangano kanye nezwe. Xhumana nesikhulu Esihola Izimali (CFO) somnyango, i-National Treasury, kanye ne-Auditor-General ngokuhambisana nemithetho, ukubika, kanye nokuqedwa kokuhlola. Qinisekisa ukuzinza kokukhiqiza okuvela ekuqaleni kuye kokuphela, okuhlanganisa ukukhiqiza ngokuvikeleka nangokuhambisana nemithetho izinto eziyimfihlo kanye nokuqapha okuphelele izimpahla zokukhiqiza, ukulandelwa kwezimpahla zokukhiqiza, kanye nokunciphisa ingozi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokulawulwa kwamakhadi ohlobo lokushayela, okuhlanganisa ukugcinwa okuhle, ukuhlolwa kwezibhalo, kanye nokuthunyelwa ngokuvikeleka ukuze kugcinwe ukuzinza kwemikhiqizo kanye nenabelo. Phatha imali kanye nezezimali ze-DLCA. Bumba uphinde ulawule ukwabiwa kwemali yonyaka we-DLCA ngokuhambisana nezindlela zokuphathwa kwezimali zahulumeni. Hlanganisa ukwabiwa kwemali nezidingo zokusebenza, imigomo ebalulekile, kanye nokuqagela ukukhiqiza. Qinisekisa ukuthi imali yesikhashana ixhasa ukubuyiselwa izindleko kanye nokuzinza kwezinhlangano Ezigadayo. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana ne-PFMA kanye Nemigomo ye-Treasury. Seka futhi ulondoloze izindlela zokulawula ngaphakathi ukuze kuvikelwe ukusetshenziswa kabi, ukuchithwa kabi noma okungalungile kwemali, noma ukukhwabanisa. Lungiselela imibiko yezimali eqinisekile yokuqumba izinqumo zangaphakathi nangenhloso yokubuka kwangaphandle. Hola ukulungiselela ukubhekisiswa ngaphakathi nangaphandle uphinde usebenzise izincomo ezivela ekubhekisisweni. Phatha ukuhlanganisa izikhwama ezivela kubaphathi ababhalisile. Phatha ukuqathaniswa kwemibiko yebhange phakathi kwebhange nenhlangano. Seka izindlela zokulawula ukuphatha izikweletu zenhlangano esigidayo. Phatha ukuthengwa kwemikhiqizo kanye nokuphathwa kwezivumelwano. Phatha ukuthengwa kwezimpahla kanye nezemisebenzi ngokuhambisana nemigomo ye-Supply Chain Management (SCM). Bukela izivumelwano ezihlobene nokutholwa kwezinto ezingenabo bungozi, izinto ezikhokhiswayo zamakhadi, kanye nezenzo zolwazi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinkokhelo zabathengisi ziqinisekile futhi zenzelwa ngesikhathi. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokulawula ingozi kanye nokuhambisana nemithetho ku-DLCA. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa futhi kusetshenziswa izindlela zokulawula ingozi ze-DLCA. Yenza kube lula ukuqapha ingozi, ukuhlola, kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokunciphisa ingozi. Bheka uphinde ubike ngokusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokunciphisa ingozi. Gcina ukubuyekezwa njalo kolwazi olumayelana nengozi lumnyango uphide ubike ku-Accounting Officer, abaphathi kanye ne-Komiti YokuLawula Ingozi. Phatha izinsiza ze-DLCA. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nazo zonke izidingo zokuphathwa kwezokwengqondo, imithetho, imigomo, kanye nemiyalo ephathelene nendima. Seka futhi ulondoloze ukuqhubeka kwezokuphatha izinhlelo kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ngaphakathi kwendima. Thuthukisa imibiko yezimali mayelana nokuqagela, ukubuka ukuya phambili, kanye nokuqapha imiphumela. Lungiselela uphide uhlole izindlela zokuqagela. Bheka ukulawula khwalithi yomsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kokubika kwangaphakathi kanye neplani ebalulekile yesikhundla esikhulu sokuhola. Buka ukuhlela, ukuhleleka, kanye nokwabelana komsebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukubuka nokuhlola kwenziwa kuzo zonke izindawo zesikhundla esikhulu sokuhola.

xh.title: Talshipa eliKhulu elijonge i-Akhawunti yeKhadi leSayilensi yoShishino
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNkululeko ePretoria ukulawula imisebenzi yokwenza amakhadi eselayisensi yokushayela kwisebe lezothutho, enika umvuzo we R1,554,696 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isiqinisekiso kumgangatho we-NQF 7 njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA kwiNkonzo zeNdlela zokuLawula / iNkonzo yokuzala iimveliso / uBugcisa boBuchwepheshe beShishini / uLawulo boShishino kunye neminyaka eyi-5 yamava okusebenza edidiyelweyo kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo kwimeko yokwenza iimveliso okanye kwimeko yokuzala iimveliso ezininzi. Isatifikethi sokuQinisekisa ukuQeda iNkqubo ye-National School of Government's Senior Management Service Pre-Entry Programme. ULwazi naBuchwepheshe: ULwazi olubanzi lweendlela zokwenza iimveliso/zokwenza izinto. ULwazi lwe-PFMA, iTreasury Regulations, kunye ne-Supply Chain Framework. Ukuqonda ngokujulileyo ukutshintsha kobuchwepheshe bekhadi elinobuchule nendlela yokuqamba. ULwazi lokulawula ukushicilela okukhuselekileyo kakhulu nendlela yokusasazwa. ULwazi lweendlela zokudibanisa iinkqubo ze-ICT nemilingo yokwenza iimveliso. ULawulo ekutshintshweni kwesebe, ekusebenziseni iikhompyutha, okanye ekuzenzakalelayo. Ukuba nakho ukulawula abathengisi, i-SLA's, kunye nobudlelwane obusesemthethweni phakathi kukaRhulumente nabantu. Ukuqonda ngokucacileyo ngokuziphatha okuhle, ukuzinza kolwazi, nokuba sekhusini. ULwazi lweNyongo yoLawulo eLuntu phakathi koRhulumente. ULwazi lweendlela zokuphuhlisa ishishino ngokukodwa malunga noshishino lokushicilela. ULwazi lokuyila iinkqubo zokubika ngokulawula ishishino.
xh.duties: Qikelela ubuqu kwimisebenzi yokugqiba izikrwele zelayisensi yokushayela. Qikelela ebalulekileyo ukulawula iinkonzo zokugqiba ezidityanisiweyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulungelelwaniso namagqabantshintshi asebe, iimfuno zokuvelisa iinkonzo, nentendero labathengi. Khuthaza isiko lokusebenza ngamandla aphezulu elibhekisele ekuphumeleleni kwezentlalo-ntle, kubungcali, ekuphuculeni ngokuzinzileyo, nasekuphuculeni abantu. Beka iindlela kwaye umdla wamava kumatshini wakho abo bakhi okuvelisa ukuyila iinkqubo, ukubeka iinqwelomoya, nokusabela kwiimfuno ezitshintshayo ekulweni nasekuveliseni. Lawula ngokuchanekileyo isaziswa phakathi kwabalinganiselo, abanikelo, nendlela yokubika ngenkqubo nempilo kumalinganiselo, kwiingozi, nakwiindaba ekugqibeleni kwemveliso. Lawula ubunyulu ngokuchanekileyo nezinga ekuphumeleleni, kuquka ukuzinza kolunye useto lwe-machina, iindlela zokulungisa izinto ezimbi, neendaba zokuthotywa kwamaxabiso ezifana nokunciphisa iinkukumo nokuphucula iindlela. Lawula ngokuchanekileyo ukhuseleko nokuzinza kolwazi lwakho lomgaqo-nkqubo, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba ukhuseleko luya kuphuculwa ngokuhamba kwexesha ngokwemfuno yesimo ekwingqongwana yelizwe. Qhagamshelana nomlawuli wezimali wesebe (CFO), weNational Treasury, ne-Auditor-General malunga nokuzinza, ukubika, nokugqiba iindaba ezibuzwayo. Qinisekisa ukuzinza ngokupheleleyo ekugqibeleni kwemveliso, kuquka ukwenza okukhuselekileyo, ukwenza ngokwemigaqo yomcalu okuqukiweyo, nolawulo olupheleleyo ngaphezu kweendaba zokuhamba nokufikelwa ngemveliso, ukuqondwa nokuhamba, nokunciphisa iingozi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Ifms Operations
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: IFMS Operations role at National Treasury in Pretoria, requiring financial systems experience and a diploma in accounting or financial management.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6) in Accounting or Financial Management. A Bachelor’s degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in any of the above disciplines is an added advantage. A minimum 4 years’ experience of which 2 years should be on an Assistant Director level or equivalent obtained financial systems. Strong knowledge of transversal financial systems (such as BAS, LOGIS or PERSAL), analytical skills, and leadership capabilities. Knowledge of Public sector MTEF Process. Knowledge of Budgeting preparation and analysis. Knowledge of Microsoft Office especially for Excel.
jobs.duties: Policy Development: Budget Management, Monitoring and Control: Prepare and monitor operational and capital budgets, with chief directorate management. Compile, coordinate and support the management of the original and adjustment budgets, and provide MTEF input and consolidate inputs for compilation of Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Assist in maintaining projected estimates, schedules, and baselines. Liaise with service providers, internal stakeholders and relevant government departments on budget, financial administration and related operational matters. Review monthly reports and investigate fluctuations. Coordinate and consolidate inputs for monthly, quarterly and annual budget performance reports. Provide budget advisory support to management and ensure alignment between operational plans, procurement plans and available funds. Expenditure Control and Payments: Manage expenditure control, maintain financial records and supporting schedules, and prepare monthly cash flow and reconciliation reports. Review, verify, amend and consolidate expenditure-related payment submissions, including consultant rate cards, service provider invoices, software license fees, other payment requests and supporting documents. Manage cash flow and provide early warning reports on variances from planned expenditure. Maintain expenditure schedules and payment tracking records. Monitor cash flow and spending against approved allocations. Prepare monthly reconciliation, cash flow and expenditure reports. Process journals and address expenditure variances. Ensure compliance with financial prescripts and procedures. Provide advice and guidance on expenditure control and payment procedures. Asset Management and Administration: Quarterly updating of Asset Management Register of the Unit and recommend goods for disposal. Ensure compliance to the PFMA and Treasury Regulations. Reconcile asset register with Finance and/or National Treasury assets department. Coordinate the verification, movement and safeguarding of assets assigned to the unit. Monitor asset losses, transfers and disposals and ensure supporting documentation is complete and submitted timeously. Financial Management and Reporting: Manage and coordinate financial administration activities in support of the Chief Directorate’s operational and strategic priorities. Analyse expenditure, commitments and available funds to support accurate financial planning and decision-making. Coordinate the preparation and submission of monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports for management consideration. Review reconciliations, supporting schedules and financial records to ensure completeness, accuracy and audit readiness. Monitor compliance with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, departmental policies and applicable financial prescripts. Identify financial risks, control weaknesses and reporting discrepancies and recommend corrective measures. Provide financial advice, guidance and support to managers, internal stakeholders and relevant governance structures. Resource Administration and Facility Management: General office administration management which includes fleet management, messenger services, office assistance, refreshments co-ordination, stationery requests and other procurement requests (VAS 2’s). Management of performance and development. Undertake general people management of subordinates which includes management of performance agreements, reviews, evaluations and other administrative functions of the sub-directorate. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Compile and submit all required administrative reports. Quality control of work delivered by employees. Plan and allocate work, manage leave and attendance, and ensure effective utilisation of human, financial and physical resources.
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e- Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e-Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, ID, etc., however these documents need not be certified at point of application, however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies, only for a specific period, of which the submitted documents will then be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and to sign a Performance Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment and for candidates whose appointment exceeds 12 calendar months will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) calendar months excluding leave taken as prescribed by Public Service Regulation 68. The status of your application will be visible on the e-Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Note: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or to put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human Resources Recruitment Support Team on Recruitment.Enquiries@treasury.gov.za. af.title: Onderdirekteur: IFMS-bedrywe
af.summary: Pos van Onderdirekteur: IFMS-bedrywe by National Treasury in Pretoria, wat finansiële stelselervaring en 'n diploma in rekeningkunde of finansiële bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (ewekardig aan NQF vlak 6) in Rekeningkunde of Finansiële Bestuur. 'n Baccalaureusgraad (ewekardig aan NQF vlak 7) in enige van bogenoemde dissiplines is 'n bykomende voordeel. 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se ervaring waarvan 2 jaar op 'n Assistentdirekteursvlak of ekwivalent moet wees, verkry in finansiële stelsels. Sterk kennis van transversale finansiële stelsels (soos BAS, LOGIS of PERSAL), analitiese vaardighede, en leierskapsvermoëns. Kennis van Publieke sektor MTEF Proses. Kennis van Begrotingsvoorbereiding en analise. Kennis van Microsoft Office veral vir Excel.
af.duties: Beleidsontwikkeling: Begrotingsbestuur, monitering en beheer: Berei en moniteer operasionele en kapitaalbegrotings voor, tesame met hoofdirektoraatbestuur. Stel oorspronklike en wysigingsbegrotings op, koördineer en ondersteun die bestuur daarvan, en verskaf MTEF-insette en konsolideer insette vir die samestelling van Ramings van Nasionale Uitgawes (ENE). Help om projekte-rames, skedules en basislyne te handhaaf. Skakel met diensverskaffers, interne belanghebbendes en relevante regeringsdepartemente oor begroting, finansiële administrasie en verwante operasionele aangeleenthede. Hersien maandelikse verslae en ondersoek skommelings. Koördineer en konsolideer insette vir maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse begrotingsprestasieverslae. Verskaf begrotingsadviesondersteuning aan bestuur en verseker belyning tussen operasionele planne, verkrywingsplanne en beskikbare fondse. Uitgawbebeheer en Betalings: Bestuur uitgawbebeheer, handhaaf finansiële rekords en ondersteunende skedules, en berei maandelikse kontantvloei- en reconciliëringsverslae voor. Hersien, verifieer, wysig en konsolideer uitgawe-verwante betalingsvoorleggings, insluitend konsultantkoerskaarte, diensverskafferfakture, sagtewarelisensiegelde, ander betalingsversoeke en ondersteunende dokumente. Bestuur kontantvloei en verskaf vroegtydige waarskuwingsverslae oor afwykings van beplande uitgawes. Handhaaf uitgaweskedules en betalingsopsporingsrekords. Moniteer kontantvloei en bestedding teenoor goedgekeurde toekenninge. Berei maandelikse reconciliërings-, kontantvloei- en uitgaweverslae voor. Verwerk joernale en spreek uitgawe-afwykings aan. Verseker nakoming van finansiële voorskryfte en prosedures. Verskaf advies en leiding oor uitgawbebeheer en betalingsprosedures. Batebestuur en Administrasie: Kwartaallikse bywerking van Batebestuurregister van die Eenheid en beveel goedere virskikking aan. Verseker nakoming van die PFMA en Tesouriereëlings. Reconcilieer bateregister met Finansies en/of National Treasury se bate-afdeling. Koördineer die verifikasie, beweging en beveiliging van bates wat aan die eenheid toegewys is. Moniteer bateverliese, oordragte en verskikkings en verseker dat ondersteunende dokumentasie volledig en betyds ingedien word. Finansiële Bestuur en Verslagdoening: Bestuur en koördineer finansiële administrasie-aktiwiteite ter ondersteuning van die hoofdirektoraat se operasionele en strategiese prioriteite. Analiseer uitgawes, verbintenis en beskikbare fondse om akkurate finansiële beplanning en besluitneming te ondersteun. Koördineer die voorbereiding en indiening van maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse finansiële verslae vir bestuuroorweging. Hersien reconciliëring, ondersteunende skedules en finansiële rekords om volledigheid, akkuraatheid en ouditgereedheid te verseker. Moniteer nakoming van die PFMA, Tesouriereëlings, departementbeleide en toepaslike finansiële voorskryfte. Identifiseer finansiële risiko's, beheerswakheid en verslagdoeningsafwykings en beveel korrektiewe maatreëls aan. Verskaf finansiële advies, leiding en ondersteuning aan bestuurders, interne belanghebbendes en relevante bestuursstrukture. Hulpbronadministrasie en Fasiliteitsbestuur: Algemene kantooradministrasiebestuur wat vlootbestuur, boodskapperdienste, kantoor bystand, versnaperingkoördinasie, skryfbehoeftesversoeke en ander verkrywingsversoeke (VAS 2's) insluit. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling. Onderneem algemene mensebestuur van ondergeskiktes wat bestuur van prestasie-ooreenkomste, hersienings, evaluerings en ander administratiewe funksies van die subdirektoraat insluit. Vestig, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasiereëlings. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in. Kwaliteitsbeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Beplan en allokeer werk, bestuur verlof en bywoning, en verseker effektiewe benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne.

zu.title: Deputy Director: Ifms Operations
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Deputy Director: IFMS Operations e-National Treasury e-Pretoria, esidinga amava kumalethiwe ezezimali futhi i-diploma ekuBhaliseni noma ekuPhathweni kweMali.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga asi-12 sidingekile kanye ne-National Diploma (elingana namabanga ama-6 e-NQF) ekuBhaliseni noma ekuPhathweni kweMali. I-degree ye-Bachelor (elingana namabanga ama-7 e-NQF) kunoma yisiphi isiqeqesho esingenhla kuyisonga enhle. Amava amaminyaka angu-4 lapho kungaphezulu kweminyaka emi-2 kumele kube kwizinga lika-Assistant Director noma esilinganiso esifanayo esitholwe kumalethiwe ezezimali. Ulwazi olujulile mayelana namalethiwe ezezimali awo wonke amaphiko (njenge-BAS, i-LOGIS noma i-PERSAL), amakhono okuhlaziya futhi amakhono okuhola. Ulwazi mayelana nenqubo ye-MTEF komphakathi kahulumene. Ulwazi mayelana nokulungiswa nokuhlaziya imijoho. Ulwazi ngamahlelo we-Microsoft Office ikakhulukazi i-Excel.
zu.duties: Izinqubo ezinhle: Ukuphathwa kweNgcebo, Ukuqapha nokuLawula: Hlela futhi qapha imijoho yokusebenza nemijoho yemali eqoqelwe ukwakhiwa, kanye nokuphathwa kwebandla labaholi abaphakeme. Qamba, lungisa futhi usekele ukuphathwa kwemijoho yokuqala nokuqoqwa kwemali, futhi unikeze umnikelo we-MTEF futhi uhlanganise izimnikelo ukuze kuhlelwe amabalwe esiLimo (ENE). Siza ekugcineni izilinganiso ezibekiwe, izikhathi ezihleliwe, nezisekelo. Xhumana nabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, abandelana abangaphakathi neminyango kahulumeni ehlobene nemijoho, imicimbi yolawulo lwemali nezinye izindaba zokusebenza. Hlola izibalo zeminye yonke futhi uphenye ngemikhawulo yokushintsha. Hlela futhi uhlanganise izimnikelo zemibiko yemijoho yaminye yonke, yamakhulu amathathu neminyaka yonke. Nikeza ngcebo yeseluleko kobuhle futhi qinisekisa ukuhambisana phakathi kwemiklamo yokusebenza, imiklamo yokuthenga nemali etholakalayo. ILawulo Lokusebenzisa Imali kanye neNkokhelo: Phatha ilawulo lokusebenzisa imali, gcina irekhodi lezemali futhi uhlele izikhathi zokusekela, futhi ulungise izibalo zeminye yonke zemali nokuhambisana kwazo. Hlola, qinisekisa, lungisa futhi uhlanganise izimnikelo zokukhokha ezihlobene nokusebenzisa imali, okuhlanganisa amakhadi wesilinganiso sabaholi, izikweletu zabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo, izimali zelayisensi yesoftiwe, ezinye izicelo zokukhokha futhi uhlele amafayela okusekela. Phatha ukugeleza kwemali futhi unikeze izibiko zokuqwashisa ngokushintsha okuyiyo emphakathini wehlule imali ehleliwe. Gcina izikhathi zokusebenzisa imali futhi ulandele irekhodi lokukhokha. Qapha ukugeleza kwemali nokusebenzisa imali ngokuhambisana nemigomo evunyiwe. Lungisa izibiko zeminye yonke zokuqhathanisa, ukugeleza kwemali nokusebenzisa imali. Cwilisa amaphuphu futhi ulungise imikhawulo yokusebenzisa imali. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunokulandelwa kwezimiso nemigomo yemali. Nikeza iseluleko nomholo ngendlela yokulawula ukusebenzisa imali futhi ngemikhakha yokukhokha. Ukuphathwa kwezimpahla nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo: Ukubuyekeza kwamakhulu amathathu irekhodi lezimpahla lesikhungo futhi ukwelule ukuthi izimpahla zingahlelwa njani ukulahlwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunokulandelwa kwe-PFMA nezimiso ze-National Treasury. Qhathanisa irekhodi lezimpahla nomnyango wezemali noma i-National Treasury. Hlela ukuqinisekisa, ukushintshwa nokugcinwa kwezimpahla ezinikeziwe lesikhungo. Qapha ukulahleka, ukudluliselwa nokulahlwa kwezimpahla futhi qinisekisa ukuthi amafayela okusekela aqediwe futhi ethunyelwa ngasikhathi. Ukuphathwa kwezemali nokubika: Phatha futhi uhleze imicimbi yolawulo lwemali ekusekeleni amaphuzu abalulekile abuhle futhi aphakathi wobuhle. Hlola ukusebenzisa imali, izibopho nemali etholakalayo ukuze usekele ukuhlelwa ngokunembile kwemali futhi ukuthathwa kwezinqumo. Hlela ukulungiswa nokuthunyelwa kwemibiko yemali yaminye yonke, yamakhulu amathathu neminyaka yonne ekuqondweni kwabaholi. Hlola ukuqhathanisa, izikhathi zokusekela futhi irekhodi lezemali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba ngokuphelele, ngokunembile futhi ukulungele ukuhlolwa. Qapha ukulandelwa kwe-PFMA, izimiso ze-National Treasury, imigomo yomnyango futhi izimiso ezihambisana nemali. Chaza ubungozi bezemali, ubuthakathaka bolawula nokungahambelani kwezibiko futhi ukwelule izinyathelo zokulungisa. Nikeza iseluleko, umholo futhi usekele ngemali abaholi, abandelana abangaphakathi futhi izakhiwo ezibalulekile zokubusa. Ukuphathwa kwezinsiza nokuphathwa kwesikhungo: Ukuphathwa okuvamile kohlwini oluhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezimoto, izinsizakalo zabagijimi, usizo lwehhovisi, ukuhlanganisa iziphuzo, izicelo zokubhala nezinye izicelo zokuthenga (i-VAS 2). Ukuphathwa kokusebenza futhi ekuqubeneni. Yenza ukuphathwa okuvamile kwabantu abangaphansi kwakho okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwezivumelwano ukusebenza, ukuhlolwa, ukubuyekeza nezinye imisebenzi yolawulo yesikhundla esingaphansi. Seka, yenza futhi gcina izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenza futhi ezinembile. Hlela futhi uthumele yonke imibiko edingekayo yolawulo. Ukulawula izinga lekhiwizo yomsebenzi owenziwe ngabasebenzi. Hlela futhi wabelane umsebenzi, phatha ukuphumula futhi ukubakhona, futhi qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwabantu, imali nezinsiza ezibonakalayo.

xh.title: Deputy Director: Ifms Operations
xh.summary: Isebe leNational Treasury elisePretoria lifuna umntu oza kuzalisa isithuba sikaDeputy Director: IFMS Operations, ofuna amava okusebenza ngenkqubo zemali kwaye ane-diploma kw-Accounting okanye kwi-Financial Management.
xh.requirements: Kufunelwa i-Grade 12 kunye neNqanaba lesiZwe i-Diploma (elingulingana ne-NQF level 6) ku-Accounting okanye ku-Financial Management. I-Bachelor’s degree (elingulingana ne-NQF level 7) kuyo nayiphi na kwezi ndiy ezisemazantsi luyoncedo oluqhakamshayo. Amava angaphantsi kweminyaka emi-4 apho iminyaka engama-2 kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba le-Assistant Director okanye elifanayo afunyanwe kumazwe. Ulwazi olunamandya ngolwazi bokusebenzisa kwizipheno zokusebenza ezihamba phambili (njenge-BAS, LOGIS okanye i-PERSAL), amandyaokuqhakamsha kwaye namandya okukhokela. Ulwazi ngeenkonzo zeNtsika yaseburhulumente kwi-MTEF Process. Ulwazi ngokulungiselela i-Budgeting nokuqwalasela. Ulwazi nge-Microsoft Office ngokukodwa nge-Excel.
xh.duties: Inkululo yeNkqubo: Ukulawula uLwangemali,okuQwalaselayo nokuLawula: Lungiselela kwaye uluhlole imigangatho yokusebenza nedayim yemali, kunye nokulawulwa kwenkqubo ephambili. Qumba, qhube kwaye uxhase ukulawula iibhajeti ezokuqala nasezilungisiwenyo, kwaye unikeze igalelo le-MTEF uze udibanise iingalelo ngolungiselelo lwe-Estimates of National Expenditure (ENE). Nceda ukugcina ulwancedo olulinganisiweyo, iisheduli, kunye nemigangatho esisiseko. Xhumana nabanikezela ngeenkonzo, nabathintekayo ngaphakathi namarhulumente abalulekileyo kumacandelo ngemali, ukulawulwa kwemali kwaye nangeminye imicimbi yokusebenza. Phonononga iingxelo nyanga zonke kwaye uphando utshintsho. Qhube kwaye udibanise iingalelo zeengxelo zemisebenzi yebhajeti nyanga nganye, kwikota nganye naknyaka. Unikeze inkxaso yenkqubo yebhajeti kubaphathi kwaye uqinisekise ulungelelwaniso phakathi koqweniso lokusebenza, amacebo okuthenga kwaye nefahla etholakalayo. Ukulawula uTlawulo lweKhradenkuni nokuRhelwa: Lawula ulawulo lokutshintsha, gcina iirekhedi zemali nuiheduli ezixhasayo, kwaye ulungiselele iingxelo zokucothama kwe-cash flow nyanga nganye. Phengisisa, qinisekisa, lungisa kwaye udibanise izibhalo ezinxulumene netlawulo lokuhamba phambili, kuquka iikhadi ezibonisisa amaxabiso abangcebisi, iinvoices zabanikezelwa ngeenkonzo, iimali zelayisensi yesftware, ezinye iicelo zokuRhelwa namaxwebhu axhasayo. Lawula ukucothama kwe-cash flow kwaye unikeze iingxelo eziyisexesha ngethuba ngokutshixa ngokubaliswa kokutshintshiswa kwemali. Gcina iischeduli zotlawulo nokulandela irekhodi lemalu ahamba phambili. Qwalasela ukucosothama kwe-cash flow nakusetyenziswa imali okuvunyelweyo. Lungiselela iingxelo nyanga nganye ezimbalaniswayo nokucothama kwe-cash flow nakusetyenziswa imali. Qhube iijenali uze ulungise utshintsho ekutlawulweni kweakhradenkuni. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho nemigaqo yemali. Unikeze inkxaso nokuqwalasela ngolawulo lokutlawula nokuRhelwa. Ukulawulwa kokuBamba nalawulo lokuSebenza: Ukuvuselela iSicwangciso seSizukulwana ngokubamba kwemali seNyanga nganye kwaye ucede ukwazisa ukutshatyalaliswa kwempahla. Qinisekisa ukuthobela i-PFMA nemiqathango yeTreasury. Mbalanisela isicwangciso semali kwi-Finance nakwisebe leemali kwiTreasury yaseburhalelibazwe. Qhube ukuqinisekisa, ukutshintsha kwaye ukhusele imali enikiwe kwinqcwadi yecebo. Qwalasela ukulahleka, ukudlulisa nokutshatyalalisa imali kwaye qinisekisa ukuba axwebhu axhasayo adlule ixesha. Ukulawulwa kokuLondoloza imali kokuBhalisa: Yilawule kwaye uqhube imicimbi yolawulo lemali kwinkxaso yemigangatho yokusebenza nesicwangciso seNkqubo ephambili. Hlola ukutlawulwa, izibhalo nemali etholakalayo ukuxhasa ukulungiselela imali ngokuchanekileyo nokuthatha iigqibo. Qhube ukulungiselela nokunikezela iingxelo zokuqinisekisa imali ezimbalelwa ngokusebenza kubaphathi kwangamaxesha onke, kwikota okunyaka. Phengisisa imibalaniso, ischeduli ezixhasa kwaye nalawulo elwenza ulwazi lokugcina imali ukuqinisekisa ukugqitywa, ukuchanekileyo nokulungele ukuqwalaselwa. Qhube ukuthobela imithetho ye-PFMA, imigaqo yeTreasury, iinkqubo zemiyalezo yamaphandla kwaye neyemali ephethwe ngumthetho. Qaphela iingozi zemali, ubuthathaka belawulo nokungahambelani kokubhalelwa kwaye ucele ukulungiswa kwemiba. Unikeze iinkcukacha, izalathiso nenkxaso ngokulawula imali, kubaphathi, kubathintekayo ngaphakathi nakuqhinga lokulawula. Ukulawulwa kweZixhobo nalawulo lweeNyango: Ilawulo eluyiyindidi leofisi equka ukulawulwa kwemithi yaseburo, iinkonzo zabathunywa, incedo leofisi, ukwamkela abantu, iinkcukacha nasezinye iicelo ezithunyelwa kwi-VAS 2’s. Ukulawula ukulunga nokuphuhliswa kwemigangatho. Yenza ukulawula kwendalo kwantlandlalo equka ukugcina imigangatho yokusebenza, iingxelo zonke, qinisekisa ulungelelwaniso kwaye omnye imicimbi yolawulo yesikhululo esincinci. Misela, yenza kwaye ugcine ukulawula iinkqubo zokuThintana ezilungele ukuSebenza. Zama ukugcina ulwazi olutsha ngokubhaliswa kolawulo. Ukulawula ngobugitya iinkqubo ezingakanani nayiyo nayikuphi na efanayo. Cwangcisa kwaye wabelana ngokusebenza, lawula i-absenteeism kwaye uqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kolwazi, iimali nokuSebenza.

jobs.title: Economist: Monetary Policy and Financial Markets
jobs.summary: Economist at National Treasury in Pretoria researching monetary policy and financial markets, requiring a National Diploma in Economics or related field and 3 years' experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF level 6) in Economics or Econometrics or Finance or Statistics or Business Science or Data Science or Accounting or Mathematics Business Science or Data Science. Bachelors degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) will be an added advantage. A minimum 3 years’ experience is required in policy analysis/ academics or within an economic consulting environment. Knowledge and experience of principles of research methodology. Knowledge and experience in analysis of economic trends. Knowledge and experience of the South African economic trends and sources of data and information.
jobs.duties: Economic research, policy analysis, and assessments of policy proposals: Assist in the research and analysis of monetary policy, financial markets and the external account. Provide inputs into memorandums to the Minister and DG on economic developments in the economy. Produce independent research papers on relevant economic issues. Produce commentary on economic data releases. Provide inputs to reports on developments in the SA economy disseminated to internal stakeholders. Provide data in user-friendly format to internal stakeholders upon request. Support and build strong stakeholder relations: Provide inputs into speeches, presentations and memorandums. Engage and participate in seminars on economic policy issues. Engage stakeholders on policy and related issues. Chapter 2 of Budget and MTBPS inputs and assumptions: Provide inputs into Chapter 2 of Budget Review and MTBPS. Assist with number checking and proof reading of Budget Chapters. Provide inputs into the quarterly assumptions’ meetings.
