af.title: Ekonoom: Monetêre Beleid en Finansiële Markte
af.summary: Ekonoom by National Treasury in Pretoria wat monetêre beleid en finansiële markte ondersoek, met 'n vereiste van 'n Nasionale Diploma in Economics of 'n verwante veld en 3 jaar ondervinding.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 6) in Economics of Econometrics of Finance of Statistics of Business Science of Data Science of Accounting of Mathematics Business Science of Data Science. 'n Bachelors-graad (gelykstaande aan NQF-vlak 7) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar ondervinding word vereis in beleidsontleding/akademies of binne 'n ekonomiese konsultasie-omgewing. Kennis en ondervinding van die beginsels van navorsingsmetodologie. Kennis en ondervinding in die ontleding van ekonomiese tendense. Kennis en ondervinding van die Suid-Afrikaanse ekonomiese tendense en bronne van data en inligting.
af.duties: Ekonomiese navorsing, beleidsontleding en评估 van beleidsvoorstelle: Bystand verleen met die navorsing en ontleding van monetêre beleid, finansiële markte en die eksterne rekening. Voorsien bydraes tot memoranda aan die Minister en DG oor ekonomiese ontwikkelinge in die ekonomie. Produseer onafhanklike navorsingsartikels oor tersaaklike ekonomiese kwessies. Produseer kommentaar oor vrystellings van ekonomiese data. Voorsien bydraes tot verslae oor ontwikkelinge in die SA-economie wat aan interne belanghebbendes versprei word. Verskaf data in gebruikersvriendelike formaat aan interne belanghebbendes op versoek. Ondersteun en bou sterk belanghebbendeverhoudinge: Voorsien bydraes tot toesprake, aanbiedings en memoranda. Neem deel aan en deelneem aan seminare oor ekonomiese beleidskwessies. Skakel met belanghebbendes oor beleid en verwante kwessies. Bydraes en aannames vir Hoofstuk 2 van Budget en MTBPS: Voorsien bydraes tot Hoofstuk 2 van Budget Review en MTBPS. Bystand verleen met syferkontrolering en proeflees van Budget-hoofstukke. Voorsien bydraes tot die kwartaalvergaderings oor aannames.

zu.title: Umnotho: Inqubomgomo Yemali Kanye Nemikhakha Yezimali
zu.summary: Umnotho kwi-National Treasury e-Pretoria ocwaninga inqubomgomo yemali nasekuthengisweni kwemali, edinga i-National Diploma kwezomnotho nakumkhakha ohlobene kanye neminyaka eyi-3 yokusebenza.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka i-Grade 12 editshalwe kakhulu kanti kudingeka futhi i-National Diploma (elingana ne-NQF level 6) kwezomnotho noma i-Econometrics noma izimali noma izibalo noma i-Business Science noma i-Data Science noma i-Accounting noma i-Mathematics Business Science noma i-Data Science. I-Bachelors degree (elingana ne-NQF level 7) izoba yinsetshenzelwa enkulu. Kudingeka ukuba nomumo wokusebenza okungeminyaka eyi-3 ekufeni inqubomgomo/ ezingeni lemfundo ephezulu noma endaweni yokubamba izwi ngomnotho. Ulwazi futhi nokusebenza ngemigqa yendlela yokucwaninga. Ulwazi nokusebenza ekuhlaziyeni imigqa yezomnotho. Ulwazi futhi nokusebenza mayelana nemigqa yezomnotho yase-South Africa futhi kumithombo yedatha yaziwa kanti futhi nolwazi.
zu.duties: Ucwaningo lwezomnotho, ukuhlaziya inqubomgomo, kanye nokuhlola iziphakamiso zequbo: Siza ekucwaningeni nasekuhlaziyeni inqubomgomo yemali, imikhakha yezimali kanye nenani elingaphandle. Nikela ngeminikelo emibhalweni ethunyelwa kwaMinister kanye no-DG mayelana nokuthuthuka kwezomnotho kule ndawo. Hlola futhi ubhale amaphepha ocwaningo ngamaphuzu abalulekile mayelana nezomnotho. Bhala imibono mayelana nedatha yezomnotho evunyelwe ukuthi ishicilelwe. Nikela ngeminikelo emibhalweni mayelana nokuqhubeka kwezomnotho kule ndawo egudluzelwa abasenzo bangaphakathi. Hlinzeka ngedatha ngendlela elula kubasenzo bangaphakathi uma beyicela. Sekela futhi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nababambisene nabo: Nikela ngeminikelo ezinkulumweni, kubukhweni ngaphambi kommelwane kanye namabalwa. Bandakanyeka futhi uthathe inxaxheba kuma-seminars mayelana namaphuzu enqubomgomo yezomnotho. Khuluma nababambisene nabo mayelana nenqubomgomo kanye namaphuzu ahlobene nayo. Okufakwayo kusuka kwi-Chapter 2 ye-Budget kanye ne-MTBPS kanye nezinkolelo-zenkolelo: Nikela ngeminikelo kwi-Chapter 2 ye-Budget Review kanye ne-MTBPS. Siza ukugqamba amanani kanye nokuqamba okubhalwayo kuma-Chapter e-Budget. Nikela ngeminikelo kuhlelo lokuhlangana nezinkolelo-zenkolelo zenyanga ezinhathu.

xh.summary: Itshintshelo kwamandla emali eMzantsi Afrika, ebuya ngeenkqubo zethutyana ezibekiweyo nokuqwalaselwa ngokomgaqo-nkqubo kunye nezithuba ezifunwa ngumntu ongcali kwisebe le-6 le-6 level kwiNqanaba le-6 le-6 level, ethanda ukwenza imisebenzi yokuhluza nokuphucula iinkqubo ze-6. Kukho iNqanaba le-6 le-6 level efunwa kubomi be-6 level, 6 level, kwindalo ekwangoku.

I-Nqanaba le-7 lefom yesebe le-7) liza kuba lundoqo. Kufuneka kube namava eminyaka emi-3 ngethamsanqa ngentlalutya yeNkqubo yangaphakathi
xh.duties: Uphando lwamandla emali, uhlalutyo lweenkqubo, nokuqikelela iinjongo zeenkqubo: Siza kuphando nokuhlalutya inkqubo yemali, iimarike zemali nakwinqanaba lwangaphandle. Nikela ngeengeniso kwimemo ezisiwa kwiNgangelosi nakwiNqanaba eliphezulu ngemiba yamandla emali nakwindalo. Velisa amaphepha ephando angathathi ndawo kumiba ethile yamandla emali. Velisa izimvo malunga nokukhululwa kwamandla emali. Nikela ngeengeniso kumabali ngemiba ekwindalo yamandla emali aseMzantsi Afrika eveliswa kubaphathi abangaphakathi. Nikezela ngedatha kulungiselelo olulula kubaphathi abangaphakathi ngenkufunwa. Xhasa uze wakhe iindibaniselwano ezomeleza nabaphathi: Nikela ngeengeniso kwintetho, iintonaga nakwimemo. Thatha inxaxheba kumaziko aphathwa ngokumigaqo yamandla emali. Qhagamshelana nabaphathi ngemigaqo nangemiba ehlobene nayo. Iingxoxo ziika-2 zeSicatulo seNgeno nemicimbi ye-MTBPS nengeniso: Nikela ngeengeniso kwiSahluko 2 sikaLoluvo loMgunyaziso weNgeno nase-MTBPS. Siza ngokujonga amanani nokuqwalasela iisahluko zesiCatulo seNgengeno. Nikela ngeengeniso kwiindibano zeenyanga zethatu ezimalunga nengeniso.

jobs.title: Scientist Production Grade a - C
jobs.salary_text: R791 157 – R1 189 767 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package), (Offer will be based on proven years of experience)
jobs.summary: Scientist Production Grade A–C at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria, conducting flood frequency assessments and hydraulic modelling for dam safety purposes.
jobs.requirements: A Science degree (BSc) (Hon) or relevant qualification. Compulsory registration with the SACNASP as a professional Natural Scientist. Three (3) years post-qualification Natural Science experience, preferably in flood frequency analysis (deterministic, empirical and statistical), hydraulic modelling, water resource simulation and yield modelling. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Understanding of hydrological processes. Knowledge of the application of models such as HEC-RAS, the Water Resource Simulation Model 2000 (WRSM 2000), Water Resource Yield Model (WRYM), the CLASSR/PATCHR and/or similar models. Experience in programme and project management. Scientific methodologies and models. Understanding of research and development. Computer-aided scientific applications. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Creating high-performance culture. Professional judgement. Data analysis, policy development and analysis. Presentation and monitoring skills. Decision- making, team leadership and analytical skills. Creativity, financial management, customer focus and responsiveness. Good communication skills both verbal and written. Networking and computer literacy (including MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, ArcGIS). People management, planning and organising. Conflict and change management. Problem-solving and analysis. Willingness to travel throughout South Africa for the execution of duties whilst working irregular hours.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be part of a team of hydrologists, primarily engaged in flood frequency assessments for dam safety purposes. Such work will include (but not limited to): assisting colleagues with coordination of assigned work; assisting with flood data collection such as during and after extreme flood events and converting the flood data into hydrological information; extension and improvement of ratings and filling of gaps in data, etc. to improve the quality of hydrological information; execute acquisition and verification of relevant data and information for use in hydrological and flood frequency (deterministic, empirical and statistical) analyses and assessments at relevant flood sites; presenting findings of assessments at evaluation meetings and writing technical reports; assist with the undertaking of the water resource and yield studies and hydraulic assessments.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie Graad A - C
af.summary: Wetenskaplike Produksie Vlak A–C by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria, wat oorvloedfrekwensie-assesserings en hidroliese modellering vir damveiligheidsdoeleindes uitvoer.
af.requirements: 'n Wetenskaplike graad (BSc) (Hon) of tersaaklike kwalifikasie. Verpligte registrasie by die SACNASP as 'n professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Drie (3) jaar post-kwalifikasie Natuurwetenskaplike ervaring, by voorkeur in oorvloedfrekwensie-analise (deterministies, empiries en statisties), hidroliese modellering, waterbronsimulasie en opbrengsmodellering. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie. Begrip van hidrologiese prosesse. Kennis van die toepassing van modelle soos HEC-RAS, die Water Resource Simulation Model 2000 (WRSM 2000), Water Resource Yield Model (WRYM), die CLASSR/PATCHR en/of soortgelyke modelle. Ervaring in program- en projekbestuur. Wetenskaplike metodes en modelle. Begrip van navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaarondersteunde wetenskaplike toepassings. Kennis van regsvoorskrifte. Tegniese verslag-skryf. Skep van 'n hoëprestasie-kultuur. Professionele oordeel. Data-analise, beleidsontwikkeling en analise. Voorleggings- en moniteringsvaardighede. Besluitneming, spanleierskap en analitiese vaardighede. Skeppendheid, finansiële bestuur, klintefokus en reaksievermoë. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide mondeling en skriftelik. Netwerk bou en rekenaarvaardigheid (insluitend MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, ArcGIS). Mensebestuur, beplanning en organisering. Konflik- en veranderingsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise. Bereidwilligheid om deur die hele South Africa te reis vir die uitvoering van pligte terwyl onreëlmatige ure gewerk word.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal deel wees van 'n span hidroloë wat hoofsaaklik betrokke is by oorvloedfrekwensie-assesserings vir damveiligheidsdoeleindes. Sulke werk sal onder meer (maar nie beperk nie) die volgende insluit: help van kollegas met die koördinering van toegewysde werk; behulpsaam met die versameling van oorvloeddata soos tydens en na uiterste oorvloedgebeure en die omskakeling van oorvloeddata in hidrologiese inligting; uitbreiding en verbetering van graderings en invulling van gapings in data, ens. om die kwaliteit van hidrologiese inligting te verbeter; uitvoer van verkryging en verifikasie van tersaaklike data en inligting vir gebruik in hidrologiese en oorvloedfrekwensie (deterministiese, empiriese en statistiese) analises en assesserings by tersaaklike oorvloedterreine; voorlegging van bevindings van assesserings by evaluasievergaderings en die skryf van tegniese verslae; behulpsaam met die onderneming van waterbron- en opbrengstudies en hidroliese assesserings.

zu.title: Usayensi Ukukhiqiza Izinga A - C
zu.summary: Usayensi Ukukhiqiza Izinga A–C eDepartment of Water and Sanitation ePretoria, ukwenza ukulinganisa ukuvamise kwamanani amafulethi kanye nokumodela kwamakhompyutha ngenhlobonhlobo yokuphepha izibuko.
zu.requirements: I-degree yeSayensi (BSc) (Hon) noma izifundo ezihambisana nalesi. Ukubhaliswa ngokuphoqelelo ne-SACNASP njengesayensi yemvelo ejwayelekile. Unyaka abayisithupha (3) ngemva kokuthola izifundo isipiliyono eSayensi Yemvelo, ikakhulukazi kuhlaziyo lokuvamise kwamanani amafulethi (okweqiniso, okuhlola kanye nokubala), ukumodela kwamakhompyutha, ukulinganiswa kwemithombo yamanzi kanye nokumodela kokukhiqiza. Ukwaziswa kwelayisense yokushayela ephathekayo eseyiphumelelwe isikhathi. Ukuqonda izinkambiso zokuhlangana kwamanzi. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kwamamodeli njenge-HEC-RAS, i-Water Resource Simulation Model 2000 (WRSM 2000), i-Water Resource Yield Model (WRYM), i-CLASSR/PATCHR kanye/noma amamodeli afanayo. Isipiliyono ekuphathweni kwemikhiqizo kanye namaphrojekthi. Izindlela zesayensi nezibonakaliso. Ukuqonda ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zesayensi ezisebenziswa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukudala isiko lokusebenza kahle kakhulu. Ukwahlulela ngobuchwepheshe. Ukuhlaziya idatha, intuthuko yomthethosisekelo kanye nokuhlaziya. Amakhono okwethula kanye nokuqapha. Ukwenza izinqumo, ukubeke phambili ithimba kanye namakhono okuhlaziya. Ukubumba, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukugxila kwindaba kanye nokucomba. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle kokubili okuthathu ngomlomo nokubhaliwe. Ukuxhumana nobuntu nokuba nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (okuhlanganisa i-MS Word, i-MS Excel, i-MS PowerPoint, i-ArcGIS). Ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuhlela kanye nokuhlela. Ukuphathwa kwezingxabano kanye noshintsho. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kulo lonke iSouth Africa ukuze kuqedywe imisebenzi kuyilawo ukuhamba ngezingxenye ezingajwayelekile zesikhathi.
zu.duties: Ophumelele uyoba yingxenye yethimba labahlanganisi bamanzi, ababandakanyekakhulu ekulinganisweni kokuvamise kwamanani amafulethi ngenhlobonhlobo yokuphepha izibuko. Lomsebenzi uzohlanganisa (kodwa ungangabikhona kunqunyelwe): ukusiza abasebenzi ngenhlelelo komsebenzi onikiwe; ukusiza nangokutholwa kwedatha yamafulethi njengasikhathini nasemuva kwezehlo ezinkulu zamafulethi kanye nokuguqula idatha yamafulethi ibe yolwazi ngamanzi; ukwandisa kanye nokuthuthukisa amanani kanye nokugcwalisa izikhala kwidatha, njll. ukuthuthukisa izinga lolwazi ngamanzi; ukwenza ukulandwa kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwedatha ehlobene nolwazi olusetshenziswa ekuhlaziyweni nokulinganiswa kwamanzi kanye nokuvamise kwamanani amafulethi (okweqiniso, okuhlola kanye nokubala) emasiteshi amafulethi ahlobene; ukwethula imiphumela yokulinganisa emihlanganweni yokuqapha kanye nokubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe; ukusiza ekwenzeni ucwaningo lwemithombo yamanzi kanye nokukhiqiza kanye nokuqapha amakhompyutha.

xh.title: I-Scientist Production Grade A - C
xh.summary: I-Scientist Production Grade A–C kwiDepartment of Water and Sanitation ePretoria, ebeka amava aqwalasela rhoqo amaza nokulinganisa amanzu ngenjongo yokhuseleko lwamadama.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sayenzati sayensi (BSc) (Hon) okanye izidanga ezifanelekileyo. Ukubhalwa kuSACNASP njengosenyazi sayensi sendalo kuyaphothulwa. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kwisenyazi sayensi sendalo emva kokufumana isidanga, ngokukhethwa kakhulu kwihlalutyo lokubakho rhoqo kwamaza (ezichasiweyo, ezenziwe ngokweenkqubo nakwezibaluleko), ukulinganisa ukusetyenziswa kwamanzi, nokulinganisa imveliso yamanzi. Ukuvumbula ilayisenisi yokushayela evuselelweyo esebenzayo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zamaza. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kweemodeli ezinjengeHEC-RAS, iWater Resource Simulation Model 2000 (WRSM 2000), iWater Resource Yield Model (WRYM), iCLASSR/PATCHR nokwezinye iimodeli ezifanayo. Amava kulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Iindlela zoyilo nezimodeli zesayensi. Ukuqonda uphando nolimo. Izicelo zesayensis ezixhaswa yikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokuthobela umthetho. Ukubhala iingxelo zobugcisa. Ukudala isiko lomsebenzi wamgangatho ophezulu. Isigqibo sobungcali. Ukuhlalutya iinkcukacha, uphuhliso lweenkqazo nohlalutyo. Amava wokubonisa nokulawula. Isakhono sokwenza izigqibo, intloko yeqela nosakhono sohlalutyo. Ukuyila, ulawulo lweemali, ukujongana nabathengi nokusabela. Isakhono sobuqwethu ngesandi nasemabhalweni. Ukuqhabisanisa nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (kuquka iMS Word, iMS Excel, iMS PowerPoint, iArcGIS). Ulawulo labantu, uqhubo nolungiselelo. Ulawulo loxhatsho lwexesha lutsha noluguquko. Ukusombulula iingxaki nohlalutyo. Ukulungelelanisa ukuhamba kuwo onke amazwe ase South Africa ngenjongo yokwenza imisebenzi ngelixa usebenza iiyure ezingaqhelekanga.
xh.duties: Umntu ofunyanwe kuya kuba ngomnye wesebe labantu abaqeqeshiweyo kumanzi, abaphathe ngokubakho imisebenzi yokulinganisa ukubakho rhoqo kwamaza abanzi ngenjongo yokhuseleko lwamadama. Olo msebenzi uya kuquka (kodwa ungadingiwe): ukuncedisa abalingane nolungiselelweni lomsebenzi onikeziweyo; ukuncedisa ekuyileni iinkcukacha ezimalunga namaza abanzi njengexesha nangemva kokuba kweziganeko zamaza abanzi angenanzo, nokuguqula ezo nkcukacha zaba lilwazi ngenjongo yamaza; ukwandisa nokuphucula ukulinganisa nokuzalisa iindawo ezingenanto kwinkcukacha, njl. ukuphucula umgangatho wolwazi ngenjongo yamaza; ukwenza ukulanda nokunqanda iinkcukacha nolwazi olufanelekileyo lokusetyenziswa kwolanlwazi nakuqwalaselo lokubakho rhoqo kwamaza (ezichasiweyo, ezenziwe ngokweenkqubo nakwezibaluleko) nakuqwalaselo kwindawo yamaza abanzi; ukubonisa iziphumo zoqwalaselo kwiminyhadala yokuqwalasela nokubhala iingxelo zobugcisa; ukuncedisa ekwenzeni iifundo zamaza ngenjongo yokulinganisa amaza nokulinganisa ubukho bamaza.

jobs.title: Scientist Production Grade a - C
jobs.salary_text: R791 604 – R1 189 767 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package), (Offer will be based on proven years of experience)
jobs.summary: Manage geohydrological monitoring and assessment, including scientific analysis and regulatory functions for groundwater resources at the Pretoria Head Office.
jobs.requirements: A Science degree (BSc) (Hon) or related qualification in the field of Hydrogeology/ Geohydrology or related field. Compulsory registration with SACNASP as a professional Natural Scientist. Three (3) years post qualification Natural Scientific experience. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Experience and knowledge of groundwater resource monitoring, assessment (including geophysical survey) and turning groundwater data into information. Basic knowledge of groundwater related analysis tools such as GIS and related models such as MODFLOW. Ability to conduct research, interpret data and communicate findings verbally or in writing.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement methodologies, policies, systems and procedures for Geohydrological monitoring and assessment. To perform scientific analysis and regulatory functions on the process of geohydrological monitoring and assessment. Review and design optimal national groundwater level and quality monitoring programmes and networks. Mentor, train and develop candidate scientists and others to promote skills/knowledge transfer and adherence to sound scientific principles and code of practice. Gather and interpret data, evaluate results, model and disseminate geohydrological information to various stakeholders. Communicate geohydrological information to various internal and external stakeholders as part of annual Groundwater status report. Manage the performance and development of staff. Contribute to global water agenda and related international projects.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie Graad a - C
af.summary: Bestuur geohidrologiese monitering en assessering, insluitend wetenskaplike analise en reguleringsfunksies vir grondwaterhulpbronne by die Pretoria Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: 'n Wetenskapgraad (BSc) (Hon) of verwante kwalifikasie in die veld van Hidrogeologie/ Geohidrologie of 'n verwante veld. Verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as 'n professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Drie (3) jaar post-kwalifikasie Natuurwetenskaplike ervaring. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige onvervalde bestuurderslisensie. Ervaring en kennis van grondwaterhulpbronmonitering, assessering (insluitend geofisiese opname) en die omskakeling van grondwaterdata tot inligting. Basiese kennis van grondwaterverwante analise-instrumente soos GIS en verwante modelle soos MODFLOW. Vermoë om navorsing te doen, data te interpreteer en bevindings mondeling of skriftelik te kommunikeer.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en implementeer metodologieë, beleid, stelsels en prosedures vir geohidrologiese monitering en assessering. Voer wetenskaplike analise en reguleringsfunksies uit oor die proses van geohidrologiese monitering en assessering. Hersien en ontwerp optimale nasionale grondwaterpeil- en gehaltemoniteringsprogramme en -netwerke. Mentorkandidate, lei en ontwikkel kandidaatwetenskaplikes en ander om oordrag van vaardighede/kenntenis en nakoming van gesonde wetenskaplike beginsels en kode van praktyk te bevorder. Versamel en interpreteer data, evalueer resultate, modelleer en versprei geohidrologiese inligting aan verskeie belanghebbendes. Kommunikeer geohidrologiese inligting aan verskeie interne en eksterne belanghebbendes as deel van die jaarlikse grondwaterstatusverslag. Bestuur die werkverrigting en ontwikkeling van personeel. Dra by tot die globale wateragenda en verwante internasionale projekte.

zu.title: Usosayensi Wokukhiqiza izinga a - C
zu.summary: Phatha ukulawula nokuhlola izinto ezingaphansi komhlaba ezibhekene namanzi, okuhlanganisa ukuhlaziywa kwesayensi nemisebenzi ehlobene nemithetho yamanzi angaphansi komhlaba ePretoria Head Office.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeSayensi (BSc) (Hon) noma isiqu esihlobene ebangan i-Hydrogeology/ Geohydrology noma elinye igunya elihlobene. Ukubhaliswa okuyimfuneko ku-SACNASP njengososayensi wezemvelo ongumingi. Iminyaka eyi-three (3) yokusebenza kwesayensi yemvelo emva kokuqeda iziqu. Ukuzivumela nge-drivers license evuzayo engakapheli. Ukhulele nokwazi ukulawula nokuhlola imithombo yamanzi angaphansi komhlaba, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola izinto ezingaphansi komhlaba nokuqhuba idatha yamanzi angaphansi komhlaba ibe ulwazi. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngamathuluzi okuhlaziya izinto ezingaphansi komhlaba njenge-GIS namamodeli ahlobene njenge-MODFLOW. Ikono lokwenza ucwaningo, ukuhumusha idatha nokudlulisa izimphumela ngomlomo nangesibhalo.
zu.duties: Bumba futhi usebenzise izindlela, izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo namaphrosthedha ekulawuleneni nokuhlohleni izinto ezingaphansi komhlaba. Ukwenza ukuhlaziywa kwesayensi nemisebenzi ehlobene nemithetho endleleni yokulawula nokuhlola izinto ezingaphansi komhlaba. Phinda ubuke futhi udize izinhlelo nezinkimbinkimbi ezihlelekile zezwe lonke zokulawula izinga nokuqonda ubuhle bamanzi angaphansi komhlaba. Qondisa, qeqesha futhi uthuthukise ososayensi abasafunda nabanye ukuze kube nokudluliselwa amakhono/ulwazi kanye nokulandelwa kwemigiqelo yesayensi efezekile nekhowudi yokwenza imisebenzi. Qoqa futhi uhumushe idatha, hlola izimphumela, vezwa futhi ulule olwazi ngamanzi angaphansi komhlaba kubahlaleki abahlukene. Dlulisa ulwazi ngamanzi angaphansi komhlaba kubahlaleki bangaphakathi nangaphandle njengengxenye yombiko wonyaka wesimo samanzi angaphansi komhlaba. Phatha ukusebenza kokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Yifa kuhle lokuzwakalwa kwamanzi emhlabeni jikelele namaphulo amazwe ngamazwe ahlobene nawo.

xh.title: Isayensi Umveliso Inqanaba A - C
xh.summary: Ukulawula ulwando nokuqwalasela kwejohayidroloji, kuquka uhlalutyo lwesayensi nemisebenzi yokulawula malunga namathambo amanzi e-Pretoria Head Office.
xh.requirements: Isidanga kwiSayensi (BSc) (Hon) okanye izifundo ezinxulumene nayo kwinkundla ye-Hydrogeology/Geohydrology okanye inkundla enxulumene nayo. Ubhalo obuyiyo nge-SACNASP njengesayensi yendalo ngobuchwepeshe. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava obuchwepeshe bemveliso kwiSayensi yendalo emva kwezifundo. Ukuzisa ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo nengangazange iphelelwe lixesha. Amava nolwazi ngolwando namathambo amanzi, uqwalaselo (kuquka upando lwejofizikh) nokuguqula idatha yamathambo amanzi ibe ngolwazi. Ulwazi olusiseko lwezixhobo zohlalutyo ezingqamana namathambo amanzi ezinjenge-GIS namamodeli anxulumene nawo njenge-MODFLOW. Ikhono lokwenza uphando, ukuqonda idatha nokusabela iziphumo ngomlomo okanye ngokubhalwayo.
xh.duties: Yakha uze usebenzise iindlela, iinkqubo, izixhobo nemiqathango yokulwanda noqwalaselo kwejohayidroloji. Ukwenza uhlalutyo lwesayensi nemisebenzi yokulawula kwindlela yokulwanda noqwalasela kwejohayidroloji. Phinda uhlole uze wakhiwe iinkqubo namanethiwekhi aphanayo wezizwe jikelele ekuqwalaselweni kwinqanaba nengakanani kwamathambo amanzi. Yaleka, qeqesha uze uphucule izayensi ezingamagqatswa nabanye ukukhuthaza ukuhanjiswa kolwazi/abukho kwaye kugcinwe imigaqo yobuchwepeshe esisiseko nekhowudi yokwenza umsebenzi. Qokelela uze uqonde idatha, qwalasela iziphumo, yila uze usasaze ulwazi lwejohayidroloji kubo bonke abanomdla. Yaziisa ulwazi lwejohayidroloji kbo bonke abanomdla bangaphakathi nangaphandle njengesigaba sexesha lidanywe elingaballi lwe-Groundwater status report. Lawula inkqubo yomsebenzi nophuculo labasebenzi. Yiba negalelo kwagenda yamanye amazwe amanzi nakuqeqesho lwamazwe ngamazwe eluxhubene nalo.

af.title: Beheer Ingenieurstechnikus Graad a
af.summary: Beheer Ingenieurstechnikus om tegniese hidrologiese dienste en waterbroninfrastruktuur vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Kimberley te bestuur.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma in Siviele Ingenieurswese. Ses (6) jaar na kwalifikasie in tegniese Ingenieurswese-ervaring. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Ingenieurstechnikus. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstrykte bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van tegniese ontwerp en analise van hidrologiese infrastruktuur en/of waterbroninfrastruktuur. Kennis van hidrologiese databestuur. Begrip van navorsing en ontwikkeling. Kennis en ervaring in rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Kennis van regsonderhoud en projekbestuur. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik), konflikbestuur en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en analise, besluitneming, spanwerk, kreatiwiteit, finansiële bestuur, mensebestuur, klantfokus, reaksievermoë, beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste en ondersteuning in samewerking met Ingenieurs, Tegnoloë en medewerkers in die veld, werkswinkel, en tegniese hidrologiese aktiwiteite. Verseker die bevordering van veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulasievereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge, en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie in te sluit. Verseker gehaldeborging van tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en magtig/maak aanbevelings vir goedkeuring deur die betrokke gesag. Bestuur administratiewe, menslike hulpbron en verwante funksies. Verskaf insette in die begrotingsproses, operasionele plan, aanbestedingsplan en verwante aangeleenthede. Stel verslae op en dien dit in soos vereis. Anders Risiko- en Rampbestuursaangeleenthede. Navorsing en ontwikkeling deur deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Verskaf mentorskap en toesig van personeel. Navorsing/literatuurstudies oor tegniese ingenieurstegnologie om kundigheid te verbeter. Skakel met relevante liggame/raade oor ingenieurswegerigte aangeleenthede. zu.title: Control Engineering Technician Grade a
zu.summary: I-Control Engineering Technician ukulawula imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe yamanzi kanye nezinsiza zamanzi ze-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Kimberley.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma ku-Civil Engineering. Kweminyaka emithandathu (6) emva kokuqeqeshwa kwamakhono wobuchwepheshe. Ukubhaliswa ngamaphoyisa njengoba kudingwa kwi-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengoba kungummeli wobuchwepheshe. Ukusaza kwamalungiselelo ebhajethi okusemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemikakho yobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya imikakho yamanzi bese kubandakanya imikakho yezinsiza zamanzi. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwemininingwane yamanzi. Ukuqonda ucwaningo kanye nokuthuthukisa. Ulwazi namakhono ekusebenziseni izinhlela zokusebenza ezinzima. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho kanye nokuLawula iphrojekthi. Ukuhlela amaphuzu eNcwadi zobuchwepheshe. Amandla okuxhumana kahle (ngomlomo nangokubhala), ukulawula ingxabano kanye namandla okuxoxisana. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda, ukwenza izinqumo, ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukuqamba, ukulawula imali, ukulawula abantu, ukugxila kumthengi, ukuphendula, ukuhlela kanye nokuqondisa.
zu.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yobuchwepheshe nolwesekelo kanye nabakhiqizi, izinzululwazi kanye nabahlobo emzileni, esitshalweni, kanye nemicimbi yobuchwepheshe yamanzi. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kokuphepha ngokuhambisana nemithetho nemiyalo. Hlola izincwadi zobuchwepheshe ezingaphilanga, imidwayizo ejwayelekile, kanye nezinhlaka zokusebenza ukuze kufakwe ezobuchwepheshe ezisha. Qinisekisa izinga lobuchwepheshe emikakweni ngemithetho yohlelo futhi nikela/ngakha izincomo ezinamagunya okuphepha kubandakanye igunya eliphathelene. Phatha imisebenzi yolawulo, abantu kanye nemisebenzi ephathelene nikela mininingwane enqubongweni yokwenza ibhajethi, iplani yokusebenza, iplani yokuThenga kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile. Hlela beseuthumela amaphuzu njengoba kudingeka. Zulu izinto ezingamaphepha ukulawula kanye Nokulawula ingozi. Ucwaningo kanye nokuthuthukisa ngokuphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo ukuze ugqame ezobuchwepheshe ezisha kanye nezinhlela zokusebenza. Nikela ngomholo kanye nokuqondisa abantu. Ucwaningo/Imfundo yezincwadi zobuchwepheshe ukuze kwandiswe ulwazi. Yenza unxibelelwano namaphoyili/amakhonsadhi ezinto ezihlobene nobuchwepheshe. Kufanele ukubekezela ekusebenzeni kude nenhla futhi uhambe ibanga elide isikhathi eside.

xh.title: Control Engineering Technician Grade a
xh.summary: UmPhathi wezobuChwephesha obhekisa kuzolawulo ukuze aphathe iinkonzo zobuchwephesha be-hydrological kunye nobuchwephesha obusebenzisa amanzi baseBe leManzi nokuQhushumbisa iindonga zomlambo eKimberley.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma kwisiGxina sobuChwephesha. Ukusuka emva kweminyaka emithandathu (6) ukuba negunya elingekho ngaphantsi kobuchwephesha beBangel. Ukuqatyiwa ukubhalwa kwiBhunga labaBengi baseMzantsi Afrika (ECSA) njengomPhathi wezobuChwephesha. Ukwazisa ngeelayisensi yokuqhuba ekanempilo ngokusemthethweni engaphelelwa lixesha. Ukwazi ubuchwephesha bomdwebo bobuchwephesha nokuthungatha iinkcukacha zobuchwephesha zobakho okanye iindlela ezithengwayo zokwenza imisebenzi. Ukwazi ubuchwephesha beendaba ezibhekisa kumanzi. Ukuqonda ukuphandla nokuphuhlisa. Ukwazi nokusebenza ngeenkqubo zekhompyutha ezibhekisa kubuchwephesha bokwakhiwo. Ukwazi izinto ezibhekisa kumthetho wokuzelelwano noLawulo lweziPhango. Ukubhala iingxelo zobuchwephesha. Amandla okuqukuqela abantu ababini (ngokuthetha nokubhala), ukulawula iingxunguphu namandla okulingana. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuziqhelanisa, ukwenza iigqibo, ukusebenza njengeqela, ukuyila, ukulawula iimali, ukulawula abantu, ukujongana nabathengi, ukusabela, ukulungiselela nokuhlela.
xh.duties: Phatha iinkonzo ezobuchwephesha nenkxaso kunye noBachwephesha, abaNjingalwazi nabaQhagamshelana kwindawo, kwindawo yokusebenza, nakumisebenzi yobuchwephesha ye-hydrological. Qinisekisa ukuthuthuzela kokhuseleko ngokwemigiqwalo nemithetho. Linganisa imanuals ezikhoyo zobuchwephesha, iimpawu ezijwele kakhulu zodweliso, neenkqubo ukuze kungeniswe新技术. Qinisekisa ıkhwalithi yemizobo zobuchwephesha ngokwemigaqo yayo uvume/zenze izindululo ezimayela nokuqatywa ngumphathi ofanelekileyo. Phatha imisebenzi yolawulo, imisebenzi ebhekisa kubantu nayo yonke eminye imisebenzi ephathelene nayo. Nikela izimvo kwingqongo yesikhawulezo, kwinqubo yokwenza isicwangciso sokusebenza, isicwangciso sokuthenga, nakwezinye izinto ezidibana nazo. Hlela uze ungenise iingxelo njengoko kufuneka. Ngenisa izinto ezibhekisa kwiNgxwule nakuLawulo leeNxaxheba. Uphononongo nentlutho ngokuphila kokuphuhlisa ngokuqhubekayo komsebenzi ukuze ugqamele iindlela ezintsha zobuchwephesha neenkqubo. Nikeza inkxaso-makhono lolawulo kubasebenzi. Uphononongo/izifundo zobuchwephesha kobuchwephesha bokwakhiwo ukuphucula amandla obuchwephesha. Qhagamshela nabalambe/bakumagunya amagunya ngokwemiba ebhekise kubuchwephesha. Makabe lukhululekile ukuba wamkele ukusebenza kude nendawo yakokusebenza aze ahamba kakhulu ixesha elide.

Kennis en begrip van openbare diensbeleide en administratiewe prosedures. Kennis van basiese finansiële bestuur en PFMA. Kennis van geskillebeslegtingsproses. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet hoogs betroubaar, selfgemotiveerd, buigsaam, kreatief, kliënt- en klantgefokus wees. Bly op hoogte van die voorskrifte, beleide en prosedures wat van toepassing is op haar/sy werksterrein om doeltreffende en doeltroonde ondersteuning aan die Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal te verseker. Goeie verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Bestuur en koördineer die vloei van inligting binne die kantoor van die Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal. Lewer uitvoerende administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste aan die Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal. Aankope van goedere en dienste, verseker dat die bate-register opgedateer word, help met die koördinering van maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae. Kwaliteitsversekering van dokumentasie en bly op hoogte van openbare voorskrifte, beleide en prosedures wat van toepassing is op die werksterrein om doeltreffende ondersteuning aan die Kantoor van die Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal te verseker. Stel korrespondensie en verslae op aan tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Verseker 'n doeltreffende en doeltroonde rekordbestuurstelsel vir alle voorleggings en korrespondensie. Bestuur die elektroniese indiening en voorleggings van die Tak. Koördineer en reël/reël werkswinkels, vergaderings en strategiese beplanningssessies. Verteenwoordig die bestuurder by sekere vergaderings en werkswinkels. Bestuur navrae van die kantoor van die Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal. Bestuur van finansiële en menslike hulpbronne in die Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal. Opstel van die begroting in ooreenstemming met MTEF en PFMA en fasiliteer die proses van begrotingsprojeksie met alle projekbestuurders. Monitor maandelikse en kwartaallikse begrotingsbesteding.

zu.title: Umphathi Wehhovisi
zu.summary: Phatha futhi uhlobole ukugeleza kolwazi futhi ukhombise ukusekelwa ngamasevisi abucwepheshe kuSekela Mongameli Jikelele ePretoria Head Office.
zu.requirements: Isimfundo esifanele samazinga ayi-NQF level 6 ekuPhathweni kokuHulumeni, ekuPhathweni ekuBuseni kanye nokuPhathwa kwabantu. Ukuphila iminyaka emihlanu (5) ngokusebenza ngamasevisi esekelwa komkhakha wezobhalo kuMphathi ophakeme. Ubuchwepheshe obuphezulu okubhaleni kumphumela wohlelo lweMicrosoft Office. Amakhono amahle okuphatha ihhovisi kanye namaxubhulu wezinsizakalo ezingabucwepheshe bokusekela. Amakhono aqhakambisayo aphathelene nokuhlela futhi aqhakambisa ukuthungwa ngaphambili. Amakhono aphumelelayo okuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukwethembeka okuhle kanye nokuziphatha okuhle ngokomculo. Ukubalula ihenqwecwexe yetherekisi lesitimela egqamile nengiphelelwe yisikhathi. Ulwazi kanye neqinisekiso ngamapholisi amnyangweni wezinkomfa kanye namaxubhulu abucwepheshe bokuphathwa kwezobhalo. Ulwazi ngokuPhathwa kwemali ebasic kanye nePFMA. Ulwazi lenganqubo yokuxazulula izinkingi. Abantu kanye nokuPhathwa kwezinhlobo ezahlukene. Ukuxazulula izinkingi kanye nokuqonda inqubo. Umuntu okhethwe kumele abe nokuzethemba okuphezulu, azigqugquzele, abe nokuguquguquka, abe nokudala njalo, aqondiswe kumthengi futhi aqondiswe kumthengiwo. Uyigcine uhamba nesikhathi ngamapholisi, amapholisi namaxubhulu asetshenziswa endaweni yakhe yokusebenza ukuze aqinisekise ukusekelwa okuphumelelayo futhi okusebenzayo kuSekela Mongameli Jikelele. Ukwethembeka okuhle kanye nokuziphatha okuhle ngokomculo.
zu.duties: Qondisa futhi uhlobole ukugeleza kolwazi ngaphakathi kwelisebenzi leSekela Mongameli Jikelele. Nikela amasevisi abalulekile abuncipha abavela komsebenzi wezobhalo kuSekela Mongameli Jikelele. Ukuthenga izimpahla nezinsizakalo, qinisekisa ukuthi usuku lokubhalisa izimpahla luhamisekeke, siza ekuhlelweni kwezibiko zeminye yonke, yenyanga zonke kanye nezomnyaka. Ukugunyaza izinga lekhasibuso futhi ugcine ukuba nesikhathi ngemithetho, izinqubomgomo kanye namasu esabhalo ukusetshenziswa endaweni yokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiselwe ukweseka okusebenzayo kuMsebenzi kaSekela Mongameli Jikelele. Bhala izinhlamvu nokubika kubantu abahlotshaniswe nomsebenzi. Qinisekisa isimiso esisebenzayo nesiphumelelayo sokuphathwa kwezibhalo zonke izithakazelo nezinhlanhlu. Phatha ukuvaliwa kwezibhalo ngokubhalisa kwekhomphyutha nokuthunyelwa kwesoHlangothi. Hlela futhi ulungise / uhlele amakhono asukwamkhakha, izinkundla kanye nesikhathi esihleliwe sophangiso. Mela Umphathi emikhakheni ethile yamakhosi nezikhungo. Phatha imibuzo yomsebenzi kaSekela Mongameli Jikelele. Ukuphathwa kwezimali nabantu basebenzayo kuSekela Mongameli Jikelele. Ukuhlela izabelo zemali ngokuhambisana neMTEF kanye nePFMA futhi ukhokhe inqubo yokuqagela izabelo zonke abaphathi bemikhakha. Qapha ukuchithwa kwesabelo semali nyanga zonke nenyanga yamakhulu.

xh.title: Umphathi weOfisi
xh.summary: Phatha uhlu lulwe ukutya kolwazi nikeze inkxaso yocupulo lwenkokeli kwiSekela Mongameli-Jikelele eOfisini eNkulu ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Ifomali yamabanga afanelekileyo eNQF level 6 kuze kulawulo koluntu, uLawulo loLawulo nokuLawulwa kwabantu. Iiminye emihlanu (5) yamava ekuboneleleni ngenkxaso yezicwangciso kwiNkulumbuso elungileyo. Ulwazi olunamandla kumbonelelo weMicrosoft Office. Amakhono alawulo ofisi amacebo enkxaso yezicwangciso zolawulo. Amakhono alungileyo eplani nokuqulunqa. Amakhono abalulekileyo (lwazi oluthethwayo nolubhaliweyo).
xh.duties: Phatha uhlele inkqubo yolwazi kwiofisi kaSekela Mongameli-Jikelele. bonelela ngenkxaso yezicwangciso ekwaba kusesixhenxi kwiSekela Mongameli-Jikelele. Xelela izinto ezifunekayo zolawulo ngokwemigaqo, qinisekisa uluhlu lwezinto ezahlulahlukileyo zilungisiwe, ncedisa ngokulawula iingxelo zenyanga, kwikota nakwindalo. Qinisekisa izinto zolawulo kwaye uhlale ukhona ngokwemigaqo yaseburhulumenteni, imigaqo nolawulo olufanelekileyo kwimeko yakho yakwasekuhlaleni kuze kuqinisekiswa inkxaso efunekayo kuwo Ofisi kaSekela Mongameli-Jikelele. Bhala iindaba ezithunyelwa kwaye uxele iingxelo kubaluveli abafanelekileyo. Qinisekisa inkqubo efanelekileyo neseziko lezicwangciso kwazo zonke iingxelo ezithunyelweyo nezicwangciso. Lawula inkqubo yokugcina iifayile ezikwi-intanethi kunye nezinto ezithunyelweyo esiCungu. Lawula ukulungelelanisa neenkqubo, amaqela azele kukhangelwa imicimbi yokusebenza, iintlanganiso kunye nezicwangciso ezibalulekileyo. Mela uMphathi kwezinye iintlanganiso nemicimbi. Lawula imibuzo kwiofisi kaSekela Mongameli-Jikelele. Lawula imali nabantu abangundoqo kwisebe.

jobs.title: Senior Human Resource Practitioner
jobs.summary: Senior HR Practitioner needed at the Hartbeespoort Cluster Office to facilitate recruitment and selection processes, manage appointment procedures and report on employment equity statistics.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma at NQF level 6 in Human Resources Management or relevant qualification with majors in Human Resource Management. Three (3) years’ experience in specialisation in Recruitment and Selection and OSD appointment procedures. Experience in developing and managing data tracking systems and reporting on progress of filling of posts. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge and experience in drafting reports and submissions. Knowledge and experience of administrative, clerical procedures and systems. Knowledge and understanding of Human Resource Management legislation, policies, practices, procedures and Human Resource Planning. Knowledge of equal opportunities and affirmative action guidelines and laws. Understanding of socio-economic and development issues. Extensive exposure to OSD recruitment processes, verifications and knowledge and understanding of the OSD Framework. Problem solving and decision-making skills. Good communication and presentation skills (written and verbal). Strong negotiation and conflict management skills. Willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Facilitate Recruitment and Selection processes. Prepare detailed schedules (long list), score sheets and applications from the Z83 application system. Supply statistics regarding employment equity. Facilitate the shortlisting and interview processes. Draft appointment submissions and route for approval. Render a human resource advisory service to line managers on recruitment and selection. Ensure that OSD appointments are done in compliance with the OSD Framework. Ensure personal suitability checks. Ensure the promotion of effective human resource management. Ensure that policies / legislations / prescripts are followed and complied with during the recruitment and selection process. Monitoring and evaluation of all HR processes, supervision, training and motivation of staff. Co-ordinate and conduct investigations of human resource related problems and advise management accordingly. Management of the recruitment and selection database.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Menslike Hulpbronpraktisien
af.summary: Senior HR-praktisien benodig by die Hartbeespoort Cluster-kantoor om werwing- en keuringsprosesse te fasiliteer, aanstellingsprosedures te bestuur en oor indiensnemingsgelykheidsstatistiek te rapporteer.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma op NQF-vlak 6 in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur of 'n relevante kwalifikasie met hoofvakke in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Drie (3) jaar se ervaring in spesialisering in Werwing en Keuring en OSD-aanstellingsprosedures. Ervaring in die ontwikkeling en bestuur van datavolgstelsels en verslagdoening oor vordering met die vul van poste. Die openbaarmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en ervaring in die opstel van verslae en voorleggings. Kennis en ervaring van administratiewe, klerklike prosedures en stelsels. Kennis en begrip van menslike hulpbronbestuurswetgewing, beleide, gebruike, prosedures en menslike hulpbronbeplanning. Kennis van gelyke geleenthede en regstellende aksie-riglyne en wette. Begrip van sosio-ekonomiese en ontwikkelingskwessies. Uitgebreide blootstelling aan OSD-werwingsprosesse, verifikasies en kennis en begrip van die OSD-raamwerk. Probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie en voorleggingsvaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Sterk onderhandeling en konflikbestuursvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Fasiliteer werwing- en keuringsprosesse. Berei gedetailleerde skedules (lang lys), punblaaie en aansoeke vanuit die Z83-aansoekstelsel voor. Verskaf statistiek rakende indiensnemingsgelykheid. Fasiliteer die kortlyste- en onderhoudprosesse. Opstel van aanstellingsvoorleggings en roeteer vir goedgekeuring. Lewer 'n menslike hulpbronbradvleiestdiens aan lynbestuurders oor werwing en keuring. Verseker dat OSD-aanstellings gedoen word in ooreenstemming met die OSD-raamwerk. Verseker persoonlike geskiktheidskontroles. Verseker die bevordering van doeltreffende menslike hulpbronbestuur. Verseker dat beleide / wetgewing / voorskrifte gevolg en nagekom word tydens die werwing- en keuringsproses. Monitering en evaluering van alle HR-prosesse, toesig, opleiding en motivering van personeel. Koördineer en voer ondersoeke uit na menslike hulpbronverwante probleme en gee dienooreenkomstig advies aan bestuur. Bestuur van die werwing- en keuringsdatabasis.

zu.title: Umntu oPhakamileyo oSebenza ngeZinsiza Zabantu
zu.summary: Kudingeka umPhathi oPhakeme we-HR e-Hartbeespoort Cluster Office ukuze alawule izinqubo zokubuyekeza nokuqoka, aphathe izinqubo zokubeka ezikhundleni abeRibike ngezibalo zokulingana kobusebenzi.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma Yesizwe ezingeni le-NQF 6 ekuPhathweni Kwezinsiza Zabantu noma izifundo ezihambisano ezinamagugu aphambili ekuPhathweni Kwezinsiza Zabantu. Umphumela weminyaka emithathu (3) wobuningi bokusebenza ekubuyekezeni nokuqokeni nasezinqubweni zokubeka ezikhundleni ze-OSD. Ubulingi ekwakheni nasekulawuleni amasistimu okulandela idatha nekubikeni ngokuqhubekayo kokugcwalisa izikhundla. Ukwembula ilayisense yomshayeli evumelekile engakapheli. Ulwazi nobulingi ekubhalweni kwezibiko nezincomo. Ulwazi nobulingi mayelana nezinqubo nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwezocwepheshe namalungu wesikhundla. Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho, izinqubomgomo, izenzakalo, izinqubo kanye noKuhlelelwa Kwezinsiza Zabantu. Ulwazi ngamacebo okulingana amathuba nomthetho wesenzo esiqinisekisiwe. Ukuqonda izinkinga ezenza ukuthuthuka kwezomnotho nehlabathi. Ukuvezwa okuningi ezinqubweni zokubuyekeza ze-OSD, ukuqinisekisa kanye nolwazi nokuqonda iSikhungo se-OSD. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nokwethula (abhalwe nokuKhulunywa). Amakhono amakhulu okuxoxisana nokuphathwa kwezinkinga. Ukuthanda ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Qondisa inqubo yokubuyekeza nokuqoka. Hlela izinhlela zesenzo ezinemininingwane (uhlu oludele), amapheshana amaphuzu kanye nezicelo zisuka ohlelweni sezicelo ze-Z83. Nikeza izibalo mayelana nokulingana kobusebenzi. Qondisa inqubo yokubeka ohlwini abafanelekile nokubuzwa imibuzo. Bhala izincomo zokubekwa ezikundleni futhi zithunyelwe okugunyaziwe. Nikeza isevisi yeseluleko sezinsiza zabantu kubaphathi bezigaba ngokubuyekeza nokuqoka. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukubekwa ezikhundleni kwe-OSD kwenziwa kuhambisana ne-Sikhungo se-OSD. Qinisekisa ukuhlola ukufaneleka komuntu. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsiza ezisebenzayo zabantu. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinqubomgomo / umthetho / imiyalo ilandelwa futhi kuhozwa kuyo ngesikhathi senqubo yokubuyekeza nokuqoka. Buka kanye nokuhlola zonke izinqubo ze-HR, ukulawula, ukuqeqesha kanye nokukhuthaza abasebenzi. Hlela futhiwenze uphenyo mayelana nezinkinga ezihlobene nezinsiza zabantu bese unikeza abaphathi izeluleko ngokufanele. Lawula idathabheysi yokubuyekeza nokuqoka.

xh.title: Somdla oqhuba iBango lokuQoqosha
xh.summary: Kufunwa i-Senior HR Practitioner e Hartbeespoort Cluster Office ukuyala iinkqubo zokuqesha nokukhethwa, ulawule iinkqubo zokuqeshwa kwaye uchaze ngeBango ngokulingana ngokwemibalabala.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma kwi-NQF level 6 kwi-Human Resources Management okanye isifanekiso esifanelekileyo neenekcukacha eziyimigangatho ekuQoqoshweni koBantu. I-Three (3) years imboniso kwenzozo ekuQoqoshweni nokukhethwa iinkqubo ze-OSD nezokuqeshwa. Imboniso yokuphuhlisa nokulawula iinkqubo zokuvela iBango ukubika ngokusonjululeka kokuGcwaliswa kwe-post. Ukuvezwa kolayisensi yokuhamba egqithisiweyo esasebenzayo. Ulwazi nolwazi lokubhalwa kwevekisi nokuNgeniswa. Ulwazi nolwazi lweenkqubo zolawulo zofikelelo ekuqhutywa kweBango. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngomthetho weBango, iimpolisa, inkqubo kwaye uQoqosho oluQeqeshiweyo lweBango. Ulwazi ngokulingana Kolubalo oluThathu ngokulandela amacebo okulingana ngokomthetho kunye nokulawula okufunyenweyo. Ukuqonda ukuba kufuneka ukudibana okuthe chatha, oluqhubela phambili. Ukuboniswa okuthe chatha kumonakalo ekuQoqoshweni kweekranken ze-OSD, ukuzinza kunye nokuqonda nokulawula iNdlela ka-OSD. Isiphithiphithi kwaye iNkundla yokuzimisela ngokweNtsebenzisano. Ulwazi nokuqhagamshelana okulungileyo (okubhaliweyo nokuBIZA). Isakhono esigqithisileyo sokubalekisa iingxabano ezahlukeneyo kunye nokulawula. Ukulungele ukuHamba.
xh.duties: Kwala iinkqubo zoQoqosho kunye noKhetho. Lungisa ijadali eneenkcukacha (uludlu olude), amaphepha omanani kunye nokuvela kwinkqubo yokuvela kwi-Z83. Zisa iibalo ngokulingana kobuMsebenzi. Yala iinkqubo zokubeka kuluhlu olumfutshane kunye nokuqhuqatha. Bhalisa iingeniselo zokuqeshwa kwaye zithunyelwe kunye nokuvunywa. Nikeza inkonzo yengcebiso ngamabango abantu kuBaphathi beqela ngokuQoqosha nokukhethwa. Qinisekisa ukuba ukugcinwa kweenkonzo ze-OSD kwenziwa ngokuthobela isiKhokelo se-OSD. Qinisekisa ukuhlolwa kokufaneleka komntu. Qinisekisa ukuthuthuzwa kobuMsebenzi obusebenzayo beBango. Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo/zomthetho/ezalathwayo zilandelwa kwaye zithotyelwe ngexesha lenkqubo yoQoqosho nokukhethwa. Ukuqwalasela nokuhlolwa kweenkqubo zonke ze-Bango, ukulawula, ukuzimasa kwaye ukhuthaze abasebenzi. Qhansa kwaye wenze uphando malunga neengxaki ezinxulumene neBango kwaye ucele ngokulawulo ngokweemfuno. Ulawulo lwegcine leBango lenkqubo yokukhethwa.

jobs.title: Scientific Technician: Production Grade a - C
jobs.salary_text: R407 337 – R610 131 per annum, (OSD), (Offer will be based on proven years of experience)
jobs.summary: Scientific technician needed in Kimberley to perform geohydrological functions and apply operational standards for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Natural /Water Groundwater/ Geohydrology related Sciences or relevant qualification. Three (3) years’ post qualification technical scientific experience in groundwater. Compulsory registration with SACNASP as Certificated Natural Scientist. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Understanding of programme and project management. Scientific methodologies and models. Research and development. Computer-aided scientific applications. Knowledge of groundwater resources management is essential. Extensive experience in water management, Environmental field, urban development, agricultural, waste management and mining. Understanding of department’s role and function with respect to Water Quality and Water Resources Protection. Knowledge of the National Water Act, 36 of 1998 and related policies, strategies and guidelines. Understanding of principles of integrated Water Resource Management. Experience in minimizing the impacts from industries, agriculture, urban development and mining. Computer literacy. Innovative thinking. Negotiation skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Knowledge of legal compliance. Technical report writing. Data analysis. Scientific presentation. Decision making. Customer focus and responsiveness. Problem solving.

Provide technical/scientific data, information and advice. To perform technical scientific analysis and regulatory functions. Preparation of data and routine interpretation. Database and data management. Analysis of technical scientific data. Dissemination of information. Apply the appropriate scientific and technical procedures/skills to generate information and knowledge. Formulate proposals and compile reports. Research and development. Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures. Equipment reviews and procurement of new equipment. Research/literature studies to improve expertise. Publish and present technical reports and research findings. Liaise with relevant bodies/councils on Geohydrological related matters. Supervise technical support and processes. Manage the performance management and development of staff. All duties will be performed in a Geohydrological environment.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Tegnikus: Produksie Graad a - C
af.summary: Wetenskaplike tegnikus benodig in Kimberley om geohidrologiese funksies uit te voer en operasionele standaarde vir die Department of Water and Sanitation toe te pas.
af.requirements: 'N Nasionale Diploma in Natuurlike-/Water-/Grondwater-/Geohidrologie-verwante Wetenskappe of 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie. Drie (3) jaar se na-kwalifikasie tegniese wetenskaplike ervaring in grondwater. Verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as Gesertifiseerde Natuurwetenskaplike. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Begrip van program- en projekbestuur. Wetenskaplike metodologieë en modelle. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde wetenskaplike toepassings. Kennis van grondwaterhulpbronbestuur is noodsaaklik. Uitgebreide ervaring in waterbestuur, omgewingsveld, stedelike ontwikkeling, landbou, afvalbestuur en mynbou. Begrip van die departement se rol en funksie met betrekking tot Waterkwaliteit en Waterhulpbronbeskerming. Kennis van die Nasionale Waterwet, 36 van 1998 en verwante beleide, strategieë en riglyne. Begrip van beginsels van geïntegreerde Waterhulpbronbestuur. Ervaring in die minimalisering van die impakte van nywerhede, landbou, stedelike ontwikkeling en mynbou. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Innovatiewe denke. Onderhandelingsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis van regsonderhouding. Tegniese verslagskrywing. Data-ontleding. Wetenskaplike aanbieding. Besluitneming. Kliëntfokus en -reaksievermoë. Probleemoplossing.
af.duties: Voer tegniese wetenskaplike en geohidrologiese funksies en take uit wat interpretasie binne 'n gevestigde raamwerk vereis. Pas operasionele standaarde toe en konsolideer metodologieë, beleide, stelsels en prosedures. Identifiseer leemtes en ontwikkel toepaslike intervensies en uitbreiding van die grondwatermoniteringsnetwerk. Voorbereiding en deelname aan navorsingsaktiwiteite. Dataversameling deur veldopnames. Onderhoud, kalibrering en bedryf van wetenskaplike toerusting. Verskaf geohidrologiese tegniese ondersteuning en advies. Bou werkverhoudings met kliëntebasis op en brei kliëntebasis uit. Bevordere publieke bewustheid van wetenskaplike aktiwiteite. Verskaf tegniese/wetenskaplike data, inligting en advies. Voer tegniese wetenskaplike ontleding en regulerende funksies uit. Voorbereiding van data en roetine-interpretasie. Databasis- en databeheer. Ontleding van tegniese wetenskaplike data. Verspreiding van inligting. Pas die toepaslike wetenskaplike en tegniese prosedures/vaardighede toe om inligting en kennis te genereer. Formuleer voorstelle en stel verslae op. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures. Toerustinghervisies en verkryging van nuwe toerusting. Navorsing/literatuurstudies om kundigheid te verbeter. Publiseer en bied tegniese verslae en navorsingsbevindings aan. Skakel met relevante liggame/raad oor geohidrologieverwante aangeleenthede. Hou toesig oor tegniese ondersteuning en prosesse. Bestuur prestasiebestuur en ontwikkeling van personeel. Alle pligte sal in 'n geohidrologiese omgewing uitgevoer word.

zu.title: Isayensi yobuchwepheshe: Umkhiqizo Wezinga a - C
zu.summary: Kudingeka isayensi yobuchwepheshe e-Kimberley ukwenza imisebenzi ye-geohydrological kanye nokusebenzisa imitsetfo yesisebenziso koMnyango weze-Amanzi nekuCocekwa.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma kwezolimo/ezemvelo/namaphuzu amanzi emhlabathini/isayense ye-geohydrology noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Iminyaka emithathu (3) yamava obuchwepheshe besayensi emva kwalolu thwemu kumanzimhlabathini. Ukubhaliswa okuyimphilo ku-SACNASP njengesayensi egunyaziwe yemvelo. Ukufaka esidlangalaleni ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile engakapheli. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye namaphrojekthi. Izindlela namaphathi wobuchwepheshe besayensi. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zesayensis ezibhalwe ngesikhombisi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwamaphuzu amanzi emhlabathini lubalulekile. Amava amakhulu ekuphathweni kwamanzi, emkhakheni wezemvelo, ekuthuthukisweni ezindaweni ezahlakene, ezolimo, ekuphathweni kwemfucuza kanye kumayini. Ukuqonda indima nomsebenzi womnyango maqondana nenhleleko yamaphuzu amanzi nokuvikelwa kwamaphuzu amanzi. Ulwazi lomthetho we-National Water Act, 36 of 1998 kanye nemikhakha ehambisanayo, amasu kanye nezindlela. Ukuqonda izimiso zenhleleko ebandakanyekayo yokuphathwa kwamaphuzu amanzi. Amava ekunciphiseni imithelela emikhakheni yamayini, ezolimo, ekuthuthukisweni ezindaweni ezahlakene. Ukulunga ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha. Ukucabanga okusha. Amaphuzu okuxoxisana. Amaphuzu okubhala nokukhuluma kahle. Ulwazi ngokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukubhala imibiko yobuchwepheshe. Ukuhlaziya idatha. Ukubonisa ngobuchwepheshe besayensi. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuqwalasela kanye nokuqondiswa yikhasimende.应对策略，采用中文回复。 Ukuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Qhuba imisebenzi nemitshitsho yobuchwepheshe bomnokwenzwayo kanye nezinhlobo zomkhakha we-geohydrological ephuma ocwaningweni. Yenza usebenzise imitsetfo yesisebenziso, uhlanganise izindlela zokusebenza, imikhakha kahulumende, izinhlelo kanye namaphrothokholi. Qaphela imikhawulo futhi wakhe izinyathelo ezifanele kanye nandiswa kwenhleleko yokulalela amanzi emhlabathini. Luklanye nokuba yingxenye yemisebenzi yocwaningo. Qoqa idatha ngemikhankaso yasesigodini. Ukugcina, ukulungisa nokusebenzisa izibonakaliso zesayensi. Nikeza inkondolo yobuchwepheshe ngesayensi ye-geohydrological. Sakha izimphathiswano ezilungele imisebenzi nezikhwama zakho futhi usondeze izikhwama zakho. Khuthaza ulwazi lwesayensi emphakathini. Nikeza idatha lemininingwane yobuchwepheshe yesayensi, imininingwane kanye nencese. Ukwenza ukuhlaziywa kobuchwepheshe besayensi kanye nemisebenzi yemithetho. Ukulungisa idatha nokuhlaziywa okujwayelekile. Ukuphatha idatha kanye nokuqoqwa kwedatha. Ukuhlaziywa kwedatha yobuchwepheshe besayensi. Ukusabalalisa imininingwane. Sebenzisa izindlela ezifanele zesayensi nobuchwepheshe ukuze kwenziwe imininingwane nolwazi. Bala iziphakamiso futhi uhlele imibiko. Ucwaningo nentuthuko. Ukuthuthuka ngobungcweti okuphila ukulandela izindlela ezintsha zesayensi kanye namaphrothokholi. Ukubuka izibonakaliso kanye nokuthenga izintsha. Ucwaningo/ukufunda izincwadi ukuze kwakhuliswe ulwazi. Kushicilelwe futhi kunikwe imibiko yobuchwepheshe kanye neziphumo zocwaningo. Xhumana namakomidi/amarhawundi abalulekile ngemikhakha ye-geohydrological. Qondisa inkondolo yobuchwepheshe kanye namaphrosesi. Phatha inkondolo yokuphathwa kanye nentuthuko yabasebenzi. Konke imisebenzi kuzosenziwa emkhakheni we-geohydrological.

Responsible for compiling monthly reports for Employee Relations Unit. To assist in procurement process for Employment Relations needs. Assist in the implementation of approved resolutions by relevant structures. Compile statistics regarding labour issues, investigate cases and arrange appointments of Investigating Officers. Keep statistics of all Employee Relations cases lodged with the component.

Hou statistieke van alle Werknemerbetrekkinge-sake wat by die komponent aanhangig gemaak is.

af.requirements: 'n Ter sake NQF-vlak 6-kwalifikasie (Nasionale Diploma) in Finansiële Bestuur of enige verwante kwalifikasie in die veld, plus een (1) tot twee (2) jaar se ervaring in Inkomste-bestuur. Die openbaring van 'n geldige, onverstreke bestuurderslisensie. Praktiese ervaring van die SAP-stelsel en die WARMS-stelsel. Kennis en begrip van finansiële wetgewing, beleide, praktyke en prosedures. Kennis en begrip van finansiële voorskrifte soos die PFMA, Tesourieregulasies, en die Division of Revenue Act (DORA), National Water Act (NWA), Kennis van en toepassing van International Financial Reporting Standards van toepassing op inkomste, Generally Recognized Accounting Practice, Public Service Anti-Corruption Strategy, bedrog en voorkoming. Kennis van gelyke geleenthede en regstellende aksie-riglyne en wette. Kennis van administratiewe en klerklike prosedures en stelsels. Kennis en begrip van Departementele beleide en prosedures. Raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Kennis van die implementering van beleide van PMDS. Probleemoplossing en ontleding. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Kliëntoriëntasie en kliëntfokus. Goeie kommunikasie. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. In staat wees om onafhanklik te werk, bereidwilligheid om wyd te reis.
af.duties: Verskaf effektiewe finansiële administrasie en Inkomste-bestuursdienste binne die Streek op SAP, insluitend kliëntfakture, inkomstesameling, skuldreconciliasies, betalingstoekenning, bestuur van wagrekeninge, monitering van Algemene Joernaal- en Skuldigersgrootboek-transaksies, kliëntverhoudingsbestuur, en verseker dat alle funksies akkuraat, doeltreffend en binne die voorgeskrewe tydraamwerke uitgevoer word. Herdruk van kliëntstate en fakture. Bywoon van maandelikse kliëntvergaderings met strategiese kliënte as deel van die bestuur van inkomste-bestuurskontrakte. Bystand verleen met die tariefbepalingsproses in die Streek. In staat wees om alle Inkomste-bestuursverslae wat ad hoc benodig word, te verskaf. Stel inkomsteverslae op en dien dit betyds in. Toesig oor personeel.

zu.title: Umhloli wezimali kahulumenu: Ukulawula imali engenayo
zu.summary: I-Department of Water and Sanitation ifuna umhloli wezimali kahulumenu wokwenza imisebenzi yokulawula imali engenayo okuhlanganisa ukubhala izikweletu, ukulawula imali engenayo kanye nokubhalanisa izikweletu kwi-SAP.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezingeni le-NQF level 6 (National Diploma) ku-Financial Management noma nanoma yisiphi isiqu esihambisana naso kule nsimu, kanye namava eminyaka eyi-one (1) kuya kwezi-(2) two ekulawulen iholo. Ukuchaza ilayisense yomshayeli ongasebenayo. Amava okusebenzisa ngokubambayo isistimu ye-SAP nesistimu ye-WARMS. Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho wezimali, izinqubomgomo, amasiko, kanye nenqubo. Ulwazi nokuqonda imiyalo yezimali efana ne-PFMA, Treasury Regulations, kanye ne-Division of Revenue Act (DORA), National Water Act (NWA), Ulwazi nokusetyenziswa kwe-International Financial Reporting Standards ezibhekayo kumholo, Generally Recognized Accounting Practice, Public Service Anti- Corruption Strategy, fraud, and prevention. Ulwazi lwezindlela zamathuba alinganayo kanye namalungiselelo abantu abamnyama, kanye nomthetho. Ulwazi ngezenqubo zokuphatha, izenqubo zeclerical, kanye nezasistimu. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo kanye nenqubo yomnyango. Isakhiwo sokuphatha ulwazi ngemisebenzi. Ulwazi lokuqalisa izinqubomgomo ze-PMDS. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye Nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha abantu kanye nobuhlukahluko. Ukuqondiswa kwabathengi nokugxila kubathengi. Ukuxhumana kahle. Ububeke kanye nokuziphatha ngokulungile. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza lodwa, ukuzimisela ukuhamba kakhulu.
zu.duties: Inikeza ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezimali kanye namasevisi abalwayo emboleni ngokuphathwa kwemali engenayo ngaphakathi kwesifundazwe ngokusisebenzisa i-SAP, okuhlanganisa ukubhala izikweletu zabathengi, ukulawula imali engenayo, ukubhalanisa izikweletu, ukwabelana izimali eziyisikhokho, ukuphatha ama-akhawunti we-suspense, ukulawula amathuluzi we-General Journal kanye netransakshini ze-Debtors' Ledger, ukuphatha ubudlelwano nabathengi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi yenziwa ngokunembile, ngokusebenza kahle futhi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe. Ukuphinda kushicilelwa izitatimende zabathengi namafomula. Ukubamba amahlanganwe nyanga zonke nabathengi ababalulekile njengengxenye yokuphatha amakontraxi okulawula imali engenayo. Ukusiza nqubo yokunquma izindleko esifundazweni. Ukuba nakho ukuniketa wonke amarephothi okulawula imali engenayo adingekayo ngesikhathi esingajelekile. Ukuhlela bese kuthunyelwa amarephothi womholo ngokusheshayo. Ukuphatha abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Human Resource Clerk (PRODUCTION)
jobs.summary: Provide human resource clerical services including recruitment administration, conditions of service processing, and general HR support at the Groblersdal Area Office.
jobs.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate. Knowledge of PERSAL system, database and spread sheet application. Knowledge of the Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, and other relevant HR prescripts will be an advantage. Good communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Rendering human resource clerical services. Provide administrative support for recruitment and selection, appointments, probation, and service terminations. Administer processes related to conditions of service (leave, housing, medical aid, allowances, etc.). Address enquiries and Human Resources registry services. Capture and update transactions on the PERSAL system. Address HR administration enquiries from internal and external stakeholders. Maintain and update personnel filing systems (electronic and physical). Provide general administrative support, including drafting routine correspondence, submissions and reports. Ensure effective and efficient interpretation and implementation of the departmental HRM Policies, system, regulation guidelines, resolution and other prescribes.
jobs.applications: Interested applicants must submit their applications via the online link https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity document, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity and a pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Human Resource Clerk (PRODUKSIE)
af.summary: Verskaf menslike hulpbron-klerklike dienste, insluitend werwingsadministrasie, verwerking van diensvoorwaardes en algemene HR-ondersteuning by die Groblersdal Area Office.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/Graad 12-sertifikaat. Kennis van die PERSAL-stelsel, databasis en sigbladtoepassing. Kennis van die Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations en ander relevante HR-voorskrifte sal 'n voordeel wees. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Lewer menslike hulpbron-klerklike dienste. Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning vir werwing en seleksie, aanstellings, proeftyd en diensbeëindigings. Administreer prosesse wat verband hou met diensvoorwaardes (verlof, behuising, mediese bystand, toelaes, ens.). Hanteer navrae en menslike hulpbron-registerdienste. Voer transaksies op die PERSAL-stelsel in en werk dit by. Hanteer HR-administrasienavrae van interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Onderhou en werk personeel-lêerstelsels (elektronies en fisies) by. Verskaf algemene administratiewe ondersteuning, insluitend die opstel van roetine-korrespondensie, voorleggings en verslae. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe interpretasie en implementering van die departementele HRM-beleide, stelsel, regulasie-riglyne, resolusie en ander voorskrifte.

zu.title: Human Resource Clerk (PRODUCTION)
zu.summary: Ukunikeza izinsiza zobungqangi zezinsiza zabantu okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kokuqasha, ukucutshungulwa kwezimo zenkonzo, kanye nokusekela okujwayelekile kwe-HR esikhungweni sase-Groblersdal Area Office.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Senior/Grade 12. Ulwazi ngesistimu ye-PERSAL, idathabhesi kanye nesicelo lesipredushithi. Ulwazi ngomthetho wenkonzo kaZwelonke, Izimiso zenkonzo kaZwelonke, kanye nananyunye okushiwo ngokuhlobene ne-HR kuzoba yinzuzo. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulumayo). Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxhaxha.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsiza zobungqangi zezinsiza zabantu. Ukunikeza ukusekela okuphatha kwesikhungo sokubumba nabantu, ukubekwa esikhundleni, isikhathi sokulinga, nokuphela kwenkonzo. Ukuphatha izinqubo ezihlobene nezimo zesikhungo (ukulalela, izindlu, usizo lwangempela, izabelo, nokunye). Ukuphendula imibuzo nezinsiza zobungqangi zezinsiza zabantu. Ukufaka futhi ubuse izinkokhobeli kwisistimu ye-PERSAL. Ukuphendula imibuzo yokuphatha izinsiza zabantu evela kubangenayo kanye nabanikabelo bangaphandle. Ukugcina futhi ubuse izistimu zokulondolozwa kwemibhalo (elekthronikhi nezomzimba). Ukunikeza ukusekela okujwayelekile okuphathiwe, okuhlanganisa nokulungisa okuqashiwe, iziphakamiso kanye nezibika. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthathwa kwezinyathelo okuphumelelayo nokusebenza kwezinqubomgomo ze-HRM zomnyango, isistimu, izinqubo zomthetho, izinkomba, izinqunto, nokunye okuphathwayo.

xh.title: Mncedi weMisebenzi yabaNtu (PRODUCTION)
xh.summary: Nikela iinkonzo zobhala-msebenzi zemisebenzi yabantu kuquka ulawulo lokuzala abantu, ukuqhuba imimiselo yesebenze, nankxaso jikelele ye-HR eKwindla loMsebenzi laseGroblersdal.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi se-Senior/Grade 12. Ulwazi ngenkqubo ye-PERSAL, yasemhlanganweni wamanani nayo yesicelo se-spread sheet. Ulwazi ngoMthetho wesebe likaZwelonke, ngokuLawulwa kweSebe likaZwelonke, nakwezinye iimiso ezimalunga nemisebenzi yabantu kuya kuba luncedo. Amapangeli mahle wokunxibelelwana (awabalweyo nathiyo ethethwayo). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamandla.
xh.duties: Ukunikela iinkonzo zobhala-msebenzi zemisebenzi yabantu. Qinisekisa inkxaso yolawulo ekubeni nabantu nasekhethweni, ekumisweni kwabasebenzi, kwixesha lokuzama, nakwindlulo yesebenze. Lawula iinkqubo ezinxulumene nemimiselo yesebenze (iikhonzo, izindlu, incedo yezempilo, izibonelelo, njl.njl.). Phendula imibuzo neenkonzo zesikhululo semisebenzi yabantu. Faka uhlaziyo iintengiselwano kwinkqubo ye-PERSAL. Phendula imibuzo yolawulo lemisebenzi yabantu evela kubathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Gcina uhlaziyo iinkqubo zokugcina iifayile zabasebenzi (ezibhalwe ngokubhalisa nangokubamba). Qinisekisa inkxaso yolawulo jikelele, kuquka nokubhala iinkomba zothungelwano, iinkethulo neengxelo zexesha. Qinisekisa ukuqonda nokusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo iimGaqo ze-HRM ze-sebe, inkqubo, izikhokelo zomthetho, izigqibo nezinye iimiso.
