zu.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo le-HR ehlanganisa ukubhala izinto kwi-PERSAL kunye nokuququzelela iNqubomgomo ukuyala abaphathi bemiqango kwi-Gqeberha.
zu.requirements: Isatifiketha Samabanga Aphakeme/Isiqephe 12. Ulwazi ngenkqubo ye-PERSAL, isiseko sedatha nosetyenziso lwamashidi ohudi. Ulwazi lwe-PSA, i-PSR neminye imiyalelo nemithetho ehambelanayo ye-Human Resources. Amakhono abalulekileyo okuxoxa (abhalwe nangomlomo) nendlela yokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo.
zu.duties: Umuntu ofaneleyo uzobe nesibopho sokunika abaphathi bemiqango inkulumo-mpikiswano ejwayelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuhumusha nokusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo nangokushibhileyo iNqubomgomo ye-HRM yomnyango, inkqubo, imiqathango yokulawula, izinqumo neminye imiyalelo. Ukubhala izinxulumo kwi-PERSAL. Ukubutha nokukhetha. Intuthuko Yenhlangano. Izintambo zabasebenzi. Intuthuko Yemithombo Yabantu. Ukubhala izibhalo. Ukuphathwa kwayo yonke imisebenzi yolawulo Yemithombo Yabantu okt. izimo zomsebenzi, ukuqeda isevisi nokulawula iholo. Nikela ngezevisi ze-HR Registry.

xh.title: Umsekeli wabe wemisebenzi yabantu kwindalo
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kwimisebenzi yabantu kuquka nokubhalisa iinkqubo zePERSAL nokuqondeza ngecebo lokuqalisa izigqibo kubaphathi bomgca ophakamileyo eGqeberha.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphanisileyo/abangama-12. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yePERSAL, isiseko sedata nakusetyenziso kwamaspredishithi. Ulwazi ngePSA, iPSR nolunye ulwabiwo nemithetho ehlobene nemisebenzi yabantu. Amabalo amaninzi wokunxibelelana (okubhalisiweyo nokuThethwayo) anokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo.
xh.duties: Umthunywa ophumeleleyo uya kuba nenxaxheba ekunikeni ingcebiso nengcali kubaphathi bomgca ophakamileyo. Qinisekisa ukuhunyushwa okusebenzayo nokuqondo nokwenziwa kwezinye iingcebiso zebe ezolulu ulawulo lolwazi oluqhutywa ngemigaqo yemisebenzi yabantu, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zolawulo, izikhokelo, izigqibo nay copies. Ukbhalisa iinkqubo ezingekho malini kwelinye. Uluntu oluqulunqwa oluvela kubantu abafuna nomsebenzi. Ukuze kubekho imiba efanayo noluntu olunamandla. Uluntu oluqhutywe ngokuzimisela. Uluntu oluqhutywe ngamandla ombane. Uluntu oluqhutywe ngokubonelela ngamandla obugcisa. Uluntu oluqhutywe ngamandla obugcisa obungangqindiyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director; Governance and Regulations Rights of
jobs.department: Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for Governance and Regulations Rights providing advisory support on Parliamentary and Cabinet matters within the Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate and an NQF7 bachelor’s degree as recognised by SAQA in Youth Development, Social Sciences, Development Studies or related field. A minimum of 3 years’ first level/middle management experience in youth development/stakeholder or related field. Knowledge: Legislation, governance framework and prescripts applicable; Knowledge of the National Youth Policy, NYDA Act, Stakeholder Management, Project Management, Risk Management, Protocol and Etiquette, Political processes, functions and context, Understanding and appreciation of Youth Development, Research. Skills, Primary: Project Conceptualisation and Management, Stakeholder Management, Networking and Relationship Building, Programme and project management, Effective report writing skills, Presentation and written communication skills, Impact and Influence. Secondary: Basic Budgeting and Financial Management; Problem solving and decision-making; Project management; Computer Literacy (MS Office Suite); Networking and building bonds; Impact and influence; Diversity management. Personal Attributes: Ethical behaviour; honesty and Integrity; Emotional Intelligence; Passion and Achievement driven; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to maintain confidentiality of information; Respect for copyrights/ aversion to plagiarism.
jobs.duties: Provide technical and advisory support to principals to make informed decisions; Support management on Parliamentary matters; Compile Cabinet Memos when requested; Develop submissions and briefing notes for the political principals, Draft speaking notes for the principals; Draft Cabinet Memorandums; Manage and coordinate national youth engagements to advance youth development; Manage national youth engagements to advance youth development; Manage the implementation of quarterly National Youth Machinery meetings, Conceptualise and manage youth development outreach projects., Facilitate participation of stakeholders in national projects to advance youth development.; Facilitate implementation, monitor, evaluate and report progress of national projects that advance youth development; Coordinate international stakeholder engagements to advance youth development. Coordinate international stakeholder engagements on youth development, and facilitate participation of stakeholders in international youth development events. Provide support in coordination of international multilateral and bilateral engagements (UN, AU, SADC, BRICS, IBSA, Commonwealth, Non-Aligned Movements, and bilateral engagements).: Facilitate implementation, monitor, evaluate and report progress of national projects that advance youth development; Facilitate implementation, monitor, evaluate and report progress of international projects that advance youth development; Report progress on bilateral and multilateral international engagements that advance youth development to stakeholders; Draft cluster and cabinet memorandums on relevant international projects and facilitate their presentation., Provide support in NYDA performance oversight. Compile quarterly NYDA Monitoring reports; Plan and monitor implementation of NYDA site visits, coordinate responses to Parliamentary questions directed to the NYDA, and facilitate approval of the quarterly tranche payments of the NYDA. Facilitate appointment and induction of the NYDA Board. Facilitate approval and monitor implementation of the Shareholder Compact, and quality control the plans and reports of the NYDA. Supervise and ensure the effective utilisation of human and material resources; Allocate work and resources to subordinates to ensure that priorities, targets and deadlines are achieved; supervise and manage staff, including performance management, development, discipline and workplace support. Sign and submit leave forms within the prescribed timeframes.

zu.title: Sekela-noMphathi; Umbuso nemithetho yamalungelo

Usuku olungenani lwe-3 lwezimbili lokuqala/phakathi kokuphatha emphakathini kwe-youth development/stakeholder noma enkambini ehlobene. Ulwazi: Izinqubo zomthetho, uhlelo lolawulo nemiyalo yomsebenzi; Ulwazi lweNational Youth Policy, NYDA Act, Stakeholder Management, Project Management, Risk Management, Protocol and Etiquette, Political processes, functions and context, Ukuqonda nokwazisa kwe-Youth Development, Research. Amakhono, Okuyinhloko: Project Conceptualisation and Management, Stakeholder Management, Networking and Relationship Building, Programme and project management, Amakhono okubika ngokusebenzayo, Amakhono okubonisa nokuqamba, Nomthelela nokukhuthaza. Okwesibili: Basic Budgeting and Financial Management; Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo; Project management; Computer Literacy (MS Office Suite); Ukuxhumaniswa nokwakhiwa kwamandla; Nomthelela nokukhuthaza; Ukuphatha ukwahlukahlukana. Izici zomuntu: Ukuziphatha ngokunesiko; Ukuqiniseka ngokusesikweni; Ukuzwisisa izinkanuko; Inkanuko kanye nokwenza okuhle; Ikhono lokusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo; Ikhono lokugcina imfihlo yolwazi; Inhlonipho yamalungelo abantu/bobandlulo bokuvukela ukuziphendukela.
zu.duties: Nika ababusi abaphambili inkxaso yobuchwepheshe neluleko ukuze bathathe izinqumo ezisemqoka. Sekela abaphathi ezindabeni zePhalamende; Hlola futhi uhlele amamemorandamu eKhabhinathi uma kucelwa; Bola izithubo nezaziso ezimfishane zababusi abaphambili, Bola izinkombana zokukhuluma zababusi abaphambili; Bola amamemorandamu eKhabhinathi; Phatha futhi uhlele izinkulumo-mphisano zesifunda ngabasha ukuthuthukisa intuthuko yabasha; Phatha izinkulumo-mphisano zesifunda ngabasha ukuthuthukisa intuthuko yabasha; Phatha ukuhleleka kwezinkomishi zenyanga njalo Kanye kwamakhulu ezinkulumo-mphisano zokuqondisa inqubomgomo yesifunda ngabasha, Qamba futhi uphathe amaphrojekthi okufinyelela abantu ngentuthuko yabasha., Budalele ukuthi abanye abahlanganyeli ezinhlelweni zesifunda ukuthuthukisa intuthuko yabasha.; Budalele ukuphatha izinhlelwa zomsebenzi, ulawule, uhlôle futhi ubike inqubekela phambili yamaphrojekthi wesifunda awuthuthukisayo intuthuko yabasha; Hlela futhi ubudalele izinkulumo-mphisano zezizwe ngamazwe nabahlanganyeli ukuthuthukisa intuthuko yabasha. Hlela izinkulumo-mphisano zezizwe ngamazwe ngentuthuko yabasha, futhi budalele ukubamba iqhaza kwabahlanganyeli emicimbini yamazwe ngamazwe ngentuthuko yabasha. Nikeza inkxaso ekuhleleni izinkulumo-mphisano zamazwe ngamazwe amaningi nambili (UN, AU, SADC, BRICS, IBSA, Commonwealth, Non-Aligned Movements, kanye nezinkulumo-mphisano zambili).: Budalele ukuphatha izinhlelwa zomsebenzi, ulawule, uhlôle futhi ubike inqubekela phambili yamaphrojekthi wesifunda awuthuthukisayo intuthuko yabasha; Budalele ukuphatha izinhlelwa zomsebenzi, ulawule, uhlôle futhi ubike inqubekela phambili yamaphrojekthi amazwe ngamazwe awuthuthukisayo intuthuko yabasha; Bika inqubekela phambiliyezinkulumo-mphisano zambili namaningi zamazwe ngamazwe ezithuthukisayo intuthuko yabasha kubahlanganyeli; Bola amamemorandamu wesigaba nesikaKhabhinathi ngamaphrojekthi amazwe ngamazwe afanele futhi ubudalele ukuthi abukhiswe., Nikeza inkxaso ekuqondiseni imisebenzi yeNYDA. Hlola futhi ubike izibiko zeNYDA njalo kwamakhulu; Hlela futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezinkomishi zokuvakasha iziteshi zeNYDA, hlela izimpendulo zemibuzo yePhalamende ehlose iNYDA, futhi budalele ukugunyazwa kwesabelo samakwarteri seNYDA. Budalele ukubekwa kanye nokuqanjwa kabusha kwabalingisi beNYDA. Budalele ukugunyazwa futhi ulawule ukuphatha kweShareholder Compact, futhi lolule Ukulungiswa kohlelo futhi ubuke izibiko zeNYDA. Lulule futhi uqiniseke ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinsiza zomuntu nomthombo; Aba umsebenzi futhi izinsiza kubantu abangaphansi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izidingo, amanani namaphrojekthi afinyelelwa; lulule futhi uphathe abasebenzi, okubandakanya ukuphatha ukusebenza, intuthuko, inqubo futhi inkxaso yokusebenza. Sayina futhi thumela amafomu ezikhuphele esikhathini esibekiwe.

Isiqondo esingaphantsi kweminyaka engama-3 somsebenzi wobukhulu bobugcisa/balawulo mmandla wokuqala kwintshukumo yobuso/butho okunye namabala ahambelanayo. Ulwazi: iMithetho, inkqubo yaseManyuze nelawulo ephantsi; Ulwazi ngeNgqikithi yeZizwe eZintsatshana kuLutsha, uMthetho we-NYDA, ulawulo lwabathathi nxaxheba, ulawulwezo, ulawulo lweengozi, iNkqubo namaqhashu, iinkqubo neenkqubo zeendaba zodzulazo, iinkqubo, iinkonzo neendaba, ukuqonda kwaye kuhlonelwe iNtshukumo yoLutsha, noPhando. Amakhono, eQela lokuqala: uQamba nokulawula amaphulo, ulawulo lwabathathi nxaxheba, ukuqhagamshelana nokwakha iindibano, ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo, amakhono okubhala iingxelo ezisebenzayo, amakhono okubonisa nokuvelisa iindaba, ukuqhathanisa kwaye kuqonda ukunika isikhokelo. eQela lesibini: iNdlela yokusebenza neNqeqho yokubalwe imali; ukuzonqula iingxaki nokwenza iigqibo; ulawulo lweephulo; ukwazi ukuqhagamshelana namakhompyutha (MS Office Suite); ukuqhagamshelana nokwakhiwa iindibano; ukunika isikhokelo; ulawulo loluhluko. Iimpawu zobuntu: ukuziphatha ngokwesimilo; inyaniso nokuqina kwenkqubo; ukuqonda iinto ezingabonakaliyo; ingqondo ecingileyo; ukuzimisela kwaye ugqibezele imigqa; ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo; ukwazi ukugcina iimfihlo zolwazi; ukuhlonela i copyright/ ukuziphathe ngokumelana nobusela.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yobugcisa nenceba kuwo onke amaqhawe ukuze bakhe iigqibo ezikumgama ochanekileyo; Nikela ngenkxaso ekulawuleni imiba yePalamente; Qamba iMemos zeKhabhinethi xa kucelwa; Qamba iinkqubo nezicelo zeendaba ngezizathu ezipolitiko, Qamba iindaba ezibaliweyo ngezizathu ezipolitiko; Qamba iMemorandam zeKhabhinethi; Lawula kwaye ulungelelanise iindibano zezizwe zonke ngabambi kwintshukumo yophuhliso yolutsha; Lawula iindibano zezizwe zonke ngabambi ukunceda ukuphuhliswa kolutsha; Lawula ukuphunyelelwa kweendibano zokuqweqe zenqanaba leSizweI seMigqa yolutsha yehlabathi lonke, Yiqamba kwaye ulawule amaphulo okukhululeka kolutsha phaya kolutsha., Yenza ukuba abathathi nxaxheba bakwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba kumaphulo kwizizwe zonke ezingcono ezingekuthunyelwa kubutsha; Yenza ukuphunyelelwa, ukulandelela, ukulinganisa nokubika inkqubo yamaphulo ezizwe zonke ukuthuthuzela ukuphuhliswa kolutsha; Longeleele iindibano zabathathi nxaxheba kwizizwe zikwonke ukuze kuthuthuzelwe ukuphuhliswa kolutsha. Longeleele iindibano zabathathi nxaxheba kwizizwe zikwonke ngokuphuhliswa kolutsha, kwaye wenze ukuba abathathi nxaxheba bakwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiindibano zolutsha lwamazwe ngamazwe. Nikela ngenkxaso ekuqhubeni iindibano zamazwe ngamazwe ezinguqwayo ezingangeni ngqo kwakunye nengangena ngqo (UN, AU, SADC, BRICS, IBSA, Commonwealth, Non-Aligned Movements, namanyano angenangqo).: Yenza ukuphunyelelwa, ulandelelo, ulinganiso nokubika inkqubo yamaphulo ezizwe zonke ukuze athuthuzele ukuphuhliswa kolutsha; Yenza ukuphunyelelwa, ulandelelo, ulinganiso nokubika inkqubo yamaphulo ngamazwe ngamazwe ukuthuthuzela ukuphuhliswa kolutsha; Bika inkqubo yamanyano angangeni ngqo namazwe ngamazwe ngokuthuthuzela ukuphuhliswa kolutsha kubathathi nxaxheba; Qamba iimemorandam yekhabhinethi ngesiseko ngamaphulo ngamazwe ngamazwe ukwaye ulungiselele ukuboniswa kwawo., Nikela ngenkxaso ekulawulweni ukusebenza kwe-NYDA. Qamba iingxelo zokuqhuba zika-NYDA zehlo elinye ngenyanga ezimbalwa; Cwangcisa kwaye ulandelele ukuphunyelelwa kwendwendwe kwindawo ka-NYDA, ulungelelanise iimpendulo zemibuzo yePalamente ethunyelwe kwi-NYDA, kwaye wenze ukuba kwamkelwe ukuhlawula iinkotho ze-NYDA zehlo elinye kwelinye ihlo. Yenza ukuba kubekwe kwaye kungeniswe iBhodi ka-NYDA. Yenza ukuba kwamkelwe kwaye kulawulwe ukuphunyelelwa koManyano woMntu othabatha isabelo, kwaye ulawule ubungakanani beeplani neengxelo ze-NYDA. Lawula kwayuqinisekise ukusetyenziswa kusebenzayo koluntu nento zomsebenzi; Yabelela umsebenzi nezinto zomsebenzi kumalungu abangaphantsi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba imigqa, iinkonzo namaxesha okugqibela aphunyelelwa; lawule kwaye ulawule abasebenzi, kuquka ulawulo lokusebenza, uphuhliso, isohlwayo nenkxaso yendawo yokusebenza. Sayina kwaye ulwise iifomu zeholo phantsi kwamaxesha alo ahlongwayo.

jobs.summary: Director of Supply Chain Management overseeing procurement, logistics, inventory and contract management for the Free State Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Bachelor’s Degree as recognised by SAQA (NQF 7) in Supply Chain Management / Logistics /Public Management or related field. 5 years of experience at a middle/senior managerial level. 7 years or more experience in Supply Chain Management. Experience in various aspects of supply chain management, such as procurement, logistics, inventory management, and contract management, is crucial. Knowledge of PFMA, SCM Regulatory Framework and all prescripts governing procurement in the Public Service. Customer service principles (Batho Pele principles). Technical knowledge. Budgeting and financial management. Understanding of SCM policies and procedures, Computer literacy and a valid driver’s license. The following will be an added advantage: A post-graduate qualification in SCM/Procurement or MBA.
jobs.duties: Develop and manage the demand and acquisition processes. Develop, manage and maintain logistical information and SCM performance. Manage and coordinate the sourcing and purchasing decision of all goods and services in the Department. Maintain, monitor and manage relationships between acquisition management and suppliers. Evaluate that spending of goods and services is according to the Demand Management Plan of the Department. Coordinate supplier scheduling, delivery times and supply continuity. Develop and maintain manuals on SCM policies and procedures. Ensure that goods and services are sourced through fair, equitable, transparent, competitive and cost-effective systems. Set performance standards in respect to service delivery to departmental clients. Manage the resources of the Directorate, i.e. human, asset and financial resources.
jobs.applications: Applications can be hand delivered or sent via email to recruitment1@destea.gov.za and quote the reference number for the abovementioned position on the subject line (email) when applying. Quoting the reference number, applications can be hand delivered at the Ground Floor Security Entrance, 113 St Andrews Building, St Andrew Street, Bloemfontein or sent via email. Kindly take note that the email size limit is 4MB. You are therefore kindly requested to send documents separately, should they exceed the allowed limit. FOR ATTENTION : Mesdames K. Majafa / M. Parkies/ N. Ramaebebe/Mr. T. Chaka at (066) 487
jobs.notes: Women and People with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Directions to applicants: Applications must be hand delivered or e-mail on a new Z.83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on internet at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies and must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae (Separate application for every vacancy). Applicants are requested to complete Z83 form properly and in full. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with these instructions will not be considered. The onus is on the applicants to ensure that their applications are emailed (PDF document to a maximum of 4 megabytes), submitted electronically or hand delivered timeously. The Department will not be held responsible for several delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) before the interviews. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and criminal case shall be opened. Candidates who possess foreign qualifications and/or short course certificates must take it upon themselves to have their qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and provide proof of such evaluation report (only when shortlisted). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Applicants are respectfully informed that if no notification of appointment is received within 4 months of the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications and communication will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. The department reserves the right not to appoint. Note: Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre-entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS Handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of the candidate. The department shall communicate the logistics for the psychometric assessment to the candidate. All shortlisted candidates for other posts, shall undertake a pre-entry assessment which will be in the form of a practical / technical exercise. Candidates will also be assessed on Integrity (Ethical Conduct). Selection panels shall score the technical exercise as an additional criterion in the interview process. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12 months. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Supply Chain Management RE NO: Dedt 13/09/26
af.summary: Direkteur van Supply Chain Management wat toesig hou oor verkryging, logistiek, voorraad- en kontrakbestuur vir die Free State Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad soos deur SAQA erken (NQF 7) in Supply Chain Management / Logistics / Public Management of 'n verwante veld. 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. 7 jaar of meer ervaring in Supply Chain Management. Ervaring in verskeie aspekte van supply chain management, soos verkryging, logistiek, voorraadbestuur en kontrakbestuur, is van kardinale belang. Kennis van PFMA, SCM Regulatoriese Raamwerk en alle voorskrifte wat verkryging in die Openbare Diens regeer. Kliëntediensbeginsels (Batho Pele-beginsels). Tegniese kennis. Begroting en finansiële bestuur. Begrip van SCM-beleide en -prosedures, rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Die volgende sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees: 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie in SCM/Procurement of MBA.
af.duties: Ontwikkel en bestuur die vraag- en verkrygingsprosesse. Ontwikkel, bestuur en onderhou logistieke inligting en SCM-prestasie. Bestuur en koördineer die broning en aankoopbesluitneming van alle goedere en dienste in die Departement. Onderhou, monitor en bestuur verhoudings tussen verkrygingsbestuur en verskaffers. Evalueer dat besteding van goedere en dienste ooreenkomstig die Vraagbestuursplan van die Departement is. Koördineer verskaffer-skedulering, afleweringstye en verskaffingskontinuïteit. Ontwikkel en onderhou handleidings oor SCM-beleide en -prosedures. Verseker dat goedere en dienste deur billike, regverdige, deursigtige, mededingende en kostedoeltreffende stelsels gebron word. Stel prestasiestandaarde ten opsigte van dienslewering aan departementale kliënte. Bestuur die hulpbronne van die Direktoraat, d.w.s. menslike, bates- en finansiële hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umphathi: Supply Chain Management RE NO: Dedt 13/09/26
zu.summary: Umphathi we-Supply Chain Management ophethe ukuthenga, i-logistics, ukuphatha izimpahla ezigoselwayo kanye nokuphatha amasivinini ayisipho sasemahle kwi-Free State Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor eziyinhloko ezivunyelwe yi-SAQA (NQF 7) kwi-Supply Chain Management / Logistics / Public Management noma olimi oluhlobene. 5 iminyaka yobuchwepheshe ezingeni lomphathi ophakathi/ophakeme. 7 iminyaka noma ngaphezulu yobuchwepheshe kwi-Supply Chain Management. Ulwazi emagqabhini aphandezonke e-supply chain management, njengokuthenga, i-logistics, ukuphatha izimpahla ezigoselwayo, kanye nokuphatha amasivinini, lubalulekile. Ulwazi lwe-PFMA, Isimiso Sokubuswa Kwe-SCM kanye nazo zonke imiyalo ephatha ukuthenga kwi-Public Service. Izimiso zokukhonza umthengi (Izimiso ze-Batho Pele). Ulwazi lobuchwepheshe. Ukwenza amabhajethi nokuphatha imali. Ukuqonda amasivinini nezinqubo ze-SCM, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kanye nelayisensi yokushayela evunyelwe. Okulandelayo kuzoba yinenzuzo engeziwe: Isiqu se-post-graduate kwi-SCM/Procurement noma i-MBA.
zu.duties: Bumba bese uphatha inqubo yemfuneko nokutholwa. Bumba, phatha bese ulondoloza ulwazi nge-logistics kanye nezinga lokusebenza kwe-SCM. Phatha bese uhleba izinqumo zokusesha futhi zokuthenga zonke izimpahla kanye nezinsiza kulesi umnyango. Londoloza, qaphela bese uphatha ubudlelwano phakathi kokuphatha ukutholwa kanye nabathengisi. Hlola ukuthi ukuchithwa kwemali ezimpahleni nasezinsizeni kuhambisana neNdaba Yokuphatha Imfuneko yomnyango. Hleba ukusheduza abathengisi, izikhathi zoku delivered futhi ukuqhubeka kokuhlinzeka. Bumba bese ulondoloza imibhalo yemisimango kanye nezinqubo ze-SCM. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimpahla nezinsiza zitholwa ngemisimba elungileyo, ebulungayo, esobala, ehlangeneyo futhi ecebile ngemali. Hlela amazinga okusebenza mayelana nokuhlinzeka ngesevisi kumthengi bomnyango. Phatha izinsiza zeDirectorate, okungukuthi, izinsiza zabantu, izimpahla nezinsiza zemali.

xh.title: Umlawuli wezikhundla: Isebe le-SCM RE NO: Dedt 13/09/26
xh.summary: Umlawuli we-SCM onceda ukulawula uphuhliso lweemfuno, imithetho yamathanga, ukugcina kwaye ulawule ukubonelela, ulondoloze izinto nezinkonzo kwisebe le-SCM, elibonelela imithetho yoluntu, izinkonzo, ukugcina imali, ukugcina izinto nezenzo zokubonelela ukulungelelanisa izindlu ezahlukeneyo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga saseTshuma esifanelekileyo njengokukuqaphwa yi-SAQA (NQF 7) kwinkqubo yokulawula ukubonelela ngezinto / Logistics / Public Management okwalo naliphi na icandelo elithe lwahluka. Iwaka leminyaka yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokulawula. Iwaka elingenaphi ndawo okanye ngaphezulu lamava kwinziso yokulawula ukubonelela. Iwaka leminyaka yamva kulawulo lokubonelela izinto kwindlela nenzalo yokuhamba izinto ekuthengwa ngayo iinkonzo ekusetyenzisweni koluntu. Ukuba nolwazi malunga nemigaqo yamathanga akwisikhululo samaziko. Ulwazi ngesakhono sezolimo ezilawula iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zoluntu. Imigangatho yokuqonda abaqhelisi bephakathi. Isakhono esitsalwa yi-ndlela zokuqonda imigaqo. Ukwenza imali yesixeko ekukhetha iimali nokuqonda iinkcukacha. Ukuqonda imigaqo nezentsika ze-SCM izinto ezingekho sikwenzi, iziqinisekiso zokuba ngumntu osebenza ngesandla esingenampazamo.
xh.duties: Phuhlisa uphulela imisebenzi yokufuna nokufumana izinto. Phuhlisa, ulawule uze ulondoloze ulwazi malunga nemithetho yokuhamba izinto kunye nokuvela kwangaphambili kwe-SCM. Lawula uphinde ulungelelanise izigqibo zokukhetha nokuthenga zonke izinto nezinkonzo kwisebe. Londoloza, qonda uze ulawule ubudlelwane phakathi kolawulo lokufumana izinto kunye nababhaleli bempahla. Linganisela ukuba ukuhamba-hamba kwemali kwemithetho nezinkonzo kwenziwa ngokomgca wokuqonda iNkcubeko wesebe. Lungelelanisa ukumiswa kwamaxesha ababoneleli, iimaxesha okuza ngawo imithetho nokuhamba kokuqhinelwa kokuzeleka. Phuhlisa ulondoloze iincwadi ezibonelela ngeenqobo ezithetha ngemigaqo yenyani kuneendlela nenziso zokukhetha imithetho nezinkonzo ekuqinisweni, ngokulungelelanisa kwangaphambili, ngokwazima ngokusebenzisa izinto ezingakumbi ukuba kunokwenzeka ngokulungelelanisa ngokulingana. Sela iindlela ezifanelekileyo ezibhekisa kwindlela ezifanelekileyo yokubonelela ulwazi. Lawula ukuya kumthengisi wesikhundla, ukuba ngowemikhosi, ixabiso kwaye nangaphezulu.

af.title: Direkteur: Regulerende Stelsels en Belanghebbendes
af.summary: Direkteursrol wat toesig hou oor regulerende stelsels en belanghebbende betrekkinge binne die Free State Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Baccalaureusgraad soos deur SAQA erken (NQF 7) in Ekonomie of Besigheidsbestuur. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/ senior bestuursvlak. 7 jaar ervaring met 'n rolfokus op die koördinasie van sektorbelanghebbendes en 'n diepgaande begrip van die omgewing vir besigheidsregulerende bestuur. Ervaring in die bestuur van katalitiese projekte, insluitend die ontwikkeling van projekte, die toewysing van hulpbronne en die monitering van vordering. Begrip van beleggingsbevordering en -fasilitering. Begrip van die finansiële implikasies verbonde aan reguleringseenheid en belanghebbendebestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Die volgende sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees: Goeie kennis van toepaslike wetgewing wat Sektorbestuur reël. Kennis van Projekbestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf ondersteuning om staatsburokrasie te bespoedig en te verminder vir die doeltreffende implementering van beleggingsprojekplanne. Kweek en versterk blywende belanghebbende betrekkinge vir beide die departement en die provinsie. Fasiliteer en bevorder die Beleggingswaardeketting in verband met beleggingsprojekte. Hou toesig oor die implementering van katalitiese projekte van die privaatsektor in die Provinsie. Implementeer departementele programme wat voortspruit uit Uitvoerende Raadsbesluite, Begrotingsstembevels en vergaderings met instellings soos die Department of Trade, Industry and Competition (the dtic) en relevante Publieke Entiteite. Dra by tot die ontwikkeling van Strategiese dokumente vir die Departement. Bestuur die hulpbronne van die Direktoraat, d.w.s. menslike, bates- en finansiële hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umqondisi: Izinhlelo Zolawulo Namabhange Abantu Abahlobene Nenhlangano
zu.summary: Indima kaMqondisi okubheke phambili ngokusondza nezinhlelo zolawulo kanye nobuhlobo nabahlanganyeli ngaphakathi kwe-Free State Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esifanele somfundisi esivunyelwe yi-SAQA (NQF 7) ku-Economics noma ku-Business Management. 5 iminyaka yamava kulelo izinga eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokuphatha. 7 iminyaka yamava ekugxileni ekwenisweni kolwazi ngokusuka kwezinhlangano eziphakamisa izwi kulayisense, kanye nokuqonda ngokujulile emkhakheni wezokuphathwa kokuqondiswa kwezohwebo. Amava ekuphathweni kwamaphrojekthi abalulekile, okuhlanganisa ukwakha izinhlela zamaphrojekthi, ukwabelwa izinsizakusebenza, nokuphatha inqubo. Ukuqonda ngokukhuthaza nokwenza kube lula ukutshalwa kwezimali. Ukuqonda ngemiphumela yezimali ehlobene nokuqondiswa kokuhambisana nemithetho kanye nokuphathwa kolwazi ngabantu abahlobene nenhlangano. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyelwe. Okulandelayo kuzoba usizo olungeziwe: Ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho ehambisana nokuphathwa kolwazi ngabantu abahlobene nenhlangano. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso ukuze kusheshiswe futhi kuncishiswe izinqamlezodwebu kahulumini wokuqeqesha ngokusebenzayo izinhlela zokuhlela amaphrojekthi okutshalwa kwezimali. Londa futhi uthuthukise ubuhlobo obusihlala njalo obuhlobene nomnyango kanye nasezweni lonke. Qedelela futhi ukuthuthukisa uchungechunge lweNani Lokutshalwa kwezimali ngokuhlobene namaphrojekthi okutshalwa kwezimali. Qapha inqubo yokuphumelelisa amaphrojekthi abalulekile asekhaya kwezimali esifundazweni. Phumelela izinhlelo zomnyango eziphuma kwabaphethe izinqumo, emihlanganweni yokuqondiswa yebhajethi ezinokuthi zibe khona namanyuvesi njenge-Department of Trade, Industry and Competition (the dtic) nezikhungo zikawonke-wonke eziyinhloko. Sebenzela ekwakheni amadokhumenti eStrategiya kuMnyango. Phatha amathambo eQophelo, okungukuthi, abantu, izimpahla, nezimali.

xh.title: Ulawuli: Iinkqubo zoLawulo nabaQhagamshelana
xh.summary: Indima yoLawuli ebeqondisa iinkqubo zolawulo nobudlelwane nabashwalayi-bee ngaphakathi kwisebe loRhuqo, lweShishini noQoqosho lweFree State.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo seBachelor esamkelwa yi-SAQA (NQF 7) kuQoqosho okanye kuLawulo lweShishini. Unyaka lwe-5 loluhlu lokulinga kwinqanaba lokulawula eliphakathi noma eliphezulu. Unyaka lwe-7 loluhlu lokulinga kunye nolondolozo olujolise kwikwanaba lokulawula kubashwalayi-bee besebe kwaye kuqondwa ngokucacileyo indawo yolawulo lolawulo lweshishini. Unyaka lolulingo ekuqondeneni amaphulo aphatha amandla, kuquka ukuqumba iiplani zeprojekthi, ukwabela izixhobo, nokuqonda intshukamo. Ukuqonda ukukhuthaza nokwenza kulula utyalo-mali. Ukuqonda imiphumo yemali enxulumene nokuzithoba ngokwemigaqo yolawulo nolawulo lwabashwalayi-bee. Ukuba novele lokusebenza ngesikrini sewompyuta. Iriyala elisebenzayo yomqhubi. Oku kulandelayo kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo: Ulwazi oluhle ngomthetho ofanelekileyo olawula ulawulo loQoqosho. Ulwazi ngokuLawulwa kweProjekthi.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ekukhawuleziseni nasekunciphiseni iinkqubo ezinde kakhulu zorhulumente ukuze kusebenze ngokusebenzayo iiplani zeprojekthi yotyalo-mali. Phuhlisa wenze amakhulu ubudlelwane obusisigxina nabashwalayi-bee bobungcali kwisebe nakwiphondo. Yenza kulula wenze amandla iQela lenani lotyalo-mali malunga neeprojekthi zotyalo-mali. Lawula iphoso yamaphulo eprojekthi zentshona yangasese kwiphondo. Phumeza iinkqubo zesebe ezivela kwiZigqibo zeNkulumbuso, kwiNtshukhamo yeNgeno-mali kwimizekelo nemiqathango kunye nentlangano namaziko afana nesebe loRhuqo, lweShishini noloMngqungqusho (the dtic) namaziko kaRhulumente alo nento efunekayo. Yaka isandla ekwenzeni amaxwebhu aBalulekileyo esebe. Lawula izixhobo zoLawulo, oko kukuthi, izixhobo zabantu, izinto ezixhonyiweyo nezeemali.

jobs.title: Organisational Development Specialist
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.closing_date_text: 02 October 2026 at 16:00 FOR ATTENTION : Mesdames. M Parkies/ K Majafa/N. Ramaebebe/ Mr. T. Chaka
jobs.summary: Organisational Development Specialist needed in Bloemfontein to maintain organograms and review departmental structures, requiring a relevant degree and 3-4 years of OD experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Degree (NQF Level 7) in Organisational Development and/or business administration with an OD focus. 3-4 years’ experience in OD environment. Certificate in business process mapping, JE initial and Follow-up training certificate and JE Panel certificate. Knowledge of setting of norms and standards, knowledge of the department, cost benefit analysis, hr practice, compilation of job descriptions, relevant legislations and policies, general office administration practice, PERSAL, job evaluation processes, compensate system, working knowledge of Org- Plus/ Visio, Structure Costing Models and BPM & SOP Techniques. Computer literacy and a valid driver’s license.

af.title: Organisasie-ontwikkelingspesialis
af.summary: Organisasie-ontwikkelingspesialis benodig in Bloemfontein om organogramme te onderhou en departementele strukture te hersien, met 'n toepaslike graad en 3-4 jaar se OD-ondervinding as vereiste.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike graad (NQF-vlak 7) in Organisasie-ontwikkeling en/of besigheidsadministrasie met 'n OD-fokus. 3-4 jaar ondervinding in 'n OD-omgewing. Sertifikaat in besigheidsproseskartering, JE-aanvanklike en opvolgopleidingsertifikaat en JE-paneelsertifikaat. Kennis van die instelling van norme en standaarde, kennis van die departement, koste-batenalanise, hr-praktyk, opstel van werksbeskrywings, relevante wetgewing en beleide, algemene kantooradministrasiepraktyk, PERSAL, werkevalueringsprosesse, kompenseerstelsel, werkkennis van Org-Plus/Visio, strukturele kostemodelle en BPM- en SOP-tegnieke. Rekenaargeletterdheid en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Om die organogram/organogramme te ontwikkel en te onderhou; ontleed die huidige departementele organogram, identifiseer die behoeftes/leemtes om hersiening/herontwerp van die departementele organogram te rig, doen navorsingsvoorstel van organogram om te verseker belyning met die goedgekeurde spesifieke sektor generiese of waar van toepassing, raadpleeg die relevante belanghebbendes/rolspelers om insette/kopersmark te bekom, stel die voorgestelde organogram op en verskaf tydige terugvoer aan relevante belanghebbendes, finaliseer en dien in om instemming te verkry, neem deel om behoorlike implementering, monitering en evaluering van die goedgekeurde struktuur te verseker. Om norme en standaarde te ontwikkel, te hersien en te ontleed; Assesseer tekortkomings/behoeft vir wysiging/ontwikkeling van norme en standaarde, ondersoek die wysiging/ontwikkeling van norme en standaarde, opstel van norme en standaarde, raadpleeg relevante belanghebbendes, verkry goedkeuring, monitor die implementering. Voer werkevaluering uit op geidentifiseerde/voorrangswerke en gee advies oor die toepassing daarvan; versamel vereiste inligting oor die werk, voer werkanalise-onderhoud, vaslegging van inligting in die JE-stelsel, bied die geevalueerde werke aan die Kwaliteitsversekeringskomitee/Paneel, stel voorlegging op om implementeringsgoedgekeuring te verkry, hou rekords (bygewerkte databasis) van gevalueerde werke en rapporteer tydig, versprei/kommunikeer inligting oor die uitslag van die geevalueerde werke aan die relevante Seniorbestuurder. Om advies te verskaf oor die ontwikkeling van werksbeskrywings; doen navorsing oor die inhoud van die werk en benchmark met ander departemente/provinsies, verskaf insette oor die konsep werksbeskrywings, voer onderhoude met aangewysde/kennisgewende amptenare, versoek insette oor die konsep werksbeskrywings, verskaf advies oor die uitleg en spesifikasie van die aanvaarbare sjabloon, hou rekords (bygewerkte databasis) van goedgekeurde werksbeskrywings en rapporteer tydig. Om hulpbronne te bestuur om te verseker dat die doelwitte van die komponent bereik word; bestuur van personeel binne die komponent, die ontwikkeling en bywerking van werksbeskrywings vir rapporterende personeel, die prestasiebestuur van personeel binne die komponent, fasilitering van opleidingsintervensies, gee rigting, leiding en advies aan personeel binne die komponent. Bestuur van bates.

zu.title: Uchwepheshe WokuThuthukiswa kweNhlangano
zu.summary: Kudingeka uchwebi lokuThuthukiswa kweNhlangano eBloemfontein ukuze agcine ama-organogram abuyekeze izakhiwo zomnyango, edinga idigri ehlobene nomnyaka we-3-4 wokuThuthukiswa kweNhlangano.
zu.requirements: I-Degree (NQF Level 7) ehambisana naleyo Nqangi ku-Organisational Development futhi/noma ukuphathwa kwebhizinisi egxile ku-OD. Unyaka we-3-4 wokuhlolwa emvelaphini ye-OD. Isitifiketi ekubameni wenqubo yebhizinisi, isitifiketi saye u-JE okuwukuphela kokufundwa okokuqala nokulandela kanye nesitifiketi seJE Panel. Ulwazi ngokusethwa kwanani namazinga, ulwazi ngomnyango, ukuhlaziwa kwezinzuzo zezindleko, izinqubo ze-hr, ukuhluza incazalo yomsebenzi, umthetho namapholisi ahlobene, izindlela zokuphatha ihhovisi ngokujwayelekile, i-PERSAL, izinqubo zokuqonda inani lomsebenzi, ohlelo lokuhlinzeka, ulwazi lokusebenza nge-Org-Plus/ Visio, I-Structure Costing Models nezindlela ze-BPM & SOP. Ukwazi ukusebenza ngakhamphuytha nelayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuthuthukisa nokugcina i-organogram/s; hlaziya i-organogram yamanje yomnyango, thola izidingo/izikhala ukuze kuqondiswe ukubuyekezwa/kwakhiwa kabusha i-organogram yomnyango, yenza ucwaningo olubekiwa ngolwazi nge-organogram ukuze kuqiniseke ulinganiswe ngokunemukelwe ngokunjalo ngalowo mkhakha noma lapho kufanele khona, xoxa nabahlanganyeli abahlobene / abadlali indima ukuthola izimongo/ukwamukelwa, uhluze i-organogram ephakanyisiwe unikeze umnikelo wezindlebe ohle kubahlanganyeli abahlobene, uqedele futhi unikeze ukuqinisekiswa, uthathe inxaxheba ekuqinisekiseni ukusetshenziswa okuhle, ukulandela nokuhlolwa kokwakhiwa okunemukelwe. Ukuthuthukisa, ukubuyekeza nokuhlaziya amanani namazinga; hlola izifo/izidingo zokulungiswa/ukuthuthukiswa kwanani namazinga, phenya ukulungiswa/ukuthuthukiswa kwanani namazinga, cuba amanani namazinga, xoxa nabahlanganyeli abahlobene, uthole ukunemukelwa, ulandele ukusetshenziswa. Yenza ukuhlola imisebenzi emiswa ohlelwe ngaphambili futhi unikeze izeluleko ngokusetshenziswa kwayo; qoqa ulwazi oludingekayo ngomsebenzi, yenza izingxoxo zokuhlola umsebenzi, faka ulwazi ohlelweni le-JE, phatha imisebenzi ehloliwe eKomitini / Phaneli Yokuqinisekisa Ikhwalithi, hlela isibopho ukuze uthole ukunemukelwa kokusetshenziswa, gcina izinketho (isisekelo sezimongo esihlaziyiwe) ngemisebenzi ehloliwe ubike ngokushesha, sakisana/athumele ulwazi ngemiphumela yemisebenzi ehloliwe kumongameli ophakeme ohlobene. Ukunikeza izeluleko ekuthuthukiseni incazalo yomsebenzi; yenza ucwaningo ngokuqukethwe komsebenzi uze uqhathanise namanye eminyango/ izifundazwe, nikeze izimongo ekubeni kocwaningo kwencazalo yomsebenzi, yenza izingxoxo nabasebenzi abaqokiwe/abanolwazi, cela izimongo ekubeni kocwaningo kwencazalo yomsebenzi, nikeze izeluleko ngendlela nokuningi kwesifanekiswe esinamukeleka, gcina izinketho (isisekelo sezimongo esihlaziyiwe) ngezi-JD ezinamukelekwe ubike ngokushesha. Ukuphatha izinsiza ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi izinjongo zenhlengo zifinyelelwa; ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenhlengo, ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlaziywa kwezincazalo zomsebenzi zabasebenzi ababhikada, ukulawulwa kokusebenza kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenhlengo, ukweseka ukuthuthukiswa kokuhlolwa, inikeza isiqondiso, isiqondiso nezeluleko kubasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenhlengo. Ukuphathwa kwempahla.

xh.title: INkundla yoPhuhliso lweeNtshixho
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNkundla yoPhuhliso lweeNtshixho eBloemfontein ukugcina ii-organogram nokuphonononga iisakhiwo zesebe, kufuneka idigrii efanelekileyo kunye neminyaka eli-3-4 yamava kwi-OD.
xh.requirements: IDigrii efanelekileyo (NQF Level 7) kwi-Organisational Development kunye/nokurhululo koshishino oluneqondo le-OD. Iiminyaka eli-3-4 yamava kwimeko ye-OD. Isatifikethi sokubhala iinkqubo zoshishino, isatifikethi seqeqesho le-JE lokuqala nokuqhubekayo kunye nesatifiketho se-JE Panel. Ulwazi ngokuqonda imigaqo nemilinganiselo, ulwazi ngesebe, ukuhlalutya iindleko neziboneelo, iziqhelo ze-hr, ukuqokelela iinkcazelo zemisebenzi, imithetho nemigaqo ephathelene noko, iziqhelo zoqeqesho jikelele lofiso, i-PERSAL, iinkqubo zolinganiso lwemisebenzi, inkqubo yomvuzo, ulwazi lokusebenza i-Org-Plus/Visio, i-Structure Costing Models kunye ne-BPM & SOP Techniques. Ulwazi lokusebenza ikhompyutha kunye nelayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukuyila nokugcina ii-organogram; ukuyila i-organogram yangoku yesebe, ukuchonga iimfuno/iintshixho ukuze zinike isalathiso kuphononongo/kuyilo kwakhona i-organogram yesebe, ukuqhuba isiphakamiso sesifundo se-organogram ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulungelelwaniso kwesectori eqeqeshiweyo esemthethweni okube sisebenza apho, kupelekwa nabanomdla/abahluli nxaxheba ukuze kufunyanwe izimvo/inkxaso, kuqokelelwe i-organogram eceliweyo kunye nokubuyisela ngexesha elifanelekileyo izimvo kubanomdla, kuqedwa kwaye kunikelwe ukufumana isivumelwano, kuqhutywa inxaxheba kuqinisekiso lwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo, ulwazi oluqhubekayo nokuqwalaselwa kwesakhiwo esemthethweni. Ukuyila, ukuphonononga nokuhlalutya imigaqo nemilinganiselo; ukulinganisa iintshixho/iimfuno zokulungiswa/ukuyila imigaqo nemilinganiselo, ukuphonononga ukulungiswa/ukuyila imigaqo nemilinganiselo, ukubhala imigaqo nemilinganiselo, kupelekwa nabanomdla, kufunyanwe isigunyaziso, kulawulwa ukusebenza. Ukuqhuba ulinganiso lwemisebenzi kwimisebenzi echongiweyo/yomgangatho ophezulu kunye nokubulela ngokusetyenziswa kwayo; ukuqokelela ulwazi olufunekayo ngomsebenzi, ukuqhuba idinga lolinganiselo lomsebenzi, ukufaka ulwazi kwi-JE System, kubekwa imisebenzi elinganiswe ngaphambi kwe-Komiti ye-Quality Assurance / i-Panel, kuqokelelwa isithuba sokufumana isigunyaziso senziwa, kugcinwe irekhodi (idathabheysi eyesihlwahlwahlo) kwimisebenzi elinganiswe kwaye kubikwe ngexesha elifanelekileyo, kusasazwa/kunyazwa ulwazi ngemveliso yemisebenzi elinganiswe kumanejala ophakamileyo. Ukubonelela ngengcebiso ekuyileni iinkcazelo zemisebenzi; ukuqhuba isifundo ngokuqulethwa komsebenzi kunye nokulinganisa namanye amasebe/ngephondo, kunikezelwa izimvo kwandaqulo yeinkcazelo zemisebenzi, ukuqhuba iingxoxo nabaphathi abachaziweyo/abalwazi, kucelwa izimvo kwandaqulo yeinkcazelo zemisebenzi, kunikezelwa ingcebiso ngolungelelwaniso nemida kwesitemplate esemthethweni, kugcinwe irekhodi (idathabheysi eyesihlwahlwahlo) kwiinkcazelo zemisebenzi ezemthethweni kwaye kubikwe ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Ukulawula amakhaya abantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba iinjongo zelungu zifinyezelwa; ulawulo lwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwelungu, ukuyila nokuhlaziya iinkcazelo zemisebenzi zabaphethe ababiko, ulawulo lolusebenzo lwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwelungu, ukulungelelisa izikhokelo zeqeqesho, kunikezelwa isalathiso, isikhokelo nengcebiso kubasebenzi ngaphakathi kwelungu. Ulawulo lwempahla.
