af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Logistiek
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur Logistiek pos in Bloemfontein wat 'n relevante graad en 3 jaar toesighoudende logistieke ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike graad (NQF Vlak 7) kwalifikasie in Verskaffingskettingbestuur/Logistieke Bestuur/Openbare Bestuur/Administrasie. 3 jaar verwante logistieke bestuurservaring op toesighoudende vlak. Kennis van LOGIS-stelsel, PFMA, SCM Regulerende Raamwerk en alle voorskrifte wat verkryging in die Openbare Diens beheer. Rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Koördineer en hersien die verwerking van rekwisisies vir goedere en dienste; ontvang 'n rekwisisie, verwerk rekwisisie, koördineer die plasering van bestellings vir goedere en dienste, plaas 'n bestelling vir die diens in die geval van 'n diens wat benodig word, bestel en verkry goedere indien dit nie 'n winkelartikel is of die item nie op voorraad is nie. Koördineer die veilige bewaring en verspreiding van goedere; ontvang en kontroleer goedere, voer goedere op die relevante verkrygingstelsel in, stuur beskadigde, verkeerde en onderstandaard goedere terug, reik goedere uit soos benodig, voorbereiding en samestelling van betalingsdokumente. Hou toesig oor werknemers om 'n doeltreffende logistieke bestuursdiens te verseker en onderneem alle administratiewe funksies wat vereis word met betrekking tot finansiële en HR-administrasie. Dit sal, onder andere, die volgende behels: algemene toesig oor werknemers, ken pligte toe en voer gehaltebeheer uit op die werk wat deur toesighouers gelewer word, adviseer en lei toesighouers met betrekking tot alle aspekte van die werk, bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van toesighouers, verseker dat alle toesighouers opgelei en ontwikkel word om in staat te wees om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en doelmatig te lever, ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en prosesse om doeltreffende en doelmatige funksionering te verseker. Bestuur van menslike, finansiële en bateshulpbronne. Beheer en veilige bewaring van alle verskaffingskettingdokumente.

zu.title: Umcebisi Wohlelo: Amalogistics
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMcebisi wohlelo: Amalogistics e-Bloemfontein esidinga iziqu ezihlobene neminyaka emithathu yokuhlangenwe nakho ekuphatheni amalogistics.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele (NQF Level 7) kwi-Supply Chain Management/Logistics Management/Public Management/Administration. 3 years iminyaka yokuhlangenwe nakho ekuphatheni amalogistics elokhu kuhlobene esigabeni sokuphatha. Ulwazi ngesistimu ye-LOGIS, i-PFMA, isisekelo sezomthetho se-SCM nazo wonke imiyalo ephatha ukuthenga kusebenzi kaMbuso. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha nefayela elivunyelwe lokushayela.
zu.duties: Qondanisa futhi uhlole ukucutshungulwa kwezicelo zezimpahla nezinsizakalo; wamukele isicelo, ucubunge isicelo, uqondanise ukubekwa kwemiyalo yezimpahla nezinsizakalo, ubeka umyalo wensiza ekubeni kudingeka insiza, umyale futhi uthole izimpahla uma singeyonto egcinwayo noma into ingenayo esitsheni. Qondanisa ukugcinwa okuphephile nokusatshalaliswa kwezimpahla; wamukele futhi uhlole izimpahla, ufake izimpahla esistimu efanele yokuthenga, ubuyisele izimpahla ezonakele, ezingalungile noma ezingekwezinga eliphezulu, unikeze izimpahla njengoba kudingeka, ulungise futhi uqoqe amadokhumenti okukhokha. Qaphise abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe insiza ephumelelayo yokuphathwa kwamalogistics futhi wenze yonke imisebenzi yobulungiswa edingeka ngokuphathwa kwezimali nabantu. Lokhu kuhlanganisa, phakathi kokunye, okulandelayo: ukuphatha ngokuvamile abasebenzi, ukwaba imisebenzi futhi wenze ukulawula izinga emsebenzini owenziwe ababhaliswa abayophathwa, welule futhi uhoke abayophathwa ngakho konke okuhlobene nomsebenzi, uphathe ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nendlela abayophathwa ngayo, uqinisekise ukuthi bonke abayophathwa bagcotshiwe futhi bakhuliswe baze bakwazi ukuletha umsebenzi wesilinganiso esidingekayo ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle, uthuthukise, usize futhi ulawule izistimu nezinqubo zomsebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza okuphumelelayo. Uphathwa kwabantu, izimali nezinsiza ezimpahla. Ukulawula nokugcina ngokuphepha yonke imibhalo yesintenga.

xh.title: UmLawuli oNcedisayo: iLogistics
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba ngumLawuli oncedisayo weLogistics eBloemfontein, sidinga isidanga esifanelekileyo neminyaka emithathu yamava okulawula uhamba lwezinto.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esifanelekileyo (NQF Level 7) kwilohamathi yokuLawula ukuNikezwa kwezinto/uLawulo loHamba lwezinto/uLawulo oluPhakathi/uLawulo. Iminyaka emi-3 yamava ahlobene nolawulo lohamba lwezinto kwinqanaba lolawulo. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-LOGIS, we-PFMA, we-SCM Regulatory Framework nazo zonke iimimethelo ezilawula inani kwiNkonzo kaSebe. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha namvumbo yokushayela.
xh.duties: Qondanisa kwaye uqhambise ulungiselelo lwemiqabo yezinto nezinkonzo; wamkela umqabo, ulungise umqabo, uqondanise ubekho kwemiqabo yezinto nezinkonzo, ubeke umqabo wonkonzo xa kufuneka inkonzo, uodole kwaye uze ufumane izinto xa zingekho kwindawo yokugcinwa okanye xa Into ingenayo kwisitoko. Qondanise ukugcinwa ngokhuseleko nokusasazwa kwezinto; wamkele kwaye uhlole izinto, ufake izinto kwinkqubo yefundo ebuzwayo, ubuyise izinto ezonakeleyo ezingachanekanga nezingagqwesanga, unike izinto njengoko kufuneka, ulungise kwaye uqokele amaxwebhu okuhlawula. Lawula abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe inkonzo yempilo ngokuchanekileyo yolawulo lwezinto, kwaye wenze yonke imisebenzi yolawulo edingekayo malunga nolawulo lweemali nolawulo labantu. Oku kuya, phakathi kwamanye, kubandakanya oku kulandelayo: ulawulo olubanzi labasebenzi, umise imisebenzi kwaye wenze ulawulo lolungelo komsebenzi ohlawulweyo ngabasebenzi abalawulwayo, uxele kwaye uqhube abalawulwayo malunga nazo zonke iindlela zomsebenzi, ulawule ukusebenza, ukuziphatha nenkundla yabasebenzi abalawulwayo, uqinisekise ukuba bonke abalawulwayo bahlolwe baze bakhuliswe ukuba bakwazi ukunika umsebenzi owufunekayo ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenza kakuhle, uphuhlise, usebenzise kwaye ulawule iinkqubo nemisebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kakuhle nokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo. Ulawulo lwemithombo yabantu, yemali nempahla. Ulawulo nokhuselo kwonke amaxwebhu esikolo esikhulu sezinto.

jobs.title: Fraud and Anti-corruption Investigator
jobs.department: Department of Economic Development and Tourism
jobs.closing_date_text: 02 October 2026 at 16:00 FOR ATTENTION : Mesdames. M Parkies/ K Majafa/N. Ramaebebe/ Mr. T. Chaka
jobs.summary: Fraud and anti-corruption investigator needed in Bloemfontein to develop prevention strategies and conduct investigations for the Free State Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate Degree (NQF Level 7) NQF 7 in Criminology or Police. 3-4 Years relevant experience in the fraud and anti-corruption related field. Understanding of the Legislative Framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of working procedures in terms of the working environment. Fraud and Anti-corruption related policies/ strategies/ guidelines. Computer literacy and a valid drive’s license.
jobs.duties: Provide inputs in the development and implementation of Fraud Detection and Anti- Corruption Prevention Strategy/Plan in the Department; review and evaluate anti-corruption capacity measures within the Department, conduct information sessions on Fraud and Anti-corruption strategy/plan. Investigate all corruption, fraud and theft cases reported as well as irregularities, fruitless and wasteful expenditure that has occurred and advise the supervisor on the way forward; ensure that the departmental cases reported and received through the Provincial Fraud and Corruption hotline are attended and investigated, recommend and complete disciplinary actions for cases of corruption in consultation with labour relations unit of the Department or the SAPS, ensure that witnesses receive protection and remain anonymous, serve as a chief witness in the departmental hearings as well as criminal and civil cases, work closely with the SAPS and other relevant authorities on cases relating to fraud, corruption and theft in the Department. Compile investigation reports on fraud, corruption and theft related cases for further handling by the Supervisor or the Head of component, for internal disciplinary hearings and for criminal or civil proceedings; compile and submit reports on cases related to irregularities, fruitless and wasteful expenditure that has occurred in the Department, update the fraud register on cases investigated, compile a portfolio of evidence on preliminary and final investigation results. Advice the Department/ Accounting Officer on the fraud and corruption outcomes related to the financial disclosures and the way forward thereof; request information required as per the directives on financial disclosure, investigate discrepancies where there are any. compile and submit reports thereof. Detect fraud and corruption activities and refer allegations to a relevant law enforcement agency or other appropriate agencies/bodies in terms of format arrangement i.e Special Investigation Unit (SIU) or the Hawks depending on the merits of the case.
jobs.applications: Applications can be hand delivered or sent via email to recruitment4@destea.gov.za and quote the reference number for the above- mentioned position on the subject line (email) when applying. Quoting the reference number, applications can be hand delivered at the Ground Floor Security Entrance, 113 St Andrews Building, St Andrew Street, Bloemfontein or sent via email. Kindly take note that the email size limit is 4MB. You are therefore kindly requested to send documents separately, should they exceed the allowed limit. FOR ATTENTION : Mesdames K. Majafa / M. Parkies/ N. Ramaebebe/Mr. T. Chaka at (066) 487
jobs.notes: Females are encouraged to apply. Directions to applicants: Applications must be hand delivered or e-mail on a new Z.83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on internet at www.dpsa.gov.za-vacancies and must be accompanied by a detailed Curriculum Vitae (Separate application for every vacancy). Applicants are requested to complete Z83 form properly and in full. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with these instructions will not be considered. The onus is on the applicants to ensure that their applications are emailed (PDF document to a maximum of 4 megabytes), submitted electronically or hand delivered timeously. The Department will not be held responsible for several delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) before the interviews. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and criminal case shall be opened. Candidates who possess foreign qualifications and/or short course certificates must take it upon themselves to have their qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and provide proof of such evaluation report (only when shortlisted). Failure to do so will result in your application being disqualified. Applicants are respectfully informed that if no notification of appointment is received within 4 months of the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications and communication will only be limited to shortlisted candidates. The department reserves the right not to appoint. Note: Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre-entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. Assessment for core competencies outlined in the SMS Handbook shall be conducted within one month of the appointment of the candidate. The department shall communicate the logistics for the psychometric assessment to the candidate. All shortlisted candidates for other posts, shall undertake a pre-entry assessment which will be in the form of a practical / technical exercise. Candidates will also be assessed on Integrity (Ethical Conduct). Selection panels shall score the technical exercise as an additional criterion in the interview process. Successful candidates will be appointed on a probation period of 12 months. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Bedrog- en Antikorruptie-ondersoeker
af.summary: Bedrog- en antikorruptie-ondersoeker benodig in Bloemfontein om voorkomingstrategieë te ontwikkel en ondersoeke vir die Free State Department of Economic Development and Tourism uit te voer.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike graad (NQF Level 7) NQF 7 in Kriminologie of Polisie. 3-4 Jaar relevante ervaring in die bedrog- en antikorruptieverwante veld. Begrip van die Wetgewende Raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens reël. Kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Bedrog- en antikorruptieverwante beleide/strategieë/richtlyne. Rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Lewer insette by die ontwikkeling en implementering van die Bedrogopsporings- en Korruptievoorkomingstrategie/-plan in die Departement; hersien en evalueer antikorruptiekapasiteitsmaatreëls binne die Departement, voer inligtingsessies oor die bedrog- en antikorruptiestrategie/-plan uit. Ondersoek alle korrupsie-, bedrog- en diefstalsake wat aangemeld is, asook onreëlmatighede, vermorsde en ondoeltreffende besteding wat voorgekom het, en stel die toesighouer in kennis oor die weg vorentoe; verseker dat departementele sake wat aangemeld en deur die Provinciale Bedrog- en Korrupsie-hotlyn ontvang is, hanteer en ondersoek word, beveel en voltooi dissiplinêre maatreëls vir korrupsiesake in oorleg met die arbeidsverhoudinge-eenheid van die Departement of die SAPS, verseker dat getuies beskerming ontvang en anoniem bly, tree as hoofgetuie op by departementele verhore sowel as strafregtelike en siviele sake, werk nou saam met die SAPS en ander tersaaklike owerhede oor sake rakende bedrog, korrupsie en diefstal in die Departement. Stel ondersoekverslae oor bedrog-, korrupsie- en diefstalverwante sake op vir verdere hantering deur die Toesighouer of die Hoof van komponent, vir interne dissiplinêre verhore en vir strafregtelike of siviele verrigtinge; stel verslae op en dien dit in oor sake verbonde aan onreëlmatighede, vermorsde en ondoeltreffende besteding wat in die Departement voorgekom het, werk die bedrogregister by met sake wat ondersoek is, stel 'n portefeulje van bewyse op oor voorlopige en finale ondersoekresultate. Stel die Departement/Rekenpligtige Beampte in kennis oor die bedrog- en korrupsie-uitslae verbonde aan die finansiële openbare openbarings en die weg vorentoe daarvoor; versoek inligting wat vereis word volgens die richtlyne oor finansiële openbarings, ondersoek diskrepansies waar daar enige is. stel verslae op en dien dit in. Spoor bedrog- en korrupsie-aktiwiteite op en verwys beweringe na 'n tersaaklike regshandhawingsagentskap of ander toepaslike agentskappe/liggame ooreenkomstig die formaatreëling d.w.s. Special Investigation Unit (SIU) of the Hawks afhangende van die meriete van die saak.

zu.title: Uphenyi we-Fraud and Anti-corruption
zu.summary: Uphenyi we-Fraud and anti-corruption ufuna i-Bloemfontein ukuba abeke izindlela zokuvikela futhi enze izinsuku zophenyo ze-Free State Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
zu.requirements: I-Degree efanele (NQF Level 7) NQF 7 kwi-Criminology noma i-Police. 3-4 Iminyaka yeminyuziso ebandakanya ukukhiqiza amanga kanye ne-anti-corruption related field. Ukuqonda i-Legislative Framework ephatha i-Public Service. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokusebenza ngokommandla wokusebenza. I-Fraud and Anti-corruption related policies/ strategies/ guidelines. Ulwazi lwekhomphyutha nemvume yokushayela.
zu.duties: Nika izinputs ekuqokweni futhi ukusetshenzisweni kwe-Fraud Detection and Anti-Corruption Prevention Strategy/Plan kulelo mnyango; kuphinde kuqashelwe futhi kuhlolwe izindlela zokuvikela ukungalungi kweminyango, khokha ezinkundleni zolwazi mayelana ne-Fraud and Anti-corruption strategy/plan. Phenya zonke izekelo zokungalunga, ukukhiqiza amanga nendaba ebukhuni ezikelwe kanye nokungalungile, ukuchitha imali ngaphandle kwenjongo kanye nokulahlekelwa imali okwenzeke futhi uphakamisele ongqongqoshe indlela yokuhamba phambili; qinisekisa ukuthi izekelo zeminyango ezikelwe noma ezitholwe nge-Provincial Fraud and Corruption hotline ziqondiswa futhi ziphenywa, yiphakamise futhi uqedele izenzo zomgwenyane ezizekelweni zokungalunga ngokubonisana nenyengo yokusebenza komnyango noma i-SAPS, qinisekisa ukuthi ofakazi bathola ukuvikelwa futhi bahlale beyingcali, khonza njengofakazi ogqamile ezinkulumlweni zeminyango kanye nasezimeni zomgwenyane noma zenhlalo, basebenze kakhulu ne-SAPS namanye amagunya ahambisana nalokho ezimeni ezihlobene nokukhiqiza amanga, ukungalunga nendaba ebukhuni kulelo mnyango. Hlanganisa imibiko yophenyo mayelana nezizekelo zokukhiqiza amanga, ukungalunga nendaba ebukhuni ukuba iqhutshwe phambili ngongqongqoshe noma ihhoveli le-component, ngezinkulumbulo zangaphakathi zomgwenyane nangomgwenyane noma izinkulumo zenhlalo; hlanganisa futhi uhambise imibiko mayelana nezizekelo eziphathelene nokungalungile, ukuchitha imali ngaphandle kwenjongo kanye nokulahlekelwa imali okwenzeke kulelo mnyango, buyekeza i-fraud register ngezizekelo eziphenyiwe, hlanganisa i-portfolio of evidence ngeziphumela zophenyo lokuqala nokuqeda. Phakamisela umnyango/ i-Accounting Officer iziphumela zokukhiqiza amanga nokungalunga eziqhathaniswa nokwaziswa kwemali kanye nendlela yokuhamba phambili ngayo; cela ulwazi oludingeka njengokuqondiswa kokwaziswa kwemali, phenye iziphikis lapho kunakho. hlanganisa futhi uhambise imibiko ngakho. Thola imisebenzi yokukhiqiza amanga nokungalunga futhi uholele iziphakamiso egunyeni elihambisana nomthetho noma kwezinye izikhungo/ amasimba ngokwaletha okuhlelishiwe i-Special Investigation Unit (SIU) noma i-Hawks kuye ngamandla esiqu sesikelwa.

xh.title: Umphandi webugcisa bokulahleka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo kunye nokuthintela ukwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umphandi webugcisa bokulahleka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo kunye nokuthintela ukwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni eBloemfontein ukuba aze acwangcise iinkqubo zokuthintela nokuphanda iimeko ezahlukeneyo zeFree State Department of Economic Development and Tourism.
xh.requirements: IDigrii efanelekileyo (NQF Level 7) NQF 7 kwiCriminology okanye kwiPolisa. 3-4 Iyure iminyaka engomsebenzi ongummiselo kwindalo yokulahleka kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni nakubugcisa bokwenza izinto ezingekho mthethweni. Ukuqonda uMthetho weNkqubo kaRhulumente oLawulayo. Ulwazi ngendlela yokusebenza ngokomgaqo-nkqubo wendalo yokusebenza. Iinkqubo zokulahleka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo kunye nezeMigaqo yokuthintela ukwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha nelayisensi yokushayela eyamkelekileyo.
xh.duties: Nika izigqibo ekwenzeni nakusebenzeni kweStrateji/Icandelo lokutyhaya ukuba kubonakale ukulahleka kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni nokuThintela-Ukuqhweswa kwentlalo kwesebe; phinda uhloliswe kwaye ulinganise izithatho zamandla ezintlobo ezahlukeneyo zokuThintela-ukwenza izinto ezingekho mthethweni ngaphakathi kwesebe, yiba nezihlobo ezahlukeneyo ngokwazo ngolwazi ngenkqubo yokulahleka kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni nokuthintela ukwenziwa kwazo. Phando zonke iimeko zokwenza izinto ezingekho mthethweni, ukulahleka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo nazo nezenziwe ngokungekho mthethweni, zithathwe njengoko zibikiwe kunye nokungalunga kwenkqubo yokusebenza, ukutshatyalaliswa kwemali ngokungalunganga nokutshatyalaliswa kwemali, kwaye weluleke umphathi wakho ngendlela ekuya kuhamba ngayo; qinisekisa ukuba iimeko ezibikiweyo kwesebe nazo ezifunyenwe ngomzila wocingo lweFurovinsi nolungelelaniswe ngokubikiweyo kwintsebenziswano phakathi kwabasebenzi baseSebe nabasebenzi bayo, ziphathwe ngokulungileyo zize ziphandwe, zeze kwenziwa izinto ezifanelekileyo ngokomthetho wezabasebenzi kuphando iimeko ezahlukeneyo zokwenza izinto ezingekho mthethweni, zeze kugqitywa ngokubanika isohlwayo esifanelekileyo, kunye nezithili zokwenzeka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo ngokusebenzisa inkqubo yokuphathwa kweemeko ezahlukeneyo, qinisekisa ukuba ngabafungi abathembekileyo bafumana ukhuseleko kunye nokuqinisekiswa ukuba balandwa ngokulingeneyo, ngokusesikweni sokuphatha iimeko ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo ngakumbi na kwakhona kwiimeko ezahlukeneyo zokwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni kunye nobugebengu, basebenze kunye neSAPS nazo nokunye na amagunya afanelekileyo kwimeko ezahlukeneyo ezinxulumene nokwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni, ubugcisa bokulahleka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo nako kusebe. Lungelelanisa iingxelo zophando ngeenkqubo zokwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni, ubugcisa bokulahleka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo kunye neziyimfuno zokubakho kwezinye iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni, zize zisetyenziswe ngabaphathi okanye ngumlawuli wezinto ezahlukeneyo kwesebe, kwiinkqubo zangaphakathi zokuphatha iimeko ezahlukeneyo zokwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni nakwiinkqubo zokulunga ezahlukeneyo nakulawulo lwemali; lungelanisa kwaye ugcwalise iingxelo ngeemeko ezahlukeneyo ezinxulumene nokungalunga kwenkqubo yokusebenza, ukutshatyalaliswa kwemali ngokungalunganga nokutshatyalaliswa kwemali, nakwindalo ekuvunyelweni kwayo kusebe, hlaziya idatha yemeko yokulahleka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo ngezinto ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo eziphandiweyo, lungelanisa umboniso wemisebenzi eyimfuno yokwenziwa kwaye iqinisekiswe ngokwemigaqo yokuphanda efunyanwe kwinqanaba elingakanani na lokuqala nokugqibela. Nika isebe nomlawuli wezimali isalathiso ngenkqubo yokulahleka kwezinto ezahlukeneyo nangobugcisa bokwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni nakwindalo yokubakho kwezinto ezahlukeneyo ezahlukeneyo nakwindalo eya kwenziwa nakho; cela imiba engowona lawulo lwemali ekufuneka yenziwe ngokomthetho, phando iimeko ezingaqondileyo xa zikhona. lungelanisa kwaye ugcwalise iingxelo ngale miba. Bonakalisa iinkqubo zokwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni kunye nobugcisa bokwenziwa kwezinto ezingekho mthethweni kwaye udlulise iingxelo ezahlukeneyo kumagunya alo nkqubo efanelekileyo okanye kumagunya amnye anako ukwenza oku ngokomthetho weSIU okanye iHawks kuxhomekeke kubungakanani balemeko.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager Nursing PHC (PNA8)
jobs.summary: Deputy Manager Nursing PHC position in Mangaung Metro District requiring a nursing diploma or degree and at least 8 years of post-registration experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R25 qualifications i.e Diploma/Degree in Nursing or equivalent qualifications that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Current registration with South African Nursing Council as a professional nurse. Current registration with South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A minimum of 8 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in general nursing. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience at management level. Valid driver’s license. Computer literacy. Extensive experience in Primary Health Care. Skills And Knowledge: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frame works such as: Nursing Act, Health Act. Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code and procedure, Grievance Procedure, etc. Strong leadership skills, Financial Management skills.
jobs.duties: Support re-engineering of Primary Health Care to promote access to quality health care service. Implement the assessments, compliance and attainment of ideal clinic status for all facilities in the Local Areas. Monitor performance of key priority programs according to APP and AOP targets. Management of key priority programs. Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team to ensure good quality of care across all disciplines. Perform quality improvements audits and surveys and report Senior Management and multidisciplinary health team. To monitor and evaluate delivery of quality of health care within the Facilities. Provide advice on various aspects of quality care within the entire district. Provide monthly reports to supervisors and Senior Management. Monitor clinical and non-clinical on regular basis to ensure compliance to processes. Represent the entire district at the Provincial Quality, Finance and key priority program forums.
jobs.enquiries: Mr TA Mokoqo Cell: 067 422 55554 Assistant Director: Admin and Support. Email: MokoqoTA@fshealth.gov.za
jobs.applications: To be done at: https://ihealth.fshealth.gov.za/e-Recruitment
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. The application must indicate the correct Job title, the office where the position is advertised and the Reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to fully complete the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications filed by hand on the Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in a possession of foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Dual citizenship holders must provide the Police Clearance certificate from country of origin when shortlisted. All non-SA Citizens will be required to submit a copy of proof of South African permanent residence when shortlisted. Applications that do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements will not be considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. The Department does not accept applications via fax or post. Failure to upload and submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointments. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre-assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging PHC (PNA8)
af.summary: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging PHC-pos in Mangaung Metro-distrik wat 'n verpleegdiploma of -graad en ten minste 8 jaar ervaring na registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R25-kwalifikasies, d.w.s. Diploma/Grade in Verpleegkunde of ekwivalente kwalifikasies wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegsraad as 'n professionele verpleegkundige. Huidige registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegsraad (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 8 jaar toepaslike/erkenning ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in algemene verpleging. Ten minste 3 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenning ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Uitgebreide ervaring in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Vaardighede en kennis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander relevante regsraamwerke soos: Verpleegwet, Gesondheidswet. Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidswet, Pasienteregtehandves, Batho Pele-beginsels, Openbare Diensregulasies, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Dissiplinêre kode en prosedure, Klagteprosedure, ens. Sterk leierskapvaardighede, Finansiële bestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Ondersteun die heringenieurswese van Primêre Gesondheidsorg om toegang tot gehalte-gesondheidsorgsdiens te bevorder. Implementeer die assesserings, voldoening en bereiking van ideale kliniekstatus vir alle fasiliteite in die plaaslike areas. Monitor prestasie van sleutelprioriteitsprogramme volgens APP- en AOP-teikens. Bestuur van sleutelprioriteitsprogramme. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie gehalte sorg oor alle dissiplines te verseker. Voer gehalteverbeteringsoudits en opnames uit en rapporteer aan senior bestuur en multidissiplinêre gesondheidspan. Monitor en evalueer die lewering van gehalte-gesondheidsorg binne die fasiliteite. Gee advies oor verskeie aspekte van gehaltesorg binne die hele distrik. Verskaf maandelikse verslae aan toesighouers en senior bestuur. Monitor kliniese en nie-klinieke op 'n gereelde basis om voldoening aan prosesse te verseker. Verteenwoordig die hele distrik by die provinsiale Gehalte, Finansies en sleutelprioriteitsprogramfora.

zu.title: Sekela Mphathi wezokunakekelwa eziyisisekelo ezempilweni PHC (PNA8)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mphathi wezokunakekelwa ezempilweni PHC esifundazweni se-Mangaung Metro District esidinga i-diploma noma i-degree ezokunakekelwa kanye nokungenwa iminyaka engu-8 isuka emva kokubhaliswa.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezisisekelo ze-R25 okungukuthi i-Diploma/Degree eNursing noma izidingo ezingalingana ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengesiGuli sezokunakekelwa. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje eNORTH African Nursing Council njengesiguli sezokunakekelwa. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje eNORTH African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiguli sezokunakekelwa. Okungenani iminyaka engu-8 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanele/okubonakalayo ezokunakekelwa emva kokubhaliswa njengesiguli sezokunakekelwa e-SANC ezokunakekelwa ejwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube ukuhlangenwe nakho okufanele/okubonakalayo ezingeni labaphathi. Ilayisense yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha. Ukuhlangenwe nakho okuningi ezokunakekelwa eziyisisekelo ezempilweni. Amakhono kanye nolwazi: Ulwazi ngamasu nendlela yokunakekelwa ezokunakekelwa, izimiso ezomthetho zezokunakekelwa, kanye nezinye izakhiwo zomthetho ezihambisana njengoba ku: Nursing Act, Health Act. Occupational Health and Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho Pele Principles, Public Service Regulations, Labour Relations Act, Disciplinary Code kanye nendlela, Indlela yezikhala, njl. Amakhono abaphathi aqinile, amakhono ePhathiwe yezimali.
zu.duties: Sekela ukubuyiswa kwesimo kokwakheka kwezokunakekelwa kwezempilo eziyisisekelo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukufinyelela ezinkonzweni ezinhle zezokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Phatha izilinganiso, ukuhambisana nokufinyelela esimeni sezinkliniki ezinhle kuzo zonke izikhungo kumakhaya endawo. Qapha ukusebenza kohlelo lwezinto ezibalulekile ngokushaya komqondo kohlelo lwe-APP kanye nokushaya komqondo kohlelo lwe-AOP. Phatha izinhlelo eziyizinto ezibalulekile. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu labantu abanemikhakha ehlukene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle kuyo yonke imikhakha. Yenza izikahliziyo zokusuthuthukisa izinga kanye nezinhlelo zocwaningo uphinde ubike abaphathi abaphezulu kanye neqembu labantu abanemikhakha ehlukene ezempilweni. Qapha bese uhlolela ukulethwa kokunakekelwa okuhle ezempilweni ngaphakathi kwezikhungo. Nikeza izeluleko ngemikhakha ehlukene yokunakekelwa okuhle kuyo yonke indawo. Nikeza abaphethe imibiko yanyanga zonke kanye nabaphathi abaphezulu. Qapha okungaphezulu nangaphansi kwezokwelapha njalo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhambisana namasu. Mela yonke indawo emikhakheni yohlelo lweKhulu lesifundo ngohlulo, izimali kanye nezinhlelo ezibalulekile.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedisayo wezoBongikazi weMfundo yoBuntu baseMzantsi Afrika (PNA8)
xh.summary: Isithuba soSomagcini weNkqubo yoBongikazi esisithuba seMfundo yoBuntu baseMzantsi Afrika esithi sifuna umntu onediploma okanye idigri kwinkonzo yokunyanga, kwaye abe neminyaka engu-8 ubudala engangaphantsi kokuba esebenze emva kokubhaliswa kwakhona.
xh.requirements: Izifundo eziyimfuneko ezisezantsi ze-R25, oko kukuthi iDiploma/IDigri ezoBongikazi okanye izifundo ezingundoqo ezingenantlonipo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqirha wezoBongikazi. Ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwiBhunga loBongikazi baseMzantsi Afrika njengoGqirha wezoBongikazi. Ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwiBhunga loBongikazi baseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengoGqirha wezoBongikazi. Ukuba neminyaka engu-8 ubudala ingundoqo ngokusesikweni yokusebenza emsebenzini wezoBongikazi emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqirha wezoBongikazi kwi-SANC kwimisebenzi yomzimba onke. Oko kukuthi kubekho iminyaka engu-3 ubudala phakathi kwexesha elitshiwo ngasentla kwindlela yokulawula. Ilayisensi yokushova ebhalwe ngokusesikweni. Ukuba nolwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Uphononongo olujulileyo kwindlela yokusebenza ngemizekelo yeMfundo yoBuntu baseMzantsi Afrika eNtshona.
xh.duties: Xhasa kwakhwa ukwakhiwa kwezeMpilo yeNkunzi yoNtlalo ukuze kwandiswe ifikelelo kwinkonzo yezempilo emgangathweni elingundoqo. Zalisa iintlolo, ulwalamano nokufinyezwa kobungqangi bekliniki okuyinto esivelayo kuzo zonke iindawo eziKwimo yoBukhosi baseNgingaqamba. Lilisele impumelelo yeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo ezisisixo ngokwezi njongo ze-APP nese-AOP. Ulawulo lweenkqubo ezibalulekileyo ezisisixo. Sebenza njengesithundithuseqo sendlela-ntsebenziswano phakathi kweendlela ezahlukeneyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathazo olulungileyo kuzo zonke iindlela. Gcina ulwazi lokuphucula umgangatho wenkonzo kwaye ubike eBuhlalaphi bukaRhulumente naseqela leMfundo yoBantu baseMzantsi Afrika. Lilisele nokuqonda inkonzo yezempilo ekwimo yobuchule yoBahlali baseMzantsi Afrika. Nikela iingcebiso malunga neendlela ezahlukeneyo zokhathazo oluLungileyo kulo lonke umbindi woBukhosi baseMzantsi Afrika. Nikela iingxelo zenyanga kubaphathi bakho nakuRhulumente oPhakamileyo. Qwalasela untlalo nthlobo ngamnye ngokunesikhathi esimiselweyo ukuvakalisa ulwazi malunga neendlela ezahlukeneyo zokhathazo oluLungileyo kumbindi woBukhosi baseMzantsi Afrika onke.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Phc(pnb4)
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager for the HIV/AIDS and TB programme at Mangaung Metro District Office, requiring a nursing qualification and ten years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R25 qualifications i.e Diploma/Degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse plus a post –basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with SANC.A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. At least 6 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the 1-year post basic qualification. At least 3 years of the period referred to must be appropriate/ recognizable experience at Management level. Valid driver’s license. Computer literacy. Skills And Knowledge: Training in HIV/AIDS management i.e NIMART & wide experience in HAST programme. Travelling extensively and work extra hours. Strong ability to build and work as a team member. Good communication skills and intersectoral collaborations. Strong management and leadership skills. Ability to analyze data and quality assessment. Appropriate financial management.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic direction for the HIV/AIDs and TB(HAST) programme in the district. Implementation of the strategies aimed at behavioural change in reducing infections and retention of patients to care. Implement HAST programme according to the strategic plans. Provide programme technical and clinical and clinical support to the health care facilities and stakeholders. Implementation of all HAST programs in the district and monitors thereof. Management of HAST multidisciplinary team and stakeholder coordination. Analyze and manage HIV/AIDS and TB to strengthen programme implementation. Undertake clinic, hospital support visits and audits to ensure programme compliance. Lead health and wellness events that seek to influence behavioural change.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. TA Mokoqo Assistant Director: Admin and Support Email: MokoqoTA@fshealth.gov.za Cell: 067 422 5555
jobs.applications: To be done at: https://ihealth.fshealth.gov.za/e-Recruitment
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. The application must indicate the correct Job title, the office where the position is advertised and the Reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to fully complete the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications filed by hand on the Z83 will unfortunately not be considered. Should you be in a possession of foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Dual citizenship holders must provide the Police Clearance certificate from country of origin when shortlisted. All non-SA Citizens will be required to submit a copy of proof of South African permanent residence when shortlisted. Applications that do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements will not be considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. The Department does not accept applications via fax or post. Failure to upload and submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointments. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre-assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on posts technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Phc(pnb4)
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder vir die HIV/AIDS- en TB-program by Mangaung Metro Distrikkantoor, wat 'n verpleegkwalifikasie en tien jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R25-kwalifikasies, d.i. 'n Diploma/Degraad in verpleegkunde of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige plus 'n postbasiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by SANC. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ten minste 6 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na verwerwing van die 1-jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie wees. Ten minste 3 jaar van bedoelde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vaardighede en kennis: Opleiding in HIV/AIDS-bestuur, d.i. NIMART en uitgebreide ervaring in die HAST-program. Uitgebreide reis en buite-ure werk. Sterk vermoë om as 'n lid van 'n span saam te werk. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede en intersektoriële samewerking. Sterk bestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede. Vermoë om data en gehaltebeoordeling te ontleed. Toepaslike finansiële bestuur.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese rigting vir die HIV/AIDS- en TB(HAST)-program in die distrik. Implementering van strategieë wat op gedragsverandering gemik is om infeksies te verminder en pasiënte in sorg te behou. Implementeer die HAST-program volgens die strategiese planne. Verskaf tegniese en klinieke en klinieke steun aan die gesondheidsorgfasiliteite en belanghebbendes. Implementering van alle HAST-programme in die distrik en die monitering daarvan. Bestuur van die HAST-multidissiplinêre span en koördinering van belanghebbendes. Ontleed en bestuur HIV/AIDS en TB om programme implementering te versterk. Onderneem kliniek- en hospitaalondersteuningsbesoeke en oudits om programnakoming te verseker. Lei gesondheids- en welstandgebeurtenisse wat daarop gemik is om gedragsverandering te bewerkstellig.

zu.title: Umphathi oncedisayo Phc (pnb4)
zu.summary: Umphathi oncedisayo ohlelweni lwe-HIV/AIDS nethubethoshi (HAST) enkantolo yesifunda sase-Mangaung Metro District, ofuna iziqu zokwelapha kanye namava eminyaka engu-10.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezisisiseko i-R25 okungukuthi iDiploma/Digri kwezokwelapha noma iziqu ezingangayo ezivumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengongengazi ogwamile. Ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengongengazi ogwamile kakulunye nethobhu lokwelapha enyakeni owodwa okusemvokelwa yi-SANC. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yamava afanelekile/okwaziwa wokwelapha ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengongengazi ogwamile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-6 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yimava efanelekile/okwaziwa ngemva kokuthola ithobhu leminyaka eyodwa ngemva kweziqu. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yesikhathi esishiwo kumele ibe yimava efanelekile/okwaziwa ezingeni lokuphatha. Ilayisensi yokushayela ngokusemthethweni. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amafundo nolwazi: Ukufundiswa ekuphathweni kwe-HIV/AIDS okungukuthi i-NIMART namva amakhulu ohlelweni lwe-HAST. Ukuhamba kakhulu nokusebenza amahora aphezu kwayo. Isipho esikhulu sokwakha nokusebenza njengelungu legroupu. Amakhono okuthintana kahle kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwabasekho. Amakhono amakhulu okuphatha nokuholisa. Isipho sokuhlaziya idatha kanye nokuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi. Ukuphatha kwezimali okufanelekile.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso esingunomphela ohlelweni lwe-HIV/AIDS nethubethoshi (HAST) esifundeni. Ukusetshenziswa kwezindlela ezihlose ukushintsha ukuziphatha ekunciphiseni izifo ezelwa, ukugcinwa kwamagula ekwelaphweni. Sebenzisa uhlelo lwe-HAST ngokwezinhlelo zokuqondisa. Nikeza inkombo yohlelo, usekelo lwezokwelapha kwezikhungo zempilo nababambisene nabo. Ukusetshenziswa kwezohlelo zonso ze-HAST esifundeni nokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwazo. Ukuphathwa kwegroupu ehlangene ye-HAST kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwababambisene nabanye. Hlaziya uphathe i-HIV/AIDS nethubethoshi ukuze kululiswe ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zohlelo. Yenza izivakashi zokusekela ematholwa nasemaplanga kanye nokuhlola ukuqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo lulandelwa. Hola imikhakha yezempilo kwezempilo ehlose ukushintsha ukuziphatha.

xh.title: Umphathi Wencedo Phc (pnb4)
xh.summary: Umphathi oncedo kunkqubo ye-HIV/AIDS ne-TB kwiNkantsi yesebe leMangaung Metro District, efunwa isifanekiso sokunyanga kunye neminyaka elishumi yamava.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingunyelu ze-R25 ezithi Iyipholoma/Isidanga kwiNkcubeko okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo esivumela ukuwazisa kwi-SANC njengoGqirha weNkcubeko. Ukuwaziswa kwiBhunga leNkcubeko lasaMzantsi Afrika njengoGqirha weNkcubeko kunye nokuqwalaselwa-konke komfundo ongancedo ongaphezulu kochesi onobungakanani bonyaka owodwa onqatshiwe yi-SANC. Okungenani unyaka bawo-10 amava aqhelanekayo/avunyelwa kwinkonzo yokunyanga emva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoGqirha weNkcubeko. Okungenani unyaka bawo-6 kwexesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka abe ngamava aqhelanekayo/avunyelwa emva kokufumana isifanekiso sonyaka owodwa esingangenwa ngenkqubo. Okungenani unyaka bawo-3 kwexesha elitshiwo kufuneka abe ngamava aqhelanekayo/avunyelwa kwinqanaba loLawulo. Ilayisenisi yokushumba evunyiweyo. Ukusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha. Amakhono elulo nobuqwa: Uqeqesho kulawulo le-HIV/AIDS okuithi i-NIMART & namava amaninzi kunkqubo ye-HAST. Ukuhamba ubuncinane nexesha elongezelelweyo kukusebenza. Isakhono esomeleleyo sokuakha usebenze njengelungu leqela. Amakhono abalulekileyo ekunxibelelaneni noludlelwano nobunye obunye phakathi kweendawo. Isakhono esomeleleyo solawulo nolwe. Isakhono sokuqwalasela iinkcukacha zemihla nabulingcali bobuchule obuchanekileyo. Ulawulo lweemali olufanelekileyo.
xh.duties: Nika isalathiso esibalulekileyo inkqubo ye-HIV/AIDS ne-TB (HAST) kwisithili. Ukuphothulwa kweendlela ezijolise ekutshintsheni kokuziphatha ekuqhelaniseni iintsholongwane nokugcina abagulelwa kwinkqubo yokhathalelo. Phumla inkqubo ye-HAST ngokwemigangatho yeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo. Nika inkxaso yeenkcukacha ezobugcisa nezobugqirha kunye nonxibelelwano lwezempilo kumaziko ezempilo nabaphathe-maliswe. Ukuphothulwa kweenkqubo zonke ze-HAST kwisithili nokulawula kwazo. Ulawulo lwethu elinoxhaso ngobungcali obahlukeneyo le-HAST nobudlelwane nabaphathiswa. Hlaziya ulawule i-HIV/AIDS ne-TB ukuqinisa ukuphunyezwa kwenkqubo. Yenza olovo lwezikhuselo zesigulagula nezibhedlele ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana kwenkqubo. Yenza iindibano ezimalunga nexesha lempilo namagumbi ejolise ekutshintsheni kokuziphatha.

jobs.title: Director: Provincial Council on Aids
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive salary package). The remuneration package includes a basic salary, State’s contribution to the Government Employee Pension Fund and a flexible portion which may be structured in terms of the rules for the structuring of the flexible portion; and may include a 13th cheque, motor car allowance, home owner’s allowance and medical aid assistance.
jobs.summary: Director role overseeing the Free State Provincial Council on Aids, coordinating multi-sectoral HIV, TB and STI implementation.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate NQF Level 7 qualification as recognised by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) preferable in Public health and/or related disciplines. 5 years of experience at a middle / senior managerial level. Experience in social science, HIV, TB and STI related issues. Relevant experience working with Non-Governmental Organisations (NGO’s) and Donor funded programmes. Experience in the monitoring and evaluation of policies/implementation strategies and the management of resources. Planning, organising analytical and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of the relevant legislation applicable to the Council on AIDS, understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Potential applicants for posts in the Senior Management Service as well as existing SMS members who wish to progress to higher levels within the SMS are expected to successfully complete the compulsory pre-entry Certificate for entry into the SMS which took effect on 1 April 2020 (Full details can be sourced by following the link: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Individual applicants are expected to pay for the course, and the duration of the course is 120 hours). No applicant will be appointed in the absence of the certificate.
jobs.duties: Provision of professional administrative and secretariat services to Free State PCA. Manage and provide oversight on the implementation of the integrated multi-sectoral Provincial Implementation Plan for HIV, TB &STIs. Manage the establishment of HIV, TB and STI’s related Programme Forums, monitor and oversee implementation of resolutions. Monitor and evaluate the multi – sectoral response on HIV, TB and STI’s in the province. Supervise multistakeholder coordination including social mobilization (i.e. door to door) of HIV and TB programmes and provide strategic support to the Free State Provincial AIDS Council and all its structures i.e. District & Local AIDS Councils. Manage resources (Human physical and financial) in accordance with relevant directives and legislations.
jobs.applications: Submitted to Leanne Terblanche or Thabo Tsotetsi, Room 7, Ground floor, O.R Tambo House, Bloemfontein, or e-mail to recruitment@fspremier.gov.za
jobs.notes: The successful candidate will be required to enter into a Performance Agreement within 3 months after assumption of duty and will be required to disclose his/her financial interests in accordance with the prescribed regulations. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Applications must be submitted using the newly implemented Z83 form, obtainable from any Public Service Department or the DPSA website, under public service vacancy circulars and should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV only (with full particulars of the applicants’ training, qualifications, competencies, knowledge, duties & experience). All required information on the Z83 application form must be provided. Communication from the HR of the Department regarding the submission of certified copies of qualifications and other relevant documents will be limited to shortlisted candidates. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Applications that do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks/security clearance. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. Applicants are respectfully informed that if no response is received within 4 months of the closing date, they must accept that their application was unsuccessful. The department reserves the right not to fill this position. Persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. No late or faxed applications will be considered. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Provincial Council on Aids
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat toesig hou oor die Free State Provincial Council on Aids, en multisektoriale MIV-, TB- en STI-implementering koördineer.
af.requirements: Toepaslike NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie soos deur die South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) erken, verkieslik in Openbare gesondheid en/of verwante dissiplines. 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Ervaring in sosiale wetenskappe, MIV-, TB- en STI-verwante aangeleenthede. Relevante ervaring in die werk met Nie-regeringsorganisasies (NGO's) en deur skenkers befondsde programme. Ervaring in die monitering en evaluering van beleide/implementeringsstrategieë en die bestuur van hulpbronne. Beplannings-, organisatoriese, analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis van die toepaslike wetgewing wat op die Council on AIDS van toepassing is, begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Dienst regeer. Potensiële aansoekers vir poste in die Senior Management Service, asook bestaande SMS-lede wat na hoër vlakke binne die SMS wil vorder, word verwag om die verpligte voor-toelingsertifikaat vir toelating tot die SMS suksesvol te voltooi wat op 1 April 2020 in werking getree het (Volledige besonderhede kan verkry word deur die skakel te volg: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Individuele aansoekers word verwag om vir die kursus te betaal, en die duur van die kursus is 120 uur). Geen aansoeker sal in die afwesigheid van die sertifikaat aangestel word nie.
af.duties: Verskaffing van professionele administratiewe en sekretariële dienste aan Free State PCA. Bestuur en voorsien toesig oor die implementering van die geïntegreerde multisektoriale Provinciale Implementeringsplan vir MIV, TB en STI's. Bestuur die totstandbrenging van MIV-, TB- en STI-verwante Programforumme, monitor en oorsien die implementering van besluite. Monitor en evalueer die multisektoriale reaksie op MIV, TB en STI's in die provinsie. Oorsien multisakebelanghebbende-koördinering, insluitend sosiale mobilisering (d.w.s. van deur tot deur) van MIV- en TB-programme, en verskaf strategiese ondersteuning aan die Free State Provincial AIDS Council en al sy strukture, d.w.s. Distrik- en Plaaslike Vigsrade. Bestuur hulpbronne (menslike, fisiese en finansiële) ooreenkomstig toepaslike riglyne en wetgewing.

zu.title: Direktha: Provincial Council on Aids
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikadirektha esibuka i-Free State Provincial Council on Aids, sihlela ukuphathwa kwe-HIV, TB and STI kuzo zonke izingxenye.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezinga le-NQF Level 7 njengoba zivunywe umnyango we-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA) okuncamelayo kwi-Public health kanye/noma izifundo ezihlobene nalokho. Uhambo lokusebenza iminyaka engu-5 ezingeni labaphathi abaphakathi / abaphezulu. Uhambo lokusebenza kwabezifundo zentando yabantu, kwezindaba eziphathelene ne-HIV, TB and STI. Uhambo lokusebenza oluhlobene nokusebenza nama-Non-Governmental Organisations (NGO’s) namuhlelo oxhaswa ngabaphi. Uhambo lokusebenza ekubukeni nokuhlaziweni kwemithetho/amasu okuphatha kanye nokulawula izinsiza. Amakhono okuhlulela, ukuhlela, ukuhlaziya nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene ne-Council on AIDS, nokunemba emithethweni ebusa i-Public Service. Abafaka izinto abanomthombo wezikhundla kwi-Senior Management Service kanye nalabo abasele bengamalungu e-SMS abafuna ukuya ezingeni eliphezulu ngaphakathi kwe-SSMS, kulindeleke ukuthi baqedele ngempumelelo i-compulsory pre-entry Certificate for entry into the SMS eqale ukusebenza ngosuku luka-1 April 2020 (Imininingwane yonke itholakala ngokulandela isixhumanisi: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Kulindeleke ukuthi abafaki izinto ngabanye bakhokhe umkhuba, futhi isikhathi somkhuba ngu-120 hours). Akukho muntu ofaka izinto ozoqokwa engenale satifiketi.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsizakalo ezingunozwela nengabalingisi ku Free State PCA. Ukuqondisa futhi kulawule ukuphatha i-Provincial Implementation Plan for HIV, TB &STIs ehlanganisiwe enzingeni lomnyango ohlangene. Ukuqondisa ukusungwa kwezinkundla zohlelo ezihlobene ne-HIV, TB and STI’s, bese ubuka futhi ulawule ukuphathwa kwezinqumo. Ukubuka futhi kuhlaziye impendulo yezingxenye eziningi ze-HIV, TB and STI’s esifundazweni. Ukubuka ulawulo oluhlangene labalingisi abaningi kufaka phakathi ukusakaza kwentando yabantu (okungukuthi umnyango kumnyango) kwemikhuba ye-HIV and TB futhi ukunikeza inkxaso ebuqameleni ku Free State Provincial AIDS Council nazo zonke izakhiwo zayo okungukuthi i-District & Local AIDS Councils. Ukuphatha izinsiza (abantu, izimpahla nemali) ngokuvumelana nemiyalo nemitsetho ehambisana nayo.

xh.title: Umphathi: Provincial Council on Aids
xh.summary: Isithuba somntu ophethe i-Free State Provincial Council on Aids, olungelelanisa ukuphunywa koluvo olunabantu abahlukahlukenyo ngokwe-HIV, i-TB namanxwala afana ne-STI.
