xh.duties: Imisebenzi

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.department: Department of Public Works and Infrastructure
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive package). The remuneration package consists of a basic salary (70%), the Employer contribution to the Government Employee Pension Fund and flexible portion, which may be structured in terms of the rules for the structuring of the flexible portion and which may include 13th cheque, motor car allowance, homeowner’s allowance, and medical aid assistance.
jobs.summary: Chief Financial Officer at Level 14 in Bloemfontein requiring a BCom and five years of SMS experience in financial management.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate BCOM (NQ7) in Accounting, Financial Management, Commerce, Economics or an equivalent qualification recognised by SAQA, and a minimum of five (5) years’ experience at Senior Management Service (SMS) level in financial management. The Nyukela Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme is to be completed before appointment to the post. Extensive knowledge of and experience in Public Service financial management; Valid driver’s licence. Appointment is subject to the following: Performance Agreement, Personnel Suitability Checks, SMS Contract, Competency Assessment, and Financial Disclosure.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic financial leadership and direction to the Department by ensuring sound financial governance, prudent financial management, and compliance with the Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, and other applicable legislative and regulatory frameworks. Provide strategic financial advice and support to the Accounting Officer and Executive Management on all matters with financial, governance and strategic implications. Develop, implement and continuously improve financial management strategies, policies, systems, standards and internal controls to promote sound financial governance. Ensure effective financial planning, budgeting, expenditure management, revenue management, financial reporting, cash flow management and forecasting across the Department. Ensure the maintenance of complete, accurate and reliable financial records in accordance with prescribed accounting standards and legislative requirements. Oversee the preparation and submission of the Department’s and all statutory month, quarterly and annual financial reports to Provincial Treasury, oversight structures and other relevant stakeholders. Monitor compliance with applicable accounting standards, financial legislation, Treasury Regulations, departmental policies and internal control measures. Direct and oversee the development, implementation and monitoring of the Department’s Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Annual Budget, Adjustments Budget and budget implementation plans. Ensure effective management of departmental budgets, including expenditure monitoring, cash flow management, budget forecasting, virements, roll-overs and budget adjustments. Align financial planning and budget allocations with the Department’s Strategic Plan, Annual Performance Plan and Operational Plans to support the achievement of strategic objective. Oversee the implementation and continuous improvement of management accounting systems to support informed decision-making and financial sustainability. Provide strategic oversight of Supply Chain Management, procurement, contract management and asset management functions in accordance with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Preferential Procurement legislation and other applicable regulatory prescripts. Ensure the development and implementation of effective procurement, contract management and asset management policies, systems and controls. Oversee the preparation and implementation of the Departmental Procurement Plan and ensure alignment with approved strategic priorities and available budgets. Ensure the effective management, safeguarding, maintenance and accounting of departmental assets. Establish, implement and maintain an integrated system of internal financial controls to promote accountability, transparency and sound governance. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of internal and external audit recommendations and ensure timely resolution of audit findings. Facilitate financial assurance processes and strengthen governance through effective risk management and compliance monitoring. Develop and maintain an appropriate framework of financial delegations to support effective financial administration. Advise and support the Accounting Officer and Executive Management in fulfilling their responsibilities in terms of the PFM and other applicable legislation. Develop innovative financial strategies and solutions to improve operational efficiency, cost-effectiveness and value for money in service delivery. Facilitate the implementation of applicable national and provincial financial norms, standards and best practices across the Department. Provide strategic oversight of financial management information systems and ensure business continuity arrangements for critical financial systems and services. Provide strategic leadership and effective management of the Chief Directorate by ensuring sound governance, high performance and continuous improvement. Lead, develop, mentor and manage employees through effective performance management, coaching, succession planning and capacity building. Manage the human, financial and physical resources of the Chief Directorate in accordance with applicable legislation and departmental policies. Develop and manage the Chief Directorate’s operational and budget plans, monitor expenditure, and ensure effective utilisation of allocated resources. Promote ethical leadership, accountability, good governance and a high-performance organisational culture.
jobs.enquiries: Mr M Tshabalala Head: Public Works and Infrastructure Tel No: (051) 492 3909
jobs.applications: The Department of Public Works and Infrastructure to be Submitted To: Head: Public Works and Infrastructure, Human Resources Management Directorate. P.O Box 7551, Bloemfontein, 9300 Or Applications that are hand delivered must be brought at the Foyer of OR Tambo House where they must be placed in the appropriately marked box at: Security Ground Floor, OR Tambo House, St. Andrews Street, Bloemfontein or e-mail to e- recruitmentfsdpwi@fsworks.gov.za. No Applications will be accepted by staff in offices in the building.
jobs.notes: Directions to applicants Applications must be submitted on the new prescribed Z83 application form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at http://www.info.gov.za. The Z83 should be completed in a manner that allows the selection committee to assess the application based on the information provided on the form. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication. If the certified copies contradict the details on the CV or Z83 form, the candidate will automatically be disqualified and removed from the shortlist. Should an applicant possess a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered. Applicants must indicate the reference number of the vacancy in their applications. Should an applicant wish to apply for more than one post, separate applications must be submitted i.e. all the documentation must be submitted for each post applied for. Applications received after the closing date and those that do not comply with these instructions will not be considered. Candidates requiring additional information regarding the advertised post should direct their enquiries to the relevant person as indicated in the advertisement. Note: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Short-listed candidates will on the day of interview undergo a security assessment. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks as deemed appropriate and inclusive inter alia of criminal record check, citizenship verification, financial/asset record checks, qualification/study verification and previous employment verification. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. The successful candidate will be required to enter into a performance agreement, annually disclose financial interests, and comply with all requirements applicable to members of the Senior Management Service. The Department is committed to the achievement and maintenance of diversity and equity in employment, particularly in respect of race, gender, and disability. Preference will therefore be given to candidates whose appointment will promote representativeness in line with the Department’s Employment Equity Plan. If you have not been contacted within 4 months of the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. Faxed or late applications will not be accepted. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hooffinansiële beampte
af.summary: Hooffinansiële beampte op Vlak 14 in Bloemfontein wat 'n BCom en vyf jaar se SMS-ervaring in finansiële bestuur vereis.
af.requirements: Toepaslike BCOM (NQ7) in Rekenkunde, Finansiële Bestuur, Handel, Ekonomie of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat deur SAQA erken word, en 'n minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op Senior Management Service (SMS)-vlak in finansiële bestuur. Die Nyukela Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme moet voor aanstelling in die pos voltooi word. Uitgebreide kennis van en ervaring in Openbare Diens finansiële bestuur; Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Aanstelling is onderhewig aan die volgende: Prestasieooreenkoms, Geskiktheidsondersoeke van Personeel, SMS-kontrak, Bevoegdheidsassessering, en Finansiële Voldoeningsverslag.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese finansiële leierskap en rigting aan die departement deur goeie finansiële bestuur, versigtige finansiële bestuur en nakoming van die Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (PFMA), Tesourie-regulasies en ander toepaslike wetgewende en regulatoriese raamwerke te verseker. Verskaf strategiese finansiële advies en steun aan die Accounting Officer en Uitvoerende Bestuur oor alle aangeleenthede met finansiële, bestuurs- en strategiese implikasies. Ontwikkel, implementeer en verbeter voortdurend finansiële bestuursstrategieë, beleide, stelsels, standaarde en interne kontroles om goeie finansiële bestuur te bevorder. Verseker doeltreffende finansiële beplanning, begroting, bestuursuitgawes, inkomste bestuur, finansiële verslagdoening, kontantvloei bestuur en prognoses oor die departement. Verseker die handhawing van volledige, akkurate en betroubare finansiële rekords in ooreenstemming met voorgeskrewe rekenkundige standaarde en wetgewende vereistes. Hou toesig oor die voorbereiding en indiening van die departement se en alle statutêre maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse finansiële verslae aan die Provinciale Tesourie, toesigstrukture en ander relevante belanghebbendes. Monitor nakoming van toepaslike rekenkundige standaarde, finansiële wetgewing, Tesourie-regulasies, departementele beleide en interne beheermaatreëls. Stuur en hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van die departement se Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), Jaarlikse Begroting, Aanpassingsbegroting en begrotingsimplementeringsplanne. Verseker doeltreffende bestuur van departementele begrotings, insluitend uitgawemonitering, kontantvloei bestuur, begrotingsprognoses, herleidinge, oorpligtinge en begrotingsaanpassings. Belyn finansiële beplanning en begrotingsallocasies met die departement se Strategiese Plan, Jaarlikse Prestasieplan en Operasionele Planne om die bereiking van strategiese doelwitte te ondersteun. Hou toesig oor die implementering en voortdurende verbetering van bestuursrekenkundige stelsels om ingeligte besluitneming en finansiële volhoubaarheid te ondersteun. Verskaf strategiese toesig oor Supply Chain Management, verkryging, kontrakbestuur en bates bestuur funksies in ooreenstemming met die PFMA, Tesourie-regulasies, voorkeurverkrygingswetgewing en ander toepaslike regulatoriese voorskrifte. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van doeltreffende verkrygings-, kontrakbestuur- en batesbestuursbeleid, stelsels en kontroles. Hou toesig oor die voorbereiding en implementering van die Departementele Verkrygingsplan en verseker belyning met goedgekeurde strategiese prioriteite en beskikbare begrotings. Verseker die doeltreffende bestuur, beveiliging, onderhoud en rekeningkunde van departementele bates. Stel 'n geïntegreerde stelsel van interne finansiële kontroles op, implementeer en onderhou dit om verantwoordelikheid, deursigtigheid en goeie bestuur te bevorder. Koördineer en monitor die implementering van interne en externe oudit-aanbevelings en verseker tydige oplossing van ouditbevindings. Fasiliteer finansiële versekeringsprosesse en versterk bestuur deur doeltreffende risikobestuur en nakomingsmonitering. Ontwikkel en onderhou 'n toepaslike raamwerk van finansiële afwentelings om doeltreffende finansiële administrasie te ondersteun. Adviseer en ondersteun die Accounting Officer en Uitvoerende Bestuur om hul verantwoordelikhede ingevolge die PFMA en ander toepaslike wetgewing na te kom. Ontwikkel innoverende finansiële strategieë en oplossings om bedryfdoeltreffendheid, koste-effektiwiteit en waarde vir geld in dienslewering te verbeter. Fasiliteer die implementering van toepaslike nasionale en provinsiale finansiële norme, standaarde en beste praktyke oor die departement. Verskaf strategiese toesig oor finansiële bestuursinligtingstelsels en verseker besigheidskontinuïteitsreëlings vir kritiese finansiële stelsels en dienste. Verskaf strategiese leierskap en doeltreffende bestuur van die Hoofdirektoraat deur goeie bestuur, hoë prestasie en voortdurende verbetering te verseker. Lei, ontwikkel, mentor en bestuur werknemers deur doeltreffende prestasiebestuur, afrigting, opvolgbeplanning en kapasiteitsbou. Bestuur die menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne van die Hoofdirektoraat in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en departementele beleide. Ontwikkel en bestuur die Hoofdirektoraat se operasionele en begrotingsplanne, monitor uitgawes en verseker doeltreffende benutting van toegewysde hulpbronne. Bevorder etiese leierskap, verantwoordelikheid, goeie bestuur en 'n hoë-prestasie organisasiekultuur.

zu.title: IChief Financial Officer
zu.summary: IChief Financial Officer ku-Level 14 eBloemfontein kadingwa i-BCom kanye neminyaka emihlanu yesipiliyunjini se-SMS ekuphathweni kwezimali.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi esifanele se-BCOM (NQ7) kwe-Accounting, Financial Management, Commerce, Economics noma isitifiketi esilinganayo esivunyiwe yi-SAQA, kanti kadingwa ubulunga bonyaka abayisihlanu (5) ngokulinganayo kwizinga le-Senior Management Service (SMS) ekuphathweni kwezimali. I-Nyukela Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme kufanele igqitywe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ulwazi olunamandla nokuphathwa kwezimali kwi-Public Service; ilayisense yokushayela elivunyiwe. Ukubekwa esikhundleni kusekelwe okulandelayo: Isivumelwano semisebenzi, Ukuhlolwa kwezidingo zomuntu, Isivumelwano se-SMS, Ukubheka ubunjalo, kanye nokubika ngemali.
zu.duties: Nikeza ubuholi bezinqubo ezibalulekile nezinqondiso kwi-Department ngokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle kwezimali, ukuphathwa kwabihe kwezimali, nokuhambisana ne-Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (PFMA), iziMiso zeTreasury, nezinye izindlela ezibalulekile ezomthetho nemithelela. Nikeza izeluleko ezibalulekile nezimali kanye nokwesekwa kwentengo ye-Accounting Officer kanye ne-Executive Management kuyo yonke imikhakha enemithelela yezimali, ukuphathwa, kanye nezinqondo ezibalulekile. Bumba, phumeza uphucule ngokuqhubekayo izinqubo zokuphathwa kwezimali, izinqubomgomo, izimiso, izinga namalawu angaphakathi ukuze akhuthaze ukuphathwa okuhle kwezimali. Qinisekisa ukucubungula okusebenzayo kwezimali, ukwenza izabelo, ukuphathwa kokuchitha, ukuphathwa kwemali engenayo, ukubika ngeimali, ukuphathwa kokuhamba kwemali nokubikezela kuyo yonke i-Department. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemibhalo yezimali egcwele, elungile ethembekile ngokuhambisana nemizwelo ebekiwe yokubala kwezimali nezidingo zomthetho. Qapha ukulungiswa nokungeniswa kwemibikobiko yezinyanga, yamaphakathi nonyaka kwi-Department yonke futhi ngokomthetho ebikwa kwi-Provincial Treasury, izakhiwo eziqaphayo kanye nezinye izinhlangani ezibalulekile. Buka ukuthobela imizwelo yokubala kwezimali, umthetho wezimali, iziMiso zeTreasury, izinqubomgomo zomnyango kanye nezinyathelo zolawulo lwangaphakathi. Hola uphumeze ulawule uphucule kanjalo ukuthuthukiswa kwesakhiwo saphakathi se-Department se-Medium-Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF), isabelo sonyaka, isabelo esilungisiwe kanye nezinhlela zokuphumeza isabelo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwamasabelo omnyango, okuhlanganisa ukulawula ukuchithwa, ukuphathwa kwesikhathi somshwalense nokuhamba kwemali, ukubikezela isabelo, ukudluliselwa kwemali, ukugqibisa ukugqiba konyaka nezilungiso zesabelo. Hlanganisa ukucubungula izimali namasabelo nenhlelo-lenqondo ye-Department, inhlelo yemisebenzi yonyaka kanye namahlela okusebenza ukuze useke ukufeza inhloso ebalulekile. Lawula uphumeze uphucule kanjalo izimiso zokuphathwa kwezimali zezibalo ukuze useke izinqumbo ezisemqoka nokuzinza ngezimali. Nikeza ubuholi bezinqondo bezinqubo kwi-Supply Chain Management, ukuthenga, ukuphathwa kwamavesi kanye nomsebenzi wokuphathwa kwempahla ngokuhambisana ne-PFMA, iziMiso zeTreasury, umthetho we-Preferential Procurement kanye nezinye imiyalelo ebalulekile. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuphumezwa kwezinqubomgomo zokuthenga ezisebenzayo, ukuphathwa kwamavesi kanye namapholisi okuphathwa kwempahla. Qapha ukulungiswa nokuphumezwa kwenhlelo yokuthenga yesifunda futhi ngokomnyango, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana nezinto ezibalulekiley ezivunyiwe namasabelo atholakalayo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle, ukugada, ukulondoloza nokubala ngeimali yezimpahla zomnyango. Saka phumeza ulondoloze isimiso esihlangene solawulo lwangaphakathi lwezimali ukukhuthaza ukubekekile, ukubonakala nokuphathwa okuhle. Linganisa ulawule uphumeze izeluleko zenhloli engaphakathi nangaphandle futhi qinisekisa ukuxazulula ngokushesha izinselelo eziyisiyingi ezitholwa ngohlelo lokubhekisisa. Qedela izinqubo zokuqinisekisa izimali futhi wenze ngamandla ukuphathwa ngokuzonda ubungozi nokubheka ukuthobela imithetho. Bumba ulondoloze usakhiwo olufanele lokwabelana ngemigomo yezimali ukusekela ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwezimali. Sikhwesaba useke i-Accounting Officer kanye ne-Executive Management ekufezeni imisebenzi yabo ngokwe-PFM nemithetho yokwenzeka. Bumba izinqubomgomo nezixazululo zemali ezintsha ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza ngempumelelo, ukulinganisela ngokwezindleko kanye nento etholakalayo ngemali ekulethweni kwenkonzo. Qedela ukuphumeza imigomo yezimali, izindingo nemikhuba emihle kazwelonke nasifundazeni kuyo yonke i-Department. Nikeza ubuholi bezinqondiso kumanethiwekhi wokuphathwa kwezimali kanye nesimiso esihamba phambili esinamathiselwe kumanethiwekhi abalulekile nezinsizakalo ezihamba phambili futhi ezibheke inqubo yokuphela kokusebenza. Nikeza ubuholi bezinqondiso kanye nokuphathwa okusebenzayo kwi-Chief Directorate ngokwethula ukuphathwa okuhle, ukusebenza kahle nokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo. Hola uphucule ulawule abasebenzi ngokusebenzisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kokusebenza, ukwesekwa nokuqondisa, ukucubungula ukulandelana kanye nokwakhiwa amandla enkonzo. Lawula izinsizakalo ezintho, ezimali namaphysical e-Chief Directorate ngokuhambisana nomthetho osebenzayo namapholisi omnyango. Bumba ulawule amahlela abuyekeze i-Chief Directorate, ulawule ukuchithwa, ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwamathomu abekiwe. Khuthaza ubuholi obuhle, ukubekekile, ukuphathwa okuhle kanye nenhleso yokusebenza kahle kakhulu.

xh.title: Noxumba Wezimali
xh.summary: Noxumba Wezimali kwinqanaba 14 eBloemfontein ofuna i-BCom kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava e-SMS kwindlela yokulawula imali.
xh.requirements: I-BCOM (NQ7) efanelekileyo kwi-Accounting, Financial Management, Commerce, Economics okanye isifanekiso esilinganayo esivunyiwe ngumazwe we-SAQA, kunye neminyaka engu- (5) ubuncinane yamava kwinqanaba lokuLawula AbaPhakathi (SMS) kwindlela yokulawula imali. Inkqubo yeNyukela Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme mayigqitywe ngaphambi kokwenzelwa umsebenzi kwisithuba. Ulwazi olubanzi nolamava kwindlela yokulawula imali yoQoqosho Lomanyano; Ilayisenisi yokushayela eseleyo. Ukubekelwa umsebenzi kuxhomekeka koku kulandelayo: Isivumelwano ngokuSebenza, Iimvavanyo zeKhaladi, Isivumelwano se-SMS, uVavanyo lokuZinza, nokuXulula iNkcazelo ngeMalayo.
xh.duties: Nika inkundla yokulawula imali nokuqhutywa phambili kwisebe ngokuqinisekisa ulawulo oluhle lwemali, ukulawula imali ngokuqonda, nokuqhathanisa noMthetho woLawulo lweMali woQoqosho Lomanyano, 1999 (PFMA), iMigaqo yeNqongwana, nolunye ulwavo lomthetho nalwezigaqo ezifanelekayo. Nika inkundla yoluleko lokulawula imali kunye nenzayo kuMlawuli wee-Akhawunti nakuBaphathi Bamagosa ngayo yonke imiba enemiphumela ekulawulweni kwemali, kolawulo nakuqhutyweni phambili. Tumba, sebenzisa yaye uphucule ngokuqhubekayo iindlela zamagama, iinkqubo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zemigaqo nolawulo lwangaphakathi ukukhuthaza ulawulo oluhle lwemali. Qinisekisa uqokelelo lwezimali olusebenzayo, ulawulo lwebhajeti, ulawulo lokuhamba kwemali, ulawulo lwenkqubo yemali, iingxelo zimali, ulawulo lwamaza emali nokubhaka kuyo yonke isebe. Qinisekisa ulondolazo lweerekhodi ezizele, ezichanekileyo ezithembekileyo zemali ngokwemigaqo echaziweyo yee-akhawunti noku ngokwemfuno yomthetho. Lawula ulungiselelo nokuhambiswa kweekhawuntara zenyanga, zethutyana negqitha kwihlobo zomnyaka zengxelo zemali zesebe kwaye ezingamagosa kwiProvincial Treasury, kumagunya okuqwalasela nakwabanye abathintelayo. Qwalasela ukuzinza ngokwemigaqo yee-akhawunti ezifanelekayo, umthetho wemali, iMigaqo yeNqongwana, iinkqubo zesebe nolawulo lwangaphakathi. Qondisa ulawule ukutumba, ukusebenzisa nokuqwalasela iNkqubo yeMitha yokuTshaza iMali (MTEF) yesebe, iBhajeti yoNyaka, iBhajeti yoLungiselelo nolwakhiwo lokusebenza kwebhajeti. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lweebhajeti zesebe, kuquka ulawulo lokuhamba kwemali, ulawulo lwamaza emali, ukubhaka ibhajeti, i-virement, ama-roll-over nolungiselelo lwebhajeti. Misela uqokelelo lwemali nokuqwalasela kwamagabelo ebhajeti nokuLungelelanisa iNkqubo yokuQhuba phambili yesebe, iNkqubo yoKusebenza ngomNyaka nokuQwalasela iNkqubo zeMisebenzi ukuxhasa ukuphunyezelwa komgomo oqhuba phambili. Lawula ukusebenzisa nokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo iinkqubo zokuqwalasela ii-akhawunti zolawulo ukuxhasa izigqibo-ezinikiweyo nokuqhutywa phambili kokuzinza kwemali. Nika ulawulo oluluqu phambili loluLawulo lweNqubo yeNtengiselwano, intengiselwano, ulawulo lweNkontilaki nolawulo lwempahla ngokwakhe PFMA, iMigaqo yeNqongwana, umthetho weNtengiselwano eNqabileyo nolunye ulwavo lolawulo. Qinisekisa ukutumba nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zentengiselwano, ulawulo lweekontilaki nolawulo lwempahla ezisebenzayo, iinkqubo nolawulo. Lawula ulungiselelo nokusebenzisa iNkqubo yokuNgenisa yesebe futhi uqinisekise uLungelelaniso nakuMiso ngokuMiselweyo phambili nokusetyenziswa kwebhajeti ekhona. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo, nokuQinisekisa impahla yokugcina, ukuLondoloza nokuBala kwempahla yesebe. Misela, sebenzisa futhi uLondoloze inkqubo edityaniswe yonke yolawulo lwangaphakathi lwemali ukukhuthaza ukuxela, ukuchaza ngokucacileyo nokulawula okuhle. Yongeza uLawule ukusebenziswa kweekhawuntara ezinomdla nangaphandle ezincoma nokuqinisekisa izisombulo ngexesha lemfundo yazo. Yolusa iinkqubo zokuQinisekisa iNzuzo yemali yize uQuke iNkqubo yokuLawula iMingoSule nokukhupha ulwazi, nokuQwalasela ukuzinza. Tumba futhi uLondoloze ulwavo olufanelekileyo lokwabelana kwamagunya okuLawula imali ukuxhasa ulawulo lwemali olusebenzayo. Nika ululeko noncedo kuMlawuli wee-Akhawunti nakuBaphathi Bamagosa ngokugqiba iMisebenzi yawo ngokwemiQathango ye-PFM nalo nyeye umthetho ofanelekayo. Tumba iindlela ezitsha zamagama kwezimali nokuQwalasela ngokuzinza kokuSebenza, ukusebenza ngokweXabiso nokuQinisekisa uxabiso lemali ekunikeni iinkonzo. Yolusa ukusebenziswa kweziMigaqo namazinga amaNanga naweSifunda kwimali kwakulo lonke isebe. Nika ulawulo oluQhuba phambili lweNkqubo zokuLawula iMali kwaye uQinisekise iNtshukumo yokuQhutywa kwemisebenzi yeNkqubo eNgathi kweSizwe nakuQoqosho iNkulu. Nika ulawulo oluQhuba phambili nokuLawula okuSebenzayo kwiNdlenkululele eNkulu ngokuQinisekisa ulawulo oluhle, ukuPhelelwa nguBunyulu nokuPhucula. Qhutywa, tumba, nkethisa futhi ulawule abasebenzi ngokwenza inkqubo yokuSebenza ngokuQinisekisa ukuQondwa kwemisebenzi, ukuyala, ulwakhiwo lokuLandela nokuQaqamba kwamandla. Lawula imizimba yomntu, yemali nendalo yeNdlenkululele eNkulu ngokwemithetho nayenzeke nokuSebenzayo kwemiQathango. Tumba ulawule iiNkqubo zokuSebenza neBhajeti zeNdlenkululele eNkulu, uQwalasele ukutShatsha kwemali, uQinisekise ukuSebenziswa okuQinisekileyo kwamandla akabelwe. Khuthaza ukuba ngumQambi weNkqubo, uxela, ulawulo oluhle noluKhoyo lweNkqubo eQinqweyile.

jobs.title: Director: Risk Anti-corruption & Integrity Management
jobs.department: Department of Agriculture and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs).
jobs.closing_date_text: 28 September 2026, 16h00. No late applications will be considered.
jobs.summary: Lead enterprise risk management, anti-corruption and integrity services for the Gauteng Department of Agriculture and Rural Development at Head Office.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Risk Management or related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years’ experience at middle or senior management level in Risk management environments. A valid driver’s licence. Competencies: Leadership, Management, Planning, Organizing, People management, Service Delivery, Communication, Decision Making, Problem solving, Report writing, Teamwork, Risk management, Customer management, Innovation/ continuous improvement, Analytical, Negotiations, Computer literacy, Project management, Flexible. Knowledge of Departmental policies and procedures, Government Priorities, Risk management policies and frameworks, Reporting procedures, Information system, SA Constitution, Employment Equity Act,1998. Ability to Interpret & Evaluate Information, Verbal and written communication, Organizing/maintaining information, communicating information, Computer Literacy, Problem solving and conflict management, Listening and negotiation, Tact and diplomacy, Teamwork, Discipline, Financial Management. Business acumen, Team Leader, Strategist, Flexible/Change oriented, Problem-solving ability, Responsive, Interpersonal relations, Customer focus, Loyal and friendly, Open-minded, Responsible and accountable.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of enterprise risk management services. Conduct strategic risk assessment. Conduct operational risk assessment. Develop and review the risk management strategy. Coordinate monthly progress reporting against the risk register. Develop and monitor the organisational risk management plan. Ensure training of risk officials and risk committee members. Prepare monthly and quarterly reports for risk management committee. Develop and review organisational risk management policy. Manage the implementation, development and monitoring of business continuity plans. Establish BCP governance structures. Develop policies and standards related to disaster recovery. Ensure that business continuity plans are in place. Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements. Promote the implementation of code of conduct and ensure ethical environment. Develop, implement and maintain policies, procedures and systems. Identify risk and threats related to ethical environment. Conduct ethics and integrity awareness for the department. Promote financial disclosure system. Develop and maintain internal anti-corruption systems. Investigate all allegations of fraud and corruption received from internal and external persons. Conduct research on latest fraud and corruption legislation and develop educational programmes. Develop and implement fraud prevention ad anti-corruption strategies. Conduct fraud risk assessment. Develop and monitor the fraud prevention plan. Provide strategic direction for the directorate. Research and keep abreast of breast practice initiatives and developments within the directorate. Develop business/ strategic plan for the directorate and align it with Chief Directorate and ensure implementation thereof. Oversee the development and implementation of operational plans for the directorate. Develop and coordinate a service delivery improvement plan. Manage resources (Human/ Finance/Equipment/ Assets). Ensure proper implementation of budget by monitoring, projecting and reporting expenditure. Ensure proper spending in line with strategic objectives. Monitor the optimal utilization and functionality of equipment. Evaluate and monitor performance of employees to ensure achievement strategic goal. Manage the human resource development of employees in the directorate. Enhance and maintain employee motivation.
jobs.applications: To apply for the above position, please apply online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za or email at GDARDRecruitment@gauteng.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Ms. Gugu Nevondo at 072 904 1694– Recruitment
jobs.notes: Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on a New Z.83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Applications with the Old Z.83 form will not be considered. A New Z.83 form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialled by the applicant. A recent, comprehensive CV, specifying all qualifications and experience, with respective dates must accompany the application form. Applications are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Communication regarding certified documents will be limited only to the shortlisted candidates. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela certificate) is required before the appointment can be made. Enrolment for the course should be made on the NSG’s website at https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entryprogramme.                 All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Following the interview and technical exercise, the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency-based assessments). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. It is the Department intention to promote equity through the filling of all numeric targets as contained in the Employment Equity Plan (Coloureds and Indians are encouraged apply). To facilitate this process successfully, an indication of race, gender and disability status is required. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). General information. The Department will not accept posted and emailed applications. The Gauteng Department of Environment reserves the right to fill or not fill the advertised posts. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Risk Anti-corruption & Integrity Management
af.summary: Bestuur ondernemingsrisikobestuur, korrupsiebestryding en integriteitsdienste vir die Gauteng Department of Agriculture and Rural Development by Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: Matric plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) in Risk Management of 'n verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op middle or senior management vlak in Risk management omgewings. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Leierskap, Bestuur, Beplanning, Organisasie, Mensebestuur, Dienslewering, Kommunikasie, Besluitneming, Probleemoplossing, Verslagskrywing, Spanwerk, Risikobestuur, Kliëntbestuur, Innoveer/ deurlopende verbetering, Analities, Onderhandeling, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Projekbestuur, Aanpasbaar. Kennis van departementele beleide en prosedures, Regeringsprioriteite, Risikobestuursbeleide en -raamwerke, Verslagdoeningsprosedures, Inligtingstelsel, SA Constitution, Employment Equity Act, 1998. Vermoë om inligting te interpreteer en te evalueer, verbale en geskrewe kommunikasie, inligting organiseer/handhaaf, inligting kommunikeer, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Probleemoplossing en konflikbestuur, Luister en onderhandeling, Tak en diplomasie, Spanwerk, Dissipline, Finansiële bestuur. Besigheidsinsig, Spanleier, Strateeg, Aanpasbaar/veranderingsgerig, Probleemoplossingsvermoë, Responsief, Interpersoonlike verhoudings, Kliëntfokus, Loyaal en vriendelik, Oopkop, Verantwoordelik en aanspreeklik.
af.duties: Bestuur die voorsiening van ondernemingsrisiko-bestuursdienste. Voer strategiese risiko-assesserings uit. Voer operasionele risiko-assesserings uit. Ontwikkel en hersien die risikobestuurstrategie. Koördineer maandelikse vorderingsverslae teen die risikoregister. Ontwikkel en monitor die organisatoriese risikobestuursplan. Verseker opleiding van risiko-amptenare en risikokomiteelede. Berei maandelikse en kwartaalverslae vir die risikobestuurkomitee voor. Ontwikkel en hersien organisatoriese risikobestuursbeleid. Bestuur die implementering, ontwikkeling en monitering van besigheidskontinuiteitsplanne. Stel BCP-bestuursstrukture op. Ontwikkel beleide en standaarde wat verband hou met rampherstel. Verseker dat besigheidskontinuiteitsplanne in plek is. Verseker belyning met regulerende vereistes. Bevorder die implementering van die gedragskode en verseker 'n etiese omgewing. Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf beleide, prosedures en stelsels. Identifiseer risiko's en bedreigings wat verband hou met die etiese omgewing. Voer etiek- en integriteitsbewustheid vir die departement uit. Bevorder die finansiële openbaarmakingstelsel. Ontwikkel en handhaaf interne korrupsiebestrydingstelsels. Ondersoek alle bewerings van bedrog en korrupsie wat van interne en eksterne persone ontvang is. Voer navorsing oor die jongste bedrog- en korrupsiewetgewing uit en ontwikkel opvoedkundige programme. Ontwikkel en implementeer bedrogvoorkoming- en korrupsiebestrydingstrategieë. Voer bedrogrisiko-assessering uit. Ontwikkel en monitor die bedrogvoorkomingsplan. Verskaf strategiese rigting vir die direktoraat. Doen navorsing en hou tred met best-practice inisiatiewe en ontwikkelinge binne die direktoraat. Ontwikkel 'n besigheids-/strategiese plan vir die direktoraat en belyn dit met die Hoofdirektoraat en verseker die implementering daarvan. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling en implementering van operasionele planne vir die direktoraat. Ontwikkel en koördineer 'n diensleweringverbeteringsplan. Bestuur hulpbronne (Menslik/Finansies/toerusting/bates). Verseker behoorlike implementering van begroting deur uitgawes te monitor, te projekteer en te rapporteer. Verseker behoorlike besteding in ooreenstemming met strategiese doelwitte. Monitor die optimale benutting en funksionaliteit van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie van werknemers om bereiking van strategiese doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die menslike hulpbronontwikkeling van werknemers in die direktoraat. Verbeter en handhaaf werknemermotivering.

zu.title: Umholi Wokulwa Nobuqhothha Nokuqinisekisa Iphrothokholo Yezingozi
zu.summary: Hola ukuphathwa kwezingozi zabusha bokuhweba, ukulwa nobuqhothha nezinsiza zokuqinisekiswa iholo kuso Department of Agriculture and Rural Development eGauteng e Head Office.
zu.requirements: Ithuluzi lokugqashula ngemva kweminyaka eyi-7 kubuqotho bokulawula izingozi noma inkundla ehlobene njengoba kuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yohlu lokusebenza ezingeni laphakathi noma esiphezulu sobuholi kumasimu okulawula izingozi. Ilayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni. Amakhono: Abuphathi, Ukuphatha, Ukubuka, Ukuhlela, Ukuphatha abantu, Ukunikezwa kwenkonzo, Ukuxhumana, Ukwenza izinqumo, Ukuxazulula izinkinga, Ukubika, Ukusebenza njengeqembu, Ukulawula izingozi, Ukuphatha abathengi, Intuthuko/ukuthuthukisa ngokuphefumula, Ukuhlaziya, Izinkulumo zokuxoxisana, Ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha, Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, Ukuguquguquka. Ulwazi ngwezinqubomgomo nenzindo zomnyango, Okubalulekile kuhulumeni, Izinqubomgomo nezakhiwo zokulawula izingozi, Izindlela zokubika, Uhlelo lokwaziswa, Umthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, Umthetho Wokulinganisa Ukusetshenziswa, 1998. Ikono lokuhumusha nokuhlola ulwazi, Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nangokubhala, Ukuhlela/ukulondoloza ulwazi, ukuxhumanisa ulwazi, Ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuphatha ingxabano, Ukulalela nokuxoxa, Ukuzwela nobuqotho, Ukusebenza njengeqembu, Isiyaluyalu, Ukuphatha imali. Ukubona kabusha ibhizinisi, Umholi weqembu, Umcapatjhi, Ukuguquguquka/Okujwayele ukushintsha, Ikono lokuxazulula izinkinga, Okusabelayo, Izindaba zomuntu siqu, Ukugxila kubathengi, Ukuzithoba futhi unobungcweti, Ovulekilekhekhondo, Ophembelele futhi ophathekayo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuphathwa kwezingozi zabusha bokuhweba. Yenza isilinganiso sezingozi ezinhlekelwe uhlelo. Yenza isilinganiso sezingozi eziseduzansi nensebenzo. Buka kabusha futhi uthuthukise umkhuba wokuphathwa kwezingozi. Hlanganani ngemibiko yokuqhubela phambili ngenyanga ngokumelana nobhalo lwezingozi. Buka futhi ulawule uhlelo lwezinhlangano lokuphathwa kwezingozi. Qinisekisa ukwelatshwa kwabasebenzi bezingozi namalungu ekhomithi yezingozi. Lungiselela imibiko yenyanga neyesikhashana yekhomithi yokuphathwa kwezingozi. Buka kabusha futhi uthuthukise inqubomgomo yezinhlangano yokuphathwa kwezingozi. Phatha ukuphunyukiswa, ukuthuthukiswa nokubukwa kwezindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi. Sula izakhiwo zobuholi be-BCP. Buka izindlela namazinga ahlobene nokubuyiselwa emuva kwezisulo. Qinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuqhubeka kwebhizinisi zikho. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho. Khuthaza ukuphunyukiswa kwekhodi yokuziphatha futhi qinisekisa isimo sobuzithiba. Buka, phumeza futhi zigcine izinqubomgomo, izindlela nezinhlelo. Hlola izingozi nezinsongo ezingehlobene nesimo sobuzithiba. Yenza imfundiso ngabuzithiba nokuqinisekiswa kweprothokholo yomnyango. Khuthaza uhlelo lokwazisa ngemali. Buka futhi ulawule izinhlelo zangaphakathi ezimalwa nobuqhothha. Phenya yonke imangalelo yobuqhothha nokufakwa izinkulumo ezamukelwe kubantu bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Yenza ucwaningo ngomthetho uphezulu wobuqhothha nokufakwa izinkulumo futhi uthuthukise izinhlelo zemfundo. Buka futhi uphumeze izinqubo zokuvikela ubuqhothha nezindlela ezimalwa nobuqhothha. Yenza isilinganiso sezingozi zobuqhothha. Buka futhi ulawule uhlelo lokuvikela ubuqhothha. Nikeza isiqondiso esihlekelele uhlelo. Yenza ucwaningo futhi ugcine ukwaziswa ngezindlela ezinhle zokwenza futhi nangokuthuthuka phakathi kwesikhundla. Buka futhi ulawule uhlelo lwebhizinisi noma isu lesikhundla futhi ulinganise nenhloko yezikhundla futhi qinisekisa ukuphunyukiswa kwaso. Buka ngalwesikhathi ukuthuthukiswa nokuphunyukiswa kwezindlela zomsebenzi wesikhundla. Buka futhi ulawule uhlelo lokuthuthukiswa kokunikezwa kwenkonzo. Phatha izinsiza (Abantu/ Imali/ Izinto/ Izimpahla). Qinisekisa ukuphunyukiswa okufanele kwebhajethi ngokubuka, ukubikeka nokubika okuhora. Qinisekisa ukuchithwa okufanele okuhambisana nenhloso ezihlekelele. Buka ukusetshenziswa okuphezulu nokusebenza kwezinto. Buka futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufeza inhloso ezihlekelele. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi abayisixhumanisi esikhundleni. Phakamisa futhi ulawule ukukhuthazwa kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Titshala: Lawulo lweNgozi, iinkonzo ezichasene noKukhukhumaliswa nokuZinikela
xh.summary: Lawula ulawulo lwengozi yelinye rhwebo, iinkonzo ezichasene nokukhukhumaliswa nendlela yokuzithemba kwisebe leGauteng Department of Agriculture and Rural Development eNtloko yesebe.
xh.requirements: I-matric kunye nelifikhasin entshona (NQF level 7) kuLawulo lwenKgozi okunye umhlaba ongaxelwa njengesiqinisekiso ngu-SAQA. Iminyaka engu-5 yokulinga kwinqanaba lalawulo aphakathi okaphezulu kwindawo yolawulo lwenKgozi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono: Ukulawula, ukulawula, ukusungula icebo, ukuhlela, ulawulo lwabantu, ukuhambisa inkonzo, unxibelelwano, ukwenza isigqibo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukubhala ingxelo, ukusebenza njengaqabane, ulawulo lwenKgozi, ulawulo lwabathengi, intsha / ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo, ukucutha ulwazi, ukuxoxisana ngeemfuno, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ulawulo lweenkqubo, ukuguquguquka. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo nemigaqo yesebe, iNdawo zikarhulumente eziphambili, imigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo zolawulo lwenKgozi, iinkqubo zokuxela, inkqubo yolwazi, uMgaqo-siseko weNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho woLingana koBasebenzi,1998. Ukuba nakho ukucazulula kwaye uhlole ulwazi, unxibelelwano ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo, ukuhlela / ukulondoloza ulwazi, ukunxibelelana ulwazi, ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha, ukusombulula iingxaki nolawulo lokungabonisani ngamacebo, ukumamela nokuxoxisana ngeemfuno, ukuzipatha kahle nobunyulu, ukusebenza njengaqabane, isithuthi, ulawulo lwemali. Ukuqonda izinto zorhwebo, Ntlokulu eqabane, umcaktheni, ukuguquguquka / oqhelene nenguqu, ikhono lokusombulula iingxaki, othi ngokukhawuleza aphendule, ubumnye nobudlelwane, ukujongwa kwabathengi, othembekileyo nogqwesa, onqwenela ukuphila ngendlela evtsho, onoxanduva kuphela nawe uhamba phambili.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zolawulo lwengozi yerhwebo. Qhuba isicwangciso sokuhlolwa kwingozi. Qhuba isicwangciso sokuhlolwa kwingozi ezisebenzayo. Yila kwaye uhlolisize isicwangciso solawulo lwengozi. Lungisanisa iingxelo zentshukela zenyanga ngokuchasene nesiphithiphithi sengozi. Yila kwaye ulawule icebo lokulawula ingozi elungiselelwe loluntu. Qinisekisa ukulatshwa kwabasebenzi abangenelelo kwingozi namalungu ekomiti yengozi. Lungiselela iingxelo zenyanga neze kwikota zekomiti yolawulo lwengozi. Yila kwaye uhlolisize umgaqo-nkqubo wolawulo lwengozi weluntu. Lawula ukusebenziswa, ukuyila nokulawula iiplani zoqhubekelo-phambili lerhwebo. Misela iinkqubo zolawulo zeplani zoqhubekelo-phambili lerhwebo. Yila imigaqo-nkqubo namazinga ahlobene nokubuyisela iinguqu ezibiyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iiplani zoqhubekelo-phambili lerhwebo zikho. Qinisekisa ulungelelwaniso neemfuno zomgaqo-nkqubo. Khuthaza ukusebenziswa kwendlela yokuziphatha kwaye uqinisekise imo engatshotshoyo. Yila, sebenzisa kwaye ulondoloze imigaqo-nkqubo, iinkqubo neenkqubo zolawulo. Qonda iingozi nokusiba ezihlobene nemo engatshotshoyo. Qhuba olwazi mayela nendlela yokuziphatha nendlela yokuzithemba kwisebe. Khuthaza inkqubo yokuxela ngemali. Yila kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo zangaphakathi ezichasene nokukhukhumaliswa. Phanda bonke izityholo zokurhweba ngokungalunganga nokuKhukhumaliswa ezivela kubantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle. Qhuba uphando malunga namagqabantshintshi okurhweba ngokungalunganga nokuKhukhumaliswa kwaye uhlole iinkqubo zemfundo. Yila kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokuthintela ukurhweba ngokungalunganga ezingachasene nokukhukhumaliswa. Qhuba isicwangciso sokuhlolwa kwingozi yokurhweba ngokungalunganga. Yila kwaye ulawule icebo lokuthintela ukurhweba ngokungalunganga. Nikeza isalathiso esicwangciso kwisebe. Phanda kwaye ulandele iziphakamiso namaphuhliso amava amagqibeleyo kwisebe. Yila icebo lokushicilela / isicwangciso kwisebe kwaye ulungise ulungelelwaniso nesebe elikhulu kwaye uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa kwaso. Lawula ukuyila nokusebenziswa iiplani ezisebenzayo kwisebe. Yila kwaye ulungisanise icebo lokuphucula inkonzo. Lawula izixhobo (Abantu / Imali / Izixhobo / Iimpahla). Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa okuchanekileyo kwesihlweko ngokulawula, ukuchaza nokuxela ngokusetyenziswa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukuchithwa kwemali ngokulungelelana nemiqathango yokusetyenziswa ngokusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo. Lawula ukusetyenziswa okuyimfuneko nokusebenza kolunye useto lwezixhobo. Hlola kwaye ulawule ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuze uqinisekise ukufezekiswa kwenjongo. Lawula uphuhliso lwabasebenzi kwisebe. Phucula kwaye ulondoloze inkuthazo yabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Roads Construction
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 – R1 858 821.per annum, (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion of 30% that may be structured in terms of applicable rules. Which includes state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund (13% of basic salary). The successful candidate will be required to enter into a performance agreement within three months after assumption of duty.
jobs.summary: Lead roads construction and capital infrastructure projects as Chief Director at the Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport head office in Johannesburg.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7 in Civil/Structural Engineering/Built Environment as recognized by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Registered with professional body (such as Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA), South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP), South African Council for Quantity Surveying Profession (SACQSP) etc. 5 years senior management experience within transport infrastructure environment and or built environment. Extensive experience in planning management and execution of roads construction projects will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s license. Completion of the Nyukela Senior Management Pre-entry certificate endorsed by National School of Government must be submitted prior to appointment. Knowledge: Knowledge of SLAs, Knowledge of construction contract law & administration, Engineering Profession Act 2000, Gauteng Transport Infrastructure Act 2001, National Roads Traffic Act. 1996, National Environmental Management Act 1998, Colto Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Works, General Conditions of Contract (GCC & FIDIC), Departmental technical standards 7 code of procedures, Knowledge of relevant legislation and policies related to the field or line of work. Skills: Strategic capability and leadership skills, problem solving and analysis, creativity, financial management, customer focus and responsiveness, communication, negotiation, conflict management and change management skills.
jobs.duties: Manage overall programming, budgeting, and reporting of capital projects. Manage, coordinate and oversee the implementation of construction of Departmental Roads Infrastructure /Capital Projects. Monitor project management efficiencies according to organizational goals to direct and indirect services for the attainment of organizational objectives. Provide project management support. Render Occupational health and safety service. Manage and maintain the construction of the roads in the regions. Manage construction standards. Manage construction quality assurance. Ensure that project standards, specifications and service levels according are set to departmental objectives to ensure optimum operational availability. Oversee the management of construction management guidelines, processes, standards and strategies. Identify construction trends and opportunities for businesses processes improvement. Approves recommendations for changes and improvements to existing construction management guidelines, standards, policies and procedures. Oversee implementation of guidelines, standards, policies, procedures and strategies and related prescripts. Ensure the development and implementation of support tools. Monitor the implementation of compliance and applicable polices and legislation. Ensure the implementation of sound effective and efficient internal control system. Provide strategic leadership to the component. Establish and maintain appropriate internal controls and reporting systems in order to meet performance expectations. Develop and manage the operational plan of the Chief Directorate and report on progress. Manage and coordinate personnel provisioning. Manage performance and development of employees. Monitor the budget and expenditures of the Chief Directorate. Plan, organize and control activities pertaining to the functions of the component. Adhere to and promote legislative departmental prescripts and the Code of Conduct for the Public Services.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. M. Mashele/ Mr. S. Ngcobo Tel No: (011) 355-7082/7043
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please apply online at http://jobs.gauteng.gov.za. For general enquiries please contact Human Resource on 011 355-7521/7252. Only online applications will be considered.
jobs.notes: In line with the Department’s employments Equity Plan, preference will be given to Females and Persons with disabilities candidates. Applicants must utilise the most recent Z83 application form for employment, issued by the Minister for the Public Service and Administration in line with Regulation 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016. All fields in the New Z83 form must be completed, initialled and signed. Furthermore, a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) must also be attached. Failure to attach the completed Z83 and Comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV) will result in disqualification. The New Z83 form is obtainable from any Public Service Department or the DPSA website www.dpsa.gov.za/documents. Only shortlisted candidates who meet all the requirements of the post will be requested to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and valid driver’s license (where driving/travelling is an inherent requirement of the job) not older than six (06) months. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. It is our intention to promote representation (race, gender and disability) in the Public Service through the filling of posts and candidates whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representation will receive preference. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity through the filling of all numeric targets as contained in the Employment Equity Plan. To facilitate this process successfully, an indication of race, gender and disability status is required. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have foreign qualifications evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). The Department reserves the right not to appoint. If you do not receive any response from us within 3 months, please accept your application was unsuccessful. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Padkonstruksie
af.summary: Bestuur padkonstruksie- en kapitale infrastruktuurprojekte as Hoofdirekteur by die Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport hoofkantoor in Johannesburg.
af.requirements: NQF level 7 in Siviele/Strukturele Ingenieurswese/Bou-omgewing soos erken deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Geregistreer by 'n professionele liggaam (soos Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA), South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP), South African Council for Quantity Surveying Profession (SACQSP) ens. 5 jaar senior bestuurservaring binne 'n vervoerinfrastruktuur-omgewing en of bou-omgewing. Uitgebreide ervaring in beplanningbestuur en uitvoering van padkonstruksieprojekte sal 'n voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Voltooiing van die Nyukela Senior Management Pre-entry certificate wat deur die National School of Government onderskryf word, moet voor aanstelling ingedien word. Kennis: Kennis van SLA's, Kennis van konstruksiekontrakte en -administrasie, Engineering Profession Act 2000, Gauteng Transport Infrastructure Act 2001, National Roads Traffic Act. 1996, National Environmental Management Act 1998, Colto Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Works, General Conditions of Contract (GCC & FIDIC), Departementele tegniese standaarde 7 kode van prosedures, Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing en beleide verwant aan die veld of lyn van werk. Vaardighede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede, probleemoplossing en analise, kreatiwiteit, finansiële bestuur, kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë, kommunikasie, onderhandeling, konflikbestuur en veranderingbestuursvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur algehele programmering, begroting en verslagdoening van kapitale projekte. Bestuur, koördineer en hou toesig oor die implementering van konstruksie van Departementele Paaie-infrastruktuur/Kapitale Projekte. Monitor projekbestuur-doeltreffendheid volgens organisatoriese doelwitte vir direkte en indirekte dienste vir die bereiking van organisatoriese doelwitte. Verskaf projekbestuursondersteuning. Lewer Beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsdiens. Bestuur en handhaaf die konstruksie van paaie in die streke. Bestuur konstruksiestandaarde. Bestuur konstruksie-kwaliteitsversekering. Verseker dat projekstandaarde, spesifikasies en diensvlakke gestel word volgens departementele doelwitte om optimum operasionele beskikbaarheid te verseker. Hou toesig oor die bestuur van konstruksiebestuursriglyne, prosesse, standaarde en strategieë. Identifiseer konstruksietendense en geleenthede vir besigheidsprosesverbetering. Keur voorstelle vir veranderinge en verbeterings aan bestaande konstruksiebestuursriglyne, standaarde, beleide en prosedures goed. Hou toesig oor implementering van riglyne, standaarde, beleide, prosedures en strategieë en verwante voorskrifte. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van ondersteuningsinstrumente. Monitor die implementering van nakoming en toepaslike beleide en wetgewing. Verseker die implementering van 'n deeglike doeltreffende en doeltredende interne beheerstelsel. Verskaf strategiese leierskap aan die komponent. Stel en handhaaf toepaslike interne beheer en verslagdoeningstelsels ten einde prestasieverwagtinge te bereik. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die Hoofdirektoraat en rapporteer oor vordering. Bestuur en koördineer personeelverskaffing. Bestuur prestasie en ontwikkeling van werknemers. Monitor die begroting en uitgawes van die Hoofdirektoraat. Beplan, organiseer en beheer aktiwiteite wat betrekking het op die funksies van die komponent. Voldoen aan en bevorder wetgewende departementele voorskrifte en die Gedragskode vir die Openbare Diens.

zu.title: Chief Director: Roads Construction
zu.summary: Holisa imiprojekthi yokwakhiwa izindlela nekapitali njengoChief Director e-ofisini enkulu yeGauteng Department of Roads and Transport eGauteng.
zu.requirements: Izinga le-NQF 7 kwi-Civil/Structural Engineering/Built Environment njengoba kuqashelwe yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Ukubhaliswa kubuhlobo bemisebenzi (njenge-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA), South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP), South African Council for Quantity Surveying Profession (SACQSP) etc. Iminyaka eyi-5 yamava obuholi obuphezulu emzileni wesakhiwo sezokuthutha noma emzileni wesakhiwo. Amava amanani ekwelapha, ukuphatha nokuphumelela imiprojekthi yokwakhiwa izindlela kuzoba yinzuzo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukugcwaliswa kwe-Nyukela Senior Management Pre-entry certificate egunyaziwe yi-National School of Government kufanele kunikwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngama-SLA, Ulwazi ngomthetho wekhontrakthi yokwakhiwa nokuphathwa kwayo, Engineering Profession Act 2000, Gauteng Transport Infrastructure Act 2001, National Roads Traffic Act. 1996, National Environmental Management Act 1998, Colto Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Works, General Conditions of Contract (GCC & FIDIC), Departmental technical standards 7 code of procedures, Ulwazi ngemithetho namapholisi ahlobene nomkhakha noma umgwaqo wokusebenza. Amakhono: Amakhono obuholi kanye namandla okuhlela, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya, ukudala, ukuphatha imali, ukugxila kuthengi kanye nokuqondisa, ukuxhumana, ukuxoxisana, ukuphatha izinkinga kanye nokuphatha ushintsho.
zu.duties: Qondisa ijubhelwa elibanzi, ukubhajetha nokubika imiprojekthi ekapitali. Qondisa, lungisanisa futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwakho kokwakhiwa kwezindlela ze-Departmental Roads Infrastructure /Capital Projects. Qapha ukusebenza kahle kokuqondisa imiprojekthi ngokusho kwezinhloso zenhlangano ngenkonzololo eqondile nengaqondile ukuze kufinyelelwe izinhloso zenhlangango. Nikeza inkxaso yokuphatha imiprojekthi. Letula inkonzo yezempilo nokuphepha kwabasebenzi. Qondisa futhi ugcine ukwakhiwa kwezindlela ezifundeni. Qondisa izinga lokwakhiwa. Qondisa ukuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi yokwakhiwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinga lemiprojekthi, izinkomba kanye namazinga enkonzo abekwe ngokusho kwezinhloso zomnyango ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala okuhle kokusebenza. Lawula ukuphathwa kwemihlahlandlela yokwakhiwa, inqubo, amazinga kanye nezindlela zokusebenza. Khomba izindlela zamanje zokwakhiwa namathuba okuthuthukiswa kwenqubo yebhizinisi. Vumela iziphakamiso zoshintsho nentuthuko kwemihlahlandlela ekhona yokuphatha ukwakhiwa, amazinga, amapholisi kanye nenqubo. Lawula ukusetshenziswa kwemihlahlandlela, amazinga, amapholisi, inqobo kanye nezindlela kanye nemibhalo ehlobene. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi okuxhasa. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kokulandelwa kwemithetho namapholisi afanele nemithetho. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwesistimu egudluzayo, esebenzayo nasebenza kahle yokulawula ngaphakathi. Nikeza ubuholi bobuchwepheshe kuleyo nkomba. Sula futhi ugcine izilawulo ezifanele ngaphakathi kanye namasistimu okubika ukuze kuhlangatshezwe izethembe zokusebenza. Yakha futhi uphathe iplani yokusebenza ye-Chief Directorate ubike ngokuqhubekayo. Qondisa futhi ulungisanise ukubonelela abasebenzi. Qondisa ukusebenza nokuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi. Qapha ibhajethi nokuchithwa kwemali e-Chief Directorate. Hlela, hlela futhi ulawule imisebenzi ehlobene nemisebenzi yenkomba. Landela futhi ukhuthaze imithetho yomnyango kanye nekhodi yokuziphatha kwezinkonzo zomphakathi.

xh.title: Umlawuli Omkhulu: uYilo lweeNdlela
xh.summary: Qhoboshela ukuyila iindlela zokuyila iindlela ezinkulu zendlela xa ngumlawuli omutsha kwindlu yesebe le-Gauteng Department of Roads and Transport e-Johannesburg.
xh.requirements: Isixa sabakhiwo besi-7 kwi-Civil/Structural Engineering/Built Environment njengokoqondwa ngurhulumente we-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Uggibele ngokwexesha kumalungiselelo olunyanzelekileyo (njenge-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA), South African Council for the Project and Construction Management Professions (SACPCMP), South African Council for Quantity Surveying Profession (SACQSP) etc. Unyaka wamashumi amahlanu wolwa ngokumandla wolawulo Iwesakhono ngakumbi embindini weTransport Infrastructure and built Environment. Ukuqonda ngokubanzi ngokusetyenziswa kwamaphuwo axhaphaziyweyo ngokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo yolwa Iwendlu kwaye kuzakutyhilwa ngakumbi. Ufanele ukuba nelayisense yokushayela. Ukugqiba kweNyukela Senior Management Pre-entry certificate eyixabiso yi-National School of Government kufuneka ithunyelwe ngaphambi kokumiswa. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngSLAs, Ulwazi ngomthetho wezimvume nokulawulwa kwekonstrukthara, Engineering Profession Act 2000, Gauteng Transport Infrastructure Act 2001, National Roads Traffic Act. 1996, National Environmental Management Act 1998, Colto Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Works, General Conditions of Contract (GCC & FIDIC), Departmental technical standards 7 code of procedures, Ulwazi ngemithetho echaza nemigangatho enxulumene nolwimi. Isakhono: Isakhono soLawulo kunye nonyuso, isakhono sokuqonda nokusombulula iingxaki, ukuyila, ukulawula imali, ukujongana nokhuseleko nokuphendula, ukunxibelelwana, ukuthengisa, ukulawula ingxaki nokutshintsha indlela yokulawula.
xh.duties: Lawula ngokubanzi ukucwangcisa ixesha, yokwenza umthetho wemali, nedangatye kumaphulo edidiyari. Palala, qhoboshela kwaye ulawule ukuphumeza kwakho ukuqakuliswa kweekonstrukthara zeZenzo zoMbindi weeNdlela / iindidi zemisebenzi edidiyari. Qwalasela iziphumeo zolawulo lwamaphulo ngokwemigqango yeqela ukuze kubekho iinkonzo zangqondwane nangalugqatso ukuba kufezwe iinjongo zeqela. Nika inkxaso yolawulo lwamaphulo. Yazi inkonzo yokuqinisekisa impilo nokhuseleko lomsebenzi. Lawula kwaye ulondoloze ukuqakuliswa kweendlu zeendlela kummandla. Lawula iinkqubo ezimayela nokuqakuliswa kweekonstrukthara. Lawula inqanaba lengqiqo nokuqakuliswa. Qinisekisa ukumisela iinkqubo, iinkcukacha kwendlela yenzowabo neziqu zokusebenza ngokomgqango wesebe ukumise ulwabiwo olubalulekileyo lolawulo lweemisebenzi. Qhoboshela ulawulo lweekonstrukthara, iinkqubo, imigangatho namacebo. Phawula iindlela zeekonstrukthara namathuba okuyila ukusetyenziswa kweentsika zeshishini. Vuma ukuyalela iinguqulo namasetyenziso endlela ekhoyo ngokumayela nokuqakuliswa, imigangatho, iinkqubo nemithetho yolawulo. Qhoboshela ukusebenzisa iinkqubo, imigangatho, iinkqubo namacebo ngokutsho kwemithetho. Qinisekisa ukuyila nokuphumeza izixhobo zokukhusela. Qwalasela ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ezilawulayo kwemithetho nangumthetho. Qinisekisa isixhobo esikhuselayo, esisebenzayo nangqiqo ngaphakathi. Nika inkokeli eqondileyo kumbahluli-ndawo. Misela kwaye ulondoloze izixhobo zolawulo ezifanelekileyo nokuvela ngezinto ezikhethekileyo ngesiphitha nangendlela yokuyibika ukugubha ngenkqubo. Yakha kwaye ulawule iplani yemisebenzi yolawulo lwendlela yasehlanganweni nelawula iinkqubo ngokumayela nokuqinisekisa uluhlu lweesebe namacebo. Lawula ulondolozo lweplani yomsebenzi nezingqondwana. Lawula imali nemisebenzi ekulawulweni. Cwangcisa, qamba kwaye ulawule imisebenzi emayela nendlela ekwenziwa ngayo umhlathi weesakhiwo. Qwalasela imali negalelo kulawulo olukhulu. Hamba ngokomthetho kwaye uphakamise iinkqubo namacebo ngokomthetho kwisebe kwaye athobe ngokomthetho wokuza kwindlela ekubakho ngayo abasebenzi.

jobs.title: District Director

jobs.duties: Manage the provision of Agricultural Extension and Advisory Services. Manage district agricultural projects. Manage the provision of all agricultural specific interventions and engineering support. Contribute to the development and implementation of policies. Manage the provision of administration support to the district (including the support to Animal Health institutions (Veterinarian Services) operating within the district boundaries. af.title: Distrikshoof

af.requirements: 'n NQF-vlak 07-kwalifikasie in Landbou en 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. Ervaring: 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak. Kennis: RSA-grondwet, White Paper on Agriculture for KZN, Norms and Standards for Extension and Advisory Services, KwaZulu-Natal Agricultural Development Policy, National Policy on Comprehensive Producer Development Support,, Agricultural Extension and Advisory Principles, Scientific Agricultural Production Methods, Agriculture and Agro-Processing Master Plan (AAMP), Provincial Growth and Development Plan, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Labour Relations Act, Employee Performance and Management System, Community Development, Public Participation, Community Outreach, Project Management Principles, Social Dynamics of KZN Communities, Service Delivery Frameworks and Treasury Regulations. Bestuur die voorsiening van administratiewe ondersteuning aan die distrik (insluitend die ondersteuning aan Diergesondheidsinstellings (Veeverrydiensste) wat binne die distriksgrense opereer. Bestuur die hulpbronne van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: District Director
zu.summary: Kudingeka abaningi be District Director bezifundazwe za uMzinyathi nale iLembe ukuphatha izinsizakusebenze zolimo, imiproje yezifundazwe, nokuphathwa kwezinqubomgomo.
zu.requirements: NQF level 07 in Agriculture kanye nesitifiketi sokushayela esivumelekile. Experience: 5 years experience esimeni sokuphatha esiphakathi noma esiphezulu. Knowledge: RSA Constitution, White Paper on Agriculture for KZN, Norms and Standards for Extension and Advisory Services, KwaZulu-Natal Agricultural Development Policy, National Policy on Comprehensive Producer Development Support, Agricultural Extension and Advisory Principles, Scientific Agricultural Production Methods, Agriculture and Agro-Processing Master Plan (AAMP), Provincial Growth and Development Plan, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations, Public Finance Management Act, Labour Relations Act, Employee Performance and Management System, Community Development, Public Participation, Community Outreach, Project Management Principles, Social Dynamics of KZN Communities, Service Delivery Frameworks kanye ne Treasury Regulations. Skills: Language, listening, presentation, interpersonal relations, computer, strategic planning, organizational, research, leadership, facilitation, project management, financial management, time management, report writing, problem solving, communication, conflict management, change management, ukuzithiba kanye nethonya lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegxabo nangaphandle kokuphathwa kwabanye, people management, analytical thinking kanye no decision making.
zu.duties: Manage the provision of Agricultural Extension and Advisory Services. Manage district agricultural projects. Manage the provision of all agricultural specific interventions and engineering support. Contribute to the development and implementation of policies. Manage the provision of administration support to the district (including the support to Animal Health institutions (Veterinarian Services) operating within the district boundaries. Manage the resources of the Directorate.

xh.title: Direktha weSebe
xh.summary: Kufuneka abaDirektha beeSebe kumasebe ka-uMzinyathi naka-iLembe ukuze balawule iinkonzo zezikhongozelelo zolimo, imisebenzi yesebe, nokuphumeza imigaqo.
xh.requirements: Ifundo lenqanaba le-NQF 07 kuZolimo nepermesi yokuqhuba evakalayo. Iminyaka yamava: 5 iminyaka yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lobulungisa. Ulwazi: iRhoqoMgaqo we-RSA, iPeppa Emhlophe ngoZolimo yaKZN, imiQathango nemiGaqo-ngqo yeseZikhongozelelo nesebe lembono, iNkqubo yoPhuhliso loZolimo yaKwaZulu-Natali, iNkqubo yeSizwe yoNxulunyuso oZinzeleyo kuPhuhliso koBaphuhlisi, iimBaqo zeZikhongozelelo zoLimo nesebe lembono, iindlela eZinzululwazi zoKutya koLimo, iPlani eNkulu yoZolimo noBumba-Izinto (AAMP), iNkqubo yoPhuhliso noKukhula koBummandla, uMthetho woBucwele, iMigaqo yoBucwele, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhament, uMthetho weMibutho yaBasebenzi, iNkqubo yoMgangatho woKwenza iMisebenzi noLawulo koBasebenzi, uPhuhliso loBomi babantu, uNyulo loLuntu, ukuya kubakho ngoLuntu, iimBaqo zoLawulo loBuGcisa, iNkqubo zeNtshona-nxaxheba zoBomi babantu baKZN, iNkqubo zoNikezelo leseBenzela kunye neMigaqo yoRhament. Ikhono: ulwimi, ukumamela, izibizo, iintlungu zobuntu, ikhompyutha, ukuQamba iPlani yoxanduva, ukuhleleka, ukuphonononga, ukulawula, ukwenza kube lula, uLawulo loBuGcisa, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lwexesha, ukubhala iingxelo, ukusombulula iingxaki, unxibelelwano, uLawulo lweNxaxheba, uLawulo lweNguquko, ukuzilawula nokuba nakhonba ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo ngaphandle kolawulo oluncinci, uLawulo babantu, ukuQwalasela nokuThatha iSigqibo.
xh.duties: Phatha ukunikezelwa kwezikhongozelelo kunye nesebe lempendulo. Phatha imisebenzi yezolimo yesebe. Phatha ukunikezelwa kwazo zonke iintswelo-mfuno ezizezolimo kunye nenkxaso yezobunjiniyela. Yegna ekwenzeni kunye nokuphumezeni iindlela-zezMigaqo. Phatha ukunikezelwa kwenkxaso yolawulo kwesebe (kuquka inkxaso iinstitutions zezeMpilo zeZilwanyana (Iinkonzo zoGqirha wezilwanyana) ezingasebenza ngaphakathi kwemida yesebe. Phatha amacebo eSebe.

jobs.title: Director: Ethekwini Region
jobs.department: Department of Community Safety and Liaison
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package) is payable to the successful candidate. The package includes a basic salary (70 % of package) and a flexible portion (30% of package) that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules. The successful candidate will be subject to security clearance and the signing of a performance agreement within three months of appointment.
jobs.summary: Director position in Durban providing strategic leadership for crime prevention and police performance monitoring in the Ethekwini region.
jobs.requirements: A Degree (NQF level 7 or higher) in Social Science / Police Science / Criminology or relevant equivalent qualification coupled with a minimum of 5 years’ middle / senior management experience in Criminal Justice environment. A valid driver’s license Code B. Nyukela SMS Pre-entry certificate submitted prior to appointment. Applicants must be prepared to work extended hours. The successful candidate must have knowledge of the Constitution of RSA, 1996, Knowledge of public service Act and regulations, PFMA, South African Police Act,1995, National Crime Prevention Strategy, 1996, KZN Commissions Act,1999, Domestic Violence Act,1998, Child Care Act,1983, Criminal Procedure Act,1977, Employment Equity Act,1998, Skills Development Act,1998, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act,2000, Promotions of Access to Information Act,2000, Electronic Communications & Transactions Act, 2002, State Information Technology Agency Act,1999,National Youth Development Agency Act, 2008, Civilian Secretariat for Police Service Act,2011, Fleet management, Labour Relations Act,1995, Communication and protocol, Communication skills, Project management skills Community Development, Report writing skills, Computer and Financial Management skills.
jobs.duties: To provide strategic direction and coordination in the Region. Manage and promote crime prevention and partnerships. Ensure the monitoring and evaluation of police performance in the region. Ensure the development and implementation of integrated and costed Annual Police Service Delivery Plan for the Region and outreach areas. Manage the development, evaluation and review of regional community safety models, initiatives and monitoring tools. Ensure effective management of resources for the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. N.D Mchunu Tel No: (033) 341 9300 OTHER POSTS
jobs.applications: With the implementation of the online recruitment system, applicants for any vacant post within the Province of KwaZulu-Natal may apply for a post in the following ways: -a) via the S’thesha Waya Waya - KZN Online recruitment portal at (https://www.eservices.gov.za) or b) by submitting by post their Z83 and CV directly to the department to The Head: Community Safety and Liaison, Human Resource Management, Private Bag, X 9143, Pietermaritzburg, 3200, or hand delivered to 179 Jabu Ndlovu Street, Pietermaritzburg. FOR ATTENTION : Ms. Z.R Bekwa
jobs.notes: Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed curriculum vitae (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified qualifications, all non-SA citizens must submit a copy of proof of permanent residence in South Africa on or before the day of the interviews). Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. For SMS posts, all shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Prior to appointment, a candidate will be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services which is an online course offered by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced from the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. The successful candidate will be required to complete such prior to appointment. All personal data on applications will be dealt with in terms of the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013. The Department reserves the right not to fill and/or make an appointment to any of the advertised posts and to use other recruitment processes to fill these posts should it choose to do so. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Ethekwini-streek
af.summary: Direkteurspos in Durban wat strategiese leierskap bied vir misdaadvoorkoming en monitering van polisieprestasie in die Ethekwini-streek.
af.requirements: 'n Graad (NQF vlak 7 of hoër) in Sosiale Wetenskappe / Polisiewetenskappe / Kriminologie of 'n relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie tesame met 'n minimum van 5 jaar se middel- / seniorbestuurservaring in 'n Kriminele Regspleidingsomgewing. Verseker die monitering en evaluering van polisieprestasie in die streek. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van 'n geïntegreerde en gekosteerde Jaarlikse Polisiediensleweringplan vir die streek en uitbreidingsgebiede. Bestuur die ontwikkeling, evaluering en hersiening van streekgemeenskapsveiligheidsmodelle, inisiatiewe en moniteringsinstrumente. Verseker doeltreffende bestuur van hulpbronne vir die Direktoraat.

zu.summary: Isikhundla sobaphathi eDurban esibonelela ngokuqondisa okuhlelekile ekuvikweni kobugebengu nakulawulweni kokusebenza kwamaphoyisa esifundeni i-Ethekwini.

Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni ye-Code B. Isitifiketi se-Nyukela SMS Pre-entry sithunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Abafake izifundo kufanele balungiselele ukusebenza amahora amude. zu.duties: Ukubonelela ngokuqondisa okuhlelekile nokuhlela kuleziNgosi. Ukuphatha futhi kukhuthaze ukuvikwa kwobugebengu kanye nezinhlangano ezisebenzisanayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawula kanye nokuhlola ukusebenza kwamaphoyisa esifundazweni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kohlelo oluhlanganiswe olunemali ehleliwe lwemisebenzi yamaphoyisa lwonyaka loluNgosi nakumayikhono abalulekile. Ukulawula ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlola kanye nokubuka kabusha izindlela zokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwomphakathi zesifundazwe, izinhlelo ezishaqiswayo namathuluzi okulawula. xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba ngumlawuli eDurban sibonelela ngengqungquthela yokulawula ukuqonda ukwenza iinkqubo zokuthintela ubugcisa nokulawula ulwazi lwamaphoyisa kwindawo i-Ethekwini.
xh.requirements: IDigri (NQF level 7 okangaphezulu) kwizSocial Science / Police Science / Criminology okanye isiqinisekiso esifanayo esithe phantsi komyalezo othengisa ubuchwepheshe obungaphezulu kweminyaka eyi-5 kwimeko yaseNgingaqinanga kwindawo ekwi-Criminal Justice. Ifayile ye-Nyukela SMS Pre-entry certificate ifakwe ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe isikhundla. Abafaka isicelo kufuneka bekulungele ukusebenza iiyure ezongezelelweyo. Omele kufuneka akwazi ukuqonda uguqulelo lwe-National Crime Prevention Strategy, 1996, KZN Commissions Act,1999, Domestic Violence Act,1998, Child Care Act,1983, Criminal Procedure Act,1977, Employment Equity Act,1998, Skills Development Act,1998, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act,2000, Promotions of Access to Information Act,2000, Electronic Communications & Transactions Act, 2002, State Information Technology Agency Act,1999, National Youth Development Agency Act, 2008, Civilian Secretariat for Police Service Act,2011, Fleet management, Labour Relations Act,1995, Communication and protocol, Communication skills, Project management skills Community Development, Report writing skills, Computer and Financial Management skills.
xh.duties: Ukunika inkqubo yolawulo nokuqhuba iindlela ezidityaniswe kwiSithili. Lawula kwaye ukhuthaze ukuthintela i-crime namanxibelelan namashishini. Qinisekisa ukulawula kwaye kuqwalaselwe ukusebenza kwamapholisia kulesi sithili. Qinisekisa ukuba kuyakhiwe kwaye kusetyenziswe iNkqubo yeMisebenzi yokuGcinwa kweeNkonzo zeQela lePoyisa kwakaWoNyaka, eNgenisa iNtlawulo yayo yonke into, ekuSetyenziselwa iSithili neendawo eziyiwo zokuqokelelana kuzo. Lawula ukwakhiwa, ukuqwalaselwa nokuqwalasela kabusha iindlela zokhuseleko koluntu, iinkqubo ezitsha namathuba okulawula eSithilini. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokusebenzayo amathuba eNkokhelo yeli Qela leNkonzo.
