af.summary: Lei misdaadvoorkoming en gemeenskapspolisieringsvennotskappe vir die Department of Community Safety and Liaison in Newcastle, met die vereiste van 'n tersaaklike diploma en drie jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: 'n 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma (NQF vlak 6 of hoër) in Sosiale Wetenskappe / Polisiewetenskap of 'n tersaaklike gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat deur SAQA erken word, tesame met 'n minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring in 'n Misdaadvoorkomings- en Vennootskapsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurderlisensie. Aansoekers moet bereid wees om verlengde ure te werk. Die suksesvolle kandidaat moet kennis hê van die Grondwet, Public Service Act and Regulations, PFMA, Civilian Oversight Act, SAPS Act, kennis van die Domestic Violence Act, Projekbestuur, Misdaadvoorkomingsbeleid, Kommunikasievaardighede, Projekbestuursvaardighede, Verslagskryfvaardighede, Rekenaarvaardighede, Finansiële bestuursvaardighede, Konflikoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Om polisie-gemeenskapsverhoudinge en gemeenskapsveiligheidsstrukture te bevorder. Implementeer veiligheidsmodelle en -inisiatiewe vir die distrik. Ontwikkel en handhaaf gemeenskapspolisieringsforums, gemeenskapsveiligheidsforums en gemeenskapsmisdaadvoorkomingsvennotskappe en -verenigings. zu.title: Umqondisi omsiza: Ukuvikela Ubelelesi Nobudlelwano

zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezwe yeminyaka eyi-3 (NQF level 6 noma ngaphezulu) kwezeSayensi Zezenhlalo / Isayensi yamaphoyisa noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezihlonzekiwe ezibingelelwa i-SAQA, kanye nokuba namava okungenani eminyaka engu-3 kwindawo yokuvikela ubelelesi nakoSobudlelwano. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Abafaka izicelo kufanele bazibe kulungele ukusebenza amahora amide. Umkhethwe kufanele abe nolwazi ngomthethosisekelo, umthetho kanye nemithesho Yesevisi Yomphakathi, i-PFMA, umthetho wokuqaphela abasengozini, umthetho we-SAPS, ulwazi ngomthetho wokuphanga ngasese, Ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, Izinhlelo zokuvikela ubugebengu, Amandla okuxhumana, Amasu okuphatha amaphrojekthi, Amandla okubhala imibiko, Amakhono wokusebenza ngesiCikizi, Amakhono okuphatha izimali, Amakhono wokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukukhuthaza ubuhlobo phakathi komphakathi namaphoyisa kanye nezakhiwo zokuphepha komphakathi. Ukuphatha izinhlobo zemisebenzi yokuphepha kanye nezinhlelo ezifunyenwayo esifundeni. Ukuthuthukisa futhi zigcinwe amahlelo okupolisa omphakathi, amahlelo okuphepha komphakathi kanye nobudlelwano bokuthintana bokuvikela ubelelesi emphakathini kanye nabahlanganyeli. Ukuphatha izinhlobo zemisebenzi zokuphepha komphakathi nezinhlelo ezifunyenwayo esifundeni. Ukuqinisa ubudlelwano nenhlangano zabantu basemphakathini ekuvikeleni nasekuphatheni izinkinga zokuletha ubugebengu esifundeni. Ukuhlanganisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweminyango eminingi ukuze kuphathe izixhumanisi ezithinteka kwezidingo eziphambili zokupolisa.

jobs.title: Chief Director
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (an all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Chief Director role in the eThekwini Health District providing strategic leadership for district health service delivery, requiring senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: NQF level 7) in Health; Plus degree or diploma in health management or Degree/diploma in general management. Plus A minimum of Five (5) years’ experience in senior management Plus Unendorsed valid driver’s license. Proof of Computer literacy with proficiency in Microsoft software applications. Additional Information: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Clinical Health Science; Current registration with the relevant health professional body; Experience in primary health care and district health system. Post-graduate qualification in Public Health/master’s in business management. Project Management. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: The incumbent of this post will report to the Chief Director: District Health Services: Head Office and will be responsible to ensure and account for the delivery of integrated, effective and efficient health service at all levels of care based on the Primary Health Care approach through the District Health System within EThekwini District. The ideal candidates must: Possess a clear understanding of the challenges facing the public health sector due to poverty, resource limitations and opportunistic diseases such as TB, HIV and AIDS. Have the ability to analyse and interpret complex management data and information to inform decision-making and alignment processes timeously. Have the ability to develop innovative solutions for complex health and other service delivery management problems. Possess strong leadership to:- ensure buy-in/support of other organs of state and external stakeholders to accomplish deliverables identified in the Annual Performance Plans of the District. Provide strategic direction to Institutions. Mediate processes for the allocation of resources to Institutions. Build a highly effective and efficient health service delivery team in the District; and reason/present/negotiate the case of the District at departmental management and planning fora. Have the ability to assess and manage the performance of the District Health System and directly supervise staff. Have the ability to interact effectively and efficiently with a wide range of stakeholders. Have the ability to turn around negative audit findings in the district to be a positive one. Possess a good Knowledge and understanding of universal health coverage. Possess a clear understanding of risk and other management processes and the application thereof to ensure that the decentralised management model of the department is performing optimally. Possess knowledge of the governance framework and legislative imperatives set for the area of operation. Be computer literate with a proficiency in MS Office Software applications.
jobs.duties: Based on relevant policy imperatives, provide strategic leadership and ensure the development, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of an Annual District Health Services Delivery Plan. Account in terms of planned initiatives for the delivery of health services in Ethekwini District. Coordinate and facilitate processes to prioritise health service delivery initiatives and the allocation of concomitant resources amongst health facilities in Ethekwini District, whilst promoting service delivery equity. Monitor and evaluate health service delivery within in Ethekwini District, identify high risk areas and facilitate timeous corrective action where required. Provide transversal clinical support and other support services to Institutions. Ensure the development of an innovative and human rights sensitive cadre of health workers at all levels. Identify and address transversal health service delivery barriers that cannot be resolved at Institutional and district level and filter those requiring intervention at Provincial level. Facilitate the process of ensuring universal health access (NHI) for Ethekwini Health District. Oversee and coordinate the delivery of Emergency Medical Services (EMS) and Forensic Pathology Services (FPS) across the district. Implement good governance, transparency, and accountability practices. Drive all public health services within the district towards achieving and sustaining a clean audit. Please note that you will be responsible for all hospitals regardless of level of care Responsible for providing strategic leadership and overall management of all health services within the district. Ensure the delivery of high-quality, equitable, and patient-centred care across the district, while driving compliance, efficiency, and continuous improvement. Effectively manage and optimise all resources under your stewardship, including physical, and technological assets, to ensure efficiency, accountability, and maximum impact on service delivery. Build and maintain strong relationships with community structures, oversight bodies, NGOs, and other health sector partners. Participate in DDM, Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) and other intersectoral collaborations. Ensure all public health facilities on readiness for audits, inspections, and quality assurance assessments. Promote a positive organisational culture in the district. Supervise, mentor, and develop public health teams in ensuring high performance, continuous improvement, and policy compliance.
jobs.applications: Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs or submit their Z83 and CV directly to the following email address HeadOffice.HRJobapplication@kznhealth.gov.za Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying online or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the list of Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs All applications should be forwarded to: The Chief Director: Human Resource Management Services KZN Department of Health, Private Bag X9051, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 OR Hand delivered to: 330 Langalibalele Street, Natalia Building, Registry, Minus 1:1 North Tower FOR ATTENTION : Mr. A Memela
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed, initialed and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV only (with detailed experience). The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (when shortlisted). Applicants: Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. If you apply for more than 1 post, submit separate applications for each post that you apply for. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. NB: For the Pre-Entry Certificate for SMS, any individual may register for the course and complete such in anticipation of wishing to apply for a SMS post in future. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms- pre-entry-programme/.Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such, however it is not required that an applicant submit such when applying for the post prior to the closing date. af.requirements: NQF level 7) in Gesondheid; Plus graad of diploma in gesondheidsbestuur of Graad/diploma in algemene bestuur. Plus 'n Minimum van Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in senior bestuur. Plus Ongeëndorsede geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bewys van rekenaarvaardigheid met vaardigheid in Microsoft-sagtewaretoepassings. Bykomende Inligting: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) in Kliniese Gesondheidswetenskap; Huidige registrasie by die toepaslike gesondheidsprofessieliggaam; Ervaring in primêre gesondheidsorg en distriksgesondheidstelsel. Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Openbare Gesondheid/meesters in besigheidsbestuur. Projektbestuur. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Die beamsal in hierdie pos sal rapporteer aan die Hoofdirekteur: Distriksgesondheidsdienste: Hoofkantoor en sal verantwoordelik wees om te verseker en verantwoording te doen vir die lewering van geïntegreerde, effektiewe en doeltreffende gesondheidsdiens op alle sorgvlakke gebaseer op die Primêre Gesondheidsorg-benadering deur middel van die Distriksgesondheidstelsel binne EThekwini Distrik. Die ideale kandidate moet: 'n Duidelike begrip besit van die uitdagings wat die openbare gesondheidssektor in die gesig staar as gevolg van armoede, hulpbronbeperkings en opportunistiese siektes soos TB, HIV en Vigs. Die vermoë hê om komplekse bestuursdata en inligting te analiseer en te interpreteer om betyds besluitvorming en belyningsprosesse te inlig. Die vermoë hê om innoverende oplossings vir komplekse gesondheids- en ander diensleweringbestuursprobleme te ontwikkel. Sterk leierskap besit om:- ondersteuning/steun van ander staatsorgane en eksterne belanghebbendes te verseker om leweringsposte geïdentifiseer in die Jaarlikse Werkverrigtingsplanne van die Distrik te bereik. Strategiese rigting aan Instellings verskaf. Prosesse bemiddel vir die toekenning van hulpbronne aan Instellings. 'n Hoogs effektiewe en doeltreffende gesondheidsdiensleweringsspan in die Distrik bou; en die saak van die Distrik by departementele bestuurs- en beplanningsfora beredeneer/voorlê/onderhandel. Die vermoë hê om die werkverrigting van die Distriksgesondheidstelsel te assesseer en bestuur en personeel direk te superviseer. Die vermoë hê om effektief en doeltreffend met 'n wye reeks belanghebbendes te kommunikeer. Die vermoë hê om negatiewe ouditbevindings in die distrik na 'n positiewe een te keer. Goeie kennis en begrip besit van universele gesondheidsdekking. 'n Duidelike begrip besit van risiko- en ander bestuursprosesse en die toepassing daarvan om te verseker dat die gedesentraliseerde bestuursmodel van die departement optimaal presteer. Kennis besit van die bestuursraamwerk en wetgewende imperatiewe wat vir die bedryfsarea gestel is. Rekenaarvaardig wees met 'n vaardigheid in MS Office-sagtewaretoepassings.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap op grond van toepaslike beleidsimperatiewe en verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering en evaluering van 'n Jaarlikse Distriksgesondheidsdiensleweringsplan. Redegee oor beplande inisiatiewe vir die lewering van gesondheidsdienste in Ethekwini Distrik. Koördineer en fasiliteer prosesse om gesondheidsdiensleweringinisiatiewe en die toekenning van gepaardgaande hulpbronne onder gesondheidsfasiliteite in Ethekwini Distrik te prioritiseer, terwyl diensleweringsgelykheid bevorder word. Moniteer en evalueer gesondheidsdienslewering binne Ethekwini Distrik, identifiseer hoërisikoareas en fasiliteer tydige korrektiewe optrede waar nodig. Verskaf transversale kliniese ondersteuning en ander ondersteuningsdienste aan Instellings. Verseker die ontwikkeling van 'n innoverende en menseregte-gevoelige kader van gesondheidswerkers op alle vlakke. Identifiseer en spreek transversale gesondheidsdiensleweringstremplings aan wat nie op Instellings- en distrikvlak opgelos kan word nie en stuur dié wat ingryping op Provinsiale vlak vereis, deur. Fasiliteer die proses om universele gesondheidstoegang (NHI) vir Ethekwini Gesondheidsdistrik te verseker. Hou toesig oor en koördineer die lewering van Noodmediese Dienste (EMS) en Forensiese Patologiedienste (FPS) regoor die distrik. Implementeer goeie bestuurs-, deursigtigheids- en verantwoordingspraktyke. Dryf alle openbare gesondheidsdienste binne die distrik om 'n skoon oudit te bereik en vol te hou. Neem asseblief kennis dat u vir alle hospitale verantwoordelik sal wees ongeag die sorgvlak. Verantwoordelik vir die verskaffing van strategiese leierskap en algehele bestuur van alle gesondheidsdienste binne die distrik. Verseker die lewering van hoëgehalte, billike en pasiëntgesentreerde sorg regoor die distrik, terwyl voldoening, doeltreffendheid en deurlopende verbetering gedryf word. Bestuur en optimaliseer effektief alle hulpbronne onder u beheer, insluitend fisiese en tegnologiese bates, om doeltreffendheid, verantwoordbaarheid en maksimum impak op dienslewering te verseker. Bou en handhaaf sterk verhoudings met gemeenskapsstrukture, toesigliggame, NGO's en ander gesondheidssektorvennote. Neem deel aan DDM, Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) en ander intersektoriale samewerkings. Verseker gereedheid van alle openbare gesondheidsfasiliteite vir oudite, inspeksies en gehaltesekeringsassessering. Bevorder 'n positiewe organisatoriese kultuur in die distrik. Superviseer, mentor en ontwikkel openbare gesondheidspanne om hoë werkverrigting, deurlopende verbetering en beleidvolgehou te verseker.

zu.title: Chief Director
zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Chief Director EThekwini Health District esinikeza ubuholo bezobuchwepheshe ekuletheni imisebenzi yezempilo yesifunda, esidinga okuhlangenwe nakho ekuphathweni abaphakathi.
zu.requirements: I-NQF level 7) kwezempilo; kanye nesiqu noma idiploma ekuphathweni kwezempilo noma i-degree/diploma ekuphathweni okuvamile. Ukuze kugcwaliseke inani elinganiselwe leminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yeminyaka yokusebenza enkundleni yokuphatha abaphakathi kanti kufanele ibe nevaza lokushayela elingenachaphaza. Imvumo yokwazi kakhulu ngekhompyutha ngokubekhono kumiso yemikhando ye-Microsoft software applications. Ulwazi Olungeziwe: Isiqu sokufunda esingaphansi kwesiqu (NQF level 7) kwI-Clinical Health Science; Ukuqanjiswa okuhambisanayo nesiqu ngaphansi komzimba wezempilo; Okuhlanganisa imisebenzi yezokwelapha komphakathi kanye nesimiso sezempilo sesifunda. Isiqu esingaphezulu (Post-graduate) kwe-Public Health/master's in business management. Project Management. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukulolonga kanye Nezidingo Zika Mandla: Lowo osesikhundleni salolu bungcwethe uzophenduela ku- Chief Director: District Health Services: Head Office futhi uzobe nomthwalo wokuqinisekisa futhi aphenduele ngezenzo ekubekeni ngokuhleliwe kokulethwa kwemisebenzi yezempilo ehlanganisiwe nesebenzayo futhi ngokuphumelela emazingeni onke anakekelwa esekelwe esikweni sezenzo zemvelo ngaphakathi kwesimiso sezempilo sesifunda EThekwini District. Abafanelekile kakhulu abantu abafanele: Babe ukuqonda okucacile ngeminikelo ephethe imisebenzi yomphakathi yezempilo ngenxa yobuphakathi, izinkinga zensiza kanye nezigulo ezingabakhokheli ezinjengo-TB, i-HIV nengculaza. Babe amandla okuhlaziya futhi ahiye imininingwane ezelezayo ekuphathweni futhi inikeze isiqondiso ezinqubweni zokwenza izinqumo kanye nokuhambisa izinhloso ngokuhamba kwesikhathi esifanele. Babe amandla okuphuhlisa izixazululo ezintsha ezihamba phambili ezingachazeki emigweni yezempilo kanye nasezinye izinkinga ekuphathweni kokuletha imisebenzi. Babe amandla obuholo obuzinze okuhambisana nalezi zinhloso: ukuzinisekisa ukwamukelwa/ukusekela kwabanye amabanse kahulumeni kanye nalabo abangabaholi bokugcwalisa izinhloso ezichaziwe kwiNkambo Yonyaka Yokuqamba Yomphakathi yesifunda. Nikeza isiqondiso esihamba phambili Ezikhungweni. Phakamisa izinqubo zokuwaba izinsiza Ezikhungweni. Akha iqembu elisebenza kahle futhi eliphumela kahle ekuletheni imisebenzi yezempilo kusifunda; bese enika imibuzo/ukubonisa/ukuxazulula inkinga yesifunda ezinkundleni zokuphatha nomshini kahulumeni. Babe amandla okuhlola futhi balawule ukuphumelela kwesimiso sezempilo sesifunda kanye nokulawula ngqo abasebenzi. Babe amandla okusebenzisana kahle futhi ngokusebenza ngokupheleleyo nabantu abahlukene kakhulu. Babe amandla okushintsha iziphetho ezingemihle eziyisiphithiphithi zesikhwama senhlalo esifundazweni zibe ngemihle. Babe ulwazi oluhle kakhulu futhi baqonde ngokupheleleyo ngokulunga ukulunga kwamahle nabomhlaba. Babe ukuqonda okucacile ngesidingo kanye namanye amaqoqo okuphatha kanye nokusetshenziswa kwawo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi isimiso esihlukaniswe sokuphatha somnyango sisebenza ngamandla amakhulu. Babe ulwazi ngohlaka lomthetho kanye nezingidingo ezibekiwe ezweni lokuqhuba. Babe kakhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokuba khona kumiso yemikhando ye-MS Office Software applications.
zu.duties: Bekelwe izinkomba zomgomo ofanele, nikeza ubuholo bezobuchwepheshe futhi qiniseka ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, ukulawula kanye nokuhlola iNkambo Yonyaka Yokuhanjiswa Kwemisebenzi Yezempilo Yesifunda. Phendula mayelana nezinhloso ezicwelwe ngokuhlelele ekulethweni kwemisebenzi yezempilo EThekwini District. Linganisa futhi wenze izinqubo zokuqamba phambili izinhloso zokuletha imisebenzi yezempilo nokwaba okuhambisana nalokho izinsiza phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo EThekwini District, ngenkhiye kunweba ukulingana ekuletheni imisebenzi. Lawula futhi hlole ukulethwa kwemisebenzi yezempilo ngaphakathi EThekwini District, chaza izindawo ezibungazekayo futhi wenze isenzo sokulungisa ngesikhathi esifanele lapho kudingeka khona. Nikeza inkxaso yoklinika evela kwezinye izikhundla kanye nezinye izinsiza zokwesekela Ezikhungweni. Qiniseka ukuthuthukiswa kweqembu elisha nelibonisa ukuba nobuhlakani bezamabungu zabasebenzi bezempilo emazingeni onke. Chaza futhi uxaze izithiyo ezivela kwezinye izikhundla ekuletheni imisebenzi yezempilo ezingakwazi ukuxazululwa ezingeni Lezikhungo nangesifunda futhi udlulisele labo abadinga ukungenelela ezingeni Lezifundazwe. Yenza izinqubo zokuqinisekisa ukufinyelela kwazo bonke ezempiloni (NHI) kwi-EThekwini Health District. Lawula futhi linganisa ukulethwa kwezinsiza Zokwelapha Iziphephelo (EMS) kanye Nezinsiza Zokuqaphela Izigulo (FPS) esifundazweni sonke. Phatha izinqubo zokubusa kahle, ukusobeka, kanye nobunenhlalo. Khuthaza onke imisebenzi yezempilo yomphakathi esifundeni ukufeza futhi sigcine ukulungiswa kwesikhwama senhlalo. Sicela uqaphele ukuthi uzobe unomthwalo weziboshwa ngawo onke izibhedlela kungakhathaliseki izinga lokunakekelwa Unomthwalo weziboshwa ngokunikeza ubuholo bezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuphatha ngokupheleleyo onke imisebenzi yezempilo esifundeni. Qiniseka ukulethwa kokunakekelwa okulingenayo, okulinganayo, nokujwayele umguli esifundeni sonke, ngenkhiye ukhuthaza ukuzilandela, ukusebenza kahle, kanye nokuthuthuka okuqhubekayo. Phatha ngokusebenza kahle futhi ukhulise onke izinsiza ongomake wazo, okuhlanganisa izimpahla zomzimba futhi kanye nobuchwepheshe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kahle, ubunenhlalo, kanye nokuba nomthelela omkhulu ekuletheni imisebenzi. Akha futhi agcine ubudlelwano obusobekile nobunamandla nobusobekayo nezinhlanganiso zomphakathi, amabanse abolulelayo, i-Ngos, kanye nabanye abahlobo bemicabango yezempilo. Thatha inxaxheba ku-DDM, i-Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) kanye namanye amakhandlela ashibhile. Qinisekisa ukube abo bonke izikhungo zomphakathi zezempilo zilungele ukuhlolwa, ukuqashwa, kanye nokuhlola izinga lokhwalithi. Khuthaza isiko esihle senhlangano esifundeni. Lawula, fundisa, futhi uthuthukise amaqembu omphakatha wezempilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumelela okuphezulu, ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo, kanye nokuzilandela umgomo.

xh.title: Qhadu
xh.summary: Indima kaQhadu kuQhadu weZempilo eNgqini ye-EThekwini ebonelela ngabaholi abachanekileyo beqela abalawula iinkonzo ezisetyenziswa kwengingqi, kwaye kufuneka babe namava abaholi abakhulu.
xh.requirements: Qinisekisa ukuba ngumntu onemfundo yobuchule kwiqela leNQF 7) kwiZempilo; Kwaye unedigri okanye idiploma kulawulo lezempilo okanye idigri/diploma kulawulo jikelele. Kwaye uqedele iminyaka esi-5 (5) ngaphezulu yokugqiba imisebenzi ebekade eyinkulu. Kwaye unelayisensi yokushayela evuziweyo engenabhalo. Qinisekisa ukuba unesiqinisekiso sobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha unako ukusebenza ngesoftwe yeMicrosoft. Iinkcukacha ezongezelelweyo: Udityaniso lokuqala (inqanaba le-NQF 7) kwiSayensi yeZempilo yeNgcaciso ebanzi; UkuBhaliswa kwangoku emzimeni wezempilo ochungechunge; Iimfundo zokwenza iinkonzo zempilo ekuqaleni kwaye ulawule inkqubo yezempilo yengingqi. Udityaniso lwesibini kokuqala kwiZempilo yoLuntu/Masters kulawulo loshishino. Ulawulo lomsebenzi. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho kunye namava afunekayo: Umgangatho wokuqamba isikhundla senkonzo uya kubika kuQhadu: Iinkonzo zeMpi Yengingqi: INtloko yeQumrhu kwaye uya kuba nawo amaxanduva okuqinisekisa kwaye abike ngokunikela ngeenkonzo ezidityanisiweyo, ezisebenzayo kwaye ezilungeleleneyo zempilo kuzo zonke iinqanaba ezilungelelweyo ukunikela iNkonzo yeMpi ekuqaleni ngokusebenzisa iNkqubo yeMpi Yengingqi ngaphakathi kwiNgqi ye-EThekwini. Abagqibi abadingekayo kufuneka: Babe nokuqonda okucacileyo ngeengxaki ezibhekisa kuhlulo lwezempilo lwabantu ngenxa yendlalo, imigangatho encinci yamathuba kunye neziifo ezinjengeTB, HIV negawulwa. Babe namandla okuhlalutya nokutolikwa iinkcukacha zolawulo ezintsonkothileyo nolwazi ukuxhasa izigqibo-mthetho kunye neenkqubo zokuqwalaselwa ngesikhathi esifanelekileyo. Babe namandla okuphuhliswa iindlela ezintsha zokulungisa iingxaki ezintsonkothileyo zempilo nakunye ezinye iinkonzo ezilawula iingxaki zokunikela. Babe nogqithiso lokulawula oluqinileyo:- ukuze baqinisekise ukuvunywa/inkxaso kolunye amalungu karhulumente kunye nababukeli abangaphandle ukuba baqeqeshe ukunikela okuchaziweyo kuQoqo loNyaka lokuSebenza kweNgqi. Nikeza iNdlela yeNgqondo eQinileyo kwiZiko. Lawula iinkqubo zokwesabelwa kwamathuba kwiZiko. Sakha iqela elisebenzayo kwaye elilungelelanisileyo lokunikela ngeenkonzo zempilo eNgqini; kwaye axele/alethe/ncedisana nenyani yeNgqi kwiinkqubo zolawulo nezeplani zesebe. Babe namandla okuqwalasela nokulawula inkqubo yeMpi Yengingqi kwaye alawule ngqo abasebenzi. Babe namandla ochumaniso olusebenzayo kwaye olulungele neqela elibanzi lababukeli. Babe namandla okujika iziphumo ezingezizo ezilungileyo zokuhlelwa kwengingqi zibe ezilungileyo. Babe nolwazi oluhle kwaye baqonde ukubonelela kwempilo kwilonke eliluguqu-guqu. Babe nokuqonda okucacileyo ngengozi nakunye iinkqubo zolawulo nokusetyenziswa kwazo ukuze baqinisekise ukuba inkqubo yesebe yokulawula ukwenziwa kwemisebenzi ayingoonya kakhulu. Babe nolwazi ngolawulo lweenkqubo kunye neemfuno zomthetho ezisetyenziswa kwindawo yokusebenza. Babe nolwazi lobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha unako ukusebenza nge-MS Office Software.
xh.duties: Kuxhomekeke kwiimfuno zecandelo ngokomgaqo-nkqubo, znika inkululeko echanekileyo yokulawula iindlela kwaye uqinisekise uphuhliso, ukuqatshulwa, ukuqonda nokuhlolwa koNyaka woMgewu woKunikela ngeenkonzo zeZempilo eNgingqi. Phendula ngokwemiqathango ehleliweyo ngokunikela ngeenkonzo zempilo kwiNgqi ye-Ethekwini. Lungiselela kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zokuqwalasela iindlela zokunikela ngeenkonzo zempilo nokwesabelwa kwamathuba abalulekileyo phakathi kweziko lezempilo kwiNgqi ye-Ethekwini, ngelixa uxhasa ukulingana ekunikeleni ngeenkonzo. Qonda kwaye uhlole ukunikela ngeenkonzo zempilo ngaphakathi kwiNgqi ye-Ethekwini, qonda iindawo ezikho babungozi kwaye ulawule iinkqubo ezilungileyo zolungiso xa kufuneka. Nika inkxaso yezempilo echanekileyo ezikhusela amalungelo abantu nakunye inkxaso kwiZiko. Qinisekisa ukuphuhliswa kweqela elinesibhakabhaka kwaye elihlonipha amalungelo abantu abasebenza ngemveliso kuzo zonke iinqanaba. Qonda kwaye ulungise iinqele zokunikela ngeenkonzo zempilo ezingalungiswanga kwiNqanaba leZiko naseNgingqi kwaye udlele ezo zifuna ukungenelela kwiNqanaba loPhondo. Lawula iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ukufikelela kwempilo kuzo zonke iindawo (NHI) kwiNgqi yeZempilo ye-Ethekwini. Lawula kwaye ulungelelanise ukunikela ngeenkonzo zeMedic Yomngeni (EMS) kunye neenkonzo zeNqanaba loMzekeliso (FPS) kwingingqi. Zonke iinkqubo ezilungileyo zolawulo, ukubonakala kwenkqubo nokuba nabaphenduli. Qhuba zonke iinkonzo zempilo zoluntu kwiningqi ukuba zifezekise kwaye zigcine ukhathazo lokuhlelwa kakuhle kweenkonzo. Nceda qaphela ukuba uya kuba nawo onke amaxibele obe ngumntu onoxanduva lawo onke amaxibele ngenqanaba lemxholo. Umgangatho wokunikela inkululeko echanekileyo yolawulo kunye nokulawula iilonke iinkonzo zempilo ngaphakathi kwengingqi. Qinisekisa ukunikela ngamalungu amakhulu, alinganayo, kwaye axhasa umntu ongumntu kwellingqi, ngelixa xhasa ukuthobela, ukusebenza kakuhle, nokuphucula ngokuqhubekayo. Lawula kakuhle kwaye ulungelelanise zonke amathuba angaphantsi kolawulo lwakho, kuquka izinto ezibonwayo, kunye nezobuchwepheshe, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kakuhle, ukuphendula, kunye nomphumo omkhulu ekunikeleni ngeenkonzo. Sakha kwaye ugcine ubudlelwane obunamandla neendlela zoluntu, nabagadii beenkqubo, NGO, kunye nabanye abalingani besebe lezempilo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiDDM, Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) nakunye nabalungiselwa ngokusesikweni. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iziko lezempilo zilungelo lokuhlelwa, ukuqwalaselwa, kunye noqwalaselo lomgangatho. Xhasa inkqubo echanekileyo yokuqamba izinto kwengingqi. Lawula, ncede, kwaye uphuhlise amaqela abasebenzi basesebe lempilo kuqinisekisa ukusebenza kakuhle, ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo, kunye nokuthobela iinkqubo zomthetho.

jobs.title: Chief Director
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum, (an all-inclusive SMS salary package). (All-inclusive salary packages, which consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules).
jobs.summary: Chief Director to lead Strategic Health Programmes at the KwaZulu-Natal Health Head Office, requiring an NQF level 7 health qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Health Science or MBCHB; Plus Current registration with the relevant health professional body; Plus A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at a senior managerial level managing Strategic Health Programmes. Plus Unendorsed valid Code B driver’s licence (Code 08). Computer literacy in Microsoft Software applications. Additional Qualification: A post graduate qualification in Public Health Management or relevant Health Management qualification; Plus experience in Health Programme Management and District health Services Management will be an added advantage. NB: For the Pre-Entry Certificate for SMS, any individual may register for the course and complete such in anticipation of wishing to apply for an SMS post in future. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms-pre-entry- programme/.Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such, however it is not required that an applicant submit such when applying for the post prior to the closing date. However, prior to an appointment being made to any SMS post, the appointee to such a post must have completed the pre-entry certificate and must be in possession of such prior to taking up the post. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be and integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence and integrity. NB: All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of work experience endorsed and stamped by the employer/s prior to the date of the interview. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies: The incumbent of this post will report to the Deputy Director General: Clinical Support Services, and will be responsible to provide management, leadership and coordination of Strategic Health Programmes, which includes HIV/AIDS, TB, MCWH, Nutrition, Food Services Management MMC, ACSM, Strategic Information Management and Youth, Gender and Transformation, in the Department. The ideal candidate must: Have the ability to work independently and under pressure. Be able to handle sensitive and personal information with strict confidence. Possess strong leadership and strategy execution skills. Have experience in budgeting, financial planning and analysis. Possess good understanding of HR practices and staff relations. Have high level of communication skills (written and verbal). Be computer literate with a proficiency in Microsoft Office Software applications. Have planning and organisational, project management, financial management, decision making and problem solving skills. Have an understanding of legislative prescripts governing the public service. Possess knowledge of government communication structures and principles.
jobs.duties: Job Purpose: Provide Strategic capabilities and Leadership in strengthening Strategic Health Programmes through planning, setting up of governance structures, service development through programming and project management, monitoring and reporting. Oversee and manage the implementation of strategic health programmes activities, budget and policies across interrelated functions to ensure that all targets are achieved in line with the strategic plans of the Department. Develop appropriate environment for implementing medium and long term plans to mitigate the impact of HIV/AIDS and Tuberculosis pandemic, Maternal Mortality, Malnutrition and Child related, Communicable Diseases as well as Mens Health trends and identify strategies for evaluation of services. Ensure development and implementation of effective communications strategies and reliable information systems for the benefit of the Department. Identify and address transversal health service delivery barriers that need intervention from beyond strategic health programmes. Co- ordinate the multi-sectoral responses for the HIV, TB and STIs in line with the Provincial HIV, TB and STI plan. Co-ordinate the support, resource acquisition and distribution from all Donor funded Support Partners including signing of MOUs between the KZN Department of Health and Partners. Liase with all relevant stakeholders. Including Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) and Development Model (DDM) partakers with a view to finding innovative solutions for identified policy barriers in SHP. Provide Strategic leadership to Provincial Teams and District Teams in the Development, Implementation monitoring and reporting on the HIV and TB Conditional Grant Business Plan in line with the Conditional Grant Framework and DORA indicators. Ensure the effective, efficient and economical management of allocated resources of SHP component.
jobs.applications: Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs or submit their Z83 and CV directly to the following email address HeadOffice.JobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za. NB//The subject of your e-mail must be the post name that you are applying for. Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centre’s (DOACS) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying online or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the list of Designated Online Application Centre’s (DOACS) at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs All applications should be forwarded to: The Chief Director: Human Resource Management Services, KZN Department of Health, Private Bag X9051, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 OR Hand delivered to: 330 Langalibalele Street, Natalia Building, Registry, Minus 1:1 North Tower FOR ATTENTION : Miss L Mthalane
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the new prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed, initialed and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV (with detailed experience). Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation. Applicants: Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. If you apply for more than 1 post, submit separate applications for each post that you apply for. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful.

af.title: Hoofdirekteur
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur om Strategiese Gesondheidsprogramme by die KwaZulu-Natal Health Hoofkantoor te lei, waarvoor 'n NQF-vlak 7 gesondheidskwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 7) in Gesondheidswetenskappe of MBCHB; Plus Huidige registrasie by die tersaaklike gesondheidsprofesionele liggaam; Plus 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak in die bestuur van Strategiese Gesondheidsprogramme. Plus Onaangemerkte geldige Kodus B-bestuurderslisensie (Kodus 08). Rekenaargeletterdheid in Microsoft-sagtowepassings. Bykomende kwalifikasie: 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Openbare Gesondheidsbestuur of 'n tersaaklike Gesondheidsbestuurskwalifikasie; Plus ervaring in Gesondheidsprogrambestuur en Distriksgesondheidsdienste-bestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. NB: Vir die Voor-toelatingsertifikaat vir SMS, kan enige individu vir die kursus registreer en dit voltooi in afwagting daarvan om in die toekoms vir 'n SMS-pos aansoek te doen. Die kursus is by die NSG beskikbaar onder die naam Certificate for entry into the SMS en die volledige besonderhede kan verkry word deur die skakel te volg: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms-pre-entry- programme/.Individue wat die kursus reeds voltooi het, en wat dus in besit is van 'n sertifikaat, is welkom om dit in te dien, maar dit word nie vereis dat 'n aansoeker dit indien wanneer hy/sy voor die sluitingsdatum vir die pos aansoek doen nie. Voor enige aanstelling egter in 'n SMS-pos gemaak word, moet die aangestelde in so 'n pos die voor-toelatingsertifikaat voltooi het en in besit daarvan wees voordat die pos aanvaar word. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toelatingsassesserings onderneem. Die een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteit (etiese gedrag) assessering wees. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate vir SMS-poste sal aan 'n tegniese oefening en onderhoud onderwerp word. Na die tegniese oefening en onderhoud sal 'n maksimum van drie (3) SMS-kandidate 'n psigometriese assessering ondergaan om kognitiewe vermoëns, gedragsvoorkeure, emosionele intelligensie en integriteit te assesseer. NB: Alle gekorte lysde kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van werkervaring voor die datum van die onderhoud in te dien, wat deur die werker/s onderskryf en gestempel is. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede: Die ampshouer van hierdie pos sal aan die Adjunk-Direkteur-generaal: Clinical Support Services rapporteer, en sal verantwoordelik wees om bestuur, leierskap en koördinering van Strategiese Gesondheidsprogramme te verskaf, wat HIV/AIDS, TB, MCWH, Nutrition, Food Services Management MMC, ACSM, Strategic Information Management en Youth, Gender and Transformation in die departement insluit. Die ideale kandidaat moet: In staat wees om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk. Sensitiewe en persoonlike inligting met streng vertroulikheid kan hanteer. Sterk leierskap- en strategie-uitvoeringsvaardighede besit. Ervaring in begroting, finansiële beplanning en ontleding hê. 'n Goeie begrip van HR-praktyke en personeelverhoudings besit. 'n Hoë vlak van Kommunikasievaardighede (geskrewe en mondelings) hê. Rekenaargeletterd wees met 'n vaardigheid in Microsoft Office-sagtowepassings. Beplannings- en organisatoriese, projekbestuurs-, finansiële bestuurs-, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede hê. 'n Begrip van wetlike voorskrifte wat die openbare diens regeer, hê. Kennis van regeringskommunikasiestrukture en -beginsels besit.
af.duties: Doel van die pos: Verskaf strategiese vermoëns en leierskap in die versterking van Strategiese Gesondheidsprogramme deur beplanning, die opstel van bestuursstrukture, diensontwikkeling deur programmering en projekbestuur, monitering en verslagdoening. Oorsien en bestuur die implementering van strategiese gesondheidsprogramme se aktiwiteite, begroting en beleide oor onderling samehangende funksies om te verseker dat alle teikens bereik word in ooreenstemming met die strategiese planne van die departement. Ontwikkel 'n geskikte omgewing vir die implementering van medium- en langtermynplanne om die impak van die HIV/AIDS-en-Tuberkulose-pandemie, Moedersterftes, Wanvoeding en Kind-verwante, Oordraagbare Siektes asook Mans-gesondheidstendense te verminder, en identifiseer strategieë vir die evaluering van dienste. Verseker die ontwikkeling en implementering van doeltreffende kommunikasiestrategieë en betroubare inligtingstelsels tot voordeel van die departement. Identifiseer en spreek dwarslopende gesondheidsdiensleweringshindernisse aan wat ingrypings van buite strategiese gesondheidsprogramme benodig. Koördineer die multisektorale response vir HIV, TB en STI's in ooreenstemming met die Provinciale HIV-, TB- en STI-plan. Koördineer die ondersteuning, hulpbronverkryging en -verspreiding van alle deur skenkers gefinansierde Ondersteuningsvennote, insluitend die ondertekening van MOU's tussen die KZN Department of Health en Vennote. Skakel met alle tersaaklike belanghebbendes. Insluitend Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) en Development Model (DDM) deelnemers met die oog daarop om innoverende oplossings vir geïdentifiseerde beleidshindernisse in SHP te vind. Verskaf strategiese leierskap aan Provinciale Spanne en Distrikspanne in die Ontwikkeling, Implementering, monitering en verslagdoening oor die HIV- en TB-voorwaardelike toelaagbesigheidsplan in ooreenstemming met die Conditional Grant Framework en DORA-aanwysers. Verseker die doeltreffende, doeltrefferende en ekonomiese bestuur van toegekende hulpbronne van die SHP-komponent.

zu.title: I-Isikhulumi
zu.summary: I-Chief Director yokuhola izinhlelo zeStrategic Health Programmes eKwaZulu-Natal Health Head Office, edinga isitifiketi seNQF level 7 kwezempilo kanye neminyaka emihlanu yobuniningwane ezingeni eliphezulu lokubusa.
zu.requirements: Izindingo: Isitifiketi seziqu ezingaphansi kwesigaba (NQF level 7) kwezempilo noma i-MBCHB; Kanti futhi ibhalise njalo enhlanganweni ezihlonza izifo; Ubuniningwane beminyaka emihlanu (5) ngaphezulu obudala ezingeni eliphezulu lokubusa amakhono obuphathi. Kanti futhi ungathathi ihovisi lesiqu B driver's licence (Code 08) esingavunyiwe. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kusoftware yeMicrosoft. Iziqu ezingeziwe: Isitifiketi seziqu ezingaphezulu kwezobuphathi bempilo komphakathi noma iziqu ezihambisana nezobuphathi; Kanti futhi ubuniningwane ekuphathweni kwezinhlelo zempilo kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsiza zesifunda kuzoba yinzuzo. NB: Mayelana ne-Certificate for entry into the SMS, noma ngubani ongathanda ukubhalisa kulezi zifundo bese ayigqitsha ethemba lokuthi esikhathini esizayo angathanda ukufaka isicelo esikhundleni seSMS. Leli fundo lifinyeleleka e-NSG ngaphansi kwegama elithi Certificate for entry into the SMS futhi imininingwane yonke ingatholwa ngoku landela le link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms-pre-entry- programme/.Abantu abesigqitsha lezi zifundo futhi baba nesitifiketi bayamukelekwa ukuthi basinikeze, nokho akudingekile ukuthi umfaki isicelo asinikeze ngesikhathi efaka isicelo sesikhundla ngaphambi kosuku lokuvala. Nokho, ngaphambi kokuba umuntu abekwe esikhundleni seSMS, lowo obekwa kuleso sikhundla kufanele asigqitshile isitifiketi sokungena futhi abe nasesikhathini sokuthatha isikhundla. Bonke abantu abakhethwe, okuhlanganisa ne-SMS, bazokwenza izivivinyo ezimbili zokungena. Esinye sezivivinyo sibe yisivivinyo senzuzo ukuqinisekisa ukufaneleka komuntu ngokusekelwe izindingo zezezobuchwepheshe ngokubanzi kanti esinye sibe yisivivinyo sokuziphatha okuhloniphekile. Bonke abantu abakhethwe kumakhono eSMS bazothathwa isivivinyo sezobuchwepheshe kanye nokubuzwa imibuzo. Emva kwesivivinyo ngokobuchwepheshe nokubuzwa imibuzo, abantu abathathu (3) abakhethwe kwi-SMS bazokwenza isivivinyo sokulinganisa ukukhulu kokuhamba kwengqondo, izinketho zokuziphatha, ukuqonda izinkinga kanye nokuziphatha okuhloniphekile. NB: Bonke abantu abakhethwe bazodinga ukunikeza ubufakazi beminyaka yomsebenzi ogunyaziwe futhi unophazisha ngaphambi kosuku lokubuzwa imibuzo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa kanye namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Lowo uthatha lesi sikhundla uzokubika kuDeputy Director General: Clinical Support Services, futhi uzobe nehlaya yokuqondisa,ukuHola nokuhlanganisa izinhlelo zempilo ezibalulekile, okuhlanganisa iHIV/AIDS, i-TB, i-MCWH, ukudla, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza zokudla iMMC, iACSM, ukuphathwa kolwazi olubalulekile kanye nezensizwa, isini nentuthuko, kuyo loMnyango. Lowo angathanda ukuthatha lesi sikhundla kufanele: Akwazi ukusebenza kodwa ngesikhathi esinobungozi. Akwazi ukuphatha ulwazi oluzwelayo nolomuntu siqu ngokuzethemba. Abe namakhono okuhola futhi aphathe kahle izinhlelo. Abe nobuniningwane ekuqondeni imali, ukuhlela imali nokuyahlukahluka. Aqonde kahle izindlela zokuphatha abasebenzi kanye nobudlelwane babo. Abe namakhono okuxhumana okude noma okubhaliwe. Akwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngesoftware yeMicrosoft. Abe namakhono ekuhleleni, ekuqondiseni imikhakha, ekuhleleni imikhakha, eqondiseni imali, ekuqondeni izinkinga kanye nokuzixazulula. Aqonde imithetho elawula imikhakha kaMnyango. Akwazi ukuxhumana ngokwezombusazwe kanye nokuqonda izakhiwo zendabuko
zu.duties: Injongo Yomsebenzi: Kulethe izikhondo ezinhle zokuqondisa kanye nokuHola ekugcineni amakhono abaphathi eMihlaba yeZezimali mibhalo, iNdlu yesiNgisi isincomo, iKhompyutha nokuhlela imisebenzi. Qaphela futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zempilo ezibalulekile, amabhajethi nemigomo emisebenzini ehlobene ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhloso zifinyelelwa ngokulandelana amaphulani abalulekile eHhovisi lezeMpiLo. Yakha isimo esifanele sokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zesikhathi esiphakathi nendebe yokuqeda ukubakhona kwe zifo zocansi nezeGula, ukufa kwezinsizwa, izinto ezibangelwa ukungalondwa kwezinsizwa, izifo ezithathelwanayo kanye nesimo sezempilo sabezinsizwa bese uhlonza izindlela zokuqinisekisa izinsizakalo. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezindlela zokuxhumana ezisebenzayo kanye nezinhlelo zolwazi ezethembekile enzuzweni yoMnyango. Hlola futhi ulungise izithiyo ezenza ingozi ezinhlelweni zempilo ezidinga ukungenelela ngaphezu kwezinhlelo zempilo ezibalulekile. Hlanganisa izimpendulo zamaselula amaningi ngeHIV, iTB kanye neSTI ngokulandelana iNkambiso yesifunda seHIV, iTB kanye neSTI. Hlanganisa ukusekela, ukuthola izinsiza kanye nokwabiwa kwazo kubo bonke abalingana ngemali abasiza, okuhlanganisa ukusayina kweMOU phakathi kukaMnyango wezeMpilo waseKZN kanye nabalingana. Xhumana nabo bonke abathintekayo. Okuhlanganisa nalabo abathatha inhlathiyo ku-Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) kanye ne-Development Model (DDM) ngenjongo yokuthola izixazululo ezintsha kumabariya amaphulani abalulekile ezinhlelweni zempilo. Nikeza abaphathi abakhulu isiqondiso abaqondisa amaphathi awesifunda kanye nawo wesifunda ekuqondiseni, ekuhleleni, ekuqinisekiseni izinhlelo kanye nokubika ngohlelo lweHIV neTB Conditional Grant Business Plan ngokulandelwa isakhiwo se-Conditional Grant kanye neDORA. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokusebenza, okunengqondo nangokugcina izinsiza ezabelwe kuyo yonke ingxenye yezinhlelo zempilo ezibalulekile.

xh.title: uMkhokeli oMkhulu
xh.summary: uMkhokeli weNkqubo ukuqhuba iNkqubo eziQondiswayo zezeMpilo eKwaZulu-Natal Health Head Office, ngesifundo seNQF level 7 empilweni namava emi (5) yokulawula esinqanaba esiphezulu.
xh.requirements: Izifundo eziphantsi kwesiqu (NQF level 7) kwisiZwe saBantu nafezela; Plus uBhalo lwangoku kwigumbi elilawulayo lezeMpilo ezeMululu; Plus uVumbo lweNyanga emi (5) yamava ngokulawula ngenqanaba eliphezulu kwiNkqubo eziQondiswayo zeMpilo. Plus uVuzo oluHlawulweyo, oluSebenzayo lweKhodi B (Khodi 08). Ulwazi lokusebenza ngeKhompyutha kwiinkqubo zeMicrosoft. IziFundo eziNgezelekileyo: Isiqu esiphezulu seziFundiso zoLawulo lwaMaLuvo ezeMpilo okanye isiqu esihlobene nokuLawulwa kweMpilo; Plus amava ekulawulen iNkqubo yeMpilo kunye noLawulo lweenkonzo zeSithili kuya kuba ngumfa olongezelelekileyo. NB: Malunga neSatyifiketi sokuQala kubaBhalo beSMS, nabani na ungangena ebhalweni waza wagqiba le nkqubo elinde ukuba athande ukusebenzisa isithuba seSMS xesha elizayo. Le nkqubo iyafumaneka kwi-NSG ngokuthi yiSatyifiketi sokuNgena kwiSMS yaye iinkcukacha ezizeleyo zingafumaneka ngokulandela lo mgca: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms-pre-entry- programme/.Abantu abagqiba le nkqubo selebenze, yaye ke babanamatyifiketi bayamkelwa ukuba bazinike, nangona kunjalo akufuneki mntu onike le nto xa esenza isicelo sesithuba phambi komhla wokuvala. Kodwa, phambi kokuba kwenziwe ukubekwa kwenyathelo kuyo nayiphi na indawo yeSMS, lowo usetyenziswa kule ndawo kufuneka abe sele agqibile isatyifiketi sokuqala yaye abe neso phambi kokuba athathe isithuba. Bonke abaBhalwa abakhethiweyo, kuquka neSMS, kuya kwenza iindlela ezimbini zokuQala. Enya kuya kuba yimisebenzi yaqondo nangokomzimba ukuqondisa ukuba umntu uyamelana nendawo okuqondiswe kuyo ngokobuchwepheshe namagunya abekekileyo, yenye kufuneka ibe yinkqubo yobuqu (ukuziphatha ngokweenkqubo). Bonke abaBhalwa abakhethiweyo kwiindawo zeSMS kuya kubekwa ngaphantsi komsebenzi ochwephesheleyo negumbi lokubuzwa. Emva komsebenzi ochwephesheleyo negumbi lobuzo, inani elingaphezulu kwe (3) abaBhalwa beSMS kuya kwenzelwa ukulingwa ngokomqondo ukuqonda ukuphila koluntu, izinto azikhethwayo ngokomntu, ukuqonda imiva yamava kunye nobuqu. NB: Bonke abaBhalwa abakhethiweyo kuya kufuneka banike iBali lamava omsebenzi esetyenziswe negunguqwelwa ngumsebenzisi/abasebenzisi phambi komhla wokuqondisa. ULwazi, iziKholezo, ukuQeqesha namava aQinisekileyo: Lo mntu kule ndawo kuya kuxela kuNdunankulu oNgsesondweni: Iinkonzo eziNcedisayo zobuGqirha, yaye kuya kubakuba nemisebenzi yokunikela ngokulawula, ukukhokela nokuhambelanisa iNkqubo eziQondiswayo zezeMpilo, ezingabandakanya iHIV/AIDS, iTB, iMCWH, iNutrition, uLawulo lweenkonzo zoKutya iMMC, iACSM, uLawulo lweNkcazelo eNtloko kunye nonGatsha, oBuhle nobuLili kunye noTshintsho, kwiSebe. Umntu ofanelekileyo kufuneka: Abe namandla okusebenza yedwa nangaphantsi kwexinzelelo. Abe nokwazi ukupatha iinkcukacha ezibuzekileyo nezomntu zinobuqu ngenkathalo enkulu. Abe noBunkokeli obuNamandla nokuQonda iindlela. Abe namava kwisenzo sokwenza amaphulo, iindlela zokucinga ngenyimali nokuqonda. Aqonde amava kaBantu ngokwemisebenzi yabo yokuQeqesha iinKqubo nangokubakho kwabasebenzi. Abe namandla mahle okuthetha-hamba (ebaliweyo nangokomlomo). Abe nokwazi okusebenzayo ngeKhompyutha ezinkqubweni zeMicrosoft Office. Abe namandla okuqamba, okulawula iinKqubo, okuphatha iimali, ukwenza izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki. Aqonde imigaqo-yomthetho eLawulayo yoLawulo lwentlalo. Abe nolwazi ngeenKqubo zokuThetha-hamba zoLawulo lwentlalo.
xh.duties: Injongo yoMsebenzi: Kunikela ngezakhono eziNtloko kunye noBunkokeli ekomelezweni kweNkqubo yezeMpilo eziBalulekileyo ngokuqamba iindlela zokucinga, ukuseka iinkqubo zolawulo, ukuphuhlisa inkonzo ngokwenza iinkqubo kunye nokulawula imisebenzi yokwakhiwa, ukuqonda nokubika. Qondise ulawule ukusetyenziswa kweendlela zokwenza umsebenzi weenkqubo ezingabalulekileyo zempilo, abasimali namagqabantshintshi kumasebe ahambelana ngokubanzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba onke amanqabanqaba afunyaniswe ngokwamacebo ambalwa weSebe. Phuhliza amava afanelekileyo okusetyenziswa iindlela zokuqamba iindlela zexesha eliqatha nengasexesha ukunciphisa umbane weHIV/AIDS kunye nesiyelelanu seTuberculosis, ukufa kookhokho abazala, ukungondleki kokutya nangabantswana, iinketho ezidlulisekayo kunye nemiba eqhathwa yiMiqathu yaBantu, kwaye ke ukhulule amathuba okusetyenziswa ezinye iindlela zokuqonda iinkonzo. Qinisekisa ukomelelwa nokusetyenziswa kweendlela ezisebenzayo zokuthetha-hamba kunye neendlela ezithembekileyo zeendaba ezanceda iSebe. Phawula ngokubhekisa iziphene ezingathatha iimpendulo ngaphakathi kundlu yamava azele imisebenzi engenamsebenzi ongathunyelwa ngaphakathi kweenkqubo zentlalo ngokubanzi phakathi kwesikhululo seenkonzo nakumazwe amathathu. Qondise iimpendulo eziphindaphindwayo ezindidi-ngendini zezigulane zeHIV, TB namaxhoba ezifo ezidluliswayo ngokwamacebo abemi behlala eHIV, TB namaxhoba ezifo ezidluliswayo. Lawula inkxaso, iindlela ezifunekayo zokuzuzisa nokuqhuba ngaphandle kwayo nayiphi na inkxaso eqinisekiswa ziQabane loGcino, kuquka nokuqamba iMigqabiso yokuQonda phakathi koSebe loKwaZulu-Natal loGcino kunye namaQabane. Thethana ngqo nabo bonke abantu abafanelo. Kuquka nabaWelisa uSebenzo iSukuma Sakhe (OSS) neQondo laMaQondo (DDM) ngenjongo yokufumana iindlela ezitsha ezizakuqondisa iingcango ezingaqondwanga kwizigaba ezingalawulekiyo zempilo ize ngenyaniso. Nikela ngenkundla yokukhokela kumaQela aPhakathi nakumaQela eSithili ekuphuhliseni, ukwenza ukuqondisa nokubingelela isiQingatha seHIV kunye neBhodo yoQhagamshelo seTB ngokwesiQingatha seBhodo soQhagamshelo kunye nabachazi beDORA. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngamandla, ngokukhawuleza nangokugcina amathuba abekelwe eceleni kwesiphAKU saKho seendawo ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: District Director
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: District Director providing strategic leadership for health service delivery in the Uthukela Health District, requiring a health qualification and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Health; Plus degree or diploma in health management or Degree/diploma in general management. Plus A minimum of Five (5) years at a middle/senior managerial level in Public Health Care environment Plus Unendorsed valid driver’s license. Computer literacy with proficiency in Microsoft software applications. Additional Information: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Clinical Health Science; Current registration with the relevant health professional body; Experience in primary health care and district health system. Post-graduate qualification in Public Health / Master in Business Management. Project Management. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: The incumbent of this post will report to the Chief Director: District Health Services: Head Office and will be responsible to ensure and account for the delivery of integrated, effective and efficient health service at all levels of care based on the Primary Health Care approach through the District Health System within UThukela District (whichever is relevant). The ideal candidates must: Possess a clear understanding of the challenges facing the public health sector due to poverty, resource limitations and opportunistic diseases such as TB, HIV and AIDS. Have the ability to analyse and interpret complex management data and information to inform decision-making and alignment processes timeously. Have the ability to develop innovative solutions for complex health and other service delivery management problems. Possess strong leadership to: ensure buy-in/support of other organs of state and external stakeholders to accomplish deliverables identified in the Annual Performance Plans of the District. Provide strategic direction to Institutions. Mediate processes for the allocation of resources to Institutions. Build a highly effective and efficient health service delivery team in the District; and reason/present/negotiate the case of the District at departmental management and planning fora. Have the ability to assess and manage the performance of the District Health System and directly supervise staff. Have the ability to interact effectively and efficiently with a wide range of stakeholders. Have the ability to turn around negative audit findings in the district to be a positive one. Possess a good Knowledge and understanding of universal health coverage Possess a clear understanding of risk and other management processes and the application thereof to ensure that the decentralised management model of the department is performing optimally. Possess knowledge of the governance framework and legislative imperatives set for the area of operation. Be computer literate with a proficiency in MS Office Software applications.
jobs.duties: Based on relevant policy imperatives, provide strategic leadership and ensure the development, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of an Annual District Health Services Delivery Plan. Account in terms of planned initiatives for the delivery of health services in the District. Coordinate and facilitate processes to prioritise health service delivery initiatives and the allocation of concomitant resources amongst health facilities in the District, whilst promoting service delivery equity. Monitor and evaluate health service delivery within the District, identify high risk areas and facilitate timeous corrective action where required. Provide transversal clinical support and other support services to Institutions. Ensure the development of an innovative and human rights sensitive cadre of health workers at all levels. Identify and address transversal health service delivery barriers that cannot be resolved at Institutional and district level and filter those requiring intervention at Provincial level. Facilitate the process of ensuring universal health access (NHI) for UThukela Health District. Oversee and coordinate the delivery of Emergency Medical Services (EMS) and Forensic Pathology Services (FPS) across the district. Implement good governance, transparency, and accountability practices. Drive all public health services within the district towards achieving and sustaining a clean audit. Responsible for providing strategic leadership and overall management of all health services within the district. Ensure the delivery of high-quality, equitable, and patient-centred care across the district, while driving compliance, efficiency, and continuous improvement. Effectively manage and optimise all resources under your stewardship, including physical, and technological assets, to ensure efficiency, accountability, and maximum impact on service delivery. Build and maintain strong relationships with community structures, oversight bodies, NGOs, and other health sector partners. Participate in DDM, Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) and other intersectoral collaborations. Ensure all public health facilities on readiness for audits, inspections, and quality assurance assessments. Promote a positive organisational culture in the district. Supervise, mentor, and develop public health teams in ensuring high performance, continuous improvement, and policy compliance.
jobs.applications: Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs or submit their Z83 and CV directly to the following email address HeadOffice.HRJobapplication@kznhealth.gov.za Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying online or receiving your hardcopy application. af.title: Distriksdirekteur
af.summary: Distriksdirekteur wat strategiese leierskap verskaf vir gesondheidsdienslewering in die Uthukela Health District, met die vereiste van 'n gesondheidskwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in Gesondheid; Plus 'n graad of diploma in gesondheidsbestuur of 'n graad/diploma in algemene bestuur. Plus 'n Minimum van Vyf (5) jaar op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in 'n Publieke Gesondheidsorgomgewing. Plus 'n ongewysigde geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid met behoorsaamheid in Microsoft-sagtewaretoepassings. Bykomende Inligting: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in Kliniese Gesondheidswetenskap; Huidige registrasie by die tersaaklike gesondheidsprofessionele liggaam; Ervaring in primêre gesondheidsorg en die distriksgesondheidstelsel. Nagraadse kwalifikasie in Publieke Gesondheid / Meester in Besigheidsbestuur. Projektbestuur. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Die bewoner van hierdie pos sal aan die Hoofdirekteur: District Health Services: Head Office verslag doen en sal verantwoordelik wees om, en rekeningkapping gee oor, die lewering van geïntegreerde, doeltreffende en effektiewe gesondheidsdiens op alle sorgvlakke, gebaseer op die Primêre Gesondheidsorbenadering deur die Distriksgesondheidstelsel binne UThukela District (na gelang van wat tersaaklik is), te verseker. Die ideale kandidate moet: Oor 'n duidelike begrip beskik van die uitdagings wat die openbare gesondheidssektor in die gesig staar weens armoede, hulpbronbeperkings en opportunistiese siektes soos TB, HIV en Vigs. Die vermoë hê om komplexe bestuursdata en inligting te ontleed en te interpreteer om besluitneming en belyningsprosesse tydig te infor. Die vermoë hê om innoverende oplossings te ontwikkel vir komplekse gesondheids- en ander diensleweringbestuursprobleme. Oor sterk leierskap beskik om: die instemming/ondersteuning van ander staatsorgane en eksterne rolspelers te verseker om lewerables wat in die Jaarlikse Prestasieplanne van die Distrik geïdentifiseer is, te bewerkstellig. Strategiese rigting aan Instellings verskaf. Prosesse vir die toewysing van hulpbronne aan Instellings bemiddel. 'n Hoogs effektiewe en doeltreffende gesondheidsdiensleweringspan in die Distrik bou; en die saak van die Distrik by departementele bestuurs- en beplanningsfora beredeer/voorlê/onderhandel. Die vermoë hê om die prestasie van die Distriksgesondheidstelsel te assesseer en bestuur en personeel direk te superviseer. Die vermoë hê om effektief en doeltreffend met 'n wye reeks rolspelers te interakteer. Die vermoë hê om negatiewe ouditbevindings in die distrik na 'n positiewe een te transformeer. Oor goeie Kennis en begrip van universele gesondheidsdekking beskik. Oor 'n duidelike begrip beskik van risiko- en ander bestuursprosesse en die toepassing daarvan om te verseker dat die gedesentraliseerde bestuursmodel van die departement optimaal funksioneer. Oor kennis beskik van die bestuursraamwerk en wetgewende imperatiewe wat vir die bedryfsgebied gestel is. Rekenaarvaardig wees met 'n behoorsaamheid in MS Office-sagtewaretoepassings.
af.duties: Gebaseer op tersaaklike beleidsimperatiewe, bied strategiese leierskap en verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering en evaluering van 'n Jaarlikse Distriksgesondheidsdiensteleweringplan. Rekenkap gee aangaande beplande inisiatiewe vir die lewering van gesondheidsdienste in die Distrik. Koördineer en fasiliteer prosesse om gesondheidsdiensleweringinisiatiewe en die toewysing van gepaardgaande hulpbronne onder gesondheidsfasiliteite in die Distrik te prioritiseer, terwyl diensleweringsekiteit bevorder word. Monitor en evalueer gesondheidsdienslewering binne die Distrik, identifiseer hoërisiko-gebiede en fasiliteer tydige korrektiewe optrede waar nodig. Verskaf transversale kliniese ondersteuning en ander ondersteuningsdienste aan Instellings. Verseker die ontwikkeling van 'n innoverende en menseregte-gevoelige kader van gesondheidswerkers op alle vlakke. Identifiseer en spreek transversale gesondheidsdiensleweringstruivelke wat nie op Institusionele en distriksvlak opgelos kan word nie en stuur dié wat ingryping op Provinsiale vlak vereis, deur. Fasiliteer die proses om universele gesondheidstoegang (NHI) vir Uthukela Health District te verseker. Hou toesig oor en koördineer die lewering van Emergency Medical Services (EMS) en Forensic Pathology Services (FPS) oor die distrik heen. Implementeer goeie bestuurspraktyke, deursigtigheid en verantwoordbaarheid. Stuur alle openbare gesondheidsdienste binne die distrik aan na die bereiking en volhoubare handhawing van 'n skoon oudit. Verantwoordelik vir die verskaffing van strategiese leierskap en algehele bestuur van alle gesondheidsdienste binne die distrik. Verseker die lewering van hoëgehalte, billike en pasiëntgesentreerde sorg oor die distrik, terwyl voldoening, doeltreffendheid en deurlopende verbetering gedryf word. Bestuur en optimaliseer effektief alle hulpbronne onder u sorg, insluitend fisiese en tegnologiese bates, om doeltreffendheid, verantwoordbaarheid en maksimale impak op dienslewering te verseker. Bou en handhaaf sterk verhoudings met gemeenskapsstrukture, toesigliggame, NGO's en ander gesondheidssektorvennote. Neem deel aan DDM, Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) en ander intersektorale samewerking. Verseker gereedheid van alle openbare gesondheidsfasiliteite vir oudite, inspeksies en gehaltsversekeringsassessering. Bevorder 'n positiewe organisatoriese kultuur in die distrik. Superviseer, leer en ontwikkel openbare gesondheidspanne om hoë prestasie, deurlopende verbetering en beleidvolge te verseker.

zu.title: Umntu ophethe isiFunda
zu.summary: I-District Director ekunika ubuhholo obuhlelekile ekuthunyelweni amasevisi ezempilo ESifundeni i-Uthukela Health District, idinga isiqu sezempilo kanye neminyaka emihlanu yokusebenza emazinga aphezulu okuphatha.
zu.requirements: Izindingo: Isiqu somatikuletini esingaphansi kwesikhundla seNQF level 7 kwezEmpilo; Plus idiploma noma ibanga kwi-management yezempilo noma ibanga/diploma kwi-general management. Plus A minimum of Five (5) years at a middle/senior managerial level in Public Health Care environment Plus Unendorsed valid driver’s license. Kubalulekile ukwazi kusebenzisa ikhomphyutha ngokuthanda ukuqonda ukusebenzisa i-software ye-Microsoft. Ulwazi olwengeze: Isiqu somatikuletini esingaphansi kwesikhundla seNQF level 7 kwe-Clinical Health Science; Ukwazi ukubhalisa kuleso sakhiwo esibhekene naleso ngemva kweminyaka; Ulwazi ekuqeqeshweni kwamasevisi ezempilo aqala phakathi nesistimu yezempilo yesifunda. Isiqu se-post-graduate kwi-Public Health / i-Master in Business Management. I-Project Management. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa nezidingo: Umuntu ophethe lesi sikhundla uzobika ku- Chief Director: District Health Services: Head Office futhi uzobe nomthwalo wokubeka iphuzu ekutholeni futhi ekuhlola ukubhalisa kwamasevisi ezempilo kahle kakhulu kwezinhlelo ezihlangeneyo, ezisebenzayo kanye ezisebenza kahle onke amayinga nokunakekelwa kusuka enkambisini yamasevisi ezaqala phakathi enkampanini yezempilo yesifunda se-UThukela District (okuthile okusemthethweni). Abantu abafanelekileyo badinga ukuba nalokhu okulandelayo: Bazi kahle inkinga ebiqondiswa umphakathi wezempilo ngenxa yokuswela imali, inkinga zemithombo nobuhlungu bezifo ezifana no-TB, i-HIV kanye ne-AIDS. Bakhona ukuhlaziya futhi bakuqonde ukwaziswa okuyinkimbinkimbi kokuphatha ukuze bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo ngokushesha. Bakhona ukuthuthukisa izisombululo ezingaka zona kumazinga obunzima obuphathwayo kwezempilo namanye amasevisi. Babe namandla okuhola ukuze: bakaqinisekise ukusekelwa kwezinye izikhungo zombuso nabangaphandle ukuze kufinyelelelwe izinhloso ezibalulwe kumaphulen e-Annual Performance Plan eSifundeni. Nikeza isiqondiso esihle kwiZikhungo. Phakamisa izinqubo zokwabelana imithongo kwiZikhungweni. Sakhe iqembu elisebenza ngempumelelo futhi kahle lezempilo ESifundeni futhi bakwazi ukuchaza, bethule noma bazwe inkulumo yaleso sifunda kumafora ephatha nokuqamba amaphulen oMnyango. Bakhona ukuhlola futhi balawule imigqa yamasevisi ezempilo yesifunda kanye nokuphatha abantu ngqo. Bakhona ukuxhumana kahle futhi ngempumelelo nabantu abaningi. Bakhona ukuphendula izinto ezingemihle eziye zavela ekuhloziweni kwesifunda zenze zibe nhle. Bazi kahle futhi baqonde ukufinyelelela kwezempilo kukawonke wonke. Baqonde kakuhle ubungozi kanye nanenye inqubo yokulawula bese bayisebenzisa ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi imodeli yokuphatha iMnyango iyasebenza kahle kakhulu. Bazi inqubo yokuphatha kanye nemithetho ebalulekile kweso sikhala. Bazi ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha ngokuthanda ukuqonda ukusebenzisa i-MS Office Software applications.
zu.duties: Kusuka kwimigidingo ehambisana nemikhawulo yezinqubomgomo, nikeza buhholo obuhlelekile bese uqinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, okokulawula kanye nokuhlola iNkampani yokuNikela amasevisi ezempilo eNgodini yonyaka. Phendula ngaphansi kwezinhlelo ezicwelisiwe mayelana nokunikezwa kwamasevisi ezempilo ESifundeni. Hlanganisa futhi uhlole izinqubo zokuqamba phambili izinhlelo zokunikezwa amasevisi ezempilo kanye nokwabelwa kwemithombo ezingelayo phakathi kwemifuhlakhaya yezempilo ESifundeni, nakuba kunyusa ukulingana ekunikezweni amasevisi. Lawula futhi uhlola ukunikezwa amasevisi ezempilo ngaphakathi kwesifunda, tshola izindawo ezibhekene nobungozi futhi uhlole ngokushesha ukuthathwa kwesinyathelo esilungile lapho kudingeka khona. Nikeza ukusekelwa okujwayelekile kokuhlinzwa kanye namanye amasevisi okusekela Izikhungweni. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwekhasimende elihle nelemizwa yamalungelo abantu abasebenza ngempi lo yezempilo kuzo zonke izinga. Tshola ubuvalwe bokunikezwa amasevisi ezempilo obungahlanganiswa kahle kwiZikhungo nangesabelo, futhi udloze abadinga ukungenelela ezingeni lesiFundazwe. Hlolela inqubo yokuqinisekisa ukufinyeleleka okujwayelekile kwamasevisi ezempilo (NHI) ESifundeni sezempilo i-Uthukela. Bukela futhi uhlanganise ukunikezwa amasevisi e- Emergency Medical Services (EMS) kanye ne- Forensic Pathology Services (FPS) esifundeni sonke. Sebenzisa izinqubo ezinhle zokuphatha, ukusobala, kanye nobuzwe. Gcina wonke amasevisi ezempilo emphakathini esifundeni athambele ukufinyelela nokugcina ukuhlolwa okuhlanzekile. Uxhaswe ngokunikeza ubuhholo obuhlelekile kanye noku lawula ngokupheleleyo onke amasevisi ezempilo ngaphakathi kwesifunda. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwezempilo ezingena ngekhwalithi ephezulu, elinganayo, futhi egxile kumuntu esifundeni sonke, ngokuqhuba ukuzinza, ukusebenza ngempumelelo, kanye nokuthuthuka ngokungaluleki. Lawula ngempumelelo futhi uvuselele ngokupheleleyo onke amthombo osemadolobheni wakho, okuhlanganisa izimpahla zomzimba, kanye neteknoloji, ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza ngempumelelo, ukubophezela, kanye nokuba namphumela aphezulu ekunikezweni amasevisi. Sakhi futhi ugcine ubudlelwano obusinamandla namakhasimende emphakathini, izinhlaka ezibuka iphutha, i-NGOs, kanye namanye abalingani bezinga lezempilo. Ngena kwi- DDM, i- Operation Sukuma Sakhe (OSS) kanye nanhlangano ezinye ezingaphakathi kwamayinga. Qinisekisa ukuba ukulungele ukuya kokuhlola, ukuhlolwa, kanye nokuhlolwa kwekhwalithi kwawo wonke amafasilitiwezempilo emphakathi esifundeni. Khuthaza isiko elihle le nhlangano esifundeni. Qaphela, fundisa, futhi uthuthukise iqembu lomphakathi wezempilo ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza ngamandla aphezulu, ukuthuthuka okungaluleki, kanye nokuzinza kwemikhawulo.

jobs.summary: Director role in KwaZulu-Natal Health District providing strategic leadership and oversight of district health service delivery plans.
jobs.requirements: An Undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) in Health; Plus degree or diploma in health management or Degree/Diploma in general management. Plus A minimum of five (5) years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level in Public Health Care environment Plus Unendorsed valid driver’s license. Computer literacy with proficiency in Microsoft software applications. Additional Information: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Clinical Health Science; Current registration with the relevant health professional body; Experience in primary health care and district health system. Post-graduate qualification in Public Health / Master in Business Management. Project Management. The incumbent of this post will report to the Chief Director: Ethekwini District Office: and will be responsible to ensure and account for the delivery of integrated, effective and efficient health service at all levels of care based on the Primary Health Care approach through the District Health System within Ethekwini District. The ideal candidates must: Possess a clear understanding of the challenges facing the public health sector due to poverty, resource limitations and opportunistic diseases such as TB, HIV and AIDS. Have the ability to analyse and interpret complex management data and information to inform decision-making and alignment processes timeously. Have the ability to develop innovative solutions for complex health and other service delivery management problems. Possess strong leadership to: ensure buy-in/support of other organs of state and external stakeholders to accomplish deliverables identified in the Annual Performance Plans of the District. Provide strategic direction to Institutions. Mediate processes for the allocation of resources to Institutions. Build a highly effective and efficient health service delivery team in the District; and reason/present/negotiate the case of the district at departmental management and planning fora. Have the ability to assess and manage the performance of the District Health System and directly supervise staff. Have the ability to interact effectively and efficiently with a wide range of stakeholders. Have the ability to turn around negative audit findings in the district to be a positive one. Possess a good Knowledge and understanding of universal health coverage Possess a clear understanding of risk and other management processes and the application thereof to ensure that the decentralised management model of the department is performing optimally. Possess knowledge of the governance framework and legislative imperatives set for the area of operation. Be computer literate with a proficiency in MS Office Software applications.
jobs.duties: Based on relevant policy imperatives, provide strategic leadership and ensure the development, implementation, monitoring and evaluation of an Annual District Health Services Delivery Plan. Account in terms of planned initiatives for the delivery of health services in the District. Coordinate and facilitate processes to prioritise health service delivery initiatives and the allocation of concomitant resources amongst health facilities in the District, whilst promoting service delivery equity. Monitor and evaluate health service delivery within the District, identify high risk areas and facilitate timeous corrective action where required. Provide transversal clinical support and other support services to Institutions. Ensure the development of an innovative and human rights sensitive cadre of health workers at all levels. Identify and address transversal health service delivery barriers that cannot be resolved at Institutional and district level and filter those requiring intervention for Chief Director Ethekwini District. Facilitate the process of ensuring universal health access (NHI) for Ethekwini Health District. NB//: The incumbent of this post will be required to possess the following skills: Innovation, Coordination, Human resources management, Risk Management, Monitoring and Evaluation and Financial Management skills.

'n Duidelike begrip van risiko- en ander bestuursprosesse en die toepassing daarvan besit om te verseker dat die gedesentraliseerde bestuursmodel van die departement optimaal presteer. Kennis van die bestuursraamwerk en wetgewende imperatiewe wat vir die bedryfsgebied vasgestel is, besit. Rekenaargeletterd wees met 'n vaardigheid in MS Office-sagtewaretoepassings.
af.duties: Gebaseer op tersaaklike beleidsimperatiewe, verskaf strategiese leierskap en verseker die ontwikkeling, implementering, monitering en evaluering van 'n Annual District Health Services Delivery Plan. Verantwoording doen in terme van beplande inisiatiewe vir die lewering van gesondheidsdienste in die distrik. Koördineer en fasiliteer prosesse om gesondheidsdienslewering-inisiatiewe en die toewysing van saamlopende hulpbronne onder gesondheidsfasiliteite in die distrik te prioritiseer, terwyl diensleweringsekwiteit bevorder word. Moniteer en evalueer gesondheidsdienslewering binne die distrik, identifiseer hoë risikoareas en fasiliteer tydige korrektiewe aksie waar nodig. Verskaf transversale kliniese ondersteuning en ander ondersteuningsdienste aan instellings. Verseker die ontwikkeling van 'n innoverende en menseregte-sensitiewe kader van gesondheidswerkers op alle vlakke. Identifiseer en aanspreek transversale gesondheidsdiensleweringstremmings wat nie op instellings- en distriksvlak opgelos kan word nie en filtreer die wat ingryping vir Chief Director Ethekwini District vereis. Fasiliteer die proses om universele gesondheidstoegang (NHI) vir Ethekwini Health District te verseker. NB//: Die ampdraer van hierdie pos sal vereis word om oor die volgende vaardighede te beskik: Innovasie, Koördinasie, Menslikehulpbronbestuur, Risikobestuur, Monitering en Evaluering en Finansiële bestuursvaardighede.

zu.title: uMqondisi
zu.summary: Indima yoMqondisi ESifundeni se-KwaZulu-Natal Health District ehlinzeka ngobuholo obubhekise phambili futhi ngokuqapha izinhlelo zokuletha izinsizakalo zezempilo esifundeni.
zu.requirements: Izindingo: Isifundo esingezantsi (NQF Level 7) kwezempilo; kunomqondo ongaphezulu noma isitifiketi kokuqashwa kwezempilo noma umqondo ongaphezulu/isitifiketi kokuphathwa komqondo. Okunye: Ukuqashwa okuncane kweminyaka emihlanu (5) mayelana nokuhola emazingeni aphakathi noma phezulu endaweni yokwenza izinsizakalo kwezempilo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evunyiwe. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokwazi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zekhompyutha zeMicrosoft. Imininingwane yokwengeza: Isifundo esingezantsi (NQF level 7) kwezempilo yasekhilinikhini; ukubhalisa kwamanje nomuntu ohlobene nezinsizakalo ezempilweni; Ukuqashwa ekuletheni izinsizakalo ezempilo ezingasekelwe ekuqaleni futhi esifundeni sezempilo. Isifundo esiphezulu kwezempilo zabantu / umqondo weMaster's kokuPhathwa kwezinsizakalo. ukuPhathwa kwezinhlelo. Lowo othatha isikhundla uzobika kuMengameli ohle phambili: eNdiya yase Ethekwini District: futhi uzobe nesibopho sokuqinisekisa futhi abike ngokuletha izinsizakalo ezibandakanyekayo, ezisebenzayo futhi ezikhulu ezindaweni zonke zokunakekelwa okusekelwe esikalini sekusukela ekuqaleni kwezempilo ngesifunda sezempilo ngaphakathi kwesifunda sase Ethekwini. Abantu abafanelekileyo kumele: Babe nomqondo ocacile ngemibuzo ehlangabezana nayo umkhakha wezempilo kahulumeni ngenxa yobumpofu, kwehluleka kwemithombo futhi izifo ezinjengo TB, HIV negculaza. Babe namandla okuhlola futhi bacabange imininingwane enkulu ekuphathweni ukuze baxhase izinqumo futhi balungise izinqubo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Babe namandla okuthuthukisa izixazululo ezintsha ezibhekene nezinkinga ezinkulu ezempilo noma ezinye ezinkulu ekuphathweni kokuletha izinsizakalo. Babe nobuholo obukhulu ukuze: baqinisekise ukwamukelwa/ukwesekwa kweminye imikhakha kahulumene futhi labo abangaphandle abasiza ekwenzeni izinto ezibekiwe kwizinhlela zomsebenzi ngonyaka ezifundeni.
