Nikeza isiqondiso esibhekise phambili Kumayunivesi. Bahlule imigidingo yokwabelwa kwemithombo Kumayunivesi. Akhe iqembu elisebenzayo futhi elikhulu ngokuletha izinsizakalo ezempilo ESifundeni; futhi axhumanise/bonise/qhathanise icala lesifunda ekuqashweni kohlelo kanye namafáthu ebandakanya ukucabanga Babe namandla okuhlola futhi baphathe ukusebenza kwesifunda sezempilo futhi baphathe abantu ngokuqondile. Babe namandla okuxhumana ngokusebenzayo futhi ngokukhulu nomuntu ohlukahlukeneko Babe namandla okutshintsha iziphetho ezingemihle ekuhloleni ESifundeni zibe zimihle Babe nolwazi oluhle futhi baqonde ukufikelela ezempilweni kwabanke bonke Babe nomqondo ocacile ngengozi futhi ngeminye imigidingo yokuphatha ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi indlela yokuphatha ukubandakanyeka komnyango isebenza kahle. Babe nolwazi ngohlelo lokuphatha futhi imigidingo yemithetho ebekiwe endaweni yokusebenza. Babe nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokwazi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ze-MS Office.
zu.duties: Bhekise kumigomo ehambisanayo, nikeza buhlelo bokuhola obucishe kakhulu ukuze qinisekise ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa, ukuqapha nokuhlola iNQF Level 7 yeNdlela Yokuletha Izinsizakalo Ezingangingeki Ezitholakala Njalo ngonyaka. Phendula ngaphansi kwezinhlelo eziceliwe mayelana nokuletha izinsizakalo ezempilweni ESifundeni. Hlanganisa futhi wenze izindlela zokuqamba izinhlela zokuhamba phambili ngokuletha izinsizakalo ezempilweni nokwabiwa kwemithombo efakwa kalula ezinhlelweni zezempilo ESifundeni, kuyilapho kukhuthazwa ukulingana kokuletha izinsizakalo. Qapha futhi uhlôle ukuletha izinsizakalo ezempilweni ngaphakathi kwesifunda, tshola izindawo ezingengozi eziphezulu futhi uvakashele ukuthathwa kwezinyathelo zokulungisa ngesikhathi esifanele lapho kudingeka khona. Nikeza inkxaso ebanzi yokwelapha nezinye izinsizakalo Emtakweni. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi bezempilo abayitsha futhi abanamfanelo yamalungelo abantu maqondana nezinyanga ezahlukene. Tshola futhi ulungise izithiyo ezibhokadhwe ngokuhamba phambili ekuletheni izinsizakalo ezingezwa ngqo ezingavunyelwe ukuba zixazululeke ENqulwini futhi ESifundeni futhi udlele lezo ezifuna ukungenelela koMqondo ongumengameli wokuqala wase Ethekwini District.vakashele inqubo yokwenza isiqiniseko sokutholakala kwezempilo ezibanzi (NHI) kuso Ethekwini Health District. NB//: Umuntu othatha le ndima uzodinga ukuba nalokhu okulandelayo: ukubumba izinto ezintsha, ukuhlanganisa, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuPhathwa kwengozi, ukuqapha nokuhola kanye nobu kokubamba izimali.

xh.title: Umlawuli
xh.summary: Indima kaMlawuli kwiKwaZulu-Natal Health District enika intshilo ebalulekileyo nokulawula iinkqubo zokubonelela ngeenkonzo zempilo kwesisithili.
xh.requirements: Isexesha sokufunda esingenaphulo (NQF Level 7) kwiZempilo; kunye nesidanga okanye isatifiketi kwintatho yezempilo okanye isidanga/isatifiketi kwintatho jikelele. Kunye neminye emiqulu emihlanu (5) yamavaqngamva kwizinga eliphakathi/eliphezulu lokulawula kwikondo lonke lezempilo koluntu. Ilayisense yokushayela evakalayo engenasigqibo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokuchanekileyo ngamava amaninzi kumanqaku eMicrosoft software applications. Iinkcukacha ezingaphezulu: Isexesha esingenaphulo (NQF Level 7) kwisiXeko seZempilo; uBhalo oluseleyo kunye nomzimba ohlabathayo wezempilo; amava kwinkonzo yempilo yokuqala kunye nenkqubo yezempilo yommandla. Isidanga se-*post-graduate* kwimpilo yoluntu okanye i-*Master* kwintatho yoshishino. Ukuqonda ukulawula iiprojekthi. Osebenzayo kule ndawo kuya kubika kuMlawuli oMkhulu: IOfisi yeSikeko: kwaye kuya kumfuna kuqinisekisa kuqonde nokuvela ngenxa yokubonelela ngokuhlanganisela okusebenzayo, okusebenzayo ngokuchanekileyo nangokukhawuleza iinkonzo zempilo kuzo zonke iinqanaba ezahlukeneyo zokhathalelo ezisekelwe kwindlela yokukhathalela iinkonzo eziphili ezisisiseko ngokusebenzisa inkqubo yoMmandla weZempilo ngaphakathi kweSikeko. Abantu abafanelekileyo kufuneka: Babe nocaciso olucacileyo lweengcango ebandakanya isixeko sempilo koluntu ngenxa yokuswela, imigangatho engonakalisiwa, iinkathazo ezinobungozi ezinjengeTB, HIV and AIDS. Babe namandla okwahlula nokutolikira iinkcukacha eziyinkimbinkimbi ezilawulayo nezinkcukacha ezinceda ekwenzeni izigqibo nokulungelelanisa iinkqubo ngexesha. Babe namandla okuyila iindlela ezintsha zokuqonda iinkathazo eziyinkimbinkimbi ezibangelwa kukubonelela ngeenkonzo. Babe namandla amakhulu okulawula: ukuqinisekisa ukwamkelwa/inkxaso kwezinye iindawo karhulumente namadoda angaphandle ukuba bagqibezele imigqatho eboniswe kwiNkqubo yoNyaka woMsebenzi weSikeko. Banike indlela ebalulekileyo kwiZiko. Babe namandla okulinganisa iinkqubo zokwabelwa amathuba kwiZiko. Bakhe iqela elisebenzayo ngokuchanekileyo nelisebenzayo nangokukhawuleza lokubonelela ngeenkonzo zempilo kwiSikeko; banike iinkcazelo/ziveze/ngxaxha iingxelo zesikeko kwindawo yolawulo nokulungelelanisa isebe. Babe namandla okuqonda nokulawula ukusebenza kwenkqubo yoMmandla weZempilo kuqonde nokuqonda abasebenzi ngokuthe ngqo. Babe namandla axhama ngokuchanekileyo nangokukhawuleza nabantu abaninzi abavela kwindawo. Babe namandla okujika iziphumo ezingezizo ezilungileyo zesikeko zibe ezilungileyo. Babe nolwazi oluhle kwaye baqonde ukubonelela ngokubanzi ngempilo. Babe nocaciso olucacileyo lobungozi kunye nezinye iinkqubo zolawulo nokusebenzisa ukuzisebenzisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba inkqubo yokulawula egqithiselweyo esebe iyasebenza ngokupheleleyo. Babe nolwazi lwenkqubo yolawulo nayimfuno yomthetho emiselweyo kwindawo yokusebenza. Bazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokuchanekileyo ngamava amaninzi kumanqaku eMS Office Software applications.
xh.duties: Kuxhomekeke kwiimfuno eziphathwayo zemigaqo, nikela intshilo ebalulekileyo yokulawula kuqinisekiswa ukuphuhliswa, ukusebenzisa, ukulawula nokugqiba iNkqubo yokuSebenzisa iinkonzo zeZempilo eNgangingqi yoMnyaka. Phendula ngokwemiqathango eyiliweyo malunga nokubonelela ngeenkonzo zempilo kwisiXeko. Lungelelanisa kwakhona kwaye uncinyise iinkqubo zokuqwalasela iindlela ezibalulekileyo zokubonelela ngeenkonzo zempilo nokwabiwa kwamathuba abalinganyelweyo phakathi kweziko lamaziko empilo kwisiXeko, ngelixa ixhasa ulingano lokubonelela ngeenkonzo. Lawula kuqinisekise ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zempilo ngaphakathi kwesiXeko, kuqwalaselo iindawo ezimngcipheko mkhulu uncinyisele umngeni wokungcatsha ngokuhamba kwexesha apho kufuneka khona. Bonezela inkxaso yemisebenzi yezempilo kwakunye nenkxaso ezinye iinkonzo kwiZiko. Qinisekisa ukuba kuyakhiwe iqela elinomtsalane nelithanda malunga namalungelo abantu elisebenza ngempilo kwalo lonke inqanaba. Qwalasela kwaye ulungise iibhari ezibangelwa kukubonelela ngeenkonzo eziguquguqukayo ezingalungiseki kwiziko nakumasipala, kwaza ke ezo zifuna ukungenelela zidluliselwe kuMlawuli oMkhulu weKhalaba leSikeko. Yenza ukuba kube lula inkqubookuqinisekisa ufikelelo olubanzi kwempilo (NHI) kwikhalaba leSikeko loEmpilo. NB//: Osebenzayo kule ndawo kuya kufuneka abe namakhono alandelayo: Ukuqumba, Ukulungelelanisa, Ukuqonda abantu abavela ekuhlaleni, Ukulawula ingozi, Ukulawula nokuhlonipha iingxelo kwaye uqonde iiFayili nezinto ezibalulekileyo ezingenamali.

jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 - R1 551 807 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive salary package)
jobs.summary: Lead Ladysmith Regional Hospital as CEO, managing clinical and administrative support services to ensure effective and efficient healthcare delivery.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in a clinical related field, with a valid registration with the relevant professional body, A post graduate degree/ diploma in management. 5 years of experience at senior managerial level. Unendorsed valid Code B driver’s licence (Code 08). Additional Information: Management experience at a Regional/Tertiary Hospital will be an added advantage. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: - Knowledge of relevant legislation such as National Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PMFA), Public Service Act and related regulations and policies. Core Competencies: - Strategic capability and leadership, Programme and Project Management, Financial management, Management of people and empowerment. Progress Competencies: - Service delivery innovation, knowledge management, Problem solving and analysis, Communication, Client orientation and customer focus.
jobs.duties: Job Purpose To plan, direct, co-ordinate and manage the delivery of clinical and administrative support services in an effective an efficient manner, working with the key executive management team at the hospital and within the legal and regulatory framework, and government requirements, to represent the hospital authoritatively at provincial and public forums, to provide strategic leadership to improve operational efficiency within the health establishment to improve health outcomes. Strategic Planning: Prepare a strategic plan for the Hospital to ensure that it is in line with the 10-point plan, national, provincial, regional and district plans as well as the Department’s strategies goals and Objectives. Financial Management: Ensure that adequate policies, systems and procedures are in place to enable prudent management of financial resources, financial planning, resource mobilization, including monitoring and evaluation; Ensure appropriate asset management and accountability of all assets of the institution; Identify strategic and operation risks and ensure that strategies are in place to address these, as well as monitor the progress; Maximize revenue through collection of all income due to the hospital. Facilities Management: Ensure business support and systems to promote optimal management of the institution as well as optimal service delivery, ensure that systems and procedures are in place to for infrastructure planning and timeous maintenance of facilities and its equipment. Human Resource Management: Implement and maintain human resource management policies and guidelines, systems and procedures that will ensure effective and efficient utilization of human resources; Promote a safe and healthy working environment through compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, including occupational health and safety committees; Ensure continuous development and training of personnel and implement monitoring and evaluation of performance. Procurement and Management of Equipment and Supplies: Implement a procurement and provisioning system that is fair, transparent, competitive and cost effective in terms of provincial delegated authority in line with PFMA, and Supply Chain Management prescripts; Ensure that goods and services are procured in a cost effective and timely manner; Ensure sound contract management for all contracted services. Clinical and Corporate Governance: Oversee clinical governance to ensure high standards of patient care, establish community networks and report to the Hospital Board and other relevant oversight committees/bodies; Ensure the establishment of the relevant governance structures linked to clinical and non- clinical functions and responsibilities; Manage all the institutions risks and implement strategies to ensure optimal achievement of health outcomes.
jobs.applications: Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs or submit their Z83 and CV directly to the following email address HeadOffice.HRJobapplication@kznhealth.gov.za Applicants may also visit any one of our Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) where our friendly staff will assist you with applying online or receiving your hardcopy application. You can find the list of Designated Online Application Centres (DOACS) at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs All applications should be forwarded to: The Chief Director: Human Resource Management Services, KZN Department of Health, Private Bag X9051, Pietermaritzburg, 3200 OR Hand delivered to: 330 Langalibalele Street, Natalia Building, Registry, Minus 1:1 North Tower FOR ATTENTION : Mr. A Memela
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the prescribed Application for Employment form (Z83) which must be originally signed, initialed and dated. Applications received on the incorrect Z83 will not be considered. All required information on the Z83 must be provided. Failure to complete or disclose all information will automatically disqualify the applicant. The Z83 should be accompanied by a comprehensive CV only (with detailed experience). Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by SAQA. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all foreign qualifications evaluated by SAQA and to provide proof of such evaluation (when shortlisted). Applicants: Please ensure that you submit your application before the closing date as no late applications will be considered. If you apply for more than 1 post, submit separate applications for each post that you apply for. Should you not be contacted within 3 months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. NB: For the Pre-Entry Certificate for SMS, any individual may register for the course and complete such in anticipation of wishing to apply for a SMS post in future. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by following the link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-courses/sms- pre-entry-programme/.Individuals who have completed the course already, and who are therefore in possession of a certificate are welcome to submit such, however it is not required that an applicant submit such when applying for the post prior to the closing date. However, prior to an appointment being made to any SMS post, the appointee to such a post must have completed the pre-entry certificate and must be in possession of such prior to taking up the post. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: All shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of work experience endorsed and stamped by employer/s prior to the date of the interview.

af.title: Hoof Uitvoerende Beampte
af.summary: Lay Ladysmith Regional Hospital as CEO aan, bestuur kliniese en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste om effektiewe en doeltreffende gesondheidsorglewering te verseker.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) in 'n kliniesverwante veld, met 'n geldige registrasie by die tersaaklike professionele liggaam. 'n Nagraadse graad/diploma in bestuur. 5 jaar se ervaring op senior bestuursvlak. Ongeëndorsede geldige Code B-bestuurslisensie (Code 08). Bykomende Inligting: Bestuurservaring by 'n Streeks-/Tersiêre Hospitaal sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Vereiste Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede: - Kennis van tersaaklike wetgewing soos die National Health Act, Public Finance Management Act (PMFA), Public Service Act en verwante regulasies en beleide. Kernbevoegdhede: - Strategiese vermoë en leierskap, Program- en Projektbestuur, Finansiële bestuur, Bestuur van mense en bemagtiging. Vorderingbevoegdhede: - Dienslewering-inovasie, kennisbestuur, Probleemoplossing en -ontleding, Kommunikasie, Kliëntoriëntasie en kundersfokus.
af.duties: Werkdoelwit Om die lewering van kliniese en administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste op 'n effektiewe en doeltreffende wyse te beplan, te rig, te koördineer en te bestuur, in samewerking met die sleutel-uitvoerende bestuurspan by die hospitaal en binne die regtelike en regulatoriese raamwerk en regeringsvereistes, om die hospitaal gesaghebbend by provinsiale en openbare forums te verteenwoordig, om strategiese leierskap te verskaf om operasionele doeltreffendheid binne die gesondheidsinstelling te verbeter om gesondheidsuitkomste te verbeter. Strategiese beplanning: Berei 'n strategiese plan vir die Hospitaal voor om te verseker dat dit in ooreenstemming is met die 10-punt plan, nasionale, provinsiale, streeks- en distriksplanne asook die Departement se strategiese doelwitte en Objektiewe. Finansiële Bestuur: Verseker dat voldoende beleide, stelsels en prosedures in plek is om versigtige bestuur van finansiële hulpbronne, finansiële beplanning, hulpbronmobilisering, insluitend monitering en evaluering moontlik te maak; Verseker toepaslike batebestuur en verantwoordelikheid vir alle bates van die instelling; Identifiseer strategiese en operasionele risiko's en verseker dat strategieë in plek is om dit aan te spreek, asook om die vordering te monitor; Maksimeer inkomste deur die invordering van alle inkomste wat aan die hospitaal verskuldig is. Fasiliteitebestuur: Verseker besigheidsondersteuning en stelsels om optimale bestuur van die instelling sowel as optimale dienslewering te bevorder, verseker dat stelsels en prosedures in plek is vir infrastruktuurbeplanning en tydige onderhoud van fasiliteite en toerusting. Menslikehulpbronbestuur: Implementeer en handhaaf beleide en riglyne, stelsels en prosedures vir menslikehulpbronbestuur wat effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van menslike hulpbronne sal verseker; Bevorder 'n veilige en gesonde werksomgewing deur nakoming van die Occupational Health and Safety Act, insluitend komitees vir beroepsgesondheid en -veiligheid; Verseker deurlopende ontwikkeling en opleiding van personeel en implementeer monitering en evaluering van prestasie. Aankope en Bestuur van Toerusting en Voorrade: Implementeer 'n inkoop- en voorsieningstelsel wat billik, deursigtig, mededingend en kostedoeltreffend is in terme van provinsiale gedelegeerde gesag in ooreenstemming met PFMA, en Supply Chain Management-voorskrifte; Verseker dat goedere en dienste op 'n kostedoeltreffende en tydige wyse verkry word; Verseker deeglike kontrakbestuur vir alle gekontrakteerde dienste. Kliniese en Korporatiewe Goewerance: Hou toesig oor kliniese goewerance om hoë standaarde van pasiëntsorg te verseker, vestig gemeenskapsnetwerke en rapporteer aan die Hospitaalraad en ander tersaaklike toesigkomitees/liggame; Verseker die instelling van die tersaaklike goewerance-strukture gekoppel aan kliniese en nie-kliniese funksies en verantwoordelikhede; Bestuur alle risiko's van die instelling en implementeer strategieë om optimale bereiking van gesondheidsuitkomste te verseker.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu
zu.summary: Hola i-Ladysmith Regional Hospital njengoba uyi-CEO, uphatha izinsizakalo zokwelapha nokwesekwa kolawulo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthuthwa kwezokunakekelwa kwempilo ngokusebenza kahle nangokuphumelela.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingeziwe ezingaphansi kwe-NQF level 7 kumkhakha ohlobene nokwelapha, nibe nokuqashelwa okusemthethweni komzimba ogcwele wobungcweti. I-degree noma i-diploma yasemva kwesikole ekuholweni. 5 iminyaka yemfundo ezingeni eliphezulu lobuqu. I-Code B driver's licence (Code 08) ezingavalwanga futhi esemthethweni. Ulwazi Olwengeziwe: I mfundo ekuholweni esibhedlela i-Regional/Tertiary izoba yinhlangothi ekhokha kakhulu. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa namandla ayingqalasizinda edingekayo: - Ulwazi ngemithetho ehlobene njenge-National Health Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PMFA), i-Public Service Act nemigoqa nemigomo ehlobene nayo. Amandla ayingqalasizinda abalulekile: - Ikhono lokuhola nokubeka ihlelo, ukuqeqeshwa kwezinhlelo kanye nokuqashwa kwezinkinga, ukuqashwa kwezimali, ukuqashwa kwabantu nakunika amandla. Amandla ayingqalasizinda okuqhubekayo: - Ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo, ukuqashwa kolwazi, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nencazelo, Ukuxhumana, ukuqondiswa koluntu kunokusobelela ngakwebathengi.
zu.duties: Inhloso yomsebenzi Ukucubungula, ukuhola, ukuhlanganisa nokuphatha ukuthuthwa kwezinsizakalo zokwelapha nokwesekwa kolawulo ngendlela esebenza kahle futhi iphumelela, ukusebenza nenhlangano ephansi yabaquqethe ebusweni besibhedlela kanye nangaphakathi kwesakhiwo somthetho nomgomo, kanye nezidingo zahulumende, ukumela isibhedlela ngamandla emihlanganweni yesifundazwe nasesidlangalaseni, ukunikeza iholo eliqondile ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kwemisebenzi endlini yokunakekelwa impilo ukuze kuphuculwe iziphumelele ezempilo. Ukuhlela Okuhlelekile: Hlela isu elihlelekile kusiBhedlela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi sihambisana ne-10-point plan, amasu ezwe, isifundazwe, isifunda kanye namasu nemiqondo yomnyango. ukuPhatha Izimali: Qinisekisa ukuthi kunemigomo, izinhlelo kanye nemigomo yokuqashwa okuhle ukuze kuphathwe ngobuhlakanipha izimali, ukuhlelwa kwezimali, ukuvunyelwa kwezinsizakalo, okuhlanganisa nokubuka kanye nokuqashwa; Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okufanele kwezimpahla kanye nencazelo yazo zonke izimpahla zesikhungo; Hlonza izinkinga eziyisiphephelo kanye namsebenzi, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amasu akhona ukuzixazula, kanye nokubuka inqubo ekuyona; Khulisa inzuzo ngokuqoqa yonke imali enikwe isibhedlela. ukuPhathwa kwezikhungo: Qinisekisa ukwesekwa kwebhizinisi kanye nezinhlelo ukukhuthaza ukuphathwa okuhle kakhulu kwesikhungo kanye nokuthuthwa kwezinsizakalo okuhle kakhulu, qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo kanye nemigomo ikhona ukuze kuhlelwe izingqophamkhathi kanye nokugcinwa kwesikhathi esifanele kwezikhungo nezinsiza zazo. ukuPhathwa kweZinsizakalo Zabantu: Setsha kanye nogqoza imigomo kanye nemigomo yokuqashwa kwabantu, izinhlelo kanye nemigomo ezoqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kakhulu futhi kuphumelela kwezinsizakalo zezabantu; Khuthaza indawo yokusebenza ephephile futhi enempilo ngokuqondiswa ngomthetho i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, okuhlanganisa namakomidi wezokwenzakala nokuphila emsebenzini; Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi futhi setsha ukubuka nokuhlola ukusebenza. ukuthenga kanye noKuphatha izingxenye kwozo Zinsizakalo: Setha isinhlelo yokuthenga nokuqashwa okulungele, eqondile, ekhuphisana futhi esebenza ngemali ngokwesimo sokugunyazwa yisifundazwe ngokuhambisana ne-PFMA, namagunya okuqashwa koluhlelo; Qinisekisa ukuthi impahla nezinsizakalo zithengwa ngendlela esebenza ngemali futhi ngesikhathi esifanele; Qinisekisa ukuqashwa okuhle kwemigomo yazo zonke izinsizakalo eziguquliwe. ukuLawulwa kokuHlelokwasimu nokwezimboni: Bukela ukuqashwa kwezokwelapha ukuze kuqinisekiswe izindinganiso eziphezulu zokunakekelwa kwesiguli, sasha izinkungo zendawo kanye nokubika ku-Hospital Board namakomidi/abanye abaphathi abahlobene; Qinisekisa ukumiswa kwezinhlelo zokuqashwa ezihlobene nemithelela yezokwelapha kanye naleyo ezingeyona; Phatha yonke imikhuba yesikhungo kanye nokushayela amasu okuqinisekisa ukuphumelela kakhulu kweziphumo ezimpilweni.

xh.title: I-Senior Manager Ephethe iNkonzo
xh.summary: Qhatha i-Ladysmith Regional Hospital njengoko yi-CEO, ulawule iinkonzo zokuxhasa ezenzelayo nezolawulo ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho ukunikwa kwezempilo ngokusebenzisekayo nangokuchanekileyo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-matric (NQF level 7) kwicala elidibana nezempilo, kunokugqiba esemthethweni kumzimba wezomsebenzi ochanekileyo, Isidanga/satifikethdi se-post graduate kulawulo. Iminyaka eyi-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo. Ilayisense yomqhubi we-Code B (Code 08) esemthethweni engenaziphika. Iinkcukacha ezongezelelweyo: Amava olawulo kwi-Hospital ye-Regional/Tertiary kuya kuba yinzuzo. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho namAba afunekayo: - Ulwazi ngemithetho echaseneyo njengoko kuku-National Health Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PMFA), i-Public Service Act nemigaqo-nkqubo echanekileyo. Amandla angundoqo: - Amandla okuqamba amacebo okubhekisa phambili kunye nokukhokela, ulawulo lwe-Programme ne-Project, ulawulo lweemali, ulawulo labantu nokuwabusisa. Amandla okusuka phambili: - Uqeqesho lokwenza iinkonzo ngendlela entsha, ulawulo lolwazi, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda, Unxibelelwano, ukujolisa kumthengi nokuqwalasela iimfuno zakhe.
xh.duties: Injongo yomsebenzi Ukuyila, ukulawula, ukuhambelana nokulawula ukunikwa kwezinkonzo zokuxhasa ezenzelayo nezolawulo ngendlela esebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo, ngokusebenza nethimba eliphambili lolawulo kwisibhedlele nakulawulo olusemthethweni nolulawulayo, nokuqwalasela iimfuno zahulumende, ukumela isibhedlele ngokusemthethweni kumabanga abekiweyo nakwindalo, ukunika inkokhelo ephambili yokuphucula ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwisiseko sezempilo ukuze kuphuculwe iziphumo ezibalulekileyo zezempilo. Uqeqesho lokuQamba amaCeba: Lungisa iceba elijoliswe kakhulu eliya kusibhedlele ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba lihambelana neceba elingamaphondo ali-10, namaceba angamazwe, amaphondo, iindawo nakumaphondo aphakathi kwakunye nemiqongo yamacebo e-Department. Ulawulo lweMali: Qinisekisa ukuba kukho iinkqubo zemigaqo-nkqubo, iinkqubo nendlela eziza kuvumela ulawulo olulungileyo lwemali, ukuyila amacebo eemali, ukuqokelelwa kweemali, kuquka ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela; Qinisekisa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lweempahla nokuqwalasela zonke iimpahla zesikhungo; Qaphela iingozi eziphambili nasekuqhubeni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho iindlela zokuzilawula ezo ngxaki, nakuqwalasela inkqubela; Yandisa imali egcinwe ngokuyiqokelela yonke imali efanelwe isibhedlele. Ulawulo lweZakhiwo: Qinisekisa inkxaso yoshishino nendlela eziza kukhuthaza ulawulo olufanelekileyo kwisikhungo nokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho iinkonzo ezisebenzayo, qinisekisa ukuba kukho iinkqubo nendlela zokuyila iinfrastraktha nokugcinwa kwexesha elilungileyo lezakhiwo nempahla yayo. Ulawulo lweMisebenzi yabaBantu: Zisebenzise zigcine iinkqubo zemigaqo-nkqubo nolawulo lomsebenzi wabantu, iinkqubo nendlela eziza kuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo kolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu; Khuthaza indawo yokusebenza ekhuselekileyo nempilayo ngokuzithobela umthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act, kuquka namakomiti woqeqesho nempilo yokusebenza; Qinisekisa ukuphuculwa rhoqo nokuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi kwaye usebenzise ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela kokusebenza. Ukuthenga nokuLawula impahla nokuQokelela izinto: Zisebenzise inkqubo yokuthenga nokunika iinkonzo ezilungileyo, eziqhamo kakhulu, eziqalisayo kwaye zithengisa ngeemali ezingabizi kakhulu ngokwesigqibo esinikiweyo siphakathi kwephondo ngokwemigaqo ye-PFMA, namagama e-Supply Chain Management; Qinisekisa ukuba impahla naye nkxonzo zithengwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangemali engabizi kakhulu; Qinisekisa ulawulo olungcono lwamagama onke amakhonza amanxweme. Ulawulo lweNtetho yokuSebenzela nokuBusa: Qwalasela ulawulo lwentetho yokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho iinqanaba eziphezulu zokunyanga abagula, seka iinxulunibano zommandla uze uxele i-Hospital Board nalamanye amakomiti/abakhuseli abalawulayo; Qinisekisa ukusekwa kweendlela zolawulo ezihambelana nendima nezibophelelo ezingenzelayo nangazenzekayo; Lawule zonke iingozi zesikhungo uze usebenzise iindlela eziza kuqinisekisa ukufikelela kweziphumo ezibalulekileyo zezempilo.

jobs.title: Head Clinical Department
jobs.salary_text: R2 704 842 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (excluding commuted overtime)
jobs.summary: Head the Clinical Department at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, managing clinical services for Region 1 and beyond as a Specialist Cardiologist registered with HPCSA.
jobs.requirements: Registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa as a Specialist Physician and Sub-specialist Cardiologist. FP(SA) and Cert Cardio (SA) / MMed or equivalent and/or a PhD and/or an established and demonstrated record of research experience (5 or more publications in peer reviewed journals) and /or evidence of supervision of registrars /fellows (3 or more candidates) A minimum of seven (7) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Cardiologist must include experience in clinical management as a clinical head of unit; Additional Qualification: Evidence of quality teaching and learning practice. Evidence of management and administrative skills. Computer literacy and A valid driver' s licence. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competence Required: Clinical, procedural and training skills. Counselling and conflict resolution skills. Leadership, administration, management skills, programme planning, strategic planning supported by evidence of experience in these areas. Assessment of patients within his/her field of expertise. Ability to communicate at a higher level. Ability to network with management at all levels within the Provincial structures. Knowledge and an understanding of the Public Finance Management Act and its implications for departmental budgeting. Knowledge and an understanding of the Postgraduate Education regulations and requirements as determined by the Health Professions Council of South Africa, the College of Physicians and Cardiologists of South Africa and the University of KwaZulu-Natal. A high level of knowledge of the field of Cardiology including interventional cardiology and electrophysiology.
jobs.duties: On the clinical side, incumbents will manage clinical services in an extended area of the province, which promotes the provision of clinical services for Region 1 and beyond the major metropolitan centres. The incumbent would be expected to apportion their time and energy appropriately between the major centres to develop the teaching/service platform (Durban, Pietermaritzburg, Empangeni, Stanger and Port Shepstone). The incumbent will also develop research initiatives, which focus on the enhancement of service delivery in the context of the burden of cardiac disease. The incumbent should also ensure that clinical service in Region 1 are co-ordinated and these are in line with the teaching platform of the University of Kwa-Zulu Natal. Through this, we will increase equity of service delivery, and enhance the development of our decentralised training platform in line with the needs arising from the National Development Plan. Involvement in relevant administration structures of the Department of Medicine, UKZN in coordination with the Academic Head of Department. Contribute to the co-ordination of specialist services ensuring the development and the implementation of policies and clinical protocols that will impact positively on the clinical outcomes, access to services and devolving services to distant; the monitoring and evaluation of adverse events and ensuring the implementation of plans to address these events; mortality and morbidity reviews are conducted within the institution and other hospitals in the catchment areas; cost effective approaches to clinical care. Undertake postgraduate and relevant undergraduate training, teaching and examinations in the field of Cardiology. Coordinate services and teaching with the Heads of units at the Regional hospitals in Region 1 Ensure that the environment complies with the Health and Safety Act, that staff adhere to the safety precautions and that staff welfare is maintained to attain optimal performance. Develop outreach programmes to the relevant regional hospitals in Region 1 in line with the KZN Department of Health's Outreach Programme. Develop audit tool to assess the Outreach Programme of the department and report these to Academic Head of Department of Paediatrics and Child Health.
jobs.enquiries: Professor TC Hardcastle Tel No: (031) 240 100, Ext 2389
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: An Application for Employment Form (Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the short-listed candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Departement
af.summary: staan aan die hoof van die Kliniese Departement by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, bestuur kliniese dienste vir Streek 1 en verder as 'n Spesialis-Kardioloog geregistreer by die HPCSA.
af.requirements: Registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa as 'n Spesialis-Geneesheer en Subspesialis-Kardioloog. FP(SA) en Cert Cardio (SA) / MMed of gelykwaardig en/of 'n PhD en/of 'n gevestigde en bewese rekord van navorsingservaring (5 of meer publikasies in geresenseerde tydskrifte) en/of bewys van toezig hou our registrateurs/vennote (3 of meer kandidate). 'n Minimum van sewe (7) jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kardioloog moet ervaring in kliniese bestuur as 'n kliniese hoof van 'n eenheid insluit; Bykomende Kwalifikasie: Bewys van gehalte-onderrig en leerpraktyk. Bewys van bestuurs- en administratiewe vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kliniese, prosedurale en opleidingsvaardighede. Beradings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Leierskap, administrasie, bestuursvaardighede, programbeplanning, strategiese beplanning ondersteun deur bewyse van ervaring in hierdie areas. Evaluering van pasiënte binne sy/haar vakgebied. Vermoë om op 'n hoë vlak te kommunikeer. Vermoë om met bestuur op alle vlakke binne die Provinsiale strukture te netwerk. Kennis en 'n begrip van die Public Finance Management Act en die implikasies daarvan vir departementele begroting. Kennis en 'n begrip van die Regulasies en vereistes vir Nagraadse Onderwys soos bepaal deur die Health Professions Council of South Africa, die College of Physicians and Cardiologists of South Africa en die University of KwaZulu-Natal. 'n Hoë vlak van kennis van die veld Kardiologie insluitend ingreep-kardiologie en elektrofisiologie.
af.duties: Aan die kliniese kant sal ampshouers kliniese dienste in 'n uitgebreide area van die provinsie bestuur, wat die voorsiening van kliniese dienste vir Streek 1 en verby die groot metropolitaanse sentrums bevorder. Van die ampshouer verwag word om hul tyd en energie toepaslik tussen die hoofsentrums te verdeel om die onderrig/diensplatform te ontwikkel (Durban, Pietermaritzburg, Empangeni, Stanger en Port Shepstone). Die ampshouer sal ook navorsingsinisiatiewe ontwikkel wat fokus op die verbetering van dienslewering in die konteks van die las van hartsiektes. Die ampshouer moet ook verseker dat kliniese diens in Streek 1 gekoördineer word en in lyn is met die onderrigplatform van die Universiteit van Kwa-Zulu Natal. Hierdeur sal ons die billikheid van dienslewering verhoog en die ontwikkeling van ons gedesentraliseerde opleidingsplatform verbeter in ooreenstemming met die behoeftes wat voortspruit uit die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan. Betrokkenheid by relevante administratiewe strukture van die Department of Medicine, UKZN in koördinasie met die Akademiese Hoof van Departement. Bydra tot die koördinasie van spesialisdienste wat die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleide en kliniese protokolle verseker wat 'n positiewe impak sal hê op kliniese uitkomste, toegang tot dienste en die oordra van dienste na afgeleë gebiede; die monitering en evaluering van nadelige gebeurtenisse en die versekering van die implementering van planne om hierdie gebeurtenisse aan te spreek; sterfte- en morbiditeitsondersoeke word binne die instelling en ander hospitale in die opvangsgebiede uitgevoer; kostedoeltreffende benaderings tot kliniese sorg. Onderneem nagraadse en tersaaklike voorgraadse opleiding, onderrig en eksaminering in die veld Kardiologie. Koördineer dienste en onderrig met die Hoofde van eenhede by die Streekshospitale in Streek 1. Verseker dat die omgewing aan die Wet op Gesondheid en Veiligheid voldoen, dat personeel die veiligheidsvoorsorgmaatreëls nakom en dat personeelwelsyn gehandhaaf word om optimale prestasie te bereik. Ontwikkel inloopprogramme na die tersaaklike streekshospitale in Streek 1 in ooreenstemming met die KZN Department of Health se Inloopprogram. Ontwikkel 'n oudithulpmiddel om die Inloopprogram van die departement te assesseer en rapporteer dit aan die Akademiese Hoof van Departement van Paediatrics and Child Health.

zu.title: Umhlangankulu Womnyango Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Hola Umnyango Wezokwelapha e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, uphathe izinsiza zezokwelapha ze-Region 1 nakube ngaphezu kwako njengochwepheshe we-Cardiologist obhalise kwi-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: Ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa njengochwepheshe we-Specialist Physician ne-Sub-specialist Cardiologist. I-FP(SA) ne-Cert Cardio (SA) / M-Med okuyinto efana nayo nakho noma i-PhD nakho noma isimo esiqinisekisiwe nesibonakalayo sokuhlangenwe nakho kolwazocwaningo (5 noma ngaphezulu kwezinto ezishicilelwe kwamaphepha abuyekezwa ngabalingisi) nakho noma ubufakazi bokuhlakanipha kweziqu /abahola iziqu (3 noma ngaphezulu kwabafundi). Kumele kube nokuhlangenwe nakho okuncane kweminyaka eyisikhombisa (7) ngemuva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengengcweti yezifo zentliziyo; lokhu kumele kubandakanye nokuhlangenwe nakho ekuphathweni kwezokwelapha njengenhlokana yeyunithi. Iziqu ezengeziwe: Ubufakazi bobuhle bokufundisa nokufunda. Ubufakazi bokuphathwa nezikhungo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nedrayiva elikhiphiwe ngokusemthethweni. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Nokubekezelela Okudingekayo: Amakhono ezokwelapha, okwenziwa ngezandla nokufundisa. Amakhono okweluleka nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuba ngumholi, okuphatha izikhungo, okuphatha, okuhlela amaphrogramu, okuhlela amasu okuhamba phambili axhaswe ngobufakazi bokuhlangenwe nakho kule mikhakha. Ukuhlola iziguli ngaphakathi komkhakha wolwazi lwakhe. Ikhono lokuxhumana ezzingeni eliphezulu. Ikhono lokuxhumanisa ekuphathweni kuzo zonke izinkomba ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo ze-Provincial. Ulwazi nokungokomqondo mayelana ne-Public Finance Management Act nezimpinda zayo ekwenzeni iholo lomnyango. Ulwazi nokungokomqondo mayelana nemithetho nezidingo zemfundo eyizinga eliphezulu njengokuqunjwe yi-Health Professions Council of South Africa, i-College of Physicians and Cardiologists of South Africa ne-University of KwaZulu-Natal. Ulwazi olulingene eliphezulu emkhakheni we-Cardiology okubandakanya i-interventional cardiology ne-electrophysiology.
zu.duties: Ngaseceleni ezokwelapha, ababambe isikhundla bazophatha izinsiza zezokwelapha endaweni enwetshiwe esifundazweni, okukhuthaza ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zezokwelapha ze-Region 1 nakube ngaphezu kwamasikhombiso amakhulu. Ababambe isikhundla bazolinganise isikhathi namandla abo ngendlela efanele phakathi kwamasikhombiso amakhulu ukuthi bathuthuse inkundla yokufundisa/ukukhonza (i-Durban, i-Pietermaritzburg, i-Empangeni, i-Stanger ne-Port Shepstone). Ababambe isikhundla bazobe futhi esungula izinhlelo zolwazocwaningo, ezigxila ekwenzeni izinsiza zisize kangcono ngokuya esimweni sobunzima begula ngifo senhliziyo. Ababambe isikhundla kumele baqiniseke futhi ukuthi insiza yokwelapha kwi-Region 1 ihlelwe kahle futhi lokhu kuhambisana nenkundla yokufundisa ye-University of Kwa-Zulu Natal. Ngale ndlela, sizonyusa isidingo sokulingana ekunikezweni kwezinsiza, futhi size sikhuthaze ukuthuthukiswa kwenkundla yethu yokufundisa ehambahmabayi ngokuhamba kwezidingo ezibuya kuqamba kwe-National Development Plan. Ukubandakanyeka ezakhiweni ezithintekayo zokuphathwa komnyango we-Medicine, UKZN ehlelwa ngaphandle nesikhulu esikhulu somkhakha wezokwelapha. Nikale ekuhlelweni izinsiza zochwepheshe niguqula izinqubo namaphrotokholi ezokwelapha azokube nomthelela omuhle ezinhlamvini zezokwelapha, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni nokususela izinsiza kude; ukuhlola nokubuyekeza izenzakalo ezingezinhle kuqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuze izenzakalo; ukubuyekezwa kwabasha nokugula kwenziwe ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela nakwezinye izibhedlela ezindaweni ezijwayele ukukhonza; izindlela eziholo elifanele ezokwelapha. Yenza imfundo eyizinga eliphezulu nakho okuphathelene nokufundisa nokuhlola abafundi abangakafundela iziqu emkhakheni i-Cardiology. Hlela izinsiza nokufundisa nabanhloli wezikhungo ezisesikhundleni kumaspala amakhulu ahamba phambili esifundazweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto ezikufanele zihambisana nokuqashwa komthetho we-Health and Safety Act, ngokuthi abasebenzi balandela izexwayo zokuvikela ukhuseleko futhi abasebenzi bagcineke ngokuhambisana nokutholakala ukuze kufinyelelwe kwizinga elihle lokubakhona komsebenzi. Sungula amaphrogramu okukhululeka kwabashushu kumasikhombiso amakhulu ahamba phambili esifundazweni ngokuhamba kwe-KZN Department of Health's Outreach Programme. Sungula ithuluzi lokubuyekeza i-Outreach Programme yomnyango ulule le kuye enkundleni yezokufundisa nenhloko yomnyango we-Paediatrics and Child Health.

xh.title: Umphathi weSebe lezeMigangatho
xh.summary: Ukuhola iSebe lezeMigangatho e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, ulawula iinkonzo zemigangatho ze-Region 1 nangaphezu koko njengoko nguGqirha weNgqondo othi bhadi ebhaliswe kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Ubhaliso ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa njengoGqirwa oPhambili kwiNtluphi kwaye nguGqirha oPhambili kwiNtluphi ye-Cardiologist. FP(SA) kwaye ne-Cert Cardio (SA) / MMed okanye into efanayo kwaye/noma i-PhD kwaye/norekhodi esekiweyo kwaye eboniswayo wolwazi lokuphanda (5 okuba ngaphezulu kweepapasha kumagazini abukewayo abangabo) kwaye/nomqondo wokuqeqesha abaqeqeshi /abafundi (3 okuba ngaphezulu). Kufuneka kube nobunyulu beminyaka yosixhenxe (7) ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha we-Cardiologist, kwaye kufuneka kuquke amava olawulo emigangathweni njengenhloko yemigangatho yeyunithi; IziQinisekiso eZongezelelweyo: Iimbekiso wolwazi lokufundisa nokugqiba amakhosi amaqondo. Iimbekiso wolawulo kwaye nokusingathwa kolawulo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwaye nephepha lokulawulwa elisebenzayo. Ulwazi, Amakhosi, uQeqesho, Nemigaqo eYfunekayo: Amakhosi emigangatho, yenza imigaqo yoxhobo, nokuqeqesha. Amakhosi wolalela abantu namaxhobo oqhathanisa amakhosi abakhethwe kwindima. Ulawulo, ngokusingathwa kolawulo, amakhosi oluLawulo, ulungelelwaniso lweenkqubo, ulungelelwaniso lwezicwangciso ezikumgangatho ophezulu lxhaswa ziimbekiso zamava kwezi ndawo. Ukuvakalaya abakhweli ngaphakathi kwelizwe. Ulwazi lokuthetha ngakumbi kumgangatho ophezulu. Isakhono sokuba nengxoxo nolawulo kumagangatho onke angaphakathi kweekhomiti. Ulwazi kwaye ukuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act kwaye nemithelela yayo kwimigangatho yokuhola yesebe. Ulwazi kwaye ukuqonda imigaqo yemfuno yesiGqirha sabafundi kwaye nemigaqo ye-Health Professions Council of South Africa, iKholeji yabaGqirha nabacardiologist beSouth Africa, kwaye neNyuvesi yase-KwaZulu-Natal. Ulwazi olukumgangatho ophezulu kumgcakho we-Cardiology kuquka i-interventional cardiology kwaye ne-electrophysiology.
xh.duties: Kumcelo mngangathweni, ababambe izikhundla baya kuzulawula iinkonzo zemigangatho kwizicwangciso eziqulunqwe kweliphondo, okuxhasa ukunikwa kweekonzo zemigangatho ze-Region 1 nangaphandle kweziko lezakhiwo ezinkulu zedolophu. Umntu othatha le ndima uyakuthathelwa njengomthwalo ukuba ahlengahlengise ixesha namandla akhe ngokufanelekileyo phakathi kweziko ezinkulu ukuze aqhube iziko lemfundo/inkonzo (Durban, Pietermaritzburg, Empangeni, Stanger kwaye e-Port Shepstone). Lo mntu othatha le ndima uya kuzakha iinkqubo zophando, ezijolise ekuphuculeni ukunikwa kweenkonzo kwindawo ethile yobunzima bokugula kwentliziyo. Lo mntu othatha le ndima kufuneka aqiniseke ukuba iinkonzo zemigangatho kwi-Region 1 zihlelwe ngokuhambelana kwaye ezikwindlela yokufundisa eNyuvesi yase-Kwa-Zulu Natal. Ngale ndlela, siza kwandisa ululingano lokunikwa kweenkonzo, kwaye siphucule uphuhliso lwekhompyutha esahlulahlulileyo yokufundisa ngokwemfuno evela kwi-National Development Plan. Inxulumene nalawulo olubalulekileyo lweSebe loGqirha, i-UKZN ngokuhambisana nenhloko yeSebe lemfundo ephakamileyo. Ukuxhasa ekubumbaniseni iinkonzo zabagqirha abaphambili ukuze kuqinisekiswe uphuhliso kwaye nokusebenzisa imigaqo nemithetho yemigangatho eya kuvelisa iziphumo ezilungileyo kwimigangatho yokunika iinkonzo, ukufikelela iinkonzo nokuza iinkonzo kwindawo ekude; ulawulo lweziganeko ezingezanga zilungile kwaye ukuqinisekisa ukusetbenziswa kwezicwangciso ezijolise ekulungiseni ezi ngxoxo; iingxoxo ezibekwa ngokwemigaqo yamalungu amakhosi kwaye nokungalunganga ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo nangamanye ezibhedlele kwindawo yokuzisa iinkonzo; iindlela ezimalini zokunika iinkonzo ezifanelekileyo. Ukuqeqesha abafundi abangenayo kunye nabafundi abangaphandle, ukufundisa nokuvekwa kwiindima ze-Cardiology. Ukubumbanisa iinkonzo nokufundisa neenkokheli zeeyunithi kwiibhedlele ezingammandla kwi-Region 1 Ukuqinisekisa ukuba indawo ihambelana ne-Health and Safety Act, ukuba abasebenzi balandela iindlela zokhuseleko, kwaye ukulondoloza ukhuseleko nabasebenzi ukuba kuphume iziphumo ezilungileyo. Ukwakha iinkqubo zokuza ngeenkonzo kwiibhedlele ezingammandla kwi-Region 1 ngokuhambisana neNkqubo yokunika iinkonzo ye-KZN Department of Health. Ukuqamba isixhobo sokulinganisa iNkqubo yokunika iinkonzo yesebe kwaye uchaze ezi nkqubo kwinhloko yeSebe lemfundo le-Paediatrics and Child Health.

jobs.title: Head Clinical Department
jobs.salary_text: R2 704 842 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime)
jobs.summary: Lead the clinical department at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital as a specialist surgeon with gastroenterological subspecialty registration and a strong research record.
jobs.requirements: Registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa as a Specialist Surgeon / MMed, and/or FCS (SA) or equivalent, and registration in the Sub- specialist category of Gastroenterological Surgery (Cert Gastroenterology (SA) Surg and a demonstrated record of research experience (5 or more publications in peer reviewed journals) and /or evidence of supervision of registrars /fellows (3 or more candidates)A minimum of seven (7) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Specialist Surgeon and Sub- specialist GI Surgery must include experience in clinical management as a clinical head of unit or equivalent. Additional Qualification: A PhD or equivalent. Evidence of quality teaching and learning practice. Evidence of management and administrative skills. Computer literacy AND A valid driver' s licence. Knowledge. Skills. Training and Competence Required: Clinical, procedural and training skills. Counselling and conflict resolution skills. Leadership, administration, management skills, programme planning, strategic planning supported by evidence of experience in these areas. Assessment of patients within his/her field of expertise. Ability to communicate at a higher level. Ability to network with management at all levels within the Provincial structures. Knowledge and an understanding of the Public Finance Management Act and its implications for departmental budgeting. Knowledge and an understanding of the Postgraduate Education regulations and requirements as determined by the Health Professions Council of South Africa, the College of Surgeons of South Africa and the University of KwaZulu-Natal. A high level of knowledge of the field of hepatic, colorectal or pancreatic surgery.
jobs.duties: On the clinical side, incumbents will manage clinical services in an extended area of the province, which promotes the provision of clinical services for Region 1 and beyond the major metropolitan centres. The incumbent would be expected to apportion their time and energy appropriately between the major centres to develop the teaching/service platform (Durban, Pietermaritzburg, Empangeni, Stanger and Port Shepstone) for surgery. The incumbent will also develop research initiatives, which focus on the enhancement of service delivery in the context of the burden of surgical and related gastroenterological disease. The incumbent should also ensure that clinical services in Region 1 are co-ordinated and these are in line with the teaching platform of the University of Kwa-Zulu Natal. Through this, we will increase equity of service delivery, and enhance the development of our decentralised training platform in line with the needs arising from the National Development Plan. Involvement in relevant administration structures of the School of Medicine, UKZN in coordination with the HoD Surgery and the Dean. Contribute to the co- ordination of specialist services ensuring the development and the implementation of policies and clinical protocols that will impact positively on the clinical outcomes, access to services and devolving services to distant ; the monitoring and evaluation of adverse events and ensuring the implementation of plans to address these events; mortality and morbidity reviews are conducted within the institution and other hospitals in the catchment areas; cost effective approaches to clinical care. Undertake postgraduate and relevant undergraduate training, teaching and examinations in the field of Specialised Surgery. Coordinate services and teaching with the Heads of units at the Regional hospitals in Region 1. Ensure that the environment complies with the Health and Safety Act, that staff adhere to the safety precautions and that staff welfare is maintained to attain optimal performance. Develop outreach programmes to the relevant regional hospitals in Region 1 in line with the KZN Department of Health's Outreach Programme. Develop audit tool to assess the Outreach Programme of the department and report these to Academic Head of Department of Surgery and the CEO’s office.
jobs.enquiries: Professor TC Hardcastle Tel No: (031) 240 100, Ext. 2389
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: An Application for Employment Form (Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the short listed candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Departement
af.summary: Lood die kliniese departement by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital as 'n spesialischirurg met registrasie in die gastroenterologiese subspesialiteit en 'n sterk navorserkord.
af.requirements: Registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa as 'n Specialist Surgeon / MMed, en/of FCS (SA) of gelykwaardig, en registrasie in die Sub- specialist category of Gastroenterological Surgery (Cert Gastroenterology (SA) Surg en 'n bewese rekord van navorsingservaring (5 of meer publikasies in gegrantpeerde joernale) en /of bewyse van toesig oor registrars /fellows (3 of meer kandidate). 'n Minimum van sewe (7) jaar ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Specialist Surgeon en Sub- specialist GI Surgery moet ervaring in kliniese bestuur as 'n kliniese hoof van 'n eenheid of gelykwaardig insluit. Addisionele Kwalifikasie: 'n PhD of gelykwaardig. Bewyse van gehalte-onderrig en leerpraktyk. Bewyse van bestuurs- en administratiewe vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid EN 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis. Vaardighede. Vereiste opleiding en bevoegdheid: Kliniese, proseduruele en opleidingsvaardighede. Beradings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Leierskap, administrasie, bestuursvaardighede, programbeplanning, strategiese beplanning ondersteun deur bewyse van ervaring in hierdie areas. Assessering van pasiënte binne sy/haar veld van kundigheid. Vermoë om op 'n hoër vlak te kommunikeer. Vermoë om met bestuur op alle vlakke binne die Provinsiale strukture te netwerk. Kennis en 'n begrip van die Public Finance Management Act en die implikasies daarvan vir departementele begroting. Kennis en 'n begrip van die voorskrifte en vereistes vir nagraadse onderwys soos bepaal deur die Health Professions Council of South Africa, die College of Surgeons of South Africa en die University of KwaZulu-Natal. 'n Hoë vlak van kennis van die veld van hepatiese, kolorektale of pankreaseirurgie.
af.duties: Aan die kliniese kant sal die ampsdraer kliniese dienste in 'n uitgebreide gebied van die provinsie bestuur, wat die voorsiening van kliniese dienste vir Region 1 en verby die groot metropolitaanse sentrums bevorder. Van die ampsdraer word verwag om hul tyd en energie toepaslik tussen die groot sentrums te verdeel om die onderrig/diensplatform (Durban, Pietermaritzburg, Empangeni, Stanger en Port Shepstone) vir chirurgie te ontwikkel. Die ampsdraer sal ook navorsingsinisiatiewe ontwikkel wat fokus op die verbetering van dienslewering in die konteks van die las van chirurgiese en verwante gastroenterologiese siektes. Die ampsdraer moet ook verseker dat kliniese dienste in Region 1 gekoördineer word en in ooreenstemming is met die onderrigplatform van die University of Kwa-Zulu Natal. Daardeur sal ons die billikheid van dienslewering verhoog en die ontwikkeling van ons gedesentraliseerde opleidingsplatform verbeter in ooreenstemming met die behoeftes wat voortspruit uit die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan. Betrokkenheid by relevante administratiewe strukture van die Skool vir Geneeskunde, UKZN in koördinasie met die HoD Surgery en die Dekaan. Bydrae tot die koördinasie van spesialisdienste om die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleide en kliniese protokolle te verseker wat 'n positiewe impak sal hê op die kliniese uitkomste, toegang tot dienste en die oordra van dienste na afgeleë ; die monitering en evaluering van nadelige gebeurtenisse en die versekering van die implementering van planne om hierdie gebeurtenisse aan te spreek; mortaliteits- en morbiditeitsontledings word binne die instelling en ander hospitale in die opvangsgebiede uitgevoer; koste-effektiewe benaderings tot kliniese sorg. Onderneem nagraadse en tersaaklike voorgraadse opleiding, onderrig en eksamens in die veld van Spesialisirurgie. Koördineer dienste en onderrig met die hoofde van eenhede by die Streekhospitale in Region 1. Verseker dat die omgewing voldoen aan die Wet op Gesondheid en Veiligheid, dat personeel die veiligheidsvoorsorgmaatreëls nakom en dat die welsyn van personeel gehandhaaf word om optimale prestasie te bereik. Ontwikkel uitreikprogramme na die tersaaklike streeksdistrikshospitale in Region 1 in ooreenstemming met die KZN Department of Health se Uitrekprogram. Ontwikkel 'n oudithulpmiddel om die Uitrekprogram van die departement te assesseer en rapporteer dit aan die Akademiese Hoof van die Departement Chirurgie en die CEO se kantoor.

zu.title: Umphathi Womnyango Wezokwelapha
zu.summary: Hola umnyango wezokwelapha e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital njengochibiyeli wezokuhlinza onobhalo lwesigaba esithile sokuhlinza izitho zokugaya ukudla futhi enenomlando oluwumqondo wocwaningo.
zu.requirements: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengochibiyeli wezokuhlinza / MMed, kanye/noma i-FCS (SA) noma okulinganayo, kanye nokubhaliswa kwesigaba se-Sub-specialist sokuhlinza izitho zokugaya ukudla (Cert Gastroenterology (SA) Surg kanye nomlando obonakalayo wocwaningo (5 noma ngaphezulu okushicilelwe kumaphephandaba abuyekezwe ngabanye) kanye/noma ubufakazi bokuhlola ababhalisi /abafundi (3 noma ngaphezulu abantu).Ubuncane beminyaka eyisikhombisa (7) yeminyaka yokuhlinza ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengochibiyeli wezokuhlinza kanye ne-Sub-specialist GI Surgery kufanele kuqukathe isipiliyoni ekuqondweni kwezokwelapha njengenhloko yeyunithi noma okulinganayo. Iziqu ezeduze: I-PhD noma okulinganayo. Ubufakazi bokufundisa nokufunda okunobungako. Ubufakazi bokuphatha nobuhlakani bokusebenza. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha FUTHI Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi. Amandla. Ukuqeqeshwa nokuqonda okudingekayo: Amandla ezokwelapha, zokwenza izinqubo nokufundisa. Amandla okweluleka nokuqonda izinkinga. Amandla okuba ngumholi, ukuphatha, ukulawula, ukuhlela amaphulo, ukuhlela ngokobuchwepheshe okusekelwe ngobufakazi besipiliyono kule mikhakha. Ukuhlola abagula ngaphakathi kwesigaba sakhe/sayo sokuhlakanipha. Ikhono lokuxhumana ezingeni eliphezulu. Ikhono lokuxhuma nokuphatha emazingeni onke ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo zesifundazwe. Ulwazi nokuqonda i-Public Finance Management Act kanye nesithikithina sayo ekwenzeni amabhajethi omnyango. Ulwazi nokuqonda imithetho nezidingo zemfundo ezingaphezu kwebanga njengoba kubekwe yi-HPCSA, i-College of Surgeons of South Africa kanye ne-University of KwaZulu-Natal. Izinga eliphezulu lolwazi ngemikhakha yokuhlinza isibindi, i-colorectal noma i-pancreatic.
zu.duties: Ezokwelapha, abaphathi bazobe bephatha izinsiza zokwelapha endaweni enwetshisiwe yesifundazwe, okuthuthukisa ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokwelapha i-Region 1 nangaphandle kwezikhungo ezinkulu zasemadolobheni. Abaphathi bazobe bethathwa ukuthi bahlele isikhathi nemandla abo ngendlela efanele phakathi kwezikhungo ezinkulu ukuze bathuthukise inkundla yokufundisa/nokukhonza (Durban, Pietermaritzburg, Empangeni, Stanger kanye ne-Port Shepstone) yokuhlinza. Abaphathi bazobe futhi bathuthukisa imigqudo yocwaningo, egqamisa ekuthuthukiseni ukulethwa kwenkonzo ngokwesimo esibhekene nobuhlungu beziguli ezihlobene nezitho zokugaya ukudla. Abaphathi kufanele futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izinsiza zokwelapha i-Region 1 zihlelwe kahle futhi zikulandela inkundla yokufundisa ye-University of Kwa-Zulu Natal. Ngale ndlela, sizokwazi ukwandisa ukulingana ekunikezweni kwezinsiza, futhi sithuthukise ukuthuthukiswa kwenkundla yethu yokuqeqesha ehlakahlakeni ngokwezidingo ezivela ku-National Development Plan. Ukubandakanyeka kwezakhiwo zokuphatha ezihlobene ze-School of Medicine, UKZN ngokuvumelana no-HoD Surgery kanye no-Dean. Ukufaka isandla ekuhleleni izinsiza zabachibiyeli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinqubomgomo kanye namaphrothokholu ezokwelapha azoba nomthelela omuhle ezumphumela ezokwelapha, ukufinyelela ezinsizeni kanye nokuthumela izinsiza kude; ukuqapha nokuhlola izenzakalo ezimbi futhi kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokulungisa le zenzakalo; ukubuyekezwa kokufa nokugula kwenziwa ngaphakathi kwesikhungo kanye namanye osibedela kumakhaya okwelashwa; izindlela ezibiza kakhulu ezingasiza ezokwelapha. Ukwenza ukuqeqeshwa kwemfundo ephakeme kanye nokufundisa okuhlobene nebanga elingaphansi kwesibili, ukufundisa kanye nokuhlola emkhakheni we-Specialised Surgery. Ukuhlela izinsiza nokufundisa kanye nezinhloko zeziyunithi osibedela se-Regional i-Region 1. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo ihambisana ne-Health and Safety Act, ukuthi abasebenzi balandela izindlela zokuphepha futhi ukuthi impilo yabasebenzi igcinwa ukuze kufinyelelwe emgqeni ophumelelayo. Ukuthuthukisa amaphulo okufinyelela osibedela se-Regional i-Region 1 ngokuhambisana ne-KZN Department of Health's Outreach Programme. Ukuthuthukisa ithuluzi lokuhlola ukuze kuhlolwe i-Outreach Programme yomnyango futhi kubikwe le koku-Academic Head of Department of Surgery kanye nenhloko ye-CEO.

xh.title: Umntu onobumba ngasentla kwisebe lezonyango
xh.summary: Qhubelela phambathi isebe lezonyango e Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital njengochwepheshe wokuhlinza ongumchwepheshe othile kwindawo yesifo sokugonya amathumbu, onelayisensi yokubhalisa kweso siqondisi nerekhodi eqinileyo yokuphanda.
xh.requirements: Ukubhalisa kwi Health Professional Council of South Africa njengochwepheshe wokuhlinza / i-MMed, kwayo naxa / i-FCS (SA) okanye into efanayo, nokubhalisa kwindawo yomchwepheshe othile kwi Gastroenterological Surgery (i-Cert Gastroenterology (SA) Surg nerekhodi ebonakalisiweyo yokuphanda (5 okanye ngaphezulu kwezindatshana ezibhalwe ngabaphandi abanamagama) kwayo naxa / ubungqina bokulalela abafundi abangabaphandi / abafundi abangamagosa (3 okanye ngaphezulu kwezigulane). Kufuneka kube nobugqira obungaphantsi kobunyulu be-7 (7) iminyaka emva kokubhalisa kwi HPCSA njengochwepheshe wokuhlinza kwaye kufuneka kuqikelele ukuba noluhlu lwamava kwintengiso yamava njengentloko yesebe lezonyanga okanye into efanayo. Iziqulatho ezingezantsi: I-PhD okanye into efanayo. Ubungqina bokuzilolonga kobugqirha nokufundisa. Ubungqina bokulawula nakhono lolawulo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha KWAYE ilayisensi yomqhubi egqityiweyo. Ulwazi. Khono. Uqeqesho nakhono olufunekayo: Amakhono ezonyango, amakhono okwenza iinkqubo namakhono okufundisa. Amakhono okweluleka nokuzeza iingxaki. Khono lokulawula, lolawulo, ukulawula, ukuqamba iinkqubo, ukuqamba iindlela zokuqhubela phambathi axhaswa bubungqina bomava kule minyaka. Ukuvavanya abaguli ngaphakathi kwendawo yakhe yobugqirha. Ulawulo lokunxibelelana kwinqanaba eliphezulu. Ulawulo lokudibanisa nabaphathi kumanqanaba onke ngaphakathi kwezakhiwo zePhondo. Ulwazi nokuqonda i Public Finance Management Act nemithelela yayo kumalinganiselo wemali yesebe. Ulwazi nokuqonda imigaqo nemiqathango yemfundo ephakamileyo njengoko igqitywe yi Health Professions Council of South Africa, i College of Surgeons of South Africa ne University of KwaZulu-Natal. Ulwazi oluphezulu ngendawo yokuhlinzwa esibindi, amathumbu agqithisayo okanye inkrwada ye pancreas.
xh.duties: Kumacala ezonyango, abantu abazayo baza kulawula iinkonzo zezonyango kwelona nginga lude lwephondo, nto leyo ekhuthaza ukunikela iinkonzo zezonyango kwi Region 1 nangaphaya kweziko ezinkulu zesixeko. Kulindeleke ukuba umntu ozayo abe ngumgcini wexesha namandla akhe ngokufanelekileyo phakathi kweziko ezinkulu ukuze aqhubele phambathi indawo yokufundisa / iinkonzo (Durban, Pietermaritzburg, Empangeni, Stanger ne Port Shepstone) kuhlinzwa. Umntu ozayo uza kwenza iinkqubo zophando, ezijolise ekuphuculweni kokunikela iinkonzo ngokusesikweni sezifo zokuhlinza nezinxulumene nazo. Kufuneka umntu ozayo aqiniseke ukuba iinkonzo zezonyango kwi Region 1 zihleliwe kwaye zikulandelelwano lwesikhokelo sokufundisa se University of Kwa-Zulu Natal. Ngokwalo lo ndlela, siza kwandisa ulinganiselo lokunikela iinkonzo, kwaye siphucule ukuphuhliswa kwendawo yethu yokufundisa ehlakazekileyo ngokwemfuno evela kwi National Development Plan. Ukubandakanywa kwiinkqubo zolawulo ezihlobene ne School of Medicine, UKZN ngokuvumelana ne HoD Surgery ne Dean. Qhubela phambili ukuhlelwa kwezinkonzo zochwepheshe ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphuhliswa nokusebenziswa kweenkqubo namagqabantshintshi ezonyango aza kuba nomthelela omhle kumzipho wokuphela, ukufikelela kwiinkonzo nokuqhuba iinkonzo kwindawo ekude; ulawulo loluntu nokuqwalasela iiganeko ezimbi kwaye kuqinisekiswe ukusebenzisa iinkqubo zokuzeza ezi ngqangqo; iindawo zokuphela nokugula zibhalwa ngaphakathi kwesikhululo namanxiwa amanye amaxa esibhedlele kummandla wokwamkela; iindlela ezisebenzayo ngokwexabiso ekunyangekeni. Yenza uqeqesho lomfundo ephakamileyo noluhlobene nolwangaphantsi, ukufundisa nokuhlola kwelona ndawo ihlayo lokuhlinza. Hlela iinkonzo nokufundisa neentloko zamasebe kumaxa esibhedlele angamaphondo kwi Region 1. Qinisekisa ukuba indawo ihambelana ne Health and Safety Act, ukuba basebenzi bagcina iingqwalasela zokhuseleko nokuba impilo yabasebenzi igcinelwa ukufikelela kwinqanaba elingcono lokusebenza. Yenza iinkqubo zokukhululela ezihlobene namaxa esibhedlele amaphondo kwi Region 1 ngokwemigaqo ye KZN Department of Health's Outreach Programme. Yiza nethuluzi lokuhlola ukuze kuqwalaselwe i Outreach Programme yesebe kwaye uzichazele kwi Academic Head of Department of Surgery naku CEO's office.

jobs.title: Head Clinical Department
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R2 704 842 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), excluding commuted overtime.
jobs.summary: Head the Clinical Department at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, requiring an MBChB, HPCSA registration as a Cardiothoracic Surgery specialist, and at least seven years' post-registration experience.
jobs.requirements: MBChB Degree or equivalent qualifications. Registration certificate with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Cardiothoracic Surgery and current registration. Minimum 7 years’ post- registration experience as a specialist Cardiothoracic Surgeon. Additional qualifications: PHD will be an added advantage. MMed (Cardiothoracic) or equivalent higher degree FC Cardio (SA). Experience in a tertiary/quaternary academic setting. Experience in clinical governance, service development, and academic leadership. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Expertise in the management of acute and chronic cardiac surgical and thoracic surgical conditions including emergencies and trauma. Knowledge of national and international demography, current health and public service legislation, regulation and policy, including medical ethics, epidemiology, and statistics. Strong clinical decision-making, communication, and interpersonal skills. Experience in multidisciplinary teamwork, clinical training and functioning in a quaternary hospital. Ability to teach, supervise, and mentor trainees, junior staff and allied staff. Knowledge of research principles with ability to drive academic output. Leadership, administrative, and conflict resolution skills.
jobs.duties: Lead and manage the Clinical Unit as delegated by the CEO and Medical School Dean in the following areas: Ensure high standards of clinical care, ethics, and governance. Oversee unit administration, staff performance, and service delivery. Provide specialist clinical services, including outpatient care, consultations and emergencies. Participate in after-hours consultant cover. Lead training of undergraduate and postgraduate students and allied health staff. Develop and implement clinical protocols in association with other surgical disciplines. Support clinical audit and quality assurance programmes. Promote outreach and strengthen regional cardiothoracic surgical services at secondary and tertiary level hospitals. Ensure efficient and cost-effective use of resources. Collaborate with UKZN, CMSA, health system partners and other thoracic surgical units at provincial, national and international levels. Promote and support research and academic development as delegated by the CEO aligned with the policies of UKZN and the College of Cardiothoracic Surgeons.
jobs.enquiries: Professor TC Hardcastle Tel No: (031) 240100, Ext. 2389
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: An Application for Employment Form (Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the short-listed candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Departement
af.summary: Hoed die Kliniese Departement by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, wat 'n MBChB vereis, HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Kardiothorakale Chirurgie-spesialis, en ten minste sewe jaar se post-registrasie-ervaring.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad of ekwivalente kwalifikasies. Registrasiesertifikaat met die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Kardiothorakale Chirurgie en huidige registrasie. Minimum 7 jaar se post-registrasie-ervaring as 'n spesialis Kardiothorakale Chirurg. Bykomende kwalifikasies: PHD sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. MMed (Cardiothoracic) of ekwivalente hoër graad FC Cardio (SA). Ervaring in 'n tersiêre/kwaternêre akademiese omgewing. Ervaring in kliniese bestuur, diensonwikkeling en akademiese leierskap. Kennis, Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Kundigheid in die bestuur van akute en chroniese kardiale chirurgiese en torakale chirurgiese toestande, insluitend noodgevalle en trauma. Kennis van nasionale en internasionale demografie, huidige gesondheids- en openbare dienswetgewing, regulasies en beleid, insluitend mediese etiek, epidemiologie en statistiek. Sterk kliniese besluitneming, kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Ervaring in multidissiplinêre spanwerk, kliniese opleiding en funksionering in 'n kwaternêre hospitaal. Vermoë om studente, junior personeel en verwante personeel te onderrig, toesig te hou en te begelei. Kennis van navorsingsbeginsels met vermoë om akademiese uitset te dryf. Leierskap, administratiewe en konflikbeslegtingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Lei en bestuur die Kliniese Eenheid soos gedelegeer deur die CEO en Mediese Skool Dekaan in die volgende areas: Verseker hoë standaarde van kliniese sorg, etiek en bestuur. Hou toesig oor eenheidadministrasie, personeelprestasie en dienslewering. Verskaf spesialiste kliniese dienste, insluitend buitepasientesorg, konsultasies en noodgevalle. Neem deel na-ure konsultantdienste. Lei opleiding van voorgraadse en nagraadse studente en verwante gesondheidspersoneel. Ontwikkel en implementeer kliniese protokolle in assosiasie met ander chirurgiese dissiplines. Ondersteun kliniese oudit en gehaltversekeringsprogramme. Bevraf uitreik en versterk streek kardiothorakale chirurgiese dienste by sekondêre en tersiêre vlak hospitale. Verseker doeltreffende en koste-effektiewe gebruik van hulpbronne. Werk saam met UKZN, CMSA, gesondheidsisteem vennote en ander torakale chirurgiese eenhede by provinsiale, nasionale en internasionale vlakke. Bevorder en ondersteun navorsing en akademiese ontwikkeling soos gedelegeer deur die CEO in ooreenstemming met die beleide van UKZN en die College of Cardiothoracic Surgeons.

zu.title: Umntu ophethe iClinical Department
zu.summary: Ukubusa iClinical Department e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, kudingeka i-MBChB, ukubhalisa kwa-HPCSA njengesinyathelo esiphathekayo se-Cardiothoracic Surgery, kanye nenkokhelo yeminyaka yisikhombisa ubudala ngemuva kokubhalisa.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-MBChB noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Isitifiketi sokubhalisa kwa-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengo-Medical Specialist ku-Cardiothoracic Surgery kanye nokubhalisa kwamanje. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-7 yamava ngemuva kokubhalisa njengo-specialist Cardiothoracic Surgeon. Iziqu ezingezansi: i-PHD izoba yinzuzo. I-MMed (Cardiothoracic) noma i-higher degree efanayo i-FC Cardio (SA). Amava endaweni ye-tertiary/quaternary academic. Amava ku-clinical governance, ekuthuthukisweni kwenkonzo, nakobuqhawe bemfundo. Ulwazi, Amakhono Namandla: Ukuba ngihlelo ekuphathweni kwezimo zesifo senhliziyo ne-thoracic ebugcwele nethile zesikhathi eside, okuhlanganisa izimo eziphuthumayo kanye ne-trauma. Ulwazi mayelana ne-demography yezwe nomhlaba, umthetho, imitheshwana kanye nenqubomgomo yempilo yamanxusa namasevisimphakathi yamanje, okuhlanganisa izimiso zezokwelapha, i-epidemiology, ne-statistics. Amakhono amakhulu okwenza izinqumo ze-clinical, okuxhumana, nokuhezana nabantu. Amava ekuqashweni komsebenzi we-multidisciplinary, ukuqashwa kwemfundo ye-clinical nokusebenza esibhedlela se-quaternary. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukulawula, futhi uqondise abaqeqeshi, abasebenzi abancane kanye nabasebenzi abahlobene. Ulwazi lwezimiso zocwaningo ngekhono lokuphusha okukhiphayo kwemfundo. Ubuqhawe bokuhola, okuphathwayo, kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukuhola futhi uphathe i-Clinical Unit njengokuqokwa ngu-CEO noSekela we-Medical School kule minyaka elandelayo: Qinisekisa izinga eliphezulu lenkonzo ye-clinical, izimiso, kanye nobulungiswa. Lawula izindaba zolawulo zenqamo, ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, kanye nokulethwa kwenkonzo. Nikeza izinsiza ze-clinical ezingamabhiliyoni, okuhlanganisa ukunakekelwa kwabagulelayo, izixoxo kanye nezimo eziphuthumayo. Hlanganyela ekubeni ngumhloli emva kwehora. Hola ukufundiswa kwabafundi be-undergraduate ne-postgraduate kanye nabasebenzi be-allied health. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise amaphrothokholo e-clinical ehlobene namanye amaqoqo e-surgical. Sekele uhlelo lokuhlola i-clinical kanye namaprothokholo womkhwaiko wekhwalithi. Khuthaza ukuzula futhi uqinise izinsiza ze-cardiothoracic surgical kulezi zinkambu zamazinga a-secondary ne-tertiary. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nangemali ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Sebenzisana ne-UKZN, i-CMSA, izinyanga zezempilo kanye namanye amaqoqo e-thoracic surgical emazinga abaphathi, kazwelonke namhlaba. Khuthaza futhi usekele ucwaningo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwemfundo njengoba kuqokwe ngu-CEO kuhambisana namapholisi e-UKZN kanye ne-College of Cardiothoracic Surgeons.

xh.title: Umhlekisi weSebe leZozigulana
xh.summary: Monga iSebe leZozigulana e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, kufuneka abe nge-MBChB, arekhode kwi-HPCSA njengesiganga sezokuGinya iNtlungu eNgenangomso, abe nobulumko obungazilanga ngaphantsi kweminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe yonke ukusukela kurekhodo.
xh.requirements: i-Degree ye-MBChB okanye izifundo ezilinganayo. Isatifikethi sokuBhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesiganga se-Clinical Specialist eZokuginya iNtlungu eNgenangomso nokuBhalisa okuqhubekayo. Ubulumko obungazilanga ngaphantsi kweminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe yokusuka kurekhodo njengesiganga se-Cardiothoracic Surgeon.
