Izifundo ezingezantsi: i-PHD iya kuba ngumonde. i-MMed (Cardiothoracic) okanye i-degree ephezulu elinganayo i-FC Cardio (SA). Ubulumko kwindawo yemfundo eyi-tertiary/quaternary. Ubulumko kwilungiselelo lezoxulo, ukuphuhliswa kweenkonzo, kunye nokuqhathaniswa kwemfundo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, iindidi zobuchule: Ulwazi lokulawula iimeko ezibuhlungu zokuhlola intlungu yenhliziyo zangoku nakumaxesha amade kubandakanya iziphithiphathi kunye namachapho. Ulwazi ngabantu belizwe jikelele namazwe angaphandle, ngolawulo lwempilo yokhoyo nolwaseburhulumente, i-regulation namacebo, kuquka nezigulo ezininzi, unxibelelwano olungabonakaliyo, nokuqonda ngokubala. Amandla amakhulu okuqamba iigqibo zezozigulana, unxibelelwano, namakhono okuhamba nabantu. Ubulumko kokusebenza njengeqela labantu abanemithwalo yemfundo ehlukahlukeneyo, ukulungiselela imfundo kwezozigulana nokusebenza esibhedlele se-quaternary. Amandla okufundisa, okumela, nokukhokela abafundi, abasebenzi abasha kunye nabo basebenza kwamanye amacandelo. Ulwazi ngeentsingisana zophando namandla okuzisa iziphumo zemfundo. Amandla okuba ngumhlekisi, okulawula, nokusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Qonda ulawule iClinical Unit njengoko imisiwe ngumphathi we-CEO nangumongameli wesikolo sama-Doc kule minyaka ilandelayo: Qinisekisa iizinga elingagqibekanga luluhle lokunakekelwa kwabezozigulana, iindaba zobugcisa kunye nolawulo. Yiba nomdla wokulawula i-unit, ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, kunye nokubamba iinkonzo. Nika iinkonzo zezozigulana zangqondo, kuquka ukunakekelwa kwabagula bengaphandle, iingxoxo ezithile nezibuhlungu. Thatha inxaxheba ekuvikeleni ixesha legqitha. Qhuba imfundo yabafundi abangenayo nabanegqitha lokudityaniswa kwemfundo kwezozigulana. Yila uphuhlise i-protocol zezozigulana ngokudibana namanye amacandelo okudityaniswa kobugcisa boKuhlola. Xhasa ukuqinisekisa iziphumo ezibaliweyo nokuqinisekisa isoftware. Khuthaza ukunyuka nokomeza iinkonzo zokudityaniswa kwe-cardiothoracic surgical kumazwe amabini nama-tertiary level hospitals. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okusebenzayo kakuhle kwe-R10. Hamba naye nge-UKZN, i-CMSA, abantu abavela kumazwe amabini kunye nezinye i-units evela kwamaphondo, kwilizwe kunye namazwe ngaphakathi.

jobs.city: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R2 168 145 – R2 301 186 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package) Grade 2: R2 370 74 – R2 592 273 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package) (All-inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules.) Other Benefit (S): Compulsory Commuted Overtime & Medical Aid (Optional)
jobs.summary: Head of Clinical Unit in anaesthetics at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration as a medical specialist with at least seven years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Anaesthetics plus 7 years’ experience. Grade 2: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist in Anaesthetics plus 9 years’ experience. Senior Certificate / Grade 12. Appropriate tertiary qualification in Health Sciences (MBChB or equivalent). Appropriate postgraduate qualification in Anaesthetics, e.g. FCA (SA), MMed Anaesthetics or equivalent qualification. Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthetics. Current registration with the HPCSA. Appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthetics, in accordance with the applicable grade and public service requirements. Proof of current and previous experience endorsed by the Human Resource Department. A valid driver’s licence would be an advantage. Commuted overtime participation where applicable and in accordance with service-delivery requirements. Knowledge of the relevant legislations, Policies and Standard operating procedures. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Sound knowledge and clinical expertise in Anaesthesia and Perioperative Medicine, including the assessment and management of patients requiring anaesthesia for elective and emergency procedures. Competence in the provision of safe general, regional and appropriate anaesthetic techniques, including airway management, resuscitation and perioperative patient care. Competence in the assessment and management of critically ill and high-risk patients and the ability to provide appropriate anaesthetic support in emergency and critical care situations. Sound knowledge of anaesthetic drugs, equipment, monitoring systems, patient safety principles and relevant clinical guidelines and protocols. Strong clinical decision-making, analytical, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, particularly in emergency, high-risk and high-volume clinical environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with patients, families, clinicians and members of the multidisciplinary healthcare team. Good leadership, supervisory, mentoring and team-management skills, with the ability to lead and support the Anaesthesia clinical team. Ability to coordinate and manage the provision of anaesthetic services and ensure effective utilisation of available human and material resources. Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams, including Surgery, Emergency Department, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Orthopaedics, Critical Care and other relevant clinical services. Computer literacy and ability to utilise relevant electronic clinical information systems. Ability to participate in clinical governance, quality assurance, clinical audits, morbidity and mortality reviews, incident reporting, risk management and quality-improvement initiatives. Ability to provide teaching, training, supervision and mentorship to Medical Officers, Registrars, interns, students and other healthcare professionals. Ability to contribute to undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, research, continuing professional development and service improvement. Ability to manage workload effectively and function independently and under pressure, including participation in after-hours, weekend and public holiday services. Ability to develop, implement and monitor clinical protocols, standard operating procedures and quality standards within the Anaesthesia service. Commitment to providing safe, ethical, patient- centred and evidence-based anaesthetic and perioperative services.
jobs.duties: Provide and oversee comprehensive, safe and quality anaesthetic and perioperative services to patients undergoing elective and emergency procedures. Ensure appropriate pre-operative assessment, intra-operative anaesthetic management and post-operative care of patients, including high- risk and critically ill patients. Provide specialist clinical leadership and ensure effective coordination and functioning of the Anaesthesia clinical unit. Participate in emergency, after-hours, weekend and public holiday anaesthetic services as required by the institution. Ensure appropriate management of airway emergencies, resuscitation and other anaesthetic-related emergencies. Promote adherence to clinical guidelines, anaesthetic protocols, patient safety standards and relevant professional and institutional policies. Participate in clinical governance activities, including clinical audits, morbidity and mortality reviews, quality assurance, risk management, incident reporting and implementation of quality-improvement initiatives. Monitor and improve the quality, efficiency and turnaround time of anaesthetic services in support of theatre and emergency service delivery. Promote effective multidisciplinary collaboration with surgical, obstetric, orthopaedic, emergency, critical care and other clinical services. Provide teaching, training, supervision and mentorship to Registrars, Medical Officers, interns, students and other healthcare professionals. Participate in undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, continuing professional development, academic activities and research. Develop, implement, review and monitor departmental policies, guidelines, protocols and standard operating procedures. Ensure appropriate utilisation, availability and maintenance of anaesthetic equipment, medicines, consumables and other departmental resources. Participate in service planning, monitoring and evaluation and identify areas requiring improvement in the provision of anaesthetic services. Contribute to the development of critical care, resuscitation and perioperative services in accordance with the level of care provided by the institution. Participate in outreach and support services to referring facilities, where required. Ensure accurate clinical documentation, record keeping and reporting within the Anaesthesia service. Participate in departmental, institutional and relevant clinical governance meetings and committees. Manage and utilise human, financial, equipment and other resources responsibly and contribute to the identification of service and infrastructure needs. Maintain professional competence and comply with the requirements of the Health Professions Council of South Africa and relevant Department of Health policies, legislation and regulations. Perform administrative and other duties as delegated by the relevant supervisor.

af.title: Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid Graad 1 en 2
af.summary: Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid in narkose by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n mediese spesialis met ten minste sewe jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Narkose toelaat plus 7 jaar se ervaring. Graad 2: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis in Narkose toelaat plus 9 jaar se ervaring. Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12. Toepaslike tersiêre kwalifikasie in Gesondheidswetenskappe (MBChB of gelykwaardig). Toepaslike nagraadse kwalifikasie in Narkose, bv. FCA (SA), MMed Narkose of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Narkose. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA. Toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Narkose, in ooreenstemming met die toepaslike graad en openbare diensvereistes. Bewys van huidige en vorige ervaring wat deur die Menslike Hulpbrondepartement onderskryf is. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal 'n voordeel wees. Deelname aan pendeloortyd waar toepaslik en in ooreenstemming met diensleweringvereistes. Kennis van die relevante wetgewing, beleide en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Deeglike kennis en kliniese kundigheid in Narkose en Peri-operatiewe Geneeskunde, insluitend die assessering en bestuur van pasiënte wat narkose vir elektiewe en noodgevalprosedures benodig. Bevoegdheid in die verskaffing van veilige algemene, regionale en toepaslike narkosetegnieke, insluitend lugwegbestuur, reanimasie en peri-operatiewe pasiëntsorg. Bevoegdheid in die assessering en bestuur van krities siek en hoë-risiko pasiënte en die vermoë om toepaslike narkoseondersteuning in noodgeval- en kritieke sorgsituasies te verskaf. Deeglike kennis van narkosemiddels, toerusting, moniteringstelsels, pasiëntveiligheidsbeginsels en relevante kliniese riglyne en protokolle. Sterke kliniese besluitneming, analitiese, probleemoplossings- en prioriteitsvaardighede, veral in noodgeval-, hoë-risiko- en hoë-volume kliniese omgewings. Uitstekende skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, met die vermoë om doeltreffend met pasiënte, gesinne, klinici en lede van die multidissiplinêre gesondheidsorgspan te kommunikeer. Goeie leierskap-, toesig-, mentorskaps- en spanbestuursvaardighede, met die vermoë om die Narkose kliniese span te lei en te ondersteun. Vermoë om die verskaffing van narkosedienste te koördineer en te bestuur en om doeltreffende benutting van beskikbare menslike en materiaalhulpbronne te verseker. Vermoë om doeltreffend binne multidissiplinêre spanne te werk, insluitend Chirurgie, Noodgevalafdeling, Verloskunde en Ginekologie, Ortopedie, Kritieke Sorg en ander relevante kliniese dienste. Rekenaarvaardigheid en vermoë om relevante elektroniese kliniese inligtingstelsels te benut. Vermoë om aan kliniese bestuur, gehalteversekering, kliniese oudits, morbiditeits- en mortaliteits hersienings, voorvalrapportering, risikobestuur en gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe deel te neem. Vermoë om onderrig, opleiding, toesig en mentorskap aan Mediese Amptenare, Registrateurs, internes, studente en ander gesondheidsorgprofessionals te verskaf. Vermoë om by te dra tot voorgraadse en nagraadse onderrig, navorsing, voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling en diensverbetering. Vermoë om werklading doeltreffend te bestuur en onafhanklik en onder druk te funksioneer, insluitend deelname aan buite-kantoorure, naweek- en openbare vakansiedienste. Vermoë om kliniese protokolle, standaard bedryfsprosedures en gehaltestandaarde binne die Narkosediens te ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor. Toewyding aan die verskaffing van veilige, etiese, pasiëntgesentrede en bewysgebaseerde narkose- en peri-operatiewe dienste.
af.duties: Verskaf en oorsien omvattende, veilige en gehaltenarkose- en peri-operatiewe dienste aan pasiënte wat elektiewe en noodgevalprosedures ondergaan. Verseker toepaslike pre-operatiewe assessering, intra-operatiewe narkosebestuur en post-operatiewe sorg van pasiënte, insluitend hoë-risiko en krities siek pasiënte. Verskaf spesialistiese kliniese leierskap en verseker doeltreffende koördinering en funksionering van die Narkose kliniese eenheid. Neem deel aan noodgeval-, buite-kantoorure, naweek- en openbare vakansie narkosedienste soos deur die instelling vereis. Verseker toepaslike bestuur van lugwegnoodgevalle, reanimasie en ander narkoseverwante noodgevalle. Bevold nakoming van kliniese riglyne, narkoseprotokolle, pasiëntveiligheidsstandaarde en relevante professionele en instellingsbeleide. Neem deel aan kliniese bestuursaktiwiteite, insluitend kliniese oudits, morbiditeits- en mortaliteits hersienings, gehalteversekering, risikobestuur, voorvalrapportering en implementering van gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Monitor en verbeter die gehalte, doeltreffendheid en omlooptyd van narkosedienste ter ondersteuning van teater- en noodgevaldienslewering. Bevorder doeltreffende multidissiplinêre samewerking met chirurgiese, verloskundige, ortopediese, noodgeval-, kritieke sorg- en ander kliniese dienste. Verskaf onderrig, opleiding, toesig en mentorskap aan Registrateurs, Mediese Amptenare, internes, studente en ander gesondheidsorgprofessionals. Neem deel aan voorgraadse en nagraadse onderrig, voortgesette professionele ontwikkeling, akademiese aktiwiteite en navorsing. Ontwikkel, implementeer, hersien en monitor departementele beleide, riglyne, protokolle en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Verseker toepaslike benutting, beskikbaarheid en onderhoud van narkosetoerusting, medisyne, verbruiksgoedere en ander departementele hulpbronne. Neem deel aan diensbeplanning, monitering en evaluering en identifiseer areas wat verbetering benodig in die verskaffing van narkosedienste. Dra by tot die ontwikkeling van kritieke sorg-, reanimasie- en peri-operatiewe dienste in ooreenstemming met die vlak van sorg deur die instelling verskaf. Neem deel aan uitreik- en ondersteuningsdienste na verwysende fasiliteite, waar vereis. Verseker akkurate kliniese dokumentasie, rekordhouding en verslagdoening binne die Narkosediens. Neem deel aan departementele, instellings- en relevante kliniese bestuursvergaderings en komitees. Bestuur en benut menslike, finansiële, toerusting- en ander hulpbronne verantwoordelik en dra by tot die identifisering van diens- en infrastruktuurbehoeftes. Onderhou professionele bevoegdheid en voldoen aan die vereistes van die Health Professions Council of South Africa en relevante Department of Health beleide, wetgewing en regulasies. Voer administratiewe en ander pligte uit soos deur die relevante toesighouer gedelegeer.

zu.summary: Umphathi weyunithi yezokwelapha kwezokwelapha ngamakhondomisi e-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital, ofuna ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengongoti wezokwelapha ongamakhondomisi ohlalomunye onosuku olungu-7 lokuqeqeshwa.
zu.requirements: Isigaba 1: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengongoti wezokwelapha kwezokwelapha ngamakhondomisi ohlalomunye oneminyaka engu-7 yokuqeqeshwa. Isigaba 2: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengongoti wezokwelapha kwezokwelapha ngamakhondomisi ohlalomunye oneminyaka engu-9 yokuqeqeshwa. Isitifiketi somculo / Isigaba 12. Izifundo ezifanele zemfundo ephakeme kwezEzemculo (MBChB noma okufanayo). Izifundo ze-masters ezifanele kwezokwelapha ngamakhondomisi, isb. FCA (SA), MMed Anaesthetics noma izifundo ezifanayo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengongoti wezokwelapha kwezokwelapha ngamakhondomisi. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ku-HPCSA. Uqeqesho olufanele njengongoti wezokwelapha kwezokwelapha ngamakhondomisi, ngokuvumelana nesigaba esifanele nemfuno yesevisi kahulumeni. Isibonakaliso soqeqesho lwamanje nokudlule esiqiniselwe ngumnyango wezinsizakalo zomuntu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evula amathonya iyothi ibe yinzuzo. Ukubamba iqhaza kwikhondomusi yokusebenza ngemva kwamasikhathi lapho kufanele khona futhi ngokuvumelana nemfuno yokulethwa kwezinsizakalo. ulwazi ngemithetho, amapholisi namaSOP ahlobene. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqeshe nokuzikhandela okudingekayo: Ulwazi olujulile nenzobomfihlo yezokwelapha ngamakhondomisi kanye nezokwelapha kwesikhathi esingaphambi kokuhlinzwa, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola futhi uphathe abagula abadinga amakhondomisi okuhlinzwa okuhleliwe nezimo eziphuthumayo. Ukuzikhandela ekunikeni amakhondomisi ajulile, ajwayelekile nafanele, okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa kwendlela yokuphefumula, ukuvuswa kwesifo sofuzo futhi uphathe umguli esikhathi esingaphambi kokuhlinzwa. Ukuzikhandela ekuhokeni futhi kuphathe abagula abakhulu futhi abasesengotini futhi ukubonisa ukuzikhandela ekunikeleni ngenkambu yamakhondomisi ezimweni eziphuthumayo nasokuhlengwa okuphuthumayo. Ulwazi olujulile ngemithi yamakhondomisi, emishini yokuqapha, imigomo yokuvikela umguli futhi ngemithetho yezokwelapha. Ukuzibophezela ekwenzeni izinqumo eziyinhloko, ukuhlola, ukuxazulula izinkinga futhi uhlele izinto eziyinhloko, ikakhulu ezimweni eziphuthumayo, ezisesengotini futhi ezinomthamo omkhulu wokusebenza. Amakhono okuxhumana okushokiwe nesidalwa, nokuba nokwazi ukuxhumana kahle nomguli, nosapho, nabakhiqizi kanye nalabo abayingxenye yeqembu lokwelapha. Amakhono okube nomthelela ekubukeni kanye nokuphathwa kweqembu kanye nokuqondisa futhi useke iqembu le-Anaesthetics. Ukuzikhandela ekubukeni kanye nokuphathwa kokunikezwa kwamakhondomisi kanye nokwenza isiqiniseko sokusetshenziswa kabi noma okufanele kwezinsizakalo ezitholakalayo. Ukuzikhandela ekubukeni kwezinhlelo zekhompyutha kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa izinhlela zekhompyutha eziyinhloko. Ukuzikhandela ekubukeni kwezindinganiso zezokwelapha, ukwenza imibiko yezokwelapha, ukuhlola izifo, ukwenza imibiko yezinkinga, ukuqapha kwezinsizakalo kanye nokuphuculwa kwezinto ezithinteka nomuntu. Ukuzikhandela ekunikezeni nokuqeqesha, ukuphathwa kanye nokukhuthaza abantu ukuba baqeqeshe, babhekane nemisebenzi yamakhondomisi. zu.duties: Nikela futhi ubheke izinsizakalo zamakhondomisi ezijulile, ezivikela umguli futhi zinhle kubagula abayokwenza imisebenzi yesikhashana nezimo eziphuthumayo. Thatha inxaxheba ekwelapheni, ekuqapheni kanye nokubuyekezwa futhi uqaphe izindawo ezidinga ukuphuculwa ekunikeleni ngezinsizakazo zamakhondomisi. Thatha inxaxheba kwicwangciso lenkonzo, ukuqaphela nokulinganisa ukusetyenziswa kwezinto ezingangqwalwa ngenxa yokwenza iinkonzo ze-anesthesia. Nikela ekuyileni amacandelo okukhusela kakhulu, ukuvusa umzimba wabaguli kunye nokukhathalela abaguli ngokusesikweni nangokwebeki lokukhusela okunikwa zisikhululo. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkonzo yokunika isikhokelo nokuxhasa iindawo ezingafumani ngokusesikweni, apho kuyimfuno khona. Qinisekisa ukuqondwa ngokusesikweni ngeempawu ezingagqithiswanga, ukugcina iingxelo nokubika ngaphakathi kwinkonzo ye-anesthesia. Thatha inxaxheba kwimilinganiselo yesebe, yezikhululo kunye namagatya aphakamileyo okuqonda kwezicwangciso nakwabakhusela. Lawula kwaye usebenzise ngokufanelekileyo izixhobo, imali, nemithi yokugqithisa ngenkxaso yokusetyenziswa kwemithi yokugqithisa nokuba nexesha lokuba nexesha lokuqonda izidingo. Gcina ukuzithoba ekusebenzela ngokusesikweni kwaye uzithobe ngokwemigaqo ye-HPCSA namagqabantshintsi weMithetho, imigaqo yesebe leMithetho. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo nabanye abakuthunyelweyo.

jobs.title: Head Clinical Unit (INTERNAL Medicine)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R2 168 145 – R2 301 186 per annum Grade 2: R2 370 741 – R2 592 273 per annum The all-inclusive package consists of 70% basic salary and 30% flexible portion that may be structured in terms of the applicable rules, 18% inhospitable of basic salary plus fixed commuted overtime.
jobs.summary: Lead the internal medicine clinical unit at Madadeni Provincial Hospital, providing specialist medical services and ensuring clinical governance.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate qualification in the appropriate Health Science (MBCHB). PLUS, Current registration with the Health Professionals Council of South Africa as a Specialist in the category of Internal Medicine. Plus At least Five (5) years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with HPCSA as a medical specialist in the category of Internal Medicine. Knowledge, Skills and competencies required. Knowledge of appropriate specialist procedures and protocols within the field of expertise. Knowledge of legislative prescripts governing the public service. Human resources management, financial management and general administrative skills. Control of budget, monitoring expenditure and project management. Computer literacy in MS Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Report writing, presentation and teaching skills. Strategic capability and leadership skills. Problem solving, project management and change management. Concerns for excellency, courtesy and interpersonal skills. Awareness of cross-cultural differences.
jobs.duties: Render efficient and cost-effective internal medicine services to patients managed by Madadeni Hospital and its drainage sites. Strengthen and ensure continuous clinical governance for internal medicine services within the area of jurisdiction. Ensure the rational use of resources (including laboratory investigations, medication, consumables and equipment). Deliver effective and efficient administration of the Internal Medicine Department. Plan and partake in the training of staff including Nurses, Clinical Support Personnel, Medical Officers, Interns and undergraduate Medical Students and also support relevant clinical research, clinical trials and CPD activities. Develop regional services within the field of Internal Medicine and improve the functioning of renal services. Provide clinicians with expert advice and opinion to aid diagnosis, management and treatment of patients. Conduct out-patient specialist clinics and in-patient and provide expert opinion where required. Ensure provisioning of a 24-hour service in Internal Medicine. Provide vision, strategic direction and inspire employees to deliver excellent, quality health services. Manage the performance of allocated human resources. Ensure that working environment complies with Health and Safety Act, staff adheres to the safety precautions and that staff is maintained to attain optimal productivity. Formulate and manage protocols in accordance with Department of Health policies that will have a positive impact on staff and ensure that staff is aware and adhere to protocols. Compile medium- and long-term expenditure framework and implement fiscal control measures on an ongoing basis. Provide measures and guidance on quality assurance to comply with set quality standards. Generate reports, plans, presentations, and perform other administrative duties attached to this position. Strengthen partnership with relevant stakeholders i.e. Tertiary hospitals i.e. Greys, IALCH, Referral Hospitals, Community members, etc. Liaison with the relevant Chief Specialist regarding service development. Improve management of referrals. Maintain clinical, professional and ethical standards. Manage EPMDS of the Internal Medicine department. ENQURIES : Dr. X.F Nene Tel No: (034) 328 8007

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Eenheid (Interne Geneeskunde)
af.summary: Lei die kliniese eenheid vir interne geneeskunde by Madadeni Provinsiale Hospitaal, verskaf spesialis mediese dienste en verseker kliniese bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Geskikte kwalifikasie in die toepaslike Gesondheidswetenskap (MBCHB). PLUS, huidige registrasie by die Health Professionals Council of South Africa as 'n Spesialis in die kategorie Interne Geneeskunde. Plus Ten minste vyf (5) jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n mediese spesialis in die kategorie Interne Geneeskunde. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede benodig. Kennis van toepaslike spesialisprosedures en protokolle binne die veld van kundigheid. Kennis van wetgewende voorskrifte wat die openbare diens regeer. Menslike hulpbronbestuur, finansiële bestuur en algemene administratiewe vaardighede. Beheer van begroting, monitering van uitgawes en projekbestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Outlook, Excel, Word en PowerPoint. Verslagdoening, aanbieding en onderrigvaardighede. Strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing, projekbestuur en veranderingbestuur. Bekommernis vir uitnemendheid, hoflikheid en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Bewustheid van kruiskulturele verskille.
af.duties: Lewer doeltreffende en koste-effektiewe interne geneeskunde dienste aan pasiënte wat deur Madadeni Hospitaal en sy dreineringsgebiede bestuur word. Versterk en verseker deurlopende kliniese bestuur vir interne geneeskunde dienste binne die regsgebied. Verseker die rasionele gebruik van hulpbronne (insluitend laboratoriumondersoeke, medikasie, verbruiksgoedere en toerusting). Lewer effektiewe en doeltreffende administrasie van die Interne Geneeskunde Departement. Beplan en neem deel aan die opleiding van personeel insluitend Verpleegkundiges, Kliniese Ondersteuningspersoneel, Mediese Beamptes, Interns en voorgraadse Mediese Studente en ondersteun ook toepaslike kliniese navorsing, kliniese proewe en VGO-aktiwiteite. Ontwikkel streekdienste binne die veld van Interne Geneeskunde en verbeter die funksionering van niereiensdienste. Verskaf klinici met kundige advies en mening om diagnose, bestuur en behandeling van pasiënte te help. Voer buitepasient spesialisklinieke en binnepasiente uit en verskaf kundige mening waar nodig. Versesterk die voorsiening van 'n 24-uur diens in Interne Geneeskunde. Verskaf visie, strategiese rigting en inspireer werknemers om uitstekende, gehalte gesondheidsdienste te lewer. Bestuur die prestasie van toegekende menslike hulpbronne. Verseker dat die werksomgewing voldoen aan die Wet op Gesondheid en Veiligheid, personeel voldoen aan die veiligheidsvoorsorgmaatreëls en dat personeel gehandhaaf word om optimale produktiwiteit te bereik. Formuleer en bestuur protokolle in ooreenstemming met Departement van Gesondheid beleide wat 'n positiewe impak op personeel sal hê en verseker dat personeel bewus is en aan protokolle voldoen. Stel medium- en langtermyn uitgaweraamwerk op en implementeer fiskale beheermaatreëls op 'n deurlopende basis. Verskaf maatreëls en leiding oor gehaltversekering om aan vasgestelde gehaltstandaarde te voldoen. Genereer verslae, planne, aanbiedings en voer ander administratiewe pligte uit wat aan hierdie pos gekoppel is. Versterk vennootskap met toepaslike belanghebbendes d.w.s. Tersiêre hospitale d.w.s. Greys, IALCH, Verwysingshospitale, Gemeenskapslede, ens. Skakeling met die toepaslike Hoofspesialis rakende diensontwikkeling. Verbeter bestuur van verwysings. Handhaaf kliniese, professionele en etiese standaarde. Bestuur EPMDS van die Interne Geneeskunde departement. Navrae: Dr. X.F Nene Tel No: (034) 328 8007

zu.title: Umphathi Womnyango Wezokwelapha (INTERNAL Medicine)
zu.summary: Holela umnyango wezokwelapha wongaphakathi eMadadeni Provincial Hospital, unikeza izinsiza ezingodokotela bazisebenzise futhi uqinisekise ulawulo lwezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezifanele kulezi Zesayensi Yezempilo (MBCHB). FUTHI, ubhaliswe njengamanje kwi-Health Professionals Council of South Africa njengongodokotela ohlose ikhathi elithile kwihlelo le-Internal Medicine. Futhi ube nobuhle obungangeni ngaphansi kweminyaka emihlanu (5) usebenza njengongodokotela ohlose ikhathi elithile emkhakheni we-Internal Medicine emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla akingwayo. Ulwazi ngemiyalo nemigomo yongodokotela ohlose ikhathi elithile ngaphakathi komkhakha wakho. Ulwazi ngemithetho elawula imapulikhimpende. Amakhono okulawula abantu, okuphatha imali namakhono okubhekana nezinto ezijwayele ukwenziwa. Lawula imali, qaphela okushithe kakhulu uphinde ulawule imisebenzi ekhokhelwayo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ku-MS Outlook, Excel, Word kanye ne-PowerPoint. Ukukwazi ukubhala imibiko, ukukhuluma phambi kwabantu nokufundisa. Amakhono okubonisa indlela nokuba ngumholi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha imisebenzi nokulawula inguquko. Ukukhathazeka ngokwenza okuhle, ukuziphatha kahle kanye namakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ukuba nokuzazi ngezinkohliso zamasiko ahlukene.
zu.duties: Nikeza izinsiza ezibamba kakhulu futhi ezingabizi kakhulu zongaphakathi kwabesilisa nabesifazane abaphathwa i-Madadeni Hospital namanye amasibaya ayo. Qinisa uqinisekise ulawulo oluqhubekayo lwezokwelapha zongaphakathi ngaphakathi kwendawo ozayo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ngokuhlakanipha (okuhlanganisa ucwaningo lwelebhu, imithi, okusetshenziswa kanye nezinsiza). Yenza ukuphathwa okusebenza kahle kwaye kubamba kakhulu komnyango we-Internal Medicine. Hlela uphinde uthathe inxaxhebe ekufundeni abasebenzi kuhlanganise odadewethu, abantu abasiza ekwelapheni, odokotela, abafundi kanye nabafundi baseyunivesithi abafunda ukuba odokotela futhi uphinde useke ucwaningo oluhlobene nokwelapha, izilingo zokwelapha namasebenzi e-CPD. Yenza amasevisi asebantwini emkhakheni we-Internal Medicine uthuthukise ukusebenza kwamasevisi ekuthambaneni. Nikeza odokotela ingcebiso nombono wobuhlakani ukuze basize ekutholweni isifo, ekuphathweni nasekuphathweni kwesifo. Yenza amakliniki odokotela abasiza abaphathekayo ngaphandle kwesibhedlela nalabo basengozini baphathekwa ngaphakathi uphinde unikeze umbono wakho noma udaba lapho kudingeka khona. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwesevisi yamahora angu-24 kwi-Internal Medicine. Nikeza umbono, qondisa ngomumo othile uphinde wakhize abasebenzi ukuthi bakunikeze izinsiza ezinhle, ezinhle kakhulu zezempilo. Lawula ukwenza kwabantu ababelwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokusebenza ihambisana nomthetho we-Health and Safety Act, abasebenzi balandela iziqondiso zokuphepha futhi abasebenzi bagcinwe besephumeleleni ukugcina amandla okusebenza kahle. Yakha ulawule imigobo ngokuya ngemigomo yomnyango we-Health okuzoba nomthelela omuhle kubasebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi abasebenzi bayazi futhi bayilandela imigomo. Hlela umumo wokuhela imali wesikhathi esiphakathi nesisemuhla uphinde uqale amasu okulawula imali ngokuqhubekayo. Nikeza amasu alawula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi konke kwenziwa kahle ukuze kuhambisane namazinga okukhiqiza amahle. Yenza imibiko, amaphulani, izikhulumi, futhi wenze eminye imisebenzi yokuphatha edwetshwe kulesi sikhundla. Qinisa ubudlelwano nabahlanganyeli abahlobene i.e. Tertiary hospitals i.e. Greys, IALCH, Referral Hospitals, Community members, etc. Xhuma noChief Specialist ohlobene ngesikhathi ngokuqhubekiswa kwamasevisi. Yenza kakhulu ukuphatha abayathunyelwa. Gcina amazinga okukhiqiza okuhle, obuhlakani nezobuciko. Lawula i-EPMDS yomnyango we-Internal Medicine. ENQURIES : Dr. X.F Nene Tel No: (034) 328 8007

xh.title: Umntu Ophethe Isebe Lezempilo (INTERNAL Medicine)
xh.summary: Qhubele inqanaba lezempilo le internal medicine kwi-Madadeni Provincial Hospital, nikeza iinkonzo zezempilo ezikumgangatho ophezulu uze uqiniseke ulawulo lwezempilo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo kwi-Health Science (MBCHB). KWANGALO, Ugqibo lokubhalisa kwi-Health Professionals Council of South Africa njengesiganga kwelinye le internal medicine. KWANGALO Ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava afanelekileyo njengesiganga sokugqibela emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesiganga kwelinye le internal medicine. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla afunekayo. Ulwazi ngeendlela zamaganga namacebo afanelekileyo kwindawo ochukuze kuyo. Ulwazi ngemithetho elawula inkonzo kawonke-wonke. Ulawulabantu, ulawulo lwemali kunye namakhono omlawulo jikelele. Ulawulo lwebhajethi, ukutyhila ukusebenzisa imali kunye nolawulwamaphulo. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-MS Outlook, Excel, Word ne-PowerPoint. Amakhono okubhala iingxelo, okubonisa nokufundisa. Amandla okujongana neengxaki ngokusesikweni, ulawulwamaphulo nokutshintsha izinto. Inkathalo ngokuziphumezelela, intlonipho kunye namakhono okuhlobana nabantu. Ukuqonda ngemiba yemvelaphi ezahlukene.
xh.duties: Nikeza iinkonzo ze-internal medicine ezisebenzayo kwaye zigcinimali kubakholelwa abalawulwa yi-Madadeni Hospital nakuwo onke amaziko ayo okuhambelana nawo. Qinisa uze uqiniseke ukulawula okuqhubekayo kwezempilo kwiinkonzo ze-internal medicine kwicala lolawulo. Qiniseke ukusetyenziswa ngokuchaneka kwemithombo (kuquka uphando lwelebhorethi, imithi, izinto ezisetyenziswa kunye nempahla). Yonke imisebenzi yolawulo ye-Inzo ye-Internal Medicine iqhubeke ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokufanelekileyo. Cwangcisa uze ungene kwindalo yokufundisa abasebenzi kuquka oogqatsha bezempilo, abantu abancedisa kwezempilo, oogqirha bezobugqirha, abafundi abangenamvuzo kunye nabafundi basezingabini bezobugqirha, uze uxhase uphando lwezempilo, izilingo zeempilo kunye nemisebenzi ye-CPD. Phuhlisisa iinkonzo zengingqi kwinkalo ye-Internal Medicine uze uphucule ukusebenza kweekonzo ze-renal. Nikeza oogqirha ingcebiso ngenkululeko yokunceda ekwenzeni isipheto, ekulawuleni nasekuyaphulweni abakholelwa. Qhuba iiklinikhi zabakholelwa abangahlali esibhedlele nabalawula abahlala esibhedlele uze unike ingcebiso apho kufuneka khona. Qiniseke ukunika inkonzo yeeyure ezingama-24 kwi-Internal Medicine. Nikeza imbono, indlela yokuziphatha ngokwesigqibo uze khuthaze abasebenzi ukuba banikeze iinkonzo zempilo ezilula nangomgangatho. Lawula inkqubo yokusebenza kwabantu ababelwe. Qiniseke ukuba indawo yokusebenza ihambelana noMthetho wezeNtlalo yabaPhila nokuQonda, ukuba abasebenzi balandela iingqondo zokhuseleko nokuba abasebenzi balondolozwa ukuba bafikelele kwizinga eliphezulu lokukhiqiza. Lungelelanisa uze ulawule iingqondo ngokwemigaqo yeSebe lezeMpilo ezakuba nomphumo olungileyo kubasebenzi uze uqiniseke ukuba abasebenzi bayazazi bayaze balandele iingqondo. Hlola i-caliba elingakanani nexesha elide eliphelileyo loqhagamshelo lwemali uze ufakela iziphelo zolawulo lwezimali ngokungapheli. Nikeza iingqondo nesenzo lokwenzela ukhuseleko lomgangatho ukuze uhambelane neengqondo ezikwisimo esibalulekileyo. Yila iingxelo, iplani, iingxelo eziphawulayo uze wenze eminye imisebenzi yolawulo edibene nale ndawo. Qinisa uqhagamshelo namaphuzu ahambelana nabo abalulekileyo njenge-Tertiary hospitals njenge-Greys, IALCH, izibhedlele zokubhekisa, amalungu omphakathi, nokunye. Thethathu nabantu abahambelana nabaganga abajikelele ngophuhliso lweenkonzo. Phucula ulawulo labo bahlwayo. Gcina amanqanaba obugqirha, obungcali nobungqikithiyo. Lawula i-EPMDS yesebe le-Internal Medicine. IMIBUZO : Dr. X.F Nene Tel No: (034) 328 8007

jobs.title: Head Clinical Unit – Paediatrics Pulmonology/icu
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R2 168 145 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (excluding commuted overtime).
jobs.summary: Lead the paediatric pulmonology and intensive care clinical unit at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: Degree in medicine MBCHB. Registered Paediatrician, Certificate in subspecialties (Paediatric Pulmonology). Current Registration Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA), registration certificate with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist or Subspecialist in Pulmonology plus 5 years’ experience after registration. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: The incumbent would need to serve at a high level of leadership. Provide vision in developing the service in paediatric critical care and/or pulmonology.
jobs.duties: Administration in Paediatric Pulmonology – providing annual audits and/or administration in Paediatric Critical Care (Paediatric intensive and high care) providing annual audits. Undertake ward rounds in the paediatric intensivist care, high care and/or pulmonology. Pulmonology: Bronchoscopy – flexible and rigid, lung function testing analysis, evaluation of advanced pulmonology investigations mandatory. Skills to function in ICU environment viz insertion of invasive monitoring devices and treatment in critical ill children. Consultation for referrals of children with critical illness and/or lung disease. Calls in the PICU and pulmonology simultaneously. Clinics in either Pulmonology or post PICU/HCU patient. Training of fellows in subspecialty training. Teaching of undergraduate medical students. Training post graduate students (registrars/medical officer) in child health. Expected to undertake outreach at tertiary/regional hospitals. Community engagement. Involved in clinical governance and quality improvement plan. Monitoring of commuted overtime forms of consultant’s activities within pulmonology and critical care.
jobs.enquiries: Professor TC Hardcastle Tel No: (031) 240100, Ext. 2389

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Eenheid – Kindergeneeskunde Longsiektes/icu
af.summary: Lê die kliniese eenheid vir kindergeneeskundige longsiektes en intensiewe sorg by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal.
af.requirements: Geneeskundige graad MBCHB. Geregistreerde Kindergeneesheer, Sertifikaat in subspesialiteite (Kindergeneeskundige Longsiektes). Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA), registrasiesertifikaat by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis of Subspesialis in Longsiektes plus 5 jaar se ervaring na registrasie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Die ampsdraer sal op 'n hoë vlak van leierskap moet dien. Verskaf visie in die ontwikkeling van die diens in kindergeneeskundige kritiese sorg en/of longsiektes.
af.duties: Administrasie in Kindergeneeskundige Longsiektes – verskaf jaarlikse oudits en/of administrasie in Kindergeneeskundige Kritiese Sorg (Kindergeneeskundige intensiewe en hoë sorg) verskaf jaarlikse oudits. Onderneem saalrondtes in die kindergeneeskundige intensiewe sorg, hoë sorg en/of longsiektes. Longsiektes: Bronchoskopie – buigsaam en styf, longfunksie-toetsanalise, evaluering van gevorderde longsiekte-ondersoeke verpligtend. Vaardighede om in 'n ICU-omgewing te funksioneer d.w.s. invoeg van indringende moniteringstoestelle en behandeling van kritiek siek kinders. Konsultasie vir verwysings van kinders met kritieke siekte en/of longsiekte. Oproepe in die PICU en longsiektes gelyktydig. Klinieke in óf Longsiektes óf na PICU/HCU-pasiënt. Opleiding van genote in subspesialiteitsopleiding. Onderrig van voorgraadse mediese studente. Opleiding van nagraadse studente (registrateurs/mediese beamptes) in kindergesondheid. Verwag om uitreikwerk by tersière/regionale hospitale te onderneem. Gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid. Betrokke by kliniese bestuur en gehalteverbeteringsplan. Monitering van pendel-oortydvorms van konsultant se aktiwiteite binne longsiektes en kritiese sorg.

zu.title: Isikhulu Esihola Iyunithi Yezokwelapha – I-Paediatrics Pulmonology/icu
zu.summary: Hola iyunithi yezokwelapha ye-paediatric pulmonology kanye nezokunakekelwa okugxilile e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: I-degree kumnyama we-medicine i-MBCHB. I-Paediatrician ebhalisile, i-Certificate kwi-subspecialties (i-Paediatric Pulmonology). Ukube ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA), isatifikethi sokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengo-Medical Specialist noma i-Subspecialist kwi-Pulmonology kanye neminyaka eyi-5 yohlelo emumva kokubhalisa. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho kanye nama-Competencies Adingekayo: Umphathi okhethwe kuzodinga ukusebenza ezingeni eliphezulu lebulungelo. Nikeza isibono ekuthuthukisweni kwesevisi ezokunakekelwa okugxilile kwe-paediatric kanye/noma i-pulmonology.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwe-Paediatric Pulmonology – ukunikela izikulo zonyaka kanye/noma ukuphathwa ezokunakekelwa okugxilile kwe-paediatric (ukunakekelwa okugxilile kanye nokunakekelwa okuphezulu kwe-paediatric) ukunikela izikulo zonyaka. Yenza amajulela ezokuhamba ezokunakekelwa okugxilile kwe-paediatric, okunakekelwa okuphezulu kanye/noma i-pulmonology. I-Pulmonology: I-Bronchoscopy – eqinile noma eguquguqukayo, ukuhlaziya izivivinyo zokusebenza kwamaphaphu, ukuhlola izivivinyo eziphezulu ze-pulmonology kuyadingeka. Amakhono okusebenza emhlabeni we-ICU njengokuFaka izinto zokuqapha ezifakiwe kanye nokwelapha izingane ezigula kakhulu. Ukubonisana ngokuthunyelwa kwezingane ezigula kakhulu kanye/noma ezinasesifo sephephu. Amakholi ku-PICU kanye ne-pulmonology ngesikhathi esisodwa. Amaklinikhi noma ku-Pulmonology noma kubhedi abaphathi be-PICU/HCU. Ukuqeqesha abafundi be-fellow ekutholeni i-subspecialty. Ukufundisa abafundi be-undergraduate be-medicine. Ukuqeqesha abafundi abangaphandle kwesikole (abarejista/abaphathi be-medicine) ezokempilo yezingane. Kulindelekile ukuba wenze ukufinyelela kwezokwelapha ezibhedlela ezinga eliphezulu/ngezifunda. Ukuxhumana nomphakathi. Ukubandakanyeka ekulawulweni kwezokwelapha nendlela yokuthuthukisa izinga. Ukuqapha amafomu we-commuted overtime emisebenzini yekhonsuli kwi-pulmonology kanye nezokunakekelwa okugxilile.

xh.title: Umntathi Wesebe Lezempilo – I-Paediatrics Pulmonology/icu
xh.summary: Qhela icandelo lempilo le-paediatric pulmonology kunye nolunakekelo olubalulekileyo kwi-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: I-degree yezonyango i-MBCHB. I-Paediatrician ebhalisiweyo, i-Certificate kwi-subspecialties (i-Paediatric Pulmonology). Ukbhaliso kwaze kwangoku kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA), isatifikethi sobhaliso nge-HPCSA njengo-Medical Specialist okanye i-Subspecialist kwi-Pulmonology ngenani leminyaka engama-5 yamava emva kobhaliso. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho kunye namakhono afunekayo: Umntu oze kule sithuba kuya kudingeka ukuba asebenze kwinqanaba eliphezulu lebulungisa. Mnika isibonakaliso ekuphuculeni inkonzo ekukenkcekeni kobunzima bezempilo kubantwana kunye/noma i-pulmonology.
xh.duties: Ukulawulwa kwi-Paediatric Pulmonology – ukubonelela ngenzululwazi yonyaka kunye/noma ulawulwo ekuKenkcekeni Kobunzima bezempilo kubantwana (i-paediatric intensive kunye ne-high care) ukubonelela ngenzululwazi yonyaka. Thatha i-ward rounds ekunakekelweni kwabagulayo abalula kubantwana, i-high care kunye/noma i-pulmonology. I-Pulmonology: I-Bronchoscopy – flexible kunye ne-rigid, uhlalutyo lwe-lung function testing, ukuqwalasela i-pulmonology investigations ezithuthukileyo kuyimfuneko. Amakhono okusebenza kwimeko ye-ICU oko kukuthi ukufakwa kwezixhobo zokuqwalasela ezifakiweyo kunye nonyango kubantwana abagula kakhulu. Ingxoxo yokuqaliswa kwezinto kubantwana abagula kakhulu kunye/noguneso amaphaphu. Amacala kwi-PICU kunye ne-pulmonology ngaxeshanye. Iikliniki nakweyiphi na i-Pulmonology okanye i-patient emva kwe-PICU/HCU. Uqeqesho lwe-fellows kwisubspecialty training. Ukufundisa abafundi abangazanga bafumane i-degree yezonyango. Uqeqesho labafundi abaphumeleleyo (i-registrars/medical officer) kwezempilo zabantwana. Kulindeleke ukuba uthathe i-outreach kumazele we-tertiary/regional. Ukuqhubana nomntwonke. Ukubandakanyeka kwicebo lokuqwalasela izempilo nokuphucula ngobulungisa. Ukuqwalasela iifomu ze-commuted overtime zemisebenzi ye-consultant ngaphakathi kwe-pulmonology kunye nonakekelo olubalulekileyo.

jobs.title: Head Clinical Unit
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R2 168 145 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), excluding commuted overtime.
jobs.summary: Lead the Paediatric Neurosurgery Clinical Unit at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, overseeing clinical care, governance, staff performance, and service delivery.
jobs.requirements: MBChB Degree or equivalent qualifications. Registration certificate with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Neurosurgery and current registration as a Medical Specialist in Neurosurgery with the HPCSA. Minimum 5 years’ post-registration experience as a specialist Neurologist. Additional qualifications: Mmed or equivalent higher degree. Experience in Paediatric Neurosurgery. Experience in a tertiary/quaternary academic setting. Experience in clinical governance and service development. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies: Expertise in the management of Paediatric Neurosurgery conditions. Knowledge of national and international demography, current health and public service legislation, regulation and policy, including medical ethics, epidemiology, and statistics. Strong clinical decision-making, communication, and interpersonal skills. Experience in multidisciplinary teamwork, clinical training and functioning in a quaternary hospital. Ability to teach, supervise, and mentor trainees, junior staff and allied staff. Knowledge of research principles with ability to drive academic output. Leadership, administrative, and conflict resolution skills.
jobs.duties: Lead and manage the Paediatric Neurosurgery Clinical Unit as delegated by the Head Clinical Department of Neurosurgery in the following areas: Ensure high standards of clinical care, ethics, and governance. Oversee unit administration, staff performance, and service delivery. Provide specialist clinical services, including outpatient care, consultations and neurosurgical emergencies. Participate in after-hours consultant cover. Lead training of undergraduate and postgraduate students and allied health staff. Develop and implement clinical protocols as pertaining to paediatric neurosurgery conditions and other neurosurgical-related conditions. Support clinical audit and quality assurance programmes. Promote outreach and strengthen regional paediatric neurosurgery services at secondary and tertiary level hospitals. Ensure efficient and cost-effective use of resources. Promote and support research and academic development as delegated by the Head Clinical Department aligned with the policies of UKZN.
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: An Application for Employment Form (Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Hoof Kliniese Eenheid
af.summary: Bestuur die Pediatriese Neurochirurgiese Kliniese Eenheid by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital en hou toesig oor kliniese sorg, bestuur, personeelprestasie en dienslewering.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad of gelykwaardige kwalifikasies. Registrasiesertifikaat by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Neurochirurgie en huidige registrasie as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Neurochirurgie by die HPCSA. Minimum 5 jaar se ervaring na registrasie as 'n spesialis Neuroloog. Bykomende kwalifikasies: Mmed of gelykwaardige hoër graad. Ervaring in Pediatriese Neurochirurgie. Ervaring in 'n tersiêre/kwaternêre akademiese omgewing. Ervaring in kliniese bestuur en diensontwikkeling. Kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Kundigheid in die bestuur van Pediatriese Neurochirurgiese toestande. Kennis van nasionale en internasionale demografie, huidige gesondheids- en openbare dienswetgewing, regulasies en beleid, insluitend mediese etiek, epidemiologie en statistiek. Sterk kliniese besluitneming, kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Ervaring in multidissiplinêre spanwerk, kliniese opleiding en funksionering in 'n kwaternêre hospital. Vermoë om leerlinge, junior personeel en verwante personeel te onderrig, te superviseer en te mentor. Kennis van navorsingsbeginsels met vermoë om akademiese uitset te dryf. Leierskap, administratiewe en konflikoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en bestuur die Pediatriese Neurochirurgiese Kliniese Eenheid soos gedelegeer deur die Hoof Kliniese Departement van Neurochirurgie in die volgende areas: Verseker hoë standaarde van kliniese sorg, etiek en bestuur. Hou toesig oor eenheidsadministrasie, personeelprestasie en dienslewering. Verskaf spesialis kliniese dienste, insluitend buitepasient sorg, konsultasies en neurochirurgiese noodgevalle. Neem deel na-ure konsultant dekking. Lei opleiding van voorgraadse en nagraadse studente en verwante gesondheidspersoneel. Ontwikkel en implementeer kliniese protokolle soos dit pediatriese neurochirurgiese toestande en ander neurochirurgie-verwante toestande raak. Ondersteun kliniese oudit en gehalteversekeringsprogramme. Bevreedig inligting en versterk streek pediatriese neurochirurgie dienste by sekondêre en tersiêre vlak hospitale. Verseker doeltreffende en koste-effektiewe gebruik van hulpbronne. Bevreedig en ondersteun navorsing en akademiese ontwikkeling soos gedelegeer deur die Hoof Kliniese Departement in ooreenstemming met die beleide van UKZN.

zu.title: Umlawuli Weqembu Lezokwelapha
zu.summary: Hola iqembu lezokwelapha le-Paediatric Neurosurgery e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, ngenkathi uphethe inakekelo lezokwelapha, ulawulo, ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, nokulethwa kwenkonzo.
zu.requirements: Isiqu se-MBChB noma iziqu ezingalinganayo. Isitifiketi sokubhalisa neHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengongqeshi bezokwelapha abakhunjulwa ngokuba ngochwepheshe bezokwelapha kwi-Neurosurgery kanye nokubhalisa njalo njengongqeshi bezokwelapha ochwepheshe kwi-Neurosurgery ne-HPCSA. Okungenani minyaka yengu-5 yamava okusebenza emuva kokubhalisa njengochwepheshe we-Neurologist. Iziqu ezengeziwe: i-Mmed noma isiqu esiphezulu esilinganayo. Amove kwi-Paediatric Neurosurgery. Amove endaweni yezemfundo eyisikhungasemtholampilo esikhungweni sesithathu/sesine. Amove ekulawulweni kwezokwelapha nasekuthuthukisweni kwenkonzo. Ulwazi, amakhono namandla okwenza umsebenzi: Ukuhlakanipha ekuphathweni kwezimo ze-Paediatric Neurosurgery. Ulwazi ngenani labantu kuzwelonke nakwamanye amazwe, umthetho ophathelene nezempilo nomsebenzi wokhonza umphakathi wangamanje, imithetho kanye nenqubomgomo, okuhlanganisa izimilo zokwelapha, i-epidemiology, kanye nezibalo. Amandla okwenza izinqumbo eziphathelene nezokwelapha, ukuxhumana, namakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Amove ekusebenzeni ndawonye emaqembuhlukuhlukile, ekugadlweni izokwelapha kanye nokusebenza esibhedlela sesikhundla sesine. Amandla okufundisa, okuhlola, kanye nokukhokela abafundi, abasebenzi abasha kanye nabasebenzi abahlobene. Ulwazi lwezimiso zocwaningo kanye namandla okukhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kwemisebenzi yezemfundo. Amandla okuhola, okulawula, kanye nokuxazulula iziphixeko.
zu.duties: Hola uphathe iqembu lezokwelapha le-Paediatric Neurosurgery njengoba kunikezwe ngumlawuli weqembu lezokwelapha le-Neurosurgery kuleminyakho elandelayo: Qinisekisa amazinga aphezulu enakekelo lezokwelapha, izimilo, kanye nolawulo. Qapha ukulawulwa kweqembu, ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, nokulethwa kwenkonzo. Nikeza izinkonzo zezokwelapha zachwepheshe, okuhlanganisa inakekelo labagulayo bangaqhwayi, ukubuzwa kanye nezimo eziphuthumayo ze-neurosurgical. Thatha inxaxheba ekugadweni kosuku olwedlule komcebisi. Hola ukugadlwa kwabafundi ngesikhathi se-undergraduate kanye nabafundi besikhathi sokugodla kanye nabasebenzi bezempilo abahlobene. Thuthukisa futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo zezokwelapha ezihlobene nezimo ze-paediatric neurosurgery kanye nezinye izimo eziyhlobene ne-neurosurgical. Sekela ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha kanye neminhlehlo ezingaqinisekiswa izinga. Khuthaza ukufinyelela futhi uqinise izinkonzo ze-paediatric neurosurgery zommandla ema-sithathu nama-sibili esibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nangenzeko yemithombo. Khuthaza futhi usekele ucwaningo kanye nentuthuko yezemfundo njengoba kunikezwe ngumlawuli weqembu lezokwelapha ehambisana nenqubomgomo ye-UKZN.

xh.title: Umntu Ophethe Isebe Lomsebenzi Wezempilo
xh.summary: Phatha Isebe Lomsebenzi Wezempilo Le-Paediatric Neurosurgery e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, lugqibo ukunakekelwa kwezempilo, ulawulo, ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, nokunikela ngencebo.
xh.requirements: IGreyid le-MBChB okanye izifundo ezilinganayo. Isatifikethi sokubhalisa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomchweli wezempilo kwi-Neurosurgery nokubhalisa kwangoku njengomchweli wezempilo kwi-Neurosurgery kwi-HPCSA. Okungapheli kweminyaka emi-5 yamava emva kokubhalisa njengomchweli we-Neurologist. Izifundo ezongezelelweyo: i-Mmed okanye igreyid ephezulu ezinganayo. Amanqanaba amava kwi-Paediatric Neurosurgery. Amanqanaba amava kwindawo yezifundo ephantsi/nephezulu kwinqanaba le-tertiary. Amava kulawulo lwezempilo nasekunikelelweni ngenkqubo yesebe. Ulwazi, Amakhono Namava Okusebenza: Abambe kakhulu ekulawulweni kwezempilo ezinxulumene ne-Paediatric Neurosurgery. Ulwazi ngemibalo yabantu yaselwandle nasekhaya, ngomthetho osebenzayo wezempilo nowmasebenzi kaZwelonke, imithetho yomanyano lwezempilo, kubandakanya indlela zokuziphatha zobugqirha, i-epidemiology, namazinga okubala. Amandla ekwenzeni izigqibo ezinxulumene nezempilo, ekuthetheni, nasekuzingiseleleni nabantu. Amava ekusebenzeni njengodidi olunje ngoko, ekufundiseni izempilo, nasekusebenzeni esibhedlele esiphakathi kwinqanaba le-quaternary. Amandla okufundisa, okulawula nasekwakhiseni abafundi, abasebenzi abasemva kwakhokelela nabasebenzi abancedisayo. Ulwazi ngeziseko zophando kunye namandla okukhuthaza inkqubo yophando. Amakhono okubambelela ekulawulweni, ekulawuleni iinkqubo, nasekuxazululeni iingxabano.
xh.duties: Phatha ulawule isebe lomsebenzi wezempilo le-Paediatric Neurosurgery njengoko kugqithiswe ngumphathi wezempilo we-Neurosurgery kummandla olandelayo: Qinisekisa iinqanaba eziphezulu ekunakekelweni kwezempilo, ekuziphatheni, nasekulawulweni. Qwalasela ulawulo lwesebe, ukusebenza kwabasebenzi, nokunikela ngencebo. Nikela ngenkonzo yochwepheshe bezempilo, okubandakanya ukunakekelwa kwabagulayo abangangeni esibhedlele, iingxoxo, nemo ezibalaseleyo ze-neurosurgery. Thatha inxaxheba ekunikeleni ngenkxaso yamava emva kweyure ezisebenzayo. Phatha uqeqeshe lwabafundi abafundi isidanga kwaye abangangenanga kulo nalawo asebenzela ukunikezelwa kwezempilo. Yila uphumeze iinkqubo ezinxulumene neemeko ze-paediatric neurosurgery nazo zonke ezinye iimeko ezinxulumene ne-neurosurgery. Xhasa uluhlu lwezempilo nokugcina inkqubo yomgangatho. Khuthaza kunye nokomeleza iinkonzo zeedolophu ezisesikweni kwisebe le-paediatric neurosurgery kumaziko amabanga aphantsi nasephezulu. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwezibonelelo ngokuchanekileyo nangexabiso elingabizi kakhulu. Khuthaza ukuze uxhase uphando nokuvela kwezifundo njengoko kugqithiswe nguMphathi wezempilo we-Neurosurgery ngokulandela iinkqubo ze-UKZN.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis: Pediatrie
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Pediatrie gesoek vir Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal om kritieke sorg, saalrondes, opleiding en konsultasies te verskaf.
af.requirements: MB; ChB-graad. Huidige registrasie as 'n Spesialis in Pediatrie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Registrasiesertifikaat as 'n Spesialis in Pediatrie by HPCSA. Bykomende kwalifikasie: Ervaring in kritieke sorg sal 'n voordeel wees. Ervaring: Graad 1 Geen ervaring vereis nie. Graad 2: 5 Jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Pediatrie). Graad 3: 10 Jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Pediatrie). Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Breë kennis van werk in algemene Pediatrie en Etiek. Goeie kommunikasie en toesighoudende vaardighede. Toepaslike spesialisassessering, diagnoses en pasiëntbestuur. Bekendheid met prosedures en bestuurprotokolle binne die subspesialiteit van pediatriese kritieke sorg. Werk met multidissiplinêre spanne. Toesig en onderrig van voorgraadse en nagraadse studente. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Selfvertroue. af.duties: Verplig om op te lei in pediatriese kritieke sorg. Onderneem saalrondes in die pediatriese intensiewe sorg, hoësorg en sale. Konsultasie vir verwysings van kinders met kritieke siekte. Betrokke by kliniese bestuur en gehaltestrydingsplan.

zu.title: Isekhelisi Sezokwelapha: Ezingane
zu.summary: Kufunwa Isekhelisi Sezokwelapha Kwezingane e Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e KwaZulu-Natal ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okubalulekile, ukuzulazula emigulukudwini, ukuqeqesha kanye nokweluleka.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-MB; ChB Ukwabhalisela okwamanje njengeseKhelisi Kwezingane ne Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Isitifiketi Sokubhalisa njengeseKhelisi Kwezingane ne HPCSA Iziqu ezingezelekile: Ukuba namavao ekunakekelweni okubalulekile kuzoba yithrusthusi Amava: Izinga 1 Akukho mava odingekayo. Izinga 2: Imyaka eyi-5 yamava afanele njengeseKhelisi Sezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhalisa ne HPCSA njengeseKhelisi Sezokwelapha (Ezingane). Izinga 3: Imyaka eyi-10 yamava afanele njengeseKhelisi Sezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhalisa ne HPCSA njengeseKhelisi Sezokwelapha (Ezingane) Ulwazi, Amakhono, ukuqeqesha kanye namakhono adingekayo: Ulwazi olubanzi lokusebenza kwezingane jikelele kanye Nezokuziphatha. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle kanye namakhono okuphatha. Ukuhlola okufanele, ukuxilonga kanye nokuphatha iziguli. Ukwazi izinqubo kanye namaphrotokholi okuphatha ngaphakathi kwesigaba esincane sokunakekelwa okubalulekile kwezingane. Ukusebenza namakhasimende ahlukahlukene. Ukuphatha kanye nokufundisa abafundi abangenanga nabanaphesheya. Izici zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela engxumeni. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba. Iqinisekho ngokuzethemba. Ikono lokwakha kanye nogcina ubuhlobo.
zu.duties: Kudingeka uqeqesheke ekunakekelweni okubalulekile kwezingane Ukuzulazula emigulukudwini yokuqeqeswa okunakekelwa ngokujulile kwezingane, ukunakekelwa okuphezulu kanye namawadi Ukweluleka ngokuthunyelwa kwezingane eziguliswe ngokugula okubalulekile. Amacala kwinsevisi yezingane Amakliniki kweziguli ezithunyelwe e PICU/HCU. Ukuqeqesha kwabafundi abangenanga kwesigaba esincane. Ukufundisa abafundi bezokwelapha abangenanga. Ukuqeqesha abafundi abaphesheya (abajwaye/baholi bezokwelapha) kwezingane. Kulindeleke ukuba uwenze ukuthi kuhlangatshezwe namaspithala amakhulu/asifundazwe. Ukuxhumana nomphakathi. Ukubandakanyeka ekuphathweni kwezempilo kanye necandelo lokuthuthukiswa ikhwalithi.

xh.title: Igunya lezokwelapha: I-Paediatric
xh.summary: Kufuneki igunya lezokwelapha kwi-Paediatrics kwi-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukunika ukhathalo olubalulekileyo, iintshukumo zegumbi lokugula, uqeqesho nokuvela kumabandla.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-MB; ChB. Ukubhalisa ngoku njengogunyaziswa kwi-Paediatrics kunye ne-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Isatifiketi sokubhalisa njengogunyaziswa kwi-Paediatrics kunye ne-HPCSA. Iqualification yokongezelelweyo: Amava ekuqeqesheni ukhathalo olubalulekileyo kuya kuba luluncedo. Amava: Inqanaba 1 Akukho mava ufunekayo. Inqanaba 2: Iminyaka emi-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengogunyaziswa lezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogunyaziswa lezokwelapha (i-Paediatrics). Inqanaba 3: Iminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengogunyaziswa lezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogunyaziswa lezokwelapha (i-Paediatrics). Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namandla afunekayo: Ulwazi olubanzi lokusebenza kwi-Paediatrics jikelele nakwi-Ethics. Amakhono amabalwe athetha kwaye alawule. Ukulinganisa, ukuyalatha ukuxilongo nokulawula abaguli njengogunyaziswa. Ukuzazi iinkqubo namaphrothokholi wolawulo ngaphakathi kwesahluko se-Paediatric critical care. Ukusebenza namakomkhulu amaninzi anamasebe. Ukumyalela nokuqeqesha abafundi abangenayo nabanegradu abangangenayo. Iimpawu zokuziphatha: Ukumelana nengxaki. Amandla okusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba. Iqondo lokuzithemba. Amandla okwakha nokuqinisa iindibaniselwano.
xh.duties: Kufunekile ukuqeqeshwa kwi-paediatric critical care. Ukwenza iintshukumo zegumbi lokugula kwi-paediatric intensive care, high care namagumbi okugula. Ukuvela kumabandla kubaphulaphuli abanokugula okubalulekileyo. Amasango kwiinkonzo ze-paediatric. Amakliniki kubaphulaphuli abaphuma kwi-PICU/HCU. Uqeqesho labafundi kwisahluko se-subspecialty. Ukufundisa abafundi abangenayo kwezokwelapha. Uqeqesho labafundi abangangenayo (ababhalisiweyo/ogunyaziswa bezokwelapha) kwi-paediatrics. Kulindelekile ukwenza unyazo lokuya kumazezibedlwa e-tertiary/regional. Ukuzibandakanya nommango. Ukubandakanyeka kolawulo lweklinikhi nendlela yokuphucula izinga.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist: Obstetrics and Gynaecology and
jobs.centre: Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital (IALCH) and rotations through the Durban Metropolitan Complex of hospitals as delegated by the Head of Department (outreach)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (excluding commuted overtime) Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (excluding commuted overtime) Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (excluding commuted overtime)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in Durban, requiring HPCSA registration and a reproductive medicine certification.
jobs.requirements: MB; ChB Degree; Medical Specialist qualification in Obstetrics and Gynecology. Current registration as a Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Additional Qualification: Certification with HPCSA as a reproductive Medicine specialist NB: Candidates with no Certificate but with proven interest and experience in Reproductive health will be considered if no suitable candidate is found. Experience: Grade 1: No experience required. Grade 2: Five (5) years but less than ten (10) years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist- Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Grade 3: Ten (10) years and above appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist Obstetrics and Gynaecology. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Sound clinical knowledge and experience in Obstetrics and Gyn ecology. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service legislation, regulations and policies including medical ethics, epidemiology and statistics. Good communication, leadership, decision-making and clinical skills.
jobs.duties: Management of clinical services as delegated. Outpatient and inpatient clinical responsibilities with after-hour participation in IALCH (within the sub-discipline and other Obs and Gynae services) as per the departmental call roster. Develop and grow the clinical platform for management of patients with reproductive challenges. Participate in the development and on-going provision of under- and post- graduate health personnel teaching as per the academic program of the department. Participate in the Quality Improvement Programmes of the Department. Maintain clinical, professional and ethical standards. Maintain necessary discipline over staff under his/her control. Attend to administrative matters as pertains to the Department. Be involved in community-orientated programmes (outreach) including the provision of expert advice and services to all health facilities within the province as delegated. Please note: This is a service post, and is not necessarily linked to being trained as a subspecialist in the sub-discipline - the latter requires separate application when the training position is available
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: An Application for Employment Form (Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the short listed candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis: Verloskunde en Ginekologie en
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in Durban, wat HPCSA-registrasie en 'n reproduktiewe geneeskunde-sertifisering vereis.
af.requirements: MB; ChB-graad; Mediese Spesialis-kwalifikasie in Verloskunde en Ginekologie. Huidige registrasie as 'n Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie. Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Verloskunde en Ginekologie. Bykwalifikasie: Sertifisering by die HPCSA as 'n reproduktiewe geneeskunde-spesialis NB: Kandidate sonder 'n sertifikaat maar met bewese belangstelling en ervaring in reproduktiewe gesondheid sal oorweeg word indien geen geskikte kandidaat gevind word nie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen ervaring vereis nie. Graad 2: Vyf (5) jaar maar minder as tien (10) jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis- Verloskunde en Ginekologie. Graad 3: Tien (10) jaar en meer toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Spesialis Verloskunde en Ginekologie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Degelike kliniese kennis en ervaring in Verloskunde en Ginekologie. Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Dienswetgewing, regulasies en beleide insluitend mediese etiek, epidemiologie en statistiek. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en kliniese vaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur van kliniese dienste soos gedelegeer. Ambulante en hospitale kliniese verantwoordelikhede met buite-ure deelname by IALCH (binne die subdissipline en ander Obs en Gynae-dienste) volgens die departementele oproeprooster. Ontwikkel en laat groei die kliniese platform vir bestuur van pasiënte met reproduktiewe uitdagings. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling en voortdurende verskaffing van voor- en nagraadse gesondheidspersoneelonderrig volgens die akademiese program van die departement. Neem deel aan die Kwaliteitsverbeteringsprogramme van die Departement. Handhaaf kliniese, professionele en etiese standaarde. Handhaaf noodsaaklike dissipline oor personeel onder sy/haar beheer. Behandel administratiewe sake soos dit op die Departement betrekking het. Betrek wees in gemeenskapsgeoriënteerde programme (voorligting) insluitend die verskaffing van kundige advies en dienste aan alle gesondheidsfasiliteite binne die provinsie soos gedelegeer. Let wel: Dit is 'n dienspos, en is nie noodwendig verbind aan die opleiding as 'n subspesialis in die subdissipline nie - laasgenoemde vereis afsonderlike aansoek wanneer die opleidingspos beskikbaar is

zu.title: Izikhungo Zezokwelapha: I-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology
zu.summary: Isikhungo sezokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology esibhedlela i-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital eDurban, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA nesitifiketi sezokuzala.
zu.requirements: Idegree ye-MB; ChB; Isifundo sezikhundla sezokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gynecology. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje njengesikhungo kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhungo sezokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. Isifundo Esingeziwe: Isitifiketi kwi-HPCSA njengesikhungo se-Reproductive Medicine QAPHELA: Abasebenzi abangenawo isitifiketi kepha abanomdla obonakaliswe nayo futhi benomuzwa otholakele kwezempilo yokuzala bayocatshangelwa uma kungekho umuntu ofanele okutholakele. Umuzwa: I-Grade 1: Akuwo umuzwa odingekayo. I-Grade 2: Iminyaka emihlanu (5) kodwa ngaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi (10) yomuzwa ofanele njengesikhungo sezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhungo sezokwelapha - i-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. I-Grade 3: Iminyaka eyishumi (10) nangaphezulu yomuzwa ofanele njengesikhungo sezokwelapha emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhungo sezokwelapha i-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho namakhono adingekayo: Ulwazi olujulile nezinto eziyenziwe ngokwelapha kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. Ulwazi ngemithetho yangokwedlule mayelana nezempilo kanye nesevisi yomphakathi, imithetho kanye namapholisi ahlanganisa izimiso zokuziphatha kwezokwelapha, i-epidemiology kanye nezibalo. Amakhono okuxoxa, ukuba ngumholi, ukwenza izinqumo kanye namakhono okwelapha angcono.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kwesevisi yokwelapha njengokuqunyiwe. Izibopho zokwelapha zabagulayo abangaphakathi nabamaqembu angaphandle ngokuthatha inxaxheba emahoreni kamuva kwi-IALCH (ngaphakathi kwesigaba esingaphansi kanye namanye amasevisi e-Obs ne-Gynae) njengengxenye yohlu lokuqasha komnyango. Ukuthuthukiswa nokukhuliswa kwendawo yokwelapha ukuze kutholakale ukuphathwa kwabagulayo abanezinkinga zokuzala. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuthuthukiseni nasekunikezweni okuqhubekayo kokuqeqeshwa kobuchwepheshe bezempilo abasemakolishi nangemva kwemikolo njengohlelo lwemfundo lomnyango. Ukuthatha inxaxhebe ohlelweni lwe-Quality Improvement Programmes zomnyango. Ukugcina amazinga okwelapha, obungcweti nezimiso zokuziphatha. Ukugcina umtsetfo odingekayo kubasebenzi abangaphansi kolawulo lwakhe. Ukuqwalasela izindaba zokuphathwa ezithintela umnyango. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lwendawo emphakathi (ukwetyula) kuhlanganisa inikezwa leluleko ngamakhono emabhizinisi kumazwe onke amasikhungo wezempilo ngaphakathi kwesifunda njengokuqunywe. QAPHELA: Lesi isikhundla sesevisi, futhi asihlobene ngokuphela nokuqeqeshwa njengomkhulu-ngqangi ohlelweni oluncane - lokhu kokugcina kudinga isicelo esihlukile uma isikhundla soqeqeshwo sitholakala.

xh.title: Isiganga somtholampilo: I-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology
xh.summary: Isiganga somtholampilo kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e-Durban, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA nesatifikethi yezonyango lokuqaliswa inyaniso.
xh.requirements: I-Degree ye-MB; ChB; Isidanga sokuba ngumtholampilo kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gynecology. Ukubhaliswa okuqhubekayo njengomchwethazi kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. Ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesiganga somtholampilo kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. Isidanga esongezelelweyo: Isatifikethi kwi-HPCSA njengomchwethazi we-Medicine yokuzala QAPHULA: Abaqeqeshi abangenayo Isatifikethi kodwa balu thando olubonakalayo nolunamava kwimpilo yezoqaliswa inyaniso baya kucatshulwa ukuba akukho mthengi ocwangcisiweyo ofunyenweyo. Amany∶ Inqanaba le-1: Akukho mava lufunekayo. Inqanaba le-2: Iminyaka emihlanu (5) kodwa ngaphantsi kweminyaka elishumi (10) yamava afanelekileyo njengesiganga somtholampilo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesiganga somtholampilo- i-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. Inqanaba le-3: Iminyaka elishumi (10) nangaphezulu yamava afanelekileyo njengesiganga somtholampilo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesiganga somtholampilo i-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho neNkomfa eFunekayo: Ulwazi olululo lomtholampilo namava kwi-Obstetrics ne-Gyn ecology. Ulwazi ngemithetho ekhoyo yezempilo nesebe lokhonza lotyholo, imithetho nale ngqikithi ezibandakanya izigaba zokuziphatha kwezomtholampilo, i-epidemiology namabalengwe. Ukuziqhelanisa kolwazi, ukuzoba abantu, ukwenza izigqibo namakhono omtholampilo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iinkonzo zomtholampilo njengoko kugqithiswe. Iinkqubo zomtholampilo zabakhwelile nabangenayo ngenyanga phantsi kwelichwathithi kwi-IALCH (ngaphakathi kwindalo-phantsi kwaye nakwezinye iinkonzo ze-Obs and Gynae) njengoko kujongwe ngumlenze webumba. Ukuphucula kukhule indawo yomtholampilo ekulawulweni kwezigulana eziyinqanaba lokuzala. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuphuculeni nasekuqhubeni uqeqesho lwabasebenzi bezeempilo abangenayo kwaye abakhokele ekwindwe njengoko kujongwe kwinkqubo yemfundo yesebe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zoPhuculo lokuGqibelela kwiSebe. Ukugcina iinkalo zomtholampilo, ezingcali nezokuziphatha. Ukugcina inqalelo efunekayo kubasebenzi abakulawulweni. Ukuzala izinto zolawulo njengoko zithintela kwiSebe. Ukubandakanyeka kwiinkqubo ezijolise nommango (i-outreach) kuquka nokuvelisa ingcebiso ngeengcali nezenkonzo kuzo zonke izikhululo zezeempilo ngaphakathi kwiphondo njengoko kugqithiswe. Nceda qaphela: Le yisithuba senkonzo, kwaye asidibani nokuqeqeshelwa njengomchwethazi kwicala ephantsi ecaleni - oku kugqithiselwa kusicebo soqhagamshelwanaxa isikhundela soqeqesho sikhona

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (excluding commuted overtime) Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (excluding commuted overtime) Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package), (excluding commuted overtime)
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Oncology sought for Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring HPCSA specialist registration in Radiotherapy Oncology.
jobs.requirements: MBChB or equivalent. Registration Certificate as a Specialist: Radiotherapy Oncologist with the HPCSA and Current Registration Card with HPCSA. Experience: Grade 1: Experience Not applicable. Candidates who have completed the FC Rad Onc Part II exams and are awaiting results are welcome to apply. Appointment can only occur once specialist registration is available. Grade 2: Five (5) years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA as a Specialist in Radiation Oncology. Grade 3: Ten (10) years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with HPCSA as a Specialist in Radiation Oncology. Participation in provision of postgraduate health personnel teaching, including registrar teaching. Attend and participate in departmental academic sessions and meetings for part 1 and part 2 registrars as well as medical officers. The successful applicant will be required to perform after hour duties and be part of a multi-disciplinary team when deemed necessary. Participate in Clinical Governance.
