af.title: Mediese Spesialis Onkologie
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Onkologie gesoek vir Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, met vereiste vir HPCSA-spesialisregistrasie in Radiotherapie-onkologie.
af.requirements: MBChB of gelykwaardig. Registrasiesertifikaat as 'n Spesialis: Radiotherapie-onkoloog by die HPCSA en Huidige Registrasiekaart by HPCSA. Ervaring: Graad 1: Ervaring Nie van toepassing nie. Kandidate wat die FC Rad Onc Deel II-eksamens voltooi het en op resultate wag, is welkom om aansoek te doen. Aanstelling kan eers plaasvind sodra spesialisregistrasie beskikbaar is. Graad 2: Vyf (5) jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Spesialis in Radiasie-onkologie. Graad 3: Tien (10) jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Spesialis in Radiasie-onkologie. Bykomende Kwalifikasies: Registrateurs wat hul opleiding voltooi het, mag ook aansoek doen op voorwaarde dat hul aanstelling onderhewig sal wees aan die voorlegging van dokumentêre bewys van registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa as 'n Spesialis in Radiasie-onkologie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Deeglike kliniese kennis binne die dissipline van mediese en radiasie-onkologie. Vermoë om alle onkologiese noodgevalle te hanteer. Kennis van etiese mediese praktyk. Vermoë om volwasse pasiente met soliede-orgaan-maligniteite en geselekteerde limfome te assesseer, diagnoseer en te bestuur. Bevoeg in die radioterapie-bestuur van pediatiese maligniteite.
af.duties: Verskaffing van holistiese sorg vir onkologiepasiente in die Ethekweni Onkologie-kompleks, insluitend Addington en Inkosi Albert Luthuli hospitale, asook uitreikdienste na Ngwelezane/Queen Nandi hospitaal soos deur die departement vereis. Onderhou mediese rekords, insluitend op 'n elektroniese platform. Neem deel aan die Kwaliteitsverbeteringsprogramme van die Departement/Hospitaal. Handhaaf kliniese, professionele en etiese standaarde. Betrokke wees by gemeenskapsgerigte/uitreikprogramme, insluitend die verskaffing van kundige advies en dienste aan alle gesondheidsfasiliteite binne die provinsie soos gedelegeer deur die hoof van die departement en die behoeftes van die Provinsie. Deelname aan die verskaffing van nagraadse onderrig van gesondheidspersoneel, insluitend registratore-onderrig. Bywoon en deelneem aan departementele akademiese sessies en vergaderings vir deel 1- en deel 2-registratore asook mediese beamptes. Die suksesvolle aansoeker sal vereis word om na-ure pligte uit te voer en deel te wees van 'n multidissiplinêre span wanneer dit nodig geag word. Neem deel aan Kliniese Bestuur.

zu.title: Izikhulu Esezemedini Kwe-Oncology
zu.summary: Kufunwa Izikhulu Esezemedi Kwe-Oncology e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, kudingeka ubhaliso lwesikhulu se-HPCSA kwe-Radiotherapy Oncology.
zu.requirements: I-MBChB noma okulinganayo. Isitifikedi Sobhaliso njengesikhulu: I-Radiotherapy Oncologist ne-HPCSA kanye nekhadi labha okamanje ne-HPCSA. Isiphalo: I-Grade 1: Isiphalo asisebenzi. Izifakazi ezigcobe isiwi se-FC Rad Onc Part II futhi salinde imiphumela samukelekile ukuthi bafake isicelo. Ukugcotshwa kungenzeka kuphela uma kutholakala ubhaliso lwesikhulu. I-Grade 2: Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yesiphalo esifanele njengesikhulu Sezemedi emva kobhaliso ne-HPCSA njengesikhulu kwe-Radiation Oncology. I-Grade 3: Iminyaka eyishumi (10) yesiphalo esifanele njengesikhulu Sezemedi emva kobhaliso ne-HPCSA njengesikhulu kwe-Radiation Oncology. Izifundo ezingeziwe: Ababhalisi abasede ukugcoba ukhotheyo babo bangafaka futhi isicelo ngokwezimo yokuthi ukugcotshwa kwabo kuzobe kusemthefwini wokuthi bafake ubufakazi bokuthi babhalise ne-HPCSA njengabaKhulu kwe-Radiation Oncology. Ulwazi, Amandla, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi oluhle lweklinikhi endimeni yesezemedi kwe-oncology nokuthutha igciwane ngesiza eshishilo. Ikhono lokuphatha yonke imibeke yomoya i-oncological. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha okuhle kwezokwelapha. Ikhono lokuhlolisisa, ukuhlonza ukugula futhi uphathe abaguli abadala abanesifo sezitho ezilukhuni futhi abane-lymphomas. Ukwazi ukuphatha abaguli ngokwesiza sikhathi ngokuthutha igciwane kodwa ngabantwana.
zu.duties: Nikela ngenakekelo oluphelele kwabaguli bwe-oncology e-Ethekweni Oncology complex kuhlanganise i-Addington ne-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Hospitals kanye namasevisi okufinyelela kwa-Ngwelezane/Queen Nandi Hospital njengoba kudingwa umnyango. Igcina amarekhodi ezokwelapha, kuhlanganise nalawo endaweni yohlelo lwamakhompyutha. Thatha inxaxheba kuhlelo lokuthuthukiswa ikhwalithi womnyango/Isibhedlela. Gcina amazinga ahle ezokwelapha, ngomsebenzi nokuziphatha okuhle. Zibandakanye kuhlelo lwomphakathi noma lwamasevisi okufinyelela, kuhlanganise nezinikezelo zelulezo lezikhulu namasevisi kuzo zonke izikhungo zezempilo endaweni, njengoba kumyalelwe sikhulu esiholi umnyango futhi njengoba kudingwa isifundazwe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekunikezeni ukufundisa izisebenzi zezempilo ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kuhlanganise nokufundisa ababhalisi. Hlala uthathe inxaxheba futhi usebenze emihlanganweni nezinkomfa zomnyango kwabafundi be-part 1 kanye ne-part 2 kanye nabaholiwe bamasevisi. Umuntu ophumelele isicelo uzodingeka ukuba aze asebenze ngemva kwamahora futhi abe yingxenye yeqembu elihlukene kwezindaba uma kuthathwa njengesidingo. Thatha inxaxheba ekulawuleni izindaba zeklinikhi.

xh.title: Izibazi lezonyango le-Oncology
xh.summary: Kufunwa izibazi lezonyango le-Oncology kwi-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, kufuneka kube khona ubhaliso lwezibazi kwi-HPCSA kwRadiotherapy Oncology.
xh.requirements: I-MBChB okanye eleyantlonto. Isatifikethi sobhaliso njengesibazi: i-Radiotherapy Oncologist kunye ne-HPCSA nakwikhadi lobhaliso langoku kunye ne-HPCSA. Isipilingo: Inqanaba le-1: Isipilingo asisebenzi. Abasekelwayo abaqedile i-FC Rad Onc Part II exams balinde imiphumela banikwe isikhundla sokusebenza isicelo. Ukwamkelwa kunokwenzeka kuphela kude kube khona ubhaliso njengesibazi. Inqanaba le-2: Iinyanga ezintlanu (5) zesipilingo esifanelekileyo njengesibazi lezonyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesibazi kwRadiation Oncology. Inqanaba le-3: Iminyaka elishumi (10) yesipilingo esifanelekileyo njengesibazi lezonyango emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesibazi kwRadiation Oncology. Iziqinisekiso ezingezantsi: Abarabasha abaqedile isikolo sabo banako ukusebenzisa isicelo ngokwameko lokuba ukwamkelwa kwabo kuya kuxhomekeka ekuzuzeni ubhaliso kunye ne-HPCSA njengesibazi kwRadiation Oncology. Ulwazi, Amandla, Isikolo nokuZinzeleyo afunekayo: Ulwazi oluhle lokwelona kwinkqubo yamagulo e-medical kunye ne-radiation oncology. Amandla okupatha zonke iingozi ze-oncological. Ulwazi ngokuziphatha ngokwendalo ekwelweni lokuchatha. Amandla okuqwalasela, ukuxilonga nokulawula abagulihlangothi abadala abanesimo se-solid organ malignancies kunye namagulo amanqanaba abakhethiweyo. Ukuzinza ekulawulweni kweradiyothulaphi kwamagulo abantwana.
xh.duties: Ukunikezwa kokhathalelo lokuphela kwabaguli be-oncology kwii-Ethekweni Oncology complex kuquka i-Addington ne-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Hospitals nakwiinkonzo zokukhusela i-Ngwelezane/Queen Nandi Hospital njengoko kufunwa yisebe. Ugcino lwamaphulo ezonyango, kuquka ngaphezulu kwinkqubo yamabhalo abakhoyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo zokuphucula umgangatho weSebe/iSibhedlele. Ukugcina umgangatho wezonyango, wemisebenzi yendalo, noyokuziphatha. Ukuzibandakanya kwiinkqubo zomphakathi/zokukhusela kubandakanya ukunikezwa kweenkcebiso zabachwephesha nokwinkonzo kuzo zonke iziseko zokhathalelo loluntu kurhulumente njengoko kuphothwe ngumntu onyathele iSebe ngezidingo zesifunda. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekunikeni izifundo zokufundisa abasebenzi bezonyango abangamabanga aphezulu, kuquza nokufundisa abarabasha. Ukuza nokuzibandakanya kwiinkqubo neemibhalo yesebe ngeemeko zabafundi bengcwele kunye namadoda athenjelwe ngobuchwephesha ezibhedlele; njengoko kufunwa ngumntu ongumanyano weengqondo kwelona elihlukene.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist: Trauma and Burns
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum, (all inclusive) salary package, (excluding commuted overtime). Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum, (all inclusive) salary package, (excluding commuted overtime). Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum, (all inclusive) salary package, (excluding commuted overtime).
jobs.summary: Medical specialist in trauma and burns sought for Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring MBChB, FCS(SA) or MMed Surg, and HPCSA registration as a trauma surgeon.
jobs.requirements: MBChB or equivalent; Applicants must be in possession of an appropriate higher surgical qualification (FCS(SA) and/or MMed Surg) and currently registered with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Trauma Surgeon. Registration Certificate as a Specialist Trauma Surgeon. Additional Qualifications: eFAST course, MIMMS and, or ACLS/PALS. DSTC or Burns experience. Cert Trauma (SA) sub-specialist training complete. Preference will be given to applicants who have completed the Cert Trauma (SA) sub- specialist exam. Experience: Grade 1: Experience Not applicable requires the Fellowship in Surgery of the College of Medicine of South Africa or equivalent, and registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa. Applicants must be registered as a specialist in surgery at the commencement of duties. Grade 2: requires appropriate qualification, specialist registration certificate plus 5 years’ experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Grade 3 requires appropriate qualification, specialist registration certificate, plus 10 years’ experience after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery.
jobs.duties: Participation in the clinical trauma and burns services: inter disciplinary in- house coordination of the management of the patients: supervision of the surgical trainees rotating through the trauma and transplant units: ensuring the highest standards of clinical, professional, and ethical behaviour: assist in teaching of undergraduate medical students, postgraduate surgical trainees: conduct, assist, and stimulate research within the ethical guidelines of the Health Care Act: promote education in trauma prevention and transplant community awareness. Physical presence on arrival of scene calls and unstable cases expected.
jobs.enquiries: Dr T C Hardcastle Tel No: (031) 240 1000, ext 2389 or speed dial 6195
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: An Application for Employment Form (Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the short listed candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis: Trauma en Brandwonde
af.summary: Mediese spesialis in trauma en brandwonde gesoek vir Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat MBChB, FCS(SA) of MMed Surg, en HPCSA-registrasie as 'n traumachirurg vereis.
af.requirements: MBChB of ekwivalent; Aansoekers moet oor 'n toepaslike hoër chirurgiese kwalifikasie (FCS(SA) en/of MMed Surg) beskik en tans by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Trauma Surgeon geregistreer wees. Registrasiesertifikaat as 'n Spesialis Trauma Surgeon. Bykomende kwalifikasies: eFAST-kursus, MIMMS en, of ACLS/PALS. DSTC- of brandwonde-ervaring. Cert Trauma (SA) subspesialis-opleiding voltooi. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan aansoekers wat die Cert Trauma (SA) subspesialis-eksamen voltooi het. Ervaring: Grade 1: Ervaring nie toepaslik nie vereis die Fellowship in Surgery of the College of Medicine of South Africa of ekwivalent, en registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa. Aansoekers moet as 'n spesialis in chirurgie geregistreer wees by aanvang van pligte. Grade 2: vereis toepaslike kwalifikasie, spesialisregistrasiesertifikaat plus 5 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Grade 3 vereis toepaslike kwalifikasie, spesialisregistrasiesertifikaat, plus 10 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n Medical Specialist in General Surgery.
af.duties: Deelname aan die kliniese trauma- en brandwondedienste: interdissiplinere interne koördinering van die bestuur van die pasiënte: toesig oor die chirurgiese opleidingstudente wat deur die trauma- en transplantrasionele eenhede roteer: versekering van die hoogste standaarde van kliniese, professionele en etiese gedrag: hulpverlening by die onderrig van voorgraadse mediese studente, nagraadse chirurgiese opleidingstudente: uitvoer, help en stimuleer van navorsing binne die etiese riglyne van die Health Care Act: bevordering van opvoeding in traumapreventie en transplantaat-gemeenskapsbewustheid. Fisiese teenwoordigheid by aankoms van toneelroepe en onstabiele gevalle word verwag.

zu.title: Uchwepheshe Wezokwelapha: Izelamoni Nezibotho
zu.summary: Uchwepheshe wezokwelapha eziselameni nezibotho uyafunwa e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, kudingeka i-MBChB, i-FCS(SA) noma i-MMed Surg, nokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengochwepheshe wezelamoni.
zu.requirements: I-MBChB noma okulinganayo; Abafakelwayo kumele babe nelayisensi ezifanele mayelana neziqu eziphezulu zokuhlinza (i-FCS(SA) kanye/noma i-MMad Surg) futhikube ngabhalile njengamanje ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoChwepheshe Wezelamoni. Isitifikedi Sokubhalisa NjengoChwepheshe Wezelamoni. Iziqu Ezengeziwe: ikhosi ye-eFAST, i-MIMMS kanye noma i-ACLS/PALS. Isipiliyoni se-DSTC noma se-Burns. Ukuqede ukulekelelwa kwe-Cert Trauma (SA) sub-specialist. Okukhethwayo kuyobe kuyabanikele abafakelwayo abaqede isivivinyo se-Cert Trauma (SA) sub-specialist. Isipiliyono: Izinga 1: Isipiliyoni asisebenzi kudinga i-Fellowship in Surgery of the College of Medicine of South Africa noma okulinganayo, nokubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa. Abafakelwayo kumele babhaliswe njengochwepheshe ekuhlinzeni ekuqaleni kwemisebenzi. Izinga 2: kudinga iziqu ezifanele, isitifikedi sokubhalisa sochwepheshe kanye neminyaka eyi-5 yesipiliyoni ngemva kokubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoChwepheshe Wezokwelapha Wequelo Loqobo. Izinga 3 kudinga iziqu ezifanele, isitifikedi sokubhalisa sochwepheshe, kanye neminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni ngemva kokubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengoChwepheshe Wezokwelapha Wequelo Loqobo.
zu.duties: Ukubambe iqhaza emisebenzini yezokwelapha ezelameni nasemzimbeni oshisiwe: ukulungiselelana ngaphakathi kwendlu phakathi kwemithimba yezemisebenzi ehlukene ekuphathweni kwabaguli: ukugada abafundi bokuhlinza abasuka baye emthimbeni wezelamoni noku-Shintsha amalungu: ukuqinisekisa amazinga aphezulu kakhulu ekwelapheni, ekuhlonipheni ngomsebenzi, nasekuziphatheni okuyimfanelo: ukusiza ekufundiseni abafundi beziqu ezingaphansi kukachwepheshe, kanye namafundi abahlinzayo ngaphezu kweminyaka: ukwenza, ukusiza, futhi ukukhuthaza ucwaningo ngaphakathi komgwinya oyingqayizivele we-Health Care Act: ukukhuthaza imfundo ekuvikeleni izelamoni nokwazisa imiphakathi ngoku-Shintsha amalungu emzimbeni. Kubalulekile ukuba ukhona ngokomzimba ekufikeni kwezibhamu ezisukuma isigameko nasezimeni ezingazinile.

xh.title: Izigqibo zezempilo: Iingcali zeedlozi nokutsha
xh.summary: Kufunekwe igqwetha lezempilo kwiingcali zeedlozi nokutsha kwi-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, kufuneka ibe nge-MBChB, i-FCS(SA) okanye i-MMed Surg, nokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha weendlebe zeedlozi.
xh.requirements: I-MBChB okanye okulinganayo; Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nelayisenisi esimfaneleyo sezempilo esezantsi (i-FCS(SA) kwaye/okanye i-MMed Surg) kwaye njengangoku babhaliswe kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha weendlebe zeedlozi. Isatifikethi sobhaliso njengesigqibo seengcali zeedlozi. Iziphumo ezingaphezu kwazo: ikhosi ye-eFAST, i-MIMMS kwaye, okanye i-ACLS/PALS. I-DSTC okanye amava okutsha. Uqeqesho olupheleleyo lwe-Cert Trauma (SA) lwengcali encinci. Kuya kubakho inketho abafaka isicelo abaqeqeshwe ngokupheleleyo kuviwo lwe-Cert Trauma (SA) lwengcali encinci. Amava: Inqanaba 1: Amava akafanelekanga, kufuneka kubekho iFellowship in Surgery ye-College of Medicine of South Africa okanye okulinganayo, nobhaliso kwi-HPCSA. Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babhaliswe njengengcali kwiqondo lokusika ekuqaleni komsebenzi. Inqanaba 2: kufuneka kubekho isiqu esimfaneleyo, isatifikethi sobhaliso lweengcali kanaye neyamava eminyaka emi-5 emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengengcali yezempilo eGeneral Surgery. Inqanaba 3: kufuneka kubekho isiqu esimfaneleyo, isatifikethi sobhaliso lweengcali, kanaye neyamava eminyaka eli-10 emva kobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengengcali yezempilo eGeneral Surgery.
xh.duties: Inkululeko kwiinkonzo zeedlozi nokutsha: ukulungelelanisa ngaphakathi iinkonzo phakathi kweendawo ezahlukeneyo ekulawulweni abagulayo: ukulawula abaqeqeshwa bokusika abajikelezayo kwindawo zeedlozi nokuhanjiswa: kuqinisekiswa iindinganiso eziphezulu zokuziphatha ngokwebhayoloji, ngobungcali, nengqondo: ukuncedisa ukufundisa abafundi bezempilo abangaphantsi kwesidanga, abaqeqeshwa abangaphezulu kokusika: ukwenza, ukuncedisa, nokukhuthaza uphando ngaphakathi kwemiqathango yengqondo yeHealth Care Act: ukukhuthaza imfundo ekuthinteleni iingcali zeedlozi nolwazi olutsha kuqoqosho. Kubekho okulindelekileyo ukuba kubekho ngokomzimba ekufikeni kwezibizo zendawo kwaye kubekho iimeko ezingazinzi.

jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in General Surgery (Grades 1-3) at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, with salary up to R2,301,186 per annum.

Grade 2: Appropriate qualification plus five (05) years post registration Experience as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Grade 3: Appropriate qualification plus ten (10) years post registration experience as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery. Senior Certificate /Grade 12 or equivalent, an appropriate tertiary qualification (MBCHB) or equivalent Plus, registration certificate with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in General Surgery Plus Current registration with HPCSA as a Specialist in General Surgery (2026/2027 receipt). FCS (SA) and MMed (Gen Surg), All successful candidates will have to spend minimum 1 year in service and those candidates with FCS and awaiting MMED may apply and will be considered. Knowledge of current Health and Public Servants legislation, regulation and policy, including Medical Ethics, Epidemiology and Statistics. Good communication and human relations Sound knowledge of clinical procedures and protocols within the discipline. Assessment and management of patients. Participate in continuing professional development. Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self- confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationships.

To co-ordinate the Hepatobiliary Unit and Burns of DPKISMH with necessary the necessary surgical and administrative skills. Accept responsibility for administration of anaesthesia. Assess patients, plan, initiate and supervise medical care management. Align clinical service delivery plans with hospital plans and priorities. Willingness to participate in the after- hours call system, with an undertaking to sign a contract to participate in commuted overtime per week, is essential. Develop, maintain and audit the correct implementation of clinical protocols and guidelines. Implement and maintain an efficient, effective and seamless service delivery process within the Institution and referring facilities. Plan and provide continuous medical education to multidisciplinary team members and conduct and stimulate research. Supervision of postgraduate and undergraduate training. Participate in postgraduate and other relevant academic / and training programmes. Participate in the continued medical education programme in the institution. Manage EPMDS of junior staff. Participate in the extended management activities. Develop, implement and monitor quality improvement programmes. Develop and participate in the outreach/in reach programmes. Engage in academic research culminating in the publication of papers in scientific journals or the presentation of the results of such research at scientific congresses Provide support to the Head of Department, in ensuring an efficient standard of patient care and services are maintained. Leadership and decision-making abilities as well as problem solving and conflict management. Knowledge of Human Resource management. Information management and quality assurance. Ensure the proper and economical use of equipment and other resources. Information management and quality assurance. Ensure the proper and economical use of equipment and other resources.

jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Radiology positions at Grades 1 to 3 available at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring HPCSA registration.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Appropriate qualification Plus registration with HPCSA as a Specialist in Radiology. No experience required. Grade 2: Appropriate qualification plus five (05) years post registration experience as a Medical Specialist in Radiology. Grade 3: Appropriate qualification plus ten (10) years post registration experience as a Medical Specialist in Radiology. Senior Certificate/Grade 12. Appropriate qualification in Medicine, e.g. MBChB or equivalent qualification. Appropriate postgraduate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Radiology, e.g. MMed (Radiology) and/or FC Rad (SA) Diag. Knowledge of clinical governance framework and the legislated norms and standards. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Sound knowledge and clinical expertise in Diagnostic Radiology and the appropriate utilisation of relevant imaging modalities, including X-ray, ultrasound, CT, MRI and other specialised imaging services available at the institution. Competence in accurate interpretation and reporting of diagnostic imaging investigations and identification of urgent and life-threatening radiological findings. Competence in performing and/or supervising appropriate image-guided procedures within the scope of practice. Sound knowledge of radiation safety, radiation protection, contrast media safety and patient safety principles. Knowledge and application of relevant clinical guidelines, radiology protocols, professional standards, medical ethics, legislation and Department of Health policies. Strong clinical decision-making, analytical, problem-solving and prioritisation skills, particularly in emergency and high-volume clinical settings. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear and clinically relevant reports and communicate critical findings timeously to referring clinicians. Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team and provide specialist radiological advice to clinical services. Good leadership, supervisory, mentoring and teaching skills, with the ability to supervise and develop Medical Officers, Registrars and junior medical staff. Computer literacy and ability to utilise PACS, RIS and other relevant electronic clinical information systems. Ability to participate in clinical governance, quality assurance, clinical audits, morbidity and mortality reviews and quality-improvement initiatives. Ability to contribute to research, undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, continuing professional development and service development. Ability to manage workload effectively, meet appropriate turnaround times and function independently and under pressure. Ability to contribute to radiology outreach services and strengthen referral and diagnostic support to referring facilities. Commitment to providing safe, ethical, patient-centred and evidence-based specialist radiology services.
jobs.duties: Provide comprehensive and quality specialist radiology services to patients, including interpretation and reporting of radiological investigations and appropriate clinical advice to referring clinicians. Perform and/or supervise appropriate diagnostic and image-guided radiological procedures within the scope of practice and ensure compliance with relevant clinical and safety protocols. Participate in the provision of emergency, after-hours, weekend and public holiday radiology services as required by the institution. Participate in clinical governance activities, including clinical audits, quality assurance programmes, morbidity and mortality reviews, risk management and implementation of quality improvement initiatives. Promote the appropriate and cost-effective utilisation of radiological investigations, equipment, consumables and other departmental resources. Participate in multidisciplinary clinical meetings and provide specialist radiological input to support appropriate diagnosis, management and referral of patients. Provide teaching, training, supervision and mentorship to Registrars, Medical Officers, interns, students and other relevant healthcare professionals. Participate in undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, continuing professional development and academic activities within the institution. Participate in research activities and contribute to the development and implementation of evidence-based radiology practices. Participate in radiology outreach services and provide specialist support to referring healthcare facilities, where required. Contribute to the development, implementation and review of departmental policies, guidelines, protocols and standard operating procedures. Participate in the planning, monitoring and evaluation of radiology services and contribute to improving service delivery, turnaround times and patient outcomes. Ensure accurate clinical documentation, reporting and maintenance of appropriate patient and departmental records. Participate in departmental, institutional and relevant clinical governance meetings and committees. Manage and utilise radiology resources responsibly and contribute to the identification of equipment, infrastructure, staffing and service delivery needs. Maintain professional competence and comply with the requirements of the Health Professions Council of South Africa and relevant Department of Health policies, legislation and regulations. Perform administrative and other duties as delegated by the Head of Clinical Unit/Clinical Manager or relevant supervisor.

Vermoë om werklading doeltreffend te bestuur, toepaslike omkeertye te haal en onafhanklik en onder druk te funksioneer. Vermoë om by te dra tot radiologie-uitreikdienste en verwysings- en diagnostiese ondersteuning aan verwysende fasiliteite te versterk. Toewyding om veilige, etiese, pasiëntgesentrede en bewysgebaseerde spesialisradiologiedienste te verskaf.
af.duties: Verskaf omvattende en gehalte spesialisradiologiedienste aan pasiënte, insluitend interpretasie en verslagdoening van radiologiese ondersoeke en toepaslike kliniese advies aan verwysende klinici. Voer toepaslike diagnostiese en beedgeleide radiologiese prosedures binne die omvang van praktyk uit en/of hou toesig daaroor en verseker nakoming van relevante kliniese en veiligheidsprotokolle. Neem soos deur die instelling vereis deel aan die verskaffing van noodgeval-, na-uur-, naweek- en openbare feesdagradiologiedienste. Neem deel aan kliniese bestuursaktiwiteite, insluitend kliniese oudite, gehalteversekeringprogramme, morbiditeit en mortaliteits hersienings, risikobestuur en implementering van gehalteverbeteringsinisiatiewe. Bevordie toepaslike en kostedoeltreffende benutting van radiologiese ondersoeke, toerusting, verbruikbare items en ander departementele hulpbronne. Neem deel aan multidissiplinêre kliniese vergaderings en verskaf spesialisradiologiese insette om toepaslike diagnose, bestuur en verwysing van pasiënte te ondersteun. Verskaf onderrig, opleiding, toesig en mentorskap aan Registrars, Mediese Offisiere, internec, studente en ander relevante gesondheidsorgprofessionals. Neem deel aan voor- en nagraadse onderrig, deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling en akademiese aktiwiteite binne die instelling. Neem deel aan navorsingsaktiwiteite en dra by tot die ontwikkeling en implementering van bewysgebaseerde radiologiepraktyke. Neem deel aan radiologie-uitreikdienste en verskaf spesialisondersteuning aan verwysende gesondheidsorgfasiliteite, waar vereis. Dra by tot die ontwikkeling, implementering en hersiening van departementele beleide, riglyne, protokolle en standaard bedryfsprosedures. Neem deel aan die beplanning, monitering en evaluering van radiologiedienste en dra by tot die verbetering van dienslewering, omkeertye en pasiëntuitkomste. Verseker akkurate kliniese dokumentasie, verslagdoening en instandhouding van toepaslike pasiënt- en departementele rekords. Neem deel aan departementele, instellings- en relevante kliniese bestuursvergaderings en komitees. Bestuur en benut radiologie-hulpbronne verantwoordelik en dra by tot die identifisering van toerusting, infrastruktuur, personeel en diensleweringsbehoeftes. Handhaaf professionele bevoegdheid en voldoen aan die vereistes van die Health Professions Council of South Africa en relevante Department of Health-beleide, wetgewing en regulasies. Voer administratiewe en ander pligte uit soos gedelegeer deur die Hoof van Kliniese Eenheid/Kliniese Bestuurder of relevante toesighouer.

zu.title: Ochwepheshe Bezokwelapha kwi-Radiology izinga 1, 2 noma 3
zu.summary: Izikhundla zabochwepheshe bezokwelapha kwi-Radiology kwizinga 1 kuye kweyisi-3 zitholakala eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, zidinga ukubhalisele kwi-HPCSA.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Itholakali elifanele futhi libhalise ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe kwi-Radiology. Asikho isidingo senkalo. Izinga 2: Itholakali elifanele kanye neminyaka emihlanu (05) yenkalo emva kokubhalisa njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Radiology. Izinga 3: Itholakali elifanele kanye neminyaka eyishumi (10) yenkalo emva kokubhalisa njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Radiology. Senior Certificate/Grade 12. Itholakali elifanele kwimizwa yomzimba, isb. MBChB noma itholakali elingalingana. Itholakali leziqu elingaphansi kwesikolo esiphakeme elifanele elivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengochwepheshe wezokwelapha kwi-Radiology, isb. MMed (Radiology) kanye/noma FC Rad (SA) Diag. Ulwazi ngesimiso sobuholi bezokwelapha kanye namagugu nemithetho emisiwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuzilolonga kanye Namandla Abalulekile: Ulwazi olujulile namanobumba okwelapha kwi-Diagnostic Radiology nokusetshenziswa okufanele kwemodi yokuthwebula izithombe ezihlobene, okuhlanganisa i-X-ray, i-ultrasound, i-CT, i-MRI nezinye izinsiza ezikhethekile zokuthwebula izithombe ezitholakala esikhungweni. Ukuzenza kahulu ekutolakeni nasekubikeni ngemiphumela yokwelapha ngokuthwebula izithombe kanye nokuqonda imiphumela ebhalayo neyeletha ubungozi. Ukuzenza kahulu ekwenzeni futhi/noma ekubukeleni izindlela ezifanele eziholwa yizithombe ngaphakathi kwezinkambiso zomsebenzi. Ulwazi olujulile ngokuphepha kokushisa, ukuvikelwa kokushisa, ukuphepha kwemfashini yokuqhathanisa kanye nemigaqo yokuphepha komuntu ofundwayo. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa imihlahlandlela ezihlobene yezokwelapha, izimiso ze-radiology, izinga lezobuchwepheshe, izimiso zokuziphatha kwezokwelapha, umthetho kanye nomthethosisekelo womnyango wezezemphilo. Amakhono amahle okwenza izinqumo ezisolile zezokwelapha, ukuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqamba izinhlelo, ikakhulukazi ezimeni eziphuthumayo nasezindaweni ezinomsebenzi omningi. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa ngokubhala nangomlomo, okuhlanganisa ikono lokunika imibiko ecacile neqhula ngokwelapha kanye nokuxoxa ngemiphumela ebalulekile ngokushesha kubachwepheshe abathumelayo. Ikono lokusebenza kahle eqenjini elihlangene kwezinhle kanye nokunika ngelakho njengochwepheshe kwi-radiology ezinsizini zezokwelapha. Amakhono amahle obuholi, okugada, okuyisibonelo nokufundisa, ngekono lokugada futhi uthuthukise abaDayimani, abaFunda iziqu, kanye nabasebenzi bezokwelapha abasezingeni elingaphansi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokusebenzisa i-PACS, i-RIS kanye nezinye izimiso zemininingwane kwekhompyutha. Ikono lokuthatha inxaxheba kokubhunga kwezokwelapha, ukuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi, ukuhlola izokwelapha, ukuhlola ukubhubha nokufa, kanye namaphojekthi okuthuthukisa ikhwalithi. Ikono lokunikela ocwaningweni, ekufundiseni abafundi abasha nabalandelako, ekuthuthukiseni iziqu ezingaphansi kwesikolo esiphakeme, kanye nasekuthuthukiseni insiza. Ikono lokulawula umthwalo kahle, ukuhlangabezana naxesha okufanele futhi usebenze wedwa naphansi komlungiswa. Ikono lokuthatha inxaxheba ezinsizeni zokunikezelwa kwe-radiology kanye nokugcina ezinsizeni ezithumayo futhi unikeze inkxaso ekuqondweni nokuqashwa kwesifo. Ukuzibophezela ekunikezeleni ngokuphepha, ngokuziphatha, kubaluleka komuntu ofundwayo futhi usekelwe ubufakazi njengochwepheshe kwe-radiology.
zu.duties: Nika izinsiza ezibanzi kwaye zingakhela-lahleko zobuchwepheshe kwi-radiology iziguli, okuhlanganisa ukuqonda futhi ubike ngemiphumela yokwelapha ngezithombe, kanye nelakho njengochwepheshe kubachwepheshe abathumelayo. Yenza futhi/noma ugade izindlela ezifanele zokuqapha izithombe nokuqondiswa izithombe ngaphakathi kwenkambiso yomsebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuhlonishwa imithetho nezimiso ezihlobene nezokwelapha nokuphepha. Thatha inxaxheba ekunikezeni izinsiza ze-radiology ezikhathini eziphuthumayo, emva kwamasikhathi okusebenza, ngefasshukilini nangezikhathi zeholide zomphakathi njengoba kudingwa isikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba emisebenzini yobungqangi bezinkambiso, okuhlanganisa ukuhlolwa kokwelapha, amaphojekthi ukuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi, ukuhlola ukubhubha nokufa, ukulawula ubungozi kanye nokusebenzisa amaphojekthi okuthuthukiswa khwalithi. Khuthaza ukusetshenziswa okufanele futhi kungebi kakhulu imiphumela yokwelapha, izinsiza, okusetshenziswa kanye nezinye izinsiza zomnyango. Thatha inxaxheba emihlanganweni yeqembu elihlangene kwezinhle kwaye unikeze ngelakho njengochwepheshe kwe-radiology ukuxhasa ukuqondwa okufanele, ukuphathwa nokuthunyelwa kweziguli. Nikeza ukufundisa, ukuzilolonga, ukugada nokuba yisibonelo abaFundeni iziqu, abaDayimani, abafundi abasha, abafundi kanye nalabo bomnyango wezokwelapha. Thatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni abaphakamile kanye nabafundi abaphakeme, ekuthuthukiseni iziqu kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nemisebenzi yezikolo ngaphakathi kwesikhungo. Thatha inxaxheba emsebenzini wocwaningo futhi unikeze ekuthuthukiseni nasekusebenziseni izimiso ze-radiology ezelwe ubufakazi. Thatha inxaxheba ezinsizeni zokunikezelwa kwe-radiology futhi unikeze inkxaso njengochwepheshe ezinsizeni ezithumayo, lapho kudingeka khona. Nikeza ekuthuthukiseni, ekusebenziseni nasekuhlola imithethosisekelo yomnyango, imihlahlandlela, izimiso kanye namagugu okusebenza abalawulayo. Thatha inxaxheba ekuhlelweni, ekuqapheleleni nasekuhloleni izinsiza kwe-radiology futhi unikeze ekuthuthukiseni ukulethwa kwensiza, izikhathi zokuqeda umsebenzi, kanye nemiphumela yomuntu ofundwayo. Qinisekisa ukushicilela kakhula imibiko nokugcina imibiko elungile yomuntu ofundwayo kanye nomnyango. Thatha inxaxheba kumhlangano kanye nasekubhorenzini komnyango, sesikhungo mayelana nobungqangi kanye namakomidi. Lawula futhi usebenzise ngokubambekayo izinsiza ze-radiology futhi unikeze ekuqondeni izidingo zokutholwa zensiza, izakhiwo, abasebenzi, kanye nezidingo zokulethwa kwensiza. Gcina izinga eliphezulu lobuchwepheshe futhi uhambisane nezidingo ze-Health Professions Council of South Africa kanye nemithethosisekelo yomnyango wezezemphilo, umthetho, kanye nemitheayo. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo kanye neminye njengoba kudluliswe abuNhloko beKlasi/abaphathi bezokwelapha noma kubhekane kanye nawe.

xh.title: Oogqirha abaBanga beRadiology inqanaba 1, 2 OKANE 3
xh.summary: Izithuba zoogqirha abaBanga beRadiology kwizinqanaba 1 ukuya kwi-3 zifumaneka eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, kwaye kufuneka ubhaliswe kwi-HPCSA.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Isidanga esifanelekileyo kunye nobhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oBanga beRadiology. Akukho mfundo yamava efunekayo. Inqanaba 2: Isidanga esifanelekileyo kunye neminyaka emihlanu (05) yamava emva kobhaliso njengoGqirha wezempilo oBanga beRadiology. Inqanaba 3: Isidanga esifanelekileyo kunye neminyaka elishumi (10) yamava emva kobhaliso njengoGqirha wezempilo oBanga beRadiology. Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo/Inqanaba 12. Isidanga esifanelekileyo kuNgcweti, umzekelo i-MBChB okanye isidanga esilinganayo. Isidanga esifanelekileyo se-postgraduate esivumela ubhaliso kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqirha wezempilo oBanga beRadiology, umzekelo i-MMed (Radiology) kunye/nokuba yi-FC Rad (SA) Diag. Ulwazi ngolwakhiwo lolawulo olusembathweni kunye namagunya nemigangatho equlunqiweyo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho noKwazi okuFunekayo: Ulwazi oluzinzileyo nobuchwepheshe obusembathweni ku-Diagnostic Radiology nokusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kwezixhobo ezithunyelwa iimpawu, kuquka i-X-ray, i-ultrasound, i-CT, i-MRI nezinye iinkonzo ezithunyelwa iimpawu ezikhethekileyo ezitholakala kwisiko. Ukwazi ukutolika ngokuchanekileyo nokubika iingxelo zophando oluthunyelwa iimpawu zefundo yokuxilonga nokuchonga iziphumo ezibangeleyo ezingozi ezisemathamsanqweni. Ukwazi ukwenza kunye/nokuba ngumlawuli weenkqubo ezifanelekileyo eziholelwa yimifanekiso ngaphakathi kwemida yomsebenzi. Ulwazi oluzinzileyo ngokhuseleko lweradheyishini, ukhuselwa kwefuthe leradheyishini, ukhuseleko lwezixhobo ezihluxa imifanekiso kunye nemigaqo yokhuseleko lompatient. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa iindlela ezingathatha isigqibo ezifanelekileyo zokuxilonga, iinkqubo zeradiology, imigangatho yomsebenzi, iziko lenkolo yezokwelapha, umthetho namagqabantshihi asebe leNtsholongwane yeMpilo. Amakhono amaninzi okuthatha izigqibo ezingumthetho, okwahlula-hlula, okusombulula iingxaki nokuqamba izinto eziphambili, ngakumbi kwiimeko ezingozi nakwiindawo ezinomthwalo omkhulu wokuxilonga. Amakhono obhalo nakuthetha abalulekileyo, kuquka nokuba nakho ukubaniwe nokuza nengxelo ecacileyo nengalathela kwizigulo kunye nokudlulisa iinkcazelo eziphambili ngexesha elifanelekileyo kugqirha abathumileyo. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokusebenza kahle kwaye usetyenzise iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo njengomntu ogqithisayo kunye nokuza namacebo obuchule obukhethekileyo kwinkonzo yezokuxilonga. Amakhono obuqu kwinkokeli, kulawulo, kwinkqubo yokunceda abafundi nakwinkqubo yokufundisa, kunye nokuba nakho ukulawula kuphuhlise Oogqirha baseMzantsi Afrika, Ababhalisi nakwabanye abasebenzi abasese kobugqirha. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakumbi ngekhompyutha kunye nokuba nakho ukusebenzisa i-PACS, i-RIS kunye nezinye iinkqubo zolwazi oluxhelwe iimpawu. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kwinkqubo yezokulawula iinkonzo, ukwaziswa kokuchaneka kwemigaqo, ukuhlola amagqabantshihi, ukuphonononga ukuswela kwezinto ezibangeleyo ukutshona kwabantu kunye nezinto ezingcazuluswa ngokuphucula imigaqo. Ukuba nakho ukuphucula izinto ezintsha nakwinkonzo, ukufundisa abafundi abangangenangqondo kwi-postgraduate, ukuphuhlisa ulwazi olusemqoka kwinkonzo yomsebenzi nokuphuhlisa iinkonzo. Ukuba nakho ukulawula umthwalo womsebenzi ngokufanelekileyo, ukugqiba kwisikhathi esifanelekileyo nokusebenza ngokuzimela nakwiimeko ezinzima. Ukuba nakho ukuphucula iinkonzo zokuyalela ngaphandle kommandla wesixeko kunye nokulawula ukudluliselwa kolwazi nakwezonyaka kwindawo ethumela iimpawu. Ukuzimisela ukunikela iinkonzo ezikhuselweyo, ezilungileyo ngokusesikweni, ezijolise kumatienti ezingena mthetho ezisekelwe kobufundisi obukhethekileyo beradiology.
xh.duties: Kunikela iinkonzo zeradiology ezikhuselweyo nangomgangatho ophezulu kubathengi bezezempilo, kuquka ukutolika nokubika iziphumo zophando lweradiology kunye nemiceli yenggxebe ebalulekileyo kugqirha abathumayo. Ukwenza nokuba ngumlawuli wee-Nkqubo zokuxilonga nokusetyenziswa kwezixhobo eziholelwa imifanekiso ngaphakathi kwemida yomsebenzi nokucinga ukulandelwa kweenkqubo ezibalulekileyo zokuxilonga nokhuseleko. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekunikeleni iinkonzo zeradiology kwimeko ezibangeleyo, emva kweyure ezinqamlezileyo, ngeweekend nakwiintsuku zorhatyo lomnusi wenrh Early age njengoko kufuneka sisiko. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokulawula inkonzo yokuxilonga, kuquka ukuhlola ulwazi ngokugqibela, iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa umgangatho, ukuphonononga ubunzima nokuswelwa kolwazi, ulawulo lweengozi nokuphuculwa kwemigaqo equlunqiweyo. Ukukhuthaza ukusetenziswa ngokufanelekileyo nangexabiso leziphumo zokuxilonga, izixhobo, izinto ezisetyenziswa nakwzinye izixhobo zesebe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiindibano ezahlukeneyo zokuxilonga nokunikela ingcamango yeradiology ekhethekileyo ukuxhasa ukuxilonga okufanelekileyo, ulawulo nokudluliselwa kwabathengi bezezempilo. Ukunikela isikhokelo, uqeqesho, ulawulo nokuqeqesha abafundi abangenangqondo kwi-postgraduate, Oogqirha baseMzantsi Afrika, abathengi, abafundi nakwabanye abasebenzi basezempiloni. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekufundiseni kwabangenangqondo nase postgraduate, ekuphuhliseni ulwazi lwemisebenzi nakwizinto ezijolise ngeklasi kwisiko. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zophando nokunikela ekuphuculweni nakokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo ze-radiology ezingenamthetho. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkonzo zokuyalela ngaphandle kommandla wesixeko sokuxilonga nokunikela inkxaso ekhethekileyo kwiindawo ezingathumela izigulana ezizezempilo, apho kufuneka khona. Ukuphucula ekuphuhlisweni, ekusebenziseni nakuphononongeni iinkqubo zamagqabantshihi, imigaqo, iinkqubo namagqabantshihi okusebenza aqulunqwe ngokomthetho wokuqhuba iinkonzo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakhiweni, ekulinganisweni nasekugqibeni iinkonzo zeradiology nokunikela ekuphuculeni ukunikwa kwenkonzo, ixesha lokugqiba izinto nakwiziphumo zabathengi. Ukuqinisekisa ukubakho kolwazi oluchanekileyo lokuxilonga, ukubikwa kolwazi nokugcinwa kolwazi lwemigaqo yabathengi nesebe. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwindibano yesebe, yasecaleni kunye namagqabantshihi alawula iinkonzo ezibangelwa ukungabi bikho kolwazi. Ukulawula nokusebenzisa izixhobo zeradiology ngokuzinika iindaba ezifanelekileyo nokunikela ekuchongeni iimpawu zolawulo, izixhobo, abasebenzi nemfuneko yokunikela iinkonzo. Ukugcina amakhono abuchule kwinkonzo nokuhamba nokuqwalasela iimfuno ze-Health Professions Council of South Africa kunye namagqabantshihi alawulo leNtsholongwane yeMpilo, umthetho neemigaqo equlunqiweyo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo yesebe kunye neminye imisebenzi njengoko ibekwe nguMlawuli weNtsholongwane yoGqirha oPhakamileyo/nguMlawuli weNkqubo yokuxilonga okanye ngumlawuli ofanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Nursing Manager (PN-A 9 – Level 3 Hospital)
jobs.summary: Nursing Manager (PN-A9) at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring a nursing degree and 10 years' experience including 5 years at management level.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification Degree/Diploma in General Nursing. Current registration with SANC as General Nurse. A minimum of 10-years appropriate / recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 -years of the period referred to above must be appropriate / recognizable experience at management level. Additional Qualification: Diploma in Midwifery and Diploma/Degree in Nursing Administration and Education Any Speciality in Nursing Experience of Managing Complex Nursing Environment Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of relevant legislative framework governing the public service. Demonstrate an in depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Possess communication skills for dealing with patients, and other members of the multi- disciplinary team including the writing of reports. Good human relations displaying a concern for patients, promoting and advocating patients’ needs and expectations (Batho Pele). High concern for excellence, tenacity and resilience. Leadership and management skills. Problem analysis and decision- making skills. Demonstrate a basic understanding of HR and Financial policies and practices. Demonstrate basic computer literacy as a support tool to enhance service delivery. Ability to plan and organise own work, time and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care in the units. Be able to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Provide guidance and leadership towards the realization of strategic goals and objectives of the nursing division. Provide professional, technical and management support for the provision of quality patient care through proper management of nursing care programs. Advocate and ensure the promotion of nursing ethos and professionalism. Develop and monitor the implementation of policies, programmes, regulations, practices, procedures and standards pertaining to nursing care. Represent Nursing Department in the Senior Management Team. Establish, maintain and participate in inter-professional and multi- disciplinary teamwork that promotes efficient and effective patient care across all domains. Ensure effective management, supervision and utilization of human and material resources. Ensure adherence to prescribed nursing policies and procedures. Supervise and ensure the provision of an effective and efficient patient care through adequate nursing care. Deal with disciplinary and grievance matters. Evaluate and monitor compliance with clinical protocols, norms and standards of the hospital. Participate in implementation and adherence to National Core Standards. Work effectively and amicably with persons of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences.
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: An Application for Employment Form (Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the short listed candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Verpleegbestuurder (PN-A 9 – Vlak 3 Hospitaal)
af.summary: Verpleegbestuurder (PN-A9) by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, vereis 'n verpleeggraad en 10 jaar se ervaring insluitend 5 jaar op bestuursvlak.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie Graad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Huidige registrasie by SANC as Algemene Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 10-jarige toepaslike / erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 5-jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike / erkende ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Bykomende Kwalifikasie: Diploma in Vroedkunde en Diploma/Graad in Verpleegadministrasie en -onderrig. Enige Spesialiteit in Verpleging. Ervaring in die bestuur van 'n komplekse verpleegomgewing. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van die tersaaklike wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare diens beheer. Toon 'n diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Besit kommunikasievaardighede vir die hantering van pasiënte en ander lede van die multidissiplinêre span, insluitend die skryf van verslae. Goeie menslike verhoudings wat besorgdheid oor pasiënte toon, en pasiënte se behoeftes en verwagtinge bevorder en onderskryf (Batho Pele). Hoë strewe na uitmuntendheid, deursettingsvermoë en veerkragtigheid. Leierskap- en bestuursvaardighede. Probleemontleding en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR- en finansiële beleide en praktyke. Toon basiese rekenaargeletterdheid as 'n ondersteuningsmiddel om dienslewering te verbeter. Vermoë om eie werk, tyd en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg in die eenhede te verseker. Wees in staat om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Bied leiding en leierskap tot die verwesenliking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke van die verpleegafdeling. Bied professionele, tegniese en bestuursondersteuning vir die verskaffing van gehalte-pasiëntesorg deur behoorlike bestuur van verpleegsorgprogramme. Onderskryf en verseker die bevordering van verpleegetos en profesionaliteit. Ontwikkel en monitor die implementering van beleide, programme, regulasies, praktyke, prosedures en standaarde rakende verpleegsorg. Verteenwoordig die Verpleegdepartement in die Senior Bestuurspan. Stel in stand en neem deel aan interprofessionele en multidissiplinêre spanwerk wat doeltreffende en effektiewe pasiëntesorg oor alle domeine bevorder. Verseker effektiewe bestuur, toesig en benutting van menslike en materiële hulpbronne. Verseker nakoming van voorgeskrewe verpleegbeleide en -prosedures. Toesig hou en die verskaffing van effektiewe en doeltreffende pasiëntesorg deur toereikende verpleegsorg verseker. Hanteer dissiplinêre en grieweangeleenthede. Evalueer en monitor nakoming van kliniese protokolle, norme en standaarde van die hospitaal. Neem deel aan implementering en nakoming van Nasionale Kerntandaarde. Werk effektief en saam met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienste verskille.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokunakekela Abagulayo (PN-A 9 – Level 3 Hospital)
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezokunakekela Abagulayo (PN-A9) e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, ofuna idigri yokunakekela abagulayo kanye namawemu we-10 okuhlolwe kuhlanganise amawemu angu-5 ezingeni lokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-R425 Degree/Diploma eNokunakekela Ngokujwayelekile Abagulayo. Ukubhalisa okwamanje ne-SANC njengesiguli esinakekela ngokujwayelekile. Uhambo olungenangaphansi kwamawemu angu-10 ohlolwayo / oluqashwayo lokunakekela abagulayo emva kokubhalisa njengesiGuli esinakekela ngobuchwepheshe ne-SANC eNokunakekela Ngokujwayelekile. Okungenani iminyaka engu-5 kwesikhathi esisho ngenhla kumele ibe yohambo oluhlolwayo / oluqashwayo ezingeni lokuphatha. Iziqu Ezengeziwe: i-Diploma eNokunakekela Abesifazane Abakhulelwe kanye ne-Diploma/Degree eNokuphathwa Kwezokunakekela Abagulayo Nakemfundo. Nakuyiphi inhlobonhlobo eNokunakekela Abagulayo. Uhamo lokuphatha Indawo Enzima Yokunakekela Abagulayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uKufundisa kanye namaKhono Adingekayo: Ulwazi ngohlelo lomthetho oluhlelekile olubheka umphakathi wokwenza izinsiza. Kubonise ukuqonda okujulile ngomthetho wezokunakekela abagulayo kanye nemikhuleko yomthetho nezokuziphatha okuhlobene nokunakekela abagulayo. Kubambe amakhono okuxhumana okuyokusebenzisa nabagulayo, nakwezinye izitho zendawo yokusebenza khona nabantu bamaselula abangenamkhawulo okuhlanganise nokubhala imibiko. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu obubonisa ukukhathazeka ngabagulayo, ukukhuthaza futhi ukumela izidingo nokulindelekile kwabagulayo (Batho Pele). Ukukhathazeka okuphezulu ngokuphumelela, ukubekezela nokumelana nezenzo ezinzima. Amakhono okuhola kanye nokuphatha. Amakhono okuhlaziya izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo. Kubonise ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kwezinqumomngcele zokuphatha nabantu kanye nezimali. Kubonise ulwazi oluyisisekelo lwesikhompyutha njengesixhosi sokweseka ukulethwa kwezinsiza. Ikono lokuhlela futhi ahothe umsebenzi wakhe, isikhathi nesesiguli sokusekela ukuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa okufanele kwabagulayo emagumeni. Akakwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi koxandhoko.
zu.duties: Nikeza isiqondiso kanye nokuhola ngasikhondlakhondla ukufeza amagemu abhekene nomgomo wokuqonda izinjongo zokunakekelwa kwabagulayo. Nikeza isiseko senkonzo, ubuchwepheshe kanye nonkululeko wokweseka ukulethwa kokukhululeka kwabagulayo ngokuphatha ngendlela efanele imigomo yokunakekelwa. Kukhulule futhi uqinisekise ukukhuthaza izinkambiso zokunakekela abagulayo kanye nokuziphatha ngobungcweti. Butha kanye nokubheka ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumomngcele, amagumu, imithetho, izenzo, izinqumo kanye namazinga ahlobene nokunakekelwa kwabagulayo. Yima isikhundla sikaMnnyango Wezokunakekela Abagulayo kuHlelo Labaphathi Abaphezulu. Sima, sihlale futhi ukuthi ngaphakathi kobudlelwano phakathi kwezinkathazi nakulabo bamaselula abangenangomkhawulo okukhuthaza ukunakekelwa kwabagulayo okusebenza kahle nakho konke okusemabhizinisini. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo, ukulawula kanye nokusebenzisa abantu nemithi eya ekudingweni. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nemithetho yokunakekela abagulayo ezeqanjwe. Lawula kanye nokusekela ukulethwa kokunakekelwa okusebenzayo nakokuqhuthekayo abagulayo ngokunakekelwa abafanele. Cophela izindaba zokungaphathwa kahle kwezindlebe zomuzi. Hlola futhi ubheke ukuhambisana nemigomo yobuchwepheshe, imithetho kanye namazinga esibhedlela. Ngamunye ekusetshenzisweni kanye nokuhambisana namazinga abekwe yizwe. Sebenza ngempumelelo futhi ngobuhlobo nabantu abamehluko okuhlukene ngokocansi, izinkolelo, izinhlobonhlobo noma inkolo.

xh.title: Umongikazi oLawulayo (PN-A 9 – Inqanaba lesi-3 Isibhedlele)
xh.summary: Umongikazi oLawulayo (PN-A9) e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, efunayo isidanga se-mongikazi kunye neminyaka eli-10 yamava ebandakanya iminyaka eli-5 kwinqanaba lolawulo.
xh.requirements: Izidanga se-R425 Degree/Diploma ekunyamekelweni abaguli abalimele. Ukubhaliswa ngokusesikweni kwi-SANC njengomongikazi onolwazi. Ukuba nawolwazi oluncedisayo / olubonakalayo oluqikelelo kwiminyaka elingama-10 ekunyamekelweni abaguli emva kokubhaliswa njengomongikazi ongumsebenzi oqotho kwi-SANC ekunyamekelweni abaguli abalimele. Okona kancinci kwiminyaka elingama-5 kuloo mikhondo elicinyuliweyo ngasentla kufuneka ibengolwazi olufanelekileyo / olubonakalayo kwinqanaba lolawulo. Izidanga ezongezelelweyo: Degree kwiMidwifery kunye noDiploma/Degree ekulawuleni abantwana bemithombo yolwazi ekunyamekelweni abaguli nolondolozo lwemfuno yamalungu. Ulwazi ngokulawula indawo enkulu yamagumbi okugula apho abaguli banyamekelwa. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho nokuQonda okufunekayo: Ukuqonda imigaqo-nkqango echaza indlela ezisoloko zisetyenziswa kuluntu olukwisiphithiphithi. Bonisa ukuqonda okuphangileyo ngomthetho wokunyamekela abaguli kunye nemigaqo-nkqango ethe nkqo yokunyamekela abaguli ngendlela ekusemthethweni nephatha wonke umntu ngokulingana. Amandla okuthetha nabantu nabaninyamekela abaguli, nabo bonke abantu bakwigumbi lokusebenza elibandakanya iindidi ezahlukeneyo zabantu abaqeqeshekileyo kuquka ukubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Nika inkqaso nolawulo ngakumbi ekufezweni iinjongo ezibalulekileyo kunye namaphupu ahlukeneyo ekwikomitye yokuqatha ekugqithela kwindawo ekuyo. Nika inkxaso yamabango, yobuchwepheshe kunye yolawulo kwkuqatshwa kwabaguli abanolwazi kunye nabasebenzisi bomgcini wamalungu akwisiphithiphithi soluntu olubandakanya ukubhalwa kwemibiko. Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu obubonisa ukukhathaleka ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza nokhusela iimfuno zabo kunye nethemba labaguli (iBatho Pele). Ukukhathaleka ngokuphawulekayo ngokufezekisa izinto ngendlela ecacileyo, ukungahambi tsho nokuba nomonde. Amandla okukhokela nolawula. Amandla okuhlola iingxaki nokuthatha iigqibo. Bonisa ukuqonda okusesisekelu kwimigaqo kunye namacebiso eeHR. Bonisa ulwazi olusesisekelu lwesebenzisa ikhompyutha njengesixhaso ekuphuculeni iinkonzo. Amandla okucwangcisa nokuqamba umsebenzi wakhe, ixesha nakwabasebenzi abamfanelayo ukunika isiqinisekiso sokuba kukho ukunyamekela kakuhle ukugula ekumangqa. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ixesha elinzima.

Ensure sound labour relations in compliance with the relevant legislation while maintaining the interest of the patients. Participate in outreach programmes. Provide training for nurses, junior staff, interns and medical students. Examination, diagnosis and total management of Orthopaedic Patients. Identification and management of emergencies.

af.title: Mediese Offisiere
af.summary: Mediese offisiere gesoek vir Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal om noodgevallesorg, saalrondes en 24-uur kliniese dekking met gepaardgaande oortyd te bied.
af.requirements: Vlak 1: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Vlak 2: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat met 'n minimum van vyf (05) jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Offisier na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Vlak 3: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat met 'n minimum ervaring van 10 jaar toepaslike Ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn. Senior Certificate, 'n Toepaslike tersiêre kwalifikasie (MBChB) Plus, Registrasiesertifikaat by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Voltooiing van Gemeenskapsdiens is verpligtend. Gemeenskapsdiens offisiers sal nie oorweeg word nie. Vermoë om die behoefte te identifiseer en dienooreenkomstig te verwys. Handhaaf behoorlike mediese rekords. Kennis van die kliniese bestuursraamwerk en die wetgewende norme en standaarde. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Degelike kommunikasie, onderhandeling, beplanning, organisasie, leierskap, besluitneming en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre spanopset te werk. Beskik oor kennis en vaardighede in basiese kliniese sorg. Vermoë om pasiënte onafhanklik te bestuur. Vermoë om te werk en betekenisvolle verhoudings met 'n diverse gemeenskap te handhaaf. Vermoë om 'n positiewe bydrae in 'n besige departement te lewer. Veerkrag en vermoë om met verandering te cope. Addisionele nagraadse kursusse (ACLS, BLS, ATLS ens.) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Basiese kennis van mediese praktyketiek. Ongeëndorseerde geldige kode B bestuurderslisensie (Kode 08).
af.duties: Verantwoordelikheid vir die sorg van pasiënte by die noodgevalledepartement. Neem deel aan 24-uur kliniese dekking deur gepaardgaande oortyd te verrig. Bywoning van saalrondes en deelname aan die akademiese programme. Verskaf aanvanklike ressusitasie en sorg van pasiënte. Verseker dat die wetenskaplike beginsels van kliniese sorg gehandhaaf word. Verseker kliniese doeltreffendheid en effektiewiteit. Neem deel aan kliniese ouditprogramme soos wanneer geskeduleer. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Neem deel aan doeltreffende bestuur van klagtes en pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle. Verseker nakoming van huidige wetgewende en etiese beginsels. Verseker goeie arbeidsverhoudinge in ooreenstemming met die tersaaklike wetgewing terwyl die belange van die pasiënte gehandhaaf word. Neem deel aan uitreikprogramme. Verskaf opleiding vir verpleegkundiges, junior personeel, internes en mediese studente. Ondersoek, diagnose en totale bestuur van Ortopediese Pasiënte. Identifisering en bestuur van noodgevalle.

zu.title: Oswela Kwezokwelapha
zu.summary: Bafunwa oswele bezokwelapha esibhedlela i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal ukunikeza nokwelaphwa okuphuthumayo, ukuhamba emawadeni kanye nokubakho ngokwelapha amahora angu-24 ngenkathi kwenziwa i-overtime.
zu.requirements: Grade 1: Isifundo esifanelekile esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesiNgqongqoshe Wezokwelapha. Grade 2: Isifundo esifanelekile esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesiNgqongqoshe Wezokwelapha nenhlanganisela yeminyaka engu-five (05) yokuhlola okufanelekile njengeswela bezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesiNgqongqoshe Wezokwelapha. Grade 3: Isifundo esifanelekile esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesiNgqongqoshe Wezokwelapha nenhlalo yeminyaka eyi-10 yokuhlola okufanelekile njengesiNgqongqoshe Wezokwelapha. Senior Certificate, Isifundo sethu esifanelekile (MBChB) Futhi, Isitifiketi sokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesiNgqongqoshe Wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa okwamanje kwi-HPCSA njengesiNgqongqoshe Wezokwelapha. Ukugcwaliseka kwe-Community Service kuyiyimpoqo. Oswele be-Community Service angeke bacatshangelwe. Ikghono lokuhlonza isidingo bese kubhekiswa ngokufanele. Ukugcina amarekhodi wezokwelapha ahleli kahle. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokulawula izokwelapha kanye namagugu nemithetho edingwayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho kanye noKghonayo okudingekayo: Amaxoxo ahleliwe, izinkulumo eziyisivumelwano, ukuhlelela, ukuhlelela, ubuholi, ukwenza izinqumo namakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ikghono lokusebenza eqenjini elihlukahlukene lamagatsha. Ukuba nolwazi namakhono ekunakekelweni okuyisisekelo kwezokwelapha. Ikghono lokuphatha abaguleli ngokuzimele. Ikghono lokusebenza futhi ukugcina ubudlelwano obunenjongo nomphakathi ohlukahlukene. Ikghono lokufaka isandla esihle esigatsheni esidumingayo. Ukuqina kanye nokghono ukumelana noshintsho. Amakosi weziqu e-postgraduate (ACLS, BLS, ATLS etc.) kungaba yinzuzo. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngobugiginya bemithetho yezokwelapha. Ilayisense eseqinise ephephile i-code B ekadereva (Code 08)
zu.duties: Inxibelelwano yonakekelo lwabaguleli esigabeni sezokwelapha ephuthumayo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekubakhoi ngokwelapha amahora angu-24 ngokwenza i-overtime. Ukuhamba emawadeni nokuthatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lwezemfundo. Ukunikeza ukuvuselela kokuqala, kanye nokunakekelwa kwabaguleli. Qinisekisa ukuthi imigaqo yesayensi yokunakekelwa ngokwelapha igcinwe. Qinisekisa ukusebenza nokusebenza kahle ngokwelapha. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokuhlola izokwelapha lapho kuhlelwa khona. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokuthuthukisa izinga. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuphathweni okuhle kwezikhupho kanye nezensho zokuphepha kwabaguleli. Qinisekisa ukulandelana kwemithetho yamanje mayelana namanani nemigiginya. Qinisekisa ubuhle bezindaba zomsebenzi ngokulandela imithetho ehlobene ngelapho kugcinwa kuthakazelwa izinkomombo zabaguleli. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ohlelweni lokunikeza usizo olungeni eduzane. Ukunikeza uqeqesho koswetse abasiza, abasebenzi abancane, abaqeqeshi kanye nabafundi bezokwelapha. Ukuhlola, ukuxilonga nokuphatha ngokuphelele abaguleli be-Orthopaedic. Ukuhlola kuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo.

xh.title: Oogqirha Bezempilo
xh.summary: Kufunwa oogqirha bezempilo kwiDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ukunika unyango oluphuthumayo, ukuzonkqoza kwiwardi nokugqitha iureyile yenyanga namazwe angama-24 zolonwabo lomsebenzi ongaphaya kweyure.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ubhaliso kuHPCSA njengoGqirha weZempilo. Inqanaba 2: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ubhaliso kuHPCSA njengoGqirha weZempilo ngenani elingaphantsi kweminyaka emihlanu (05) yamava afanelekileyo njengoGqirha weZempilo emva kobhaliso kuHPCSA njengoGqirha weZempilo. Inqanaba 3: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ubhaliso kuHPCSA njengoGqirha weZempilo namava angaphaya kweminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengoGqirha weZempilo. Isatifikethi seSiniyare, Isifundo sezidanga esifanelekileyo (MBChB) Kananjalo, Isatifikethi sobhaliso kuHPCSA njengoGqirha weZempilo. Ubhaliso lwangoku kuHPCSA njengoGqirha weZempilo. Ukugqiba iInkonzo yoLuntu yinyanzela. Abasebenzi beInkonzo yoLuntu abayi kubanjwa ngqondo. Amandla okuqonda isidingo sokuthumela umntu kwindawo efanelekileyo ngokufanelekileyo. Ukugcina iirekhodi ezifanelekileyo zezempilo. Ulwazi ngeyoreyim yobulungiselelo bezempilo nangenqanaba nemigaqo esemthethweni. Ensure sound labour relations in compliance with the relevant legislation while maintaining the interest of the patients. Participate in outreach programmes. af.requirements: Vlak 1: Geskikte kwalifikasie wat registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Vlak 2: Geskikte kwalifikasie wat registrasie by HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat met 'n minimum van vyf (05) jaar geskikte ervaring as Mediese Beampte na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn. Vlak 3: Geskikte kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn toelaat met 'n minimum ervaring van 10 jaar geskikte Ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn. Senior Sertifikaat, 'n Geskikte tersiêre kwalifikasie (MBChB) Plus, Registrasiesertifikaat by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Voltooiing van Gemeenskapsdiens is verpligtend. Gemeenskapsdiensbeamptes sal nie oorweeg word nie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Degelike kommunikasie-, onderhandelings-, beplannings-, organiseer-, leierskaps-, besluitneming- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre spanomgewing te werk. Oor kennis & vaardighede in basiese kliniese sorg beskik. Vermoë om pasiënte onafhanklik te bestuur. Vermoë om werk te doen en betekenisvolle verhoudings met 'n diverse gemeenskap te handhaaf. Vermoë om 'n positiewe bydrae in 'n besige departement te maak. Veerkragtigheid en vermoë om met verandering te cope. Bykomende nagraadse kursusse (ACLS, BLS, ATLS ens.) sal 'n bygevoegde voordeel wees. Basiese kennis van mediese praktyksetiek. Ongeëndorsede geldige kode B-bestuurslisensie (Kode 08). Vermoë om die behoefte te identifiseer en dienooreenkomstig te verwys. Kennis van kliniese bestuursraamwerk en diegewette vasgelêde norme en standaarde.

Bywoning van saalrondtes en deelname aan die akademiese programme. Verskaf aanvanklike resussiterings- en peri-operatiewe kliniese sorg van pasiënte. Verseker dat die wetenskaplike beginsels van kliniese sorg gehandhaaf word. Verseker kliniese doeltreffendheid en doeltreffenheid. Neem deel aan kliniese ouditprogramme soos en wanneer geskeduleer. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Neem deel aan effektiewe bestuur van klagtes en pasiëntveiligheidsinsidente. Verseker nakoming van huidige wetgewende en etiese beginsels. Verseker goeie arbeidsverhoudinge in ooreenstemming met die relevante wetgewing terwyl die belange van die pasiënte gehandhaaf word. Neem deel aan uitreikprogramme. Verskaf opleiding vir verpleegsters, junior personeel, internships en mediese studente. Ondersoek, diagnose en algehele bestuur van Ortopediese Pasiënte. Identifisering en bestuur van noodgevalle. Handhaaf behoorlike mediese rekords.
