Grade 2: Vyf (5) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die SACP as 'n apteker. Ses (6) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n apteker by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsberoepsraad ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Grade 3: Dertien (13) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die SACP as 'n apteker. – Veertien (14) jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as 'n apteker by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsberoepsraad ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Inklusiewe salarispakket: 70% en 30% buigsame gedeelte kan herstruktureer word. Senior Certificate STD 10 / Grade 12 plus 'n Nasionale Diploma / Graad in Farmasie plus, Huidige registrasie as 'n Apteker by die SAPC plus, registrasie as 'n Apteker by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsberoepsraad ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig soos in Suid-Afrika vereis nie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Rekenaargeletterdheid en ongewysigde geldige Code B-bestuurslisensie (Code 08). Deeglike kennis van wetgewing van toepassing op apteekpraktyke. Spanbou-, konflikbestuurs- en analitiese vaardighede. Toepaslike kliniese en teoretiese kennis. Professionele strewing na uitnemendheid. Deeglike interpersoonlike, kommunikasie, beplannings- en organiseringsvaardighede. Deeglike kennis van Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en werknemerverhoudingswetgewing. Bereidwilligheid om aptekerassistente en internskappe te tutoreer en te mentor. Kennis van die beginsels van voorraadaanvulling en die bedryf van 'n apteekwinkel. Rekenaargeletterdheid vir die voorsiening van voorskrifdienste aan pasiënte. Om kostedoeltreffende, hoë gehalte farmaseutiese dienste aan pasiënte, sale en klinieke te bied binne alle toepaslike wetgewing.
af.duties: Onderhou akkurate en toepaslike rekords in ooreenstemming met regvereistes. Verskaffing van farmaseutiese dienste aan sale en departemente. Verskaffing van farmaseutiese dienste deur voorskrifte te dispenseer. Neem deel aan apteekverwante komitees (PTC, Antibiotiese Beheer en Farmakowagzaamheid. Raak betrokke by doeltreffende kommunikasie met departemente en diensverskaffers om te verseker dat hoë diensgehalte gelewer word. Onderhou behoorlike gebruik en sorg van alle hulpbronne en verseker optimale benutting. Verrig standby-pligte en oortyd wanneer vereis (buite-ure dienste). Neem deel aan geskofte werksure om pasiënttoegang tot medisyne te verbeter volgens rooster. Beplan eie werk en administreer werkprosedures om die doelwitte vir die departement te bereik en sodoende doeltreffende dienslewering te verseker. Doen aanbevelings ten opsigte van beleide / strategieë vir die doeltreffende funksionering van die apteekdepartement. Bystand en opleiding aan personeel volgens departementele vereistes. Wees bereid om 'n tutor vir studente en internskappe te wees. Verseker implementering, monitering en evaluering van EPMDS (Aptekerassistent. Onderhou voorraadvlakke en verseer beskikbaarheid van medisyne. Implementering van die Standaardprosedures, goeie apteekpraktyk, norme en standaarde ten opsigte van die verkryging, berging en dispenseering van farmaseutiese produkte. Stel medicynbeskikbaarheidsverslae op en ontleed dit en neem korrektiewe maatreëls om medicynvoorraadtekorte te voorkom.

zu.title: Umuthi-wezokwelapha Izinga 1, 2 & 3
zu.summary: Izikhundla sezabathinti bemithi kumazinga 1 kuya ku-3 e-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, esidinga ukubhalisa ku-SAPC kanye nokuqashwa kweminyaka yohlelolo ehlukene.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Ithifikhethi elifanelekile kanye nokubhalisa ku-SAPC njengomuthi-wezokwelapha - Unyaka owodwa (1) weminyaka yohlelelo emva kokubhalisa njengomuthi-wezokwelapha eqhutshwa isikhungo sezokunakekelwa kwabezempilo sanamanye amazanga ngokubhekise kubasebenzi bokuqashiwe kumazwe ngaphandle abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengokuqashiwe e-South Africa. Izinga 2: Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yohlelelo emva kokubhalisa ku-SACP njengomuthi-wezokwelapha. Iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yohlelelo emva kokubhalisa njengomuthi-wezokwelapha eqhutshwa isikhungo sezokunakekelwa kwabezempilo sanamanye amazanga ngokubhekise kubasebenzi bokuqashiwe kumazwe ngaphandle abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengokuqashiwe e-South Africa. Izinga 3: Iminyaka eyishumi nantathu (13) yohlelelo emva kokubhalisa ku-SACP njengomuthi-wezokwelapha. – iminyaka eyishumi nane (14) yohlelelo emva kokubhalisa njengomuthi-wezokwelapha eqhutshwa isikhungo sezokunakekelwa kwabezempilo sanamanye amazanga ngokubhekise kubasebenzi bokuqashiwe kumazwe ngaphandle abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengokuqashiwe e-South Africa. Iphakheji yeholo ehlanganisa konke: 70% kanye namaphesenti angu-30 angahlukaniswa kabusha. Isitifiketi samatungo ephezulu STD 10 / Izinga 12 kanye ne-Diploma yezwe / I-degree ku-Pharmacy kanye nokubhalisa okwamanje njengomuthi-wezokwelapha ku-SAPC kanye nokubhalisa njengomuthi-wezokwelapha eqhutshwa isikhungo sezokunakekelwa kwabezempilo sanamanye amazanga ngokubhekise kubasebenzi bokuqashiwe kumazwe ngaphandle, abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi, njengokuqashiwe e-South Africa. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa kanye Nokuqonda Okudingekayo: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nelesihephu likashayeli lesimemo esikhona se-Code B (Code 08). Ulwazi oluqinile ngezomthetho ezihambisana namashebe epharmacy. Ukwakha iqhaza, ukuphatha izinkinga kanye namakhono okuhlaziya. Ulwazi olufanelekile lwezokwelapha kanye nolwazi ngomlando wokusebenza. Inkathi yokukhathalela ngobuciko. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, okuthintana, ukwelula kanye nokuqoqwa okuqinile. Ulwazi oluqinile ngokuqeqeshwa kwabantu kanye nomthetho wohlelo lohlelo nabasebenzi. Isifiso sokufundisa futhi uholele abasizi bocomuthi-wezokwelapha kanye ne-abasheshisekelo. Ulwazi ngemigomo yesibalo sokugcwalisa izitoko kanye nokusebenza kwe-Sitore se-Pharmacy. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ukwenzela ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokunikeza imithi kubagula. Ukunikeza izinkonzo zokunakekelwa ngezemithi ezilungile, ezingabizi kakhulu kubagula, amawadi kanye namakliniki ngaphakathi kwawo wonke umthetho osebenzayo.
zu.duties: Gcina irekhodi eqinisekisiwe elifanelekile ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho. Ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokunakekelwa ngemithi emawadi nasezikhungweni. Ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokunakekelwa ngemithi ngokunika imithi. Ukubamba iqhaza emakomidi ahlobene nepharmacy (PTC, Antibiotic Stewardship kanye ne-Pharmacovigilance). Ukuxhumana ngokusebenzayo nasezikhungweni kanye nabahlinzeka ukwenzela ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inkonzo ezinga eliphezulu inikezwa. Gcina ukusetshenziswa okufanelekile nokunakekelwa kwayo yonke imithombo futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okuhle kahle. Yenza imisebenzi yokulalela futhi ukwenze isikhathi esidingekayo uma kudingeka (inkonzo yemuva kwamahora). Bamba iqhaza emahora wokusebenza ahlukene ukuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwabagula kumithi njengoba kushiwo ohlelweni. Cwebeza umsebenzi wakho futhi uphathe izinqubo zomsebenzi ukufeza imigomo yesikhungo ukuze kuqinisekiswa ukulethwa kwenkonzo esebenzayo. Nikela ngeminikelo ngokuvunyelwa ngemigomo / amasu ngeqhaza elisebenzayo lepharmacy. Siza futhi uqeqeshe abasebenzi ngokuvunyelwa kwezidingo zesikhungo. Zibe nokuthanda ukuba nguthisha kubafundi kanye ne-abasheshisekelo. Qoqa, ulalele kanye nokuhlaziya isikhathi sabasebenzi (Pharmacist Assistant). Gcina izinga lesitoko kanye nokutholakala kwemithi. Ukuhlelwa kwezinqubo eziyisisekelo, amashebe amahle epharmacy, amagunya kanye namazinga ngokuvunyelwa kokuthenga, ukulondoloza kanye nokunika imithi. Hlela kanye uhlaziye imibiko yetholakalo lemithi futhi uthathe izinyathelo zokulungisa ukuvimbela ukungalitholi kwemithi kusetoko.

xh.title: Umenzi wamayeza weGredi 1, 2 no-3
xh.summary: Izithuba zomenzi wamayeza kwiGredi 1 ukuya kwi-3 eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, ezifuna ukubhalisa kwi-SAPC namanqanaba ahlukeneyo emava.
xh.requirements: IGredi 1: Ikhwalifayeshini efanelekileyo nokubhalisa kwi-SAPC njengomenzi wamayeza - Umva womnye (1) unyaka kwiinkalo ezifanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengomenzi wamayeza kwikhonsathi yamachiza echazwe ngamazwe ngokubhekisele kwi basebenzi abagqithiswe ngamazwe abangekafunelwa ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. IGredi 2: Ishumi elihlanu (5) leminyaka yomva ofanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-SACP njengomenzi wamayeza. Lishumi elithandathu (6) leminyaka yomva ofanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengomenzi wamayeza kwikhonsathi yamachiza echazwe ngamazwe ngokubhekisele kwi basebenzi abagqithiswe ngamazwe abangekafunelwa ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. IGredi 3: Lishumi elithathu (13) leminyaka yomva ofanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-SACP njengomenzi wamyeza. – Lishumi eline (14) leminyaka yomva ofanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa njengomenzi wamayeza kwikhonsathi yamachiza echazwe ngamazwe ngokubhekisele kwi basebenzi abagqithiswe ngamazwe abangekafunelwa ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Iphakheji yomvuzo equlathe yonke into: Amaphesenti angama-70% namaphesenti angama-30% elunga nokuqulathwa anokuqulunqwa kwakhona. Isatifikethi Samaxweshe eSTD 10 / iGredi 12 ogqithiseyo nesiDiploma / iSidanga seSizwe kwiPharmacy ogqithiseyo, ukubhalisa okwangoku njengomenzi wamayeza kwi-SAPC, nokubhalisa njengomenzi wamayeza kwikhonsathi yamachiza echazwe ngamazwe ngokubhekisele kwi basebenzi abagqithiswe ngamazwe abangekafunelwa ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi njengoko kufuneka eSouth Africa. Ulwazi, Amakhono eNqanaba eliphezulu, uQeqesho neNtshukumo eFunekayo: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha neLayisensi evakalayo ekhethwe ikhodi B (Ikhodi 08). Ulwazi olululo ngemithetho esebenza kwiNqanaba eliphezulu lezenzo zePharmacy. Ukwakha iqela, ulawulo lwemincadi n.amakhono okuhlalutya. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lokusesikweni nolwaz olunxulumene namachaza. Inkathalo yomsebenzi yomgangatho ophezulu. Aakhoni amakhono okuhamba nabantu, apha ukuthetha, ukucwangcisa nokuhlela. Ulwazi olululo ngolawulo lwamabayi bezemidlalo nomthetho ohlobene noququzelelo. Ukuzimisela ukufundisa nokukhokela abalawuli bomenzi wamayeza nabaqeqeshi. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yokuzaliswa kwesitokhwe nokusebenza kweNqanaba eliphezulu legumbi lokugcina amayeza. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ukuhlinzeka ngolonakalo lokwabelana amayeza kumagula abafundi. Ukunika ukhuseleko ngokweendleko eziphantsi, inkonzo yemfutshane yamayeza kumagula, amawadi nasezikhulwini ngaphakathi kwawo onke amathetho.
xh.duties: Gcina amarekhodi achanileyo afanelekileyo ngokwemigaqo yomthetho. Uhlinzeko lwamayeza kwawawadi nakumasebe. Uhlinzeko lwamayeza ngokuwabelana amayeza athengwayo. Thatha inxaxheba kumakomiti ahlobene namayeza (i-PTC, uLawulo lwe-antibiotic nokuQwalasela ukuCoceka kweyeza). Xhumana kakuhle kwaye usebenzise ukuqondana namasebe nabaniki besebenza ukuqinisekisa uluntu lweNqanaba eliphezulu. Zigcina ukusebenza kakuhle kwaye ugqamise ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanileyo kwamayeza. Umsebenzi wokulinda oluqhuba phantsi kweekhondo nangaphezu kweenyanga ekuyimfuneko (inkonzo emva kweyure). Thatha inxaxheba kwiyure ezahlulahlula ukuphucula ukungena kwamagula amayeza ngokwesikhasana. Cwangcisa umsebenzi ngokwakho uze ulawule iinkqubo zomsebenzi ukuze ufikelele ekujolisweni kumasebe ukuqinisekisa uluntu olusebenzayo. Nikeza izindululo ngamagqabantshintshi / amacebo okusebenza kwaye asebenze kakuhle kuPharmacy. Nceda uze uqeqeshe amalungu ngokwemfuno yomthetho. Zibalulise ukuba ngutitshala kwabafundi nabaqeqeshi. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa nokuqwalasela i-EPMDS (Umlawuli womenzi wamayeza). Gcina iNqanaba lesitokhwe nokuqinisekisa ukubakho kwamayeza. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo eziqhelweyo, ukuziphatha okuhle kumayeza, imilinganiselo nemiQathango ngokubhekisele kwindlela yokufumana, ukugcina nokubhaga amayeza. Hlela uze uhlalutye iingxelo zokubakho kwamayeza uze uthathe izigqibo ezilungisa isimo ukuzithintela ekubeni amayeza angabikho.

jobs.title: Operational Manager (PHC)
jobs.centre: Ilembe Health District Office (KwaDukuza Primary Health Care)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R720 819 - R821 454 per annum. Plus 8% rural allowance. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical aid (optional), and Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed requirements).
jobs.summary: Manage and monitor primary health care services and systems within the Ilembe Health District, ensuring performance standards are met.
jobs.requirements: Matric Certificate or Grade 12 (Senior Certificate). Diploma or Degree in General Nursing Science and Midwifery that allows registration with SANC as a General Nurse, plus (1) year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) plus, Registration Certificate with SANC as a General Nurse with Midwifery and Primary Health Care, plus, Current Registration with SANC (2026). A minimum of 09 years appropriate/recognizable nursing experience as a General Nurse after registration of which 05 years must be appropriate recognizable experience after obtaining 1 year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care nursing and registration as a clinical nurse practitioner. Preference will be given to candidate who possess a valid Code 08 Drivers License and have computer literacy. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Knowledge of all applicable legislations such as Nursing Act, Mental Act, OH&S Act, Batho Pele Principles and Patients Right Charter, Labour Relations Act, Grievance procedure, etc. Knowledge of public service regulations. Disciplinary code, human resource policies, hospital generic and specific policies. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem solving, conflict handling and counselling. Financial and budgetary knowledge. Good listening and communication skills. Co-ordination and planning skills. Team building and supervisory skills. Good interpersonal relationship skills. Good insight of procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Ability to assist in information of patient care related policies. Computer skills in basic programmed.
jobs.duties: Monitor and evaluate the performance of Primary health care services and systems within the designated services area in the line with public health indicators, set standards and target with a view to report thereon and initiate a corrective active timeously. Analyse health policy and programmed imperatives with a view to develop customize implementation strategies to guide to primary health care services providers in the service area towards complying with the stated norms, standard and target. Participate actively in Operations Sukuma sakhe. Monitor implementation of PHC re-engineering. Ensure that compliant management is functional in the clinic. Participate in achieving norms and standards (OHSC). Contribute to the realization of ideal clinic status determination. Identify transversal health care and systems barrier (including emerging health trend in service areas) with a view to ensure corrective action at appropriate level. Ensure and monitor that primary health service within the designated service areas are provided with adequate support by multi- disciplinary teams attached to the clinics as well as other corporate services attached to the facility. Ensure an integrated approach with the implementation of various primary health care programmers provide a seamless services delivery platform, including prioritizing needs of the service area and allocate resources accordingly. Ensure that effective and efficient utilization of allocated resources, including the development of staff, procurement planning inputs and maintenance of prescribed information management systems.
jobs.applications: Please forward all applications to: The Director: District Health Office, ILembe Health District Office, Private Bag X10620, KwaDukuza, 4450 OR Hand delivered to: corner of 1 King Shaka Street and Cato Street, King Shaka Centre, KwaDukuza, 4450 or Email it to mandla.mthembu@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Mr M.D Mthembu
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: The following documents must be submitted, the most recent Z83 application form for employment which is obtainable at any Government Department or the website: www.kznhealth.gov.za, The Z83 form must be completed in full. The reference number must be indicated in provided form Z83 e g. EMRSILE 01/2024. Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Information such as Educational qualification dates(s) of registration with council, relevant work experience and periods in service should be clearly indicated on the CV. Applicants are not required to submit Copies of qualification and other relevant documents on application. Such documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only. Applications must be submitted on or before the closing date. Please note that due to the number of applications anticipated, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to short listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within two months after the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The appointment is subject to positive outcome obtained from NIA to the following checks (security clearance, credit records, qualification, citizenship and previous experience employment verifications and verification from the company Intellectual Property (CIPC). The Department reserves the right not to fill the post (s). Persons with disabilities should feel free to apply for the post Further, respective successful candidate will be required to enter into a permanent employment contract with the Department of Health and a Performance Agreement with his/her immediate supervisor. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if no notification of appointment is received within 3 months after the closing date, they must accept that their applications were unsuccessful. The Department Reserves the Right to or not to make appointment(s) to the advertised post(s) Applicants in possession of a foreign qualifications are not required to submit Copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Such documents will be requested only if shortlisted. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. NB: Due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S & T allowance to candidates attending the interviews. This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department.”

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder (PHC)
af.summary: Bestuur en monitor primêre gesondheidsorgdienste en -stelsels binne die Ilembe Gesondheidsdistrik, en verseker dat prestasiestandaarde nagekom word.
af.requirements: Matrik-sertifikaat of Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat). Diploma of Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vroedvrouskunde wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige moontlik maak, plus (1) jaar post basiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde, Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en Sorg (PHC) plus, Registrasiesertifikaat by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige met Vroedvrouskunde en Primêre Gesondheidsorg, plus, Huidige registrasie by SANC (2026). 'n Minimum van 09 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare verpleegervaring as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige na registrasie waarvan 05 jaar toepaslike herkenbare ervaring moet wees na verkryging van 1 jaar post basiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorgverpleging en registrasie as 'n kliniese verpleegpraktisyn. Voorkeur sal gegee word aan kandidate wat oor 'n geldige Kode 08 Bestuurderslisensie beskik en rekenaargeletterd is. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van alle toepaslike wetgewing soos die Nursing Act, Mental Act, OH&S Act, Batho Pele-beginsels en Patients Right Charter, Labour Relations Act, Grievance procedure, ens. Kennis van openbarediensregulasies. Dissiplinêre kode, menslikehulpbronbeleid, hospitaal se generiese en spesifieke beleide. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming en probleemoplossing, konflikhantering en berading. Finansiële en begrotingskennis. Goede luister- en kommunikasievaardighede. Koördinasie en beplanningsvaardighede. Spanbou en toesighoudende vaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Goeie insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Vermoë om te help met inligting oor pasiëntsorgverwante beleide. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Monitor en evalueer die prestasie van primêre gesondheidsorgdienste en -stelsels binne die aangewese diensarea in ooreenstemming met openbare gesondheidsaanzwysers, vasgestelde standaarde en teiken met die doel om daaroor te rapporteer en tydig korrigerende maatreëls in te stel. Analiseer gesondheidsbeleid en programimperatiewe met die oog daarop om pasgemaakte implementeringsstrategieë te ontwikkel om primêre gesondheidsorgdiensverskaffers in die diensarea te lei om aan die gestelde norme, standaarde en teikens te voldoen. Neem aktief deel aan Operations Sukuma sakhe. Monitor implementering van PHC-heringenieuring. Verseker dat klagtebestuur in die kliniek funksioneel is. Neem deel aan die bereiking van norme en standaarde (OHSC). Dra by tot die verwesenliking van die bepaling van ideale kliniekstatus. Identifiseer transversale gesondheidsorg- en stelselversperrings (insluitend opkomende gesondheidstendense in diensareas) met die oog daarop om korrigerende optrede op toepaslike vlak te verseker. Verseker en monitor dat primêre gesondheidsdienste binne die aangewese diensareas voldoende ondersteuning word deur multidissiplinêre spanne wat aan die klinieke verbonde is, asook ander korporatiewe dienste wat aan die fasiliteit verbonde is. Verseker 'n geïntegreerde benadering met die implementering van verskeie primêre gesondheidsorgprogramme om 'n naatlose diensleweringsplatform te bied, insluitend die prioritisering van behoeftes van die diensarea en die toekenning van hulpbronne dienooreenkomstig. Verseker die effektiewe en doeltreffende benutting van toegewysde hulpbronne, insluitend die ontwikkeling van personeel, verkopingsbeplanning-invoere en die instandhouding van voorgeskrewe inligtingbestuurstelsels.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokusebenza (PHC)
zu.summary: Phatha futhi ulawule izinkonzo nezinhlela zezokwelapha ezingunhlangothi kwi-Ilembe Health District, uqinisekisa ukuthi amasu okusebenza ahlangabezana nawo.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric noma i-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate). IDiploma noma i-Degree kwi-General Nursing Science and Midwifery evumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengoba i-General Nurse, kanye ne-(1) year post basic qualification kwi-Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) kanye, nesitifiketi sobhaliso kwi-SANC njengoba i-General Nurse ene-Midwifery ne-Primary Health Care, kanye, nobhaliso lwamanje kwi-SANC (2026). Okungenani eminyakeni engu-09 yamava ahambisana/awaziwayo wezokuhlalela njengoba i-General Nose emva kobhaliso, lapho kuyiminyaka engu-05 okumele ibe yamava ahambisana awaziwayo emva kokuthola 1 year post basic qualification kwi-Primary Health Care nursing kubhaliso njengoba i-clinical nurse practitioner. Izethameli ezinodlalo olusemsebenzi we-Code 08 Drivers License kanye nokubhalisele ekhompuyutheni zizonikezwa ukuthandwa. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho nokuzikhombisa okudingekayo: Ulwazi ngawo wonke umthetho osebenzayo njengoba Nursing Act, Mental Act, OH&S Act, Batho Pele Principles ne-Patients Right Charter, Labour Relations Act, inqubo yezikhalazo, njll. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesevisi yomphakathi. Ikhodi yokulawula, izinqubomgomo zezinsizakalomuntu, izinqubomgomo eziyisisekelo nokuqokelelwe ezibhedlela. Ukuba ngumholi, ukuhlola izinhlangano, ukwenza izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye nokweluleka. Ulwazi lwezimali nezabelomali. Amakhono ahle wokuzwa nokucoma. Amakhono okuhlanganisa futhi ulwazi. Amakhono okwakha iqembu nokuqondisa. Amaxhono obuhlobo bomuntu. Ukuqonda okuhle kwezinqubo nezinqubomgomo ezihlotshaniswe ne-Nursing care. Ikhonookusiza ekwakheni izinqubomgomo ezihlotshaniswa nenakekelo yesiguli. Amakhono ekhompuyutha okwiminhlelo eyisisekelo.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi uhlasiswe ukusebenza kwezinkonzo nezinhlela zezokwelapha ezingunhlangothi endaweni ezibalulekile yokwaziswa ngenhlobo yokwaziswa komphakathi, amasu abekelwe futhi ijubane ngenhloso yokubika ngawo futhi uqale isexaziso esihlanzele. Luka izinqubomgomo zempilo neminhlela ebalulekile nenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinhlela zokuqaliswa ezilungeze ukuhlola abanikezeli bezinkonzo zezokwelapha ezingunhlangothi endaweni ezibalulekile ukuze bahlangabezane namagunya, amasu futhi ijubane. Mthatha ngomzamo kwi-Operations Sukuma sakhe. Qapha ukuqaliswa kobunjiniya be-PHC re-engineering. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwezimpumuzo kusebenza esigulini. Thatha inxaxheba ekufikeni emagunya nasemafunwani (OHSC). Faka isandla ekufezeni isimo esikahle, sigudle ukuqinisekiswa. Hlaza izithiyo eziwela nzalo kokubili ekunakekelweni kwempilo nakwezinhlela (kubandakanya izinhlobo eziphakeme noma eziqhamukayo) ukuze uqiniseke isexaziso esimbalwe kumazinga abekelwe futhi anele. Qinisekisa futhi uqaphe ukuthi izinkonzo zezokwelapha ezingunhlangothi endaweni ezibalulekile zinikela inkxaso yanele ngamathimba ahlukene anamakhono abahlotshaniswa namakliniki kanye nezinye izinsiza zokwazisa ezinguxhumile nasendaweni. Qinisekisa indlela ephathekanyeko ekuyiseni kwenkinga yezinhlela ezinkonzo ezingunhlangothi ukunikezela inkonzo ekuhlangene ngokupheleleyo, kubandakanya ukubeka phambisa iimfuno zendawo ezibalulekile futhi usabelwe izinsiza ngokufanele. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nangaphezulu kwezinsiza ezelwe, kubandakanya ukuthuthukiswa kabanini, ukucubungula imibhalo yokuphatha imininingwane ephoqele kumafomu aqinisekiswe futhi alondolozwe.

xh.title: Umphathi wokuSebenza (PHC)
xh.summary: Phatha uze ulawule iinkonzo nezixhobo ezinkonzeni ezidibene nempilo yamaphakathi kwiLembe Health District, kuqinisekiswe ukuba kuhlangatyezulweyo kwemigangatho yemisebenzi.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric okanye iGrade 12 (Senior Certificate). I-Diploma okanye i-Degree kwi-General Nursing Science nase-Midwifery evumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengongqamba jikelele, kwaye nenze (1) yeminyaka eyi-1 isidanga ngaphezu kwesiseko kwisifundo se-Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) nayo, nelayisentshi yokuBhalisa kwi-SANC njengongqamba jikelele onasem-Midwifery nakwi-Primary Health Care, kwaye kubekho isatifikethi sokuBhalisa ngoku kwi-SANC (2026). Kufuneka abe nobugama obungaphantsi kweminyaka engama-09 yamava akhoyo aqaqambelweyo njengongqamba jikelele emva kokuBhaliswa, apho eminyaka emi-05 kufuneka ibe yamava akhoyo aqaqambelweyo emva kokufumana isidanga esingowe-1 ngaphezu kwesiseko kwi-Primary Health Care nursing nokubhalisa njengomcela wekliniki. Ikhetho liza kunikwa kumqambi ophethe i-Code 08 Drivers License eseleyo anelise ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho nokuQaqambelwa okuFunekayo: Ulwazi ngawo onke amagazathi asebenzayo anjenge-Nursing Act, Mental Act, OH&S Act, Batho Pele Principles ne-Patients Right Charter, Labour Relations Act, i-Grievance procedure, njl. Ulwazi ngomthetho wesebe lakarhulumende. Ikhodi yokulawula indima, iinkqubo zemithombo yabantu, iinkqubo ezingeyiyo nasezithile zesibhedlele. Ukuzoba ngaphambili, ukuCoca, ukuThatha iziGqibo nokusombulula iinkinga, ukupatha iingxabano noyilo lomceli-mngeni. Ulwazi ngeemali nazemali-ngqayifana. Ukulalela ngokuhle namakhono oThetha-thethwano. Amakhono oLungelelaniso noCoco. Amakhono oSungulo olusebenzayo noLawulo labasebenzi. Amakhono alungelanisa ubudlelwane nabantu. Ukuqonda okuhle ngeenkqubo nangemithetho ehlangene nonyango lwegazi. Ikhono lokuncedisa ekulungiseni iinkqubo ezihlobene nenyango labagulayo. Amakhono ekhompyutha kwinkqubo esisiseko.
xh.duties: Linganisa uze ulawule imisebenzi yemisebenzi yokuLinganisa konke ukuphela kwamava nemithetho yamava apho ekuqhubekwa kuyo inkonzo ngokulungelelanisa nemigaqo yemithetho, ukuhlanganisa imigaqo nemiGangatho uze uqinisekise izinto ezimiselweyo ukuze kubakhokho ingxelo ngezinto ezikhoyo nokuhanga izinyathelo zokuLungelelanisa ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Lungelelanisa imigaqo yemithetho nokuQeqeshwa ngokulungelelanisa imigaqo yokwakha nokwenza ii-strategies ezizodibana nemiba yokwenza inkonzo eya kumathuba aLungelelanisa imigaqo yokuNgenisa amava kuqinisekiso oluhle lolwazi ekuqhubekeni kwenkonzo ngokulungelelanisa nezixhobo eziguqukayo ezahlukeneyo. Zibandakanya ngokusebenzayo kwimisebenzi ye-Operations Sukuma sakhe. Qapha ukwenziwa kokuqulunqwa ngokutsha kwe-PHC. Qinisekisa ukuba urhwebo lomthetho lusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo kwisebe. Thatha inxaxheba ekufezweni kwemigaqo nemiGangatho (OHSC). Nika ngemviswano ekufezweni kwekliniki ekubunjwa nge-ideal clinic status determination. Qaphela imiba eLungelelanisa yemithetho yokunika isiqobo nokubanjwa kwemithetho ekujoliswe kuyo (kuquka izinto ezintsha ekuqhubekayo kumathuba okuLungelelanisa) ngokusuka kwisigqibo somthetho oLungelelanisekileyo nolungileyo. Qinisekisa uze ulawule ukuba inkonzo eLungelelanisa iyabelwa kangakanani na, nokuba nkqo ngokusebenzisa amaqela aLungelelanisa nemiThetho eLungelelanisa kangangokuba kuya kufuneka abe nabasebenzi abakulungelelanisa imisebenzi yekhadi elungelelanisa kakhulu nokulinganisela imigangatho yeNkonzo yokuQeqeshwa nokulungelelanisa imithetho nemiGangatho. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nokuLungelelanisa imithetho yokulinganisela imigangatho ezokulinganisa imisebenzi egqitywe ngokulungelelana nemithetho yokuLungelelanisa nokuQeqesha imithetho, nokuzinza kokubakho nokulungelelaniswa kwaba bali-mithetho basebenza ngokutsha kumathuba aLungelelanise ngokukhanya nokugcina imithetho elungelelanisa amathuba okuLungelelanisa iNkonzo.

jobs.title: Clinical Programme Co-ordinator
jobs.centre: Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital REQUIREEMENTS   :   Senior Certificate/Grade 12 Degree / Diploma in Nursing Science and Midwifery or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse Current registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) 2026 A minimum of 7 years appropriate /Recognized Experience in Nursing after registration with SANC in General nursing Additional Qualifications: Certificate in Infection Prevention and control Valid driver’s license Knowledge, Skills And Competencies Demonstrate an in depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and Ethical nursing practices and how this impacts on service delivery. Knowledge of Infection Control policies and guidelines. Leadership, Organizational, Decision making and problem-solving skills Good communication, interpersonal relations. Demonstrate basic understanding of Human Resource and Financial policies and Practices. Computer Literacy.
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R571 161. Plus 13th cheque, homeowner’s allowance; Employee must meet the prescribed requirements and Medical Aid optional.
jobs.summary: Coordinate clinical infection prevention and control programmes at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, requiring a Professional Nursing qualification and seven years of experience.
jobs.duties: Develop and implement an Infection prevention and control plan for the institution. Ensure that Infection prevention and control as well as Antibiotic stewardship committee are in place and functional. Promote Infection prevention and culture within the institution by conducting relevant workshops, Audits, meetings and awareness. Identify Infection control risks and make recommendations on mitigation strategies. Provide training to all categories of staff on Infection policies, principles and practices. Conduct Infection prevention and control Surveillance and report on incidence and prevalence of alert organisms and communicable diseases to District and to Communicable Disease Centre. Identify and report all Hospital Acquired Infections. Visits the Departments within the institution to identify infection prevention and control risks. Ensure that all departments comply with Infection Prevention and control Framework, protocols and guidelines. Identify outbreaks of infections, initiate investigation and control measures in collaboration with Infection prevention and control Committee. Provide effective and efficient Infection Prevention and Control service in the institution. Serve as a Clinical governance champion in the facility, ensuring effective clinical risk management system. Review institutional Infection prevention and control Standard operating procedures. Provide advice on various aspects of infection prevention and control, relevant policies to management.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. GF Mncwango - Assistant Nurse Manager Nursing (M&E) Tel No: (031) 240 1083

af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder
af.summary: Koördineer kliniese infeksievoorkoming en -beheerprogramme by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, wat 'n Professionele Verpleegkwalifikasie en sewe jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.duties: Ontwik en implementeer 'n Infeksievoorkoming- en -beheerplan vir die instansie. Verseker dat Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer asook die Antibiotiese beheerkomitee in plek is en funksioneel is. Bevorder Infeksievoorkoming en -kultuur binne die instansie deur toepaslike werkswinkels, oudits, vergaderings en bewustheid te hou. Identifiseer Infeksiebeheerrisiko's en doen aanbevelings oor verminderingsstrategieë. Verskaf opleiding aan alle kategorieë personeel oor Infeksiebeleid, -beginsels en -praktyke. Voer Infeksievoorkoming- en -beheerbewaking uit en doen verslag oor die voorkoms en prevalensie van waaksaamheidsorganismes en oordraagbare siektes aan die Distrik en aan die Communicable Disease Centre. Identifiseer en rapporteer alle hospitaalverworwe infeksies. Besoek die Departemente binne die instansie om infeksievoorkoming- en -beheerrisiko's te identifiseer. Verseker dat alle departemente voldoen aan die Raamwerk, protokolle en riglyne vir Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer. Identifiseer uitbreek van infeksies, en begin ondersoek en beheermaatreëls in samewerking met die Infeksievoorkoming- en -beheerkomitee. Verskaf 'n doeltreffende en effektiewe Infeksievoorkoming- en -beheerdienst in die instansie. Dien as 'n Kliniese bestuurskampioen in die fasiliteit, en verseker 'n doeltreffende stelsel vir kliniese risikobestuur. Hersien die instansie se Standard operating procedures vir Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer. Verskaf advies oor verskeie aspekte van infeksievoorkoming en -beheer, asook toepaslike beleid aan bestuur.

zu.title: Umxhumanisi Wezinhlela Zokwelapha
zu.summary: Ukuhumanisa izinhlela zokuvikela nokuqapha izifo ezingatheleleka kanye nokulawula e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, okudinga iziqu zobuhlengikazi obungamagunyazi kanye neminyaka eyisikhombisa yohlu lobungcweti.
zu.duties: Bumba futhi usebenzise icebo lokuvikela nokuqapha izifo ezingatheleleka nokulawula esikhungweni. Qiniseka ukuthi ukuvikela nokuqapha izifo ezingatheleleka nokulawula kanye nkomidi yokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwezithibiamabhayothiki sekukhona futhi sisebenza. Khuthaza ukuvikela izifo ezingatheleleka namasiko esikhungweni ngokuqamba amakilasi ohamba phambili, ukuhlola, izinkomfa nokwazisa. Hlola izingozi zokuqapha izifo ezingatheleleka unikeze izinkomba mayelana nezindlela zokunciphisa. Nikeza ukuqeqeshwa kuzo zonke izigaba zabasebenzi mayelana namapholisi, izimiso namasu okuqapha izifo. Qapha ukusabalala kwezifo ezingatheleleka nokulawula ubike ngokuvela nokubaluleka kwezinto eziyisengozi kanye nezifo ezingathathelana kumhlangano naseKilabhu Yezifo Ezingathathelana. Hlola ubike yonke imifo evela esibhedlela. Vakashela Amaphoyintu aphakathi kwesikhungwa ukuze uhlole izingozi zokuvikela nokuqapha izifo ezingatheleleka nokulawula. Qiniseka ukuthi yonke amaphoyintu ahambisana Nesakhiwo Sokuvikela nokuqapha Izifo Ezingatheleleka, imithetho nemihlahlandlela. Hlola ukuphuma kwemifo ezingatheleleka, qala iphupho lokuhlola nezinyathelo zokulawula kuhlanganiswe nkomidi Yokuvikela nokuqapha Izifo Ezingatheleleka. Nikeza insiza yokuvikela nokuqapha Izifo Ezingatheleleka esikhungweni. Yiba ngumpetha Wolawulo Lwelasho esikhungweni, ukuqinisekisa uhlelo olusebenzayo lokuphathwa kwezingozi zelasho. Phinda ubheke izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokusebenza zesikhungwa mayelana nokuvikela nokuqapha Izifo Ezingatheleleka. Nikeza izeluleko mayelana nezici ezahlukene zokuvikela nokuqapha izifo ezingatheleleka, namapholisi ahambisana nabalawuli.

xh.title: umo wokuqamba wenkqubo yamava ngokwesigqi
xh.summary: Ukuqhubeza iinkqubo zokuthintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo ezingeyaqhubela phambili e Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, okufuna izifundo zokuba Ngonganga oGunyazisiweyo kwaye neminyaka yamava esixhenxe.
xh.duties: Qamba uze uphumeze icebo lokuthintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo kwishishini. Qinisekisa ukuba komnyhadala wokuThintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo, kwaye nakomnyhadala oLawula ukusebenzisa izibulala-mkobva, beselele kwaye besebenza kakuhle. Khuthaza ukuThintela ngokwesigqi kwaye usakaze isiko kwishishini ngokubamba iindibano ezifanelekileyo, ukuHlalutya, iindibano kunye nokuvakalisa. Phawula iingozi ezithintela ukusasazwa kwesifo uze wenze izindululo ngeendlela ezithile ezokuzikhusela ekulweni iingozi ezinjalo. Nikeze iintlobo zonke zogqo ekuyimfundo kwimizimba yokuthintela izifo ngamagunya ayo, iindetha kunye nokwenza okusesikweni na. Yenza isiphithiphithi sokuthintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo kwaye ichaze ngemeko yokwanda okanye kwesisixo sezi zifo ezibangelwa amathambo awo kwaye ezibangela izifo ezichukumisayo kwikomkhulu nakwindlu yolwazi lwamathumba. Phawula kwaye uxele zonke izifo ezingeniswa kwisibhedlele. Undwendwela oonqwenela ngaphakathi kwishishini ukuze uphawule iingozi ezithintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo. Qinisekisa ukuba uyonke imiyalelo iyakwisiseko sokuthintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo, izigqibo kunye nezikhokelo. Phawula iinduli zemikhuba yezifo, qalisa isipho kwaye izigqibo zokulawula ngokusebenzisana nekomiti lokuthintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo. Nikeze inkonzo yokuThintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo evela kwishishini ngokugqibeleleyo kwaye ngesigqibo. Zibalaza njengommandla welawulo lokusesikweni kwifasilithi, ngokuqinisekisa urhweba lokusingathwa kweengozi zokusesikweni ngokugqibeleleyo. Phinda upheze imithetho yokusebenza ngokugqibeleleyo yokuThintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo kwishishini. Nikeza ingcebiso kumapandla amaninzi okuthintela ngokwesigqi nokulawula izifo, izixhobo ezifanelekileyo kulawulo.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner (PHC)
jobs.centre: Ilembe Health District Office (KwaDukuza Primary Health Care)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 - R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 - R752 913 per annum plus 8% rural allowance Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical aid (optional), and Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed requirements).
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner providing comprehensive primary health care services in KwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Matric Certificate or Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) Diploma or Degree in General Nursing Science and Midwifery that allows registration with SANC as a General Nurse, plus (1) year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) plus, Registration Certificate with SANC as a General Nurse with Midwifery and Primary Health Care, plus, Current Registration with SANC (2026) A minimum of 4 years appropriate/ recognizable nursing experience as s General Nurse. Minimum Requirements for the post: Grade 2: Matric Certificate or Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) Diploma or Degree in General Nursing Science and Midwifery that allows registration with SANC as a General Nurse, plus (1) year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC Registration Certificate with SANC as a General Nurse with Midwifery and Primary Health Care, plus, Current Registration with SANC (2026). A minimum of 14 years appropriate/ recognizable nursing experience after registration as s General Nurse with SANC of which 10 years of the period must be appropriate/ recognizable PHC experience after obtaining a one year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care. NB: Please note that most of the Clinics in KwaDukuza Sub District operates from 07h00 to 18h00. KwaDukuza Clinic operates over 24 hours, Mpumelelo and Groutville Clinic operates on call after 18h00. Staff may be requested to relieve/ allocated in any of the nine (09) facilities within the Sub District if and when the need arises. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Knowledge of all applicable legislations such as Nursing Acts, Mental Acts, OH & S Act, Batho Pele Principles and Patient’s Rights Charter, Labour Relations Act, Grievance procedure, etc. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem solving, conflict handling and counselling. Good listening and communication skills. Co-ordination and planning skills. Team building and supervisory skills. Good interpersonal relationship skills. Good insight of procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Ability to assist in information of patient care related policies.
jobs.duties: Provide quality comprehensive Primary Health Care by providing promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative services for the clients and community. Ensuring proper utilization and safekeeping of basic medical equipment, surgical and pharmaceutical stock. Assist in orientation, induction and monitoring of all nursing staff. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all nursing staff and to give guidance. To provide nursing care that leads to improved health service delivery by upholding principles of Batho Pele. Execute duties and functions with proficiency and perform duties according to scope of practice. Implement infection control standards and practices to improve quality nursing care. Assist with conducting clinical audits and developing quality improvement plans. Improve the knowledge of staff and patients through health education and in service training. Implement Nursing care standards, and practices for quality nursing care according to guidelines and prescripts. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders, implementation of the Integrated Multi Stakeholder Health Promotion Strategy. Management of patients records, both written and electronic. Ensuring proper utilization of Human, material and financial resources and keeping up to date records of resources. Ability to plan and organize own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care in the clinic. Motivate junior staff regarding development in order to increase level of expertise and assist patients to develop a sense of self-care. Strengthen data systems and treatment outcomes by assisting and capturing on Tier.net. Ensure the collection, collation and timeous submission of accurate verified data. Support the realization and maintenance of ideal Clinic and OHSC Programme in the facility.

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (PHC)
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn wat omvattende primêre gesondheidsorgdienste in KwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal, lewer.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Matrieksertifikaat of Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat) Diploma of Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vrouwkunde wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige moontlik maak, plus (1) jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde, Gesondheidsontleding, Behandeling en Sorg (PHC) plus, Registrasiesertifikaat by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige met Vrouwkunde en Primêre Gesondheidsorg, plus, Huidige registrasie by SANC (2026) 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/ herkenbare verpleegervaring as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige. Minimvereistes vir die pos: Graad 2: Matrieksertifikaat of Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat) Diploma of Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vrouwkunde wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige moontlik maak, plus (1) jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde, Gesondheidsontleding, Behandeling en Sorg (PHC) Registrasiesertifikaat by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige met Vrouwkunde en Primêre Gesondheidsorg, plus, Huidige registrasie by SANC (2026). 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/ herkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige by SANC waarvan 10 jaar van die tydperk toepaslike/ herkenbare PHC-ervaring moet wees na verkryging van 'n eenjarige postbasiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. NB: Neem asseblief kennis dat die meeste van die klinieke in KwaDukuza Subdistrik van 07h00 tot 18h00 werk. KwaDukuza Kliniek werk oor 24 uur, Mpumelelo en Groutville Kliniek werk op roep na 18h00. Personeel kan versoek word om te onthaal/ toegewys te word in enigeen van die nege (09) fasiliteite binne die Subdistrik indien en wanneer die behoefte ontstaan. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van alle toepaslike wetgewing soos die Nursing Acts, Mental Acts, OH & S Act, Batho Pele-beginsels en Patient's Rights Charter, Labour Relations Act, klagteprosedure, ens. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossings-, konflikhanterings- en beradingsvaardighede. Goeie luister- en kommunikasievaardighede. Koördinerings- en beplanningsvaardighede. Spanbou- en toesighoudende vaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verwantskapsvaardighede. Goeie insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Vermoë om te help met inligting oor pasiëntsorg-verwante beleide.
af.duties: Lewer gehalte-omvattende Primêre Gesondheidsorg deur bevorderende, preventiewe, kuratiewe en rehabilitasiedienste vir die kliënte en gemeenskap te verskaf. Verseker behoorlike benutting en veiligbewaring van basiese mediese toerusting, chirurgiese en farmaseutiese voorraad. Help met oriëntering, inleiding en monitering van alle verpleegpersoneel. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor alle verpleegpersoneel en gee leiding. Verskaf verpleegsorg wat lei tot verbeterde gesondheidsdienslewering deur die beginsels van Batho Pele te handhaaf. Voer pligte en funksies met vaardigheid uit en verrig pligte volgens die omvang van praktyk. Implementeer infeksiebeheerstandaarde en -praktyke om gehalte-verpleegsorg te verbeter. Help met die uitvoer van kliniese oudite en die ontwikkeling van gehalteverbeteringsplanne. Verbeter die kennis van personeel en pasiënte deur gesondheidsopvoeding en in-diens-opleiding. Implementeer verpleegsorgstandaarde en -praktyke vir gehalte-verpleegsorg volgens riglyne en voorskrifte. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werkverwantskap met verpleeg- en ander belanghebbendes, implementering van die Geïntegreerde Multi-Belanghebbende Gesondheidsbevorderingsstrategie. Bestuur van pasiëntrekords, beide geskrewe en elektronies. Verseker behoorlike benutting van menslike, materiële en finansiële hulpbronne en hou op datum rekords van hulpbronne. Vermoë om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg in die kliniek te verseker. motiveer junior personeel rakende ontwikkeling ten einde vlak van kundigheid te verhoog en help pasiënte om 'n sin van selfsorg te ontwikkel. Versterk datastelsels en behandelingsuitkomste deur te help en op Tier.net vas te lê. Verseker die versameling, kollasie en tydige indiening van akkurate geverifieerde data. Ondersteun die verwesenliking en instandhouding van ideale Kliniek en OHSC-program in die fasiliteit.

zu.title: Umgcweli Wezokwelapha Ezingcaphepheni (PHC)
zu.summary: Umgcweli wezokwelapha ezingcaphepheni ohlinzeka ngokuzinza ngemisebenzi yezempilo eyangasese eKwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: Ithemu 1: Isitifikedi seMatric noma iGrade 12 (Isitifikedi Esiphezulu) Dipuloma noma Ikhosi eZifundweni Zezokwelapha Ezingcaphepheni kanye Nokuvela okuvumela ukubhalisa kuSANC njengesibhali sezokwelapha, kanye nakholeji yeminyaka (1) ngemva kokuthola isifundo esisesikhundleni sezokwelapha ezingcaphepheni, ukuhlola impilo, ukwelapha nokunakekela (PHC) kanye, Isitifikedi Sokubhalisa kuSANC njengesibhali sezokwelapha okukhombisa ukubhaliswa esibhalweni sokubeletha kanye nezeMpilo Eyangasese, kanye, Ukubhalisa Okwamanje kuSANC (2026) okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu4 yokuqeqeshwa okufanele/okuhlonishwe ezokwelapha njengesibhali sezokwelapha. Izidingo Ephiwelayo Zesikhundla: Ithemu 2: Isitifikedi seMatric noma iGrade 12 (Isitifikedi Esiphezulu) Dipuloma noma Ikhosi eZifundweni Zezokwelapha Ezingcaphepheni kanye Nokuvela okuvumela ukubhalisa kuSANC njengesibhali sezokwelapha, kanye nakholeji yeminyaka (1) ngemva kokuthola isifundo esisesikhundleni sezokwelapha ezingcaphepheni, ukuhlola impilo, ukwelapha nokunakekela (PHC) Isitifikedi Sokubhalisa kuSANC njengesibhali sezokwelapha okukhombisa ukubhaliswa esibhalweni sokubeletha kanye nezeMpilo Eyangasese, kanye, Ukubhalisa Okwamanje kuSANC (2026). Okuncane kakhulu iminyaka engu14 yokuqeqeshwa okufanele/okuhlonishwe ngemva kokubhalisa njengesibhali sezokwelapha kuSANC okokuyiminyaka engu10 kuleyo minyaka kumele kuyilolu hlobo olufanele/oluhlonishwe lwePHC ngemva kokuthola kholeji yonyaka owodwa yesifundo ngemva kwesisekelo kuzeMpilo Eyangasese. NB: Sicela uqaphele ukuthi iningi lezikliniki KwaDukuza Sub District isebuka kusukela ngo07h00 kuya ku18h00. Isikliniki saseKwaDukuza sisebuka amahora angu24, isikliniki saseMpumelelo naseGroutville sisebuka ngesigcingo ngemva kwama18h00. Abasebenzi bangacelwa ukuba bafake esikhundleni/babelwe kunoma yisiphi isiza esiyisishiyagalolunye (09) ngaphakathi kweSub District uma kunesidingo nokuthi kwenzeke. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Nekhono Elidingekayo: Ulwazi ngawo wonke umthetho osebenzayo njengoba kuyimithetho Yesibhali, imithetho Yengqondo, iNcwadi Yomthetho YeNyuvesi, Izimiso ZikaBatho Pele neNkqubo Yezamalungelo Komuntu Ophathwayo, umthetho Wezomsebenzi, inqubo yokubeka izikhalazo, njll. Buka izinkululeko zokuhamba ngokweluleka, ukuhlanganisa izinto ngokuhle, ukwenza izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye nokweluleka. Amakhono amahle okulalela nokuKHULUMANA. Amakhono okuHlanganisa nokuhlela. Amakhono okwakha iqembu nokuQondisa. Amakhono amahle ohlelo lwabantu. Ukuqonda okuhle ngezinqubo nezinkambiso eziphathelene nokwelapha. Ikhono lokusiza ekwakheni izinkambiso eziphathelene nenhlelekela yomuntu ophathwayo.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngokulinganiselwa okuhle mayelana nezeMpilo Eyangasese ngokuHlinzeka ngemisebenzi yokukhuthaza, thibela, Welapha futhi ususe imiphumela engemihle yamaphoyisa nendawo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kokuqondile kanye nokulondolozwa okuphephile kwamathuluzi okugonya, ukugqoka nokugcina izinto ezingangeniswa esandleni. Siza kokuHlanganisa,ungenisa bese ulawula wonke umuntu oqeqeshiwe. Hlinzeka ngokuQondisa ngqo nangaphandle kukaHlelo lwethu lweqembu lokucathula imidlalo yolimi nokunikeza isiqondiso. Hlinzela ngokunakekela okuholele ekutheni kuqhubeke kuhamba kahle ezimpilweni zomphakathi okuholela ekutheni kusinakekele izinkambiso zikaBatho Pele. Zenza imisebenzi nezinkambiso ngokugqamisa amakhono okwenza imisebenzi ngokomthetho ohlekile. Qamba izinhlobo ezithile zokusetshenziswa nokuHlinzeka ngezinto ezingangeni esandleni. Siza ekwenzeni ukuHlolwa kwakho nokwakhe izinkambiso ezithile zokuphucula. Khulisa ulwazi lwabasebenzi namaphoyisa ngokuHlinzeka ngemfundo kanye nasekuqeqeshweni ngokusebenzisa. Setha izinkambiso zokunakekela, nokuzijwayeza ngokuhlinzeka ngokuhle okulinganiselwe ukunakekela izinkambiso. Hlala uxhumana nabanye abantu,umntu ophathwayo kanye Nezinye izinhlangano ezenza isikhundla esiyisikhulu sokuxhumana nebantu. Lawula amaphili okuQashwa, kokubili okushiwo ngomlomo futhi usebenzise ikhompyutha. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwethemba kwezomuntu, izinto kanye nezimali kanye nokuHlala unolwazi lwemali. Ikhono lokuhlela futhi uhlele imisebenzi yakho nabanakekeli abakhona ukuthi kwenzeke ukwelashwa. Buka abantu abancane ukuba bakhule ngokomthelela babheke phambili ekutheni bakhulise amakhono sabo futhi bakhuthaze amaphoyisa ukuba babe nolwazi lwokuzinakekela. Siza ekubuqweni nasekuHlolweni ukuthi kube khona ukuqoqwa nokuthunyelwa kwesiHeho. Hlinzeka ngenkxaso yokukhulisa izinto ezimbalwa ezingatholakali.

xh.title: Umpracthisi woZamagigaba Wokhathalelo Lwezempilo (PHC)
xh.summary: Umpracthisi woZamagigaba Wokhathalelo Lwezempilo onikezela iinkonzo ezigqithisileyo zokhathalelo lwezempilo ekuqaleni kwiKwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Isatifikethi seMatric okanye iGrade 12 (Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo) I Diploma okanye I Degree kwisiXhobo seNursing General neseMidwifery esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengongqathi jikelele, kwaye ngaphezu koko (1) unyaka wemfuno yasemva kwesiseko kwiClinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) kwaye ngaphezu koko, Isatifikethi Sobhaliso ngeSANC njengongqathi jikelele oneMidwifery nokuQala kokhathalelo lwezempilo, kwaye ngaphezu koko, UkuBhalisa kwangoku ngeSANC (2026). Iminyaka engaphezulu kwe4 yamava afanelekileyo/okuqaphelwa kokuzigigaba njengongqathi jikelele. Iimfuno ezingowona-mlinganiselo walesi sithuba: Inqanaba 2: Isatifikethi seMatric okanye iGrade 12 (Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo) I Diploma okanye I Degree kwisiXhobo seNursing General neseMidwifery esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengongqathi jikelele, kwaye ngaphezu koko (1) unyaka wemfuno yasemva kwesiseko kwiClinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC Isatifikethi Sobhaliso ngeSANC njengongqathi jikelele oneMidwifery nokuQala kokhathalelo lwezempilo, kwaye ngaphezu koko, UkuBhalisa kwangoku ngeSANC (2026). Iminyaka engaphezulu kwe14 yamava afanelekileyo/okuqaphelwa kokuzigigaba emva kokuBhalisa njengongqathi jikelelo ngeSANC apho iminyaka eyi10 kule minyaka kufuneka ibengamava afanelekileyo/okuqaphelwa kwiPHC emva kokufumana unyaka omnye wemfuno yasemva kwesiseko kuPrimary Health Care. NB: Nceda qaphela ukuba uninzi lweZiko Lokwelapha kwiKwaDukuza Sub District lusebenza ukusuka ngo07h00 ukuya ku18h00. IZiko Lokwelapha leKwaDukuza lisebenza iiveyili eyi24 ziiyure, iMpumelelo neliGroutville Clinic lisebenza ngenkcitho emva kwe18h00. Abasebenzi banokucelwa ukuba base / bagcinwe kulo nayiphi na yezi ziko ezithoba (09) ngaphakathi kwiSub District xa kwaye ngaxa sidingeka. Ulwazi, Amandla oKuzigibela, uQeqesho namAmandla aFuniweyo: Ulwazi ngayo yonke imithetho yaseburhulumente efana namagazethi eZigigaba, amagazethi eQondo, uMthetho weOH & S, iBatho Pele Principles neNqununu yamaLungu ogulayo, uMthetho woBudlelwano boBasebenzi, inqubo yezingxamolelo, nokunye. Ukpokothwa kwabaholi, ukuhlela, ukuthabisa iigqibo nokuzalisa iingxaki, ukupatha iingxazamgama nenkxaso yamava. Amandla amabalwa okuziva nokunxibelelanisa. Amandla okuhlanganisa nokucwangcisa. Amandla okwakha iqela elisebenzayo namandla okuqondisa. Amandla amabalwa okwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ukuqonda okuhle kweenkqubo namagazethi anxulumene nokhathalelo lwamagigaba. Amandla okunceda ekudalweni kolwazi ngamagazethi anxulumene nokhathalelo logulayo.
xh.duties: Nikela nokuqala kolwazi olugqithisileyo kolwazi lwempilo ngokunikezela iinkonzo ezikhuthazayo, ezivikelayo, ezichaphazelayo nokuqalisa kwakhona amagulayo nomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo nokugcinwa ngokhuseleko kwamacebo okwamagigaba, okwenyango nokugcinwa kwezinto zenyango. Nceda ekuzinzeni, ekungeniseni nasekubukeni onke amagigaba okhathalelo. Nikezela ngokuqondisa ngqo nangengqondilelo onke amagigaba okhathalelo nokunika isalathiso. Nikezela ngokhathalelo oluya kwaphucula ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo zeempilo ngokuzigcina kwemigaqo yeBatho Pele. Zenza imisebenzi namagunya ngobuchule bese uzenza imisebenzi ngokommandla wamagunya. Zisa inkqubo yolawulo lotyhefu nakuqhuba ukuze kuphuculwe khona ukhathalelo oluhle lwamagigaba. Nceda nokuqhuba uhlolo lokwelapha nasekubunjweni kweenguqulelo zokuphuculwa kolwazi. Phucula ulwazi lwabasebenzi namagulayo ngokufundisa ngokuze ngesikhathi esifanelekileyo. Zisa iinkqubo namagunya okhathalelo lwamagigaba, nakuqhuba ukhathalelo oluhle ngokwemigaqo nemicimbi. Gcina ubudlelwano obuqhubekayo ngokusebenza namagigaba ngeentshaba ezinye, ukulandelwa kweIntegrated Multi Stakeholder Health Promotion Strategy. Ulawulo lokubhaliswa kwemimfazwe yamagulayo, kokubini okubhaliweyo nakwekhompyutha. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo kolwazi, izinto noshishino lemali kwaye ugcine iirekhodi ezisemva ngesikhathi ngokwemithombo yolwazi. Amandla okucwangcisa nokuhlela umsebenzi wakho nalo abantu abaxhasi ukunqinisekisa ukhathalelo olufanelekileyo lwamagigaba kwiziko lokwelapha. Khuthaza abasebenzi abancinane ngokuqhubeka kolwazi ukuze kwande inqanaba lobuchule kwaye uncede amagulayo ukuba aphucule umbono wokuzikhathalela. Phucula iinkqubo zeefom nokuveliswa kokwelapha ngokunceda nokubhala kwiTier.net. Qinisekisa ukuqokelelwa, ukudityaniswa nokuthunyelwa ngesikhathi kwefom egqithisiweyo. Xhasa ukuzaliseka nokugcinwa kweIdeal Clinic noHlelo lweOHSC kwiziko.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner (PHC)
jobs.centre: Ilembe Health District Office (KwaDukuza Primary Health Care)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 - R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 - R752 913 per annum plus 8% rural allowance Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical aid (optional), and Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner providing comprehensive primary health care services at KwaDukuza within the Ilembe Health District, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic PHC qualification.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Matric Certificate or Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) Diploma or Degree in General Nursing Science and Midwifery that allows registration with SANC as a General Nurse, plus (1) year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) plus, Registration Certificate with SANC as a General Nurse with Midwifery and Primary Health Care, plus, Current Registration with SANC (2026) A minimum of 4 years appropriate/ recognizable nursing experience as s General Nurse. Code 10 Drivers License. Requirements: Grade 2: Matric Certificate or Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) Diploma or Degree in General Nursing Science and Midwifery that allows registration with SANC as a General Nurse, plus (1) year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC Registration Certificate with SANC as a General Nurse with Midwifery and Primary Health Care, plus, Current Registration with SANC (2026). A minimum of 14 years appropriate/ recognizable nursing experience after registration as s General Nurse with SANC of which 10 years of the period must be appropriate/ recognizable PHC experience after obtaining a one year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care. Code 10 Drivers License. NB: Please note that most of the Clinics in KwaDukuza Sub District operates from 07h00 to 18h00. KwaDukuza Clinic operates over 24 hours, Mpumelelo and Groutville Clinic operates on call after 18h00. Staff may be requested to relieve/ allocated in any of the nine (09) facilities within the Sub District if and when the need arises. Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competence Required: Knowledge of all applicable legislations such as Nursing Acts, Mental Acts, OH & S Act, Batho Pele Principles and Patient’s Rights Charter, Labour Relations Act, Grievance procedure, etc. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem solving, conflict handling and counselling. Good listening and communication skills. Co-ordination and planning skills. Team building and supervisory skills. Good interpersonal relationship skills. Good insight of procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Ability to assist in information of patient care related policies.
jobs.duties: Provide quality comprehensive Primary Health Care by providing promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative services for the clients and community. Ensuring proper utilization and safekeeping of basic medical equipment, surgical and pharmaceutical stock. Assist in orientation, induction and monitoring of all nursing staff. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all nursing staff and to give guidance. To provide nursing care that leads to improved health service delivery by upholding principles of Batho Pele. Execute duties and functions with proficiency and perform duties according to scope of practice. Implement infection control standards and practices to improve quality nursing care. Assist with conducting clinical audits and developing quality improvement plans. Improve the knowledge of staff and patients through health education and in service training. Implement Nursing care standards, and practices for quality nursing care according to guidelines and prescripts. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders, implementation of the Integrated Multi Stakeholder Health Promotion Strategy. Management of patients records, both written and electronic. Ensuring proper utilization of Human, material and financial resources and keeping up to date records of resources. Ability to plan and organize own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care in the clinic. Motivate junior staff regarding development in order to increase level of expertise and assist patients to develop a sense of self-care. Strengthen data systems and treatment outcomes by assisting and capturing on Tier.net. Ensure the collection, collation and timeous submission of accurate verified data. Support the realization and maintenance of ideal Clinic and OHSC Programme in the facility.
jobs.applications: Please forward all applications to: The Director: District Health Office, ILembe Health District Office, Private Bag X10620, KwaDukuza, 4450 OR Hand delivered to: corner of 1 King Shaka Street and Cato Street, King Shaka Centre, KwaDukuza, 4450 or Email it to mandla.mthembu@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Mr M.D Mthembu
jobs.notes: Directions to Candidates: The following documents must be submitted, the most recent Z83 application form for employment which is obtainable at any Government Department or the website: www.kznhealth.gov.za, The Z83 form must be completed in full. NB: Due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S & T allowance to candidates attending the interviews. af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (PHC)
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (PHC) wat omvattende primêre gesondheidsorgdienste by KwaDukuza binne die Ilembe Gesondheidsdistrik verskaf, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n post-basiese PHC-kwalifikasie vereis.
