'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige by SANC waarvan 10 jaar van die periode toepaslike/erkenbare PHC-ervaring moet wees na die verkryging van 'n een jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Kode 10 Bestuurderslisensie. NB: Let daarop dat die meeste van die Klinieke in KwaDukuza Sub-distrik vanaf 07h00 tot 18h00 werk. KwaDukuza Kliniek werk oor 24 uur, Mpumelelo en Groutville Kliniek werk op roep na 18h00. Personeel kan versoek word om te ontlast/toegewys te word in enigeen van die nege (09) fasiliteite binne die Sub-distrik indien en wanneer die noodsaak ontstaan. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding En Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van alle toepaslike wetgewing soos Verpleegwette, Geesteswette, OH & S Wet, Batho Pele-beginsels en Handves vir Pasiente se Regte, Arbeidsverhoudingswet, Grieprosedure, ens. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossing, konflikhantering en berading. Goed luister- en kommunikasievaardighede. Koördinasie- en beplanningsvaardighede. Spanbou- en toesighoudende vaardighede. Goed interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Goed insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Vermoë om te help met inligting van pasiëntsorgverwante beleide.
af.duties: Verskaf gehalte omvattende Primêre Gesondheidsorg deur bevorderende, voorkomende, kuratiewe en rehabilitatiewe dienste aan kliënte en die gemeenskap te lewer. Verseker behoorlike benutting en veilige bewaring van basiese mediese toerusting, chirurgiese en farmaseutiese voorraad. Bied bystand by oriëntasie, inlywing en monitering van alle verpleegpersoneel. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor alle verpleegpersoneel en gee leiding. Verskaf verpleegsorg wat lei tot verbeterde gesondheidsdienslewering deur die beginsels van Batho Pele te handhaaf. Voer pligte en funksies met bekwaamheid uit en verrig pligte ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk. Implementeer infeksiebeheerstandaarde en -praktyke om gehalte verpleegsorg te verbeter. Bystand verleen met die uitvoer van kliniese oudits en die ontwikkeling van gehalteverbeteringsplanne. Verbeter die kennis van personeel en pasiënte deur gesondheidsopvoeding en in-diensopleiding. Implementeer verpleegsorgstandaarde en -praktyke vir gehalte verpleegsorg volgens riglyne en voorskrifte. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleeg- en ander belanghebbendes, implementering van die Geïntegreerde Veelheid-Belanghebbende Gesondheidsbevorderingstrategie. Bestuur van pasiëntrekords, beide geskrewe en elektronies. Verseker behoorlike benutting van menslike, materiële en finansiële bronne en hou opgedateerde rekords van bronne by. Vermoë om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg in die kliniek te verseker. motiveer junior personeel rakende ontwikkeling om vlak van kundigheid te verhoog en help pasiënte om 'n sin vir selfsorg te ontwikkel. Versterk datastelsels en behandelingsuitkomste deur bystand en vaslegging op Tier.net. Verseker die versameling, kollasie en tydige indiening van akkurate geverifieerde data. Ondersteun die verwesenliking en instandhouding van ideale Kliniek- en OHSC-program in die fasiliteit.

zu.title: Umqeqeshiwezo Wezokwelapha Okuyisibonelo (PHC)
zu.summary: Umqeqeshiwezo Wezokwelapha Okuyisibonelo ohlinzela ngemisebenzi eyisizinda yokunakekelwa kwezempilo eKwaDukuza ngaphakathi kwe-Ilembe Health District, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwe-SANC nefomeshini yesikhundla esingemuva kwe-PHC.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Isitifiketi se-Matric noma i-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) i-Diploma noma i-Degree kwi-General Nursing Science kanye ne-Midwifery evumela ukubhaliswa kwe-SANC njengoba u-General Nurse, futhi (1) unyaka ofomeshini yesikhundla esingemuva kwe-Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) kanye nalolu, Isitifiketi Sokubhaliswa kwe-SANC njengoba u-General Nurse one-Midwifery kanye ne-Primary Health Care, kanye nalolu, Ukubhaliswa Okwamanje kwe-SANC (2026) Okuncane kweminyaka engu-4 yohlelo olufanele/ oluvelele lokuqashwa komsebenzi wokuhlola njengoba sengu General Nurse. I-Code 10 Drivers License. Izidingo: Izinga 2: Isitifiketi se-Matric noma i-Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) i-Diploma noma i-Degree kwi-General Nursing Science kanye ne-Midwifery evumela ukubhaliswa kwe-SANC njengoba u-General Nurse, futhi (1) unyaka ofomeshini yesikhundla esingemuva kwe-Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC Isitifiketi Sokubhaliswa kwe-SANC njengoba u-General Nurse one-Midwifery kanye ne-Primary Health Care, kanye nalolu, Ukubhaliswa Okwamanje kwe-SANC (2026). Okuncane kweminyaka engu-14 yohlelo olufanele/ oluvelele lokuqashwa komsebenzi wokuhlola ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoba sengu General Nurse kwe-SANC okuyingxenye kuyo iminyaka engu-10 kuleso sikhathi kufanele kube yimpihalo elungile/ elivelele ye-PHC ngemuva kokuthola unyaka oyedwa wofomeshini yesikhundla esingemuva kwe-Primary Health Care. I-Code 10 Drivers License. QAPHELA: Sicela uqaphele ukuthi iningi lezikliniki eKwaDukuza Sub District zisebenzakusuka ngentshona kuya kusihlofana (07h00-18h00). I-KwaDukuza Clinic isebenza amahora angu-24, i-Mpumelelo kanye ne-Groutville Clinic zisebenza ngesimemo ngemuva kwe-18h00. Abasebenzi banganconywa ukuba basize/ babekwe kunoma yisiphi isikhungo esiyisishiyagalombili (09) ngaphakathi kwe-Sub District uma kunesidingo nokuthi lise yini. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho Nokuzijwayeza Okudingekayo: Ulwazi ngazo zonke izilinganiso ezihambisana nawo njengezokuZingela, i-Mental Acts, i-OH & S Act, i-Batho Pele Principles kanye ne-Patient’s Rights Charter, i-Labour Relations Act, inqubo yokubeka izinkinga, njl. Ubuholi, ukuhleleka, ukuthatha izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphatha izinkinga kanye nokweluleka. Amakhono okuzwa kahle nokuxhumana kahle. Amakhono okuhlanganisa nokuhlela. Amakhono okwakha iqembu nokuba ngumphathi. Amakhono amahle ohlelo lobudlelwano obwakho. Ukuqonda kahle inqubo kanye namaphulasi ahlobene nokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha. Isikhathi sokusiza ekwakheni amaphulisi ahlobene nokunakekelwa kwegula.
zu.duties: Nika ikhwalithi ephelele yokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokuqasha imisebenzi yokukhuthaza, yokuvikela, yokwelapha kanye nokulungisa abakhasini kanye nomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okufanele kanye nokugcinwa kokuvaliwe kwesibhakela sezokwelapha, ukwelashwa kanye nezinto zokwelapha. Siza ekulumakeni, ekufakeni esikhundleni kanye nokuqapha bonke abasebenzi bokhwe. Nikeza ukuphathwa okuqondile nokungaqondile kubo bonke abasebenzi bakhokho futhi ube nomthombo. Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuholela ekuthuthukisweni kokuhlinzeka ngesevisi yezempilo ngokugcina imigomo kaBatho Pele. Zenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchwepheshe futhi wenze imisebenzi ngokwesibopho senqubo. Hlela amazinga wokuqapha okutheleleka nokwenza ukuze uthuthukise ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Siza ekwenzeni ukuhlola okufunda kwezokwelapha kanye nokuqamba amaphulangokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi. Thuthukisa ulwazi lwabasebenzi kanye neziguli ngemfundo yezempilo kanye nokuqeqesha ngaphakathi. Hlela amazinga nokwenza amaphulaisi we-Kliniki nokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Gcina ubuhlobo obuhle nabasebenzi nakunabanye abantu, ukuhlela ukuHlanganyela kwe-Integrated Multi Stakeholder Health Promotion Strategy. Ukuqashwa kwamaphulu wesifo, kokubili okubhaliwe nakwamakhompyutha. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kokuqeqesha okufanele kokuHlinzeka ngokunakekelwa nokwaziswa okunjalo. Hlola ulwazi lwabasebenzi kanye namaphulu wesifo ukuba bakwazi ukuzinakekela ngokwabo. Qinisa amasistimu wemininingwane kanye nemiphumela yokwelashwa ngokuzisa okusha kwi-Tier.net. Qinisekisa ukuqoqa, ukuhlanganisa nokuthumela isikhathi esifanele imininingwane eqinisekisiwe. Sekela ukuphumeleliswa kanye negqondo lokuVala okuqinisekiloluhlaza ne-OHSC Programme kwisikhungo.

xh.title: Umongikazi wokuQeqesha wezonyango (PHC)
xh.summary: Umongikazi wokuQeqesha wezonyango onika iinkonzo ezizelelweyo zokhathalelo lwempilo yamva nje eKwaDukuza ngaphakathi kwesiLungu seMimandla yeMpilo ilembe, efunayo ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC nesidanga se-PHC sasemva kokufunda isiseko.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Isatifikethi se-Matric okanye i-Grade 12 (i-Senior Certificate) iDiploma okanye iDegree kwi-General Nursing Science nase-Midwifery evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqitha weGeneral Nurse, kanjalo ne-(1) yenyanga sidanga sasemva kwesiseko kwi-Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) kanjalo neSatifikethi sokuBhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqitha we-General Nurse ngeMidwifery nase-Primary Health Care, kanjalo neNqanaba lokuBhaliswa lamanje kwi-SANC (2026) Iminyaka elinganayo i-4 yamava okuqonda okanye owaziwayo wokuba ngumongikazi njengoGqitha we-General Nurse. I-Code 10 Drivers License. Iimfuno: Inqanaba 2: Isatifikethi se-Matric okanye i-Grade 12 (i-Senior Certificate) iDiploma okanye iDegree kwi-General Nursing Science nase-Midwifery evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqitha weGeneral Nurse, kanjalo ne-(1) yenyanga sidanga sasemva kwesiseko kwi-Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC Isatifikethi sokuBhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqitha we-General Nurse nge-Midwifery nase-Primary Health Care, kanjalo neNqanaba lokuBhaliswa lamanje kwi-SANC (2026). Iminyaka elinganayo i-14 yamava okuqonda okanye owaziwayo wokuba ngumongikazi emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqitha we-General Nurse kwi-SANC apho iminyaka eli-10 leloluxesha kumele ibe ngamava okuqonda okanye owaziwayo we-PHC emva kokufumana isidanga senyaka elinye sasemva kwesiseko kwi-Primary Health Care. I-Code 10 Drivers License. QAPHELA: Nceda qaphela ukuba uninzi lweeKlinikhi eKwaDukuza Sub District zisebenza ukusuka nge-07h00 ukuya kwe-18h00. I-KwaDukuza Clinic isebenza i-24 yamaveki, i-Mpumelelo ne-Groutville Clinic zisebenza ngomseyo emva kwe-18h00. Abasebenzi banokucelwa ukuba bazalise okanye babekwe nakweyiphi na kwezisithoba (09) zezibonelelo ngaphakathi kwi-Sub District xa kwaye xa kusimthetho. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namaQondo aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngawo onke amagazethi afanelekayo anjengamagazethi eNursing, amagazethi e-Mental, i-OH & S Act, iBatho Pele Principles ne-Patient's Rights Charter, i-Labour Relations Act, inqubo yezikhalazo, njl. Ukulawula, ukuqhuba, ukwenza izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki, ukupatha iingxabano kunye neselulo. Amakhono amabalawuli kunye nokunxibelelana. Amakhono okuhlela nokusebenzisana. Amakhono okwakha iqela kunye nokuqhuba abanye. Amakhono abalawuli obudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ukuqonda okuhle ngeenkqubo namagazethi ahlobene nonyango lomongikazi. Ikhono loncedo ekwenzeni iinkqubo ezahlobene nonyando lwesigulane.
xh.duties: Nika injongo ezingagungqiyo kwi-Primary Health Care ngokunikela iinkonzo zokukhuthaza, zokuthintela, zokwelapha nokubuyisela isimo kumaxhwebhu nasekuhlangenweni. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okufanelekileyo nokugcinwa kakuhle kwesixhobo sokwelapha, i-surgical stock kunye namachiza. Nceda ekungeniseni, ekuboniseni nasekujoliseni onke amasebenzisi onyango. Nikela ngoncedo oluqondileyo nolungalulelangi kuyo yonke imisebenzi yamasebenzisi onyango yaye unike imiqondiso. Ukunikela unyango oluya kwandisa ukuhanjiswa kweenkonzo zempilo ngokuzigcina ngemigaqo ye-Batho Pele. Zenza imisebenzi kwaye usebenze ngokuqonda yaye wenze imisebenzi ngokommandla wokusebenza. Zisebenzisa iinkqubo zemigaqo yokulawula utyhefu ukuyipucakalisa unyango olugungqiyo. Nceda ngokwenza ukuhlolwa kwezonyango yaye uphucule iinkqubo zokuphucula injongo. Phucula ulwazi lwabasebenzi nolwesigulane ngokufundiswa ngempilo nangokuziqeqesha kumsebenzi. Zisebenzisa imigaqo yonnyango lomongikazi, namacenzo agenwe unyango olungagungqiyo ngokwemigaqo yaye ngokwemithetho. Gcina ubudlelwane obuakhiyo bokusebenza nabongikazi nabanomdla, ukusebenzisa iIntegrated Multi Stakeholder Health Promotion Strategy. Ulawulo lwerekhodi zabagulayo, zokubhaliweyo nezekhompyutha. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okululo kwezabantu, izinto nezemali, kwaye ugcine irekhodi yesi singamaxa. Ikhono lokucwangcisa nokuqhuba umsebenzi wakho nabo bancedisayo ukunyanzelela unyango olululo lomongikazi eklinikhi. Khuthaza abasebenzi abancinane ngenkqubo yophuhliso ukwandisa inqanaba lwamakhono yaye uncedise abagulawi ukuba baphuhlise inqulo lokuzikhathalela. Phucula iinkqubo zolwazi nemezu yokwelapha ngokuncedisa nokubhala kwi-Tier.net. Qinisekisa ukuqokelelwa, ukuhlanganiswa nokuhambisa ixesha ngelona lidata echanekileyo. Xhasa ukuzalisekisa nokugcina i-Ideal Clinic ne-OHSC Programme kwisibonelelo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resource Management
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 – R573 987 per annum. Other Benefits Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply) ,13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional).
jobs.summary: Manage human resource components and provide strategic leadership at the eThekwini District Office for the Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate or equivalent Bachelor’s Degree or National Diploma in Human Resource Management/ Personnel Management/ Human Resource Development or Public Management. A minimum of five years operational experience in Human Resource of which three years of that must be supervisory experience in Human Resource. Valid Driver’s license. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations and other prescripts applicable to Human Resource. Knowledge of PERSAL system Knowledge of basic principles of HR Management. Ability to interpret and apply policies, acts, ability to comprehend Human Resource issues. Interpersonal relations, innovation and communication skills. Financial Management, Change Management. Time management, facilitation skill, risk management. Good interpersonal relation skills. Computer literacy. Auditing skill and report writing skills Problem solving and Decision-making skills.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership of human resource management for the facility. Manage all Human Resource components, that is, Human Resource Practices, Human Resource Planning and Development, Staff Relations and Employee Wellness and ensure the provision efficient and effective services are provided. Monitor and evaluate human resource activities of the district office human resource. Ensure quality development of HRMS in line with norms and standards for CHC Ideal Clinic Realization and Maintenance Programme. Ensure effective human resource records and documents management system. Manage the payroll programme. Ensure the timely and efficient compensation of employees. Manage recruitment, selection and verification processes. Ensure the co-ordination of Institutional Management Labour Committee Meetings (IMLC). Ensure training of staff on labour relations matters. Ensure compliance with grievance and disciplinary procedures. Coordination of conciliation, mediation and arbitration proceedings. Ensure that misconduct cases in the institution are dealt with timeously. Oversee co- ordination of Institutional Employee Health and Wellness activities. Provide leadership in managing processes of aligning organizational, and post establishment structures with emerging service delivery demands as well as the imperatives set in the Annual Performance Plan for the facility or the district office. Serve in the transformation activities of the department and the district office such budget allocations as well as standard and workload statistics. Conduct staff satisfaction surveys and exit interviews. Oversee the effective implementation of the Human Resource Management policy imperatives and ensure consistency in the application. Develop strategies aimed at improving service delivery. Ensure and facilitate the consolidation of HR Plan for the facility. Provide early warnings and develop innovative solutions to overcome identified problem areas.
jobs.applications: May be hand delivered or courier to forwarded to: The Human Resource Manager, EThekwini District Office, 85 King Cetshwayo Highway, Mayville, Durban, 4000. Applicants are encouraged to apply for posts through the online e-Recruitment system at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applications may alternatively be emailed to:EthekwiniDistrictHealth.HRJobApplication@kznhealth.gov.za quoting reference number only in the subject line.
jobs.notes: Directions To Candidates: The applicant must submit a fully completed Z83 form and a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) only (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of all documents and Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resources). The official Z83 form ‘Application for employment’ (the new amended version of the Z83 form effectively from 01/01/2021 must be used only; the old Z83 form will be rejected, if used). The amended Z83 application for employment form is obtainable at any Government Department OR downloaded from the website – www.kznhealth.qov.za or www.dpsa.gov.za-vacansies. The ‘Reference Number’ and ‘Position’ for which are applying (as stated in the advert) must be clearly indicated in the columns provided on the form Z 83 e.g. Reference number PMMH 01/2026. Applications may also be submitted online via the KZN e-Recruitment System at www.kznonline.gov.za/kznjobs. Applicants must register, complete their profile and upload their CV. The appointments are subject to positive outcomes obtained from the State Security Agency (SSA) to the following checks (security clearance (vetting), criminal clearance, credit records, and citizenship), verification of Educational Qualifications by SAQA, verification of previous experience from Employers and verification from the Company Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC). To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre-entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details         here:       https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre- entryprogramme/ appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS. Only shortlisted candidates will submit proof before interview. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. The successful candidate would be required to sign a performance agreement within three months of appointment. Please note that due to the high number of applications anticipated, applications will not be acknowledged. Correspondence will be limited to short listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within two months after the closing date of the advertisement, consider your application as unsuccessful, please. African males and Persons with disabilities from all designated race groups are encouraged to apply for the post. Please note that no S&T payments will be considered for payment to candidates who are invited for interviews. It is the shortlisted candidate’s responsibility to have a foreign qualification, which is a requirement of the post, evaluated by the South Africans Qualifications authority (SAQA). Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The Department reserves the right not to fill the post/s. Failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. (This Department is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer, whose aim is to promote representivity in all levels of all occupational categories in the Department.)

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Menslike Hulpbronbestuur
af.summary: Bestuur menslike hulpbron-komponente en verskaf strategiese leierskap by die eThekwini Distrik kantoor vir die Department of Health.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate of gelykwaardige Bachelor's Degree of National Diploma in Human Resource Management/ Personnel Management/ Human Resource Development of Public Management. 'n Minimum van vyf jaar se operasionele ervaring in Menslike Hulpbronne waarvan drie jaar van daardie ervaring toesigervaring in Menslike Hulpbronne moet wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations en ander voorskrifte van toepassing op Menslike Hulpbronne. Kennis van PERSAL-stelsel. Kennis van basiese beginsels van MH-bestuur. Vermoë om beleide en wette te interpreteer en toe te pas, vermoë om Menslike Hulpbronkwessies te begryp. Interpersoonlike verhoudings, innovasie en kommunikasievaardighede. Finansiële bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur. Tydbestuur, fasiliteringsvaardigheid, risikobestuur. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Ouditeringsvaardighede en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaf strategiese leierskap van menslike hulpbronbestuur vir die fasiliteit. Bestuur alle Menslike Hulpbron-komponente, dit is, Menslike Hulpbronpraktyke, Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning en -ontwikkeling, Personeelverhoudinge en Werknemerswelwees en verseker die voorsiening van doeltreffende en effektiewe dienste. Monitor en evalueer menslike hulpbronaktiwiteite van die distrikkantoor se menslike hulpbronne. Verseker gehalte-ontwikkeling van HRMS in ooreenstemming met norme en standaarde vir CHC Ideal Clinic Realization and Maintenance Programme. Verseker effektiewe menslike hulpbronrekords en dokumentbestuurstelsel. Bestuur die loonstaatprogram. Verseis die tydige en doeltreffende vergoeding van werknemers. Bestuur werwing, keurings- en verifikasieprosesse. Verseker die koördinering van Institutional Management Labour Committee Meetings (IMLC). Verseker opleiding van personeel oor arbeidsverhoudingsake. Verseker nakoming van klagte- en dissiplinêre prosedures. Koördinering van konkiliëring, bemiddeling en arbitrasieverrigtinge. Verseker dat wangedragsgewalle in die instelling betyds hanteer word. Hou toesig oor die koördinering van Institutional Employee Health and Wellness-aktiwiteite. Verskaf leierskap in die bestuur van prosesse om organisatoriese en posvestigingsstrukture in lyn te bring met ontluikende diensleweringsbehoeftes asook die imperatiewe wat in die Annual Performance Plan vir die fasiliteit of die distrikkantoor vasgestel is. Dien in transformasie-aktiwiteite van die departement en die distrikkantoor soos beggeallokasies asook standaard en werkladingstatistiek. Voer personeeltevredenheidsopnames en uitgangsonderhoude uit. Hou toesig oor die effektiewe implementering van die menslike hulpbronbestuursbeleid se imperatiewe en verseker konsekwentheid in die toepassing daarvan. Ontwikkel strategieë wat gemik is op die verbetering van dienslewering. Verseker en fasiliteer die konsolidasie van die MH-plan vir die fasiliteit. Verskaf vroeë waarskuwings en ontwikkel innoverende oplossings om geïdentifiseerde probleemgebiede te oorkom.

zu.title: Umncedi Wezinqotho: Izabelo Msebenzi
zu.summary: Phatha izingxenye eziyizabelo msebenzi futhi unikele ubuqhongo obuyisikingathi eKantolo Yesifunda i-eThekwini kwiDepartment of Health.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate noma iziqu ezingalingana ne-Bachelor’s Degree noma i-National Diploma kwi-Human Resource Management/ Personnel Management/ Human Resource Development noma i-Public Management. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu yokuhlangenwe nakho kumsebenzi we-Human Resource, okuyiminyaka emithathu kuyo kumele kube ukuhlangenwe nakho ekubhaliseni abasebenzi kwi-Human Resource. I-Driver’s license evumelekile. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa kanye Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi nge-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations namanye amabhayimethi asebenza ku-Human Resource. Ulwazi lwesistimu ye-PERSAL. Ulwazi lwezimiso ezisisekelo ze-HR Management. Ikhono lokuhumusha nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, umthetho, ikhono laokuqonda izinkinga ze-Human Resource. Izindlela zokuzipatha nabanye, ubuciko futhi ukuxhumana. I-Financial Management, I-Change Management. I-Time management, ikhono lokukhokisa, ukuqashwa kwezingozi. Amakhono mahle okuzipatha nabanye. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha. Ikhono lokuhlola nokubhala imibiko. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga nokuthatha izinqumo.
zu.duties: Nika ubuqhongo obuyisikingathi ekuphathweni kwezabelo msebenzi kwesikhungo. Phatha wonke amakhasu e-Human Resource, okuyi, Izenzakalo ze-Human Resource, Ukuhlelwa kwe-Human Resource kanye Nokuqeqeshwa, Izindlela Zabasebenzi kanye Namaphiliyensi Obasebenzi futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kunikezwa izinsiza ezisebenza ngokuphumelelayo nangokugcina isikhathi. Buka futhi uhlolisise imisebenzi ye-Human Resource yekantolo yesifunda. Qinisekisa ukuthuthukiswa okuhle kwe-HRMS ngokuvumelana nezindinganiso kwi-CHC Ideal Clinic Realization and Maintenance Programme. Qinisekisa isistimu yokuphathwa kwezinkomba nezixhumanisi ezisebenzayo ze-Human Resource. Phatha uhlelo lokuqashwa komholo. Qinisekisa ukukhokhwa ngokushesha nangempumelelo kwabasebenzi. Phatha inqubo yokubungaza, ukukhetha futhi uqinisekise. Qinisekisa ukuhlanganiswa kwemicimbi ye-Institutional Management Labour Committee Meetings (IMLC). Qinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzi ngemikhwe yezimo zabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nokuqondana kwezinqubo zezikhalazo nezohlwayo. Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinkulumo zokubuyisana, ukubhunga futhi uye ezinkantolo zokuphathwa kwezehla. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimo zokwenza amasokizi esikhungweni ziphathwa ngesikhathi. Lawula ukuhlanganiswa kwemisebenzi ye-Institutional Employee Health and Wellness. Nikeza ubuqhongo ekuphathweni kwezinqubo zokuqondanisa izakhiwo zenhlangano, kanye nezakhiwo sezikhundla nezimfuneko ezivela ekunikweni izinsiza kanye nokuqakuliswa kwi-Annual Performance Plan yesikhungo noma ikantolo yesifunda. Ukuba yingxenye yemisebenzi yokushintsha komnyango nekantolo yesifunda njengokwabiwa kwezimali kanye nendlela ezingabalweni nokubeka kwezibalo zemisebenzi. Yenza izinhlelo zokuhlola inzwela zabasebenzi kanye namaxoxo lokuphuma. Lawula ukusetshenziswa ngokuphumelelayo kwezinqubomgomo ze-Human Resource Management futhi uqinisekise ukungaguquki ekusetshenzisweni. Butha izinqubomgomo ezihloswe ukuthuthukisa ukunikezwa kwezinsiza. Qinisekisa futhi ukukhuthaza ukuhlanganiswa kwe-HR Plan yesikhungo. Nikeza izexwayiso ngasese butha izixazululo ezintsha ukuze qeda izindawana eziphawulwe njengezinkinga.

xh.title: Umncedisi weQhosa: uLawulo loBuntu baseMsebenzini
xh.summary: Lawula iinxalenye zobuntu baseMsebenzini kwaye zinike ulawulo oluzabalathayo kwiofisi yeSithili saseThekwini kwiSebe lezeMpilo.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate okuya kulingana nayo okanye i-Bachelor’s Degree okanye i-National Diploma kwuLawulo loBuntu baseMsebenzini/ uLawulo lweBasebenzi/ uPhuhliso loBuntu baseMsebenzini okanye uLawulo lukaRhulumente. Iqondo elingaphantsi kweminyaka emihlanu yamava opheleleyo kubasebenzi abantu apho iminyaka emithathu kuleyo kufuneka ibe ngamava okulawula abantu baseMsebenzini. Ilayisensi esemthethweni yokuQhuba. Ulwazi, amakhono, uQeqesho namaphawu aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngePublic Service Act, iPublic Service Regulations nezinye izalathiso ezisebenza kubantu baseMsebenzini. Ulwazi lengxoxo yesixokelelwano sePERSAL Ulwazi lwemigaqo yeziseko yoLawulo lwaBantu baseMsebenzini. Ikhalipho lokutolika nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zemigaqo, izinto ezimthethweni, ikhalipho lokuqonda iingxaki zobuntu baseMsebenzini. Imibhungqano phakathi kwabantu, uvelwano namakhono othungelwano. uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lokuTshintsha. uLawulo lwexesha, ikhono lokukhokela iinkqubo, uLawulo lwengozi. Amakhono amabalwe phakathi kwabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokuvavanya nokubhala iingxelo Amakhono okuSombulula iingxaki nokuthatha isiQqumo.
xh.duties: Nika ulawulo oluzabalathayo kolawulo lobuntu baseMsebenzini kule ndawo. Lawula zonke iinxalenye zobuntu baseMsebenzini, oko kukuthi, iinkqubo zoLawulo loBantu baseMsebenzini, uQeqelwa noCwangciso loBantu baseMsebenzini, iNxulumano noBasebenzi nempilo yoBasebenzi kuqinisekise ukubonelelwa ngenkonzo esebenzayo nesebenzayo. Qwalasela kwaye ulinganisise imisebenzi yobantu baseMsebenzini kwiofisi yesithili yobantu baseMsebenzini. Qinisekisa uphuhliso olungangezigaba lwe-HRMS ngokwemilinganiso nemigangatho ye-CHC Ideal Clinic Realization and Maintenance Programme. Qinisekisa indlela esebenzayo yokulawula irekhodi nemitshato yobuntu baseMsebenzini. Lawula inkqubo yokuhlawula umvuzo. Qinisekisa ukuba basebenzi bahlawulwa ngexesha elifaneleyo nangendlela esebenzayo. Lawula inkqubo yokungeniswa, ukukhethwa nokuvavanywa kwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukudityaniswa kwabahlukeneyo kwabasebenzi kwiindibano ze-Institutional Management Labour Committee Meetings (IMLC). Qinisekisa uqeqesho lwabasebenzi kumacala ezimalo nabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuzityeza kwemigaqo yamacala angab enraged nemigaqo yokuLawula iSohlwayo. Dibanisa inkqubo yemibhondo yamacala amabini, yokuzisa uviwo nemibuzo yolwazi phakathi kwecala elithunyiweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba amacala okwenza kaloku kwifemernti apha lwathiwa ngelixa elifanelekileyo. Lawula ukudityaniswa kolwazi lwezemfundo nempilo yeBasebenzi kwifemernti. Nika ulawulo kumanyathelo okulungelelanisa inkampani nolawulo lwesikhundla nezigqibo zemfuno yemizekelo njengoko kumiswe kwiplani yemveliso yonyaka efumanekayo kwifemernti kwakunye nesithili. Zithabathe iinkalo ezahlukeneyo zentshabalalo yesebe kwaye unike io fisi yesithili kubalo beemali ezahlukeneyo njengoko kumiswe ngokwesiko nakubalo bokusetyenziswa. Yenza iingxelo ezivela kubasebenzi kwaye uvavanye usetyenziso lwentsha yokusingatha imisebenzi. Lawula ukusebenza ngokusebenza kwe-Human Resource Management policy kwaye uqinisekise ukulandelwa kolawulo ngokufanayo. Phuhlisa amacebo okuphucula inkonzo. Qinisekisa kwaye ukhokela ukubalwa koLwazi olubini lweNkonzo kwisithili. Nika ipeki ezivulekileyo kubakho ulwazi olutsha lweehsports ezizakuyindlela ekumgangatho ophezulu phakathi nangaphezulu. Yenza ukuba ngowona mcimbi wokuvakaliswa kweNkonzo kweqondo lomntu ofuna ukuzinceda ngokunika iinqobo eziqondiswe kumcimbi wakho.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Finance M & E
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 –R573 987 per annum. Other Benefits Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply) ,13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional).
jobs.summary: Assistant Director: Finance M&E at the eThekwini District Office, overseeing grant financial management reporting.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate or equivalent qualification Degree or Advanced Diploma in Cost and Management Accounting/Financial Management at NQF level 7 A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in Financial Management of which three (3) years’ must be supervisory experience in Financial Management environment. Valid driver’s license Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Detailed knowledge of budgeting and financial management area of operation and associated processes. Ability to communicate with all stakeholders and role –players at all levels in clear and unambiguous language. Good knowledge of Public Finance Management as well as relevant Acts and Regulations. Sound Management, negotiation, interpersonal and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of Labour Relations, discipline and grievance procedure. Good organizational and planning skills and ability to make independent decisions. Knowledge of departmental and transversal systems e.g. (PERSAL, Vulindlela and BAS). Knowledge of MS office Software applications. Numerical skills and understanding of grant funding management.
jobs.duties: The incumbent of this post will report to the Deputy Director: Finance M&E and will be responsible to report on activities to ensure effective and efficient production of reliable information on the District Grants financial Management of the Department. Facilitate development of grant funding business plan per financial year. Coordinate, manage and collate/consolidate budget estimates for grant funding as per business plans. Facilitate the division/distribution of the budget allocation between all sub-programmes. Prepare, analyse and report on expenditure versus budget for the entire grant funding in the district. Manage, coordinate and provide guidance to cash flow meetings and spending patterns. Identify, rate and institute control measures to minimise financial risks in the district. Conduct analysis on the expenditure trend to determine whether budgetary allocations are in line with the envisaged output performance and targets as per business plan. Provide regular reports pertaining to the grant performance for example DORA reports, variance reports and other reports. Manage the journalising process within the institution. Ensure correct staff linking and verification within objectives and responsibility. Manage resources with the sub-directorate. Conduct support visits to institutions within the district.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Finansies M & E
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur: Finansies M&E by die eThekwini Distrikkantoor, wat toezicht hou oos die finansiële bestuursverslagdoening van toelaes.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat of equivalente kwalifikasie Degree of Advanced Diploma in Cost and Management Accounting/Financial Management at NQF level 7 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in Finansiële Bestuur waarvan drie (3) jaar toesigervaring in 'n Finansiële Bestuursomgewing moet wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Gedetailleerde kennis van begroting en finansiële bestuur se bedryfsarea en geassosieerde prosesse. Vermoë om met alle belanghebbendes en rolspelers op alle vlakke in duidelike en ondubbelsinnige taal te kommunikeer. Goeie kennis van Publieke Finansiële Bestuur asook relevante Wette en Regulasies. Degelijke bestuurs-, onderhandelings-, interpersoonlike en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis van Arbeidsverhoudinge, dissipline en klagteprosedure. Goeie organisatoriese en beplanningsvaardighede en vermoë om onafhanklike besluite te neem. Kennis van departementale en transversale stelsels bv. (PERSAL, Vulindlela en BAS). Kennis van MS office sagtewaretoepassings. Numeriese vaardighede en begrip van toelaefondingsbestuur.
af.duties: Die amp draer van hierdie pos sal aan die Adjunkdirekteur: Finansies M&E rapporteer en sal verantwoordelik wees om oor aktiwiteite te rapporteer om doeltreffende en effektiewe produksie van betroubare inligting oor die Distriktoelaes se finansiële bestuur van die departement te verseker. Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van 'n toelaefondingsbesigheidsplan per finansiële jaar. Koördineer, bestuur en versamel/konsolideer begrotingskattings vir toelaefondings volgens besigheidsplanne. Fasiliteer die verdeling/verspreiding van die begrotingstoekenning tussen alle subprogramme. Berei voor, ontleed en rapporteer oor bestedings teenoor begroting vir die totale toelaefondings in die distrik. Bestuur, koördineer en verskaf leiding oor kontantvloei-vergaderings en bestedingspatrone. Identifiseer, gradeer en instelleer kontrolemaatreëls om finansiële risiko's in die distrik te minimaliseer. Doen ontleding van die bestedingstendens om te bepaal of begrotingstoekennings in ooreenstemming is met die beoogde uitsetprestasie en teikens volgens besigheidsplan. Verskaf gereelde verslae aangaande die toelaeprestasie byvoorbeeld DORA-verslae, afwykingsverslae en ander verslae. Bestuur die joernaliseringsproses binne die instelling. Verseker korrekte persoonskakeling en verifikasie binne doelwitte en verantwoordelikheid. Bestuur hulpbronne binne die subdirektoraat. Doen ondersteuningsbesoeke aan instellings binne die distrik.

zu.title: Umncintiswana Owayo: Finance M & E
zu.summary: Umncintiswana Owayo: Finance M&E e-eThekwini District Office, ethatha inqophamlando engemizuzwana yalawa imibiko yokuphathwa kwezimali ngesibonezelo.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate noma izifundo ezilinganayo Degree noma Advanced Diploma kwi-Cost and Management Accounting/Financial Management ezingeni le-NQF level 7. Ubudala obungangeni eminyaka emihlanu (5) wobuhlole obwenziwe ebunzimeni bobulawa bezimali, kubhekwa khona ubuhlole obwenziwe eminyakeni emithathu (3) ngaphansi komtapo wabalawuli ozenza kulo mnyango we-financial management. I-driver's license evumelekileyo Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Ulwazi olubhaliweyo ngendawo yokuvulwa kobulumko kanye nendawo yomsebenzi womphathwa kwezimali, kanye nezinkonzo ezihlotshaniswa nayo. Isakhono sokuthetha ngokucacileyo ngesiyesi esi-cacileyo, isithethi kwaye asinasiphithiphithi abantu abafuzisileyo kuleyondawo, ngazo zonke iinzwelo zomanyano lwabo. Ulwazi olulungileyo ngomthetho wemali yoluntu, kanye noMthetho kanye neMigaqo enqamlezileyo. Isakhono sokugcina imisebenzi, ukududula ngokomthetho kakhulu, ukuzimisela nokutshisa ubundlobongela abantu, kwaye neyoku-sombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi ngamathetho abasebenzi, ngendlela yokusingatha ukungalawuleki komsebenzi kwaye nendlela yokuziphatha ngakumbi ngokuthetha. Isakhono esilunge ukuhlelwa komsebenzi, kwaye isakhono sokubiza izigqibo ngokuzimela. Ulwazi ngezinto ezifanayo ezimbaxa, ezifana ne-(PERSAL, Vulindlela and BAS). Ulwazi ngemiqulu ye-MS office Software applications. Isakhono sokubala kwaye sibe nokuqonda ukulawulwa kwezimali ezinikwa ngokwesibonezelo.
zu.duties: Umntu owayo kweli sikhundla siza kubika ku-Deputy Director: Finance M&E, aze abeke izimvo ngomsebenzi ukuze kuqiniseke nangokulinganayo ukudluliselwa kolwazi oluthembekileyo ebunzimeni bomphathwa kwezimali wezibonezelo eDistrikini sikawumnyango. Phakamisa intshukumo yokuphuhliswa kobuchule bezibonezelo besabhala ngonyaka ofanelekileyo. Qhube, yenze kwaye uqoqe/hlanganisa izilinganiselo zokuhlelwa kobuchule bezibonezelo njengoko kuyimfuneko kuphetho kobuchule bobugcisa. Qonda kwaye ulandele ukutholakala kobuchule ngokwengxenye ukuya kuzo zonke izinto ezingaphantsi kwezinto eziqhelekileyo. Lungiselela, hlwaye kwaye uchaze ngenkcazelo yokutshixa imali kwakunye nokuhlelwa kwezimali ngokupheleleyo kwezibonezelo ezinkulu e-distrikini. Yenza kakhulu, qhube kwaye unike ngokucacileyo inkqubela ngokuhlangana kwemali ukuya kubakho isikhundla sokuchitha imali. Qaphela, wakhe kwaye umiswe izigqibo ezizakunceda ukunciphisa ubungozi bezimali e-distrikini. Yenza i-nalythi ngomdlalo wokuqonda ukuba ingaba izabelo ezinkanwilwe ngokuhlelwa ziyasebenza kwamagqabi ngokohamba emva kwemimiselo ebaliweyo yokuba sebenze njengoko kumiswe kwipulani lobugcisa benkonzo. Nikela ngemibiko eqhelekileyo ngenkqubela yesibonezelo, njengokuba ngolu hlobo DORA reports, variance reports neminye imibiko. Lawula inkqubo yokubhalwa kwezinto ngokomthetho ngaphakathi kwesixhobo. Qinisekisa ukwahlukaniswa okufanelekileyo nokuhlangenwa komsebenzi kwigumbi elihloko. Lawula amathuba amakhulu ohlelo lwesapho esingaphantsi kolawulo. Yenza ukubakho kwesikhundla kweekhowudi ngenkxaso ezenzakalelayo kwiziko ngaphakathi kwesigcawu.

xh.title: Isebe lezeMali: I-Deputy Director Finance M&E
xh.summary: I-Deputy Director eNgingizimu Africa: Imisebenzi yeMali ekupheleni konyaka we-2020. Ngokuphathelele kokuqinisekisa ukuba imali ichanekile, kufuneka ubone ukuba nayiphi na imisebenzi ekwi-arhente ngokupheleleyo iyakwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ubengumntu onomdla kakhulu kwimisebenzi yohulo yemali. Iminikelo yokulinganisa imali ahlobo njengale ntlandathathu yamagqabantshintshi: igama elithi 'imisebenzi yomanyano lweqonga ngokubanzi kakhulu liyakubakho njengenye yezinto ezininzi ezingaqondwa kakuhle ngabantu abangaziyo ngemali echwetheziweyo. Kufuneka uqinisekise ukuba imali ethunyelwe kwiSizwe ngokupheleleyo ihamba ngokuchanekileyo. Namhlanje kufuneka ugqibe imisebenzi yakho ngokupheleleyo ukuze wonwabele imisebenzi yakho yemihla ngemihla.
xh.duties: Umphathi wesi siguqulo sasemva sobuntathu: i-Deputy Director: Finance M&E. Ukuze wenze imisebenzi yakho ngokuchanekileyo, kufuneka ubhale ngayo into ezakwenziwa kwisebe apho uphathwa khona. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi iyakwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo nakwezinye iindawo ezahlukahlukeneyo. Kufuneka uqinisekise ukuba nayiphi na imisebenzi ekwi-arhente ngokupheleleyo iyakwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Fleet
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 –R573 987 per annum. Other Benefits Home Owner Allowance (conditions apply) ,13th Cheque (conditions apply), Medical Aid (Optional).
jobs.summary: Oversee fleet management across hospitals and district health facilities in eThekwini, ensuring compliance, conducting audits and reporting to district and provincial management.

A minimum five (5) years’ experience in fleet management of which three (3) years must be supervisory experience in Transport related environment, Valid driver’s license. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Ability to apply technical/professional knowledge and skills in the work area and wider work environment. Ability to keep abreast of work-related developments. Change Management, Decision making, time management skills. Risk Management Skills Good interpersonal relation skills. Public Service Financial Management, Departmental policies and procedures, project management, Intermediate Human Resources Development, General management, Strategic management, Skills Development Act, LRA, BCEA. Leadership, Facilitation, Computer literacy skills Good Presentation skill, Innovative, Analytical, Verbal and written communications skills Good People Management skill.
jobs.duties: Oversee management and use of the fleets in hospitals, CHCs, EMS, Mortuaries and PHC. Ensure compliance to fleet management policies and prescripts. Conduct fleet audits. Compile and present reports to district management and provincial office as required. Monitor and report on fleet management indicators on Annual Performance Plan Ensure availability of fleet to reduce complaints by monitoring that servicing and necessary repairs are conducted. Conducting physical inspections to determine the condition of fleet for possible damage. Identifying underutilized vehicles due for replacement (BOS). Monitor the allocation of KZN vehicles and vehicles used for private on official use. Maintain proper records for fleet management and audit purposes. Ensure functionality of accident committees across the district. Identify fleet risks related to fleet management and implement mitigation strategies. Monitor fleet expenditure across the district. Conduct stakeholder engagements for the rationalisation of transport. Provide on road, emergency support for incidents relating to fleet for example hijacking and accident. Provide input and implement policies pertaining licensing of district vehicles. Monitor licensing disc and tracking disc for all vehicles in the district Monitor asset register of Departmental vehicles, Coordinate and monitor payment of fines to relevant traffic departments.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Vloot
af.summary: Oorsien vlootbestuur oor hospitale en distriksgesondheidsfasiliteite in eThekwini, verseker nakoming, voer oudite uit en rapporteer aan distriks- en provinsiale bestuur.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Graad of Nasionale Diploma in Vervoerbestuur of Openbare Bestuur of Openbare Administrasie. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in vlootbestuur waarvan drie (3) jaar toesigervaring in 'n vervoerverwante omgewing moet wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Vermoë om tegniese/professionele kennis en vaardighede in die werkarea en wyer werksomgewing toe te pas. Vermoë om tred te hou met werkverwante ontwikkelinge. Veranderingsbestuur, besluitneming, tydbestuursvaardighede. Risikobestuursvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Openbare Dienste Finansiële Bestuur, Departementele beleide en prosedures, projekbestuur, intermediêre Menslike Hulpbronontwikkeling, algemene bestuur, strategiese bestuur, Vaardigheidsontwikkelingswet, LRA, BCEA. Leierskap, fasilitering, rekenaargeletterdheidsvaardighede. Goeie aanbiedingsvaardigheid, innoverend, analities, mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Goeie mensbestuursvaardigheid.
af.duties: Oorsien bestuur en gebruik van vloot in hospitale, CHCs, EMS, Lykhuise en PHC. Verseker nakoming van vlootbestuursbeleide en voorskrifte. Voer vlootoudite uit. Stel verslae op en bied dit aan distriksbestuur en provinsiale kantoor soos vereis. Monitor en rapporteer oor vlootbestuursaanwysers op die Jaarlikse Prestasieplan. Verseker beskikbaarheid van vloot om klagtes te verminder deur te monitor dat diens en nodige herstelwerk gedoen word. Fisiese inspeksies uitvoer om die toestand van vloot vir moontlike skade te bepaal. Onderbenutte voertuie identifiseer wat vir vervanging in aanmerking kom (BOS). Monitor die toekenning van KZN-voertuie en voertuie wat vir privaat gebruik amptelik gebruik word. Handhaaf behoorlike rekords vir vlootbestuur en ouditdoeleindes. Verseker funksionering van ongelukkomitees oor die distrik. Identifiseer vlootrisiko's verbonde aan vlootbestuur en implementeer mitigasiestrategieë. Monitor vlootuitgawes oor die distrik. Voer belanghebbende-betrokkenheid uit vir die rasionalisering van vervoer. Verskaf pad- en noodhulp vir voorvalle wat met vloot verband hou, byvoorbeeld kaping en ongelukke. Verskaf insette en implementeer beleide rakende lisensiëring van distriksvoertuie. Monitor lisensieskyf en opsporingskyf vir alle voertuie in die distrik. Monitor bate register van Departementele voertuie. Koördineer en monitor betaling van boetes aan die onderskeie verkeersdepartemente.

zu.title: Umsekela Mfundi Ohola: Imaqembu Ezimoto
zu.summary: Qapha ukuphathwa kwamaqembu ezimoto ezibhedlela nasemagunyeni ezempilo esifundeni eThekwini, uqinisekise ukuziphendulela, wenze ukubuyekezwa kube ugxile kanjalo ubeke umbiko kubaphathi besifundo nabaphathi esifundazweni.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate noma isimo sokuhambisana nesiqu. I-Degree noma i-National Diploma kwi-Transport Management noma i-Public Management noma i-Public Administration. Okungenani amakhulu amahlanu (5) iminyaka yamava ekuphathweni kwamaqembu ezimoto, okuyiminyaka emithathu (3) kumele kube ngamava okuhlakanipha ngenani kokuhlola emkhakheni ohlobene no-Transport. Idrayiva elifanele. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho Nokwaziswa Okudingekayo: Ikhono lokusebenzisa ulwazi olusebenzayo/lomuntu ochwepheshe namakhono endaweni yokusebenza nendaweni ebanzi yokusebenza. Ikhono lokuba usephusheni ngentuthuko ezihlobene nomsebenzi. Ukuphathwa Kwesinguquko, Ukwenza izinqumo, amakhono okuphatha isikhathi. Amakhono Okuphatha Ingcuphitelo Amakhono amahle ohlwibanano nomuntu. Ukuphathwa Kwezimali Komphakathi, Izinqubomgomo nezinqubo Zomnyango, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuqeqeshwa kwemithombo yabasebenzi kwazinga eliphakathi, ukuphatha ngokuvamile, ukuphatha ngokuqondile, i-Skills Development Act, i-LRA, i-BCEA. Ukukhokha, Ukukhuthaza, amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha Amakhono amahle okuzibonisa, Okubalulekile, Okuhlwayo, Amakhono okuxoxa ngomlomo nangokubhala Amakhono amahle Okuphatha Abantu.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuphathwa nokusetshenziswa kwamaqembu ezimoto ezibhedlela, amagumbi ezempilo ahlanganisiwe, i-EMS, izindawo zokugcina izidumbu kanye ne-PHC. Qinisekisa ukuziphendulela kuzinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kwamaqembu ezimoto nasezimweni. Yenza ukubuyekezwa kwamaqembu ezimoto. Hlanganisa futhi unikeze imibiko kubaphathi besifundo nasehhovisi lesifundazwe njengoba kudingeka. Qapha ubeke umbiko kumabonisi okuphathwa kwamaqembu ezimoto ku-Annual Performance Plan Qinisekisa ukutholakala kwamaqembu ezimoto ukunciphisa izikhalazo ngokuqapha ukuthi ukulekwa nokulungiswa okudingekayo kwenziwa. Wenza ukubuyekezwa ngokomzimba ukunquma isimo samaqembu ezimoto ngesithsakazo esingase sibe khona. Ukuhlukanisa izimoto ezingasetshenziswa kakhulu ezifanele ukushintshwa (BOS). Qapha ukwabiwa kwezimoto ze-KZN nezimoto ezisetshenziselwa ukusetshenziswa ngasese ngasese. Gcina irekhodi elifanele lokuphathwa kwamaqembu ezimoto nangenhloso yokubuyekezwa. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwamakomithi ezinsimu kulo lonke isifundo. Hlukanisa ingozi zamaqembu ezimoto eziyohlobene nokuphathwa kwamaqembu ezimoto bese usebenzisa izindlela zokunciphisa. Qapha ukuchithwa kwemali yamaqembu ezimoto kulo lonke isifundo. Yenza ukubambisana nabahlanganyeli ngokuhlukanisa kabusha ukuthunyelwa kwezimoto. Nikeza usizo oluyinhlobo lwendlu ngesikhathi sezinsimu eziyinhlekelele ezihlobene namaqembu ezimoto ngokwesibonelo ukweba nensimu. Faka imininingwane usebenzise izinqubomgomo eziphathelene nelayisensi yezimoto zesifundo. Qapha idiski yelayisensi nedebe yokulandela izimoto kulo lonke isifundo Qapha irekhodi lezimpahla zezezimoto Zomnyango, hlela futhi uqaphe ukukhokhwa kwezimali zezehlabathi ezithintelayo emagunyeni ohlelo lwethuvela.

xh.title: Umphathi Ongenelo: Uqeqesho lemimoto
xh.summary: Qwalasela ulawulo loqeqesho lemimoto kuzibangela kunye neziko lezempi lo eThekwini, kuqinisekiswa ukuzithoba kumthetho, ukuqhuba uvavanyo nokubika kubaphathi bezithili kunye nabaphathi basembindini.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate okanye isidanga esilinganayo i-Degree okanye i-National Diploma kwi-Transport Management okanye i-Public Management okanye i-Public Administration. Okungaphezulu kweminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava kulawulo loqeqesho lemimoto apho iminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka ibe yimava yokuqhuba kwendawo ehlobene noThutho, ilayisenisi yomqhubi esebenzayo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namandla aFunekayo: Ikhono lokusebenzisa ulwazi lwamandla obuchwephesha/lobugcisa kwendawo yomsebenzi nako kunye nendawo ekujikelezi kuyo. Ikhono lokugcina iqondo ngenkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezihlobene nomsebenzi. UkuLawula uTshintsho,ukuThatha iziGqibo, amakhono obusela inkqubo. Amakhono oLawulo loMngcipheko Amakhono amabalwe nendlela yokwazana nabantu. UkuLawula kweMali koMphakathi, iinkqubomgama nendlela zokusebenza zeSebe, ulawulo lweenkqubo, uPhuhliso lwaBasebenzi loBuchwephesha ongalinganisanga, uLawulo jikelele, uLawulo lweNqanaba eliphezulu, i-Skills Development Act, i-LRA, i-BCEA. UkuQhuba, ukuNcedisa, amakhono oKwazi ukuSebenzisa iKhompyutha Amakhono amabalwe nokubonisa okuhle, okutsha, okuhlaluhlisayo, okwenziwa ngomlomo nokubhalwa, namakhono oLawulo abaBasebenzi.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ulawulo nokuSebenzisa iqela lemimoto kuzibangela, kwi-CHCs, i-EMS, izikhululo zabafiwa kunye ne-PHC. Qinisekisa ukuzithoba kumthetho kumthetho nemiGaqo yokuLawula iqela leMimoto. Qhuba uvavanyo lokuQinisekisa iMimoto. Qamba uBunge bokuBika ubunike abaPhathi beSithili kunye neNtliko yaSebe njengoko kufuneka. Qwalasela ukuBika ngeembonakaliso zokuLawula iqela leMimoto kwinkqubo yoMsebenzi woNyaka Qinisekisa ukufumaneka kweMimoto ukuze kuncitshiswe iingxelo ngokuQwalasela ukuba kwenziwa inkonzo namakonzo afunekayo. Qhuba uvavanyo ngokubonakaliyo ukuze kubekwe isimo seMimoto nako kunye nako unako ukutshatyalaliswa. Kuqatshwa iMimoto ezingasetyenziswa kangako ezifanele ukutshatyalaliswa (i-BOS). Qwalasela ukwabiwa kweMimoto ze-KZN kunye neMimoto ezoSetyenziswa ngesizathu sobuQu kumsebenzi oQaqshileyo. Gcina iirekhodi ezifanelekileyo zokuLawula iqela leMimoto nenzalo yokuQinisekisa. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kweekomiti zoonxibelelwano kwisiThili. Qaphela iingozi ezingavela kwinkqubo yokuLawula iMimoto nendlela yokuzilawula. Qwalasela iindleko zokuLawula iqela leMimoto kwisiThili. Qhuba imibuzo-ndibano nabathintekayo ngenjongo yokuYila uThutho. Nikeza inkxaso ngiMoto yoonxibelelwano bexesha Ibhengekileyo nokuNcedisa kwiziganeko ezifana ne-Qinisekisa ilayisenisi yeenqwemela zokuziqhelanisa ezingekho emthethweni kuqwalaselwa kuzo zonke iMimoto kwiSithili Qwalasela umbhalo welayisenisi kwaye ulandele idiski ethule yonke imimoto kwisithili Gcina irekhodi yamafa eSebe looMsebenzi, Lalisa ukuQwalasela ukuHlawula iIntlawulo zeNtshishino kwizikhongozeli ezifanelekileyo ze-Nxa yokuHlawula iNgxelo.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse (SPECIALTY) Theatre
jobs.centre: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.city: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse sought for Theatre speciality at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, with post-registration experience graded across two salary bands.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing, Grade 2: A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate/ recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing of which at least 10 (ten) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the 1 (one) year post basic qualification in relevant speciality. Senior Certificate or equivalent, Degree/Diploma in General nursing, One (01) year Post Basic qualification in Operating Theatre Nursing Science. Registration certificate with South African Nursing Council (SANC). Current SANC receipt (2026). A minimum of four (4) years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Successful candidate will have to spend minimum of one year in service. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal framework such as Nursing Acts, Health Act, Patient Right Charter, Batho Pele Principle, Public Service Regulations, Disciplinary Code and Procedures in the Public Service. Financial and Budgetary knowledge pertaining to relevant resources under management. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Leadership, Organizational, Decision making, Problem solving, Co – ordination, Liaisons and Interpersonal skills within the limits of the Public Sector and Institutional policy framework. Interpersonal skills including Public relation, Negotiating, Conflict handling and Counselling skills. Computer skills in basic programs.
jobs.duties: Assist in planning/organizing and monitoring of objectives of the specialized unit in consultation with subordinates. Effective management of patients, display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating. Proper treatment and care including awareness and willingness to respond to patient’s needs, requirements and expectations. Provision of quality services through setting of standards, policies and procedures. Participate in the implementation of National Priorities clinical guidelines, protocols. Maintain accurate and complete patient records according to legal requirements. Exercise control over discipline, grievance and labour relations issues. Promote good working relationships amongst staff and patients. Assist in supervision and development of all nursing staff. Ensure effective participation in all hospital programs e.g. IPC, Quality Assurance, etc. Provide a Safe, therapeutic and hygienic environment for patients, visitors and staff.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige (SPESIALITEIT) Teater
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige gesoek vir Teater-spesialiteit by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, met na-registrasie-ervaring wat oor twee salarisbande gegradeer word.
af.requirements: Vlak 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging, Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van veertien (14) jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging waarvan ten minste 10 (tien) jaar van die bogenoemde tydperk gepaste/erkenbare ervaring na die verkryging van die 1 (een) jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit moet wees. Senior Sertifikaat of gelykwaardig, Graad/Diploma in Algemene verpleging, Een (01) jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie in Operasionele Teaterverpleegkunde. Registrasiesertifikaat by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegkunderaad (SANC). Huidige SANC-kwitansie (2026). 'n Minimum van vier (4) jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal 'n minimum van een jaar in diens moet deurbring. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, verpleegstatutes en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke soos die Verpleegwette, Gesondheidswet, Pasienteregtehandves, Batho Pele-beginsel, Openbare Diensregulasies, Dissiplinêre Kode en Prosedures in die Openbare Diens. Finansiële en begrotingskennis met betrekking tot tersaaklike hulpbronne onder bestuur. Insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Leierskap, Organisatoriese, Besluitnemings-, Probleemoplossings-, Koördinerings-, Skakel- en Interpersoonlike vaardighede binne die perke van die Openbare Sektor en Institusionele beleidsraamwerk. Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend Openbare betrekkinge, Onderhandelings-, Konflikhanterings- en Voorligtingsvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die beplanning/organisering en monitering van die doelstellings van die gespesialiseerde eenheid in oorleg met ondergeskiktes. Effektiewe bestuur van pasiënte, besorgdheid oor pasiënte toon, bevorder en beyker. Behoorlike behandeling en sorg insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op die behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge van pasiënte te reageer. Voorsiening van gehaltedienste deur die stel van standaarde, beleide en prosedures. Neem deel aan die implementering van Nasionale Prioriteite kliniese riglyne, protokolle. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasiëntrekords volgens wetlike vereistes. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline, griewe en arbeidsverhoudingsake. Bevorder goeie werksverhoudinge onder personeel en pasiënte. Bystand verleen met toesig en ontwikkeling van alle verpleegpersoneel. Verseker effektiewe deelname aan alle hospitaalprogramme bv. IPC, Gehaltversekering, ens. Voorsien 'n Veilige, terapeutiese en higiëniese omgewing vir pasiënte, besoekers en personeel.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Wezempilo Ohlobene (SPECIALTY) I-Theatre
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umsebenzi Wezempilo Ohlobene ombhekene ne-Theatre esibhedlela i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital e-KwaZulu-Natal, anomunyaka wokusebenza emva kokuqashwa eqenjini lokuqashwa ngaphakathi kwezinqulwana ezimbili zoholo.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 1: Okungeyona into engaphansi kweminyaka eyi-4 yokusebenza okufanele/okuvunywe ngemuva kokuqashwa njengoMsebenzi Wezempilo Ohlobene ne-SANC kuleyo Nzalo Yokunakekelwa, I-Grade 2: Okungeyona into engaphansi kweminyaka eyishumi nane (14) yokusebenza okufanele/okuvunywe kulo Nywili kanye nokusebenza ngemuva kokuqashwa njengoMsebenzi Wezempilo Ohlobene ne-SANC kuleyo Nzalo Yokunakekelwa okokokuthi okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 (ishumi) kuleso sikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele kube ukusebenza okufanele/okuvunywe ngemuva kokuthola isikhwama seminyaka eyi-1 (eyodwa) sezenzo lapha esibhekene nalelo simo. Isitifikedi se-Senior noma esilinganayo, I-Degree/Diploma kuleyo Nzalo Yokunakekelwa, Isikhwama seminyaka eyi-01 (eyodwa) sesenzo ngemuva kokuqashwa esifundeni se-Operating Theatre Nursing Science. Isitifikedi sokubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC). Isipolombe se-SANC samanje (2026). Okungeyona into engaphansi kweminyaka eyi-4 (eyine) yokusebenza okufanele/okuvunywe ngemuva kokuqashwa njengoMsebenzi Wezempilo Ohlobene ne-SANC kuleyo Nzalo Yokunakekelwa. Lowo ophumelelayo uzodinga ukusebenza okungenani unyaka oyisikhathi. Ulwazi, Amandla, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Okwenza Izinto Abadingekayo: Ulwazi ngemikhuba nezinqubo zokunakekelwa, izintshumayelo zonywili, kanye nezinye izimiso ezihlobene njengezinye izi-Act eziyisikhungo Senywili, i-Health Act, i-Patient Right Charter, Iminongo ye-Batho Pele, Izimiso Zomphakathi, Ikhodi Yokulawula Nokwenza Izinto Esikhungweni Somphakathi. Ulwazi mayelana nezimali namapheshi oholo ohlobene nezinsiza ezisizingeni sakho. Ukuqonda kwemikhuba nezimiso ezihlobene nokunakekelwa. Amawusizo, Umbhobho, Ukwenza Izinqumo, Ukuxazulula Izinkinga, Ukuhlanganisa, Ukuxhumanisa kanye Nokuqhathaniswa nabantu emaphakethe noma imibhalo yamandulo, emibhalweni. Amawusizo ohlanganyelo ahlanganisa Ubudlelwano Nomphakathi, Ukuxoxisana, Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, kanye Nokuqeqesha. Amawusizo kulezi nyathelo zemisebenzi yesicelo seminikelo.
zu.duties: Usiza ekulungiseleleni/ukuhleleni kanye nokubhekelwa kwezinjongo yesigaba esibhekene nalo ekuqondeni nophakamisa noma uqobo kwemithetho. Ukuphatha ngempumelelo iziguli, kanye nokuphakamisa ukunakekelwa kweziguli. Ukuphatha nokunakekelwa okuhle okuhlanganisa ukuqonda nokuthanda ukusabela kwezidingo, izidingo nezilindelo zesiguli. Ukunikezwa kwezinsiza ezinhle ngokuhlelela kwemigomo, izimiso nezinqubo. Ukubamba iqhaza ekusetshenzisweni kwezimiso zokuqala eziphakeme kwezobuchwepheshe, izinqubo. Ukuphatha ngokujabulayo nokugcina izibhalo ezifanele zesiguli ngokwemithetho. Ukusebenzisa amandla phezulu ekubhekeleni nezingqinamba kanye nemithelela yomsebenzi. Ukukhuthaza ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi neziguli. Ukusiza ekuhlolweni nasekuthuthukisweni kuyo yonke imisebenzi yonywili. Ukuqinisekisa ukubamba iqhaza kokuqeqeshwa okuhle kuyo yonke imikhuba yomnyango njenge-IPC, Ukuphathwa kwe-Holikhwa, njll. Ukunikeza ukugqama okuvikelekile, okwamukelekile nokuhlanzelekile iziguli, abavakashi kanye nauthu

xh.title: Umongikazi oPhathwayo (SPECIALTY) kwiTheatre
xh.summary: Kufunwa uMongikazi oPhathwayo wokusesigxabeni kwiTheatre eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, anamava emva kokuqulunqwaswa njengomongikazi abekwe kumqondo wemivuzo emiqulu ebekwe kwela nqanaba mivuzo.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Amava amancinci aneminyaka yamane (4) ehambelanayo/ekwaziwayo kwimisebenzi yokongikazi emva kokuqulunqwa njengoMongikazi oPhathwayo ngeSANC kwisiXhobo sokuQeqeswa iNtloko kwiZiko jikelele. Inqanaba 2: Amava amancinci aneminyaka elishumi eline (14) ehambelanayo/ekwaziwayo kumisebenzi yokongikazi emva kokuqulunqwa njengoMongikazi oPhathwayo ngeSANC kwisiXhobo sokuQeqeswa iNtloko kwiZiko jikelele, apho ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi (10) kule minyaka idiwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava ahambelanayo/akwaziwayo emva kokufumana isidanga somnyaka owodwa (1) wokuQeqeswa emva kokuqeqeselwa ekuqaleni kwesigaba ekusesigxabeni. Isatifikethi seNqanaba ePhakamile okanye esilinganayo, iDiploma/IDigri ekwiQeqeswa iNtloko jikelele, Isidanga somnyaka omnye (01) semva kokuQeqeselwa ekusesigxabeni kumFundo weSayensi yokuQhuba kwiTheatre. Isatifikethioku qulunqwa ngeSouth African Nursing Council (SANC). Isiphothi seSANC (2026). Amava amancinci aneminyaka emine (4) ehambelanayo/ekwaziwayo emva kokuqulunqwa njengoMongikazi oPhathwayo ngeSANC kwisiXhobo sokuQeqeswa iNntloko jikelele. Umphumeleli kuya kufuneka ahlale kakhulu unyaka owodwa enkonzweni. Ulwazi, amakhono, uQeqesho neNtshukumo efunekayo: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo nezith wobomi nokongikazi, ngezithethe zokongikazi, namanye amagama agramanayo efuna ulwazi afana namagama wokuQhuba abongikazi, umthetho weMithlalo, isatifikethi seMigunya yokuPhila, iNkqubo yeNtshukumo, iMigaqo yoKhetho lwabasebenzi baseRhurhweni, iNkqubo yokulawula oluqhawule kubasebenzi baseRhurhweni. Ulwazi ngokulawula neMali oSwelo-mali kwizibonelelo ezikwisikhundla salawulo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo namagunya agramanayo ngesixhobo sokongikazi. Amandlaokuhlala phambi, uBumba, ukwenzaisigqibo, ukuSombulula iingxaki, ukuHlanganisa namakhonoukuQondisa kwaye namakhono ongq dilikileyo ngaphakathi kweendawo zowarha yomKhankanywa neNkqubo yolawulo kwisikhundla. Amakhono oqhagamshelwano aquka iinkqubo zoLuntu, ukuHoxwa amazwi, ukuSombulula iingxabano nokuNika iNgcebiso. Amakhono eKhompyutha ekwinngqamela ezisisiseko.
xh.duties: Nceda ukuqamba/uBumba kunye noKuhlola iinjongo zesixhobo kwingcebela kunye nabangamanyathelo ngaphantsi. ULawulo olusebenzayo lweSigulane, ukhombisa inkathalelo kwiSigulane, ukukhuthaza nokumela. Unyango oluNgcali nokunika ingqalelo kubandakanya ukuqonda nokulungele ukuphendula iimfuno, iimfuno nemilinganiselo yomntu. Unika iNkonzo yomgangatho ophezulu ngokuMisa imilinganiselo, amagunya namba. Ulungiselela ukuSetyenziswa iNkqubo yamagunya aBucala obuBakhulu obukoluKhetho, iProto. Uphathe iSazizi ngokudanyeko nokuQhawule nokuQhawule kwabasebenzi ngokwemigaqo yomthetho. Khuthaza ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabasebenzi nasoLuntu. Nceda kulawulo noVuselelo lwoNke abasebenzi bamaKhosi. Qinisekisa ulungiselelo oluSebenzayo lwoNke amacandelo esibhedlele, umzx. iIPC, Umdla wolunxibelelwano, nezinye. Nikezise iNdawo eKhuselekileyo, yokwelapha nahle yokucoca iNdawo oLuntu, iindwendwe nabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse (SPECIALTY)
jobs.centre: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.city: Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional nurse speciality post at Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration and four to fourteen years of relevant nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing, Grade 2: A minimum of fourteen (14) years appropriate/ recognizable experience in Nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing of which at least 10 (ten) years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the 1 (one) year post basic qualification in relevant speciality. Senior Certificate or equivalent, Degree/Diploma in General Nursing, One year post basic Degree/Diploma in Critical Care plus four (04) years appropriate /recognizable registration experience as a General Nurse. Registration with SANC as a General Nurse and Speciality Nurse. Proof of current/previous work experience endorsed and stamped by Human Resource Department will be required for shortlisted candidates. Successful candidate will have to spend minimum of one year in service. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Knowledge of Nursing Care, Processes and Procedures, Nursing statutes, and other relevant Legal frameworks. Good communication skills-verbal and written. Co- ordination and liaison skills. Problem solving skills.
jobs.duties: Assist in planning/organizing and monitoring of objectives of the specialized unit. Provide a therapeutic environment for staff, patients and public. Provide comprehensive, quality nursing care. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all Nursing Staff /Housekeeping staff and to give them guidance and ensure continuity of patient care on all level. Demonstrate effective communication patient and families with the multi-disciplinary team, other department within the hospital. Assist with allocation/change list, day and night duty rosters and inputs for leave. Assist in record keeping and provide statistical information on training and staffing. To assist in EPMDS evaluation of staff and implement EAP. Assist in orientation, induction and monitoring of all nursing staff. To complete patient related data and partake in research. Promote quality specialized nursing care as directed by scope of practice and standards determined by the relevant specialty. To assist with relief duties of the supervisor and act as junior shift-leader on both day and night shift. To partake in overall specialized unit functions, i.e. team building Effective and efficient management of all resources. Liaise with professional Nurse in charge in surgical high care/renal unit. Allocation of Staff on day and night duty within the Directorate in rotational basis. To nurse a critically ill patient who is ventilated, on haemodialysis and continuous-venous haemodialysis. To nurse all types of patients regardless of diagnoses according to disease profile within the directorate. Maintain Professional growth/ethical standard and self- development.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige (SPESIALITEIT)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige spesialiteitspos by Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal, wat SANC-registrasie en vier tot veertien jaar se relevante verpleegervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde, Graad 2: 'n Minimum van veertien (14) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in Verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde waarvan ten minste 10 (tien) jaar van bogenoemde periode toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring moet wees na verkryging van die 1 (een) jaar post basiese kwalifikasie in die relevante spesialiteit. Senior Sertifikaat of gelykwaardig, Graad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleegkunde, Een jaar post basiese Graad/Diploma in Kritiese Sorg plus vier (04) jaar toepaslike/erkenbare registrasie-ervaring as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige. Registrasie by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige en Spesialiteitsverpleegkundige. Bewys van huidige/vorige werkervaring wat deur die Menslike Hulpbron Departement geoorsig en gestempel is, sal vir gekorte lysde kandidate vereis word. Suksesvolle kandidate sal 'n minimum van een jaar in diens moet deurbring. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van Verpleegsorg, Prosesse en Prosedures, Verpleegstatute, en ander relevante Regskader. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede- mondeling en skriftelik. Koördinasie- en skakelvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met beplanning/organisasie en monitering van doelwitte van die gespesialiseerde eenheid. Verskaf 'n terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënte en publiek. Verskaf omvattende, gehalte verpleegsorg. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor alle Verpleegkundige Personeel/Huishoudelike personeel en om hulle leiding te gee en kontinuiteit van pasiëntesorg op alle vlakke te verseker. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte en families met die multidissiplinêre span, ander departemente binne die hospital. Bystand verleen met toewysings/veranderingslys, dag- en nagdiensroosters en insette vir verlof. Bystand verleen met rekordhouding en verskaf statistiese inligting oor opleiding en personeel. Om bystand te verleen by EPMDS-evaluering van personeel en om EAP te implementeer. Bystand verleen met oriëntasie, inleiding en monitering van alle verpleegkundige personeel. Om pasiëntverwante data te voltooi en aan navorsing deel te neem. Bevorder gehalte gespesialiseerde verpleegsors soos gerig deur die omvang van praktyk en standaarde bepaal deur die relevante spesialiteit. Om bystand te verleen met bystandspligte van die toesighouer en optree as junior skiftleier op beide dag- en nagshift. Om deel te neem aan algehele gespesialiseerde eenheidsfunksies, d.w.s. spanbou Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van alle hulpbronne. Skakel met Professionele Verpleegkundige in beheer in chirurgiese hoësorg/renale eenheid. Toewys van personeel op dag- en nagdiens binne die Direktoraat op rotasie basis. Om 'n kritieke siek pasiënt te verpleeg wat geventileer is, op hemodialise en deurlopend-veneuse hemodialise is. Om alle tipes pasiënte ongeag diagnoses te verpleeg volgens siekteprofiel binne die direktoraat. Handhaaf Professionele groei/etiese standaard en self-ontwikkeling.

zu.title: UJwayele Ohlinzayo (UMKHAKA OKUKHETHIWE)
zu.summary: Isikhundla somkhakha kajwayele ohlinzayo esibhedlela i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sidinga ukubhaliswa ku-SANC kanye neminyaka eyisine kuya kwengamashumi nane yemfundo yokuqasha ehambisana nobunesi.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 1: Okungenani eminyakeni emi-4 yohluhlelo/olubonakalayo lolwazi kwinzulu emva kokubhaliswa njengoJwayele Ohlinzayo ku-SANC kuGenzelwa nokuSiza Komhlaba, I-Grade 2: Okungenani eminyakeni engamashumi nane (14) yohluhlelo/olubonakalayo lolwazi kweNzulu emva kokubhaliswa njengoJwayele Ohlinzayo ku-SANC kuGenzelwa nokuSiza Komhlaba lapho okungenani eminyakeni eyi-10 (ishumi) yaleso sikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele kube uhluhlelo/olubonakalayo lolwazi emva kokuthola isidanga seminyaka eyi-1 (eyodwa) ngemuva kokuqeqeshelwa okuyisisekelo kumkhakha okukhethiwe. I-Senior Certificate noma okulinganayo naledo, Degree/Diploma kuGenzelwa nokuSiza Komhlaba, Degree/Diploma yeminyaka eyodwa ngemuva kokuqeqeshelwa okuyisisekelo ku-Critical Care kanye neminyaka emi-4 (04) yohluhlelo/olubonakalayo lolwazi lokubhaliswa njengonesi Jikelele. Ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoNesi Jikelele noNesi Womkhakha Okukhethiwe. Ubufakazi bemisebenzi yamanje/yangaphambili obugunyazwe futhi butshwe isiGaba Sabasebenzi seHuman Resource buzodingwa abagqwayi abangeniswe uhlu. Umgqwayi ophumelelayo uzodinga ukuqeda okungenani unyaka owodwa esikhundleni. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namaKhono aFuniwe: Ulwazi ngeNzulu NokuSiza, Inqubo namaHlelo, iziMiso zenZulu, kanye namanye amaHlelo oMthetho ahambisanayo. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle-hle-abhalwe noma akhulunywa. Amakhono okuHlela kanye nokuXhumana. Amakhono okuSula Izinkinga.
zu.duties: Siza ekwenzeni isu/ukuhlela futhi ulawule imigomo yegumbi elikhethiwe. Nikeza indawo ethuthukisa ukuphila kubasebenzi, abagulayo nomphakathi. Nikeza inzulu elula nekhwalithi yokunakekelwa. Nikeza okunguqondile nokungaqondisi ukulawula bonke abasebenzi beNzulu/abasebenzi basekhaya futhi ubanikeze isiQondiso ukuze kuqiniseke ukuqhubeka kokunakekelwa kwesiguli kuzo zonke izinga. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo abagulayo nabezindlu ndawonye nethimba elihlukene, omunye umnyango ngaphakathi kwesibhedlela. Siza nokuHlelwa kwesigaxa/kuluhlu lokushintsha, imugqa wemisebenzi yemini nobusuku nokungeniswa kwemihlelo yamaholide. Siza ekugcineni imibhalo futhi unikeze izinhlolokuthi mayelana nokuqeqeshwa nokuhlelwa kwabasebenzi. Ukusiza ekulinganisweni kwe-EPMDS kwabasebenzi futhi usebenzise i-EAP. Siza ekwaziseni, ukufakwa nasekuhleni abasebenzi bonke abenza inzulu. Ukuqedela imininingwane ehambisana nesiguli futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuphenyeni. Khuthaza ikhwalithi ephezulu yenZulu yomkhakha okukhethiwe njengoba kuqondiswe isibalo somsebenzi namazinga abekwe ngumkhakha okukhethiwe ohambisanayo. Ukusiza nemisebenzi yokuthatha isikhundla somlawuli futhi ube ngumholi oshaje emigqeni yemini nobusuku. Ukuthatha inxaxheba imisebenzi yegumbi elikhethiwe yonke, okuyibanga elakha ithimba ukuLawula ngokusebenzayo nangokufanele yonke imithombo. Xhumana noJwayele Ohlinzayo ophethe enkonzelweni yokuSiza ekuhlinzweni/egumbini le-renal. UkuHlelwa kwabasebenzi emigqeni yemini nobusuku phakathi kweDirectorate ngokujikeleza. Ukuhletha isiguli esibuhlungu kakhulu esiphefumula ngesisetshenzwa, ku-haemodialysis kanye ne-continuous-venous haemodialysis. Ukuletha zonke izinhlobo zeziguli noma zihlotshaniswe kanjani ngokwegciro lesifo phakathi kweDirectorate. Gcina ukukhula kweNzulu/izinga zokuziphatha ngokuziphatha nokuziqeqesha.

xh.title: Umqeshi weProfeshoni (ISIKOLOMO)
xh.summary: Isithuba se-speciality somqeshi weprofeshoni kwi Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna ukubhalisa kwiSANC nobunyani beminyaka elisuka kumanina kuya kumashumi amaninana bokukhathalela abantu abagulayo.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Okungenani 4 years imicimbi efanelekileyo/eyaziwayo yokukhathalela abantu abagulayo emva kokubhalisa njengoMqeshi weProfeshoni kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing, Inqanaba 2: Okungenani fourteen (14) years imicimbi efanelekileyo/eyaziwayo eNursing emva kokubhalisa njengoMqeshi weProfeshoni kwiSANC kwiGeneral Nursing apho okungenanis kwi10 (ten) years kwexesha elithunyiwe ngasentla kufuneka kube ngumcimbi ofanelekileyo/oyaziwayo emva kokufumana i1 (one) year post basic qualification kwisikolo esifanelekileyo. Senior Certificate okanye ezifanayo, Degree/Diploma kwiGeneral Nursing, One year post basic Degree/Diploma kwiCritical Care ngenxa yamashumi amaninana (04) years ukubhalisa komcimbi ofanelekileyo/oyaziwayo njengoGeneral Nurse. Ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGeneral Nurse noSpeciality Nurse. Isibongozo somsebenzi wangoku/wangaphambili esigqinwe nesitumpu ngumSebe weHuman Resource siza kufuneka kumanyathelo abhaliswe. Umntu ophumeleleyo kuya kufuneka achithe okungenayo one year kusebenzo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho noKuzinzaoku Kufunekayo: Ulwazi ngokuKhathalela abantu abagulayo, Iinkqubo neendlela zokuSebenza, imithetho yokuKhathalela abantu abagulayo, nanye iinkqaba ezomthetho ezifanelekileyo. Amakhono amabalonke kokuthetha nobhalwe. Amakhono okuhlanganisa noxhumano. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Nceda ekucwangciseni/ekulungiseni nasekuqwalaselweni iinjongo zesithuba esikolo somcimbi. Nikela indawo yokwelapha kubasebenzi, abagulayo nomntwonke. Nikela ukukhathalela okubanzi, okunobunganga abantu abagulayo. Nikela ulawulo oluthe ngqo nolunge ngqo lwabasebenzi bonke abakhathalela abantu abagulayo/Basebenzi bokusingatha indlu ubanike isikhokelo ukuqinisekisa ukusuka kakhathalelo abagulayo kumanqanaba onke. Bonisa ukuthetha okusebenzayo abagulayo nosapho ngeqela elinamaphandle, isinye isebbe ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Nceda nokwabalwa/kutshintshwe uluhlu, imizuzu yemini nasemini nasebusuku nemitaro yokuphumla. Nceda ekugcineni iirekhodi noku nikela iinkcukacha zokulinganisa ngokuqeqeshwa nabasebenzi. Ukunceda ekuqwalaselweni kwe-EPMDS sabasebenzi nokuzeke i-EAP. Nceda ekuqeqeshweni, ekuqaliseni nasekuqwalaselweni abasebenzi bonke abakhathalela abantu abagulayo. Ukugqibiza iinkcukacha ezahleneyo nabagulayo nokuqhatha kulwazi. Khuthaza ukukhathalela abagulayo okunobunganga ngokomcimbi njengokuqondiswa ngommandla wokusebenza ngamagunya abekiweyo ngummandla ofanelekileyo. Ukunceda nomsebenzi wokunceda womlawuli nokuba ngumkhosi wobhalo komncinci kumshini wemini nasemini nasebusuku. Ukuqhatha kumsebenzi jikelele wesithuba sokukhathalela ngokomcimbi, oko kukuthi ukwakha iqela Uku lawula ngempumelelo nangokusebenzayo yonke imithombo. Xhumana noMqeshi weProfeshoni ofakiwe kulawulo kwiklinikh yokukhathalela ebiqhakamshayo/renal. Ukwabalwa kwaba basebenzi kumshini wemini nasebusuku ngaphakathi kwiDirectorate ngokutshintsha-tshintsha. Ukukhathalela abagulayo abagula kakhulu abanam hoya otyhilwe, kwihaemodialysis nokuqhuba-haemodialysis. Ukukhathalela abantu abagulayo boke iindidi nangendlela ngalanye yokuqwalaselwa ngokomcimbi ngaphakathi kwedirectorate. Ukuzigcina ukukhula kweProfeshoni/izinga lokuziphatha nokuziphilella.
