Vereiste Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid: Kennis van Verpleegsorg, Prosesse en Prosedures, Verpleegstatute, en ander tersaaklike Regsrakwerke. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede-verbale en geskrewe. Koördinasie- en skakelingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Help met die beplanning/organisering en monitering van doelwitte van die gespesialiseerde eenheid. Behoorlike triëering en bestuur van noodgevalle in die eenheid. Verskaf 'n terapeutiese omgewing vir personeel, pasiënte en publiek. Verskaf omvattende, gehalte verpleegsorg. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor alle verpleegpersoneel/huishoudelike personeel en gee hulle leiding en versek die kontinuiteit van pasiëntesorg op alle vlakke. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte en families met die multidissiplinêre span, ander departemente binne die hospital. Help met toewysing/veranderlyste, dag- en nagdiensroosters en insette vir verlof. Help met rekordhouding en verskaf statistiese inligting oor opleiding en personeel. Om te help met EPMDS-evaluering van personeel en implementering van EAP. Help met oriëntering, inductie en monitering van alle verpleegpersoneel. Om pasiëntverwante data te voltooi en aan navorsing deel te neem. Bevorder gehalte gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die bestek van praktyk en standaarde bepaal deur die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Om te help met verligtingspligte van die toesighouer en optree as junior skifleier op beide dag- en nagshift. Om deel te neem aan algehele gespesialiseerde eenheidsfunksies, d.w.s. spanbou. Effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van alle hulpbronne. Skakel met professionele verpleegkundige in beheer in chirurgiese hoësorg/niereenheid. Toewysing van personeel op dag- en nagdiens binne die Direktoraat op rotasiebasis.

zu.title: Professional Nurse (SPECIALTY)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sesi Professional Nurse sesikhungo esithize esibhedlela i-Dr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, esidinga ukubhaliswa ku-SANC kanye neminyaka eyisithupha kuya kweyishumi nane yesiphiwo sezogula kuye ngezinga.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-4 yohlobo olufanele/oluhlonitshwayo olwenziwa ngemva kokubhalisa njengonoziguli onesiwo nesandla kwi-SANC kuhlelo lokuqeqesha ngokujwayelekile. Izinga 2: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-14 (eshiyi nanhlanu) yohlobo olufanele/oluhlonitshwayo kwi-Nursing ngemva kokubhalisa njengonoziguli nesandla se-SANC kuhlelo lolu-1 lokuqeqeshwa njengonoziguli, lapho okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 (kuni) kule minyaka edlule kufanele kube yohlobo olufanele/oluhlonitshwayo ngemva kokuthola isikhashana seminyaka eyi-1 (eyodwa) yokuba ngumfundi oqeqeshiwe kohlelo lolu-1 lokuqeqeshwa. Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu noma iziqu ezingaphezulu. Isiqu noma iziqu ze-Diploma ezisesigabeni se-General Nursing Registration ne-SANC njengesi General Nurse ne-Specialty Nurse. Isiqu se-Degree noma i-Diploma yamayunwe angu-1 ngesikhathi sokuba ngumfundi oqeqeshiweohleini lwe-Trauma kanti kune iminyaka engu-4 (okuyine) yokuhlolwa kohlelo olufanele/oluhlonitshwayo njengesi General Nurse. Isitifiketi sangalesosikhathi se-SANC (2024). Isitifiketi sangalesosikhathi noma esingaphambilini sezinsuku zomsebenzi kuzodingeka sibe nesithombe sika-Human Resource Department abantu ababekwe ohlwini. Kuzomele abantu ababekwe ohlwini bahlale isikhathi esingafani nomsebenzi ongaphansi kwesikhathi esingafani. Ukwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa kanye nokulungele ukusebenza okudingekayo: ukuqonda kokunakekelwa kwesifazane, inqubo nemikhakha, izindikimba zokunakekelwa kanye namanye amakhono okubekela ezinye izigaba. Ukuxhumana kahle ngomlomo kanti nalapha kubhaliwe. Ikhono lokubeka kulunge kanye nokubeka ezindaweni zawo. Ikhono lokuqonda ukuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Siza ekubumeni/ukuhleleni kanye nokuqapha imigomo yesebe elikhunjuziwe. Ukuhlukanisa ngokufanele kanye nokuphathwa kwezimo eziphuthumayo esebeni. Ukunikeza isimo esinempilo esibekelwe abasebenzi, abagulayo kanye nomphakathi. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa okuphelele, okuningi kwemikhuba yezesifazane. Ukunikeza ukulawula okuqondile nokungalawuleki kwabasebenzi abasezifazaneni bonke/abasebenzi bokulondoloza indlu futhi banikeze imiyalelo futhi qinisekisa ukuqhubeleka kokunakekelwa kwesiguli kumazinga wonke. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo kubagulayo nemindeni ngesikhathi sempilo, abalinganiswa abaningi, kanye namanye amanyango endawo yokwelashwa. Siza ekwabeleni / ushintshweni ohlwini, nkathi yosuku nobusuku kanye nemibhalo yokuphumula. Siza ekuqopeni amarekhodi futhi unikeze ulwazi lwesibalo ngokuqeqeshwa nezibasebenzi. Ukusiza ekuhloleni i-EPMDS yabasebenzi nokusebenzisa i-EAP. Siza ekuqondiseni, ukungeniswa kokuqeqeshwa kanye nokuqapha abasebenzi bonke basesifazaneni. Ukuqedela idatha ehlobene nesiguli kanye nokuthatha inxaxheba ucwaningo. Ukukhuthaza ukunakekelwa okukhulu okwesifazane njengokuqondiswa nangesikhathi sokuzivocavoca kanye namazinga abekwe isikhathi esingafanele. Ukusiza ngezinsuku zokusiza komphathi wokuqondisa futhi abe nogqethe kumashemu obusuku nobusuku. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emisebenzini yonke yesebe elingajwayelekile, okungukuthi ukwakha iqembu. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kwamaphoyeza wonke. Xhumana nonesi elisesikhundleni sokulawula ezinsizeni zokwelashwa eziphansi noma esebeni leso. Ukwabelwa kwabasebenzi kumashemu obusuku nobusuku ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sokuzivocavoca ngokuzungezisa.

xh.title: Ummeli weSikhokho (IZIQENDU)
xh.summary: Isithuba sesiqendu sommeli weSikhokho eDr Pixley Ka Isaka Seme Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna ukubhalisa kwiSANC kunye neminyaka emine ukuya kweyishlanu nobuncinane yamava okhathalelo lwesigula ngokwemigangatho.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-4 yamava ahambelanayo/azaziwayo ekhathalelweni lwesigula emva kokubhalisa njengoMmeli weSikhokho kwiSANC ekhathalelweni lwesigula jikelele. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyishlanu nane (14) yamava ahambelanayo/azaziwayo ekhathalelweni lwesigula emva kokubhalisa njengoMmeli weSikhokho kwiSANC ekhathalelweni lwesigula jikelele, apho ubuncinane kwiminyaka eli-10 (lishumi) kule minyaka ekushiweyo ngasentla kufuneka kube yamava ahambelanayo/azaziwayo emva kokufumana isidanga se-1 (lonyaka) sekhwalifayeshini yasemva kwesiseko kwesiqendu ehambelanayo. Isatifikethi samabanga aphezulu okanye isidanga esilinganayo. Isidanga/Ithiphloma ekhathalelweni lwesigula jikelele nokubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGqirha weSikhokho jikelele noMmeli weSikhokho wesiqendu. Isidanga/Ithiphloma yonyaka owodwa yasemva kwesiseko kwiTrauma kunye neminyaka emi-4 (04) yamava okubhalisa ahambelanayo/azaziwayo njengoGqirha weSikhokho jikelele. Ukubhalisa okwangoku kwiSANC (2026). Ubufakazi bamava okusebenza okwangoku/okwangaphambili begqithiswe begaxwe yiNtsebenzo yoBuntu kuya kufuneka kumagqabi abhaliselwe. Iqela eliphumeleleyo kuya kufuneka lichithe ubuncinane unyaka owodwa enkonzweni. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namaQondo aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngokuKhathalelwa kweSigula, iinkqubo neNkqubo, izigaba zoKhathalelo lwesigula, nezinye iinkqubo zoMthetho ezihambelanayo. Amakhono amde wokunxibelelwana - ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo. Amakhono oQhingamshicelo noNxulumano. Amakhono oQondo-ndlebe ngokuxazula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Nceda ukuqamba/ukuhlela nokugcina amalungiselelo amagcisa wesiqendu. Isigqibo esifanelekileyo kunye nokulawula iimeko eziphuthumayo kwisiqendu. Bonezela indawo yokwelapha abasebenzi, abaguli noluntu. Bonezela ukhathalelo lwesigula olubandakanya yonke into nolungileyo. Bonezela ulawulo oluqondileyo nangamathuba athile koluntu lube khona kuso onke amakhulu oMmele weSikhokho abakhathalelo bekhaya, kwaye ubanikeze isalathiso kuqiniseke ukungapheli kokhathalelo lwesigula kwinqanaba ngalinye. Bonakalisa ukunxibelelana okusebenzayo phakathi kwabaguli nezaphuli nobumanyano beqela elinguwo, ezinye iintsebenzo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele. Nceda nokwaba/okutshintsha uluhlu, uluhlu lokusebenza emini nasebusuku kunye nezigqibo zokushiya. Nceda ekugcineni amarekhodi kunye nokubonezela ulwazi ngenani ngokuqeqesha nangokusebenza. Nceda kwilingqinisiso leEPMDS abasebenzi bayo ukuze kusetyenziswe iEAP. Nceda ekumiswa koluntu, kwisikhokelo nakugcina abasebenzi bonke bemikhathalelo. Kuqoke iingcaciso zemvelaphi yomguli oqhagamshelana nophando. Khuthaza ukhathalelo lwesigula ngumthetho wolwazi olulawulayo ngokobuganga beqondo nangokulinganiselwa kwindalo yesiqendu. Nceda ngemisebenzi yokuzivocavoca yomlawuli uze ube ngumkhosi ongqingalayo osukwini nakubusuku. Thatha inxaxheba ngokupheleleyo imisebenzi yamagcisa, oko kukuthi ukwakha iqela. Ulawulo olusebenzayo nolusemthethweni lwazo zonke iimpahla. Qhagamshela noMmeli weSikhokho ongunobangela kwikhathalelo eliphezulu lokuhlinza/isigaba sokuhambisa amanzi. Ukubekwa kwabasebenzi ekusebenzeni emini nasebusuku ngaphakathi komgangatho ngokutshintshana.

jobs.reference_number: MED BIO SCI/1/2026 Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology
jobs.title: Medical Biological Scientist: Reproductive Biology /
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime) Grade 2: R482 499 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime) Grade 3: R564 822 per annum, all-inclusive salary package, (excluding commuted overtime).
jobs.summary: Medical Biological Scientist in Reproductive Biology at Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, requiring HPCSA registration and reproductive medicine experience.
jobs.requirements: Professional registration and qualifications, An appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Biological Scientist – Reproductive Biology/Clinical Embryology Current registration with the HPCSA in the relevant category is required. Additional Knowledge: At least 1 year experience in a reproductive medicine unit Experience: Grade 1: No experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Biological Scientist (Reproductive Biology/Clinical Embryology) for South African-qualified employees. One year's relevant experience after HPCSA registration for foreign-qualified employees who are not required to perform community service in South Africa. Grade 2: Minimum of 10 years' relevant experience after HPCSA registration for South African- qualified employees. Minimum of 11 years' relevant experience after HPCSA registration for foreign-qualified employees who are not required to perform community service in South Africa. Grade 3 Minimum of 20 years' relevant experience after HPCSA registration for South African-qualified employees. Minimum of 21 years' relevant experience after HPCSA registration for foreign- qualified employees who are not required to perform community service in South Africa.
jobs.duties: The incumbent should be able to demonstrate the following Scientific excellence strong knowledge of reproductive biology and contemporary embryology. Technical competence proficiency in ART laboratory techniques and a commitment to maintaining high technical standards. Attention to detail meticulous handling, identification and documentation of reproductive material. Integrity and accountability recognition of the ethical and professional responsibilities associated with handling human gametes and embryos. Teaching and mentorship willingness to contribute to the development of future reproductive health professionals. Research and innovation commitment to advancing infertility care through research, audit and evidence-based practice. Adaptability and leadership ability to contribute to the ongoing development of a high-quality tertiary ART service. Teamwork ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary tertiary healthcare environment. Communication clear, respectful and professional communication with patients and colleagues. This post reports to Head of Reproductive Medicine Unit, department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology The successful candidate will work collaboratively with reproductive medicine specialists, obstetricians and gynaecologists, nurses, laboratory personnel and other members of the multidisciplinary team to support couples and individuals undergoing fertility assessment and assisted reproductive treatment.
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: An Application for Employment Form (Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the shortlisted candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying. IALCH invites applications from suitably qualified and motivated Medical Biological Scientists specialising in Reproductive Biology/Clinical Embryology to join its newly established multidisciplinary infertility and assisted reproductive technology (ART) service in the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Medies-Biologiese Wetenskaplike: Reproduktiewe Biologie /
af.summary: Medies-Biologiese Wetenskaplike in Reproduktiewe Biologie by Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, wat HPCSA-registrasie en ervaring in reproduktiewe geneeskunde vereis.
af.requirements: Professionele registrasie en kwalifikasies, 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Medies-Biologiese Wetenskaplike – Reproduktiewe Biologie/Kliniese Embriologie toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA in die tersaaklike kategorie word vereis. Bykomende kennis: Ten minste 1 jaar se ervaring in 'n reproduktiewe geneeskundige eenheid. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Medies-Biologiese Wetenskaplike (Reproduktiewe Biologie/Kliniese Embriologie) vir Suid-Afrikaans-gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. Een jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na HPCSA-registrasie vir buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om gemeenskapsdiens in Suid-Afrika te doen nie. Graad 2: Minimum van 10 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na HPCSA-registrasie vir Suid-Afrikaans-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 11 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na HPCSA-registrasie vir buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om gemeenskapsdiens in Suid-Afrika te doen nie. Graad 3 Minimum van 20 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na HPCSA-registrasie vir Suid-Afrikaans-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Minimum van 21 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na HPCSA-registrasie vir buiteland-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie verplig is om gemeenskapsdiens in Suid-Afrika te doen nie.
af.duties: Die posbekleër moet die volgende kan demonstreer: Wetenskaplike uitnemendheid: sterk kennis van reproduktiewe biologie en kontemporêre embriologie. Tegniese bevoegdheid: bekwaamheid in ART-laboratoriumtegnieke en 'n toewyding om hoë tegniese standaarde te handhaaf. Aandag aan detail: noukeurige hantering, identifisering en dokumentasie van reproduktiewe materiaal. Integriteit en aanspreeklikheid: erkenning van die etiese en professionele verantwoordelighede wat verband hou met die hantering van menslike gamete en embrio's. Onderrig en mentorskap: bereidwilligheid om by te dra tot die ontwikkeling van toekomstige reproduktiewe gesondheidsprofessionals. Navorsing en innovasie: toewyding om onvrugbaarheidsorg deur navorsing, oudit en bewysgebaseerde praktyk te bevorder. Aanpasbaarheid en leierskap: vermoë om by te dra tot die voortdurende ontwikkeling van 'n hoëgehalte tersiêre ART-diens. Spanwerk: vermoë om doeltreffend binne 'n multidissiplinêre tersiêre gesondheidsorgomgewing te werk. Kommunikasie: duidelike, respekvolle en professionele kommunikasie met pasiënte en kollegas. Hierdie pos rapporteer aan die Hoof van die Reproduktiewe Geneeskundige Eenheid, departement van Obstetriek en Ginekologie. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal saamwerk met reproduktiewe geneeskundige spesialiste, obstetrikoloë en ginekoloë, verpleegkundiges, laboratoriumpersoneel en ander lede van die multidissiplinêre span om paartjies en individue wat vrugbaarheidsassessering en bygesteunde reproduktiewe behandeling ondergaan, te ondersteun.

zu.title: Isayensi Yebhayoloji Yezokwelapha: Ibhayoloji Yokuzala /
zu.summary: Isayensi Yebhayoloji Yezokwelapha kwiBhayoloji Yokuzala e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, edinga ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA nokuba namava kokwelapha kokuzala.
zu.requirements: Ukubhalisa ngobungcweti nezifundo ezifanele, Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengobaNgumsayensi WeBhayoloji Yezokwelapha – IBhayoloji Yokuzala/Embryology Yezokwelapha Kudingeka ukuthi usebhalile njengamanje ku-HPCSA esigabeni esihambisana nalelo. Ulwazi olwengeziwe: Okungenani unyaka oyedwa wamava kwesebe lezokwelapha kokuzala Amava: IGrade 1: Awekho amava emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengobaNgumsayensi WeBhayoloji Yezokwelapha (IBhayoloji Yokuzala/Embryology Yezokwelapha) kubasebenzi abathole izifudo eNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka oyedwa wamava ahambisanayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kubasebenzi abathole izifudo kwezinye izwe abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. IGrade 2: Okuncane iminyaka engu-10 yamava ahambisanayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kubasebenzi abathole izifudo eNingizimu Afrika. Okuncane iminyaka engu-11 yamava ahambisanayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kubasebenzi abathole izifudo kwezinye izwe abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika. IGrade 3 Okuncane iminyaka engu-20 yamava ahambisanayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kubasebenzi abathole izifudo eNingizimu Afrika. Okuncane iminyaka engu-21 yamava ahambisanayo emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA kubasebenzi abathole izifudo kwezinye izwe abangadingi ukwenza inkonzo yomphakathi eNingizimu Afrika.
zu.duties: Umuntu othathwe kule sikhundla kufanele akwazi ukukhombisa okulandelayo Ukuphumelela kwesayensi ulwazi olunamandla ngokubhayoloji kokuzala embryology yanamuhla. Ukubekezela ngobuchwepheshe ukuzidela ekusebenzeni kahle kumatekhnikhi e-ART laboratory nentamo yokugcina izinga eliphezulu lobuchwepheshe. Ukunaka iminikimingi ukuphathwa okuqonde kakhulu, ukuhlonza ukuqoshwa kwakho konke mayelana namabhayoloji okuzala. Ukuqotho nenxibelelwano nokuqashelwa ukwaziswa ngezibopho zokuziphatha nokubamba iqhaza ekubhalweni kwamabhayoloji okuzala komuntu. Ukufundisa nokuhola ukulungele ukusiza ekuthuthukiseni abazoba ngobuchwepheshe bezempilo yokuzala. Ukucwaningo nokusungula amasu amasha intomboso yokuqhuba phambili inkonzo yokwelapha ukungazali ngokucwaninga, ukuhlola nokwenza ngokufaka isibonelo. Ukuzivumelanisa nekhono lokubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni ngokuqhubekayo inkonzo ye-ART yezifundo ezingaphezulu yezinga eliphezulu. Ukusebenza njengomth Seamless amandla okusebenza kahle kaphakathi kwendawo ehlukene ngokwezifundo yezokwelapha ezibekiwe. Unxibelelwano olucacile, oluhloniphekayo nolunobungcweti kumagula laba kanye nabasebenzi nomakhelwane. Lesi sikhundla sibika kuNtetheleli Wesebe Lezokuzala, umnyango we-Obstetrics and Gynaecology Umuntu ophumelele uyousebenza ngokubambisana nososayensi bezokuzala, obstetricians, abazalingiswa bezofuzo, abahlengikazi, basebenzi belaboratory namalunga omphakathi wokuqashelwa kwabaningi ukuze asize abantu kanye nabahlanganyeli ngokwedlana abakwenza isibonelo ukuze bafune izidingo zokuzala baphathwe kahle ngemikhiqizo yemisho yokuzala.

xh.title: Isayensi yeBhayoloji yezoNyango: iBhayoloji yeNzululwazi eZalayo /
xh.summary: Isayensi yeBhayoloji yezoNyango kwiBhayoloji yeNzululwazi eZalayo e Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, ifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA nendalo kwimisebenzi yonyango lwezululwazi ezalayo.
xh.requirements: Ukubhaliswa ngobugcisa nezifanelekimisimo, Isifanelekimiso esifanelekayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesayensi yebhayoloji yezonyango – iBhayoloji yeNzululwazi eZalayo/Embryology yezoKliniki Kufuneka kubekho ukubhaliswa okwangoku kwi-HPCSA kwiklasi ezichanekileyo. Ulwazi olongezelelekayo:Ubuncwane bephondo leminyaka engu-1 lokwenza umsebenzi kwiyunithi yonyango lwezululwazi ezalayo. Isipili: iGreyidi 1: Akukho nqanaba lomsebenzi emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesayensi yebhayoloji yezonyango (iBhayoloji yeNzululwazi eZalayo/Embryology yezoKliniki) kubasebenzi ababhaliswe eMzantsi Afrika. Unyaka omnye wamava ahambelana nomyalezo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi ababhaliswe kwamanye amazwe abangenadingo yokwenza inkonzo yomphakathi eMzantsi Afrika. iGreyidi 2: Uncedo lweemininfi yeminyaka elingu-10 wamava ahambelana nomyalezo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi ababhaliswe eMzantsi Afrika. Uncedo lweemininfi yeminyaka elingu-11 wamava ahambelana nomyalezo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi ababhaliswe kwamanye amazwe abangenadingo yokwenza inkonzo yomphakathi eMzantsi Afrika. iGreyidi 3 Uncedo lweemininfi yeminyaka elingu-20 wamava ahambelana nomyalezo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi ababhaliswe eMzantsi Afrika. Uncedo lweemininfi yeminyaka elingu-21 wamava ahambelana nomyalezo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA kubasebenzi ababhaliswe kwamanye amazwe abangenadingo yokwenza inkonzo yomphakathi eMzantsi Afrika.
xh.duties: Umntu ofanelekileyo kufuneka akwazi ukubonisa okulandelayo Uphawu olugqithisileyo kolwazi olusigqithileyo ngebhayoloji yenzululwazi ezalayo kunye ne-embryology yam nyaka. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngobugcisa ukuzipatha kakuhle kumanqanaba obugcisa obuseziko le-ART nethemba lokugcina amanqanaba aphakamileyo obugcisa. Kuqwalaselwa iinkcukacha ukuphatha ngokucophelela, ukuqamba iinkcukacha nokubhala ngokucophelela ngemithi ezalayo. Ukuzithoba nenuxanduva ukwaziswa kweenkxwelo zokuziphatha ngokutsha nokungagqithiswa kumanyathelo amalungisa kunye nokuphathwa kwamaseli ezala abantu kwaye nanjengesixhobo sokuphatha iembryosi. Ukufundisa nokukhokelela ukuzimisela ukwenzakalisa isixhobo searhente yamva ngecandelo lezempilo ezalayo. Uphononongo nobungqatsha ukuzimisela ekuphuculeni inkcitha yonyango lwenzala ngephononongo, ukuhlolwa nokusebenza ngokwezibini. Ukuziqhelanisa nokulawula ukuba nakho ekuphuculeni iinkonzo ze-ART ezingangeni kwiziko lemfundo ephilileyo. Ukusebenza njengesebe ukuba nakho ukusebenza kakuhle kwimeko yezenkalo ezininzi zokusika ezikhoyo kwisibhedlele esiphakamileyo. Unxibelelwano olucacileyo, oluhloniphekileyo nolungagqithiswa kumagama athethwayo abantu neentlambo zomsebenzi. Esi sithuba sibika kwiNtloko yeYunithi yoNyango lweZululwazi eZalayo, isebi lezokuBatala nezeGynecology Umntu ophumeleleyo uza kusebenza ngokubambisana nabagcisa bazonyango lwezululwazi ezalayo, abadokodela bezokuzala, abafundisi bezokhulisa, oongqongqoshi bemihla ngemihla, basebenzi belaboratori nakunye namalungu amanye eqela elisebenza ngokubambisana ekuxhaseni amaqabane nabantu ababuzwa ngokulinganiswa ukuzala kwaye benze inkonzo yokuzala.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Sessions: Cardiothoracic Surgery
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R671.00 Grade 2: R766.00 Grade 3: R887.00 Hourly Rate per session/ (Notch per annum)
jobs.summary: Sessional medical specialist in cardiothoracic surgery sought for Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, requiring HPCSA specialist registration and relevant clinical experience.
jobs.requirements: MBChB Degree; Applicants must be registered as a Specialist -Cardiothoracic Surgery with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Current registration as Specialist Cardiothoracic Surgery with the HPCSA. Experience: Grade 1: No experience required after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Cardiothoracic Surgery). Grade 2: Five (5) years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Cardiothoracic Surgery). Grade 3: Ten (10) years appropriate experience as a Medical Specialist after registration with HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Cardiothoracic Surgery). Additional Qualifications: Additional experience in providing a specialist service in either VATS surgery, cardiac transplant surgery, Op-CAB, ECMO or oesophageal surgery. Skills, Knowledge, Training and Competence Required: The incumbent should have a comprehensive knowledge of the specialty discipline of Cardiothoracic Surgery including all aspects of General Thoracic Surgery, and Surgery for Acquired & Congenital Cardiovascular Disease. Surgical skills in the operative management of diseases within the specialty are an absolute prerequisite. In addition, teaching and computer literacy are essential requirements. The applicant must have undergone training in a cardiothoracic unit in an accredited academic centre either within the country or elsewhere. Competence in the clinical evaluation of the cardiothoracic surgical patient, interpretation of special investigations, especially radiological, operative intervention and post- operative management are of paramount importance. Demonstrate the ability to supervise and teach junior staff. Demonstrate the ability to work as part of a multidisciplinary team. Proven management ability, sound communication, negotiation, planning, organising, leadership, decision-making and interpersonal skills.
jobs.duties: Provide a clinical service encompassing the diagnosis, investigation, peri- operative care and surgical management of cardiothoracic patients. Actively participate in the academic programme run by the department for the post- graduate training of registrars including teaching and research. Supervise and upskill registrars and junior consultants to enhance operative clinical skills and decision making. Achieve a level of theoretical knowledge and surgical skills requisite to the training of a Cardiothoracic Surgeon. Participate in after-hours services when required.
jobs.applications: All applications must be addressed to the Human Resources Manager, and should be placed in the application box situated at Security at the entrance to the Management Building at IALCH or to applications@ialch.co.za
jobs.notes: An Application for Employment Form (Z83) must be completed and forwarded. This is obtainable from any Public Service Department or from the website www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed Curriculum Vitae. Certified copies of qualifications, proof of registration and other relevant documents will be requested from shortlisted candidates only which may be submitted to HR on or before the day of the interview. Original signed letter from your current employer, confirming current and appropriate work experience related to the requirements and recommendations of the advert to be submitted only when shortlisted. People with disabilities should feel free to apply for the posts. The reference number must be indicated in the column provided on the form Z83, e.g. ref APRO/1/2006. Please note that failure to comply with the above instructions will disqualify applicants. It is the short listed candidate’s responsibility to have the foreign qualification, which is the requirement of the post, evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and to provide proof of such evaluation on or before the day of the interview. Failure to comply will result in the application not being considered. The selected candidate will be subjected to a pre-employment screening and verification process including a CIPC (Companies Intellectual Property Commission) screening. Due to the large number of applications we receive, receipt of applications will not be acknowledged. Should you not be advised within 60 days of the closing date, kindly consider your application as unsuccessful. Please note that due to financial constraints, there will be no payment of S&T Claims. This Hospital is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer whose aim is to promote representatively in all levels of all occupational categories in the Hospital. Person with disabilities and African males are encouraged to apply. Please note that other race groups are also not restricted from applying. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.

af.title: Mediese Spesialisissies: Kardiothorakale Chirurgie
af.summary: Sessiespesialis in kardiothorakale chirurgie word gesoek vir Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, wat HPCSA-spesialisregistrasie en relevante kliniese ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad; Aansoekers moet as 'n Spesialis -Kardiothorakale Chirurgie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) geregistreer wees. Huidige registrasie as Spesialis Kardiothorakale Chirurgie by die HPCSA. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen ervaring word vereis na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Kardiothorakale Chirurgie). Graad 2: Vyf (5) jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Kardiothorakale Chirurgie). Graad 3: Tien (10) jaar se toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis (Kardiothorakale Chirurgie). Bykomende kwalifikasies: Bykomende ervaring in die lewer van 'n spesialisdiens in óf VATS-chirurgie, hartoorplantingchirurgie, Op-CAB, ECMO of slukdermchirurgie. Vaardighede, kennis, opleiding en bevoegdheid vereis: Die ampdraer behoort oor omvattende kennis van die spesialiteitsdissipline Kardiothorakale Chirurgie te beskik, insluitend alle aspekte van Algemene Thorakale Chirurgie en Chirurgie vir Verworwe en Kongenitale Kardiovaskulêre Siekte. Chirurgiese vaardighede in die operatiewe bestuur van siektes binne die spesialiteit is 'n absolute voorvereiste. Daarbenedewens is onderrig en rekenaarvaardigheid noodsaaklike vereistes. Die aansoeker moet opleiding in 'n kardiothorakale eenheid by 'n geakkrediteerde akademiese sentrum, hetsy binne die land of elders, ondergaan het. Bevoegdheid in die kliniese evaluasie van die kardiothorakale chirurgiese pasiënt, interpretasie van spesiale ondersoeke, veral radiologiese, operatiewe ingrepe en postoperatiewe bestuur is van uiterste belang. Toon die vermoë om junior personeel te superviseer en te onderrig. Toon die vermoë om as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Bewese bestuursvermoë, deeglike kommunikasie-, onderhandeling-, beplannings-, organisasie-, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en interpersoonlike vaardighede.
af.duties: Lewer 'n kliniese diens wat die diagnose, ondersoek, peri-operatiewe sorg en chirurgiese bestuur van kardiothorakale pasiënte behels. Neem aktief deel aan die akademiese program wat deur die departement aangebied word vir die nagraadse opleiding van registrateurs, insluitend onderrig en navorsing. Superviseer en bekwaam registrateurs en junior konsultante om operatiewe kliniese vaardighede en besluitneming te verbeter. Bereik 'n vlak van teoretiese kennis en chirurgiese vaardighede wat vereis word vir die opleiding van 'n Kardiothorakale Chirurg. Neem buite-ure dienste deel wanneer vereis.

zu.title: Izikhathi Zomsebenzi Ongemaphakathi Wochwepheshe Wezokwelapha: Ukuhlinzwa Kwe-Cardiothoracic
zu.summary: Kufunwa umsebenzi ongaphakathi wochwepheshe wezokwelapha ekuhlinzeni kwe-cardiothoracic e-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, okudinga ukubhalisa kochwepheshe kwe-HPCSA namava ohlinzeko olwangempela.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-MBChB; Abafaka izicelo kumele babhaliswe njengochwepheshe -Ukuhlinzwa kwe-Cardiothoracic ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Ubhalo lokwamanathi njengochwepheshe we-Cardiothoracic Surgery ku-HPCSA. Amava: I-Grade 1: Abadingwa noma yimuphi umuzwa emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha (Cardiothoracic Surgery). I-Grade 2: Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava alungile njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha (Cardiothoracic Surgery). I-Grade 3: Iminyaka eyishumi (10) yamava alungile njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengochwepheshe Wezokwelapha (Cardiothoracic Surgery).Izifundo ezengeziwe: Amava engeziwe ekunikezeni inkonzo yochwepheshe kunoma yisiphi isikhathi se-VATS surgery, cardiac transplant surgery, Op-CAB, ECMO noma oesophageal surgery. Amakhono, Ulwazi, Ukuqeqesha Nokuzinza Okudingekayo: Umbhalo kumele abe nolwazi olubanzi ngesikhathi sezwe sokuhlinza kwe-Cardiothoracic Surgery okuhlanganisa zonke izingxenye zokuHlinza I-Thoracic Ngokuvamile, kanye NokuHlinza Isifo Senhliziyo Nesemithambo SabaTholwaye NaseKuzalweni. Amandla okuhlinza ekuphathweni kwemisebenzi ngesikhathi sokuhlinza ngaphakathi kwesikhathi sezwe kudinga kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukufundisa nolwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kuzidingo eziyisisekelo. Umfaki isicelo kumele eduze nokuqeqeshwa kuyunithi ye-cardiothoracic esikhungweni sezifundo esamukelekwe noma kunoma kuphi lapha ezweni noma kwenye indawo. Ukuzinza ekuhloleni umguli wokuhlinza i-cardiothoracic ngokwesifo, ekutolikeneni ukuhlola okukhethekile, ikakhulukazi okutshwayo, ukungenelela ekuhlinzeni kanye nokuphathwa ngemva kokuHlinza kubaluleke kakhulu. Khombisa ikhono lokubaphatha kanye nokufundisa abasebenzi abancane. Khombisa ikhono lokusebenza njengengxenye yethimba elinamakhono ahlukene. Amandla okuphatha abekiwe, ukuxhumana okululekile, ukuhlolana, ukuhlela, ukuhlelisa, ukuba ngumholi, ukwenza izinqumo, kanye namakhono okuzichazela nabantu.
zu.duties: Nika inkonzo yezokwelapha ehihamba ukubhekana nesifo, ukuhlola, ukunakekelwa ngesikhathi esiseduze NokuHlinza nokuphathwa kwabaguli be-cardiothoracic. Thatha inxaxheba ngokuzimisela ohlelweni lwesifundo olwenziwa umnyango ukuqeqesha abaqeqeshi abasha be-post- graduate okuhlanganisa ukufundisa nokucwaninga. Qaphela futhi uphucule amakhono abaqeqeshi abasha nabachwepheshe abancane ukuthuthukisa amakhono okuhlinza nezinqumo ezinzile. Fikelela ezingeni lolwazi olungenzangempela namakhono okuhlinza adingekayo ekubumbeni uchwepheshe WokuHlinza I-Cardiothoracic. Thatha inxaxheba ezinkonzini zemva wezinsuku lapho kudingeka khona.

xh.title: Iinkqubo zabaGqwethi wezeMezimba: uKudibela kwiNkundla yokuBumba nokuDibela iNtliziyo
xh.summary: Kufunekwe umGqwethi wezeMezimba ongumSebenzi woNyulo kuKudibela kwiNkundla yokuBumba nokuDibela iNtliziyo kwiSibhedlele i-Inkosi Albert Luthuli Central Hospital, ofuna ukubhaliswa njengoGqwethi kwi-HPCSA nokuba namava ahambelana nokugqitha kwezempilo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-MBChB; Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babhaliswe njengoGqwethi -uKudibela kwiNkundla yokuBumba nokuDibela iNtliziyo kuBhunga lweMisebenzi yezeMpilo eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA). Ukubhaliswa okwangoku njengoGqwethi wokuDibela kwiNkundla yokuBumba nokuDibela iNtliziyo ku-HPCSA. Amava: iQqabi 1: Akukho mva afunekayo emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoGqwethi weZempilo (uKudibela kwiNkundla yokuBumba nokuDibela iNtliziyo). IqQabi 2: Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ahambelana njengoGqwethi weZempilo emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoGqwethi weZempilo (uKudibela kwiNkundla yokuBumba nokuDibela iNtliziyo). IqQabi 3: Iminyaka elishumi (10) yamava ahambelana njengoGqwethi weZempilo emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoGqwethi weZempilo (uKudibela kwiNkundla yokuBumba nokuDibela iNtliziyo). IziQqamliso eziNgaphelelayo: Amava angezongakpo ekuboneleleni ngenkonzo yomGqwethi nakuhlwayo oluVula iThorax ngeVidiyo (VATS), uKudibela kokuNgenisa iNtliziyo, i-Op-CAB, i-ECMO okanye uKudibela kwesoFaya. Ikhono, ulwazi, uQeqesho lweNqanaba elibonelelwe nemisebenzi eMfunekayo: Kufuneka abe nokuba nolwazi olubanzi kwinkqubo yobuGqwethi yokuDibela kwiNkundla yokuBumba nokuDibela iNtliziyo, kuquka zonke iindawo zoKudibela iThorax jikelele, noKudibela iMikheniso yokuQoqwa kwaye yoluzalwe nayo yoMzimba woMthwalo weGazi. Ikhono lokwenza iNkundla yokuDibela ekulawulweni okusebenzayo kweemeko ezikwindla yobuGqwethi liyimfuno ephelileyo. Ngaphezu koko, ukufundisa nokwazi ukusebenzisa iKhompyutha zeemfuno ezibalulekileyo. Umfaki isicelo kufuneka edlule kuQeqesho kwiziko lokudibela iNkundla yokuBumba nokuDibela iNtliziyo esemthethweni kwindawo yemfundo yolwazi, nokuba ngaphakathi kwelizwe okanye kwenye indawo. Ikhono lokulinganisa ngokwamaxwesha oMgqwigqwi weNkundla yokuDibela iNtliziyo nayo, incazelo yeNdzuzo ezithe ngqo iindanda, ikakhulu ezokuSika nokuPapasha, ukungenelela ngokuDibela nokuLawula nangemva kokuSebenza kubalwa ngakumbi. Ukubonisa ikhono lokulawula nokufundisa abasebenzi abasezantsi. Ukubonisa ikhono lokusebenza njengenxalenye yeQela elisezini elahlulwe-hlulweyo. Ikhono elivezweyo lokulawula, unxibelelwano oluhle, uthetho-thethwano, uLungelelwaniso, uMiselwe-hlelo, uLawulo, uNqumbo-gqibo nezakhono zokuHlobana nabantu.
xh.duties: Ukubonelela ngenkonzo yamaxwesha oko kukuvakalelwa, uPhando, ukunakekelwa ngaphambi kokubanjwa unyulo ukuze kwenziwe isigulane kwindlu yamayeza nakwindlu yamayeza yokubanjwa unyulo nangaphezulu koko nakwindlu yamayeza yokubanjwa unyulo nasekudibeleni nangezempilo ukunyuka amava abo kwindlu yokubanjwa unyulo okanye ikhondo elijonge phambili kubasebenzi besikhululo nakuKucocwa kweeMeko kwamagqabi. Ukuze kugqitywe kubekho uLungelelwaniso oluzoQeqesha abaQeqeshi basezantsi. Ukuba nalwazi olusemthethweni nakuzoQeqesho ezifanelekileyo ukuqeqesha umGqwethi wokuDibela iThorax. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkonzo zangemva kweevegi zenyulo xa kufuneka.

jobs.title: Deputy Director-general: Office of the CFO
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director-general in the Office of the CFO at the Mpumalanga Department of Education, requiring an honours degree and eight years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate SAQA recognised Honors Degree or Post Graduate Diploma or equivalent qualification (NQF level 8) relevant to the specific field plus a minimum of 8 years experience at senior managerial level. Registration as CA (SA) would be an added advantage. Valid driver's license. Knowledge, skills, training and competencies required: Sound technical knowledge of GRAP (Generally Recognised Accounting Practices), which will encompass the transition to the accrual basis of accounting, performance budgeting and the Public Service Legislative Framework for Financial and Supply Chain Management. In depth knowledge and understanding of the provisions of the Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations and the Division of Revenue Act. Sound knowledge of the Public Service Act and –Regulations, the Employment of Educators Act and other HR-related policy frameworks and practices. Sound knowledge of the strategic planning processes. Ability to provide sound technical advice on the performance of the departmental financial system to the Accounting Officer and Line Managers. Strong leadership ability in securing financial resources for the Department to adequately fund the Strategic Plan. Ability to capitalize on human potential and to build a strong financial delivery team. Advanced planning, organising and project management skills. Excellent verbal communication- and report writing skills. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a relevant technical exercise. Please note: With effect from 1 April 2020, an individual may only qualify for appointment at SMS level provided that said official has successfully completed a Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme and that he/she can produce the required Pre-entry Certificate as issued by the National School of Governance (NSG) on her/his own cost. For further information related to the on-line course, interested officials are advised to contact nyukela@thensg.gov.za. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity.
jobs.duties: Develop, implement and maintain appropriate mechanisms to timeously respond to the changing needs for financial information, the interpretation thereof and the rendering of technical advice to the Accounting Officer. Ensure that the financial resources and assets of the Department are utilised effectively and economically to realize the objectives of the Strategic Plan. Provide technical advice to Line Managers to ensure the equitable allocation, maintenance and utilization of resources in line with the strategic objectives of the Department, legislative imperatives and good governance principles. Ensure compliance with the provisions of the Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations and the Division of Revenue Act. Meet the reporting requirements and standards set in terms of the PFMA, Division of Revenue Act and financial statements. Ensure adequate internal financial control arrangements and systems for the accountable delegation of financial powers, asset security, monitoring and evaluation, early warning and timeous corrective action. Assist the Accounting Officer by applying cost benefit analysis principles ensuring value for money. Oversee the budgetary process within the Department, exercise budgetary control and provide early warning arrangements at a strategic level. Develop and facilitate the implementation of Supply Chain Management Systems consistent with legislative and other good governance arrangements. Oversee the preparation and submission of the annual financial statement and liaise with the Auditor General in this regard. Oversee the rendering of diverse HR Management-, labour relations and HR development services within the Department.
jobs.applications: The Mpumalanga Department of Education awaits applications from suitably qualified and experienced persons for appointment to positions, as set out below: Should be uploaded via the following link https://erecruitment.mpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: The successful candidate will have to sign an annual performance agreement, annually disclose his/her financial interests and be subjected to a security clearance. Appointment will be subject to competency assessment. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job. Following the interview and technical exercise the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency based assessments) The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Applications should be submitted on the latest Form Z.83, obtainable from any Public Service Department. Applications must in all cases be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only. Only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview following communication from the relevant HR section of the Department. The filling of posts will be done in terms of the Department’s approved Employment Equity Plan. Due to ongoing internal processes, the Department reserves the right to withdraw any post at any time. The Department reserves the right to verify the qualifications of every recommended candidate prior to the issuing of an offer of appointment. All short-listed candidates will be subject to a vetting process prior to appointment. If no response is received from Mpumalanga Department of Education within 90 days after the closing date of the advertisement, applicants must assume that their application was not successful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Enquiries should be directed to 013 766 5524/5175/5267/5458/5350: Ms. NP Magagula / Ms. SL Mkhatshwa / Ms. SR Ndzinisa / Mr. X Sifunda, YT Mthethwa - HR Recruitment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Onderdirekteur-generaal: Kantoor van die CFO
af.summary: Onderdirekteur-generaal in die Kantoor van die CFO by die Mpumalanga Department of Education, wat 'n honneursgraad en agt jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike SAQA-erkende Honneursgraad of Nagraadse Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 8) wat vir die spesifieke veld relevant is, plus 'n minimum van 8 jaar ervaring op senior bestuursvlak. Registrasie as CA (SA) sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Deeglike tegniese kennis van GRAP (Generally Recognised Accounting Practices), wat die oorgang na die toerekeningsbasis van rekeninghouding, prestasiebegroting en die Openbare Diens Wetgewende Raamwerk vir Finansiële en Voorsieningskettingbestuur sal omvat. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die bepalings van die Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations en die Division of Revenue Act. Deeglike kennis van die Public Service Act en -Regulations, die Employment of Educators Act en ander HR-verwante beleidsraamwerke en -praktyke. Deeglike kennis van die strategiese beplanningsprosesse. Vermoë om deeglike tegniese advies te verskaf oor die prestasie van die departementele finansiële stelsel aan die Rekenpligtige Beampte en Lynbestuurders. Sterk leierskapsvermoë om finansiële hulpbronne vir die Departement te bekom om die Strategiese Plan voldoende te finansier. Vermoë om op menslike potensiaal te kapitaliseer en 'n sterk finansiële afleweringsspan te bou. Gevorderde beplannings-, organisasie- en projeksbestuursvaardighede. Uitstekende mondelinge kommunikasie- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Kortlys-kandidate sal aan 'n toepaslike tegniese oefening onderwerp word. Neem asseblief kennis: Met ingang van 1 April 2020 kan 'n individu slegs vir aanstelling op SMS-vlak in aanmerking kom mits genoemde beampte die Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme suksesvol voltooi het en dat hy/sy die vereiste Toelatingsertifikaat soos deur die National School of Governance (NSG) uitgereik op eie koste kan voorlê. Vir verdere inligting rakende die aanlyn-kursus word belangstellende beamptes aangeraai om nyukela@thensg.gov.za te kontak. Alle kortlys-kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee toelatingsassessering onderneem. Die een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteitsassessering (etiese gedrag) wees. Alle kortlys-kandidate vir SMS-poste sal aan 'n tegniese oefening en onderhoud onderwerp word. Na die tegniese oefening en onderhoud sal 'n maksimum van drie (3) SMS-kandidate psigometriese assessering ondergaan om kognitiewe vermoëns, gedragsvoorkeure, emosionele intelligensie en integriteit te assesser.
af.duties: Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf toepaslike meganismes om betyds te reageer op die veranderende behoeftes vir finansiële inligting, die interpretasie daarvan en die verskaffing van tegniese advies aan die Rekenpligtige Beampte. Verseker dat die finansiële hulpbronne en bates van die Departement effektief en ekonomies benut word om die doelwitte van die Strategiese Plan te verwesenlik. Verskaf tegniese advies aan Lynbestuurders om die billike toekenning, instandhouding en benutting van hulpbronne in ooreenstemming met die strategiese doelwitte van die Departement, wetgewende imperatiewe en goeie bestuursbeginsels te verseker. Verseker nakoming van die bepalings van die Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations en die Division of Revenue Act. Voldoen aan die verslagdoeningsvereistes en -standaarde wat ingevolge die PFMA, Division of Revenue Act en finansiële state gestel word. Verseker toereikende interne finansiële beheerreëlings en stelsels vir die verantwoordelike afvaardiging van finansiële bevoegdhede, bateveiligheid, monitering en evaluering, vroee waarskuwing en tydige korrektiewe optrede. Bystand aan die Rekenpligtige Beampte deur koste-batontledingsbeginsels toe te pas om waarde vir geld te verseker. Hou toesig oor die begrotingsproses binne die Departement, oefen begrotingsbeheer uit en verskaf vroee waarskuwingsreëlings op strategiese vlak. Ontwikkel en fasiliteer die implementering van Voorsieningskettingbestuurstelsels wat in ooreenstemming is met wetgewende en ander goeie bestuursreëlings. Hou toesig oor die voorbereiding en indiening van die jaarlikse finansiële staat en skakel in hierdie verband met die Auditor General. Hou toesig oor die lewer van diverse HR-bestuurs-, arbeidsverhoudinge- en HR-ontwikkelingsdienste binne die Departement.

zu.title: Iseluleko-Sikhulu: Ihhovisi likaMlawuli-Mali
zu.summary: Iseluleko-Sikhulu ohovisini likaMlawuli-Mali eMnyangweni weMfundo waKwaMpumalanga, okudinga idigri ye-honours kanye namava eminyaka yisishiyagalombulu ebuqothweni bokuphatha abantu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Honors Degree ezifanele ezivunyelwe yi-SAQA noma i-Post Graduate Diploma noma iziqu ezingajwayelekile (NQF level 8) ezihambisana nenhlabathi ethize kanti futhi kudingeka ubenamava angu-8 eminyaka ngenani elinganani lokuqothwa ekuphathweni. Ukubhaliswa njengo-CA (SA) kungaba yindlela engeza inzuzo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa namandla okusebenza adingekayo: Ulwazi olujulile lobuchwepheshe mayelana ne-GRAP (Generally Recognised Accounting Practices), okuzohlanganisa inguquko eya kwesisekelo se-akhawunti sokwamukela, ukulungiselela ingxenyana yemali yokusebenza kanye neNqubo yomthetho yeSevisi Yomphakathi yezezezimali nokuphathwa kwenxuba yamalungu. Ulwazi olujulile nokukuqonda izimiso ze-Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations kanye ne-Division of Revenue Act. Ulwazi oluhle ngomthetho wePublic Service Act nalo mthetho olandelayo, i-Employment of Educators Act kanye nezinye izinqubomgomo ezihlotshaniswe nabantu kanye nendlela yokwenza izinto. Ulwazi oluhle ngezinqubo zokuqamba izinhlelo. Ikhono lokunikeza seluleko oluhle lobuchwepheshe ngemisebenzi yesistimu yezimali yomnyango kumlawuli-akhawunti kubaphathi bekhadi phakathi kwemininingwane elandelayo. Ikhono elikhulu lokuba ngumholi ekutholeni izinsiza zemali zomnyango ukuze ihlinzeke ngokwanele iNqubo Yesu esihlelekile. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ingqikithi yamandla abantu nokwakha iqembu elinamandla lezezezimali. Amakhono aphakeme ekwelula, ukuhlela kanye nokuphatha imikhakha. Amakhono aphakeme okukhuluma ngomlomo nokubhala imibiko. Abathunyiwe bazobekwa isivivinyo sobuchwepheshe esihambelanayo. Sicela uqaphele: Ukusuka ngo-1 April 2020, umuntu angamukeleka nje kuphela okubekwa esikhundleni esisingathini se-SMS uma lolo muntu eqede ngempumelelo iNqubo yokuhola yabaqothwa besimo esiphakeme kulezi sevisi yomphakathi futhi engakwazi ukukhiqiza isitifikathi esidingekayo sokungena ngaphambili njengoba kunikezwa i-National School of Governance (NSG) ngezindleko zakhe. Ukwazi okwengeziwe ngokuhlobene nenqubo yokuqeqesha kwi-intanethi, abaholi abanomdlandla bakhuthazwa ukuba baxhumane nyukela@thensg.gov.za. Bonke abathunyiwe okubandakanya abase-SMS bazothatha izivivinyo ezimbili zokungena. Okunye kuzosiba isivivinyo sokwenza izinto ukwazi ukulingana komuntu okhethiwe ngesikhathi kubhekwe imfuno yobuchwepheshe ngayinye nangaphandle kwayo, okunye kumele kubheke ukwethembeka (indlela yokuziphatha). Bonke abathunyiwe kumakhono e-SMS bazobhekwa isivivinyo sobuchwepheshe kanye nesiqhingi. Emva kohlolo lobuchwepheshe kanye nesiqhingi, abantu abangaphezulu konthathu (3) abase-SMS bazohlolwa ngamaphsiyokhometriku ukubheka amandla okucabanga, okukhetha indlela yokuziphatha, ukuqonda izinkiningo, kanye nokwethembeka.
zu.duties: Yakha, faka esebenzini kanye neqophe izindlela ezifanele ukuphendula ngokushesha izidingo ezishintshayo zolwazi lwezimali, ukutolikwa kolwazi nokunikezwa kweseluleko sobuchwepheshe kumlawuli-akhawunti. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zemali kanye nezimpahla zomnyango zisetshenziswa ngokusebenza kahle nangokugwema ukuchithwa ukuze kuzuze izinhloso zeNqubo Yesu esihlelekile. Nikeza iseluleko sobuchwepheshe kubaphathi bekhadi phakathi kwemininingwane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlukaniswa ngokungalungi, ukugcinwa nokusetshenzwa kwemitholampilo ngokuhambisana nezinhloso ezihlelekile zomnyango, imithetho ebalulekile kanye nezimiso zokuphatha okuhle. Qinisekisa ukuvunyelwa kwezimiso ze-Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations kanye ne-Division of Revenue Act. Hlangabezela izidingo ezibekiwe zokubika kanye namazinga ngesimiso se-PFMA, Division of Revenue Act namavesi e-akhawunti. Qinisekisa izinhlelo ezanele zolawulo lwezezimali langaphakathi kanye nezimiso zokuqwashisa ngokusemthethweni amandla okusebenza ngawezezimali, ukuvikeleka kwempahla, ukuqapha kanye neqoqo, ukwesaba kusenesikhathi kanye nokulungisa ngokushesha. Siza umlawuli-akhawunti ngokusebenzisa izimiso zokuqoqa inzuzo kanye nezindleko ukuze kutholwe inani lemali. Bheka isinqubo yemali engeniwe ngaphakathi komnyango, lawula leyo mali engeniwe bese unikeza izinhlelo zokwesaba kusenesikhathi esibekiwe. Yakha futhi uthuthukise ukusetshenziswa kwezimiso ze-Supply Chain Management ngokuvumelana nomthetho kanye nezinye izinhlela zokuphatha okuhle. Bheka ukulungiselela nokuthumela imibiko yamavesi we-akhawunti yonyaka futhi uxhumane no-Auditor General mayelana nalokho. Bheka ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo ezihlukene zokuphathaabantu, izimiso zobudlelwane basebenbeni kanye nentuthuko yabantu ngaphakathi komnyango.
