xh.summary: Sekela-Mongameli Jikelele kwiOfise kaCFO kwisebe lezemfundo likaMpumalanga, lifuna izidanga zobungqondra neyimviyo yeminyaka esibhozo kwinkqanaba eliphezulu lobaphathi.
xh.requirements: Isidanga obusiyo sobuGqatswa be-SAQA okanye i-Post Graduate Diploma okanye isidanga esilinganayo (NQF level 8) esithintela indawo ethile elifanele, ngaphezu komyalezo weminyaka engu-8 yamava enqanaba eliphezulu lobaphathi. Ukubhalisa njengo-CA (SA) kuya kuba lusizi olongezelelweyo. Ilayisensi yokushaya ibhayisikele esemthethweni. Ulwazi, amakhono eqhinelwe ngako, imisebenzi yokuqeqeshwa namakhono ayimfuneko: Ulwazi olululo noluchanekileyo nge-GRAP (Generally Recognised Accounting Practices), oluza kuquuka intshukumo ukuya kwinkqubo yokubala okugqithisiweyo, ulwabiwo-lwabiwo lomsebenzi wokwenza, nakaSaziso somthetho woMsebenzi woLuntu mayelana noLawulo lwezeMali noLawulo loNkontsho. Ulwazi oluNALWO nokuqonda okujulile ngesiqinisekiso soMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zoRhulumente, iNgqungquthela yoMthetho ka-Nqqhengqheko, noMthetho wokuQoka ngoMvuzo. Ulwazi olululo noluchanekileyo ngoMthetho woMsebenzi woLuntu nangeNgqungquthela yawo, uMthetho wokuQeshwa abaFundisi, nezinye iinkqubo-mthetho zemigaqo ezithintelwe nangabantu nobaqeshi obunye. Ulwazi olululo noluchanekileyo ngeenkqubo zocwangciso lwezithuba. Ikhono lokunikela ingcebiso ezilulo nenzima mayelana nokuqhuba kwangaphambili iinkqubo zeemali zesebe kumLawuliwo-Xhaso nabaphathi abanjengomgca oqhutyiweyo. Ikhono elomeleleyo lokubamba iqhaza ekufumaneni iindawo zomthombo-wemali zisebe ukuyigcina ngokwaneleyo umnikelo wamandla kwiCwangciso ePhambili. Ikhono lokwakha isakhono sabantu nokwakha iqela elomeleleyo lokuhambisa imali. Amakhono aphambili ekucwangciseni, ekuqwalaseleni nasekuqwalaseleni imisebenzi. Amakhono amangangqina okuthetha iilwimi nangokubhala iingxelo. Abafothuliweyo bazakubekwa kwisikhathi esincinci kwithesthi yamakhono. Nceda qaphela: Ukususela ngomhla wama-1 April 2020, umntu unganconwa kwisithuba kuphela kwinqanaba le-SMS ukuba lowo mntu uphumelele iNkqubo yeNkululeko yoBukhosi baseMandla Aphakamileyo yomSebenzi woLuntu yaye ukuba angakwazi ukuzisa isatifikethi esifunekayo se-Pre-entry njengoko sikhiqizwa yi-National School of Governance (NSG) ngentlawulo yakhe. Ukufumana ulwazi oluthe veteransa malunga nekhosi yehlabathi-jikelele, abafileyo bakhuthazwa ukuba baqhagamshelane ku-nyukela@thensg.gov.za. Bonke abafaki-zicelo abafotuliweyo, kuquka i-SMS, baza kwenza iintsingiselo ezimbini ezangaphambi kokungena. Enye iza kuba ngumzamo weqhagra ukumisela ulwaneliseko lomfaki-zicelo ngokusela kwamfuno ezilulo nezoqobo zesithuba yaye enye kufuneka ibe ngumzamo wokuzinza ekubeni ngumntu ongathembekiyo (ngokuziphatha ngendlela esemthethweni). Bonke abafaki-zicelo abafotuliweyo kwiinkqubo ze-SMS bazakubekwa kwisikhathi esincinci kwisiphithiphithi samakhono nangabucwangu. Landela isikhathi esincinci samakhono nangabucwangu, umanyano lwe-SMS (3) lweenqweli-moya liza kwenza iingcamango ezikwi-level elingakumbi ukulinganisa ukuziqhelanisa ngokobuchopho, ukhetho lwezenzo, ukuqonda iimvakalelo, nangokuzinza ekubeni ngumntu ongathembekiyo.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa, ukuyisebenzisa yaye ukuhlala uligcina kwakhona iindlela ezifanelekileyo ukuphendula ngexesha elifanelekileyo iimfuno ezitshintshayo zolwazi ngeemali, ukuçatshulwa kolwazi kwaye unike ingcebiso ezilulo nenzima kumLawuliwo-Xhaso. Qinisekisa ukuba amathuba ezeMali nempahla yesebe asetyenziswa ngokusebenzayo nangokugcinwa ukuze kuzuze ngokupheleleyo iinjongo zeCwangciso ePhambili. Nikela ingcebiso ezilulo nenzima kubaphathi abanjengomgca oqhutyiweyo ukugxininisa ukwabiwa ngokulunga, ukugcinwa nokusebenzisa amathuba ngokuhambelana neenjongo ezilulo zesebe, imigaqo-mthetho nangemigaqo yolawulo oluhle. Qinisekisa ukuzilolela ngokusesikweni kwemigaqo yoMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zoRhulumente, iNgqungquthela yoMthetho ka-Nqqhengqheko, noMthetho wokuQoka ngoMvuzo. Phikelela ngeemfuno zangabucwangu nangemilinganiselo emiselwe ngoMthetho woLawulo lwezeMali zoRhulumente, uMthetho wokuQoka ngoMvuzo nangezifanekiso-mali. Qinisekisa izikhululo ezanelweyo zolawulo lweemali zangaphakathi naye ngeenkqubo zokuqhuba amandla eemali ngokufanelekileyo, ukhuseleko lwempahla, ukulawula nokuqwalasela, ukulumkisa ngaphambili nokuzeke ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Siza umLawuliwo-Xhaso ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo-mthetho zokuqwalasela ngeentsengo nezinzuzo ukugxininisa ukuthobela iNANI. Lawula iinkqubo zamathuba eemali ngaphakathi kwesebe, wazi amathuba eemali unike imiba yokulumkisa ngaphambili enqanaba elililo. Cwangcisa ukuze ukhuthaze ukusebenza kweekhathalogu zoLawulo loNkontsho ngokuhambelana nemigaqo-mthetho nangolunye ulawulo oluhle. Lawula ukuqwalaselwa nokuhambiswa kwezifanekiso-mali zonyaka wemali yaye uchaze umcimba kunye noVeki Jikelele ngomcimba lowo. Lawula ukuqhubwa kweenkonzo ezahlukeneyo zoLawulo lwabantu, izindaba zokusebenza nokuphuhlisa abantu ngaphakathi kwesebe.

jobs.title: Chief Director: HR Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs.
jobs.summary: Chief Director for HR Management at the Department of Education Head Office in Mbombela, offering R1 554 696 per annum.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate SAQA recognised Bachelors Degree or Advanced Diploma or equivalent qualification (NQF level 7) relevant to the specific field plus a minimum of 5 years experience at senior managerial level. Proven outstanding managerial and service delivery competency. In depth knowledge and understanding of the relevant policy frameworks including the Public Service Act and Regulations, the national and provincial HR and IT policy frameworks, PFMA and Financial Regulations, as well as the legislation and policies governing the provisioning, employment and conditions of service of educators. Extensive and credible experience in the application of systems, processes, procedures and best practices in the areas of human resource management and labour relations. Proven communication and interpersonal skills at all levels. Sound analytical and problem solving skills. Planning, organising and project management skills. Excellent leadership and managerial skills. Ability to develop logical frameworks and other models. Ability to develop and adhere to work schedules and to work under pressure. Developed computer literacy. Willingness to travel and work beyond normal working hours. Valid driver's license. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a relevant technical exercise. Please note: With effect from 1 April 2020, an individual may only qualify for appointment at SMS level provided that said official has successfully completed a Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme and that he/she can produce the required Pre-entry Certificate as issued by the National School of Governance (NSG) on her/his own cost. For further information related to the on-line course, interested officials are advised to contact nyukela@thensg.gov.za. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity.
jobs.duties: Ensure the development, planning, implementation, monitoring, assessment and co-ordination of policy and systems for the rendering of human resource management-, labour relations as well as human resource development services. Manage HR planning and -provisioning, remuneration and - performance matters. Manage labour relations, as well as matters related to incapacity, inefficiency and misconduct. Manage the rendering of human resource development services. Ensure compliance, implementation and maintenance of national and provincial policy frameworks in the responsible areas of activity. Ensure mission effectiveness and operational efficiency through effective and efficient resources management, including the human resources, finance, equipment and systems of the component. Contribute to the strategic direction of the Department. Pro-actively build sound relationships with key stakeholders and clients, including organised labour. Empower staff within the component through coaching, development and skills transfer. The appointee will be a member of the management echelon of the Department of Education, and will be expected to contribute at that level. Promote a culture of efficiency and quality.
jobs.applications: The Mpumalanga Department of Education awaits applications from suitably qualified and experienced persons for appointment to positions, as set out below: Should be uploaded via the following link https://erecruitment.mpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: The successful candidate will have to sign an annual performance agreement, annually disclose his/her financial interests and be subjected to a security clearance. Appointment will be subject to competency assessment. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job. Following the interview and technical exercise the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency based assessments) The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Applications should be submitted on the latest Form Z.83, obtainable from any Public Service Department. Applications must in all cases be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only. Only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview following communication from the relevant HR section of the Department. The filling of posts will be done in terms of the Department’s approved Employment Equity Plan. Due to ongoing internal processes, the Department reserves the right to withdraw any post at any time. The Department reserves the right to verify the qualifications of every recommended candidate prior to the issuing of an offer of appointment. All short-listed candidates will be subject to a vetting process prior to appointment. If no response is received from Mpumalanga Department of Education within 90 days after the closing date of the advertisement, applicants must assume that their application was not successful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Enquiries should be directed to 013 766 5524/5175/5267/5458/5350: Ms. NP Magagula / Ms. SL Mkhatshwa / Ms. SR Ndzinisa / Mr. X Sifunda, YT Mthethwa - HR Recruitment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: HR-bestuur
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur vir HR-bestuur by die Department of Education se hoofkantoor in Mbombela, teen R1 554 696 per jaar.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike SAQA-erkende Bachelors-graad of Gevorderde Diploma of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 7) relevant tot die spesifieke veld plus 'n minimum van 5 jaar ervaring op senior bestuursvlak. Bewese uitstaande bestuurs- en diensleweringsbevoegdhede. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van die relevante beleidsraamwerke insluitend die Public Service Act and Regulations, die nasionale en provinsiale HR- en IT-beleidsraamwerke, PFMA en Financial Regulations, asook die wetgewing en beleid wat die voorsiening, diens en diensvoorwaardes van opvoeders regeer. Uitgebreide en geloofwaardige ervaring in die toepassing van stelsels, prosesse, prosedures en beste praktyke in die areas van menslike hulpbronbestuur en arbeidsverhoudinge. Bewese kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede op alle vlakke. Degelike analitiese en probleemoplossende vaardighede. Beplannings-, organiseer- en projeksbestuursvaardighede. Uitstekende leierskap- en bestuursvaardighede. Vermoe om logiese raamwerke en ander modelle te ontwikkel. Vermoe om werkskedules te ontwikkel en daaraan te voldoen en onder druk te werk. Ontwikkelde rekenaargeletterdheid. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en buite normale werksure te werk. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Gelysde kandidate sal aan 'n relevante tegniese oefening onderwerp word. Let asseblief hierop: Met ingang van 1 April 2020 kan 'n individu slegs vir aanstelling op SMS-vlak in aanmerking kom mits bedoelde beampte die Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme suksesvol voltooi het en die vereiste Toelatingsertifikaat soos uitgereik deur die National School of Governance (NSG) op eie koste kan voorlê. Vir verdere inligting verbandhoudend met die aanlyn-kursus, word geinteresseerde beamptes geraadpleeg om nyukela@thensg.gov.za te kontak. Alle gelysde kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toelatingsassesserings onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om die geskiktheid van 'n kandidate te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes en die ander moet 'n integriteitassessering (etiese gedrag) wees. Alle gelysde kandidate vir SMS-pos sal aan 'n tegniese oefening en onderhoud onderwerp word. Na die tegniese oefening en onderhoud, sal 'n maksimum van drie (3) SMS-kandidate psigometriese assessering ondergaan om kognitiewe vermoens, gedragsvoorkeure, emosionele intelligensie en integriteit te beoordeel.
af.duties: Verseker die ontwikkeling, beplanning, implementering, monitering, assessering en koordinering van beleid en stelsels vir die levering van menslike-hulpbronbestuur, arbeidsverhoudinge sowel as menslike-hulpbronontwikkelingsdienste. Bestuur HR-beplanning en voorsiening, vergoeding en prestasie-aangeleenthede. Bestuur arbeidsverhoudinge, sowel as aangeleenthede verbonde aan onvermo, ondoeltreffendheid en wangedrag. Bestuur die levering van menslike-hulpbronontwikkelingsdienste. Verseker nakoming, implementering en onderhoud van nasionale en provinsiale beleidsraamwerke in die verantwoordelike aktiwiteitsareas. Verseker missie-effektiwiteit en operasionele doeltreffendheid deur effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van hulpbronne, insluitende die menslike hulpbronne, finansies, toerusting en stelsels van die komponent. Dra by tot die strategiese rigting van die Department. Bou pro-aktief goeie verhoudinge met sleutelbelanghebbendes en kliënte, insluitend georganiseerde arbeid. Bemagtig personeel binne die komponent deur afrigting, ontwikkeling en vaardigheidsoordrag. Die aangestelde sal 'n lid van die bestuursechelon van die Department of Education wees, en sal verwag word om op daardie vlak by te dra. Bevorder 'n kultuur van doeltreffendheid en gehalte.

zu.title: Umnikazi Oholayo: Ukuphathwa kwe-HR
zu.summary: Umnikazi Oholayo wokuphathwa kwe-HR e-Department of Education Head Office e-Mbombela, enikeza i-R1 554 696 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: I-degree yesiqu elitholwa ngokuhambisana ne-SAQA noma i-Advanced Diploma noma izifundo ezilinganayo (i-NQF level 7) ezihambelana nakungakuthile kanye nokuba uneminyaka engu-5 yamava ezingeni eliphezulu lokubusa. Ukwazi ukubusa nokuhlinzeka ngesevisi ngendlela evezwa ngokungenisa izinkinga ezihambisana nalokhu. Ukuqonda ngokujulile imithethonqondo yezinhlelo zomphakathi kanye noMthetho wesevisi yomphakathi namalawu awo, izinhlelo zomphakathi kanye nezentela yomphakathi nasezifundazweni ze-HR ne-IT, i-PFMA kanye nomthetho wezimali, kanye nomthetho namapholisi ahlose nokuqashwa, ukusebenza nokuqashwa kwabafundisi. Ukuqonda ngokujulile imithethonqondo yezinhlelo zomphakathi kanye namapholisi ahlose nokuqashwa, ukusebenza nokuqashwa kwabafundisi. Ukuba namava aqotho kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni kwezinhlelo, inqubo, izindlela nezinye izinhlela ezinhle ezindaweni zokuphathwa kwabasebenzi kanye nezindaba zomsebenzi. Ukwazi ukuxhumana nabantu futhi usebenze ngokuhambisana nabo ongazini konke izinga. Ukuba nokuhlakanipha ekuhlaziyeni izinto kanye nokuqonda izinkinga. Ukuba nokuhlakanipha ekubekeni ihlelo, ekulungiseni izinto nakuphathweni kwezinhlela. Ukuba nobuqhawe bokuba abaholi kanye namava okubusa. Ukuba nokuhlakanipha kokwakheka kwemikhozwakhozo. Ukuba nokuhlakanipha kokulandela isikhathi somsebenzi nangokusebenza ngomzamo ongajwayelekile. Ukuba nokuhlakanipha kokubhala nokuqonda ikhompuyutha. Ukuqonda ukuthanda ukuhamba nokusebenza ngemvamu edlule kwejwayelekile. Ukuba nelayisensi yokushayela. Abantu abakwesabisekile bazohlangabezwa nokuqashwa okuncane. Sicela uqaphele: Ukusuka ngomhlaka 1 April 2020, umuntu angaqashwa kuphela ezingeni le-SMS uma eseqedile i-Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme futhi engakwazi ukuletha isatifikethi esitholakala ngaphambi kokuqashwa njengoba sikhishwa i-National School of Governance (NSG) ngesimali yakhe. Ngolwazi olubhekene nesifundo se-inthanethi, abantu abathanda ukwazi bayacelwa basenze i-nyukela@thensg.gov.za. Bonke abantu abakwesabisekile, kuhlanganise ne-SMS, bazohlangabezwa ngemibuzo emibili eyisibonakaliso. Omunye uzoba yisibonakaliso senqubo ukuze kubonakale ukufaneleka komuntu okwesabisekile ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zesikhundla, kanti omunye kumele abe ukuhlola isibonakaliso sokuziphatha. Bonke abantu abakwesabisekile kuzobe kunemibuzo yezobuchwepheshe kanye nesikhulu esiphezulu. Ngemva kwemibuzo yezobuchwepheshe, kuzoba nomuntu ongaceli idatha yabantu abangangaphezulu kwe-3 (3) abenza iziqu ze-SMS ukuba baye bahlolwe ukuze kubonakale ukukwazi ukucabanga, izinto azithandayo, ukuziphatha okuhle, kanye nokuqonda inhliziyo yakhe.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuthi kukhona ukulungiselelwa, ukubekwa kwehlelo, ukusetshenziswa, ukuhlola, ukubuka nokuhlanganisa kwezinhlelo kanye namapholisi ukuze kube khona ukuphathwa kwabantu, izindaba zomsebenzi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu. Phatha ukubekwa kwehlelo kwabantu, ukubhalisa, ukuhlinzwa ngemali kanye nezindaba zomsebenzi. Phatha izindaba zomsebenzi, kanye nezindaba eziphathelene nokungasebenzi kahle, ukungalungi nokungalaleli. Phatha ukunikezwa kwisevisi yokuthuthukiswa kwabantu. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa, ukusetshenziswa nokugcinwa kwezinhlelo zamapholisi omphakathi nasemaphethelweni. Qinisekisa ukuthi kusebenza kahle futhi kuhlinzwa kahle ngokuphathwa kwemithombo yezimali, izinto, izinhlela kanye nabantu. Yabela ngohlelo lwe-Department of Education. Yenza ubuhle bokuxhumana nabantu abalingene ukuthi kube khona ubuhle bokuxhumana, futhi usize abantu basebenze kahle, bathuthuke futhi bafunde. Lo muntu uzoba ngumunye wabaphathi abaphakathi e-Department of Education, futhi kuzofuneka asebenze ngaleyo ndlela. Qondisa abantu ukuthi basebenze ngokuhle futhi babe nemandla.

xh.title: Umntu ongumlawuli ophantsi weQela labaSebenzi: Ulawulo lwe-HR
xh.summary: Umntu ongumlawuli ophantsi weQela labaSebenzi kwisebe lezemfundo kwindlu enkulu yesebe eMbombela, elinika R1 554 696 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sezamabakwaligama esamkelwe yi-SAQA okanye iDiploma ePhakamileyo okanye isifanekiso sezazini esilinganayo (NQF level 7) esithintekileyo kwicala elithe lwalo elongeze ixesha elingaphantsi kweminyaka engama-5 lokuba namava kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo. Ubuchule obuvela obugqithisileyo bolawulo nokunikela inkonzo. Ulwizi olunzulu nokukuqonda iinkqubo zeenqobo ezithintekoyo eziquka iNtetho yokuSebenza kukaRhulumente neZimiso, iinkqubo zeenqobo ze-HR ne-IT ezikwindalo yeprofinsi nakuluntu, i-PFMA neZimiso zeMali, kunye nentetho neenqobo ezilawula ukubonelela, ukusebenza nemimiselo yabasebenzi abangaba thizineli. Namava amaninzi axabisekileyo ekusebenziseni iinkqubo, iinkqubo, iinkqubo ezichanekileyo nezona zilungileyo kummandla wokulawula abantu nokubakho kweenkxalabo. Amandla okuzithethela nokusebenzisana nabantu abaqinisekisiweyo kuzo zonke iinqanaba. Amandla okuhlola-ngqondo nokusombulula iingxaki. Amandla okucwangcisa, ukuqamba nokulawula iiprojekthi. Amandla amabalulekileyo okukhokela nokulawula. Amandla okuyila iinkqubo ezingqineliswayo nezinye iimodeli. Amandla okuyila nokuzithoba kumaxesha emisebenzi nokusebenza ngocinezelo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha olunamandla. Qinala lokuhamba nokusebenza ngaphaya kwamaxesha ajlilo anje. Ilayiseni yokuqeshisa esemthethweni. AbaPhakanyiselwayo baya kujonyelwa kwisikhathi sokuzama isakhono. Nceda qaphela: Ukususela ngo-1 April 2020, umntu unganako ukuba ngumntu ofanelekileyo kwi-SMS kuphela ukuba lowo msebenzi uqhibe isixhobo seNtetho kaRhulumente yeSikhulu seNqanaba eliphezulu kwaye angakha izatifikethi ezifunekayo ezikhiswa yi-National School of Governance (NSG) ngeemali yakhe. Ngolwazi oluthe lwaco lwesakhono esikwi-intanethi, abaSpukanyiswa bakhuthazwa ukuba bathinte nyukela@thensg.gov.za. Onke abaPhakanyiselwayo, kuquka ne-SMS, baya kuqhuba iindibaniselwa ezimbini ezingangeniswanga. Elinya lya kuba sisixhobo sokuzama ukumisela ukufaneleka komntu ngokusekelwe kwiimfuno zesikhundi ezinzulu nangobuqhelana, nelinye kufunke sibe kukulinganiswa kobuzigama (ukuziphatha ngokusesikweni). Onke abaPhakanyiselwayo kumagatya e-SMS baya kujonyelwa kumzamo wezakhono nantetho. Emva komzamo wezakhono nantetho, abantu abaninzi abangama-(3) abakwi-SMS baya kwenziwa iindibano ezilinganisa ukuziphila kobuchule, iinketho zenkqubo yabasebenzi, iintlungu ezibini ngokomoya, nokuziphatha ngokusesikweni.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuyila, ukucwangcisa, ukusebenzisa, ukujonga, ukulinganisa nokuhlanganisa iinkqobo neendlela zokusebenzisa ukunika iinkonzo zolawulo abantu, iingxaki zokusebenza nokhulo labasebenzi. Lawula i-HR yokucwangcisa nokwamkela izinto, umvuzo nemiba yemiganu. Lawula iingxaki zokusebenza, njengoko kunye nemiba evela ekungaphilanga, ukungenzi emsebenzini nokuziphatha kakubi. Lawula ukunikela iinkonzo zokhulo lwabasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa, ukusebenziswa nokugcinwa kweenkqubo zombuso nezakwiprofinsi kummandla ophantsi kolawulo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza komgxalwa kwaye kusebenze ngokuchanekileyo ngokulawula ngokuchanekileyo izixhobo ezisebenzayo, kuquka abantu, imali, izixhobo neendlela zokusebenza kweso sixhobo. Yonakale ngakumbi kumacandu eMbaleki angundoqo nakumthengi, kuquka iilabhu ezinganamvela. Linika amandla abasebenzi kuso sixhobo ngokulungisa ukuziphatha, ukukhula kwaye ufunde ngokuchanekileyo izakhono ezizayo. Lo mntu oqeshwa ngulo nyathelo oluphezulu lolawulo loLuntu Isebe lemfundo, kwaye kulindeleke ukuba akho kwele minyaka yonke yemisebenzi yayo. Khuthaza inkqubo yokuziphatha ngokuchanekileyo neziko ezifanelekileyo.

jobs.title: Director: Inclusive Education and Education Support
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs.
jobs.summary: Lead the Inclusive Education Directorate at Mpumalanga Head Office, developing policy, programmes and systems for inclusive education.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate SAQA recognised Bachelors Degree or Advanced Diploma or equivalent qualification (NQF level 7) relevant to the specific field plus a minimum of 5 years experience at a middle/senior managerial level. Knowledge of and experience in high level planning and management. He or she will provide strategic leadership in the Directorate. Knowledge of government and departmental policies as well as proven ability to work as part of a team. Competencies: In depth knowledge and understanding of all legislation related to the Public Service and the education sector. Distinct competence and a proven track record in the areas of participative management and leadership, organisational development, policy formulation, as well as programme management and evaluation. Ability to capitalize on human potential and to build a strong team. Strong leadership ability. Advanced planning, organisational and project management skills. Sound analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to develop logical frameworks and other planning models. Sound financial management skills. Proven ability to communicate effectively with a broad spectrum of role players, both in writing and verbally. Excellent report writing skills. Excellent networking skills. Willingness to travel and work beyond normal working hours. Ability to maintain the required level of information confidentiality and security. Good computer user skills. The ability to provide strategic leadership and to deliver excellent results under pressure will be a strong recommendation. Valid driver's license. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a relevant technical exercise. Please note: With effect from 1 April 2020, an individual may only qualify for appointment at SMS level provided that said official has successfully completed a Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme and that he/she can produce the required Pre-entry Certificate as issued by the National School of Governance (NSG) on her/his own cost. For further information related to the on-line course, interested officials are advised to contact nyukela@thensg.gov.za. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity.
jobs.duties: The Department of Education seeks to employ a dynamic leader as Director for the Inclusive Education Directorate. The successful candidate will take responsibility for the development and maintenance of policy, programmes and systems for inclusive education. He or she will also be a member of the management structure of the Department, and will be expected to contribute at that level. The Directorate is responsible for a range of functions, including: Development, evaluation and maintenance of policy, programmes and systems for; ordinary learners, learners with special learning needs and, psychological, guidance and social support programmes. Design systems to improve the efficiency and productivity of the Directorate. Pro-actively build sound relationships with key stakeholders and clients, including organised labour. Promote a culture of efficiency and quality. Empower staff within the component through performance management, coaching, development, and skills transfer.
jobs.applications: The Mpumalanga Department of Education awaits applications from suitably qualified and experienced persons for appointment to positions, as set out below: Should be uploaded via the following link https://erecruitment.mpg.gov.za

af.title: Direkteur: Inklusiewe Onderwys en Onderwysondersteuning
af.summary: Lood die Direktoraat Inklusiewe Onderwys by Mpumalang Hoofkantoor en ontwikkel beleid, programme en stelsels vir inklusiewe onderwys.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike SAQA-erkende Bachelors-graad of Gevorderde Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF-vlak 7) relevant tot die spesifieke veld, plus 'n minimum van 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Kennis van en ervaring in hoëvlak beplanning en bestuurswerk. Hy of sy sal strategiese leierskap in die Direktoraat bied. Kennis van regerings- en departementele beleide asook bewese vermoë om as deel van 'n span te werk. Bevoegdhede: Diepgaande kennis en begrip van alle wetgewing wat verband hou met die Openbare Diens en die onderwysektor. Duidelike bevoegdheid en 'n bewese rekord op die gebiede van deelnemende bestuur en leierskap, organisatoriese ontwikkeling, beleidsformulering, asook programbestuur en evaluering. Vermoë om menslike potensiaal te benut en 'n sterk span op te bou. Sterk leierskapsvermoë. Gevorderde beplannings-, organisatoriese en projekbestuursvaardighede. Klank analitiese en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Vermoë om logiese raamwerke en ander beplanningsmodelle te ontwikkel. Klank finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Bewese vermoë om effektief met 'n breë spektrum van rolspelers te kommunikeer, beide skriftelik en mondelings. Uitstekende verslagskryfvaardighede. Uitstekende netwerkvaardighede. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en buite normale werksure te werk. Vermoë om die vereiste vlak van inligtingvertroulikheid en sekuriteit te handhaaf. Goeie rekenaargebruikersvaardighede. Die vermoë om strategiese leierskap te bied en uitstekende resultate onder druk te lewer, sal 'n sterk aanbeveling wees. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kortlys-kandidate sal aan 'n toepaslike tegniese oefening onderwerp word. Let asseblief: Met ingang van 1 April 2020 kan 'n individu slegs vir aanstelling op SMS-vlak in aanmerking kom mits genoemde beampte 'n Openbare Diens Senior Bestuursleierskapsprogram suksesvol voltooi het en dat hy/sy die vereiste Voor-toetree-sertifikaat soos uitgereik deur die National School of Governance (NSG) op eie koste kan voorlê. Vir verdere inligting verbandhoudend met die aanlyn-kursus, word geïnteresseerde beamptes geadviseer om nyukela@thensg.gov.za te kontak. Alle kortlys-kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toetree-assesserings onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal, en die ander moet 'n integriteits-assessering (etiese gedrag) wees. Alle kortlys-kandidate vir SMS-poste sal aan 'n tegniese oefening en onderhoud onderwerp word. Na aanleiding van die tegniese oefening en onderhoud, sal 'n maksimum van drie (3) SMS-kandidate psigometriese assesserings ondergaan om kognitiewe vermoëns, gedragsvoorkeure, emosionele intelligensie en integriteit te assesseer.
af.duties: Die Department of Education beoog om 'n dinamiese leier as Direkteur vir die Direktoraat Inklusiewe Onderwys aan te stel. Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelikheid neem vir die ontwikkeling en instandhouding van beleid, programme en stelsels vir inklusiewe onderwys. Hy of sy sal ook 'n lid van die bestuursstruktuur van die Departement wees, en sal op daardie vlak verwag word om by te drae. Die Direktoraat is verantwoordelik vir 'n reeks funksies, insluitend: Ontwikkeling, evaluering en instandhouding van beleid, programme en stelsels vir; gewone leerders, leerders met spesiale leerbehoeftes en, sielkundige, begeleidings- en maatskaplike ondersteuningsprogramme. Ontwerp stelsels om die doeltreffendheid en produktiwiteit van die Direktoraat te verbeter. Bou pro-aktief goeie verhoudings met sleutelbelanghebbendes en kliënte, insluitend georganiseerde arbeid. Bevorder 'n kultuur van doeltreffendheid en gehalte. Bemagtig personeel binne die komponent deur prestasiebestuur, afrigting, ontwikkeling en vaardigheidsoordrag.

zu.title: Umphathi: Imfundo ehlanganisayo nokuNikela iNkxaso eMfundeni
zu.summary: Hola iDirectorate yemfundo ehlanganisayo eMpumalanga Head Office, thuthukisa izinqubomgomo, izinhlelo kanye namasistimu emfundeni ehlanganisayo.
zu.requirements: I-Degree ye-Bachelors ebikelwa yi-SAQA noma i-Advanced Diploma noma izifundo ezilinganayo (NQF level 7) ezihambisana nendawo ethize kanye nobuncwane obungu-5 iminyaka ngaphezulu emazingeni aphakathi/phezulu okuphatha. Ulwazi kanye nobuhlotshisi ekwenzeni iplani ngokulinganisela okuphezulu nasekuphatheni. Yena noma yena uzohola ngokuqondisisa kwi-Directorate. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo zahulumeni nomnyango kanye nethonya elivezwe lokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu. Ikhono: Ulwazi oluqonde kakhulu kanye nokubuka konke umthetho ohlobene ne-Public Service kanye nendawo yemfundo. Ikhono elivezwe kanye nobungcweti obugqamayo kwindawo yokuphatha ngokubamba iqhaza kanye noholo, intuthuko yenkampani, ukwakhiwa kwezinqubomgomo, kanye nokuphathwa kokuqashwa kanye nokuqashwa kwezinhlelo. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhono labantu nokwakha iqembu eliqinile. Ikhono elikhulu lokuhola. Amakhono okwenza iplani aphakeme, ukuhlelwa kwenkampani kanye nokuphathwa kwephrojekthi. Amakhono okuhlaziya kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa amasakhiwo abhekisa emiqondweni kanye namanye amamodeli aqondiswa ekuhlelweni. Amakhono aphephile okuphathwa kwezimali. Ikhono elivezwe lokuthintana ngempumelelo nomthelela webange elibanzi, kokubili ngokubhala nangomlomo. Amakhono aphezulu okubhala imibiko. Amakhono aphezulu okwakha ukuhlanganyela. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba kubuye futhi usebenze ngemva kwamasikhathi ejwayelekile okusebenza. Ikhono lokugcina izinga elidingekayo lokwethembeka kwemayelana nobumfihlo kanye nokuvikelwa. Amakhono aphezulu okusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokunika uholo oluzoqondisisa kanye nokuletha iziphumelelo ezinhle ngaphansi kwegqubeka lokuqhathaniswa kuzobe kunconywa kakhulu. Ilayisensi yomshayeli esebenzayo. Abantu abayiziphethu bazobekwa esivivinyweni esihlobene nobuhlakani. Sicela uqaphele: Qala ngo-1 April 2020, umuntu ungangathola ukubekwa esikhundleni emzingeni we-SMS kuphela uma lowo muntu ephumelele ukuphela kwenhlelo ye-Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme futhi akwazi ukuletha iPre-entry Certificate ebingeyadingeka njengoba ikhishwa i-National School of Governance (NSG) ngesidingo sakhe. Ukwazi okwengeziwe okuhlobene nenkqubo ye-on-line, abantu abanentshisekelo bayakhuthazwa ukuba bathintane nyukela@thensg.gov.za. Bonke abayiziphethu, okuhlanganisa i-SMS, bazothatha izivivinyo ezimbili ezingeyona zokungena. Okunye kuzobe yivivinyo lokuqondiswa ekubekeni isikhundla somuntu ngokusiza kwesikhundla ngobuhlakani kanye nezidingo ezingeyona zendabuko futhi okunye kumele kubeyivivinyo lokuqonda (okuziphatha ngokusesibheni). Bonke abayiziphethu izikhundla se-SMS bazobekwa esivivinyweni sobuhlakani kanye nangemibhuzo. Emva kwesivivinyo sobuhlakani kanye nemibhuzo, abantu abafingqwa (3) abangaphezulu be-SMS bazothatha izivivinyo ze-psychometric ukuhlaziya ikhono lokucabanga, okuthandwayo ngokuziphatha, i-intelligence yokuzwa, kanye nokuqonda.
zu.duties: I-Department of Education ifuna ukusebenzisa umholi onamandla njengoMphathi weDirectorate yemfundo ehlanganisayo. Umuamukile uzothwela ibharuqa ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokugcinwa kwezinqubomgomo, izinhlelo namasistimu emfundeni ehlanganisayo. Yena noma yena uzobe engxenyeni yokuphathwa komnyango, futhi uzobe elindelekile ukuba enze konke kulelo nqondo. I-Directorate ibhekene nomkhakha oqhamuka kweziminyezo, okuhlanganisa: Ukuthuthukiswa, kuqashwe kanye nokugcinwa kwezinqubomgomo, izinhlelo namasistimu; abafundi abajwayelekile, abafundi abanazo izidingo ezikhethekile zokufunda, izinhlelo zokusekela ngokwesibongo kanye nokusekela ngokomphakathi. Yakha amasistimu ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kanye nemvelo yomsebenzi weDirectorate. Yakhela ubudlelwano obuhle proactively nabanomthelela abakhulu kanye namakhasimende, okuhlanganisa ulabho ahleliwe. Khuthaza inhlalo yokusebenza ngempumelelo kanye nensinga. Nikela amandla abasebenzi ngaphakathi kohlangothi ngokuphathwa kokusebenza, ukuqeqesha, ukuthuthuka, kanye nokudlulisa amakhono.

xh.title: Umongameli: Imfundo eQuka Yo bonke noXhaso lweMfundo
xh.summary: Qhankqatha iNgqungquthela yeMfundo eQuka Yo bonke kwiNtloko-komsebenzi yaKwaMpumalanga, uphuhlise iinkqubo, iinkqubo ezisemthethweni nezixhobo zolawulo zemfundo equka bonke.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokuqala i-Bachelors Degree esiqinisekisiweyo ngu-SAQA okanye i-Advanced Diploma okanye isidanga saba ngamagunya (NQF level 7) esifanelekayo kweli candelo elitshiwayo kunye nokuba nakho unyaka wokuqonda ubudala obungaphezulu kwe-5 ekwindanaba eliphakathi/laphezulu lolawulo. Ulwazi ngokuphanda ngokulinganayo nolawulo ezingqamweni ziphakamileyo. Yena okanye yona iya kunika inkokheli eqondileyo kwisiGqeba. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zorhulumente nesebe kunye nokuqinisekiswa kokuba nakho ukusebenza njengenxalenye yeqela. Ikhono: Ulwazi olujulileyo nokuqonda konke umthetho oqhutywa nawo oqhagamshelana nesebe laSebenzi lokuQondiswa koluntu nocalulo lwemfundo. Ikhono elicacileyo nerekhodi eqinisekisiweyo kwimimandla yolawulo olubandakanya bonke nolawulo, uphuhliso lolwabiwo, iinkqubo, njengenqanaba lolawulo lwexesha nokuqondwa kweziqendu. Ikhono lokusebenzisa amandla koluntu nokwakha iqela elomeleleyo. Amandla okuba yinkokheli anamandla. Amanyathelo okucwangcisa, ulwabiwo kunye nekhono lokulawula izicwangciso amanqanaba aphezulu. Ikhono lokwahlula nokuqonda iingxaki noku zisolula. Ikhono lokuphuhlisa iinkqubo ezingagqibekanga ezincinci namanye amacandelo okucwangcisa. Ikhono lokulawula iimali njengoko kufunekile. Ikhono eliqinisekisiweyo lokuthetha kakuhle nabanin'imalo abaninzi, kokubini kokubhala nokucoma. Ikhono eliphezulu lokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono eliphezulu lokudibanisa abantu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba nokusebenza ngaphaya kweyure ezingangagqibekanga. Ikhono lokugcina inqanaba elifunekayo lokufihleka kolwazi nolawulo lokhuseleko. Ikhono lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kakuhle. Amandla okunikela inkokheli eqondileyo nokuza nemveliso ezimngaleni ngaphantsi kwengcinezela kuya kuba ngumcebiso onamandla. Ilayisensi yokushayela eqinisekisiweyo. Abakhethiweyo kuya kwenziwa kubo isicwangciso esiya kuba sikhankanyiweyo apha. Nceda qaphela: Ukususela ngomhla wama-1 ku-April 2020, umntu ungamkeleka kuphela kwinxenye yokwenzwa njengenkokheli kwindanaba le-SMS ukuba lowo mphathiswa uphumelele iNkqubo yeNkokheli ePhakamileyo kuSebenzi lokuQondiswa koluntu kwaye unako ukuzisa isatifikatha efunekayo yokungena ngaphambili njengoko inikiwe liZiko leSizwe leFundo (NSG) ngeemali zakhe. Ngolwazi oluthe ngqo oluthe ngqo ngeNkqubo eQhuba kwi-intanethi, abakhangele ukwazi kuya kuxelelwa ukuba baqhagamshele nyukela@thensg.gov.za. Bonke abakhethiweyo, kuquka naba kwi-SMS, kuya kwenziwa iNdlela yokuvavanya nge-Pre-Entry. Esi sibini kuya kuba sisesicwangciso sokuzama ukumisela ukulungelelana kolowo kwindanaba lolawulo kwiinkqubo ezifanelekileyo kunye nezo zigqibo zezenzo ezize ngokwemigaqo, kwaye esinye kuya kuba sisicwangciso sokuzama isimilo. Bonke abakhethiweyo kumagunya e-SMS kuya kwenziswa kubo isicwangciso esifanelekileyo sokuzama iinkqubo nendlela yokuva iingxelo emva kokubakho isicwangciso sokuzama iinkqubo nendlela yokuva iingxelo, abakhethiweyo abaninzi abangangaphezu kwabathathu (3) ebe bengabakho kwi-SMS kuya kwenziswa kubo isicwangciso sokuvavanya isimo sabo sokuzama ukuya kwinkqubo yamandla okuzama ukukhula ukulunga kwemvelo.
xh.duties: ISebe leMfundo lifuna ukuba lisebenze nomntu onesiphiwo njengenkokheli njengengqamamela kwiNgqungquthela yokuNika iMfundo. Umntu ophumeleleyo uya kubeka isibiyeli-ngqangi kuphuhliso nokugcina iinkqubo, iinkqubo ezisemthethweni nolawulo lwemfundo equka bonke abantu. Yena okanye yona uya kubakho njengenxalenye yekomiti elilawulayo kwiSebe, kwaye uya kulindelwe ukuba anike isandla kolona qonga kwindanaba elingakumbi. EsiGqeba sibiza iinkalo ezahlukeneyo, kuquka; Ukuphuhlisa, ukuqonda nokugcina iinkqubo, iinkqubo ezisemthethweni nolawulo lwemfundo equka; abafundi abakhoyo, abafundi abanazo iingxaki zokufunda, iinkqubo zokuxhasa ngesigqi ngokomoya. Ukuqamba izixhobo zolawulo ezithi zibe ngcono ukulunga kwaye zibemandla kwiNgqungquthela eNtaba-bomvu. Ukwakha ngenjongo ubudlelwane obuhle ngeenkokeli ezibalulekileyo nabaxhasi, kuquka neshishini labasebenzi labo. Ukukhuthaza inkqubo yenhlahluphindo ngesiqhelo. Ukugcina abasebenzi bawolunge ngendlela yokuzonkeza ubuchule, ukukhulisa, uphuhliso nobomi bekhono.

af.summary: Direkteur van Openbare Eksamens by die Mpumalanga Onderwys Hoofkantoor, verantwoordelik vir eksamenadministrasie, IT-stelsels en die ontwikkeling van vraestelle.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike SAQA-erkende Bachelors-graad of Gevorderde Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) relevant tot die spesifieke veld, plus 'n minimum van 5 jaar ervaring op 'n middel-/senior bestuursvlak. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kandidate wat op die kortlys geplaas is, sal aan 'n relevante tegniese oefening onderwerp word. Neem asseblief kennis: Met ingang van 1 April 2020 kan 'n individu slegs vir aanstelling op SMS-vlak kwalifiseer mits die betrokke amptenaar suksesvol 'n Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme voltooi het en hy/sy die vereiste Toelatingsertifikaat soos deur die National School of Governance (NSG) uitgegee, op eie koste kan voorlê. Vir verdere inligting rakende die aanlyn kursus word geïnteresseerde amptenare versoek om nyukela@thensg.gov.za te kontak. Alle kandidate op die kortlys, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toelatingsassessering onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n assessering van integriteit (etiese gedrag) wees. Alle kandidate op die kortlys vir SMS-poste sal aan 'n tegniese oefening en onderhoud onderwerp word. Na die tegniese oefening en onderhoud sal 'n maksimum van drie (3) SMS-kandidate psigometriese assessering ondergaan om kognitiewe vermoëns, gedragsvoorkeure, emosionele intelligensie en integriteit te assesseer.
af.duties: Bestuur die eksamenadministrasiestelsel insluitend sertifiserings- en logistieke dienste. Bestuur die lewer van IT- en databestuursteunstelsels en eksamenadministratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Bestuur en koördineer die ontwikkeling en redigering van vraestelle. Bestuur die produksie van vraestelle en bestuur die toesig oor merkprosesse van inhouds- taal- en tegniese vakke. Bestuur die lewer van eksamenbeleidsnakoming en distrikskoördineringsdienste. Identifiseer en loste eksemonreëlmatighede op. Bestuur GET- en FET-eksamens as skoolgebaseerde assessering. Bestuur die lewer van algemene administrasie- asook risiko- en sekuriteitsdienste. Bou proaktief goeie verhoudings met sleutelbelanghebbendes en kliënte, insluitend georganiseerde arbeid. Bevorder 'n kultuur van doeltreffendheid en gehalte. Die aangestelde sal 'n lid van die bestuursechelon van die Department of Education wees en sal verwag word om op daardie vlak by te dra.

zu.title: Umongameli: Ukuhlolwa Kwezithombe Komphakathi
zu.summary: Umongameli Wokuhlola Izithombe Komphakathi eMpumalanga Education Head Office, onobhekezide ekuphathweni kokuqashwa kokuhololwa, kumanethiwekhi e-IT, nakukuthuthukisweni kwamaphepha ezombuzo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelors Degree ezibonakaliso eze-SAQA noma i-Advanced Diploma noma isiqui esilinganiselayo (NQF level 7) kubalulekile kulesi simo futhi ubuncane unyaka owu-5 ngokuhlolwa emazingeni aphakathi/amaphezulu okuphatha. Ilayisensi yokuqamba evumelekile. Abathunywa abafakwe ohlwini bazosubzexwa kumsebenzi wokuhlola wendawo. Qaphela kanti: Nga 1 April 2020 ngibo ekwenzelayo kubalulekile kubathunywa ukuba bagqititise ukuba bethole ukuba bangathathwa esikhundleni SMS kuphela ngenkathi lowo msebenzi egqititile i-Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme futhi yokuthi akwazi ukukhiqiza isitifikedi esifunekayo sokungena ngaphambili njengoba kufakwa i-National School of Governance (NSG) ngemali yakhe. Ngemininingwane engakumbi ngale kosi yokuxhumana thazinikulo, abantu abathakaseli baxwayiswayo ukuba bathinte i-nyukela@thensg.gov.za. Onke amathuba afakwe ohlwini, okuhlanganisa i-SMS, bazodlula kuzihlolo ezimbili zokungena ngaphambili. Enye kuzoba kusenzakalo wokwenzwa ukuze kutholwe ukulungeka komthunywa kusetshenziswa imfuneko yendawo yesikhundla kanye nalawo ajwayelekile. Enye kumele ibe kuhlolo lokwethembeka (ukuziphatha okuhle). Onke amathuba afakwe ohlwini kumasekhundla i-SMS bazohexwa ohlathini oluphathwayo kanye nendabamqondo. Emva kwesibalo esehlathini kanye nendabamqondo, ibasuka kunabantu abatathu (3) abasebenza ngohlelo i-SMS bazodlula ohlathini lokuhlola ukubona ukuthi bangakwazi ukubona ukuphathwa kwamandlo, amathuba okuhlolwa kwabasebenzi, nokuqonda imizwa yokwesaba, kanye nokwethembeka.
zu.duties: Phatha indlela yokuphatha amabhalo okuhololwa okuhlanganisa nezinsiza zokuqinisekisa nokulondoloza izinto ezijwayelekile. Phatha inkinga yokunika amandla anethiwekhi e-IT kanye nokuphatha izinto ezibhalwayo nezinsiza zokusebenzela ohlathini lokuqashwa kokuhololwa. Phatha futhi uhlole ukuthuthukiswa nokulungiswa kwamaphepha ezombuzo. Phatha ukukhiqizwa kwamaphepha ezombuzo futhi phatha ukugadwa kwendlela yokubhala iziphakamendo malungana nokubhalwa kolwimi kanye nezinto ezenziwa ngobuchwepheshe. Phatha inkinga yokuhlolwa kobunengi bezincwadi kanye nezinsiza zohlelo lwezifunda. Gqoka futhi xazulula izinkinga ezingalungile kokuhololwa. Phatha ukuhololwa kwe-GET kanye ne-FET njengoba kuhlolwa izikole ngaphakathi. Phatha inkinga yokuphathwa kwesigunga kanye nezinsiza zengozi nokulondoloza. Mhlawumbi bumselene kahle nomphakathi kanye nothetha kubantu abafana namalunga asebenza ngokwezinkambiso. Qondise ngokuthuthukiswa kwesiko elihle lokuphumelela nokuthakazelwayo. Lowo othunywe kuzoba ngumunye walabo ophakathi kwenhlangano yabaphathi e-Mpumalanga Department of Education futhi uzohlezi ithembe ukuba anezelelo kuleso sibalo.

xh.title: Umongameli: Uviwo Lwasimahla
xh.summary: Umongameli weVivo Lwasimahla eNtloko yezeMfundo yaseMpumalanga, oqoophe kokuqwalasela kolawulo lwevimo, iinkqubo zeTeKnoloji yolwazi, nokuqumba amaphepha emibuzo.
xh.requirements: Idegree yeBachelors eqaqelelweyo ekuqatshelwa yiSAQA okanye iDiploma ePhakamileyo okanye isidanga esilinganayo (NQF level 7) ehambelana nolwandle oluthile olucwangcisiweyo ngenxa yeminyaka emi-5 yamava kwinqanaba eliphakathi/eliphezulu lolawulo. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Aba mgangeliweyo kwi lukhetho baya kwenziwa uvavanyo oluxelwe kummandla wabo. Nceda qaphela: Ukususela ngomhla wama-1 kweKhotsho 2020, umntu unako kuphela ukufaneleka ukuba evezwe esithubeni seSMS ngaxa lo mntu egqibile ngempumelelo iNkqubo yeNkululeko eNqanaba eliphezulu loLawulo kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente nokuba unako ukuzala isatifikethi esifunekayo sokuNgena ngaphambili njengoko sikhutshwa yiSkolo leZobuNkululeko loLawulo (NSG) ngeemali zakhe. Ukufumana iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe ngokwale nkqubo yekhompyutha, abasebenzi abanomdla bayalulekwa ukuba bathintane ne nyukela@thensg.gov.za. Bonke abakhethiweyo, kuquka naba kwiSMS, baya kwenza iinconnectlulo ezimbini zokuNgena ngaphambili. Enye iya kuba luvavanyo olwenziwayo lokuqonda ukufaneleka komkhethiwe nxaxheela iimfuno ezibalulekileyo nezibonakalayo lesithuba, elinye kumele libe luvavanyo lolungelelwaniso (uziphatha ngokweeningqi). Bonke abakhethiweyo kumagatya asiS seSMS baya kwenziwa uvavanyo oluxelwe kummandla wabo nceda intitivhedi. Emva koluvavanyo loluxelwe kummandla wabo nceda intitivhedi, abakhethiweyo abaninzi abanga Tatu (3) abakwiSMS baya kwenzelwa iinconnectlulo ezingazamiqondiso ibalulekileyo yokuziphatha, okuqonda iinkqubo zengqondo, iintlobokazi ngokuziphatha, ubuqondo beentlanga, nolungelelwaniso.
xh.duties: Lawula inkqubo yolawulo lwevimo kuquka iinkonzo zesatifikethi nezohlengelelo. Lawula ukubonelela iinkxaso ze-IT nezinkqabo zolawulo lwexesha ngeenkxaso ezihambelana nolawulo lwevimo. Lawula kwaye ungenise uqamba nokuhlelwa kwamaphepha emibuzo. Lawula ukucutshungwa kwamaphepha emibuzo kwaye ulawule uqwalaselo lwezenzo zokumaka okwamaxaqa onobumba nezifundo ezingalawulwa ngeenkcukacha. Lawula ukubonelela iinkonzo zokuhambelana nenkqabo yemigaqo yeevimo negunya loqwalaselo lweedistrikhi. Qamba kwaye usombuluse iingxaki ezingalunganga ezenzekayo nakulawulo lwevimo. Lawula iinkonzo zolawulo kwiiNqanaba zeGet neFET njengokuhlolwa okwenziwa kwizikolo. Lawula ukubonelela iinkonzo zolawulo jikelele kunye nezeNgqikitho nezeKhuseleko. Dala kwaye uzame ukwakha iingxoxo ezinobuNyaniseko nabalingane abasebenzayo nabadlali beendaba, kuqala ngamakhosi abakhethweyo. Phucula iNkqubo yoxinekelo nakwizinto ezininzi ezigqibeleleyo. Ukwangummiswa ukuya kuba ngumntu osekelwe kummandla woLawulo weNyango yeMfundo kwaye ukhokelele kuloo nqanaba ngenxa yamagatya akhe.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Services (INFRASTRUCTURE–DORA)
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs.
jobs.summary: Lead and coordinate financial management and supply chain functions for infrastructure programmes at the Mpumalanga Department of Education head office.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate degree (NQF 7) in Commerce or Accounting or Economics and five (5) years’ relevant post-qualification (after completing qualification) experience. Computer literate. Understanding financial management as implemented in the Government and within the context of infrastructure budgeting and spending. Valid driver’s license. Computer literacy. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.
jobs.duties: Give direction to and coordinate all Financial Management functions for the Chief Directorate including all financial issues and supply chain management issues pertaining to infrastructure projects/programmes. Extract, analyse and validate financial information for infrastructure projects/programmes. Provide financial administration services for all infrastructure Programmes and Projects. Prepare financial reports. Provide budget administration services. Update and maintain a document management system for all financial documentation.
jobs.applications: The Mpumalanga Department of Education awaits applications from suitably qualified and experienced persons for appointment to positions, as set out below: Should be uploaded via the following link https://erecruitment.mpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: Appointment will be subject to competency assessment. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job. Following the interview and technical exercise the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency based assessments). af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Finansiële Dienste (INFRASTRUCTURE–DORA)
af.summary: Lei en koördineer finansiële bestuur en toeleweringskettingfunksies vir infrastruktuurprogramme by die Mpumalanga Department of Education-hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: Toepaslike graad (NQF 7) in Handel of Rekeningkunde of Ekonomie en vyf (5) jaar se tersaaklike ervaring na kwalifikasieverkryging (na voltooiing van kwalifikasie). Rekenaargeletterd. Begrip van finansiële bestuur soos dit in die Regering en binne die konteks van infrastruktuurbegroting en -besteding toegepas word. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Alle gekorte lysde kandidate, insluitend die SMS, onderneem twee voor-toetredingsassesserings. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes te bepaal, en die ander moet 'n integriteitsassessering (etiese gedrag) wees.
af.duties: Rigting gee aan en koördineer alle Finansiële Bestuursfunksies vir die Hoofdirektoraat, insluitend alle finansiële kwessies en toeleweringskettingbestuurskwessies met betrekking tot infrastruktuurprojekte/programme. Ekstraheer, ontleed en valideer finansiële inligting vir infrastruktuurprojekte/programme. Verskaf finansiële administratiewe dienste vir alle infrastruktuurprogramme en -projekte. Berei finansiële verslae voor. Verskaf begrotingsadministratiewe dienste. Werk 'n dokumentbestuurstelsel vir alle finansiële dokumentasie by en onderhou dit.

zu.title: Umongameli Ohambisayo: Izinsiza Zezimali (INFRASTRUCTURE–DORA)
zu.summary: Holisa futhi uhlele imisebenzi yokuqashwa kwemali nezinsiza zokusabalalisa kwezinhlelo zokwakha esikhungweni esikhulu se-Mpumalanga Department of Education.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele (NQF 7) ku-Commerce noma i-Accounting noma i-Economics kanye namafomu amahlanu (5) okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nokuthi ngemuva kokuthola iziqu. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezimali njengoba kusetshenziswa kuhulumeni nangaphakathi kokuqashwa nokusebenzisa imali yamaprojekthi zokwakha. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Bonke abagqwayi abakhethiwe, kuhlanganise ne-SMS, bazodinga ukwenza ukuhlola okubili ngaphambi kokungena esikhundleni. Okukodwa kuzoba ukuzivocavoca okwenziwa ngokomzimba ukuze kutholwe ukufaneleka komuntu oqokwayo ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zezobuchwepheshe nezijwayelekile zesikhundla, okunye kumele kube ukuhlola ukuziphatha (ukuziphatha ngokomthetho).
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso futhi uhlele yonke imisebenzi yoQoqo Lwezimali kuwo wonke amaqoqo aphathiwe kuhlanganise nazo yonke izinkinga zezimali nezinkinga zokuphathwa kwesikhonzo sokuqashwa ezihlobene namaprojekthi/izinhlela zokwakha. Khhipha, hlaziya futhi uqinisekise ulwazi lwezimali lwamaprojekthi/izinhlela zokwakha. Nikeza izinsiza zokulawula izimali zonke izinhlela namaprojekthi zokwakha. Lungela imibiko yezimali. Nikeza izinsiza zokulawula isabelo semali. Buyekeza futhi ulondoloze indlela yokuphatha amafayela yonke imibhalo yezimali.

xh.title: Isekela-Mongameli: Iinkonzo Zezimali (INFRASTRUCTURE–DORA)
xh.summary: Qhuba kwaye ulungiselele ukulawula izinto ezimali nemisebenzi yohombo lothunyelwa lwezinto kumacandelo eempahla ezakhiwo ehhovu elikhulu leMpumalanga Department of Education.
xh.requirements: Idegree efanelekileyo (NQF 7) kwishishini lokuthengisa okanye ukuTshata okanye iEconomics kunye neminye mihlanu (5) yamava ahambelanayo emva kokuqesha isidanga (emva kokuphothula isidanga). Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda ukulawula izinto ezimali njengokuba kwenziwa kuRhulumente nangaphakathi kwendlela yokwenza ibhajethi nokusebenzisa imali kumacandelo eempahla ezakhiwo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela eseleyo. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Bonke abagqithiswa abakhethiweyo, kuquka nama-SMS, kuya kwenza ukuqonda okubini ngaphambi kokuqeswa. Okunye kuya kuba luluvuyo lokuzilolonga lokumisela ukulungelelani komqeshwa ngokususekelwe kwiimfuno zobuchwepheshe nezijoliswe kule sithuba, elinye kumele libe lukulingo lokuziphatha (endlela yokuziphatha ngokuyiyeyonke).
xh.duties: Nika inkqubo yolwanga kwaye ulungiselele onke imisebenzi yoLawulo lwezinto ezimali kwisiKhaladi esiyiNtloko kuquka zonke izinto ezimali nemiiba yohombo lothunyelwa lwezinto ehambelanayo namaphulo/amacandelo eempahla ezakhiwo. Khupha, hlalutya uze ucace ulwazi ezimali lwamaphulo/amacandelo eempahla ezakhiwo. Yeza iinkonzo zolawulo lwezinto ezimali kuwo onke amaphulo namaphulo eempahla ezakhiwo. Lungiselela iingxelo ezimali. Yeza iinkonzo zolawulo lwebhajethi. Hlaziya uze ulondoloze inkqubo yolawulo lwamaxwebhu kuwo onke amaxwebhu ezimali.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: S/dir: ECD Centres - Conditional Grant
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for ECD Centres managing conditional grants, registration, infrastructure support and quality assurance at the Mpumalanga Education Head Office.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification (NQF 7) as recognised by SAQA in the relevant field or equivalent qualification. Minimum of 5 years’ relevant experience in an ECD environment. Valid driver's license. Knowledge of the key challenges in the ECD sector and how these can be mediated to improve the quality of learning outcomes in schools and to contribute to success in later life. Knowledge of the key business processes in the ECD sector, including registration, subsidy management and reporting processes to accurately diagnose execution strengths and weaknesses, identify key issues, and develop implementation plans. Knowledge of and ability to work with critical stakeholders within the ECD sector to strengthen the implementation of Early Childhood Development programmes. Experience in all processes required in project management to deliver projects according to plans, time and budget. Ability to translate strategy into operational reality, including breaking down strategies or programme initiatives into key tasks and identifying accountabilities. Ability to align communication, people, culture, processes, resources and systems to ensure effective implementation and delivery of required results. Ability to write clearly and understandably. Good and functional knowledge of Government prescripts, knowledge of monitoring, evaluation and reporting systems and processes. Good interpersonal relations and the ability to handle pressure. Condition: Appointment will be subject to competency assessment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.
jobs.duties: Gather national business process reform plans and interpret them in line with provincial requirements. Facilitates the adaptation of the national plans to develop integrated provincial implementation plans on ECD registration, infrastructure support, subsidy management and quality assurance and support. Coordinates the development, execution and monitoring of provincial Silver/Gold registration and subsidy implementation plans across all districts. Enables and support execution of the Provincial Programme Management Unit (PPMU) governance structures and processes to ensure effective and efficient execution of integrated provincial registration, infrastructure support and subsidy plans. Plans, coordinates and facilitates all training related to new ECD business processes at the provincial and district level. Coordinates all planned engagements of key departments and sector stakeholders critical towards the delivery of new ECD business processes. Coordinates ECD programme support requirements from district officials and supporting functional departments. Coordinates execution of stakeholder identification, engagements and communication through new and/or standard provincial communication channels with departmental internal communication team and existing district communication or engagement platforms (example- ECD forums, community forums etc.). Monitors provincial plans and tracks implementation of plans for all related districts. Consolidates provincial reports by facilitating inputs from district supervisors and functional leads. Monitors dashboards and ensures weekly results/updates are published and shared with districts.
