af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: S/dir: ECD-sentrums - Voorwaardelike Toekenning
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir ECD-sentrums wat voorwaardelike toekennings, registrasie, infrastruktuurondersteuning en gehalteversekering by die Mpumalanga Education-hoofkantoor bestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF 7) soos deur SAQA erken in die relevante veld of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Minimum van 5 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n ECD-omgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van die kernuitdagings in die ECD-sektor en hoe hierdie bemiddel kan word om die gehalte van leeruitkomste in skole te verbeter en om tot sukses in die latere lewe by te dra. Kennis van die kernbesigheidsprosesse in die ECD-sektor, insluitend registrasie, subsidiebestuur en verslagdoeningsprosesse om uitvoeringssterktes en -swakpunte akkuraat te diagnoseer, kernkwessies te identifiseer en implementeringsplanne te ontwikkel. Kennis van en vermoë om met kritieke belanghebbendes binne die ECD-sektor te werk om die implementering van vroeë kinderontwikkelingsprogramme te versterk. Ervaring in al die prosesse wat vir projbestuur vereis word om projekte volgens planne, tyd en begroting te lewer. Vermoë om strategie in operasionele realiteit te vertaal, insluitend die ontleding van strategieë of programinisiatiewe in kerntake en die identifisering van aanspreeklikhede. Vermoë om kommunikasie, mense, kultuur, prosesse, hulpbronne en stelsels in lyn te bring om doeltreffende implementering en lewering van vereiste resultate te verseker. Vermoë om duidelik en verstaanbaar te skryf. Goedie en funksionele kennis van Regeringsvoorskrifte, kennis van monitering, evaluering en verslagdoeningsstelsels en -prosesse. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en die vermoë om druk te hanteer. Voorwaarde: Aanstelling sal onderhewig wees aan 'n bevoegdheidsbeoordeling. Alle gekose kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toelatingsbeoordelings onderneem. Die een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteit (etiese gedrag) beoordeling wees.
af.duties: Versamel nasionale besigheidsproseshervormingsplanne en interpreteer dit in ooreenstemming met provinsiale vereistes. Fasiliteer die aanpassing van die nasionale planne om geïntegreerde provinsiale implementeringsplanne oor ECD-registrasie, infrastruktuurondersteuning, subsidiebestuur en gehalteversekering en -ondersteuning te ontwikkel. Koördineer die ontwikkeling, uitvoering en monitering van provinsiale Silver/Gold-registrasie- en subsidie-implementeringsplanne oor alle distrikte. Stel uitvoering van die provinsiale programbestuureenheid (PPMU) se bestuursstrukture en -prosesse in staat en ondersteun dit om doeltreffende en doeltrekkende uitvoering van geïntegreerde provinsiale registrasie-, infrastruktuurondersteunings- en subsidieplanne te verseker. Beplan, koördineer en fasiliteer alle opleiding wat verband hou met nuwe ECD-besigheidsprosesse op provinsiale en distrikvlak. Koördineer alle beplande betrokkenhede van sleuteldepartemente en sektorbelanghebbendes wat kritiek is vir die lewering van nuwe ECD-besigheidsprosesse. Koördineer ECD-programondersteuningsvereistes van distrikbeamptes en ondersteunende funksionele departemente. Koördineer uitvoering van die identifisering van belanghebbendes, betrokkenhede en kommunikasie deur nuwe en/of standaard provinsiale kommunikasiekanale met die departement se interne kommunikasiespan en bestaande distrikkommunikasie- of betrokkenheidsplatforms (byvoorbeeld ECD-forums, gemeenskapsforums, ens.). Monitor provinsiale planne en volg implementering van planne vir alle verwante distrikte op. Konsolideer provinsiale verslae deur insette van distrikttoesighouers en funksionele leiers te fasiliteer. Monitor kontroleskerms en verseker dat weeklikse resultate/opdaterings gepubliseer en met distrikte gedeel word.

zu.title: Usomlilo: I/Sikh: Amakhiba e-ECD - I-Conditional Grant
zu.summary: Usomlilo wamakhiba e-ECD uphatha ama-conditional grants, ukubhalisa, ukwesekwa kwezokwakhiwa nokuqinisekwa ikhwalithi e-Mpumalanga Education Head Office.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kweziqu ezingaphakathi (NQF 7) njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA enkhaleni ehambisana nayo noma iziqu ezilinganayo. Okungenani unyaka wama-5 wobuhamba obuhambisana emondweni lwe-ECD. Ilayisense yokushayela ethembekile. ulwazi ngomezintaba ebalulekile emkhakheni we-ECD nokuthi zingakuxazwa kanjani ukuze kuthuthukiswe ikhwalithi yemiphumela yokufunda emikoleni nokuze kufake isandla ekuphumeleleni impilo edlule. ulwazi ngemigangatho yomsebenzi ebalulekile emkhakheni we-ECD, okuhlanganisa ukubhalisa, ukuphathwa kwe-subsidy nemigangatho yokuqinisa ukuze kuhlolelwe ngokucophelela amandla nobudoba bokusebenza, kuhlole imiba ebalulekile, futhi kwakhiwe amaphulani okusetshenziswa. ulwazi kanye nobizo bokusebenza nabashallwe ababalulekile emkhakheni we-ECD ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetshenziswa kwe-Early Childhood Development programmes. uluhlelo kwemigangatho yonke efunekayo ekuphathweni amaphulo ukuze kuhlolakale amaphulo ngokwezokucinga, isikhathi nomsoco. Ikhono lokuguqula icala ibe ukubamba komqondo ngempela, okuhlanganisa ukwahlukanisa imicabango noma izibopho zephulo ibe umsebenzi olingenele ukuba uwona futhi kuhlonzwe abanobuhlalo. Ikhono lokuhambisa ukuqondana, abantu, isiko, imigangatho, amandla nezinhlelo ukuze kubhanjwe ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo nokulethwa kwemiphumela efunwa. Ikhono lokubhala ngokucacile neqhwayo. ulwazi oluhle kanye nokubanjwa kolwazi lwemithetho kaHulumeni, ukwaziswa kokubuka, ukubhala nokuqinisa izinhlelo kanye nemigangatho. ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu kanye nolwazi lokubekezelela umfutho. Isimo: ukubekwa kuzohlolisiswa ngokulinga ukubanjwa komsebenzi. Bonke ababizwa, okuhlanganisa ne-SMS, bazothatha amahlo ambili okubuka ngaphambi kokubekwa. Okunye kuzoba umzamshulo wokwenza ngokwenzime ukuze kubukeke ababizwa ngokobunengwe bawo nangokwezidingo ezingamukele ezenza kanye nobunengwe, okunye kumele kube ukubuka ukubanjwa (ngokuziphatha ngokomibhalo).
zu.duties: Butha amaphula kwenkathi yezweni lomsebenzi wokwakhiwa kwezimiso uphinde uwahumushe ngokuhambisana nezidingo zendawo yenkathi. Kuxhase ukuhlanganiswa kwamaphula kwenkathi ukuze akhiwe amaphula esebenzayo wemikhakha yenkathi yokubhalisa, ukwesekwa kwezokwakhiwa, ukuphathwa kwe-subsidy nokubhala nokuqinisa nokwesekwa. Axhase ukwakhiwa, ukusebenza nokubuka imiphumela yesikhathi senkathi yamaphula e-Silver/Gold ukubhalisa kanye nokuqiniswa kokusetshenziswa kokuweswa emkhakheni yonke. Kuxhase ukusebenza nokuqinisa amakhibhobhohli ukuphatha okuhamba (PPMU) nezakhiwo kanye nemigangatho ukubanjwa nokusebenza kwezinkathi ezenza kuhle emkhakheni yokubhalisa, ukwesekwa kwezokwakhiwa kanye namaphula e-subsidy. Asungula, axhase futhi asize ukuba kusungulwe umzamshulo wonke kwezinhlelo e-ECD ezintsha zemigangatho yemisebenzi ezintweni zendawo yenkathi nasedolofini. Axhase zonke izikhathi ezingamenywa kumabhunga wezintaba ebalulekile kanye nasemandla amnyama kubamba isandla ekuletheni imigangatho yomsebenzi e-ECD entsha. Axhase ukulethwa kwemigangatho e-ECD ngokwezidingo zokwesekwa kumaphoyisa abeyasedolofini nokuweswa amabhunga okusebenza. Axhase ukusungulwa kwabahlonga, ukubamana kanye nokuthintana ngokudlulisa izindaba, iinkonzo ezintsha noma ezisemthethweni zendawo yezindaba ngabakhi bezindaba abangaphakathi abakwamabhunga namakhibhobhohli amabhedi abakho ashiwo abakwamakhobhho (isibonelo - amabhodi e-ECD, amabhodi ogogo njll.). Asasiza ukubuka imiphumela yendawo inkathi kanye nokulandwa amaphula kumaphoyisa ohambayo. Axhase imibhalo yendawo inkathi ngokusiza ukungena abayisisebenzi kubabhaliswe asikhundleni imibhalo yendawo yonke.

xh.title: Isecuba leSekela: iS/ikhokela: Iiziko ze-ECD - I-Conditional Grant
xh.summary: Isecuba leSekela leziko ze-ECD eliphatha iimaranti ezibekekayo, ukuqatshelwa, inkxaso yesakhiwo nokuqinisekisa ngangoko kusemsebenzini kwiMpumalanga Education Head Office.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi kwesidanga (NQF 7) esivunywe yi-SAQA kwelundini elichanekileyo okanye isifundo esilinganayo. Okungenani unyaka o-5 wobuchule obuhlobene kwimeko ye-ECD. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi ngwezinxaxheba eziphambili kwicala le-ECD nendlela ezingalungiswa ngayo ukuze kuphuculwe izinga lemveliso ngemfundo kwiikholeji nakumaziko ngenkxaso ekuphumeleleni kwexesha elizayo. Ulwazi ngamachethe amabalwe emisebenzi kwicala le-ECD, kuquka ukuqatshelwa, ulawulo lwemali yenzazo nendlela yokubika ukuze kuqondwe kakuhle amandla nobunzima bokuphumeza, kuxhaswe izinto ezibalulekileyo, kwaye kwakhiwe iinkqubo zokuphumeza. Ulwazi nobuchule bokusebenza nabadibani nababalulekileyo kwicala le-ECD ukuze kuqiniswe ukuphumeza kweenkqubo zoPhuhliso lweMfundo yasekuqaleni kwabaSela. Ulwazi kuwo onke amachethe afunekayo kulawulo lwaprojekthi ukuze ziphumezeke iiprojekthi ngokweenkqubo, ixesha nembewu. Amandla okuguqula inkqubo ibe yinyani yokusebenza, kuquka ukwahlahlaba iinkqubo okanye iinkqubo ezintsha zibe ngomsebenzi ophambili nokubona obuxanduva. Amandla okuhambisanisa ukunxibelelana, abantu, inkculto, amachethe, iimbonelela nendlela zokuqinisekisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphumeza kakuhle nokuphumeza iziphumo eziyimfuno. Amandla okubhala ngokucacileyo nangokuqonda kakuhle. Ulwazi olulungileyo nolusebenzayo ngeemiyalelo kaRhulumente, ulwazi ngendlela zokwengamele, nokuqokelela inkcazelo yokusebenza. Ubudlelwane obuhle nabantu nokuwohloka ngokuchanekileyo. Iimeko: Ukwenziswa kuya kuxhomekeka kuqinisekiso lokulinganisa ngamandla. Bonke abagqatswa abakhethiweyo, kuquka ne-SMS, kuya kwenza iimvavanyo ezimbini phambi kokungena. Into enye iya kuba ngumzamo oqinisekisa ukuzenza komgqatswa ngokusekwe kwimfuno ekwicala nasekubanzi kule sivakalisho kwaye enye kufuneka ibe ngumzamo wokuqinisekisa ukuzipatha (ukuziphatha okusesikweni).
xh.duties: Qokelela iinkqubo zolungiselelo lwezoshishino zekhaya nize nichaze ngokwemfuno yephondo. Inceda ekulungiseleleni iinkqubo zakwikhaya ukuba kuhlanganiswe iinkqubo zokusebenza zephondo ngokuqatshelwa kwe-ECD, inkxaso yesakhiwo, ulawulo lwenzayo nokuqinisekisa kusemsebenzini nokuxhasa. Ihlela, iphumeze ilawule kwaye ihlohle inkqubo yokuba yikhaya okanye igolide ekubalulekeni kwaye izakha iinkqubo zenzayo kuzo onke amaphondo. Ikhuthaza kwaye ixhasa ukuphumeza kweqela elawulayo ukubakho kwesebe lePhondo nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kokuzeleleko kunye nokuqhutywa kokuzeleleko ngokuphumeza iinkqubo zokubhalisa, inkxaso yesakhiwo nenzayo. Ihlela, ilawula kwaye ihlohla zonke iindlela zokuziphilisa ezithatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yamashishini e-ECD kwiphondo nakwilize. Ilawula zonke iindlela ezicwangiweyo ezinxulumene namaphondo nabo baphethe iinkqubo kwindawo yamashishini e-ECD. Ihlela imfuno yenkxaso yeenkqubo e-ECD evela kubaphathi kwindawo yephondo kwakunye namaphondo axhasa iinkqubo. Ilawula ukuphumeza ukuziqhelanisa, ukubamba uthothotho nokuqinisekisa ngokugqithisa kwindawo entsha okanye ekuqhelekileyo yophononongo lwexesha elithile. Ilawula inkqubo iphondo nokuqinisekisa ukulandelwa kweekhadi ngokumiselwa kwexesha ngokwemfuneko yonke iiphondo. Iqokelela iindaba ezichazwe ngephondo ngokuqinisekisa ulwazi oluthathwa kubakhuseli nasekubeni ngamaphondo aqinisekiswayo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: S/dir: ECD Centres - Conditional Grant
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (an all-inclusive remuneration package). The package can be structured according to the individual’s personal needs.
jobs.summary: Deputy Director for ECD Centres Conditional Grant at the Mpumalanga Department of Education Head Office, overseeing provincial eCares system performance and user support.
jobs.requirements: A SAQA recognised three-year post-matric qualification (NQF Level 7) in Information Systems / ICT / Computer Science / Data or related field. 7 years’ relevant experience in Systems Administration and user support. Valid driver's license. Knowledge of Cloud-based system operations. Knowledge of the provincial EMIS environment and/ or ECD system landscape. Knowledge of database management. Knowledge of business intelligence reporting. Skills should include User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and training facilitation as well as data reporting and system usage monitoring. Strong analytical, data manipulation and reporting skills (Excel advanced level). Ability to coordinate multi-level stakeholders (national, provincial, district). Problem-solving ability, attention to detail, customer service orientation. Ability to work independently and travel extensively. Condition: Appointment will be subject to competency assessment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.
jobs.duties: Provincial eCares system use and performance management. Leading provincial support for system usage, performance and adoption. Monitoring user compliance with system functionality and data workflows. Advocating system utilisation for decision-making. User support and access management. Managing first line helpdesk support for PED users. Managing user access, roles and permissions. Escalating issues promptly to national and service providers. User training and capacity building, which entails conducting ongoing training on: New releases; Functional improvements; Reporting and dashboards. Supporting districts and circuits to drive usage. Leading provincial testing of system releases and updates. Developing test plans, recording User Acceptance Testing (UAT) outcomes, and submit feedback to developers. Validating system enhancements before deployment. Identifying and resolving technical issues affecting provincial users. Maintaining alignment between eCares and EMIS Masterlists. Validating EMIS number allocation in eCares. Supporting provincial reporting needs and accuracy.
jobs.applications: The Mpumalanga Department of Education awaits applications from suitably qualified and experienced persons for appointment to positions, as set out below: Should be uploaded via the following link https://erecruitment.mpg.gov.za
jobs.notes: Appointment will be subject to competency assessment. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a technical exercise that intends to test relevant technical elements of the job. Following the interview and technical exercise the selection panel will recommend candidates to attend a generic managerial competency assessment (in compliance with the DPSA Directive on the implementation of competency based assessments). The competency assessment will be testing generic managerial competencies using the mandated DPSA SMS competency assessment tools. Applications should be submitted on the latest Form Z.83, obtainable from any Public Service Department. Applications must in all cases be accompanied by a recently updated comprehensive CV only. Only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications, identity document and driver’s license on or before the day of the interview following communication from the relevant HR section of the Department. The filling of posts will be done in terms of the Department’s approved Employment Equity Plan. Due to ongoing internal processes, the Department reserves the right to withdraw any post at any time. The Department reserves the right to verify the qualifications of every recommended candidate prior to the issuing of an offer of appointment. All short-listed candidates will be subject to a vetting process prior to appointment. If no response is received from Mpumalanga Department of Education within 90 days after the closing date of the advertisement, applicants must assume that their application was not successful. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Enquiries should be directed to 013 766 5524/5175/5267/5458/5350: Ms. NP Magagula / Ms. SL Mkhatshwa / Ms. SR Ndzinisa / Mr. X Sifunda, YT Mthethwa - HR Recruitment. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: S/dir: ECD-sentrums - Voorwaardelike toelaag
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur vir ECD-sentrums Voorwaardelike toelaag by die Mpumalanga Department of Education Hoofkantoor, wat toesig hou oor stelselprestasie en gebruikerondersteuning van die provinsiale eCares-stelsel.
af.requirements: A SAQA-erkende driejaar na-matriek-kwalifikasie (NQF Level 7) in Inligtingstelsels / IKR / Rekenaarwetenskap / Data of 'n verwante veld. 7 jaar se relevante ervaring in stelseladministrasie en gebruikerondersteuning. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van wolkgebaseerde stelselbedrywighede. Kennis van die provinsiale EMIS-omgewing en/of ECD-stelsellandskap. Kennis van databasisbestuur. Kennis van besigheidsintelligensie-verslagdoening. Vaardighede moet Gebruikerwaarderingstoetsing (UAT) en opleidingsfasilitering sowel as data-verslagdoening en monitering van stelselgebruik insluit. Sterke analitiese, datamanipulasie- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede (Excel advanced level). Vermoë om multivlak-belanghebbendes (nasionaal, provinsiaal, distrik) te koördineer. Probleemoplossingsvermoë, aandag tot detail, kliëntediens-oriëntasie. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk en uitgebreid te reis. Voorwaarde: Aanstelling sal onderhewig wees aan 'n bevoegdheidsbeoordeling. Alle gekorte lys kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toetredingsbeoordelings onderneem. Die een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteit (etiese gedrag) beoordeling wees.
af.duties: Provinciale eCares-stelselgebruik en prestasiebestuur. Lei provinsiale ondersteuning vir stelselgebruik, prestasie en aanvaarding. Moniteer gebruiker se voldoening aan stelselfunksionaliteit en datawerkvloeie. Bepleit stelselbenutting vir besluitneming. Gebruikerondersteuning en toegangsbestuur. Bestuur eerstelyn-helpdeskondersteuning vir PED-gebruikers. Bestuur gebruikerstoegang, rolle en toestemmings. Eskaleer probleme onmiddellik na nasionaal en diensverskaffers. Gebruikeropleiding en kapasiteitsbou, wat deurlopende opleiding behels oor: Nuwe vrystellings; Funksionele verbeterings; Verslagdoening en dashboards. Ondersteun distrikte en kringe om gebruik te dryf. Lei provinsiale toetsing van stelselvrystellings en opdaterings. Ontwikkel toetsplanne, teken User Acceptance Testing (UAT) resultate op, en dien terugvoer aan ontwikkelaars in. Bekragtig stelselverbeterings voor ontplooiing. Identifiseer en los tegniese probleme op wat provinsiale gebruikers raak. Handhaaf belyning tussen eCares en EMIS Masterlists. Bekragtig EMIS-nommertoekenning in eCares. Ondersteun provinsiale verslagdoeningsbehoeftes en akkuraatheid.

zu.title: Iseluleko Sezomphakathi: Umqondisi Wosizo: Amakhulu/ECD - Isibonelelo Esinesimo
zu.summary: Umqondisi Wosizo weSibonelelo Esinesimo se-ECD mayikhaya Ehhovisi Elikhulu LeMinyango Yemfundo YaseMpumalanga, eqondisa ukusebenza kwesistimu yeprovinsi ye-eCares kanye nenkonzo yomsebenzisi.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-post-matric zonyaka owathathu ezivunyiwe yi-SAQA (NQF Level 7) kwe-Information Systems / ICT / Computer Science / Data noma indawo ephathelene nakho. Unyaka wokuqeqeshwa okuyisikhombisa ohambelanayo kuSystems Administration kanye ngenkxaso yomsebenzisi. Ilayisense yokushayela esivumelekile. Ukwazi ngokusebenza kwezinhlelo ze-Cloud-based. Ukwazi ngendawo ye-provincial EMIS kanye/noma izimongo zesistimu ye-ECD. Ukwazi ngokuphathwa kwe-database. Ukwazi ngokubika kwezobuhlakani beshbhizinisi. Amakhono kufanele abe nokuhlolwa kwegama lomsebenzisi (UAT) nokukhuthazwa kokuleqwa, kanye nokubika kwemininingwane kanye nokuhlola ukusetshenziswa kwesistimu. Amakhono anamandla okuhlaziya, okuhlenga imininingwane nokubika (Excel advanced level). Ikono lokuhlanganisa abahlanganyeli bezinga eliningi (national, provincial, district). Ikono lokuxazulula izinkinga, ukunakela imininingwane, kanye nokumiswa kokusebenza kwamakhasimende. Ikono lokusebenza kodwa nokuhamba kakhulu. Isimo: Ukumiswa kuzobekwe ngaphansi kokuqashwa kokulinganisa ikhono. Bonke abagqoki abafakiwe ohlwini, kuhlanganise ne-SMS, bazokwenza ukulinganiswa kabili ngaphambi kokungena. Okunye kuzoba kunzuzo yokuzivivinyo ukunquma ukufaneleka komuntu ngokususelwa kwezidingo eziqukethe inothethi nangaphakathi kwesikhundla, okunye kumele kubuzingcfwecwe imibuzo ngokuziphatha (ethical conduct).
zu.duties: Ukusetshenziswa kwesistimu ye-provincial eCares kanye nokuphathwa kokusebenza. Ukukhokela inkundla yokusebenzisa isistimu, ukusebenza nokwamukelwa kwayo. Ukulandelela ukulandelwa kwemithetho yomsebenzisi ngokusebenza kwesistimu kanye nezindlela zemibhalo yemininingwane. Ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwesistimu ekuthathweni kwezinqumo. Inkxaso yomsebenzisi kanye nokuphathwa kokufinyelela. Ukuphathwa kwenkxaso yedeski lezinsiza ekuqaleni kubasebenzisi be-PED. Ukuphathwa kokungena komsebenzisi, amaphuzu namalungelo. Ukuphakamisa izinkinga ngokushesha esigabeni senhlanga nezinkonzo zezinkonzi. Ukuleqwa kwomsebenzisi nokwakhiwa ikhono, okuhlanganisa ukwenza uqeqesho oluqhubekayo kumisebenzi: Okusha okukhishwa; Izilungezisezinsizeni; Ukubika kanye ne-dashboard. Ukukhuthaza izifundazwe namajangingi ekusukumiseni ukusetshenziswa. Ukukhokela ukuhlolwa kweprovinsi kokukhishwa nokubuyekeza kwesistimu. Ukukhiqiza amaphulani ukuhlola, ukurekhoda imiphumela yokuhlolwa komsebenzisi (UAT), nokuthumela impendulo kubakhi. Ukuqinisekisa ukulunga kwesistimu ngaphambi kokusakazwa. Ukuthola nokuxazulula izinkinga eziphathelene nobuchwepheshe ezithinta abasebenzisi baprovinsi. Ukugcina ukuhambisana phakathi kwe-eCares ne-EMIS Masterlists. Ukuqinisekisa ukwabiwa kwe-EMIS number kwi-eCares. Ukukhokela izidingo zekhasimende nokungcola kwe-provincial reporting.

xh.title: Isekela Mongameli: Idir: Iiziko ze-ECD - I-grant Esemthethweni
xh.summary: Isekela Mongameli we-grant Esemthethweni yeeZiko ze-ECD eKwindla eNkulu leSebe leMfundo laseMpumalanga, elibukelela imo yenkqubo ye-eCares yephondo ngenxaxheba kubasebenzisi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seminyaka emithathu emva kwe-matric esamkelwe yi-SAQA (NQF Level 7) kwi-Nkqubo zeZolwazi / ICT / Isayensi yeKhompyutha / Iidatha okanye inkalo ephathelene nayo. Iimvelo zolwazi zeminyaka eyi-7 kwiQhingqolwa leNkqubo ngenxaxheba kubasebenzisi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yenkqubo esekwe kwi-Cloud. Ulwazi ngendawo ye-EMIS yephondo kwaye okanye iindawo zenkqubo ye-ECD. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwe-database. Ulwazi ngokubika nge-business intelligence. Amakhono kufuneka aquke uVavavo Lokwamkelwa kubasebenzisi (UAT) nokukhokela iqhina, kunye nokubika kwedata nokuhlola ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo. Amakhono amaninzi okuhlalutya, ukulawula idatha nokubika (Excel advanced level). Ulwazi lokuhlanganisa abanomdla abanamagqithi amanin (kwindalo, kwiphondo, kwisithili). Ulwazi lokuxela iingxaki, kuqwalaselwe iinkcukacha, ukujolisa kwinkonzo yabathengi. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngodwa nokuhamba kakhulu. Isimo: Ukuqatshelwa kuya kuxhomekeka kuviwo lokulinganisa ulwazi. Bonke abakhethekileyo, kuquka i-SMS, kuya kwenza uviwo abalufakayo ngaphambi kokungena. Elinye luya kuba yimisebenzi yobuchwepheshe ukumisela ukufaneleka komkhethi ngokusekelwe kwiimfuno zobuchwephesha nezoqobo zesithuba, elinye kumele libe yiuviwo lokuqinisekisa (ukuziphatha ngokwenene).
xh.duties: Ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo ye-eCares yephondo nokulawula imo yayo. Ukukhokela inkxaso yephondo yokusetyenziswa, imo nokwamkelwa kwenkqubo. Ukuhlola ukuthobela kwabasebenzisi kumsebenzi wenkqubo nakuqhubo yedata. Ukuxhasa ukusetyenziswa kwenkqubo ekwenzeni izigqibo. Inkxabo kubasebenzisi nokulawula ukufikelela. Ukulawula inkxabo yohlelo lokuqala le-helpdesk kubasebenzisi be-PED. Ukulawula ukufikelela kwabasebenzisi, iindima namagunya. Ukuphakamisa iingxaki ngokukhawuleza kwindalo nakubaniki benkonzo. Ukuqeqesha abasebenzisi nokwakha ikhono, okuquka ukuqhuba uqeqesho oluqhubekayo nge: Okukhishwayo okutsha; Okuphuculwayo kumsebenzi; Ukubika nama-dashboard. Ukuxhasa iisithili namacandelo ukuyalela ukusetyenziswa. Ukukhokela uviwo lwenkqubo yephondo kokukhishwayo nokuhlaziya. Ukuphuhumba iindlela zovavovo, ukurekhoda iziphumo zeVavovo Lokwamkelwa kubasebenzisi (UAT), kwaye uze ngale mva ngesiphendulo kubaphuhlisi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphuculwa kwenkqubo phambi kokuyisebenzisa. Ukufumanisa nokusombulula iingxaki zobuchwephesha ezithinta abasebenzisi bephondo. Ukugcina ulungelelwaniso phakathi kwe-eCares nama-Masterlists e-EMIS. Ukuqinisekisa ukwabiwa kumanani e-EMIS kwi-eCares. Ukuxhasa iimfuno zokubika zephondo nokuqinisekisa ukuchaneka.

jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum, plus 37% in lieu of benefits
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for ECD Centres Conditional Grant at Mpumalanga Education Head Office, overseeing data quality and monitoring of early childhood development programmes.
jobs.requirements: A SAQA-recognised three-year post-matric qualification (NQF L6 or higher) in Data Management, Information Systems, Statistics, Social Sciences, Monitoring and Evaluation or a related field. Five years’ experience in data management, data quality assurance, monitoring or system support. Experience in the education sector data (e.g., EMIS) or ECD programmes is beneficial. Knowledge of database management. Knowledge of business intelligence reporting. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data validation. Strong proficiency in Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is advantageous. Command of basic database and reporting processes. Ability to support end-users and provide helpdesk-style guidance. Good communication (verbal and written) and stakeholder coordination skills. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently. A valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel provincially. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment.
jobs.duties: Monitoring and improving accuracy, completeness and consistency of ECD data in the Early Childhood Administration and Reporting System (eCares). Supporting district and provincial users with data entry, uploads, corrections and troubleshooting. Conducting data quality checks and implementing improvement measures. Maintaining records of discrepancies, resolutions and reporting artefacts. Supporting the preparation of routine provincial and district reports. Conducting and supporting user training and capacity-building. Promoting the utilisation of dashboards and reports for planning and service delivery. Supporting user access management and assisting with system usage queries. Collaborating with national, provincial and district stakeholders to drive improved data quality practices. Conducting or supporting training sessions (virtually and in-person) for provincial and district users on data quality requirements (working with a provincial training team). Reinforcing the importance of accurate data entry and maintenance. Sharing tips and guidance for improving data quality. Designing and implementing data quality and completeness reviews. Advocating for the use of eCares reports and dashboards to support ECD operations and planning. Advocating and training provincial and district users in using reports and dashboards to support their operations and planning for ECD, including data collection where appropriate. Ensuring that reports and new plans are prepared with enough lead time to get the necessary approvals.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: S/dir: ECD-sentra - Voorwaardelike toelaag
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir ECD-sentra Voorwaardelike toelaag by Mpumalanga Education Hoofkantoor, wat toesig hou oor datakwaliteit en monitering van vroeëkinderlike-ontwikkelingsprogramme.
af.requirements: A SAQA-recognised three-year post-matric qualification (NQF L6 or higher) in Data Management, Information Systems, Statistics, Social Sciences, Monitoring and Evaluation or a related field. Vyf jaar se ervaring in databestuur, datakwaliteitsversekering, monitering of stelselondersteuning. Ervaring in onderwyssektordata (bv. EMIS) of ECD-programme is voordelig. Kennis van databasisbestuur. Kennis van besigheidsintelligensie-verslagdoening. Sterk vaardigheid in Microsoft Excel en datavalidering. Sterk vaardigheid in Business Intelligence-instrumente (bv. Power BI, Tableau) is voordelig. Beheer van basiese databasis- en verslagdoeningsprosesse. Vermoë om eindgebruikers te ondersteun en hulptesk-geleidende raad te verskaf. Goeie kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik) en belanghebbende-koördinasievaardighede. Sterk probleemoplossingsvaardighede, aandag aan detail en vermoë om onafhanklik te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om provinsiaal te reis. Alle kortlys-kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toegangsonderhoude aflê. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteit (etiese gedrag) assessering wees.
af.duties: Monitering en verbetering van akkuraatheid, volledigheid en konsekwentheid van ECD-data in the Early Childhood Administration and Reporting System (eCares). Ondersteuning van distrik- en provinsiale gebruikers met data-inskrywing, oplaai, korreksies en probleemoplossing. Uitvoer van datakwaliteitskontroles en implementering van verbeteringsmaatreëls. Onderhou van rekords van afwykings, oplossings en verslagdoeningsartefakte. Ondersteuning van die voorbereiding van roetine provinsiale en distriksverslae. Uitvoer en ondersteuning van gebruikersopleiding en kapasiteitsbou. Bevordering van die gebruik van dashboards en verslae vir beplanning en dienslewering. Ondersteuning van gebruikerstoegangsbestuur en bystand met stelselgebruiknavrae. Samewerking met nasionale, provinsiale en distrikbelanghebbendes om verbeterde datakwaliteitspraktyke te bevorder. Uitvoer of ondersteuning van opleidingsessies (virtueel en in persoon) vir provinsiale en distrikgebruikers oor datakwaliteitsvereistes (in samewerking met 'n provinsiale opleidingsspan). Versterking van die belangrikheid van akkurate data-inskrywing en -onderhoud. Deling van wenke en riglyne vir die verbetering van datakwaliteit. Ontwerp en implementering van datakwaliteits- en volledigheids hersienings. Beywering vir die gebruik van eCares-verslae en -dashboards om ECD-bedrywighede en -beplanning te ondersteun. Beywering en opleiding van provinsiale en distrikgebruikers in die gebruik van verslae en dashboards om hul bedrywighede en beplanning vir ECD te ondersteun, insluitend data-insameling waar toepaslik. Verseker dat verslae en nuwe planne met genoeg voorloptyd voorberei word om die nodige goedkeurings te verkry.

zu.title: Umcdi Onomsizi: S/dir: Amasikhungo e-ECD - I-Conditional Grant
zu.summary: Umcdi onomsizi we-Conditional Grant yamasikhungo e-ECD e-Mpumalanga Education Head Office, obenakekela ikhwalithi yedatha nokulawula izinhlelo zentuthuko yomntwana ekuqaleni kuye kwasese.
zu.requirements: Izifundo zeminyaka emithathu ze-post-matric ezivunywe yi-SAQA (NQF L6 noma ngaphezulu) kwi-Data Management, Information Systems, Statistics, Social Sciences, Monitoring and Evaluation noma enkundleni ehlobene naleyo. Ukuhlatshiwa okungeminyaka emihlanu ekuphathweni kwedatha, ekuqinisekiseni ikhwalithi yedatha, ekulawulen noma ekusekeleni amasistimu. Ukuhlatshiwa kwedatha emkhakheni zemfundo (isb., EMIS) noma izinhlelo ze-ECD kuwusizo. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezinsiza zedatha (database). Ulwazi lokubika kwe-business intelligence. Ukubekezela okukhulu kwi-Microsoft Excel nokuqinisekisa idatha. Ukubekezela okukhulu kwamathuluzi e-Business Intelligence (isb., Power BI, Tableau) kuyathathwa njengesonke. Ukuqonda izinqubo ezisisekelo zamadethabhesi nokubika. Ikhono lokusekela abasebenzisi ekugcineni ukuthi benze ngokushesha nokunika inkombandlela enesimo sesikhungo sokweseka. Amakhono kahle okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nangomlomo) nokuhlanganisa abahlose abahlobene nomsebenzi. Amakhono amakhulu okuxazulula izinkinga, ukunaka imininingwane, nosho lokusebenza ngabanye. Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayela nokuzethemba ukuhamba endaweni yesifundazwe. Bonke abagqwayizi abafakiwe ohlwini, kufaka phakathi i-SMS, bazokwenza ukuhlolwa okubili okungenwa ngaphambi kokuqashwa. Okunye kuzoba yisivivinyo esisebenzayo ukuze kutholwe ukufaneleka komgqwayizi ngokusabela kwezidingo zethuluzi nangazo ezijwayelekile zesikhundla, okunye kumele kube ukuhlolwa kobuzotha (uziphatho okuhle).
zu.duties: Ukulawula nokuthuthukisa ukuqiniseka, ukuqedwa nokuhambisana kwedatha ye-ECD kulesi sikhungo sokuphatha nokubika ngentuthuko yomntwana ekuqaleni kuye kwasese (eCares). Ukusekela abasebenzisi bezigodi nabezifundazwe ekufakeni idatha, ekulayishweni, ekulungiseni amaphutha nasekusokeni izinkinga. Ukuhlola ikhwalithi yedatha nokuphatha izinyathelo zokuyithuthukisa. Ukugcina irekhodi lapho kungehlangani khona, ukuxazulula kanye nokubika ngokwenziwa komsebenzi. Ukusekela ukulungiselela okuvamile kwemibiko yesifundazwe nendawo. Ukuqasha nokusekela ukuqeqeshwa kwabasebenzisi nokwakha amandla. Ukukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwamadashibhodi nemibiko ekulungiseleleni nasekuhanisweni inkonzo. Ukusekela ukuphathwa kokungena kolawulo komsebenzisi nokusiza ngemibuzo yokusetshenziswa kwesistimu. Ukusebenzisana nabahlose bamazwe, izifundazwe namagodi ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela zenhla zekhwalithi yedatha. Ukuqasha noma ukusekela izifundo zokuqeqesha (ngaphandle nangaphakathi) abasebenzisi besifundazwe nendawo kuzidingo zekhwalithi yedatha (ukusebenza nenhla yokuqeqesha yesifundazwe). Ukuqinisa ukubaluleka kokufaka nokugcina idatha eqinisekile. Ukwabelana ngezeluleko nenkombandlela yokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yedatha. Ukuyila nokuphatha ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi yedatha nokugqamisa ukugcwaliswa. Ukugqugquzela ukusetshenziswa kwemibiko nedashibhodi ye-eCares ukuze kusekelwe imisebenzi nokulungiselelwa kwe-ECD. Ukugqugquzela nokubaqeqesha abasebenzisi besifundazwe nendawo ekusetshenziseni imibiko namadashibhodi ukuze kusekelwe imisebenzi yabo nokuhlelela i-ECD, kuhlanganise futhi nokuqoqa idatha lapho kufanele khona. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imibiko nezinhlelo ezintsha zilungiselelwa ngokuba nokuqasha isikhathi esanele sokuthola izimvume ezidingekayo.

xh.title: Umsekeli weNhlanganiso: S/dir: Iiziko ze-ECD - Igranti yeemfuno
xh.summary: Umsekeli weNhlanganiso wegranti yezikhululo ze-ECD kwiNtshona Koloni eMpumalanga Education Head Office, ejonge ngokucocisa ulwazi nokuphonononga inkqubo yophuhliso lwabantwana basebuchotsheni.
xh.requirements: Isifundo seminyaka emithathu emva kwe-matric esamkelwe yi-SAQA (NQF L6 okangaphezulu) kwiNkokhelo yolwazi, Iinkqubo Zolwazi, Iziqikithi, Izenzululwazi Zeentlalo, Ukuphonononga nokuHlola okanye indlela elicofa kuyo. Amava eminyaka emihlanu ekulawuleni ulwazi, kuqinisekiso lwegugu lolwazi, ekuphononongeni okanye inkxaso yenkqubo. Amava kumzweli wolwazi kwicala lemfundo (umz., EMIS) okanye inkqubo ze-ECD luncedo. Ulwazi ngokulawula isiseko sedatha. Ulwazi ngokubika ngenkoliso yeshishini. Ukuziphatha kakuhle kwi-Microsoft Excel nokuqinisekisa idatha. Ukuziphatha kakuhle kwiithuluzi Zenkoliso yeshishini (umz., Power BI, Tableau) kuyenzakalisa. Ulawulo lweenkqubo ezisisiseko zesiseko sedatha nokubika. Amandla okunikela inkxaso kubasebenzisi bokugqibela nokubanika inkxaso yendlela yokuphuma kunobuncwana. Amakhono amahle lokunxibelelana (ngomlomo nangokubhalayo) nokuqhuba oorhwebo. Amakhono amanam amandla okusombulula iingxaki, ukunaka iinkcukacha, nokuze ukwazi ukusebenza uzimele. Ilayisense yomqhubi esemthethweni nokuqinisekela ukuhamba kwiphondo. Bonke abagqithiswa abafunyaniswe kwisihlomelo, kuquka i-SMS, kuya kwenza amaxa abo aze athathwe ngaphambili. Omnye uya kuba ngumzobo wamava ukumisela ukufaneleka kommangalelwa ngokusekwe kwiimfuno zobufundi nezibini zesithuba kwaye omnye kumele ukuba uluhluvo lokuziphatha ngokwexesha (isiphengo).
xh.duties: Ukuphonononga nokuPezela isiqinisekiso, ukuqinisekisa ukudityaniswa nokuhambelana kwedatha ye-ECD kwinkqubo yokuLawula nokubika uPhuhliso lokuQala kobomi (eCares). Ukunikela inkxaso kubasebenzisi beedistrikithi nasemaphondweni ngenkqubo yokufaka idatha, ukupapasha, ukulungisa iimpazamo nokuqhuba iingxaki. Ukwenza iingqinisekiso zedatha ezikulungele nokuNika amandla okuphucula iinkqubo. Ukugcina iirekhodi zamaphositho, ukumiselwa kwemiba yedatha kunye namaxwebhu okubika. Ukunika inkxaso ekulungiseleleni iinkqubo ezisemthethweni zamaphondo nadeedistrikithi. Ukuphatha nokunika inkxaso ekusebenzeni nasekubakheni amandla abasebenzisi. Ukukhuthaza ukusebenzisa amadashibhodi nokuBika malunga nokucwangcisa nokunikela inkonzo. Ukwenza inkxabo ekulawuleni uFikelelo lomsebenzisi kunye nokuNcedisa ngeendaba ngokusetyenziswa kwenkqubo. Ukusebenzisana namaphondo, kumazwe nasemaphondweni ukukhuthaza amandla amakhulu ekulawuleni ulwazi. Ukwenza okanye ukunikela inkxabo ekuyini imfundo (ngomzila nakwakhona) kubasebenzisi bamaphondo nasedistrikithi ngeemfuno zedatha ezikulungele (ukusebenza nethimba lemfundiso lomaphondo). Ukunika isiqinisekiso ngokuBaluleka kokufaka idatha ngokuchanekileyo nokugcina idatha ihleli. Ukwabelana ngeendlela nokuNxibelela ngokwenzela ukuphucula idatha. Ukuyila nokuphumeza iingqinisekiso zedatha nokugqibelela iingqinisekiso zedatha. Ukulwela ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ze-eCares namadashibhodi ukunikela inkxaso ekusebenzeni nokuCwangcisa iinkqubo ze-ECD. Ukulwela nokuyala abasebenzisi bamaphondo nasedistrikithi ukuba basebenzise iinkqubo namadashibhodi ukunikela inkxaso kumashishini abo nokuCwangcisa iinkqubo ze-ECD, kuquka ukuqokelela idatha kwimeko efanelekileyo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokubika noMculo wamashishini amsha zilungiselwa ngexesha elifanelekileyo lokufumana izigqibo ezifunekayo.

Escalate unresolved technical issues to provincial or national support structures where required. Support continuous improvement of training approaches based on user feedback and district user needs. af.title: Senior Administratiewe Beampte: S/dir: ECD-sentrums - Voorwaardelike Toekenning
af.summary: Senior administratiewe beampte wat ECD-sentrums ondersteun met die uitrol van die eCares-stelsel, gebruikeropleiding, data-invoer en tegniese probleemoplossing by die Mpumalanga-hoofkantoor.

Praktiese ervaring in die gebruik van inligtingstelsels of databasisse. Intermediêre data-analise- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Opleidingsfasilitering- en gebruikerondersteuningsvaardighede. Data-analise- en verslagdoeningsvaardighede op 'n intermediêre vlak, insluitend die identifisering van tendense, gapings en ongereeldhede. Opleidingsfasilitering- en gebruikerondersteuningsvaardighede, insluitend die vermoë om tegniese konsepte op 'n duidelike en praktiese wyse te verduidelik. Probleemoplossings- en analitiese denkvaardighede, met die vermoë om praktiese oplossings vir bedryfs- en stelselverwante uitdagings te ontwikkel. zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wezokuphathwa: S/dir: Amasikhungo E-ECD - I-Conditional Grant
zu.summary: Umphathi omkhulu wezokuphathwa osekela amasikhungo E-ECD ngenqubo yokusetshenziswa kwesistimu ye-eCares, ukuqeqesha abasebenzisi, ukuqoqa imininingwane nokuxazulula izinkinga zobuchwepheshe esikhungweni esikhulu se-Mpumalanga.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingemuva kwezikole ezihambisana ne-Information Systems, Education, Data Analysis, Public Administration, noma inkundla ehlobene. Isipili sinkundla yokuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsimbi zomtholampilo, ukuqeqesha, noma ukusekela abasebenzisi (ngokwesibonelo emfundweni noma E-ECD). Ukubekwa emtholampilo kwekhomphyutha nokuzethemba ekusebenziseni izinsimbi zamakhomphyutha. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba endaweni futhi usebenze ngokuqondile nabasebenzisi kuleyo ndawo. Ukubekwa emtholampilo okuqinile kwekhomphyutha (MS Office, izinsimbi ze-inthanethi, izinkundla zokufaka imininingwane). Isipili sinkundla esipilisayo ekusebenziseni izinsimbi zolwazi noma izinto zokulondolozwa kwemininingwane. Amakhono aphakathi nendawo wokuhlaziya imininingwane nokubika. Amakhono okuqondisa ukuqeqesha nokusekela abasebenzisi. Ukuphathwa nokuhlolwa kwamafayela. Amakhono aqinile ekusebenziseni ikhomphyutha nokubekwa emtholampilo ngezinsimbi zamakhomphyutha, nokuba nayo ikhono lokuzethemba ekusebenziseni izinsimbu eziningi nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Amakhono okuhlaziya imininingwane nokubika ezingeni eliphakathi, okuhlanganisa ukuqaphela iziqhinga, izikhala, nokungahambelani. Amakhono okuqondisa ukuqeqesha nokusekela abasebenzisi, okuhlanganisa ikhono lokuchaza izinkomba zobuchwepheshe ngendlela ecacile futhi esebenzayo. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya, nokuba nayo ikhono lokuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo ezinkingeni zokusebenza nezihlobene nezinsimbi. Amakhono aphumelelayo okukhuluma nokubhala ahambisana nokuxhumana nabaphathi bendawo nabahlinzeki bezenzo E-ECD. Bonke abagqwayizi abakhethiwe, okuhlanganisa i-SMS, bazothatha ukulinganiswa okubili ngaphambi kokungena. Okunye kuzoba ukuzivocavoca okusebenzayo ukuze kutholwe ukufaneleka komgqwayizi ngokusekelwe kwezidingo zobuchwepheshe nezijwayelekile zesikhundla okunye kumele kube ukulinganisa ukuziphatha (isimo sokuziphatha ngokuzethemba).
zu.duties: Nika ukusekelwa okokuqala abaphathi bendawo namasikhungo E-ECD ngokusetshenziswa kwe-eCares, ukuqoqa imininingwane, nokuxazulula izinkinga. Nika ukusekelwa kobuchwepheshe abasebenzisi ngokuqoqwa kwemininingwane, ukulayisha amafayela, ukubuyekeza ukubhalisa, nezinkomba zensimbi. Dlulisela izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezingaxazululeki ezinhlelweni zokusekela ezifundweni noma ezweni lapho kudingeka khona. Sekela ukuthuthuka okuqhubekayo kwezindlela zokuqeqesha ngokusekelwe emvimweni wabasebenzisi ngezidingo zabasebenzisi bendawo. Khuthaza isiko lokusebenzisa imininingwane, ukufunda, nokubekezele endaweni yamasikhungo E-ECD. Nika ukusekelwa ekuphathweni nokugcinweni kwemininingwane abasebenzisi bendawo.

xh.title: Umphathi Ophakamileyo Wezorhwebo: S/dir: ECD Centres - Conditional Grant
xh.summary: Umphathi ophakamileyo wezorhwebo onxelayo iindawo ze-ECD ngokusetha kwangaphambili kwinkqubo ye-eCares, uqeqesho labasebenzisi, ukuqokelela iingcombolo nokusombulula iingxaki ezinzima ngokobuchwephesha kwindlu enkulu yesebe eMpumalanga Head Office.
xh.requirements: Izidanga ezifanelekileyo zemuva kwesikolo kwiinkqubo zeNgcombolo, eMfundo, kuQeqesho lweNgcombolo, eKulawuleni koluntu, okwenkalo ekuhambelanayo. Ulwazi lokunxelayo ukusetywa kweenkqubo, uqeqesho, okunikela inkxaso kumsebenzisi (ngokuthanda kakhulu emfundeni okanye kwi-ECD). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha nethemba lokusebenza ngenkqubo ze-dijithali. Ukuzimisela okuhamla phakathi kwesithili nokusebenza ngqo nabasebenzisi kwindawo yokusebenza. Ulwazi olugqithisileyo lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office, iinkqubo ezikwi-intanethi, iindawo zokufaka iingcombolo). Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iinkqubo zeengcombolo okanye iinguquzi zeengcombolo. Amandla apha ngakumbi ekwenzeni uqeqesho kwi-data nokwenza iingxelo. Amandla okukhuthaza uqeqesho nokunika inkxaso kumsebenzisi. Ulawulo nokucwangciswa koxwebhu. Amandla amakhulu ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha nakwikhompyutha ye-dijithali, kunye namandla okuzisebenzisa ngokuzigqatsa kuyo nayiphi na iinkqubo namacebiso. Amandla okwenza uqeqesho kwi-data nokwenza iingxelo kwinqanaba eliphakathi, kuquka nokuchonga iindlela ezihamba ngayo, iindawo ezikhawulezileyo, nezinto ezingahambisaniyo. Amandla okukhuthaza uqeqesho nokunika inkxaso kumsebenzisi, kuquka namandla okucacisa izinto zobuchwephesha ngendlela ecacileyo nesebenzayo. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki nokucinga ngokudibanisa izinto, kunye namandla okuphuhlisa izisombululo ezisebenzayo kwiingxaki ezimalana nokuqhuba nasezobuchwephesha. Amandla asebenzayo okuthetha nokubhala okulungele ukunxibelelana nabaqeshwa basesithili kunye nababanikeli benkonzo ye-ECD. Onke amagqabantshintshi abekiweyo, kuquka ne-SMS, kuya kwenza iintsingiselo ezimbini zangaphambili zokungena esikhundleni. Ezi zinto ziya kuba ngumzamkelo osebenzayo wokuqonda ukufaneleka komgqatsi ngokusekelwe kwiimfuno zobuchwephesha neziqu zendawo yokusebenza, yile ngesine kuya kuba luncedo lokulinganisa ukuziphatha kwesisethu.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yokuqala kubaqeshwa basesithili nakwindawo ze-ECD ngokusetyenziswa kwe-eCares, ukufaka iingcombolo, nokusombulula iingxaki. Nikeza inkxaso ngokobuchwephesha kumsebenzisi ngokuqokelela iingcombolo, ukulayisha uxwebhu, ukuhlaziya ukubhaliswa, kunye neziganeko zenkqubo. Thumela iingxaki ezingasombululanga ngokobuchwephesha kumaziko enkxaso kwiprovinisi okanye kwilizwe apho kufuneka khona. Nxiba inkxaso ekuphuculeni ngokuhamba kwexesha iindlela zokuqeqesha ngokusekelwe kwiimvakalelo zabasebenzisi ngeemfuno zabasebenzisi basesithili. Khuthaza inkqubo yokusebenzisa iingcombolo, okufundwa, nokuziphendulela ngaphakathi kumaziko we-ECD asesithili. Nikeza inkxaso ekulawuleni iingcombolo nasekuzigcinweni kumsebenzisi basesithili.

jobs.summary: Deputy Director role coordinating crime prevention and community safety partnerships in the Bojanala district of the North West province.

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Misdaadvoorkomingsvenootskappe
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur-pos wat misdaadvoorkomings- en gemeenskapsveiligheidsvenootskappe in die Bojanala-distrik van die North West-provinsie koördineer.
af.requirements: Graad (12) sertifikaat of gelykwaardig plus 'n drie (3) jaar Nasionale Diploma/ Graad (NQF vlak 6/7) in Sosiale Wetenskappe, LLB, Ontwikkelingsstudies, Polisiërings- en Gemeenskapsontwikkeling. Vyf (5) jaar se tersaaklike werkervaring binne 'n veiligheids- en sekuriteitsomgewing waarvan drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar se ervaring op 'n juniobestuursvlak (Assistent-direkteur). Geldige Kode EB (08) bestuurderslisensie. Kennis: Kennis en begrip van die Geïntegreerde Misdaad- en Geweldvoorkomingsstrategie, Kennis van die Witverklaring oor Veiligheid en Sekuriteit, Kennis van die SAPS-wet, Kennis van die Burgerlike Sekretariaatwet, Kennis van die Openbare Dienswet en Regulasies. Openbare Diens Gedragskode. Begrip van die Openbare Finansiële Bestuurswet. Raamwerkswet vir Interregeringsverhoudinge. Vaardighede: Gemeenskapsmobilisering. Belanghebbende bestuur en samewerking. Koördinering en fasilitering. Onderhandeling en hulpbronmobilisering. Interpersoonlike en Gevorderde Verslagskryf. Program- en projektebestuursvaardighede. Kliëntgerigtheid en klantefokus. Basiese navorsing en data-ontledingsvaardighede. Vermoë om beleide te interpreteer. Fasiliterings- en goeie voorleggingsvaardighede. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasie. Beplanning, Organisasie en Leierskap. Vermoë om selfstandig en as deel van 'n span te funksioneer. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en onreëlmatige ure te werk. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede en besluitneming. Konflikbestuur en Veranderingsbestuursvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft, Excel en PowerPoint).
af.duties: Ontwikkel en hersien gemeenskapsvoorligtingsprogramme. Verbeter die gehalte en toeganklikheid van veiligheidsprogramme. Moedig dialoog oor veiligheid en misdaadvoorkoming aan. Inisieer en koördineer misdaadvoorkomingsprogramme. Koördineer die ontwikkeling, implementering en hersiening van Provinciale Misdaadvoorkomingsstrategieë. Bevordel gemeenskapsdeelname aan misdaadvoorkomingsinisiatiewe. Koördineer die ontwikkeling en evaluering van veiligheidsmodelle. Bevordel gemeenskap-Polisie-verhoudinge. Stel gemeenskapsveiligheidsstrukture in sta, monitor en verbeter dit. Stel openbaar-private vennootskappe in stand en bevorder dit. Bestuur sleutelprestasie-verantwoordelikhede van die personeel onder u bestuur. Monitor en verslag doen oor die subdirektoraat se hulpbronne, bied ondersteuning met die opsteling van die uitgawebegroting, rapportering van koste vir aktiwiteite en help met die ontwikkeling van 'n begrotingsinstrument vir die subdirektoraat.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaSekela-Mongqondzili: Uxhumano Lokuvikela Ubugebengu
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela-Mongqondzili esihlanganisa uxhumano lokuvikela ubugebengu nokuqinisekisa ukuphepha komphakathi esifundeni i-Bojanala esifundazweni i-North West.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Grade (12) noma esifanayo kahle nge-National Diploma/ Degree yeminyaka eyishumi (3) (NQF level 6/7) kwe-Social Sciences, LLB, Development Studies, Policing and Community Development. Ukuhleleka emsebenzini okuhambisana neminyaka emihlanu (5) ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuphepha nokuvikelwa, lapho kuneminyaka eyinthathu (3) kuya kuyisihlanu (5) yokuheleleka kwesigaba sezabasizi kubhalwe (Assistant Director). I-Driver`s License ye-Code EB (08) esebenzayo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi nokuQonda i-Integrated Crime and Violence Prevention Strategy, ulwazi nge-White Paper on Safety and Security, ulwazi nge-SAPS Act, ulwazi nge-Civilian Secretariat Act, ulwazi nge-Public Service Act and Regulations. Ukuziqonda ngocoqengco I-Public Service Code of Conduct. UkuQonda ngomthetho we-Public Financial Management Act. I-Intergovernmental Relations Framework Act. Amakhono: Ukusula umphakathi. Ukuqondisa abanolwazi nokubambisana. Ukuhlanganisa nokuqondisa. Ukuxoxisana nokuvelisa izinsiza. Ukuxhumana nabantu nokuBhala imibiko yeNqanaba eliPhakeme. Amakhono okuphatha amahlelo namaphrojeke. Ukubhekiswa kwayiklayenti nokugxila kumthengi. Amakhono okucwanisisa okuyisisekelo kanye nokuhlaziya idatha. Ikhono lokuhumusha izinqubomgomo. Amakhono okuqondisa nokunikeza izethulo ezinhle. Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhala kahle. Ukuhlela, ukuhlelela, kanye noBukhosi. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela nangaphakathi kweqembu. Ukuzibika ekwazweni ukuthi uzohamba futhi usebenze emahoreni angajwayelekile. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Amakhono okuPhatha izingxabano nokuPhatha Ushintsho. Ukuba nalwazi lweKhompyutha (Microsoft, Excel and PowerPoint).
zu.duties: Yakha futhi uhlole imihlela yokufinyelela komphakathi. Thuthisa izinga nokuqondwa kwezinhlela zokuphepha. Khuthaza izixoxo ngezenzo zokuphepha nokuvikela ubugebengu. Qala futhi uhlanganise imihlela yokuvinjela ubugebengu. Hlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa nokuhlolwa kweProvincial Crime Prevention Strategies. Khuthaza ukubandakanywa komphakathi ekuvikeleni ubugebengu. Hlanganisa ukuthuthukiswa nokuhlolwa kwezinhlelo zokuphepha. Khuthaza ubudlelwane bomphakathi noMaphoyisa. Saka, hlole futhi uthuthise izakhiwo zokuphepha komphakathi. Saka futhi ukhuthaze uxhumano oluyimphakathi kanye nobuhlangenomnikazi. Phatha izibopho ezingokusebenza kahle kwebalulele okuphethwe ngamunye. Hlola futhi wenze umbiko ngezinsiza esebkukledirakhthi, unikeze inkuxhe ekwenzeni ukubajethezwa kokuchitha, ukubika ngemali echithwe kumasebenzi, futhi usize ekwakhiweni kwesixhobha sokubajetha ibalazwe kuse-bkukle-direktorath.

xh.summary: Indima yesekela mongameli ekuququzeleleni uqhagamshelwano lokuthintela iwebhu nokhuseleko lomanyano kwilizwe leBojanala elithi North West.

zu.title: Umncedi Wezikhulu: Umeluleki we-EAP
zu.summary: Umncedi Wezikhulu Umeluleki we-EAP ohlinzeka ngeluleko lokuhlakanipha kwengqondo namaphrogramu eminzuzo abasebenzi bomnyango eNtabasihlalo eMmabatho.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Matric (Grade 12) kanye ne-Bachelor Degree ye-Social Work noma i-Social Science, ukubhaliswa ku-South African Council of Social Service Profession (SACCSP) noma i-Health Professional Council (HPC). Ukuqashelwa kweminyaka eyi-Three (3) kuya kuyi-five (5) yokusebenza kokubhekele impilo nokuphila kahle kwabasebenzi okuyilapho iminyaka eyi-two (02) kufanele ibe kulinga lokubhekisa. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olusebenzayo kwindawo yokubhekele impilo nokuphila kahle kwabasebenzi, imithetho yomphakathi, izinqubomgomo nezinye izimiso ezihlobene, ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo nezinkinga. Amakhono: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft office). Ikhono elivezwe lokubusa nezici zobuholo obushukumisayo. Ikhono lokugcina izinhlobo ezinhle zokuxhumana nabantu nokusebenza njengengxenye yeqembu kanye nokusebenza wedwa. Amakhono okuhlaziya kanye nakhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono abonisiwe mayelana nokubhala imibiko. Amakhono amakhulu okuxhumanisa nokuqonda. Amakhono okululeka. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana okubhalwayo nokukhulunywa.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngeluleko lokuhlakanipha kwengqondo abasebenzi bomnyango kanye nemindeni yawo enwetshiwe, qhuba iphrogramu yezomnotho nezomnotho okuphila kahle, nikeza ulwazi nokuqondisa ngezinkinga zokuhlakanipha kwengqondo, qinisekise iphrogramu yokuqalanisa impilo nomsebenzi kumnyango, phatha abantu, izinsiza zomnotho nezinye izinsiza kumnyango, Siza ekwakheni nokuqalisweni kwe-EHW, izinqubomgomo zokubhekele impilo nokuphila kahle kwabasebenzi, Ukuthuthwa kophrogramu zokubhekele impilo nokuphila kahle kwabasebenzi (EHW), phatha, hlanganisa futhi wenze kube lula i-EAP, iphrogramu ye-HIV/AIDS kanye nokuqushumbisa.

xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seMatric (Grede 12) esongezelelwengqangqwa yesidanga seBachelor kwiSocial Work okanye iSocial Science, uBhalo kwiSouth African Council of Social Service Profession (SACCSP) okanye iHealth Professional Council (HPC). Kwiminyaka emithathu (3) ukuya kumihlanu (5) yamava okusebenza kwiEmployee Health and Wellness apho kweminyaka mibini (02) kufuneka ibe ngengqangqwa yabaphathi. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olusebenzayo kwimimeri yomzimba nengqondo ekondlweni kwempilo, izinto ezisemthethweni zerhafu, iinkqubomorpho neminye imiyalelo eluhlanganeni nentlobo-mbumbulu kwindaba, iindlela ezahlukene zokuphathwa kwentlukwano. jobs.title: Assistant Director: Labour Relations
jobs.department: Department of Community Safety and Transport Management
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09) CENTER         :   Mahikeng: Head Office
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role facilitating grievances, disciplinary hearings, and collective bargaining representation for the Department of Community Safety and Transport Management in Mahikeng.
jobs.requirements: Matric (Grade 12) certificate or equivalent plus National Diploma / Bachelor's Degree (NQF6/7) /in Labour Relations / Labour Law / Industrial Relations. Valid Drivers License. Three (3) to five (5) years relevant working experience in the Field of Labour Relations of which two (2) years must be at a Supervisory (Salary Level 7/8) level. A valid drivers license. Knowledge: Through knowledge of Labour Legislations, Acts, Public Service Policies / Regulations and Collective Bargaining Agreements. Ability to work under pressure. The ability to develop and interpret policies. Skills: Computer literacy in Microsoft packages. Research, conflict resolution skills, interpersonal skills, communication (verbal and report writing). Analytic investigation and presentation skills.
jobs.duties: Facilitate / investigate grievances. Investigate misconduct and conduct disciplinary hearings. Represent the employer at conciliations and arbitrations. Represent the department at Collective Bargaining structures and at the Provincial Labour Relations Forum. Compile various Labour Relations reports. Advise management on Labour Relations issues. Strike management. Manage the performance of personnel within the unit. Capacity building in the department.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Arbeidsverhoudinge
af.summary: Assistent-direkteurrol wat griewe, disiplinêre verhore en kollektiewe bedingingverteenwoordiging vir die Department of Community Safety and Transport Management in Mahikeng fasiliteer.
af.requirements: Matriek (Graad 12) sertifikaat of gelykwaardig plus Nasionale Diploma / Bachelors Degree (NQF6/7) in Arbeidsverhoudinge / Arbeidsreg / Nywerheidsverhoudinge. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Drie (3) tot vyf (5) jaar relevante werkservaring in die veld van Arbeidsverhoudinge waarvan twee (2) jaar op 'n toesighoudende (Salary Level 7/8) vlak moet wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Deeglike kennis van Arbeidswetgewing, Wette, Openbare Diensbeleid / Regulasies en Kollektiewe Bedingingsooreenkomste. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Die vermoë om beleid te ontwikkel en te interpreteer. Vaardighede: Rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft-pakkette. Navorsing, konflikoplossingsvaardighede, interpersoonlike vaardighede, kommunikasie (mondeling en verslagskrywing). Analitiese ondersoek en voorleggingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Fasiliteer / ondersoek griewe. Ondersoek wangedrag en hou disiplinêre verhore. Verteenwoordig die werkgewer by bemiddelings en arbitrasies. Verteenwoordig die departement by Kollektiewe Bedingingsstrukture en by die Provinsiale Arbeidsverhoudingeforum. Stel diverse Arbeidsverhoudingeverslae op. Adviseer bestuur oor Arbeidsverhoudinge-aangeleenthede. Stakingsbestuur. Bestuur die prestasie van personeel binne die eenheid. Kapasiteitsbou in die departement.

zu.title: Umuntu Ohola Isikhundla: Izindaba Zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuhola izinkinga, izinkululeko zokulalelwa kwezehlazo, kanye nokumela kwabasebenzi kwiNdlu Yokuxoxisana Ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwiNyuvesi Yokuvikela Ukuphila Kwabantu Nokuphathwa Kwezokuthutha eMahikeng.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi seMatric (Iklasi 12) noma okulinganayo kahle kanye neDiploma Yesizwe / I-degree yeBachelor's (NQF6/7) /kwezindaba zabasebenzi /komthetho wabasebenzi /wezindaba zomsebenzi. Ilayisense yokushayela evumelekile. Ukutholakala kweminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kwayisihlanu (5) yeminyaka yamava okusebenza ohlotini lwezindaba zabasebenzi lapho kumele kubekho iminyaka emibili (2) ezingeni lomphathi (Izinga Leholo 7/8). Ilayisense yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olujulile ngomthetho wabasebenzi, ama-Act, amapholisi aseNkonweni Kahulumeni / Izimiso kanye nezivumelwano zokuqoqwa kwemibono. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegciwane. Ikono lokuthuthukisa nokuhumusha amapholisi. Amakhono: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwemikhiqizo ye-Microsoft. Amakhono okucwaninga, okuxazulula izinkinga, amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, ukuxhumana (okwenziwa ngomlomo nokubhala imibiko). Amakhono okucwaninga nokubhukuda ngokuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Ukuhola / ukucwaninga izinkinga. Ukucwaninga ukuziphatha kabi nokwenza izinkululeko zokulalelwa kwezehlazo. Ukumela iqhaza emsebenzini ezinkundleni zokubuyisana nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukumela umnyango ezakhiwo zokuqoqwa kwemibono nakwiNkundla Yezindaba Zabasebenzi Yezifundazwe. Ukuqoqa imibiko ehlukene yezindaba zabasebenzi. Ukweluleka abaphathi ngezindaba zabasebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwezikhali. Ukuphatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwenhlobo. Ukwakha amandla kumnyango.

xh.title: Umncedisi woNxulumani: iNgxaki yeMiba yabaSebenzi
xh.summary: Indima kaGqirha oPhezulu ekuthetha ngokumelana nengxaki yemiba yabasebenzi, iinkomfa zeesikolo nokumela iqela elibhekisa kumsebenzi weKhuluma kwiRhulumente noQeqeshe lweNkundla yoluntu kwiKhabhane yokuQondisisa nokuLawula iRhulumente kwindawo yeMahikeng.
xh.requirements: Isatifikedi seMatric (Grade 12) okanye esilinganayo sengaphezulu kwesidanga seNational Diploma / Iziqendu zeBachelor (NQF6/7) kusezlwini lwemiba yabasebenzi / umthetho wemiba yabasebenzi / iziqu zoluntu. Ifaythi yelayisensi yokushayela. Amakhulu amathathu (3) ukuya kwamahlanu (5) leminyaka yokusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kwilwazi lemiba yabasebenzi apho kwiminyaka emibini (2) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba labaphathi (Salary Level 7/8). Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olunzulu ngomthetho wezomsebenzi, iMithetho, iNgqungquthela zeZopolitiko zeZikhonzo / Ikrayitheriya namaQekelelo oCenga uQeqeshe. Isakhono sokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Isakhono sokwakha ukuqonda iNqila. Isakhono: Ulwazi lwekhompyutha ekusingcelweni kweMicrosoft. Uphononongo, izakhono zokuqwalasela iingxabano, izakhono ezikuluntu nokuthetha nabanye, ukunyaniseka kolwimi (okubhalwayo nakwiNgcaciso yeNgxelo). Uphononongo lokwahlulela iingxaki nokuzibonakalisa.
xh.duties: Lawula uphando / iphelaphi iingxaki. Phanda ukuziphatha kakubi uze wenze iinkomfa zolwesine. Mela iqumrhu elimele abaqashi kwiinkomfa zoxolelwano nakwezabaphathi ababhangi amacala. Mela isebe kumaziko ekuCenga kuQela kwanakwiNgqungquthela yeZemiba ezKulawulo kuBakho baseNgingqi. Qeqa iingxelo ezahlukeneyo zeZemiba zeziSebe. Celisa abalawuli ngeemba zeZemiba ezisebenzaniso. Lawula izigobo. Lawula ukusebenza komsebenzi basele ndlu emnyama. Yakha amandla kwisebe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Demand Management
jobs.department: Department of Community Safety and Transport Management
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to manage demand planning, supplier database implementation and procurement training within the North West Department of Community Safety and Transport Management.
jobs.requirements: Matric/Grade 12 and an appropriate bachelor’s degree (NQF Level 7) in Supply Chain Management (SCM) Logistics Management / Financial Management. A minimum of 5 years work experience in Supply Chain Management. Three- year Supply Chain Management on supervisory level. Valid Driver’s licence. Knowledge: Knowledge of Walker financial management system/ BAS, knowledge of legislative framework governing SCM. procurement business and ability to manage demand system and controls. Knowledge of Batho Pele Principles and application thereof. Knowledge of public service regulations Act. Skills And Competencies: Advanced computer literate and leadership abilities, interpersonal skill, written and verbal communication and conflict resolution skill. Excellent verbal and written communications skills, sound analytical / innovative thinking and problem-solving skills. Computer literacy. Strong planning and coordination abilities. Ability to work under pressure and extended hours so as to meet the deadline dates. Knowledge and application of legislative frame works that governs Supply Chain Management in the Public Service environment.
jobs.duties: Conduct total needs assessment within the Department. Manage implementation of Central Supplier Data Base. Conduct market, industry and commodity analysis and compile report for approval. Conduct trainings to all end users in relation to compilation of Demand and Procurement Plans for the Department. Compile memo to all End Users for submission of annual needs. Manage needs assessment performance in accordance with the framework. Compile Demand Management and Procurement Plan for the Department. Develop and maintain Demand Management and Procurement Plan for the Department. Implement Demand Management Plan and Procurement Plan for the Department. Implement Departmental Supply Chain Management policies, all legislative framework governing Supply Chain Management. Ensure the determination of specifications requirement are linked to the strategic Plan and budget of the Department. Perform membership position in Specification committee meetings. Manage Key performance areas of team members. Be involved in the budget projection of the unit. Compile Bid files for all procurement plan projects. Compile report progress of procurement plan on monthly and quarterly basis. Perform any task delegated by the supervisor.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Vraagbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur benodig om vraagbeplanning, implementering van die verskafferdatabasis en inkoopopleiding binne die North West Department of Community Safety and Transport Management te bestuur.
af.requirements: Matric/Grade 12 en 'n toepaslike baccalaureusgraad (NQF Level 7) in Supply Chain Management (SCM) Logistics Management / Financial Management. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar werkservaring in Supply Chain Management. Drie jaar Supply Chain Management op toesigiheidsvlak. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis: Kennis van Walker financial management system/ BAS, kennis van die wetgewende raamwerk wat SCM regeer. besigheid in verkryging en vermoë om vraagstelsel en -kontroles te bestuur. Kennis van Batho Pele Principles en die toepassing daarvan. Kennis van die openbare diensregulasies-wet. Vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Gevorderde rekenaargeletterdheid en leierskapsvermoëns, interpersoonlike vaardigheid, skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie en konflikoplossingsvaardigheid. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, deeglike analitiese / innoverende denke en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Sterk beplannings- en koördineringsvermoëns. Vermoë om onder druk en buitengewone ure te werk om sperdatums te haal. Kennis en toepassing van wetgewende raamwerke wat Supply Chain Management in die openbare diensomgewing regeer.
af.duties: Voer 'n algehele behoeftebepaling binne die departement uit. Bestuur die implementering van die Central Supplier Data Base. Voer mark-, bedryfs- en kommoditeitsanalise uit en stel 'n verslag op vir goedkeuring. Verskaf opleiding aan alle eindgebruikers met betrekking tot die opstel van vraag- en verkrygingsplanne vir die departement. Stel 'n memo op aan alle eindgebruikers vir die indiening van jaarlikse behoeftes. Bestuur die prestasie van behoeftebepaling in ooreenstemming met die raamwerk. Stel die vraagbestuurs- en verkrygingsplan vir die departement op. Ontwikkel en onderhou die vraagbestuurs- en verkrygingsplan vir die departement. Implementeer die vraagbestuursplan en verkrygingsplan vir die departement. Implementeer departementele Supply Chain Management-beleide en alle wetgewende raamwerke wat Supply Chain Management regeer. Verseker dat die bepaling van spesifikasierekenisvereistes gekoppel word aan die strategiese plan en begroting van die departement. Tree op as lid in spesifikasiekomiteevergaderings. Bestuur die sleutelprestasieareas van spanlede. Raak betrokke by die begrotingsprojeksie van die eenheid. Stel bodlêers op vir alle verkrygingsplanprojekte. Stel maandelikse en kwartaallikse vorderingsverslae van die verkrygingsplan op. Voer enige taak uit wat deur die toesighou gedelegeer word.

zu.title: Umncedisi Wezikhulu: Ukuphathwa Kokufunwa Kwemikhiqizo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umncedisi wezikhulu ukuphathwa kokuhlela okufunwayo, ukusetshenziswa kwesiqu kwenxibelelwano sabathengisi kanye nokuqeqeshwa kokuthenga ngaphakathi kwe-North West Department of Community Safety and Transport Management.
zu.requirements: I-Matric/Grade 12 kanye nedigri eshibhile efanele (NQF Level 7) ku-Supply Chain Management (SCM) Logistics Management / Financial Management. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 yomgwaqo wokusebenza ku-Supply Chain Management. Unyaka othathu woku-Supply Chain Management emazingeni okulawula. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngokusetshenziswa kwe-Walker financial management system/ BAS, ulwazi ngesakhiwo sezomthetho esilawula i-SCM. Amabhizinisi okuthenga nenkokhelo yokuphatha inkqubo yokufunwa kanye nalawulo. Ulwazi nge-Batho Pele Principles kanye nokusetshenziswa kwazo. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-public service regulations. Amakhono nenhlonipho: Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ngokuqinile kanye namakhono okuba ngumholi, ikhono lokuxhumana nabantu, ukubhala nokuKhuluma kanye nakhono okuxazulula imiqhushumba. Amakhono aphezulu okukhuluma nokubhala, ukucabanga okuhlukaniswe kahle / okuqhamuka kakhulekhule nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Amakhono amakhulu okuhlela uhambo kanye nokuqondisa. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwesithunzi kanye namahora amakhulu ukuze kuqedele emini ezibekiwe. Ulwazi kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezakhiwo ezimthetho eziphatha i-Supply Chain Management emhlabeni wezinsizakalo zikahulumeni.
zu.duties: Qagela intuthuko yezidingo ngaphakathi koMnyango. Phatha ukuphatha kohlelo lokugcina imininingwane yabathengisi abakhulu. Qagela ukuhlaziya imakethe, imbona kanye neziqaleko bese uqamba umbiko ukuze uvunyelwe. Phatha uqeqesho kubo bonke abasebenzisi ekutheni bahlele amaphulani okufunwayo nokuthenga ukuze kusebenze ngaphakathi koMnyango. Qamba imemo kubo bonke abasebenzisa ukuze benzise izidingo zabo zeminyaka yonke. Phatha ukusebenza kokuqagela izidingo ngokuvumelana nesakhiwo esihleliwe. Hlela ukuphathwa kokufunwayo kanye nephulani lalelo bathengi kuwo womabili amaphulani azokusetyenziswa ohlelweni lokuthengisa. Hlela amaphulani okuqonda isidingo nokuthenga abathengi abangaphakathi ohlelweni lwe-Department of Community Safety and Transport Management. Sebenzisa izinkambiso ezihleliwe zokuphathwa kwemikhiqizo, zonke izakhiwo ezomthetho ezilawula ukuphathwa kokuhlela nokuthenga. Qiniseka ukuthi ukucaciswa kokufunwayo kuhlobene nohlelo oluhlele ngokuhlakaniphile kanye ne-sikhathi. Zibandakanya emgwaqweni wokubhuka imali ekusingathweni kweqembu. Phequlula amafayela okuthenga amaphrojekthi wonke amaphulani okuthengisa ekuqhubekayo. Qamba umbiko wokuqhubekela phambili kwephulani lokuthenga nsuku zonke nangokwekhota kanye namakota. Zenza noma yimiphi imisebenzi ekiwe ngumlawuli.

xh.title: Umncedi weNkulumbuso: uLawulo loMfuno
xh.summary: Kufuneka kude kude umncedi weNkulumbuso ukulawula uqwalaselo lomfuno, ukusebenzisa isiseko sedata yabahlinzeki nokuzimasa kokuqokelela izinto ngaphakathi kwisebe leNorth West Department of Community Safety and Transport Management.
xh.requirements: Matric/Grade 12 kunye neqonga elilungileyo le-degree yesidanga (NQF Level 7) kwiSupply Chain Management (SCM) Logistics Management / Financial Management. Iminyaka engu-5 ubuncinane yamava wokusebenza kwiSupply Chain Management. Iminyaka emithathu yamava kwiSupply Chain Management kwinqanaba lokulawula. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi: Ulwazi ngokulawula inkqubo yemali yeWalker / BAS, ulwazi ngoluhlu lwemithetho olulawula iSCM. ishishini lokuthenga nako nokwazi ukulawula inkqubo yomfuno nolawulo. Ulwazi ngeenzaMthetho zeBatho Pele nokuzisebenzisa. Ulwazi ngomthetho wemigaqo yesebe likarhulumente. Amakhono nobuchule: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngobuchwepheshe obuphezulu nendlela yokuba ngumphathi, amakhono okusebenzana nabantu, amakhono okubhala nokuThetha nokusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono aphambili okuthetha nokubhala, iingqondo ezohloliyo / ezingqamayo zokucinga namakhono okusombulula iingxaki. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amakhulu okucwangcisa nokuhlanganisa. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngocinezelo nangamaxa amade ukuze uhlangabezane namaxesha okuvala. Ulwazi nokusebenzisa iindlela zemithetho ezilawula iSupply Chain Management kwimeko yesebe likarhulumente.
xh.duties: Qwalasela iimfuno ezipheleleyo ngaphakathi kwisebe. Lawula ukusebenzisa iCentral Supplier Data Base. Yenza uhlalutyo lwemarike, shamwari nengqengqe kwaye uqokelele ingxelo yokuvunywa. Yaza abasebenzisi bonke ngeendlela zokuqokelela iindleko zokuqokelela izinto nezicwangciso zokuThenga zesebe. Qokelela imemo kubo bonke abasebenzisi ukuba bazithumele iimfuno zonyaka. Lawula inkqubo yokuqwalasela iimfuno ngokwemithetho. Qokelela isicwangciso soLawulo loMfuno nesokuThenga izinto sesebe. Yakha ulwazi lokulawula nokuthenga izinto sesebe. Lawula isicwangciso soLawulo loMfuno nesokuThenga sesebe. Lawula iindlela zokuThenga izinto zesebe, zonke iindlela zemithetho ezilawula iSupply Chain Management. Qinisekisa ukuba iimfuno ezichaziweyo zidityaniswa nesicwangciso nembetho yesebe. Yiba lilungu kwindibano yekomiti lezoMiso. Lawula amacala amakhulu okusebenza kwamalungu eqela. Zibandakanye kwinkqubo yembetho yeqela. Qokelela iifayile zeBakhusi kwazo zonke izicwangciso zokuThenga izinto. Qokelela ingxelo yentsovo yesicwangciso zokuThenga izinto ngenyanga nakweyita. Yenza naluphi na umsebenzi onikiwe ngumlawuli.

jobs.department: Department of Community Safety and Transport Management
jobs.summary: Senior state accountant needed to administer salary payments, deductions and over/under payments at the Department of Community Safety and Transport Management in Mmabatho.

af.title: Senior Staatsrekenaar: Salarisadministrasie en
af.summary: Senior staatsrekenaar benodig om salarisbetalings, aftrekkings en oor-/onderbetalings by die Department of Community Safety and Transport Management in Mmabatho te administreer.
af.requirements: Matric of gelykwaardig. Drie (3) jaar graad of diploma in Finansiële Bestuur, Rekeningkunde (NQF6/7) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie met Rekeningkunde as 'n module. Drie (3) tot Vyf (5) jaar ervaring in 'n Salarisadministrasie-omgewing waarvan Twee (2) jaar op toesienvlak moet wees. Inleiding tot PERSAL-sertifikaat en salarisadministrasie-sertifikaat word vereis. Belastingberekeninge 1-sertifikaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury-regulasies. Finansiële Handleiding, Basic Conditions of Employment Act en Riglyn vir die Bestuur van Departementele Skuld. Rekenaargeletterdheid – Word, Excel en PowerPoint is belangrik. Werkende kennis van regeringsstelsels (PERSAL). Vaardighede: Kommunikasie (geskryf en mondeling), interpersoonlike verhoudinge. af.duties: Administreer die betaling van personeel (Salarisse en Toelaes). Voer berekenings uit van oor-/onderbetalings van salarisse. Administreer die stoporder-aftrekkings van salarisse. Verseker die veilige bewaring van salarisdokumente. Bestuur die prestasie van personeel binne die eenheid.

zu.title: Ongumlawuli Ophakemei Wezimali Zikahulumeni: Ukuphathwa Kweziholo
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlawuli ophakemei wezimali zikahulumeni ukuphatha ukukhokhelwa kweziholo, izinkokhelo ezingezwa noma ezidlule e-Department of Community Safety and Transport Management e-Mmabatho.
zu.requirements: I-Matric noma esingangenwa ngokulingana. I-degree noma diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) kwi-Financial Management, i-Accounting (NQF6/7) noma isiqui esingangenwa ngokulingana esinensi-Accounting njengesimiso. Ukuhlolisisa iminyaka emithathu (3) kuya kuhlola kunyaka (5) kulandelo le-Salary Administration lapho kubalwa khona eminyaka emibili (2) kumele ibengaphezulu kwesigaba sobukhulu. Kudingeka isitifiketi se-Introduction to PERSAL nesitifiketi se-salary administration. Isitifiketi se-Tax calculations 1 sizoba yinikezo engeziwe. Ulwazi: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izinhlaka ze-Treasury. I-Financial Manual, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act kanye ne-Guide on Managing Departmental Debt. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha – i-Word, i-Excel ne-PowerPoint zibalulekile. Ulwazi lokusebenza izinhlelo kahulumeni (PERSAL). Amakhono: Ukuxhumana (okubiwayo nokubhaliwayo), ubudlelwano nabantu. Ukuguquguquka kanye nokusebenza njengesiqhaza. Amakhono ekhompuyutha, ukuhlela, kanye nokuhlela izinto. Amakhono okulawula ingxabano. Ukuziqhubela phambili kanye nokugxila kumiphumela, kufanele ukuthi ukwazi ukuhlola ngaphansi kwenguqulo.
zu.duties: Lawula ukukhokhelwa kwabasebenzi (Amaholo kanye nezinsiza). Yenza izibalo zamanani ezehla noma eziphakeme kweziholo. Lawula ukukhokhelwa kwezinkokhelo ezikhishiwe kumaholo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokuphepha kwamafayela weziholo. Phatha ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesigaba.

xh.title: Mphathi wolwelo lwezimali zelizwe: Ulawulo lomvuzo kunye
xh.summary: Kufunekho mphathi wolwelo lwezimali zelizwe ozakulawula nahlawule imali yemivuzo, izahlulelo kunye nezahlulelo ezongezelelweyo/ezingalunganga kwisebe le Department of Community Safety and Transport Management eMmabatho.
xh.requirements: Matric okanye elinganayo. Degree okanye diploma yeminyaka emithathu (3) kwFinancial Management, Accounting (NQF6/7) okanye isiganga esilinganayo esineno-Accounting njengemodyule. Emva kwamava eminyaka elithathu (3) ukuya kwelihlanu (5) kwimeko yolawulo lomvuzo apho iminyaka emibini (2) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba labalawuli. Kufunekwe isatifikethi se-Introduction to PERSAL nesatifikethi solawulo lomvuzo. Isatifikethi se-Tax calculations 1 siza kuba yoncedo. Ulwazi: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury regulations. Financial Manual, Basic Conditions of Employment Act kunye ne-Guide on Managing Departmental Debt. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha – Word, Excel kunye ne-PowerPoint kubalulekile. Ulwazi lokusebenza lweenkcubo zahulumendi (PERSAL). Amandla: Unxibelelwano (elubhalwe noluthethwayo), uqhathaniso komntu nomntu. Ukuqhwbeza-njengakunye kunye nomsebenzi wothiyo. Amandla ekhompyutheni, uqokelelo, kunye nokulungelelanisa. Amandla okulawula iingxabano. Uzibophelele okuququmbela iziphumo, kwaye kufuneka akwazi ukunika iziphumo ngexesha lokuxinzelela.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuhlawulwa kwabasebenzi (Imivuzo kunye neemali ezongezelelweyo). Yenza iimbalo ezahlulelo ezongezelelweyo/ezingalunganga zemivuzo. Lawula izahlulelo ezintlo ezithathwa kumivuzo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokhuseleko kweefayile zemivuzo. Lawula inkqubela phambili yabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwento.

af.requirements: Matric (Grade 12) sertifikaat plus 'n drie (3) jarige graad of nasionale diploma in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur/Openbare Bestuur (NQF6/7). Een (1) tot twee (2) jare relevante ervaring. zu.title: Umenzi wezomsebenzi wabantu (ezokuPhila kanye neMvelo
zu.summary: Phatha ukukhishwa komholo ngenxa yokungaphatheki, ukuphumela emsebenzini ngenxa yegula kanye nezinkomba ezimalwe emsebenzini kusetshenziswa i-PERSAL e-Department of Community Safety and Transport Management e-Mmabatho.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Matric (Grade 12) kahle nesiqu sobuDegree eminyaka emithathu (3) noma i-National Diploma kwi-Human Resource Management/Public Management (NQF6/7). Unyaka (1) kuya konyaka (2) wokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nalesi sikhundla. Kudingeka isitifiketi se-PERSAL ku-leave Administration. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nokukhishwa komholo ngenxa yokungaphatheki nokuphumela emsebenzini ngenxa yegula e-Public Service, i-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, i-BCEA ne-Labour Relations Act. Ulwazi lwe-DPSA mayelana nokuPhila komsebenzi kanye ne-Strategic Framework of 2008. Amakhono: Amakhono okuhlela noqhutshwa. Amakhono okuxhumana ahle, amakhono okubetha izinhlelo kanye nobudlelwano obuhle nabantu, nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa kokukhishwa komholo ngenxa yokungaphatheki, ukuphumela emsebenzini ngenxa yegula, nezilimiselo ezimalwe emsebenzini. Ukuqopha ulwazi mayelana nezilimiselo ezimalwe emsebenzini, izifo kanye namafomula we-invoice kwi-PERSAL. Nikela ngemibono ekuyona yamukele i-Head of Department bese uphatha iziphetho zesicelo somsebenzi sokukhishwa komholo ngenxa yokungaphatheki nokuphumela emsebenzini ngenxa yegula. Ugqoze irejista yezicelo ezihlanganiswe nomsebenzi namafomula we-invoice. Nikela ngesekelo lophatho ku-Sub-Directorate: Integrated Employee Health and Wellness. Siza ekuhleleni futhi uqhutshwe izinkalo zokuqeqeshwa endaweni yokusebenza.

xh.summary: Lawula iholide yokungakwazi ukusebenza, okuthunyelwa emhlalweni ngenxa yokugula, neesikhalazo ezimalunga nomsebenzi kusetyenziswa i-PERSAL eKwindla loLuntu oluneKhuseleko noLawulo loThutho eMmabatho.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi se-Matric (Grade 12) esongezelelwe kwisidanga seminyaka emithathu (3) i-Degree okanye i-National Diploma kwiHuman Resource Management/Public Management (NQF6/7). Unyaka omnye (1) kumaxesha amabini (2) amava ahambelana nendlela. Kufuneka kube nesatifikethi se-PERSAL kwi-Leave Administration. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olulolu ngeholide yokungakwazi ukusebenza nokuThunyelwa emhlalweni ngenxa yokugula kuRhulumente, i-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act, i-BCEA neLabour Relations Act.
