af.title: Rekeningklerk Toesighouer: Provinsiale Registrering
af.summary: Hou toesig oor motorvoertuigregistrasie en -lisensieringdienste, insluitend inkomstesameling en -rekening, by 'n registrerende owerheid in die Noordwes-provinsie.
af.requirements: Matric/Grade 12 of ekwivalent. Drie (3) – Vyf (5) jaar relevante ervaring in 'n NaTIS-motorvoertuigadministrasie-omgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede/Kennis/Vaardighede: Kennis en begrip van die National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, Public Finance Management Act, Treasury Regulations en ander Openbare Diens-verwante wetgewing. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Uitstekende tydbestuurvaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid, probleemoplossing en vermoë om in 'n span sowel as onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Lewer die toesig oor dienste by die registrerende owerheid. Administreer die registrasie en lisensiering van motorvoertuie. Bestuur die sameling van inkomste vir die registrasie en lisensiering van motorvoertuie. Voer daaglikse en maandelikse rekening van NaTIS-inkomstesameling uit. Administreer die sameling en toewysing van nominale waarde-dokumente. Verseker nakoming van die National Road Traffic Act. Stel Sensitiewe Transaksieversoeke op in ooreenstemming met die NaTIS-Helpdesk-vereistes. Verseker dat alle NaTIS-toerusting en materiaal te alle tye beskikbaar is. Hou toesig oor die werkverrigting en ontwikkeling van personeel by die registrerende owerheid. Stel maandelikse finansiële en nie-finansiële verslae op. Hou toesig oor die sleutelverantwoordelikhede van personeel.

zu.title: Umphathi WomKhiqizi WezokuBala: UkuBhalisa KweSifundazwe
zu.summary: Qapha izinkonzo zokubhalisa nokuGunyazwa kwemoto, okubandakanya ukuqoqa imali engenayo kanye nokuqathanisa, esikhungweni sokubhalisa eNorth West province.
zu.requirements: I-Matric/Grade 12 noma okulinganayo. Ezimqondo (3) – ezinhlanu (5) iminyaka yemfundo yamava ahambisanayo emhlabeni we-NaTIS Motor Vehicle Administration. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono/ulwazi/izindidi: Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda kwe-National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Treasury Regulations kanye nenye iLegislation ehambisana nePublic Service. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcinsocko. Izindidi ezinhle zokuxhumana ngokubhala nangokukhuluma. Izindidi ezinhle zokuphatha isikhathi. Izindidi zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nenyengo lokusebenza ohlwini kanye nokusebenza wedwa.
zu.duties: Nika isiqondiso kwezinkonzo ngaphakathi kwesikhungweni sokubhalisa. Phatha ukubhalisa nokugunyazwa kwezimoto. Phatha ukuqoqa imali engenayo yokubhalisa nokugunyazwa kwemoto. Yenza ukuqathanisa kwansuku zonke kany nenyanga yokuqoqa imali engenayo ye-NaTIS. Phatha ukuqoqa kanye nokuqashwa kwemibhalo enobuningwane. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwe-National Road Traffic Act. Hlela izicelo Zezinto Eziyimfihlo ngokuvumelana nezidingo ze-NaTIS Help desk. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke amapulatifomu kanye nezinto ze-NaTIS ayatholakala noma yinini. Qapha ukusebenza kanye nentuthuko yabasebenzi esikhungweni sokubhalisa. Hlela imibalo yenyanga yezimali kanye neyengabuyi imali. Qapha izibopho eziyisihluthulelo zabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umphathi wabasebenzi abangabagcini bakhadi: UkuBhaliswa koluntu
xh.summary: Qondisa iinkonzo zokubhalisa nokunika amalayisensi izithuthi zokuhamba, kuquki ukuqokelela imali yokungena nokwabelana ngayo, kwiziko logunyaziso lokubhalisa kwiphondo le North West.
xh.requirements: I-Matric/IsiGqebelo 12 okanye into efanayo. Iminyaka elithathu (3) – elihlanu (5) yamava ahambelanayo kwendawo ye-NaTIS yoLawulo lwezithuthi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Iakhono/ulwazi/amakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda umthetho we-National Road Traffic Act 93 ka-1996, umthetho we-Public Finance Management Act, iZiga zeTreasury namanye oMthetho ahambelanayo noLawulo loLuntu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Amakhoni amabalise ahle nokuwabhala. Ikhono elihle lokulawula ixesha. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukusombulula iingxaki nakhono lokusebenza njengesithiyo nakuzimele.
xh.duties: Phatha ulawulo lweenkonzo kwiziko logunyaziso lokubhalisa. Lawula ukubhalisa nokunika amalayisensi izithuthi zokuhamba. Lawula ukuqokelelwa kwemali yokubhalisa nokunika amalayisensi izithuthi zokuhamba. Yenza ukwabelana kwemali yonke ngenyanga eyeqokelelwe kwi-NaTIS. Lawula ukuqokelelwa nokwabiwa kwamaxwebhu anexabiso elifanayo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho we-National Road Traffic Act. Hlenga iimfuno ze-Sensitive Transaction Requests ngokwemfuno ye-NaTIS Help desk. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iixelo nezinto zokusebenza ze-NaTIS zikho ngalo lonke ixesha. Qondisa ukusebenza nokuphuhlisa abasebenzi kwiziko logunyaziso lokubhalisa. Hlenga iingxelo zenyanga zemali nangaphandle kwemali. Qondisa iimfuno ezibalulekileyo zabasebenzi.

zu.title: Umphathi Womlondolozi Wabaluleki Bantu: Isimiso REF. NO
zu.summary: Qaphatha isimiso somtholampilo kanye nokwesekwa kwabathengi eNorth West Head Office, kugcinwe imininingwane ye-PERSAL kanye nesakhiwo sezikhundla.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12 noma esingenye idi elinganayo esinolwangomsebenzi wezinyanga ezintathu (3) kuya kwezinhlanu (5) sifunekayo ekwesekweni kwabathengi kwezabaluleki bantu kanye nokuphatwa kweisimiso. Isifingqo se-Introduction to PERSAL, PERSAL Establishment kanye ne-PERSAL Personnel Administration Certificate. Ulwazi: Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda isixhumanisi somthetho esibusa I-Public Service Regulation, I-Public Service Act. Ukuqonda isixhumanisi somthetho nesimiso somthetho esibusu ukuphatwa kwezabaluleki bantu kanye ne-PERSAL. Ukuhlaziya izibalo kanye nokubhala idatha (File transfer protocol, kudonswa idatha kwi-PERSAL iyafakwa ku-Excel) Amafuzu: Okukhulunywa nokubhalwa, izimilo zomuntu, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxazulula izinkinga namafuzu okuhlaziya. Ukucubungula kanye nokuhlela, Ukusebenza njengaqhikiza, Ukuguquguquka nokuxazulula izinkinga
zu.duties: Gcina futhi ubuyekeze isimiso sezikhundla kanye nokuzinza kwemininingwane eNyuvesi. Nikezela ukwesekwa kwabathengi be-HRM bongaphakathi nangaphandle. Bhala wonke amathuluzi e-isimiso ku-PERSAL. Bhala ukubekwa kwebasebenzi ngokwesakhiwo esamukelekwe eNyuvesini. Yakha futhi ulungise isikhundla esimisweni ngokwesakhiwo esamukelekwe eNyuvesini ukuze usihlobanise ngendlela elifanele. Lungiselela imibiko yesimiso, izibalo kanye nokuthumelana kwemibhalo.

Isatifikethi seIntroduction to PERSAL, iPERSAL Establishment nePERSAL Personnel Administration. Ulwazi: Ulwazi nokuqonda ngesiseko sezomthetho esilawula iPublic Service Regulation, iPublic Service Act. Ukuqonda ngesiseko sezomthetho nolawulo esilawula uLawulo lweNtomziyo yabaSebenzi nakuPERSAL. af.title: Administrasiebeampte: Geslagsfokuspunt en Diversiteit

Twee (2) tot Drie (3) jaar werkservaring in spesiale program/Geslagsfokuspunt en Diversiteitsbestuursomgewing. Kennis: Deeglike kennis van relevante wetgewing en beleide, Transformasie-agenda in die staatsdiens, kennis van Internasionale konvensies/ooreenkomste oor teikengroepe. Vaardighede: Uitstekende kommunikasie (skriftelik en mondeling) vaardighede, goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, bewese aanbiedingsvaardighede, finansiële bestuurs- en leierskapsvaardighede, projekbestuursvaardighede, Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS word, MS Power point, Ms Excel), monitering en evaluering en rapporteringsvaardighede, vermoë om navorsing te doen, projekbestuurs- en administratiewe vaardighede, goeie organisatoriese vaardighede, Menslike verhoudingsvaardighede, probleemoplossing en konflikoplossingsvaardighede, diens- en resultaatgerig. zu.title: Ofisa Oqondiswa Izindaba Zolawulo: Indawo Yokuqala Yezocansi Nohlobolwangu Nenzono
zu.summary: Kudingeka Ofisa Oqondiswa Izindaba Zolawulo e North West Head Office ukuba acothe izinhlelo zocansi, uhlobolwangu nenzele yomsebenzi.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samakadeyidi (12) noma okulingana naso, kanye nediploma yezinkathi ezintathu (3) ezingaba i-Diploma Yezwe / i-Bachelors Degree kwi-Public Management & Governance, Humanitarian Studies, Psychology, Social Sciences (NQF6/7), isitifiketi kwi-Gender/Youth Development/ Disability studies noma enkundleni efanayo. Ubudala bobuchwepheshe bomuntu oqashwe bona bufana nobungange minyaka yamabili (2) kuya kwamathathu (3) umsebenzi ohlotshaniswa nenhlelo ekhethekile/Indawo Yokuqala Yezocansi nokuphathwa kwenzele. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluhle ngezimiso zomthetho kanye nemithetho ekhona, igenda leguquko kusebenzahulumeni, ulwazi ngemivumelano yamazwe ngamazwe/izinkomba ngamagembu abizwe ngamekhaya kanye. Ikhono: Ikhono elihle (nokuswafuthwa nangokunengqa) kokuqopha inqwaba nangokubhala, ukubelwa komuntu oethukile kusizo, ikhono elavela ngokusuka esiqhingini, ukuqashwa komuzi futhi nengxenye yokubaluleka, khono lokuphatha izinkwazi, ukuaziswa amakhompyutha (MS word, MS Power point, Ms Excel), ukuqashwa ukunconywa ngokuphathwa kwesimo futhi nangomkhankaso wokuqaphela, ikhono lokwenza ucwaningqangi, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga nokuphathwa, ikhono lokuhlehla ukwenza umsebenzi, ukuxhumanisa abantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga namakhosi, ukubhukuda nangeziphumo. Ikhono lokuphela kwamathemu nokukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi koxandilelwe futhi nangaphansi kwesibhaxu. Ikhono lokuqopha amakheli kubika kanye nezinkampani. Ikhono lokusebenza eyedwa futhi nangaphakathi kweqembu.
zu.duties: Guqulela ukusetshenziswa kwenhlela Yocansi, isuke, izingane, abantu abadala futhi nabo Abahlulekile. Xhumanisa ukusetshenziswa kwenzele yomsebenzi KumnYAngeni. Nikela ngokusekelwa kokulawula ukuphathwa kokubhukuda emhlanganweni wokuguqula nenhlela yokuqaphela kanye nezinkundla. Guqulela futhi ukhombise izinhlela zokuguquleka kanye nokuthuthukiswa okuwumsebenzi wokungenelela. Sekele ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlela zokuguqula kanye nemisebenzi. Guqulela, qaphela futhi uhlole ngokufinyeleleka kwemithetho, izinhlela, izindlela futhi ize imigomo yomNyAngo esetshenzisiwe.

xh.summary: Kufuneka kwenzeke iofisa lolawulo e North West Head Office ukuze kwenziwe udibaniso lweenkqubo zoluntu, kuhlonipheke imithetho yabasebenzi ekhankanywe ngokwexesha kwinkqubo yabo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi senqanaba lesi-12 okanye esingangaso, kanjalo nediploma yelizwe zeminyaka mithathu (3) / idigri yeBachelors kwi Public Management & Governance, izifundo zeHumanitarian, iPsychology, izifundo zeSocial Sciences (NQF6/7), isatifikethi kwiifilimu zobugcisa/ukuthetha koluntu iGender/Youth Development/Disability studies okwisele ndawo. Ulwazi lweminyaka mithathu (3) kumsebenzi wemiko yokukhetha kwinkqubo yekhompyutha/indawo yoluntu kwimixholo yoluntu ekhankanyiweyo. Ulwazi: Ukuba nolwazi oluhle ngemithetho nemigaqo ekhankanyiweyo, iTransformation agenda kumthetho wakawonke-wonke, nolwazi ngemithetho yamazwe ngamazwe/ivumba ukugcina iinkqubo zeGender/Youth Development/Disability studies. Ikhono: Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelwana (elibhalwayo nelithethayo), ukuba namandla okunxibelelwana nabantu, ikhono elikhankanyiweyo lokubonelela ngesaziso, ulawulo lwezimali namandla okukhokela, ikhono lokulawula inkqubo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS word, MS Power point, Ms Excel), ukulawula nokuhlola nokubika ngokuchanekileyo, ukuba namandla okuphanda ngokutsha, ukulawula inkqubo nokulawula abantu, ukwazi ukulungelelanisa izinto, ukuba namandla okwenza ubudlelwane, namandla okusombulula iingxaki ezithile, ukubandakanya kubandakanya izinto ezichanekileyo. Ukuba namandla okugqibela imisebenzi ngexesha elichaziweyo nokusebenza ngaphantsi kwengxaki. Ikhono lokulungiselela iingxelo neengcamango. Ikhono lokusebenza eyedwa nakwisikhululo seenkokeli.

Kubandakanywe inkxaso yolawulo ekuphumezeni iinkqubo ezikwimigaqo yendalo ekhankanyiweyo. Kubandakanywe nokubonelela iinkqubo ezingangenwa mntu nokuzimisela kwezempumelelo ezichanekileyo. Kubandakanywe inkxaso ekuphumezeni iinkqubo zoluntu ekhankanyiweyo. Kubandakanywe ukulawula, ukuqwalasela nokuhlola ngokuphumeza imigaqo, iinkqubo, iindlela ezichanekileyo neendawo ekhankanyiweyo kwicandelo.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (INTERNAL Medicine)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: A medical specialist in internal medicine is sought for George Regional Hospital to deliver quality clinical services across the Rural East Ecosystem.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or a recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of a foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Internal Medicine. Inherent requirement of the job: Performing commuted overtime and participation in the after-hours call system. A valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license as well as willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good work etiquette; excellent communication skills; conflict management; cost conscious care provision. Good technology and computer skills; problem-solving experience; leadership and mentoring experience. Performance of audits, research and publications. Experience in teaching, conducting and supervising research. Proven knowledge of public health policies, guidelines and related prescript to manage resources effectively.
jobs.duties: Render an efficient, cost-effective high quality Internal Medicine service to patients managed by the hospital and district as the Rural East Ecosystem, by balancing throughput with quality. Always deliver service with professional and ethical behaviour. Assist with effective and efficient administration of the Internal Medicine Department. Assist the Head of Department with specific projects relating to Antibiotic Stewardship, PPTC, Critical Care and Clinical Governance. The desired candidate will be required to set an appropriate example of an exemplary medical practitioner and serve as a role model and clinical mentor to junior doctors and associated clinical staff. -Assist with unit training commitments. Ensure the rational use of resources, participate in audits and Clinical Governance activities. Participate in Outreach and Support services, as needed, to the greater Rural East Ecosystem. Ensure good relations with patients, nursing staff, colleagues and referral services at tertiary and district hospital level. Adhere to requirements for all HR matters. Do appropriate clinical audits and research within the department to stay abreast of clinical development.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Mediese Spesialis Vlak 1 tot 3 (INTERNE Geneeskunde)
af.summary: 'n Mediese spesialis in interne geneeskunde word gesoek vir George Streeks-hospitaal om gehalte kliniese dienste oor die Landelike Oos Ekosisteem te lewer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Ervaring: Vlak 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Vlak 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van 'n buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemer) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Interne Geneeskunde. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Uitvoering van verskuilde oortyd en deelname aan die buite-ure oproepstelsel. 'n Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurslisensie asook bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie werketiket; uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede; konflikbestuur; koste-bewuste sorgverskaffing. Goeie tegnologie- en rekenaarvaardighede; probleemoplossingservaring; leierskaps- en mentorskapervaring. Uitvoering van oudite, navorsing en publikasies. Ervaring in onderrig, die uitvoer en toesig hou van navorsing. Bewese kennis van openbare gesondheidsbeleid, riglyne en verwante voorskrifte om hulpbronne doeltreffend te bestuur.
af.duties: Lewer 'n doeltreffende, koste-effektiewe hoë gehalte Interne Geneeskunde-diens aan pasiënte wat deur die hospitaal en distrik as die Landelike Oos Ekosisteem bestuur word, deur deurset met gehalte te balanseer. Lewer altyd diens met professionele en etiese gedrag. Bystand verleen met doeltreffende en effektiewe administrasie van die Interne Geneeskunde Departement. Bystand verleen aan die Hoof van die Departement met spesifieke projekte rakende Antibiotiese Beheer, PPTC, Kritiese Sorg en Kliniese Bestuur. Die gesogte kandidaat sal vereis word om 'n toepaslike voorbeeld van 'n voorbeeldige mediese praktisyn te stel en as 'n rolmodel en kliniese mentor vir junior dokters en geassosieerde kliniese personeel te dien. -Bystand verleen met eenheidsopleidingsverpligtinge. Verseker die rasionale gebruik van hulpbronne, neem deel aan oudite en Kliniese Bestuur-aktiwiteite. Neem soos benodig deel aan Uitreik- en Ondersteuningsdienste tot die groter Landelike Oos Ekosisteem. Verse goeie betrekkinge met pasiënte, verpleegpersoneel, kollegas en verwysingsdienste op tersiêre en distrikshospitaalvlak. Voldoen aan vereistes vir alle HR-aangeleenthede. Doen toepaslike kliniese oudite en navorsing binne die departement om tred te hou met kliniese ontwikkeling.

zu.title: Onyengqondo Wezokwelapha Ezingeni 1 kuya ku-3 (INTERNAL Medicine)
zu.summary: Kufunwa onyengqondo wezokwelapha wemizi yangaphakathi esibhedlela iGeorge Regional Hospital ukuze anikeze izinsizakalo ezinhle zokwelapha kuyo yonke iRural East Ecosystem.
zu.requirements: Ithobana elincane lemfundo: Ithobanaelifanele elivumela ukubhaliswa kuHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengenjengqondo Yezokwelapha Emizini Yangaphakathi. Ukubhaliswa komkhandlu wezinkundla: Ukubhaliswa kuHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengonyengqondo Wezokwelapha Emizini Yangaphakathi. Isipiliyoni: IGrade 1: Akukho okunye ngemuva kokubhaliswa kuHPCSA njengonyengqondo Wezokwelapha Emizini Yangaphakathi. IGrade 2: Okuncane kweminyaka engu-5 isipiliyoni esifanele njengonyengqondo Wezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhaliswa kuHPCSA (noma omunye umkhandlu wezempilo ovunyiwe wesizwe sangaphandle mayelana nomsebenzisi othole izifundo ezweni elingaphandle) njengonyengqondo Wezokwelapha Emizini Yangaphakathi. IGrade 3: Okuncane kweminyaka engu-10 isipiliyoni esifanele njengonyengqondo Wezokwelapha ngemuva kokubhaliswa kuHPCSA (noma omunye umkhandlu wezempilo ovunyiwe wesizwe sangaphandle mayelana nomsebenzisi othole izifundo ezweni elingaphandle) njengonyengqondo Wezokwelapha Emizini Yangaphakathi. Isidingo esisusela kuleso sikundla: Ukwenza isikhathi esengeziwe sokusebenza nokubamba iqhaza kwenkqubo yokuphendwa ngemva kwezihora zokusebenza. Ilayisensi ehlayo (Code B/EB) yokushayela kanye nesifiso sokuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Isimo esihle sokusebenza; ikhono elihle lokuxhumana; ukuphathwa kwezingxabano; ukunakekelwa okunolwazi mayelana nezindleko. Ikhono elihle lobuchwepheshe nakumakhompyutha; isipiliyoniokusombulula izinkinga; isipiliyoni sobuholi nokwelisa. Ukwenza okuhlolywayo, ucwaningo nakushicilelwa. Isipiliyoni sokufundisa, ukwenza nokubuka ucwaningo. Ulwazi oluqinisekile ngemithetho yezempilo yomphakathi, imihlahambilanhlayiyana nemiyalo ehlobene nayo ukuphatha izinsiza ngendlela efanele.
zu.duties: Nika insiza yemizi yangaphakathi esebenzayo, enezindleko ezincane futhi yenhle kubaphathekwe abonakelelwa isibhedlela nedistrikthi njengeRural East Ecosystem, ngokulinganisa inani labaphathekwe nokulingana. Phela nkathi zonke unikeza insiza ngokuziphatha ngobungcweti kanye nesimo esifanele. Siza ekuphathweni okusebenzayo nakusebenza kahle komnyango Wezokwelapha Emizini Yangaphakathi. SisaNhloko womnyango ngaphrojekthi ezithize ezingezwa Ukubuka Ngokusondezile Ukusetshenziswa Kwamakhemikhali, iPPTC, Ukunakekelwa Okubalulekile noBuhlola Bemithetho Yezokwelapha. Umuntu oyisifiso uzodingwa ukuba aseke isibonelo esifanele somnyengqondo wezokwelapha onesimo esihle futhi abe yisibonelo somuntu ongumfundisi wamakhemikhali kubadokotela abasha nakubasebenzi abahlobene nalawo makhemikhali. -Siza nasezibophweni zokufundisa kuleso sikhungo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa ngokufanele kweminsiza, ukubamba iqhaza kokuqashwa kanye nemisebenzi yoBuhlola Bemithetho Yezokwelapha. Bamba iqhaza emisebenzini yokunweba nasekusizeni, njengesidingo, kwindawo enkulu yeRural East Ecosystem. Qinisekisa ubuhlobo obuhle nabaphathekwe, basebenzi bezesibhedlela, abalingani nabezinsizakalo zokuthumela ezibhedlela ezingaphezulu nasemandleni edistrikthi. Zithobele imithetho nazo zonke izindaba ze-HR. Yenza okuhlolywayo kokwelapha okufanele kanye nocwaningo umnyangweni ukuze uhlale usemhlabathini wokuthuthuka kokwelapha.

xh.title: Igcisa lokwelapha inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (INTERNAL Medicine)
xh.summary: Kufunwa igcisa lokwelapha ngaphakathi kwezemisho zeGeorge Regional Hospital ukuze kunikwe iinkonzo zobugcisa ezilunge ngokuqhubekayo kulo wonke iRural East Ecosystem.
xh.requirements: Isidanga semfundo esingaphantsi: Isifanekiso esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalwa kwiHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengegcisa lokwelapha ngaphakathi kwezemisho. Ukubhalwa kolwabiwo lwemisebenzi: Ukubhalwa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengegcisa lokwelapha ngaphakathi kwezemisho. Iminyaka yamava: Inqanaba 1: Akukho mva kokubhalwa kwiHPCSA njengegcisa lokwelapha ngaphakathi kwezemisho. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengegcisa lokwelapha emva kokubhalwa kwiHPCSA (okanye ulwabiwo lwemisebenzi yeHealth Professional yesizwe esingaphandle eliqinisekisiweyo malunga nomsebenzi onemfundo yelizwe lesingaphandle) njengegcisa lokwelapha ngaphakathi kwezemisho. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengegcisa lokwelapha emva kokubhalwa kwiHPCSA (okanye ulwabiwo lwemisebenzi yeHealth Professional yesizwe esingaphandle eliqinisekisiweyo malunga nomsebenzi onemfundo yelizwe lesingaphandle) njengegcisa lokwelapha ngaphakathi kwezemisho. Iminyaka yemisebenzi edityaniswe nenyani: Ukwenza iqondo lesikhathi sokusebenza esidluleyo nokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokubiza kwangemva kwamaxa. Ilayiseni eseyinyaniso (Code B/EB) kwaye ulungele ukuhamba. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Indlela elungileyo yokusebenza; amakhono obuqhawule ubuchwepheshe; ulawulwe kolwenzakalo; ukunikela ngezinto ngokugcina iindleko. Amakhono amakhulu kunye nekhompyutha; amava okusombulula iingxaki; amava obuqhawe nokuqeqesha abanye. Ukwenza ukuqokelela ulwazi, uphando noshicilelo. Amava ekufundiseni, ekwenzeni ekunokulawulwa uphando. Ulwazi oluchaziweyo ngeenkqubo zamazwe abantu, iindlela zokulungelelanisa nemigaqo egcabene nokuLawula amathuba.
xh.duties: Nika inkonzo esebenzayo, efanele ngexabiso nakhona lelilungileyo inqanaba lokwelapha kwiziguli ezilawulwa isibhedlele nommandla njengesebe leRural East Ecosystem, ngokulinganisa isiphithiphithi nomgangatho. Nika inkonzo nge nkqubo yobugcisa nomzekelo ongafaneleyo yonke imihla. Uncede ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangokulawula iSebe leInternal Medicine. Uncede uNtshaba weSebe ngeendaba ezithile ezidalwe ngokuLawulwa ii-antibiotic, PPTC, iZemilo ePhambili nomLawulo weZempilo. Iqela elifunwayo liza kufuneka linike umzekelo ofanelekileyo ngomprakthikhali wezempilo ongummiselo oqondileyo, abe ngumqeqeshi wezempilo kubagqatsha bezempilo abancinane kwaye abe ngumqeqeshi wobugcisa kubasebenzi bezempilo abaqhagamshelanayo. -Uncede ngeenkqubo zokubhalisa kwisiphelo sendalo esikwiRural East Ecosystem. Qinisekisa ukusebenzisa amathuba ngokufanelekileyo, thatha inxaxheba kuqokelelo lwangoku kunye nemicimbi yeClinical Governance. Thathe inxaxheba kwiinkonzo zokubuyisela ngenkxaso, njengoko kufuneka, kwianqalo ezingakumbi zeRural East Ecosystem. Qinisekisa ubuhlobo obulungileyo neziguli, oogqirha bezempilo, oogqirha bayo kwakhona nakwiinkonzo ezibhekisa kwisibhedlele samabanga aphezulu kwaye ezingasekelwa. Landela iimfuno zamaphulo okuLawula uMntu wonke. Yenza izikhulumi ezingcali kwezempilo kunye nophando kwisiphelo sendalo esikwiRural East Ecosystem ukuze uhlale ulandele inkqubela phambili.

Teaching, training and supervision of junior medical staff and students with participation in the hospital academic program as well as outreach supervision to primary health care nurse practitioners. Domain specific outputs and participation within the KESS ecosystem, including participation in and alignment with district-hospital-level services, referral facilities and Mental Health Care Review Board liaison.

Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis in Psigiatrie, na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot 'n buitlands gekwalifiseerde werknemer). Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis in Psigiatrie, na registrasie by die HPCSA (of 'n erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council met betrekking tot 'n buitlands gekwalifiseerde werknemer). Vermoë om hoëgehalte spesialisvlak kliniese sorg in die ontslag- en buitepasiëntomgewing te lewer, insluitend goeie kennis van wetgewing en beleid, mediese rekordhouding, verslagskrywing en rekenaargeletterdheid. Vermoë om die uitsette van 'n groot kliniese werklading te balanseer met die onderrig- en toesigvereistes van die pos. Sterk administratiewe, bestuurs-, kommunikasie- en konflikbeslegtingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Kliniese dienslewering op spesialisvlak oor die volle spektrum van distriksvlak Psigiatrie, insluitend sale, buitepasiënte, Emergency Centre en gespesialiseerde klinieke by Khayelitsha Distrikshospitaal. Onderrig, opleiding en toesig oor junior mediese personeel en studente met deelname aan die hospitaal se akademiese program asook uitreiktoesig aan primêre gesondheidsorgverpleegkundiges. zu.title: Isikhundla sezokwelapha esiyinga 1 kusiya kwesiyinga 3 (IZIFUNDO ZENGQONDO)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umuntu ozelelwe isikhundla sezokwelapha ezifundeni zengqondo e-Khayelitsha District Hospital, Western Cape, ukuze anikeze izinsizakalo ze-clinical ezifundeni zengqondo ezingeni lesikhundla kanye nokulawula izinto ze-clinical kuyo yonke isifunda.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphansi eziyisidingo: I-qualification efanele evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa njengomuntu ozelelwe isikhundla sezokwelapha ezifundeni zengqondo. Ukubhaliswa kwi-professional council: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA, njengomuntu ozelelwe isikhundla sezokwelapha ezifundeni zengqondo. Isipiliyoni: Grade 1: Akukho okudingekayo ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomuntu ozelelwe isikhundla sezokwelapha ezifundeni zengqondo. Grade 2: Ubuncane beminyaka emi-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengomuntu ozelelwe isikhundla sezokwelapha ezifundeni zengqondo, ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (noma i-foreign Health Professional Council eqashelwe mayelana nomsebenzi oqeqeswe kwelinye izwe). Grade 3: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njengomuntu ozelelwe isikhundla sezokwelapha ezifundeni zengqondo, ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (noma i-foreign Health Professional Council eqashelwe mayelana nomsebenzi oqeqeswe kwelinye izwe). Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Isipiliyono se-clinical ezifundeni zengqondo emazingeni ezinsizakalo yesifunda kanye nokuqwasha kwezempilo yomphakathi kuqala. Ikhono lokunikeza ukunakekelwa kwe-clinical okwenani eliphezulu esimeni sokungena esibhedlela nasenkundleni yokuhlinzeka abagulayo bangaphandle, okuhlanganisa ulwazi oluhle nge-mithetho kanye namapholisi, ukugcina irekhodi yezokwelapha, ukubhala imibiko kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokulinganisa imiphumela yomthwalo wemisebenzi omkhulu we-clinical nezidingo zokufundisa kanye nokuhlola. Amakhono amakhulu okuphatha, okubusa, okuxhumana kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo ze-clinical enkingeni yesikhundla kuyo yonke imikhakha yezifundo zengqondo emazingeni esifunda, okuhlanganisa amawadi, abagulayo bangaphandle, i-Emergency Centre kanye namakiliniki akhethekile e-Khayelitsha District Hospital. Ukuphatha kanye nokulawula izinto ze-clinical okuhlanganisa ukubusa, inqubo yokuphatha abantu, ukuphatha i-OPD, ukuhlaziya idatha, kanye nokuthuthukisa izinga. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha kanye nokuhlola osohleki bezokwelapha abasha kanye nabafundi ngokubamba iqhaza ohlelweni le-academic lesibhedlela kanye nokuhlola ukusiza abasebenzi besiqophe kwezempilo yomphakathi abanakekela ngqondo. Imiphumela ethile ekule minyakazo nokubamba iqhaza ngaphakathi kwesimiso se-KESS, okuhlanganisa ukubamba iqhaza kanye nokuhambisana nezinsizakalo emazingeni esibhedlela lesifunda, iziteshi zokuqondisa kanye nokuxhumana ne-Mental Health Care Review Board.

xh.title: Igcwele leMizi yezEzonyango eliseQophelweni 1 ukuya ku-3 (Izilumkiso ngokusesikweni)
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe igcwele leMizi yezEzonyango elingasese kwisibhedlele saKhayelitsha District, eWestern Cape, ukunika iinkonzo ezisesikweni zonyango lwengqondo nokulawula izinto zonyango kweloxeshwa lonke.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokufunda esingaphantsi kwexesha elifanelekileyo: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwisiBhunga seeNyaniso ezeMizi yezEzonyango saseMzantsi Afrika njengogcwele leMizi yezEzonyango kulwangesikweni. Ukubhalisa kwibhunga lenyaniso: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA, njengogcwele leMizi yezEzonyango kulwangesikweni. Isiphaluka: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengogcwele leMizi yezEzonyango kulwangesikweni. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengogcwele leMizi yezEzonyango kulwangesikweni, emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye isiBhunga seNyaniso seeMizi yezEzonyango saselwandle esiqaphelekileyo malunga nomsebenzisi oqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe). Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo njengogcwele leMizi yezEzonyango kulwangesikweni, emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye isiBhunga seNyaniso seeMizi yezEzonyango saselwandle esiqaphelekileyo malunga nomsebenzisi oqeqeshiweyo kwamanye amazwe). Iimpawu zokuqonda ulwazi (ulwazi/izakhono): Amanqaku obuchule ngonyango lwengqondo ezingeni loxeshwa kwinkonzo yezempilo yokusingathwa ngamagumbi. Ikhono lokunika inkonzo yonyango olusesikweni lwegcwele lobuchule kwisimo sabaguli bokuhlala nasebungeni, kuquka ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho nemigaqo, ukugcina irekhedi yonyango, ukubhala iingxelo nokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ikhono lokulinganisa imveliso yomthwalo omkhulu wenyango nezifiso zokufundisa nokhuseleko lwendawo. Izakhono ezomeleleyo zolawulo, zokulawula abantu, zokunxibelelana nezokuzisa uxolo ekuxabeni.
xh.duties: Ukuhlinzwa ngokonyango kwinkonzo kwizinga logcwele kwizigaba zonke zonyango lwengqondo kwindawo yokusingathwa ngamagumbi, kuquuka iindawana zokulala, abaguli abangangenanga, iNdawo yeSangqa kunye namagumbi akhethekileyo kwisibhedlele saKhayelitsha District. Ulawulo nolawulo lonyango okuquka ukulawula, iinkqubo zoLawulo lwabantu, ulawulo lwe-OPD, ukuhlalutya iingxelo, nokuphucula umgangatho. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha nokukhusela oonyango abasezantsi nabafundi kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yezemfundo yesibhedlele, kunye nokukhusela ngokunyuka kubasebenzi bezempilo bokusingathwa ngamagumbi. Iimveliso ezikhethekileyo zendawo kunye nokuthatha inxaxheba ngaphakathi kwendalo ye-KESS, kuquka ukuthatha inxaxheba nokulungelelanisa iinkonzo zenga yesibhedlele sezeshwa, iindawo ezithumela kwezinye iindawo nokunxibelelana neBhunga loNgcineliso lokuNyangwa lweMpngqeleko.

Isidingo esingakubekiwe somsebenzi: Ilayisensi evumelekile (i-Code B/EB) yokushayela, ukuthanda kanye namandla okuhamba. Kulindeleke ukuba umuntu ophumelelayo athathe inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokusebenza isikhathi esingaphezu kwesokudini okuhlawulelwayo kanye nenhlelo yokuphuma kumminzimu. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhombi): Amandla okuphatha kanye nokubika ngazo zonke izifundo nezinqubo zokuhlola emzimbeni. Ukuhamba ngenhlelo yokuzifunda kwimisebenzi ye-radiology yamathambo nemitshumbulu. Ukusebenza nqokuqotho nomgwaqo kubasebenzi bezibhedlela ukuphucula izinsizakalo zomuntu. Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda ngomthetho ofanele, izinqubo nezinkambiso zesibhedlela. Ukubhala kanye nokuqamba izindaba kahle ngomlomo nangezandla.
zu.duties: Ukwenza izinsizakalo zokuthi kubonwe ngokusetha izithombe nokubika ngazo zonke izinhlobo zokuthi kubonwe izithombe. Qinisekisa ukuthi kugcinwe amazinga okunakekelwa kwezinga eliphezulu kuzinsizakazo ze-radiology. Hola abantu, ukufundisa, ukulungiselela nokubuka umsebenzi owenziwe abantu. Ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo ngendlela ephumelelayo, ukuphatha izimpahla, izinto ezisetyenziswa kanye nezinsizakalo ngokusebenza kahle.

Ukuba mgangatho weziqu wokuqonda izinto ezahlukeneyo ezimayela neRADIOLOGY ezingakalungiswa ngenkqubo yamava aqeqeshe abantu nokuqeqesha abasebenzi ngokwemigaqo eyahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngokomthetho ochanekileyo ngokubeka ingcali yengcamango echitha ulwazi olwenziweyo ngolwimi nengcamango ebhaliweyo, kwaye enako ukusebenza nabasebenzi bayo ukwenza inkqubo eyahlukeneyo ethetha ngobuchwepheshe bomsebenzi ochithwa kumaxesha ethutyana.

Khokela abasebenzi, ukufundisa, ukuqeqesha kwaye ulawule abasebenzi. Ukusetyenziswa ngokusebenza kolwabiwo lwento, ukulawula izinto ezingenangxwelo, ezingakwazi ukuhlelwa ngenkqubo yamava aqeqesha abantu.

zu.title: Isekhelathi Sezokwelapha Izinga 1 kuye ku-3 (I-PSYCHIATRY)
zu.summary: Kufunwa Isekhelathi Sezokwelapha ezobungqondakazi eGroote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, okunikeza izinkonzo zezokwelapha ezobungqondakazi kanye nokuhlakanipha abasebenzi abancane.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingavunyelwe ukuthi zibe ngaphansi kwalolu hla: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesekhelathi sezokwelapha ezobungqondakazi. Ukubhaliswa kolungu olunemvume: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesekhelathi sezokwelapha ezobungqondakazi. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile ngemva kokuvalwa kwefayela kwi-HPCSA njengesekhelathi sezokwelapha ezobungqondakazi. Izinga 2: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-5 isipiliyoni esifanele njengesekhelathi sezokwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (noma ikhonseli yamaphrofeshinali ezempilo yezizwe ezingamukelekile mayelana nomuntu oqashiwe oqeqeshewe kwelinye ilizwe) njengesekhelathi sezokwelapha ezobungqondakazi. Izinga 3: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-10 isipiliyoni esifanele njengesekhelathi sezokwelapha ngemva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA (noma ikhonseli yamaphrofeshinali ezempilo yezizwe ezingamukelekile mayelana nomuntu oqashiwe oqeqeshewe kwelinye ilizwe) njengesekhelathi sezokwelapha ezobungqondakazi. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Isevisi yokusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi esijwayelekile iyadingeka. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi nethemba eliqinile lokwelapha nesipiliyoni ekuhloleni, ukufunda isimo nesimo sokwelapha ngolwazi olusekelwe ngobufakazi bokuphathwa kwezifo zomqondo ezingaleso sikhathi noma ezihlala njalo kuzo zombili izigodlo zokungena abagulayo noma ezingangeni. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo, okubandakanya ulwazi nge-MHCA. Ikhono eliqinile lokuxhumana nabantu, ukubeka ibhodi nokuba ngumholi, elikhono lokuhlanganisa nokuphatha iqembu elihlangene nemikhakha ehlukene. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuqeqesha nokuhlakanipha ngokwelapha, okufanelekile enkohleni yokukhula kwamakhosi nezifundo zabafundi. Ulwazi ngesu lokucingisisa kanye nenqubo yokuhlola ukusebenza ngokwelapha, elikhono lokuhlola ngokujulile nokwenza ucwaningo lokwelapha. Isipiliyono esiqinile sokuhlulela ngokwelapha nokuthatha izinqumo, elikhono lokumela umnyango noma iqembu emakomiti anamakhono ahlukene futhi aphatha izinkonzo zokwelapha.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesisevisi sezokwelapha, okubandakanya ukugadela iziguli ezingangeni ezobungqondakazi kanye nesevisi ye-ECT e-GSH. Nikela ngesisevisi sezokwelapha, okubandakanya ukugadela nokuba ngumholi wezinsimbi zokungena nokungangeni kwabagulayo ezitholakala kwisifunda sezempilo yomqondo i-Klipfontein. Ukufundisa, ukuqeqesza nokuhlakanipha abasebenzi abancane, okubandakanya owayini nabafundi. Izinhlelo zocwaning olusekelwe kwisipiliyoni zokwelapha nokuhlola ukusebenza. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nangempumelelo kurekhodi lezokwelapha nemibiko yomuntu ophethwe yisimo sakhe. Ukusekela uMkhulu webhodi kanye noMkhulu weQembu leSisevisi Yokwelapha ekufezeniseni imithetho yonke isisevisi, okubandakanya ukumela iBhodi e-GSH PTC.

xh.title: Isigqibo Sokwelapha Isigaba 1 ukuya ku-3 (ISIFO SOKUQONDA)
xh.summary: Kufunwa isigqibo sokwelapha esimkhathini wesifo sokuqonda kwi-Groote Schuur Hospital, Observatory, sibonelela iinkonzo ezingqonge eziklinishi kwisifo sokuqonda kwaye siphethe abasebenzi abangabaningi.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifunekayo ezingaphantsi kwesiqinto: Isifundo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesigqibo sokwelapha esimkhathini wesifo sokuqonda. Ukubhalisa koluntu olungamagcisa: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesigqibo sokwelapha esimkhathini wesifo sokuqonda. Ishishini: Isigaba 1: Akukho nto kuyure emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesigqibo sokwelapha esimkhathini wesifo sokuqonda. Isigaba 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka engu-5 yeshishini elifanelekileyo njengesigqibo sokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye iqumrhu elazisiweyo lezempilo yoluntu lwezizwe kumsebenzi oswele izifundo ezingamazwe) njengesigqibo sokwelapha esimkhathini wesifo sokuqonda. Isigaba 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka engu-10 yeshishini elifanelekileyo njengesigqibo sokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye iqumrhu elazisiweyo lezempilo yoluntu lwezizwe kumsebenzi oswele izifundo ezingamazwe) njengesigqibo sokwelapha esimkhathini wesifo sokuqonda. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukusebenza ngeyure evela kumvuzo ngaphandle kuyinyani. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi namakhono olona lokulingelesi, ukuyinika isigqibo nendlela yokuphatha ngesibhalo izifo ezingqonge nangaphakathi kwindlu yamayeza ezingahlaliyo nendawo yamayeza enganayo. Ukulawula kwakhona ulwiso ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo, kuquka ulwazi ngoMthetho woMculo woNcedo lweMfundo kwi-WHS (MHCA).
xh.duties: Ukwazi ukunika iinkonzo ezingqonge kwisifo sokuqonda, kuquka ukuphethe iofisi yamayeza ngeengxoxo nomzimba wengqondo kwi-Klipfontein. Ukuphatha nokulungisa izinto ezenziwayo kwindlu yamayeza ephatha izifo ezilula. Ukulungisa ulwazi lwesigulane kwifayile yokugcina iinkcukacha zesifo somzimba. Ukuphatha abantu abangamantshona nomzimba wengqondo kwindlu yamayeza.

Tred hou met die jongste ontwikkelings op die gebied van Narkosekunde en Kritieke Sorg. Administrasie: Hospitaal- en Universiteitsverwante administratiewe take. Navorsing met betrekking tot Narkosekunde en Kritieke Sorg, en verwante onderwerpe, wat die fasilitering insluit van die navorsingskomponent wat deur die HPCSA van registrars vir spesialiteitsregistrasie vereeg word en publikasie in gelyke beoordeelde, geakkrediteerde joernale.

zu.title: Ithuba Lesikhulumi Sochwepheshe Ezingeni 1 kuya ku-3 (ANAESTHESIOLOGY)
zu.summary: Kufunwa Isikhulumi Sochwepheshe se-Anaesthesiology esebenza kwiTygerberg Hospital, Parow Valley, ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwesiguli ngaphambi kanye ngesikhathi kanye nanemuva kokuqashwa, nokufundisa abafundi abangenayo nabanephatho eliphezulu.
zu.requirements: Ithuba lemfuno yemfundo: Ithuba elifanelekelayo elivumela ukubhalisa kwiHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengesikhulumi sochwepheshe se-Anaesthesiology. Ukuqashwa kolwazi olungamkhakha: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulumi sochwepheshe se-Anaesthesiology. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho mfuno ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulumi sochwepheshe se-Anaesthesiology. Izinga 2: Iminyaka engu-5 nangaphezulu yesipiliyoni esifanele njengesikhulumi sochwepheshe ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (noma kwelinye iziko lezempilo elivunyiwe mayelana nomsebenzisi oqeqeshwe kwamanye amazwe) njengesikhulumi sochwepheshe se-Anaesthesiology. Izinga 3: Iminyaka engu-10 nangaphezulu yesipiliyoni esifanele njengesikhulumi sochwepheshe ngemuva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (noma kwelinye iziko lezempilo elivunyiwe mayelana nomsebenzisi oqeqeshwe kwamanye amazwe) njengesikhulumi sochwepheshe se-Anaesthesiology. Imfuno elawula lo msebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nomzimba wokuhamba njengengxenye yohlelo lokwesekwa emmangweni. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngemva kohlobo lwemisebenzi ukuze kuhlangatshezwe izidingo zokuqhutshwa komsebenzi. Izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/izikhali): Ukubonisa ukusebenza ndawonye kwezikhathi ezihlukene nokuba nobudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ukubonisa ukuhlela nokwenza iprojekthi ucwaningo oluhambisana nekhondo futhi lube negalelo elikhulu njengesikhulumi sochwepheshe se-Anaesthesiology. Ukubonisa ikhono lokubikezela ababhalisiwe e-Anaesthesiology, okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela ukuhlolwa kwabo kwe-Fellowship e-Anaesthesiology. Ikhono elikhulu lokukhuluma.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwesiguli ngaphambi kanye ngesikhathi kanye nanemuva kokuqashwa kumagumbi okuqashwa nasemagumbini okunakekelwa okuyisimo esibucayi ngokuya ngamazinga afunwa kusikhulumi se-Anaesthesiology. Ukufundisa nokubakhulelisa i-Anaesthesiology kanye nokunakekelwa okuyisimo esibucayi abafundi abangenayo, abafundi abanephatho eliphezulu kanye nabalingani. Ukukalabha abafundi kanye nabalingani. Ukuhlala ulandela izinto ezisha emkhakheni we-Anaesthesiology nokunakekelwa okuyisimo esibucayi. Izenzo zokuphatha: Izenzo zokuphatha ezihambisana neSibhedlela kanye neNyuvesi. Ucwaningo oluhambisana ne-Anaesthesiology nokunakekelwa okuyisimo esibucayi, kanye nemicimbe ehlobene, okuhlanganisa ukweseka ingxenye yocwaningo efunwa ngababhalisiwe i-HPCSA ukuze babhalise njengabachwepheshe kanye nokushicilela kwamajournal avunyiwe futhi ahlolelwe abalingani.

xh.title: Isigqithi sezokwelapha inqanaba 1 ukuya kwi-3 (ANAESTHESIOLOGY)
xh.summary: Kufunwa Isigqithi sezokwelapha kwiAnaesthesiology esibhedlele i-Tygerberg Hospital, eParrow Valley, ukunika inkathalo ngaphambi nangemva kokusebenza kwezolwe kwaye kufundise abafundi abangenayo nabaphumeleyo.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo semfundo esingaphantsi: Isigqibo esifanelekileyo esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesigqithi sezokwelapha kwiAnaesthesiology. Ukubhalisa kwikomishoni yabasebenzi: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesigqithi sezokwelapha kwiAnaesthesiology. Isiphiwo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho ntoni emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengesigqithi sezokwelapha kwiAnaesthesiology. Inqanaba 2: Amava angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-5 njengesigqithi sezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye kwikomishoni yamanye amazwe eziqinisekisiweyo ngokwabasebenzi abavela kumazwe ngaphandle) njengesigqithi sezokwelapha kwiAnaesthesiology. Inqanaba 3: Amava angaphantsi kweminyaka eli-10 njengesigqithi sezokwelapha emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA (okanye kwikomishoni yamanye amazwe eziqinisekisiweyo ngokwabasebenzi abavela kumazwe ngaphandle) njengesigqithi sezokwelapha kwiAnaesthesiology. Imfuno engaphakathi yomsebenzi: Ilayisense yokushuka esemthethweni nentando yokuhamba njengenxalenye yenkqubo yokufikelela kubantu. Intando yokusebenza ngenyanga emva kweyure zomsebenzi ukwanelisa iimfuno zokuqhuba. Iimpawu zokwazi/izakhono: Iibangela zokubonisa ukusebenza ngokutsha ngeqela kunye nobudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Iibangela zokucwangcisa nokuphumeza iiprojekthi zophando ezibalulekileyo nezithintelayo njengesigqithi sezokwelapha kwiAnaesthesiology. Iibangela zokubonisa ukuba nakho ukulawula ababhalisiweyo kwiAnaesthesiology, kuquka nokulungiselela uviwo lwabo lweFellowship kwiAnaesthesiology. Izakhono ezithembekileyo zokunxibelelana.
xh.duties: Kwanelaza inkathalo yeguli kwangaphambi nangemva kokusebenza kwezolwe kwakunye namanqanaba okhathalelo ebandakanyekayo ngemilinganiselo efunwa kumsingathi weAnaesthesiology. Ukufundisa nokulayisha iAnaesthesiology nokuKhathalelo okuBalulekileyo kubafundi abangenayo, abaphumeleyo nabalinganiswayo. Ukulinganisa abafudi nabanlinganiswayo. Ukuhlala ufumana iinkcazelo ezintsha kwinkqubo yeAnaesthesiology nokuKhathalelo okuBalulekileyo. Urhulumente: Imisebenzi yolawulo ehlobene nesibhedlele neYunivesithi. Uphando oluhlobene neAnaesthesiology nokuKhathalelo okuBalulekileyo, namagama ahlobene nalo, akuquka ukulawula inxalenye yophando efunwa ngababhalisiweyo yi-HPCSA ukubhalisa kwisigaba nokushicilela kwijonali ezichongiweyo, ezivunyiweyo.

jobs.title: Registrar (MEDICAL) (RADIOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: R1 041 402 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.) (It will be expected of the successful candidate to participate in a system of remunerated commuted overtime).
jobs.summary: Registrar in Radiology at Tygerberg Hospital providing 24-hour tertiary diagnostic services with compulsory overtime.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Medical Practitioner. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Inherent requirement of the job: Commuted overtime is compulsory. Emergency and after hour call cover. Each Registrar will be appointed in a specific training hospital but will be required to work across the distributed training platform. Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence, willingness and ability to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Primary Examination – Part 1 FC Rad (Diag.) SA. Supervised clinical experience in any aspect of diagnostic imaging. Effective leadership & interpersonal skills. Appropriate and sufficient clinical experience since obtaining the degree of MBChB. Knowledge and practical skills. Appropriate general medical and radiology experience. Computer skills including typing, managing spreadsheets and using databases. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
jobs.duties: Provision of safe, comprehensive 24-hour tertiary level diagnostic service to patients at Tygerberg Hospital and associated training hospitals. Produce timeous and accurate radiological reports and assist in optimal workflow through imaging domains. Perform onsite after-hours duties as per call roster. Attend teaching program activities, tutorials and assessments as part of the registrar training program. Assist with the training medical students, nursing staff and radiographers. Learn critical skills required of Radiologist. Involvement in research/audits relating to Radiodiagnosis.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Appointment as Registrar will be for a maximum contract period of 5 years. It may become necessary to second/transfer staff to another hospital/institution during their period of training, in which case affected staff will be consulted prior to any decision being implemented. Registrars will function across health facilities, as per an agreed programme. Should registration with the HEI as a student be discontinued for any reason the appointment as a Registrar also discontinues. Consideration will be given to existing employees who are already on higher salary packages to retain their existing salary position, as personal. As such they are entitled to receive pay progression. Appointment as Registrar will be on contract. Employees in service who opt to continue with their pension benefits as Registrar, will be required to resign after completion of their registrarship should they not be successful for advertised Specialist positions. -The Department of Health is guided by the principles of Employment Equity. Candidates with disability are encouraged to apply and an indication in this regard will be appreciated. Specific Registrar posts within the Department will be identified as part of the Affirmative Action programme to create a representative Specialist cadre in line with applicable procedures. Preference will be given to SA citizens/permanent residents with a valid identity document. Registrars will be required to register as post-graduates with Stelllenbosch University according to the yearbook and guidelines. “Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for a change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Registrateur (MEDIES) (RADIOLOGIE)
af.summary: Registrateur in Radiologie by Tygerberg Hospital wat 24-uur tersiêre diagnostiese dienste lewer met verpligte oortyd.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as Mediese Praktisyn moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Praktisyn (Onafhanklike Praktyk). Inherente vereiste van die werk: Gerooide oortyd is verpligtend. Nood- en buite-ure oproepdekking. Elke Registrateur sal in 'n spesifieke opleidingshospitaal aangestel word maar sal oor die verspreide opleidingsplatform heen moet werk. Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie, bereidwilligheid en vermoë om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Primêre Eksamen – Deel 1 FC Rad (Diag.) SA. Outeurskap kliniese ondervinding in enige aspek van diagnostiese beelding. Doeltreffende leierskap- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Toepaslike en voldoende kliniese ondervinding sedert die verwerwing van die MBChB-graad. Kennis en praktiese vaardighede. Toepaslike algemene mediese en radiologie-ondervinding. Rekenaarvaardighede insluitend tik, die bestuur van sigblaaie en die gebruik van databasisse. Uitstekende mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Lewering van 'n veilige, omvattende 24-uur tersiêre vlak diagnostiese diens aan pasiënte by Tygerberg Hospital en geassosieerde opleidingshospitale. Lewer tydig en akkurate radiologiese verslae en help met optimale werkvloei deur beeldingsdomeine. Voer buite-ure dienste ter plaatse uit volgens die oproeprooster. Bywoon van onderrigprogramaktiwiteite, tutoriale en assesserings as deel van die registrateur-opleidingsprogram. Bystand met die opleiding van mediese studente, verpleegpersoneel en radiograaf. Aanleer van kritieke vaardighede wat van 'n Radioloog vereis word. Betrokkenheid by navorsing/oudits met betrekking tot Radiodiagnose.

zu.title: Umregistrara (MEDICAL) (RADIOLOGY)
zu.summary: Umregistrara ku-Radiology eTygerberg Hospital ehlinzeka ngesevisi yokuqonda isifo yezinga eliphezulu amahora angu-24 nongethimali yamahora amaningi edingekayo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esingaphansi kakhulu semfundo: Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengompraktisa wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwikhansele yezobungcweti: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njengompraktisa wezokwelapha (Independent Practice). Isidingo esibalulekile somsebenzi: I-overtime edingekayo iyaphoqeleka. Ikhava yokuvala esimweni esiphuthumayo nangemva kwamahora. Munye nomunye umregistrara uzobekwa esibhedlela sokuqeqesha esithile kodwa uzodingeka ukuthi asebenze kuyo yonke inkundla yokuqeqesha ehlongolwe. Ilayisensi yokuqamba (Code B/EB) esemthethweni, ukuzikhethela nendlela yokuhamba. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhali): Isivivinyo sokuqala – Part 1 FC Rad (Diag.) SA. Isipiliyoni sezokwelapha esiqondiswe kunoma yisiphi isici sezithombe zokuqonda isifo. Amandla abalulekile abaholi & bokusebenzisana nabantu. Isipiliyoni sezokwelapha esifanele nesanele kusukela ekutholeni idigri ye-MBChB. Ulwazi nendlela yokusebenza. Isipiliyoni sezokwelapha jikelele kanye ne-Radiology. Amandla ekhompyutha okuhlanganisa ukuthayipha, ukuphatha amaspredshithi nokusebenzisa amadathabhesi. Amandla aphambili okuxhumana ngomlomo nakubhalwe.
zu.duties: Ukunikezwa kwesevisi yokuqonda isifo ephephile, ebanzi yezinga eliphezulu amahora angu-24 kubaphathi eTygerberg Hospital nasemahospithali okuqeqeshwa ahlobene nakho. Ukukhiqiza imibiko ye-radiology eqondile ngesikhathi futhi usize ekuphatheni kwezomsebenzi kumazinga ezithombe. Ukwenza imisebenzi yasendaweni ngemva kwamahora njengoko kushiwo ohlwini lwabasebenzi. Ukubakhona kumisebenzi yokufundisa, izifundo kanye nokuhlola njengengxenye yohlelo lokufundisa lwabaregistrara. Ukusiza ekufundiseni abafundi bezokwelapha, abantu basesibhedlela nabasebenzi bezithombe zokuqonda isifo. Ukufunda izikhali eziyingozi ezidingeka kwi-Radiologist. Ukubandakanywa kuphando/ukuhlola okuhlobene ne-Radiodiagnosis.

xh.title: Registrar (MEDICAL) (RADIOLOGY)
xh.summary: Registrar kwiRadiology eTygerberg Hospital ebonelela iinkonzo zokuxilonga zesithathu ezenza umsebenzi wee-awuni ezingama-24 ngenxa yomsebenzi weyure eongezelelweko okuqathelwe njengoko kuyimfuneko.
xh.requirements: Izifundo efunekayo ezingaphantsi: Ifomali efanelekileyo evumela ukubhalisa kwHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoGqirha. Ukubhalisa kwiRhulumba lamabanga: Ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirza (Independent Practice). Imfuno engaphakathi yomsebenzi: Umsebenzi weyure eongezelelweko oqathelwe liyimfuno. Ukughadelwa kwiimeko eziphuthumayo nakumsebenzi wamahla angelawulwa. Umntu ngamnye uRegistrar uya kugqityelwa kwindawo ethile yokholwa eTygerberg Hospital kodwa uya kufuneka asebenze ngaphaya kwebala lokholwa olusasazekileyo. Ilayisenisi yomqhubi (Code B/EB) esebenzayo, ulwalamano noku kukwazi ukuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Primary Examination – Part 1 FC Rad (Diag.) SA. Ulwazi lomzimba lokuqeqeshwa nakulo naliphi na icala lokuxilonga ngezonqa. Amandla okubonisa ukulawula noku tiesana nabantu. Ulwazi lokugqibeleleyo lokwenza imisebenzi yezempilo ukususela kwinxuva lokufumana isidanga se-MBChB. Ulwazi nezakhono zokusebenza. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lwendalo yokwenza imisebenzi yezempilo nokuqonda iRadiology. Izakhono zesixhobo sekhompyutha eziquka ukuthayipha, ukulawula amaspredshithi nakusebenzisa iidatabhezi. Izakhono ezimhlelokubhalwa noku thetha nakubhalwa.
xh.duties: Uku bonelela ngenkonzo yokuxilonga ezolula, eze ngokupheleleyo kwinqanaba lesithathu amahla angama-24 kumagqirha eTygerberg Hospital nakwizibhedlele ezidityaniswe nokholwa. Ukubhala iirepothi eziyimanga ezikhawulezayo ngezifundo ze-radiology kunye nokunceda ekunqweni iindlela ezize ngokuchanekileyo kwindawo ezikhusela iinkonzo. Ukwenza umsebenzi wamahla angelawulwa endaweni ethile njengoko kumiselwe ngumzila wokuqhuba umsebenzi. Ukuzimasa nakusebenza kwinkqubo yoku thuthisa, kwiithutyana kwingqinelana nezenzo njengenxalenye yendlela yokuthuthisa abarabaxhantishi. Ukunceda ekuthuthiseni abafundi bagqirha, abahlolokhula beempilo nakubafundi bokuqonda iindawo zokubhalisa izifundo ezingokuya kwphando/rhululethi ebbandakanya isimo sokwenza iRadiology.

af.title: Mediese Beampte Graad 1 tot 3 (ORTEPEDIE)
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Graad 1 tot 3 in Ortopedie by New Somerset Hospital, Western Cape, wat kliniese en chirurgiese sorg aan ortopediese pasiente verskaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Praktisyn toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by die HPCSA met betrekking tot SA gekwalifiseerde werknemers nie. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn met betrekking tot SA gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 6 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsraad met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike ervaring as 'n Mediese Praktisyn na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Praktisyn met betrekking tot SA gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie as Mediese Praktisyn by 'n erkende buitelandse Gesondheidsprofessionele Raad met betrekking tot buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis te verrig nie. af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder (EENHEID van Infeksie
af.summary: Kliniese Programkoördineerder benodig by Tygerberg Hospital om infeksievoorkoming en -beheerdienste te bestuur en te koördineer, met 'n verpleegkwalifikasie en SANC-registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige as vereistes.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF 'n 3-jarige Diploma in Verpleegkunde (R171) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) AS 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige toelaat. (Hierdie dispensasie is slegs van toepassing op poste van Kliniese Programkoördineerder waar dit 'n inherente vereiste van die pos is dat die ampsdraer registrasie by die SANC moet handhaaf). Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die South African Nursing Council in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om wagdienste te verrig soos nodig ontstaan. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om onafhanklik sowel as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te funksioneer. Effektiewe kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede en die vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer. Basiese rekenaarvaardigheidsvaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Kennis en insig rakende Infeksievoorkoming en -beheer. Kennis van relevante wetgewing en beleid rakende IPC binne die Publieke Sektor. Vermoë om gehalte-pasiëntesorg te bevorder deur die instelling, implementering en monitering van standaarde.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die beplanning, bestuur, koördinering en handhawing van 'n optimale Infeksievoorkomings- en -beheerdiens by Tygerberg Hospital. Identifiseer die behoefte aan standaarde, beleide en prosedures rakende IPC. Neem deel aan die ontwikkeling van standaarde en monitor die implementeringsproses. Effektiewe bestuur en benutting van hulpbronne om operationele funksionering in die area te verseker. Inisieer en neem deel aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en navorsing binne die verpleegkundedepartement. Lewer 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan die Verpleegdiens en die instelling. Handhaaf etiese standaarde en bevorder professionele groei en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umxhumanisi Wenqubo Yezokwelapha (UNIT of Infection
zu.summary: Umxhumanisi Wenqubo Yezokwelapha udingeka eTygerberg Hospital ukuphatha futhi ahambisanise izinkonzo zokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka, okudinga izifundo zobuhleki kanye nokubhaliswa kwe-SANC njengesiGuli Sezempilo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphansi kancane: Isifundo esiyisisekelo i-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ezezobuhleki) noma isifundo esilingana (i-R683) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiGuli Sezempilo. Noma Idigri Yeminyaka Eyi-4 ezezobuhleki (i-R174) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiGuli Sezempilo. Noma Idiploma Yeminyaka Eyi-3 ezezobuhleki (i-R171) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiGuli Jikelele. (Lolu hlelo lusebenza kuphela ezikhundleni zomxhumanisi wenqubo yezokwelapha lapho kuyisidingo esingcaleni sesikhundla ukuthi umuntu ogcwele isikhundla ahlale abhaliswe kwi-SANC). Ukubhaliswa komkhandlu wabahlenga: Ukubhaliswa kwe-SANC njengesiGuli Sezempilo. Isipiliyoni: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-7 yesipiliyoni esifanele/ esiyavelelwa kwezobuhleki ngemuva kokubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council ezezobuhleki jikelele. Isidingo esingcaleni somsebenzi: Ikhono nolwazi lokwenza imisebenzi yokulinda njengesidingo. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimele kanye nokuqoqa iqembu elinamagatsha amaningi. Ikhono lokuxhumana elisebenzayo, lobuntu, lokuhola, lokwenza izinqumo kanye nokuqonda izinkinga. Izikhali zokuhlelela ezinhle kanye nerekhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkinga. Izikhali eziyisisekelo zokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono elihle lokuxhumanalisa okubhaliwe nangomlomo. Ulwazi nokuqonda okuhlobene nokuvikela ukutheleleka noku kulawula. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye namapholisi ahlobene ne-IPC ngaphakathi kwesektorikazwe. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwegula okukhulu ngokumisa, ukuphatha kanye nokuqapha amasu.
zu.duties: Uphiwe ngokucubungula, ukuphatha, ukuhambisa kanye nokugcina inkonzo engcono kakhulu yokuvikela nokulawula ukutheleleka eTygerberg Hospital. Ukubona isidingo samasu, amapholisi kanye nokuqondisa nge-IPC. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakheni amasu kanye nokuqapha inqubo yokuphatha. Ukuphatha nokusebenzisa okuhle okwakhiwayo ukubheka ukuthi isikhungo sisebenza kahle endaweni. Ukuqala ukuthi uthathe inxaxheba ekufundiseni, ekuthuthukiseni nakwocwaningo ngaphakathi kumnyango wezobuhleki. Ukunika inkonzo yokusekela inkonzo Yobuhleki nalesikhungo. Ukugcina amasu wobuhlakani bokuqondisa futhi uthuthukise ukukhulela ngobungcweti kanye nokuzithuthukisa.

xh.title: Umqambi Wenkqubo Yezempilo (UNIT YokuTshafulwa Kwezifo)
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe khona uMqambi Wenkqubo Yezempilo eTygerberg Hospital ukuze alawule axunge ixibelelwano lweenkonzo zokuthintela nokulawula ukutshafulwa kwezifo, kwaye kufuneka abe nelayisensi yobuhlekisi anze arekhodeke kwi-SANC njengoGqirha Wezempilo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi kwaye: Isigqeba sesiqu se-R425 (okt. idiploma/izedyana ngeqhina kubuhlekisi) okanye isiqu esilinganayo (R683) esikuvumela urekhode ngokutsha kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqirha Wezempilo. OKT Iqedo Leminyaka Emi-4 kwiqhina le-Bachelor Degree kubuhlekisi (R174) elikuvumela urekhode ngokutsha kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoGqirha Wezempilo. OKT Idiploma yeminyaka emi-3 kubuhlekisi (R171) elikuvumela urekhode ngokutsha kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) NJENGO Hlekisi Jikelele. (Esi sicwangciso sifanelekile kuphela kumathuba woMqambi Wenkqubo Yezempilo apho kuye kubekwe ngokwesiqu somsebenzi ukuba umntu oze atshate isikhundla agcine arekhode ngokutsha kwiSANC). Irekhodo nomthunywa webalawulo: Ukurekhodwa kwi-SANC njengoGqirha Wezempilo. Iimfuno zokuba namava: Ukuba nolwazi oluchanekileyo/olubonakalayo kwiminyaka elingaphaya kwe-7 kubuhlekisi emva kokurekhodwa kwiSouth African Nursing Council kwiHlekisi Jikelele. Into efuneka ngokomsebenzi ngokwakhe: Ukuba nolwazi nentwelo yokwenza imisebenzi yokulindela njengoko kusoloko kubakho isidingo. Iimfuno (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokusebenza kodwa nakubandakanyeka kwindlu yabantu abanamakhondo ahlukeneyo. Ukuzithetha kakuhle, ukuxhoma nomntu, ukulawula, ukuzigqiba isigqibo kunye namakhondo okuhlambulula iingxabano. Ukulungiselela kakuhle izinto kwaye ulwazi lokusebenza ngenxa yoxinzelelo. Ulwazi olusisiseko lokusebenza ngamakompyutha. Ulwazi lokubhala nokuthetha kakuhle. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngenkqubo Yokuthintela nokulawula Ukutshafulwa Kwezifo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemigaqo echaza inkqubo Yokuthintela nokulawula Ukutshafulwa Kwezifo ngaphakathi koluntu Lwakawonke. Ulwazi lokukhuthaza ukunyamekela kakuhle abaguli ngokumisela, ukusebenzisa nokuqwalasela imigaqo.
xh.duties: Ukubizwa ngokuba ngowokuqamba, ukulawula, ukuxeba nokuqwalasela inkqubo yokuthintela nokulawula ukutshafulwa kwezifo eTygerberg Hospital. Ukuchonga iimfuno zemigaqo, iinkqubo kunye namacebo okukhankanya inkqubo Yokuthintela nokulawula Ukutshafulwa Kwezifo. Ukubandakanyeka ekuyileni imigaqo kwaye uliqwalasele inkqubo yokuze kusebenze. Ukulawula nokusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo izinto ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba inkqubo isebenza kulawo mamkhondo. Ukuqamba ukuba kubakho ukufundiswa, ukukhula nokuphonononga ngaphakathi kwesebe lezempilo. Ukuhlinzeka ngenkonzo yokuxhasa inkonzo YeZempilo nalo msebenzi. Ukugcina imigaqo yokuziphatha ngokucokisekileyo kwaye ukhuthaze ukhula kolwazi nokuzikhulisa.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing Grade 1 (GENERAL) (HIV/AIDS)
jobs.summary: Manage nursing operations and health committees at Michael Mapongwana CDC in Khayelitsha, requiring a nursing qualification with SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 7 years’ appropriate/ recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s license. Willingness to perform relief within the Facility. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of National and Provincial Health Policies and Nursing Acts and Laws. Ability to work accurately under pressure and maintain a high standard of professionalism. Ability and willingness to train staff. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Oversee and ensure fully functional health committees, including organising regular meetings, training members, and compliance with relevant health legislation. Manage human resources by maintaining a fully staffed CHC, coordinating staff training aligned with skills development plans, resolving labour relations issues, and monitoring absenteeism. Control and monitor financial resources by preparing balanced budgets, ensuring expenditure controls, meeting revenue targets, and complying with financial regulations. Supervise supply chain functions to maintain adequate stock of essential supplies, manage asset registers, ensure functioning equipment, and oversee government vehicle usage and servicing. Ensure accurate and timely health information management, including data quality checks, timely reporting, and optimal use of PHCIS systems. Promote quality of care through Batho Pele principles, ensuring health and safety standards, conducting monthly clinical audits (M&M meetings), and overseeing infection control and staff training initiatives.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Kindly note that the advert for the POST 32/331: Deputy Director: Employee Relations (Dispute Resolutions, Misconduct And Litigation) Directorate: Employee Relations, Salary R 932 292 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.) Centre: Head Office, Cape Town (Stationed on the premises of Stikland Hospital) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 32 dated 04 September 2026, with reference number Post 32/331: Post must be amended to include driver’s licence.
