af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleegkunde Vlak 1 (ALGEMEEN) (HIV/AIDS)
af.summary: Bestuur verpleegbedrywighede en gesondheidskomitees by Michael Mapongwana CDC in Khayelitsha, wat 'n verpleegkwalifikasie met SANC-registrasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. OF 'n 4-jarige Bachelorgaad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar se toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om verligtingsdiens binne die Fasiliteit te verrig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van Nasionale en Provinsiale Gesondheidsbeleid en Verpleegwetgewing. Vermoë om akkuraat onder druk te werk en 'n hoë standaard van professionaliteit te handhaaf. Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om personeel op te lei. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenvaardigheid.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor en verseker ten volle funksionele gesondheidskomitees, insluitend die reël van gereelde vergaderings, die opleiding van lede en nakoming van tersaaklike gesondheidswetgewing. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne deur 'n ten volle bemanne CHC te handhaaf, die koördinering van personeelopleiding in ooreenstemming met vaardigheidsontwikkelingsplanne, die oplossing van arbeidsverhoudingsake en die monitering van afwesigheid. Beheer en moniter finansiële hulpbronne deur gebalanseerde begrotings op te stel, beheer oor besteding te verseker, inkomste-teikens te bereik en aan finansiële regulasies te voldoen. Ousingaan met die toeleweringskettingfunksies om voldoende voorraad van noodsaaklike voorrade te handhaaf, bateRegisters te bestuur, funksionerende toerusting te verseker en die gebruik en instandhouding van regeringsvoertuie te oorsien. Verseker akkurate en tydige gesondheidsinligtingbestuur, insluitend datakwaliteitskontroles, tydige verslagdoening en optimale gebruik van PHCIS-stelsels. Bevorder gehalte van sorg deur Batho Pele-beginsels, die versekering van gesondheids- en veiligheidsstandaarde, die uitvoer van maandelikse kliniese oudits (M&M-vergaderings) en toesig oor infeksiebeheer en personeelopleidingsinisiatiewe.

zu.title: Umphathi WezokuSebenza Wezokunakekelwa Ezingeni Loku-1 (OKUJWAYELEKILE) (HIV/AIDS)
zu.summary: Phatha izimiso zokunakekelwa kanye namakomidi ezempilo e-Michael Mapongwana CDC e-Khayelitsha, okudinga izifundo zokunakekelwa zenhlanganisela yokubhalisa ku-SANC.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esincane esidingekayo: Isifundo se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/ideshi ezokunakekelwa) noma esifundo esilinganayo (R683 okanye u-R254) esikuvumela ukuthi ubhalise ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogugiwe. Noma I-Degree ye-Bachelor yeminyaka e-4 eZokunakekelwa (R174) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 kanye no-R1497 noma u-R171 kanye no-R1497) esikuvumela ukuthi ubhalise ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogugiwe. Ukubhalisa kwenhlangiselwa: Ukubhalisa ku-SANC njengogugiwe. Isipiliyoni: Ubulula beminyaka e-7 isipiliyoni esifanele/ esihlolakalayo ezokunakekelwa emva kokubhalisa njengogugiwe ku-SANC eZokunakekelwa Okujwayelekile. Isidingo esiphakathi kwaleso sikundla: Ilayisensi yokuqasha. Ukuzithobilela ukusebenza ukusiza kuleziikhungo. Amandla (ulwazi/ikhono): Ulwazi ngamapholisi wezempilo kazwelonke nasezifundazweni, kanye noMthetho Wezokunakekelwa. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokunembile ngaphansi kwegcinamazinyo, nokugcina izinga elikhulu lobungwe. Ikhono nomzimba wokufundisa abasebenzi. Amakhono amahle okuxoxa nokwakha ubuhlobo kanye nabanye. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi uqiniseke ukuba kukhona amakomidi ezempilo asekela kahle, okuhlanganisa ukuhlela izinkomishana zokuqasha, ukufundisa amalungu kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho ezempilo. Phatha izinsiza zomuntu ngokugcina i-CHC enabasebenzi abadingekayo, ukuhumusha ukufundiswa kwabasebenzi kuhambisana neplani yokuthuthukiswa kakhono, ukuxazulula izinkinga zokusebenza, kanye nokubuka ukungabikho. Lawula futhi ubuke izinsiza zemali ngokulungisa amabhajethi, ukuqinisekisa ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kwemali, ukufinyelela izinhlisomphumela, kanye nokuhambisana nomthetho wezimali. Buka isisekelo sezinsiza zokuqashwa ukuze ugcine ukwanele kwalezo zinto eziyisidingo, lawula irekhodi lezimpahla, ukuqinisekisa izinsiza ezisebenza, kanye nokubuka ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqashwa kwezimoto zahulumeni. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kweenzuzo zokunakekelwa, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola ikhwalithi yegcinamazinyo, ukwenza izikhwapha isikhundla esifanele, nokusebenzisa izinhlelo ze-PHCIS ngokugcwele. Khuthaza ikhwalithi yokunakekela kuma-Batho Pele, ukuqinisekisa izinga lempilo nokuphepha, ukwenza ukubukezwa kweklinikhe njalo ngenyanga (izinkomishana ze-M&M), kanye nokubuka ukulawula ukuvela kwesifo kanye nezinhlela zokufundisa abasebenzi.

xh.title: Umphathi wokuQhuba iNkundla yeNdlavayo yoGqatso 1 (Jikelele) (HIV/AIDS)
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yokhathalo Iwabantu abagulayo kunye neekomiti zempilo kwindawo ekuthiwa yi-Michael Mapongwana CDC e-Khayelitsha, kufuneka idinga isifikelelo sokukhathalela abagulayo esinobhaliso koluntu Iwe-SANC.
xh.requirements: Iminikelo yemfundo encinane: Isifikelelo esisisiseko se-R425 (okt idiploma/idigri ekwitsholongwano) okanye isifikelelo esilinganayo (i-R683 plus i-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa koluntu lwaseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengogqirha weempilo. OKT Idigri yeBachelor yeminyaka emi-4 ekwitsholongwano (R174) okanye isifikelelo esilinganayo (i-R683 plus i-R1497 okanye i-R171 plus i-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa koluntu lwaseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengogqirha weempilo. Ukubhalisa koluntu lwabafundi: Ukubhalisa koluntu lwaseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) njengogqirha weempilo. Ikhondo: Iminyaka engu-7 encinci yokukhondo eqwalaselwayo/eqaphelayo kwimpilo emva kokubhalisa njengogqirha weempilo koluntu lwaseMzantsi Afrika (SANC) kwizifundo ezisisiseko. Iminikelo ebalulekileyo yesikhundla: Ifayili yokuqhuba egunyazisiweyo. Ukulungelelana ukusebenza ukunceda kwindawo esebenzayo. Iimpawu zokuziphatha (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lweenkqubo zeempilo karhulumente nakwindawo yephondo ngokukodwa, kunye neMithetho yokuQwalasela iimpilo. Isakhono sokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo phantsi koxinzelelo lokugcina umgangatho ophezulu wokuziphatha okunesigqibo. Isakhono nokulungelelana ukulungisa abasebenzi. Isakhono sokunxibelelanA sokubakho kobudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenza ngakwikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Qwalasela ukuqinisekisa ukuba iikomiti ezisebenzelayo zempilo zisebenza ngokupheleleyo, kuquka ukuqwalasela iindibano ezisoloko zibekelwe ixesha, ukulungiselela amalungu, nokuvuselela ukuthobela umthetho othintela impilo. Lawula abasebenzi ngokugcina isikhululo se-CHC esinabasebenzi abanelaniyo, ukuqwalasela ukulungiselela amakholwa amasebenzi ngokuvumelana neenkqubo zophuhliso lamakhono, ukusombulula iingxaki zobudlelwane basesebenzini, nokulawula ukungabikho kwabasebenzi. Lawula ukuqwalasela nokuqaphela iimali ngokulungiselela amabhajeti alinganayo, ukuqinisekisa ulawulo lokuchithwa kwemali, ukufezana namaphakamiso aveliswa yimali, nokuthobela imigaqo yemali. Qwalasela imisebenzi ye-supply chain ukuze kugcinwe iimpawu eziphambili ezaneleyo, ulawule iirejista zeempahla, uqinisekise ukusebenza kolawulo lweqaphelo, ukuze uqwalasele ukusetyenziswa koluntu nokunikelwa ngemoto karhulumente. Qinisekisa ulawulo lolwazi ngempilo oluchanekileyo nangexesha elifanelekileyo, kuquka ukuqinisekisa ngangoko kunokwenzeka ukulungisa ulwazi, ukurhulunywa ngexesha elifanelekileyo, nokusetyenziswa okulungileyo kweenkqabo ze-PHCIS. Khuthaza umgangatho wokhathalo ngokusezimvisisweni ze-Batho Pele principles, ukuqinisekisa imilinganiselo yempilo nakhuselo, ukuqhuba iindibano ezingavisiswanga ezenziwa ngenyanga ezikwindla zokuchongwa ezibonisayo nokubeka isigqibo sokulawula iintsholongwane, kunye neenkqabo zokulungiselela abasebenzi.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing: General (MEDICAL Female
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing General sought at Khayelitsha District Hospital in the Western Cape, requiring a nursing qualification with SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. or 4-year Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 7 years appropriate / recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work rotational shifts, including day and night duty, as well as weekends and public holidays in accordance with operational requirements. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of legal framework and regulations regarding nursing practice. Good leadership and people management skills. Maintain constructive relationships with members of the multi-disciplinary team. Computer literacy and Appropriate financial management skills. The ability to communicate effectively (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Supervise and ensure the provision of effective and efficient patient care through adequate nursing care. Coordinate and monitor the implementation of nursing care plan and evaluation thereof. Ukuthatha inhlangothi emicimbini yomphakathi nokuqala ukwazisa ngemikhakha ehlobene nezempilo. Isifundo esingowona siseko: Isifundo esiyisisiseko i-R425 (okt., isatifikethi/isidanga sokunakeswa) okt isifundo esilinganayo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhalisa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengomongikazi wezesibhedlele.

Isatifikethi sokufunda kwamabanga aphakamileyo (R635) esamkelwe yi-SANC kwizifundo ezimalunga nokunakekela kwamabanga abo baphila kurobho.

Okungenani iminyaka elithoba yexesha elitshiwo ngenhla kufuneka ibe yisipiliwo esifanelekileyo/esibonakalayo emva kokufumana isatifikethi se-1-year post-basic kwilapho kukho isipiliwo esichanekileyo.

Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word and Excel).

Nceda ekulawulweni kwesisindo sezifo ngokwemigaqo nemiyalelo ye Western Cape.

Gcina ukukhula ngobuchwephesha/izinga lokuziphatha nokuziphucula.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 to 2 (PHC)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner (Grade 1 to 2) sought for Gouda Clinic in the Western Cape to manage burden of disease and provide quality primary healthcare.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e., diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic qualification, with a duration of at least a 1-year diploma, in Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, accredited with the SANC (R 48) OR a 4-year bachelor's degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. A postgraduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Primary Care Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the South African Nursing Council as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years of appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse in General nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification in Diploma in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment Care or a post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Primary Care Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: A valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): NIMART training or experience. Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Nursing and public service legislation. Computer literacy (MS Word and Excel). Ability to promote quality patient care through the implementation of protocols, guidelines and standards.
jobs.duties: Assist with the management of the burden of disease in accordance with the guidelines and protocols of the Western Cape. Provide and maintain quality of care to all patients and health services. Maintain accurate clinical records, statistics registers, and referral records. Effective utilisation of Resources/Stock within the limited budget constraints. Participation in Community events and initiating awareness with regards to health-related issues. Maintain and participate in inter-professional and multi-disciplinary teamwork but able to work independently. Supervise and mentor lower categories of staff. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self- development.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post basic qualification: Diploma in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment Care or a post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Primary Care Nursing. It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Vlak 1 tot 2 (PHC)
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (Vlak 1 tot 2) gesoek vir Gouda Kliniek in die Western Cape om siektelast te bestuur en gehalte primêre gesondheidsorg te verskaf.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Postbasiese kwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 'n 1-jaar diploma, in Kliniese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap: Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en Sorg, geakkrediteer by die SANC (R 48) OF 'n 4-jaar baccalaureusgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Primêre Sorg-verpleegkunde. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die Suid-Afrikaanse Verpleegraad as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Vlak 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene verpleging. Vlak 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Diploma in Kliniese Verpleegkunde-wetenskap, Gesondheidsassessering, Behandelingsorg of 'n nagraadse diploma (R635) geakkrediteer by die SANC in Primêre Sorg-verpleegkunde. Inherente vereistes van die werk: 'n Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): NIMART-opleiding of ervaring. Toon diepgaande kennis van verpleeg- en staatsdienswetgewing. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word en Excel). Vermoë om gehalte pasiëntsorg te bevorder deur die implementering van protokolle, riglyne en standaarde.
af.duties: Help met die bestuur van die siektelast in ooreenstemming met die riglyne en protokolle van die Western Cape. Verskaf en handhaaf gehalte sorg aan alle pasiënte en gesondheidsdienste. Handhaaf akkurate kliniese rekords, statistiekregisters en verwysingsrekords. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne/voorraad binne die beperkte begrotingsbeperkings. Deelname aan gemeenskapsgebeure en die inisieer van bewustheid aangaande gesondheidsverwante kwessies. Handhaaf en neem deel aan interprofessionele en multidissiplinêre spanwerk, maar in staat om onafhanklik te werk. Onderrig en mentor laer kategorieë personeel. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umpraktisi Wezokwelapha Ongezulu Isikhundla 1 kuya ku-2 (PHC)
zu.summary: Umpraktisi Wezokwelapha Ongezulu (Isikhundla 1 kuya ku-2) ofunwayo we-Gouda Clinic e-Western Cape ukuphatha isibalo sesifo nokunikeza ikhwalithi ephilayo yezokunakekelwa kwezempilo.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezenza ukuthi ufaneleke: I-Basic R425 qualification (okuthi i-diploma/degree ekukhunyulwa kwezifo) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council njengoba u-Professional Nurse. Isifundo esingeniso esiphakeme, esithatha unyaka oyingotsha okungenani i-diploma, kwi-Clinical Nursing Science: Health Assessment, Treatment and Care, esamukelekwe kwi-SANC (R 48) NGEYA i-4-year bachelor's degree ekukhunyulwa kwezifo (R174) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 kanye ne-R1497 noma R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council njengoba u-Professional Nurse. I-postgraduate diploma (R635) esamukelekwe kwi-SANC kwi-Primary Care Nursing. Ukubhalisa komkhandlu wezingcweti: Ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council njengo-Professional Nurse. Isipiliyoni: Isikhundla 1: Unyaka ongengo-4 ungamandla/obonakalayo bokukhunyulwa kwezifo ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengo-Professional Nurse ekukhunyulweni kwagogo. Isikhundla 2: Unyaka ongengo-14 onamandla/obonakalayo bokukhunyulwa kwezifo ngemva kokubhalisa kwi-SANC njengo-Professional Nurse ekukhunyulweni kwagogo. Okungakenziwe okungenani iminyaka engu-10 kuleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kubekhona isipiliyoni esamukelekayo/ebonakalayo ngemva kokuthola i-1-year post-basic qualification kwi-Diploma in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment Care noma i-post graduate diploma (R635) esamukelekwe kwi-SANC kwi-Primary Care Nursing. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisense elivela yinoma elijwayelekile (Code B/EB) lokushayela. Ukuzigcina emandleni (ulwazi/izikhali): I-NIMART ukuqeqeshwa noma isipiliyoni. Bonisa ulwazi olujulile ekukhunyulweni kwezifo nokuhleleka komthetho wesevisi yomphakathi. Ukubakwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Word kanye ne-Excel). Ikhono elikhuthaza inakekelo ekhwalithi kumagula ngokuphoqa imithetho, izeluleki nezindinganiso ezibekiwe.
zu.duties: Siza ekuphathweni kobunzima besifo ngokulandela izeluleki kanye neyimithetho e-Western Cape. Nikeza kanye ugcine ikhwalithi yonakekelo kubo bonke abagulayo kumasevisi wezempilo. Gcina ukuqashelwa okuchaziwe komagula, izitadi zenani, namarekhodi okuthumela. Ukusebenzisa kahle amatholwa/impahla ngaphakathi kwezinkinga ezingezansi esibekiweni sexabiso. Ukuthatha inxaxheba emicimbini yomphakathi kanye nokuqala ulwazi mayelana nezinto ezihlobene nezempilo. Gcina kanye uthathe inxaxheba emsebenzini ohlangene namakhono amaningi kepha ukwazi ukusebenza wedwa. Qaphisa futhi ubequqe abasebenzi abangaphansi kwalesi sikhundla. Gcina ukukhula ngokwenzela/izinhlalo ezomoyo nokuziphucela.

xh.title: Umpracthisi Wezempilo Ongezantsi Ohlakanipileyo Isikhundla 1 ukuya ku-2 (PHC)
xh.summary: Kufunwa umPracthisi Wezempilo Ongezantsi Ohlakanipileyo (Isikhundla 1 ukuya ku-2) we-Gouda Clinic e-Western Cape ukulawula umthwalo wezifo kunye nokunika inmngangatho uphezleyo wenzempilo ephambili.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezisezantsi kakhulu: Isifundo esisisiseko se-R425 (o.k.t., idiploma/izingqiqo kwindangwe yenzulu) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 plus i-R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengogqatso lokuhlangisa olungcwatyileyo. Isifundo esingaphandle kwesisiseko, esithatha ubuncinane nyaka om-1 widiploma, kwiziko lenzululwazi lokuhlangisa: Isikolo sempilo, Isixhobo sokuqwalasela impezulu, Unyango nolwazi, esemthethweni nge-SANC (i-R 48) OKANE idigri yeminyaka emi-4 kwindangwe yenzulu (i-R174) okanye isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 plus i-R1497 okanye i-R171 plus i-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengogqatso lokuhlangisa olungcwatyileyo. Ipostgraduate diploma (i-R635) esemthethweni nge-SANC kwisikolo sezempilo ephambili. Ukubhaliswa kolwazi loluhlelo: Ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council njengogqatso lokuhlangisa olungcwatyileyo. Isikhundla 1: Ubuncinane kwiminyaka eli-4 yamava amfaneleyo/awayaziwayo okuhlangisa emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqatso lokuhlangisa olungcwatyileyo kwindangwe jikelele. Isikhundla 2: Ubuncinane kwiminyaka eli-14 yamava amfaneleyo/awayaziwayo okuhlangisa emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqatso lokuhlangisa olungcwatyileyo kwindangwe jikelele. Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 kule minyaka ebiziwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava amfaneleyo/awayaziwayo emva kokufumana isifundo sengownyaka om-1 esingaphandle kwesisiseko kwidiploma kwiziko lenzululwazi lokuhlangisa, ukwahlulelwa kwempezulu, unyango nolwazi okanye ipost graduate diploma (i-R635) esemthethweni nge-SANC kwisikolo sezempilo ephambili. Iimfuno eziphawulekayo zomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yokushayela (i-Code B/EB) eseza kusebenza. Amapaspoti (ulwazi/amaziko): Isikolo ok amava se-NIMART. Kubonise ulwazi olujulileyo ngokuqhathaniswa kwamathuba okuhlangisa nomthetho womsebenzi wentangaworhulumende. Ukubathwa ngesikrini sika-Sauron (i-MS Word kunye ne-Excel). Ukukwazi ukunyusa ulungelelwaniso lwezempilo kakho ngokurhuṁa kumthetho ngenkqubo yeskolo ezemthethweni neengqiqo.
xh.duties: Nceda ulawule umthwalo wezifo ngokumiselo nangokurhuṁa kumthetho wase-Western Cape. Nikeza nzigcine ulungelelwaniso lwezempilo kuyo yonke imibuzo nesebe lemibuzo yezempilo. Gcina ubume obunyanzelekileyo bemvulathwa yolwazi lobugcisa, ngezibhalwe ngezinto zokubala, kunye nemiqulu yemibuzo yokuqhutsha. Ukusebenzisa ngokuphumeleleyo imibuzo/izinto ngaphakathi kweendibano ezincinane zemali. Ukuzinikela ngokubakho kuluntu kumacandelo omatsha alungelelwaniso kwaye uqalise ulungelelwaniso ngemibuzo ephathelene nempilo. Gcina ube ngumlingani ngokuhlangana kweentlanganiso-phondo ngokukhutshwa kodwa usenokwazi ukusebenza ngokwakho. Qwalasele ngenkqubo ukuqwalasela inkqubo yezigunyaziso, iziqinisekiso nezigqibo zezigqibo. Gcina inkqubo ngokuphumelela ngokuhamba kwamathuba/izehlakalo ezisezantsi ezifaneleyo nokuziphendulela.

Toon diepblootgestelde kennis van verpleeg- en openbare dienswetgewing. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word en Excel). Vermoë om gehalte pasiëntsorg te bevorder deur die implementering van protokolle, riglyne en standaarde.
af.duties: Bystand verleen met die bestuur van die siektelast in ooreenstemming met die riglyne en protokolle van die Western Cape. Verskaf en handhaaf gehalte sorg aan alle pasiënte en gesondheidsdienste. Handhaaf akkurate kliniese rekords, statistiekregisters en verwysingsrekords. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne/voorraad binne die beperkte begrotingsbeperkings. Deelname aan gemeenskapsgeleenthede en die inisieer van bewustheid ten opsigte van gesondheidsverwante kwessies. Handhaaf en neem deel aan inter-professionele en multi-dissiplinêre spanwerk, maar in staat om onafhanklik te werk. Onderrig en mentor laer kategorieë van personeel. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umuntu Ovela Kumsila Wezokwelapha Ohlinzayo Isigaba 1 kuya ku-2 (PRIMARY Health
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu ovela kumsila wezokwelapha ohlinzayo eKoue Bokkeveld Mobile esifundeni i-Witzenberg Sub-district ukuze anikeze izinsizakalo zezenkalo ezingunhlango bese ezulazula ibhadra elithwesa isifundo.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo eyingenusi: Isifundo esiyisisekelo i-Basic R425 (okuyidiploma/iqupe kwezokunusinga) noma isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R254) esivumela ukubhalisa eSouth African Nursing Council njengomenzi wezokunusinga osebenza ngobungcweti. Isifundo ngemva kokuqeda okuyisisekelo, esithatha okungenani unyaka o-1 wediploma, kusayensi yokunusinga okuhlinzayo: Isiqiniseko Sempilo, Ukwelashwa Nokunakekelwa, esiqinisekiswe yi-SANC (i-R 48) NGAPELA idiploma yeminyaka eyi-4 kwezokunusinga (i-R174) noma isifundo esilinganayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R1497 noma i-R171 kanye ne-R1497) esivumela ukubhalisa eSouth African Nursing Council njengomenzi wezokunusinga osebenza ngobungcweti. Idiploma ngemva kwesiqu sedigri (i-R635) e&qinisekiswe yi-SANC ekuNakingweni Kwezinsizakalo Ezingunhlango. Ukubhalisa kwikhaladi lemsebenzi: Ukubhalisa eSouth African Nursing Council njengomenzi wezokunusinga osebenza ngobungcweti. Isipiliyoni: Isigaba 1: Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-4 yesipiliyoni esifanelekile/esoqashwayo sezokunusinga ngemva kokubhalisa e-SANC njengomenzi wezokunusinga osebenza ngobungcweti kuNnusinga Jikelele. Isigaba 2: Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-14 yesipiliyoni esifanelekile/esoqashwayo sezokunusinga ngemva kokubhalisa e-SANC njengomenzi wezokunusinga osebenza ngobungcweti kuNnusinga Jikelele. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-10 kokusho okwenziwe ngenhla kumele kube yisipiliyoni esifanelekile/esoqashwayo ngemva kokuthola idiploma yonyaka o-1 yesifundo ngemva kwesisekelo kulawo mkhakha okhethekile. Izidingo ezikuleso sikhundla ngokwemvelo: Ilayisensi yokushayela (ikhodi B/EB) esebenzayo. Amandla/izindlela (ulwazi/obuchwepheshe): Ukulolongwa noma isipiliyoni se-NIMART. Faka isiboniso solwazi olujulile ngomthetho wezokunusinga nowezinsizakazo zikahulumeni. Ukubhalisele ekusebenziseni ikhompuyutha (i-MS Word ne-Excel). Amandla okukhuthaza inani elihle lenakekelo yigciwane ngokuqashiswa kwemithetho, iziqondiso nezidingezu.
zu.duties: Siza ekuzulazuleni ibhadra elithwesa isifundo ngokuvumelana neziqondiso nemithetho ye-Western Cape. Nikela bese ulondoloza inani lenakekelo kuwo wonke amagciwane nezinsizakalo zezenkalo. Gcina amarekhodi ohlinzayo aqinisekile, amarejista ezibalo, namarekhodi okuthumela. Ukusetshenziswa okuyisigqo Kwezinsiza/Impahla phakathi kokuqhawula kwesabelo esinciphile. Ukubamba iqhaza emicimbini emphakathi bese kuqalisa ukwazisa ngemikhakha ehlobene nezenkalo. Londoloza bese ubamba iqhaza kumsebenzi wesiqembu phakathi kwabelungu bezinkalo nolwazi oluhlukahlukene kodwa ukwazi ukusebenza wedwa. Qaphela bese umcondo izigaba eziphansi zabasebenzi. Londoloza ukukhula komsebenzi/izinga lenkolo yokwenza uhleze akuzuzisa.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi weS ezempilweni onqwanqweni lweGrede 1 ukuya kwi-2 (PRIMARY Health
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe ngumsebenzisi weS ezempilizoni onqwanqweni kwiKoue Bokkeveld Mobile kwisiphondo se-Witzenberg Sub-district ukunika unyango lwezempilo olusesixhenxe noku lawula umthwalo wezifo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga somfundo esingaphantsi kwemfuno: Isidanga esiyimfuno yeBasic R425 (okt. idiploma/isidanga kwezunyango) okt isidanga esilingana nalo (R683 plus R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengomsebenzisi weS ezempilo oPhambili. Isidanga ngaphezu kwesidanga seziseko, esibude bonyaka ubuncinane idiploma yonyaka o-1, kwizEzenzo zeziNyanga ezimayelana neMpilo: kuLinganiswa, kuNyango nokuQonda, esigunyaziswe yi-SANC (R 48) OKT isidanga se-bachelor's seminyaka emi-4 ezunyangelweni (R174) okt isidanga esilingana nalo (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengomsebenzisi weS ezempilo oPhambili. Idiploma yokufunda ngaphezu kwezidanga (R635) esigunyaziswe yi-SANC kwiNyango lweZempilo ezisesixhenxe. Ukubhaliswa kwinkundla yabahanzi: Ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengomsebenzisi weS ezempilo oPhambili. Uluhlu lweempazamo kumsebenzi: Grede 1: Ubuncinane iinyanga ezili-4 zoluhlu lweempazamo kumsebenzi ofanelekileyo/ovakalayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomsebenzisi weS ezempilo oPhambili kwiNyango jikelele. Grede 2: Ubuncinane iinyanga ezili-14 zoluhlu lweempazamo kumsebenzi ofanelekileyo/ovakalayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomsebenzisi weS ezempilo oPhambili kwiNyango jikelele. Ubuncinane iinyanga ezili-10 kwexesha elitshiwe ngasentla kufuneka zibe luluhlu lweempazamo kumsebenzi ofanelekileyo/ovakalayo emva kokufumana isidanga sokufunda ngaphezu kwesidanga seziseko unyaka o-1 kuleso sicatango. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokuqamba efanelekileyo (ikhowudi B/EB). Iimfuno (ulwazi/akhoni): uQeqesho okt uluhlu lweempazamo kwi-NIMART. Umboniso welwazi olujulileyo kwiziyalo kunye nemithetho yesebe lemizi. Ulwazi lweekhompyutha (i-MS Word ne-Excel). Ikhono lokukhuthaza unyango oluhle lwegula ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo, iindlela zokusebenza namazinga.
xh.duties: Nceda ekulawuleni umthwalo wezifo ngokwemigaqo nolwalamano lwase-Western Cape. Nikela zigcine inqanaba lenyango kuzo zonke iigula nesebe ezempilweni. Phatha ngokuchanekileyo iirekhodi zenyango, iirekho ezibalwayo, neerekhodo zokuqamba. Ukusebenzisa ngenkqubo zovimba/izinto ngaphakathi kweemida zomngxangamsilingo. Ukuzinikela kumcimbi womntakwethu nokuqalisa ukwazisa ngokwemiba ezimalunga nezempilo. Phatha ube nomnyhadala wenzuzo-ngqo exesha elinganayo kodwa ukwazi ukusebenza ngokwakho. Qeqesha bonelele abasebenzi abangesantsi kwesidanga. Phatha ukukhula/izinga lenkqubo olungqindilili nezinto ezibalulekileyo ezikho ngokuzinto ezikhoyo.

jobs.title: Industrial Technician Control General Engineering
jobs.summary: Manage and oversee 24/7 operations of the Hospital Command Centre at Groote Schuur Hospital, ensuring continuous monitoring of integrated building, CCTV, ICT and critical infrastructure systems.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: National Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (T- or N- or S- Stream) or registration as Engineering Technician in terms of the Engineering Professions of South Africa Act, (Act 46 of 2000). Experience: Extensive appropriate experience in integrated Building Management Systems (BMS), CCTV, ICT operational monitoring and critical infrastructure systems within a hospital or complex operational environment. Experience in operational coordination, incident management and infrastructure resilience planning. Project and contract management experience. Experience in a 24-hour operational or control room environment. Inherent requirements of the job: Able to perform standby and call-out duties. Able to work shifts in a 24-hour hospital environment. Valid driver’s licence. Able to respond physically on-site during major incidents. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Sound knowledge of integrated control systems, including BMS, emergency power monitoring, fire detection interfaces and security monitoring systems. Knowledge of regulatory compliance frameworks including Occupational Health & Safety Act and applicable SANS standards. Understanding of structured incident management principles and the Incident Command System (ICS). Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams during operational disruptions and declared major incidents. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel and Outlook). Strong analytical, planning and organisational skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively under pressure and maintain situational awareness in high-risk environments. 24- hour operational or control room environment experience.
jobs.duties: Hospital Operations Command Centre Management: Manage and oversee the 24/7 operations of the Hospital Command Centre, ensuring continuous monitoring and operational readiness of all integrated systems including BMS, CCTV, ICT network monitoring, emergency power interfaces and contact centre infrastructure. Major Incident Command (ICS Bronze Commander): Function as Bronze Commander during declared incidents such as fires, flooding, power interruptions or ICT outages. Coordinate engineering, ICT, security and support services teams, escalate to Silver and Gold Command where required, and activate Business Continuity Plans in line with the Hospital Major Incident Plan. Regulatory Compliance and Governance: Ensure full compliance with statutory, regulatory and hospital engineering standards. Conduct compliance audits, manage vendor performance against SLAs, certify work completion and maintain accurate operational documentation. Risk, Incident and Communication Management: Lead investigations into system failures and infrastructure disruptions. Prepare and implement risk mitigation plans. Oversee inbound and outbound operational communications, including dispatch of engineering, security and support service teams. Leadership and Workforce Development: Supervise Command Centre personnel, manage shift rosters, implement SPMS processes, facilitate training and ensure compliance with HR and labour legislation.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for these posts. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. ERRATUM: Kindly note that the advert for the Post 32/333: Assistant Manager Nursing (Primary Health Care) Nomzamo CDC, Khayelitsha/Eastern Sub- structure, Salary R785 568 per annum Centre: Nomzamo CDC advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 32 dated 04 September 2026, with reference number Post 32/333: Post has been cancelled. Kindly note that the advert for the POST 32/331: Deputy Director: Employee Relations (Dispute Resolutions, Misconduct And Litigation) Directorate: Employee Relations, Salary R 932 292 per annum (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.) Centre: Head Office, Cape Town (Stationed on the premises of Stikland Hospital) advertised in the Public Service Vacancy 32 dated 04 September 2026, with reference number Post 32/331: Post must be amended to include driver’s licence. af.title: Nywerheidstegnikus Beheer Algemene Ingenieurswese
af.summary: Bestuur en toesig oor 24/7-bedrywighede van die Hospitaalbeheersentrum by Groote Schuur-hospitaal, om deurlopende monitering van geïntegreerde gebou-, CCTV-, IKR- en kritieke infrastruktuurstelsels te verseker.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Nasionale Diploma in Elektriese of Meganiese Ingenieurswese (T- of N- of S-Stroom) of registrasie as Ingenieurstegnikus ingevolge die Engineering Professions of South Africa Act, (Act 46 of 2000). Ervaring: Uitgebreide toepaslike ervaring in geïntegreerde Geboubestuurstelsels (BMS), CCTV, IKR-bedryfsmonitering en kritieke infrastruktuurstelsels binne 'n hospitaal- of komplekse bedryfsmilieu. Ervaring in bedryfskoördinasie, voorvalbestuur en infrastruktuurweerbaarheidsbeplanning. Projek- en kontrakbestuurservaring. Ervaring in 'n 24-uur bedryfs- of beheerkameromgewing. Inheemse vereistes van die werk: In staat om bystand- en oproepligte uit te voer. In staat om skofte in 'n 24-uur hospitaalomgewing te werk. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. In staat om fisies op die terrein tydens groot voorvalle te reageer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Deeglike kennis van geïntegreerde beheerstelsels, insluitend BMS, noodkragmonitering, brandopsporingskoppelvlakke en sekuriteitsmoniteringstelsels. Kennis van regulasie-nakomingsraamwerke insluitend die Occupational Health & Safety Act en toepaslike SANS-standaarde. Begrip van gestruktureerde voorvalbestuursbeginsels en die Incident Command System (ICS). Vermoe om multidissiplinêre spanne tydens bedryfsversteurings en verklaarde groot voorvalle te koördineer. Rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel en Outlook). Sterke analitiese, beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoe om doeltreffend onder druk te werk en situasiebewustheid in hoërisiko-omgewings te handhaaf. 24-uur bedryfs- of beheerkameromgewingservaring.
af.duties: Bestuur van die Hospitaalbedrywighedebeheersentrum: Bestuur en toesig oor die 24/7-bedrywighede van die Hospitaalbeheersentrum, om deurlopende monitering en bedryfsgereedheid van alle geïntegreerde stelsels verseker, insluitend BMS, CCTV, IKR-netwerkmonitering, noodkragkoppelvlakke en kontaksentruminfrastruktuur. Bevel oor groot voorvalle (ICS Bronze Commander): Tree op as Bronze Commander tydens verklaarde voorvalle soos brande, oorstromings, kragonderbrekings of IKR-onderbrekings. Koördineer ingenieurswese-, IKR-, sekuriteits- en steundienste-spanne, skaal op na Silver en Gold Command waar nodig, en aktiveer Besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne in ooreenstemming met die Hospitaal se Groot Voorvalplan. Regulatiewe nakoming en bestuur: Verseker volle nakoming van statutêre, regulasie- en hospitaalingenieurswese-standaarde. Voer nakomingsoudits uit, bestuur verkoperprestasie teenoor SLA's, sertifiseer voltooiing van werk en handhaaf akkurate bedryfsdokumentasie. Risiko-, voorval- en kommunikasiebestuur: Lei ondersoeke na stelselfalings en infrastruktuurversteurings. Berei en implementeer risikobeperkingsplanne voor. Hou toesig oor inkomende en uitgaande bedryfskommunikasie, insluitend die ontplooiing van ingenieurswese-, sekuriteits- en steundienste-spanne. Leierskap en arbeidsmagontwikkeling: Oesien Beheersentrumpersoneel, bestuur skofroosters, implementeer SPMS-prosesse, fasiliteer opleiding en verseker nakoming van HR- en arbeidswetgewing.

zu.title: Industrial Technician Control General Engineering
zu.summary: Phatha futhi ulawule ukusebenza okuyi-24/7 kwe-Hospital Command Centre e-Groote Schuur Hospital, uqinisele ukulandelana kokubuka kwesistimu ehlanganisiwe yokwakha, i-CCTV, i-ICT kanye nesistimu yemizila ebalulekile.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingaphansi kwesidingo esincane: National Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (T- or N- or S- Stream) noma ukubhaliswa njengo-Engineering Technician ngokusho kwe-Engineering Professions of South Africa Act, (Act 46 of 2000). Isipheqeleuli: Isipheqeleuli esikhulu esifanele kwisistimu ehlukanisiwe yokuphatha izakhiwo (BMS), i-CCTV, ukulawula ukusebenza kwe-ICT kanye namasistimu emizila ebalulekile emnhlabeni wokusebenza wesibhedlela noma kumazinga ebucayi. Isipheqeleuli ekwenzeni ihlelo lokusebenza, ekuqondiseni izinkinga nasekweni uhlelo lokuzivikela kwemizila. Isipheqeleulu ekuphathweni kwamaphrojekthi nasekweni amakonthulaka. Isipheqeleuli emhlabeni wokusebenza okuyi-24-hour noma kwelungu lokulawula. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukuba nakho ukwenza imisebenzi yokumisaphephe futhi kubizwe uma kudingeka. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokushintshwa kwamashifu emhlabeni wesibhedlela okuyi-24-hour. Ilayisense yokushayela evaliwe. Ukuba nakho ukuziphendula ngokomzimba endaweni ngesikhathi sezinkinga ezinkulu. Ikhono (ulwazi/akhono): Ulwazi oluhle ngesistimu ehlukanisiwe yokulawula, okuhlanganisa i-BMS, ukubuka amandla ephutha, amasistimu okuthola imililo kanye namasistimu okubuka ukuphepha. Ulwazi ngesakhiwo esihambisana nemithetho yokulawula, okuhlanganisa i-Occupational Health & Safety Act nezindinganiso ze-SANS ezisebenzayo. Ukuqonda imigomo yokulawula izinkinga exhubile kanye ne-Incident Command System (ICS). Ikhono lokuhloma amaqembu ahlukene ngasesikhathini sezinkinga zokusebenza kanye nezinkinga ezinkulu ezibikiwe. Ukubaka khompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel ne-Outlook). Ikhono elikhulu lokuhlaziya, ukuhlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Ikhono elihle lokuthinta inhliziyo nokukhuluma. Ikhono lokusebenza kahle ngaphansi koxuba kanye nokugcina ukwazi okwenzayo emhlabeni ongoyingozi. Isipheqeleulu emhlabeni wokusebenza okuyi-24-hour noma kwelungu lokulawula.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha i-Hospital Operations Command Centre: Phatha futhi ulawule ukusebenza okuyi-24/7 kwe-Hospital Command Centre, uqinisele ukulandelana kokubuka nokulungele ukusebenza kwazo zonke izistimu ehlakanishiwe, okuhlanganisa i-BMS, i-CCTV, ukubuka ukusebenza kwenethiwekhi ye-ICT, izinhlokocompilo zamandla ephutha kanye nenhlokocompilo yendawo yokuthintana. Ukuhlomula Izinkathi Ezinkulu (ICS Bronze Commander): Yiba ngumholi wesikhundla se-Bronze Commander ngesikhathi kubikhwe izinkinga ezinkulu njengemililo, ukwanda kwamanzi, ukuphazamiseka kwamandla noma ukuphela kwe-ICT. Hlela amaqembu abakhi, be-ICT, bokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kanye nensekelo, dlulisela ku-Silver ne-Gold Command lapho kudingeka khona, futhi usebenzise Izinhlelo zoQofo lwesikhathi esizayo ngokuhambisana ne-Hospital Major Incident Plan. Ukulawula nokuhambisana Nemithetho: Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwayo yonke imithetho, izindinganiso zokusebenza zesibhedlela kanye nobunjiniyela. Yenza isivivinyo sokuhambisana nemithetho, phatha ukusebenza komthengisi ngokwama-SLA, qinisekisa ukugqitywa komsebenzi futhi ugciname ubuqotho bemibhalo yokusebenza. Ukuphatha Izingozi, Izinkinga Nokuxhumana: Holisa ukuphenya ngokusilela kamasistimu nokuqhubeka kwezinkinga zemizila. Lungiselela futhi usebenzise izinhlelo zokunciphisa izingozi. Buka ukuxhumana okungena nasekuphumayo kokusebenza, okuhlanganisa ukuthumela amaqembu okwakha, bokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwayo nensekelo. Ukubusa Nokuthuthukiswa Kwabasebenzi: Qondisa abantu be-Command Centre, phatha amashifu, usebenzise izinqubo ze-SPMS, yeqelele ukufundisa uqiniseke ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho ye-HR kanye nezomsebenzi.

xh.title: Itekhnishani yezamashishini eLawulo eNjineli Jikelele
xh.summary: Phatha kwaye ulawule ukusebenza kwiyure ezili-24/7 kweZiko loLawulo lweSibhedlele eGroote Schuur Hospital, kuqinisekiswe ukulandelela ngokungaloleki kweenkonzo ezibekiweyo zokwakha, ze-CCTV, ze-ICT nencedanelelwa yamajelo obugcisa obalulekileyo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifunekayo ngona: National Diploma kwi-Electrical okanye i-Mechanical Engineering (T- okanye N- okanye S- Stream) okanye ukubhaliswa njengeEngineering Technician ngokweEngineering Professions of South Africa Act, (Act 46 ka-2000). Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluthe ngqo oluninzi kwinkqubo yokwakha ebandakanyeneyo (BMS), i-CCTV, ukulawula ukusebenza kwe-ICT nencedanelelwa yamajelo obugcisa obalulekileyo ngaphakathi kwesibhedlele okanye kwindawo ekusebenza kuyo izinto ezinzima. Ulwazi lokuhlelela ukusebenza, ukulawula iingxaki nokuqwalasela ukuqina kwenkonzo efunyanwa ngaphandle. Ulwazi lokuphatha iiprojekthi namagqabantshintshi. Ulwazi kwindawo yokusebenza amayure angama-24 okanye kwigumbi lolawulo. Iimfuno ezizaliseleka ngaphakathi kwmsebenzi: Ukuba nakho ukwenza imisebenzi yokulinda kwaye ubizwe xa kufuneka. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokutshintshwa kweshifthi kwisibhedlele esisebenza amayure angama-24. Ilayisenisi ethobekileyo yokushayela. Ukuba nakho ukuzibonakalisa ngokomzimba kwindawo yomsebenzi xa kubakho iingxaki ezinkulu. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluhle ngamajelo olawulo abandakanyeneyo, aquka i-BMS, ukulawula amandla e-engcaleni, amajelo okuqaphela umlilo namajelo okuqaphela khuseleko. Ulwazi ngamacebo othembeko omthetho aquka i-Occupational Health & Safety Act namagqabantshintshi e-SANS afanelekileyo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokulawula iingxaki nendlela yokulawula iingxaki (ICS). Amandla okuhlelela iinqembu zabantu abanemisebenzi eyahlukeneyo ngecuba kukho ukuphazamiseka kukusebenza naxa kuvelwe iingxaki ezinkulu. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel ne-Outlook). Amandla amakhulu oko kuhlalutya, ukuqamba amacebo nokuqamba iindlela zokuhlelela. Amandla ahle kwayo kubhalwa nokuThetha. Amandla okusebenza kakuhle ngenxaxha kwaye ulondoloze ukuqonda imeko yendawo kwindawo ezinemingcinga ephezulu. Ulwazi lokusebenza kwindawo esebenza amayure angama-24 okanye kwigumbi lolawulo.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha iZiko loLawulo lokuSebenza kweSibhedlele: Phatha kwaye ulawule ukusebenza kwiyure ezili-24/7 kweZiko loLawulo lweSibhedlele, kuqinisekiswe ukulandelela ngokungaloleki nokulungelelana ukusebenza kwaye yonke inkqubo ebandakanyeneyo kuquka i-BMS, i-CCTV, ukulawula inethiwekhi ye-ICT, amajelo amandla engcaleni nencedanelelwa yamajelo obugcisa bengingqi. uLawulo lweNgxaki eNkulu (ICS iBronze Commander): Ukuba ngumlawuli iBronze xa kubhengezwe iingxaki ezinje ngemililo, ukufakwa manzi, ukuphahlwa kwamandla okanye ukuphahlwa kwe-ICT. Uhlelele iinqembu zolwakhiwo lwezamashishini, ze-ICT, zokhuseleko nenzinkonzo zokuxhasa, uphakamise kwelinye inqanaba ukuya kwi-Silver ne-Gold Command apho kufuneka khona, kwaye uvule amacebo oKusuka kuQhagamshelo lokuSebenza ngokwesisicwangwso sokuBakho kweNgxaki eNkulu eSibhedlele. uThembeko koMthetho noLawulo: Qinisekisa ukuthembeka ngokupheleleyo kwemigaqo yomthetho, yomthetho wezemidlalo nedayimetha yezamashishini yesibhedlele. Yenza uqwalaselo lokuzinikela, phatha inkonzo yomthengisi nangokwamayiloni e-SLA, qinisekisa ukugqitywa komsebenzi uze ulondoloze umbhalo ochanekileyo wezinto ezisenziwayo. uLawulo lweengozi, lweNgxaki nokuThetha: Yenza iingxelo zophando ngokusilela kweenkqubo nokuphahlwa kwenkonzo efunyanwa ngaphandle. Lungiseza kwaye usebenzise amacebo okuthomalalisa iingozi. Lawula ukungeniswa nokuphumiswa kwezinyathelo zokusebenza ezithethwayo, kuquku nakusetyenzwa iinkqubo zokuthumela iinkqubo zokusebenza zolwakhiwo, zokhuseleko nezokuxhasa. uKukhokela nokuPhuhlisa abaSebenzi: Qwalasela abantu baseZiko loLawulo, phatha i roster zoshintsho loshifti, yenza amanqanaba e-SPMS, yenza isixhobo esiluncedo sokuzifundisa iqinisekise ukuthembeka ngokwezemisebenzi yabantu nomthetho wabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Clinical Technologist Grade 1 to 3 (CARDIOLOGY)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R413 121 per annum Grade 2: R482 499 per annum Grade 3: R564 822 per annum
jobs.summary: Clinical Technologist (Cardiology) position at Tygerberg Hospital requiring HPCSA registration, with salaries ranging from Grade 1 to Grade 3.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows for registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Clinical Technologist in Cardiology. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as Clinical Technologist: Cardiology. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Cardiology in respect of RSA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Cardiology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Cardiology respect of SA qualified employees. A Minimum of 11 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Cardiology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. - Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Cardiology in respect of SA qualified employees. A minimum of 21 years’ relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA as a Clinical Technologist: Cardiology in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in South Africa. Inherent requirement of the job: After-hours’ service is compulsory. Valid driver's license. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Advanced knowledge of Echocardiography, Hemodynamics and Cath lab work including IVUS and OCT and IABP therapy and hemodynamic analysis. Importantly you need to be very skilled in pacemaker implant testing and follow up of pacemaker, ICD’S and CRT devices. Need to do ECG Holter ECG, stress ECG and Dobutamine stress Echo. Relevant experience in all aspects of Cardiac Physiology. Emergency procedures and ACLS competency required.
jobs.duties: Perform electrocardiograms (ECGs) on patients in laboratory, ward, and intensive care unit (ICU) settings to monitor and assess rhythm abnormalites. Conduct stress tests and exercise tolerance tests in laboratory settings to evaluate cardiac performance under physical exertion. Perform echocardiography (including transthoracic and transesophageal echocardiograms) on patients in Echo unit, ward, and ICU settings to assess heart structure and function. Carry out Holter monitoring and ambulatory blood pressure monitoring to evaluate cardiac rhythm and blood pressure over extended periods. Perform advanced cardiac diagnostic procedures, such as tilt table testing and cardiac event monitoring, in laboratory and clinical settings. Assist in cardiac catheterization procedures and other interventional cardiology procedures in the catheterization laboratory with regards to hemodynamics and emergency procedures. -Participate in intraoperative monitoring during pacemaker surgeries to ensure patient safety. Participate in research projects related to cardiology, contributing to advancements in cardiac care and technology. Engage in ongoing quality control and infection control measures to maintain high standards of patient care and safety. Train and mentor Clinical Technology students in cardiology, sharing expertise and practical knowledge. Perform administrative duties as assigned, including maintaining patient records, managing equipment, and ensuring compliance with clinical protocols.

Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to health professionals who apply for the first time for registration as Clinical Technologist: Cardiology with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). -It should be noted that the advertised post is linked to the Institution that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.summary: Kliniese Tegnoloog (Kardiologie) pos by Tygerberg Hospital wat HPCSA-registrasie vereis, met salarisse wat wissel van Graad 1 tot Graad 3.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog in Kardiologie toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as Kliniese Tegnoloog: Kardiologie. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Kardiologie ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Kardiologie ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie nodig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Kardiologie ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 11 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Kardiologie ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie nodig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. - Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Kardiologie ten opsigte van SA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers. 'n Minimum van 21 jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Kliniese Tegnoloog: Kardiologie ten opsigte van buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers, vir wie dit nie nodig is om Gemeenskapsdiens te verrig nie, soos in Suid-Afrika vereis. Inhaerente vereiste van die werk: Na-ure diens is verpligtend. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Gevorderde kennis van Echokardiografie, Hemodinamika en Katlaboratoriumwerk insluitend IVUS en OCT en IABP-terapie en hemodinamiese analise. Belangrik is dat u baie bedrewe moet wees in pasmaker-inplantingtoetsing en opvolg van pasmaker, ICD'S en CRT-toestelle. Benodig om EKG Holter EKG, inspanning EKG en Dobutamien inspanning Echo te doen. Relevante ervaring in alle aspekte van Hartfisiologie. Noodprosedures en ACLS-bevoegdheid vereis.
af.duties: Voer elektrokardiogramme (EKG's) op pasiënte in laboratorium-, saal- en intensiewesorgeenheid (ICU)-omgewings uit om ritme-afwykings te monitor en te evalueer. Voer inspanningstoetse en oefeningverdraagsaamheidstoetse in laboratoriumomgewings uit om hartprestasie onder fisiese inspanning te evalueer. Voer echokardiografie (insluitend transtorakale en transesofageale echokardiogramme) op pasiënte in Echo-eenheid, saal- en ICU-omgewings uit om hartstruktuur en -funksie te assesseer. Voer Holter-monitering en ambulante bloeddrukmonitering uit om hartslagritme en bloeddruk oor lang tydperke te evalueer. Voer gevorderde hartdiagnostiese prosedures uit, soos kanteltafeltoetsing en hartgebeurtenismonitering, in laboratorium- en kliniese omgewings. Bystand in hartkatheterisasieprosedures en ander intervensionele kardiologieprosedures in die katheterisasielaboratorium met betrekking tot hemodinamika en noodprosedures. -Neem deel aan intraoperatiewe monitering tydens pasmakeroperasies om pasiëntveiligheid te verseker. Neem deel aan navorsingsprojekte wat verband hou met kardiologie, en dra by tot vooruitgang in hartversorging en -tegnologie. Neem deel aan deurlopende gehaltebeheer en infeksiebeheermaatreëls om hoë standaarde van pasiëntversorging en -veiligheid te handhaaf. Train en mentor Kliniese Tegnologie-studente in kardiologie, en deel kundigheid en praktiese kennis. Voer administratiewe pligte soos toegeken uit, insluitend die handhaaf van pasiëntrekords, die bestuur van toerusting, en die verseker van voldoening aan kliniese protokolle.

zu.title: Ubuchwepheshe Bezokwelapha Bokungasese Beminyaka yobudala 1 kuye kwa-3 (I-CARDIOLOGY)

zu.requirements: Izifundo ezidingekayo: Isifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha bokungasese kwi-Cardiology. Ukubhaliswa kubhungo lobuchwepheshe: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha bokungasese: I-Cardiology. Isipiliyoni: Isigaba 1: Asikho isipiliyoni emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha bokungasese: I-Cardiology mayelana nabasebenzi abathola izifundo e-RSA. Unyaka o-1 wesi-piliyoni esifanele emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha bokungasese: I-Cardiology mayelana nabasebenzi abathola izifundo kwamanye amazwe, abangadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi, njengokuqityiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Isigaba 2: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha bokungasese: I-Cardiology mayelana nabasebenzi abathola izifundo e-SA. Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-11 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha bokungasese: I-Cardiology mayelana nabasebenzi abathola izifundo kwamanye amazwe, abangadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi, njengokuqityiswa eNingizimu Afrika. - Isigaba 3: Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-20 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha bokungasese: I-Cardiology mayelana nabasebenzi abathola izifundo e-SA. Ubuncane beminyaka eyi-21 yesipiliyoni esifanele emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha bokungasese: I-Cardiology mayelana nabasebenzi abathola izifundo kwamanye amazwe, abangadingeki ukuba benze isevisi yomphakathi, njengokuqityiswa eNingizimu Afrika. Isidingo sangaphakathi somsebenzi: Isevisi yemahora angemuva kweyomsebenzi iyisidingo. Ilayisensi yomshayeli evumelekile. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluthuthukile lwe-Echocardiography, i-Hemodynamics kanye nomsebenzi we-Cath lab okuhlanganisa i-IVUS ne-OCT kanye nokwelashwa kwe-IABP kunganhlalakahle. Kubalulekile ukuthi ube nobuchwepheshe obukhulu ekwenzeni ukuhlolwa kwe-pacemaker kanye nokulandela i-pacemaker, ama-ICD'S namadivayisi e-CRT. Kudingeka ukwenze i-ECG Holter ECG, i-stress ECG kanye ne-Dobutamine stress Echo. Isipiliyoni esifanele kuzo zonke izinkomba zesiLPhysical Physiology. Izinqubo eziphuthumayo kanye nobuchwepheshe be-ACLS kudingeka.
zu.duties: Yenza ama-electrocardiograms (ama-ECG) kubantu abagulayo kwilabhu, emagcekeni, nasendaweni yezinkulungwane eziphuthumayo (ICU) ukuze ulawule futhi uhlole izinkinga zegama. Yenza izivivinyo zesibhunyulo kanye nezivivinyo zesikunyulu kwilabhu ukuze uhlole ukusebenza kwenhliziyo ngesikhathi sokuziloloha ngokomzimba. Yenza i-echocardiography (okuhlanganisa i-transthoracic kanye nama-transesophageal echocardiograms) kubantu abagulayo kwilabhu ye-Echo, emagcekeni, nasendaweni yezinkulungwane eziphuthumayo ukuze uhlole isakhiwo nokusebenza kwenhliziyo. Qamba ukulandelwa kwe-Holter kanye nokulawulwa kwegazi ukuze uhlole igama lenhliziyo kanye negazi ixesha elide. Yenza izinqubo eziphuthumayo zokuhlola inhliziyo, njengokuhlola ngokugxila etafuleni nokulawulwa kwezehlakalo zenhliziyo, kwilabhu kanye nasendaweni yezokwelapha. Siza kuzinkqubo zokuqhuba isikhingci senhliziyo kanye nezinye izinqubo zokwelapha nge-cardiology kwilabhu yokuqhuba isikhingci mayelana ne-hemodynamics kanye nezinqubo eziphuthumayo. -Thatha inxaxheba ekulawulweni phakathi nokwenza ukuqhuba kwesikhathi phakathi kwezinkqubo zokuqhuba i-pacemaker ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha komuntu ophila. Thatha inxaxheba kwimiklamo yocwaningo mayelana ne-cardiology, ukuthumelela ekuthuthukisweni kokunakekelwa nokuchwepheshe kwenhliziyo. Zibandakanya ezintweni zokuqinisekisa isimo ngaso sonke isikhathi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kungalawuleki ukutheleleka ukuze kugcinwe izinga eliphezulu lokunakekelwa nokuphepha komuntu ophila. Hlola futhi ulule abafundi be-Clinical Technology ku-cardiology, ukwabelana ngolwazi nobuchwepheshe. Yenza imisebenzi yokuqondisa njengokuqokelelwa, okuhlanganisa ukugcina izinto zomuntu ophila, ukuphatha izesekho, nokuthi kuthobwe izinqubo zezokwelapha ezibalulekile.

Amava awayini elinganayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengento yezobuTekhnoloji yamakliniki: Cardiology malunga nabasebenzi basemandle abagqithisweyo kumazwe ngamazwe, abangafunwa ukuba benze iNkonzo yomPhakathi, njengoko kufunwa eMzantsi Afrika. - Grade 3: Amava eminyaka eli-20 elinganayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengento yezobuTekhnoloji yamakliniki: Cardiology malunga nabasebenzi abagqithisweyo e-SA. Amava eminyaka eli-21 elinganayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengento yezobuTekhnoloji yamakliniki: Cardiology malunga nabasebenzi basemandle abagqithisweyo kumazwe ngamazwe, abangafunwa ukuba benze iNkonzo yomPhakathi, njengoko kufunwa eMzantsi Afrika. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Inkonzo yangaphandle kwiiyure zomsebenzi iyaphothwa. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhompethensi (ulwazi/izikholo): Ulwazi oluphakamileyo nge-Echocardiography, i-Hemodynamics nomsebenzi we-Cath lab kuquka i-IVUS ne-OCT kunye nonyango lwe-IABP nolanalizishini yamazalegazi. Kubalulekile ukuba ube namava amaninzi ekuvavweni kokufakwa kwamaxhala e-pacemaker nasekuzingatsheni i-pacemaker, i-ICD ne-CRT devices. Kufuneka ukwenze i-ECG Holter ECG, i-stress ECG nika-Dobutamine stress Echo. Amava ahambelana nayo yonke into ngokwefizikhi yentliziyo. Iinkqubo zesigwegaba kunye nekhompetensi ye-ACLS ziyafuneka.
xh.duties: Yenza izielektrokhadiyogramu (i-ECGs) kwabaguli kwilabhu, kwigumbi lokulala, nakwingxowa yokunyangeka ixesha elide (i-ICU) ukuze ulawule uvakale ukungalingani kwemithambo. Qhuba izivavanyo zindwengula nokuqina komzimba kwilabhu ukuze ulinganise isimo sentliziyo ngelixa kukho nzima lomzimba. Yenza i-echocardiography (kuquka i-transthoracic kunye ne-transesophageal echocardiograms) kwabaguli kwigumbi le-Echo, kwigumbi lokulala, nakwingxowa yonke unyango lwesigina ukuze uhlolisise isakhiwo nemisebenzi yentliziyo. Yenza ulawulo lwe-Holter nokuqaphela umthamo wegazi ixesha elide ukulinganisa ukuya phambili kwemithambo yegazi ngelixa elidlulayo. Yenza iinkqubo zokuvavanya isifo sentliziyo ezibalulekileyo, ezinjengesivavanyo se-tilt table kunye nokuqaphela iziganeko zentliziyo, kwilabhu nakwindawo yamakliniki. Nceda kumasebe okufakwa i-catheter kwentliziyo nakwezinye iinkqubo ebalulekileyo zonyango kwilabhu yokufaka i-catheter ngakumbi kwizinto ezichukumisayo nemisitho yamaza legazi. -Thatha inxaxheba kulawulo lwendalo-ngqo ngelixa kwenziwa iindwendwe zokufakwa kwepacemaker ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhuseleko lomguli. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphrojekthi ophando ahlobene ne-Cardiology, ungene phakathi kwimiba ecacisa ngeenkqubo nobuThanjhwe bexesha elizayo ekunyangekeni izifo. Zibandakanya kumanyathelo aqhubekayo o lawulo oluhle nolulwa nasantlazi ukuze bagcine amagaba aphezulu okunyathelwa kwakhona nokhuseleko lomsebenzi nenyango lwabaguli. Yazi intsebenziso yolwazi kwizifundo zamaklinhiki kwiCardiology, ngexabiso elimaphakathi kodwa elinamava ahambelana nendlwini yokusebenzisa ulwazi lobungcali. Yenza imisebenzi yentsebenziso njengoko nikwe ngoko, nasekugcineni i-nkwputhu yendlela yokulawula isimo kunye nokuqinisekiswa kwamagatya egazi kunye nokuvunywa, ngokuqinisekisa imigangatho yokunyanga ukulondoloza nokuphuhlisa izigaba.

Gcina ulawule izibalo ze-Worker Relations uhleze umbiko ohlelekile wabaphathi nabahlanyele abafanele. Siza ngokulungiselela imikhakha yokubuyisana noxazulo, okuhlanganisa ukulungiselela ukubhali kwamafayela okusekelayo nokugcina izinkomishi zoxazulo. -Nika inkxaso yokulawula i-Administrative Clerk ne-Intern usize i-Senior Administrative Officer ngezibopho zokulawula. Khuthaza ukuziphendulela ngomthetho wabasebenzi, izivumelano zenkundla kanye nenqubomgomo nenqubo yomnyango ye-Worker Relations.

xh.title: IOfisa yeNgqungqutha: Imiba Yabasebenzi
xh.summary: Isithuba seOfisa yeNgqungqutha ngaphakathi kwi Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness esinika inkxaso kumiba yabasebenzi nokuqhuba iinkqubo zolungelelano nezinqweliso.
xh.requirements: Isimimangalo esincinci somfundo: Isatifikethi samabanga aphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo). Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo kwimeko yemiba yabasebenzi. Isimfuno engaphakathi msebenzi: Ilayisenisi yomqhubi ye-Code B/EB eseleyo. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba. Ikhono lokusebenza ngodidi lomntu naphantsi koxinzelelo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokusebenzela ngokuchanekileyo kwimeko yeqela. Ikhono (ulwazi/akhono): Umthetho wabasebenzi nemiqathango yokubumba. Iinkqubo zolawulo lwemiba yabasebenzi, iinkqubo, namagqabantshintshi. Iinkqubo zomthetho namacebiso afanelekileyo eziko, lwephondo, nolwavelwano. Iinkqubo zolungelelano, izinqweliso, nokusombulula iingxabano. Iinkqubo zokubumba namava olwabiwo lwabasebenzi. Ukuzazi ikhompyutha. Aakhono zobudlelwane bomntu nomntu nolawulo lobudlelwane. Aakhono wolawulo lweengxabano nokuqxumba. Aakhono okwenza iigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki. Aakhono okutolika iinkqubo. Aakhono zokubonisa nokuqhuba. Aakhono zobuThetha ngomlomo nangezibhalo ezichanekileyo. Aakhono zolawulo nolawulo lweekomiti. Ikhono lokulungisa nokuqwalasela izibalo namaxesha emiba yabasebenzi.
xh.duties: Nika izindululo, inkxaso nokuqondisa abasebenzi nabaphathi ngemiba yabasebenzi, umthetho wabasebenzi, imiqathango yokubumba nadiinkqubo zesebe. Qhuba uze ulawule iimeko zolungelelano nolawulo lwezinqweliso, kuquka ukugcina iidesabhasi, iirejista, nerekhodi zecala. Khuthaza ukusebenza ngokusebenzela ngokuchanekileyo kwe-Institutional Management and Labour Committee (IMLC) ngokulungelelanisa iindibano, ukulungisa iajenda, ukurekhoda imizuzu nokugcina izibalo zolwabiwo lwabasebenzi. Nika inkxaso yolawulo nendebe zokuhamba kwemiba yabasebenzi ekuyimfuneko zokuqeqesha nophuhliso. Gcina uze uqwalasele izibalo zemiba yabasebenzi ulungise amaxesha eziphandla lolawulo nabalindelekileyo. Nceda kulungelelano lweemeko zoxoliso nolwesixhobo solwazi, kuquka ulungelelano lwamaxwebhu enkxaso nogcino lweerejista zeengxabano. -Nika inkxaso yokulawula kwi-Administrative Clerk ne-Intern uze uncede i-Senior Administrative Officer nemitato yolawulo. Khuthaza ukuthobela umthetho wabasebenzi, imiqathango yokubumba nadiinkqubo namacebiso emiba yabasebenzi esebe.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Finance/admin (REVENUE)
jobs.centre: Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre (Orthotics and Prosthetic Centre)
jobs.summary: Administrative officer managing patient administration, medical records and revenue functions at the Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with Mathematics and/or Accounting as passed subject and/or Senior Certificate (or equivalent) with experience/competencies that focuses on the Key Performance Areas (KRA’s) of the post. Experience: Appropriate experience in Revenue (Patient Administration and medical records). Appropriate experience in a hospital administration environment. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) drivers’ license. Expected to travel between O&P Centre, Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre and Brackengate Transitional Care Facility to provide support when operationally required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy in Microsoft Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Access). Workable knowledge of AR System, Clinicom, BAS as well as knowledge of UPFS, Chapter 18, PFMA, handling of state money, patient records management and all circulars, instructions and policies related to the above. Good supervisory, interpersonal, leadership and communication skills and a strong sense of responsibility. Good organizational and administrative skills and the ability to function in a team and under pressure.
jobs.duties: Manage Patient Administration Services and Medical Records with the aim of enhancing data quality and patient information and records according to Finance instruction, circulars, and policies. Manage the fees department and ensure implementation and compliance with relevant Finance Instructions, Revenue notices, SOP’s and PFMA as well as conducting and attending meetings and forums. Effective management of Revenue debt and budget control. Ensure completion and submission of monthly reports and provide feedback to management. Ensure effective Human Resources Management, which includes the management of disciplinary procedures as well as supervision and evaluation of staff under your control. Support with security contract and telecommunication service request and repairs. Provide support to management and staff as service delivery needs arise.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Administratiewe beampte: Finansies/admin (INKOMSTE)
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte wat pasiëntadministrasie, mediese rekords en inkomstefunksies by die Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Certificate (of ekwivalent) met Wiskunde en/of Rekeningkunde as geslaagde vak en/of Senior Certificate (of ekwivalent) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat op die Sleutelprestasiegebiede (KRA's) van die pos fokus. Ervaring: Geskikte ervaring in Inkomste (Pasiëntadministrasie en mediese rekords). Geskikte ervaring in 'n hospitaaladministrasie-omgewing. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Daar word verwag om tussen O&P Centre, Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre en Brackengate Transitional Care Facility te reis om ondersteuning te bied wanneer dit operasioneel vereis word. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Access). Werkbare kennis van AR-stelsel, Clinicom, BAS asook kennis van UPFS, Hoofstuk 18, PFMA, hantering van staatsgeld, pasiëntrekordbestuur en alle sirkulêres, instruksies en beleide wat verband hou met bogenoemde. Goeie toesighoudende, interpersoonlike, leierskaps- en kommunikasievaardighede en 'n sterk sin van verantwoordelikheid. Goeie organisatoriese en administratiewe vaardighede en die vermoë om in 'n span en onder druk te funksioneer.
af.duties: Bestuur Pasiëntadministrasiedienste en Mediese Rekords met die doel om datakwaliteit en pasiëntinligting en rekords te verbeter volgens Finansies-instruksies, sirkulêres en beleide. Bestuur die fooie-afdeling en verseker implementering en nakoming van toepaslike Finansies-instruksies, Inkomste-kennisgewings, SOP's en PFMA asook die hou en bywoning van vergaderings en forums. Effektiewe bestuur van Inkomste-skuld en begrotingbeheer. Verseker voltooiing en indiening van maandelikse verslae en verskaf terugvoer aan bestuur. Verseker effektiewe Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, wat die bestuur van dissiplinêre prosedures asook toesig en evaluering van personeel onder u beheer insluit. Ondersteun met sekuriteitskontrak en telekommunikasiediensversoeke en herstelwerk. Verskaf ondersteuning aan bestuur en personeel soos diensleweringbehoeftes ontstaan.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokuphatha: Izimali/ukuphathwa (INGENISO)
zu.summary: Umphathi wezokuphatha obephatha ukuphathwa kweguli, imibhalo yezokwelapha kanye nemisebenzi yegeniso kwi-Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) ene-Mathematics kanye/noma i-Accounting njengesifundo esidlulile kanye/noba Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) onamava/ukuziqhenya okugxila kumaphula amandla okwenza umsebenzi (KRA’s) wesikhundla. Amava: Amava afanele ezingenisweni (Ukuphathwa kweguli kanye nemibhalo yezokwelapha). Amava afanele esimweni sokuphathwa kwezibhedlela. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Amalayisensi wokushayela (Code B/EB) osebenzayo. Kulindeleke ukuba uhambe phakathi kwe-O&P Centre, Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre kanye ne-Brackengate Transitional Care Facility ukuze unikeze inkxaso uma kudingeka ngokwezomsebenzi. Ukuziqhenya (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi lwekhompyutha ku-Microsoft Office (MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Access). Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwe-AR System, Clinicom, BAS kanye nolwazi lwe-UPFS, Isahluko 18, PFMA, ukuphathwa kwemali kahulumeni, ukuphathwa kwemibhalo yeguli kanye nawo wonke amaketanga, imiyalo kanye namapholisi ahlobene nalokhu. Amasu mahle okuhlola, okuhlobana nabantu, okuhola kanye nokuxhumana kanye nendima enkulu yobuncwadi. Amasu mahle ohlelo kanye nezokuphatha kanye namandla okusebenza eqenjini nangaphansi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Phatha Isevisi Yokuphathwa Kweguli kanye Nemibhalo Yezokwelapha nenhloso yokuthuthukisa izinga ledatha kanye nolwazi nemibhalo yeguli ngokwezimali, amaketanga, kanye namapholisi. Phatha isigaba sezimali futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwayo nokuhambisana nemiYalo Yezimali ehlobene, izaziso zegeniso, i-SOP’s kanye ne-PFMA kanye nokubamba nokujoyela imihlangano kanye namaphoramu. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwesikoto seenzuzo kanye nolawulo lwebhajethi. Qinisekisa ukugcwaliswa kanye nokuhambiswa kwemibiko yenyanga ngenyanga futhi unikeze umbiko ohleziwe ebusweni. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo Kwemisebenzi Yomuntu, okufaka phakathi ukuphathwa kwenqubo yokujezisa kanye nokuqapha kanye nokuhlola abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Nikela inkxaso ngokusebenzana nesivumelwano sokuqinisekiswa kanye nesicelo sesevisi yezoxhumano kanye nezinto zokulungisa. Nikela inkxaso ebusweni kanye nabasebenzi njengoba kuziswa izidingo zokuletha isevisi.

xh.title: Ofisi yoLawulo: iZeMali/ulawulo (iNGENISO)
xh.summary: Ofisi yomlawulo ebalula ulawulo lwesigulane, amarekhodo eMediko nemi. Shisho loNgeniso e-Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingowona siphelo: I-Senior Certificate (okuba silingana nayo) ene-Mathematics kwaye/okanye i-Accounting njengomthetho odlulileyo kwaye/okungekhona i-Senior Certificate (okuba silingana nayo) ngamava/ukuzibonakalisa oqwalaselwa kwiindawo ezibalulekileyo zoKusebenza (i-KRA) yesithuba. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo kuNgeniso (uLawulo lwezigulane namarekhodo eMediko). Amava afanelekileyo kwindawo yolawulo lwesibhedlele. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kolusebenzi: ilayisenisi yomqhubi (Code B/EB) eseleyo. Kulindeleke ukuba uhambe phakathi kwe-O&P Centre, i-Western Cape Rehabilitation Centre kunye ne-Brackengate Transitional Care Facility ukuze ubonelele nceda xa kufuneka ngokomsebenzi. Ukuzibonakalisa (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuluba ngekhompyutha kwi-Microsoft Office (i-MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Access). Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwe-AR System, i-Clinicom, i-BAS nakho ulwazi lwe-UPFS, i-Chapter 18, i-PFMA, ukuphatha imali karhulumente, ulawulo lwerekhodo zegulane nayo yonke imiyalezo, imiyalelo namapolisi ahambelana noku kwangasentla. Amakhono amabalulekileyo oLawulo, obuntu bokunxibelelana nabantu, bobuquulo nobuquulo bokunxibelelwana kunye nendyikitya yokubathath'inyanzelo. Amakhono abalulekileyo olwazi lolungiselelo nolawulo kunye noku. Alula kukwazi ukusebenza nakwiqela elinye nakwiqela elinye nangantsino.
xh.duties: Balula iinkonzo zoLawulo lwezigulane kunye neNqaku zeMediko ngenjongo yokuphucula umgangatho wedatha nanolwazi mayela nesigulane namarekhodi ngokwemiyalelo yezeMali, iindaba ezithunyelwayo, namapolisi. Balula isebe leemfihlelo qinisekisa ukusebenza nokuthobela imiyalelo ephathwayo yezeMali, iindaba ezithunyelwayo zeNgeniso, i-SOP kunye ne-PFMA nakho ukubamba nokubakhona kwiintlanganiso namagumbi. Ulawulo olusebenzayo lwezikweletu zeNgeniso lolawulo lwebhajeti. Qinisekisa ukugqitywa nokuthunyelwa kweengxelo zenyanga zinyanga kwaye ubonelele ngeNgxelo ebuyela embindini kubaphathi. Qinisekisa uLawulo olusebenzayo lweZeMiSebenzo yoLuntu,oko kuquka ulawulo lwendlela ezisetyenziswa ekuhohlweni kwabasebenzi kunye nokuqondisa nokuhlola abasebenzi abakulawulo lwakho. Nceda ngemivuzo yokhuseleko nezicelo zenkonzo yokunxibelelwana kunye nokulungiswa. Bonelela nceda kubaphathi nakubasebenzi njengoko iimfuno zokuhanjiswa kwenkonko zisuka zifike.
