af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Inligtingsbestuur
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte vir Inligtingsbestuur by Worcester Streeks-hospitaal, wat gesondheidsorgdatakwaliteit, nakoming, en monitering en evaluering verseker.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike Nasionale Diploma (NQF6) of gelykwaardig. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Inligtingsbestuur binne 'n gesondheidsverskaffer-omgewing. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en oortyd te werk indien nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie werkskennis en ervaring in Gesondheidsinligtingstelsels (SINJANI; Clinicom; ECCR, Hectis en SPV. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Windows (Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook). Logiese denker met aandag aan detail en vermoë om akkurate en betroubare uitsette in 'n sperdatygedrewe omgewing te lewer.
af.duties: Databestuur en Kwaliteitsversekering: Verseker die akkuraatheid, kwaliteit en nakoming van gesondheidsorgdata deur validering, ouditering, verslagdoening en voldoening aan voorgeskrewe standaarde, terwyl data-gebruikers en deurlopende kwaliteitsverbetering ondersteun word. Monitering en Evaluering: Analiseer gesondheidsdata, monitor prestasie en ondersteun ingeligte besluitneming en kwaliteitsverbetering. Inligtingstelselbestuur: Bestuur hospitaalinligtingstelsels deur gebruikers te ondersteun, datakwaliteit te monitor, stelseltoegang te beheer en nakoming te verseker. IT-ondersteuning en Koördinering: Verskaf IT-ondersteuning, bestuur helpdesk-versoeke, onderhou IT-bates en verseker stelselnakoming en -kontinuïteit. Lijnfunksie en Personeeltoesig: Hou toesig oor personeelprestasie en -ontwikkeling terwyl doeltreffende bedrywighede en nakoming van HR-beleide verseker word. Ondersteuning aan toesighouer: Verseker dienskontinuïteit deur vir die toesighouer waar te neem wanneer vereis en belanghebbende-koördinering te ondersteun.

zu.title: Inkantshela Yolwazi: Ulawulo Lolwazi
zu.summary: Inkantshela Yolwazi yomsebenzi wolawulo lolwazi e-Worcester Regional Hospital, eqinisekisa izinga lomphumela wamaphrobhlemi, ukuzigcina emthethweni, kanye nokulawula nokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo eyingqayizivele: National Diploma (NQF6) efanele noma elingana nayo. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele kwi-Information Management ngaphakathi kwendawo yonikezelo lezempilo. Izidingo zomsebenzi ezingakhishiwa: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekayo. Ukuthanda ukuhamba nokusebenza noma kunini uma kudingeka. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza nolwazi kwi-Health Information Systems (SINJANI; Clinicom; ECCR, Hectis kanye ne-SPV. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokuphumelelayo kwi-MS Windows (Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook). Ukucabanga ngokuya ngezimpilo nokuqaphela imininingwane kanye namandla okukhiqiza imiphumela eqinisekile nethembekile kwindawo eshicilelwa isikhathi.
zu.duties: Ulawulo Lombhalo Nokugqinisa Ikhwalithi: Iqinisekisa ukujwayelekile, ikhwalithi, nokuziphatha ngokuvumelana komphumela wezempilo ngokuqinisekisa, ukuhlola, ukubika, nokulandela izinga ezibekiwe, kuyilawudla isekela abasebenzisi umbhalo bokuqhubeka okuqhubekayo nokuphuculwa ikhwalithi. Ukulawula Nokuhlola: Ihlola umbhalo wezempilo, ilawula ukwenza kwaye isekela ukuthathwa kwezinqumo nokuqondile nokuphucula ikhwalithi. Ulawulo Lwamasistimu Wolwazi: Ilawula amasistimu wolwazi esibhedlela ngokusekela abasebenzisi, ukulawula ikhwalithi yombhalo, ukulawula ukungena kwamasistimu, kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuziphatha ngokuvumelana. Isekelo Lwe-IT Nokuqondanisa: Inikeza isekelo le-IT, ilawula izicelo zesikhungo sosizo, igcina izimpahla ze-IT, futhi iqinisekisa ukuziphatha kwamasistimu ngokuvumelana nokuqhubeka. Umsebenzi Welayini Nokuqondisa Izisebenzi: Iqondisa ukwenza nokuphuhliswa kwezisebenzi kuyilawudla iqinisekisa ukusebenza okuphumelelayo nokuziphatha ngokuvumelana nemigomo ye-HR. Isekelo Kumqondisi: Iqinisekisa ukuqhubeka kwesevisi ngokwenza umsebenzi womqondisi uma kudingeka kwaye isekela ukuqondanisa nabahlanganyeli.

xh.title: I-ofisi yomlawuli wolawulo lwamagama
xh.summary: Isebe lezomphathi: ulawulo lweenkcukacha kusapho, isibhedlele sesithili saseWorcester Regional Hospital, sifuna omlawuli weenkcukacha ekusebenzeni ngokulawula ulwazi oluphathwayo nolungisiweyo, kwindawo apho kufuneka kuqinisekiswe unobangela wamagama, imithetho yecandelo lolwazi, kwaye kugqithwe kwindlela yokuhlolwa nokulinganiswa.
xh.requirements: Izifundo eziyimfuno: Isidanga seSizwe esifanelekileyo (NQF6) okanye okulingana naso. Isipilo: Isipilo esifanelekileyo sokulawula lwazi kwindawo enika inkonzo yempilo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela ethe xesha. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba nokusebenza ngaphezu kwesigqoko xa kuyimfuneko. Ukuziphatha (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza nolwazi oluqinileyo kwiZixhobo zolwazi ezingcombolo zempilo (SINJANI; Clinicom; ECCR, Hectis, ne-SPV). Ulwazi oluqinileyo lwekhompyutha kwi-MS Windows (Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook). Ukuqonda izinto ngokweqondo nokuqwalasela iinkcukacha, kunye nakhono lokunika iziphumo ezichanekileyo nokuqinisekileyo kwindawo ethobelwa yixesha lokuphela.
xh.duties: Ukulawula iingcombolo nokuQinisekisa umgangatho: Iqinisekisa ukuchaneka, umgangatho, noku符合 ngokwezinye izinto ezingcombolo zempilo ngokuqinisekisa, ukukhangela, okokuxela, nokuthobela iimigangatho echaziweyo, ngelixa ixhasa abasebenzisi begongolo nokuqhubekekela kolona lonke ukuphuculwa komgangatho. Ulwazi lolunye ngokuqonda kwendalo: Ihlalutya iingcombolo zempilo, ilawula ukusebenza, kwaye ixhase ukuzigqiba kwemiqibo nentsindi yokwenza iingxoxo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi olubhekisa kumzi wesixhobo: Ilawula izixhobo zolwazi lwesibhedlele ngokuxhasa abasebenzisi, ukulawula umgangatho weengcombolo, ukulawula ukufikelela kwesixhobo, nokuqinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo. Inkxaso yezixhobo ze-CW (Computer Works) nokuqhathanisa: Inika inkxaso ye-CW, ilawula iimfuno zedesk yoncedo, igcina izinto ezithengwayo ze-CW, futhi iqinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo nokuqhubekekela kwesixhobo. af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Verskaffingskettingbestuur (LOSS
af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte-posisie in Verskaffingskettingbestuur by die Metro Gesondheidsdienste-kantoor in die Western Cape, wat ervaring in batebestuur en verkryging vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde en/of Rekenkunde as 'n geslaagde vak en/of Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/bevoegdhede wat fokus op die Sleutelprestasie-areas (KRA's) van die pos. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in Batebestuur, Verskaffingskettingbestuur en Verkrygingsprosesse. Toepaslike ervaring in LOGIS, EPS en Baterapportering. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om swaar bokse en toerusting te lig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Diepgaande kennis van SCOA-kodes en verslae oor LOGIS en in staat om herconciliasies te doen. Organisatoriese, bestuurs-, leierskapsvaardighede en 'n aanleg om met finansiële syfers te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike en organisatoriese vaardighede. Goeie sterk personeelsbestuursvaardighede, vermoë om in 'n spankonteks te werk en spanlede te motiveer. Rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft Office. Kennis van PFMA, Finansiële instruksies, Provinsiale en Nasionale Tesourie-regulasies, Verskaffingskettinginstruksies asook die Rekenaaramptenaarstelsel.
af.duties: Effektiewe bestuur, verkryging en monitering van die Voorraad- en Batebestuursproses en voorbereiding van dokumente vir die Kwotasiekomiteevergaderings. zu.title: I-ofisa Yolawulo: Supply Chain Management (LOSS
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumlawuli e-Supply Chain Management e-ofisini le-Metro Health Services e-Western Cape, esidinga isiphiwo sokuphathwa kwezimpahla kanye nokuthenga.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwesigaba: Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) anebe-Mathematics kanye/noma i-Accountancy njengesisindo esiphumelelwe kanye/noma Senior Certificate (noma okulinganayo) onesiphiwo/ikhono esigxila kumaphupha okusebenza okubalulekile (KRA's) esikhundleni. Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanele sokuphathwa kwezimpahla, Supply Chain Management kanye nenqubo yokuthenga. Isiphiwo esifanele kwi-LOGIS, EPS kanye nokwenza amavezu ezimpahla. Isidingo esingokwemisebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukuzithobe lokuphakamisa amabhokisi nezinto ezisindayo. Izinkanuko (ulwazi/ikhono): Ulwazi olujulile lwamakhodi e-SCOA kanye namavezu e-LOGIS kanye nokuhlakanipha ukwenza ukulinganisa. Izikhono zokuhlela, zokuphatha, zokuba ngumholi, kanye nenguqo yokusebenza nezibalo zezimali. Izikhono ezinhle zokusebenza nabantu nenhlelo yokuhlela. Izikhono ezinamandla zokuphatha abantu, ikhono lokusebenza esigabeni samaqembu kanye nokukhuthaza amalunga eqembu. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha ku-Microsoft Office. Ulwazi lwe-PFMA, iziyalezo zezimali, imithetho yesifundazwe nezwe i-Treasury, iziyalezo ze-Supply Chain Management kanye nesistimu yomlawuli wezimali.
zu.duties: Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo, ukuthenga nokugqamisa inqubo yokuphathwa kwezimpahla nezasetshenzwayo, kanye nalokho ukulungisa amadokhumenti okuhlanganisela amakomidi ekshefuli. Ukwenza ukubalwa kwempahla ngokwesikhashana ngokwezimiso ezibekiwe. Ukubeke ekugcineni ukuthola, ukuyabelana nokuphakamisa izinto/izimpahla ezisindayo. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokumisana kanye nokunika inkonzo yensekelo ezingeni eliphezulu kumlawuli, ibholodi nasezikhungweni ngaphakathi kwesifundazwe se-Metro. Ukuphatha abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwengxenye ye-Supply Chain Management kuzo zonke izindaba zokuPhatha Abantu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinto ezisetshenziswa zihambisana nezidingo zomthetho (ukuhambisana ne-Audit). Ukusiza ekwenzeni amavezu emali enyakeni nakuleyo ephakathi konyaka, ukulungisa futhi ukuqinisekisa amavezu ezimpahla nyanga zonke kuhlanganise nokulinganisa. Ukugunyaza izeluleko zokuthenga, ama-oda kanye nezinkokhelo lapho kufanele khona. Ukuphatha yonke imibuzo ehlobene ne-SCM kanye nokwenza ukulawula ukuhambisana okuhlobene ne-SCM. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kusetshenziswa futhi kusetshenziswe izinqubo ezizinhle zomsebenzi.

xh.summary: Isithuba soLawuli iNqanaba lokuthengisa eLawulweni lweNqanaba lokuthengisa kwiofisi yeMetro Health Services eWestern Cape, sifuna imfuno yolwazi kwiinkqubo zolawulo lobuzo nolwazi lokuthenga.
xh.requirements: Iminigcangcobo emincinci yesifundo: Isatifikethyi esiphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo) eneMathematics nakuba Accountancy njengesifundo esidlulileyo nange Isatifikethyi esiphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo) enemfuno/ukuziphatha okugqithisela kuwo awona mandla abalulekileyo (KRA’s) esi sithuba. Imfuno: Imfuno efanelekileyo kuLawulo lweZixhobo, uLawulo lweNqanaba lokuthengisa nakwiinkqubo zokuThenga. Imfuno efanelekileyo kuLOGIS, EPS nakwingxelo yeZixhobo. Imfuno esisiseko somsebenzi: ilayisenisi yomqhubi (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukulungele ukuzisa iibhokisi ezinzima ngezixhobo. Ukuziphatha (ulwazi/amaziko): Ulwazi olujulileyo ngeKhowudi zeSCOA nangamava ingxelo kwiLOGIS nokuqhathanisa. Ikhono lokuzila, lokulawula, nokubekisa abantu nentutho yokusebenza ngamanani emali. Ikhono elilula lokuzila nalo lonwabo. Ikhono elinamandla lokulawula abantu, ikhono lokusebenza kwiqela nokuqhuba abantu bakwiqela. Ulwazi ngekhowudwa kwiMicrosoft Office. Ulwazi ngomthetho wePFMA, iimiyalelo zeMali, urhelo lweRhulu liqondo ngamava iNgingi neziko njengenye ngakumbi.
xh.duties: Ukuphatha ngokusebenzayo, ukuthenga nokugcina amava inqanaba la mexenzo yoLawulo lweZixhobo kunye noLawulo lweZixhobo, kwakunye noku lungiselela amaxwebhu ngamava iinkqubo zomhla wokuvala kwamava iKomiti yeQuote. Ukwenza istock take yezixhobo ngokwemigaqo. Ukuphatha ukwamkelwa, ukunikwa nokususwa kwezixhobo ezinzima. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuncedisa nokunikela inkxaso esebenzayo kumphathi, kubaphathi nakwiiziko ezingaphakathi kwesithili saseMetro. Ukulawula abasebenzi kwicala loLawulo lweNqanaba lokuthengisa ngakunye nayo yonke imicimbi yoLawulo abantu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iintengiso zihambelana nemfuno zomthetho (ukuqinisekiswa kweAudit). Ukuncedisa ngokusikelwa ingxelo yeSiv esezantsi seNyanga nePhakathi kwexesha, ukulungelelanisa nokugqiba iingxelo zezixhobo ngenyanga eziquka nokubalwa. Ukugunyazisa iNdlela yoKuthenga, iOdolo nentlawulo apho kufunekana khona. Ukuphatha yonke imibuzo enxulumene ne-SCM kwaye uqinisekise ulawulo ngokuthengisa olunxulumene ne-SCM. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba okusemthethweni kokusebenza kusebenza nakuqatywa.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL Nursing)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 per annum
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse (Grade 1 to 3) providing primary health care at Franshoek Groendal CDC in Stellenbosch Sub-district, requiring a nursing diploma or degree with SANC registration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse or 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (code B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to effectively communicate (verbal and written). Knowledge and insight of relevant legislation and policy related to nursing within the public sector and basic computer literacy (MS Word, Excel and Outlook) to be able to communicate, capture patient information, check results, capture data and do and track referrals on the different electronic systems. Ability to promote quality patient care through the implementation of protocols, guidelines, and standards.
jobs.duties: Provision of Primary Health Care in accordance with the guidelines and protocols of the Western Cape. Maintain accurate clinical records, statistics registers, and referral records. Effective utilization of Resources/Stock within the limited budget constraints. Participation in Community events and initiating awareness with regards to health-related issues. Maintain and participate in inter-professional and multi-disciplinary teamwork but able to work independently. Supervise and mentor lower categories of staff and improving quality of health services. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self-development.
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. A practical test may form part of the selection process. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It should be noted that advertised posts are linked to the Institution/ Facility that forms part of the Ecosystem Service platform. Upon appointment, incumbents will be expected to render clinical services across institutions in the Ecosystem, as needed to sustain health service delivery. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Isifundo esiyisisekelo se-R425 (okunguthi idiploma/idigri ekuqeqeshweni kwabahlengikazi) noma isifundo esifanayo (i-R683 kanye ne-R254 kanye ne-R880) esivumela ukubhalisa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoba ngumhlengikazi osezingeni eliphezulu. I-Grade 2: Ubumnyama be-10 iminyaka yesipiliyoni esifanelekile / esivunyiwe ekunakekelweni kwabahlengikazi emva kokubhalisa ku-SANC njengomhlengikazi osezingeni eliphezulu ekunakekelweni okuvamile. I-Grade 3: Ubumnyama be-20 iminyaka yesipiliyoni esifanelekile / esivunyiwe ekunakekelweni kwabahlengikazi emva kokubhalisa ku-SANC njengomhlengikazi osezingeni eliphezulu ekunakekelweni okuvamile. Isidingo esingokwemvelo somsebenzi: Ilayiseni ebhaliweyo yedrayiva ye-Code EB/EC. Ukuzithoba ukuba unikeze inkonzo yokuqeqesha ngeyure ezivaliwe kubasebenzi abasebenza ebusuku. Ukukhanya ngokwazi (iziqu/zakhono): Ukuba nekhono elihle lokubambisana nabantu, noku4gumba, kanye nenhlangano. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Word, Excel & Outlook) Ulwazi mayelana noqeqesho lwemfundo yabahlengikazi.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi kwesikhathi / ukubuyekezwa kwezakhono namakhono abeluleki kanye nenqubo yokumunca kwabahlengikazi. Siza ekuphathweni okusebenzayo nasekusebenziseni izinsiza ezingokomzimba, ezingokwemishini kanye nezimali ngaphakathi kwesikhungo sokuqeqesha abahlengikazi. Gcina amazinga amahle futhi akhuthaze ukukhula komsebenzi nokuziphucela komunye. Thatha inhlangothi ekuqeqeshweni komuntu siqu, ucwaningweni nasekubambisweni kwemigomo emihle. Setha izu4gumbi zokuqashisisa ukuze kutholwe ukukhono komsebenzi nakabafundi.

Ulwazi ngokufundisa nokulolonga abantu abanika isibonelelo.

Sikhokela ukulawula nokusebenzisa izixhobo ezizodwa ngokwemithi, ububele nemali ecaleni kwesebe lokungenisa abasebenzi kumthunywa weenkwenkwezi. Gcina izinga eliphezulu lolwazi lwamathuba wocingo, ubungqabavu nangaphezulu kwezinye izigaba zokuzilolonga nokuzilungisa izinto. Imibuzo ngokwakho, ukuphila ngokuphila kwakho, amagama amahle, ubudlelwano nabasebenzi ngokugqithisileyo nokuthuthukiswa kwabo okanye abaphakathi kubo. Dlulisa inkqubo yokulinganisa izakhono ezidinga ukuthi umntu aqonde ukwaziyo kubasebenzi nabafundi.

Bereidwilligheid om binne die Cederberg subdistrik te reis om onderhouds- en herstelwerk uit te voer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid 1993 en sy tersaaklike regulasies. Vermoë om algemene gebouonderhoud te doen en met pligte in ander onderhoudsambagte te help waar nodig, insluitend maar nie beperk tot basiese skrynwerk, verfwerk, elektries, loodgieterswerk en algemene herstelwerk, binne die bestek van bevoegdheid en veiligheidsvereistes nie. Vermoë om te lees, skryf en geskrewe instruksies te volg, insluitend handleidings en geskrewe prosedures. Vermoë om toegekende hulpbronne soos gereedskap en materiaal optimaal te benut en vaardig te wees in die gebruik van 'n verskeidenheid gereedskap. Vermoë om meganiese/elektriese foutopsporing uit te voer en herstelwerk tot op komponentvlak te doen. Rekenaarvaardigheid (d.w.s. Ms Word, Excel, e-pos en internetgebruik).
af.duties: Voer installasie, onderhoud, foutopsporing en herstelwerk in die tersaaklike ambag uit, naamlik elektries of loodgieterswerk. Voer algemene onderhoudstake in ander ambagte uit waar nodig, insluitend basiese skrynwerk, verfwerk, elektriese werk, loodgieterswerk en algemene gebouherstelwerk. Lei en koördineer die daaglikse aktiwiteite van die onderhoudspan deur take toe te wys, werkvoortgang te monitor en te verseker dat onderhoudsversoeke doeltreffend hanteer word. Voer onderhoudsverwante administrasie uit, insluitend die voltooiing van werkkaarte, rekordhouding, verslae, voorraad/gereedskapbeheer, batesinligting, bestellings en opvolging van onderhoudsversoeke. Verseker dat onderhoudswerk veilig en in ooreenstemming met die vereistes van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid uitgevoer word. Voer finansiële, menslike hulpbron- en algemene administratiewe pligte uit wat verband hou met die onderhoudsfunksie.

Vertroudheid met PGWC-inligtingstelsels (IS), soos ECCR en ECM Opentext. Vertroudheid met die Vula-verwysingstelsel. Verseker effektiewe rekordbestuur en die instandhouding van liasseerstelsels. Skakel met provinsiale departemente en alle ander belanghebbendes. - Onderhou datavaslegging vir die beroerte-eenheid op die Res-Q-databasis en verseer tydige en akkurate invoer van beroertepasiëntrekords en voorlegging van verwante verslae.

zu.title: Inceku yolawulo: Inkxaso (NEUROLOGY)
zu.summary: Yenza isikhundla sokulawula inkxaso yolawulo ku-HOD nepheqane le-Neurology esibhedlela i-Tygerberg Hospital, ngokuphatha ukubhuka kwamangosi ekliniki, nokugcina imibhaloncabanza kanye nezinhlela yolwazi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi: Isitifiketi samatikheti aphezulu (noma esilinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele sokusebenza kwizinto zolawulo ezibhalwe ngaphansi komykhathi wedolobha, kanye nemvelaphi ekweleteni imibiko eminingi ekutholakala ngaphansi kwemithetho yezulu, futhi kuhlanganise imithetho yezulu yokulandela ukusetshenziswa kwezinyanga zokuhlolwa kwezokwelashwa ekiliniki, kwakhiwa uhlelo lokukhulu komndeni ohlinzekwa yi-Res-Q, njengengxenye yokuhlola izinto ezinkulu kanye nezinsizakalo ekutholakala ukuze kube khona imithetho yokusetshenziswa kwawo wonke amagundane ahlobene nokuhlolwa kwabasizinayo ezingeni eliphansi le-Neurology, okuwukufaka ukuhlolwa kwenhliziyo, ukuphila kwengalo, kanye nokukwazi ukuthi ukholiwe ukuthi umndeni uhlala ngokulandela imithetho yokuhlakula izinsizakalo zangempela zasekhaya esibangeni. ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo umphathi weHOD nepheqane le-Neurology. Phatha ukubhuka kwamangosi amasha, ukubhuka kohlolo nokuhlelwa kwe-Botulinum Toxin Clinic kusetshenziswa inkundla ye-Vula nedayari ephakathi. Xhumana nenceku ye-Neurology OPD ngokubhuka kwamangosi amasha. Ukugcina ukhondwana, ukuthumela futhi ukulayisha kwi-IS yonke imibiko ekhishwe ngaphakathi kwesigaba. Yamukela futhi usize amangosi eza e-A8 Laboratory ngezinhlelo noma imibuzo. Yamukela futhi ubhalise yonke imibhalo/imi tholakala engenayo (ngokulethwa ngesandla, nge-imeyili noma ngefoni), uphathhe ngokufanele noma uwethule kulunga olufanele leqembu. Qinisekisa inkxaso yolawulo ekwenzekeni ngokusebenza kahle nokuphathwa kwe-ofisi. Phatha imisebenzi yonke yolawulo kuhlanganise ukuthumela izinhlelo zokuqasha nokubhaliswa kwamafomu e-PGWC-HR, uku-oda izimpahla zensiza zedeshi yasekhaya, neqembu lezinto ezisetshenziswa, kanye nokuphathwa kwefa lezinto abasabelwayo zidingo zangempelasonto namafomu eholo. Misa ukuphathwa kwemibiko nokuqhubeleka kokugcina izinto zenziwe ngokwesikhathi. Thumela imibiko ephathelene namaphoyisa namaphoyisa aqotshwe ku-Res-Q ngokushesha futhi ngokucophelela ukuze kuhlinzeka ngamaphuzu ukuvikelwa iziguli ezingakwazi ukuqasha, kuhlanganise nezinye izinhlelo zokubhukuda imibuso evela kwabavela nobantu besifazane abangenamkhaya namaphoyisa angazange asiphathe isikhwama.

xh.title: Umlawuli Wolawulo: Inkxaso (NEUROLOGY)
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kuHOD nakwishqeli ye-Neurology e-Tygerberg Hospital, uphatha ukubekwa kwabathengi kumaziko, uvalelise ulawule iinkqubo zolwazi.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingoonobangela: i-Senior Certificate (okanye esilinganayo). Isiphiwo: ulwazi olufanelekileyo lolawulo kwimvelasebe yesibhedlele/ yezonyango. Iikhompawundi (ulwazi/ amakhono): ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office suite njenge-Word, Excel ne-Outlook). Amakhono amahle okuthayipha nokuhlela. Ukumanya iinkqubo zolwazi ze-PGWC (IS), ezifana ne-ECCR ne-ECM Opentext. Ukumanya iinkqubo zokuqondisa i-Vula. Ulwazi ngendlela zovavvo ezisetyenziswa kwimvelasebe ye-Neurology (iifundo zokuqhuba kwezithunjwana, i-EMG, i-EEG, amandla adalwa, ukutsala i-lumbar puncture). Ikhono lokusebenza ngodwa. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi ngokuchanekileyo nangokucokisekileyo. Amakhono amahle omnxeba nabantu nokuqonda ukuze usebenze phantsi koxinzelelo nakwishqeli. Ikhono eliphezulu lokunxibelelwana ngokusebenzayo (ngokuthetha nokubhala).
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kuHOD nakwishqeli ye-Neurology. Phatha ukubekwa kwezicwangciso zomthengi omtsha, ukubekwa kwezicwangciso zovavvo nokucwangcisa i-Botulinum Toxin Clinic usebenzisa ipleyifomu le-Vula nedayari ephakathi. Qhagamshelana nomlawuli we-Neurology OPD malunga nokubekwa kwabathengi abatsha. Valelisa, thumela elo rhulunywa kwaye ulayishe kwi-IS zonke iingxelo ezikhutshwe ngaphakathi kwesebe. Yamkela uze uncede abathengi abaya e-A8 Laboratory ngezicwangciso okanye imibuzo. Yamkela uze ubhalise lonke unxibelelwano olungenayo/imibuzo (ngokulethwa ngesandla, nge-imeyile okanye ngentethomnxeba), uluhlele ngokufanelekileyo okanye ulunikele lolunye ilungu leshqeli elicafisileyo. Qinisekisa inkxaso yolawulo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo kwaye ulawule ofisi. Yenza imisebenzi jikelele yolawulo kuquka ukunikezela kweziqendu zokuqhuba kwaye ushiye iifomu zekhefu kwi-PGWC-HR, ukulayisha izinto ezithengwayo zofisi nempahla kunye nokulawula izinto. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lweekhordh eze wondla iinkqubo zokuvalelisa. Qhagamshelana namasebe abavelisi nakuzo zonke ezinye iindwendwe. - Gcina ukungena kwezidata ze-stroke unit kwidathabheyisi ye-Res-Q, uqinisekisa ukungena ngexesha nangokuchanekileyo kweekhordh zabathengi be-stroke kunye nokunikezela kweengxelo ezahambelana nayo.

Ulwazi ngomthetho ohlobene namapholisi e-Department of Health Western Cape. Izikhondo zokuxhumana ngomlomo nangesibhalo ngokusebenzayo, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba elinobunjiniyela abaningi kanye nokukhuthaza izinga lesikhundla.

Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwesibhedlela okuyisisekelo nokuxhumana okusebenzayo. Ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ngokusebenzayo. af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir skoonmaakpligte, insluitend vee, stofvee, mop, skroei, poleer, afvalhantering en instandhouding van algemene netheid en higiëne van die area. Hou by veiligheidsmaatreëls en verseker nakoming van BeroepsGesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeleid en Infeksiepreventie- en beheermaatreëls. Verskaf hulp aan die toesighouer met algemene huishoudelike pligte soos beheer van skoonmaak- en huishoudelike toerusting, sorg en beheer van linne en opdiening van maaltye aan pasiënte.

zu.title: UMSEBENZI WENDLU (THEATRE)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umuntu ongumsebenzi wendlu e-Knysna Hospital ukwenza imisebenzi yokuhlanza, ukugcina ukuhlanzekile futhi abuse impahla ngokuphephile, nokusebenza nge-shemu nasebusuku.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesibambo: Ukubala nokufunda okuyisisekelo. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele emvelwaneni wendlu/ukuhlanza esikhungweni sezempilo. Isidingo esingaphakathi kwesikhundla: Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi emzimba kanye nokusebenzisa impahla yokuhlanza enamandla nendlu enamandla. Ukuthanda ukusebenza amashemu, ngeziphuthamfihla zamasonto, ngezinsuku zomphakathi, njengesibopho ebusuku, nangokugqitha isikhathi uma kudingeka. Ukuthanda ukujikeleza kumawomnyango ahluke ngokwezidingo zokusebenza noma lapho kudingeka. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokuhlanza impahla. Usizo kumphathi wendlu nokulandela izinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela zokuhlanza. Ulwazi ngokulawula izinkomba, izimpahla, ingubo kanye nempahla.
zu.duties: Ubhekele imisebenzi yokuhlanza, okuhlanganisa ukushoba, ukusula uthuli, ukusula ngamakhobodo, ukugrudula, ukwenza kuqame, ukuphatha izinkuni kanye nokugcina indawo ihlanzekile nesihle. Ubhekele ukuhlanza nokugcina kokuqophelela izinsimbi. Ulandele izindlela zokuphepha futhi waveza ukulandela izinqubomgomo ze-Occupational Health and Safety kanye nezinyathelo zokuvinjelwa kokutheleleka. Nikeza usizo abaphathi ngemisebenzi ejwayelekile yokugcina indlu efana nokulawla ukuhlanza kanye nempahla yasekhaya, ukunakekelwa nokulawula ingubo kanye nokupha iziguli ukudla.

xh.title: Umncedi wekhaya (I-THIYA)
xh.summary: Kufuneka umncedi wekhaya eKnysna Hospital ukwenza imisebenzi yokucoca, ukugcina ucoce kwaye uphathe izixhobo ngokhuselekileyo, nokusebenza ngokutshintsha iishifti nasebusuku.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezincinane: Ulwazi olusisiseko lokubala nokufunda. Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo kwimbonakalo yokukhohlisa/ukucoca kwiziko lempilo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kolusebenzi: Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi emzimbeni nokuqhuba izixhobo ezinzima zokucoca nezokhohlisa indlu. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngokutshintsha iishifti, ngeentsuku zeeveki, ngeholidi zikarhulumente, ngobusuku, nangexesha elidlulelayo xa kudingeka. Ukuzimisela ukujikeleza kumasebe ahlukahlukeneyo ngokweemfuno zokuqhuba naxa kudingeka. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/iakhono): Ulwazi olusisiseko ngokucoca izixhobo. Inkxaso kumlawuli wokhohliso indlu nokuthobela iinkqubo namacebo okucoca. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwesitokhwe, iimpahla, iindonga ezinemivalo, nezixhobo.
xh.duties: Uxanduva lokwenza imisebenzi yokucoca, kuquka ukusula, ukucima uthuli, ukusula ngamakhobokhobo, ukutshula, ukukhanya izinto, ukuphatha imfucu, nokugcina ucoce ngokubanzi nokucoce kwendawo. Uxanduva lokucoca nokugcina ngokhuselekileyo izixhobo. Ukuthobela iindlela zokhuseleko kuqiniseke ukuthobela iinkqubo zoKhuseleko koMsebenzi noMpilo kwaye kuqinisekise ukuthobela iinkqubo zoLawulo lokuthintela iindwangu. Nikela ngenkxaso kumlawuli ngemisebenzi yokuqhoboka indlu ngokubanzi njengokolawulo lokucoca nezixhobo zokhohlisa indlu, ukukhathalela noku lawula iindonga ezinemivalo, nokunikela abagulwa ukutya.

jobs.title: Driver (LIGHT Duty Vehicle)

I-Permit yokushayela kahulumeni (PDP) evumelekile. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngemahora amaningi. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono okuxhumana amahle (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa). Ikono lokusebenza kodwa nokuba nesibopho nokubhekana nesibopho ngokunesiqu kanye nokuba nobudlelwano obuhle. Ukuba nenzuzu yokomzimba futhi ukwazi ukwenza imisebenzo edinga amandla omzimba. Ulwazi lokuqondiswa kwansuku zonke, ukugcinwa kwayo, ukuhlola izimoto ukuthi zinoono nokushayela ngokupheph.

Yenza imisebenzi yothutho ngokuhambisana neshejuli. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunokuphathwa kwansuku zonke kwezothutho okusebenzayo futhi unikeze inkxaso umbonisi.

Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngeda nezantsi ngokubeka uxanduva nokwabelana ngexanduva ngokumiselweyo njengoko amakhono abonisayo alungileyo. Zenza ukulinganisela okuyimiselwa kwimoto ze-GG nokuxela ngosuku iimvalo. Qinisekisa ukuba iimoto zigcinwa zicocekile zahlale zicocekile. Qinisekisa ukuba iimoto ezisetshenziswa zigcinwa zicocekile zahlale zicocekile. Zenzisa imisebenzi yothutho ngokwemcimbi weshedule. Qinisekisa ukuba kwenziwa ngemigaqo imisebenzi yolawulo lothutho yonke imihla kunye nenkxaso kumLawuli.

Maintain and participate in inter- professional and multi-disciplinary teamwork but able to work independently. Supervise and mentor lower categories of staff and improving quality of health services. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self- development.

jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. A practical test may form part of the selection process. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereid om by verskillende fasiliteite binne die subdistrik te werk, insluitend 'n Mobiele eenheid, hospitaal en wanneer nodig binne die gemeenskap (COPC-konsep). Geldige (kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). Kennis en insig van tersaaklike wetgewing en beleid verbonde aan verpleging binne die openbare sektor en basiese rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, Excel en Outlook) om te kan kommunikeer, pasiëntinligting vas te lê, uitslae na te gaan, data vas te lê en verwysings op die verskillende elektroniese stelsels te doen en na te speur. Vermoë om gehalte pasiëntsorg te bevorder deur die implementering van protokolle, riglyne en standaarde.
af.duties: Verskaffing van Primêre Gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die riglyne en protokolle van die Western Cape. Onderhou akkurate kliniese rekords, statistiekregisters en verwysingsrekords. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne/voorraad binne die beperkte begrotingsbeperkings. Neem deel aan gemeenskapsgeleenthede en inisieer bewustmaking rakende gesondheidsverwante kwessies. Onderhou en neem deel aan interprofessionele en multidissiplinêre spanwerk, maar in staat om onafhanklik te werk. Onderrig en mentorer laer kategorieë van personeel en verbeter die gehalte van gesondheidsdienste. Onderhou professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: UGqawe wezokunyukatisi Wezinga 1 kuye kwe-3 (General Nursing)
zu.summary: Kudingwa ugqawe wezokunyukatisi ukuze athuthukele ekunikezeni izinsiza ezempilo eziyisisekelo eDrakenstein Sub-district, kadingeka ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC kanye nesifundo se-basic nursing.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Isifundo se-Basic R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ekunyukatisi) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 kanye no-R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqawe wezokunyukatisi noma i-Bachelor Degree yeminyaka eyi-4 ekunyukatisi (R174) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 kanye no-R1497 noma i-R171 kanye no-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqawe wezokunyukatisi. Ukubhaliswa kwikhasimba lomsebenzi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqawe wezokunyukatisi. Isipiliyangakho: Izinga 1: Akukho Izinga 2: Okuncane kakhulu kweminyaka eyi-10 yohlelo lokusebenza lwezokunyukatisi olufanele/olungahlonitshwa emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqawe wezokunyukatisi ku-General Nursing. Izinga 3: Okuncane kakhulu kweminyaka eyi-20 yohlelo lokusebenza olufanele/olungahlonitshwa ekunyukatisi emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqawe wezokunyukatisi ku-General Nursing. Izidingo ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ukulungele ukusebenza ezikhungweni ezingafaniyo ngaphakathi kwe-Sub District kuhlanganise i-Mobile, isibhedlela futhi uma kudingeka ngaphakathi komphakathi (umqondo we-COPC). Ilayisense yokushayela (code B/EB) esebenzayo. Amandla (ulwazi/amaskilli): Ukuba nesenzo sokuxhumana ngokusebenza kahle (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Ulwazi futhi ukuqonda umthetho kanye nenqubomgomo ehlobene nezokunyukatisi ngaphakathi kwesigaba sabantu futhi ulwazi olusisekelo lwekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel kanye ne-Outlook) ukuze ukwazi ukuxhumana, uqoqe imininingwane yomguli, uhlole imiphumela, uqothe idatha futhi wenze futhi ulande izithumelo kumasistimu abhalwe ngekhompyutha ahlukene. Isenzo sokuthuthukisa izinga lezinsiza kubaguli ngokuphatha imithetho yokuqondisa, imihlahlandlela, kanye namazinga.
zu.duties: Nikeza Izinsiza Zezempilo Eziyisisekelo ngokuvumelana nemihlahlandlela namapholisi ase Western Cape. Gcina irekhodi lezokwelapha eliqinisekisiwe, izibhalo ezibala izibalo, kanye namarekhodi okuthumela abantu kwezinye izikhungo. Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenza kahle izinsiza/izimpahla ngaphakathi kwezinkinga zesabelomali esincane. Thatha inxaxheba emicimbini yomphakathi futhi qalisa ukwazisa ngendaba ezihlotshaniswe nezempilo. Gcina futhi uthathe inxaxheba emsebenzini wabantu abahlukene ngezikhondo nensebenziswano yamakhasimba ahlukene kodwa ukwazi ukusebenza eyedwa. Qaphisa futhi uhola abasebenzi abangamazinga aphansi futhi uthuthukise izinga lezinsiza ezempilo. Gcina ukukhula komsebenzi/izindinganiso zokuziphatha kanye nokuzithuthukisa.

xh.title: Ugqirha weNkcubeko weZibizo Onamaza 1 ukuya ku-3 (iNkcubeko ngokubanzi)
xh.summary: Kufuneka ugqirha wamagqirha weNkcubeko ovela kwimizuzu ye-1 ukuya kwe-3 (iNkcubeko ngokubanzi) ukwenzela iinkonzo eziyindawo yonke, ezifuna ukubhalisa kwi-SANC kunye nesesipili sezibizo esisezantsi. Kugqirha wamagqirha wamazwe ngamazwe oziya kumazwe ngamanye amazwe.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingaphantsi: Isifundo se-Basic R425 (okt. idiploma/ideyiri kwizibizo) okt. isifundo esingathandabuziyo (R683 nge-R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha wezigwangqa okt. ideyiri yesidanga se-4 kwizibizo (R174) okt. isifundo esingathandabuziyo (R683 nge-R1497 okt. R171 nge-R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha wezigwangqa. Ukubhaliswa koluntu olungcwathi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqirha wezigwangqa. Isipili: Isidata 1: Akukho Isidata 2: Ukuba unyaka wakhe wonke / waziwa kwimisebenzi yezibizo emva kobhalisa kwi-SANC njengogqirha wezigwangqa kwiNkcubeko. Isidata 3: Unyaka wonke / waziwa kwimisebenzi yezibizo emva kobhalisa kwi-SANC njengogqirha wezigwangqa kwiNkcubeko. Iimfuno zomsebenzi: Ukulungele ukusebenza kwiziko ezahlukeneyo ngaphakathi kwesiNgingezi nekwaqeqeshwa, isibhedlele naxa kufuneka ngaphakathi koluntu (mgaqo we-COPC). Ilayiseni (code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukuziphatha (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokuthetha ngokusebenzayo (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo). Ulwazi lokuqonda imigaqo namacebo abalulekileyo kumsebenzi wezibizo ngaphakathi koluntu lwengingqi, kunye nesiseko sekhompyutha elula (MS Word, Excel, Outlook) ukwazi ukuthetha, ukubhala ngomntu, ukujonga amarekhodi, ukubhala ngomntu, ukubhala ngomntu, ukubhala ngomntu, ukubhalisa amakhadi abantu kwiindidi ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi lokukhuthaza umsebenzi omhle wento ngokusebenzisa imigaqo, iindlela, kunye neemfuno zomsebenzi.
xh.duties: Unikezelo lweZibizo eziPhambili zeMpilo ngokwemigaqo kunye namacebo e-Western Cape. Ukugcina irekhodi elicacileyo lezempilo, izikelo zokubala iintsingiselo, kunye namarekhodi okuthumela abaguli. Ukusebenzisa ngokusebenzayo izixhobo/izinto ngaphakathi kwemida yesixhobo esincinci sesithuba semali. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumadelo oluntu nokwazisa ngokugqithisayo ngeemiba ezimalunga nezempilo. Ukugcina ukuthatha inxaxheba kwindima yomsebenzi ophakathi phakathi kwezinye izigaba basebenzi kodwa ukwazi ukusebenza ngodwa. Ukulawula kunye nokukhulisa abasebenzi abangasezantsi kwaye uphucule umgangatho wesebenzo ezempilweni. Ukugcina ukukhula/emiqathango yesigqibo nokuziphucula.
